title: Can I add notes to received orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It is now possible to add notes to received orders. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I send an invoice to a client for a service they booked using Wix Bookings?
content:
Go to the Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant session in your calendar. Click Manage. Click Collect Payment next to the relevant client. Click Charge with invoice. Note: If your client does not have an email on file, you need to add one to send an invoice. Click Create Invoice. Review the invoice details to make sure they're correct. Then choose what you want to do next:

- Print: Print out the invoice if your client requires a physical copy.
- Share Link: Create a shareable link that you can send via email, social media or messenger app. Click to create a link to the invoice. Click Copy Link. Click Done. Note: when you create the link to the invoice, it automatically marks the invoice as Sent.
- Send via Email: Send the client their invoice via email. Click to edit the subject line. Click to edit the message you send in the email. Click Send.

title: How can I set the 'Join this site's community' checkbox to be selected by default for new site members on Wix?
content: In the Editor, click Menus & Pages, click Member Signup, click Member Signup Form, select Social & Community, and enable the Join the community is checked by default toggle.

title: How can I fix elements that appear in the wrong location on my Wix mobile site?
content: Elements you added to your page in the desktop editor may be placed differently on the mobile version of your site. You can manually rearrange these elements by dragging them to your chosen location. If an element appears on the menu, header, or footer of a mobile site, it is not possible to click and drag it around the page. However, you can use the right-click menu to move these elements between the menu, header and footer. When placing an item in the gap between elements, you may need to adjust the spacing. Use the Auto Space on Drag tool to automatically create even spaces between the elements.

title: How can I resolve a 401 Unauthorized error when trying to access a webpage?
content: If you receive an Error 401 (Unauthorized) message, it means you're trying to access a page that you must first log in with a valid user ID and password to view. To resolve it: check that the URL (web address) you are trying to access is correct, then re-enter it in your address bar and press Enter. If you're trying to access a page other than the homepage, go to the homepage URL (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com), then look for a login link, click it, and enter your credentials. If you're using incorrect credentials, follow the steps on the site to reset your password or contact the site owner to request access. Use another supported browser. If the error only occurs in one browser, clear your browser's cache.

title: How can I add an expiration date to loyalty points in my Wix Loyalty Program?
content:
Before you begin, note that to launch a Loyalty Program you first need to upgrade your site. To add a points expiration date to your Loyalty Program:
- Go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage Program.
- Click the Points and rewards tab.
- Click the toggle next to Points expiration to set it as active.
- Select the terms of your loyalty points expiration:
  - Expiration period: Choose how long customers have to redeem points before they expire.
  - Share of points to expire: Choose the percentage of points that will expire after the expiration period.
  - Send an email reminder: Automatically send an email notification 14 days before your customers' points expire.
- Click Save.

title: Can I customize all aspects of my site to be RTL per language in Wix Multilingual?
content: No. With Wix Multilingual, you can currently customize some aspects of your site, such as the menu, text, and images, to be RTL per language (e.g., Hebrew, Arabic). For additional RTL capabilities, you can submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How can my client switch between content mode and full mode in the Studio Editor?
content: Your client can use the shortcut to the dashboard: click the Wix Studio icon at the top left, click Dashboard, click the Arrow next to Edit Site, and select the relevant mode from the drop-down.

title: How can I add and set up the HubSpot by Syncsmart.io app on my Wix site?
content:
Go to the HubSpot by Syncsmart.io app in the Wix App Market. Click Add to Site. Review the access request information. Click Allow and Add. Register your account. After the redirect, enter your details to log in to HubSpot.

Note: To use this feature, you must have a premium site with a connected domain, and a free HubSpot CRM account to connect to your site.

title: How can I customize the video settings in my Wix Pro Gallery to play videos on hover and enable sound?
content:
To customize your video settings in the Wix Pro Gallery:

* Click your Pro Gallery in your editor.
* Click Settings.
* Click the Advanced tab.
* Customize the following options:
  * **Play Videos:** Click the drop-down to choose **On hover**.
  * **Play with sound:** Click the toggle to **enable** the sound on your video:
    * **Enabled:** Videos play with sound in the gallery view.

**Note:** Your videos always play with sound in expand mode.

title: How do I connect Ziina as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right and change it if incorrect. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Ziina. If you already have a Ziina account, enter your API Key and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Ziina account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from Ziina with your API Key, then return to Accept Payments and follow the Have an account steps to connect.

title: Can I pin an element to all site pages at once in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, there is no feature that lets you pin an element to all site pages at once – you need to repeat the action for every individual page.

title: How can I choose the fit mode for an image in the Studio Editor?
content:
Select the relevant image. Click the Settings icon. Select an option from the Display mode drop-down:

- Fill bounding box: The image fills the bounding box so there aren't any empty areas, while still maintaining its original aspect ratio. If the image aspect ratio doesn't match the bounding box proportions, parts of the image are cropped out in the process.
- Fit to bounding box: The entire image is shown inside the bounding box. If the image aspect ratio doesn't match the bounding box proportions, the image shrinks so it's fully displayed. The image is centered inside the box, which may create empty spaces.
- Keep image ratio: The image width is fixed to the bounding box, while the height adjusts automatically to match the image's original aspect ratio. This option is not available for stretched images. If you want to select this option, unstretch the image first.

The display mode you choose for the image applies to all breakpoints.

title: What happens to my Google Workspace business email data after I cancel my subscription?
content: When you cancel your Google Workspace business email, your subscription remains active until the next renewal date. After that date, your subscription will expire and you'll no longer be able to read, receive, or send email from your account. According to Google's Terms of Service, business email data is retained for 180 days from the expiration date. If you repurchase your business email during this time frame, your business email data will be restored.

title: How can I send a copy of a site visitor's data from my Wix site to comply with privacy regulations?
content: In the CMS, use the filter menu option to filter the data in your collection based on the unique identifier for your visitor. Click Import/Export and select Export Filtered Data. The filtered data from your collection is exported to a CSV file with the same name as your collection and saved to your browser's default location. Send the visitor the exported file. These instructions apply to both optional sandbox and live Collections and assume your collection includes a field that uniquely identifies data you collect from a site visitor.

title: What should I do if my Wix domain has entered the Redemption Period and I want to retrieve it?
content: If your domain is registered at Wix and has entered the Redemption Period, go to your Domains page and locate the relevant domain. Review the redemption fee information in the redemption notification, then click Keep Domain. Enter your payment details in the checkout and click Submit Payment. Note: Retrieving your domain can take up to 7 days to complete. We'll notify you of any progress via the email associated with your Wix account.

title: How do I create a Google Ads Performance Max Shopping campaign with Wix?
content: To create a Performance Max Shopping campaign with Wix, go to Google Ads in your site's dashboard, click Start Advertising, then click Advertise Products under the Boost product purchases advertising goal. Before launching, create a Google Merchant Solutions account to list your products by clicking Go to Google Merchant Solutions. Once your Google Merchant Solutions account is connected and your products are approved, choose your campaign language, location(s), and set a campaign budget. Purchase a subscription and launch your campaign. You can track your campaign's progress and metrics from the Google Ads with Wix dashboard.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix blog to reach a broader audience?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Language and Region. Click the Site language drop-down to select the language for your site. Click Save. Wix Blog supports 28 different languages, including Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Tagalog, Thai, and Turkish.

title: Can I create folders to organize my videos in the Wix Video Library?
content: Currently, you can't create folders to organize your videos in your Wix Video Library. You can, however, create Channels and group your videos into different categories.

title: Can I use multiple hamburger menus to display different menus on my site?
content: You can now display different menus on multiple hamburger menus across a site.

title: How can I add a standalone event button on my Wix site?
content:
To add an event button:
- Click Add on the left side of the Editor.
- Select Events.
- Drag the single event display to the page.
- Click the Wix Events app in the Editor.
- Click Display Events.
- Under What do you want to show?, select A Single Event.
- Select the relevant event.
- Click the Layout tab.
- Select Button.
- (Optional) Edit the button:
    - Click the Text tab to edit the button text or add a label.
    - Click the Design tab to edit the look of the button.

Note: The standalone event button is currently not available in Editor X.

title: How can I create a new group in Wix Groups for members with shared interests?
content: Choose from pre-existing templates or create one from scratch to create your first group in Wix Groups.

title: How can I edit a member role on my Wix site?
content:
To edit a member role on your Wix site:

- Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage Member Roles at the top right.
- Click the More Actions icon on the role you want to edit.
- Click Edit Roles.
- Edit the role's name, color or description.
- Click Save.

title: How can I set up a loyalty program on my Wix site?
content:
Important: You can set up your loyalty program for free, but you must upgrade to a plan that includes accepting payments to launch the program.

Step 1 | Create your loyalty program
Go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard. Click Start Now. Enter your program info: Program name; Points name; Points icon. Click Continue to Setup.

Step 2 | Choose how members earn points
Click the Points and rewards tab. Hover over the relevant Ways to earn method and click Edit. Edit Let customers know how to earn points and Customer earns, then click Save. Repeat for each way to earn you would like to edit.

Step 3 | Set up loyalty rewards
On the Points and rewards tab, scroll down to Rewards. Create a new reward or edit an existing reward. Edit your reward coupon: Select what reward you want to offer; Reward name; Apply to; set the discount your coupon offers and/or the points it costs a customer. Click Save. Repeat for each reward you would like to add or edit.

Step 4 | Decide whether to activate email automations
Click the Email automations tab. Click the Status toggle. Active: Customers will automatically receive an email when they earn a reward. Inactive: Customers will not automatically receive an email when they earn a reward.

Step 5 | Review your loyalty program
Click the Program info tab. Review your Program details and click Edit Details to make any changes. Review your Program overview and click the Points and rewards or Email automations tab to make any changes. Click Launch Program in the top right. Click Launch Program in the pop-up.

Step 6 | View your new site pages
Click View in Editor at the top of the screen. To view your new Loyalty and My Rewards pages, navigate to them by clicking the Switch Page panel on the top left of the Editor.

title: How can I create an appointment in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a New Service in the top right. Under Appointment, click Edit below the relevant appointment template or click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template. Fill out the Service details, including Name, optional Tagline, optional Description, optional Image, Duration, and Buffer time. To create a multi-day service, select Custom from the drop-down and set the session duration to cover multiple days (up to 99 hours).

title: How does billing work for Google Ads campaigns on this service?
content:
A monthly subscription is billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole for all campaigns you run. The monthly subscription amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month. The subscription includes the amount billed monthly (before VAT) as a whole and tax. A 15% fee applies to your payment for running and optimizing your campaign; the remaining 85% goes toward your ad credit, which is spent on ad clicks.

You can pause your campaign at any time. Your remaining ad credits stay in your account, and if the paused campaign was your last active campaign on the account, auto renew is turned off for the subscription.

If you want additional ad credit, you can make a one-time purchase of credits that are added to the total in your account. You can then readjust the daily budget of one or more campaigns as needed. This won’t affect your overall monthly subscription.

You can manage your subscription from the campaigns page of your dashboard. Click Manage Spend & Credits at the top to update your monthly subscription or adjust your daily spend across all campaigns you're running.

title: How can I block off time for multiple staff members using the Time Blocker app in Wix Bookings?
content: After adding the Time Blocker app, go to Staff in your site's dashboard. Under Add blocked time to your booking calendar, click the drop-down next to Staff and select the checkbox next to the relevant staff members. Tip: select the checkbox next to Select all to block off your entire team's calendars. Enter a title for the blocked time period, for example, "training". Set the Block Period start and end dates and times using the drop-downs. Optionally choose how often the blocked time recurs from the Repeats drop-down; this option is only available for 1-day block periods. Click Block. Note: Blocked time prevents clients from booking appointments but does not affect existing class or course sessions.

title: How can I customize the design of my horizontal menu container in Wix Editor?
content: The menu container is the space around the items. To customize the menu container in Wix Editor, select the menu in the editor, click the Design icon, click Customize Design, then click Menu container under What do you want to design? Use the options to customize the container: Background Fills lets you select a color and adjust opacity; Borders lets you select a border color, choose a border style, use the Lock / Unlock icon to choose whether all sides are the same or different sizes, and type the pixel number to change the border size; Corners lets you use the Lock / Unlock icon to choose whether the corners are the same or different sizes and type the pixel number to change the corner radius; Shadows lets you click Add a shadow to add a shadow, adjust opacity, and customize the shadow color, type, angle, distance, blur, and size; Layout lets you use the Lock / Unlock icon to choose whether the padding is the same or different sizes and type the pixel number to change the padding size.

title: How can I customize the fields on my Wix site's checkout page to collect specific information from customers?
content: To customize checkout page fields, go to Checkout Settings in your site's dashboard, click Customize your checkout, then click Edit next to Checkout form. You can customize default fields: click the Phone field in the preview and enable or disable the Required field toggle; click the group of fields under Delivery details and enable or disable the Show "Address - line 2" toggle. The email and name fields have no customizations. To add a new field, click Create field on the left, select the field type, and customize it using the available general and advanced customizations. You can also create conditional rules that control which fields are displayed, such as showing additional fields when a customer selects "Yes" to a business purchase question. Customers who answer "No" won't see those fields. To view what customers entered in custom fields, go to the order in the Orders tab. Customers who check out with PayPal do so in the PayPal dashboard, so they may not see custom fields you added. If you added a custom field before advanced checkout forms were released, it still appears on your live site and in the new form composer with fewer customization options; to customize it, delete the field and re-add it, which cannot be undone.

title: How can I add a Category Menu to my Wix Blog using the Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, select the page where you want the add-on to appear. Click the Add icon on the left of your editor, click Blog, scroll down and choose the Category Menu element to add, then drag the element to position it on the page.

title: How can I add a pinned scroll effect to a section in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the section in the Editor. Click Position in the Inspector. Click the Position type drop-down and select Pinned. By default, a pinned section overlaps the section below it. Note: To apply the Pinned effect, your section must border at least 1 edge of the page (top, bottom, rightmost or leftmost) on all breakpoints. If it's a global section, make sure it's positioned this way across all pages that display it.

title: How can I set up catering services using Wix Restaurants?
content:
Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Pickup tab. Set the pickup time for 0 minutes. Click Save at the top right.
- Click the Delivery tab. Click into each delivery area to edit them. Set the Maximum Delivery Time to 0 minutes. Click Save at the top right.
- Click the Order scheduling tab. Click the Scheduled orders toggle to enable it and set how far in advance customers can place orders:
  - Minimum time: Enter a number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list.
  - Maximum time: Enter a maximum number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list.
- Disable the ASAP toggle. Click Save at the top right.

title: Can I create product options for digital products in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a digital product with different product options.

title: How can I check if a domain name is available using Wix?
content: Go to the domain search page. Enter a domain name and extension in the search field. Click Search. If the domain is available, click Get It to register the domain. If the domain is not available, try another domain and/or extension.

title: How can I view and filter my music sales transactions on Wix Music?
content: To view your transactions, go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant payment to see more information. To filter your transactions, go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Filter. Select the checkbox next to the filter(s) you want to apply. If you sell other products or services on your site, you can filter the list to only show Wix Music transactions by selecting Wix Music as the Order Type.

title: How can I prevent search engines from indexing a specific page on my Wix site?
content:
To prevent search engines from indexing a specific page on your Wix site, follow these steps in the Editor:

- Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant page.
- Click **SEO Basics**.
- Disable the **Let search engines index this page** toggle.

If you want to let search engines index your page again, simply enable the **Let search engines index this page** toggle to make the page visible to search engines again.

title: How can I add a repeater in the Studio Editor and what should I be aware of when customizing it?
content:
To add a repeater in the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Layout Tools, click Repeaters, then drag a repeater onto the page.

When customizing a repeater, note that when you add an element to a repeater item, it's automatically added to the other items to keep the design consistent. However, you can still customize the individual elements inside each item (e.g., text, images). Removing an element from one repeater item deletes it from all other items. It is not possible to add the following elements to repeaters: Pro Gallery, Accordion, Tabs, and all third-party apps.

title: How can I manually authenticate my custom email domain purchased outside of Wix?
content: To manually authenticate a custom domain purchased outside of Wix (e.g., GoDaddy.com), go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Under Sender Details, click Add Details. If you previously entered an email address, click Edit Details instead. Enter a From name, enter a Reply-to email connected to your custom domain, and click Save. Confirm your email address by entering the confirmation code sent to the address you just added, then click Confirm. Once your email is confirmed, you will see 'Not authenticated' under Domain status. Click Authenticate this domain. Copy the CNAME records shown. Sign in to your external domain provider and locate the DNS settings. Paste the CNAME record from Wix into the corresponding fields, making sure the CNAME Host and Points to values match exactly as they appear in the Wix records, then click the confirm message in your domain provider's DNS settings. It can take a few hours for the records to propagate and authentication to complete; if you do not see it, allow up to 24 hours. You can check the status in your Email Marketing dashboard under Sender Details by refreshing the page to see Domain status.

title: How can I use the AI Text Creator in Editor X to generate text for my website?
content:
### Step 1 | Enter the relevant information for your text
To get started, select a text box in your Editor. You can then access the AI text creator to generate titles or paragraphs based on the details you enter.

#### To enter information for your AI-generated text:
- Add a new text box or select an existing one in the Editor.
- Click **Create AI Text**.
- Enter your business type.
- (Optional) Enter your business name.
- Select a text type: **Title** or **Paragraph**.
- Select a topic from the drop-down.

   **Tip:** You can choose **Other** to enter your own topic.
- (Optional) Add any other relevant information in the text under **What's important to mention?**.
- Click **Create Text**.

### Step 2 | Review and use a text suggestion
After clicking **Create Text**, you receive 3 text options to choose from. All options are based on the information you provide, but written in slightly different styles. Once you decide on an option you like, you can either apply it to the current text box or copy it for later use.

#### To review and use a text suggestion:
- Review the text options and decide which one you want to use.
- Choose what to do next:
   * **Use Text:** Apply this text to the text box you selected.
   * **Copy Text:** Copy the text to your clipboard.
- (Optional) Click **Edit Text** to make changes to the AI-generated text.

### Didn't like the suggestions?
You can refine the information you previously entered by clicking the Back icon at the top left.

title: What should I do if I receive the error message "You already have a Google Workspace business email account. You can manage it from the Google Admin Console" when trying to purchase a business email?
content:
This error message appears when the business email you are trying to purchase already exists. You can manage your Google Workspace account through your Google Admin console.

If you did not purchase this business email, or can’t recover access to it, you need to contact Google Workspace directly to be able to use the email account.

If your domain is already registered on Google's end, you should see a message that the domain is already taken. Workspace provides a form in order to verify that you are the current owner of this domain. Once verified, and if you have successfully purchased a business email, you can connect it to your domain by following the steps in Adding Google Workspace MX Records in Your Wix Account.

title: What resources does Wix offer for educators teaching students aged 13-18?
content: Wix offers Tomorrow Classroom, a free platform and suite of learning resources tailor-made for classroom educators teaching students ages 13-18. It includes free lesson plans, activities, templates, and classroom management solutions designed to help educators and students dive into web creation, design, and coding to create portfolio websites, capstone projects, passion projects, and more.

title: What is the full form of CMS, and what benefits does the Wix CMS provide?
content: CMS stands for Content Management System. The Wix CMS lets you manage your site's content in collections separate from your editor, connect that content to elements such as repeaters, galleries, and tables, and display it dynamically. It also supports dynamic pages, custom forms, SEO options, access controls, backups, integration with Wix App Collections, and a Sandbox for testing.

title: Can I manually add recipients to an email automation using a segment trigger?
content: Yes. You can use the Segments trigger to manually add recipients to an email automation. For example, if someone RSVPs to an event over the phone, you can ensure that they receive the automatic email sent to people who RSVP online. To do this, you first need to create a contacts segment that filters contacts based on a label you create (for example, "Offline RSVPs"). Then, create an automation using the Segments trigger, set to trigger when a contact enters your new segment. When you add this label to your contact, they will enter the segment and the email automation will be triggered.

title: Can I offer both appointments and classes in the same time slot using Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, clients cannot book an Appointment with you if you have a Class offered in the same time slot. As a workaround, it is possible to offer two Class services at the same time. While creating one of them, limit the number of participant to one.

title: How do I transfer my domain away from Wix to another host?
content: You can transfer a domain purchased from Wix to another domain host. If you transfer it away, your Wix site is disconnected and Wix can no longer assist with managing the domain. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, select Transfer away from Wix, review the info, click Transfer Domain, and click I Still Want to Transfer. Wix sends a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's registrant contact email address. After you get the code, follow your new domain host's instructions. For .co.uk domains, contact your new domain provider to get the IPS tag before starting; enter your new provider's IPS tag, click Continue, then click Submit Request. The transfer is finalized within 7 days.

title: How can I display tax and shipping information next to product prices in my Wix store?
content:
To display tax and shipping information next to product prices, go to your site's dashboard, click Settings, select Products & Inventory, and scroll down to the Price and shipping display.

To display tax messages next to product prices, go to the price and shipping settings in your site's dashboard and enable the Show if tax is included or not toggle. This displays a "Sales Tax Included" or "Excluding Sales Tax" message.

To display shipping messages next to product prices, go to the price and shipping settings in your site's dashboard and enable the Show info about shipping and delivery toggle. Enter a shipping message (maximum 23 characters). This is the text customers see next to product prices. Optionally, link the message to a pop-up by selecting the Let customers click this text to open a pop-up with more information checkbox, entering a title, and entering the shipping and delivery information.

title: How can I change a section into a full page on my Wix ADI site?
content: Click the section you want to move inside ADI, click the More Actions icon, click Move to, click New Page, then click Move. You cannot convert your header or footer into a whole page. Your new page has the name Blank Page.

title: How can I use the 'Bot Traffic over Time' report in Wix Analytics to optimize my site's SEO?
content:
The 'Bot Traffic over Time' report lets you see an overview of which bots crawl your site and how often they crawl it. You can use this information to:

* Understand how specific bots interact with your site by selecting them in the Line Chart Split View.
* Identify potential issues with your site using Advanced Filters.
* Make decisions about updating your site pages to manage your crawl budget.

title: How can I uninstall the Zoom app from Wix Bookings?
content: To uninstall the Zoom app, go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the Zoom app. Click Delete. Select your reason for deleting the app from the dialogue box. Click Delete App.

title: Can I add line breaks in menus and orders using Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it is now possible to add line breaks. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app and Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I connect my Wix domain to an external site without changing the name servers?
content:
Contact your site host and ask for the relevant DNS records (the A and CNAME records) to which your Wix domain should point. Then, in your Wix account:

- Go to Domains.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Select Manage DNS Records.
- Edit your CNAME records as needed: hover over the relevant CNAME record and click Edit, click Got it in the pop-up, edit the Host Name field (include the www prefix for Host Name), edit the Value field to the web address the record points to, click Save, then click Save Changes in the pop-up.
- Edit your A records as needed: hover over the A record and click Edit, click Got it in the pop-up, edit the Host Name field (leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign), edit the Value field to the IP address the record points to, click Save, then click Save Changes in the pop-up.

Note: Any changes to the A/CNAME records can take up to 48 hours to complete.

title: How can I change the color of the drop-down arrow on the mobile menu in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your mobile editor. Click the mobile menu. Click **Edit Menu**. Click the menu. Click the **Design** icon. Click **Fill Color & Opacity**. Click the color box under **Arrow** and select a new color.

title: Can I charge users for downloading my branded app?
content: Currently in the Branded App, it is not possible to charge people for downloading the app. You are able to sell goods and services inside your app with Apple in-app purchase.

title: How do I connect a pricing plan to a File Share folder from the Pricing Plans dashboard?
content: Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard. Choose the plan you want to use under Active Plans. Select File Share Subscriptions under Connect & Manage Benefits. Select the folder you want to include and the type of access to grant using the drop-down menus. Click Add Item to connect another folder to the pricing plan. Click the Remove icon to remove a folder from the plan.

title: How can I change the design of a member badge on my site?
content:
Before you begin, to use member badges, you must install a Member's Area on your site.

Go to Site Members.
Click More Actions at the top right and click Manage Badges.
Click the Show More icon on the badge you want to change.
Click Edit.
Change the design options:
- Background Color: Click the field and select a color for the badge background.
- Text Color: Click the field and select a color for the badge text.
- Click Add under Icon and select a new icon for your badge from the Media Manager, or upload your own.
Click Save.

title: How can I add an app to a site using the Studio Editor's app market?
content: Click App Market on the left side of the Editor, then click App Market again. Use the search bar and the categories on the left to find the app you need. Click the app you want to add, then click + Add to Site. After adding an app, a widget is often automatically added to the page you're working on, or relevant new site pages are automatically created to show the app's content. You can then click the widget or go to the pages that were added to customize the settings to your client's needs.

title: How can I assign a role to a staff member so they can accept payments using Wix Mobile POS?
content: Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Click + Invite People. Enter the person's email address. Select the checkbox(es) next to the relevant role(s) that let collaborators accept mobile POS payments. Optionally add custom permissions. Click Send Invite. The person you invite receives an invitation by email and must accept the invitation.

title: How can I resolve the 'There Are No Available Rooms' error in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
To resolve the 'There Are No Available Rooms' error in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, follow these steps:

- In Reservation settings under Property Settings, enable the **Show unavailable rooms in search results** checkbox under **Search rules**. This gives your guests the chance to try searching for alternative dates or to contact you about making a reservation.
- In General Settings under Property Settings, select the correct opening dates for your property under **Season and time**.
- In the **Markets** section of your site's dashboard, connect the relevant countries from which you accept reservations.
- Check that your Inventory Calendar is configured correctly: check if you have **Stop Sell** active on the relevant dates (Stop Sell dates appear in red on the calendar); check if **Close to arrivals** or **close to departures** are active on the incorrect dates; and check if you have the correct minimum stay set up for the relevant room that's not available to reserve on your site.
- Make sure the relevant rate plan isn't hidden from your site.

If the problem persists, contact us.

title: How can I cancel and refund an order using the Wix app?
content:
To cancel and refund an order in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Sales and select Orders.
- Tap the relevant order.
- Tap the More Actions icon at the top right.
- Tap Issue Refund.
- Tap to select the checkbox(es) next to the relevant service(s) you want to refund and cancel.
- (Optional) Tap Edit Amount to offer partial refunds: enter the relevant amount you want to refund, then tap Apply.
- Tap Next.
- (Optional) Select the reason you provided a refund from the Refund Reason drop-down.
- (Optional) Notify your customer: enable Send a confirmation email and enter a note to your customer. The note appears in the confirmation email.
- Tap Next.
- Tap Issue Refund to confirm.

Note: You cannot undo this action.

title: How can I add navigation arrows to my gallery in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the gallery. Click the Settings icon. Enable the Navigation arrows toggle. Navigation arrows are available in the Grid (Portrait), Slider (Arrows), and Slider (Postcard) galleries.

title: How can I ensure that each item in my CMS collection has a unique dynamic item page URL?
content: Every collection must have a Primary field. To have a dynamic item page URL for an item, add unique content to the Primary field for each item. By default, each collection includes a Primary field named "Title", but you can change the name of this field or choose another to be your Primary field. We recommend making sure each item has a unique value in the primary field.

title: How can I schedule a course session in Wix Bookings?
content: Before you begin, create the Course service you want to schedule. Then go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the time slot in which the course takes place for the first time, and select Course session. Add the course session details: Course/Service, Staff, Start Time, Duration (select Custom for a custom duration), and Repeat. For Repeat, choose an option from the drop-down; select Doesn't Repeat to only offer the course once, select the day(s) of the week the course takes place, and optionally click the field next to Until and choose the date of the last class. Choose Save & Add New to save the session and start scheduling another one, or Save to save the session and return to your calendar. Tip: Go to the Bookings Services tab and click Show Schedule next to the relevant course to view a summary of its schedule. You can also select the Schedule view in your calendar to check the list of upcoming sessions on the certain date.

title: Can I connect and disconnect logos created in Wix to my sites?
content: Yes. You can now connect and disconnect logos created in Wix to your sites. All of your logos can be accessed from the My Logos & Brands page.

title: How can I add and set up gift cards using the Gifted app on my Wix site?
content:
Add and set up gift cards using the Gifted app:

- In Wix Editor: Go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side, search for the Gifted app, click Add to Site, then click Allow and Add.
- In Studio Editor: Go to your editor, click App Market on the left side, click App Market, search for the Gifted app, click Add to Site, then click Allow and Add.
- In Dashboard: Go to the Wix App Market in your site's dashboard, search for the Gifted app, click Add to Site, then click Allow and Add.

This adds a Gift Card page to your site, which is not visible to visitors until you publish. Sign up or log in to your Gifted account. Click Customize your gift card and choose what to do next:

Enter the gift card details:
- Select Custom Value and enter minimum and maximum possible values, or select Set Values and enter the gift card amounts you offer, separated by commas.
- Set when the gift card expires, or set it to never expire.
- Optionally enter additional info, such as terms and conditions.
- Click Save.

Design the gift card:
- Click Gift Card Design at the top.
- Design the look of your gift card using the available options.

Go back to your Editor and publish your site.

title: How can I resize and make additional edits to images in my Wix blog post?
content: To resize an image in a post, go to Blog in your site's dashboard, open an existing post or create a new one, select the image you wish to edit, and drag the side handles on the image to resize it. To make further edits to an image, go to Blog in your site's dashboard, open an existing post or create a new one, select the image you wish to edit, click the Image Editor icon in the toolbar above the image, use the available tools in the Photo Studio to edit your image, and click Save to implement the changes you made.

title: Can I display a price range for products with different prices in Wix Stores?
content: Displaying the price as a range, for example $20 - $30, is not supported. However, it is now possible to display "From" before the product price to indicate a price range. If you sell a product with product options sold at different prices, the lowest price is displayed in the Product Gallery and on the Product Page before a customer selects a product option.

title: How can I customize visitor interactions and notifications for my Wix Photo Albums Favorites list?
content: To customize visitor interactions and notifications for a Wix Photo Albums Favorites list: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Album next to the relevant album. Click the drop-down in the Favorites Lists section to expand it. Set your album's heart icon settings: enable the Let visitors select photos by clicking on a heart icon toggle to allow visitors to mark their favorite photos with heart icons, and choose whether clicking the heart icon adds the photo to a Favorites list or marks the photo as liked. Enable the Notifications for Favorites lists toggle to receive notifications when certain Favorites lists actions are taken, and select the checkboxes next to the actions you'd like to receive notifications for. Click Save.

title: Can I limit multi-service appointments to a single staff member in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to limit multi-service appointments to a single staff member. For example, at present, when a client books a manicure and pedicure, they have the option to book a separate staff member for each service.

title: How can I embed my entire Tumblr blog on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Copy the following code: <script type='text/javascript' src='https://blogname.tumblr.com/js'></script>. Replace "blogname" with your username. If you're using a custom domain, replace "blogname.tumblr.com" with your domain. Then go to your Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Embed Code, and click Embed HTML. Copy and paste the code you modified into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field and click Update. Optionally, enter alt text that describes what you're embedding in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field. When ready, publish your site.

title: Can I transfer an existing Facebook Ads campaign from one site to another in Facebook Ads?
content: Currently in Facebook Ads, you cannot transfer an existing Facebook Ads campaign from one site to another. It is possible, however, to contact Wix and have our team transfer the campaign over. If you want to transfer your campaign to another Wix site, you can contact Wix Customer Care. Please specify in your request the old site name as well as the new site name where you want the campaign transferred. Also please note that you can only transfer a campaign once its current subscription has expired. If a campaign is transferred, all its data will move from the old site to the new site. You will also need to cancel your monthly subscription from the old site and repurchase a Facebook Ads subscription for the new site.

title: Review 量太少的品类，AI 做痛点分析还有价值吗？
content: 原文指出，痛点挖掘的输入是差评；月销个位数、总 Review 不到几十条的细分品类，AI 分析出来的“高频痛点”其实是两三个人的个人体验。这种品类该做的是直接找目标用户聊，不是让 AI 归纳统计上不成立的样本。

title: How can I add a text marquee to my Wix site and customize its design?
content:
**To add a text marquee:**
- Go to your editor.
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Text**.
- Click **Text Marquee**.
- Drag a design you like onto your page.
- Enter your text: click **Change Text**, then enter your text under **Add your own text**.

**To design the text marquee element:**
- Select the relevant text marquee element.
- Customize your text marquee using the available options under **Design**:

**Text**
- Change the theme, font, size, color and formatting (e.g. bold, italics).
- Adjust the capitalization to your liking (e.g. uppercase, title case).
- Adjust the spacing between characters, as well as the spacing between the text and the separator icon.

**Separator**
- Click the **Replace** icon to change the shape. You can choose from many different designs in the Media Manager, or upload your own SVG.
- Click the **Remove** icon to delete the separator.
- Adjust the **Shape color** and **Shape size**.

**Movement**
- **Speed:** Drag the slider to make the text move faster or slower.
- **Direction:** Make the text move from left to right or right to left.
- **Pause on hover:** Enable the toggle to make the text stop moving when visitors hover over it.

**Tip:** You can rotate the element so the text moves vertically.

title: How can I apply a stack to elements in the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Click an element that you want to be in the stack. Hold down the Shift key and select the other stack elements. Click Stack. Optionally, drag the line between the elements to set margins. You can also create negative margins to make elements overlap intentionally.

title: How can I create a discount coupon in the original Wix Hotels?
content: To create a coupon in the original Wix Hotels: Go to your dashboard. Click the Hotels tab. Click the Price Options tab. Click Coupons. Click Create New. Enter a name for your coupon in the Name your coupon field. Click the Set coupon type drop-down menu and select a type: Payment Discount (amount based discount, e.g. $10) or % Discount (percentage based discount, e.g. 10%). Enter the discount amount or percentage. Click the Valid from field and select the start date of the coupon. Click the Valid to field and select the end date of the coupon. (Optional) Enter the coupon limit in the Limit number of coupons to field. Enter the code that you want your customers to use in the Coupon Code field. Click Save.

title: Can I sell product subscriptions using Wix Retail POS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell product subscriptions at a point of sale. However, you can sell product subscriptions on your site.

title: Can I upload fillable PDF forms using the PDF Viewer app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to upload fillable PDF forms using the PDF Viewer app. You can, however, add Wix Forms and customize it so you can collect information from site visitors.

title: Can I add one form to multiple site pages using Wix Forms?
content: Yes. You can now add a form to multiple site pages using new Wix Forms.

title: What should I do if I'm having issues with images on my Wix site?
content: Make sure that the files you are uploading meet the requirements. Try viewing your site on another device to see if the image issue occurs there as well. Click any "?" inside the editor and type your problem. Follow the general interactive tutorial. If you are still having problems after completing the steps above, contact Customer Care and provide a screenshot of the issue.

title: How can I edit a campaign image in the Wix app for my email marketing campaign?
content: In the Wix app, go to the email marketing dashboard. Tap the Drafts tab. Tap the campaign you want to customize. Tap Edit. If you don't see the option to edit, your campaign was created on a desktop and you must customize it from there. Tap the image you want to customize. Edit your image using options such as Change Photo, Edit Photo, and Link. For Link, tap the Include Link toggle, then select My Wix Site, My Wix App, or Custom Link. Use the Add a URL field to add a different link, then tap Done. You can use the navigation arrows to move your image to a different location in the campaign. Tap Close.

title: How can I duplicate my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Site at the top of the editor. Click Duplicate Site. Enter a name for the duplicate site. Click Duplicate.

title: How do I identify and use the Layers panel in the Wix Editor?
content: Use the Layers panel to select and manage elements on your site. Click Layers on the bottom left of the editor. Click either Header, Page, or Footer to view the elements in that area. Locate the relevant element from the list and click it. To move an element forward, select Ctrl + ↑; to bring it to the front, select Ctrl + Shift + ↑. To move it backward, select Ctrl + ↓; to send it to the back, select Ctrl + Shift + ↓. To recenter an element that was moved outside the editor viewport, select the element in the panel, hover over the Information icon, and click Recenter element.

title: How can I retrieve data from my Wix account that isn't directly accessible?
content: Most of your data is accessible directly from your Wix account, including information about sites in your account, premium services, and personal information such as your address and billing information. Alternatively, you can choose to download an archive of your data. This archive includes your information that you're unable to find in your Wix account, including technical data and personal information that is collected by Wix.

title: How can I switch from Wix Studio to the regular Wix experience, and what should I do before making the switch?
content: Only the workspace owner can leave Wix Studio, and you can only leave from the original workspace you first created in Wix Studio. Before you begin, remove all of your teammates from this workspace. If you're a Wix Partner, also remove your custom branding. To switch to the regular Wix experience, go to Workspace Settings in your Wix Studio workspace; click Find out more at the bottom; select the I understand that I will lose access to all Studio and Partner features checkbox to confirm; click Leave Wix Studio. To remove teammates, go to Team in your Wix Studio workspace; click the More Actions icon next to the relevant teammate; click Remove from Team; click Remove Collaborator to confirm. To remove custom branding, go to Custom Branding in your Wix Studio workspace; click Remove Custom Branding; click Remove to confirm. If you choose to leave Wix Studio, your free site CMS quota reverts to 1,000 collection items.

title: How can I disable a purchased gift card that was sent to the wrong email address?
content: Go to Sales in your site's dashboard. Hover over the sale you want to disable and click View. Click the Show More icon, then click Disable gift card. Click Disable gift card again to confirm.

title: Can I display multiple manual (offline) payment methods to my customers on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a feature that would allow you to display multiple manual (offline) payment methods to your customers. If you offer several offline payment options (e.g. cash, bank transfer, check), use the instructions section to explain how to pay with each one.

title: How does Wix determine which customers are subject to US sales tax?
content: Sales tax is charged according to the billing address (zip code) entered with your credit card information and type of subscription purchased. Please ensure your billing information is correct. If it's not, you can update your billing information.

title: Why is a member not appearing on the Members page in my Wix Blog site?
content: Possible reasons include: the member was approved but has not logged in after approval; the member accepted an invite but has not logged in since receiving it; or the member has not joined your community. Members appear on the Members page only after they sign in for the first time, and besides logging in, members need to join your community to appear on the Members page. The Community is an opt-in feature that allows members to decide whether their information can be viewed by other members. To encourage members to join, set the Join this site's community checkbox to be selected by default. To check if a member has signed in, go to the Site Members tab in your site's dashboard.

title: Can I resize my logo on my mobile site using ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot resize your logo on your mobile site. However, you can resize your logo from a desktop.

title: Can I allow customers at my Facebook Shop to check out using the Facebook Pay payment method with Wix Stores?
content: It is now possible to allow customers at your Facebook Shop to check out using the Facebook Pay payment method. To do so, connect your store to Facebook using the Facebook Shops by GoDataFeed third-party app. Go to the App Market to add the app. Learn how to create a Facebook shop using the Facebook Shops by GoDataFeed app.

title: How can I create folders and upload files using the Wix File Share app?
content: With the File Share app, you can organize your files by creating folders and uploading various file formats such as images, videos, audio, and documents. Wix supports a wide range of file formats across different products. When using the File Share app, you can upload larger file sizes and there's no limit to the number of files you can upload to your site.

title: What are the benefits of choosing a classic ad format for my Facebook Ads campaign?
content:
The benefits of choosing a classic ad:

* Fully customizable: Choose the ad's image, caption, headline and call-to-action to drive potential customers to a specific place.
* Video capabilities: With classic ads, you can choose to upload a video to make your product or service come to life in the ad.
* More focused creative: Since you get more control over the messaging, you can use a classic ad to drive potential customers to a specific sale or place on your site (like a landing page or one-off page) rather than a product page.

title: How can I add a YouTube video to my site using the Single Video Player?
content: To add a YouTube video using the Single Video Player, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Video and Music. Click Single Video Players. Click the YouTube Video option and drag it to the relevant location. Click Change Video. Paste the video URL in the What's the video's web address? field. Customize the playback options: Autoplays can be enabled or disabled; when enabled, the video autoplays on mute and visitors can turn the sound on manually; when disabled, the video does not play automatically. Plays in a loop can be enabled or disabled; when enabled, the video starts again automatically after it ends; when disabled, the video does not start again automatically after it ends. Scroll down and enter a description of the video in the What's this video about? field. Publish your site. Important: The smallest player size you can add is 320 pixels by 180 pixels because audio controls cannot be displayed on smaller players due to a YouTube restriction. In your YouTube video settings, make sure the video is set to Public and the Allow Embedding box is checked. Views for embedded videos may not register on that video's native platform. A YouTube video always plays from the beginning (00:00:00) in your Single Video Player, even if you enter a URL set up to start playing from a different point (e.g. 15 seconds in).

title: How can I review reports about members from my site's dashboard?
content: To review reports from your site's dashboard, go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Click the Reported tab. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant member. Choose what to do with this member: Review Reports: See the report details, including the member who submitted the report, the date and the reason, if the member specified it. According to how you want to handle this report, click Block Member or Remove Reports. Remove Reports: Delete and dismiss the report that was submitted about this member. View member: Before making your decision, open the reported member's Contact Card to see more details about them. Block member: Block this member from your Members Area, so they can't access it nor sign up again using the same email address. When removing a report, it gets automatically deleted with no option to see it again in the future.

title: Can I customize the fonts and colors of the thank you message when guests reply to an invitation in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to disable the Thank You message or customize the fonts and colors. You can however edit the text of the thank you message for RSVP events.

title: Can I password protect my entire site with a single password using Wix Editor?
content: You can now password protect your entire site with a single password.

title: How can I access the Photo Albums Media Manager in Wix?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant album. Hover over the relevant gallery and click Manage Media. Click the Import Photos icon at the top right. The album's Media Manager will open and you'll see all of the app's media. As a workaround, you can download images from your site's Media Manager and then upload them to your photo albums. Once you upload these images, you can edit their titles and descriptions.

title: How can I add an image, video, GIF, or emoji to my Wix Forum post or comment?
content:
To add an image, video, GIF or emoji to a post or comment in Wix Forum:

* Go to the forum on your live site.
* Click **Create New Post** to add a new post, or select an existing post to comment on it.
* Add the relevant text to your post or comment.
* Click the icons on the toolbar to add the following:
   * **Image**: Click the **Image** icon and select the image you want to upload.
   * **GIF**: Click the **GIF** icon to select a GIF.
   * **Video**: Click the **Video** icon to upload a video.
   * **Emoji**: Click the **Emoji** icon to add an emoji.
* When you're ready, click **Publish**.

title: How can I create a new tag for my orders in Wix Stores?
content: To create a new tag, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the relevant order, click the Tag field on the bottom right, enter the tag text (e.g. Preorder), and click +Create. After you create a tag, you can use it to filter your orders. You can create up to 100 tags.

title: How can I add structured data markup to my Wix site's pages using the Wix Editor?
content: To add structured data markup to your Wix site's pages using the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Click the Advanced SEO tab. Click Structured Data Markup. Click +Add New Markup. Add your new markup under Write your markup in JSON-LD format. Click Apply. You can add up to five markups per page. After you've added your markup, click the More Actions icon to edit, test, or delete it.

title: How can I add and set up an image button in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add an image button: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Button. Click Image Buttons. Click or drag the relevant button to add it to your page.

To add a link to your image button: Select your new button. Click the Link icon. Select a link type on the left. Depending on the link type you selected, add the relevant information. Click Done.

To customize your image button: Select the button in your editor. Click Change Image. Click the relevant tab at the top of the panel to select the button state you want to edit: Regular, Hover, or Clicked. Click Change Image. Choose Media from Wix or + Upload Media, then click Apply. To apply a transition effect, choose Dissolve under Apply transition effects?. To add a tooltip, enter the text of your tooltip under Does this button have a tooltip?. To add an animation effect, click the Animation icon, select an animation to apply to the button, and optionally click Customize to adjust the animation.

Note: Adding a tooltip is a crucial step towards making your site accessible. Hover (tap) effects on image buttons are not currently supported on iOS. Viewers on iOS devices do not see the hover state if they tap the button.

title: How can I get the URL of my Studio template in Wix Studio?
content: Go to Custom Templates in your Wix Studio workspace. Click the More Actions icon next to the Studio template and select Edit template. Click Publish at the top right. Copy the template URL.

title: I'm troubleshooting why my automated email isn't being sent after a form submission. I've confirmed that I've checked the automation statistics.
content: If your automation is triggering but the automated email isn't sent, check the spam folder: the email could end up in your contact's spam folder. If checking the spam folder doesn't solve the issue, whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com. If you have not set a confirmed reply-to email, whitelist @automations.ascendbywix.com. If you have set a confirmed reply-to email, whitelist your email address. Check that the recipient's email address is active and that they've subscribed to your mailing list; if they have, you'll see a "SUBSCRIBED" label on their contact card. If your automation sends an email to an inactive contact, the email will not go through. Check that the recipient's email address is valid; if it's not, the recipient won't receive an email (even if the automation was set up correctly). For Wix Forms automations, check that the form was successfully submitted, that the right form is selected as part of your trigger, and that there is an email/phone field in your form. Action is Send an email: Form must include an email field. Check that the email field is the correct form field type; in the Editor, hover over your email field to make sure its title is "Email Field." Check that the email field is synced with an email field in your Contact List; the synced field must be either "Email" or "Email (Main)." If it's anything else, it won't work as an email field, a contact is not created, and an automated email cannot be sent. Check if you hold multiple email addresses for one contact: automated emails are usually sent to an additional email rather than the contact's main/primary email; contacts with only one email address are not affected.

title: How can I add a tracking number to an order using the Wix app?
content:
Add tracking numbers to your orders so both you and your customers can track the progress of their packages. To add a tracking number using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Sales**.
- Tap **Orders**.
- Tap the relevant order.
- Scroll down and tap **Add Tracking Number**.
- To add the barcode, select an option:
  - **Scan barcode:** Tap the barcode symbol and scan the barcode.
  - **Manually enter barcode:** Tap **Tracking Number**, enter the barcode, and tap save.
- To add the shipping carrier, select an option:
  - **Select an existing carrier:** Tap **Shipping Carrier**. Select a carrier from the list. Tap **Apply**.
  - **Add a new carrier:** Tap **Shipping Carrier**. Scroll down and tap **Add Carrier**. Enter the carrier name and tap **Add**. Tap **Apply**.
- (Optional) Tap the **Send Shipping Confirmation** toggle to disable it.
- Click **Save**.

title: How can I change the priority of MX records in Wix?
content:
It is not possible, or necessary, to change the Priority values (e.g., 0, 10, 20) of MX records in Wix. The Priority values of your MX records are automatically determined by the order in which you add them. The first record you add is given a Priority value of 10, the next is given a Priority of 20, and so on.

When adding MX records, add the record with the lowest Priority value first. Then, continue adding the records in order, with the second lowest Priority value next, and so on. MX record Priority values are only arbitrary numbers that indicate the order of the records. Their numbers do not need to match the values in your email provider's directions, but they do need to be in the same order.

title: How can I enable the download option for images in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
To enable downloading of images in the Wix Pro Gallery:

- Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Click the Download toggle to enable it.

Note: Pro Gallery has a built-in Right Click Protect feature on desktop, so it's not possible to save images added to your Pro Gallery with a right click.

title: Can I see the browsing history of a visitor after they have left my site using Wix Chat?
content: Currently, once a visitor has left your site, it is not possible to see how much time they spent browsing or which pages they visited. You can view this information for live site visitors.

title: Can I add coupons or discounts to a payment form in Wix Forms?
content: Yes. You can now create a coupon for a payment form. Visitors can add a code during checkout and apply it towards their purchase.

title: How can I save my site in the Wix Editor?
content:
Click **Save** at the top right of the Editor. Click **Done** in the pop-up window.

Your site is automatically saved regularly as you are working in the Editor. It starts after the first manual save on your site. Even with autosave, it is recommended to save your site regularly to avoid losing any changes.

title: How can I use the AI tool in the Studio Editor to make a section responsive?
content:
To generate a responsive section with the responsive AI tool in the Studio Editor: click the Desktop breakpoint at the top of the Editor, select the relevant section, click the Responsive AI icon, then click **Generate Now**. In the preview, click through the breakpoints to see how the section looks, then choose what to do next:

* **Apply Design:** Instantly apply the AI suggestions to the section.
* **Discard Changes:** Ignore the AI suggestions and go back to your original design.

The responsive AI tool automatically identifies groups of related elements in your layout, applies the best layout tool for each group (e.g. grid, stack), and adjusts element definitions (e.g. size, responsive behavior) to ensure they look great on all breakpoints. You don't have to apply the suggestion if you don't like what you see in the preview.

title: How can I add a dataset filter to display content from multiple collections in the Wix Editor?
content:
Using a dataset filter in the CMS allows you to display content from multiple collections on a single page. Before you begin, your primary collection should already be connected to a dataset that connects to the page elements, and your secondary collection must have a field that matches the values of a field in your primary collection exactly.

Add a dataset and connect it to your secondary collection:
- Click **CMS** on the left.
- Click **Manage Page Connections**.
- Click **Add a Dataset** in the panel on the right.
- Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select your secondary collection.
- (Optional) Edit the name of the dataset.
- Click **Create**.

Add a filter to your secondary collection's dataset:
- Click the **More Actions** icon next to your secondary collection's dataset in the panel on the right.
- Select **Dataset Settings**.
- Click **+ Add Filter**.
- Click the **Field** drop-down and select the field that has the same values as a field in your primary collection.
- (Optional) Click the **Condition** field to change the operator that determines how the filter is applied.
- Select **Another dataset** under **Value source**.
- Click the **Dataset** drop-down and select the dataset that connects to your primary collection.
- Click the next **Field** drop-down and select the field from your primary collection that matches the secondary collection field.
- Click **Add Filter**.

Connect elements to the secondary collection's dataset to show content from the collection:
- Click the relevant element (e.g. text, image) and select the **Connect to CMS** icon.
- Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select your secondary collection's dataset.
- Click the relevant drop-down(s) under **Connections** and select the secondary collection's field(s) that you want to connect.

**Note:** Don't worry if any of the CMS connections in your editor appear to disconnect at this point. Once you're done with the connections, you can click **Preview** to test the new connections.

Click **Preview** to test your connections, then publish your site when you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I add items to my Favorites screen in Wix Retail POS?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, then tap Settings. Tap Manage next to Favorites. To add an item, tap the Add icon, select Products, Categories, Discounts, or Gift Cards, and tap the item you want to add. You can optionally drag items to reorder them, then tap Save.

title: Is it possible to automatically create an invoice when a program is purchased?
content: You can now automatically send an invoice when someone purchases a program.

title: Can I customize event tickets and confirmation emails with design features like logos, images, or videos in Wix Events?
content:
While you can edit the text on the event tickets and confirmation emails, it is not possible to customize them with design features such as logos, images, or videos.

### Tip
Customize the ticket PDF and include it in the email to excite guests for the upcoming event.

title: How can I add a watermark to an image using Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the relevant image, click the Settings icon, click Adjust, then click Text on the left. Click a text style to add it to your image and type your watermark message. Optionally, click Design to customize the text: use Font to change your font and font size; use Styles to format text as Bold, Italic, or Underline and choose your text color; use Alignment to choose Left, Center, Right, or Justify and adjust line spacing; use Opacity to increase or decrease transparency; use Rotate and flip to change orientation with Rotate left, Rotate right, Flip horizontally, or Flip vertically. Click Save.

title: What should I do if I forgot my Wix account password and can't sign in?
content: If you are unable to sign in to your Wix account because you forgot your password, you can have a reset link sent to your email address. To have a password reset link sent to your email: Go to the Wix Log In page. Enter your email address and click Continue with Email. If you're not sure which email address you used, try the email locator. Click Forgot Password?. Select Forgot my password and click Next. Enter your email address and click Send. Check your email and follow the instructions to create your new password. If your email address exists in our system, you'll receive an email with the link to reset your password. Be sure to check your spam or junk folders. If you don't receive the email, make sure that you entered your email address correctly. Troubleshooting password reset issues: Clear your browser’s cache and try again: clear your browser’s cache, close the browser and reopen it, then go back to the password reset email and click the link. If you see a security warning pop-up, click Load Anyway. Check that cookies aren’t blocked in your browser: go to your browser settings and make sure that you have not chosen to block cookies. Recover your account: if you still can't sign in, you can try recovering your account. If you previously added a recovery phone number to your account, you can use it to access your account. If you haven't added a recovery phone number, you can fill out the Wix Account Recovery form. Learn more about recovering your account.

title: How can I enable and customize tip options for customers in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: To allow customers to add a tip in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, first verify that you have set up your payment methods in your payment settings, because tips don't work with manual/offline payments. Then go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard and click the Advanced tab at the bottom. Enable the Tips toggle to allow customers to leave a tip when placing an order. (Optional) To customize the preset tip options, select a default unit for the tip (Percentage or Currency) and enter 3 different values for the preset tip in the text fields. You can click Set as default by one of the preset amounts to select it as the default for tips. Enable the Allow customers to leave a custom tip toggle to allow customers to leave a tip in their desired amount. Click Save.

title: How can I add a scroll effect to the header in the Studio Editor?
content:
To apply a scroll effect to the header in the Studio Editor:

- Select the header.
- Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor.
- Under Header settings, choose a Scroll effect and set it up:
  - Scroll with site: No scroll effect is applied. When visitors scroll down the page, they also scroll away from the header.
  - Freeze: The header stays in place as visitors scroll down the page, so it's always visible. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling. If you set it to not overlap, you can set a top offset to create some distance between the header and the top of the page.
  - Disappear: As visitors scroll down the page, the header starts to disappear. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling, choose the direction for the header to disappear, and set the distance, delay, duration, and ease of the effect.
  - Fade out: When visitors scroll down the page, the header fades out of view. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling, and set the delay and duration of the effect.

Tip: The scroll effect only applies to the page you're currently working on.

title: How can I show overflow content on my site page using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, select your page: go to the relevant page, click Layers at the top of Editor X, and click Page. Then click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X, click the Layout tab, and select Show from the Overflow Content drop-down. By default, site pages are set to show the overflowing content, and a scroll bar is automatically added so your visitors can see the rest of the content.

title: Can I get a refund for my Google Ads with Wix campaign if I am not satisfied?
content: Ad credits added to Google Ads with Wix are paid with a monthly subscription or a one-time payment, and these payments are non-refundable. If you pause a campaign, you can resume it later using only your remaining Google ad credits. Note that any Google Ads credits with an expiry date may expire while the campaign is paused.

title: How do I upgrade my Hopp by Wix account to a Pro plan?
content: Go to hopp.co and log in. Click Upgrade at the top right. Select the type of plan you want to purchase: Monthly (you will be billed once monthly) or Yearly (you will be billed once annually, at a discounted price). Click Upgrade to confirm. Enter your payment method details and click Submit Payment. Click Get Started to begin using your Pro features.

title: Is it possible to customize the cursor style in Wix Blocks by uploading an image of your choice?
content: Currently in Blocks, it is not possible to customize the cursor style by uploading an image of your choice. You are limited to the default cursor options provided by the system. This feature would allow you to create a custom cursor for your widgets.

title: Is there a feature in Wix Email Marketing to print email campaigns directly?
content: Currently, there is no printing feature in Wix Email Marketing. Tip: You can easily print your email campaigns by pressing Ctrl + P on your keyboard and then follow the instructions to print.

title: How can I create a multi-day service on Wix Bookings that starts on a specific day?
content:
To create a multi-day service that starts on a specific day in Wix Bookings:
- Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard.
- Click Add a New Service.
- Select Start from Scratch under Class or Course.
- Complete the General Info and Service Details sections with all of the necessary information about the service.
- Click Your Calendar under Add Sessions to Get Booked.
- Select the staff member in charge of the session.
- Set the start date and time.
- Select Custom from the Duration drop-down and set the number of hours the session lasts so it covers multiple days (up to 99 hours).
- Select Doesn't Repeat.
- Click Save.

Note: To create even longer services, you can schedule an additional session that starts as soon as the first one ends. Note that this appears as two sessions on your live site.

The dates and times you select then appear on the service page before your clients book.

title: What are the benefits of selecting Private registration for a domain with Wix?
content: Private registration (with Wix as your registrar) lets you keep your personal information private: your personal details are replaced with Wix's details and are not available in the public WHOIS database. Similar to public registration, Wix lists an alternative email address and phone number instead of your personal information, and anyone trying to get in touch with you is referred to a dedicated online contact form instead (with the exception of ICANN, the domain regulatory body). Private registration safeguards you against identity theft, unwanted solicitations, and domain hijacking. Important: Private registration does not guarantee protection from spammers, and it does not protect you in cases where disclosure of your details is required under applicable law.

title: How can I check if there are any Facebook comments on a specific page of my Wix site?
content: To test whether any comments have been left for a specific page on your site, go to https://developers.facebook.com/docs/plugins/comments. Place the relevant page URL under URL to comment on and press the Enter key. If any comments have been left for that URL, they appear below the Comment box.

title: How can I access my marketing reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Marketing section. Click the relevant report.

title: How do I set up the POS solutions available in the UK?
content: According to the source, the POS options mentioned for the UK include Wix Mobile POS, Square, SumUp, and cash. For SumUp: download the Wix app; go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and connect SumUp as your payment provider; contact SumUp to order a SumUp card reader. You can set up SumUp without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments you need a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports payments. SumUp card readers connect via Bluetooth and can swipe, tap, or insert debit/credit cards.
