For Square: download the Wix app; download the Square app; go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and set up Square as your payment provider; contact Square to order your free magstripe reader. You can set up Square without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments you need a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports payments. The magstripe reader plugs into your smartphone or tablet's headphone jack. Cash: after downloading the Wix mobile app, you can accept cash payments at a POS with no further setup.

title: How can I update my invoice details for Wix services, and are there any restrictions on what can be changed?
content:
To update your invoice details for Wix services:
- Go to Billing History in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the subscription you want to update the invoice for.
- Click Update invoice details.
- Enter your new details in the relevant fields and click Save.

Important restrictions:
- All countries: Country cannot be changed.
- European Union: VAT ID and Country cannot be changed.
- United States: Postal Code, State, and Country cannot be changed.
- Singapore: GST and Country cannot be changed.

The changes you make apply to both current and future invoices. However, for legal reasons and depending on local tax laws, some changes only apply to future invoices and will not appear on your current invoices.

title: How can I delete multiple images from the Shared Gallery app on my live site?
content:
To delete multiple images or videos from your live site:

- Go to the Shared Gallery app on your live site.
- Log in using the email address associated with your Wix account.
- (Optional) If you've created albums, select the album that has the images or videos you want to delete.
- Click the More Actions icon above the image or video.
- Choose Select from the dropdown menu.
- Select the images or videos that you want to delete.
- Click Delete in the top right corner of the app.
- Click Delete in the pop-up to confirm.

Tip: Click Delete All Media from the Settings tab in your Editor to reset your gallery and delete all images and videos at once.

title: How can I choose which events Facebook tracks for my domain using Wix?
content: Your domain must be verified on Facebook before you can choose which 8 events Facebook tracks. Due to the release of iOS14 in February 2021, tracking events in Facebook is limited to 8 conversion events. Facebook initially pre-assigns these 8 events based on data from your recent campaign spend, but you can edit the event configurations from the Events Manager by following Facebook's instructions. When you verify your domain on Facebook, select the 8 events you want to track, using the Wix table of trackable events as a reference. If you do not select 8 tracking events, Facebook will automatically choose them for you.

title: How can I cancel my Wix Premium or Studio plan, and what happens if I cancel within the 14-day money-back period?
content: You can cancel your Premium plan or Studio plan at any time. To cancel, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Cancel Plan, and click Cancel Now to confirm. If you cancel during the first 14 days, your plan ends immediately and you are fully refunded (within the next 20 business days). If you cancel after 14 days, the plan remains active until the end of the billing cycle (yearly or monthly).

title: How do I enable 2-step verification for my Wix account using the SMS option?
content: To enable 2-Step verification for your Wix account using the SMS option: go to Account Settings in your Wix account; scroll down to 2-Step verification; click Enable next to Verify logins by phone (SMS); add your phone number; click OK; go to your phone and get the 6-digit code; go back to Wix and enter the code; click Confirm. Note: If you are not receiving the SMS associated with your account's 2-step verification, please contact support.

title: I want to make a duplicate version in the dashboard of my site for testing and trying new things.
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Home on the left. Click the Site Actions icon. Click Duplicate Site. Enter a name for the duplicate site. Click Duplicate.

title: How can I connect Pay Now by Klarna through Wix Payments to accept EUR payments?
content: To connect Pay Now by Klarna through Wix Payments, go to the Accept Payments tab on your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Wix Payments. If Klarna through Wix Payments is available in your area, you will be automatically connected. If you already connected your Wix site to Klarna through a different provider, you can change it to Wix Payments. It is not possible to link an existing Klarna account to Wix Payments. Complete setup with Wix Payments in order to get payouts to your bank account.

title: How can I edit the social media image, title, and description for a product in my Wix Stores?
content:
To edit images, titles, and descriptions for a product in Wix Stores:
- Go to Products in your site's dashboard.
- Click the product you want to customize.
- Click Edit SEO Settings on the right.
- Click the Social Share tab.
- Edit the product image: hover over the image and select an option. To edit the existing image, click the Adjust icon to open the Photo Studio, edit the image, and click Save. To replace the image, click the Change icon, select an image, and click Add to Page.
- Edit the title by entering your title in the og:title field. By default, Wix uses your page's title tag.
- Edit the description by entering your description in the og:description field. By default, Wix uses your product's meta description.
- Click Twitter Settings to set a different image and text for Twitter shares: click the Change icon to select a different image, choose a card size under Select card size, add a title under twitter:title, and add a description under twitter:description.
- Click Save.
Tip: In some cases, Facebook might show outdated information about your product. Learn how to troubleshoot outdated info and images on Facebook.

title: How can I set default work hours for my business in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Default Hours in your site's dashboard. Select the checkboxes next to the days your business is open. Enter a start and end time for the first day. Optional: Add an additional time period for the same day by clicking the add hours icon and entering a start and end time. Repeat for all other work days. Click Save.

title: How can I add and set up a repeater in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click List. Click a template to add it or drag it to the relevant location on your site. To set up your repeater's content: select the repeater in your editor, click Manage Items, then do the following: click Duplicate Item to add more items to the list; click and drag items to re-order the list; hover over an item and click the More Actions icon to delete or duplicate it.

title: How can I withdraw my earnings from selling digital and print images in the Wix Art Store?
content: If you sell digital and print images, the images are sold through a third-party service, Order a Print and not through Wix. You can withdraw your earnings at any time on the Withdrawals tab of Wix Art Store, all you need is a PayPal account. It may take up to 5 days for your earnings to appear in your PayPal account after withdrawing them.

title: How can I get started with the rankingCoach SEO app for online marketing?
content: Check out the rankingCoach SEO app by rankingCoach to get started. For questions or comments, contact the rankingCoach GmbH team: support@rankingcoach.com; http://www.rankingcoach.com; +49 213 454-0549.

title: Can I customize the 'Special Requests' option for online orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently in Wix Restaurants, it is not possible to customize the 'Special Requests' option for online orders and give customers different guidelines for how they can make requests. You can, however, remove the option to make special requests from a specific dish. By hiding the special requests option, customers cannot ask for changes to the dish(es) you've specified. Learn how to hide special requests in Step 7 of this article.

title: How can I make my PDF and Word documents accessible for all site visitors?
content: As PDFs and Word documents are not Wix products, you need to adjust them on their respective platforms or programs. Learn how to make PDF files accessible and how to make your Word documents accessible. Then go back to the Accessibility Checklist to continue improving your site for accessibility.

title: How can I add my EU VAT ID when making a purchase on Wix to avoid being charged VAT?
content:
If you are a business in the EU and you have a registered, valid EU VAT ID, you can enter it on the purchase page and you will not be charged VAT.

To add your EU VAT ID:
1. Select your purchase from Wix and proceed to the checkout.
2. Enter your other payment and billing details.
3. Enter your VAT ID in the VAT ID field.

Tip: You can verify your VAT ID using the European Commission's VIES VAT validation tool.

4. Click Submit Purchase.

Note: The VAT information you enter applies to future invoices only (including your current purchase). While you can update your current invoices, some fields cannot be changed. For example, VAT ID and Country cannot be changed for current invoices which relate to previous purchases.

title: How can I connect my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar to Airbnb iCal?
content: In Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, go to Channel Manager and click Connect next to Airbnb iCal. Choose Send next to the relevant rooms you want to share with Airbnb iCal, click Next, and click Copy next to the relevant rooms. Then log in to your Airbnb account, click Calendar and select the listing calendar you want to change, click Availability, click Connect to another website under Connect calendars, paste the URLs from your external Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar into the Calendar address field, give the calendar a name, and click Save. Note: Airbnb iCal uses a one-way iCal integration; calendar availability syncs from Wix Hotels by HotelRunner to Airbnb iCal, but rates and reservations do not.

title: How can I add an anchor to an element in Editor X?
content: To add an anchor to an element in Editor X: Click the element you want to add an anchor to. Click the Anchor section in the Inspector on the right side of the Editor. Enable the Add an anchor toggle. Enter the anchor name. Note: It is not possible to add an anchor to Masters or elements attached to Masters.

title: How do I connect Evergreen Payments Northwest as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.

Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

Click See More Payment Options.

Click Connect next to Evergreen Payments Northwest.

Depending on whether you are creating a new Evergreen Payments Northwest account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

Have an account
- Enter your API Key.
- Click Connect.

Don't have an account
- Click Create Evergreen Payments Northwest account.
- Fill in the registration form and click Continue.
- Wait for an email from Evergreen Payments Northwest to get your API Key credentials.
- Return to the Accept Payments tab (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I save the addresses of customers that I deliver to regularly in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It's now possible to save the address of a specific customer that you deliver to regularly by adding a Members Area.

title: What happens if someone deletes a page I'm currently working on in Editor X?
content: You'll be automatically re-directed to the site's home page. You'll also see a notification at the bottom left corner of the Editor.

title: How can I add Wix Video to my site using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the App Panel icon on the top bar, type "Wix Video" in the search bar and select Wix Video from the drop-down menu, click Add to Site, then click OK. This adds a video widget where you can fully customize the settings to suit your needs.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual to translate Facebook ads for my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Facebook ads with Wix Multilingual. When creating a Facebook ads campaign for your Wix site, you can write the content of the ad caption and headline in whatever language you prefer, and this will be displayed to the viewer of the ad. For dynamic ads that display store products, product names and descriptions are synced from your Wix store based on the main language of your site. Translations using Wix Multilingual do not sync with your ad campaign. Viewers of the ad only see product names and descriptions in your site's main language.

title: What should I do if my Wix domain renewal payment fails and my domain expires?
content: If payment is not made by your domain subscription renewal date, most domain types enter a 30 day grace period. You can still reactivate your domain during this period for no additional fee. If payment is made successfully within the 30 day grace period, your domain name can usually be reactivated at no extra cost. After the grace period, your domain name is canceled and enters the redemption period, lasting approximately 30 days. The cost of retrieving a domain during the redemption period is $100. Wix strongly advises you to resolve payment issues before the domain enters the redemption period. If you are unsure why your payments have failed, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I set up gift cards on my Wix site?
content: To get started, go to Gift Card in your site's dashboard. You can get complete instructions on how to set up gift cards on your site.

title: Can I integrate Wix Restaurants with the Toast POS system?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Toast POS (Point of Sale) system. In the meantime, you can integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS using a webhook.

title: How do I set up Tap to Pay on my Android phone using Wix Mobile POS?
content:
Requirements: Tap to Pay is currently available only in the US, and Android requires Android 11 or later. Download the Wix app, then create and verify a Wix Payments account.

To set up Tap to Pay:
- Enable Tap to Pay in the dashboard: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, then click Accept or click the toggle next to Tap to Pay to enable it.
- Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Point of Sale under Getting Paid. Tap the Connect icon at the top right. Tap Activate Tap to Pay. Tap Activate.
- Make sure NFCs are enabled in your phone. Tip: Search for NFC in your settings and enable them.

title: How can I set up free video viewing for specific videos on my Wix site?
content:
To set up free viewing of specific videos on your Wix site:

- Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard.
- Click the checkbox next to each video you want to allow free viewing. Note: Click Select All to select every video in the list.
- Click Set Pricing.
- Click Free.
- Click the Viewer options drop-down and choose who can watch the selected videos:
  - Anyone can watch: Viewers are not required to sign up.
  - Sign up only: Viewers are required to sign up.
- Click the Download options drop-down and select an option:
  - Allow downloads: Viewers can download the video.
  - No downloads: Viewers are not able to download the video.
- Click Save.

Note:
- Videos you upload are set to free for viewing by default.
- You can only enable downloads for the videos that are owned by you. Viewers will not be able to download videos that you've uploaded from external websites like YouTube, Vimeo etc.

title: How can I add and set up tabs in the Wix Editor?
content:
Add tabs to your site: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Interactive. Click Tabs under Boxes. Click and drag your chosen tab design to add it to your page.

Give a name to each tab: Click the tabs in your editor. Click Manage Tabs. Hover over the relevant item in the panel. Click the More Actions icon. Click Rename. Enter the new name into the field. Click Done.

Add elements to your tab items: Click the tabs in your editor. Open the relevant tab item from the drop-down menu. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click and drag your chosen element over the tab. Drop the element when you see the Attach to Tab message.

What's next? Manage and customize your tab items to change their design, layout, and more.

title: How can I view my site's sitemap on Wix?
content: You can view your sitemap index by adding sitemap.xml to the end of your domain name in your browser's address bar. To see your other sitemaps, add the relevant URL path from the types of sitemaps table to the end of your domain name.

title: How can I add and customize navigation arrows in my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add and customize navigation arrows in your Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor:

- Go to your editor.
- Click the Pro Gallery element on your page.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Design** tab on the left.
- Click **Navigation Arrows**.
- Enable the **Show navigation arrows** toggle.
- Customize the arrows using the options:

  * **Arrow style:** Click to select an arrow design, or click the Add icon to upload your own.
  * **Arrow background:** Click the drop-down to select a Shadow, Box or no background.
    + **Shadow:** Adds a slight shadow around the arrow.
    + **Box:** Adds a box around the arrow. Click the color box to change the box color, and drag the relevant sliders to adjust its transparency and round its corners.
    + **None:** No background is added to the arrow.
  * **Arrows size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the navigation arrows.
  * **Arrows color:** Click the color box to select the navigation arrow color. Select a color from your site colors or choose your own.
  * **Arrows position:** Select the relevant checkbox to display navigation arrows on or outside the gallery. **Note:** Displaying navigation arrows on your gallery may cover part of your gallery items.
  * **Center arrows to:** Choose to center your arrows on either side of the gallery itself, its images or text. **Note:** To see this option, make sure you have chosen to display text underneath or above your gallery items. This option is currently unavailable in the Thumbnails and Slider layouts.
  * **Horizontal Padding:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of space between your arrows and the border of your gallery.

**Tip:** You can also enable navigation arrows in the Grid and Collage layouts, by setting the scroll direction to **horizontal** in the **Layout** tab.

You can enable navigation arrows in the Thumbnails, Slider, Slideshow and Column layouts. If you enabled the Expand Mode for your gallery, navigation arrows are automatically displayed, and you can customize their color from the Design Settings tab inside the Expand Mode by clicking the color box beside Icon color. Navigation arrows in the Expand Mode are only visible on desktop — not on mobile; site visitors must swipe left or right to navigate through the gallery on mobile.

title: How can I manage my menu items using the new Wix Menus app?
content: Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Click More Actions at the top right. Select Manage items. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant item. Choose what you want to do: select Duplicate to create a copy of your item, or select Delete item; once deleted, this item and its info will be removed from your menu and can’t be restored. Tip: Change tabs to view lists of all of your Variants and Modifiers.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings for my Wix portfolio?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Click Portfolio Projects or Portfolio Collections to customize the SEO settings of your project or collections pages. Then customize your SEO Settings. This applies the same SEO logic to all of your project and collections pages at the same time.

title: How can I change a collaborator's role?
content: To change a collaborator's role, go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant collaborator, then click Change Role. Select or deselect the relevant roles and click Save.

title: How can I ensure my business emails are not marked as spam when sending to Google or Yahoo accounts?
content: From February 2024, to comply with Google and Yahoo’s new spam regulations, business email users must set up SPF. If you send more than 5000 messages per day to Google or Yahoo personal email accounts, you must also set up DKIM and DMARC; for high-volume senders, email delivery may be affected if all 3 records are not added. SPF permits your mail server to send emails on behalf of your domain and helps prevent spammers from sending messages with a forged email address. DKIM verifies that your email was sent from a reliable, trustworthy source and was not modified in transit. For business emails purchased from Wix, follow Google Workspace instructions to add SPF or DKIM records; for mailboxes purchased elsewhere, contact your provider. Wix recommends a combination of SPF and DKIM for email authentication; if your organization sends more than 5000 emails per day, use DMARC in addition to SPF and DKIM.

title: How can I discard a test site in the Release Manager?
content: Go to the Release Manager. Click the Show More icon on the relevant test site. Click Discard. Click Discard in the pop-up window. You can discard a current test site if you no longer need it; once discarded, you can no longer publish that version and will need to create a new one.

title: How can I add a managed writer to a specific post in my Wix blog?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Blog and select the post you want to add a managed writer to. Click Settings on the left side of the post composer, scroll down and click the Author drop-down menu, then click +New Author. Enter a name under Author Name, optionally add a profile picture and title, click Add, and click Publish.

title: How can I delete a post in my Wix Forum as an admin?
content: On your live site, log into the forum using the email address associated with your Wix account. Click the Show More icon on a post. Click Delete Post. Click Delete to confirm.

title: How can I categorize my custom code on my website to comply with data privacy laws?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Advanced and click the Custom Code tab. Click + Add Custom Code at the top right. Add your custom code. Click the Code Type tab. Select the category that best describes your code's purpose. Click Apply. Categories include Essential, Marketing, Analytic, or Functional. Custom codes are categorized as essential by default; if your code can be more accurately described as Marketing, Analytic, or Functional, it is your responsibility to classify it as such. Correct categorization helps your site comply with data privacy laws such as the GDPR and the LGPD, which require that visitors can decline the use of non-essential cookies while using your site.

title: Can I grant permission to someone to edit and manage specific online programs?
content: You can grant people permission to edit and manage specific online programs.

title: Why can't my customers apply a coupon code during the Wix Events checkout process?
content:
If customers can see the Enter Coupon Code field but cannot apply the coupon, check the following:

- The coupon was created for the Wix Events app and is set to apply to a specific ticket, a specific event, or all tickets. Go to the Coupons tab in your site's dashboard, select the coupon, check the Apply to drop-down, and if necessary select a different option and click Save.
- The coupon was entered correctly, because coupon codes are case sensitive. Make sure the customer used the correct upper and lowercase letters.
- The coupon has not been restricted to a specific event or ticket type. If it is restricted, customers cannot enter it for a different ticket or event. Check the Apply to drop-down and adjust if necessary.
- The coupon has not expired. Check the dates in the Valid between section, and if necessary change the end date or select Don't set an end date and save.
- The coupon does not have a limited number of uses. Check the info in the Limit uses section, and if necessary increase the limit or select Unlimited and save.

Also note that the coupon field is only available during the Add Your Details stage of the Checkout process, and it only appears if you've already created coupons for your event. Customers cannot apply coupons from the Wix app, but they can apply them from the mobile version of your site.

title: How can I troubleshoot issues with Google Analytics on my Wix site?
content:
If you're experiencing issues using Google Analytics on your Wix site, try the following troubleshooting steps:

1. Make sure your domain is connected to Wix correctly. You can check your domain connection using Wix Domain Assistant.
2. Make sure the property ID is correctly formatted. You can track information in Google Analytics about your site visitors using a Google Analytics 4 (GA4) property (G-XXXXXXXXXX). If you're not sure if your property ID is correctly formatted, follow the steps to get your Google Analytics property ID and check the format. Note: From July 1, 2023, Universal Analytics (UA) properties will stop collecting data. If you previously connected a UA property to your site, you should upgrade to a Google Analytics 4 (GA4) property.
3. Make sure you haven't added the HTML element. Check to make sure you haven't added Google Analytics using the HTML tool.
4. Make sure you haven't added Google Analytics multiple times. Check that you haven't added Google Analytics to both Google Tag Manager and Marketing Integrations. If you've added it in multiple locations, remove it from one of the locations to allow Google Analytics to work properly.
5. Use DebugView to check your Google Analytics connection. After adding your Google Analytics (GA4) tracking code to your Wix site, it may take some time before you see statistics in your Google Analytics account. If you are no longer receiving data in Google Analytics, you can use Google's DebugView to troubleshoot connection issues. DebugView shows you the events that Analytics collects in real time.
6. Check if you have a cookie banner on your site. When you add the cookie banner to your site, it automatically disables the usage of non-essential cookies and scripts until your visitor provides consent. As a result, Google Analytics will only collect information after a visitor approves using the relevant cookies.

Note about Google Analytics and cookie banners: Using a cookie banner on your site can reduce the site traffic recorded by GA4. This is because some visitors might not give their consent to be tracked. For this reason, it is normal if you see a drop in your Google Analytics numbers. Due to recent regulations that apply to Google, if you don't have a cookie banner on your site and a site visitor comes from a country that requires consent (e.g. those covered by GDPR) no data is sent to Google Analytics. Google only tracks sessions when visitors give explicit consent. As you know your target audience best, use this information to make an informed decision about whether to add a cookie banner.

title: How can I get started with Wix Retail POS for my brick and mortar business?
content:
To get started with Wix Retail POS for a brick-and-mortar business:

- Create your Wix Payments account. To process payments, you need to get verified by Wix Payments for a POS account, and your business type must be supported.
- Purchase POS hardware from the POS hardware shop. The POS software is already installed and connects to your site when you log in to your Wix account.
- When your order arrives, unbox and connect the tablet to the rest of the hardware you selected, then make your first sale.
- Log in to your Wix account to access your full Wix catalog on your tablet.
- Upgrade to a Retail POS plan to accept card payment and access advanced features.

Note: Wix Retail POS is currently available for businesses located in the US and Canada, and payment processing at Wix POS is done through Wix Payments.

title: How can I use the POSTA app by TORAB to create ESTAFETA shipping labels for my online store?
content: With the POSTA app by TORAB, you can create ESTAFETA shipping labels for your online store. Before using the app on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. The app is available only in Spanish and only for Mexico. Features include integrating your ESTAFETA account with your site, creating shipping labels for your orders to save time and avoid losses, sending your customers their tracking number, and getting dedicated technical support. To get started, check out the POSTA app by TORAB; for questions or comments, contact TORAB directly using the website or email listed in the source.

title: How can I create a form using the new Wix Forms in Editor X?
content:
To create a form with the new Wix Forms in Editor X:

- Click Add Elements at the top of Editor X.
- Click Contact & Forms.
- Click Create New Form.
- In the form builder, click the Edit icon at the top left to name your form. The form name is only visible to you.
- Choose form fields under Add form fields. Field types include:
  - Contact fields: Add fields that collect and store personal data in Wix Contacts.
  - General fields: Add elements like multi choice, checkboxes, drop-downs, and answer boxes.
  - Layout elements: Add a header or text element to organize your form or further explain a field.
- Optional: Click a field to customize it further, including updating the field settings, making it a required field, or resizing the field to make a form with multiple columns.
- Optional: Click Rules or Pages at the left to add conditional rules or multiple pages to your form. Rules can determine if another field is shown, hidden, required, or optional. Pages keep questions organized. Make sure you add a Submit field to each page so visitors can navigate through the pages by clicking 'Next.'
- When ready, click Save at the top right.

Important: Make sure you add a Submit field to the bottom of your form. If you do not have a submit button, visitors have no way to send the form to you.

title: How can I invite collaborators to edit a site in Wix Studio?
content:
To invite people to your site team in Wix Studio:

- Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left.
- Hover over **Site**.
- Hover over **Team Work**.
- Click **Invite People to Collaborate**.
- Enter the email address of the person you want to invite.
- Select the checkbox next to the role(s) you want to assign to this person.

  **Tip:** You can create custom roles for people, where you handpick the permissions.
- Click **Send Invite**.

**Note:**
- Wix Studio sites have 5 free collaborator seats as standard. To get more collaborator seats, you will need to upgrade your site.
- If you already have more collaborators than your plan allows, they can remain as collaborators. However, you will not be able to invite new collaborators until you upgrade your site.
- Keep track of how many collaborator seats you have filled with the progress bar on the Roles & Permissions page of your dashboard's Settings.

The person you invited gets an email, from which they can accept and join the site.

title: How do I indicate whether I sell restricted products or services when setting up payment methods?
content:
When setting up your payment methods, you need to indicate whether you sell or do not sell any restricted products or services:

- Click **I'm not selling anything on the list** if you are not selling any items which may be restricted by your payment provider. Be sure to check with your provider's terms of service to be sure of what products they allow. For Wix Payments users, please check the Wix Payments restricted and prohibited products and services list.

- If you click **I am selling products & services on the list**, the available payment provider options will be adjusted according to the chosen category.

title: How can I automatically generate invoices for online paid orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Go to Checkout Settings in your site's dashboard. Enable the Automatically create invoices for every new order paid online toggle under Payments. Note: If you issue a partial or complete refund on an order, the invoice doesn't update to reflect the refund amount. Invoices are only created for orders paid online through your site (not with the manual payment method) and orders you haven't yet manually created an invoice.

title: How can I disable the reading time stamp on my Wix blog posts?
content: In your Editor, click the Wix Blog app, click Settings, click the Display tab, and deselect the Date and reading time checkbox. Note: It is not possible to remove the reading time without removing the date.

title: How can I use PayPal to purchase a Premium or Studio plan on Wix?
content: Go to the Upgrade page. If you have multiple sites, select the site you want to upgrade. Click Select under the plan you want to purchase, choose your subscription cycle, and click Select again. Click Buy Now. Select PayPal from the list of options in the Wix checkout. Fill in your invoice details in the form below the PayPal option, then click Continue to PayPal. This brings you to the PayPal website to log into your PayPal account. If you do not have a PayPal account, you can choose to set one up at this point. In your PayPal account, choose a card to pay with, then click Agree and Pay Now. You will then be brought back to your Wix account and a message will appear confirming your payment. Important: You cannot update your PayPal account preferences from the Wix checkout. You must go to PayPal to update your PayPal preferences, e.g., to choose a different preferred payment method. If you have a declined charge on a subscription that you originally paid for with PayPal, you must use the card payment option within your account to pay the amount due. Note: This feature is not yet available in all regions.

title: Can I use different document files for each language on my Wix site using the CMS?
content: Currently, with the CMS (Content Management System) and Wix Multilingual, it is not possible to use different document files for each of your site's languages. This refers to the Document and Multi-Document field types in CMS collections.

title: I want to know how to set up a table and connect it to my collection in Wix Studio.
content:
Before you begin, add and set up the content collection you want to display in the table.

To add and set up a table:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Layout Tools.
- Click Tables.
- Drag the design you like onto your page.
- Connect the table to a content collection: click the Connect to CMS icon, then choose the dataset you want to display in the table in the Inspector.
- Click Manage Table and set up the table columns:
  - Reorder: Click the Reorder icon next to the relevant column and drag it up or down into place.
  - Change column name: Hover over the relevant column, click the More Actions icon, and select Edit label. Enter the new name and click Done.
  - Delete column: Hover over the relevant column, click the More Actions icon, and select Delete.
  - Manage Connections: Click Manage Connections to change any of the CMS connections. Then click the relevant drop-downs under Connections in the Inspector panel to edit the connections and links.

title: How can I add a link to an image in my Wix Blog post?
content:
To add a link to an image in your Wix Blog post:
- Add a new image: Click the Add icon, click the Image icon, then choose to upload media or select one from stock images.
- Edit an existing image: Click the relevant image in your post, then click the Link icon.
- Copy the URL of the link you want to add and paste it into the link box.
- Select the relevant checkboxes to choose how the link behaves: Link opens in a new tab; Noreferrer; Nofollow; Sponsored.

title: Is it possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Clover POS system?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Clover POS (Point of Sale) system. In the meantime, you can integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS using a webhook.

title: How can I display shared folders on multiple pages of my Wix site using the Wix File Share app?
content:
Before you begin: add the Wix File Share app to your site. Then add the Shared Folder app as an "Add-On". Both apps work together to enable you to share your files/folders on multiple site pages.

To add the app: click the File Share app in your editor, click Settings, click Add-Ons, click Choose Add-On, then click the Add to Page drop-down and select the page you want to add the app to.

To choose a folder to display: click the Shared Folder app in your editor, click Settings, click Select Folder, then select an existing folder or click + New Folder.

To customize what is displayed: click the Shared Folder app in your editor, click Settings, click the Display tab, select the checkboxes next to the elements you want to display, and use the Sort folder items by drop-down to choose Last updated, Item name A-Z, Item name Z-A, Most views, Most favorites, Item type, or Item size. Choose an alignment for the display: Left or Right.

To customize the design: click the Shared Folder app in your editor, click Settings, click the Design tab, then customize Icons, Style & Color; Buttons & Actions; or Table & Background.

Publish your site to view the changes.

title: How do I connect my Wix Restaurant to Square POS?
content:
Before you begin, make sure to connect Square as your payment provider. Connecting other payment providers will result in an additional processing fee.

To connect your POS:
- Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click POS Integration.
- Click Square under Point of Sale.
- Click Add to Site and then again to confirm.
- Review permissions and click Add to Site.
- Click Connect.
- Enter your Square credentials and click Sign In.
- Click Set up integration by the Wix Restaurant you want to connect.
- Click the Location drop-down and select the Square POS location you want to sync with.
- Click Save.

title: How can I manually crop an image in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the image in the Editor. Click the Crop icon. Crop your image by doing the following: drag the crop handles to select the part of the image that you want to crop; move the crop window over the exact area you want to crop; drag the slider to zoom the image in and out, or enter a percentage value in the text field. Click Apply.

title: Can I adjust the chatbox's look and settings for different breakpoints in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the customizations you make to the chatbox automatically apply to all breakpoints. It is not possible to adjust the chatbox's look and settings per breakpoint.

title: How can I create an online event using Wix Events?
content:
Decide where you'd like to host your online event. Then, in your site's dashboard:
- Go to Events.
- Click + Add Event.
- Select a type of event: Ticketed Event or RSVP Event. This selection can't be changed after you click Create Draft.
- Enter the General Info.
- Enter the Date and time. For online events, we recommend displaying your time zone.
- Select a location:
  - For an online only event, click Online and enter an Online Location Title.
  - For a hybrid event, click Physical Location, start typing the address of the location and select it from the list, and optionally enter a Venue Name.
- Click Create Draft.
- When you've finished adding other customizations, publish your event.

title: What is the character limit for email marketing campaigns, and how can I ensure my emails are not marked as spam?
content: Your email campaign does not have a character limit, however short and sweet is usually the way to go. Email campaigns with extensive amounts of text are more likely to be marked as spam by your subscribers. Tip: Unless you are sending your subscribers a blog post or a message that relies on text, it is preferable to stick to 1 to 3 paragraphs.

title: How can I customize the advanced settings of my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor, click Settings, and click the Advanced tab. Then customize the advanced settings using the available options. The Advanced tab includes options such as Play Videos (On Hover, Autoplay, On click), Play with Sound (Enabled, Disabled), Playback Speed, Loop Video, Show play button, Gallery direction, Image Quality, Image Sharpening, Convert images to WebP, Automatically resize images, and Lightroom Integration.

title: Can I upload XML files in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, uploading XML files is not supported. CSV files can be uploaded to import products in Wix Stores.

title: How can I connect payabl. as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to payabl.

If you have an account: enter your Merchant ID, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account: click Create payabl. account, register for a payabl. merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add a wireframe or pre-designed section in the Studio Editor?
content: Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor. Click Sections / Wireframes. Click a category to see the available designs. Drag a section onto the page. Customize the section to your needs: click elements to customize their content, change the background, and replace images and text with your own.

title: Is it possible to set multiple check-in times or specific arrival time slots for events in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set multiple check-in times or specific arrival time slots for events. As a possible workaround, you can create separate ticket types for different time slots (e.g. A 3:00 ticket, a 3:30 ticket, etc.).

title: How can I customize the social share settings for my site's pages on Wix?
content: To customize a page's Social Share settings on Wix, go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Tools and settings and click Go to SEO Settings under SEO Settings. Select the page type you want to edit. You will only see options for the pages that are part of your site; for example, if you added Wix Stores, you can customize settings for Products. Click Edit next to Basics & social share. Scroll down to Social share and customize og:title, og:description, and og:image. You can use static text to apply the same title and description to every page, or use variables to create rules to use different values for each section or page. If you prefer the same image for all your pages, add an image URL. Click Get an Image URL from Site Files to copy the URL of a site media file; hover over an image, click the More Actions icon, and select Copy URL. Click Save. Note that each social media channel uses its own criteria to choose the title, description, and image, so the Social Share settings may not always be used.

title: When I restore a deleted site, are the automations restored automatically?
content: Currently, when you restore a previously deleted site, your automations are not automatically restored with it. You will need to create your automations again.

title: Can I customize the sender details for the email notifications participants receive from my Online Program?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the sender details for your Online Program notifications. The email notifications participants receive from your programs are always sent from notifications@challenges.wix.com. It is possible to customize the notifications, including their titles, messages, and buttons.

title: Can I link an image to each product variant in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is possible to link separate images to all the choices connected to one product option (e.g. green, blue). It is not possible to link to every variant when you have more than one type of product option (e.g. green and long, green and short, blue and long, blue and short).

title: How do the environments and APIs for building apps on Wix differ?
content:
Wix offers 2 environments for building apps: the Wix CLI and Blocks. You can use the Wix CLI for app development as an alternative to the Wix Developers Center or by integrating it into your existing Developers Center app; it supports React-based frameworks and provides tools to create apps with minimal configuration. Blocks lets you design and build reusable full-stack applications and UI components, and provides deployment and release flows, backend logic, and databases without server maintenance, along with layout and design tools for widgets and pages.

Wix offers 3 APIs for building apps: the REST API, the JavaScript SDK, and Velo. The REST API allows you to access and manage Wix business solutions from any platform. The JavaScript SDK provides functionality that enables you to access and manage Wix business solutions from JavaScript applications. Velo by Wix is a JavaScript library that allows you to write both frontend and backend code for Blocks apps. You can build apps with the Wix CLI using the JavaScript SDK and REST. You can build apps with Blocks using Velo.

title: How can I change the currency in my Wix Art Store when selling both digital and print items?
content:
To change your currency when selling digital and prints in your Wix Art Store: go to your site's dashboard, click the Art Store tab on the left, click the Store Info tab, scroll down to Location Settings, click the Currency drop-down and select your currency, then click Save at the bottom of the page.

Note: Changing your currency switches the currency symbol, but does not convert your prices.

The following currencies are supported in your Wix Art Store: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, HKD, HUF, ILS, JPY, MXN, NOK, NZD, PHP, PLN, RUB, SEK, SGD, THB, TWD, USD.

title: How can I add and set up the Table Master app on my Wix site?
content:
Before you begin, your spreadsheet needs to be published before you can upload it.

To add the Table Master app:
- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Table Master app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**. The app is not yet available for the Studio Editor.

To enter table data:
- Select your table in your editor.
- Click **Settings**, then the **Data** tab.
- Add data manually or upload a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
- To add data manually: select **Insert data manually** under **Data Source**, click **Manage Data**, add your data, and click **Save & Close**.
- To upload a Google Sheets spreadsheet: select **Google Spreadsheet URL** under **Data Source**, add your Google Sheet's URL under **Spreadsheet URL**, and click **Submit**.

To customize layout and display:
- Click the **Layout** tab.
- Use the **Column limit** toggle. When enabled, set the number under **Maximum columns to show**; when disabled, there is no limit on displayed columns.
- Select table height under **Table height**: **Fixed size with scroll** or **Fit to content**.
- Select mobile behavior under **Mobile layout**: **Expand** or **Scroll**.
- Click the **Display** tab.
- Use **Show header & footer**, **Show search**, **Search text**, and **Allow sorting** toggles as needed. When sorting is enabled, visitors can click a column to sort in ascending or descending alphabetical or numerical order.

To customize text and colors:
- Click the **Design** tab.
- Click **Background color**, choose a color under **Primary color**, and use the **Use gradient** toggle if desired. If using a gradient, select a second color beside **Secondary color**.
- Set border color, border width, and corner radius under **Outer Border**.
- Click **Back**, then **Table**, then **Text** under **Columns** or **Rows** to customize fonts.
- Under **Rows**, set background colors for rows, including odd and even rows and a hover background color.
- Under **Inner Border**, select a color and width.
- Publish your site to see changes live.

You can also search the Wix App Market for additional table apps or create a table using Velo by Wix.

title: Can I use Braintree to accept recurring payments on my site?
content: You can accept recurring payments from your customers using the following payment providers, if they're available in your region: Wix Payments (for all payment methods except for Klarna Online Bank Transfer), Wix Payments Brazil, Stripe, PayPal, Isracard, Bankful, KOMOJU, Priority Payments, and Evergreen Payments Northwest. Currently, it is not possible to accept recurring payments with providers that are not listed above (e.g. Braintree, Square...etc).

title: I'm experiencing an issue with a strangely large space between the footer and the bottom of the page that cannot be fixed.
content:
To resolve a gap below the footer on the live site in Wix, the source lists these options:
- Change the page background color to match the footer.
- Add content to your page so it is longer. Note that a gap may still appear on larger viewports, and a vertical scrollbar can appear on smaller viewports.
- Resize the footer to make it longer.
- Use the Layers Panel to find, delete, or reposition hidden elements that may be causing the gap.

For a gap between the page content and the footer, you can also adjust the page height by clicking and dragging the Adjust Page Height icon. If your page is covered in strips, click and pull the footer down in order to click the main part of the page.

title: How can I share a link to my Booking Page using Dayful by Wix?
content:
To share a link to your Booking page using Dayful by Wix, follow these steps:

Go to Booking Page in your Dayful dashboard.
Choose what you want to do:
* Click **Copy** under Share Your Services at the top to copy the full link.
* Click **Share** under Share Your Services at the top.
* Click one of the social media app icons to share a link directly to that relevant platform.
Click **Done**.

title: How can I access and manage my photo albums on Wix?
content: You can view and manage all of your photo albums at any time from the My Albums tab on your site's dashboard. While editing your site, you can also click the Photo Albums app and click Manage Albums.

title: How can I invite new members to a site on the Spaces App?
content:
To invite new members to a site on the Spaces App:

- Go to the relevant site on the Spaces App.
- Tap **Invite**.
- Select an option:
  - **Send an SMS**: Tap **Send and SMS**. Choose if you want to allow the Spaces App to access your contacts. Select the contacts you want to invite. Tap **Next**. Send the SMS.
  - **Share via Social & More**: Tap **Share via Social & More**. Choose how you want to send your invite to. For example, Facebook, Whatsapp, Gmail and more.
  - **Copy Link**: Tap **Copy Link**. Paste the link into a new message using the application of your choice.

Note: Some sites might not have the invite option.

title: how do I delete a page from my Wix site when delete is not an option
content: In the Wix Editor, click 'Pages & Menu,' hover over the relevant page, click the 'More Actions' icon, and choose 'Delete.' Then click 'Delete' in the pop-up notification. If a page is linked to a Wix app (e.g., Blog, Stores, etc.), deleting the page also removes the app. To delete pages associated with Wix apps (e.g., Wix Stores, Wix Events, Wix Blog), you must delete the apps themselves to remove their pages.

title: How can I ensure explicit consent for email marketing on my Wix site?
content: To request explicit consent before sending marketing materials, you can add a checkbox next to your 'Subscribe' button, obliging site visitors to check the box and confirm consent before subscribing. With Wix Forms, you can add an opt-in checkbox to your form. With Get Subscribers, you can add a checkbox to get explicit consent from site visitors, and you can also link your privacy policy or your terms and conditions policy. It is your responsibility to ensure that Wix services are permitted and abide by your local laws. The information is not legal advice, and you should seek legal advice to understand and prepare for possible additional requirements.

title: Can you now add running text (otherwise known as text marquee) to your clients' sites?
content: Yes, you can now add running text (otherwise known as text marquee) to your clients' sites.

title: How can I add a 'coming soon' page to my site using ADI?
content: To add a coming soon page: Click the header. Click the Show / Hide icon next to Site Menu. Hover over Add at the top of ADI. Click Section to Page. Click Text on the left and select a text section to add to your site. Click the Title / Subtitle fields on the left and type your message. Note: If necessary, click the Show / Hide icon next to the relevant text to make it visible. Tip: Customize your section design to give it a new look and feel.

title: Can I moderate comments on my Wix blog by accepting or rejecting them before they are published?
content: Currently, all comments that are made by your visitors are published instantly. It is not possible for blog owners to moderate comments by accepting or rejecting certain comments.

title: How can I set the minimum and maximum number of nights for guests in Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Hotels tab on the left. Click Settings. Scroll down to the Length of Stay section. Enter the minimum number of nights your guests can stay under Min Nights. Enter the maximum number of nights your guests can stay (up to 365 nights) under Max Nights. Click Save. You can also set the minimum and maximum nights for periods when seasonal rates apply. For Channel Manager users, minimum stay rules are synced with the Channel Manager while maximum stay rules are not.

title: How can I deactivate a shipping rule in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Shipping & fulfillment in your site's dashboard. Click the toggle next to the relevant country to deactivate the shipping rule.

title: How can I set permission levels for my live streaming event page on Wix?
content:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have set up a live stream page as described in Step 1.

To set permission levels for your live streaming event page on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Select your live streaming page.
3. Click the Show More icon.
4. (Optional) Click **Hide** to hide the page from your site's menu.
5. Click **Settings**.
6. Click the **Permissions** tab.
7. Select one of the following options under **Who can view this page?**:
   * **Everyone**: The page is public and open to all visitors.
   * **Password Holders**: Only people who have the password can view this page.
     **Tip:** If you select this option, make sure to send the password to registered guests.
   * **Members Only**: Site visitors who try to access this page are prompted to sign up and log in.
     **Note:** To use this option, be sure to add a Member's area to your site.
8. Click **Done**.

title: What happens when a user reaches the email sending limits in Google Workspace?
content: Google Workspace limits the amount of mail a user can send to keep the systems healthy and accounts safe. The limits restrict the number of messages sent per day and the number of recipients per message. After reaching one of these limits, a user cannot send new messages but can still access his or her account to receive incoming email.

title: How can I take a screenshot on my mobile device?
content: Follow the device-specific instructions for Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows Phone, and Blackberry.

title: How can I edit the cover information of my Wix photo album?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Album next to the relevant album. Click Edit at the top right. Click Media on the left. Hover over the album cover and click Change Photo. Upload the relevant image. Click Text, then click the Cover tab. Edit your cover information: use Album title to add or change the album title; use Button text to add or change the button text; use More info: click the toggle to add additional information such as a wedding date or venue name; use Business info: click the toggle to add a business name or logo. The logo should be 300 x 100 px, and PNG format is recommended. You can also click Design, then Layouts, then the Cover tab to select a cover layout; click Back to design; click Colors, then the Cover tab to customize text and background colors. Click Publish Now at the top right. Changes are saved automatically, but you need to click Publish Now to see changes on your live site. The album name you choose is part of your photo album URL.

title: How do I add the Colorado Retail Delivery Fee app to my Wix site?
content: Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor; in Editor X, click App Market at the top of Editor X. Start typing "Colorado Retail Delivery Fee" in the search bar and select it from the results. Click Add to Site, review the permissions, and click Add to Site again. The app requires no setup; once added, the fee is automatically added to relevant orders.

title: How can I set up an automated email to recover abandoned carts in Wix Stores?
content: Click +New Automation and select Email visitors to recover abandoned carts. The email automatically displays one of the items they abandoned.

title: How can I restrict access to my Wix store pages using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Choose the page you want to restrict. For a Category Page or Shop Page, click Store Pages, then click Category Page or Shop. For a site page with a Product Gallery, click Site Menu, then click the page with the Product Gallery you want to restrict. Click the Settings or More Actions icon on the page. For Gallery Pages only, click Settings. Click the Permissions tab. Set a permission level: Password holders — enter the password; Members only — select Members only, then choose which members can access the page: All members, or Only selected members or paying customers. For selected members, click the Edit icon to select from your Member Roles. To allow membership plan holders access, select a pricing plan you created or click Create a Plan to add the Pricing Plans app and create your membership plan or package.

title: Can I change the cover image of my program's videos?
content: You can now change the cover image of your program's videos with a new advanced video step.

title: How can I start building a free website with Wix and what features are available?
content: With Wix, you can start building a free website using the Wix website builder. The source lists these available features: professionally designed, free templates that you can view; design features and a rich library of free visual content, including custom color palettes, transparent videos, and vector art; a site dashboard with tools such as email marketing, SEO tools, and a client management system; free hosting with 500MB storage and 1GB bandwidth; access to hundreds of free apps in the Wix App Market; automatic mobile optimization; the Wix mobile app; and an extensive Help Center with thousands of articles plus Customer Care experts for support.

title: How can I resolve a paper jam issue with my HP Terminal Receipt Printer on Wix Retail POS?
content: To clear jammed paper, disconnect the printer from the tablet to turn it off. Rotate the top cover counterclockwise to open it. Open the paper compartment. Clear and reload the paper. Close the paper compartment and turn the top cover clockwise. Connect the printer to the tablet to turn it back on.

title: Is it possible to migrate loyalty points from the Smile app to the Wix Loyalty Program?
content: Yes, you can migrate loyalty points from the Smile: Points & Rewards app to the Wix Loyalty Program.

title: Can I download an SVG logo file with a background color from Wix?
content: Currently, all SVG logo files come with a transparent background by default. If you want to use a logo file with your chosen background color, you can use one of the PNG files that come in your downloaded ZIP file. Keep in mind that PNG files may lose quality if you resize them.

title: How can I create a custom app in Wix Studio using Wix Blocks?
content: In Wix Studio, go to Custom Apps in your workspace. Click + Create New App at the top right. Choose how to create your app: from a blocks template or a blank canvas, or explore other frameworks (CLI and Self-Hosted). Build your app by adding widgets, elements, code and more. Once you've clicked Build within Blocks and added your app's name and description, it will be listed in the Custom Apps tab in your Wix Studio workspace.

title: Can I add social share icons for LinkedIn and Instagram to my email marketing campaigns?
content: You can add social share icons to the footer of your email campaigns. This allows your subscribers to share it to their Facebook, Twitter and Pinterest accounts and now other social media networks like LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Is it possible to integrate make.com with Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate make.com with Wix. A native integration with make.com would mean that you could connect other third-party platforms to Wix, with no code required.

title: What are the security guidelines for using Wix Retail POS devices?
content:
Follow these guidelines:

- Use the POS devices as “blackbox” devices, only for communication with your Wix online business and processing credit cards.
- Do not use Wix POS tablets to surf the internet, use direct messaging applications, or transfer data.
- Do not install any applications on the device, especially from unknown sources, unless directed to do so by Wix. Do not install apps through the Google Play.
- Do not try to root the device.
- Do not enable developer mode on the device.
- Do not change any configuration on the device that may lower its security or change its accessibility settings.
- Physically protect all Wix POS devices (tablet, terminal, printer, etc.) at all times. Do not allow unauthorized persons access to the devices.
- Do not connect any external devices to the Wix POS devices via cable, USB, wireless connection, or any other method.
- Do not connect the Wix POS devices to any computer or server via USB or wireless connection.
- Do not allow any unauthorized person to remove or swap the terminals, and ensure that the terminal is secured at all times.
- After you finish using your Wix POS devices, store them securely in a way that is inaccessible to unauthorized persons.
- Do not connect the Wix POS devices to any unknown, public, or unsecured networks or internet connections.
- Do not share your Internet connection with customers (i.e. Guest WIFI). Make sure your internet solution is utilized exclusively for POS use.
- Make sure the Internet and network that the Wix POS devices use has host isolation in place, denying any communication between devices in it.

title: How can I transfer a free Wix site to another account, and what should I be aware of before doing so?
content:
To transfer a free site to another Wix account, go to your site's dashboard, click the Site Actions icon at the top of the page, and select Transfer site. Enter the recipient's email address and, if necessary, choose whether the recipient is a client, agency or freelancer, or someone else. If the person you're transferring to does not yet have an account, they'll be prompted to create one when accepting the transfer. Click Continue. Optionally, select the checkbox next to the relevant options: Keep my role as Co-Owner of this site after the transfer (you become a collaborator on the site with the Admin (Co-Owner) role, which the new site owner can remove at any time), and Create a copy of this site and keep it in my account. Click Continue, confirm that the site transfer details are correct, click Transfer Ownership, and then click Got it.

Before you begin:
- Once you transfer the site, the site ownership is transferred and all future subscription payments are managed by the new owner.
- You can choose to simply add someone as a collaborator instead of transferring ownership — see Roles and Permissions.
- A free site's URL is in the form of siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress. The site prefix is specific to your account, so when you transfer the site to another account the site's URL will also change.

Note: The recipient has 3 days to accept the invite. If they accept, you will receive an email once the transfer is complete. You can track and manage your transfers in Roles and Permissions.

title: How can I create an album using Wix Music and set it up for downloads or sales?
content:
To create an album using Wix Music:
- Go to My Music in your site's dashboard.
- Click + Add Music.
- Click Create Album.
- Enter the Album Info details: Album Cover by clicking Add Image and selecting your cover image, Album Name, Album Version, Artist Name, Genre, and Album Description.
- Enter the Sale and Download Options on Your Site details: choose an Album Download Options setting such as Sell for a fixed price, Free download, No downloads, Let fans name their price with a minimum price, or Require email for download. Select a Currency, enter the Album Price, and optionally add a Bonus Item by clicking Add an Item.
- If needed, enter Links to Other Music Platforms by enabling the toggle, selecting the relevant platform, and pasting the link.
- Click Save & Add Tracks.
Once the album is created, you can add your tracks to it.

title: Can I customize the dish title design in mobile view using the Wix Restaurants Menus app?
content: Yes. It is now possible to edit the way the name of restaurant dishes displays on mobile devices. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app.

title: How can I add and set up a currency converter in my Wix Store using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add and set up a currency converter in your Wix Store using the Wix Editor:

- Go to your editor.
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Store**.
- Click **Currency Converter**.
- Drag the converter onto your page.
- Click the currency converter in the Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Add the currencies you want to display:
  - Click the **Currencies** tab.
  - Click **+Add Currency**.
  - Select the checkbox next to the relevant currencies.
  - Click **Save**.
- Click **Design** and customize the converter's design settings:
  - Select a background color and adjust the opacity.
  - Select a border color and adjust the opacity and width.
  - Select the text font and color.

Note: The currency converter is available with the Business or the Business Elite premium plans. Currency rates are provided by XE. By clicking "Add Currencies" you agree to XE's Terms of Use.

title: Can I add an attachment to the confirmation email sent to guests in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add an attachment to the confirmation email sent to guests. As a workaround, it is possible to create an automated email that is sent whenever an action happens (e.g. whenever a visitor RSVPs for an event). While editing your automation, you can add a button and link it to a document.

title: How can I mark an appointment as paid in the Wix app if a client pays in cash?
content: To mark an appointment as paid in the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Booking Calendar. Tap the relevant appointment. Tap Collect Payment at the bottom of the screen. Tap Mark as Paid. Note: You cannot undo this action.

title: Can I add a Range Slider in the Studio Editor to filter items based on a Number field value?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to add a Range Slider input element. A Range Slider would let visitors drag to filter items that have a Number field value within a specified range, so only items within the selected range would appear in the connected repeater, gallery, or table. You can, however, add a Range Slider in the Wix Editor.

title: How can I contact Google Workspace support for questions about my Google Workspace business emails that are unrelated to billing, adding new users, or transferring my account away from Wix?
content: If you have questions about your Google Workspace business emails that are unrelated to billing, adding new users, or transferring your account away from Wix, contact Google Workspace Support. Sign in to your Google Workspace Admin console, click the Support icon in the top right corner of the page, click Contact Support at the bottom of the pop-up window, click contact Google support at the bottom, and follow Google's directions to contact Google Workspace support.

title: How can I enable or disable the Quick View feature in my Wix Store's product gallery?
content: In your editor, click the relevant Product Gallery or the Category Page. Click the Settings icon. Click the Display tab. Click the checkbox next to Quick View button to enable or disable it. Important: If the Add to Cart button is enabled and placed on top of the product image, the Quick View button won't be displayed. To customize the Add to Cart button placement, go to the Layout tab.

title: How can I apply to become a Wix Partner and what are the benefits at each program level?
content:
To apply to become a Wix Partner, if you're the workspace owner, click **Become a Partner** on the top left of your Wix Studio workspace and enter your agency's details. Your request to join the program will be reviewed within the next business day. Learn more about earning points in the Wix Partner Program.

title: How can I access Wix Forum analytics reports and switch chart types?
content: Go to Analytics & Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll to the Forum Reports section, then select the report you'd like to view. To switch chart types within a report, click the relevant tab at the top of the report to access different chart types: Bar Chart, Table, or Line Chart.

title: How can I enable and customize a cookie banner on my Wix site?
content:
To enable the cookie banner, go to Privacy & Cookies in your site's dashboard. Click Get Started next to Display a cookie consent banner, then enable the Display Cookie Banner on Site toggle. Optionally, click Save & Publish to display the default banner on your site.

To customize the banner, under Text & Display Settings you can change the Banner Color Theme from light to dark by selecting the relevant checkbox, or customize the banner's colors to match your site. If customizing, you can customize the Button Style with a choice of square, round or rounded corner buttons, and customize the text font as well as the font size. You can also edit the texts on your buttons and links, including Consent Button Text, Setting Button Text, and Privacy Policy Link Text. You can add a Decline All button by clicking the checkbox; this allows visitors to decline all non-essential cookies and have their preference remembered for future visits, and you can customize the Decline All message. You can add a cookie settings widget to all pages by clicking the checkbox; visitors click the widget to re-open the cookie banner advanced settings, and you can customize the widget text and set the widget position. You can edit the text explaining about cookies in the text box, and if needed click Restore Default Text to use the text Wix provides.

title: Can I create pricing plans with specific start or end dates?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create pricing plans with specific start or end dates. You can let your clients choose a custom start date for their subscriptions. You can also request they choose specific dates within your plan policies.

title: How can I add an RSS button to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add an RSS button to your site using the Wix Editor:
- Go to the page in your editor that you want the RSS feed to appear on.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Blog.
- Click RSS Button.
- Select an RSS button and drag to position it on the page.

Important: You can place the RSS button anywhere on your site except for directly on the blog feed. Placing the RSS button there may stop it from working correctly.

title: How can I connect DPO Group as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect beside DPO Group. If you have an account with DPO Group, enter your Company Token and Service Type that you received from DPO Group via email. If you have not received the above, email support@dpogroup.com to request this, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create DPO Group account and follow the instructions to create an account with DPO Group. Search for an email from DPO Group with your Company Token and Service Type. Go back to the Accept Payments tab, repeat the steps, and follow the steps under Have an Account to connect your newly-created account.

title: Is it possible to add a "Back" button to my Wix Editor site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a "Back" button to your site. However, you can add a button, change the text, and link it to whatever page you'd like. This request refers to adding a "Back" button to your Wix Editor site. If you would like to see a "Back" button added to product pages in Wix Stores, you can vote for it.

title: How can I create a new product category in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Store Products, or tap Catalog and select Store Products. Tap Manage Categories at the top. Tap Create Category. Optionally upload a category image. Enter a category name. Tap +Add Products. Select the products you want to add to the category and tap Add. A product can belong to more than one category. Tap Save. Important: after you create a category, it's not yet visible in your mobile app or online store. Learn how to customize your store in the Spaces by Wix (and other member apps) so that your categories are displayed in separate tabs.

title: Are navigation arrows supported on the product page in mobile view for Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add navigation arrows or "Previous" and "Next" buttons on the Product Page in the mobile view. Navigation buttons do, however, appear when viewing the product page on desktop.

title: How can I set up DoorDash Drive for my restaurant using Wix Restaurants?
content:
DoorDash Drive is only available in the United States. Before you begin, make sure your business info is up to date.

1. Register with DoorDash Drive: Go to Pickup and Delivery in your site's dashboard, click the Edit icon next to DoorDash Drive under Delivery Partners, and click Register. Follow the on-screen steps: click Agree & Continue to allow DoorDash Drive to manage restaurant orders and read basic site and business info, enter your credentials and click Sign in, then enter your business information to sign the Wix integration contract and click Submit.

2. Enable online payments: Go to Pickup and Delivery, click the Edit icon next to DoorDash Drive under Delivery Partners, and click Go to Payments to set up online payments and disable manual payments. Upgrade your site to accept payments. DoorDash only accepts online payments and doesn't accept cash.

3. Enable tips: Go to Pickup and Delivery, click the Edit icon next to DoorDash Drive under Delivery Partners, and click Go to Tips to start collecting tips at checkout. DoorDash receives the tips customers leave at checkout when you fulfill deliveries with DoorDash Drive.

4. Customize delivery settings: Go to Pickup and Delivery, click the Edit icon next to DoorDash Drive under Delivery Partners, enter your Delivery hours, and enter the Delivery partner settings: pickup instructions for driver, estimated delivery time, order minimum, and delivery fee. Optionally, select Offer free delivery above a certain subtotal and enter the subtotal. Click Save.

5. Enable DoorDash Drive: Go to Pickup and Delivery and enable the toggle next to DoorDash Drive under Delivery Partners.

title: How can I create an automation to send data to Google Sheets using the new automation builder?
content:
Step 1 | Create a new automation and connect your Google account
Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation at the top right. Click + Start from Scratch. Give your automation a title and choose a trigger. Click the Add Step icon and add an Action. Select Update Google Sheets under Integrations on the left. Click Connect Google Account. Select the relevant Google account. Click Allow.

Important: When connecting your Google account, you are providing permissions for Wix to access your spreadsheet data. You can remove permissions at any time from your Google account. If you remove Wix permissions, any automations that use Google Sheets will become disconnected and stop working.

Step 2 | Connect a spreadsheet to your automation
Click Select Spreadsheet. Choose a spreadsheet from the available files. If the spreadsheet has multiple tabs, click the Choose sheet drop-down to select which tab the automation should send data to.

Step 3 | Match trigger data to the spreadsheet
Click Match Data to Sheet. Click the drop-downs under Data from trigger to match them to the Google sheet columns. Click Save.

title: How do I approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Booking.com?
content: First, ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Booking.com: Log in to the Booking.com extranet. Click Account in the menu at the top, then select Connectivity Provider from the drop-down. If the Connectivity Provider option is not available on the page, contact Booking.com to make this option visible. Click Search, enter "HotelRunner" in the Search Provider field, and click Connect. Select the relevant permissions you want to give Booking.com. Reservations, rates and availability, guest reviews, and reporting boxes are mandatory to complete the connection.

title: How do I create a Stack in Editor X to ensure elements don't overlap on smaller screens?
content: Click the first element of your Stack. Hold down the Shift key and select all other elements that should be stacked. Click Stack. This places your elements inside a flex container with margins you can control, helping to maintain a responsive layout.

title: How can I create and customize text columns in the Wix Editor?
content:
