Columns are a great way to showcase important site information. Add a strip to your site and organize your text into neat, structured columns. You can have up to five columns.

Step 1 | Split your strip into columns:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the relevant strip.
- Click the Layouts icon.
- Click Add Column.
- (Optional) Click Manage Columns and then Add Column to add more columns.

Step 2 | Resize your columns:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the relevant strip.
- Click the Layout icon.
- Click a layout under Column Proportions.
- Click Customize Proportions and customize the layout by dragging the column edges.
Note: If you have 5 columns, you cannot customize their proportions. They are always distributed equally.

Step 3 | Add text to your columns:
- Add a text element to your site.
- Resize the text element so that it fits completely inside your column borders.
- Click and drag the text element to your chosen position on the column.
- Drop the text element when you see Attach to Column.

Important: Make sure that your text is placed in the gridlines of each column to ensure that the text is visible on all devices.

Tip: If you don't want your strip (behind your columns) to be visible, make it transparent by decreasing the opacity in the background settings.

title: Can I add a .txt file to the top-level domain for Google Analytics verification on my Wix site?
content:
It's currently not possible to add this kind of file to your Wix site. To resolve this issue, we recommend contacting Google and requesting an alternative verification method, such as adding a dedicated meta tag.

Workaround:
You can try adding a meta tag with the following information to the page that you set as the Default URL of your property in Google Analytics. Replace the placeholder text with your email address, UA-ID, and the date:

GooGhywoiu9839t543j0s7543uw1 - pls add {INSERT YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS} to GA account {INSERT YOUR UA-ID} with ‘Manage Users and Edit’ permissions - date {INSERT THE DATE}.

title: Why are my multilingual subdomains not working on my Wix site?
content:
If you are experiencing problems with your multilingual subdomains, follow the steps below:

- Make sure that your site is published. Your subdomains are only created if your site is published. To publish your site, click Publish at the top right of the editor.
- Make sure that secondary languages are set to 'visible'. Check that your secondary languages are set to 'visible' in the multilingual dashboard.
- Make sure that your site has been upgraded. Your subdomains can only be connected if your site has been upgraded. To check, go to your site's dashboard and check the plan status of your site at the top of the page.
- Check your domain connection. Your subdomain only works if your domain is connected properly. Click to access the Domain Assistant and follow the instructions to troubleshoot your domain connection. Multilingual subdomains cannot be created for domains that are connected to Wix via pointing.
- Wait up to 48 hours after connecting your domain. After connecting your domain, it takes up to 48 hours for the domain and its subdomains to propagate.

If the problem persists, contact us and we will be happy to help.

title: Can I customize the fields in the delivery form for online orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it's now possible to customize the fields in the delivery form customers fill out when ordering online. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: Can I translate Wix Forms field names per language using Wix Multilingual?
content: Yes. You can now translate your Wix Forms field names with Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I change the background color of a container box in ADI Builder?
content: Click the section that contains the container box in the ADI Builder. Hover over the box and click Box. Select a color from the palette. Tip: Click Edit site colors to change the available color palette.

title: How can I activate or deactivate a coupon in Wix Stores?
content: To activate or deactivate a coupon: Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant coupon. Click Activate or Deactivate.

title: How can I export a report of my bookings and staff data from Wix Bookings?
content: To export a report from Wix Bookings, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top of the page, then select Export booking data. Click the drop-down and choose the type of report you want to export: Booking List includes details such as Session Start Time, Date of Booking, and Client Name; Staff Hours includes details such as Service Name, Session Start Time, and Duration (minutes). Select the date range of the data you want to export, then click Export. The data is exported in .CSV file format and can be opened using software such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

title: Is it possible to resize only the top row in a section grid without affecting the bottom row?
content: Currently, it is not possible to only resize the top row while maintaining the bottom row's height when dragging a row gridline in a section grid.

title: How can I make my image fit in the space correctly on my homepage in Wix Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, select the image and click the Settings icon. From the Display mode drop-down, choose Fill bounding box, Fit to bounding box, or Keep image ratio. To reset an image after cropping, click the Settings icon, then Reset Image. For a background image in Wix Editor, click Site Design > Page Background, add or select the image background, click Change Background > Settings, then under "How's the image scaled?" select Fill or Tile and under "Where is it positioned?" select a position on the grid.

title: How can I create a new automation for my Wix group?
content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation or click an existing automation to edit it. Click + Start from Scratch. Click the title to give your automation a name. Select Wix Groups in the Trigger section. Select the relevant checkbox under Select a trigger and choose a trigger. Click the Limit Frequency to: drop-down and select how many times the same contact can trigger this automation. (Optional) Click + Add Delay and select when to perform the action. (Optional) Click + Add Condition, select your criteria from the Select criteria drop-down, select your operator, and complete your condition. Select your desired action in the Action section. (Optional) Click + Add an Action to set up a multistep automation. Click Activate.

title: Can I redeem loyalty points with Wix Hotels?
content: Currently, it is not possible to redeem loyalty points with Wix Hotels. You can however, offer coupons as rewards.

title: Can I connect Wix Music albums or playlists to a dataset in the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect Wix Music albums or playlists to a dataset in the CMS. It is only possible to connect the audio player element to data.

title: Can I limit a shipping method to customers who purchase more than a minimum amount in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it's not possible to restrict a shipping method to customers who purchase more than a minimum amount. For example, you cannot limit a $10 flat-rate shipping rule to purchases over $100. You can, however, limit purchases to a minimum order amount.

title: Is it possible to add a fulfillment service that is not listed in the available apps on Wix Stores?
content: Yes. If a fulfiller you want to work with isn't available, you can add them yourself.

title: How can I set Fit by Wix as the default member app for my fitness business?
content:
To make Fit by Wix your preferred member app, go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard. Note: choosing your preferred member app is only available from desktop. Click the More Actions drop-down at the top and select Mobile App Settings. Click the Spaces by Wix app tab. Click Choose App next to Mobile app preference. Select Fit by Wix. Click Save.

Next steps: start customizing your Fit by Wix site so it looks just the way you want and keeps your members engaged. When you customize your site on the Fit by Wix app, the changes you make appear both in Fit by Wix and in Spaces by Wix. Celebrate the change by sending your existing members an announcement directly to their mobile, encouraging them to switch to Fit by Wix. Learn how to create an announcement.

title: Can I send SMS notifications to customers about their order status and updates in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can now send SMS notifications to customers about their order status and updates.

title: How can I add and customize sections in the Wix Editor for my website?
content: You can add a blank section to start from scratch, or choose from a variety of ready-made designs organized by topic such as Promotion, Team, and List. Whether you choose a blank or pre-designed section, you can add all the elements you need and customize them to suit the section's intent. Customize any section you add to your site by choosing the background and size, and add scroll effects to create unique, eye-catching content. Sections span the full width of your visitors' browser and maintain their grouping when visitors view your site on mobile devices. Sections you've added on desktop automatically appear your mobile site. However, you may want to change the order in which they appear on your mobile site, or even hide certain sections. These changes don't affect the desktop version of your site. To get started, click Add Section on the left side of the Editor to add and set up a section on your site.

title: How can I invite guests to join an event using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Events. Select Published Events. Tap the More Actions icon next to a specific event. Tap Invite Guests. Select an option: Email Wix Contacts: Send an email directly to the contacts saved in your Wix account (site members, customers, contacts). SMS: Send an SMS (text message) to the phone contacts you select. Share via Social & More: Send the link and invitation code to people through the share links available on your phone. Copy Link: Copy the link and paste it into a new message in any application. Additionally, members can invite friends and family to join an event by clicking the Events tab in the Spaces by Wix app and then Invite under the relevant event.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual on the Spaces by Wix app?
content: Currently, Wix Multilingual is not available to add or use on the Spaces by Wix app.

title: How can I fix white spaces appearing on the background of my Wix site?
content: To resolve white spaces appearing on the background, set your background to be fixed. To change the background scrolling setting: go to the relevant page in your Editor; click Site Design on the left side of the Editor; hover over Page Background and click Customize; click Settings on the background image preview; select It's fixed under Does the image scroll?. Note: The background scrolling option is only available on image backgrounds.

title: How can I enable cash drawer management on my Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
To enable cash drawer management on your Wix Retail POS tablet:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
- Tap Settings.
- Tap the Cash Management tab.
- Enable the Track Cash toggle.
- (Optional) Enter the default cash amount you have in the register at the start of each day.

Note: You can edit this amount when you start the cash drawer.

- (Optional) Change the default register name.

Note: This option appears only if you have more than one tablet. Adding a meaningful name will help identify which report is associated to which cash register when reading printed reports.

title: How can I display Google AdSense ads on my Wix site?
content: Adding Google AdSense code using the HTML element is not recommended, and Wix cannot provide support for Google AdSense ads placed on your site using this method. Alternatively, you can display AdSense ads using the Wix Monetize with AdSense app.

title: How can I change the display settings of the old Instagram Feed app?
content:
To change the display:

- Select the Instagram Feed app in your editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Display** tab.
- Enable the **Your Profile** toggle to select the account information you want to display on your Instagram Feed.
- Enable the **Your Posts** toggle to display your posts on your Instagram Feed.
- Enable the **Hashtag Feed** toggle to display hashtags on your Instagram Feed.
- Search for hashtags to display on your Hashtag Feed under **Choose hashtags to display**.

**Note:** You need to connect an Instagram business account to customize these options.

**Note:** Hashtags that were not used in the last 30 days will not display in your Hashtag Feed. This is a limitation from Facebook.

**Note:** You can search for 30 hashtags in 7 days. This is a limitation from Facebook.

title: How can I set up an automation to remove a participant from an online program after they complete it?
content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Select the Online Programs app in the automation flow. Choose the trigger "Participant completes the program" for the specific program. Add a delay of 3 days, and use the action "Remove participant" for that program. Participants that are removed by this automation are labeled as Auto-Removed.

title: How can I check the status of the mandatory field for structured data markup in my Wix Blog?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Click Blog Posts. Click Edit next to Structured data markup. If you see the message indicating you need to update your business information, make sure you add a logo as your mandatory field, since it is required for everything to be set up correctly. Click Save. After you’ve published your site with the new markup, you can test it with Google’s Structured Data Testing Tool.

title: How can I reconnect to the correct Zoom account if I initially connected to the wrong one?
content: Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the Zoom app. Click Delete. Log out of your Zoom account. If you don't log out, you'll reconnect to the same account. Reconnect to the correct account while creating your next service. After reconnecting, you can still host the meetings you created with your first account. Just make sure to log in to Zoom using that account and hold the online service.

title: How can I change the settings of a strip background in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the strip. Click Change Strip Background. Click Settings. Customize your strip type using the available options. Strip settings differ depending on the background type: color, image, or video. For color settings, click the color box to select a new color for your strip background, then drag the slider to adjust the strip's transparency. For image settings, use Image Opacity, Color Behind Image, How's the image scaled?, Where is it positioned?, and Image Text. Scaling options include Original Size, Scale to Fill, and Tile. For video settings, use the overlay pattern options, Video opacity, Color behind video, Where's the video positioned?, and How does the video play?, including Play Speed and Play in a loop. You can preview your site to see what looks best.

title: How can I set up a delivery area for DoorDash Drive in Wix Restaurants?
content: Before you begin, set up an online payment method and enable tips for online orders. DoorDash only accepts online payment options and doesn't accept cash. To set up a DoorDash Drive delivery area: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Delivery & Delivery Partners. Click + New Area. (Optional) Enter a minimum order amount for this area. Click the Delivery method drop-down and select DoorDash Drive for Restaurants. (Optional) Click the Cover part of the delivery fee checkbox to pay part of the delivery fee that DoorDash charges your customers and enter the amount you want to cover. Under Pickup instructions, enter instructions for the DoorDash courier. Under Maximum Delivery Time, enter an estimate of how long it should take from the time you receive an order until your customers receive it (i.e. prep time + delivery time). (Optional) Click the Edit icon under Availability to edit your delivery hours, then click Apply. You can also temporarily make this delivery unavailable by disabling the Availability toggle. Click Save. If you have more than one location, you can repeat the steps above to set up additional delivery areas. (Recommended) Place a test order with delivery DoorDash to make sure delivery works smoothly.

title: Can I create service bundles in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create service bundles, or a pre-defined set of services with shared durations, price and staff members your clients can book together. As a workaround, you can create a new appointment service which combines the services, duration and staff of several different services.

title: How can I transfer my Google Workspace business email to another Wix account?
content: You cannot transfer a Google Workspace business email by itself. Transfer it as part of moving your Premium site, along with the domain associated with your business email, to another Wix account. In your site's dashboard, click Site Actions, select Transfer Site, and fill out the Transfer Ownership form. Enable both transfer options: Transfer Premium plan, and Transfer Domain & business email. The business email option appears only if you purchased a Google Workspace business email from Wix. Click Next, review the transfer details and notes, select the confirmation checkbox, click Transfer Ownership, and click Got it. The recipient must confirm the transfer and accept site ownership to complete it. You can track and manage your transfers in Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard, and re-send the invite from there if needed.

title: How can I resolve the 'Submitted URL Marked 'noindex'' error in Google Search Console?
content: If you submitted a page for Google to index and received the Submitted URL Marked 'noindex' error message, try these checks: Make sure you entered the URL correctly and that it corresponds with an existing page on your site that does not return a 404 error message or 5xx error message. Check your site's pages to make sure search engines are not prevented from indexing them; in this case, the page would have a "noindex" tag in the code and Google will not include it in search results. Also check your site's settings to make sure search engines can index it. Make sure your page is not password protected; in this case, the page would have a "noindex" tag in the code and Google will not include it in search results. Make sure the page is not set to members only; members only pages are excluded from search results by default. If the page is indexed, not a members only page, or not password protected, inspect the URL using Google's URL Inspection Tool to diagnose errors preventing the page from being indexed. Check the date below Last read in the Sitemaps report in Google Search Console; if the date is over a month ago, the error message is most likely not relevant anymore. If you've checked all the above and the page is still not indexed, request Google to index by clicking Request Indexing in the URL inspection tool.

title: How can I view and manage multiple sites in my Wix account?
content: When signing in to your Wix account, if you have more than one site, you're taken to the All Sites page. There you can view all your sites, choose between a grid or list view, search or scroll, organize sites into folders, and perform site actions. To view and manage your sites: go to Sites, click the Site Actions icon next to the relevant site, and select an action such as Edit Site, Rename Site, Get Feedback, View Live Site, Change Owner, Add Collaborators, Transfer Plan, Duplicate Site, Move to Folder, or Move to Trash. Click Select Site to access the site's dashboard.

title: How can I update my Editor X site to Wix Studio?
content: Wix is gradually rolling out the option to update Editor X sites to Wix Studio. When an Editor X site is ready to be updated, a clickable banner appears at the top of the editor. Eventually, all Editor X sites will be updated to Studio.

title: What are the operating hours for French language callback support from Wix Customer Care?
content: French language callback support is available Sunday-Friday, 7AM-10PM UTC.

title: How can I add tax to a dish in the Wix Restaurants Menus App for my US-based restaurant?
content: Go to your dashboard. Click the Menus tab. Hover over the relevant dish and click the Edit icon or click New Dish to add a new one. Enter the tax percentage in the Tax field. Click Save Changes for an existing dish or Add Dish for a new dish. This option is available if your restaurant is located in the US (including Puerto Rico, Guam, Western Samoa, Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands) or Canada.

title: How can I add and set up a custom element in the Studio Editor?
content:
To add and set up a custom element in the Studio Editor:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Embed & Social.
- Click Custom Element.
- Click the Add icon next to Custom Element.
- Add your script file: select the custom element, click Choose Source, then select Server URL or Velo file. For Server URL, enter the file URL, including the file name. For Velo file, select one of your Velo files. Enter a Tag Name for your element.
- Optional: Adjust the element's size, docking, and alignment from the Inspector panel.

Note: The tag name should be at least two words long, separated by a dash (e.g. big-weather-widget). For security reasons, the custom element is rendered inside an iFrame in the editor and in preview mode. This might affect the layout of the component. Go to your published site to see how it looks live. You can define your element's SEO settings using Velo API.

title: How can I request a review from a client in the Wix Marketplace after completing a project?
content: Go to Marketplace Overview in your Wix Studio workspace. Click the Projects tab. Hover over the relevant project and click View. To see completed projects, use the Filter by status drop-down and select Completed. Click Copy review link under Completed project, then send the link to your client. Your client must be logged into their Wix account to view and submit the review form. It is not currently possible to receive reviews from clients who did not come from the Wix Marketplace.

title: Which storefront features are mentioned in the Wix Stores Webinar: How to Optimize Your Storefront?
content: The webinar mentions these features: Shipping and pickup, Product Page customizations, Product filters, Search box, Wishlist, "Buy Now" button, Tax, Facebook shop, and Instagram.

title: How can I recover my Wix account if I can't access my email and don't have a recovery phone number?
content:
If you can't access the email account associated with your Wix account, and do not have a Recovery Phone Number enabled for your account, you'll need to fill out the Wix Account Recovery form. Wix can then check that you're the genuine owner of the account and recover it for you.

### To submit an account recovery form:
- Go to the Wix Account Recovery form.
- Select whether your site is a **Premium site** or a **Free site**.
- Follow the steps below depending on the type of site you have.

#### Premium site
- Click **Next**.
- Enter the details of the payment method that you used to pay for your site upgrade.
- Click **Next** to confirm your site's URL.
- Upload a document to prove that you own this domain.
- Upload a copy of your driver’s license or passport from your computer.
- Click **Next**.
- Enter details of the issue you're having that's stopping you from accessing your site.
- Click **Agree & Submit**.

#### Free site
- Click **Next**.
- Enter your details and the URL of your website.
- Click **Next**.
- Upload a copy of your driver’s license or passport from your computer.
- Click **Next**.
- Enter the email address that you used to sign up for the account.
- Enter the date that you created the site and the date of the last time you edited it.
- (Optional) Add the email address in which messages from any contact form on your site are sent.
- Enter details of the issue you're having that's stopping you from accessing your site.
- Click **Agree & Submit**.

### Important
- Fill out the form with as much information as you can. If you don't know something, you can leave it blank. Wix will contact you if we need more information.
- If you submit a request with an inactive or invalid email address, it won't be delivered to our Customer Care team. Make sure that you enter a valid email address that you have access to.
- We reserve the right to determine and/or grant ownership to an account or site based on our reasonable judgment. We also reserve the right to deny granting access to a user who lost the account credentials, in our sole discretion, without liability to any party.

title: How can I find the HEX, RGB, and HSB values of a color used in my Wix site's background?
content: In your Wix editor, go to the relevant page. For a page background, click Site Design on the left side of the editor, click Page Background, then click Color. For a strip, select the strip on the page, click Change Background, then click Color. Hover over the relevant color and view the number at the bottom of the panel. For theme colors, click Site Design, click Page Background, click Color, click Edit next to Theme Colors, hover over the relevant Base or Accent colors and click Edit Color, then click a color circle to view the HEX, RGB and HSB values.

title: How can I change a custom canonical tag for a page in Wix Editor?
content: To change a custom canonical tag in Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Click the Advanced SEO tab. Click Additional Tags. Click the More Actions icon next to canonical. Select Edit. Edit your tag under Tag Value. Click Apply.

title: How can I add HTML tags to text in the Wix Editor to improve site accessibility?
content:
To add HTML tags to site text in the Wix Editor and define its hierarchy:
- Select the relevant text in your editor.
- Select Edit Text.
- Select SEO & Accessibility.
- Choose an HTML tag from the drop-down menu.

title: Is it possible to view the positions of all elements on a page in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view the positions of every element on a page in the Studio Editor. You can view and manage the position of single elements and their parent containers by manually selecting them on the canvas.

title: How can I add images to my Wix Restaurant menu sections?
content: To add an image to a menu section: Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Go to the section you want to add an image to and select the relevant section. Click Edit next to Section Info. Hover over the image and click Update to edit. Select an image or click Upload Media to upload a new one. Click Add to Page. Click Save.

title: How can I change the access permissions for my Google Calendar so events display in my site's Google Event Calendar app?
content:
To change access permissions, open your Google Calendar. Click the Settings icon at the top right, then click Settings. Scroll down to Settings for my calendar on the left and select the calendar you want to share. Change your Access Permissions to one of the following:

- Public: click Make available to public and select See all event details from the drop-down.
- Public free/busy: click Make available to public and select See only free/busy (hide details) from the drop-down.
- Private: uncheck Make available to public.

Notes:
- You can only change the access permissions of the calendars you own.
- If your Google account was provided by an organization, you may need to contact your Google account administrator to change the sharing options.
- Each time you change the access permissions of a particular calendar, you need to click the Refresh button so it appears in the appropriate calendar type in your settings.

title: How can I create a branded app for an existing client site using Wix Studio?
content: In Wix Studio, go to Branded Mobile Apps in your Studio Workspace and click Get Started. Select a site for the branded app and click Continue, which takes you to the relevant site's dashboard. If you have built an app before, go directly to the Branded Mobile Apps dashboard, click the Create New Branded App drop-down at the top right, then select Create for existing site. On the Mobile app tab of the client's site dashboard, in the Your own mobile app tab, add the branded app's name and choose an icon, then click Next. Select a theme color for the app and click Next. Choose a navigation layout for the app and click Next. You can optionally scan the QR code to see how the app appears on mobile devices, then click Continue Setup. To start editing the app's features and content, click Edit Mobile App to open the web editor. Once you are finished editing, next steps include purchasing a Branded App plan for the site, connecting an Apple Developer and Google Developer account, and submitting the app to the App Store and Google Play.

title: What should I do if I receive an email from Wix about account changes that I did not authorize?
content: If you receive an email from Wix saying "Your account settings have been updated" and you did not authorize these changes, change your Wix account password immediately and then contact Wix Support. Wix also provides a link for users who are experiencing issues accessing their account, or if someone took over their account.

title: How do I update the terms & conditions checkbox at checkout in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Checkout settings in your site's dashboard. Click Policies. Select the checkbox next to the policy you want to display. Enter the policy text. If you want to make it mandatory to agree to these policies to complete checkout, click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it. Your policies are displayed in the footer of your Checkout Page.

title: How can I update my inventory automatically when receiving stock using Wix Retail POS?
content: Mark the stock as "Received" or partially received, then click "Update Inventory." Your inventory automatically adjusts to reflect the new stock levels; there is no need to manually check the stock you received and then update your inventory separately.

title: What is the difference between contacts and subscribers in Wix, and how can I find my subscribers?
content: Contacts include anyone who has contacted you through your site (e.g., through a contact form), anyone you manually added to your contacts, and any contact lists that you've imported to your contacts. Subscribers are contacts who have given permission for you to send them marketing emails. In Contacts, you can find your subscribers in the Subscribers folder on the left.

title: How can I check the renewal date of my Google Workspace business email subscription?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Check the Next Payment Due or Upcoming payment column next to your subscription. The date in the Next Payment Due or Upcoming payment column shows the renewal date. This date may differ slightly from the expiration date. Hover over the Info icon to learn more. If the auto renew has been turned off, the expiration date appears instead of the renewal date.

title: What does the Side Cart do in Wix Stores?
content: The Side Cart lets customers see what's in their cart while they're still shopping. Depending on your settings, when a customer adds an item to the cart, the Side Cart can appear at the side of the page, displaying information about products that were added to the cart.

title: Is it possible to set elements to scale proportionally in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to set elements to scale proportionally when being resized for different screen sizes. This feature is available in Wix Studio.

title: How can I optimize my mobile site content to improve loading time?
content: To optimize mobile site content and improve loading time, use the mobile Editor: open the Editor and click the Mobile Editor icon in the top toolbar. Hide unnecessary elements by clicking the element and the Hide Element icon; hidden elements can be viewed and re-added via Hidden on Mobile on the left side of the mobile Editor. Crop or resize large images: click the image, click the Crop icon, drag the handles to crop, and click Apply. Reduce the number of items in galleries and repeaters on mobile, showing only relevant and important items and media. Add a welcome screen from Mobile Tools on the left side of the mobile Editor, customize it, and click Done. Ensure visitors use supported systems and browsers: iPhone iOS 12 and above (iPhone 6 and above), Android 9.0 and above, Google Chrome or Safari.

title: What are the features and benefits of the Cap Rate Calculator by Allioo.com?
content: The Cap Rate Calculator by Allioo.com can enhance user engagement, improve your online presence, and generate high-quality leads for real estate agents and brokers. It is only available in English. Features and benefits include: modern and clean design, customizable to your website's theme; fields display as a currency automatically; helps with ranking on Google; and drive traffic by providing value to landlords. Check out the Cap Rate Calculator app by Allioo.com to get started. For questions and comments, contact Allioo.com directly.

title: How can I embed my Issuu publication code on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In Issuu Publications, log in, click "Publications" in the side panel, select the publication you want to embed, and click "Embed on website". Customize the relevant settings and click "Get embed code". In your Wix Editor, click "Add Elements" on the left side of the editor, click "Embed Code", then click "Embed HTML". Copy and paste the code from Issuu Publication into the "Add your code here (HTTPS only)" field and click "Update". Optionally, enter alt text that describes what you're embedding in the "What's in the embed? Tell Google" field. When you are ready, publish your site.

title: How can I set a layer selection preference in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click View on the top left. Hover over Layer Selection, then select the pathway you prefer: Parent first or child element first.

title: Can I display more than 20 blog posts in an RSS feed on Wix?
content: Currently, you cannot display more than 20 blog posts in an RSS feed.

title: How can I hide and show the menus and tools in the Wix Editor to have more space to work?
content:
To hide or show menus and tools in the Wix Editor:

* Click the **Hide Controls** arrow at the top of the editor.
* Click the arrow again to return to the normal editor view.

### Tip
You can press **shift + f** on your keyboard to show and hide the controls.

### Notes
* Any editor tools you have open (such as the toolbar) are also hidden when you hide the menus.
* You can still open and access the right-click menu with this feature.

title: How can I download the Wix Studio mobile app on my smartphone?
content: To download the Studio app, go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android). Type 'Wix Studio' in the search field, then click Get or Install next to Wix Studio to download the app. Log in with your Wix credentials. You can also download the Studio app right to your mobile device using the iPhone and Android links.

title: How can I edit my photo album on Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant album, then click Customize. Edit your album by adding new photos or new galleries, adding titles and descriptions to your photos, changing the layout of your galleries, customizing your album's style and design, and editing your album's cover page. When ready, click Publish Now at the top right to make your changes go live. Note: Make sure to edit your images before you upload them to Photo Albums. Once you've uploaded images to Photo Albums, you cannot edit them.

title: How can I set up Google Shopping using the "Facebook Ads, Google Ads & AI" app by AdScale?
content:
To set up Google Shopping using the "Facebook Ads, Google Ads & AI" app by AdScale:
- In the Editor, click the App Market icon on the left side.
- Start typing "AdScale" in the search bar and select "Facebook Ads, Google Ads & AI".
- Click Add to Site, then click Agree & Add.
- Sign up with Google and click Next, or sign up manually by entering your email and full name, creating a password, and clicking Next.
- Enter your credit card details and click Next. Google will charge this credit card for advertising campaigns.
- Make sure Enable Google Shopping ads on AdScale and Enable Google's keyword insights for your store are selected, then click Next.
- Select the category that best describes your products and click Next, or click I want to choose another category, select a category from the drop-down, and click Next. Click Next again.
- Set your target locations: start typing a region name (city, state, county, country etc.) and select it from the list; optionally add additional regions; optionally select Exclude and exclude regions inside selected regions; click Next; indicate whether you offer free shipping in your selected locations and click Apply.
- Set your target age range and gender and click Next.
- Leave the Product Ads option selected and click Next. You can also select the Homepage Ads option to create Google Ads.
- Select the products that you want to display on Google Shopping. By default, all of your products are selected; optionally deselect an entire category or expand a category and deselect individual products.
- Select a product description option by selecting any of the ready-made text options and clicking Next, or by entering your own text and clicking Next.
- Select the days of the week and the hours your product appears: select All days, Monday - Friday, or Custom; if you selected Custom, choose individual day and time slots; click Next.
- Set a budget for your first campaign: set the time your first campaign will run from the drop-down, select Periodic to set a custom time period, enter the budget, select your goal from the drop-down, optionally click Advanced and enter the minimum ROAS, then click Next.
- Click Finish.
After the initial setup, you can manage your campaigns in the AdScale dashboard: click the Apps tab in your site's dashboard, then click Open. To purchase a plan, click Upgrade.
Note: This is a Premium app which requires an upgrade to use. Google charges customers for displaying products on Google Shopping pages.

title: How can I view my blog's analytics using the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Blog. Tap Analytics. See an overview of your blog's statistics for the selected time period (7 days, 4 weeks, or 3 months):

- Posts Views: the overall number of views for all posts.
- Unique Posts Views: the number of different people who visited your blog. Each visitor is counted once, even if they've seen your blog multiple times during the selected timeframe.
- Shares: the number of times your posts were shared in the selected time period.
- Site Visits: the total amount of visits made to your site. The same visitor can be counted multiple times if they visit your site more than once.

Check how your most recent post is doing:

- Views: the total number of post views, including multiple views by the same reader.
- Unique views: how many people have viewed your post. A reader who views your post multiple times in the defined time period is counted once.
- Likes: the number of times a reader clicked "like" on the post.
- Shares: the number of times the post was shared.

See your three most popular posts and tap Post Analytics for in-depth information about each one.

Tip: Tap the drop-down at the top to change the selected time frame.

title: How can I offer a service for free using Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Create a new appointment, class, or course, or edit an existing one. Select Free in the Price type drop-down in the Price & Payment section. When clients view the service on your site, they see the text you entered instead of the price. You can also offer free classes without requiring clients to book a spot, or offer a free service by emailing site visitors a coupon using Wix Automations. You can also display a service on your site that doesn't have a price display.

title: How can I apply a sale price to a single product in my Wix store?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Products. Select an existing product or click +New Product to add a new one. Scroll down to the Pricing section. Enable the On sale toggle. Select an option: Percentage discount, Amount discount, or Sale price. Enter the requested value and click Save. To end the sale and return to the regular price, click the On sale toggle to disable it.

title: Can I change my existing business phone number to a different one?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change your business phone number to a different one once you've purchased it.

title: Can I set the animation distance in px* in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set this value in px*.

title: How can I resolve issues with a domain purchased from Wix that is not connecting to my site?
content:
To troubleshoot a domain purchased from Wix that is not connecting to your site, check the following:

1. Make sure your site is published. In the editor, click Publish, optionally click View Site, then click Done.
2. Make sure your domain hasn't expired. Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account and check the Next Payment Due column. If needed, click Update Payment Method under the relevant domain. If the domain is not listed, confirm you're signed in to the correct Wix account, check whether it is in the redemption period, and go to Domains to check if it was transferred from another Wix account.
3. Check that your Premium or Studio plan subscription is active. Go to Premium Subscriptions, expand the relevant plan, and view Status. If the plan status is Expired, upgrade to a new plan to reconnect your site to your domain.
4. Check that your domain is assigned to the correct site. Go to Domains, click Assign next to Not Assigned to a Site, select a site, click Next, then click Assign.
5. Check your DNS records. Go to Domains, click the Domain Actions icon, select Manage DNS Records, and confirm the A record is 185.230.63.107 and the CNAME record is initial.wixdns.net. If needed, update the A and CNAME records. Changes may take up to 48 hours to propagate.
6. Check whether ICANN deactivated your domain. If you received Action Required - Confirm Your Contact Information and did not click Confirm, go to Domains and click Resend Confirmation Email. Open Confirm Your Domain Contact Information from wix-team@notifications.wix.com and click Confirm. It may take up to 48 hours for your domain to propagate and display your site again.

title: Is it possible to create a multilingual site with bookings pages in different languages on Wix?
content: Yes. You can now translate your Bookings site with Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I add a Wix Forum to my website and customize its design to fit my brand?
content: Wix Forum allows you to create an online community on your website. Add Wix Forum to your site and customize it to match your style. To fit your brand, tailor the look and feel of your forum to match your website’s design. You can choose from various layouts and design options, and you have control over colors, fonts, and how posts are displayed, helping the forum feel like an integral part of your site.

title: My website does not appear in search engine results. How can I help search engines index and optimize my site?
content: Publishing your site makes most pages available for search engines to crawl and index, but indexing is not guaranteed and can take time. To check whether your site is indexed, search "site:" followed by your domain with no spaces; if pages are listed, they are indexed, and if there are no results, your site is not indexed yet. Make sure the page is published and the "Let search engines index your site" setting is enabled. Also check whether redirects, custom canonical tags, noindex robots meta tags, password protection, or insufficient content are blocking indexing. You can use the Wix SEO Setup Checklist to optimize keywords, title tags, and meta descriptions and to submit your site to Google for indexing; it also helps connect your site to Google Search Console. Wix automatically submits your sitemap when the checklist is completed, and you can also submit your sitemap directly in Google Search Console. If your site is indexed but ranks lower than you would like, optimize your site's content for SEO or use structured data markup to help search engines understand your page and create rich results.

title: How can I choose and customize a template for my Wix website?
content: Choosing the right template is the first step in creating a website that truly represents you or your business. Wix templates are created by designers at Wix and include sample content, color themes, galleries, inner pages and built-in business features. All templates are fully customizable, so you can add, rearrange and remove content and apps until your site looks and works the way you imagined. Wix Editor templates are organized into categories and subcategories based on business intent. Even if a template doesn't match your business intent, you can customize it to suite your needs. Editor X and Studio Editor offer pre-designed templates, a blank canvas, and wireframe templates that contain the structure for your site; you just need to add your content. All templates are responsive on different screen sizes. Wix Studio is not available to all users yet. You can also browse by design style if you cannot find a template that fits your business or website idea. You can start from a blank template or a blank template with a guiding layout already in place. You can look at website examples built by real Wix users for inspiration; these sites are not available as templates.

title: How can I assign my existing Wix Premium plan to a Wix Studio site?
content: To assign an existing Wix Premium plan to a Wix Studio site, you upgrade the Premium plan to a Studio plan. You must be the site owner of both sites or have the relevant billing permissions to reassign a Premium plan. In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you want to reassign, select Assign to a different site, and select the checkbox next to the relevant Studio site. The site must be in the same workspace as the plan you chose to reassign. Click Next, then Compare Plans. To upgrade the site, select a plan that offers more features than the current plan. Click Select under your new Studio plan, choose your subscription period, click Continue to Checkout, enter your payment details, and click Submit Purchase. Any remaining credit from your old Premium plan is deducted during the purchase process where applicable.

title: How can I customize the layout of my Booking Calendar page in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor, then go to your Book Online page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Bookings Pages, and click the Booking Calendar page. Click the Booking Calendar element on your page, click Settings, then click the Layout tab. Customize the following options: Choose a layout (choose between a daily or weekly view for your Booking Calendar), Text alignment (set the text blocks to the left, center, or right), Top & bottom padding (use the slider to control the space above and below the Booking Calendar), Side padding (use the slider to control the space to the left and right of the Booking Calendar), and Space between header & body (use the slider to control the space between the header and the body). You can also adjust the layout of your mobile site by clicking Switch to Mobile at the top of your editor, where you can choose from Monthly or Weekly layout styles.

title: How can I enable comments for all my blog posts on Wix?
content: To enable or disable commenting for all posts, go to Blog in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions drop-down, and click Blog settings. Enable the Comments toggle. Choose who can leave comments on your blog posts: Members only or Everyone. Note that you may see more spam with Everyone, which is why the ability to upload images within comments is limited to Members only. Click the Ratings toggle: Enabled allows visitors to leave a star rating when they leave a comment; Disabled prevents visitors from leaving a star rating when they leave a comment. You can also enable the comments counter in the Blog Feed Display settings to show the number of comments in your posts.

title: How can I unassign a domain from my Wix site?
content: Go to the Domains page. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Unassign from This Site. Click Unassign Domain.

title: Can I translate the product tables in Wix Stores' info sections?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate tables in Wix Stores product's info sections.

title: How can I add a new comment on a specific element in Editor X?
content: Open the relevant page in your Editor. Select a breakpoint at the top. Select the relevant element. Click the Comments icon right above the element. Enter your comment in the text box at the bottom. Use the tools right below the text box to make it more detailed: make your text bold or underlined, add a bulleted list, or add an image or a file. When ready, click the Submit icon. Tip: You can also press the Enter key on your keyboard to submit a new comment.

title: How can I add a banner announcement to the top of my site so that it appears on all pages?
content: Design your banner using a strip element, customize it with your message, and then attach the strip to your header so that it is displayed on all pages of your site. To create a banner for the top of your site: add a strip to your site, customize your strip with your message, and drag your strip into the header until the Attach to Header notification appears. Note: Your strip must be narrower than the header to fit inside it.

title: How can I customize the overlay of my video background in Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Click **Site Design** on the left side of the editor. Click **Page background**. Click **Settings**. In the **Video Settings** panel, choose whether you want to overlay a pattern or a color:
- To overlay a pattern: Select one of the available patterns from the options provided.
- To overlay a color: Enable the **Overlay a color** toggle and choose your desired color using the color picker, then set the opacity.
To remove the overlay pattern on your video background, click the **None** pattern option (the icon with the red line), or disable the **Overlay a color** toggle.

title: How can I import my Gmail contacts into Wix Contacts?
content: Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Select Import contacts from the Import/Export drop-down at the top. Click Connect under Gmail account. Sign in to your Gmail account and click Continue. Select the checkbox to give Wix access to see and download your contacts, then click Continue. Choose whether to import All my Gmail contacts or Only selected Gmail contacts. If you choose Only selected Gmail contacts, use the drop-down to select the group of contacts (i.e. Gmail label) to import. (Optional) Select the Mark as email Subscribers checkbox; if selected, all contacts uploaded in this batch will be marked as subscribers. Click Next. (Optional) Add a label by selecting an existing label or start typing to create a new label. Click Import. Click Done.

title: How can I set up order scheduling and availability in Wix Restaurant Orders (New)?
content: To set up order scheduling and availability in Wix Restaurant Orders (New), go to Restaurant Orders Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Order Scheduling next to Scheduling and Availability. Choose how quickly customers can receive their orders. For immediately or scheduled for later, select As soon as possible (ASAP) or scheduled for later, set the Scheduling rules by estimating How quickly can orders be prepared? and selecting How far in advance can orders be scheduled?, then click Save. Delivery time is added separately. For immediately, select As soon as possible (ASAP) only, set the Scheduling rules to estimate How quickly can orders be prepared?, then click Save. For fulfilled on a future date, select Preorder only, set your lead time and choose the length of your pickup or delivery window, then click Save.

title: Can I display a weekly timetable on the Wix Member Apps?
content: You can display a weekly timetable in the Wix Member apps (e.g. the Spaces App) by adding an Agenda widget. Members can see a list of your services and view them divided up day by day.

title: Can I change design presets dynamically through code in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to dynamically change design presets through code.

title: How can I add and set up an additional service list in Wix Editor to display different services on separate pages?
content:
To add and set up an additional service list in Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Bookings.
- Click Service List then select a Service List template.
- Click the Service List element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Services tab.
- Under How do you want to choose which services to display?, select the checkbox next to the relevant option: Choose by service category, Choose by service location, or Choose services directly.
- Click to select the checkbox next to the relevant categories, locations, or services you want to display. The options you see depend on your choice above.
- Click Save.
- Click Publish when you're ready to make your changes go live.

title: How can I save form fields to my contact list using old Wix Forms?
content: With old Wix Forms, you can match all form fields at once or save individual form fields. To match all form fields: click the form in your editor, click Form Settings, click the Contacts tab, click Choose Fields, then click the drop-down next to each form field and select the relevant contact field. For form fields you don't need to save, select Don't Save. For form fields without an existing match, select Create field and type a name for a new custom field. Click Save. To match individual form fields: click the field in your form you want to save to your contacts, click the Settings icon, click the drop-down under Save Field Data to Contacts, and select a field to connect this form field to. For form fields you don't need to save, select Don't Save. For form fields without an existing match, select Create field and type a name for a new custom field.

title: How do I change the daily spend of my Google Ads campaign with Wix?
content: From the main campaigns page, click Manage Spend & Credits at the right. View the ad credits remaining in the current billing cycle. Click Adjust Daily Spend to change your daily spend. Enter a new daily spend for the campaign(s) you want to change. If you are running more than one campaign, you can see the total daily spend across all your campaigns. Note: If you don't have enough for the new daily amount, you can increase your monthly subscription. Click Save to update your daily spend. If you have also increased your subscription, you will go through the checkout process at this step.

title: How can I connect my Instagram account to the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Media Manager under Settings. Tap Connected apps. Tap Instagram. Tap Connect Instagram and log in with your account details. Tap Allow.

title: How do I access my Wix Video reports?
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and scroll down to the Video section.

title: How can I change the currency in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Currency section and select a currency from the drop-down. If the currency you want does not appear in the drop-down, request additional currencies. You can add a currency converter so customers can view prices in their own currency.

title: What does the Wix article say about displaying a Cookie Banner on a Wix site for privacy law compliance?
content: The Wix article references "Displaying a Cookie Banner on Your Wix Site" as a related topic under data protection regulations such as the GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD. It also states that privacy laws may demand that you inform your visitors about which cookies are being used on your site, and that your visitors may also have the right to decline non-essential cookies. The provided text does not include step-by-step instructions for enabling the banner.

title: How do I get started with creating a Google Ads campaign using Wix?
content:
Go to Google Ads in your site's dashboard and click Start Advertising. Complete the Get ready to advertise on Google checklist, which includes publishing your site, purchasing a Premium plan that fits your business, and connecting a custom domain. Then build your Google Ads campaign by customizing your ad settings, creating your ad content, and setting a campaign budget. Finally, purchase a Google Ads with Wix subscription and launch your campaign.

Note: A new Google Ads account is created for you when you launch a Google Ads campaign with Wix. Any existing Google Ads accounts you might have are separate from this account.

title: How can I create a landing page in Editor X and set it as my homepage?
content: In Editor X, click the Pages panel at the top of the Editor. Click + Add New Page at the bottom. Click Add under Page. Enter the page name and press Enter. Design the page as you wish by adding elements, media or anything else you want visitors to see. Optionally, to set the page as your homepage: in the Pages panel, hover over the page and click the Show More icon, then select Set as Homepage. You can also add a contact form to help convert visitors to leads. When creating a landing page, consider hiding your site's header or footer if they show navigation options that should not appear, and check that your section heights add up to 100vh to prevent a scrollbar from being automatically added.

title: How can I invite someone to collaborate on my Editor X site?
content:
To invite someone to collaborate on your Editor X site:

- Click **Invite** at the top right of Editor X.
- Click **Site Team** at the top.
- Enter the email address of the person you want to invite.

**Tip:** If you're inviting multiple people, make sure to separate their email addresses with a comma.

- Click the **Choose role** drop-down and select the role you want to assign.
- Click **Send Invite**.

After sending an invite, you can see the person's name on the list with a **Pending** label. They can accept and join the team directly from the email they received from Editor X.

**Note:** When inviting someone to your site team, certain back office roles might not be available in the drop-down menu. To invite people to those roles, click **Manage Roles & Permissions** at the bottom.

title: How do I create a multi-reference field in my CMS collections?
content: To create a multi-reference field, go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant collection, then click Manage Fields. Click + Add Field. Click the Field Type drop-down menu and select Multi-Reference. Enter a Field Name. Click the Referenced Collection drop-down and select which collection you want to reference. Click Save.

title: Can I hide folders from members without access permissions in the Wix File Share App?
content: Yes. It is now possible to hide folders from members without access permissions.

title: How can I manage inventory for products without variants using the Wix app?
content:
To manage inventory for products without variants in the Wix app:

Go to your site in the Wix app.
Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
Tap **Store Products**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Store Products**.
Tap to select the relevant product.
Choose what you want to do next:

### Manage inventory automatically for this product
Enable the **Track Inventory** toggle.
Enter the stock quantity of the product.
(Optional) Add an SKU (stock keeping) number:
- Enter the number manually.
- Click the **Barcode Scanner** icon and scan the product's barcode.
(Optional) Enter a product weight.
Tap **Save**.

### Manage inventory manually for this product
Disable the **Track Inventory** toggle.
Select an inventory status:
- In Stock
- Out of Stock
(Optional) Add an SKU (stock keeping) number:
- Enter the number manually.
- Click the **Barcode Scanner** icon and scan the product's barcode.
(Optional) Enter a product weight.
Tap **Save**.

title: Can I add filters to background images in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add filters directly to background images, only to single or gallery images on your site. In the meantime, you can access the relevant image in the Media Manager, hover over it and click the Edit icon, edit the image, click Apply, click Save, and add the edited image to your background. Note: You can only edit images that you have uploaded yourself.

title: Can I share my Wix blog posts directly to Instagram from my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to share blog posts directly from your site to Instagram. You can share your blog posts directly to Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn, or choose to add a link to the post in an email.

title: How can I set up a custom email domain for my email marketing campaigns?
content: A custom email is a branded domain name used for marketing campaigns. To set up your custom email domain, follow the setup guidance for setting up your custom domain. If you already own a domain, you can add a business email address and send your email campaigns from a custom email domain. Note that some mail services may reject email marketing campaigns sent from free public domains such as Gmail, Yahoo, and AOL.

title: Can I create and manage multi-service appointments for my clients using Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now create, manage, reschedule or cancel multi-service appointments. You can enable your clients to book multiple services in a single appointment. To offer multi-service appointments, turn on the multi-service appointment toggle under Bookings settings in your site’s dashboard.

title: How can I manage the items displayed in my Wix in-page menu?
content: Click the in-page menu in your editor. Click Manage Menu. Choose what you want to do with the items: select or deselect the box next to the anchor and section names to hide or display them in the menu; click Add New Anchor to create a new anchor and display it in the menu; click Add New Section to create a new section and display it on the menu. Note: Your anchors and sections are displayed on the menu in the order that they appear on the page (top to bottom). It is not possible to change the order of items in an in-page menu.

title: How can I create a new automation in Wix to send data to Google Sheets?
content: To create a new automation and connect your Google account: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation in the top right corner. Click + Start from Scratch. Give your automation a title and choose a trigger. Scroll down to the Action section and click Update Google Sheets. Click Connect Google Account. Select the relevant Google account. Click Allow. Important: When connecting your Google account, you are providing permissions for Wix to access your spreadsheet data. You can remove permissions at any time from your Google account. If you remove Wix permissions, any automations that use Google Sheets will become disconnected and stop working. You can reset your Google permissions in an automation, but note that the trigger can't work retroactively or add any information that was "skipped" while the automation was disconnected.

title: How can I customize the tabs on my Wix Group Page using the Wix app?
content:
To customize the tabs on your Wix Group Page from the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Groups**.
- Tap on the group you want to customize.
- Tap **Edit** next to your group name.
- Tap **Group Tabs** under **Content**.

To customize a tab such as Discussion, Media, About, Events, or a custom tab:

- Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the tab.
- To rename the tab, tap **Rename**, enter a new name in the **Tab Name** field, and tap **Done**.
- You can tap **Hide Tab** to no longer display it to group members, or tap **Show Tab** to display it.

For the **About** tab, tap **Settings** to edit the group description; you can add images, videos, and GIFs using the respective icons.

For the **Events** tab, tap **Settings** and select the checkbox next to each event you want to display.

To create a **Custom Tab**:

- Tap **Group Tabs** under **Content**.
- Tap the **More Actions** icon next to **New Tab**.
- Tap **Manage** to customize your new tab: enter a name and description, and add images, videos, and GIFs using the respective icons.
- Tap **Save**.
- Tap **Delete Tab** to remove the tab completely.

You can also customize your Group Page from your desktop.

title: Can I add additional fonts to the Branded App?
content: Yes. Branded App now offers more font selections, allowing you to better customize your app and make it unique to your brand. You can check the article on customizing your app's design to learn how.

title: Can I apply a coupon when a customer purchases a gift card on Wix?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create a coupon that applies when a customer purchases a gift card. Update: It's now possible to sell gift cards at discounted prices (e.g. buy a $50 gift card for $40).

title: How can I format text in the Wix Editor to make it stand out and improve its readability?
content: In the Wix Editor, highlight the text you want to format, then click Edit Text. Use the formatting tools to adjust the theme, font, font size, bold, italics, underline, color, highlight, link, alignment, bullets and numbering, indent, text direction, effects, character and line spacing, vertical text, and HTML tags for SEO and accessibility. You can customize a theme and save it for reuse, upload your own fonts, add language fonts, and remove the underline from linked text by selecting the linked text and clicking the Underline icon. Wix font licenses in the Editor are for digital use only within your Wix site.

title: How can I limit access to specific pages on my Wix site to certain member roles using the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin: Make sure that you have created Member Roles.

To limit pages to specific members in Wix Editor:
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Permissions tab.
- Select Site Members under Who can access this page?
- Select Specific members under Which members can access this page?
- Enable the Members with roles toggle.
- Click Manage Roles and select the relevant role(s).
- Click Apply.

title: How can I customize the Side Cart in Wix to reflect my brand's look and feel?
content: To customize the Side Cart in Wix, click the Side Cart in your editor and click Settings. Use the available options: Settings to show or hide Side Cart elements; Design to customize colors, fonts, opacity levels, and more; Text to edit the default text. To customize the overlay over the rest of the page, click anywhere on the page outside the Side Cart, click Change Background, then click Settings and customize the overlay. To set what happens when customers click outside the Side Cart, click anywhere on the page outside the Side Cart, click Set Up Overlay, then use the Clicking closes lightbox toggle. When enabled, clicking outside closes the Side Cart; customers can also close it by clicking the "X" in the top corner. When disabled, clicking outside does nothing; customers can close it by clicking the "X" in the top corner. When done, click Exit Mode. Optionally, switch to the mobile editor and customize the Side Cart on mobile; customization in the mobile editor does not affect the Side Cart on desktop.

title: How can I change the layout of my Wix Video Player?
content: Click the Wix Video player in your Editor, click Settings, click the Layout tab, and select a layout. Channel layouts include Compact, Grid, Classic, Strip, Big Slider, and Small Slider. For one video layouts, you can select Compact or Strip. Each layout displays information slightly differently. To take full control, learn more about player settings.

title: What are the advantages and disadvantages of displaying a cookie banner on my Wix site?
content:
Advantages of displaying a Wix cookie banner:
- Helps your site comply with the GDPR and similar laws, such as Brazil's LGPD. Non-compliance with the GDPR can result in heavy fines amounting to as much as €20 million, or 4% of your company's annual turnover (whichever is greater).
- Shows that you care about the rights of your site visitors, which helps build trust and demonstrates that you are a responsible site owner, helping your business reputation.
- Serves as an immediate signal to visitors that your site is trustworthy; Wix.com's own data points to conversion increases within EU countries with the addition of the cookie banner.

Disadvantages of displaying a Wix cookie banner:
- Your site may appear to have a decline in traffic reports and analytics, including data on how long a visitor stayed, what keywords they used to find you, how they found you, how many pages they looked at, what pages they were on, or if they signed up or purchased something.
- Third-party marketing integrations, such as Facebook Campaigns or Google Ads, also use cookies to function and may be affected by a loss of accurate reporting.
- You may notice a difference between analytic reporting and integrations that rely on essential cookies, including notifications and integrations in the Wix Mobile App; for example, Chatbots rely on essential cookies and allow live chat with a site visitor, but the visitor may later be missing from analytic reports because they declined analytic cookies.

title: How can I add a custom cursor to a specific element on my site using the Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant page, section, or element. Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor. Scroll down to Cursor. Under Media, click + Add image or .svg. In the Media Manager, choose one of the suggested cursors or upload your own file. When ready, click Add to site. Optional: preview the site to see how the cursor looks live. Tip: You can use any JPG, PNG, or SVG file. To ensure the cursor is visible, verify that it has a defined border in a color that contrasts the background.

title: How can I save a design as an asset in the Studio Editor?
content: To save a design as an asset in the Studio Editor, right-click the relevant element or section and select Save as Asset. Enter a name for your design, select the relevant library from the Add to drop-down (you can click Create New Library to create a new one on the spot), and click Save. Design assets can be stored in Saved Assets or in a design library available on all Studio Editor sites in your account. Note: It is not possible to save global sections as assets. Also, if your section contains Wix Apps (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Bookings), Forms, Hamburger and Horizontal menus, Input fields, Lightbox, Pro Gallery, or Third-party apps (e.g., Instagram Feed), you cannot save it as a design asset.

title: Can I display back-in-stock requests only for certain products in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, you cannot limit back-in-stock requests to certain products; only for all or no products. Customers can request to be informed when an out-of-stock item is back in stock if you enabled this feature.

title: How can I add variables to the URL slug structure of a dynamic page in Wix Editor?
content: Open your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Dynamic Pages, hover over the relevant dynamic page and click the More Actions icon on the right, then click SEO. Edit the URL slug structure field: click Edit next to the URL slug structure field and choose Add Variable to select a text or number field to use its values in the URL slug structure, or add static values using only English letters, numbers or dashes. Click Save, then click Replace URLs to confirm the changes. The dynamic page's previous URLs will be deleted and will no longer work; instead, new URLs will be generated for the dynamic page. Important: If you want the old URLs to automatically redirect to the new ones you create by adding variables, make sure your site first has a connected domain. If your site does not have a domain connected, the old URLs will no longer work and instead will load 404 error pages.

title: What add-ons are available for the original Wix Hotels?
content: The original Wix Hotels comes with two free Add-Ons: Search Bar and Calendar. The Search Bar can be added to any page on your site. The Calendar can be added to any page of your site to show your hotel availability.

title: How can I connect Sezzle as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Sezzle as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Sezzle.
- If you have a Sezzle account, enter your Public Key and Private Key, then click Connect. You can locate your Sezzle API Keys in your Sezzle account.
- If you don't have a Sezzle account, click Create Sezzle account, register for a Sezzle merchant account, complete the onboarding flow, retrieve your Public Key and Private Key in your Sezzle account, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How do I add a new page to my site menu in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click Add Page at the top of the panel. Choose the page template from the options or click Blank Page. Enter the new page name. Click Done. When you add a new page, a new item is automatically added to your site menu and has the name of the page.

title: Can I share my Wix blog posts on Instagram directly from the blog post?
content: Currently, it is not possible to share blog posts on social media platforms other than Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

title: How can I move files and folders from my site's dashboard using the File Share app?
content: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. Click the Show More icon next to the file or folder you want to move. Click Move. Navigate to the folder you want to move the file or folder to. Click Move Here.

title: How can I manage my Wix Forum on a mobile device, and are there any layout considerations I should be aware of?
content: Forum management can be done on the go. Members can write and edit as normal using their mobile phones. The forum has one optimal layout for mobile to provide forum readers with an easy-to-read experience. We recommend that you do not place a forum on your homepage. Having a site with multiple pages is better than having everything on one page. The category header image does not appear on mobile devices.

title: How can I remove imported reservations from my Wix Hotels reservation calendar?
content: To remove imported reservations from your Wix Hotels reservation calendar, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Reservations tab, click the iCal tab, then click the Delete icon next to the iCal URL you want to delete. If you added only one iCal URL, you do not see the Delete icon. Instead, manually remove the URL from the iCal URL field and click Save.

title: How can I check if there is a system-wide issue affecting Wix services?
content: Check the Wix Services Status page. It lets you view the health and availability of all Wix Services in one place. If an outage occurs, you'll be able to see it on this page in (almost) real time. If the box says "Everything is working" and you're still having trouble, click the link for the Wix Technical Assistant.

title: How can I manage client bookings and attendance for my fitness studio using Wix?
content: Wix Bookings is a comprehensive scheduling solution that allows clients to book different kinds of services. Whether you and your staff offer personal training sessions, drop-in classes, or full courses, you can manage it all with Wix Bookings. You can customize the member apps (Fit by Wix, Wix Branded app, and Spaces by Wix) on your dashboard, or through the Wix mobile app. Members can book your services, join a waitlist, chat with you, and more. When members arrive for a class, you or the staff member giving the class can mark attendance right in the app.

title: How do I link my Google Analytics and Google Ads accounts to improve conversion tracking?
content:
To use this feature, you must have a Premium site with a connected domain.

Step 1 | Link your Google Analytics and Google Ads accounts

Using Google Analytics 4:
- Sign in to both your Google Analytics account and Google Ads account using the same Google login ID.
- In your Google Analytics account, click Admin in the bottom left of the page.
- Click Google Ads Linking under Property.
- Click Link.
- Select Choose Google Ads accounts in the Link setup pop-up.
- Check the box beside the Google Ads account you want to use.
- Click Confirm, then click Next.
- Choose if you want to enable auto-tagging or to leave your auto-tagging settings as they are under Enable Auto-Tagging.
- Click Next, then click Submit.

Using Universal Analytics:
- Sign in to both your Google Analytics account and Google Ads account using the same Google login ID.
- In your Google Analytics account, click Admin in the bottom left of the page.
- Click Google Ads Linking under Property.
- Click + New Link Group.
- Select the Google Ads account you want to use.
- Click Continue.
- Add a name for the link group.
- Enable linking for each view in the property you want to use.
- Choose if you want to enable auto-tagging or to leave your auto-tagging settings as they are under Advanced settings.
- Click Link accounts.

Step 2 | Create a conversion in Google Ads
- Go to your Google Ads account.
- Click Tools & Settings in the top right corner.
- Select Conversions under Measurement in the drop-down menu.
- Click Add conversion.
- Click Import.
- Select Google Analytics (UA) or Google Analytics 4 properties (App or Web) depending on the linking method you used in Step 1 above.
