- Click Continue.
- Select the analytics events that you want to track.
- Click Import and continue.
- Click Done.

title: Can I view a full order log for my restaurant orders in Wix?
content: Yes, it's now possible to view an event log for any given order. This includes when and by whom the order was accepted or rejected, the reason for rejection, and so on. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I create a clickable phone number on my Wix site using a text box?
content:
To create a clickable phone number with a text box on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Click Add on the left side of the mobile or desktop editor.
2. Click Text.
3. Select your chosen text box to add it to your site, or click and drag it to the relevant location.
4. Click the text box.
5. Click Edit Text.
6. Enter your phone number.

When you enter your number into a text box, it automatically becomes clickable, so you don't need to add any links.

You can also create a clickable phone number by connecting your phone number to a Quick Action Bar on your mobile site, or by linking your number to other elements on your site (such as a button).

Note: On iPhones and iPads, when a clickable phone number is tapped more than three times consecutively, the device blocks the ability to make the call.

title: Can I add the new Wix Restaurants Orders app to Studio sites?
content: You can now add the new Wix Restaurants Orders app to Studio sites.

title: What are some tips for improving engagement rates in Wix Email Marketing?
content:
Tips for improving your engagement rates:

- Send your email campaigns only to your active contacts to increase your customers engagement and avoid compliance restrictions.
- Clean your contact list periodically. Delete any subscribers who have not opened or clicked on an email from you in the last six months.
- For best results, send your emails between 8am to 2pm on Mon, Tues, Wed or Thurs.
- When people sign up to your email list, let them know how often they can expect an email from you.
- Write interesting and inviting subject lines. Avoid using phrases such as "100% guaranteed", adding symbols or writing in capital letters.
- Try to segment your contact list to different groups of interest, and tailor your content to each group.

Tip: Check out Wix Email Marketing Best Practices to learn more ways to improve your email delivery rates.

title: Can I accept partial payments or deposits in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to accept partial payments or deposits in Wix Stores. It is now possible to accept a partial payment for an unpaid order by manually entering credit card details, currently available if you accept payment through Wix Payments or Isracard. You can also manually create an order yourself. It is also possible to let customers pay in installments by connecting certain payment methods.

title: How can I connect my PayPal business account to my Wix site to accept payments?
content: To connect PayPal, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right and change it from the drop-down menu if it is incorrect. Click Connect next to PayPal. If you already have a PayPal business account, enter the email address associated with it, click Connect, sign in to PayPal, follow the on-screen instructions, and click Go back to Wix.com to complete the connection. If you do not have a PayPal business account, click Create PayPal account and follow the instructions on PayPal. Once your account is approved, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and follow the steps for an existing PayPal business account.

title: How can I add a video step to my online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Online Programs and click the relevant program. Click + Add next to Content/Schedule on the program page, then click Video. Enter the Basic info: provide a Step name; for self-paced programs, choose the relevant Section, and for scheduled programs, select the date. Under Video, click the Add icon, then either upload a video from your device / cloud storage using the Media Manager or add a video from the Video Library. Click Continue and select a video. You can optionally add a cover image and enter an informative description of your step. Optionally adjust the Settings overview by clicking Edit Settings and enabling the relevant toggles: Require to watch videos, setting a required percentage participants must watch to complete the step, and Autoplay next video step. Click Save. These settings apply to all video steps in your program.

title: How can I view the reserve funds in my Wix Payments account?
content:
To view your reserve funds, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click **View Payouts** next to Wix Payments, then click **Reserve Funds**. From there, do one of the following:

* Click **In reserve** to see the funds currently in reserve.
* Click **Released** to see a list of the funds that have already been released.

title: How can I add a Weekly Timetable to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add a Weekly Timetable in the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Bookings, click Weekly Timetable, then drag a timetable onto your page. The timetable automatically displays your visible classes on the days they are available; hidden classes do not appear.

title: How can I add a rich content field to my collection in the CMS?
content:
To add a rich content field to your collection in the CMS, follow these steps:
- Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections.
- Click the relevant collection.
- Click Manage Fields.
- Click + Add Field.
- Select Rich content and click Choose Field Type.
- Enter a name in the Field name field.
- (Velo only) Update the Field ID, which is used in the site's code. You cannot update this ID later.
- (Optional) Enter Help text if you want a tooltip to appear in your collection next to the field title.
- Click Save.
- Click the rich content field for the relevant item in your collection.
- Enter the text you want to use for the item and choose from the available formatting options at the top. You can also add images, videos, attachments and more features from the icons at the bottom.

title: How can I access my inbox in the Wix app and chat with site visitors in real-time?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app and tap Inbox at the bottom. To chat with site visitors in real-time, tap the More Actions icon at the top right and enable the Website chat status toggle. To chat with your site visitors, you must have the Wix Chat app installed on your site.

title: How can I fix the 'Missing field "description"' error in the Google Search Console Videos Tab?
content: To fix the 'Missing field "description"' error in the Google Search Console Videos Tab, add a description to your videos. Google requires you to add a description so that the Search Engine knows what the video is about. This helps improve your site's Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and ranking on Google search results.

title: How can I add a layouter in Editor X and customize its display?
content:
To add a layouter in Editor X: Click Add Elements at the top of Editor X, click Layout Tools, click Layouters, then drag a layouter onto your page.

To customize its display: Click your layouter, click the Inspector panel at the top right of Editor X, and under Display select a Display type. Then customize based on the selected display type: Columns lets you adjust item proportions, CSS gaps, and item direction; Rows lets you set CSS gaps for vertical space; Bricks lets you choose direction, item proportions, CSS gaps, and item alignment; Mosaic lets you adjust item proportions, CSS gaps, and item direction; Slider lets you set slider direction, item proportions, CSS gaps, enable scroll snap, and show scrollbar; Slides lets you choose direction, set items per slide, add navigation, and show scrollbar.

Note: Some old browsers don't support CSS gaps, so visitors using these browsers won't see the gaps you set between layouter items.

title: How can I enable members to chat with each other using the Members Area on my Wix site?
content: If you have Wix Chat installed, you can enable the Members Chat option so members can send instant messages to each other. Once enabled, members can see private chats as well as create their own group chats.

title: How can I set up my website to require an account before placing orders?
content: You can limit guest checkout so visitors can browse your offerings but must become site members before accessing the Cart Page to begin checkout. Before you begin, add the Wix Members Area if you do not already have it. In your editor, click Pages & Menu, then choose the path for your site: for Wix Stores, click Store Pages and Cart Page; for Wix Bookings, click Bookings Pages and Cart Page; for Wix Restaurants Orders (New), click Cart & Thank You and Cart Page. Click the Settings icon next to Cart Page, select the Permissions tab, and click Members Only. Then decide which members can access the page: All members, or Only selected members or paying customers. For the latter, limit access to a member role you created or to clients who have purchased a pricing plan.

title: How do I install and set up the Client Check-In app for my Wix Bookings?
content: To add the Client Check-In app, go to the Wix App Market, search for the Client Check-In app, and click Add to Site. The app then appears in the Apps section of your dashboard. Scan the QR code in the dashboard using your device's camera to open the app in your browser, or send the unique link to your mobile device to open the tab. Members can find their name, initials, or the service list on your device and tap Check in when they arrive. If you already installed the app, go to Manage Apps in your dashboard and click Update App next to Client Check-In. To customize the app, go to Manage Apps, select the Client Check-In app, click the Design tab, and adjust elements such as Text color, Background color, Button color, Button style, and add your logo. To adjust settings, go to Manage Apps, select the Client Check-In app, click the Settings tab, and choose options for member check in time period, service types, and what is displayed to clients; you can also add a password.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings for a dynamic list page in my CMS?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings in the Tools and settings section. Click Main Pages in the Edit by page type section. Click Edit by Page at the top. Hover over the relevant dynamic list page and click the More Actions icon on the right. Click Edit. Click the relevant tab to edit its SEO settings: Basics lets you edit your title tag, meta description, and allow search engines to index this page; Advanced lets you edit your structured data markup, robots meta tag, and additional tags; Social share lets you upload your social share image, og:title, og:description and Twitter settings. Note: To change the URL slug structure of this page, go to its SEO settings in your editor. Tip: Go to the Customize Defaults tab at the top if you want to add dynamic variables to your SEO fields. Click Publish.

title: How can I display navigation buttons and arrows on my Wix slideshow?
content:
Click your slideshow in the editor. Click the Layout icon and choose what you want to display:

- Show navigation arrows: Enable the toggle to display the arrows. Drag the sliders to customize the size and offset.
- Show slide buttons: Enable the toggle to display the buttons. Drag the sliders to customize the size, offset and spacing.

title: How can I create a new price quote using the Wix app?
content:
To create a new price quote in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Price Quotes** under **Getting Paid**.
- Tap **Create Price Quote**.
- Tap **+ Choose a contact** to select the recipient. If the recipient isn't yet a contact, you can add them to your Contact List.
- Enter your price quote title, expiration date, and default payment terms in the **Quote Details** section.
- Tap **+ Add Items** in the **Product or Service** section to select the relevant product or service. You can add a new product or service if needed.
- Optionally, tap **Add** next to **Discount** to add a discount.
- Optionally, tap **Edit** next to **Notes** or **Legal Terms** to make updates.
- Tap **Next** in the top right.
- Choose **Send via email**, **Share via**, **Download PDF**, **Preview**, or **Save and close**.

title: How can I pin an element to the screen in the Wix Editor?
content: Right-click the element in your Editor and click Pin to screen. Under Set position, select a position on the grid. To move the element horizontally, drag the slider under Horizontal offset or type a number in the field next to the slider. To move it vertically, drag the slider under Vertical offset or type a number in the field next to the slider. Preview your site to see how the pinned element looks live; you may not notice that it is blocking content until you scroll down your site in Preview mode.

title: How do I map my Wix SKUs to Amazon SKUs for Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment?
content:
Before mapping, complete setup: add the Amazon MCF app to your site, connect an Amazon account, and send your inventory to Amazon fulfillment centers.

To map Wix SKUs to Amazon SKUs:
- Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard.
- Click Open next to Multi-Channel Fulfillment.
- Select the SKU Mapping tab.
- Optional: Click Sync Wix SKUs and Continue so products added after connecting to Amazon appear in the list. The sync can take up to 10 minutes; refresh the page to see new items.
- Choose an option:
  - If your store's SKUs match SKUs in Seller Central: click Automap. Optional: to view matches, click the Filter icon and select SKUs Mapped.
  - If your store's SKUs aren't the same as Amazon SKUs: click the Edit icon next to the first product you want to map, enter the Amazon SKU for the exact same product and variant, and click the checkmark.

title: How can I set up contactless dine-in for my restaurant using the Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content:
To set up contactless dine-in for your restaurant using the Wix Restaurants Orders app:

- Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Contactless Dine-in tab.
- Click the Contactless Dine-in toggle to enable it.
- Enter the information that you want your customers to see when placing their orders:
  - Instructions: Add instructions for your customers (e.g. "Welcome! Fill in your table number and choose your dishes. We'll bring your order right to you when it's ready.").
  - Input Label: Add a field for table or booth numbers. Customers are asked to fill this out while placing their order.
  - (Optional) Direct dine-in link for customers: Click Copy Link to share a direct link with your customers for contactless dine-in.
- Click Download QR Code to download your code. You can print your QR code and place it on the tables of your restaurant so that customers can scan it, view your menu and place an order online.
- Click Save.

Important: For contactless dine-in to work, you have to enable Pickup. You also have to enable the ASAP toggle in Order scheduling.

title: How can I connect Clearpay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Clearpay as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Clearpay.
- If you have a Clearpay account, enter your Merchant ID and Secret Key, then click Connect.
- If you do not have a Clearpay account, click Create Clearpay account and register for a Clearpay merchant account. Once your merchant account is approved, you will be provided with your unique Merchant ID and Secret Key. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Once connected, you need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: 美国市场产品标签有哪些强制性合规要求？
content: 美国市场产品标签要求原产地标注（country of origin）；若销售至加州，还需加贴 Prop 65 警告标签。

title: How can I cancel an event and refund guests who purchased tickets using Wix Events?
content: Step 1 | Set Up How to Communicate the Change to Guests: Go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant event. Click the Emails tab. Make sure the Cancelation toggle is enabled. Click Edit to edit the email text. Click Save. Step 2 | Cancel Your Event: Go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon for the event you want to cancel. Click Cancel Event. Click Cancel Event to confirm. Step 3 | Refund guests: Refunds must be processed through the payment provider used for the sale and are processed for each guest individually. To get started, go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant event. Click the Orders tab. Click to select the first order you want to refund. Click Refund Order. This takes you to the payment provider used to process ticket sales. Once there, you can refund your guests one by one. Make sure to keep a record of which guests you refunded.

title: How can I cancel an app subscription on Wix?
content: To cancel an app subscription, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant app. Click Cancel App. Select Cancel auto renew and click Submit. Note that only certain roles, for example site owners, can cancel app subscriptions. If you don't see the option to cancel an app subscription, you may not have the required permissions. Don't forget to remove the app from your site if you're no longer using it.

title: How can I add Google Workspace MX records to my Wix account if I purchased a business email outside of Wix?
content: In your Wix account, go to Domains. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Edit MX Records. Click the drop-down and select Google Workspace, then click Save. If your domain is connected via the pointing method, add the Google Workspace MX records with your domain host, not Wix.

title: How can I limit the number of guests for my RSVP event and enable a waitlist on Wix?
content:
To limit registration and enable a waitlist for an RSVP event on Wix:
- Go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant event.
- Select the Settings tab at the top.
- Click Edit next to Registration Settings.
- Select Limited Guests.
- Enter the limit in the Limit the number of guests field.
- Select what happens when the guest limit is reached:
  - Close Registration: Guests can no longer register.
  - Add guests to a waitlist: Guests can continue to register, but are added to a waitlist.
- Click Save.
Note: Waitlists are not available for ticketed events.

title: How can I add the Yandex Money Form App to my site if it is no longer supported?
content: This app is no longer supported. It is still possible to add it by clicking the link and following the instructions to receive an embed code. Copy the code and add it to a page on your site using an HTML iFrame element. The Learn How link provides details.

title: How can I manage posts using the Wix Groups Feed API?
content: The Wix Groups Feed API simplifies post management and offers tools for content curation. It enables you to create, update, and delete posts, read and sort posts by group ID, and build a group feed with news or updates related to your groups' content. You can utilize code to perform various post-related actions within the group feed.

title: How can I allow my clients to cancel their subscription plans on my Wix site?
content: To allow clients to cancel, first add a Wix Members Area to your site and add a My Subscriptions page within it. Then go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard, create or edit a plan, scroll to the Settings section, and use the Allow plan cancellation toggle. Enabled lets members cancel from their My Subscriptions page; Disabled prevents cancellation. Click Save, and repeat for other plans. Canceling a subscription does not trigger a refund; refunds are handled through your payment provider, or through Wix Payments if applicable. You can also enable a grace period for recurring subscriptions.

title: How can I edit my property rates using Quick Rates in the original Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Reservations tab, and select the checkbox next to Show Rates. On the reservation calendar for the relevant room, click the new rate's starting date, move your mouse left or right until you reach your rate's end date, and click your end date. You can use the date arrows and calendar to access dates that are not visible on your screen. Select Add Quick Rate from the pop-up menu. From the pop-up, optionally edit your start and end dates, and enter the new rate per night. Quick rates apply to all rooms (or units) for this selected room type, except those with active reservations. Click Save. When Show Rates is checked, the new rates appear bolded on your reservation calendar. To delete a quick rate, repeat selecting the start and end date for the relevant room and select Reset Quick Rates from the pop-up menu.

title: How can I set up default filters in my Wix Stores product gallery?
content: In Wix Stores, select the Product Gallery you want to add filters to. Click the Settings icon, then open the Filters tab. Enable the Show filters toggle. Select the Show filters title checkbox to display or hide the title, and select the Show applied filters section checkbox to show customers which filters they have selected. You can optionally edit the Filter Title, then choose the filter types to set up: filter by category, filter by price, or filter by product options. For each filter type, click the More Actions icon and click Show or Hide to change its visibility. For the category filter, click Edit to edit the category filter name or deselect categories you do not want to display. For the price filter, click Edit to edit the price filter name. Note: Filtered products do not necessarily appear on your live site in the order in which they appear in categories.

title: How can I add a social bar to my site using the Studio Editor?
content:
To add a social bar to your page using the Studio Editor:

- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Embed & Social**.
- Click **Social Bars**.
- Drag the social bar to the desired location on the page.

title: What should I do if I see the error 'Googlebot couldn't get all resources for this page' in Google Search Console for URLs starting with frog.wix.com?
content: If you received this message for URLs beginning with frog.wix.com, these URLs are part of the structure of your Wix site. They do not affect Google's ability to crawl your site's content, and do not impact on your site's SEO. If you encounter a blocked resource that you believe should not be blocked, contact us with a screenshot of the full screen along with the domain name (e.g., subdomain.wix.com).

title: How can I send an invoice while scheduling an appointment using the Wix app?
content:
To send an invoice while scheduling an appointment using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Booking Calendar**.
- Tap the **Add** icon.
- Tap **Appointment**.
- Tap an existing client or create a new contact.
- Choose the **Service**, **Staff Member**, and **Location**.
- Set the start date and time.
- Set the end date and time.
- Tap the **Payment** drop-down under **How will you charge your client?** and select **Charge with invoice**.
- (Optional) Tap to select the **Notify client with an email** checkbox.
- Tap **Save**.
- Tap the **Due Date** drop-down to select the relevant date.
- (Optional) Add products to the invoice: tap **+ Add items** under **Products & Services**, tap to select the relevant item you want to add, tap the field under **Quantity** to choose the number of products you want to add to the invoice, and tap the field under **Price** to adjust the price.
- (Optional) Add tax to the invoice: tap **+ Add Tax**, tap the field under **Name** to add the type of tax you are applying (e.g. "Sales tax"), tap the field under **Rate (%)** to add the relevant percentage of tax you wish to apply, and (optional) tap **+ Create New Tax** to add another tax (e.g. "State tax").
- Tap **Add to Invoice**.
- Tap **Add** next to **Discount (%)** to add any relevant percentage discounts and tap **Apply**.
- Tap **Add** next to **Deposit** to add either a percentage or flat rate deposit amount to the invoice and tap **Apply**.
- Tap **Add** next to **Notes** to include any additional information in the invoice.
- Tap **Add** next to **Terms** to include your terms and conditions to the invoice.
- Tap **Next**.
- Choose how you want to send the invoice from the following options:
  - **Send via email**: tap **Send via email**, tap the field under **Subject Line** to edit the email subject, tap the field under **Add your message** to edit the email body, then tap **Send**.
  - **Share link**: tap **Share link**, then tap to select the relevant app you want to use to share the invoice (e.g. your email client, social media app or messaging service).

title: What happens if I change my page URL after updating my site URLs, and how can I manage redirects?
content: If you change your page URL after updating your site URLs, the new URL is treated as a new page and the old page will no longer work. Existing links to the old page URL that you shared on social media will stop working, and existing page SEO rankings will be lost. Search engines treat a different URL as a new page. You can let Wix automatically create a redirect when you update the URL slug, or use the URL Redirect Manager to manually create your own redirect. To set up 301 redirects, you need to upgrade your site and connect it to a domain.

title: How can I view my referral program data using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Referral Program under Customers & Leads. Review the Data section.

title: How can I add a health waiver to my Wix site?
content: Create a waiver directly from your site's dashboard using Wix Forms. You can only create 1 waiver per business. Go to Forms and Submissions in your site's dashboard, click Old Forms at the top, and click + Create Standalone Form. Select the Health Waiver form template and click Get Started. Give your waiver a name using the Form title field, use the Form description field to tell visitors what the form is about, and customize your form fields; you can click the Required checkbox to make a field mandatory. Optionally, add custom form fields by clicking + Add Field at the bottom, clicking Add next to the form field type, and customizing the field. Customize the Submit button text, enter a Thank you message, and click Save at the top of the page. After creating the waiver, share its unique URL with your clients so they can fill it out and return it.

title: Can I use formulas to apply calculations within CMS collections?
content: You can now create formulas to calculate values from CMS (Content Management System) collection fields. With expressions, you can use mathematical functions to perform calculations based on different Number field types and/or static numbers.

title: How can I change the dynamic page dataset settings in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the relevant dynamic page in your editor. Click CMS on the left, click Manage Page Connections, then click the More Actions icon next to the dynamic page dataset and select Dataset settings. In the dataset settings, choose what you want to edit. To go to the collection connected to the dataset, click Open next to Connected to collection. Click Preview to test your connections, and click Publish when you are ready to make the changes go live. Note: Dynamic page datasets do not have the Write dataset mode because dynamic pages must display content from your collection; the Write mode is used to only allow the dataset to edit or add collection content.

title: How can I add new members to my Wix group using the dashboard?
content: Go to Groups in your site's dashboard, click the relevant group, and open the Members tab. Click + Add Members on the right, then choose how you want to add members: send email invites, add existing site members, or copy a sharable link to send. You can also add your group's invite link to an email marketing campaign and send it to people you'd like to join your group.

title: What happens if I try to show a preview cover image on WhatsApp for a Wix Blog post that is over 300KB?
content: Currently, it is not possible to show a preview cover image on WhatsApp if it is over 300KB. Images larger than 300KB do not appear; only the post title is displayed. You can learn how to add cover images and share your post on social media.

title: Why is my LiveChat app not appearing on a specific page of my Wix site?
content: Certain apps such as the LiveChat app appear in your site's footer after you add them. If you hide the footer from a specific page on your site, these apps no longer appear on the page. For these apps to work properly, you need to make sure that the footer is visible on the page that you add the app to. To make your page's footer visible in Wix Editor: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, click Settings, click the Layouts tab, and select Standard.

title: Is it possible to download all gallery items at once in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to download all gallery items in a Pro Gallery at once. You can however download items individually.

title: Can I create my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site using Editor X?
content: You can now create your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site using the Studio Editor. Editor X is transitioning to Wix Studio, and Wix is gradually releasing an update that lets you move Editor X sites to Studio Editor in just a few clicks. Update your Editor X site to the Studio Editor to add Wix Hotels to your site.

title: How can I share my promotional video created with Wix Video Maker on social media platforms?
content: Create your video using Wix Video Maker. Click Save & Share, then click Share. You'll see the social media platforms you can publish your video to. Click Connect below a channel icon to connect your unconnected channel to your Wix account, then click Continue. Customize your post content and publish your post. To avoid any copyright issues, make sure to share your video using the Share feature described above. Downloading and uploading the video manually will not protect you from copyright.

title: How can I enable pre-orders for a product in my Wix store?
content: Go to Store Products in your site's dashboard. Create a new physical product or edit an existing one. Scroll down to the Pre-order section. Click the Pre-order toggle to enable it. Enter a short pre-order message. Optionally, click Limit to and enter the maximum number of pre-orders you can accept. To be able to set a limit, you must track specific inventory amounts. Note: Pre-order is not currently available through the standalone Add to Cart button. When customers pre-order a product, they pay the full amount in advance. It's not possible to collect partial payment at checkout.

title: How can I access the CRM tools for a specific site in Wix Studio?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. On the left of your dashboard, click the tool you’d like to use: Hover over Contacts and click Contacts; Hover over Contacts and click Workflows; Hover over Contacts and click Tasks & Reminders; Hover over Communications and click Inbox; Hover over Communications and click Chat; Click Automations; Hover over Marketing & SEO and click Email Marketing.

title: How do I troubleshoot my SSL certificate if my domain is connected via name servers?
content: Make sure your domain is connected to your site. If your domain is connected via name servers, make sure your domain host has the required name servers set for your domain. Then make sure you have the default A and CNAME records in your Wix account: go to Domains in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain, select Manage DNS Records, and check the records under the A (Host) and CNAME (Aliases) sections. You can optionally reset the records to the default settings. If you recently updated your DNS records, wait up to 48 hours to allow your domain to complete propagation.

title: How can I create a 'Back to Top' button in Editor X?
content: To create a "Back to Top" button in Editor X: Click Add at the top left of your Editor. Drag a button or any other linkable element (e.g., shape, vector art, image) to the desired location on your page. Click the Link icon. Select Top / Bottom of Page on the left. Select Top and click Done. Optional: pin your button to the screen so it stays visible as visitors scroll down the page by clicking the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X, clicking the Position type drop-down, and clicking Pinned. Optional: copy and paste the button to other pages on your site. Tip: add animation to your button and adjust the delay so it appears after a few seconds as visitors scroll down.

title: How do I delete an individual element from my site in the Wix Editor?
content: Open the Editor. Click the relevant element to select it. Press Delete on your keyboard, or right-click the element and click Delete.

title: How can I hide prices and currency from my menu in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Go to your menu page in your editor. Click the Menus (New) app on the page. Click the Widget Elements icon. Deselect the checkbox next to Currency. Deselect the checkbox next to Price.

title: Can I translate Wix Forum using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Forum with Wix Multilingual. See the list of translatable content in Wix Multilingual to learn what content can be translated.

title: Can Wix automatically create a branded logo based on my existing site design?
content: Currently, it is only possible to create a branded website from an existing logo design. It is not possible to automatically create a branded logo from an existing website. If you'd like a matching logo design, you can manually create your logo in the Logo Maker using the same fonts and colors used in your site editor.

title: How can I manage my billing details for the Hopp Pro plan?
content: Go to hopp.co and log in. Click Settings on the left. Click Upgrade under Manage Hopp Plan. Click Update payment method. Edit your payment details in the Update Payment Method section. Click Update on the bottom right.

title: How can I customize the Registration Form page for my event using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to the Event Details & Registration page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Event Pages, and click Event Details & Registration. Click the Event Details element on your page and click Settings. Click the Pages tab, click Go to Page next to Registration form page, select the Registration Form on the page, and click Settings. Click the Design tab to customize the design of the form page. Use General for the registration form title, text, and page background opacity and color; Event Info if shown; and Button for the RSVP button. Click Back at the top left of the panel between each of the following steps.

title: Is it possible to customize hyperlinked text for each state (Regular, Hover, and Clicked)?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize hyperlinked text for each state (Regular, Hover, and Clicked). You can add the Color animation to play on Hover / Click. This workaround only applies if the hyperlinked text is in its own text box.

title: How can I add a video to an existing blog post using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap **Manage** at the bottom. Tap **Blog**. Tap **Posts**. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant post. Tap **View Post**. Tap the **More Actions** icon at the top right. Tap **Edit Post**. Tap the body of the post. Tap the **Add** icon at the bottom left. Tap **Video**. Choose how you want to upload your video: **All Media**: Select the media file from your Media Manager and tap **Next**. **Create video**: Create your own custom video or tap **Start from Scratch**. **URL**: Enter the URL to the video and tap **Add**. **Device**: Choose your media file on your mobile device and tap **Upload**. **Free by Wix**: Choose a free video file from Wix and tap **Next**. Tap **Next**. Tap **Next**. Choose what you want to do: Tap **Save as draft**. Tap **Save and publish**.

title: Can I integrate Wix Video Library with Online Programs?
content: Yes. You can now seamlessly add videos from the library into your programs with a new advanced video step.

title: How do I add staff members to my Dayful by Wix account?
content: The Staff tab is where you add and update your staff member profiles. You can also set your default staff hours, customize individual staff hours in their profiles, invite staff members to sync their personal calendars with their Dayful by Wix calendars, and set up your video conferencing account and provider to offer online services.

title: Can I connect the names of the tabs in the Tabs element to CMS collections?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect the names of the tabs in the Tabs element to CMS collections. This would allow you to replace the static navigational text at the top of the Tabs element with text from a collection field. You can, however, connect elements that are attached to each tab, such as text, images, and buttons, to the CMS.

title: Does Wix support setting a page to refresh automatically?
content:
Currently, Wix does not have an automatic refresh page feature.

Workaround:
- Add the HTML code element in your Editor.
- Enter the code:
html
<script> var timer = null;function auto_reload(){ top.location.href = 'Enter your URL destination here'; } </script>  <body onload="timer = setTimeout('auto_reload()',5000);">

- Save and publish your site.

Note: 5000 refreshes the page every 5 seconds. You can change the number to the amount of time you want. Be aware that the script also asks if you want to refresh your Editor. Make sure you save before you refresh the Editor.

Important: This workaround only works if you have upgraded your site with a Premium Plan.

You can also set certain elements, such as videos and audio, to loop without your site being refreshed.

title: How can I embed an Odnoklassniki (OK) Like button on my Wix site?
content: First retrieve and copy the Like/Share button code from Odnoklassniki. In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Embed Code, then click Embed HTML. Click Enter Code, make sure Code is selected under What do you want to add?, and paste the copied code into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field. Click Apply. Optionally, enter alt text in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field, then publish your site when ready. In the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Embed & Social, click Embed Code, click Add to Site next to Embed Code, then click Enter Code, make sure Code is selected under What do you want to add?, paste the copied code into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field, click Apply, optionally enter alt text in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field, and publish your site when ready.

title: How do I create a draft for a single event in Wix Events?
content: To create an event draft in Wix Events, go to Events in your site's dashboard and click + Add Event. Select a type of event (this can't be changed after you click Create Draft): Ticketed Event or RSVP Event. Add your event details such as the event name, Short Teaser, categories, Event image, date and time, location, and About the event description. When ready, click Create Draft at the top right.

title: How can I resolve email issues if my domain is connected to Wix via name servers?
content: Make sure your domain is connected properly to Wix before taking any actions. If your domain is connected to Wix via name servers, ask your domain host for the MX records and enter them in the domains section of your Wix account. Learn more about adding or updating MX records. It may take up to 48 hours for DNS changes to update. Learn more about domain propagation.

title: What security measures does Wix have in place to protect user data and ensure platform security?
content:
Wix employs a variety of security measures to protect user data and ensure platform security:

- **Wix Dedicated Security Team**: Wix has a team of security and privacy professionals who maintain and improve defense systems, develop security review processes, and implement security policies. They actively scan for threats, perform penetration tests, and conduct security assessments and audits.

- **Compliance and Certifications**: Wix is a PCI Level 1 Merchant & Service Provider and is certified as ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 compliant.

- **Physical Access Controls**: Wix services are hosted on AWS and Google Cloud Platform, which maintain industry-standard security certifications.

- **Business Continuity, Incident Response and Disaster Recovery Plans**: Wix uses geographically diverse data centers and maintains plans for business continuity, incident response, and disaster recovery.

- **System Access Controls**: Wix has an access control policy for its internal network and systems, with processes for access logging, monitoring, and limitation.

- **Application Level Security, Monitoring and Risk Identification & Assessment**: Wix hashes user credentials, offers two-factor authentication, and regularly scans for vulnerabilities. They also have a security bug bounty program.

- **Control and Security Measures for Storage, Transmission and Transport of Personal Data**: All new sites have HTTPS enabled, and critical functions use at least TLS v1.2. Firewalls and intrusion prevention systems are in place.

- **Employee Awareness and Training**: Wix provides regular security training to employees and requires them to agree to a code of conduct and sign a confidentiality statement.

- **Third Party Risk Management Program**: Wix conducts risk assessments of third-party vendors' data security practices.

- **Law Enforcement Request Policy**: Wix ensures data requests from authorities are valid and made in accordance with legal procedures, challenging unlawful requests and redirecting them to the relevant customer when possible.

title: Can I crop images into shapes using the Studio Editor?
content: You can now use image masks to crop images into interesting shapes.

title: How can I add and customize a hotel search bar on my Wix site using the original Wix Hotels app?
content:
To add a search bar to your Wix site using the original Wix Hotels app:
- Click the Wix Hotels app in the Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Add-Ons** tab.
- Click the **Add to Site** drop-down next to **Search Bar**.
- Select the page you want to place the search bar on.
- (Optional) Drag the search bar to place it and use the stretch handles to resize it.

To customize the Search Bar:
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the following tabs to customize the Search Bar to suit your needs:

**Settings**
- **Layout**: Select a layout for your search bar.
- **Fields**: Select or deselect the **Kids** checkbox to show or hide this field.
- **Note:** This is useful if your hotel or rental property does not allow children.
- **Date format:** Click the drop-down and select your preferred date format.

**Design**
- **Titles text:** Select the color and font of the title text.
- **Body text:** Select the color and font of the body text.
- **Background:** Select the background color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
- **Buttons background:** Select the background color of the buttons and drag the slider to change the opacity.
- **Buttons text color:** Select the button text color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
- **Separators color:** Select the separator line color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
- **Fields background:** Select the field background color.
- **Fields text color:** Select the field text color.

**Text**
- **Title:** Edit the title text.
- **Date Labels:** Edit the check in and check out text.
- **Guest Labels:** Edit the Adult and Kids text.

The Search Bar can be placed on multiple pages of your site, and design each one differently.

title: Can I add a hyperlink to a container in the Studio Editor?
content: While you can hyperlink text, images and buttons in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to add a link to a container. As an alternative, you can add and set up a linked image inside the container and set it to be transparent. To do so, add an image to the container, click the Link icon, select a link type on the left and add the relevant link information, click Done, open the Design tab in the Inspector panel, and set the Image opacity slider to 0%.

title: Can I add profile fields for site members that they cannot edit?
content: Currently, site members can edit any field you add to their profiles. It is not possible to create fields with information that your member isn't allowed to edit from their account.

title: How can I block off time in my Wix Bookings calendar for a personal event?
content: Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click Add or click the time slot you wish to block off on the calendar. Select Blocked Time. Choose the staff member whose time you want to block from the Staff drop-down. Optionally enter a Title to explain the reason, select a start date and time, select an end date and time, optionally add a note for yourself, and click Block. During blocked time slots, customers cannot book appointments.

title: Can I rotate gallery images directly from within the gallery in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you need to access the Image Editing Tool to rotate your gallery images, you cannot do it from within the gallery itself.

title: How can I create a hybrid event using Wix Events?
content:
Hybrid events are events in which some guests attend in person while others join online. Any event you create in Wix Events can become a hybrid event. While creating the event, simply create a regular in-person event and add video conferencing.

Step 1 | Create an event with your physical location
Create an event draft (or edit an existing draft) and make sure to add the physical location where the event will take place. Create an event and save it as a draft or published event. Under Location, select Physical location. Enter the physical address where the event takes place. In the Venue name field, enter a message that lets guests know they can join online. Click Create Event.

Step 2 | Add video conferencing
After creating your event, you can add and set up video conferencing in addition to the physical location. Go to the Events in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant event. Click Features. Click Video Conferencing. Click Setup video Conferencing. Select and set up a video conferencing option: Add video conferencing with Wix Live Video, or Add video conferencing with Zoom.

Important: As of March 2024, the option to connect to Wix Live is no longer available. If you've already created events with Wix Live, you can continue using it in the meantime.

title: Can I hide the prices of my products or services in Facebook dynamic ads?
content: Currently in Facebook Ads, if you're using dynamic ads for your campaign, the prices of your products or services are displayed on the ad. It is not possible to hide the prices. If you want to take full control over your ad's creative including its image and messaging, create a classic ad.

title: How can I process an exchange for a customer using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
To let customers exchange purchased items using the Wix Retail POS tablet:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap Sales History from the bottom bar.
- Select the relevant sale.
  Tip: You can search for a sale by order number, customer name, or customer email.
- Tap Actions at the top right.
- Tap Exchange.
- Use the Plus icons to select how many of each product the customer wants to exchange.
- Tap Next.
- Select the new product the customer wants.
  Tip: You can scan the new item with your barcode scanner or select it from the product list.
- Select the type of sale:
  - The order total is the same as the original order:
    - Tap Exchange.
    - Select a receipt option:
      - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
      - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
      - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.
  - The order total is less - I need to refund my customer:
    - Tap Exchange.
    - Refund the customer using the payment method they used to pay for the order.
    - Select a receipt option:
      - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
      - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
      - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.
  - The order total is more - I need to charge my customer:
    - Tap Charge in the top right corner. The amount you need to charge your customer appears on the button.
    - Accept payment as you would for a regular sale.
    - Select a receipt option:
      - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
      - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
      - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.

Notes:
- You can only accept exchanges for store products purchased at a POS, not online.
- You cannot accept exchanges when the order was paid for with a split payment.
- You can exchange orders paid for with a gift card only when the price of the exchanged products is the same (i.e., the customer isn't refunded or charged).

title: Can I create a rental site with Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a designated solution for rental services. If you offer house rentals, you can manage your reservations using Wix Hotels. Alternatively, use Velo by Wix to add any custom features your rental service requires, or check out Twice Rentals, a third-party solution designed to add rentable products to your website in a few clicks.

title: What are guides in the Wix Editor and how do they help position elements?
content: Guides are personal position markers that you add to rulers so you can accurately structure and align your elements. Your elements automatically snap to the guides as you move them around or resize them, making it easier to reposition your page content.

title: What happened to the Wix Music distribution service and what are the alternatives for music distribution?
content:
Wix Music's distribution service ended on January 1st, 2019. To continue distributing your music, you can check out Soundrop. Soundrop is free and has tons of cool distribution features across top platforms.

Important:
* You will still receive outstanding payments for any music you sold using Wix distribution. Most stores and services release revenues within 3-4 months of a sale.
* If you have any issues with your previously distributed music, contact Wix Support.

title: How can I track Google Ads conversions on my Wix site using custom code?
content:
Before you begin, connect Google Tag Manager to your site. In your Google Ads account, create a conversion action: go to Tools & Settings, select Conversions under Measurement, click New conversion action, select Website, enter your website domain, click Scan, then use Create conversion actions manually using code / Add a conversion manually. Choose the conversion type and name, select Use different values for each conversion in the Value section, click Done, then Save and continue. Select the Use Google Tag Manager tab and note the Conversion ID and Conversion Label ID.

To set up custom code, copy the code snippet into a text editor, find the send_to line, and replace AW-CONVERSION_ID and LABEL_ID with your Google Ads values. In your site's dashboard, go to Custom Code, click + Add Custom Code, paste the snippet, name it, choose Add Code to Pages (All pages or Choose specific pages), choose Place Code in (Head, Body - start, or Body - end), and click Apply. Then go to Marketing Integrations, click Connect under Google Ads, click Add Google Ads Tag, add your conversion ID, and click Save.

title: How can I use social networks to improve my site's SEO according to the article?
content: Social networks can help boost your site's visibility, and linking back to your site from social networks is a way to boost your page ranking. Make sure your posts are relevant and hold value, as posts that are not relevant or valuable can set you back in terms of SEO. Wix offers quick and easy ways to help boost your site on social networks by letting you add social tools to your site so visitors can interact with their respective social networks. For example, you can allow a visitor to 'like' your site, thereby posting your site on their Facebook page. For help getting your site found in search results, check out the Wix SEO Setup Checklist for a step-by-step plan designed to help improve your site's SEO.

title: How can I create a recurring event in Wix Events using the dashboard?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard, then click + Add Event. Select the Event type: Ticketed event or RSVP event. Fill out General info by entering the event name, a short teaser, and up to 10 event categories; click Event image and choose an image from your media manager. In Date and time, select Recurring event. Optionally edit the default date and time: click the Edit icon next to the first date, edit the start date, end date and time, click the Timezone drop-down and select a time zone, optionally click Display timezone, and click Done. To add repeating dates in bulk, click Add Dates and select Repeating dates; set Event duration by entering the start date, end date and time; set Event recurrence by selecting the frequency and timeframe; set Event ending by selecting the last date/day; click Add. To add a specific date, click Add Dates and select Specific dates; enter the start date, end date and time; optionally click +Add more dates; click Done. In Location, click Location is TBD if the location hasn't been set, click Physical Location and enter the address for a physical location, or click Online and enter an Online Location Title for an online event. Optionally add detailed event information. When ready, click Create Draft at the top right.

title: How can I display a single video in my Wix Video player instead of a channel?
content: In your editor, click the Wix Video player, click Settings, open the Videos tab, select Single video, then search for the video you want or select a video from the list by clicking on it. Note: the single video format is not yet available with action cards, and videos that are not in a channel cannot yet be displayed in an email campaign. If you want to display a single video without the features of Wix Video, add the single video editor element.

title: How can I add an SPF record to my Google Workspace business email domain?
content: To add an SPF record for your Google Workspace business email domain, add the SPF record to the TXT field. An SPF record permits your mail server to send email on behalf of your domain, which helps prevent spammers from sending messages with forged email addresses claiming to be from your domain.

title: How can I retrieve a Vimeo URL to add a video to my site?
content: Open the video on Vimeo. Click the Share icon. Copy the video's Link URL. Note: You cannot link viewers to a specific part of a Vimeo video on your Wix site.

title: What should I do if I receive a 'Keep it different from other pages' error message in the Wix SEO Setup Checklist?
content:
If you receive a **Keep it different from other pages** error message in the SEO Setup Checklist, it means you are using the same title tags and meta descriptions for multiple pages. To resolve this, ensure that each SEO title tag is unique for each of your site's pages. Tips for writing effective SEO title tags:

* Each title tag should be unique, providing concise information on what the page is about.
* Include a target keyword for each individual page of your site.
* Add your business or site name.
* Include the location of your business to your homepage title tag; this will help Google know to display your site to searchers in your area.
* The length of your title tag should be 55-70 characters.

Use the pipe sign '|' to distinguish different parts of your title tag.

title: Can I add multiple hotels to my Wix site using the Wix Hotels app?
content: Currently, it is only possible to add one Wix Hotels app per site. If you manage more than one hotel, we recommend that you create a separate site for each one. If you have multiple rental properties (e.g., apartments) in different locations, you can add them as rooms with different addresses. A Premium Plan is for a single site only. If you want to upgrade a second site, you must purchase a second Premium Plan.

title: Can I exclude a specific IP address from Wix Analytics Traffic Reports?
content: Currently, it's not possible to exclude a specific IP address from Wix Analytics Traffic Reports. This issue was partially resolved on April 1, 2021. Now, when a site owner logs in to their Wix account, any visits using the same device & browser to their own sites won't be counted in traffic and conversion reports.

title: How can I filter blog posts by writer or category in Wix Blog?
content: Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard. Click the Filter drop-down at the top right. Click the relevant checkboxes for the writer or category you want to filter by. Click Apply to apply the filter to your search.

title: How can I add a new language to my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site?
content: Go to Languages in your site's dashboard. Click + Add Language. Select the relevant language from the Select Language drop-down. Click Add New Language.

title: Can I edit the text on the checkout page in Wix Stores?
content: The article does not mention editing text on the checkout page. It states that it is now possible to edit text on certain pages and elements in Wix Stores: Cart page text, Cart Icon text, Mini Cart text, Thank You page text, Product Widget button text, Product Page button text, and Load More button text. For other missing options, the article invites you to submit a ticket.

title: How can I add ARIA attributes to custom elements in the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor:
- Select **Settings** in the top bar of your editor.
- Select **Accessibility Wizard**.
- Select the **More actions** icon on the top bar of the Wizard.
- Select **Advanced accessibility settings**.
- Click the **Accessibility Dev Tools** toggle to enable it.
- Right-click the application or element you want to add the attributes to.
- Select **Accessibility**.
- Select **Add Attribute**.
- Select an attribute from the drop-down menu.
- Enter a label / select the level or value.
- Select **Add**.

Important: You can turn the advanced accessibility settings off at any time, and the ARIA attributes will not be deleted.

title: 如何根据过去30天的广告活动数据重新分配 Amazon 广告预算以匹配业务目标？
content: 使用过去30天的广告活动数据（广告活动名称、日预算、花费、销售额、ACOS、ROAS、展示量、点击量）和选定的业务目标来给出建议：业务目标可以是利润最大化（控制 ACOS）、销量最大化（推排名）或品牌曝光最大化。输出每个广告活动的建议日预算，并明确校验「Σ 建议预算 = 总日预算」，与提示中给出的总日预算一致；每条预算调整都要由粘贴数据中的 ROAS 或趋势支撑；列出哪些广告活动应该暂停或降低预算、哪些应该增加预算；预期调整前后的整体 ACOS 和 ROAS 变化要明确标注为模型估算，不作为实测数据。数据中没有的数字写「缺失」，不要估算，也不要引用记忆中的行业均值；每个结论标注来源：[输入数据] 或 [模型推测]。

title: How can I manage leads and client records using the Contact Management/CRM app by vcita Inc.?
content: With the Contact Management/CRM app by vcita Inc., you can manage leads, contacts, and client records in one centralized hub. Features and benefits include tagging and managing leads, contacts, and client records in one CRM hub; capturing leads and collecting emails; sending instant responses and auto follow-ups; and increasing engagement with a self-service client portal.

title: What does the source say about integrating Wix Retail POS with Wix Bookings?
content: Wix Bookings is integrated with Wix Retail POS. According to the source, you can book and collect payment for appointments, and accept payment for appointments and courses booked online. The source does not describe any additional capabilities beyond these.

title: How can I request a new feature in Wix Studio?
content: To request a feature, go to Discover in your Wix Studio workspace. Click the News Center icon at the top right and select Wix Product Roadmap. Click Request a Feature on the top right. Select the Wix product you are requesting the feature for. Enter a description of the feature you are requesting, including how it works and what it will do. Enter a description of how the feature will impact your business. Click Send. Our team reviews every feature request we receive and then carefully assesses how they align with our product roadmap for potential development. You can also share your vision for the future of Wix Studio and engage with others in the Wix Studio Community Discord.

title: I want to unfreeze the header on my Wix site.
content: Click the header in the Wix Editor. Click the More Actions icon. Click Header Scroll Settings. Select a scroll setting such as Scrolls with site, Disappears, or Fades out.

title: How can I update my old Wix Photo Albums to the new templates?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Album next to the relevant album created before December 2019. In the pop-up, click Let's Go to duplicate the album into the new template. Customize the duplicate using the new template features, click Update in the top right corner to save changes, then click Publish Now to make the album live on your site. After updating, go to your Editor to hide the old version and show the new one on your live site.

title: Does Wix support landscape view on mobile sites?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer support for any issues that may occur when viewing your Wix site in landscape view on a mobile device. Additionally, the Wix mobile apps do not offer a landscape view option. As an alternative, you can build your site with Editor X, which allows you to design your site's alignment and content for different screen sizes.

title: How can I connect an existing .ca domain I already own to my Wix site?
content:
Once your site is upgraded with a plan, you can connect a .ca domain you already own to your Wix site. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via nameservers. With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, which means you can manage them in your Wix account, and if you ever need assistance managing your DNS records, Wix Customer Care can help you.

Keep the following in mind when preparing to connect your domain:
- You will need access to your current domain registrar.
- New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix Hotels site to access additional features?
content: To upgrade Wix Hotels from the Editor: if you have not already done so, add Wix Hotels to your site. Go to the Hotel page in the Editor, click the Wix Hotels app inside the Editor, and click the Upgrade icon. Click Select under the relevant plan you want to purchase, select a subscription period, and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and follow the on-screen instructions to complete your purchase. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you experience any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: How can I resolve the issue of my Channel calendar being blocked or showing 0.00 for prices even though the Wix Calendar is normal?
content: This is most likely because some weekend prices were missing when connecting the Channel Manager. Check that you've added weekend prices for your rooms as well as seasonal room rules. If you want to keep the same prices for weekends and weekdays, input the same value in both fields. Then reload your rates by doing the following: go to the Rooms tab in your hotel dashboard, select each room type, increase both the weekend and the weekday price by 1, click Save, wait five minutes, and reset the rates for each of your rooms to their original prices.

title: How can I create dynamic pages for my blog posts using the Wix Editor?
content: Before you begin, make sure your site has the Wix Blog and you've published posts. Add the CMS to your site if you haven't already. Make sure to enable Wix App Collections in your CMS. In the Wix Editor: go to your editor. Click CMS on the left side of the editor. Click Wix App Collections. If you don't see Wix App Collections, make sure you've enabled them. Hover over Posts under Blog and click the More Actions icon. Select Add dynamic page. Select Item page and click Add to Site. Click + Add dynamic pages. Click the Choose a collection drop-down and select your Posts Wix app collection. Select List page and click Add to Site. Note: When using dynamic pages to showcase blog posts, visitors cannot Like blog posts, and cannot use Share post, Edit post, Follow post, or Comment. Blog titles must not contain the characters: -, +, (, ), $.

title: How can I send a broadcast message to participants of a session using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, then tap Calendar under Booking Calendar. Select the relevant session and tap the Broadcast icon. If it is the first time, tap Get Started. Tap the checkbox next to the contacts you want to message; each contact receives the message individually, not as a group. Tap Next, then tap the channel drop-down at the bottom left and choose how to send the broadcast: Chat sends a chat message to members in their member app such as Spaces by Wix, and you must have installed Wix Chat on your site; Email sends to contacts who provided an email address saved in your contact list; SMS sends to clients who provided their contact numbers, and you must have purchased a business phone number or have a Business Phone Number to send SMS. Compose your broadcast message, optionally attach elements, and tap Send. You must have already invited clients to your booking to send a broadcast; for group bookings, only the member who made the booking can be contacted, not their guests.

title: What should I do if the Wix Music player isn't working?
content: Delete the existing player, then add a new player from the Add panel. Your music is saved in your music library, so don't worry about deleting your player. Don't copy and paste the player itself as you might be also copying the problem.

title: How can I access and customize the mobile view of my ADI site?
content: To access the mobile view, hover over the desktop icon on the top bar of ADI and click Mobile. To change the design of page sections in the mobile view, click the relevant page section, click Designs, and select a new design. To show or hide items in a page section, click the relevant page section, click Edit, and click the Show/Hide toggle next to an item. Note: It is not possible to customize your font size from the mobile view; you can only adjust your text size from the Desktop view. Any changes made in the mobile view do not affect the desktop view of your site. This article refers to Wix ADI.

title: How can I reconnect my Zoom account to my Wix site for video conferencing?
content: When the authorization token in Zoom expires, VC links cannot be generated for your services. Reconnect your Zoom account with your Wix site to get your VC services up and running again. Go to the Staff tab in your dashboard. Click Edit under Video Conferencing. Click Continue in the pop-up window. Select your preferred VC type (Zoom or a Custom Link to another service). Confirm you are connecting the correct Zoom account. Click Connect. Reconnecting your Zoom account only affects the VC link for future bookings. Update the links for your existing services to make sure staff and clients are all in the right place.

title: How can I share my Wix Analytics reports with contributors?
content: To share reports you created, go to All Reports in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant report, select Add Contributors, and click Add Contributors in the pop-up. This will instantly make the report available to all collaborators with permission to view Analytics data.

title: How can I customize the appearance of the Wix Weather app on my site?
content:
To customize how the Wix Weather app looks on your site:

* Click the Wix Weather app in your editor.
* Click **Settings**.
* Click the **Layout** tab to choose and customize your layout:

  * **Extended:** Display the app in full, including info on the location, date etc, and set the display options:

    * **Show forecast for:** Choose how many days ahead you want to display the forecast for.
    * **Show C/F toggle:** Enable or disable the toggle which allows visitors to switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit.
    * **Show wind, humidity and visibility:** Enable or disable the toggle to show or hide more detailed weather information.

  * **Compact:** Display a smaller version, showing just the temperature and set the display options:

    * **Compact display:** Choose to display the app as horizontally or vertically.
    * **Position:** Align the info in the app to the left, right or center.

* Click the **Design** tab to customize the colors, fonts and background of the app.

  **Note:** The design options available differ depending on the layout that you chose.
* Click the **Animation** tab to add animation effects which change according to the actual weather.

  **Note:** This option is only available for the Extended display layout.

title: How can I enable comments on my uploaded videos in Wix Video?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Wix Video player. Click Settings. Click Player. In the Comments section, enable the toggle for Allow on uploaded videos. Comments can be enabled for videos that you have uploaded, but not for videos that are embedded videos from other platforms like YouTube or Facebook.

title: How do I set up a Facebook and Instagram ad campaign using Wix?
content:
Before you create a campaign, make sure you've completed the following setup steps: publish your site; upgrade your site by purchasing a plan; connect a custom domain.

To create a Sales campaign, you must connect a payment method.

Step 1 | Choose a campaign goal
1. Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a goal: Boost sales, Get sales (For Wix Stores), or Generate leads.
3. Click Get Started.
4. Sign in with your Facebook account.

Step 2 | Connect your Facebook assets
1. Click Add Facebook Assets.
2. Go through the steps to add your assets.
3. Click Connect Assets to Wix and go through the steps to connect your accounts.
4. Click Continue to Create Campaign.

Step 3 | Choose your ad settings and targeting
1. Click the Site page that your ad will lead to drop-down and select the page visitors navigate to after clicking your ad.
2. Choose AI targeting or Custom targeting:
- AI targeting: Enter the countries you want to target under Targeted countries, then click Continue.
- Custom targeting: Enter the places (cities, countries, zip codes) you want to target under Targeted countries; select a gender, age range, and audience interests; then click Continue.

Step 4 | Create your ad content
Choose an ad format and follow the instructions:
- Dynamic carousel (Wix Stores only): Enter your ad content; the limit is 500 characters. Optionally view a preview, then click Continue.
- Single image or video: Enter your primary ad text; the limit is 500 characters. Upload media for your ad. Enter an ad headline; the limit is 40 characters. Choose a Call to action button, then click Continue.

Step 5 | Set your ad budget and launch
1. Under Set campaign budget, choose Select preset budget or Enter custom budget.
2. Click Save & Checkout to finish creating your campaign and submit your purchase. If this isn't your first campaign, you won't see the checkout step; click Save & Launch instead.

Your campaign goes into review for Wix and Meta approval. This process can take up to 72 hours. Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads in your site's dashboard to check the approval progress.

title: How can I customize the member login form in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click Signup & Login. To change the default login form to custom, click Member Login Form (Default), choose Custom Form from the drop-down under Which member login form do your visitors see?, and click Add to Site. Then click any element on the form to customize it. Tip: click an element in the form to access the custom toolbar for that specific element. There, you can customize the settings, layout, design, and more.

title: How can I manage my Wix Store on a mobile device?
content: Using the Wix app, you can create store products on mobile, manage store orders on mobile, scan barcodes on mobile, and sell products at a point of sale (POS).

title: How can I customize the design of the Wix Video Player on my mobile site?
content: In the Wix mobile editor, click the video player, then click Settings. Use the Layout tab to choose Compact or Vertical, and use the Design tab to customize the player's menu and action buttons. Click the color boxes to change Background color (the menu background), Text color (the text on the menu), Button color (the button background), and Text color (the color of the text on the button). Make sure your background and button colors are different so that your text remains visible. It is currently not possible to remove or change the color of the black bars above and below the video player, and it is also not possible to resize the player.

title: How can I switch my account to a Wix Studio account if I'm already using Wix or Editor X?
content: If you're an agency or enterprise already using Wix or Editor X, you can switch your account to a Wix Studio account. You'll find multiple entry points prompting you to switch, including through the Sites page in your dashboard, the dashboard of any site you own, the Templates page, and the Account Settings menu. On switching, you'll land on the Discover page of your new Wix Studio workspace and can find all the educational resources you need to get started.

title: Can I connect a drop-down input element to a Multi-Reference field in a collection?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect an input element, such as a drop-down or radio buttons, to a Multi-Reference field in a collection.

title: How can I use the Google Reviews app by Elfsight to embed customer reviews from a Google business or location on my website?
content: Use the Google Reviews app by Elfsight to embed customer reviews from a Google business or location on your website without the need for any coding. The app offers full control over the displayed reviews with advanced sorting, filtering, and moderation; CTA buttons, a star rating snippet, and an AI-generated summary to boost conversions; and ready-to-use templates, layout designs, and review card styles. To get started, check out the Google Reviews app by Elfsight. For questions and comments, contact Elfsight directly via https://elfsight.com/ or support@elfsight.com.

title: How can I set up additional Google Workspace business emails from Wix?
content: First purchase additional business emails. Then, in your Wix account, go to Business Email. Click Show User Info on the relevant account. Click the More Actions icon next to the account you want to set up, and select Set Up User. Sign in to your Google Workspace account by entering your email address, clicking Next, and entering your password. Click Users, then click Add new user. Enter the user details and set a password (optional), then click Add.

title: Can I display the tax amount on the Cart page in Wix Stores using ADI?
content: Currently, if you set up your store using Wix ADI, the tax is automatically hidden from the Cart page until the billing address is entered. If you would like to display the tax amount on the Cart page, head to the Editor and follow the instructions. Important: This tax amount listed is an estimate. The final tax price is calculated during checkout.

title: How can I delete my blog from my Wix site if it is set as the homepage?
content: To delete your blog when it is set as your home page, add a new page. Click the Pages menu on the top bar. Click the Settings icon next to the new page you have created. Click Set as Homepage. Click the Settings icon next to Blog. Click Delete.

title: How do I enable gift cards on my Wix site?
content: Make sure you have set your site currency before setting up gift cards. Then go to the Gift Card tab in your site's dashboard and click Add Gift Card to Site. The option to enter a gift card code at checkout is automatically enabled. Do not disable the toggle after selling gift cards, since it will prevent gift card recipients from being able to use the gift card. To control this setting, go to the checkout settings in your site's dashboard, click Payments, then click the Gift cards toggle to enable or disable it.

title: Can I add custom fields to the login screen of my Branded App?
content: Currently, it's not possible to add custom fields to the member log-in screen of your Branded App. However, you can customize the signup form that appears on your desktop site.

title: How can I select a payment method for selling digital images and prints in the Wix Photo Albums Store?
content: For Wix Photo Albums Store, if you sell digital images and prints, payment is always through PayPal. However, Wix Photo Albums Store is not available to all users, and as of February 2023 it is no longer possible to add it to your site. As an alternative, you can add Wix Stores and connect it to Printful to sell your photos.

title: Is there a vacation mode feature in Wix Bookings?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to set vacation mode in Wix Bookings.

Workaround:
- If you sync your Google calendar with Wix Bookings, add the vacation days in your Google calendar. Note: Wix Bookings does not block off days added to your Google calendar as All Day events. When adding vacation days in Google calendar, make sure to add the times as well (e.g., 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM).
- Manually add the vacation days to your Wix Bookings calendar as blocked time.

title: How can I add media to an answer in the Wix FAQ App?
content: To add media to an answer in the Wix FAQ App: Click the FAQ app in your editor. Click Manage FAQs. Hover over the question you want to add media to. Click the Edit icon. Choose the relevant media from the toolbar and add it to your answer. You can also add media when you add a new question.

title: How can I add a linear gradient to the background of an element in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the relevant element in the Editor. Click Change Background. Click Color. Click the Gradient icon at the top of the color picker.
