Click the dropdown menu and select Linear as the type of gradient you would like to apply. Customize your gradient using the options: Angle: Choose the gradient's angle. Color positions & distance: Change the order of the colors, or bring them closer or further apart. Adjust colors & opacity: Change the color, and increase or decrease the opacity. Add a new color: Click anywhere on the bar that doesn't already contain a color dot to add and adjust a new color. You can also save your gradient by clicking +Add at the bottom of the panel to use it across your site.

title: How do I add a Facebook Comments box to my Wix site?
content: Click Add on the left side of the Editor. Click Social. Under Facebook, click Facebook Comments to add it, or alternatively drag the box to the relevant location. Note: Facebook Comments are saved and displayed according to the page's URL, therefore if you change your site's name or change your domain, the Facebook comments will not appear in the new site.

title: How can I manually add guests to a ticketed event with a seating map using the Wix dashboard?
content: To manually add guests to a ticketed event with a seating map in your site's dashboard: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant event and click Manage. Click the Guests tab at the top. Click Add Guests. If your event doesn't have guests yet, click Or add guests manually. Add Ticket details: Click Select tickets. Choose a seat(s) from the seating map. Click Select Tickets. (Optional) Click + Add ticket to add another ticket type. Enter the Buyer details (first name, last name, email). You can click + Add from Contacts to choose a guest from your contact list. Add the Guest details (If your registration form settings is "registration form for each ticket in an order"): If the guest is also the buyer, select the Same as buyer details checkbox. Enter the first name, last name and email. Click + Add from Contacts to select and add guests from your contact list. Select an Order status (not paid, paid, or free). Select or deselect the Send tickets via email checkbox. Click Save at the top right.

title: How can I set up payment methods for my Wix Store?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Settings, then click Accept Payments. In most cases, Wix automatically connects you to the most suitable provider available in your region. Options can include Wix Payments, Credit Card through a third-party payment provider such as Square or Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Manual. With PayPal, customers can pay by credit card even if they do not have a PayPal account. The Apple Pay button is displayed only to customers viewing your site with a Safari browser on iOS or macOS devices, and you can add Apple Pay even if you are not an Apple user. With Manual, you can accept cash, payment through apps, checks, bank transfers, or any other form of payment that is not tracked online; customers see instructions at checkout explaining how to complete payment.

title: How can I add tags to my videos in Wix Video?
content: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit icon on the video to which you want to add a tag. Enter the tags in the Tags field. Press Enter on the keyboard.

title: Can I connect fields in Wix Forms to CMS datasets to use items stored in CMS collections as choices in dropdowns or checkboxes?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible to connect fields to CMS (Content Management System) datasets. This would allow you to connect the choices that visitors select from in dropdowns, checkboxes, and other fields to items stored in CMS collections.

title: How can I notify customers when an order is shipped using ShipStation with my Wix store?
content: Send customers email notifications with tracking numbers to let them know that their packages are on the way. You can send notifications through ShipStation or through Wix. For ShipStation, sending notifications to customers is disabled by default; learn how to enable and set up customer notifications in ShipStation. For Wix, when fulfilling an order, select the Send Shipping Confirmation Email checkbox. Tip: You can also send an email by clicking More Actions in an order and then selecting the relevant option.

title: How can I access my Wix Stores reports?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. View the reports in the Stores section.

title: Can I change the home page on my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you cannot change the home page on your mobile site. The home page on your desktop site is the same for your mobile site. In the meantime, you can use Velo by Wix to do this.

title: How can I import media files from my social network accounts to my Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click + Upload Media. Select the social network on the left menu. Click the connect button. Select the files you want to upload. Click Upload Selection. You can hold down the Ctrl or Shift key on your keyboard (Cmd key for Mac) and multi-select images to upload in bulk.

title: Why are changes made in the Wix Editor not appearing on my live site?
content: Make sure you clicked **Publish** in your editor, then check your live site to see if it updated. If you're receiving an error when publishing, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve the issue. Also make sure you're using a supported browser, as outdated browsers may display rendering issues between your editor and the live site.

title: Can I change the time limit for guests to complete a ticket purchase in Wix Events?
content: Yes, you can now change the time limit for guests to complete a ticket purchase in Wix Events.

title: Can I customize the page URL for each language version on my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the page URL for each language version. For example, you cannot localize the word "shop" after the second slash in a page URL.

title: How do I schedule multi-service appointments for clients or enable them for clients in Wix Bookings?
content: In Wix Bookings, multi-service appointments are only available for appointments. To schedule one for a client, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click Add, select Appointment, enter the client name, choose the services, date, arrival time, and location, then click Book or Book & Collect Payment. To let clients book multiple services themselves, go to Booking Settings, select Multi-service Appointments under Online Bookings, enable the Allow multi-service appointments toggle, and click Save. Clients can choose up to five services in the same appointment.

title: How can I connect Flow as a payment provider on my Wix site if I already have a Flow account?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Flow. Since you have an existing Flow account, navigate to your Flow merchant's portal where you can view your credentials: Email, Identificador del cliente de Wix and Secreto del cliente de Wix. Be sure to complete the onboarding flow. Copy the credentials, paste them into the Wix Accept Payments tab, and click Connect.

title: How can I add a new booking policy in Wix Bookings?
content: In Wix Bookings, go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard, scroll down and click Booking policies, then click + Add a New Policy. Add your Policy details, including Policy name and Policy description. Select the relevant Booking Rules and choose the timeframe for cancellation, rescheduling, early bookings, and late bookings. You can also enable cancellation and no-show fees, require clients to provide their payment info, allow waitlists for fully booked classes, set the maximum number of participants allowed per booking under Group bookings, and allow clients to book a course after start date. Click Save. You can also add a new policy while creating a new service by opening Booking preferences, clicking the drop-down under Booking policy, and clicking + Add New policy.

title: How can I add and set up a mega menu in the Studio Editor?
content:
To add and set up a mega menu in the Studio Editor:
- Select the relevant horizontal menu in your editor.
- Click Manage Menu.
- Click + Add Item at the bottom of the panel.
- Select Mega menu.
- Enter a title for the mega menu. Tip: This is the title visitors hover over to see the mega menu.
- Click Done.
- Add content to the mega menu: in the Manage Menu panel, click Edit next to Container, then add any elements you need to the container.

Mega menu containers can only be added to a horizontal menu; they are not supported on vertical menus, anchor menus and hamburger menus.

title: How can I permanently delete a member's data using Wix Member Apps, and how long do I have to complete the process?
content: When a member sends a deletion request from any of the Wix member apps (Spaces app, Branded app or Fit by Wix), you receive a notification on your device. The notification includes an explanation on how to delete your member's data from your site's dashboard on your desktop computer. You must complete the request on your desktop computer, as you cannot delete a member's details from the Wix mobile app. Once you have completed the process, your member's data will be automatically removed. When finished, you must inform your member that the process is complete and that their data has been permanently erased. You must ensure that all of your member's data is deleted from the Wix database entirely and carried out within 48 hours of receiving the request.

title: Can customers track their orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, customers can track their orders. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I connect Pay-Easy as a payment method through KOMOJU on my Wix site?
content: To connect Pay-Easy through KOMOJU on your Wix site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right and change it if incorrect. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Pay-Easy, then click Connect next to KOMOJU. If you have a KOMOJU account, enter the Secret Key you received from KOMOJU and click Connect. If you do not have a KOMOJU account, click Create new account, follow the instructions to sign up, and when your account is approved repeat the connection steps and use the Secret Key option. If you already connected KOMOJU and want to add another payment method, sign in to your KOMOJU account, add the payment method you wish to connect and confirm that it is active, then go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to KOMOJU, and enable the toggle next to your desired payment method. Make sure your payment method is active in KOMOJU.

title: How can I create a landing page from scratch using the Wix Editor?
content:
To create a landing page from scratch in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Add Page** at the top of the panel.
- Choose the page template from the options.
- Enter the new landing page name.
- Click **Done**.
- Remove the header and footer from this page:
  - Click the **More Actions** icon on the page in the list.
  - Click **Settings**.
  - Click the **Layouts** tab.
  - Select **No Header & Footer**.
- Optional: Make the landing page your site's homepage:
  - Click the **Page Info** tab.
  - Click **Set** next to **Make this your homepage?**.

title: Is it possible to connect breadcrumbs to dynamic pages in the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect breadcrumbs to dynamic pages. This would allow you to add navigational links in the breadcrumbs element that visitors click to go to dynamic pages created with the CMS (Content Management System). Workarounds: You can create links to dynamic pages from various other site elements such as the menu, text, or buttons. In the Wix Editor, you can connect pagination bars on dynamic list pages that allow visitors to navigate through 'pages' of items.

title: Can I upgrade my Google Workspace plan purchased through Wix?
content: Yes. It is now possible to upgrade your Google Workspace plan purchased through Wix.

title: How can I customize the ways customers earn points in the Wix Loyalty Program to align with my business goals?
content:
To customize the ways customers earn points in the Wix Loyalty Program, tailor the ways to earn points to your specific business goals. For example, if you're hosting an event and want to encourage people to RSVP, create an incentive by offering 50 loyalty points to anyone who RSVPs. Some ways customers can earn points include:

- Becoming a site member
- Purchasing a store product
- Booking a session
- Placing a restaurant order
- Buying an event ticket
- RSVPing to an event

You can also use Wix Automations to create even more ways customers can earn points.

title: How can I connect CXPay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to CX Pay. If you have an account, enter your Merchant ID, API Key, and Secret Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create CX Pay account, fill in the sign up form and click Send. Once your CXPay account is approved, sign in and retrieve your Merchant ID, API Key, and Secret Key. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: How can I customize the SEO Basics settings for my Wix site pages?
content:
To customize SEO Basics settings for a page type in Wix:
- Go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in your site's dashboard.
- Scroll down to Tools and settings.
- Click Go to SEO Settings under SEO Settings.
- Select the page type you want to edit.
- Click Edit next to Basics & social share.
- Customize the Title tag and Meta description fields. You can edit existing variables, add variables, or enter static text. Wix adds variables such as "Page Name" and "Site Name" to title tags for Main Pages by default; for product pages, you can add the "Product Description" variable to the meta description.
- Use the index toggle to allow search engines to crawl and index pages; this applies to all pages within the same page type. Disabling it prevents search engines from crawling and indexing those pages.
- Click Save.

title: What should I do if I don't see Wix Blog in my site's Pages menu after adding it?
content: After you add Wix Blog to your site, check the Pages menu in your editor for the Blog page and the Post page. If you do not see these pages, delete Wix Blog and re-add it.

title: How can I add a Twitch video to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add a Twitch video to your site using the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Video and Music.
- Click Single Video Players.
- Click the Video Upload option and drag it to the relevant location.
- Click Change Video.
- Select Twitch.
- Paste the video URL in the What's the video's web address? field.
- Customize the playback options:
  - Autoplays: Click the toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled: The video autoplays on mute. Visitors can turn the sound on manually. Disabled: The video does not play automatically.
  - Plays in a loop: Enable the toggle to have your video play in a continuous loop.
- Scroll down, and enter a description of the video in the What's this video about? field.

title: Can I group multiple form fields in Wix Forms to edit them at the same time?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible to group multiple form fields to edit them at the same time. At present, when customizing your form, fields must be organized and have their rules edited individually.

title: How can I create a client kit in Wix Studio and invite my client to access it?
content: Go to Client Kits in your Wix Studio workspace, click + Create Client Kit, select a Studio site to create a kit for, and click Continue. Click Add resources to upload your files or choose from Wix Studio tutorial videos. Click Agency details and use the Display details toggle to share your contact details: Enabled shows your contact details as part of the client kit; Disabled does not share them with the client. Click Your client to view recipients, then either click site collaborator to add your client as a collaborator—indicating that you are sharing it with the client so they can view but not edit the kit—or click transfer site ownership to transfer the site to your client. Click Save to send the invite and share the client kit. Your client can access their personalized kit directly from their site's dashboard; clients can view the client kit but can't edit it.

title: How can I change the date and time format for my Wix site to match my region?
content: Go to the Settings tab in your site's dashboard, click Language & Region, and select your region from the Regional settings drop-down. Wix recommends completing the other Language & Region settings. You can preview how dates, numbers, currency and more display on your site.

title: Can I apply a discount to only one product or service on a Wix invoice?
content: No. When you add a discount to an invoice, it applies to all products or services added to the invoice. It is not possible to add a discount to only one product or service on an invoice. You can manually change the cost of a product or service when adding it to the invoice.

title: How can I create a new project in my Wix Portfolio?
content: Go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard. Click + Add Project at the top right, then fill out the project details.

title: How can I switch to a different account with the same payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the payment provider or method you want to change. Then follow the relevant steps for your provider. For PayPal, enter the email address of your desired account in the Account information section and click Save. For Stripe, click Change account, enter your Stripe credentials, and click Continue. For other payment providers, enter the credentials of your desired account in the Account information section and click Save.

title: Can I include information from Additional Info Sections of my Wix Stores products in the Google Merchant Center catalogue feed?
content: Currently, it is not possible to include information from any Additional Info Sections of your Wix Stores products in the Google Merchant Center catalogue feed. Only your product's basic info appears in Google Merchant Center.

title: What are the terms of service and additional policies for using OpenAI through Wix's AI-powered services?
content: Wix uses third-party AI service providers and encourages users to read and understand their policies before using Wix’s AI-powered services. For OpenAI, the source lists: Terms of Service: OpenAI Terms of Service. Additional Policies: OpenAI Usage Policy; OpenAI Sharing Publication Policy.

title: How can I sell event tickets using the Wix Mobile POS on my phone?
content: To sell event tickets using Wix Mobile POS on your phone, go to your site in the Wix app, tap the Events shortcut, select the relevant event, swipe left under Recommended Actions, and tap Sell Tickets. Tap the Add icon to select the ticket(s), then tap Next. Choose how to accept payment: For cash, tap Cash, select a preset cash amount or manually enter the exact cash amount, tap Accept Cash, give your client the change, then optionally select Check-in Guests Now and/or Send Confirmation Email and tap Done. For Wix Payments, tap Credit Card and choose Card reader or Tap to Pay; this method is currently available only in the US and to some users in Canada. Optionally select Check-in Guests Now and/or Send Confirmation Email, then tap Done. For manual card entry, tap Manual Card Entry, enter all credit card details, tap Charge, then tap Send Email to send a receipt or No Thanks. Note that manual card entry is open to merchants using a payment provider that allows manual card entry payments. For Square, tap Card, tap Open Square, swipe the client's card through the magstripe reader or manually enter the card number, tap Open, ask for the client's signature, optionally select Check-in Guests Now and/or Send Confirmation Email, then tap Done. For SumUp, tap Card, tap SumUp, log in to your SumUp account, swipe, tap, or insert the customer's credit card, ask for the client's signature, optionally select Check-in Guests Now and/or Send Confirmation Email, then tap Done.

title: How can I create and manage tasks from a contact card in Wix?
content:
Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant contact to display their contact card. Scroll down to Tasks & reminders and choose what you want to do:

- Add task: Click Add Task and create the task: enter your task text in the Write your task here... field. Optionally, click the Assign to Your Team drop-down to assign the task to a member of your team. Optionally, click Select date to select a due date for the task. Click Done.
- Edit task: Hover over a task and click the Edit icon to edit it.
- Mark complete: Check the circle next to the task to mark it as complete.

Tip: Enable desktop push notifications to receive notifications on your desktop web browser, even when you’re not on Wix.com.

title: How can I add hyperlinks to text in ADI?
content:
To add hyperlinks to your text in ADI:
- Click the text section.
- Select the text you would like to add a hyperlink to.
- Click the Link icon in the text editing menu.
- Select the link type in the menu, and add the relevant details.
- Click Done.

title: How can I share my published Wix photo album on social media?
content: After publishing your photo album, you can share it with your social networks or send an email. In your site's dashboard, go to Photo Albums, click the More actions icon next to the relevant album, and select Share. You can then copy the album link and send it to your clients or friends; click Share on Facebook; click Post on Twitter to share on X (Twitter); or click Send an Email. You can only share published photo albums. Currently, sharing is only possible on Facebook, X (Twitter), and through email campaigns. To request more sharing capabilities, click Vote for this feature in the article.

title: How do I add a slideshow to my site using ADI?
content:
Step 1 | Add a slideshow:
- Click Add on the top bar.
- Click Section to Page.
- Choose a section that contains multiple images (like Services for example).
- Scroll through the different layouts to find one with the Slideshow label.

title: What are the Wix Content Guidelines and where can I find them?
content: Wix Content Guidelines are part of Wix.com's commitment to providing a positive and respectful online experience. They articulate the acceptable content on the platform based on Wix's core values and provide transparent information about content moderation principles. You can find them at https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-content-guidelines.

title: How can I export my reservations from Wix Hotels to Excel or iCal format?
content: To export your reservations, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Reservations tab, then click the Export Calendar drop-down menu and select an export option: Export to Excel or Export to iCal. The file is downloaded to your computer. Only reservations that were made through your Wix site or added manually are exported. Reservations from external sources are not exported.

title: Can I change the text direction to RTL in the Expand Mode of my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the text direction in the Expand Mode of your Wix Pro Gallery to be RTL (right-to-left). The default text direction is LTR (left-to-right). You can however change the text alignment in the Expand Mode.

title: How can I cover a negative balance in my Wix Payments account?
content: You can cover a negative balance in your Wix Payments account by adding funds using a credit/debit card. In your site's dashboard, go to Payments and click Add Funds in the Negative Balance notification. If you have more than one negative balance, select the shortfall you'd like to cover. Enter your credit/debit card details and click Add Funds. If you still have a remaining debt from another payment method group, you can click Add Remaining Funds to cover it now or Later to cover it later. It may take up to 7 business days to process your payment and update your Wix Payments dashboard.

title: How can I view the password protection window on my Wix site?
content: Publish your site, access your live site, and navigate to the password protected page. You can only see the password window on your live site; it does not appear when previewing your site.

title: How can I connect seQura as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to seQura.

If you have an account, enter your Username, Password and Merchant ID, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create seQura account, fill in the registration form, contact seQura at sat@sequra.es to receive your live credentials, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I change my Facebook Ads campaign budget during a campaign?
content: You can change your budget at any time from your Facebook Ads dashboard. Click the Campaign Actions drop-down at the right, then click Edit Campaign. Navigate to Monthly Budget (Step 3) in the campaign setup flow. Drag the slider under How much do you want to invest? to choose a new budget amount. When you increase or decrease your budget, your estimated reach also changes; you can view your campaign's estimated ad views under the slider. Optionally, review changes in Review & Launch (Step 4) and click Edit within a section for additional adjustments. Click Submit Changes at the top, review your payment details, and click Submit Purchase. Note: 85% of your monthly budget goes to ad spend, and the remaining 15% is a Wix fee for running and optimizing your campaign.

title: How can I connect my GoDaddy domain to Wix via pointing?
content:
Before you begin, make sure you have upgraded your site with a plan and added your domain to your Wix account.

To connect your GoDaddy domain to Wix via pointing:

1. Sign in to your GoDaddy account.
2. Click the user profile icon at the top right and select My Products.
3. Click DNS to the right of your domain.
4. Update the A record that has @ in the Name column:
   - Click the Edit icon to the right of the A record that has @ in the Name column.
   - Enter 185.230.63.107 in the Points to field.
   - Click Save.
   If you don't have an A record with @ in the Name column, add one:
   - Click ADD at the bottom right.
   - Click the Type drop-down and select A.
   - Enter @ in the Host field.
   - Enter 185.230.63.107 in the Points to field.
   - Click Save.

5. Update the CNAME record that has www in the Name column:
   - Click the Edit icon to the right of the CNAME record that has WWW in the Name column.
   - In the Points to field, type: pointing.wixdns.net
   - Click Save.
   If you don't have a CNAME record with WWW under Name, create one:
   - Click ADD at the bottom right.
   - Click the Type drop-down and select CNAME.
   - Enter www in the Host field.
   - In the Points to field, type: pointing.wixdns.net
   - Click Save.

Note: It may take up to 48 hours for the DNS changes to propagate (become live) worldwide. Learn more about domain propagation.

title: How can I track chat events on my site using Google Analytics?
content: Connect Google Analytics to your site first. By default, Wix sends information to Google Analytics about these Wix Chat events: Leads, when a visitor submits the contact form in the chat, and Engagement, when a visitor opens or closes the chat window. Google Analytics displays them as: Leads from Wix Chat — Event Category: Lead, Event Action: Chat - Online Form Submitted, Event Label: Chat; Engagement with Wix Chat — Event Category: Engagement, Event Action: Chat - Opened or Chat - Closed, Event Label: Chat. To view the events in Google Analytics, sign in, go to the relevant View, click Behavior, click Events, then click Overview. It can take up to 24 hours for events to appear. Use the Google Analytics Real-Time report to test your events and make sure they are logged. Make sure your use of Google Analytics complies with local data protection regulations; using the service means engaging directly with a third-party service provider, so review that provider's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

title: How can I add animation to my site using the ADI Design panel?
content: To add animation to your site, click Design in the top bar in ADI, select Animation, select an animation type, and click the drop-down menu to select a Page Transition. You can click Preview to see how your site animation looks.

title: How do I add and set up a dataset in the Wix Editor?
content:
### Before you begin
Make sure to add the CMS to your site if you haven't already.

### Step 1 | Add a dataset
In your editor, go to the page in which you want to connect elements to a CMS collection and add a dataset. If you want to use the dataset to collect visitor submissions, choose the form dataset.
- Click **CMS** on the left.
- Click **Add Content Elements**.
- Click the dataset type you want to add:
  - **Dataset:** Add a blank dataset to connect page elements so they can display content from your collection.
  - **Form dataset:** Add a dataset configured to accept form submissions from site visitors.

### Step 2 | Connect the dataset to a collection
- Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select the collection you want to connect.
- **Tip:** Select **Create Collection** to create a new collection.
- (Optional) Click the **Dataset name** field to edit the name of the dataset.
- Click **Create**.

### Step 3 | Edit the dataset settings
- (Velo only) In the dataset settings, edit the **Dataset ID** used to identify the dataset in your page's code, if necessary.
- Click the **Dataset mode** drop-down and select an option:
  - **Read:** Connected elements can read and display content from your collection. The elements cannot modify the collection content.
  - **Write:** Connected elements cannot display content from the collection. Input elements can add content to the collection but cannot modify the collection's existing content.
  - **Read & Write:** Connected elements can display content from your collection. Input elements can add or edit content in your collection.
- (Optional) Click the permission type next to **Permissions** to edit your collection's permissions & privacy settings.
- Edit the **Maximum items displayed** field to determine how many items can initially load in connected repeaters and galleries.
- (Velo only) Select the relevant checkboxes under **Performance**:
  - **Fetch after the page loads:** The dataset's data is fetched only after the rest of the page has finished loading.
  - **Fetch pages using cursors:** The dataset will load initial and subsequent data using sequential cursors.
- (Optional) Add a filter to include or exclude items from the dataset: click **+ Add Filter**, select the **Field**, choose the **Condition**, and if necessary select the **Value source** — **Manual entry** (enter the value in the **Value** field) or **Another dataset** (select another dataset and the field you want to filter) — then click **Add Filter**.
- (Optional) Add a sort that controls the order in which connected items display.
- (Optional) Enable the **Show on all pages** toggle under **Advanced Settings** to use the dataset globally across all site pages.

### Step 4 | Connect page elements to the dataset
- In your editor, select the element you want to connect to the dataset.
- Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
- Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the dataset you want to connect.
- Click the relevant drop-down menus under **Connections** and choose the collection fields or dataset actions you want to connect to each part of the element.
- Click **Preview** to test your CMS connections.
- Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

**Tip:** You can connect text elements to the dataset item count to display the total number of items in the collection, and you can use reference fields to display content from different collections.

title: How can I choose my app's name and icon for my branded app?
content:
Important: You must design your app (e.g., logo, launch screen) before you submit your app for review.

To choose your app's name and icon:

1. Go to the Branded App dashboard in your Wix account.
2. Click **App Customization** on the left side.
3. Click the **Name and Icon** drop-down.
4. Customize your app's name and icon using the following options:
   * **Choose app name:** Enter your app's name under **App Name**.
     
     **Note:** Make sure your app name sticks to Apple and Google's guidelines to prevent it from being rejected. Learn more about the guidelines for naming your app.
   * **Choose app icon:** Click the Add icon under **App Icon** to upload the image that appears in your members' mobile home screens for the app. You can use your business logo or an alternative image as long as it's clear what your app is.

   **Note:** Make sure your app icon does not have a transparent background. Icons with transparent backgrounds will be rejected by Apple.
5. Click **Save & Continue**.

title: How do I copy and paste content between collections in the CMS, and what should I know about content type mismatches?
content: In the CMS, you can copy and paste items and fields within collections and between collections, including from external sources such as Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel. Click and drag to select the fields you want, copy them using Ctrl + C or ⌘ + C, click where you want the cells to appear, and paste them using Ctrl + V or ⌘ + V. When pasting content between collections or other sources, make sure the content type matches the field type you are pasting into. If you try to paste different content types into a collection, you'll see a warning message. If you paste anyway, a Warning icon appears in each field where the content does not match the field type; hover over the icon for more information about the mismatch.

title: How can I fix the issue of the close icon overlapping the menu items on my Wix mobile site?
content: Move your mobile menu to a different position in the header by clicking and dragging it to its new position. It is recommended to place the menu in the top right corner, or you can change the layout of your menu so it opens to the left of your mobile site.

title: Can I integrate Square POS with DoorDash Drive for my Wix Restaurant site?
content: Currently, Square POS doesn't integrate with DoorDash Drive deliveries. If you connect Square POS to your Wix Restaurant site, you'll manage your orders directly from Square POS.

title: How can I accept 3D Secure (3DS) payments on my Wix site using a third-party payment provider?
content: 3DS is supported at Wix. However, each payment provider decides whether they wish to implement 3DS while integrating with Wix. To accept 3DS payments on your Wix site using a third-party payment provider, contact your provider directly and confirm with them whether they have implemented 3DS as part of their Wix integration.

title: Why can't I save my custom voicemail greeting on the Wix mobile app?
content:
Some sites might experience an issue where you are unable to record or upload a custom voicemail greeting for your Business Phone Number on the Wix mobile app. After recording your message and tapping Save, you may see an error message which says, "Voicemail greeting wasn't saved due to a technical issue. Please try again".

Workaround: Record your greeting as WAV or MP3 and upload via the desktop dashboard in your Business Phone Number settings. If your WAV file is over 2mb, convert your file to MP3.

title: How can I change the background of each slide in my Wix slideshow?
content:
To change the background of your slideshow:

- Click the slideshow in the editor.
- Click the arrows next to the slide number to navigate to the relevant slide.
- Click Change Slide Background.
- Choose the type of background you want to add:
  - Image or Video:
    - Click Image or Video.
    - Select a file from the Media Manager or click Upload Media.
    - Click Change Background.
  - Color or Gradient:
    - Click Color.
    - Select from the following options:
      - Color: Select a color from the Color Picker and use the settings to adjust its opacity.
      - Gradient: Apply a cool effect to your slideshow background with a Linear, Radial, or Conic gradient.
      - Fluid gradient: Make your slideshows stand out with a sophisticated fluid gradient.

title: How can I find the URL of a specific page on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click "Pages & Menu" on the left side of the editor, then click the relevant page. Click the "More Actions" icon, then click "SEO Basics". Find the page's URL under "Preview on Google". Tip: You can change the page name appearing in the URL on the "Page Info" tab.

title: Does Wix support an automatic privacy policy generator?
content: Currently, Wix does not have an automatic privacy policy generator. Wix provides recommendations on creating a privacy policy, but it cannot provide legal advice and recommends seeking legal advice. Users in Germany can enable a 3rd party app, Legal Texts by Trusted Shops, to help generate a privacy policy; the app is available from the Wix App Market.

title: Can I transfer a German (.de) domain to my Wix site?
content: It is not possible to transfer a German (.de) domain to Wix. To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

title: How can I submit a project request to get matched with a Wix Professional?
content: Sign in to your Wix account. Go to your projects page in the Wix Marketplace. Click New Project at the top right and select Find me a professional. Choose what you need help with and click Next. Continue filling out the details of your request. Enter your contact details and click Submit. You'll hear back from a Professional within 1 business day. Before you hire a Wix Professional, discuss and agree on the price and payment method. Wix doesn’t get involved in disputes.

title: How do I add my store products to a Facebook Catalog using Wix?
content:
Prerequisites: You must have your Wix online store set up in order to create a Facebook Catalog.

Step 1 | Create a Facebook Catalog
Go to Meta Commerce Manager. Click Get Started. Select Create a Catalog. Select Ecommerce. Click Next. Select Upload Product Info. Select an owner for the catalog from the Catalog Owner drop-down. Enter a name for your catalog in the Catalog Name field. Click Create. Click View catalog.

Step 2 | Upload your products to your Facebook Catalog
Click Data Sources under Catalog. Select Data Feed. Click Next. Select Yes under Are you ready to upload your spreadsheet?. Click Next. Select Use a URL under Choose how to upload your file.

Note: Keep this tab open as you continue into the next step. You'll need 2 tabs open to complete the set up process.

Step 3 | Connect your Facebook Catalog to your Wix site
In a new tab, go to Marketing Integrations. Click Connect under Facebook Catalog. Click Get your Data Feed. Click Copy to copy the URL on the Here's Your Facebook Catalog Feed pop-up. Click Close. Go back to Meta Commerce Manager and paste the URL under Enter URL. Click Next. Set the schedule for how often you want the data feed to be updated. Click Next. Add a name for your data source and choose a default currency. Click Upload.

title: What are the costs associated with transferring a domain to Wix, and are there any additional fees involved?
content: When you transfer a domain to Wix, you are required to purchase a minimum of one additional year of domain registration. Wix does not charge any fees for transferring your domain to Wix. You can view the total price of transferring your domain before completing the purchase. Costs for registering domains vary depending on many factors, so view the price of registering your domain before transferring in the Extend step of the transfer process. You can use your free domain voucher when transferring your domain to Wix. In the Privacy step of the transfer process, you can select Private Registration for an additional fee. When you transfer your domain to Wix, your domain retains any time remaining on its current registration.

title: Can I upload PDFs or music files to my Wix Portfolio?
content: Currently, in Wix Portfolio you cannot upload media types other than images and videos. Some examples of additional media include text files like PDFs, word documents, and music files.

title: How can I create a new category for my services in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Categories. Click + Add New Category. Enter the Category Name. Click Add to save.

title: How can I create a custom alert in Wix Analytics to monitor specific data changes?
content: Go to Alerts and Emails Settings in your site's dashboard. Under Alerts, click + Create New Alert. Set up your alert by clicking the Select a stat drop-down and choosing from the measures grouped by Traffic, Sales, Blog, and People data. In Check every, set the frequency of the alert to daily, weekly or monthly. Choose the relevant option from the If there is drop-down, such as More than or Less than. Enter a threshold in the Number field, then click Save.

title: Can I use K-Net as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer K-Net as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through K-Net and arrange the payment offline.

title: Why is a video in my Wix Video Library unavailable and how can I resolve this issue?
content: A video in your Video Library may be unavailable because you filmed a live stream but do not have enough video storage to post the video on your site, or because you downgraded your site and now have less video storage so the video has become unavailable. You can only post the video once you delete other videos from your site or purchase a higher plan.

title: How can I access the glossary for terms used in Wix Analytics reports?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Reports. Click the report you want to learn more about. Under the report title, click Show report definitions.

title: How can I change the opacity of my background image in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the relevant page in your editor. Click **Site Design** on the left side of the editor. Click **Page Background**. Choose what you want to do: **Preset image:** Select a preset image from the options available. **Upload your own image:** Follow the steps to upload a new image: Click **Image**, click **Upload Media**, upload your image using your preferred method, then click **Change Background**. Click **Settings** on the image background preview. Note: Settings only appears if an image is selected or uploaded. Drag the **Image opacity (%)** slider to make the image more or less visible. (Optional) Click the **Color behind image** color box and select a color.

title: How can I enable desktop push notifications for my Wix site?
content: Go to Notification Preferences in your site's dashboard. For Wix Studio users, click the toggle next to Enable notifications for this site. Click the toggle next to Enable desktop notifications. Important: If your browser settings are set to Block, you will not be able to get desktop notifications. To enable desktop notifications, choose Allow in your browser's settings. Follow the instructions for the browser you are using: Chrome, Safari, or Firefox.

title: Can I play music or sounds on background videos in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, video backgrounds do not play music or sounds in Wix Editor. In the meantime, you can add the video background (a free Wix video or your own video) and add a music element to the page to play the music or sounds.

title: How can I share a CMS collection with another site or template in Wix Studio for enterprise?
content: In the Wix Studio enterprise solution, account owners, Co-owners, and teammates with enterprise dashboard permissions for Manage Organization CMS can share collections. Go to CMS in your enterprise dashboard, click the collection you want to share, and click Share With Sites at the top. Choose Sites or Templates at the top to select the type to share with. Enable the Share collection toggle next to the relevant site or template. If necessary, click Share in the popup message. Optionally, click the All items shared drop-down next to the toggle to deselect any items you do not want to share, then click Close. Repeat the sharing steps to share with more sites or templates, then click Done.

title: Can I change the payment date for an active recurring subscription?
content: You can change the payment date for active recurring subscriptions only. You cannot change it if the pricing plan recurs on a daily basis, you applied a discount to the subscription, or your site language is not set to English. For weekly plans, you can only postpone the payment day. For monthly or yearly plans, you cannot select a date within 5 days of the date you are changing from.

title: How can I change the email address where I receive order confirmation emails from my Wix store?
content: Go to the Business Info section of your site's settings. Scroll down to the Location & Contact Info section. Enter an email address in the Email field.

title: How can I invite people to collaborate on my site using Editor X?
content: To invite people to your site using Editor X, click Invite at the top right of Editor X. Enter the email address(es) of the person you want to invite, select a role from the drop-down menu, and click Send Invite. You can also invite people while creating and managing your roles.

title: How can I mark a room as 'Not Available' in Wix Hotels?
content:
To mark a room as 'Not Available' in Wix Hotels: Go to your dashboard. Click the Hotels tab. Click the Reservations tab. Click the start date on the calendar for the relevant room. Drag your mouse across and click the end date. Click Set as not available. (Optional) Add a note for yourself. Click Save.

Note: Alternatively, you can mark a room as 'Not Available' by clicking Create New on the reservation calendar, filling out the requested information, and clicking Save.

Your unavailable room is grayed out on your reservation calendar. To unblock a room, hover over the grayed out area on your reservation calendar and click Unblock.

Important: This article refers to the original Wix Hotels. If you are using the channel manager, dates marked as unavailable will not reduce the availability on your connected channels. Instead of setting dates as not available, please use manual reservations to block your calendar if you want to also use the channel manager.

title: How do I connect a table to my CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content:
Create a collection and add a table to your page. Then, in the Wix Editor:
- Click the table element on your page.
- Click the Connect to CMS icon.
- Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, select Add a Dataset, then choose the collection you want to connect, give it a name, and click Create.
- Click the relevant drop-downs under Connections to choose which collection fields connect to each column.
- Optional: Link column items to their dynamic item pages or to other locations by clicking the relevant [Field Name] column links to drop-down, selecting the dynamic item page listed as [Collection Name] (Item) or choosing another link option, and repeating for each column item you want to link.
- Optional: Add another column by clicking Add column at the bottom of the Connect Table panel on the right, clicking the Choose column drop-down, selecting the collection field you want to connect, and clicking Add Column.

title: How can I prevent visitors from downloading images from my Wix site?
content: For many galleries, visitors are unable to right-click and save images, but depending on the browser, visitors may be able to right-click and save stand-alone images. To prevent visitors from right-clicking and saving images from your site, you can use the Right Click Protect app. Note that this app does not provide full protection: visitors can still use the print screen function to copy an image, or access images through your site's source code if they know how. The app also does not provide protection for third-party apps; for example, if you add images to a third-party gallery app, visitors might still be able to right-click download if the gallery app allows this function. Another form of protection against downloading or printing images on your site is to watermark your images before uploading them, using an external photo editing program.

title: How can I set up my beauty business to accept online payments using Wix Bookings?
content: With Wix Bookings, you can let clients book and pay in advance on your website with Wix Payments, and Wix supports a variety of payment providers based on your preferences and location. You can also allow customers to pay in installments with Afterpay. For in-person or after-service payments, you can use Retail POS or Mobile POS. You can save clients' credit card details with CC on file, charge manually with cc details, request payments with Pay links, and create and send Invoices. You can also charge deposits at the time of booking if you prefer not to charge the full service fee upfront.

title: How can I improve the chances of getting sitelinks for my website in search results?
content: To improve your chances of getting sitelinks, organize navigation so that it presents a smaller number of options, based on what your visitors choose most. Brand your site with a unique name so that your site doesn't get "lost in the crowd". Make sure your meta tags are accurate. Add useful outbound links so that even if your site was not exactly what visitors were looking for, they do not return to their initial search results. Sitelinks are determined automatically by Google and it is not possible to configure them manually.

title: How can I switch from Dayful to Wix Bookings and what additional features does Wix Bookings offer?
content: Dayful is no longer available as a standalone solution. It is now part of Wix Bookings as a feature called shareable links. Wix Bookings provides more capabilities in addition to customizable booking links, such as social media integrations and additional booking channels, marketing tools, payment options, and more. You can still enjoy the freedom and flexibility to run your service business, get booked, and get paid, regardless of your online presence. When you need to scale your business with a full website, Wix Bookings has you covered. Learn more about adding and setting up Wix Bookings.

title: Can I organize apps into folders in my Wix Studio workspace?
content: Currently, it is not possible to organize apps into folders for easy management within the Custom Apps section in the Wix Studio workspace, as it is possible for sites.

title: How can I edit an uploaded image and save the edited version for future use in Wix?
content: Editing an image in the editor does not save the edited version in the Media Manager for reuse. To save an edited version for future use, use Wix Photo Studio in the Media Manager. Wix Photo Studio allows you to edit images that you've uploaded to your site and save the edited version in your Media Manager. You can add filters, rotate or crop an image and more with Wix Photo Studio. To get started, access Wix Photo Studio.

title: How can I add animation to an element in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add animation to an element in the Wix Editor:

- Click the relevant element in your editor.
- Click the Animation icon.
- Select an animation from the available options.
  * Entrance: The animation only plays once when the selected element appears on the screen.
  * Loop: The animation plays continuously on loop.
  * Scroll: The animation plays when the element scrolls into view.

Tip: You can add animation to a group of elements by selecting the group, and clicking the Animation icon.

Note: Elements in your header will animate only once, during the first visit to the page.

title: How can I improve the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) metric on my website?
content:
To improve the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) metric, consider the following steps:

* **Text-based LCP elements:** Prioritize quick loading by opting for system fonts. If a custom font is necessary, use the WOFF2 format for optimal results.

  **Tip:** In the Studio Editor, enable Default Fonts if your LCP relies on text and includes a custom font.

* **Image-based LCP elements:** Upload images in either JPG or WebP formats. JPGs can offer substantial file size reductions, up to 10 times lighter than PNGs.

* **Other tips:** Keep your webpage design simple and minimize unnecessary content. Place heavy elements such as galleries, videos, and store widgets below the fold to prioritize faster loading for critical content. Avoid animating your LCP elements, as animations like fade-in effects only initiate once your site has fully loaded.

title: Is Alma supported as a payment provider in Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Alma as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Alma and arrange the payment offline.

title: Can I customize the timing, design, and content of the Wix Reviews request email sent to customers?
content: Yes. It's now possible to make changes to the timing, design, and content of the Wix Reviews request email sent to customers. Learn how to customize the review request email.

title: How can I change the length of a page in Wix Editor if it has a footer?
content: To change the height of a page that has a footer in Wix Editor, click your footer, then click and drag the Adjust Page Height handle on the top of the footer to the desired position.

title: How do I create my first forum post on Wix Forum?
content:
To create your first forum post on Wix Forum, follow these steps:

- Publish your site.
- Go to your forum page in your live site.
- Click **Create New Post**.
- Choose what type of post you'd like to create:
  * **Start a Discussion**: Start a conversational discussion with other members.
  * **Ask a Question**: Ask a specific question and get answers directly from the community.
- Add the relevant content.
- Click the toolbar to add additional elements to your post.
- When you're ready, click **Publish**.

title: Can I gain analytics and insights for Wix Table Reservations using Wix Analytics?
content: Currently, it's not possible to gain analytics and insights for Wix Table Reservations with Wix Analytics.

title: How can I move elements between the mobile menu, header, and footer in Wix Editor?
content: To move elements between the menu, header, and footer in Wix Editor: Right-click the element on the mobile menu, header, or footer. Click Move To. Then click an option: Move to Menu Box to display the element in the menu box, Move to Header to display the element on your site's header, or Move to Footer to display the element on the site footer.

title: How can I enable tipping on my Wix Retail POS tablet for customers to leave tips during checkout?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap the Settings tab. Tap the Payment tab. Click the Collect tips at checkout toggle. Optional: Update the default tip percentages. Optional: Click the Allow a custom tip amount toggle. Enabled: Customers can enter a tip percentage. Disabled: Customers can only select one of the default tip percentages.

title: How do I fulfill Modalyst orders in my Wix store?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the relevant order, click Go to Modalyst, and pay the supplier for the order. After payment, the supplier ships the order to your customer. A shipping confirmation email with the tracking number is sent from your store brand. The tracking number, carrier name, and tracking link are added automatically to the relevant order in your Wix dashboard. Sending shipping confirmation emails when an order is fulfilled by a third party can be disabled in the eCommerce Settings tab. If a customer purchases both your own products and Modalyst products, fulfill your own products in the regular way.

title: How can I set up my Wix Inbox profile and outgoing email settings?
content: To set up your Wix Inbox profile, go to Inbox in your site's dashboard, click the Settings drop-down at the top right, and click Profile & collaborators. In the Your profile section, customize your Name, Image, and Email signature; you can use the toolbar to style the signature text. Optionally click Send Test Email to preview an outgoing email, then click Save Changes at the top right. Note: a profile image added here appears alongside outgoing chat messages; to add a profile image to outgoing emails, connect your Gmail account to Wix Inbox or purchase a business email, then edit your email profile image in your Gmail account. To manage your site's email settings, go to Inbox, click Settings, click Email, and in the Outgoing email settings section customize the Subject line, Sender identity (Profile name, Business or website name, or Profile name + business or website name), and Sender address. Click Save Changes at the top right. As site owner, you'll receive an email notification every time a chat or inbox message is received; you can change the email address these notifications go to.

title: How can I access my site settings in ADI to update my business information and manage my apps?
content: In ADI, click Site on the top bar, then click Settings. From your site settings, you can update your business and social network information, optimize your site for search engines, get site analytics, manage your apps, handle your billing history and subscriptions, and access your domain and mailbox settings.

title: How can I access and customize my sales reports in Wix Analytics?
content: To access your sales reports in Wix Analytics, go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and view the reports in the Sales section. You can also check out the Sales Overview to get a deeper understanding of your customers' spending trends. To customize your report, you can customize the data you're viewing and the way it's displayed. You can also save the views you want to return to later. Learn more about customizing your report.

title: How can I add a hotel availability calendar to my Wix site using the original Wix Hotels app?
content:
For the original Wix Hotels, add a calendar to any page of your site to show hotel availability. Customers can use the Show Availability For drop-down menu to select which room they want to view.

To add a calendar:
- Click the Wix Hotels app inside the Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Add-Ons tab icon.
- Click the Add to Site drop-down menu next to the Calendar.
- Select the page you want to place the calendar on.
- Drag the calendar to where you want it to appear on the page.

Use the Tip link to learn how to change the design of the calendar.

title: How can I feature a single product on my Wix Store using a landing page?
content: Use the design capabilities in your Wix editor to build a landing page for the product. Landing pages let customers get detailed information about your product and boost that product's SEO. If you use Google Ads, it's a great place to direct your clicks. Then add one or more Add to Cart Buttons so customers can easily purchase the product.

title: How can I archive an old email campaign in my Wix account?
content:
To archive an email campaign:

- Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage next to Most recent email campaigns.
- Hover over the relevant campaign and click the More Actions icon on the right.
- Click Archive.

To bring a campaign back from the archive, click the Archived tab at the top, hover over the relevant campaign, click the More Actions icon on the right, and click Move to active.

title: How can I set up a charge per person pricing model in Wix Hotels?
content: To charge per person in Wix Hotels: Go to your dashboard. Click the Hotels tab. Click the Rooms tab. Click the Edit icon for an existing room or click Create New to create a new one. Scroll down to the Price section. Click the Rate type drop-down menu and select Charge per person. Add or edit the weekday and weekend price. Click Save.

title: How can I add free media from Wix using the Wix Editor?
content: To add free media from Wix using the Wix Editor, go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Free Wix Images or under Free Wix Videos. Select the media you want to add, then click Add to Page. Tip: To view more options for media files that you like, hover over an image and click the Related images icon. Please note, not all media files have related media available.

title: How do I add and customize a box in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Box, click Container Boxes, then drag a box element onto your page. To customize a box design, click the relevant box in the editor, click the Design icon, select a preset design or click Customize Design, then customize your box using options such as Fill Color & Opacity, Borders, Corners, Shadow, and Spacing. The customization options available depend on the preset you choose at the top of the panel.

title: How can I create a class in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a New Service in the top right. Under Class, choose what you want to do: click Edit below the relevant class template, or click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template. Fill out the Service details: Name; Tagline (optional); Description (optional) — Tip: click Generate AI Description to let AI (Artificial Intelligence) help you create a description; Image (optional); Max participants.

title: How can I add alt text to an image in the Studio Editor to improve SEO and accessibility?
content: Click the relevant image in the editor. Click the Settings icon. Write a short description for your image under What's in the image? Tell Google.

title: Can I export my Wix Store's XML file to publish in external shopping directories like Amazon?
content: Currently, exporting your store's XML file to publish in external shopping directories such as Amazon is not supported. It is also not possible to import your store from another platform using an XML file. However, it is possible to connect your Wix Store to Amazon, export a product list as a CSV file, or import a product list using a CSV file.

title: How can I customize the success message for a new form on my Wix site?
content:
To customize the success message for a new form on your Wix site:

- Go to your editor and click the relevant form.
- Click **Edit Form** to open the form builder.
- Click the **Submit** button.
- If your form does not have a submit button, add a button by adding a **Submit** field.
- Click **Settings**.
- Edit the submit button text.
- Choose between the following options when a visitor submits a form:
  - **Show a message**: Display a custom thank you message.
    - Enter the message you want your visitors to see after submission.
    - Choose between **Custom**, which shows for a set amount of time and lets you drag the slider to set the number of seconds, or **Always**, which appears after submission and does not get removed.
  - **Redirect to an external URL**: Select a URL for your users to be redirected to after they click submit.
    - Enter the URL you want to redirect to.
    - Select whether you wish for the URL to open in the existing tab, or a new tab.

Preview your site and submit your form to see how the message appears.

title: How can I accept card payments using Wix Mobile POS if I'm located outside the US and Canada?
content:
If you are not located in the US or Canada, you can accept payment through the following third-party integrations:

* Square: Available in the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Ireland, and Japan.
* SumUp: Available in Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Switzerland, and the UK.

title: How can I manage my event tickets using Wix Events?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Events, click the relevant event, and click the Tickets tab at the top. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant ticket, then choose Hide to temporarily remove it from your live site, Duplicate to create a new ticket from an existing one, Preview to view a ticket as your guest sees it, Edit Design to customize the ticket PDF to match your event theme, or Delete to permanently delete a ticket. Note: a duplicated ticket cannot be used for a different event. To update ticket details such as the description, pricing, or number of tickets available to guests, click Edit next to the relevant ticket type.

title: How can I view and improve my site's Core Web Vitals using the Site Speed dashboard?
content: Go to Site Speed in your site's dashboard. Site speed data is only available for sites that have received 10 or more site sessions in the last 7 days. In the Real visitor experience section, review the Core Web Vitals: First Contentful Paint (FCP), Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). Labels next to each metric show Good, Fair or Poor; hover over a label to see the range defined by Google. Click Desktop or Mobile at the top to switch between site speed metrics on different devices. Click a tab to view more extensive charts for a specific metric, including its performance over the last 30 days, performance per site page, and distribution across all visitors. The dashboard also offers tips to help you improve performance.

title: What steps should I take if I suspect a payment is fraudulent in my Wix Payments account?
content: If a payment appears as "Suspicious" in Wix Payments, it may have been made without the cardholder's knowledge or permission. You can investigate by: verifying unusually high-value orders, including a face-to-face call if possible; checking the customer's contact details by phone or by searching their email address; comparing the billing address with the shipping address and asking the customer about any mismatch; watching for multiple declined payments or multiple attempts from different cards; analyzing unusual shipping behavior such as overpriced shipping, insistence on rush shipping without sign-on delivery, or shipping to forwarding companies that reship to other countries; and avoiding third-party payment requests for vendor services you do not offer, including Western Union, Zelle, Cash App, or similar money transfer requests. If you doubt the legitimacy of a payment, consider refunding it and holding off on fulfilling the order. If the order involves shipping and has already shipped, USPS, UPS, and FedEx may allow redirecting it; if it involves a Wix Events ticket, you can cancel the ticket before the event; if it involves a Wix Bookings service, you can cancel the session.

title: Can I change the language of individual invoices in Wix Invoices?
content: Currently, in Wix Invoices, it is not possible to switch languages for each invoice you create. You can temporarily change your account language in the Language & region settings of your site's dashboard. However, this affects the language of all your invoices, so make sure to change it back after you've created an invoice in another language.

title: Can members add items to a wishlist in the Spaces App?
content: Currently, members of your site cannot add or save individual products or services to a personalized wishlist on the Spaces App. With Wix Stores, you can add a wishlist on your desktop site. This lets your members keep track of their favorite things by adding them to a personal wishlist. From there, they can refer back to them at anytime to decide what they want to purchase.

title: How can I hide a page from my mobile site using the Wix mobile Editor?
content:
To hide a page from your mobile site using the mobile Editor:
- Open the mobile Editor.
- Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the mobile Editor.
- Click the relevant page.
- Click the More Actions icon.
- Click Hide on mobile.

title: How can I add a container to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Select Containers. Choose a container style (Empty, Designed, or Hover). Click and drag your chosen container to add it to the page.

title: How can I upload my own image to use as a page background in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Site Design on the left side of the editor. Click Page Background. Click Image. In the Media Manager, click + Upload Media at the top left. Add an image from your computer, other Wix sites, social networks or from a URL. Click Change Background. Optional: Click Apply to Other Pages to add the background to other pages of your site.

title: What are the recurring payment limitations for Wix Payments and PayPal?
content:
### Wix Payments
- Recurring payments are only available for credit/debit card payments.

### PayPal
- Recurring payments are only available for credit card payments.
- A merchant must have a PayPal business account to accept recurring payments.

title: How can I create a new group rule in Wix Groups using the dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Groups. Select the relevant group. Click the Settings tab. In the Group rules section, click Add Rule. Choose + Start from scratch and enter the rule title and description, or click Use Template next to the relevant rule and customize the rule's title and description. Click Save.

title: Can I import blog posts from Weebly to Wix Blog?
content: Currently, you can import blog posts from WordPress and from another Wix site. It is not possible to import blog posts from Weebly.

title: How can I customize the Booking Calendar in Wix Bookings?
content:
Prerequisites: Add the Wix Bookings app and create a service.

To customize your Booking Calendar:
- Click the Pages drop-down at the top of ADI.
- Click Book Online.
- Click Booking Calendar.
- Click the calendar section in the ADI Builder.
- Choose what you want to customize:
  - Header: Select the Show subtitle checkbox to add an extra description to your calendar page. Select the Show filters checkbox to allow clients to filter services by location, staff member or time slot.
  - Date & Time: Click the field under Section title to customize the calendar name. Select the Show available time slots only checkbox to hide services that are fully booked from your calendar. Click Edit next to Availability messages to edit the text you display on the calendar if there are no available slots to book.
  - Booking Details: Click the field under Section Title to edit the name for your booking summary. Select the Show video conferencing badge checkbox to show that you offer services online. Click the field under the checkbox to edit the text that appears on your video conferencing badge.
  - Button Text: Click the relevant text to edit the Book online button and the Request booking button.
- Click Publish to make the changes live on your site.

title: Can I disable online ordering for specific menus in Wix Restaurants and create view-only menus?
content: Yes, you can now disable online ordering for specific menus and create view-only menus in Wix Restaurants.

title: How can I add a project to my Wix Marketplace profile?
content: Go to your Wix Marketplace profile. Scroll down to the Portfolio projects section and click + Add Project. Choose the relevant Wix Premium site you've built and click Next. Enter the Site name, Description, and URL in the relevant fields. Click the Update icon under Cover Image to replace it, then select the image you want to use and click Open. Click Add Project. Click Save Changes at the top of the page. You can edit and reorder projects by hovering over them and selecting the relevant icon.

title: How can I create a multi-action automation in Wix Automations?
content: Create a new automation or edit an existing automation. Scroll down to the bottom of the automation editing screen and click + Add an Action. Click your chosen action in the Action 2 section and set up the action using the available options. Click the Timing section to expand it, then click the Choose a time to send this action drop-down to select when the follow-up action should be carried out: Wait between actions or Respond Immediately. To add additional follow-up actions, click + Add an Action and repeat the action setup and timing selections. Click Activate. Note: If you add new actions to existing automations, these actions only apply to instances triggered after you save your changes; for every instance already triggered (e.g., form submitted), the new actions will not be performed.

title: 月广告花费低于几千美元且数据量不足时，AI优化策略应如何调整？
content: 按原文 A3 边界条件：月花费几千美元以下的账户，数据量撑不起统计时按月决策、放宽阈值；新品期目标不是低 ACOS，用新品判断标准；若浪费性支出已很低，继续压 ACOS 会砍到有效流量，先测浪费比例再定预期。结论：适合用 AI 优化，但输出需逐条核对 A3 边界条件（数据量、浪费性支出、产品阶段、广告类型）。

title: Can I select different title and body text styles within Wix Forum posts?
content: Currently, it is not possible to select different title and body text styles from within Wix Forum posts. The first line of a post is set to one default heading, and the body is set to a smaller paragraph style. However, you can customize the type size and font style using the Wix Forum design settings in your site's Editor.

title: How can I view my page's source code in Google Chrome the way search engines do?
content:
To view your page's source code in Google Chrome the way search engines do, follow these steps:

* Open the relevant page of your site in Google Chrome.
* Open the page's source code view:
   * **Windows:** Right-click the page and select **View page source** (or **View source**). Alternatively, you can press **Ctrl + U** on your keyboard.
   * **Mac:** Press **Cmd** + **Option** + **U** on your keyboard.
* Open the developer tools:
   * **Windows:** Press the **F12** key on your keyboard.
   * **Mac:** Press **Cmd** + **Option** + **I** on your keyboard.
* Click the Customize and Control DevTools icon at the top right.
* Hover over **More tools** and select **Network conditions**.
* Deselect **Use browser default** under **User Agent**.
* Select **Googlebot** from the drop-down menu.
* Refresh the page.

title: How can I prevent search engines from indexing my site?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Disable the Let search engines index your site toggle. Click Hide Site.

title: Can I add vertical sections to my site in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add vertical sections to sites in the Studio Editor. As a workaround, you can use a pinned container to achieve a similar effect, making it look just like a sidebar section.

title: What factors should I consider when determining appointment availability in Wix Bookings?
content:
Here is a list of the main factors which affect whether you or your staff are available to accept appointments:

- **Default business hours**: Your default business hours, or your opening hours, determine when your staff are available to take appointments. Make sure these are set correctly to reflect your business's availability.
- **Staff working hours**: The availability of appointments largely depends on the working hours of your selected staff members. You can customize each staff member's hours individually, which can affect availability.
- **Adding one-time changes to staff hours**: You can set custom hours for your staff, either as one-time or recurring appointments. These custom hours override the default ones and can affect availability, especially if multiple staff members have custom schedules.
- **Blocked time**: You can manually block any day or part of a day in your Wix Bookings calendar for you or for a staff member. The times you block are not available for bookings.
- **Synced calendars**: Sync your personal calendars with the Wix Bookings calendar to avoid conflicts and double bookings. Events synced from these personal calendars block off the time on the Wix calendar.
- **Appointment time slots**: You can set appointment time slots at specific intervals or based on the duration of a service, including any time buffers you add between appointments.
- **Time buffer**: Set a time buffer between sessions to ensure staff have preparation time and necessary breaks.
- **Booking windows**: Booking windows let you set limits on exactly how far in advance and how close to your sessions clients can book.

These factors help ensure your live site accurately displays your business's available appointment times.

title: What are the requirements for setting up an individual Wix Payments account?
content:
Before creating a Wix Payments individual account, make sure you meet the following requirements:

* Acceptable identification: A valid (non-expired) driver's license, government issued ID card or passport.
* Address: You need to provide a physical address. PO boxes are not accepted.
* Business description: Include a brief description of your business, stating the type of products or services you sell and their prices.
* Bank account details: The name of the bank account holder needs to match the personal details provided for the Wix Payments account. Please note that only a personal bank account can be used.

While registering your details, make sure that the name in your Wix Payments account matches the bank account holder's name. For example, if you've created a Wix Payments account under Lisa Harrison but the associated bank account is listed as "Lisa's Cupcakes", the transfer will fail.

title: How can I access the Orders tab in Wix to manage subscription orders?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Sales. Select the Orders tab. You can perform all the actions on a subscription order (fulfill the order, add a tracking number, cancel it, etc.) just as you would a one-time order. Information about the subscription appears on the order page. Click View Subscription in the order to manage the subscription, such as updating the address.

title: Can I connect my Wix store with TikTok to sell products?
