content: Currently, it is not possible to connect your Wix store with TikTok and sell your products there. However, an update states that it is now possible to connect to a TikTok Shop using the TikTok Shop third-party app.

title: How can I offer Wix gift cards at discounted prices?
content: Go to Gift Card in your site's dashboard, click Edit Gift Card, and optionally edit any General Info settings. Edit the preset gift card amounts that customers can purchase by typing the amount you want to add, using a comma after each entry, and clicking the x next to any amount you want to remove. To add discounted prices, click Advanced Image and Prices, enter a discounted price next to the values you want to discount, optionally add an image for each gift card value, and click Save. Optionally edit the Expiration settings, then click Save.

title: How can I connect my Meta Pixel to my Wix Stores site so events are sent to Facebook?
content:
Go to Marketing Integrations. Click Connect under Meta Pixel & CAPI. Click Connect to Facebook. (If required) Choose your profile in the pop-up and sign in. Click Continue. Click Continue to grant the necessary permissions to Wix Marketing Tools.

The events you see in your Facebook account are:
- View Content: When a visitor views a product page.
- Initiate Checkout: When a visitor clicks on the "Buy Now" button.
- Add Payment Info: After the visitor added his payment information.
- Purchase: When a visitor purchases a product and is taken to the "Thank-you" page.

title: How can I view and manage my blog post analytics on the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Blog. Tap Analytics. Tap the relevant day range at the top of the screen. Here you can view stats on your post views, shares, most viewed posts etc. Tip: View reports of your Blog activity and Top blog posts to see how your blog is performing over time.

title: How can I display the product price per unit in my Wix Store?
content: To display a price per unit in Wix Stores: Go to Products in your site's dashboard; create a new physical product or edit an existing one; in the Pricing section, enable the Show price per unit toggle; under Total product quantity in units, select the relevant type of unit from the drop-down; enter the total product quantity in units; enter the unit you want to measure by; click Save. The price per unit is calculated automatically and appears on your live site under the product price. After setup, the calculation updates automatically whenever you change the product price, add a sale price, or add product variants with higher or lower prices.

title: How can I restore a previous version of my site using Wix?
content: Go to your site history. Click the Arrow icon next to the relevant version. Review the revision to make sure it's the one you want to restore. Click Restore. Note: Restoring a version erases any changes made after that specific version, and some elements are not affected. Tip: To filter site history, click the Show drop-down menu. You can filter to find saved, published, and starred versions.

title: How can I customize the layout of the member login bar on my Wix mobile site?
content:
To change the layout of the member login bar on mobile, click the mobile menu in the mobile editor. Click **Edit Menu**, then click the member login bar. Click the **Layout** icon. Customize the login bar layout using these options:

- **Avatar size:** Drag the slider to change the size of the member's profile pic on the login bar.
- **Login bar alignment:** Choose how to align the avatar, name, and arrow on your login bar.
- **Arrow icon:** Choose a shape for the arrow visitors click to open the login bar menu. Then drag the **Arrow size** slider to resize the arrow.
- **Dropdown:** Choose how to align the items in the login bar menu, and decide whether the avatar, name, and arrow should appear from left-to-right or right-to-left.

**Tip:** You can move the login bar between your menu, header, and footer by right-clicking it and clicking **Move To**.

title: Can I create tasks directly from site comments in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to generate a task for yourself (or your site / account team) directly from a comment.

title: Can I allow other people or businesses to sell their products on my Wix site?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a feature which would allow other people or businesses to sell their products on your site. If you have a third party app which allows this option, you can add it by embedding the HTML code.

title: How can I customize the look of my Pricing Plans page using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, go to your Plans & Pricing page (click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click your Plans & Pricing page), click the Plans & Pricing element on your page, and click Settings. Then edit the relevant settings:

• Plans tab: select the checkboxes next to the plans you want to display on your site, and click and drag the plans to change their order on your live site.
• Layout tab: customize how you arrange your pricing plans in the Pricing & Plans element, including the alignment, padding and bullet points style.
• Display tab: choose which plan elements to show under Plan Info, add a highlighted plan and choose it from the drop-down, enable the Show ribbon toggle to add a ribbon (e.g. 'Best Value'), and show or hide a disclaimer that notifies customers when the plan renews (when enabled, enter the disclaimer text, e.g. Renews Monthly).
• Text tab: edit the page title, page subtitle, button text, button text for a recurring plan with a free trial period, and the ribbon text.
• Design tab: set the background colors and opacity of your plans, select a font and color for each text option, select and customize a button style, and customize how the 'Best Value' ribbon looks; use the Highlighted tab to customize these for your highlighted plan.
• Add-Ons tab: use the Add to Page drop-down to add a Plan list (a hand-picked list of plans on any page of your site) or a Single plan, and select which page should show the add-on.

Note: Wix does not recommend adding any elements to the Plans & Pricing page, since added elements automatically appear during checkout, hide important information and interfere with the process.

title: Amazon广告的实际每次点击费用（CPC）是如何计算的？
content: Amazon广告的实际每次点击费用按公式计算：second_highest_bid + 0.01 USD，即第二高出价加0.01美元。

title: How can I require visitors to sign up before watching a free video on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Video Library and click the Edit icon next to the video. Under Video Pricing select Free. Open the Viewer options dropdown and choose Sign up only, then click Save. This only applies to free videos. Visitors who sign up are added to your Site Members group in your Contacts, and when viewers purchase a video their email address is added to your Site Members group.

title: How can I change the design of my page in the Wix Editor?
content:
To change the design of your page in the Wix Editor:
- Click Pages & Menu in your Editor.
- Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Page design.
- Select a design suggestion.
- (Optional) Click Customize Design to adjust the design to your needs:
  - Choose a style from the top of the panel.
  - Customize the design with options such as Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, and Shadow. For example, you can choose a color and make the page more or less opaque, add and adjust a border, round the page's corners, or add a shadow and adjust settings such as distance and size.

You should know: Due to updates in the Editor, this option is only available if you previously added or customized a page design. This is not the same as a page background. The page design you choose is only visible in the "middle" section of the page (within the gridlines) while the background spans the full width of the page.

Tip: Due to Editor updates, we recommend customizing the background of your page and sections to make your site look how you want.

title: How can I connect CoinGate as a payment provider for cryptocurrency payments on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect beside CoinGate. If you already have a CoinGate account, enter your Api App Token and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create CoinGate account, fill in the registration form, wait for an email from CoinGate to get your Api App Token, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your CoinGate account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I create a goal in Google Analytics to track events for my Wix site?
content: Sign in to Google Analytics. Click Admin. Under the View column, click Goals. Click New Goal. Select Custom. Click Continue. Enter a Goal Description based on the appropriate category, e.g., Enhanced Ecommerce - Bookings. Select a goal type to be Event. Click Continue. Note: You need to define at least one of the conditions, but it is recommended to set at least two conditions if you use more than one Wix application. Make sure the Use the Event value as the Goal Value for the conversion is set to Yes. Click Save.

title: How can I report a suspicious email that appears to be from Wix using Gmail?
content: If you received a suspicious email that appears to have been sent from Wix, do not click links, download attachments, or reply to the message. Forward the email directly to reportphishing@wix.com and include the full technical email headers. In Gmail on your computer, open Gmail, open the email you want to analyze, click the More icon next to the Reply icon and select Show original, click Copy to clipboard, open Google Admin Toolbox Messageheader, paste your header in the box, and click Analyze the header above.

title: Can I purchase a New Zealand (.nz) domain directly from Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a New Zealand (.nz) domain from Wix. However, if you would like to use a New Zealand domain, you can purchase one from another domain host and connect it to your Wix site. To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

title: How can I connect Faster Payment System as a payment method through Oceanpayment on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Faster Payment System. If you have an Oceanpayment account, enter your Terminal and SecureCode and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Oceanpayment account, fill in the registration form, and click Send. Wait for an email or chat message from Oceanpayment to get your Terminal and SecureCode. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Make sure the currency in your Wix account matches the currency in your Oceanpayment account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: Can I restrict access to PDF files in the PDF Viewer App to certain users?
content: You cannot directly restrict access to certain users for PDF files in the PDF Viewer App. As a workaround, you can place the PDF Viewer app on a Member Only page or a password protected page on your site. You can also display files in the Mini Viewer by clicking the PDF Viewer in your Editor, clicking Settings, clicking the Display tab, and selecting the Mini Viewer option.

title: How can I view the tracking codes on my website using Google Chrome?
content:
Open the relevant page of your site in Google Chrome, then:

- Open the developer tools: on Windows press the F12 key on your keyboard; on Mac press CMD + Option + I on your keyboard.
- Click the More Actions icon at the top right.
- Select More tools.
- Select Network conditions.
- Deselect Use browser default under User Agent.
- Select Googlebot from the drop-down menu.
- Close the Network conditions tab.
- In the top tab, select Network.
- Enter "/tags" in the filter field.
- Refresh the page to see the active tracking codes.

title: How can I customize the design of my Event Details page using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor and open the Event Details & Registration page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Event Pages, then click Event Details & Registration. Click the Event Details element on your page, click Settings, then click the Design tab. From there choose what to design: Text to customize fonts and colors for Header Date & Location, Event Name, Description, Title, Text, Ticket Name, and Additional Info; Schedule text if you added an event schedule; Ticket picker to customize ticket text, card, and shadow settings; Button & links to customize style, font style, corner radius, RSVP button text/background/border, and link color; Background to customize header background, page background, and ticket divider thickness.

title: Can I customize gallery elements in ADI?
content: Currently, you can change gallery types and layouts, but there are some features that cannot be changed in ADI. For now, the ability to customize the gallery elements is only available in the Wix Editor, and not in ADI. To use this feature, head to the Editor.

title: How can I add a sale price to a product in Wix Stores?
content: To add a sale price to one product, select the product in the Store Products tab and enable the On sale toggle. If needed, you can apply a discount to multiple products at a time.

title: How can I add or update an SRV record in my Wix account?
content:
Go to the Domains page in your Wix account. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records.

To add an SRV record: click + Add Record in the SRV section; click the Service drop-down and select the service type; click the Protocol drop-down and select a protocol type; enter the Weight, Port, Target, and Priority in the relevant fields; click the TTL drop-down and select a TTL value; click Save.

To update an SRV record: hover over the SRV record you'd like to update and click Edit; edit the SRV record; click Save.

Important: If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, you must add or update SRV records with your domain host (not Wix).

title: Can I add accordion containers to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add accordion containers to your site in the Editor. Accordions are elements that contain multiple collapsible containers. These containers have their own title and content, and expand when you click them.

### Want a workaround?
If you've enabled Velo on your site, you can collapse elements by adding code. Learn how to collapse elements with Velo by Wix.

title: How can I invite a new teammate to join my team in Wix Studio?
content: In your Wix Studio workspace, go to Team, click Invite Teammates, enter your new teammate's email in the Email(s) field, select the checkbox next to the role you'd like to assign this teammate, and click Send Invite.

title: Can I add a widget to a site as a dynamic page in the installation settings of a Wix Blocks app?
content: Currently in a Blocks app installation settings, you can define that a certain widget is added to a site as a new page. However, you cannot add a widget to a site as a dynamic page.

title: Can I sort files with numerical names in numerical order in Wix Media Manager?
content: No, it is currently not possible to sort files with names consisting of digits in numerical order in Media Manager. Media Manager sorts files by the first digit listed, so files are sorted as such: 1, 100, 11, 12, 13, 130... 20, 200, 21. As a workaround, add 0 or 00 to the beginning of each file name and re-upload the files to Media Manager. On a PC, open File Explorer and select the files you want to update. Click Home at the top left of File Manager. Click Rename. Type 0 or 00 at the beginning of the file name and press the Enter key on your keyboard. On a Mac, use the operating system instructions for changing the name of multiple files at once.

title: Can I automatically assign loyalty points to customers who pay a Wix Invoice?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically give loyalty points to customers who pay through Wix Invoices. You can however, give loyalty points to a customer manually.

title: What does Microsoft Office 365 limit regarding mailbox storage and message size?
content: Microsoft Office 365 limits a variety of services, including mailbox storage, message size, and the amount of sending and receiving. These limits are applied in order to combat spam and improve service performance.

title: How can I disable the pop-up blocker in Microsoft Edge to allow Wix.com pop-ups?
content:
To disable the pop-up blocker in Microsoft Edge and allow Wix.com pop-ups:
- Open Microsoft Edge.
- Click the Settings and more icon at the top right.
- Select Settings.
- Click Cookies and site permissions on the left.
- Scroll down and click Pop-ups and redirects under All permissions.
- Choose what you want to do:
  - Allow all pop-ups: Disable the Block (recommended) toggle.
  - Allow pop-ups only from specific sites: Click Add in the Allow section, type [*.]wix.com in the Site field, and click Add.

title: How can I customize image captions, alt text, and links in Wix Forum posts?
content:
You or your forum members can add image captions and metadata. You can also turn an image into a link.

To customize image settings:
- Go to the forum in your live site.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant post.
- Click Edit Post.
- Click the image in the post.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Enter a caption in the Image Caption field.
- Enter alt text in the Alt text field.
- Enter a web address in the Link field.
- Enable or disable the Spoiler alert toggle.
- Click Save.

Tip: Forum admins cannot customize images uploaded by other forum members.

title: How can I search for a file across all the sites in my Wix account?
content:
To search for a file across all of the sites in your Wix account using the Wix Editor:
- Go to the editor.
- Click Media on the left side of the editor.
- Click Show More under Site Files.
- Click Upload Media at the top left.
- Click the Wix icon on the left.
- Choose a folder to view the media.
- Tip: Click the Search icon to find a file.
- Optional: Select the relevant media and click Upload Selection to upload the file to this site.

title: How do I add the Faire Integration app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Faire Integration app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Review permissions and click Agree & Add. Select a plan from the pricing page. Tip: Every plan comes with a 7-day free trial period.

title: How can I connect airpay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to airpay.

If you have an account: Enter your Merchant ID, enter your Secret Key, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account: Click Create airpay account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from airpay to get your credentials including your Merchant ID and Secret Key, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s).

title: How can I change the layout of the Member Page in the Wix Editor?
content: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click Members Area. Click Member Page. Select the Member Page element. Click Change Layout. Select the layout you like.

title: How can I manage my online store using the Online Store app by Ecwid Inc.?
content: With the Online Store app by Ecwid Inc., you can manage everything from your mobile phone. You can control inventory, order management, and pricing from a single dashboard. To get started, check out the Online Store app by Ecwid Inc.; for questions or comments, contact Ecwid Inc. directly at https://www.ecwid.com/ or support@ecwid.com.

title: How can I add a new breakpoint in Editor X for a specific viewport size?
content:
To add a new breakpoint in Editor X for a specific viewport size:

- Click the Show More icon next to the breakpoints at the top of the Editor.
- Click Add Breakpoint.
- Enter the pixels for your breakpoint.
- Click Done.

Note: You can define up to 6 different breakpoints for each page / master section on your site.

title: How can I fix current issues identified by the Wix SEO Assistant?
content: To view tasks in the Wix SEO Assistant, you must have a Premium plan. To fix current issues, go to SEO in your site's dashboard, click View tasks below Issues, click a task to expand it and learn more about the issue, then follow the instructions to resolve the task.

title: How can I change the currency used to pay for my Wix Premium plan after moving to a new country?
content:
There is no direct way to switch currencies, but Wix provides a workaround for a Premium plan: cancel the Premium plan, duplicate the site, reassign the canceled plan to the duplicate, upgrade the original site from your new location, and assign your domain back to the original site.

Cancel the Premium plan that you want to change: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan associated with the relevant site. Click Cancel plan. Click Cancel Now.

Duplicate the site that the plan is assigned to: Go to the dashboard of the site. Click the More Actions icon and click Duplicate Site. Enter a name for the duplicate site. Click Duplicate.

Reassign the canceled Premium plan to the duplicate site: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Assign to a Different Site and choose the duplicated site. Click Next. Click Assign.

Upgrade the original site from your new location: Go to the dashboard of the original site. Click Upgrade on the left. Click Select under the Premium plan you want to purchase. Follow the steps to complete the purchase.

Assign your domain back to your original site: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Note: If you have more than one domain in your account, select the domain you want to reassign. Scroll down to the Unassigned Domains section. Click the More Actions icon. Click Assign to a Site. Choose a site from the options if there is more than one, then click Next. Click Assign.

This workaround involves duplicating your site, moving the existing Premium plan there, and in the meantime, upgrading the original site from the new location.

title: How can I allow visitors to change their cookie preferences on my site using a Cookie Settings Widget?
content: Go to Privacy & Cookies in your site's settings. Click Get Started or, if you already have a cookie banner enabled, Edit Cookie Banner. Enable the Display Cookie Banner on Site toggle. Select the Add cookie settings widget to all pages checkbox. Optionally, customize your Settings Widget text and position. Once clicked, the widget expands to display the cookie banner settings, allowing visitors to view or change their cookie preferences whenever they wish.

title: How can I add text to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open the relevant page in your editor. Click Add Elements, then click Text. Select a text type: Themed Text for elements that match your template's look and feel; Titles for headings; or Paragraphs for most of the text and content on your site. Click and drag your chosen text element onto your page. The article also notes that the editor uses your browser's spell check when you add text, and if spell check is not visible, it should be enabled in your browser.

title: Can I automatically share my Wix blog posts on social media platforms when I publish them?
content: Currently, it is not possible to share automatically to your social platforms when you publish a post. However, it is possible to manually share your blog or to share individual posts.

title: Why are emails missing from my Google Workspace business email inbox?
content: There are a number of reasons why messages may not arrive in your inbox. If you are experiencing issues receiving emails in your Google Workspace business email, use Google support's email troubleshooter.

title: How can I set up my Google Business Profile for 'Order with Google' in Wix Restaurants?
content:
Before you begin, make sure your site is connected to a domain.

To set up your Google Business Profile:
- Go to Restaurant Orders Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Scroll down to Promotions and Growth and click Order with Google.
- Click Set Up Profile to set up your Google Business Profile.
- Click Start Now.
- Choose how to add your Google Business Profile:

Import an existing profile:
- Click Import Existing Profile.
- If necessary, sign in to your Google account.
- Click Allow.
- Select the business profile you want to import, then click Add.

Create a new profile:
- Click Create New Profile.
- Enter the name of your business in the search bar.
- If your business appears in the list, click your business name, click Next, then click Verify & Manage.
- If you see an error message that says your business is managed by someone else, request ownership of the profile.
- If your business doesn't appear, click Next and choose how your business info will appear on your Profile:
  - Choose a business category: Enter a category for your business and select an option from the list.
  - Add your business details: Enter a description, phone number and site URL for your business.
  - Location: Select a location for your business: At a physical address, Within a service area, or At an address and a service area.
  - Enter your location details based on your previous choice. For example, if you chose Within a service area, select a country and enter a service area.
  - Click Include optional info (photos, opening hours & more) to add more information about your business: Photos, Opening hours, Add attributes.
- Click Submit to Google at the top right.
- If you are not signed in to your Google account, you'll be prompted to do so. If you do not have a Google account, you can create one.
- Follow the prompts to verify your business location.

title: How can I create a test contact in Wix to simulate site interactions?
content: Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click the More actions icon at the top of the page and select Test site flows. Click Generate Test Contact. Optional: choose Copy Email to copy the test email address, or Generate Test Contact to create another test contact. Click Close. You can edit your test contact's details at any time in your contacts list.

title: 为产品生成 FAQ 模块文案、用于 A+ Content 时，应遵循哪些来源与合规约束？
content: FAQ 模块包含 5 个最常见的客户问题和回答，问题来自竞品 Review 中的疑问；不得虚构 Review 里不存在的问题或答案。每个模块文字 ≤50 字，因为 A+ Content 是视觉驱动的，文字只是辅助。文案不得写出产品实际不具备的功能、材质、认证或效果，未提供的属性一律不要出现；涉及疗效、安全、环保、专利的表述需单独标出，提示人工核对。

title: How can I manually verify my domain with Google Workspace using a TXT record?
content: Sign into your Google Admin Console and click Domains. If Domains is hidden, click More Controls at the bottom of your Admin console and select Domains. Click Manage Domains, then click Set up Admin Console next to the domain you want to verify. If your domain isn't listed, click Add a Domain. Click Next and then Continue to choose TXT verification. Copy the TXT record and add it to your domain's DNS records in the TXT Value field. Click Verify. If you receive a message that your domain couldn't be verified, wait at least 10 minutes and try again; it may take a few tries. If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, contact your domain host and ask them to add the TXT record on their end.

title: Can I use the Wix Mobile POS to sell pricing plans outside of the US and Canada?
content: This feature is available only for Wix Payments users in the US and Canada.

title: What should I do if I'm not seeing push notifications from the Wix app on my device?
content:
If you can't see push notifications on your device's notification screen, try the following steps:

- Make sure you have enabled push notifications for the Wix app in the general notification settings of your phone. This differs from one device to another.
- Check your site notification settings in the Wix app:
  - Go to your site in the Wix app.
  - Tap your profile icon at the top.
  - Tap **Notification Settings** under **App Settings**.
  - Select your site from the list (if you have more than one).
  - Enable the **Allow Push Notifications** toggle to allow site notifications to your mobile device.
  - (Optional) Manage the notification settings for the apps on your site by enabling or disabling the toggle next to the app's name.

**Note:** If you had both Spaces by Wix and the Wix app downloaded and stopped receiving push notifications after uninstalling the Wix app, re-download the Wix app and try again.

title: Can I add multiple pickup locations for online orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, you can set up one pickup location for online orders on your live site. However, it is not possible to add more than one pickup location.

title: How do I connect Kashier Payment Solutions as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to Kashier Online Payments.

If you have an account: enter your Merchant ID, API Key & Secret Key, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account: click Create Kashier Payment Solutions account and fill in the information to create your account. Once your account is created, retrieve your credentials (Merchant ID, API Key & Secret Key) from Kashier Payment Solutions. Return to this window (repeat steps 1-4), and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Note: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Kashier Payment Solutions account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined.

title: Can I customize the delivery instruction fields for orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It is possible to customize the delivery instruction fields on the restaurant order form. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I add Wix Site Search to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of your editor. Search for the Wix Site Search app in the search bar, then click Add to Site. When you add Wix Site Search to your site, a search bar is added to your site's header. Another page called "Search Results" is also added to your site.

title: What steps can I take to ensure my Wix site complies with the CCPA regulations?
content: The CCPA aims to protect the consumer rights of California residents. To help you comply with the regulation(s) relevant to your site, use the Wix Privacy Center. The CCPA covers the right to access, the right to be deleted, and the right to opt-out of the sale of personal information.

title: 涉及具体法规条款或税率变动时，AI生成的合规清单能否直接对外使用？
content: 不能直接对外使用：涉及具体法规条款、税率、生效日期时，输出必须标注“需回官方来源核对”；若场景是“需要可担责的法律意见”，应找律师或专业顾问；适合用 AI 辅助，但所有对外/担责输出必须经人工复核或官方来源核对。

title: Can I schedule the availability of specific menu sections or items in the Wix Restaurant Orders app?
content:
No. It is currently not possible to schedule the availability of specific menu sections or individual menu items on certain days or at specific times using the Wix Restaurant Orders app. All menu sections and items appear by default in your online ordering menu.

Workarounds:
* Set items as "out of stock" so they are not available for online ordering.
* Limit a menu's availability to display it for online ordering at specific timeframes.

title: Can I set individual modifiers as 'out of stock' in the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app?
content: Yes. You can now set individual modifiers as 'out of stock' in the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.

title: Can I use coupons for Wix Events at a mobile POS?
content: It is not currently possible to accept coupons with Wix Events at a mobile POS. You can vote for the ability to accept coupons with Wix Events.

title: How can I permanently delete music files from my Wix Music library?
content:
To permanently delete music files:
- Go to Music Library in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant album, single or playlist.
- Hover over the + Add Tracks.
- Click Select Tracks to open the Music Media Manager.
- Hover over the relevant track and click the More Options icon.
- Click Move to Trash.
- Click Trash on the left.
- Hover over the relevant track and click the More Options icon.
- Click Permanently Delete.
- Select the checkbox next to I'm sure I want to delete it.
- Click Permanently Delete.

title: Can I remove or hide Wix Chat from the Quick Action Bar on my mobile site while keeping it on my desktop site?
content: When you add Wix Chat to your desktop site, it's automatically added to the Quick Action Bar on your mobile site. Currently, it is not possible to remove or hide it from the Quick Action Bar while keeping it on your desktop site.

title: How do I set up the countdown clock on my Wix site after adding it?
content:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added the Countdown Clock app to your site using the Wix Editor or Studio Editor.

To set up your countdown clock:

- Select the Countdown Clock in your editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Select countdown type** drop-down and select an option:
  * **Fixed:** Your countdown clock runs once, until a specific date and time. Enter the end date and select your time zone.
  * **Repeats:** Your countdown clock runs multiple times, i.e. every day, week or month. Select when your clock restarts, enter start and end times and select your time zone.
  * **Set per visitor:** Your countdown is specific to the visitor that's seeing it and starts when the visitor lands on the page. Choose the unit of time you want to use and the duration of the countdown.
- Click the **End Message** tab.
- Click the **Show message** toggle to enable or disable it:
  * **Enabled:** A message appears to show that the special event or sale has ended. You can click the text box in the app widget to change the text that is displayed.
  * **Disabled:** The clock remains at 00:00:00:00 and no message is displayed.

title: Can Wix's Site Search search galleries with titles and descriptions alongside images?
content: No. While Wix’s Site Search searches your website, currently it cannot search galleries with titles and descriptions alongside images.

title: How can I add and organize a staff members widget on my site?
content:
Note: The staff members widget is not yet available in Wix Studio.

To add a staff members widget to your site:
- Go to your editor.
- Go to the page where you want to add the staff members widget.
- Click Add on the left side of your editor.
- Click Bookings.
- Click Staff Members.
- Click or drag the staff members widget to add it to your page.

To organize the staff list in the staff members widget:
- Click the staff members widget in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Staff.
- Reorder the staff list: Click and drag the panel next to each staff member to reorder the list.
- Hide a staff member from the widget: Click the More Actions icon and select the Hide icon next to the relevant staff member.
- Show a hidden staff member: Click the More Actions icon and select the Show icon next to the relevant staff member.

title: How can I connect Pay-Easy as a payment method through GMO-Epsilon on my site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Pay-Easy, then click Connect next to GMO-Epsilon. For an existing GMO-Epsilon account, enter your Contract Code and click Connect. The Contract Code is the same one you use to log in to your GMO-Epsilon account. For a new GMO-Epsilon account, click Create GMO-Epsilon account, follow the instructions on the GMO-Epsilon website to complete your account setup, and once your new account is approved and valid, look for an email from GMO-Epsilon and copy your Contract Code. Return to the Accept Payments tab and complete the steps under Existing GMO-Epsilon account to connect.

title: Can I increase the amount of categories visible in the Wix Blog dashboard?
content: Currently, it is not possible to increase the amount of categories visible in the dashboard. A maximum of 100 categories can be created / seen in your dashboard. A maximum of 50 categories can be created / seen in the Editor.

title: How can I customize a box that was carried over from my desktop site to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the mobile editor, click the box. You can either add an animation by clicking the Animation icon and selecting an animation, optionally clicking Customize to adjust the animation settings, or hide the box by clicking the Hide Element icon. To unhide an element, click the Hidden on Mobile icon on the left of the mobile editor, then click Show next to the relevant element.

title: How can I connect a text element to a CMS expression in the Wix Editor?
content: In your Editor, click the element you want to connect to the CMS (e.g. text, button, gallery). Click the Connect to CMS icon. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click Create a New Dataset, then choose the collection you want to connect. Click the relevant drop-down under Connection options and select Expression. Click the Expression field. Enter the name of the function you want to use (e.g. CONCAT, DATE, TEXT). Tip: Once you start typing, you can select from a list of possible functions to use. Type an opening parenthesis: ( Enter the field IDs or values you want to use in the expression. As you type, a list of matching field IDs that you can select from appears. Type a closing parenthesis: )

title: Can customers pre-order products in Spaces by Wix?
content: Currently, if you've set up the ability to allow customers to pre-order products that are out of stock, that option is not available to customers in Spaces by Wix.

title: How can I verify my site with Web of Trust?
content: You must connect a domain to your site in order to verify it with Web of Trust. Then go to Web of Trust and sign up. Enter the claim-site link with your site URL, claim and verify, copy the meta tag code, go to Tracking & Analytics in your site's dashboard, click + New Tool, choose Verification Code, paste the meta tag code, click Apply, then return to Web of Trust and click Verify. After verifying your site, other Web of Trust users must rank your site and mark it as safe for it to be marked as safe by Web of Trust.

title: How can I upload my own fonts to the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Go to the Brand Studio. Click the My Logos & Brands drop-down at the top. Select the relevant brand. Click Edit Logo. Click the relevant text element of your logo. Click Change Font. Click Upload Fonts. Click Upload Fonts in the Manage your fonts popup and add the font from your computer. Click Done. You can only upload fonts in a TTF format. If your font is in a different format, convert the original file to TTF using an online converter.

title: How can I convert a dynamic page to a regular static page in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Wix Editor. Click Dynamic Pages. Hover over the relevant dynamic page and click the More Actions icon. Click Remove connections. Click Remove to confirm. This deletes every connection between the page elements and your CMS collection. The previously dynamic page elements become static, allowing you to click to edit their content. After converting to static, you can convert the page back to a dynamic page, but you'll need to reconnect each element manually.

title: Can I add links to lightboxes in the Rich Content Editor?
content: Currently, in the Rich Content Editor, it is not possible to add links to your site's lightboxes. This would allow you to create links in Rich Content fields used in blog posts and the CMS (Content Management System) that, when clicked, open lightboxes on your site.

title: Can customers redeem their loyalty points at checkout?
content: Yes, it's now possible for customers to redeem their loyalty points when they reach a site's checkout.

title: How can I customize the printed receipts in Wix Retail POS?
content:
Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap Settings. Tap Receipt on the left menu. Tap Customize Your Receipt. Then add any of the following to your receipt:

- Business name and website address: Enter your business's name under Business Name and add your site's URL under Website.
- Logo: Tap Add Images, select your logo from the Media Manager, and tap Choose. Your logo appears in grayscale on the receipt.
- Employee name: Click the Employee name toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, the receipt displays the name of the team member logged into the POS (e.g., Sold by Julie Kennedy). You can edit the "Sold by" text.
- Address: Click the Address toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter your business address.
- Return policy: Click the Return Policy toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter the policy.
- Custom text: Click the Custom Text toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter a message (e.g., Thank you for your purchase).

When you're finished customizing your receipt, tap Save at the top right. You can view a preview of a sample receipt on the right of the screen or tap Print Test Receipt to print a receipt using your receipt printer.

title: How can I connect Grow by Meshulam as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Grow by Meshulam as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Grow by Meshulam.
- If you have a Meshulam account, enter your Licensed Business, Password and Installments, then click Connect.
- If you do not have an account, click Create grow by meshulam account, register for a Meshulam merchant account, and once approved use the unique Licensed Business, Password and Installments credentials provided. Return to Accept Payments and follow the account-connection steps above.

title: Are accessibility features supported on sites built with ADI?
content: Currently, accessibility features are not available on sites built with ADI. To build an accessible website, switch to the Wix Editor.

title: How can I save a filtered view in the Wix Channels Dashboard?
content: Apply filters to your site list to create a filtered view. Then click Save View while in that filtered view to add a shortcut for future reference. Once saved, you can return to the filtered view at any time.

title: How can I rename my site using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile App. Tap Edit. Tap Change Header Design. Tap Customize. Enter the new site name under Title. Tap Save. Changing the name in the Wix app also updates it in your site dashboard. You can also edit the details and design of your header, such as adding a tagline, your business logo and a cover photo.

title: How can I edit my logo using the Wix Logo Maker after I've created it?
content: After creating your logo, you may want to go back and make some changes. Using the Wix Logo Maker, you can edit an existing logo and change whatever you need to make it suit your brand – the fonts, colors, symbols, images and more. If you decide to finalize and purchase your design, the editing options available to you after the initial download depend on the Wix Logo Maker plan you choose. Learn more about editing your logo in the logo maker.

title: What are the steps to change the name of a page in the Wix Editor?
content:
To rename a page in the Wix Editor: Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor. Click the relevant page. Click the **Show More** icon. Click **Rename**. Enter the new page name. Click **Done**.

**Important:** As your site menu displays your page names, changing the name of a page also changes the text on your site's menu.

title: Why are videos and animations not playing on my live site, and how can I fix it?
content:
Videos and animations may not play on a live site because of operating system settings used by you or your visitors. There are two settings that can prevent animation and videos from playing: Reduced Motion and Best Performance.

Reduced Motion stops animations and videos from playing in the browser. It is an accessibility feature intended for visitors with disabilities and certain conditions, such as motion sickness. It is available on most operating systems; you and your visitors can deactivate it from the device to see effects, motion, and animation on the site. Note that Reduced Motion is also automatically enabled for some mobile devices in low battery / power saving mode.

On Windows, the Adjust for best performance setting can affect visual effects like animated elements and videos. To change performance settings, enter "Performance" into the Windows search box, select "Adjust the appearance and performance of Windows", select the "Visual Effects" tab, and choose an option. For visitors to see animations and videos play on the live site, they should select "Adjust for best appearance".

title: How can I customize the URL structure of my Wix Stores product pages in SEO Settings?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Select the page type that you want to edit. Click Edit beside Page URL. Customize your URL under URL Structure. Select or deselect the Automatically redirect all traffic box checkbox: Selected lets Wix set up automatic redirects for your pages; Deselected means you manually set up your own redirects. Click Save, then click Confirm Changes. You can add variables to your URL structure by clicking +Add Variable, and your URL structure must include at least one variable. Search engines like Google recommend using a simple structure that is easily understandable to your site visitors.

title: How can I resolve the issue of incorrect color contrast calculation when text is placed on a container box in the Accessibility Wizard?
content:
If you place text on top of a container box without attaching it to the container, the color contrast calculation is not correct. As a result, you may see a card flagging an issue with the contrast. This is because the Wizard does not recognize the container as the background, and instead calculates the contrast based on the background that the container is on (e.g. a strip or section). In order to resolve this issue, you need to attach the text to the container box.

To attach text to a container: select the relevant text box in your editor; drag it outside of the box and drop it on the section / strip; click the text box again and drag it to your desired position into the container box; drop the text when you see the Attach to Box message.

title: How can I adjust the size of an image in Editor X?
content: Click the image in your Editor, then click the Inspector panel icon at the top right. Under Size, choose Fixed to set the width and height of your element in px, or Fluid to use relative units of measure (% or Auto) to define your element's width and height. To automatically adjust the height according to the width, select the Scale proportionally checkbox. Note: It is not possible to adjust the sizing of an image that's stretched to a grid cell, container or section. The height and width of a stretched image are set to auto, so it resizes automatically according to the dimensions of the parent element.

title: How can I reactivate a canceled Premium or Studio site plan?
content: You can reactivate a canceled site plan before the subscription ends by turning auto renew back on. If the subscription has already ended, you can purchase a new plan. Site plans canceled during the 14-day money back period are canceled immediately and cannot be reactivated by turning auto renew back on; you can upgrade the site again to purchase a new plan.

title: Can I use one Wix site plan for multiple sites in my account?
content:
No, a site plan cannot be used for multiple sites. Each site you want to upgrade must have its own Premium or Studio site plan. If you wish to apply premium features, such as connecting your own domain, to more than one site, you must purchase additional upgrades. There is no limit to the number of Premium or Studio plans you can add to your account. There is also no limit to the number of sites you can create under a single account.

Tip: You can transfer a site plan from one site to another, or transfer a site together with a site plan to another Wix account.

title: How can I create a discount coupon for my pricing plans on Wix?
content:
To create discount coupons for your pricing plans:

- Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon at the top.
- Click Create a coupon.
- Select the type of coupon: $ Discount for a fixed monetary discount amount, or % Discount for a percentage discount.
- Enter the Coupon code clients use to redeem the coupon.
- Enter the Coupon name for your own records.
- Click the Apply to drop-down and choose All plans or Specific plan; for Specific plan, select the relevant plan from the Pricing plan drop-down. You can enter the name of a plan if it doesn't appear right away.
- Choose how the coupon works with your pricing plans: First billing cycle, All billing cycles, or Custom. If your pricing plan is set to one-time payment, these options work as a single discount.
- Select the dates the coupon is valid between.
- Optionally select Limit the total number of uses for this coupon and enter the number of times it can be used.
- Optionally select Limit to one use per customer.
- Click Create Coupon.

After creating the coupon, click Coupons in Marketing & SEO in your site's dashboard to manage it. You can share coupons by sending an email campaign with your coupon code or sending coupons to clients directly from your Wix Inbox.

Note: Discount coupons for Pricing Plans cover the plans themselves, but not any setup fees you may have enabled.

title: How can I invite a client to join my site in Wix Studio?
content: Go to Sites in your Wix Studio workspace. Hover over the Collaborators icon on the relevant site. Click Invite People. Enter your client’s email address. Select the checkbox next to the relevant role/s. Click Send Invite. In the pop-up that appears, select Client and click Done. This collaborator will be marked as "CLIENT" in your Roles & Permissions table. The invitation email they receive and landing page they reach will be tailored to the client experience. You can change a client's role or remove their access at any time. Note that your clients cannot duplicate a site built with the Studio Editor unless they also use Wix Studio.

title: Can I attach a VideoBox to items in a Repeater in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to attach a VideoBox to items in a Repeater / Slideshow Repeater. As an alternative, you can attach a single video player to repeater items, or display videos in a Pro Gallery with the Slideshow / Slider layout.

title: Can I change the currency for each individual invoice in Wix Invoices?
content: Currently in Wix Invoices it is not possible to change the currency for each invoice you create. You can change your invoice currency in the Settings tab of your dashboard, but this applies to all your invoices.

title: Which users can purchase a Wix Premium or Studio site plan using Sofort?
content: Users in Austria, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands and Spain can purchase a Premium or Studio site plan using Sofort.

title: Can I upload SVG files to the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Currently, it is not possible to upload SVG files to the Wix Logo Maker. You can however, upload PNG and JPEG files.

title: How can I sync my Wix Hotels reservation calendar with an external calendar service like Google Calendar or Airbnb?
content: You can use the "Sync Wix Hotels with an external calendar" option, which allows you to sync your Wix Hotels reservation calendar with any other service that uses iCal, for example, Google Calendar, Airbnb or VRBO. You can also use the Wix Hotel Channel Manager. Important: Using both these services at once is not supported and can cause the sync with your channels to fail, potentially leading to overbookings. Before connecting the Channel Manager, make sure you have deleted all URLs from the iCal tab.

title: How can I add my business information to my Wix site to improve search engine results?
content: Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard. In the Profile section, add your business or website name, select the closest category match, upload a logo through the Media Manager, and add a short description that appears in search engine results. In the Location and Contact Info section, start typing your address and select it from the list; if needed, edit country, apartment/suite, city, and postal code. Add a location name and an address description to help customers find your business. In the Contact info section, add email, phone, fax, business hours, and time zone. Click Save. Adding your business name and location creates Local Business structured data markup for your site's homepage, which can help improve your website's search results and ranking.

title: How can I customize the reset password email for my site members on Wix?
content: To customize the reset password email, go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click the Installed for you tab, find the automation titled Send site members a reset password email, click the More Actions icon next to it, and select Edit. Scroll down to Action 1 (Send an email) and click Edit in the Create an email section. Edit the email contents: for the subject line, click Edit next to it and use + Personalize to add a dynamic value; for text, click the text element(s) and adjust the text, then use the left panel for formatting or design; for a button, click it and use the left panel to edit content or design; use Add in the left panel to add elements; use Themes in the left panel to personalize the theme; use Background in the left panel to update the background. Optionally click Preview & test to generate a preview and send yourself a test email. Click Save & Continue when done customizing, then click Save to save the automation. Make sure to keep the email type Business critical so password reset emails are sent regardless of members' consent to receive promotional emails.

title: How can I update my Velo package and install the updated version on a Wix site?
content:
Step 1 | Update the Package
Open a Wix or Editor X site. Make sure Dev Mode is enabled. Use one of these approaches to open your package for editing:
- Click the More Actions menu for the package you want to update, and click Edit Package.
- Click the More Actions menu next to the Packages section and then click Manage Installed to open the Package Manager. Then, in the Package Manager, click the More Actions menu of the package you want to update and click Edit Package.
Make your changes. We recommend you complete the Release notes section to explain to package users what changes were made in the release. The release notes appear in the Package Manager under each version you build.
Save and Build your package. When you build your package, choose the appropriate type of version - minor or major.

Step 2 | Install the Updated Package on a Site
Open the Wix or Editor X site on which you installed the package (if the site is open, refresh the editor). Make sure that Dev Mode is enabled. Note the update notification. Click See Update from the more menu. This opens the Package Manager. Click the Update to <version> button.

If you add or update an events.js file in the backend files of your package, republish the site after you install the updated version of the package.

title: How can I add a WhatsApp button to my website using the Studio Editor?
content: Open the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side, click Buttons, and drag a button to the desired location. Optionally change the button text and icon. Click the Link icon, select Web address, then choose whether the link includes an automated first message. For an automated message, enter the WhatsApp send address with the full international phone number, add the text parameter for your message, and use '%20' for spaces. For a link without a message, enter the WhatsApp send address with the full international phone number. Omit zeros, brackets, and dashes from the phone number. Select whether the link opens in a new window or the current one, then click Done. You can also use any other linkable element such as text, shapes, or media.

title: Im having trouble changing the browser tab title on my live site. I followed the steps provided, but its still not working.
content: To change the browser tab title for your live site in the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO basics, enter the page title under Title tag, and publish your site. If you see an incorrect browser tab title, adding custom code to your site may affect it. Try removing any custom code you added to your site.

title: How can I add and set up the Site Badges app using the Wix Editor?
content: To add and set up the Site Badges app using the Wix Editor: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Site Badges app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Click the app in your editor and click Settings. Click Set Up Badge. Scroll through the available badges or click the Choose Category drop-down to narrow down your search. Select the badge you want to add. Click the Settings tab. Choose where the badge should link to: None, Page, or Web Address. For Page, click the Which page? drop-down to select the relevant page. For Web Address, enter the URL in the What's the web address (URL)? field. Edit the text that appears on the badge. The design options differ depending on which badge you choose. To use your badge on a different page, you can cut and paste the app to move it to another page on your site.

title: How can I issue a refund to a customer using Wix Payments on a desktop?
content: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click on the payment to refund. Click Refund. Enter the amount to refund and a note if needed. Click Refund.

title: How can I clear my browser's cache on a mobile device to improve my Wix Editor experience?
content: To clear cache on your mobile device, follow the relevant instructions below: on Android, clear cache & cookies; on iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch, clear the history and cookies from Safari.

title: Can I adjust the height of form fields in Wix Forms?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the height of form fields in Wix Forms. Field height automatically adjusts depending on the font size.

title: How can I report an abusive Wix site that I have encountered?
content: If you encounter any Wix sites that you believe to be abusive (other than Electronic Spamming), you can file a complaint.

title: How can I request a payment from a customer using Wix Inbox?
content: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click an existing conversation, or click Compose at the top right to start a new one. Click the text box at the bottom to start typing your message. Click the Message via drop-down to select the channel to send your message through. Click the Request Payment icon. Set the amount and write a short description for your request. Click Send Request. Make sure you're ready to accept payments through Wix Inbox by connecting a payment method to your site.

title: How can I connect iCredit as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check that your business location at the top right is set to Israel. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to iCredit. If you have an account, enter your Username, App Id, Creditbox Token and GroupPrivate Token, optionally enable and set installment payments, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create iCredit account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from iCredit to get your Username, App Id, Creditbox Token and GroupPrivate Token credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I create a standard automatic discount in Wix Stores?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Automatic Discounts. Click Create Discount. Select Standard discount and click Continue. Enter the discount name. Select what the discount applies to: All products, Specific products, or Specific categories. Optionally create minimum requirements by selecting Minimum quantity of items or Minimum order subtotal. Select the type of discount from the What is the discount? drop-down and enter the required percentage, amount, or price. Select the date and time when the discount starts. Optionally select Set an end date and time checkbox and choose the end date and time. Select where customers see the sale name and details, then click Save.

title: Can I hide the view counters and likes on my posts?
content: Yes. You can choose whether you want to display or hide the counters, which indicate how many comments and likes each post has. Go to your editor. Go to your Blog page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Blog Pages, click your Blog page. Click Settings, click the Display tab. Deselect the comments counter. Deselect the likes counter. Tip: If you decide you want to display them again, you can enable them at any time.

title: How much does a Google Workspace business email cost?
content: Business email prices depend on a few factors, including the Google Workspace plan you choose. Business emails are purchased separately from Premium plans or Studio plans.

title: How can I add a new video to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Media. Select a video type under Video: Single Video Players, VideoBox, or Transparent Video. Drag a video to the desired location on the page.

title: How can I use the Wix Design Guides to structure my site in the Studio Editor?
content: Wix Design Guides lets you create rows, columns or cells in your Studio Editor to help structure and design your site in a more organized manner. The guide appears as a colored grid and does not appear on your live site. Its purpose is to guide you as you place your elements and make sure everything is aligned correctly.

title: Can I customize the message that unsubscribed readers see when they view a post connected to a subscription plan on Wix Blog?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the message that unsubscribed readers see when they view a post that is connected to a subscription plan.

title: How can I connect my Gmail account to Wix Inbox using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Inbox at the bottom, tap the More Actions icon, tap Settings, tap Sender email address, tap Use Gmail Address, select the Gmail account you want to connect, tap Connect Gmail, tap Allow to grant Wix access to your Gmail account, then tap Back to Wix App.

title: How can I send a client a payment request for a Premium plan?
content: Before you begin, you must be a Wix Partner who uses Wix Studio. Payment requests can be created for sites built using the Studio Editor, Editor X, or the Wix Editor. To send a payment request, go to the upgrade page to view Premium plan options. Click Select under your desired plan. Select a billing cycle and click Continue to Checkout. Click Create a payment request. Add your client's email address in the Add or choose client email address field. Click Send Request. Your client receives an email inviting them to review the plan and upgrade the site. Once a client upgrades a site via a payment request, they are added as a Billing Manager of that site.

title: What steps do I need to follow to add a time buffer between appointments in Wix Bookings?
content:
In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Services. Select the relevant appointment. Scroll down to the Service details section. Click the Duration drop-down to choose how long your service lasts. To enter a specific duration in hours and minutes, choose Custom. Click the Buffer Time drop-down to choose how long of a break you have between appointments. To enter your own buffer time duration in hours and minutes, choose Custom. Click Save.

Note: Creating buffer time does not add 'busy' slots like those from personal appointments in your Google Calendar. You can manually extend the 'busy' slot in your Google Calendar to allow for any additional time you need as a buffer.

title: Is E-Transactions (Crédit Agricole) supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer E-Transactions (Crédit Agricole) as a payment provider. You can accept payments to your Crédit Agricole account by connecting PayZen as a payment provider.

title: How can I change the assigned staff member for a specific upcoming session in Wix Bookings?
content: To change staff members for specific upcoming sessions in Wix Bookings, go to the Booking Calendar tab in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant session in the calendar, then click Edit. For classes and courses, click This Session. Select the required staff member from the Staff drop-down, then click Save. You can choose whether to color code your sessions by service type or by staff member using the More Actions drop-down in the Booking Calendar.

title: How can I update my payment method if a renewal payment fails or is declined?
content: If a renewal payment fails or is declined, you can update your payment method to a credit or debit card. Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click Update Payment Method under the relevant subscription, update your payment card details, and click Submit. Once you have updated your payment details, the system attempts to process the payment again.

title: How do I add and set up an upload button in my CMS using the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin: Make sure to add the CMS to your editor if you haven't already.

Add the upload button element: Go to your editor and the page where you want the upload button. Click Add Elements on the left side, click Input, click Upload Buttons under Advanced, then click and drag the upload button onto the page.

Connect to the CMS through a dataset: Click the upload button, click the Connect to CMS icon, choose an existing dataset or Add a Dataset for the collection where submissions will be stored. Add a field to the collection for upload button submissions, or connect to an existing collection field using File connects to.

Set dataset mode and collection permissions: In the panel on the right, click Dataset Settings. Set the Dataset mode to Write or Read & Write so the upload button can add files to your collection. If needed, adjust collection permissions to control who can interact with collection content on the live site.

Customize the upload button: Click Settings. In Upload settings, choose the supported file type, max number of files, and whether the field is required. In Display options, customize the field title, button text, and text below the button. Use Layout to adjust spacing, direction, alignment, and icon position, and Design to choose or customize the button design.

Create a submit button: Add a regular button or image, connect it to the same dataset, and set its click action to Submit. Without a Submit button, visitors can upload files but won't have a way to submit them to your collection.

title: How can I view and manage my event drafts in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Click the Drafts tab on the left (under Events). Hover over the relevant draft event and choose what you want to do: Click Manage to edit your event details such as tickets and seating, registration settings and exclusive features. Click the Publish icon to make your event live on your site. Click the More Actions icon to duplicate or delete your event.

title: I need to know if more information is required for Wix payment verification status for my business account.
content:
For a business account, make sure you've written your personal and company information correctly:
* Your first / middle / last name and your date of birth must match those listed in your photo ID.
* Double check that you've entered your bank account number(s) correctly.
* Your company's name and its registration number/tax ID must match the company's registered information.
* Your Doing Business As name should match what appears on your customers' statements.
* Enter a physical address to verify your account. PO Boxes are not accepted as a valid address.
* Upload an address verification document, such as a utility bill, to confirm your address. The document must have been issued within the last 6 months.
* Confirm that the Legal Business Name, Shareholder and VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN entered in the form matches those associated with your business bank account.
* Upload a document that proves the validity and ownership of the VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN during registration.
* Add your Business Description: use the dropdown menu to select your Business Type; use the text box to add a short description of your products / services.
* Upload a color copy of your photo ID and bank statement to verify your identity.
Allow 7 business days for the account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've verified the information is correct and matches your bank account details, contact Wix Customer Care. We will be happy to investigate this issue further.

title: How can I transfer a Google Workspace business email from my Wix account to Google?
content: Yes, you can transfer a Google Workspace business email from Wix to Google. This action disconnects the Workspace business email from your Wix account. To do so, contact Wix Customer Care for assistance. This is an irreversible action. Once transferred to Google, you cannot repurchase the business email through Wix.

title: Does Wix Hotels support adding additional languages beyond the ones listed?
content: Currently, Wix Hotels supports the following languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Dutch, Danish, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Swedish and Turkish. To suggest additional languages, submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How do I create and set up a stack in Editor X?
content: Click the first element of your Stack. Hold down the Shift key and select all other elements that should be stacked. Click Stack. To customize the spacing between stack items and their alignment, click the Inspector icon at the top right, enter a value in px or percentage next to Item spacing, and align your items Left, Center, Right or Justify. To edit an individual element inside a stack, double-click the element to adjust it.

title: How can I translate text, buttons, and links on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor and click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top. Select the language you want to edit, then select the text element you want to translate on your page. Click Edit Translation or Auto-translate to enter or edit the translation. Collapsible text can only be translated manually. Optionally, design the element in your secondary language; for buttons and links, click the Link icon to change the link. If the secondary language is still hidden, go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard, click the Status drop-down next to your language, and select Visible.

title: Is the translation order in the Wix Translation Manager the same as the order of text in the editor?
content: Currently, the order of the content you can translate in the Translation Manager does not match the order of text in the editor.

title: I’m having trouble finding the arrows and the "Change Slide Background" option in a full-width slideshow on Wix.
content:
To change the background of your slideshow:
- Click the slideshow in the editor.
- Click the arrows next to the slide number to navigate to the relevant slide.
- Click Change Slide Background.

To display buttons or arrows on your slideshow:
- Click your slideshow in the Editor.
- Click the Layout icon and choose what you want to display.
- Show navigation arrows: Enable the toggle to display the arrows.

title: How can I set specific call hours for my business phone number using Wix?
content: With Business Phone Number, you have full control of your line's call hours. Set the specific days and times when your number is available to take calls, or set it to be available 24/7. You can also switch to Do Not Disturb mode and make your number temporarily unavailable.

title: How can I ensure that each dynamic page in my CMS collection has a unique URL?
content: If you are going to be creating dynamic item pages for the data in a collection, make sure you have at least one field whose values uniquely identify each item. This makes sure that each page can have a unique URL. For example, if you have several different recipes for chocolate cake in your recipe collection and you call them all "chocolate cake," their dynamic pages will all have the exact same URL (for example, mysite/recipes/chocolate-cake). This means that you will not be able to control which chocolate cake recipe is displayed on your dynamic page. The same applies if you plan on creating reference fields that point to a given collection. Make sure that the Primary field in your collection has unique values so that you can select the correct item in your reference fields.

title: How can I change the settings of my quick action bar in the Wix Editor to display text labels?
content: Select the quick action bar in your mobile Editor. Click the Settings icon. Choose the Yes display option: the actions display icons with text labels.

title: How can I create a social post to promote my services using the Wix app?
content:
To create a social post promoting your services using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Services, or tap Catalog and select Booking Services.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant service.
- Tap Promote service.
- Tap Create a Post under Social Post.
- Choose an overlay.
- Tap Text to add text and customize it.
- Tap Sticker to add a sticker.
- Tap Image to change or edit the image.
- Tap Share at the top.
- Select the social media platform(s) where you want to share the post or tap Download to save the post for later use.
- Tap Done.

title: What activities are prohibited under Wix's Business Phone Number terms of use?
content:
To follow these terms and continue using a Business Phone Number, make sure you're not participating in any of the following:

* Explicit content
* Hate speech
* Unwelcome messages
* Fraudulent messages
* Messages related to cannabis

Anyone that's found in breach of these terms could have their account blocked. Learn more about Wix's Business Phone Number terms.

title: How can I use a text operator condition in the new automation builder to send a coupon only after an order is paid?
content: Create an automation that triggers when an order is placed. Add a text operator condition specifying the PAID payment status. In the THEN path, send a coupon if the condition is met. The value must be PAID / UNPAID written in English, even for sites in other languages. This will only work for payments made online.

title: Can I rearrange live site content directly from my CMS collection?
content: Yes. You can control the order in which items display on your live site directly from your CMS collection view. When you enable the Mirror on Site toggle in your collection, any live site elements connected to the collection are sorted using the same order as your collection. If needed, you can override the mirrored collection order by adding sort conditions to a dataset.

title: How can I create a Members Only page in Wix Editor and restrict access to specific members?
content:
First make sure that you've added a Members Area to your site before creating Members Only pages.

In your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon. Click Settings, then click the Permissions tab. Select Site Members, then select which members can access this page:

- All members: Any signed in member can access this page.
- Specific members: Limit this page to specific members only. You can choose one or both of the following options:
  - Members with roles: Members with a specific role. Click Manage Roles. Note: If you have not created member roles, click Create Role. Select the checkbox next to the relevant role(s) and click Apply.
  - Members with plan subscriptions: Members who've purchased a specific pricing plan. Click Manage Plans. Note: If you have not created a pricing plan, click Create Plan. Select the checkbox next to the relevant plan(s) and click Apply.

Note: By default, the Site collaborators toggle is always enabled. This ensures you and your collaborators are able to access all parts of your site.

title: How can I connect an audio player to my CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Add Elements, click Video & Music, click Audio Players, and drag the audio player you want onto your page. Select the player and click the Connect to CMS icon. In the Choose a dataset drop-down, select an existing dataset connected to your collection, or click Add a Dataset, choose the collection, give the dataset a name, and click Create. Under Connections, use the drop-downs to connect the player to the relevant collection fields, such as Artist name, Track name, Cover image, and Audio source. If needed, open Dataset Settings in the Connect Audio Player panel, edit Permissions, and choose the Dataset mode (Read or Read & Write). Customize the player's settings, design, and layout. In Settings you can adjust playback to play once or in a loop; connected collection fields override the image, audio, and track details shown in the settings. Click Preview to test the player, and click Publish when ready to make changes go live.

title: How can I create a one-time payment plan using the Pricing Plans app?
content:
