Prerequisites: Add the Pricing Plans app to your site. To sell plans on your site, connect a payment provider.

To create the plan: Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard. Click + Create Plan. Enter the plan name. (Optional) Enter a brief description. Add benefits under List what's included in this plan.

To connect benefits: Scroll down to Other benefits. Select the checkbox next to the services or content types you want to include. Add the relevant details.

To set price and duration: Select One-time payment in the Pricing options section. Enter the plan Price. Select the relevant duration from the Length of plan drop-down; choose Custom to enter your own duration. (Optional) Charge a setup fee by enabling Charge a setup fee, entering the amount under One-time setup fee, and entering the name under Setup fee name.

To adjust settings: Scroll down to Settings. You can enable Limit 1 purchase per person, enable Allow plan cancellation, enable Let people set start date, add a plan policy next to Add a policy, add custom form fields next to Collect additional info at checkout, and customize a Thank You page next to Customize a Thank You page. Click Save at the top to finish.

title: How can I search for a specific sale in Wix Retail POS?
content:
To search for a sale in Wix Retail POS:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
- Find the sale in any of the following ways:
  - Enter an order number, customer name or customer email in the search bar.
  - Filter sales:
    - Tap the Filter icon.
    - Tap the relevant filter(s) to select them.
    - Tap **Apply Filters** at the bottom.
- Tap the sale to view it.

Tip: After locating a sale you can issue a refund or make an exchange.

title: How can I stop receiving spam submissions in my new Wix Forms?
content: The new Wix Forms are integrated with spam filters. If you are receiving spam submissions, adjust your spam filter settings and select Advanced and reCAPTCHA.

title: How can I customize the success pop-up?
content: Click the cart icon element in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Pop up tab. Customize the success pop-up using the available options.

title: How can I update the inventory of multiple products at once in Wix Stores?
content: In Wix Stores, go to Inventory in your site's dashboard. Select the checkboxes next to the products whose inventory you want to update, then click Update Inventory. Choose Add to add the same number of items to the selected products, Set to set the selected products to the same inventory level, or choose In stock or Out of stock from the drop-down if you are not tracking inventory.

title: How can I request a payment through chat using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Inbox at the bottom. Choose to request a payment from an existing conversation by tapping the relevant conversation, or from a new chat by tapping the New Chat icon at the top right. In the chat, tap the Add icon at the bottom. Tap Request payment. Enter the amount and write a short description for your request. Tap Send Request. Note: If your customer is not available on chat when you send the request, they receive an email notification about it.

title: Can I connect Wix Online Programs to the CMS to bind content to page elements?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect Wix Online Programs to the CMS (Content Management System). This feature would allow you to connect content from the Online Programs app to page elements on your site such as text, images, repeaters, and more. Most Wix apps have a Wix app collection that allows you to bind their contents to page elements through CMS datasets. However, a Wix app collection for Online Programs does not exist yet.

title: How can I add a dynamic item page for my event using the Wix Editor?
content: Before you begin, add Wix Events to your site, publish your events, add the CMS to your site if you haven't already, and enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Events with the CMS. Then, in the Wix Editor: go to your editor; click CMS on the left of the editor; click Wix App Collections on the left; scroll down to the Events collections; hover over Events, click the More Actions icon, and select Add dynamic page; click Item page; click Add to Site.

title: Can I adjust the proportions of columns by entering a percentage in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the proportions of columns by manually entering a percentage amount. As an alternative, you can adjust your column's proportions by dragging the slider in the Layout panel.

title: How can I add a loop animation to an element in the Wix Studio Editor?
content:
To add a loop animation to an element in the Wix Studio Editor:
- Select the relevant element.
- Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor.
- Click the Animations and Effects tab.
- Click + Add under Loop.
- Select an animation from the list.

Tip: Hover over animations to see a preview of how they look.

title: How can I edit my site URL prefix on Wix?
content:
To view or edit your site URL prefix:
- Sign in to your Wix account.
- Click your profile at the top right and select Account Settings.
- View your URL prefix under Site URL prefix.
- (Optional) Click the Site URL prefix field to edit your prefix.

Notes:
- Site URL prefixes can be between 6-20 characters and can only contain letters and numbers.
- Each site URL prefix must be unique. If the prefix was used in the past by any Wix user, it cannot be used again, even if the account associated with it has been deleted.
- Changing your prefix changes the structure of your free Wix URL (e.g. siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress). If you've connected a domain to your site, there is no change to your URL.
- Your site URL prefix is also your Wix Customer Care profile name.

title: Can I create coupons that are valid for a selection of my services in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create coupons that are valid for a selection of your services. However, you can create coupons that are valid for individual services, or coupons that are valid for all your services.

title: How can I import a Lottie animation into the Studio Editor and set it to play in a continuous loop?
content:
Before you begin, you need a LottieFiles account. To add a Lottie Animation element:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Embed & Social.
- Click Lottie Animations.
- Click the Add to Site icon next to Lottie Animation.
- In a separate browser tab, copy the saved animation's URL from your LottieFiles account.
- Paste the animation's URL in the Editor: click the Lottie Animation element, click the Settings icon, paste the URL under What's the animation's URL?, and press Enter.

To set the animation to play in a loop:
- Select the Lottie Animation element.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Click the toggle next to Plays in a loop to turn it on.

title: Can I cancel a request to hire a Wix Professional?
content: Yes. You can cancel a request you've submitted to hire a Wix Professional, and Wix will notify your matches that this project is no longer available. To cancel a request, go to your projects page in the Wix Marketplace, hover over the relevant project, click the More Actions icon on the right, and choose Cancel Request. Select a reason for canceling the request, then click Cancel Project to confirm.

title: How can I increase my video library space on Wix Video?
content: When you upgrade your site, your storage space increases, giving you more room for growth and creating new opportunities for audience engagement. You can also add a storage plan to your site to make sure you have enough space for your media. You can do this in addition to upgrading to a Premium plan.

title: How can I view the mobile version of my Wix site from the desktop editor?
content:
To view the mobile version of your Wix site from the desktop editor:

- Open your site in the desktop editor.
- Click **Site**.
- Click **View Site on Mobile**.
- Scan the QR code using your device.

title: How can I add a Members Area with a login bar to my Wix blog using the Wix Editor?
content: To add a Members Area with a login bar using the Wix Editor: click Add Apps on the left side of the editor; enter "Members Area" or "Wix Members Area" in the search bar; select the Wix Members Area app; click Add to Site. This lets visitors log in and access all members pages, including special pages for Wix Blog, Wix Stores, and Wix Bookings. If you want the Members Area without this page, you can hide it.

title: How can I customize the settings of my search bar in the Wix Editor?
content:
Click the search bar in your editor. Click Settings.

Edit the placeholder text which appears when the search bar is empty.

Note: This text disappears when your visitor starts typing in the search bar.

Edit the Result Suggestion settings:
- Show result suggestions when a user starts typing: Enable or disable result suggestions. If enabled, result suggestions start appearing as the visitor is typing.
- Show trending items before a user starts typing: Enable or disable showing items that are trending before a user starts typing.

Note: Enabling trending items is only possible if result suggestions are also enabled.

title: 账户数据量不足时，是否适用分层搜索词优化策略？
content: 不适用。这套分层分析假设每周有几千行搜索词；月广告花费低于几千美元的账户，每个关键词的点击数是个位数，“转化率 0%”可能只是还没轮到。这种账户该按月而不是按周做决策，并且把判断阈值放宽。

title: Can I use Global Payments as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Global Payments as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Global Payments and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I add a map with my wedding venue's location to my Wix wedding website?
content: Add your event details by adding your wedding details and a map with your venue’s location to your wedding website.

title: I tried updating the picture that shows up when sharing my website link, but it didnt work.
content: To customize the image that displays when your page is shared, go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Tools and settings. Click Go to SEO Settings under SEO Settings. Select the page type that you want to edit. Click Edit next to Basics & social share. Scroll down to Social share and customize og:image. If you prefer one image for all your pages, add an image URL. Click Save. Note: Each social media channel uses its own criteria to choose the best image, so your Social Share settings are likely to be used but not guaranteed.

title: How do I add a PDF to my website?
content: To add a PDF to your website, add the PDF Viewer app by Wix for free from the Wix App Market. In the editor, click Add Apps or App Market, search for the PDF Viewer app, and click Add to Site. Then click the app, click Upload PDF, click Add File, select a PDF from your media manager or upload a new file, and click Add to page. You can customize the app by selecting a preset and adjusting the Settings, Layout, and Design options.

title: How can I add a new question and answer in the Wix FAQ app?
content: To add new questions and answers in the Wix FAQ app: Click the FAQ app in your editor. Click Manage Questions. If a pop-up does not open, try turning off your pop-up blocker or updating your browser version. Click Add New. Select Question & Answer from the drop-down menu. Enter your new question under Question. Add an answer for your question under Answer. Optionally, add media to your answer using the icons on the bottom of the editor. Select a category for your new question under Choose a category, or add a new category. Click Save. You can add linked text to your answer by selecting the text, clicking the Link icon and adding either a link to a website or to a section on your site.

title: How can I find the web address (URL) of my Wix blog post?
content: To find the web address (URL) of one of your blog posts, access your live site, click the relevant blog post, and copy the address from your browser's address bar. Your blog post URL looks different when you have a Premium Plan. Free site format: username.wixsite.com/site-address/blog-page-URL/blog-post-URL. Premium site format: yourdomain.com/post/blog-post-URL. You can learn how to change your site address, your blog page URL, and your blog post URL.

title: How can I generate and send a paystub using the Wix Paystub Generator?
content: Go to the Wix Paystub Generator and click Create a Pay Stub. Fill in the fields under the Your Business Info section, the Employee Info section, and the Salary Details section. You can optionally preview the paystub under the Pay Stub Preview section. Then choose how to receive your paystub: use Email Pay Stub to send the paystub directly to your employee, or use Download Pay Stub to download a copy of the paystub to your device.

title: Can I add additional payment options for Wix Music?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add additional payment options for Wix Music.

title: How can I set up an existing upload button to accept multiple documents in my CMS?
content:
Step 1 | Add a multi document field type to your collection: Open the collection linked to the upload button. Click the Add Field icon. Edit the field name. Click the Field Type drop-down menu and select Multi Document. Click Save. Click the X at the top right to close the CMS.

Step 2 | Update your existing upload button to accept multiple documents: Select the upload button. Click the Connect to Data icon. Click the File connects to drop-down and select the multi document field you set up. Click Settings. Click the Supported file type drop-down and select Document. Drag the Max number of files slider to the required value. Select the Required checkbox to make this a required field when a visitor is uploading files. Enter the title that appears at the top of the Upload Button under Field title. Enter the text that appears on your upload button in the Button text field. Select an option under Text below button: Show file info only displays the visitor's selected file name after the file is selected; Show custom text lets you enter text in the Custom text field to show below the button, and once the visitor uploads their file, the file name displays below the button instead. Click View Uploaded Files to go to your media manager where you can view the files visitors upload to your site.

title: How can I stay updated with the latest features and releases in Wix Studio?
content: Check out the News Center. You can also access the News Center by clicking the News Center icon at the top of your workspace, then View All. The News Center keeps you informed about the roadmap, betas, events, and additions to Wix Studio.

title: How can I adjust the color contrast on my Wix site to improve accessibility?
content: In the Wix Editor, use the Accessibility Wizard: Select Settings, select Accessibility Wizard, select Scan My Site, select cards titled Color contrast, use the slider to adjust the text and background color, then select Apply Changes. The Wizard scans your site for potential accessibility issues and allows you to enable advanced settings to keep improving your site's accessibility.

title: How can I create a member badge in Wix Forum?
content: To create your first badge, go to the Site Member tab in your dashboard and click More Actions at the top right. You can create any badges your forum needs and design them to suit the look and feel of your site. The badges appear on the Members page on profile cards. When a site visitor clicks to view a member's profile, they can see the badge there as well, including the badge description if you added one.

title: How can I delete a service from my Wix Bookings dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Services. Click the More Actions icon on the relevant service, click Delete, then click Yes, Delete to confirm.

title: How can I set a gallery item in Wix Pro Gallery to open a link when clicked?
content:
To set gallery items to open a link when clicked in Wix Pro Gallery:
- Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Click the When clicking on an item drop-down and select A link opens.
- Add links to your gallery items: Click Manage Media, click the gallery item you want to add a link to, click the Link icon on the right, select the link type and fill in the relevant information, click Done, edit the text in the Link field, click Done, and click Done to close the window.
The link opens within the same tab for internal links or a new tab for external links.

title: How can I sort items in my CMS collection automatically?
content:
Click **Sort** at the top of your collection. Click **+ Add a Sort**. Click the **Sort by** drop-down and choose the field you want to sort. Select a sorting option under **Select the order** (e.g. **A-Z**, **Low-High**, **Oldest-Newest**). The options vary depending on the field type. Click **Add Sort**.

**Note:** From the Table layout, you can sort the items manually. Click and drag the **Reorder** icon next to the relevant items to change their order.

**Tip:** Enable the **Mirror on Site** toggle to use this same item order in your site's connected elements (e.g. repeaters, Pro Galleries).

title: How can I add a Facebook video to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add a video from Facebook using the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Video and Music. Click Single Video Players. Click the Facebook Video option and drag it to the relevant location. Click Change Video. Paste the video URL in the What's the video's web address? field. Customize the playback options: Autoplays — click the toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled: the video autoplays on mute; visitors can turn the sound on manually. Disabled: the video does not play automatically. Scroll down, and enter a description of the video in the What's this video about? field.

title: Can I change the name server (NS) records for my Wix domain?
content: Currently, it's not possible to change name servers (edit NS records) for a Wix domain. You can, however, point your Wix domain to an external site. To change the name servers, you'll need to transfer your domain away from Wix.

title: How can I import media from the Media Manager to my Wix portfolio project?
content: Go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant project and click Edit. Click Manage Media next to Project Media. Note: Click Import from Wix Media Manager if this is the first media item you're adding. Click + Add Media. Click Import from Media Manager. Select the media you want to add to your project. Tip: If you do not have any media yet uploaded to your Media Manager, click + Upload on the top right to upload media from your computer. Click Add to Project on the bottom right. Click the imported media and customize: Set as cover image, Focal point, Title, Description, Alt Text (for images only), and Link. Click Done on the bottom right. Click Save & Close on the top right.

title: How can I set up a table using repeaters in Editor X?
content:
After adding a repeater to your site, set up the table by creating rows and columns:

- Change your repeater layout: select the new repeater in the Editor, click the Inspector icon at the top right, click the Layout tab, select List under Display type. (Optional) Set the spacing between your rows next to Gaps.
- Apply a grid to your repeater items: select any repeater item, click the 1x1 drop-down, and depending on the number of columns you need, choose a layout. Tip: Click Other to choose a different amount of rows and columns. Set the table cells by dragging the grid lines as needed.

title: How do I approve requests to join my private online program on Wix?
content: To approve requests to join your program, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard, click the relevant program, click Manage next to Participants, click the Pending tab, and click Approve next to the member(s) you want to approve.

title: How can I add a repeater to my site using Editor X?
content: To add a repeater in Editor X, click Add Elements at the top of Editor X. Click Layout Tools. Click Repeaters. Drag a repeater onto your page.

title: How can I set up online ordering for my restaurant using Wix Restaurants?
content: To set up online ordering with Wix Restaurants, enable your restaurant's online ordering system so customers can order and pay straight from your site. You can offer customers the choice of picking up orders or having their order delivered to them, and you can also offer future orders so customers can place orders a few hours or days before the delivery time. A Premium plan is needed to take online orders and receive payments; without it, you can still display your restaurant menu on your site.

title: How can I hide a section from my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the mobile editor, click the section you want to hide, then click the Hide icon. This hides the section from the mobile version of your site without affecting your desktop site. To show a hidden section again, click the Hidden on Mobile icon on the left side of the mobile editor, then click Show next to the relevant section.

title: What should I do now that the Cookie Alert Popup App has been retired?
content: The app has been retired from the Wix App Market, and Cookie Alert banners will no longer be supported on your site. Delete this app and switch to the Privacy Center, where you can set up a Cookie Banner to be displayed on your site.

title: Can I add a chatbot to my site, and is this feature currently in beta?
content: Yes. You can now add a chatbot to your site. Note: This feature is currently in beta.

title: How can I change the sharpness of images on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Settings on the top bar, click Image Sharpening, select a preset (None, Mild, Classic, Moderate, Strong, or Max), then click Apply. You can try different presets to see which one looks best; if your images look too sharp, click None.

title: How can I add a logo to my Wix Editor site using the Add Elements panel?
content: Open your site in the Wix Editor. Click Add Elements on the left menu. Select the Image tab. Select Custom Logo. Click Add Logo.

title: How do I set up and activate my HP Engage One Prime tablet for Wix Retail POS?
content: Turn on the tablet. Set up the Wi-Fi connection by tapping Setup Wi-Fi at the bottom of the screen, then tap the network you want to connect to. Important: connect to your own Wi-Fi account, not a public one (e.g. a mall's Wi-Fi). Enter your Wix account's email and password and tap Log In. Note: if you have more than one Wix account, make sure to log into the account with the site you want to connect to. Tap Let's Go! at the bottom to get started. Connect the tablet to the rest of your hardware. You can always check the status of your hardware to make sure everything's connected properly.

title: How can I connect AliPay as a payment method through Oceanpayment on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to AliPay. Click Connect next to Oceanpayment. If you have an Oceanpayment account, enter your Terminal and SecureCode, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Oceanpayment account, fill in the registration form and click Send, wait for an email or chat message from Oceanpayment to get your Terminal and SecureCode, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account. Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Oceanpayment account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I set a purchase price for my videos on Wix and decide if viewers can download them?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Video Library. Select the checkbox next to the video(s) you want to sell, click Set Pricing, then click Paid. Select the Video can be purchased checkbox and enter the purchase price in the Price field. Click the Download options drop-down and choose whether to allow downloads: Allow downloads means viewers can download the videos they purchase; No downloads means viewers can only watch the videos through your site or the Spaces by Wix app. Click Save.

title: What should I do if I see a pop-up to update to the new version after downloading the Branded App?
content: If you see such a pop-up after downloading the Branded App, use the steps from this article to make sure that there are no issues preventing your app from getting the newest version.

title: How can I update the card reader firmware using my POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap Settings. Select Manage Hardware. Tap Manage Card Reader. Tap Check for Update next to the Reader Firmware Version. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the update.

title: How can I assign a role to a member from the member list on my site?
content: Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant member. Click Edit Roles. Select the checkbox next to the role(s) you want to assign. When ready, click Save.

title: How can I delete a category in Wix Forum using the site's dashboard?
content: Go to Forum in your site's dashboard. Click Categories on the left. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant category. Click Delete Category. Click Delete again to confirm.

title: How do I connect Yoco as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Yoco as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Select Connect next to Yoco.
- If you have a Yoco account: enter your Public key and Secret key, then click Connect. Find your keys in the Sell Online > Payment gateway section of your Yoco Business Portal.
- If you don't have a Yoco account: click Create Yoco account and complete the online sign-up process on the Yoco website. Once your account is approved, return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have a Yoco account to link your newly-created account.

title: How do I pair the Moneris Go Terminal card reader with my POS tablet?
content: Turn on your card reader. Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap Manage Hardware. Select Set up Card Reader. Select the option that applies: Reader is connected; Reader is displayed but not connected, then tap Connect; or Reader isn't displayed, then tap Pair a New Card Reader. Click Done. Enter the 8-digit code found on a sticker on the right side of your card reader. Tap Pair Reader. Tap Done. To check connection type or Wi-Fi status, swipe down from the top of the screen to view the status bar, Wi-Fi signal strength, and battery charge level.

title: How can I extend a Wix domain that I transferred from another Wix account?
content: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click Extend next to the domain that was transferred. Select a registration period (e.g., extend by an additional one, two, or three years) and click Continue. Select a privacy option and click Continue. Tip: Learn more about domain privacy and protection. Enter your payment information and click Submit Purchase.

title: How can I add captions to images in a gallery on my Wix blog post?
content:
To add captions to gallery images:
- Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant blog post.
- Click the gallery in the post.
- Click the Organize Media icon on the blog toolbar.
- Click on the image you'd like to caption.
- Click Edit.
- Click on the text box under Title to add a caption to your image.
- Click Done.

title: How can I develop custom websites using Wix's platform?
content: You can develop custom websites on Wix by using Wix's website development platform to customize your site with code. You can extend and customize your site's UI by adding custom behaviors and interactions among UI elements, add third-party services, npm packages, and streamlined testing protocols to your site's backend, and use the Wix CMS or integrate popular external databases like Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, and more.

title: How can I add dish options to my menu in Wix Restaurants?
content: To add dish options in Wix Restaurants, go to your dashboard and click the Menus tab. Either navigate to an existing dish and edit it, or click New Dish and enter the dish details. In the Dish Options section, click New Option. In the Name field, enter a name for the option (for example, Toppings, Temperature, or Hold the...). Under Type, select Selection, Extras, or Deselection. Under Choices, enter the first choice (for example, Pineapple, Rare, or Sauce) or select it from existing choices. You can optionally enter a price for the choice. To add more choices, click New Choice and repeat the choice and optional price entries, then click Save. Note: If you add single choice selection dish options, the price displayed on the online ordering page follows this formula: base price + cheapest single choice available. If you want a single choice dish option that will not increase the cost of the dish, set it to $0.00.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix account and Editor?
content:
To change the language of your Wix account and Editor:

For Wix:
- Sign in to your Wix account.
- Click the user panel at the top right.
- Click Account Settings.
- Click the Account language drop-down and select a language.

For Wix Studio:
- Sign in to your Wix account.
- Click the user panel at the top right of your workspace.
- Click Account Settings.
- Click the Account language drop-down and select a language.

Once you change the language of your Wix account, your editor will also be displayed in that language.

title: Why didn't I receive a free domain voucher after purchasing a Wix site plan?
content:
If you didn't receive the voucher, or believe it wasn't credited to your domain purchase, you may not have been eligible for one of the following reasons:

* You purchased a monthly plan: The free domain voucher is offered as a gift with purchase of selected yearly site plans. If you purchased a monthly plan you are not eligible for the free domain voucher.
* You purchased your domain name before you purchased a site plan: If you purchased your domain name prior to purchasing your Wix site plan, it is not possible to apply the voucher retroactively or offer you a refund. If you received the voucher and already have a domain name, you are welcome to use it for the purchase of another domain name.
* The voucher has already been applied: If you have a collaborator with Billing Manager permissions, they may already have applied the voucher for your site.
* Additional Features: You redeemed your voucher, but purchased additional features such as privacy, or additional years of service on top of this.

If none of the points above apply to you, please contact us and we'll be happy to check the status of your voucher.

title: Is it possible to set a lightbox to open only once per site visitor in Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to set a lightbox to only open once per site visitor.

Tip: If you have a little coding experience, you can create a one-time popup using Velo by Wix.

You can also browse through the Wix Marketplace to find a designer to do this for you.

title: How can I create a detailed report of my site's index status using Wix Site Inspection?
content: You can create Site Inspection reports for your site in your site's SEO Dashboard. In your report, you can see a Highlights summary of the status of your entire site and a Full Report listing all the pages of your site and their individual statuses. Use the search box to find pages that contain a certain piece of text, or filter by a certain page type or status. You can also select a specific page to open a more detailed report for that page including its status results and rich results status.

title: How can I view the available print sizes for my images in the Wix Art Store?
content: To view available sizes, click the Art Store in your Editor, click the Store tab, then click Set Pricing. Available sizes can be viewed on the left. You can also set prices in this view. If you change any pricing in this view, make sure to click Done when you're finished.

title: How can I add a PayPal Donate button to my site using ADI?
content:
Add a PayPal Donate button to your site to accept donations. You can set a fixed donation amount, or allow your visitors to choose their own amount to donate. When your site visitors click the button, they are automatically directed to PayPal to make their donation.

To add a PayPal Donate button:

- Click the relevant section in ADI.
- Click **Edit**.
- Click the **Show / Hide** icon next to **Button** to make your button visible.
- Type the button's text in the text field (e.g. Donate Now).
- Click **Link** next to your button's text.
- Select **PayPal Donations**.
- Enter your PayPal email address.
- Click the **Fixed Amount** toggle to set the donation amount:
  - **Enabled:** Enter a set amount your visitors can donate and select a currency.
  - **Disabled:** Allow visitors to choose how much they want to donate.
- Click **Done**.

title: How can I add a staff member to an event using the Check-in by Wix app?
content:
To add a staff member to an event using the Check-in by Wix app:

- Log into the Check-in by Wix app.
- Tap **Manage Staff** at the bottom.
- Tap **Add Staff**.
- Enter the person's name.
- Select the **Event access** you want your staff member to have:
  - **All events:** All existing and new events you create.
  - **Specific events:** You decide which events this staff member can access.
    - Tap the **Select Events** drop-down and choose the relevant event.
    - Tap **Done**.
- Tap **Save** at the top right.

After adding the staff member, share the invite link with them to the app or have them log in using the relevant QR code.

title: How can I add a filter to a dataset in the Wix Editor to control which items appear on my live site?
content:
To add a filter to a dataset in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

- Go to the relevant page in your editor.
- Go to the relevant dataset settings:
  - Click **CMS** on the left.
  - Click **Manage Page Connections**.
  - Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant dataset and select **Dataset settings**.
- Click **+ Add Filter** under **Filter**.
- Click the **Field** drop-down and select the field you want to apply the filter to.
- Click the **Condition** drop-down and choose the condition you want to use in the filter. The options vary based on the field type that is being filtered.
- If necessary, select the **Value source**:
  - **Manual entry:** Enter the value you want to filter by in the **Value** field.
  - **Another dataset:** Select the dataset and field you want to filter from the relevant drop-downs.
- Click **Add Filter**.
- Publish your site when you are ready to make the changes go live.

This process allows you to control which collection items appear in the connected elements on your live site, such as repeaters, galleries, and input elements.

title: How do I change the og:image for my entire site, and where will the selected image appear when sharing my site?
content: To change the og:image for your whole site, open your site's settings, click 'Website settings', scroll down to 'General social image' and click 'Upload Image'. Select an image or click '+ Upload Media' to upload a new one, then click 'Choose File' to add it. Click 'Save' at the top of the dashboard and publish your site. This sets the image for sharing your site on Facebook, X or other social networks.

title: What should I do if I encounter an error message while trying to verify my site with Pinterest?
content: If you receive a Pinterest verification error, try again a few times. If it still does not work, try verifying through www.pinterest.com/website/verify. If it still does not work, contact Pinterest directly. If Pinterest says it is a Wix problem, ask Pinterest for more information, then contact Wix with that information so Wix can investigate and fix it.

title: How can I add a preset click or hover interaction to an element in the Studio Editor?
content: Select the element that should trigger the interaction, then open the Inspector and go to Animations and Effects. Select Hover / Click and click + Add. In the Setup panel choose what happens On Hover / On Click: Start Animation, Reset Animation, or Toggle On/Off. Toggle On/Off is only available for click interactions. Select the animated element: click the element's name so (self) appears to make it animate itself, or choose a different element from the drop-down or via Choose on Canvas. To select a child element, hold Cmd / Ctrl. Then click the Presets tab and choose an animation from the list. Optionally click Adjust Animation at the bottom of the Inspector and customize Delay, Duration, Easing, Scale, Angle, Distance, and Direction. You can click Preview to see how it looks and make adjustments if needed.

title: Can I customize email receipts in Wix Stores POS?
content: It is now possible to customize email receipts. Learn how to customize Mobile POS receipts.

title: Can I translate my portfolio using Wix Multilingual?
content: Yes. You can now translate your portfolio using Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I customize the layout of my Wix Pro Gallery on a mobile site?
content:
To customize the layout of your Wix Pro Gallery on a mobile site:

- Go to your mobile Editor:
  - **Wix Editor:** Click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the Editor.
  - **Editor X:** Click the relevant breakpoint at the top of Editor X.
- Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your mobile Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Select a layout for your gallery.
- Click **Customize Layout** to change the layout to look exactly as you want (see Customizable Layout Features below).

**Note:** There are no navigation arrows in the expanded view. Instead, visitors swipe the screen to view the next gallery item.

title: Can I edit my form submission data using new Wix Forms?
content: Yes. You can now edit your form submission data using new Wix Forms.

title: How can I change the URL of my Wix photo album to make it more personalized?
content: You can customize the URL of your published photo album by changing the album's subdomain prefix, making it more personal to you and your site. In your site's dashboard, go to Photo Albums, click Manage Album next to the relevant album, click Change next to the album's URL, update the URL of the album, and click Save. Per the article's guidelines, characters can only be ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, must be lowercase, hyphens cannot appear at the beginning or the end, and the total length can be no more than twenty characters.

title: How can I track the status of a chargeback in Wix Payments?
content: You can monitor your chargeback's status from your Wix Payments dashboard by looking at the status next to the relevant payment. The possible chargeback statuses include Action needed, Expired, Final, Accepted, Disputed, Lost, and Won. The dashboard can also show a status indicating how many days you have left to submit a dispute.

title: How can I add gift registry links to my wedding website using Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Button, then click Text & Icon Buttons. Drag a button onto your page and click Settings. Under Choose what displays, select Text and icon, Icon only, Text only, or Nothing. Click Choose a Link under Links To, click Web Address, and enter your registry URL. Choose whether the registry link opens in a new browser window or the current one, then click Done. Repeat these steps for each wedding registry. Another option is to add the store logo, such as Amazon or Target, to your site and link the image to your registry.

title: How can I purchase a domain from Wix and what are the steps involved?
content: In your Wix account, go to Domains and click Get a New Domain. Enter a domain name and extension in the search field, then click Search. If the domain is available, click Get It. If the domain is not available, try searching for another domain name and/or extension. Select the registration period and click Continue. Enter or edit your contact information and click Continue. Select the relevant option under Privacy & Security: Private Registration and DNSSEC (Recommended), Private Registration, or Public Registration. If you later need private registration for your domain, you must purchase additional years of domain registration and choose a private registration option. Click Continue, select your payment method, and click Submit Purchase. If you need a custom business email address to go with your domain name, click Get a Business Email to purchase email addresses that end with your new domain name.

title: How can I create a product category in Wix Retail POS for my brick & mortar store?
content: To create a product category in Wix Retail POS, open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, then tap Catalog, then tap Categories. Tap + New Category, enter a name for your category, and tap Save. To add products to your new category, tap Add Products, select the checkboxes next to the products you want to add (you can use the search bar to find specific products), and tap Add. Note: To delete a product category, select the category and tap Delete at the top right; deleting a category does not delete the products. To remove a product from a category, tap the Remove icon next to the product.

title: Is ipay88 supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer ipay88 as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through ipay88 and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I design a horizontal menu in the Studio Editor?
content: To design a horizontal menu in the Studio Editor, select the horizontal menu, click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor, and scroll down to Design. From the drop-down, select the element you want to design: Menu container, Menu items, Submenu container, or Submenu items. For menu or submenu items, select the relevant state: Regular, Hover, or Current page. Then use the available options to design the menu: Background fills, Borders, Corners, Shadows, Text, and Layout. Tip: To make your client's site look sleek on smaller screens, replace the horizontal menu with a hamburger menu; from the Layers panel, hide the horizontal menu on the small breakpoint(s), and the hamburger menu on the large breakpoint(s).

title: How can I set up my video to autoplay and loop on my Wix mobile site?
content: To set up your video for your mobile site, click your video in the mobile editor and then click the Settings icon. Use the toggle next to In a loop to enable or disable video looping: enabled means the video plays on repeat, disabled means it plays once. Use the toggle next to Autoplays to enable or disable autoplay: enabled means the video plays automatically when a visitor opens the page, disabled means it doesn't play until a visitor clicks it. Autoplay may not work on some mobile devices even if enabled. Apple and Chrome may block autoplay to prevent additional data charges from the visitor's cellphone network. No data is loaded until the user taps the play button on the audio or video player. If the visitor has enabled low-power mode on an iOS device, autoplay is automatically disabled.

title: Why are my payouts on hold in Wix Payments and how can I resolve the issue?
content: Payouts are placed on hold if there is an issue blocking your payout. The held amount includes the payout on hold, plus any other available funds that cannot be sent to your bank because of the issue. Payouts are placed on hold if you have a failed payout or an unresolved verification issue. Click on the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see the reason for the payout failure and for instructions on how to resolve it. Once the issue has been identified and resolved, the payout will be added to your next scheduled payout. If you have grouped payment methods active in your Wix Payments account, your payouts on hold status applies to whichever group is experiencing an issue.

title: How can I create and design a landing page using the Wix Landing Page Builder?
content: The Wix Landing Page Builder is a free solution for creating a striking, informative landing page. In the builder, choose from a variety of templates such as app and product landing pages; templates have been optimized for conversion to help turn visitors into customers or subscribers. After choosing a template, use the Editor to tailor and customize the page to suit your and your brand's needs while keeping visitors interested and up-to-date on your business.

title: What POS solutions does Wix offer, and what policies should I review?
content: Wix offers two POS solutions: Retail POS, a payment and inventory solution for physical stores; and Mobile POS, a POS solution that lets you make sales or charge clients on-the-go using your mobile phone. You should review the Wix POS terms of service and hardware return policy so that you know what to expect.

title: Can I add a custom thumbnail or cover image to a video connected to a collection in the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a custom thumbnail or cover image to a video connected to a collection. This applies to videos connected to gallery or video fields of a collection.

title: How do I update my Wix domain contact information?
content: Go to Domains in your Wix account, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, click Edit contact info, edit your contact information, and click Save. Note: Changing your contact information locks your domain for 60 days, during which it is not possible to transfer your domain away from Wix.

title: How can I add a tax rate to my bookings in Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your Hotels Dashboard. Click the Payments tab. Scroll down to Price Settings. Enter the tax rate you want to add to your prices in the Tax field. Click Save at the bottom. Note that Wix Hotels displays prices without the tax added until a customer selects a room and dates of stay, then the tax is included in the final price breakdown of the reservation. If you want tax included in the initial room prices, build the tax in when you set up your rates instead of using the tax field in Price Settings.

title: How can I restore an archived program in Online Programs?
content: Archived programs cannot be restored. You can duplicate the archived program and publish the new draft. To duplicate an archived program, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard, click the Archived tab, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program, and click Duplicate. The duplicate is in your Drafts tab. From the Drafts tab, click the More Actions icon next to the duplicate program, then click Publish to set it live or click Edit Settings to update or change your program settings.

title: Can I add videos as project page covers in Wix Portfolio?
content: Yes, it is now possible to add a video as a project cover using Wix Portfolio. To do so, go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard, hover over the relevant project and click Edit, scroll down to Media and click the Add icon, click Add media, upload the video file, click the image in your Media Manager, click Set as Cover, and click Done.

title: How can I connect Titre Restaurants Conecs as a payment method through Lyra on my Wix site?
content: On your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right and change it from the drop-down menu if it is incorrect. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Titre-Restaurants Conecs. If you have a Lyra account, enter your Key and ShopID and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Lyra Collect account, fill in the sign up form, and proceed with the Lyra account verification. Once the Lyra Collect account is approved, sign in to your Lyra account and retrieve your account credentials (Shop ID and Key). Return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I create and send a pay link using Wix Pay Links?
content: Go to Pay Links in your site's dashboard. Click Create Link. Choose One-time payment for a link that accepts one payment, or Multi payment for a link that accepts multiple payments, then click Next. Set up the pay link by entering a Link name and Price, and optionally add a Description, set an expiration date, customize the link using Button color, Button text, and Link image, and for multi-payment links limit the number of payments. Click Create Link. After creation, you can Copy Link, send via email by selecting a customer and clicking Send Link, use + Add Contact to create a new contact, use HTML embed, generate a QR Code, or share via Facebook, LinkedIn, or Twitter.

title: How can I remove the 'This site may harm your computer' message from my Wix site on Google search results?
content: You can remove the message by verifying your site with Google Search Console, removing the resources causing the problem by following these instructions, and submitting your sitemap directly to Google.

title: I received a manual (offline) payment and I am unable to see the payment history.
content: If you're receiving payments using the manual (offline) method, you must mark them as paid before they appear in your payments page. You can manually mark Store orders in Wix Stores and Services in Wix Bookings as paid. To view and manage your payments, go to Payments in your site's dashboard. The All payments section lists all payments received through any payment method or payment provider.

title: How can I reorder elements in my email marketing campaign?
content: To reorder elements in your campaign, go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one. Select the relevant element in your email campaign, then choose an option: drag and drop the element up or down in your campaign editor, or use the Move up/down arrows from the toolbar on the right to move the element up or down.

title: How can I add a "View Shop" button to my Facebook shop?
content: Switch to the profile associated with the business page. Go to your Facebook business page. Click the More Actions icon and select Add Action Button. Click Try it. Click View Shop. Select Shop on Facebook. Click Next. Click Save. Tip: Instead of a View Shop button, you also have the option of adding a Buy Now button. Clicking this button sends customers directly to your Wix Store.

title: Why is there a thin white line appearing across images on my iPhone when using Safari?
content:
We are aware that in rare cases thin gaps may appear across images and backgrounds on mobile live site. So far, this impacts only Safari versions 16 and above on mobile browsers, and this is a rendering issue on Apple's end. A bug report has been opened to the Safari development team, and we are waiting for a solution.

In the meantime, you may try the following steps, that helped resolve the issue for some users:
1. Go to your mobile Editor.
2. Hide all components within the site header.
3. Un-hide them again.
4. If necessary, adjust the header layout back to your preferred design.
5. Publish the site.

Should the above steps not help in resolving the problem on your site, please reach out to our Customer Care team, and we will try to find an alternative solution.

title: How can I add password protection to my Wix site?
content:
To password protect your site:

- Click **Settings** at the top of the Editor.
- Click **Site Password**.
- Select an option:
  - **Everyone**: Everyone can view your site. This means that your site is public and there are no additional restrictions.
  - **Password Holders**: Only people who have the password can view your site. Enter your chosen password.
- Click **Save**.

The password window only appears on your live site. It does not appear when previewing your site.

title: Can I purchase a gift card for a Wix Premium plan?
content: Currently, Wix do not sell gift cards for Premium plans. If you are looking to sell gift cards for your online store, you can add Wix Gift Cards.

title: Can I import blog posts from Ghost to Wix?
content: It is not possible to import blog posts from Ghost. Currently, you can import blog posts from WordPress and from another Wix site.

title: How can I set how shipping and tax display in the Cart Page using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor and open your Cart page. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Depending on your site, select the relevant option: for Wix Stores, click Store Pages and then Cart Page; for Wix Bookings, click Bookings Pages and then Cart Page; for Wix Restaurants Orders (New) or a combination of business solutions, click Cart & Thank You and then Cart Page. Click the Cart Page element on your page, click Settings, and click the Settings tab. Select or deselect the Shipping & Delivery Rates checkbox and the Tax costs checkbox. Note: Estimated taxes are not displayed if you have included tax in the price of your products. You can also display a tax or shipping message on every page with product prices.

title: Can I sort my blog posts in ways other than chronological order on Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add additional ways to sort your blog posts. Your Post List and Blog Feed displays posts in chronological order (from newest to oldest) only.

title: Can I request additional templates in Wix Studio?
content: Wix Studio offers a variety of unique website templates, all of which are fully responsive, on-trend and customizable. We are always working to add new templates, and your feedback is greatly appreciated. Additionally, if you have any specific template requests, feel free to contact us and let us know.

title: How can I change the main color in my site's color palette using ADI?
content: To change the main color in your palette: Click Design on the top bar inside ADI. Select Colors. Click the Design icon in the Main Color box at the top. Choose one of the suggested colors, or click the Add icon to choose a custom color.

title: How can I create a secondary logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Go to the Wix Logo Maker. In the Brand Studio, click the My Logos & Brands drop-down at the top, select the relevant brand, click the Create a new design icon under Brand Designs, click Logo, hover over the relevant logo design and click Select / Duplicate, then customize your logo.

title: How can I add an accessibility toolbar to my Wix site using third-party code?
content:
Wix doesn't offer built-in accessibility toolbars, but you can add one using code from a third-party provider. Important: Embedding custom code is only available for sites with a connected domain.

To add an accessibility toolbar using third-party code:
- Go to your Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Select the Custom Code tab under Advanced Settings.
- Select + Add Custom Code at the top right.
- Paste the code snippet in the text box.
- Enter a name for your code. Tip: Give it a name that is easy to recognize so you can quickly identify it later.
- Select an option under Add Code to Pages:
  - All pages: This adds the code to all of your site's pages, including any new pages that you'll create in the future. Choose whether to load the code only once per visit or on each page your visitor opens.
  - Choose specific pages: Use the drop-down menu to select the relevant pages.
- Choose where to place your code: Head, Body - start, or Body - end.
- Select Apply.

title: How can I create Local Business markup for my site's homepage in Wix?
content: You can create Local Business markup for your site's homepage by adding a business name and location to your site's Business Info. You can also optionally add a logo to include it in the markup. To create Local Business markup: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Business info. Enter your business name under Name in the Profile section. (Optional) Click Add Logo to upload a logo image. Add your location under Address in the Location and contact info section. Click Save. You can update your Local Business markup at any time by editing your business name or location. Note: Wix creates Local Business markup for your primary location only. If you have multiple business locations, Wix does not create markups for each additional location.

title: How can I create a custom form in Wix that allows visitors to submit their information directly to my CMS collection?
content:
Before you begin, make sure to add the CMS to your site if you haven't already. Create a collection where you will store the custom form submissions and set the collection permissions. You can choose Collect content or Custom permissions.

Add input elements to your site: go to the page or section where you want to create the form, click Add Elements, click Input, choose the input element type, and drag the input element onto the page. Repeat to add as many input elements as your form needs.

Connect each input element to a dataset that binds to the collection where submissions will be stored. Connect the input value to a new collection field by selecting Add new field, entering a Field Name, selecting the Field Type, and clicking Add. Repeat for each input element.

Set the dataset connected to your submissions collection to Write. If you connected dropdown or selection tag list items to another dataset, set that dataset mode to Read or Read & Write so the choices can show items from the other collection.

Add a button or image to use as your submit button, connect it to the same dataset, and set the click action to Submit. You can also add success and failure messages and choose whether visitors stay on the page or are redirected after submitting.

Customize the input elements using Settings, Layout, Design, and optionally Animation. Preview to test the form, then Publish to make changes go live. If Sandbox is enabled, sync your Sandbox collection to the live collection.

title: How do I add Wix AI Site-Chat to my site?
content:
Important: Wix AI Site-Chat cannot work alongside Wix Chat. If you have working hours set for Wix Chat, you will be unable to have the AI Site-Chat on your site.

To add the AI Site-Chat to your site:
- Dashboard: Go to the Wix AI Site-Chat in the Wix App Market. Click Add to Site.
- Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix AI Site-Chat app in the search bar then select the app. Click Add to Site.
- Studio Editor: Go to your editor. Click App Market on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix AI Site-Chat app in the search bar then select the app. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I enable the SSL certificate on an older Windows OS if I can't update the operating system?
content: Click Win + r, and type certmgr.msc. Click OK. Go to Trusted Root Certification Authorities > Certificates. Right click on DST ROOT CA X3 certificate. Click Delete. Go to Intermediate Certification Authorities > Certificates. Right click on R3 Certificate. Click Delete. Go to Third-party root Certification Authorities > Certificates. Right click on DST ROOT CA X3 certificate. Click Delete. Install new SSL Certificate: Download this certificate installation link. Double click the download to open it. Click Local Machine. Click Next. Click Install Certificate. Click Place all Certificates in the Following Store. Choose Trusted Root Certification Authorities folder. Click OK. Restart your PC.

title: How do I access the dashboard to my live website
content: Sign in to your Wix account. If you only have one site, you are taken directly to your site's dashboard. If you have multiple sites, you're directed to the Sites page, where you can access the dashboards of all your sites and click Select Site on the one you want to access.

title: Can I stack elements only on a specific breakpoint in the Studio Editor?
content: No. When you stack elements in the Studio Editor, it automatically applies to all breakpoints. Currently, it is not possible to place elements in a stack only on a specific breakpoint (e.g. stacking elements on mobile but not on desktop).

title: Can I switch the Facebook account connected to an ad campaign in Facebook Ads?
content:
Currently in Facebook Ads you cannot change the Facebook account you connected initially when first setting up a campaign. To change the account, you need to contact Customer Care. Our team will review the issue and provide you with available options. It is possible for us to remove your connected account altogether, but this is not recommended.

Important:
- If we remove your connected account, you will lose all data from any previous campaigns that launched with that account.
- Once a Facebook account is removed from our system, we no longer have access to any information about the previous connection.

If you still want to remove your account and go through the setup process again, provide the following information when you contact Customer Care:
- Your Wix site URL
- Written approval that you understand the implications of us removing your connected Facebook account

title: Can participants undo a step they have already marked as completed in Online Programs?
content: Yes. Online Programs participants can now undo a step that they have already marked as completed.

title: How can I cancel a published event using the Wix app?
content:
To cancel a published event using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events.
- Tap the relevant event status: Published Events or Draft Events.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the published event you want to cancel.
- Tap Cancel event.
- Tap Confirm.

Once you cancel an event, all registered guests automatically receive a cancellation email.

title: Can I format my message text with bold, italic, underline, bullets, or links in Wix Inbox?
content: Currently, it is not possible to format your message text (bold, italic, underline, bullets or links) from Wix Inbox. Tip: You can edit the text of your business name, subject line, and email signature.

title: What should I do if I'm unable to open the Wix Editor on my computer?
content: If the Wix Editor is not loading, the issue is usually local to your computer, browser, or internet connection. First, go through the Wix Technical Assistant and follow the steps to troubleshoot the issue. If you are still unable to open your editor, contact Wix Customer Care and provide: the name or URL of your Wix site; the name and version of the web browser you're using; the name and version of your computer's operating system; and a screenshot of your console view showing the first line of the error message. The source also describes opening an incognito window, signing in to Wix and trying to open your editor, opening the console (Ctrl + Shift + J on PC or Cmd + Option + J on Mac), clicking the Console tab, refreshing the page (F5), and taking a screenshot of the entire browser window including the console and the first red error message(s).

title: How can I change the color theme of my Wix app using the dashboard?
content: Go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard. Click the tab with the name of your own mobile app. Click Edit Mobile App. Click Design on the left panel. Click the Edit icon next to Color theme. To change the app's color theme, click Change Color Theme to select a new preset main color theme. To customize individual element colors, select which colors to edit: Primary (choose a new main color for your app), Text and icons (choose a new color for the main text and social icons), or Background (choose a new color for the app background). Click Save at the top right.

title: Can I choose multiple theme colors for my Branded App?
content: Yes. You can choose multiple theme colors for your Branded App. Select a primary theme color, a color for the text and icons in your app, as well as an app background color.

title: How can I access the Wix Photo Studio from the Wix Editor to edit my images?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Media on the left side of the editor, click Show More under Site Files, select the image you want to edit, then click Crop & Edit or Adjust in the Actions section. You can also access Photo Studio when selecting an image on your page: click the Settings icon, then click Adjust.

title: How can I change my Premium plan on Wix?
content: To change your Premium plan, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Change Plan, select the plan you want to change to, and follow the steps on screen. If changing your plan is not possible, the source provides an alternative workaround: cancel the plan's auto-renewal, duplicate the site, sign up for the new plan, apply the new subscription to your original site, and reassign your domain back to the original site.

title: How do I use the Accessibility Wizard in the Wix Editor to identify and fix accessibility issues on my site?
content: In the Wix Editor, select Settings at the top, select Accessibility Wizard, then select Scan My Site on the right. After scanning, a list of detected issues appears. Select each issue to view instructions, apply the changes when fixed, and select Continue to Step 2. All detected issues must be resolved to progress. The Find and Fix Issues step highlights additional settings that require manual adjustment; mark each option as done to finish. The Accessibility Wizard is currently supported in the site's primary language and cannot be accessed in secondary languages added with Wix Multilingual. Wix cannot guarantee compliance with regional accessibility laws and regulations, so consulting an accessibility expert is recommended.

title: How can I add a text marquee to my site using the Studio Editor?
content:
To add a text marquee using the Studio Editor, start in the Add Elements panel on the left side of the editor. Click Text, then click Text Marquee, and drag a design you like onto your page. To enter your text, click Change Text and enter your text under Add your own text.

Note: You can enter up to 450 characters.

Tip: You can add emojis to your marquee text using the relevant keyboard shortcut:
- PC: Windows logo key + .
- Mac: Control + Command + Space

title: How can I find and delete the old Cookie Alert app from my site if it's not visible in the editor?
content: Check the page layout, as the Cookie Alert app is visible only if the page layout is regular. Turn on the ruler in the editor and use Ctrl+M to go through the elements on the page. If you come across an element that has "-" in the element position (X, Y), you can remove the "-" and see what element that is. Sometimes the Cookie Alert app ends up being outside of visible grid lines and it's hard to find; you can also check the elements in the "layers". When you delete the app, it takes up to 24 hours for the banner in the app to disappear.

title: Can clients access the cart through the member apps in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible for clients to access the cart through the relevant member apps. Clients can access the cart directly from your site on desktop or the mobile web version of your site, enabling them to add multiple services before checking out.

title: Broad Match 中如何识别值得提升为 Exact Match 的关键词机会？
content: 在 Broad Match 关键词机会表中，对每个候选词列出点击量和转化率，并将点击 ≥5 且转化率 ≥10% 的词标注为“提升为 Exact”。每个结论标注来源：[输入数据] 或 [模型推测]。若判断依据不足，先列出还需要哪些数据并停下来询问，不要先给结论。

title: Can I automatically move contacts from one Wix site to another within my account?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to automatically move contacts from one Wix site to another within your account. You can use this workaround.

To move your contacts:

Export your contacts from the first site:
- Click "Manage Contacts" next to the first site.
- Optional: To choose individual contacts to export, select the checkbox beside those contacts.
- Click "More Actions" and select "Export Contacts".
- Select the contacts you want to export: "Selected contacts" or "By group" (use the drop-down menu to select a contact group, or select "All Contacts").
- Select a file format: "Google CSV file" or "Outlook CSV file".
- Click "Export".
- Save the file to your computer.

Import your contacts to the second site:
- Click "Manage Contacts" next to the second site.
- Click "More Actions" and select "Import Contacts".
- Click "Connect" under "CSV File".
- Click "Upload".
- Select the file from your computer.
- Click "Import".

Note: If your contacts are organized in groups and you want to maintain this structure, each group should be exported and imported separately.

title: How can I turn an image into a button in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the image in your Editor. Click the Settings icon. Click the When image is clicked drop-down and select A link opens. Under What does it link to? click the Link icon. Select the link type and enter the details. Click Done. Tip: Use the Wix Photo Studio to edit your image and make it look more like a button. You can cut out the background, and add text to create the button you want.

title: What should I try if I am experiencing issues with my Wix blog on my live site?
content: Try opening your blog page in an Incognito window using the browser-specific shortcut. If this resolves the issue, clear your browser cache and cookies by following the browser-specific instructions. Wix no longer supports live sites on Internet Explorer 11, so use a supported browser to view and edit your site. If issues continue, use the Wix Technical Assistant or contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I attach elements to a strip in the Wix Editor?
content: To attach an element to a strip in the Wix Editor, make sure the element fits within the strip and resize it if needed. Click and drag the element over the strip, then drop it when you see Attach to Strip. Make sure to attach elements within the vertical gridlines of the strip so they display on smaller screens.

title: How can I use the Layers panel in Wix Editor to manage elements on my site?
content: Use the Layers panel to select and manage elements on your site. Go to your editor, click Layers on the bottom left, then choose Header, Page, or Footer to view the elements in that area. Locate and click the relevant element, then choose an action: move it forward with Ctrl + ↑ or backward with Ctrl + ↓, using Ctrl + Shift + ↑ to bring it to the front and Ctrl + Shift + ↓ to send it to the back; recenter an element by selecting it in the panel, hovering over the Information icon, and clicking Recenter element; customize or adjust the element by clicking it in your editor and using the available options; or click and drag elements in the panel to change their order so the panel order matches the visual order on your site.

title: How can I access and customize the additional Wix Bookings pages in ADI?
content: Click the Page drop-down at the top of ADI. Click Book Online. Click Bookings Checkout under Book Online. Click the Bookings section in the ADI Builder. The list of Bookings pages appears on the left. Click the Edit icon beside a Bookings page to customize it.

title: How can I add a Profile page to my Members Area using the Wix Editor?
content:
If the Profile page isn't already part of your Members Area, you can add it directly from the Pages panel in your Editor by following these steps:

- Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click Members Area.
- Click Member Page.
- Select the Member Menu element and click Manage and Navigate.
- Click + Add More Tabs.
- Click + Add Tab under Profile.

When using social apps (e.g. Wix Blog, Wix Forum, Fileshare), the Profile page is automatically added to your site. You can check if it already exists in the Pages panel.

title: How can I access and view my traffic reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard, scroll down to the Traffic Reports section, and select the report you'd like to view.

title: How can I add a YouTube feed to my Wix Video widget?
content:
To add a YouTube feed as a channel in Wix Video:
- Find and copy your public YouTube channel or playlist URL. Make sure the videos are not set to private; private YouTube videos are not supported and may not display properly.
- Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Channels tab in the side panel on the left.
- Hover over the New Channel drop-down at the top right and select YouTube Feed.
- Paste your YouTube channel or playlist URL in the field.
- Click Connect.

Note: It may take several hours for your embedded YouTube channel or playlist on Wix to sync with the latest uploads from the YouTube channel.

title: How can I get started with the CMS in the Wix Editor?
content: Add the CMS (Content Management System) to your site to manage content in collections, separate from your Editor. To get started with the CMS in the Wix Editor: go to your Editor; click CMS on the left side of the Editor; click Start Now or Add to site; then select an option. You can choose Start with a preset to choose and customize a layout that comes with a collection and dynamic pages, and learn more about adding collection presets. Or you can choose Start by adding content to start from scratch by creating a collection and adding content to it. Tips: create forms with input elements and save submissions in a collection; and add a dynamic page to create an unlimited number of site pages.

title: How can I import a Lottie animation to my Wix site?
content: To import a Lottie animation to your Wix site, make sure you have a LottieFiles account. In the Editor, click Add Elements, select Embed Code, scroll down to Animation, and click Lottie to add the element. Then log in to your LottieFiles account, select your chosen animation, click Save to workspace to generate, and click the Copy icon under Asset link. In Wix, select the Lottie Animation element, click the Settings icon, paste the URL into the field under What's the animation's URL?, and press Enter. You can then click Preview animation to see how the animation plays and use the settings to adjust how it plays.

title: Can I accept manual payments for individual sales and rentals on Wix Video?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to accept manual payments for Wix Video individual sales and rentals.

Tip: You can add manual payments to any channel subscriptions connected to pricing plans by adding clients to the plan and setting the payment requirements.

title: Can I automatically create barcodes or SKUs with Wix Retail POS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create barcodes or SKUs automatically with Wix Retail POS. You can use third-party apps such as Barcode Man and Kodbar to automatically create barcodes. To get started, go to the Wix App Market.

title: How can I view and manage my upcoming sessions using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Booking Calendar. Tap Calendar. Tap the Change View icon at the top right. Choose Schedule, Day view, or 3 day. You can add advanced filters for staff, location, services, and other events. To manage pending appointments, enable manual approval, then tap View on the appointment request notification at the bottom of your screen. Tap the relevant appointment request and choose Approve, Decline, or Reschedule. For rescheduling, edit the session details and tap Save.

title: How can I track user activity on my site using the HubSpot app?
content: Once a visitor submits the contact form, they become a contact in your HubSpot account where you can track their activity on your site. To see their activity, log in to your HubSpot account, click Contacts at the top left, click Contacts, click the relevant contact to access their record, and see all their activities under the Activity tab. You can also analyze users' activity using the reports in your HubSpot marketing dashboard to see where your contacts are coming from, how often they visit your site and more.

title: How can I connect Tranzila as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Tranzila as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
  Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to Tranzila.
- If you have an account, enter your Terminal and Registered email, then click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create Tranzila account, fill in the registration form to create your account, and wait for an email or chat message from Tranzila to get your Terminal and Registered email. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the instructions under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Is it possible to add a footer-specific menu in Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add a menu that has been designed and built specifically for your site footer. As an alternative, you can add a site or anchor menu to your footer, and customize its design to look different to any additional menus you have on the page.

Important: If you have more than one site menu on your page, any changes you make to the items in one menu affect the others. For example, if you hide a page from the menu in the header, it is also hidden from the menu in the footer, and vice versa.

title: Can a Wix site be hosted externally or embedded elsewhere?
content: Your Wix site needs to be hosted and operated on Wix's servers. Since Wix is a SaaS solution, your site must run on Wix’s servers, and the SaaS architecture does not support external hosting. If you embed your site into an external location, Wix cannot provide support, and Wix is no longer in control of the way your site appears or functions.

title: How can I view which store orders are attributed to my Facebook Ads campaign?
content: This is only relevant for campaigns with the 'get more store orders' goal. To view which store orders are attributed to your campaign, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the Customize columns icon at the top right, and select the Source checkbox under Choose which columns to show. A new 'source' column is added to your orders list. Any order with a Facebook icon in the source column is attributed to your Facebook Ads campaign.

title: Is SSLCOMMERZ supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer SSLCOMMERZ as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through SSLCOMMERZ and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I add a bonus item to an album or single in Wix Music?
content: From your Music Library in your site's dashboard, select the relevant album or single. Click Edit. In the Sale and Download Options on Your Site section, click Add an Item under Bonus Item. Click Add Image or Add Doc and browse for the bonus file. Bonus items may be up to 15MB and in any of the following formats: .jpg, .png, .gif, .doc, .ppt, .pdf.
