title: Can I still use Internet Explorer 11 to edit or view my Wix site?
content: Wix no longer supports editing or viewing live sites on IE11. If you're using Internet Explorer, we recommend that you instead update to the latest version of Microsoft Edge or another supported browser on PC - Chrome or Firefox.

title: How can I add a new store page to my Wix mobile app using the site's dashboard?
content:
To add a new store page using your site's dashboard:
- Go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard.
- Click Edit Mobile App.
- Click Screens on the left.
- Click + Add.
- Tip: Click + Add next to Screens not in navigation to hide your screen while working on its content.
- Enter a name to show in the navigation menu.
- Click Add Elements.
- Select Store under Add Elements.
- Choose the element to add to your screen: Product gallery or Product carousel.
- Edit the element on the right panel of your screen.
- Click Save & Publish.

title: How can I connect my Wix store to my Amazon seller account?
content: Prerequisites: You need an Amazon Sellers account. To connect your Wix store to Amazon, go to the Amazon tab in your site's dashboard. Click Start Now. Select your Amazon marketplace from the Where do you sell from? drop-down. Select Yes, I have an existing account. Sign in to your Amazon sellers account.

title: How can I connect my Amazon affiliate account to the Amazon app on my Wix site?
content:
To connect your Amazon affiliate account to the Amazon app, open the Amazon app in your editor, click Settings, click the Settings tab, click Connect, enter your Amazon credentials, and click Connect.

Important:
- If you're a new affiliate, you need to make 3 sales through affiliate links before you can connect your account. If you don't have 3 sales, you can use the workaround solution.
- Active accounts that have no sales for a month revert back to inactive status.

If you see the error Double Check Your Info and Try Again, confirm that your credentials are correct and try connecting again. If you still can't connect, contact Amazon affiliate support.

title: How can I apply a glass effect to a container in the Studio Editor?
content: To apply a glass effect, select the relevant container, cell, or repeater item and click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Optionally, choose a Background color and use the slider to adjust its opacity. Enable the Apply glass effect toggle, then use the slider under Blur intensity to increase or decrease the blur.

title: How can I revoke an Admin status for another user in Google Workspace to delete their account?
content: Log into the Google Admin console using your Admin account. Click Users on the Admin console home page. Click the name of the Admin whose privileges you wish to revoke. Click Admin roles and privileges. Click Roles. Disable the Super Admin toggle. Click Save. Once you have revoked the required Admin status, you can delete unwanted Workspace accounts for monthly or yearly subscriptions, as needed.

title: How can I get my Facebook ad campaign approved if it was rejected for featuring COVID-19 related products?
content: Remove all COVID-19 related products from your site. Edit your Facebook Ads campaign and make sure all products in question are removed. Re-publish your Facebook Ads campaign for Facebook's approval. Facebook will review your campaign again and hopefully approve it. If Facebook still rejects your campaign, contact Wix Customer Care for assistance.

title: Is it now possible to collect payment on Android phones using tap-to-pay in Wix Mobile POS?
content: It's now possible to collect payment on Android phones using tap-to-pay. Learn how to set up tap to pay.

title: How can I share my Wix group page or a specific post to social networks?
content:
Before sharing, ensure the "Share" button is enabled in the Group app settings. Both you and your group members can share the group page or specific posts from your live site.

Go to the relevant group on your live site.

To share the group page:
- Click the Show More icon next to the name of the group page.
- Click Share.
- Choose how you want to share the group's page:
  - Share the group's page to your Facebook News Feed or your Story.
  - Share the group's page to your Twitter page.
  - Share the group's page to your LinkedIn profile.
  - Copy and paste the link into a new message using the application of your choice.

To share a post:
- Click the Show More icon next to the relevant post.
- Choose how you want to share the post:
  - Share the post to your Facebook News Feed or your Story.
  - Share the post to your Twitter page.
  - Share the group to your LinkedIn profile.
  - Copy and paste the link into a new message using the application of your choice.

title: Can I filter images by tags in the Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to search and filter images by tags in the Wix Pro Gallery.

Tip: If you connected your gallery to the CMS (Content Management System), you can allow visitors to use input elements to filter content.

title: How can I manage my existing payment methods using the Accept Payments tab in my Wix site's dashboard?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Optionally change your business location by selecting your country at the top right. Optionally scroll down and click See More Payment Options to see additional payment options available in your country. If available, scroll down and click See Options to see any further available providers. Optionally click Connect next to a payment option to learn more about connecting that option, or click Manage next to an already connected option to view possible actions.

title: How can I edit my default profile in the Spaces by Wix app?
content: Open the Spaces App. Tap My Profile at the bottom. Tap View Profile. Tap Edit Default Profile. Make the relevant changes to your profile. For Profile picture, tap the Camera icon and choose Take Photo, Choose from Device, or Remove Photo. For Profile name, enter your first and last name in the relevant fields.

title: Can I use BitPay as a payment provider in Wix?
content: Currently, BitPay cannot be connected as a payment provider in Wix. As an alternative, and depending on your location, you can accept cryptocurrency payments using Bankful as a payment provider.

title: How can I create a coupon for my Wix form to offer a discount to users?
content:
This feature is available for New Wix Forms only. Before you begin, make sure to add a payment form to your site.

To create a coupon:
- Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard.
- Click **New Coupon**.
- Select the type of coupon you want to offer:
  - **$ Discount**: Offer a fixed monetary discount amount.
  - **% Discount**: Offer a percentage discount.
- Enter the **Coupon code** participants need to use the coupon.
- Enter the **Coupon name** for your own records.
- Enter the **Discount** you want to offer.
- Select the relevant form from the **Apply to** drop-down:
  - **All Forms**: Participants can use the discount on all forms.
  - **Specific Forms**: The discount is available on the forms you choose. Select the relevant form from the **Form** drop-down.
- Select the dates the coupon is valid between.
- (Optional) Select the **Limit uses** checkbox(s) to:
  - **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon**: Set the number of times the coupon can be used.
  - **Limit to one use per customer**: The same participant can't use the coupon more than once.
- Click **Create Coupon**.

After creating the coupon, you can share it with your contacts by sending an email campaign with your coupon code or by sending coupons to clients directly from your Wix Inbox.

title: How can I display a PayPal button on the Product Page in my Wix Store?
content: To display a PayPal button in the Product Page, click the Product Page in the editor, then click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Under Buy Now, enable the Show button toggle. Enable the Change automatically by payment method toggle.

title: How can I connect my Gmail account to Wix Inbox?
content: To connect your Gmail account to Wix Inbox: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings drop-down at the top right. Click Email. Click Use Gmail Address under Send emails from your Gmail address. Click Continue with Google. Select the Google account you'd like to connect and click Continue. Select the checkboxes next to the options for what Wix can access and click Continue.

title: How can I allow search engines like Google to index my Wix site?
content: Wix sites are search engine friendly, and Wix guarantees that all of your site content can be crawled and indexed by search engines whether you have a Premium site or not. You can choose whether or not to allow search engines to index your site in your SEO Settings. To enable search engines to index your site, go to your SEO dashboard, select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings, and make sure the Let search engines index your site toggle is enabled. Note: To connect to Google Search Console, you must have a Premium plan and a domain connected to your site. After publishing, it takes time for your site to be crawled and appear in search results. Any edits or changes to your site must be crawled again before they appear. You can help speed up this process by submitting your homepage's URL to search engines.

title: How can I mark an order as paid in Wix Events if the payment was received offline?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Events. Select the published, ticketed event you want to view. Click the Orders tab. Select the checkbox next to the relevant order(s). Click Mark as Paid. Click Mark as Paid to confirm. You can also select a specific order and change the order status from Not Paid to Paid.

title: Is it possible to hide the Play button on the Wix Video Player?
content: Currently, it is not possible to hide the Play button on your Wix Video Player. In the meantime, you can achieve a similar effect by using the Single Video player. Add the single video player to your site. Enable auto play in the player: select the player in your Editor and click the Settings icon; click the Autoplays toggle under Playback Options. Disable the player controls: click the Layout icon and select Never. Note: The video will play automatically when the site loads. Visitors can click the video to pause it.

title: Is it possible to use a staging environment for apps in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to view or make changes to your app in a staging environment. However, you can preview and test a widget in an app before publishing it.

title: How can I add a watermark to my art in the Wix Art Store?
content:
A watermark is a semi-transparent design, added to images to protect against copyright. Adding a watermark is the best way to protect your images from theft.

Click the Wix Art Store gallery in your Editor. Click Settings and then the Settings tab. Enable the Watermark toggle. Click Customize Watermark. Click Change Watermark: select the watermark image from your media manager, or click Upload Images to upload a new image. Click Apply. Customize Watermark Opacity, Watermark Size, and Watermark Position.

Note: Once a customer purchases your image, the watermark will automatically disappear.

title: How can I change the pickup hours for my restaurant orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Pickup tab. Hover over the Hours field and click Edit to change your pickup hours. Choose how you want to set your pickup hours: Opening Hours, where pickup is available during your restaurant's opening hours, or Custom Hours, where you set specific days and hours. For Custom Hours, select the days, then select or deselect the 24 hours checkbox: selected means customers can pick up their orders at any time; deselected means you set specific hours when customers pick up their orders. Optionally click the Add + icon to add another day and/or time range, for example one pickup window for Monday - Thursday from 9AM-5PM and another for Friday - Saturday from 9AM-11PM. Click Apply, then click Save at the top right. You can also enable or disable the toggle in the Pickup tab to temporarily disable the pickup option for your restaurant; if disabled, customers cannot go to your restaurant to pick up orders.

title: How can I delete Wix Stores using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the Actions icon next to Store Pages. Select Delete Store. Click Delete to confirm.

Deleting Wix Stores does not cancel your Premium plan or Studio plan.

Tip: Your store data is not lost when you delete your store. If you want to display your store again, reverting to a previously saved version with the store will restore it.

title: How can I add a recovery phone number to my Wix account?
content: Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to Login Info. Click Add Phone Number next to Recovery Phone Number. Enter your mobile phone number. Click OK. Enter the confirmation code sent to your mobile phone. Click Confirm.

title: How can I create a new member role on my site to control page access?
content: Before you begin, go to your site's editor and change the pages you want to restrict to Members Only pages. To create a new role: Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Member Roles at the top right of the page. Click + New Role. Enter a name to identify the role under Role Name. Enter a short description of the role under Description. This description is not visible to site members. Select a color to help you identify the role under Role Color. Click Save Role. Then, in the Permissions tab, select the checkboxes next to the pages that you want members with this role to be able to access, and click Save.

title: Can I update my domain information from the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to update your domain information, switch your primary domain, or purchase a new one, from the Wix app. For example, if you want to add a domain name that is currently designated to another site, or use a domain to get a Business Email, you have to do this from the domains page on your dashboard.

title: How can I add and customize a table in a Wix blog post?
content:
To add a table to a blog post:
- Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
- Click Edit on the relevant blog post, or Create New Post to write a new one.
- Click Add on the left side.
- Click Table.
- Type the number of columns and rows you want in your table.
- Click Create table.
- Add the relevant content to each section of the table.
- Customize the look of the table and the text:
  - Click Text style to customize the text that appears in the table.
  - Click the Vertical alignment icon to choose how you want the text to align.
  - Click the Background color icon to change the background color of the table.
  - Click the Border color icon to change the color of the table border.
  - Click the Show More icon to select a specific row or column.
  - Click the Show More icon to add or remove rows and columns in the table.
- Click Publish.

Tip: When you select a specific row or column, you have the option to set it as a header by clicking the Set as header icon.

title: How can I connect the Triple-A Crypto Payment Gateway as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Triple-A as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Triple-A.
- If you have an account, enter your Client ID and Client Secret, then click Connect.
- If you do not have an account, click Create Triple-A Payment Gateway account, register for a Triple-A account, wait for an email from Triple-A to get your Client ID and Client Secret credentials, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Is it possible to cut out or erase a part of a shape, icon, or text in the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Currently, it is not possible to cut out or erase a part of a shape, icon, or text in the Logo Maker. Note: Shapes are always visible in white, black, monochrome, grayscale and transparent files of the logo. We do not recommend using them to cover parts of the elements in your logo.

title: What are the steps involved in creating a customized SEO checklist using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist?
content: You can create your own customized checklist in the SEO Setup Checklist by answering just three questions. Enter the name of your business, select whether you serve your customers from a physical address or online, and add three keywords that describe your business and what you offer. You can also use Wix's keyword research tool integration to help you find strong keywords for your site.

title: Is it possible to save or copy design settings to a new Pro Gallery?
content:
Currently, any design or settings changes you make to an existing Pro Gallery must be recreated from scratch in any new galleries. It's not possible to save or copy your design settings to a new gallery, or save your own presets.

As a workaround, you can duplicate an existing gallery. However, this is generally not recommended for optimal performance.

title: What should I do if my Wix site is reported for malware?
content: If you added code using the HTML app or Velo by Wix, review the code to ensure it comes from a trusted source. If we detect that your site has malicious code, your site will be taken down immediately. Once you've removed the code, or if you feel that your site was reported in error, you can submit a request to be removed from the list of malware sites here.

title: How can I connect Przelewy24 as a payment method through Skrill on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Przelewy24. If you have a Skrill account, enter your Merchant ID, E-Mail, Secret Word, and MQI/API Password. To create your Secret Word and API Password, sign in to Skrill and go to Settings > Developer Settings; your Merchant ID can be seen at the top right of your Skrill account. Click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Skrill account, register your account with Skrill, and once verified retrieve your Merchant ID from the top right of your Skrill account. Still in Skrill, go to Settings > Developer Settings to create your Secret Word and API Password. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Skrill account to avoid transaction declines.

title: How can I move multiple elements at once in the Wix Editor?
content: Align all of the relevant elements. Click the element that's at the top of these elements. Click and drag the drag handle. Move the element group to the desired position.

title: How can I add a personal note to an order in Wix Stores?
content: Go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard. Select the order you want to add the note to. Scroll down to Order Activity. Enter your note in the Add a note field. Click the checkmark to save. These notes are personal and can only be seen by you and your site collaborators.

title: How can I add a YouTube Subscribe button to my Wix site?
content: Retrieve your YouTube Channel URL first. Then go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Social, and click YouTube. Click or drag the YouTube Subscribe button to add it to your site. Click Set Your Channel or the Settings icon. Paste your YouTube channel's URL under What's your channel's address? and press the Enter key on your keyboard. To customize the button, click the Layouts icon and choose whether to display your channel name and profile picture; you can also click the Animation icon to add an animation.

title: Can I assign specific roles with dedicated permissions to collaborators in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, as part of teamwork support, you can share your app with other collaborators. However, you can only assign them the role of Co-admin, which provides them with full permissions to access and edit the app. The source describes a requested feature that would allow assigning collaborators more specific roles with dedicated permissions, with examples such as Designer (manage design only), Developer (manage code only), Content Manager (manage text and images), or App Manger (edit market listing and access and financial aspects).

title: How can I add a hamburger menu to my site using Editor X?
content: Click Add at the top left of the Editor. Click Menu & Search. Click Hamburger Menus. Drag and drop the relevant menu to the desired location on your page. (Optional) To create a new menu with custom pages: click the menu icon and select Open Menu; select the vertical menu showing your pages; click Manage Menu; click the drop-down under Which menu is displayed?; click Manage Site Menus; click + Add New Menu at the bottom to create the custom menu.

title: How do I connect PayWay by Hrvatski Telekom as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to PayWay. If you already have an account, enter your Shop Id and Secret Key and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Hrvatski Telekom account, fill in the registration form, wait for an email from Hrvatski Telekom to get your credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Make sure the currency in your Wix account matches the currency in your Hrvatski Telekom account to avoid transaction declines.

title: How can I connect my existing .ie domain to my Wix site?
content: Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .ie domain you already own to your Wix site. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via Nameservers. With this method, Wix hosts your DNS records, so you can manage them in your Wix account, and Wix Customer Care can help if you need assistance managing them. Before connecting, make sure you have access to your current domain registrar. New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Currently, it is not possible to purchase a .ie domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix; if you would like to see this feature in the future, you can Vote for this feature.

title: Why was my app review removed from the Wix App Market?
content:
Reviews might be removed due to the following reasons:

- **Spamming or advertising**: The review contains content that is considered spam or advertising.
- **Irrelevant Content**: For example, text that is gibberish and is not a review, or a review that is not related to the app itself, such as a general question about Wix or about another app.
- **Profanity or slander**: The review contains content that is considered profanity or slander.

By submitting a review to the Wix App Market, you agree to the rules stated in the App Market Terms of Use page as well as the general Wix Terms of Use. To appeal your review removal or if you have any further questions, please contact us.

title: Why can't I upload my YouTube video to my Wix site?
content:
If you are experiencing a problem with uploading a YouTube video, please check the following:

- Your video is set to **Public**. If your YouTube video is marked as **Private**, you cannot upload it to your Wix site. You can find your video's privacy settings on your video's **Basic info** tab in your YouTube account.
- **Embedding** is enabled. This setting can be found on your video's **Advanced settings** tab in your YouTube account.

title: How can I connect a Google Domain to a different Wix site if it is currently assigned to another site?
content: In your Wix account, go to Domains. Next to the relevant domain, click the Domain Actions icon. Click Assign to a Different Site. Select a site and click Next. If that site is already connected to a different domain, choose whether to redirect your new domain to the site's existing primary domain or replace the current primary domain. Click Assign.

title: Is it possible to add an anchor menu inside ADI?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add an anchor menu inside ADI. However, you can link to sections on your site menu by clicking the page header, clicking Edit next to Site Menu on the left of the builder, clicking Add a Menu Item, clicking Page, selecting the page and section from the dropdown menus, and clicking Done. Note: The option to select a page section is not displayed if you have a one-page site.

title: How can I adjust the resizing options for product gallery images in Wix Stores to prevent them from appearing cropped on mobile devices?
content:
To adjust the resizing options for product gallery images in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

- Go to the relevant page in the Editor. Make sure you are in desktop editing mode.
- Click the Product Gallery.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Click the Layout tab.
- Select a resizing option:
  - Crop: Images are cropped so that they are all the same size. If you upload images in different sizes and with different aspect ratios, part of the image may be cut off.
  - Fit: The entire image is displayed and keeps its original aspect ratio. Images in your gallery will not have the same aspect ratio unless the original images had them.
- Select an image ratio.

By choosing the Fit option, you can ensure that the entire image is displayed without cropping, maintaining its original aspect ratio.

title: How can I manually add new contacts in my site's dashboard?
content: According to the article, you can manually add new contacts in your site's dashboard. You can manage your contacts from the Contacts section of your site's dashboard.

title: Can I use Payeezy as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Payeezy as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Payeezy and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I set up Wix Multilingual on my site and manage translations effectively?
content: To set up Wix Multilingual, finish building your site in your main language, then add Wix Multilingual. During setup, select your main and secondary languages. You will be prompted with the option to translate your site manually or automatically. To manage translations, use the Translation Manager in your site's dashboard to translate or review both your site and apps content. The Translation Manager shows a list of your site's content in a single location and indicates what still needs to be translated. You can also hide or delete any languages you no longer wish to display.

title: How can I view and manage all datasets for a page in the Wix Editor?
content:
To view and manage all your page's datasets in the Wix Editor, use the panel on the right side of the editor. You can access it in any of these ways:

- From the side panel: Click CMS on the left side of your editor, then click Manage Page Connections.
- From an element: Click a supported element on your page, click the Connect to CMS icon, then click View All Page Datasets in the panel on the right.
- From page settings: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, hover over the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, and select Page Connections.

Once you're in the panel on the right, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant dataset to manage the collection content, edit the dataset settings, or go to your page settings.

title: Can I filter my calendar by session availability in the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to filter your calendar by session availability in the Wix app. However, you can filter by session availability on your desktop calendar.

title: How can I convert an existing static page to a dynamic page in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Hover over the page you want to convert and click the More Actions icon. Select Convert to dynamic page. Click Start Now. Choose whether to save the page content to a new collection or an existing collection: for New collection, enter a name for the collection; if using Velo, you can edit the collection ID of the new collection. For Existing collection, select the existing collection where you want to save the page content. Click Next. If saving to a new collection, choose which elements to convert to dynamic and set up the fields that will connect to the dynamic elements: in the panel on the right, select or deselect the elements that you want to convert to dynamic elements; hover over an element in the panel on the right and click the Edit icon to change the name, key (Velo only), or field type that will connect to the element; click Save and repeat this step for each element; click Connect Elements. You cannot convert your home page or Wix app pages to a dynamic page.

title: How can I restore my site to a previous Wix Editor version from Editor X?
content: While working in Editor X, click Site at the top, select Site History, use the list to find the Wix Editor version you want to restore, click the Arrow icon next to the relevant revision, review the revision to make sure it is the one you want to restore, and click Restore.

title: How can I create a new design library in Editor X?
content: To create a new design library in Editor X, access your Design Libraries by clicking Add Elements at the top of Editor X, then Assets, then More Actions, and select Open Libraries from the drop-down menu. Click + Create New Library. Select which assets to include from the site you're currently working on: Typography, Color Themes, Design Assets. Click Create. Enter a name for your library under Library Name. Optionally, click the Turn on sharing toggle to share this library with your teammates.

title: How can I display my photos in professional album sites using Wix?
content: Wix Photo Albums allows you to display your photos in professional album sites that you can share with your clients. Each album opens in its own, easy to share mini-site.

title: How can I retrieve the URL of my Pinterest profile to set up the Social Bar on my Wix site?
content: Sign in to your Pinterest account. Click your profile picture at the top right. Copy the URL in the browser address bar.

title: How can I set my Wix Bookings to display only my local time zone for clients?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Settings. Scroll down and select Calendar time zone. Select Your business' time zone. Disable the Let clients choose between your time zone and theirs toggle. Click Save.

title: How can I collect payment from the Orders tab using the Dashboard Card Reader?
content:
To collect payment from the Orders tab:

- Go to Orders in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant unpaid order.
- (Optional) Add a fee, tip, or discount to the order:
  - Click More Actions.
  - Select Edit Order.
  - Select an option:
    - Fee or tip: Click Add Fees & Tips, enter the details, and click Add.
    - Discount: Click Add Discount, enter the details, and click Add.
- Click Collect Payment.
- Select Charge with card reader.
- Have your customer tap, swipe, or insert their card.

title: Can I use Zippay as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Zippay as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Zippay and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I change the text of the 'New Post' button in my Wix Forum categories?
content: Go to Forum in your site's dashboard. Click the Categories tab. Click Edit next to an existing category or click New Category to create a new category. Click the New post button field and enter your text. Click Save. You can add a maximum of 24 characters to your button. To add an emoji, right-click in the New post button text box.

title: What steps do I need to follow to complete my Wix Payments account setup as an Individual/Sole Proprietorship?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Setup under Wix Payments. Select Individual/Sole Proprietorship under Business Type. Note: It is not possible to switch between business types once you select one.

Enter Your Personal Details:
- Your full name
- Your date of birth
- Upload a Valid Photo ID (Passport, Driver’s License, Identity Card)
- If asked, enter your job title (role in the business)

Enter Your Address Details:
- Your address and phone number (If you don’t have a business address, you can use your home address)
- Upload an address verification document, such as a utility bill, to confirm your address. The document must have been issued within the last 6 months

Add Your Business Description:
- Enter your "Doing Business As" name. This is how your business appears on customers' statements.
- Your statement descriptor must be between 5-19 characters
- Your statement descriptor must be similar to your business name / legal entity name /, or URL
- Your statement descriptor should not be too generic (e.g. "Store"), or already in use (e.g. "Wix.com")
- Use the dropdown menu to select your Industry
- Use the text box to add a short description of your products / services

Enter Your Bank Details:
- Enter your personal bank account's details according to your country's requirements
- Upload a color copy of your statement, or other document from your bank, to verify your bank details

Click the checkbox to accept our terms and conditions, service fees and, if required, consent for identity check. Click Submit.

Note: You can click Save as Draft if you’d prefer to complete the form later.

Verification Requirements:
- Enter a physical address to verify your account. PO Boxes are not accepted as a valid address
- Your bank statement / document should include the bank logo, as well as your account number and the account holder name
- Your first / middle / last name and your date of birth must match those listed in your photo ID

title: How can I customize the menu icon in the Wix mobile editor?
content:
To customize the menu icon in the mobile editor:

- Click the menu icon in your mobile editor.
- Click the Design icon.
- Select a preset from the options available.
- Click Customize Design.
- Select which state you'd like to customize the icon for by clicking a tab (Closed or Open).
- Choose how you want to design the icon:

Customize the fill color and opacity:
- Click the Fill Color and Opacity tab and customize it with the options:
  - Button Background: Click the color box to select a color for the button background, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.
  - Icon: Click the color box to select a color for the button icon, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.

Add and customize a border around the icon:
- Click the Border tab to set the color, visibility, and width:
  - Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.
  - Width: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the width of the border.

Customize the icon's corners:
- Click the Corners tab to make the icon corners rounder, or more square:
  - Lock / Unlock: Click the icon to enable or disable the corners having the same radius.
  - Radius: Enter the radius of the corners into the field.

Add and adjust a shadow for the icon:
- Click the Shadow tab to add and adjust a shadow with the below options:
  - Enable Shadow: Click the toggle to enable or disable a shadow.
  - Angle: Enter the angle into the text box.
  - Distance: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the distance between the icon and the shadow.
  - Size: Use the slider to adjust the size of the shadow.
  - Blur: Drag the slider to adjust the shadow's blur.
  - Opacity and Color: Click the color box to select a color for the shadow box, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.

title: Can I set a parent-child page relationship with an Editor page that is part of a third-party app in my site hierarchy?
content: Currently, when defining your site hierarchy it is not possible to set a parent-child page relationship with an Editor page that is part of a third-party app. You can define your hierarchy by setting parent-child page relationships between pages that are not part of third-party apps.

title: How can I enable autoplay for my gallery in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, open your gallery's **Settings panel**, enable **Autoplays on loading**, and control the time (in seconds) given to each image under **How long between images?**. This setting is available for Grid (Portrait), Slider (Arrows), Slider (Postcard), 3D Slideshow, 3D Carousel, and Animated Slide.

title: How can I manage and customize the tabs on my Wix site?
content:
To manage and customize tabs on a Wix site, go to your editor, click the tabs element, and use the relevant panel.

Managing tabs:
- Click Manage Tabs.
- Add a new tab: click Add Tab at the bottom of the panel.
- Rename tabs: hover over the relevant item, click the More Actions icon, click Rename, enter the new name, and click Done.
- Duplicate a tab: select the relevant item and click Duplicate Tab at the bottom of the panel.
- Change the order of tabs: click and drag the items into the order you want.
- Set your default tab: hover over the relevant item, click the More Actions icon, and click Set as default.
- Delete a tab: hover over the relevant item, click the More Actions icon, and click Delete.

Changing tabs' layout:
- Click the tabs element and click the Layout icon.
- Adjust options such as Tab distribution (Default or Stretch), Space between tabs, Space between tabs & container, Horizontal padding, Vertical padding, Overflow tabs (Scroll or Wrap), and Tab direction.

Customizing tabs' design:
- Click the tabs, click the Design icon, and click Customize Design.
- Under What do you want to design?, select and customize Tab container, Tabs, Scroll button, or Containers.
- For Tabs and Scroll button, customize each state as available.
- Tip: click the Apply design to other states icon to give items the same look for every state.

title: What are the steps to set up Facebook Ads with Wix for a campaign aimed at getting more store orders?
content:
Step 1: Make sure you are an admin of the Facebook page and Business Manager.

Step 2: Publish your Wix site and upgrade to a Premium plan.

Step 3: Connect a domain.

Step 4: For Wix Stores, if you are running a campaign with the goal of 'getting more store orders,' connect an online payment method so your site is eligible to accept online payments. If your campaign goal is about promoting your business and getting more leads, you can skip this step.

Step 5: For Wix Stores, if you are running a campaign with the 'get more store orders' goal, make sure you have added products to your online store. To add products, go to the Products page in your site's dashboard and click +New Product.

What's next? Once your site meets all the requirements, go to the Facebook Ads dashboard and create your first campaign.

title: How can I join Wix Studio if I am already using Wix?
content: If you are already using Wix, you can join Wix Studio through multiple entry points inviting you to switch, including through the Sites page, your site's dashboard and account profile, and the Wix templates page.

title: How can I connect a domain with special or foreign characters to my Wix site?
content: You can connect a domain with special or foreign characters to your Wix site. Purchase the domain from another domain host (for example www.ex¥mple.com). Use an Internationalized Domain Names encoder to translate your domain and change it to an xn-- variant; for example, www.exâmple.com becomes www.xn--exmple-xta.com. Then connect the xn-- variant of your domain to Wix's name servers. Some browsers don't support the correct translation for the special character ß to xn--. In this case, use the DENIC encoder to translate the .de domain correctly while using the special character ß. New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Currently, it is not possible to purchase a domain with special characters from Wix or transfer one to Wix.

title: How can I add a Google Map to my site using ADI?
content:
To add a map to your site, you must add a contact section. Then select the checkbox next to Map to make it visible.

To add a map: Hover over Add at the top of ADI. Click Section to Page. (If you want a whole contact page, click Page.) Click Contact. (If necessary) Select the checkbox next to Map to make the map visible.

title: Why does my Wix form continuously load but never render on my site?
content:
Wix is aware of the issue and is currently gathering more information regarding this matter. Meanwhile, please use the following workaround:

1. Open the Layers panel.
2. Locate the corrupted form.
3. Delete the form.
4. Save your site.
5. Re-add the form if needed.

Additionally, if you are using the Safari browser, please update it to the latest version by updating your macOS or you can try using another browser such as Google Chrome or FireFox.

title: How can I add the Yandex Calendar App to my website if it is no longer supported?
content: The Yandex Calendar App is no longer supported. It is still possible to add it by clicking "Click here" and following the instructions to receive an embed code, copying the code, and adding the code to a page on your site using an HTML iFrame element. For more information, use "Learn How".

title: 当账户的浪费性支出已经很低时，继续压降ACOS会有什么风险？
content: 会开始砍到有效流量：ACOS会降，销售额也会降。否定词和降价的收益来自砍掉无效花费；当浪费性支出已经很低、这类词占比已在一成以下时，继续压ACOS会误伤有效流量。应先测浪费比例，再定优化预期。

title: How can I manually change the registration status for my Wix event to 'Open' or 'Closed'?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Click to select the relevant event. Click the Settings tab. Click Edit next to Registration settings. Click Open or Closed to change the current status. Click Save. Note: You can change the registration status to Open to allow guests to register after an event has started.

title: How can I add a Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions to my Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content:
To add policy documents such as a Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions to the original Restaurants Orders app:

- Go to Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Select Order settings.
- Click Advanced.
- Click the Policies toggle to enable it.
- Choose the policies you want to add.

Add Terms & Conditions:
- Select the Terms & Conditions checkbox.
- Choose an option:
  - Link to URL: Adds a page to your site with Terms and Conditions that the customer sees when they click the hyperlink.
  - Paste as text: The Terms and Conditions are displayed in a popup while the customer is ordering or making a reservation.

Add a Privacy Policy:
- Select the Privacy Policy checkbox.
- Choose an option:
  - Link to URL: Adds a page to your site with the Privacy Policy that the customer sees when they click the hyperlink.
  - Paste as text: The Privacy Policy is displayed in a popup while the customer is ordering or making a reservation.

Add a Policy Agreement Checkbox:
Once you've selected either Terms & Conditions or Privacy Policy, you have the option to add a Policy Agreement Checkbox that requires customers to agree with your restaurant's terms.
- Select Policy Agreement Checkbox.
- Choose an option:
  - Checked by default: the checkbox is automatically selected.
  - Customers are required to check the box: the customer must confirm they accept your policies before continuing. If they don't select the checkbox, they will see an error message.

title: Is the speech recognition tool supported in the Studio Editor for performing actions like filtering store products or filling in input fields?
content: Currently, the Studio Editor does not offer a speech recognition tool. If you are using Wix Stores, you can integrate Speechly to let visitors filter store products with a push-to-talk button. This requires setting up the connection in the site code.

title: Can I have unique IDs for each widget instance when I add the same widget multiple times on a Wix site?
content: Currently, when you install a blocks app on a site and add a widget to the canvas more than once, all instances of that widget will have the same instanceId. The instanceId is a property in the object returned by the getDecodedAppInstance() in the wix-application module. This feature would allow you to distinguish between multiple widget instances on the same site.

title: How can I add a sticky scroll effect to the header in Editor X?
content:
To add a sticky scroll effect to the header in Editor X:
- Select the header in your Editor.
- Click **Position** in the Inspector.
- Click the **Position type** drop-down menu and select **Sticky**.
- (Optional) Add an offset value above the element which is the distance the header should always be from the top of the screen.

title: How can I customize which icons are displayed on my Wix Forum posts?
content:
Go to your forum in your Editor, click Settings, then click Display. From there, choose what you want to display:

* Views counter: Click the checkbox to show or hide the amount of views your post has received.
* Hashtags: Click the checkbox to show or hide any hashtags attached to the post.
* Pinterest save button: Click the checkbox to show or hide the button that saves to Pinterest.
* Badges: Click the checkbox to show or hide any badges attached to the post/author.

title: How can I add and set up a slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor?
content: To add and set up a slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Layout Tools, then click Slideshow Repeater. Drag a design you like onto the page. Customize the slideshow's content to your client's needs by clicking elements to customize them, adding more elements to the slides, deleting elements you don't need, and connecting the elements to the CMS. Note: When adding or removing elements from one slide, it affects the other slides as well.

title: How can I set an image in Wix Editor to open in a pop-up when clicked?
content: To set your image to expand when clicked in Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click the relevant image. Click the Settings icon. Click the When image is clicked drop-down menu and select It opens in a pop-up. Tip: If you add a tooltip to your image, it appears under the image in the pop-up window.

title: Can I add or edit alt text for multiple images at once in my Editor or site dashboard?
content: You can individually add or edit alt text for images inside your Editor. It is now possible to bulk add or edit alt text for Wix Bookings, Online Programs, and Portfolio from your dashboard with the SEO Assistant panel. You can also bulk add or edit alt text to static pages using the SEO Setup Checklist in your dashboard or the Accessibility Wizard in Wix Editor.

title: How can I start using the Modalyst - Dropshipping app on my Wix site?
content: To use the Modalyst - Dropshipping app on your Wix site, you need to add Wix Stores first. The app is only available in English. You can start an account for free and explore 100M+ products, add high-quality, discounted products from verified US and EU-based suppliers, add your logo to private label products and have orders sent with your branded invoice and packaging, use direct integration to the AliExpress catalog and AliExpress Dropshipping Center, and automate eCommerce operations from adding products to your store in bulk to routing orders to your suppliers. Check out the Modalyst - Dropshipping app by Modalyst to get started; for questions or comments, contact Modalyst directly.

title: How can I add advertisements to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: You can add advertisements to your site in a few different ways: upload the ad as an image and link to the relevant URL; add Marketing Integrations; use the Google AdSense app to display third-party ads; or use a popup to display your ad. You can also learn how to remove the Wix banner ad or update your site favicon to your own.

title: How can I connect Priority Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers, and click Connect next to Priority. If you have a Priority Payments account, enter your Consumer Key, Consumer Secret and Merchant ID, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Priority account, fill in the registration form and submit it. Once your account is set up, retrieve your Consumer Key, Consumer Secret and Merchant ID from Priority Payments, return to Accept Payments, repeat the connection steps, and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: Im having trouble with the verification process for my Wix Payments account. Specifically, my documents arent being accepted.
content:
Wix may request documents to verify your Wix Payments account. Check the document type you are uploading against these requirements.

Photo ID:
- Can be a passport, driver's license, or government issued ID card.
- Must be active and non-expired.
- Photo must be in color.
- ID must show all 4 borders and corners.
- ID must not have information blocked or blacked out.
- ID must be straightened, not angled or rotated.
- ID must not be blurry, overexposed, or copied from another source (e.g. screenshot).
- Your first, middle, and last name in your Wix Payments account must match those of your ID.
- Your birth date in your Wix Payments account must match that of your ID.
- For passports with a Machine-Readable Zone (MRZ), the MRZ must be visible.
- For driver's licenses or government issue ID cards, send a separate file for each side.
- Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG.
- The maximum file size is 10 MB.
- The minimum file size is 1 KB for PDF, 100 KB for other formats.

Address verification document:
- Provide a document, such as utility bill, which verifies the address you have submitted.
- Documents must be visible and clear.
- Documents must be dated within the last six months.
- Complete documents must be uploaded: one full page of the document at minimum, and the full name and address of the individual are clear and visible.
- Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG.

Bank details:
- You can provide a bank statement, a voided check, or an official letter issued by a bank.

Bank statement:
- Provide a color copy of your statement.
- The bank logo should be visible and clear.
- The full bank account number should be visible and clear.
- The document must have been issued within the last 12 months.
- The bank account holder's name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account.
- The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments account.

Voided check:
- The word "VOID" should appear on the check.
- The bank's logo should be visible and clear.
- The bank account number should be visible and clear.
- Bank account holder/company name must be printed, not handwritten.
- The check must be issued and printed by the bank.
- Voided check must not be part of a direct deposit form.
- The bank account holder's name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account.
- The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments account.

Bank letter:
- The bank logo should be visible and clear.
- The bank account number should be visible and clear.
- The letter must be issued and printed by the bank.
- The document must have been issued within the last 12 months.
- The letter must have a bank agent signature.
- The bank account holder's name should be visible and clear and match the owner of the Wix Payments account for a personal Wix Payments account.
- The name of the business checking account needs to be visible and clear and match the legal name of the business listed on the company document, and also the legal company name in your Wix Payments dashboard for a business Wix Payments account.

Banking documents may be rejected if:
- The document is blurry.
- The document is not legible (font too small).
- The document is torn or damaged.
- The document is rotated or upside down.
- The image is a mobile screenshot.
- The full account numbers are not displayed.
- The name/company on your document do not match details in your account.
- The account numbers are incorrect.
- It is not a bank statement, but a direct deposit form.
- The voided check is not printed by a financial institution.

Company details:
- The tax ID/registration number should be visible and clear.
- The company name should be visible and clear and match the business details in your Wix Payments account.
- The document must have been issued within the last 12 months.
- Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG.
- The maximum file size is 10 MB.
- The minimum file size is 1 KB for PDF, 100 KB for other formats.

Important:
- All documents must be issued within the same country you select as your business location. Documents may be rejected if issued from another country.
- For a business Wix Payments account, your ID may be issued from any Wix Payments supported country.
- Users in Canada must provide separate documents for identity and address verification.

title: How can I add the Shippo app to my Wix site to print shipping labels?
content: Before you begin, make sure you've entered your business address in the Business Info page. To add the Shippo app: Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click Get More Apps. Search for the Shippo app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Click Agree & Add. Then do one of the following: log into your existing Shippo account, or create a new Shippo account by filling in the required fields, clicking Try Shippo for Free, filling in the required information about your business, and clicking Finish. After setup, your previous orders appear in Shippo. From there, you can select the order you want to fulfill and then purchase and print the label.

title: How can I hide dynamic pages from the menu on my mobile site using the CMS?
content: To hide dynamic pages from your mobile site menu: click the Switch to Mobile icon on the top bar of the Editor, click the mobile menu icon at the top of your page, click Edit Menu, click Manage Menu, click the More Actions icon next to the dynamic page you want to hide, and click Hide on Mobile.

title: How can I add private registration to my existing Wix domain?
content: To add private registration to an existing domain subscription, extend your domain registration for at least an additional year and choose the Private registration option. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click Extend next to the relevant domain, select a registration period, select Full privacy protection, then enter your payment information and click Submit Purchase. Note: You cannot apply privacy protection to an existing domain subscription without extending it; private registration is available when purchasing a domain or when manually extending its registration for at least one year. The private registration fee is not refundable.

title: How can I dispute a chargeback in my Wix Payments account?
content: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant payment to see its details. Click Get Started. Click Dispute Chargeback under the chargeback's details. Select the product or service type of this transaction: Physical product, Digital Product, Service, Event ticket, or Other. Briefly describe your business and click Continue. Begin building your case by submitting a cover letter explaining your case and relevant evidence to verify your case. When ready, click Preview & Submit Dispute at the bottom. You can click Save Draft if you'd prefer to complete the form later.

content: Yes, you can now connect KG Inicis as a payment provider in your Wix account.

title: How do I set up a Point of Sale with Square using Wix Mobile POS?
content: To set up mobile POS with Square, download the Wix app from the Apple App Store or Google Play. Then download Square Point of Sale (POS) from the App Store on an iOS device or the Play Store on an Android device. In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments and set up Square as your payment provider. You can set up Square without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments you need a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports payments. To swipe credit cards, contact Square to order your free magstripe reader; it plugs into your smartphone or tablet's headphone jack. You can also manually enter a customer's credit card number, but Square charges a higher processing fee. Inventory is not automatically updated in the Square app; you can set up real-time inventory updates in Square using the skuIQ inventory app. POS with Square is available in US, Canada, Japan, Australia, UK, Ireland, and Falkland Islands.

title: How can I add alt text to images in the Wix SEO Setup Checklist?
content: Go to the SEO Setup Checklist in your site's SEO dashboard. Open step 2. Hover over the Add alt text to all images error and click Go for it. Click Add Alt Text. Enter appropriate alt text next to each image. Click Apply Alt Text. For gallery images, the alt text is the image's title and description.

title: My emails sent through Wix Email Marketing are being marked as spam or not received by clients, leading to delivery issues.
content: Make sure your campaign actually gets delivered to your recipients' inboxes by following email marketing best practices. Only email subscribers who have explicitly consented, build your email list organically, regularly maintain your email list, write an informative and engaging subject line, clearly identify yourself and your business, keep your audience engaged, and gradually increase the number of emails you send. Avoid purchased or scraped email lists; Wix does not allow illegitimate mailing lists, and sending to spam traps can result in restrictions. If your campaign is still not reaching inboxes, review your sender reputation, email content, and identification protocols, and consider reaching out to Wix support. You can use Wix's email marketing analytics to track opens, clicks, bounces, and other metrics.

title: How can I reassign my Ascend Plan to a different site in my Wix account?

Select the checkbox next to the relevant site. Click Next. Click Assign to confirm. Note: When you reassign an Ascend Plan, all the Ascend Premium features on the site it was originally assigned to will be disabled. This feature is not yet open to Ascend users in India.

title: How can I update outdated information and thumbnails when sharing my site on Facebook?
content: If your information appears out of date when you share your site on Facebook, check your page's title tag and meta description. After updating them, publish your site again. Facebook may take some time to process the new information. If your information still appears out of date, use the Facebook debugger: enter your site's URL in the URL field, click Debug, then click Fetch new information for URLs that have never been shared on Facebook before or Scrape Again for URLs that have been shared on Facebook before. After debugging, Facebook displays the information that was "fetched" and what is displayed when the link is shared; scroll down to Link Preview to see what will be shared. If your site is still displaying outdated info after debugging, try clicking Scrape Again; sometimes you need to click it a few times before you see the information updated. In some cases, there may be an issue on Facebook's end and the debugger does not correct the information. If this does not resolve the issue, make sure you have added your personal Facebook Account username, and not your Business page username, under the Social Settings. Make sure the thumbnail follows Facebook's recommendations in terms of size and resolution.

To view and share it, click View Test Site to access it through the URL, or copy the URL and share it individually for input. To expose a portion of your visitors to the test version, click Go to Release Manager, click the Show More icon next to your test site, click Edit exposure, and enter a number (percentage) under Version Exposure. Make sure to publish your changes first so they are visible in the test version.

content: Use the 'Submit' click action to save information to your collection that visitors provide in input elements. If the dataset mode is Read & Write, this action updates the displayed item. You can learn how to create a custom form using input elements that saves to your CMS collection.

title: Why am I not seeing statistics in Google Analytics after setting up my tracking code?
content: Typically it takes 24-48 hours before you can view your stats after setting up your tracking code. If you can't see the statistics, it's a good idea to make sure that your domain is connected to Wix. Other factors such as high traffic can also affect processing time. If you are still having problems viewing your statistics, try signing out of your Google Analytics account and then signing back in.

title: What are some examples of black hat SEO techniques and why should they be avoided?
content: Common examples of black hat SEO techniques include hidden text or links, automatically generated content, keyword stuffing, buying or selling backlinks, and using redirects to manipulate ranking. Hidden text or links include text written in the same color (or close to) as the web page background, text in an area defined as hidden or invisible using CSS, extremely small fonts, and text hidden behind another element (e.g., an image). Alt text for images is not considered hidden text because it helps search engines and screen readers understand the content of an image. Automatically generated content is low-value text generated by a program using specific topics or keywords, such as unverified automatic translations, text created using automatically generated synonyms, text created from collating search results, or text created by combining content from different web pages without adding value. Keyword stuffing is where a site contains a large number of irrelevant keywords, search phrases, or numbers to manipulate ranking, such as listing the same keyword over and over, adding keywords where they do not logically or organically fit, or mentioning keywords solely to inflate how many times they appear. Buying or selling backlinks to artificially improve ranking is penalized by search engines, and using automated programs to create links to your site can also affect ranking. Redirecting a user to a page with different content than what was made available to the search engine crawler is penalized by search engines. These techniques should be avoided because they can cause search engines like Google to rank your site lower or completely remove your site from search engine results, and search engines constantly improve detection, so your site will likely get penalized eventually.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to allow customers to place orders?
content: You can add and set up Wix Stores on your site for free, but customers can only place orders after you upgrade to a plan that allows you to receive payments. To upgrade, go to your site's dashboard, click the Upgrade icon, click Select under the plan you want to purchase, select a subscription period, click Continue to Checkout, enter your payment details, click Submit Purchase, and refresh your editor to see the upgrade applied. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity; if you have issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: What are the differences between Wix SMS and Wix Business Phone Number for sending text messages?
content: Wix offers Wix SMS and Wix Business Phone Number for communicating with customers by text message. Wix SMS automatically sends pre-installed texts, such as reminder texts to Wix Bookings customers, confirmation texts to Wix Table Reservations customers, or order updates to Wix Restaurants Orders (New) customers. It does not allow phone calls or texts that you have composed. Wix Business Phone Number can be used for both phone calls and texts, and the texts you send are composed and sent by you. It does not support automated SMS reminders or confirmations. With both products, texts and calls come from your own dedicated phone number, which you choose when you set these up. Wix SMS is not yet available for all users; if it is available on your site, you need to upgrade your site to use it. Business Phone Number is only available to Wix users in the U.S. and Canada, and you need to purchase a business number to use it.

title: How can I disable the pop-up blocker in Google Chrome to allow pop-ups from Wix.com?
content: To disable the Google Chrome pop-up blocker and allow pop-ups from Wix.com, click the More icon at the top right of your browser, then click Settings. Click Privacy and security on the left, then click Site settings in the Privacy and security section. Scroll down and select Pop-ups and redirects. To allow all pop-ups, select Sites can send pop-ups and use redirects. To allow pop-ups only from specific sites, click Add next to Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects, type https://[*.]wix.com, and click Add.

title: Why is a customer unable to apply a coupon in Wix Stores, and how can I troubleshoot it?
content:
Follow these checks based on the article:

Check the visibility of the promo code link: make sure the "Enter a promo code" link is enabled and the font color contrasts with the Cart Page background.

Check if the coupon is out-of-date: edit the start or end dates if necessary.

Make sure the coupon is activated: reactivate the coupon from Coupons in your site's dashboard if it was deactivated.

Check if the coupon reached its usage limit: remove limitations or edit the total number of uses.

Check if the customer added a blank space: tell the customer to copy and paste the coupon code without making changes. Coupons are not case-sensitive.

If the problem persists, contact us.

title: How can I update the details of my loyalty program in Wix Restaurants?
content: To update your loyalty program details: Go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Program. Click Edit Program. Update your program details: Program name; Points name by keeping the default Points or selecting Custom, e.g., “Stars” or “Hearts”, and choosing a matching star or heart points icon; and Points icon by clicking the Update icon. Click Save.

title: Why was my Wix Payments payment declined due to an unsupported currency?
content: Payment was declined by payment service provider because the currency used is not supported. Contact your payment provider to ask if the currency you are using is supported. If not, you can change your payment provider or change your currency for accepting payments. Wix Payments is currently available in the following countries and currencies: Austria (EUR), Belgium (EUR), Brazil (BRL), Canada (CAD), Finland (EUR), Germany (EUR), Ireland (EUR), Italy (EUR), Lithuania (EUR), Netherlands (EUR), Portugal (EUR), Spain (EUR), Switzerland (CHF), United Kingdom (GBP), United States (USD).

title: How can I update my restaurant's business hours using the Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Business Hours. Hover over the existing hours and click Edit. Edit your restaurant's business hours by clicking the first set of days the restaurant is open, then enter the hours for the days you selected. If not all days were selected, add a second set of days and enter the hours for those days. Click Apply. Click Save at the top of the page to save your changes.

title: What do the icons in the Wix Editor mean when I click on an element, and how can I use them?
content:
When you click an element in your Editor, you may come across several icons. The icons available depend on the element type and its settings.

- **Settings**: Click to set up the element. The settings are different for each element.
- **Layout**: Click to change the layout of the element. The layouts are different for each element.
- **Design**: Click to design the element. The design options are different for each element.
- **Animate**: Click to add animation to the element.
- **Link**: Click to add a link to the element.
- **More Actions**: Click to show more options.
- **Crop & Edit**: Click to make changes to your image.
- **Upgrade**: Click to upgrade the element/feature.
- **Help**: Click to learn more about the element or find an answer to a question you have.
- **Stretch Handle**: Click and drag to make the element longer or shorter. This icon appears on strips and pages.
- **Stretch**: Click this icon to stretch the element to either the full-width of your site, or within the gridlines. This icon appears on elements such as strips and galleries.
- **Accessibility**: Click to view and edit your attributes. This icon is only shown on elements that you have already added custom aria attributes to.
- **Connect to Data**: Connect the element to content collections to display and collect data on your site.

title: How can I set up an email alias for an existing Google Workspace user email address?
content: In your Google Workspace Admin console, you can create an email alias for an existing user. An email alias gives a user another address in the same domain as their primary address. Email messages sent to either the primary address or the alias will appear in the user's Google Workspace inbox. You can add up to 30 email aliases for each user.

title: Which external calendars can Boom Event Calendar by BoomTech sync with, and what layouts does it offer?

content: To remove a Quick Action Bar, right-click it in the mobile Editor and select Delete. Note that when you remove a QAB, it removes the details you entered for each action. If you re-add the QAB, you need to manually enter the relevant information again.

title: How can I customize the header of my branded app using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, and tap Mobile App. If needed, switch to editing your branded app by tapping the member app name at the top and selecting your branded mobile app. Tap Edit, then tap Change Header Design. Choose a header design for your home screen. For Detailed, tap Customize. In App info, add a name and tagline; enable Show logo to add a logo; enable Show general info to add a header link with social links, contact info, and site URL. In Cover photo, tap Add Image to upload a cover photo; you can add multiple photos for a slideshow and select a transition delay between photos. In Members info, enable toggles to choose member information. In Action buttons, add an invite button and a custom button. Tap Save at the top right. For Minimal, tap Customize. In Style, customize header color to match your primary color or background color and choose icons to display. In Icons, enable toggles to add icons. Tap Save at the top right.

title: How can I move an anchor to a new position on my Wix page?
content:
Click the anchor in your Editor. Drag it to the new position.

Note: It is not possible to move an anchor to your site footer.

title: How can I enable and access the Site Checker in Editor X?
content: Click Tools at the top of Editor X, select Site Checker to enable it, then click the Site Checker icon at the top right to access the tool.

title: How can I remove the 'This site may be hacked' message from my Google search results for my Wix site?
content: You can remove this message by verifying your site with Google Search Console, removing the resources causing the problem by following these instructions, and submitting your sitemap directly to Google.

title: How can I restrict access to certain pages on my Wix site to specific members or paying customers?
content: In your Editor, click Pages & Menu, click the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, click Settings, and click the Permissions tab. Under Who can view this page?, select Members Only. Then choose which members can access the page: All members, or Only selected members or paying customers, where you can select members with specific roles and/or pricing plans. If you select Members Only, be sure to add a Member's area to your site.

title: How can I change the currency for my multilingual site on Wix?
content: You can change your Site Currency at any time. The currency you choose will be the same currency displayed across all languages. It is currently not possible to display a different currency per language version of your multilingual site, and when you change your Site Currency the change applies to all languages. To change your site's currency, click Settings on the left of your Dashboard, click Language & Region in the General Settings section, scroll down to the Site Currency section, select a currency from the drop-down list, and click Save. If a different currency per language version is a feature you would like to see in the future, you can vote for it.

title: Can I add borders to strips and columns in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix does not support adding and customizing borders on strips and columns. As an alternative, you can add lines to the edges of your strips and columns from the Add Elements panel on the left.

title: How can I connect my event to a group in the Wix app?
content: Create and publish your event in the Wix app first. Then go to your site in the Wix app, tap **Manage** at the bottom, tap **Events**, tap **Published Events**, and select the relevant event. Tap the **Manage** tab, tap **Add-ons**, and tap **Add to Event** under **Group**. Select an option: tap **Create New Group**, or tap an existing group and tap **Done**. To customize the group, add the group information: tap **Add Cover Image** to add your own group image, enter a name for the group, and select a group type. **Public** means anyone can see this group, members, and posts. **Private** means anyone can see who's in this group, but only members can see posts. Use **Visibility** to select from the drop-down menu to manage your group's visibility. Tap **Done** at the top, then tap **Done** again to connect the group you just created to the event.

title: How can I connect my Google Workspace business email to a mail client using IMAP and SMTP?
content: You can connect your Google Workspace business email to your iPhone, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, Outlook or Outlook Express. View the recommended IMAP and SMTP client settings. Note: The mail clients above are external services, therefore we cannot provide assistance with the connection process.

title: How can I troubleshoot my barcode scanner on Wix Retail POS?
content: Disconnect the barcode scanner from the tablet. Wait 3 minutes. Reconnect the barcode scanner to the tablet. If the problem persists, contact Customer Care.

title: How can I assign an unassigned plan to a site in my Wix account?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the unassigned plan. Click Assign to a Site. Select the site you want to assign the plan to and click Next. Click Assign.

title: How can I improve the chances of Google using the thumbnail image I want for my site in search results?
content: It's not possible to manually change the thumbnail image that Google uses, and it's not guaranteed that Google will add a thumbnail image to your site's search result. However, you can take steps to improve your chances: use high-quality images on your site, because small or low-resolution images may not be used in search results; and add alt text to your images, because search engine bots can't read images and use alt text to get a description of the image.

title: How can I disconnect a domain from my site on Wix?
content: You can disconnect a domain from your site and assign it to a different site in your account or leave it unassigned. If the domain is a Wix domain, you can also transfer the domain to another Wix account, transfer the domain to another domain host, or point the domain to an external site.

title: How can I add a dynamic item page in the Wix Editor for my CMS collection?
content:
Before you begin: Create a CMS collection that includes the items that will each display in their own version of this dynamic item page.

In the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click CMS on the left side of the editor.
- Click Your Collections.
- Hover over the relevant collection and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Add dynamic page.
- Select Item page and click Add to Site.

Tip: Select List page as well to add a dynamic list page for the collection at the same time.

title: How can I add keywords as additional meta tags to my pages using the Wix Editor?
content: To add keywords as additional meta tags to your pages using the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Click the Advanced SEO tab. Click Additional Tags. Click + Add New Tag. Add your keywords as meta tag code in the HTML Code field. Click Apply. Note: You can add up to 10 keywords per page. Keep in mind that Google and other major search engines don't use keywords in meta tags as a ranking factor; instead, incorporate keywords/search phrases throughout your site's content organically and logically.

title: How can I adjust the spacing and padding between columns in the Wix Editor?
content: Click your strip that contains your columns in the editor. Click the Layouts icon. Drag the Column Spacing slider to increase or decrease the gap between each column, or enter a value. Drag the Padding slider to increase or decrease the space between the columns and the edge of the strip, or enter a value.

title: How can I view all of my automations in Wix?
content:
Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Your automations section to view all of your automations across 2 tabs:

* Created by you: Active and inactive automations you've created here or directly through an app.
* Installed for you: Active and inactive automations created automatically when you've installed apps.

(Optional) Click an automation to view its automation summary, including the last trigger date and the total times triggered.
