Tip: Click Filters to view only active or inactive automations, or those with specific triggers or actions.

title: Can I add a text box inside ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot add text boxes inside ADI. If you want to add more text boxes, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions there.

title: Can I remove the 'Join' button from the Program page header in the Online Programs App?
content: Yes, you can now remove the "Join" button from the Program page header.

title: My Wix Payments account verification documents have been denied, specifically the company details.
content: Your business document must meet these requirements: the tax ID/registration number should be visible and clear; the company name should be visible and clear and match the business details in your Wix Payments account; if applicable, company director documents should contain the legal entity name and list all registered directors; the document must have been issued within the last 12 months; and documents must be sent in one of the following formats: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG. The maximum file size is 10 MB, and the minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF and 100 kB for other formats. If you changed your business name and the name on the business registration document does not match your current legal business name, upload the business registration document you currently have to your Wix Payments account. You may also be requested to provide official name change documentation that displays both the original and new legal business name. If you need assistance, contact Customer Care.

title: How can I customize my outbound client emails in Wix Bookings to better fit my brand?
content: To customize outbound client emails in Wix Bookings, go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard and click Emails & SMS notifications. Hover over the automation you want to customize and click Edit next to it. For reminder emails only, click Edit next to Timing to adjust the timing of emails. Scroll down to Action 1 and choose what to customize: under Manage details, click Edit, open the More Actions icon and select Edit, then edit Sender's name and Reply-to email and click Save, then Save again to confirm. Under Create an email, you can optionally click Switch Template to choose a different style; note that switching to a different template replaces your existing automated email and you will lose any previous changes you made. Click Edit under Create an email to customize existing elements or add more elements. When finished, click Save. You can add text, images, videos and more to make your emails more personalized and informative for your clients. Note that you can only customize or edit certain parts of the pre-installed email automations to ensure uninterrupted delivery of important session information to your clients.

title: How can I connect my UK domain to my Wix site if transferring is not possible?
content: No, currently it is not possible to transfer your UK Domain Name to Wix for hosting. However, you can connect the domain name to your Wix site instead. If you would like to be able to transfer your domain to Wix, vote for this feature.

title: How can I crop or edit a gallery image in the Wix Editor?
content: To crop or edit a gallery image in the Wix Editor: Click the gallery. Click Media Manager or Change Images (depending on the gallery you are using). Click Add Media. Click Image. Click the relevant image in the Media Manager. Click Crop & Edit. Edit your image using the tools. Click here to learn about the editing tools. When you are finished, click Save. Note: You can only edit gallery images that you have uploaded yourself.

title: How can I block or delete a site member from the Member List on my Wix site?
content: To block or delete a member from the Member List: go to Site Members in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant member, and choose Block member or Delete member. Block member removes them from your Member's Area and prevents them from registering again using the same email address. Delete member removes them from your Member's Area, but their email address isn't blocked so they can sign up again. You can click multiple checkboxes to delete multiple site members simultaneously. Click Block or Delete in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I set up tax for my pricing plans in the Wix app?
content: To collect tax on the sale of pricing plans: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog. Tap Settings at the top. Select Tax. Tap the Enable Tax toggle. Enter the tax rate (e.g. 10%). Select how you want to add the tax: Include in the price: At checkout, clients see the price breakdown. Add to total at checkout: The tax is added to the plan price. At checkout, your clients see the tax that was added. Tap Save. Important: Different tax rules apply in different regions. Consult with an accountant or with your local tax authority for specific information relevant for your business.

title: Can I display user-submitted feedback to everyone, but only allow members to submit it?
content:
Yes. Suppose you have a 'Comments' collection where you store visitor submissions. You want to allow anyone to read the comments on the live site, but you only want site members to submit comments. For this to work, set the following permissions and dataset modes:

For the collection permissions: Set Custom permissions for your Comments collection. Then select View next to Everyone and select Add next to Members only. You could also select Update next to Item's creator if you want the member who submitted the comment to also be able to edit their own comment after submitting it.

For the dataset modes: Set the dataset that connects to your custom form to Write. Set the dataset that connects to the element that displays the comments to Read.

Alternatively, you could connect both your custom form and the element you use to display the comments to the same dataset. Then, choose the Read & Write dataset mode. This would allow the input elements that make up your custom form to 'write' to your collection. Meanwhile, the repeater, table, or text element used to show the comments would be able to 'read' the collection content and display it.

title: How can I change the browser theme color for my Wix mobile site?
content: Use the Mobile Tools panel to set a browser theme color on your site. Due to browser restrictions, this feature is only available on the Chrome browser on an Android device. In your mobile editor, click Mobile Tools on the left side, click the Add to Site icon next to Browser theme color, click the color box in the panel, select the color you want, and click Done. To see how it looks, visit your published site on an Android device in Google Chrome.

title: How can I set weekend rates for rooms in Wix Hotels?
content:
This applies to the original Wix Hotels. If you are using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, which is not yet available to all users, please read the information and learn how to check which version of Wix Hotels you are using.

Set your weekend nights:
- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab on the left.
- Click Settings.
- Scroll down to Regional Settings.
- Select your weekend nights.
- Click Save.

Add your weekend rates:
- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab on the left.
- Click Rooms (or Apartments if you selected Apartment as your property type).
- Click the Edit icon next to the relevant room type, or click Create New to add a new one.
- Scroll down to the Price section.
- Enter the price in the Weekend price field.
- Click Save.

Tip: You can also set seasonal rates so you can charge a higher rate during high season. Your weekend rates can differ here as well.

title: How do I create a new SMS automation using my business phone number?
content: To create a new SMS automation using your business phone number: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation. Click + Start from Scratch. To use a suggested automation, search for a keyword such as "SMS" and select from the relevant options; you can edit its trigger and actions. Click the title at the top to give your automation a name. Choose a trigger. Set up your action: select Send SMS via business number, select Customer phone number in the To: drop-down, and compose your message. Click Activate to save and activate the automation. Note: SMS automations only work if the person who triggered it has a phone number listed in their contact details. Your automated SMS message may be a transactional message that informs your customers about the product or service they have purchased, and based on how it is written, it could be filtered or blocked.

title: Is it possible to lock my mobile site so it isn't affected by changes made in the desktop Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to lock your mobile site so it isn't affected by changes you make in the desktop Editor. As an alternative, you can hide desktop elements on your mobile site, and add mobile-only elements.

title: Does Wix support a virtual tour feature in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a virtual tour feature. There is a third-party app in the App Market that allows you to add virtual tours to your site. Check out Virtual Tours.

title: How can I add a single audio track to my Wix site using the Wix Audio Player?
content: The Wix Audio Player allows you to add a single track to a page on your website. In the Editor, click Add on the left side, click Video and Music, click Audio Players, then click one of the players to add it or drag it to the relevant location. You can customize the colors, text, and border to match your site.

title: How can I address incorrect source/landing page URLs in Google Analytics due to referral spam?
content:
This is the result of an affiliate scheme (referral spam). The Google Analytics events are randomly generated and by chance are associated with your Google Analytics account. This scheme is in no way related to Wix. Google Analytics does have specific filters to remove these types of results, which you can use if you choose to. Wix cannot provide support for setting up filters as this is a Google product. You can learn more on Google's Support page.

Important:
- This technique does not damage your site in any way, including your site's ranking in Google. The only effect that you might notice is some inaccuracies in your Google Analytics results.
- By using this service, you are engaging directly with a third-party service provider. We recommend reviewing the service provider's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use prior to your use of such third-party service. You acknowledge that we are not liable for any loss or damage resulting from your use of such third-party service, including any liability arising from any personal data exchanged between you and such third-party.

title: Can I use Sofort to purchase Wix Premium Services?
content: Users in Austria, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, and Spain can purchase a Premium or Studio site plan using Sofort.

title: How can I hide the number of registered participants for a session in the Wix member apps?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Scroll down to Settings and tap Bookings Settings. Tap Customize Display. Tap to disable the Show Occupancy toggle. Tap Save. When hidden, members only see if the class or service is full or available to be booked. As the site owner, you can still see the number of participants registered for a session.

title: Can I delete my site from the Spaces by Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to remove your site from the Spaces by Wix app. Workarounds: You can remove your site from appearing in search in the Spaces app. This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app, but does not remove your site from the Spaces app for visitors who have already joined in the app. You can remove the invite banner that appears on the mobile version of your site and allows visitors to join your site in the Spaces app. You can enable the Join Approval toggle in Roles & Permissions. This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app unless you approve them.

title: Can I change the padding for mobile app elements in the branded app?
content: Yes. You can now adjust the padding for elements added to your app from the Mobile App Editor.

title: How can I enable the Snap to Objects tool in the Wix Mobile Editor?
content: Click Tools at the top right of the Mobile Editor, then select the Snap to Objects checkbox.

title: Is it possible to export blog posts from Wix to other platforms?
content: Currently, it is not possible to export blog posts to other platforms. You can share blog posts on social media.

title: How can I retrieve a list of all Third Party Apps ever installed on my Wix sites?
content: To view a list of all Third Party Apps ever installed on any of your sites, you must submit a request to retrieve an archive of your data. In the archive, you'll receive a file with a list of all your Apps, along with the contact information for each one. The columns in the file contain: By (the name of the company that created the App), Name (the name of the App), InstanceID and appDefinition (technical identification that you might need to provide to the App owner), SupportMail (the email address where you can contact the App), SupportURL (the website where you can contact the App), SupportPhone (the phone number of the App developer), and Site Name (the site on which the app is installed).

title: How can I transfer a duplicate copy of my Wix site to another account?
content: To transfer a duplicate copy of your Wix site to another account while keeping the original, go to your site's dashboard and click Site Actions, then Transfer Site. Enter the new site owner's email address under Who will be the new site owner?. Select or deselect Keep my role as Website Manager of this site after the transfer if you want to keep your existing role. Enter a name for the copy and click Duplicate. Transfer the duplicate site to the new site owner by entering the new site owner's email address, choosing if you want to keep your role after the site transfer, and choosing to create a copy of the site and keep it in your Wix account. Click Next, confirm the details of the site transfer, and click Transfer Ownership. Note: You are transferring a duplicate copy of the original site; the original site will still be in your Wix account after the transfer. When you duplicate your site, sensitive information such as contacts, orders, invoices are not copied over.

title: What is the difference between a Page Name and a Page Title?
content: The Page Name appears on your site menu. The Page Title is the headline of your site and can be seen in the browser tab; it also appears in Google search results, so use meaningful page titles. You can also set the Page Address, which appears as part of the URL of your page.

title: How can I reset a user's password in Google Workspace if they are having trouble logging in?
content: Sign in to your Google Admin account. Click Password, then Reset Password. Choose to automatically generate the password or enter a password. Optionally, click Preview to view the password, and enable Ask for a password change at the next sign-in if you want the user to change it. Click Reset. Optionally, click Click to copy password to paste the password somewhere, such as in a Google Chat conversation with the user. Then choose to email the password to the user, or click Done.

title: How can I continue adding tour dates from Songkick now that the Songkick app is no longer available?
content: The Songkick app has been retired from the Wix App Market and is no longer supported. If you would like to continue adding tour dates from Songkick, you can enter the tour dates in Songkick and embed the code in your Wix Editor.

title: How can I start editing CSS in the Wix Studio Editor?
content: In the Wix Studio Editor, open the Code panel, click Start Coding if this is your first time on the site, click Page Code, then click global.css under CSS. To style an element, select it on the canvas, keep the CSS panel open, select a class under CSS Classes (a Global class or your own class under Custom classes), and add your CSS code.

title: How can I filter and sort the Booking List on the Wix app?
content:
To filter and sort the Booking List on the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Calendar.
- Tap Booking List.
- Choose how you want to view the Booking List using the following options:
  - Service type: Select which services you want to view from the drop-down at the top: Appointments & Classes, or Courses.
  - Search by client: Tap the Search by client icon and then tap to select the relevant client(s) from the list.
  - Sort by: Tap the Sort by icon and choose the relevant option: Newest to oldest, or Oldest to newest.
  - Select a preset: Tap to select one of the presets: All, Last 7 days unpaid bookings, Past unpaid bookings, Pending sessions.

title: How can I add a sidebar to my Wix Blog Post page?
content:
To add a sidebar to your Post Page in Wix Blog:
- Go to the Pages dropdown at the top left of your Editor.
- Scroll down to Blog Pages.
- Click Post.
- Drag the Post page to resize it.
- Add the element(s) you want to place in the sidebar and resize them to fit the space.

Adding a sidebar is only possible in the old version of the Blog Post page.

title: How can I save a customized product list view in Wix Stores for future use?
content: Go to Products in your site's dashboard. Filter your products and/or select the columns you want to display. Click Save View. Enter a view name. Click Save. Note: You can't edit an existing view. Instead, you can save a new view and delete an old one.

title: How can I manage my Dayful service business using the Wix mobile app?
content: You can manage your Dayful service business on the go using the Wix app. From the app you can book clients in for your services rather than asking them to do it themselves, share a direct link to your Booking page, and add or update services and staff from your mobile device. To create more than one service or add more than one staff member, upgrade your Dayful plan. You can also upgrade your Dayful plan to accept payment online and offer discounts to recurring clients by creating Pricing Plans and packages, and share a link to your Pricing Plans with clients. You can download the Wix app to your phone for iPhone or Android.

title: What is the 'liability shift' in Wix Payments and how can I avoid being held liable for fraudulent payments?
content: The 'liability shift' describes a change in how banks and processing networks handle some types of credit card fraud. It refers to payments made in person (card present), where the card is read by a card reader. From 2015, businesses that aren’t set up to accept chip cards can be held financially liable for certain types of fraudulent payments where a chargeback is filed against the merchant. Having up-to-date card reading technology—such as Wix POS—is key to avoiding liability for these types of fraud. Generally speaking, the party supporting the most secure technology for each fraud type will prevail in a chargeback dispute. In the case of a technology tie, the fraud liability remains with the issuer. As a merchant accepting in-person payments, verify a customer's payment using a card's EMV chip whenever possible. Having an up-to-date card reader will allow you to insert or tap the chip. Use the magnetic strip (swipe) only if there is no EMV chip on your customer's card.

title: Can I use Windcave as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Windcave as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Windcave and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I customize the room list layout in Wix Hotels?
content:
To customize your room list layout in Wix Hotels:

- Click the Wix Hotels app in your Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the tabs at the top to choose what you want to customize.
- Click the Rooms list tab.
- Click the horizontal tabs to customize the following:
  - Layout: Select a layout:
    - Simple: (Default layout) Display rental properties with multiple room types, featuring a side search box.
    - Classic: Display rental properties with multiple room types, featuring a top search bar.
    - Deluxe: Show off rental property listings with multiple room types, featuring large, stunning photos and a top search bar.
    - Single: Show off single properties, such as apartments or villas, featuring large stunning photos and a side search box.

title: How can I change the zoom level in the Wix Editor if there is no built-in zoom feature?
content: The Wix Editor does not have a zoom feature, but you can use the zoom function available in your browser. Press Ctrl + + (Cmd + + on Mac) to zoom in. Press Ctrl + - (Cmd + - on Mac) to zoom out. Pressing Ctrl + 0 (Cmd + 0 for Mac) returns your browser to the default zoom. For best functionality and in order to ensure full access to the editor and its tools, it is advised to keep your browser's zoom at 100%.

title: How can I add alt text to individual images in the Wix Editor to improve SEO?
content: To add alt text to individual images in the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click the image, click the Settings icon, enter a description of the image under What's in the image? Tell Google, and add the tooltip text under Does this image have a tooltip?. Note: Currently, it is not possible to bulk add/edit alt text from your editor or site dashboard. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for that feature.

title: How do I enter a backup shipping rate for USPS Real Time shipping in Wix Stores?
content:
To enter a backup shipping rate for USPS Real Time shipping in Wix Stores:
- Go to the Shipping & fulfillment tab in your site's dashboard.
- Create a new shipping region for the US and set up shipping with USPS Calculated Rate, or edit an existing US shipping region with USPS Calculated Rate.
- Scroll down to the Backup Setting section.
- Enter a backup weight per product. This weight is used for calculations if you have added a product's weight.
- Enter a backup shipping rate.

Note: This rate is applied per order, not per product.

title: Can I change the permissions of a group admin in Wix Groups?
content: Yes. You can now change the permissions of what a group admin can do. Group admin permissions include inviting and adding members to a group, moderating group discussions, pinning important posts, approving new member requests, and removing members who should no longer be part of the group.

title: How can I submit a counter-notification if my Wix site content was removed due to a copyright infringement claim?
content: If content from your Wix site was removed, or access to your Wix account was disabled, due to a copyright infringement claim, you may send a counter-notification. You can find additional information, and submit a counter-notification on Wix's DMCA counter-notification contact page.

title: How can I view a guest's stats in Wix Table Reservations?
content: Go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click the contact's name on the relevant reservation. Scroll down and click the Table Reservations section to view the guest's stats.

title: How can I update the payment method for my premium subscription in Wix if my renewal payment fails or is declined?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click Update Payment Method under the relevant subscription. Update your payment card details. Click Submit.

title: Can I import all the details from previous events in one action in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to import all the details from previous events in one action. You can duplicate an entire event to copy its details to new events. You can also copy and paste specific details such as policies and registration messages.

title: What should I do if a payment is declined due to suspected fraud in Wix Payments?
content: If a payment is declined for suspected fraud, no further steps are needed from your end. However, if you believe this payment to be legitimate, you can ask your customer to try making the payment again. If the issue persists for the same customer, contact Wix Customer Care and provide the payment ID, amount and date.

title: How can I rotate an element in Editor X to a specific angle?
content: Select the element that you want to rotate. Click the Inspector icon at the top right. Click Adjust. Enter the angle next to Rotate.

title: How do I set up order pacing for my restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Order pacing is available only for ASAP orders. To set it up in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard, click Advanced, and click the Order Pacing toggle. If enabled, set the Order limit per 15 minutes, optionally select Include Contactless Dine-in orders, and set Rush hours by choosing days of the week and times of day, then click Apply. If disabled, customers can place orders without limitations. Click Save. Order pacing is automatically applied to online orders for delivery and pickup, and contactless dine-in orders can be included by enabling the Include Contactless Dine-in Orders toggle. You can set order pacing for peak hours, but you can't set rush hours from the Wix app; you need to do it from your desktop.

title: What should I do if my Wix site is not accessible for Wix Payments verification because it is not published?
content: Publish your site by clicking Publish at the top right of the editor. Optionally, click View Site to be taken to your live site.

title: How can I hide the header and footer on a specific page in Wix Editor?
content:
In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, click Settings, click the Layouts tab, and select No Header & Footer.

Important information: When you hide the header and footer, elements added to these areas are also hidden, including elements that are set to show on all pages. The page does not display the menu in the header; to let visitors navigate to the rest of your site, link a button to your site's main page or to a page where the menu is displayed. Certain apps (e.g. Back to Top, LiveChat) do not appear on your live site. This also affects your mobile site: the header and footer aren't displayed on the mobile version of this page. It is not possible to only hide the footer or the header; choosing No Header & Footer hides both.

title: How can I schedule a live stream in advance using Wix Video?
content:
To schedule a live stream in advance using Wix Video:
- Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard.
- Click Live Stream at the top right.
- Click Schedule Event.
- Click the Channel drop-down and select which channel your stream will appear in.
- Set when you want your stream to go live under Schedule a Live Stream:
  - Go live on: Select the date from the calendar.
  - Go live at: Select the time of day.
- Fill in the Video Info section:
  - Cover Image: Choose a cover image or video for your live stream so that your viewers do not see a blank placeholder before the live stream begins.
  - Title: The name of the video. This is required.
  - Publisher: The name of the publisher.
  - Categories: The category your live stream will appear in.
  - Tags: Tags that help viewers find your live stream.
  - Description: Information about what your live stream is about.
- Select an option under Video Pricing:
  - Free: Viewers do not need to pay to watch your video. Click the Viewer options drop-down and select an option:
    - Anyone can watch: Allow anyone to watch.
    - Sign up only: Viewers must sign up as site members before they can watch the video.
  - Paid: Viewers need to pay to watch your video. Use the checkboxes and drop-down options to rent or sell your video, set the price, and set the availability (applies to renting only).
- Click the Show Trailer toggle to display a trailer of your video and then click upload to add it (applies only if you are selling videos).
- Fill in additional information under More About This Video: Click the drop-down to enter any additional information about your video.
- Click the Let Viewers Embed this Video toggle to enable or disable the option (Premium feature):
  - Enabled: Your viewers can embed the video. Select the checkboxes next to the information you want to display on the embedded video. You can see what your video will look like in the preview on the right side.
  - Disabled: Your viewers cannot embed the video.
- Click Save.

What happens until I go live?
- A countdown timer appears within the Wix Video player on your site.
- Visitors can add your stream to their calendars.
- You can set up pricing to watch your stream.
- Your site automatically refreshes as your stream approaches so that your viewers won't need to manually reload the page.
- You can send an email campaign telling your viewers about your event. Learn more about creating email marketing campaigns.

title: How can I start using the Shippo app by Shippo on my Wix site?
content: To use the Shippo app by Shippo on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. With the Shippo app, you can manage and fulfill all of your orders in one place. Features include pre-negotiated discounts for USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL Express and more; printing pre-filled labels for your orders, with details automatically syncing from your store; detailed tracking updates for you and your customers; and automated returns with free return labels—you only pay when customers use them. This app is only available in English.

title: What should I do if I encounter an error message when linking to a URL with unsupported characters in Wix Editor?
content: If you enter an invalid URL link or a web address that contains unsupported characters, the following error message is displayed: **Check the URL and try again**. To bypass the validation, use a link shortening service such as bit.ly or goo.gl.

title: How can I fix alignment issues on my Wix site that appear differently on various browsers?
content:
Although Wix sites are optimized for most common devices and browsers, you may notice some differences in alignment between them because different browsers and devices use different rendering engines. You can adjust your site elements to ensure their alignment on different browsers by adding them to columns, repeaters, or containers.

Solution 1 | Attach elements to columns
Add strips to your site and split them into columns. You can define how big you want each column, and attach and arrange elements onto the column to ensure it suits your site's layout.

Solution 2 | Attach elements to repeaters
A repeater is a list of items that organizes your elements into templates that have the same design and layout, but different content. You can customize the content, and ensure that the elements are aligned uniformly across each item.

Solution 3 | Attach elements to container boxes
Add container boxes to your site to attach your elements to them to easily align them together. We recommend making sure that you leave extra room for text elements inside the box to avoid font issues.

title: How can I add and customize a wishlist button in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your Product Page in the Wix Editor: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Store Pages, then click Product Page. To add and customize the wishlist button: click the Product Page in the Editor, click Settings, click the Wishlist tab, and click Add Wishlist. Then click the Product Page in the editor again, click Settings, click the Wishlist tab, and customize the button using the available customizations. Note: The wishlist icon appears next to the button you display in the Product Page (the "Add to Cart" or "Buy Now" buttons). If you decide not to display either button, the wishlist icon turns into a button with text.

title: How can I add links to other music platforms for my album on Wix Music?
content: Go to Music Library in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant album. Click Edit next to Album Info. Scroll down to Links to Other Music Platforms. Enable the toggle. Select the relevant music platform and add the link. Click Save. (Optional) Click +Add link to add more links.

title: Can I change the payment cycle for my Wix Business Email subscription from yearly to monthly?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the payment cycle of a Google Workspace business email purchased through Wix. If you selected the yearly payment cycle, you cannot change it to a monthly one, or vice versa.

title: Can I integrate Woocommerce with my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add the Woocommerce app to your site. As a workaround, you can create a professional online store with Wix Stores, using custom pages where you can manage your orders and finances—from a single platform.

title: How can I verify my site with Naver Webmaster Tools using a meta tag on my Wix site?
content:
Use the Korean language version of Naver to complete the steps. It is currently not possible to verify free Wix URLs; you can only verify custom domains.

Get your meta tag from Naver: sign in to your Naver Webmaster Tools account, enter your website URL under Site Registration, click the Add icon, select HTML tag (태그), copy your meta tag, and leave Naver Webmaster Tools open.

Add the meta tag to your Wix site: in a new tab, go to your SEO Dashboard, select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings, click Naver Webmaster Tools to expand, enter your meta tag under Site verification tag, and click Save.

Complete verification on Naver: return to Naver Webmaster Tools, click 소유확인 (Ownership Confirmation), enter the numbers and letters shown in the pop-up, and click 확인 (Confirm).

title: How can I set up a deferred dataset in my CMS to improve page performance?
content: Before you begin, make sure to enable Dev Mode. In your editor, go to the relevant page and open the relevant dataset settings: click CMS on the left, click Manage Page Connections, then click the More Actions icon next to the relevant dataset and select Dataset settings. Under Performance, click the checkbox next to Fetch after the page loads. Publish your site when you are ready for the changes to go live. A deferred dataset loads its connected content after the rest of the page loads. Use it only with a clear understanding of its impact, as it is an advanced feature and can slow a page down if used incorrectly.

title: How can I enable the language auto-switch feature for my Wix site to automatically show visitors the language version of my site that matches their browser's language?
content:
To turn on the language auto-switch feature, use your multilingual dashboard or editor.

From the Multilingual Dashboard:
- Go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Language auto-switch toggle to change how your site redirects.
- Enabled: the site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language.
- Disabled: the site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors must switch to their preferred language using your language menu.

From the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top left.
- Click Manage Languages.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Language auto-switch toggle to change how your site redirects.
- Enabled: the site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language.
- Disabled: the site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors must switch to their preferred language using your language menu.

From the Studio Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top left.
- Click Manage Languages.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Language auto-switch toggle to change how your site redirects.
- Enabled: the site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language and visitors can still switch to their preferred language using your language menu.
- Disabled: the site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors can switch to their preferred language using your language menu.

Note: This feature is only available if you have at least one active secondary language in Wix Multilingual. Make sure your language is visible in the Multilingual dashboard.

Warning: Activating language auto-switch is not recommended for search engines and will harm your site's SEO if you are relying on organic traffic.

title: How can I create a new board in the Wix Media Manager and make it accessible across all my sites?
content:
Create a board inside your Media Manager. Access your Media Manager. Click **My Boards** on the left side. Click **Create New Board**. Enter the **Board Name**. Enter the **Description** for the board. Click the **Available for all my sites** toggle and choose **Enabled** so your board can be accessed from all your sites. Click **Create**.

**Notes:**
- Boards are private and only visible to the user who created them. Collaborators cannot access other collaborators' boards.
- You can't download the contents of Board folders in bulk. You have to download your files individually.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix site to ensure my audience can navigate and understand the content easily?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Under Site Language, click the drop-down to select the default language people see on your site, emails and notifications. If you have a multilingual site, click Go to Wix Multilingual to manage site languages.

title: How can I resolve issues accessing Hopp pages in Indonesia due to governmental restrictions?
content:
We are aware that users in Indonesia may experience issues accessing Hopp pages with "hopp.bio" or, in some cases, "hopp.to" URLs due to governmental restrictions. To resolve this issue, you can try the following solutions:

- Connect a Custom Domain: Upgrade to a Hopp Pro plan to connect a custom domain to your Hopp Link in Bio page.
- Try using "hopp.to" instead of "hopp.bio": Change "hopp.bio/example" to "hopp.to/example" whenever you share the link or in your browser.

Please note: Custom domains can only be connected to Link in Bio pages. For landing pages and short links created with Hopp, please use the "hopp.to" URL instead of "hopp.bio".

title: How do I connect Tranzzo as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Tranzzo as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Tranzzo.

If you have an account:
- Navigate to your Tranzzo merchant's portal where you can view your credentials: Project ID, API key and API Secret. Make sure you have finished the onboarding flow.
- Copy the credentials, then paste them into the Wix Accept Payment section.
- Click Connect.

If you don't have an account:
- Click Create Tranzzo account.
- Register for a Tranzzo merchant account.
- Once you have finished the onboarding flow, you can retrieve your Project ID, API key and API Secret in your Tranzzo account.
- Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I create an automatic discount for specific menu items in Wix Restaurants?
content: Go to Automatic Discounts in your site's dashboard. Click Create Discount. Enter the discount name. Customers see this name during checkout. Select what the discount applies to, then choose Specific menu items and select one or more menu items that the discount can be applied to. Optionally, create minimum requirements for the discount to apply: select the Minimum quantity of items checkbox and enter the number of items, or select the Minimum order subtotal checkbox and enter the minimum amount. Select the type of discount from the What is the discount? drop-down and enter the required percentage, amount, or price. Select the date and time when the discount starts. Optionally, select the Set an end date and time checkbox and select the date and time when the discount ends. Click Save.

title: How can I add extra charges to my hotel reservations in Wix Hotels?
content: To add extra charges to your hotel reservations: go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Price Options tab, click Extra Charges, and then click Create New. Enter the name of the extra charge. Click the Set charge type drop-down menu and select an option: Mandatory Charge (the service is not optional and your guests are required to pay the charge) or Optional Extra (the service is optional, and if your guests do not choose to add it they are not required to pay; if your charge is optional you can add a photo and description to explain the service). Click the Add charge per drop-down menu and select an option: Reservation (the extra charge is per reservation, for example cleaning fees) or Person (the extra charge is per person, for example breakfast). Enter the price of the charge. Select or deselect the Non-Taxable checkbox: selected means tax is not added to the extra charge, deselected means tax is added to the extra charge. Click Save.

title: How can I add a gallery to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Gallery. Click a gallery type: Grid Galleries let visitors see and browse all of your images at once; Slider Galleries let visitors browse through slides with your images, similar to a presentation; More Galleries add a fun gallery to showcase your images in a unique way, with options like Freestyle. Then click and drag the gallery onto the page.

title: How can I respond promptly to project requests in the Wix Marketplace?
content: As a Partner in the Wix Marketplace, you'll receive new project requests from potential clients and get notified in your Wix Studio workspace and via email. You can access details, respond, update project statuses, or decline projects if they're not a good fit for your business. Make sure to respond as soon as possible and update the status of the project so it does not accidentally expire. You can also set up an automation to automatically respond to new leads. Setting your availability is also essential in managing your project requests effectively. Make sure to adjust your availability when you're unavailable to avoid receiving project requests or leads that you can't respond to in a timely manner. Failure to respond to requests within 3 days can negatively affect your ranking in the Wix Marketplace, so be proactive and respond promptly to all project requests.

title: How can I make a GIF without sound accessible to visitors with sight-related impairments?
content: If your site contains GIFs or videos that do not have sound, visitors with sight-related impairments may not be able to access them. Add a text description to the media that describes the events that are taking place. For example, the text description of this GIF could be: A GIF of the sun with the word "New" flashing across it. This improves your site's accessibility, as screenreaders can "read" the description and inform the visitor of the media's content.

title: Why does my Wix site display as a thin vertical strip on mobile devices, and how can I fix it?
content: If your Wix site appears as a thin vertical strip on mobile devices, it is likely improperly connected to a domain. Incorrect domain connection specifically by masking, redirecting, or framing a free Wix URL is not supported, and masking, redirecting/forwarding, or framing a free Wix URL is not advisable for Search Engine Optimization (SEO). Search engine crawlers won't associate your site's content with your domain when framing or masking the site. To guarantee the integrity of your site's design, layout, and SEO, you must properly connect your domain to Wix. It may take up to 48 hours for the domain record changes to take effect. If 48 hours have passed since you connected your domain to your Wix site and you're still unable to access your site via your domain, use the Domain Troubleshooter to find out if there is a connection problem.

title: How can I add a 'My Cart' icon to the header of my branded app for an online store?
content:
To add a 'My Cart' icon to the header of your branded app for an online store:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Mobile App**.
- Tap **Edit** under your site name or the name of your branded app.
- Tap **Change Header Design** at the top.
- Click **Customize**.
- Scroll down and click the **Show Shopping Cart Icon** toggle to enable it.
  - **Enabled:** Your branded app header includes a shortcut so members can navigate to their shopping cart.
  - **Disabled:** There is no shopping cart icon included in your branded app header.
- Tap **Save**.

**Note:** The option to add a cart icon is only available for the **Minimal** header design.

title: How can I enable double opt-in for my Wix site forms?
content: To enable double opt-in on your site forms, go to your form settings in the editor. For new forms, select your form in the editor, click Edit Form, select the Subscribe field, click Settings, then click the Enable double opt-in toggle. For old forms, select your form in the editor, click Form Settings, click the Settings tab, click Subscriber Double Opt-In, then click the Enable double opt-in toggle. If the toggle is grayed out, it means you haven't yet added a subscriber opt-in checkbox. Enabled means anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox receives an email to verify their subscription status; once they have verified, they become subscribers in your contact list. Disabled means anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox is automatically a subscriber in your contact list and does not have to confirm their status.

title: How can I access my Wix Groups reports to track engagement and member activity?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard, scroll down to the Groups section, and select the relevant report.

title: How can I connect page elements to my CMS collections in Wix?
content: In the CMS, datasets are your tool for linking elements within your editor to the content stored in your collections. Select any supported element in your editor and click the Connect to CMS icon to map out which collection fields correspond to each part of your elements. Within your dataset settings, you can customize the dataset mode, set the maximum number of items to load at once, and fine-tune filters and sorting conditions to exclude specific items and determine their display order on your site. Learn more about connecting page elements to datasets.

title: Can mobile site visitors see a preview of a new chat message on Wix?
content: Currently, visitors to the mobile version of your site cannot see a preview of a new chat message. Instead they see a red dot notification indicating a new message. The message preview is only available on sites built using Editor X.

title: How can I enable phishing and malware protection in Chrome?
content:
To enable phishing and malware protection in Chrome:

- Click the **More Actions** icon on the Chrome browser toolbar.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click **Privacy and security**.
- Click **Security**.
- Ensure the **Standard Protection** option is selected.

**Tip**: For additional, proactive security against phishing and malware, you can select the **Enhanced Protection** option.

title: Can staff members sell event tickets using Check-in by Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible for staff members to sell tickets, which would also allow you to track the number of tickets each staff member sells. You can add staff members to an event so they can check in guests, scan tickets and manage the guest list.

title: How can I add and set up a donation form on my Wix site?
content:
Before you begin, make sure you've connected your site to a payment method and purchased a Premium plan.

To add a donation form:
Click Add on the left side of the Editor.
Click Contact & Forms.
Click Donation on the left.
Click or drag any of the forms under Donation onto your site.

To manage your donation fields:
Add a new field: click the form, click Add New Field or the Plus icon, then click the Add icon next to the field you want to add.
Edit an existing field: click the relevant field, click Edit Field, then use the available options. You can click the Field title text box to add a title. Under Show initial text, select None or Placeholder text.
Remove a field: click the relevant field and press Delete on your keyboard.

To set up payments on your donation form:
Click Donate.
Click Settings.
Choose what happens when a visitor submits a form:
Show success message: display a success message. Enter the message you want to show and set how long the message should show for.
Go to site page or popup: click the Link icon, select the link destination on the left, enter the link details on the right, and click Done.
Link to external URL: click the Link icon, enter the URL on the right, and click Done.
Show link to file download: allow visitors to download a file after submitting the form. This is a Premium feature which requires a Premium plan. Click Upload file to choose the file your site visitors will download, then edit the download link text.
Scroll down to Accept Payments on Your Form.
Click Set Up Payment Form.
Click Get Started and set up the desired payment form type.

title: How can I optimize my mobile layout using the Wix Editor?
content: The mobile-friendly version of your site is automatically created using content from your desktop site. To optimize your mobile layout, click Page Layout Optimizer on the left side of the mobile Editor, then click Optimize Now. You can click Undo to revert back to the previous version. Changing the layout on the mobile site does not affect the desktop site. It is not possible to revert back to the original template layout of the mobile site from before you added your content. Note: If you're building your site using the latest Editor experience, you won't have access to the Page Layout Optimizer tool because Wix automatically optimizes your mobile layout in the new Editor experience.

title: How can I create a new rule in Wix Forms to show or hide fields based on user input?
content:
To create new rules for your form in Wix Forms (New Forms), follow these steps:

- Click the relevant form in the editor.
- Click **Edit Form**.
- Click the **Rules** icon on the right.
- Click **+ Add Rule**.

**Note:** To enable Rules, your form must have a minimum of 2 fields.

- Fill out the sections:

**Choose a condition (If)**
- Select the field you want to base the rule on from the drop-down under **This field**.
- Select the condition for the rule from the drop-down (e.g. is empty, is filled, is equal to, etc.).
- (Optional) Add another condition to this rule.
  - Click **+ Add Condition** to add another condition.
  - Choose if the conditions should be combined with **And** or **Or**.
    - **And:** Both conditions need to be met.
    - **Or:** Either condition needs to be met.

**Decide on the result (Then)**
- Select the field you want to base the rule on from the drop-down under **This field**.
- Select the condition for the rule from the drop-down (e.g. is hidden, shown, optional, required).
  **Tip:** You can select more than one field to apply the same result.
- (Optional) Click **+ Add Rule** to add another rule.

- Click **Save Rule**.
- Click **Save** at the top right to save the form.

Your rule is now saved. Publish these changes to ensure that the next user completing your form will see the updated rule.

title: How can I access my email marketing campaign statistics on Wix?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click the Check Stats icon on any published campaign.

title: Can I change the text alignment of a form field's title in the new Wix Forms?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible to update the text alignment of a form field's title, placeholder text, or field description. For example, field titles are left aligned above a field and can't be moved to the center or right. If your site is set to right-to-left language (RTL), the form text will automatically change direction in the Editor and live site. However, in the form builder the text appears left-to-right (LTR).

title: How can I create a purchase order in Wix Stores and what are the steps involved?
content: Purchase orders are not yet available for all merchants. To create one, go to Purchase Orders in your site's dashboard and click +Create Purchase Order. Optionally edit the Ship to address. Add a supplier by clicking Select supplier, clicking +Add Supplier, entering the supplier's details, and clicking Save. Optionally enter the payment terms. To add products from your catalog, click Select from Catalog, select a product, and if it has product options click Continue and select a variant, then click Add to Order. Optionally add a description, change the SKU to the supplier's SKU if needed, select the quantity, enter your cost, and optionally click tax to create a tax rate. Repeat to add more store products. To add products not yet in your catalog, click +Add Custom Product, add the product name, optionally add a description, enter the supplier's SKU, select the quantity, enter your cost, and optionally click tax to create a tax rate. Repeat to add more custom products. Optionally add a note to the order and click +Add Discount to enter a percentage discount. Click Save as Draft. Optionally download the purchase order as a PDF file or email it to yourself; Wix suggests not entering your supplier's email address because they will not be able to reply. Optionally select Mark as ordered, then click Done.

title: How can I connect my Instagram account to my Wix Portfolio?
content: Go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard. Click the Integrations tab on the left. Click Connect next to Instagram. Click Add to Site. Click Agree & Add to allow Wix to read basic site & business info. Click Connect Instagram. Log in to your Instagram account in the pop-up window if not already signed in. Click Allow. Your Instagram account is now connected with your portfolio.

title: What should I do if my Google Workspace account is suspended due to not accepting the new Terms of Service?
content: If you receive the suspension message under the Subscriptions section of your Google Workspace dashboard, sign in to your admin account and accept the new Terms of Service that will be displayed. If you have not yet set up your Admin business email, you need to do so in order to accept Google's new Terms of Service.

title: How can I allow visitors to download videos from my Wix Video library?
content:
Go to your Video Library. Select the checkboxes next to the videos visitors can download, then click Set Pricing at the top of the video list.

Select an option:
* Free: Visitors can watch the videos for free. Click the Download options drop-down and select Allow download.
* Paid: Visitors must pay to watch the video. Select the Video can be purchased checkbox, enter the video price, then click the Download options drop-down and select Allow downloads. Note: Videos which can only be rented cannot be downloaded.

Click the Download options drop-down and select Allow downloads. (Optional) Enter the Price. Click Save.

Tip: If you don't want visitors to be able to download your videos, select No downloads under the Download options, or offer your video for rent instead of purchase.

Note: Visitors can only download videos when viewing your site on desktop. They cannot download videos on mobile.

title: How can I change the status of a hotel reservation in Wix Hotels?
content:
To update the status of a reservation:
- Go to your dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab.
- Click the Reservations tab.
- Click the relevant reservation.
- Select a status from the Reservation Status drop-down list.
- Click Save.

title: How can I display additional content from my CMS collection on my Wix Bookings pages?
content:
Use the CMS with Wix Bookings. You must use code to build custom Bookings pages, and displaying CMS collection content on Bookings pages is not yet available in all Wix accounts.

Before you begin: add the CMS to your site if you haven't already, and enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Bookings with the CMS.

Create a multiple item collection (called the 'Details' collection) that references your Bookings Wix app collection. Add items for each service, add fields for the content you want to save (e.g., Rich Content), and add a Reference field connected to the Bookings Wix app collection, such as Services under Bookings. You can select multiple services if you use a multi-reference field. For each item, select the relevant service.

Build custom Bookings pages with Velo for the Booking Service page or Booking Calendar page where you want to show the additional details.

Set up datasets on the custom page: connect a dataset to your 'Details' CMS collection and another dataset to the Bookings Wix app collection (Services under Bookings; use Calendar under Bookings when editing a Custom Booking Calendar page). Add a URL slug filter to the Services or Calendar dataset, and add a reference filter to the 'Details' dataset using the Reference (Services) or Multi-Reference (Services) field. Add supported elements, such as the Rich Content element, connect them to the relevant fields in the 'Details' dataset, and add/connect elements to the Services dataset. Optionally repeat the setup for the Custom Booking Calendar page. Preview to test the connections, then publish your site when ready.

title: How can I add a Wix Forum to my site using Editor X?
content:
To add a Wix Forum to your site using Editor X:

- Click the App Market icon on the top of Editor X.
- Type "Wix Forum" in the search field and press Enter.
- Click +Add next to the Wix Forum app.

title: How can I set up a group redirect for my Wix site to change the URL path for multiple pages at once?
content:
To set up a group redirect on your Wix site:
- Go to your SEO Dashboard.
- Select Go to URL Redirect Manager under Tools and settings.
- Click + Create New Redirect.
- Select Group redirect.
- Enter the original path for the group of pages under Old URL Path. For example, enter "products".
- Enter the new path for the group of pages under New URL Path. For example, enter "product-page".
- Click Save & Close.

Limitations of the Group Redirect Tool:
- It is not possible to add spaces in either the old or new path.
- You cannot use a path which has already been used in another redirect (single or group).
- Redirecting from your site's home page is not possible.
- You cannot add group redirects for external domains.
- Redirecting a group of pages to a single page is not allowed.

title: What should I do if I receive an email from Wix about changes to my payment method settings that I did not authorize?
content: If you receive an email saying "You changed how you accept payments on your website" and you did not authorize these changes, change your Wix account password immediately and then contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I use the AI Text Creator in the Studio Editor to generate text for my website?
content:
### Step 1 | Enter the relevant information for your text
To get started, select a text box in your Editor. You can then access the AI text creator to generate titles or paragraphs based on the details you enter.

#### To enter information for your AI-generated text:
- Add a new text box or select an existing one in the Editor.
- Click **Create AI Text**.
- Enter the business type.
- (Optional) Enter the business name.
- Select a text type: **Title** or **Paragraph**.
- Select a topic from the drop-down.
   **Tip:** You can choose **Other** to enter your own topic.
- (Optional) Add any relevant information in the text under **What's important to mention?**.
- Click **Create Text**.

### Step 2 | Review and use a text suggestion
After clicking **Create Text**, you receive 3 text options to choose from. All options are based on the information you provide, but written in slightly different styles. Once you decide on an option you like, you can either apply it to the current text box or copy it for later use.

#### To review and use a text suggestion:
- Review the text options and decide which one you want to use.
- Choose what to do next:
   * **Use Text:** Apply this text to the text box you selected.
   * **Copy Text:** Copy the text to your clipboard.
- (Optional) Click **Edit Text** to make changes to the AI-generated text.

### Didn't like the suggestions?
You can refine the information you entered on the left side of the panel, and click **Create Text** to try again.

### Note
Currently, the AI Text Creator is only available in English.

title: What information is not imported when transferring my menu to the new Wix Menus app?
content:
When importing your menu to the new app, certain parts of the data are not copied over. Here's a summary of what's included and excluded:

- **Menus**: Yes
- **Sections**: Yes
- **Items**: Yes
- **Variants**: Yes
- **Modifier Groups & Modifiers**: Partially
- **Labels**: Yes
- **Specials**: Yes
- **Archive**: No
- **Online Orders properties**: Partially

### Archive
Archived information is not imported to the new app.

### Online Orders properties
To transfer details such as stock availability and special requests, you'll need to install the new Wix Online Orders (New) app. **Tip:** Taxes do not transfer automatically. Set up the required tax rates for accurate tax collection.

title: How can I create and publish a blog post from my mobile device using Wix?
content: From a browser on your mobile device, access your blog page and log in using the email associated with your Wix account. Tap Create a Post, which is only visible to those with writing privileges. Write your post title and content, then click Save & Continue. You can choose a category and tap Done, save as a draft, or save and publish to your live site. Other blog functions such as editing and adding categories are also available.

title: How do I publish my Google Sheets spreadsheet to use it with the Table Master app?
content: Open your Google Sheets spreadsheet. Click File at the top left. Click Share. Select Publish to the web from the drop-down menu. Click Publish. If your spreadsheet has multiple tabs, select the tab you want to use in the Table Master app from the drop-down menu. Click OK in the pop-up window. Copy the URL displayed on the Link tab and paste it in the Spreadsheet URL field in the app settings.

title: How can I manage files and folders from my site's dashboard using the Wix File Share app?
content:
To manage files and folders from your site's dashboard:

- Go to File Share in your site's dashboard.
- Go to the relevant file or folder.
- Select the checkboxes next to the files or folders you want to select.
- Click the More actions icon next to the relevant file or folder.
- Choose from the following options:
  - Download: Download the file or folder to your computer.
  - Share: Share your file or folder on Facebook or X (Twitter) or copy the URL provided.
  - View on site: View how your files and folders look on your live site.
  - Rename: Enter a different name for your file or folder and click Save.
  - Permissions: Add members, roles or pricing plans to your file or folder and click Done.
  - Move: Select the folder you want to move your item to and click Move Here.
    - Tip: Click + New Folder if you need a new folder to add your item to.
  - Delete: Delete the item from the app. Click Delete to confirm.

title: How can I change the number of rows and columns in my Wix gallery?
content: Click the gallery in the Editor. Click the Layout icon. Customize the layout: for Columns, drag the slider to set the number of columns; for Rows, drag the slider to set the number of rows; for Spacing, drag the slider to set the spacing between the columns / rows. Note: Some galleries only contain the Columns option.

title: How can I connect my thermal printer to the Wix app to print online orders automatically?
content: Make sure you have a compatible printer. Pair your printer with your device using Bluetooth, WiFi, or Ethernet. Then open the Wix app and access your online ordering settings: go to your site in the Wix app, tap **Manage**, tap **Restaurants**, tap **Online Orders (New)**, tap the **More Actions** icon, and select **Manage settings**. Next, connect the printer to the app: tap **Thermal printing** under **Printing**, tap **Get Started**, tap **Next**, then tap **Next** again. Verify your printer is selected from the list and tap **Next**. You can tap another printer on the list to select it instead. Tap **Done**. To verify the printer is connected, tap **Print a test order**. Once connected, it will automatically print incoming orders. Auto-printing requires the app to be constantly open; your Online Orders page stays on even if you're inactive for a while.

title: How do I transfer my .co.uk domain away from Wix?
content:
Wix domains with a .co.uk suffix require a change of the IPS tag name to transfer away from Wix. This process does not involve an authorization code (EPP code) like with other domain transfers. You need an IPS tag to submit a transfer request for .co.uk domains; contact your new domain provider to get the IPS tag before starting.

To transfer your domain away from Wix:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Click Transfer away from Wix.
- Click Transfer Domain after reviewing the important details of the process.
- Enter your new provider's IPS tag and click Continue.
- Click Submit Request to confirm your transfer.

You don't need to do anything else in your Wix account. Your new domain provider can provide the next steps. Once the process is complete, the domain transfer will be finalized within 7 days.

title: How can I change my premium app subscription on Wix?
content: To change a premium app subscription on Wix, go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant app, click Change pricing plan, select the plan you want to change to, and click Change Plan. You can upgrade or cancel your plan; you cannot downgrade to a lower-tier plan. If you cancel, your premium app subscription will remain active until the end of your current billing cycle, and auto-renewal will be turned off. The change in the price is immediate.

title: Can I create and print multiple shipping labels at once in Wix Stores?
content: Yes. You can now create and print multiple shipping labels at the same time.

title: Can I use the Inspector to resize a section grid in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. It is now possible to resize cells and columns from the Inspector panel by entering the specific size you need.

title: Can I print receipts at a mobile POS using Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. Wix Bookings users can connect an external printer to a mobile point of sale and use it to print receipts.

title: How can I change the background color of a page in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the Layers panel at the top of the Editor, select the Page layer, and click the Inspector icon at the top right. Click the color box to set the color, and drag the slider to set the opacity. You can also click Apply to More Pages to add the same color to the background of other pages on your site.

title: Can I embed Vimeo videos in my Wix Portfolio?
content: Yes, you can now embed Vimeo videos in your Wix Portfolio.

title: Is it possible to connect Square POS with the new Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Currently, Square POS integration is available for the previous online ordering app but not for the new Wix Restaurants Orders app.

title: How can I select, arrange, and delete multiple elements in the Wix Editor?
content: To select multiple elements, click and drag your cursor over them, or hold down the Shift key and click the elements. You can also press Ctrl+A to select all elements in a specific container, or all of the page's elements if you didn't click a container first. To arrange elements, select them, click the Layout icon, then use Align, Distribute, or Match Size. To delete multiple elements, select them and press Delete on your keyboard, or right-click the group of elements and choose Delete from the menu.

title: How do I resize an image and add text or other elements to an image in Wix Editor?
content: To resize an image in Wix Editor, click the image, then drag the handles on the edges of the image to the size you want. To add text or other elements to an image, attach them to a transparent container box that appears on top of the image: click Add Elements, click Box and select the box you want to add, drag the container box onto the relevant image, make the container box transparent, then drag the relevant elements onto the container box to attach them.

title: I am experiencing issues with fonts not displaying correctly on the mobile version of my website. The fonts I am using are default fonts provided by Wix.
content: Different browsers and devices use a variety of rendering engines which may result in minor differences in the way your font appears. Fonts also render differently between iOS and Android, and the significance of the difference can vary from font to font. If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, we recommend choosing another similar looking font for your site. Certain fonts are not supported by iOS or other mobile devices. If a specific font on your site is not displaying properly on an iOS device, you can check whether the font is supported by iOS or other mobile devices. If a supported, default font is not appearing on your mobile device, or if you are experiencing other issues with text on your site, contact us and we will be happy to assist you.

title: How can I contact Editor X Customer Care for support?
content: Make sure you're logged in from a desktop computer and click below to contact us. Choose the relevant topic for your request so that it reaches a specialized Customer Care Expert. Click here to view the Wix Customer Care callback operating hours. Note: Email support is available in Russian and Korean; chat and callback services are not available in these languages.

title: How can I create a promotional video using the Wix app?
content:
To create a promotional video in the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Marketing** and select **Video Maker**.
- Tap **Get Started**.
- Choose a template from the available options or tap **Start from Scratch** to create a video without a template.
- (If you selected a template) Tap **Customize Video**.
- Tap **Add Media** to add images or video clips to your video.
- Tap **Next** and add titles to your video:
  - **Opening Title:** This appears at the beginning of your video and should introduce the concept of the video.
  - **Second Title:** This text appears next. Use it to explain more about the video content.
  - **Third Title:** This text is the next to appear. It's a good idea to make this a call-to-action to explain what you would like the viewers to do, such as "Visit Our Store".
  - **End Title:** This is the last text to appear. It is usually a good place to enter your website address or contact details, so your viewers know how to find you.
  - **Include Business Info:** Tap the toggle to choose how your business info is displayed:
    - **Enabled:** Your business information is displayed in your video. Enter your business details and add your logo.
    - **Disabled:** Your business information is not displayed in your video.
- Tap **Next** and choose from the following options:
  - **Choose a Video Style:** Play the different style options and select one for your video.
  - **Choose a Layout:** Choose between **Square**, **Landscape** and **Portrait**.
  - **Choose Colors and Font:** Select the primary color, secondary colors and font.
  - **Font:** Select the font style used on your video.
- Tap **Next** and choose a music track for your video or select **No Music**.
- Tap **Next**.
- Tap an option to choose what you want to do:
  - **Customize:** Make changes to the video.
  - **Save Video:** Save the video to your Media Manager. Choose an option:
    - **Share:** Share your video with others.
    - **Download:** Save the file to your device.
- Tap **Done**.

title: Is there a feature in Wix that automatically creates a group for online program participants?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer a feature that would automatically create a group with your online program's participants. If needed, you can always create your group manually and invite the relevant participants.

title: What features does the new automation builder offer for creating complex automation flows?
content: The new automation builder is not yet available to all users. It is available from your site's dashboard with no pre-requirements. It features a canvas view that lets you add actions, delays, and conditions at any point in the flow and visualize the automation as it is built, even when it has multiple branches. A panel guides you as you build and includes a search function to find the trigger or action you need, plus a filter drop-down menu to discover more triggers or apps. It supports larger and more complex flows with IF/ELSE conditions so you can see how each step impacts others and define what happens when a condition isn't met.

title: How can I add and customize a Google Map on my Editor X site?
content:
To add a Google Map on your Editor X site:
- Click **Add** on the top of Editor X.
- Click **Contact & Forms**.
- Click **Maps**.
- Choose a map you like and drag it onto your page.

To customize the Map settings:
- Click the Google Map in Editor X.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Customize your Map's settings:
  - **Zoom:** Choose the zoom of your map by dragging the slider.
  - **Show map and satellite views:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to switch between views.
  - **Show zoom control:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to change the zoom.
  - **Show Street View control:** Enable or disable Google Street View.
  - **Show Directions link:** Enable or disable the link to Google's directions service.
  - **Allow dragging:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to move around the map by clicking and dragging.

To choose a different Map and Pin design:
- Click your Google Map.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top right of Editor X.
- Click the Design tab.
- Choose an option for Map or Pin design.

To manage your locations (Pins):
- Click your Google Map.
- Click **Manage Locations**.
- Choose the relevant option under **How many locations do you have?**:
  - **One:** Enter the location details (Address, Title, Description, Link, Link Text).
  - **Multiple:** Enter the first location's details, click **Add Location** to add more, and repeat for each location.

**Tip:** Hover over a location and click the More Actions icon to edit, duplicate, or delete it.

title: How can I save a blog post as a draft on Wix?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post. Add the relevant content. Click the More Actions icon and select Save as draft.

title: Can I limit my collaborator's access to member pages on my site according to their role?
content: Currently, it is not possible to limit your collaborator's access to member pages on your site according to their role. Collaborators can access any member's page on your site regardless of their role. For example, this would let you manage your collaborators' access to different pages in the same way that you can manage your members' access according to their role.

title: Can I create multiple forums on one Wix site?
content: Wix is still working on the possibility of creating multiple forums on one site. In the meantime, a workaround lets you have multiple forum categories with different member permissions.

title: What is the full step-by-step process to get my Facebook Ads campaign live with Wix?
content:
Getting your campaign from set up to live is quick and easy, because the Wix AI does most of the work. Here’s how it works:

* STEP 1: Getting Started — Click “Get Started” in the Welcome Screen. You can also schedule a call with a Wix Expert anytime to get help or sales advice.
* STEP 2: Choosing a campaign goal — You have three options: 'more store orders' for campaigns run with Wix Stores, 'more leads or bookings,' or 'promote a page.' Once you pick a goal, you cannot change it.
* STEP 3: Connecting to Facebook — In the connect page, choose to connect to your Facebook business page. An ad preview will be created. You must be the admin of the Facebook Business page in order to connect it. Follow the prompts that come up.
* STEP 4: Your Ad Content — In the ad content section, you’ll see an ad already set up for you based on information pulled from your site. You can change your ad caption and image at any time, but it’s better to leave them as is, so that Wix’s algorithm can run tests to check how effective these are.
* STEP 5: Target Audience — The Wix algorithm will take care of this. Feel free to make changes to the gender, age range, interests and geographic location, but it’s best to stick to the recommended parameters.
* STEP 6: Budget — Set the budget that best suits your business. Your campaign is set to run automatically, renewing your subscription on a monthly basis until you cancel. You can also change your subscription while a campaign is running.
* STEP 7: Reviewing Your Ad — Review your ad and make sure it’s ready to launch. Check the budget, audience and creative - you can edit them anytime - and when you’re satisfied, go ahead and launch your campaign.
* STEP 8: Your Ad Will Go Live Soon — Once you’ve completed the checkout process, Wix will submit your ad to Facebook for review. Most ads go live within 72 hours. When your ad is live, you’ll be notified immediately.

All of these steps take less than 10 minutes to complete.

title: How can I manage sections in my self-paced online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: To manage sections in a self-paced online program, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard, select the relevant program, and scroll down to the Content section. Use these options: Edit a section by hovering over it, clicking Edit, editing the relevant details and/or cover image, then clicking Save. Duplicate a section by hovering over the section name, clicking the More Actions icon, and clicking Duplicate; the duplicate appears beneath the original section. Delete a section by hovering over the section name, clicking the More Actions icon, clicking Delete, then confirming Delete. Reorder a section by clicking and dragging it up or down on the page. Add a section by clicking + Add section at the bottom of your program content. Tip: click the drop-down arrow to the right of a section to expand or collapse the steps within that section.

title: Can I add multiple guests to an event and assign them tickets or seats in a single transaction?
