content: You can now add multiple guests to an event and assign them tickets or seats in a single transaction.

title: How can I add an anchor to a menu in Wix Editor?
content: Click your site menu in the Editor. Click Manage Menu. Click Add Menu Item / Add a menu item at the bottom of the panel. Add a new anchor, depending on your menu type: for advanced menus, click Section; for site menus, click Section or anchor. Select the page the anchor is on from the drop-down. Select the relevant anchor from the drop-down. Click Done.

title: Can I assign tab permissions based on member roles in Wix Member Apps?
content: Currently, it is only possible to restrict member access to specific screens in the Wix Member Apps using pricing plans and member badges. Further customization is not currently possible. There are open feature requests for Assign Tab Permissions Based on Member Roles and Allowing Multiple Permissions Per Tab.

title: What are some best practices to improve my email sender reputation?
content: Send high quality content: only send the most informative and relevant content to people who want to see it, and tailor campaigns to subscriber interests, including images and links that speak to what they want to know more about. Keep a consistent email schedule: decide on an email frequency as part of your email marketing strategy and stick to it, starting with a less-is-more approach, then figuring out an optimum email cadence that gets consistent results; experiment with different types and timing, but once you find what works, maintain a consistent schedule to avoid frustrating subscribers. Clean and maintain your subscriber list: regularly maintain your list and check for any unknown or outdated email addresses to remove, which helps avoid hard or soft bounces and falling into spam traps. Make sure your campaign looks legitimate: follow best practices for email structure, keep your subject line straightforward and not spammy, make your company name and address clearly visible, and ensure all your content and images are relevant.

title: How can I duplicate and edit an existing Wix Analytics report to create a tailored report for my business?
content:
Before duplicating and editing a report, check if a pre-built report matches your needs. To create a new report or duplicate and edit a report, you must upgrade your Wix site to the Business Elite plan (for Wix Editor users) or an Elite plan (for Studio users).

To duplicate a report: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard. Select the report you want to duplicate. Click the More Actions icon at the top right and select Duplicate and edit report. Click Start Now on the pop up window. Add your report title, select the display type (e.g. line chart, table), and a description. Click Duplicate. After duplicating and saving a report, you can access it in your Custom Reports list on the All Reports page. When a report is duplicated, only the current view (table, chart, map) is copied over into the new version. The duplicate report will not include other views. You can customize the duplicate report through the report builder interface.

To edit the dashboard: Click the More Actions icon. Select Edit dashboard from the drop-down menu.

To edit an existing tile: Click the More Actions icon. Click Edit. Change the Tile data by selecting and deselecting Dimensions and Measures. You cannot change the tile Explore; your tile topic cannot be changed, and the tile can only contain data of the same topic (Sales, Item Sales, Traffic, People, etc).

Dimensions are qualitative; you can’t operate math functions within it. Measures are quantitative; you can operate math functions within it.

To run your report, click Run at the top right. Your results will load in the data pane. You can choose to see your data in a table, bar chart, columns, scatterplot, line, area, pie chart, map, or single value. Click your preferred visualization icon, and your data will be displayed accordingly. Click Save, and the tile will be updated.

Optional: Add additional tiles to enrich your reports. Your new tiles can have different subjects such as sales, items sales, traffic or people. Once you're done editing your report, click Save at the top right.

title: How can I add a link to an image in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add a link to an image in the Wix Editor:
- Click the image in your Editor.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Click the drop-down menu under When image is clicked.
- Select A link opens.
- Under What does it link to? click the Link icon.
- Enter the link details.
- Click Done.

Tip: You can also click the Link icon to set up your link, but make sure that you complete the earlier steps above first. You can also learn how to link a button to a specific product page in Wix Stores.

title: Is it possible to restore site members when restoring a deleted site?
content: Currently, when you restore a previously deleted site, your Members Area gets restored as well. However, your site members are not restored with it. Your members will need to join your site's Members Area again. It is not possible to manually add your Members, they must sign up themselves.

title: How can I customize my logo's text in the Wix app?
content: After accessing the Logo Maker in the Wix app and selecting a logo design, tap the Text icon below your logo. Tap the Add icon to add new text, or tap existing text to change it. Customize the text using the available options: Font, Alignment, Color, Size, Outline, Line Color, Flip, Curve, Position, Spacing, Rotate, Shadow, and Blur. Tap Done.

title: How can I get a printed receipt for Wix Mobile POS.
content: To print a receipt with Wix Mobile POS, purchase a compatible Star Micronics or Epson thermal printer and pair it with your mobile device through the Wix app. Customize your receipt as desired. At a sale, process the sale and collect payment, tap Send Receipt, and select Print receipt. Connecting a printer is only available for the US and Canada, and printing receipts is currently available only for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

title: Can I translate Wix Gift Cards using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Gift Cards. See the list of translatable content in Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I delete the Wix Table Reservations app from my site?
content: To delete Wix Table Reservations, go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the Wix Table Reservations app. Click Delete. Click Go to Editor. Choose a reason for deleting the app under Why are you deleting this app?. Click Delete App.

title: How can I add a new screen to my Wix member app using the dashboard?
content:
To add a new screen to your Wix member app using the dashboard, follow these steps:

- Go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant tab (e.g. Spaces by Wix app, Branded Mobile App).
- Click Edit Mobile App.
- Click Screens on the left.
- Choose where to add the new screen:
  - Screens in navigation: Click + Add next to Screens in navigation to add the new screen to the navigation menu.
  - Screens not in navigation: Click + Add next to Screens not in navigation to add the new screen and keep it hidden from the menu. You can add it to your app's menu later, if needed.
- Type a name for the screen and press Enter on your keyboard.
- Click Save & Publish at the top right.

Tip: To reorder screens that appear in the navigation menu, click and drag the screens up or down the list.

title: How can I update the basic information of my online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Hover over the program you want to edit and click Edit Settings. Click Basic Info. Customize the settings: enter or edit the Program name; add Category labels; customize the Cover Image by adding a new image or using the Update or Delete icons; update the Description; add Instructors and assign them to your program. Click Save.

title: How can I verify my domain on Facebook to track events using Meta pixel?
content:
To track events on your site using Meta pixel after the release of iOS14 in February 2021, you must verify your domain on Facebook.

Step 1 | Confirm you own your site domain on Facebook
Verify your domain on Facebook using the meta tag method. Note: It is not possible to upload an HTML file to confirm domain ownership. Copy your meta tag.

Step 2 | Add your Facebook Meta Tag to your site
Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Custom Code under Advanced Settings. Click Add Custom Code at the top right. Paste your Facebook meta tag in the text box. Enter a meaningful name for your code so you can quickly identify it later if needed. In Add code to pages, select All pages. In Place your code in, choose Head. Click Apply.

Step 3 | Return to Facebook to complete verification
Follow the Meta instructions to associate Facebook pages with your verified domain.

title: How do I confirm my email address when sending an email campaign through Wix?
content: To confirm your email address when sending an email campaign through Wix, create and edit your email campaign. On the final step, when you click Send Now, Wix asks you to confirm your email address. Check your email account for the code; if you do not receive it, check your Spam/Junk folder. The email titled "Your Email Confirmation Code" is sent from no-reply@verification.ascendbywix.com. You can confirm your email without a code by verifying the email by signing in via a Google or Facebook account. Enter the code in the pop-up window and click Confirm. If you click Not Now, you still need to confirm your email address prior to sending your email campaign. If you sign up with an email address purchased with your Wix account, the email address is automatically verified.

title: What should I do if my Wix automation is not triggering?
content: If your automation is not triggering, check the automation summary: go to Automations in your site's dashboard, click the relevant automation, and view statistics information in the panel on the right. Then check your trigger and filter configuration: hover over the relevant automation, click the More Actions icon, click Edit, click the trigger to review its settings and filters, make any necessary updates, and click Save. Check the delay: hover over the automation, click More Actions, click Edit, click the delay to check its configuration, make any necessary updates, and click Save. Note that changing your automation delay resets actions that are "pending" for that automation. Check the limit once per person: hover over the automation, click More Actions, click Edit, click the trigger to check whether the Trigger once per person toggle is enabled, make any necessary updates, and click Save. Also note that automations don't run retroactively: an automation only runs for triggers that happen after the automation is activated.

title: Does Wix Editor support automatically adjusting the height of a strip to fit different viewports?
content: Currently, it is not possible for strips to automatically adjust their height for different viewports or screensizes (such as mobile devices). However, you can make your strip smaller or bigger in the mobile Editor by clicking and dragging the stretch handles.

title: How can I cancel my Wix domain subscription?
content: To cancel your Wix domain subscription, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain, click Cancel domain, select Cancel auto renew, and click Submit. This turns off the auto renew feature, so you'll still own your domain until the end of the subscription period after you cancel.

title: How do I set up my Google Workspace business email after purchasing it from Wix?
content: After purchasing a Google Workspace business email from Wix, wait a minimum of 5 minutes before beginning setup. In your Wix account, go to Business Email and click Setup Business Email. Enter your primary email address, enter a password, verify your password, and optionally enter details for additional emails in the blank email fields. Click Next, confirm your contact details, and click Submit. Then sign into your business email admin account to accept the Google Product Agreement and Terms of Service. You cannot access any of your other business emails until you have accepted the agreement. You may also need to verify your domain, if prompted. Once your business account is activated, it should be fully functional within 24 hours.

title: Can I connect Easebuzz as a payment provider in Wix for card payments in India?
content: Yes. Wix added a payment provider approved for the creation of new accounts in India, and you can now connect Easebuzz as a payment provider in Wix.

title: How can I fix the issue where my dynamic list page links to the wrong dynamic item page in Wix CMS?
content: Misconfigured links on your dynamic list page can cause the wrong dynamic item page URL to load. Make sure your dynamic list page links connect to the dynamic page dataset and the relevant item page. Also make sure each item has a unique URL slug. For the linked buttons or images on your dynamic list page's repeater, gallery, or table, connect them to the dynamic page dataset. Make sure the dynamic page links are connected in the dynamic dataset to the relevant item page. Make sure that each item in your collection has a unique URL slug so each item gets its own version of the dynamic item page.

title: How can I manually create an order in Wix for a custom product?
content:
Use manual orders for custom products or services you offer. This applies only to Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New) orders. Creating a manual order does not automatically generate a payment request.

Step 1 | Add items to the order
Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click +Add New Order. Click Add Custom Item. Enter an item title. Enter the price. (Optional) Enter a description of the item under Item info. Note: This description is visible to customers. Select the Is shippable item checkbox if you plan to ship this item to your customer. Click Add. (Optional) Repeat to add additional custom items.

Step 2 | Add a customer to the order
Click the Add a customer to the order drop-down. Select Existing customer or New customer. For an existing customer, select a customer and optionally click the Edit icon to view or edit the customer's details. For a new customer, click + Add new customer, enter the customer's details, and if the customer asks to subscribe to your site, click the Never subscribed drop-down next to Primary email and select Subscribed. (Optional) Add an address. (Optional) Add a label. (Optional) Assign the customer to someone on your team. (Optional) Click Add New Field to add more client info and fill out the new field. Click Save.

Step 3 | (Optional) Add a discount
Click Add Discount. Enter the discount amount. (Optional) Enter a note about the discount (not visible to customers). Click Apply.

Step 4 | Add a delivery method
Click Add Delivery Method. Select an existing shipping option or create a custom shipping rate. For an existing option, click Select from your shipping, delivery or pickup options, select an option from the dropdown, and click Add. For a custom shipping rate, click Create a custom shipping rate, enter the shipping name (e.g. Express shipping), enter the rate, optionally add scheduling by clicking the Add scheduling toggle and entering the date and time, optionally select the Is this a pickup order? checkbox, and click Add.

Step 5 | Create the order
After checking that all the details are correct, click Create Order. The new order appears in the Orders tab of your site's dashboard. Make sure to contact your customer to arrange payment.

title: How can I download multiple files from the Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Hold the Command / Control key on your keyboard, click the files you want to download, then click Download in the panel on the right. Note: You can't download the contents of Board folders in bulk; you have to download your files individually.

title: Can I add multiple menus to my mobile-friendly site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add more menus to your mobile site. You can customize the menu to make it look and behave just as you want.

title: How can I set up Single Sign-On (SSO) login for my organization using Wix?
content:
### Before you begin
* SSO login is only available with the Wix Studio enterprise solution and Wix Channels.
* Wix currently supports only the Open ID Connect protocol.
* Make sure to set the SSO configuration in your IdP settings to allow the admin to ask for consent on behalf of all users.

### Step 1 | Find your Identity Provider (IdP) settings
The information you need to find is the **Client ID**, **Client Secret**, and the **Config URL**. You can use any IdP that supports the Open ID Connect protocol.
* **Azure**: You can find the information on the App Registration page you created for Wix on your Azure Portal. You need one of the following roles in Azure to view this information: Global Administrator, Cloud Application Administrator, Application Administrator, or owner of the service principal.
* **Okta**: You can find the information on the OIDC app page in your Okta account. The Config URL (Open ID Server Discovery Endpoint) is not found in your Okta account — you need to create this URL yourself.

### Step 2 | Go to your account's SSO Settings
1. Sign in to your Wix account.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **SSO & SCIM Settings**.

### Step 3 | Select the type of SSO login you want to allow
1. Choose between **SSO for employees** or **SSO for clients** in the SSO Settings.
2. Click **Add** next to the type of SSO login you want to allow.

### Step 4 | Add your IdP information in SSO Settings
1. Enter the Client ID from your IdP in the Client ID field.
2. Enter the Client Secret from your IdP in the Client Secret field.
3. Select the Config URL option that you want to use: enter the Config URL from your IdP, or select **Override Well-known Config** to add your own authorization values (Authorization URL and Token URL).
4. Click **Save Changes**.

### Step 5 | Copy the Callback URL if your IdP requires it
Wix automatically generates two callback URLs: a Web logins URL for users who log in using a computer, and a Mobile app logins URL for users who log in using a mobile device. These URLs cannot be edited; click the Copy icon next to the relevant URL if you need to provide it to your IdP.

### Step 6 | Enable SSO login and set as required if needed
1. Click the **Enable SSO** toggle to enable or disable SSO login.
2. Click the **Set SSO as required** toggle to choose whether or not to require your users to sign in by SSO.
3. Click **Save Changes**.
Note: Wix recommends that you manually test your SSO settings before setting SSO as required.

### Step 7 | Copy your SSO login page info
1. Select the login page URL generated by Wix and copy it to share with your users.

### Step 8 | Copy the SSO ID (SSO for clients only)
1. If you chose SSO for clients, copy the SSO ID generated by Wix.

### (Optional) Step 8 | Customize the Advanced settings
1. Enter the user ID, email, first name, last name, and profile image URL in the respective fields.
2. Enable the **JIT-Provisioning** toggle if you want to create a new account when a user signs in for the first time.
3. Click **Save Changes**.

title: Is it possible to share a CMS collection across multiple sites?
content: Currently, it is not possible to share a collection (database) from the CMS (Content Management System) between one site and another. An alternative is to copy and paste content between different collections. It is possible to share collections across sites with the enterprise solution. Contact our Enterprise team to learn more.

title: How can I refund a client using the Participant List in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant session in your calendar. Click Manage to view the Participant List. Click the More Actions icon on the right side of the relevant client and click Remove. (Optional) Select the Send cancelation email checkbox and add a note to let the client know you cancelled the session or issued a refund. (Optional) Select the Mark as refunded checkbox to refund the client. Click Remove. (If necessary) Click Mark as refunded to confirm.

title: How can I change the favicon on my Wix site?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Website Settings. Click Update Image next to Favicon. Select your favicon and click Choose Files. Note: The size of your favicon must be a multiple of 48px square (such as 48x48, 96x96 etc), unless it is an SVG file. Google will rescale your favicon to 16x16px for search results. Before you begin, upgrade your site to a Premium Plan (except the Connect Domain plan) and connect a domain to your site.

title: How can I check how many package sessions a client has used in my Wix site dashboard?
content: To view the number of sessions that have been used: Go to the Subscriptions tab in your site's dashboard. Select a purchased plan from the list. View the number of sessions remaining. (Optional) Click the Edit icon to manually add or remove sessions. Tip: To check package usage in the Wix app, just tap the Subscription shortcut.

title: How can I connect Vyne as a payment provider on my Wix account?
content:
Go to Accept Payments on your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Vyne.

If you have an existing Vyne account, enter your API Key and API Secret, then click Connect.

If you do not have an account, click Create Vyne account, fill in the registration form, and wait for an email from Vyne to get your API Key and API Secret credentials. Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add a new question to my Wix FAQ using the site's editor?
content: To add a new question to your Wix FAQ using the site's editor: Click the FAQ app in your editor. Click Manage Questions. If a pop-up does not open, try turning off your pop-up blocker or updating your browser version. Click Add New. Select Question & Answer from the drop-down menu. Enter your new question under Question. Add an answer for your question under Answer. Optional: Add media to your answer using the icons on the bottom of the editor. Select a category for your new question under Choose a category. Click Save. Tip: If you want to copy questions and answers from another document and paste them into the FAQ app, remove all formatting first.

title: How can I use Boleto to pay for Wix services in Brazil?
content:
Boleto can be selected as a payment method on the checkout screen when completing your purchase. It is currently only available for Premium plans and Studio plans with yearly and multi-year subscriptions. To pay using Boleto:
- Go to the Upgrade page.
- If you have more than one site, click Upgrade Site next to the relevant website.
- Click Select under the plan you wish to purchase.
- Select a billing cycle and click Continue to Checkout.
- Select Boleto Bancário as your payment method.
- Enter your details.
- Click Generate Boleto.
- Choose a payment option: Pay online (recommended) by selecting your bank from the drop-down and clicking Log in to Bank; or pay offline by clicking Print to pay your Boleto offline.
The Boleto is issued in the name of DLocal Brasil Ltd or Mercado Pago at the service of DL7505830. DLocal is the payment processor for Wix in Brazil.

title: What should I do if I encounter a 404 error on my live site?
content: To resolve a 404 error message, try the following: reload the page by pressing Ctrl + F5 (or Cmd + R on a Mac); check that the URL you are trying to access is correct, then re-enter it in your address bar and press Enter; if you're trying to access a page other than your homepage, go to the homepage URL (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com), then access the page via a different link; if you received a 404 error on a dynamic page, use the relevant help article to learn how to resolve the issue; use another supported browser, and if the error only occurs in one browser, clear your browser's cache. If the problem persists, contact us.

title: How can I create an Instant Page using Hopp by Wix?
content: To create an Instant Page, go to hopp.co and log in. Click Instant Pages, then click Create Instant Page. Hover over a page type and click Get Started. Follow the steps on screen to set up the template — note that the steps vary depending on the template you choose. Select a template under Choose a design, then enter the text that is displayed on the end of the URL for your Instant Page under Customize your URL. Click Next to complete your page. Optionally, click Edit Page to customize your Instant Page.

title: How can I enable the option for customers to save their credit card details during checkout in Wix Restaurants Orders (New)?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Checkout, select Payments, and enable the Save customers' cards on file toggle. Note: This toggle may not be visible if you don't have a payment provider connected that supports saving cards on file.

title: How can I manage the fields of my standalone form in Wix?
content:
To manage your standalone form fields:

- Go to Forms & Submissions in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Old Forms tab.
- Scroll down to Your standalone forms.
- Click Edit next to the form you want to manage.
- Choose what you want to do:

Add a new field:
- Click + Add Field at the bottom of the form.
- In the Add form fields panel, hover over a field and click Add.

Edit a field:
- Click the text box inside the field (usually next to Question or Placeholder) to edit the form's text.

Add description text above or below a field:
- Hover over Header or Paragraph in the Add form fields panel.
- Click Add.
- Hold and drag the Reorder icon where you want the additional description.

Reorder a field:
- Hold and drag the Reorder icon where you want the field placed in the form.

Make a field required:
- Click the Required checkbox next to a field to make it mandatory for visitors to fill out.

Duplicate a field:
- Click the Duplicate icon to the right of a field to duplicate it.

Delete a field:
- Click the Delete icon to the right of a field to remove it from your form.

Note: Standalone forms are only available when using old Wix Forms.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix plan?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you want to upgrade. Click Upgrade plan. Click Select under the new plan you wish to purchase. Choose the subscription period and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase.

title: Can I customize my Wix member apps from my desktop?
content: Yes. You can now customize your member apps (branded and Spaces app) from your site's dashboard.

title: Is it possible to disable notifications from Stripe for payments made through Wix?
content: Automatic emails - to both you and your customers - following every successful payment are no longer the default experience for Stripe payments made through Wix. If you want to re-enable these notification emails, you can do so from your Stripe account.

title: How can I import images from my social networks into the Wix Editor?
content: To import images from social networks, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Image. Click Import Images. Select the relevant social network. Log in to your account and allow Wix to connect. Note: The images found in the Social Media folders on the left are a reflection of the images uploaded to your Social Media accounts. It is not possible to delete images from these folders through your Wix account. In addition, editing an image from these folders does not affect the original image in your Social Media accounts. Tip: To disconnect a social network, hover over the network name in the Media Manager, click the More Actions icon and click Disconnect.

title: How can I check and publish pending reviews in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Reviews in your site's dashboard. Click the Pending tab. Select the review you want to check. Choose what you want to do: Reply by clicking Reply to Review, entering your comment, and clicking Reply; Publish by clicking Publish to display the review on your site; or Move to Trash by clicking Reject to remove spam or abusive reviews.

title: How can I connect Payflex as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Payflex as a payment provider on your site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Payflex. If you have an account, enter your Merchant Id and Client Secret and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Payflex account, fill in the registration form, wait for an email from Payflex to get your Merchant Id and Client Secret credentials, then return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I change my Wix account information using the Wix app?
content: Currently, it's not possible to change your Wix account information in the Wix app. Your account information includes your username, phone number and Wix account name. To change your account information, go to your desktop. Updating account settings affects your entire Wix account. It is however, possible to update your business details via the Wix app. Your business details are site specific and do not affect your entire Wix account. If you have multiple sites in your account, you can have different business details for each site. To update your business details, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, scroll down to Settings and tap Business Info, update your business details, then tap Save.

title: Can I upload my own fonts to ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot upload your own fonts to ADI. If you want to upload your own fonts, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: How can I ensure my email campaign looks good across different devices and email clients using Wix Email Marketing?
content: Wix Email Marketing sends your emails with a responsive design, which means that the elements in your email automatically adjust so they'll look their best on any screen or email inbox. However, your email campaigns may look slightly different when compared between different email clients and devices, such as fonts (specifically in Gmail), alignment, and spacing. To see how your email looks, always send an email campaign test, even if you've already used that draft in the past.

title: How can I embed a video from YouTube onto my Wix site?
content: Use the single video player to embed your favorite videos from platforms such as YouTube and Facebook, or upload your own.

title: How can I choose which readers receive email notifications when I publish a blog post on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions drop-down and select Blog settings. Click Manage next to Manage your notifications & emails. Click the More Actions icon next to Notify when a blog post is published. Click Edit. Choose the recipients for each action:

- Send an email: Click Broadcast Lists under Include additional recipients. Choose who you want to send the notification to: Author Followers or Site Members. Click Add.

Note: This recipient type is automatically included as part of the pre-installed automation. If you have email notifications and push notifications enabled, you need to choose the recipients for each action separately.

Tip: You can add additional recipients by clicking + Add Recipients and selecting individual contacts, labels, or segments.

title: How can I add and manage staff members for my event using Check-in by Wix?
content: In Check-in by Wix, you can add staff members to your events and assign them to all your events or just specific ones as needed. Then onboard your staff to the app by sending them an invite link or having them scan a QR code. Once your staff members have access to the app, they can check in guests at the door and scan tickets.

title: How can I display product categories as menu items on my Wix site using ADI?
content: Before you begin, create a product category in Wix Stores. In ADI, create a blank page and rename it to match your product category's name: click **Add**, click **Page**, click **Blank**, then rename the new page. Add a product gallery or product slider to each new page: click **Add**, click **Section to Page**, click **See all** under the list of page sections, choose **Product Slider** or **Product Gallery**, then select the product gallery layout you want to use. Click the product gallery on your site and customize the options in the left panel, including **Full Width**, **Category to Display**, **Image Ratio**, and **Image Scaling**. To display a category, go to your sub-page in ADI, click the product gallery or slider section, and in the **Settings** panel select the category you want to display.

title: How can I connect my Instagram business account to the Instagram Feed app using the Wix Editor?
content:
To connect your Instagram business account to the Instagram Feed app using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Instagram Feed app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.
- Select the app on the page.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click **Connect Business Account**.
- Choose your profile in the **Log In With Facebook** pop-up.
- Select the Instagram business account profile you want to use. Important: You should select only one Instagram account.
- Select the Facebook page that is connected to the Instagram account you chose. Important: You should select only one Facebook page.
- Click **Next**.
- Review the permissions that the Instagram Feed app requires.
- Click **Done**.
- Click **OK**.

title: What are the eligibility requirements for the Google Ads credit offer for Wix sites?
content:
To be eligible for the ad credit offer, you must:

- Be new to Google advertising, with no previous Google Ads campaigns related to your site.
- Spend $500 USD (or your currency equivalent) on ad clicks within the first 60 days of your campaign.

Currency-specific requirements:
- USD: Spend 500 USD within the first 60 days to receive 500 USD ad credit.
- GBP: Spend 400 GBP within the first 60 days to receive 400 GBP ad credit.
- EUR: Spend 400 EUR within the first 60 days to receive 400 EUR ad credit.
- JPY: Spend 60,000 JPY within the first 60 days to receive 60,000 JPY ad credit.

All other currencies which are converted to USD need to spend $500 USD to receive the $500 ad credit.

Tip: Since your ad budget is spent on clicks, you have a better chance of being eligible if you set your monthly subscription to at least $300 (around 10 USD per day). You can track your eligibility from your Google Ads dashboard in Ad credit promo.

title: How can I allow clients to book multiple participants for a class or course on Wix Bookings?
content: To allow clients to book multiple participants for a class or course on Wix Bookings: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Create a new service or click an existing one to edit it. Scroll down and click the Expand icon next to Booking Preferences. Click Edit Policy. Scroll down to Group Bookings. Enter the Maximum number of participants allowed per booking. Click Save in the Booking Policy form. Click Save at the top of the service creation form to confirm your preferences. Note: Group bookings are only possible with classes and courses, but currently aren't available for appointments. Tip: While creating or editing your service, you can see the max number of participants at the top. You can also verify other details here, like the days the session takes place, its price and location(s).

title: How can I connect my existing Portmone account to my Wix site to accept payments?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Portmone. Enter the payee_id, API Login ID and Password you received from Portmone after signing the contract with them. Click Connect. Note: You can only connect a Portmone account that's registered as Legal Entities or Individual Entrepreneurs. You must also have a signed agreement for accepting payments (internet-acquiring).

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to use Wix Bookings and accept payments?
content: To choose a plan, if you have not already done so, add Wix Bookings to your site. Go to your site's dashboard. Click Upgrade. Click Select under the plan that suits your needs. Select the relevant subscription period and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly. If you've previously purchased a site plan that doesn't support Wix Bookings, you can upgrade to a plan that does. When switching plans, if the new plan costs more than the original plan you purchased, you pay only the difference in price.

title: How do I set up an HP terminal receipt printer for my Wix Retail POS system?
content: To set up an HP receipt printer for Wix Retail POS, insert the paper roll and connect the printer. Unplug the printer to turn it off, turn the top of the printer counterclockwise, open the compartment cover, place the paper roll in the compartment with the thermal side exposed and tightly rolled, pull enough paper so a bit sticks out when you close the compartment, press the compartment cover until it clicks into place, and turn the top clockwise. Using the cables supplied with the printer, connect the printer to the tablet and the cash drawer. On the POS tablet, tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, tap Settings, scroll down and tap Manage Hardware, and check that the status next to Receipt Printer reads Connected. The light on the printer should be green. Press the paper feed button to prepare for printing.

title: How can I access the Members App Reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and scroll down to the Members App section.

title: How can I create a layered structure for my site in Editor X?
content: When planning your site's design in Editor X, begin by creating a layered structure. Create the parent containers first, then add child elements by dragging and dropping them in the right place. The structure is reflected in the Layers panel. The layers are: Page (edit background color and add padding via Show More next to Page); Sections (every page has at least one section; you can create vertical and horizontal sections and Master sections that appear on multiple pages); Containers (nest elements within containers; add a basic container box or smart layout tools like Stack, Layouters and Repeaters); Elements (elements from the Add panel; you can dock single elements or stack multiple elements so they stay in the same order and spacing in every screen size). Grids are not part of the hierarchical model but may affect element sizing and positioning.

title: How can I create main forum guidelines in Wix Forum?
content:
To create your main forum guidelines in Wix Forum:
- Go to Forum in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Categories tab.
- Click Edit next to Forum info.
- Click the Forum guidelines toggle to enable it.
- Type your forum guidelines.
- (Optional): Use the toolbar to add an image, video or GIF etc.
- Click Save.

title: Can I use emojis to react to Shared Gallery posts?
content: Currently, it is not possible to react to Shared Gallery posts with emojis. However, you can react to posts by clicking the Like icon.

title: How do I connect Authorize.net Powered by Bankful as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Authorize.net Powered by Bankful as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to Authorize.net Powered by Bankful.
- If you have an account, enter your API Login ID and Transaction Key, then click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create Authorize.net Powered by Bankful account. Register for an Authorize.net Powered by Bankful merchant account and, once approved, retrieve your API Login ID and Transaction Key. Once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.
The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Bankful account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined. Learn how to change your currency.

title: How can I edit the details of a task in the Tasks & Reminders section?
content: Go to Tasks & Reminders in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant task and click Edit. Edit the necessary details: • Assignee: Click the navigation arrow next to Assigned to, then select a new assignee from the drop-down menu. • Due Date: Click the due date. Note: Click Due Date if there's no existing due date. Use the calendar to select a due date. • Linked Contact: Click the contact's name. Note: Click Link to Contact if there's no existing linked contact. Select a contact from the list. Click Save at the bottom right corner of the task.

title: How can I update my bank details for Wix Payments?
content: You can update your Wix Payments account settings, including bank account information, at any time. In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments, click Manage next to Wix Payments, click Edit Account Details, edit the relevant information, and click Save. Use the guidelines for uploading documents to ensure your files are uploaded successfully, then click Resubmit. Whenever you make a change, Wix is required to verify your information. Your account status temporarily goes back to Accepting Payments; during this time you can accept payments through your site but cannot receive payouts to your bank account. Verification can take up to 7 business days, and once complete you can receive payouts accumulated during this time. For bank details, ensure the bank account holder’s name matches the owner of the Wix Payments account.

title: How do I set up tax on my payment form in Wix Forms?
content: To set up tax on your payment form, go to your site's dashboard, click Settings on the left, and select Tax. If you haven't done so already, set up your tax rules. Select a location under Tax locations, set up the tax rate for Form payments, and click Save. This feature is only available using new Wix Forms. After customers select their billing country, they will see the tax applied at checkout.

title: How can I edit or remove a Business Owner in my Wix Payments account?
content:
After adding Business Owners to your Wix Payments account, you can go back and edit their details or remove them if they are no longer relevant.

To edit a Business Owner's details:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Click Wix Payments Dashboard.
- Click Account Settings on the left.
- Scroll down to Business Owners and click Edit next to the relevant Business Owner.
- Edit their details in the pop-up window.
- Click Save.

To remove a Business Owner:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Click Wix Payments Dashboard.
- Click Account Settings on the left.
- Scroll down to Business Owners and click Remove next to the relevant Business Owner.

Important: Wix Payments may require additional information and/or documents verifying your Business Owners' identity, to make sure your account complies with all legal requirements.

title: How can I group multiple elements within a container in Editor X?
content: Select 2 or more elements on your page, then click Place in Container. If you don't see this button, right-click the selected elements and click Place in Container. You can also press Alt + C (Option + C on Mac) on your keyboard.

title: What should I do if I want to sell my art on Wix now that the Wix Art Store is no longer available?
content: You can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your art. Wix Stores allows you to sell a variety of product types and control the delivery of customers' orders.

title: Can I add tips or extra fees when collecting payment from clients using Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now add tips when collecting payment from your clients. You can collect tips from any bookings dashboard where you can collect payment, including the booking list, booking calendar, and the Orders dashboard. You can also add extra fees directly from your Orders dashboard, such as an extra processing fee for online payments or a last-minute booking fee for appointments scheduled on short notice.

title: Can I add a comment box to individual images inside a gallery in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a comment box to individual images inside a gallery. As an alternative, several comment apps and elements are available in the Wix App Market and in the Add panel, which can be added to pages on your site: Facebook comments box, Comments, and Comments and reviews / testimonials.

title: Can I import or export portfolio items via CSV file or Excel with Wix Portfolio?
content: Currently, it is not possible to import or export items via CSV file or Excel with Wix Portfolio. As a workaround, you can work with the Wix CMS (Content Management System). The CMS allows you to import images and videos via CSV file and display them in galleries on dynamic pages, or export content as a CSV file to use it in another application such as Google Sheets or Excel. Learn more about the Wix CMS.

title: How can I change the layout of my Members Area on my Wix site?
content: Choose a layout for the pages of your Members Area, and customize it as you wish. There are two layouts: Full Width shows the Member Profile Card and the Member Menu at the top of every member page; members can choose their own picture for the header to personalize their profile. Cards shows the Member Profile Card and the Member Menu on the left of every member page. If you are using Editor X, the default layout for your Members Area is Full Width, and currently it's not possible to switch to the Cards layout.

title: Can I use additional languages in Wix Bookings that are not currently supported by the Wix Editor?
content: Wix Bookings currently supports all languages supported by the Wix Editor. To request additional languages, submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How do I set up a payment method for restaurant online orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: To set up a payment method for restaurant online orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, go to your site's dashboard, click Settings, click the Accept Payments tab, click Connect Me, then click Complete Setup and follow the steps. If you previously set up payment methods using Wix Bookings, Wix Stores, or other Wix apps, you do not need to set them up again. Wix offers multiple payment providers, or you can choose manual payments to accept cash or other forms of payment. Payment provider availability depends on your location.

title: How can I add alt text to an image in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the image in your Editor. Click the Settings icon. Write a short description for your image under What's in the image? Tell Google.

title: How can I import media files from one Wix site to another using the Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click + Upload Media. Click My Wix Account on the left menu. Select the file you want to import. Click Select Files to Upload. To import files in bulk, use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + A (for PC) or ⌘ + A (for Mac) to select multiple files at once and import them in bulk from other sites to your current site. Importing media from one site to another does not remove it from the source Media Manager; the file exists in both places after importing.

title: How can I invite a teammate to manage billing and subscriptions in my Wix Studio workspace?
content:
To invite a teammate to join your team in Wix Studio, go to Team in your Wix Studio workspace, click **+ Invite Teammates**, enter your new teammate's email in the **Email(s)** field, select the checkbox next to the role you'd like to assign this teammate, and click **Send Invite**.

You can tailor each teammate's access individually to ensure that they have the permissions necessary for the area they work in. For example, a teammate who needs to manage subscriptions can be assigned as a Billing Manager, and a teammate who only needs to connect a domain can be assigned as a Domain Manager. You can assign multiple roles to a single teammate.

title: How can I create an invoice using the Wix app?
content:
To create an invoice in the Wix app:
• Go to your site in the Wix app.
• Tap Manage at the bottom.
• Tap Getting Paid.
• Tap Manage Invoices.
• Tap + Create New. If this is your first invoice, tap Create an Invoice and add your business logo, name, and email address, then tap Save & Continue.
• Tap + Add Customer to select a contact or create a new one.
• Tap the Due Date drop-down to select the date the invoice is due.
• Tap + Add Items and select an existing product or service, or create a new one. Enter the Price and Quantity.
• Optionally add tax: tap + Create New Tax, enter the name and rate of the tax, tap Save; tap the Tax drop-down to add more than one tax type, select the tax options you want to apply, then tap Done; tap Add to Invoice.
• Tap Edit below your list of products and services to set tax calculation preferences, then choose Exclude tax from item price or Include tax in the item's price and tap Done.
• Tap Add next to Discount (%) to add a discount.
• Tap Add next to Deposit to request a partial payment up front.
• Tap Add next to Notes or Legal Terms to enter notes or terms.
• Tap Next at the top right.
• Choose Send via email, Share link, Enter card details manually, Record Payment, Preview, or Save and close.
Tip: You can also convert price quotes into invoices rather than creating an invoice from scratch.

title: Can site members monetize their groups by connecting pricing plans to them?
content: Currently, it is not possible for site members to monetize groups they create by connecting pricing plans to their groups.

title: How can I add a transparent header to the homepage of my ADI site?
content:
You can set your header to appear transparent on the homepage of your ADI site. This means that the background image in the section below the header is visible through the header. The header only appears transparent on the homepage of your site. All other pages display the header with a background color. The first section immediately following the header on the homepage must include a full-width image.

Step 1 | Change Your Site Colors to Dark Mode.
- Click Design from the ADI top bar.
- Select Colors from the drop-down menu.
- Click Edit under Color Mode on the left.
- Select Dark under Color Settings.

Step 2 | Change the Image in the Section to Full-Width.
- Click Design in the section below the header.
- Choose a Section Design with a full-width image.

Step 3 | Change the Header Design to Transparent
- Click Design in the Header section.
- Click Customize Section Design.
- Click Transparent.

title: Can I publish code-only apps in the Wix App Market?
content: Currently in the App Market, you cannot publish apps that only contain code files (previously known as Velo Packages).

title: How can I troubleshoot if my page is not eligible for rich results?
content:
Use Google's Rich Results test tool to check whether a specific page is optimized for rich results. If a rich result you expect does not appear, try these steps:

Step 1 | Check that the rich result type is supported
Not all rich result types are supported by Google. Check the list of supported rich result types to see if it is currently supported in the report.

Step 2 | Make sure the page is indexed
Rich results can only be shown for pages that can be crawled and indexed. Use the URL Inspection tool to check if a page is indexed and if Google can access it. Test the live version of the page as well to confirm that Google can access it.

Step 3 | Ask Google to recrawl your pages
If you have recently added new pages or made updates to your site, you can ask Google to recrawl your URLs. It can take up to a week for Google to index your pages after you submit a request.

Step 4 | Make sure Google can access your page
Google can only create rich results for pages it can access. Use the URL Inspection tool to check whether Google can access your page.

Step 5 | Make sure your structured data markup is valid
If your page's markup is invalid, Google may not be able to recognize it as a rich result. If the test can find your markup but it cannot parse it, it should appear in the Unparsable structured data report.

Step 6 | Check that rich results are supported for your location
Certain rich result types might not be supported for your location yet. Check the features guides section of Google's structured data documentation to see if your location is supported.

title: How can I add a new breakpoint in the Studio Editor for a specific page or global section?
content:
Select the page or global section you're working on. Click the Customize Breakpoints icon next to the breakpoints on the top bar of the editor. Click Add Breakpoint. Enter the pixels for your breakpoint. Click Done.

Note: You can define up to 6 different breakpoints for each page / master section on your site.

title: How can I send an email campaign for my Wix blog post?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click the More actions icon next to the relevant post. Select Share Post. Click Create Email Campaign. (Optional) Customize the email campaign using the available options, such as choosing a new theme, background, or editing the text. Click Next at the top right. Select the relevant contacts you want to send your email to, or enter email addresses directly. Click Next at top right. If necessary, click Edit next to the relevant option to edit your campaign details: Subject Line (enter the subject line and add the preview text), Sender details (enter the name the email is sent from and the reply-to email address), and Email recipients (edit and review the emails before sending). If you have not yet confirmed your email address, click Confirm Now. Select a send option: Send immediately by clicking Send Now, or Send later by clicking Schedule, selecting the send day and send time, then clicking Schedule Campaign.

title: Is there a text-to-speech option available for blog posts in Wix Blog?
content: Currently, there is no option to convert the text of your blog posts into audio (also known as text-to-speech). As a workaround, you can record yourself reading the blog post and add the audio file to the post.

title: How can I add an invite banner to my mobile site using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Marketing and select Site Discoverability. Tap Mobile invite banner. Enable the Add Banner toggle to show the banner.

title: How do I navigate between tab items?
content: Go to your editor. Click the tabs. Click the dropdown menu. Select the relevant tab item to open it.

title: What are the benefits of upgrading to a Wix Retail POS plan?
content:
Upgrading to a Retail POS plan allows you to:

- **Accept all types of payments:** You can accept payment by credit/debit card, gift card, or manual card entry. Before upgrading, you'll be able to accept cash payment.
- **Add staff members:** You can add more staff members to your team, and each team member can set their own passcode to log in to the POS tablet. The maximum number of staff members is determined by your site upgrade.
- **Allow customers to exchange items:** Customers can bring a store product back and exchange it for a different one.
- **Track staff member hours:** You can track your staff members' hours, view the hours each staff member puts in during a time period, or select a staff member to view additional tracking details.
- **Redeem loyalty points:** If you created a loyalty program, customers can earn and redeem loyalty points at your brick-and-mortar business as well as in your online store.

title: How can I reactivate my suspended Wix Payments account?
content: You can reactivate your suspended Wix Payments account by completing the account setup / verification process. To complete your account set-up: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Complete Set-up under Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Click Complete Account Set-up. Fill in the relevant information and click Submit. While your account is suspended, you cannot receive any payments, or process refunds, through Wix Payments.

title: Can customers set their own prices for products in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to give customers the ability to choose a price for a product they are purchasing. If you want to set variable prices yourself, you can sell store products through Wix Invoices, or negotiate prices with customers using Price Quotes and then turn quotes into invoices.

title: How can I restore a previous version of a blog post in Wix Blog?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant post. Hover over Save in the top-right corner. Click View Post History. Select the version of your post that you want to restore in the left sidebar. Click Restore. Important: You can only restore the content of your post. Post settings such as SEO settings, categories, and tags are not restored. You'll need to update these settings manually if you want to restore them.

title: How can I manage who is allowed to sell out-of-stock products using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: To manage who can sell out-of-stock products, open the POS tablet, tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, tap the Settings tab, tap the Inventory tab, then click the Sell out of stock products drop-down and select an option: Allow, so any team member can sell out-of-stock products; Allow with passcode, so only team members with permission to manage inventory can sell out of stock products; or Don't allow, so no one can sell out-of-stock products.

title: How can I display different restaurant menus on different pages of my Wix site?
content:
To display different menus on different pages:
- Click the Wix Restaurants Menus app in the Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click + New Menu Page. (A new page named Menus is added to your site).
- Click the Wix Restaurants Menus app on the new page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Display tab.
- Select Show Specific Menus under Do you want all your menus to be visible?.
- Hover over the menu name and click the Hide icon next to the menus you do not want to display on the page.

Note: Leave only the menu that you want to show.

Optional: Repeat to add additional menu pages.

Tip: Each menu page that is added to your site is given the name "Menus". We recommend that you change the name of each new page so that your customers know which is which.

title: How can I set up a payment method in Wix Hotels?
content: To set up a payment method in Wix Hotels, go to your dashboard and click the Hotels tab, then click the Payments tab. Select a Payment Method and enter your details. Available methods include Paypal, Stripe, Mercado Pago, and Offline Payments. Paypal supports registration from almost all countries. Stripe supports registration from 14 countries and more than 100 currencies. Mercado Pago is for guests from Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Venezuela; guests are asked for their ID number when booking. Offline Payments let guests book online without a connection to a payment gateway, and guests pay in person. Then enter your Price Settings: Currency, Tax if needed, and Deposit (only available for online payments). Click Save. You can set up and accept multiple payment methods in Wix Hotels.

title: What does error code 8024 mean in SSO troubleshooting?
content: Error code 8024 means "SSO user doesn't exist." In SSO for clients, users (clients) must already exist as SSO users when they attempt to log in with SSO. We identify users by their external user id (their ID in IdP) and the SSO ID. This error is returned when such a user doesn't exist.

title: How can I translate my FAQ content using Wix Multilingual in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top of the editor. Select the language you want to edit. Select the Wix FAQs section on your page. Click Edit Translation. Click FAQ on the left panel of the Translation Manager. Select Categories or Questions and answers. Translate the text. If the secondary language is still hidden, make this language visible on your site: go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard, click the Status drop-down next to your language, and select Visible. Publish your translations by clicking Publish at the top right in the editor.

title: How can I restrict access to specific pages for members with certain roles using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, hover over the relevant page, and click the More Actions icon. Click Settings, then click the Permissions tab. Select Site Members under Who can access this page? Select Specific members under Which members can access this page? Enable the Members with roles toggle. Click Manage Roles and select the relevant role(s), then click Apply. Before you begin, create member roles and assign them to different members.

title: How can I set a section as a global header in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the relevant section, click the More Actions icon, click Set as Global, select Header, and enter a name for your global section. If the option to set a global header is grayed out, it means another section is in that same position. If you can't see the other section, it might be set to Don't Display. To move your section to the top of the page, click Layers at the top of Editor X, click the More Actions icon next to the section you want to set as global, select Move Up for global headers, and repeat until the option to move up appears in gray. Then try again to set your section as a global header.

title: Why do I see a monthly subscription amount when redeeming my free premium app instead of a yearly one?
content: The Free Premium Apps that come with certain Premium Plans give you a full year free, regardless of what you see on the purchase page. The Site Booster app is renewed on a monthly basis, which is why you may see the monthly amount rather than the yearly. Note: This promotion is not yet available to all users.

title: Is Wix Retail POS supported outside the US and Canada?
content: Currently, Wix Retail Point of Sale (POS) is available only for merchants located in the US and Canada. To request support for additional countries, submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How can I ensure that my gallery items don't change the order I set in the Organize Your Gallery window when using Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Choose the Masonry or Grid layout with vertical orientation, then select the number of gallery items to display per row. Alternatively, disable Full Width for your gallery.

title: Can I add hover interactions to strips and columns in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add hover interactions to strips and columns. As an alternative, you can add hover interactions to container boxes on your site.

title: How can I customize the SEO settings for all my restaurant menu pages on Wix?
content: Go to SEO Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Restaurants Menus. Customize the meta tags and SEO defaults for your restaurant menu pages: Basics & social share lets you decide how your menu pages look on search results or when someone shares them on social media; Structured data markup gives search engines detailed information about your page; Robots meta tag adds code that instructs search engines on how to display your restaurant menu pages after crawling them; Additional meta tags add code that further describes your restaurant menu pages to search engines and social networks.

title: How can I add Wix Comments to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the Add Apps icon on the left side of your Editor. Type "Wix Comments" in the search bar. Select Wix Comments from the drop-down menu. Click Add to Site.

title: What are the limitations of using a collection with a single item in a CMS?
content:
Using a collection with a single item provides a safe and secure environment for storing content, making it an ideal solution for collaborating. However, there are some limitations compared to collections storing multiple items:

While creating a collection with a single item:
- Once created, it can't be converted to a collection for multiple items.
- The Draft & Publish Items option can't be enabled.

While managing its content:
- The primary field parameter can't be applied to a field.
- You can't import content.
- Reference and multi-reference fields can't be created.

While connecting elements in the Editor to data in a collection with a single item:
- Only “Read-Only” mode can be used for datasets.
- There is no Filter, Sort, or Number of items settings.
- You can't connect user input elements in the Editor.

title: How can I customize the layout and design of my Wix Pro Gallery for mobile devices?
content: To optimize your Pro Gallery for visitors viewing your site on mobile, note that the layout of your Pro Gallery is responsive and automatically adjusts to fit your visitor's mobile device. You can customize the layout and design so that it looks just the way you want it to on mobile.

title: Does Wix support integrating a GPS tracking system directly?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a GPS tracking feature or app. If you have an external GPS tracking system, you can try embedding it using a HTML iFrame element. You can learn how to embed HTML in the Wix Editor and Studio Editor.

title: How can I send my favorites list to clients using Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your dashboard. Click Manage beside the album you want to use. Click Manage Lists under Favorites lists. Click on the list you want to share. Click Share list. Choose how you want to share the link, or tap View List to see what it looks like. You can copy the link and send it to your client, send it via email, or send it via WhatsApp.

title: Can I assign a specific seat when selling event tickets using the Wix Events mobile POS?
content: Currently, it's not possible to assign a specific seat in your seating map while selling events tickets at a mobile POS.

title: How can I integrate Boxtal with my Wix store to manage shipments?
content: To integrate Boxtal with your Wix store, open the Boxtal app and click **Add to Site**, then click **Allow and Install**. Choose an option: log in to your existing Boxtal account, or create a new Boxtal account by clicking **Register**, filling in the required fields, and clicking **Sign Up**. Then click **Synchronise my shops**. Click **Pending** on the left to view your store orders and to print labels. To print shipping labels, first enter your business's address in the Business Info page. After setup, the Boxtal app is synced with your Wix store, so you don't have to manually enter order details into the Boxtal dashboard when you make a sale. From there, you can manage your shipments, including printing labels, tracking orders, and processing returns.

title: How can I manage my group notifications on the Wix live site?
content:
To manage your group notifications on the Wix live site: Go to your live site and log in. Go to the relevant group on your live site. Click the **More Actions** icon at the top right of the group. Click **Notification Settings**. Choose where you want to get notifications from:

**Website notifications**
Click the **Website notifications** toggle to manage site notifications (in the bell icon) when there are group updates.
- **Enabled:** You receive site notifications when there are group updates. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about: **Posts**, **Comments**, **Reactions**, **Member Requests**, **Group Updates**, and **New Members**.
- **Disabled:** You are not notified about group updates.

**Email**
Click the **Email** toggle to get notified by email when there are group updates.
- **Enabled:** You receive email notifications about the group updates you choose. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about: **Posts**, **Comments**, **Member Requests**, **Group Updates**, and **New Members**.
- **Disabled:** You do not receive email notifications about group updates.

Note: Notifications are sent to the email address you enter in the business info of your site's dashboard.

**Mobile app**
Click **Mobile App** to get notifications on the Wix mobile app for group updates.
- **Enabled:** You receive notifications on the app about the group updates you choose. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about: **Posts**, **Comments**, **Reactions**, **Member Requests**, **Group Updates**, and **New Members**.
- **Disabled:** You do not receive notifications on the app about group updates.

title: How can I manage folder permissions in the Wix File Share app from my site's dashboard?
content: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant folder. Click Permissions. Type in the name of the member/group/plan you want to add to this folder in the search bar. Select a member/group/plan to edit. Click the drop-down on the right to assign permissions. (Optional) Select the Notify members checkbox to notify the members you are giving permissions to. Click Add & Notify. (Optional) Click the drop-down beside any unwanted groups and select Remove to remove their permissions. Click Save.

title: Can I use Telr as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Telr as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Telr and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I customize the footer in Wix Editor to match my site's theme?
content:
Customize the footer to match your site's theme, or stand out to create something eye-catching for your visitors. There are a number of ways to adjust your footer:

* **Change the design:** You can adjust the color and corners, as well as add a border and shadow.
* **Resize the footer:** If you'd like to change the size of the footer, you can make it taller or shorter by dragging the stretch handle.
* **Freeze the footer's position:** You can freeze the footer so that it is always visible on your pages, even when visitors scroll through them.

Customizing the footer further personalizes your site and enhances your brand, even when your visitors have reached the bottom of the page.

title: What guidelines should I follow to avoid copyright infringement when adding content to my Wix site?
content:
When adding content to your Wix site, make sure you have the rights to use that content. Wix provides guidelines to help keep your site and content safe from copyright complaints.

- Videos: You can add videos to your site that have been uploaded to YouTube or Vimeo. If you uploaded the video yourself, you are free to use it on your site. For other content available through these services, Wix recommends reading the YouTube and Vimeo Terms of Use thoroughly before adding anything.
- Music: Most music is protected by intellectual property rights. The Wix Terms of Use state that you may not upload, post, email, transmit, or otherwise make available any content that might infringe a third party's intellectual property rights. It is your responsibility to make sure you have permission to use any audio content on your site.
- Text: All text added to your site should be original, unique and created by you. It is not permissible to copy text from another person's site.
- Software: Software may be protected by intellectual property rights. It is your responsibility to make sure you have the relevant permission/license to disclose and/or make available any software on your site.

Tip: Check out the Wix Content blog to learn more about the legalities of writing online.

title: Can I migrate a site from Editor X to the Studio Editor?
content: Yes, you can now update Editor X sites to the Studio Editor. If you can't see this option, note that this release is done gradually, and the option should be available for all sites very soon. Once the update is available, you'll see a notification in your editor.

title: How can I connect Payzone as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Payzone. If you have a Payzone account, enter your Merchant ID and Merchant Password and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Payzone account to contact Payzone, inform Payzone you wish to register for a Payzone merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved you will be provided with your unique Merchant ID and Merchant Password. Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under "Have an account" to connect your account.

title: What is the pricing for email marketing on Wix?
content: The source explains how to view and compare Wix email marketing plans rather than listing prices: go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard, under Monthly Balance click Upgrade, choose a plan that works best for you and checkout. To compare plans, use the number of emails you plan to send a month and any additional features you are interested in.

title: How can I adjust the size of my Wix Pro Gallery on mobile if it appears too big or too small?
content: To adjust your gallery size on mobile, click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the Editor, click the Pro Gallery, click Tools on the top right, select the checkbox beside Toolbar, and type your preferred width and height into the relevant (W and H) fields. You can also adjust the size using the drag handles or the Editor Tool Bar.

title: Can site visitors see how many spots remain available for classes in the calendar?
content: Currently, your site visitors cannot see in the calendar how many spots remain available for Classes. It is now possible to add a Class Timetable to your site, and timetables can be set to display the number of available spots.

title: Is it possible to validate a customer's VAT ID during checkout for tax exemptions?
content: Currently, it is not possible to request a customer's VAT ID during checkout, and use that ID to provide tax exemptions for customers who qualify (e.g. using the European VAT Information Exchange System (VIES)). It is, however, possible to add a custom field to the Checkout Page, which can be used to collect the customer's tax ID. Note that the number will not be validated.

title: How can I add and set up a site search feature on my Editor X website?
content:
Before you begin: Make sure your site is set to appear in search engines. If it's hidden, visitors won't be able to see their search results.

Step 1 | Add the Site Search App
Click Add on the top of Editor X. Click Menu & Search on the left. Select Site Search. Click the Add to Site icon next to Site Search to add it to your site.

Step 2 | Customize the Search Bar
After adding the Site Search app, choose a search bar from the Add panel and drag it to a section on your page. We recommend placing it in the default master header to ensure it's always visible. Next, customize the search bar's placeholder text, layout and design to make it your own. You can also enable quick search to let visitors see search results on the spot, in addition to the Search Results page.

Manage the search bar settings:
Select the Search Bar element on your page. Click Settings. Enter your own placeholder text in the text box. Click the Enable quick search toggle to enable or disable this option. Quick search lets visitors see relevant results on the spot as they type their keywords.

Design the search bar:
Select the Search Bar element on your page. Click the Design icon. Click a tab at the top of the panel to choose which state you are customizing (Regular, Hover or Focus). Design the search bar using the following options: Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, Shadow, and Text.

Adjust the layout of the search bar:
Select the Search Bar element on your page. Click the Layouts icon. First, choose a layout at the top. Customize the layout using the available options: Icon alignment, Text alignment, Text padding, and Icon spacing.

Tip: Tailor the search bar to your site's breakpoints so visitors can use it from any device.

Step 3 | Customize the Search Results Page
After designing the search bar, customize the Search Results page that displays the results of your visitors' queries. Change the page's title by clicking the text element, and select the Search Results app to manage its settings, layout and design.

Change the page's title:
Click the text element that reads Search Results. Click Edit Text to change the text and its formatting.

Manage the page's settings, layout and design:
Select the Search Results app on the page. Click Settings. Click the following tabs in the Settings panel to customize the page: Settings, Display, Layout, and Design.

Note: This page is hidden, which means visitors can only see it when they search for a term in the search bar.

title: How long will it take for my products to show up in a Wix Google Ads campaign?
content: First connect a Google Merchant Solutions account and get your products approved. After you list your products on Google Merchant Solutions, it can take up to 72 hours for Google to approve them. Products with 'Live' status that are also set to 'Visible' in Google Merchant Solutions appear across Google's channels as part of your campaign. Once your products are approved, create your campaign, purchase a subscription, and launch it. You can track your campaign's progress and metrics from the Google Ads with Wix dashboard.

title: How can I use keyboard shortcuts to manage my CMS collections more efficiently?
content:
From your collection's Table layout only, select a cell, then use these keyboard shortcuts:

- Ctrl + A / ⌘ + A: Select all cells
- Ctrl + C / ⌘ + C: Copy one or more cells
- Ctrl + X / ⌘ + X: Cut one or more cells
- Ctrl + V / ⌘ + V: Paste cut/copied content
- Shift + Enter: Insert an empty row below
- Tab: Go to the next cell
- Shift + Tab: Go to the previous cell
