- Shift + Click: Select a range of cells between two clicks
- Right Click / Ctrl + Click: Open the context menu

Tip: You can view this list of these shortcuts from within your collection by clicking More Actions and selecting Keyboard shortcuts.

title: How do I create a custom collection view in the CMS and manage its fields?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection, then click + New View at the top. Enter a name for the collection view and press Enter. Click the Layout drop-down and choose Table, List, or Gallery. To manage fields, click Manage Fields. Click the checkboxes next to fields to show or hide them, and click and drag the Reorder icons next to fields to change their order. You can also edit a field by clicking it, or use the More Actions icon to duplicate a field, make a field primary, or delete a field; to delete, click the Yes, delete field checkbox and then click Delete.

title: Can I use Payoneer as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Payoneer as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Payoneer and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I add Google Pay as a payment method on my Wix site?
content: To add Google Pay as a payment method on your Wix site: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, and enable the toggle next to Google Pay. Before you begin, you must set up Wix Payments to accept payments via Google Pay on your site. On checkout, customers will see Google Pay as an express checkout option, and because their accounts are linked to their Google wallet, they simply click and purchase without having to enter card or shipping details. Google Pay is currently available for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings and Wix Events only.

title: Is vacation mode supported in Wix Stores, and what workarounds are available?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set your store on vacation mode. In the meantime, you can use one of the following workarounds: create a landing page with a message about your store closure and hide your store pages from your site menu; optionally display product images in an image gallery, but since the images are not linked to your store, customers cannot buy them; use third-party apps such as the Vacation Mode app and the Vacation: Take a Rest app to put your site into vacation mode while you're away, available through the Wix App Market; or disable your store's payment methods to block customers from completing checkout. Customers who try to complete a purchase see a popup.

title: Can I receive form submission notifications in Wix Inbox using Wix Forms?
content: Yes, you can receive form submission notifications in Wix Inbox using new Wix Forms.

title: How can I invite participants to join my online program using the site dashboard?
content: To invite participants, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard, click the relevant program, and click Invite Participants. Choose an invitation method: invite site members via email by clicking Invite to Program, typing or selecting the site member emails, and clicking Invite to Program; add site members manually by clicking Add to Program, typing or selecting the site member emails, and clicking Add to Program; share an invite link by clicking Copy Link and pasting it where you want to share it; or send an email campaign by clicking Create Email Campaign, selecting a template, and customizing and sending your email campaign. Note: the share invite link and email campaign options do not appear for Secret online programs. You can also choose which types of notifications participants get.

title: Does Wix Video automatically add the ContentURL and EmbedURL fields to the structured data markup of videos?
content: When you add Wix Video to your site pages, either the contentURL or embedURL fields are now added automatically to the structured data markup of the videos, depending on the method you used to upload the file.

title: How can I tag community members in a photo using the Shared Gallery App?
content: On your live site, click a photo to go to the expand mode. Click **Tag Members**, then start typing the name of the community member you want to tag and select it from the list. Finally, click **Done**. Anyone with permission to upload photos also has permission to tag community members.

title: How can I set the image quality for individual media in the Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
To set the image quality for individual media in the Wix Pro Gallery, follow these steps:

1. Go to your editor.
2. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page.
3. Click **Manage Media**.
4. Click the relevant image / video and click the **More Actions** icon.
5. Click **Adjust Quality** and choose what you want to customize:
   * **Adjust Image Quality**: Enable the toggle to adjust the image quality. Drag the slider to increase or decrease the quality.
     **Note:** The higher the image quality, the longer it takes for your media to load. It is not recommended that you increase the image quality to above 90.
   * **Image Sharpening**: Enable the toggle to adjust the image sharpness and customize the following:
     + **Amount:** Increase or decrease the amount of sharpening applied to the image.
     + **Radius:** Increase or decrease the number of pixels from the edge that the sharpening affects.
     + **Threshold:** Set how different a pixel must be from the surrounding area before it's considered an edge pixel and sharpened by the filter.
       **Note:** The lower the threshold number, the more intense the sharpening effect.
6. Click **Apply**.

title: How can I manually mark an order as 'Paid' using the Wix app?
content: To manually mark an order as 'Paid' using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Sales and select Orders. Tap the relevant order. Tap Collect Payment at the bottom. Tap Mark as Paid. Tap Mark as Paid to confirm. Note: Orders marked as 'Paid' cannot be changed back to 'Unpaid'. If your customer paid for the order online, it is automatically marked as 'Paid'.

title: How can I add collapsible text to my site using Editor X?
content: Click **Add Elements** at the top of Editor X, click **Text**, click **Collapsible Text**, then drag your chosen text box onto the page.

title: How can I delete Wix Events from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the Actions icon next to Event Pages. Select Delete Events. Click Delete to confirm.

title: How can I create a membership plan for Wix Bookings services using the Pricing Plans app?
content: Add Wix Bookings inside ADI: click Add on the top bar, click Apps, hover over Bookings, and click Add. Add the Pricing Plan app: click Add on the top bar inside ADI, click Apps, hover over Pricing Plans, and click Add. Create the services you want to offer, and while you are creating a service, you can optionally offer it as part of a membership plan or package. Connect an online payment method; to accept recurring payment (e.g. monthly payments), you need to connect either PayPal or Stripe. Once you've created your plans and connected them to bookings services, you can customize the look of the Pricing Plans page on your site. Tip: When you view your services in the Booking Services tab, you can identify those connected to a membership plan by the information listed under Pricing.

title: How can I connect a text element to the dataset item count in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor and click the text element you want to connect. Click the Connect to CMS icon. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, select Add a Dataset, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click Create. Click the Text connects to drop-down and select Item Count under Dataset Info. Click Preview to test your item count display. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I restore specific collections from a Wix CMS backup?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Click More Actions at the top. Click Backups. Click Restore next to the backup you want to restore. Click the checkbox next to each collection you want to restore. Confirm that you want to permanently override changes made after the backup creation date. Click Restore.

title: Hey! I finished the "Verifying Your Site with Google Search Console" steps, but my site isn’t showing up in Google searches, even for specific queries, and I’ve checked that it’s indexed and can be crawled. Any ideas on what to do?
content: Indexing can take some time, and search engines cannot guarantee that every page of your site will be indexed. If your site is indexed but not showing as high as you like in search results, optimizing your site's content for SEO can help your site rank higher. A more technical but powerful way to improve your site's ranking is to use structured data markup, a standardized format for giving search engines detailed information about your page. Adding markup to your site's pages can help improve your website's search results and ranking, and search engines like Google can use markup to create rich results such as article previews, product previews, and FAQs for your page's search results.

title: How can I customize the "Continue Browsing" link on the Cart Page?
content:
Go to the Cart page in your editor, click the Cart Page element, and click Settings. Then choose what you want to do:

- Show or hide the "Continue Browsing" link: Click the Settings tab, then click the Show Link toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled: the "Continue Browsing" link appears in the Cart Page (when the cart has items and when it's empty) and in the Checkout Page. Disabled: the "Continue Browsing" link appears only in the Cart Page when it's empty.
- Set where the link directs to: Click the Settings tab. Under Where does it link to?, click the Link icon. Under Which Page?, select what page the link directs to. Click Done.
- Select a font and font color: Click the Design tab. Under Body, select a new font. Note: This affects all body text in the Cart Page. To edit the link color, click the Design tab, click the Links color box and select a new color. Note: This affects the color of all the links in the Cart Page but won't affect the "Continue Browsing" link color in the empty cart.
- Edit the "Continue Browsing" link text: Click the Text tab. Edit the Continue Browsing link text.

title: How can I add and customize a pattern in the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Go to the Brand Studio. Click the My Brands drop-down at the top. Select the relevant brand. Hover over the relevant brand design (Logo, Social Post or Business Card) and click the Edit icon. Depending on what you want to add your pattern to, click Symbols or Shapes on the left. Hover over the relevant symbol or shape and click Customize. If you have not yet added a symbol or shape, click + Add Symbol or + Add Shape. Click the Shape Fill or Icon Fill drop-down and select Pattern. This option is available when you enable the Fill Color toggle. Click Customize below the Shape Fill or Icon Fill drop-down. Click the Pattern Graphic drop-down and select Icon, Shape, Text or Image. Depending on the graphic you choose, customize your pattern using the available options: for Icon, you can change icon, adjust colors, background color, flip, zoom, position, gap, and rotate; for Shape, you can change shape, fill color, opacity, border width and color, background color, flip, zoom, position, gap, and rotate; for Text, you can edit text, change font, alignment, text color, opacity, outline color and width, background color, flip, zoom, position, gap, and rotate; for Image, you can replace image, crop, adjust, remove background, filters, opacity, background color, flip, zoom, position, gap, and rotate. Click + Upload to upload your own image. You can also use the Wix Photo Studio tools to customize your image.

title: Can customers view restaurant menus on the Wix member apps?
content: Currently, your customers cannot view your restaurant's menus from the new Wix Restaurants Menus app on the Wix member apps (Spaces or your own branded app).

title: How can I edit the privacy settings of my group in the Wix app?
content:
In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Groups, tap the relevant group, and tap Edit next to the name of your group.

Under Privacy, choose who can view this group's content:

- Public: Anyone can view the group's content and join it too.
- Private: Only members can view the group's content. Tap the Visibility drop-down and select an option:
  - Visible: Anyone can find this group on the Groups page of your live site. Choose who can join this group:
    - Only members approved by admin.
    - Only pricing plan holders: Tap Select Pricing Plans to connect an existing plan or create a new one.
    - Only event guests: Tap Select Events to set up this option, then tap Done.
  - Hidden: Only group members can see the group's content.

Tip: If you don't have any events yet, you can create an event from the Wix app.

Tap Save.

title: How do I add a subscribe form to my Wix site?
content: To add a subscribe form to your site using Wix Forms, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Contact & Forms. Scroll down to the Subscribe section and drag a form onto your site. Then click Settings, or Form Settings depending on whether you are using New Forms or Old Forms, and customize the available options such as Layout, Design, Manage, Email notifications, Submissions table, Submission limit, Autofill form info, and Subscriber double opt-in. You can also click Submit Message and choose what happens when visitors submit the form, such as Show success message, Go to site page or lightbox, Link to external URL, or Show link to file download. For details, refer to: https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-subscribe-form

title: How can I change my profile picture in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap your profile icon at the top. Tap Manage Account Settings. Tap Basic info. To change your profile picture, tap the Camera icon and choose an option: Take Photo, Choose from Device, or Remove Photo. Tap Save.

title: How can I create a subcategory in Wix Forum from my dashboard?
content:
Go to your forum in your dashboard. Click the Categories tab. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant category. Click Subcategory.

Note: The subcategory will nestle under the category directly above it. Make sure that the correct category is above the subcategory.

Tip: You can drag and drop categories and subcategories. Click and hold the relevant category or subcategory to drag up or down.

title: How can I check my upcoming sessions in the Booking Calendar using the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Booking Calendar. Choose from the following calendar views, depending on your needs:

Schedule view:
- Tap the Change View icon at the top right.
- Tap Schedule to see a list of upcoming sessions.
- (Optional) Select the relevant location(s) under View by Location at the bottom.

Day view:
- Tap the Change View icon at the top right.
- Tap Day view to see a list of upcoming sessions.
- (Optional) Select the relevant location(s) under View by Location at the bottom.

3 day view:
- Tap the Change View icon at the top right.
- Tap 3 day view.
- (Optional) Select the relevant location(s) under View by Location at the bottom.

Note: This option only appears if you offer services in multiple locations.

Tip: The color coding you apply to sessions in your Booking Calendar on desktop also appears in the Wix app.

title: What should I do to handle Personally Identifiable Information (PII) collected through my Wix site?
content: When you collect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) through your Wix site, treat that information accordingly, noting that requirements vary between jurisdictions. Familiarize yourself with the regulations that apply to you and your site, such as the GDPR and the CCPA. Mark PII fields accurately so Wix knows how to store the data on your behalf and can work to comply with relevant data protection regulations; if you mark a group of data fields as PII, Wix will treat the whole group as PII. If you are uncertain about your responsibilities, seek legal advice from an expert. The source also notes that it is the site owner’s responsibility to ensure Wix services are permitted and abiding by local laws, and that the information is not legal advice.

title: How can I view and change editing permissions for specific pages in the Wix Studio Editor?
content:
To view and change permissions per page in the Wix Studio Editor:

- Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left.
- Hover over **Site**.
- Hover over **Team Work**.
- Click **Permissions Per Page**.
- Click the drop-down next to a person's name to edit their permissions.
- Select the checkbox(es) next to the relevant access level:
  - **All pages:** Can edit all site pages.
  - **All pages and global sections:** Can edit all site pages as well as any global sections.
    **Note:** To select this option, you must first select the **All pages** checkbox.
  - **Specific pages:** Select the checkbox next to the pages this person should be able to edit.

Important: This option is only available to the site owner and co-owner.

title: How can I add a new page to my Wix site using ADI?
content:
Hover over Add on the top bar, click Page, and choose a page template from the Add Page panel.

Tip: Click Blank to add a blank page.

Note: If you add a page to a one-page site, the menu also changes. You will no longer see the page section names on the menu, just the page names. This makes it easier for your visitors to navigate around your site.

title: How can I use the Wix SEO Assistant to optimize a blog post page for search engines?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Select Posts in the sidebar, or click Manage Posts under Track your latest posts. Click Edit next to the post you want to get keyword ideas for. Select SEO on the left panel. Enter the keyword you want to target under Focus keyword. Click Get Keyword ideas to research ideas using Keyword Research Tools. Click Best practices to get some tips for the keyword. You should use different keywords for each of your pages. Click Save. Click a task to expand it and see a recommendation. Follow the instructions to resolve the task. Publish your post.

title: How can I enable participant notifications for my online program?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program. Click Edit Settings. Click Notifications. Enable the toggle next to the notification(s) you want participants to receive, such as Program Has Ended or All Steps Completed. Note: The notification that tells site members they've been invited to join a program is enabled by default and cannot be changed.

title: How can I allow fans to download my music from my Wix site and what download options do I have?
content: Control download options from the Music Library in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant album or single, click Edit in the Info section, scroll down to Sale and Download Options on Your Site, then use the Download Options drop-down. For a track within an album, hover over the track and click the Edit Track Info icon. Available options include: Sell for a fixed price (set a price in your desired currency), Free download, No downloads, Let fans name their price (you can set a minimum album price under Album Price), and Require email for download (fans must subscribe to your mailing list). Note: It is currently not possible to allow fans to download an entire playlist. The download link in the email is active for three days only; if the music is not downloaded within that period, you cannot resend the link. After purchase, customers can download purchased music an unlimited amount of times for up to 72 hours. Fans can download music in FLAC or MP3 files; FLAC is only offered if a FLAC, MP4A, or WAV version was uploaded. You can track Wix Music analytics, including download statistics, using Wix Analytics Reports.

title: How can I add a new payment method to my Wix account for future purchases?
content: Go to Payment Methods in your Wix account. Click Add a Payment Method. Enter your card/payment method details. Click Save.

title: Can I add a watermark to my images in the Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, you cannot add a watermark to your uploaded images in the Wix Pro Gallery in order to protect the copyright. As a workaround, you can create and add a watermark using text in the Wix Photo Studio. Be aware that when doing this, it is not possible to add text to multiple images at once. The text needs to be added to each image separately.

title: How can I reject a restaurant order using the Wix app?
content: To reject a restaurant order in the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app; tap Manage at the bottom; tap Orders under Business; tap the order you want to reject in the New tab (you can also do this for an order you've already accepted); tap the Show More icon at the top right; tap Reject Order; enter a reason for rejecting the order (the reason is shown on the customer's order page); tap Reject at the top right; contact the customer to let them know their order has been rejected. Important: after rejecting an order, you must contact the customer to let them know the order has been unsuccessful. Rejecting an order does not automatically void or refund the transaction. You must void the transaction in the dashboard of your chosen payment gateway. To locate the transaction ID, tap the order in the Orders tab; the ID is under the payment information.

title: How do I create an automation for a Wix form?
content:
To create an automation for your form:
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation.
- Click + Start from Scratch.
- Click the title to give your automation a name.
- In the Trigger section, click Wix Forms (blue icon).
- Under Select a trigger, choose Option chosen on a form or Form submitted.
- Under Select which forms trigger this automation, choose Any or Specific, as relevant.
- Use the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency.
- Optionally add a delay between the trigger and its action.
- Optionally add a condition.
- Choose an action, such as sending an email, a chat message, or a push notification.
- Optionally add a chain of follow-up actions.
- Click Activate to save and activate the automation.

title: Does Wix Bookings support setting appointments with true 24/7 availability?
content: Wix Bookings currently does not support setting appointments with true 24/7 availability. As a workaround, you can set each day from 00:00 to 00:00 (+1 day) both as default hours and for staff hours. Note: Setting hours from 00:00 to 23:59 leaves one minute unaccounted for and can cause issues with availability.

title: How can I set up call recordings for my business phone number using the Wix app?
content: To set up call recordings using the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Marketing and select Business Phone Number. Tap General under Line Settings. Tap Call Recording. Tap the Enable Call Recording toggle to record all of your incoming calls. Tap Save. Important: Before activating this feature, it is your responsibility to make sure it complies with your local laws and regulations.

title: How can I edit a task's details in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Dashboard at the bottom. Scroll down to Tasks & Reminders. Tap the task you want to edit. Edit the task according to your needs, including its content, contact person, assignee or due date. Tap Save at the top right.

title: Can I sell dropshipping products using the Wix Stores mobile point of sale?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell dropshipping products on your phone at a mobile point of sale. Customers can however, purchase dropshipping products on your site.

title: How can I add a new page to my site menu using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click Add Page at the top of the panel. Choose the page template from the options or click + Blank Page. Enter the new page name. Click Done. Tip: If you rename the page in the Pages & Menu panel, it automatically updates on your site menu. It also goes the other way around – if you rename the item on your site menu, it automatically updates the Pages & Menu panel.

title: How can I add a reference field to my main collection in Wix CMS?
content: Optionally, change the primary field in the collection you want to reference before adding the reference field. Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections. Select the main collection where you wish to reference the primary field from your referenced collection. Click Manage Fields, click + Add Field, select the Reference field type and click Choose Field Type, enter the Field name, edit the Field ID if using Velo only, choose the Reference Collection, optionally enter Help text, and click Save. Then select a reference for each item in your collection by clicking the reference field and selecting the primary field from the referenced collection that corresponds to the item. Use your keyboard to search for fields, or click Open Collection to view the referenced collection. Repeat for each item.

title: Why is there a large space or gap at the bottom of my dynamic item page?
content: If your dynamic item page has a large space or gap at the bottom, it's usually because item pages are different lengths, and the layout was not edited in the shortest item page. To prevent this, design according to the shortest item, in its respective item page, and use strips instead of placing elements "freely" inside the sections. To fix it, design your pages according to the shortest item. This ensures that all pages maintain a consistent layout. Also, use strips to attach elements inside the sections. This makes your design more responsive and avoids large spaces or gaps.

title: How can I promote discounts on my Wix site so customers know about them?
content: You can promote discounts by displaying them on your site and publicizing them through social media and email campaigns. On your site, place a banner at the top highlighting the discount, add an image or video strip with text and decorative items to grab attention, and create a pop-up lightbox set to appear after a customer has been on your site for a set period of time. You can also share discounts through email marketing campaigns, social media marketing posts, and social media ads such as Facebook Ads.

title: How can I update a typography style in Editor X?
content: Click the Site Styles icon on the top bar of the Editor. Click the Edit icon on a typography style. Customize the typography as you wish: change the font using the drop-down menu, adjust the text size, and make your text bold or italicized. Click Apply.

title: How can I edit an image using Adobe Express in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Click Site Files on the left. Click the image you want to edit. Click Design with Adobe Express on the right. Sign in to Adobe Express or create an account. Edit your image using the options available. Click Save at the top right. Select your file type from the File Format drop-down: JPG or PNG. Click Save. Select the edited image in the Site Files window and click Add to Page to add it to your site.

title: 如何优化Amazon Listing产品数据？
content: 按原文要点：标题≤200字符，前80字符包含关键词数据中搜索量最高的词；5个Bullet Points，每条≤200字符，以大写卖点开头并融入关键词；产品描述200字以内，讲品牌故事和使用场景；后台Search Terms 5行，每行≤250字节，不重复标题和五点中已用的词；只使用关键词数据里出现的词和搜索量，不要凭记忆补充关键词，也不要估算任何搜索量数字；关键词数据为空或少于10个词时，先说明不足以做关键词布局，并列出需要补充什么。

title: Shopify产品Feed的标题和描述有哪些长度和格式约束？
content: 标题格式为品牌 + 产品类型 + 关键属性 + 型号；前 70 字符最重要；最多 150 字符。描述前 160 字符最重要（会显示在广告中）；最多 5000 字符。

title: How do I access my people reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the People section. Select the relevant report.

title: How can I add a page transition in Editor X to enhance my site's navigation experience?
content: To add a page transition in Editor X, click Site Styles at the top of Editor X, then click Page Transitions. Select a transition from the list: None means no transition is shown when visitors move between pages; Out-In means the current page fades out and the new page fades in. Make sure to publish your site to see your page transition live.

title: Can I add custom flags to the Wix Multilingual Language Menu?
content: Currently, flags are available for all the countries included in the ISO-3166 standard. To request additional flags, submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How can I create and edit menu sections in the original Wix Restaurants Menus App?
content:
This article is about the original Wix Restaurants Menus App. Each menu is made up of sections and dishes. The default menu comes with 2 default sections.

To create the menu sections:
- Go to Menus in your site's dashboard.
- Click the default menu.
- Click the section you want to edit.
- Click Edit next to Section Info at the top right.
- Edit your menu's section:
  - Image: Hover over the section image and click Add Image to change it.
  - Name: Enter a name for the menu section.
  - Description: Enter a brief description of the menu section.
  - Visibility: Select or deselect the checkbox to show or hide the section on your menu.
- Click Save.

Want to add more sections? Create as many menu sections as you need. Click + New Section, edit your new section and click Add.

title: How can I enable Single Sign-On (SSO) login for my Wix site members?
content: SSO login is currently available only with Wix Studio enterprise solution and Wix Channels. To enable it, create members only pages, then go to Site Member Settings in your site's dashboard and add your Identity Provider (IdP) information in SSO Settings: the Client ID, Client Secret, and Config URL. Wix supports only the Open ID Connect protocol. After saving the IdP details, copy the Callback URL shown as the Web Logins URL and provide it to your IdP if needed. Then, in Site Member Settings, click SSO Settings and click the Enable SSO toggle. When enabled, users can sign in with SSO or other methods such as an email address and password; when disabled, users cannot sign in using SSO but can still use other methods. You can also click Set SSO as required: when enabled, users can only sign in with SSO, while account owners can still sign in using other methods. Wix recommends manually testing your SSO settings before setting SSO as required. Click Save Changes.

title: How can I send a link to a store product using Wix Chat?
content: To send a link to a store product using Wix Chat, choose the contact you'd like to chat with from Inbox or select a live site visitor. Click the text box at the bottom to start typing your message. Click the Message via drop-down and select Chat. Click the Products icon. Select the relevant product and click Send. A product will not be listed if it's out of stock or hidden from your store page; go to the Products page in your dashboard to manage the visibility of your store products.

title: How can I ensure that each page of my Wix site appears individually in search results?
content: Make sure to add unique title tags and meta descriptions to each page so search engines can display them in search results. Your title tags and meta descriptions should be relevant to the content of the page, which helps potential site visitors understand what the page is about based on the information displayed in search results. If you do not want an individual page to appear, you can prevent search engines from indexing that page.

title: Can I send SMS notifications to clients when scheduling, editing, or cancelling a session from the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to notify clients via SMS when scheduling, editing, or canceling a session from the Wix app. However, you can automatically send SMS reminders to members that they receive 24 hours before their booked session begins. As a workaround, you can send SMS notifications when scheduling, editing, or canceling a session from your desktop. You can use Omnisend to automatically send SMS messages for booking confirmations, reminders, cancellations, and rescheduling.

title: What should I do if I encounter issues with 3DS payment authentication while paying for Wix services?
content:
If you encounter issues with 3DS payment authentication while paying for Wix services, try the following steps to troubleshoot your payment issues:

* Enable pop-ups in your browser: If you have pop-ups blocked in your browser, you may not see the pop-up from your bank. Try enabling pop-ups and attempt to complete your payment.
* Access a different browser: You can attempt to pay using a different browser (e.g. Firefox, Safari, Google Chrome).
* Retry in incognito mode: Use your browser in 'incognito' or 'in private' mode to try and complete payment.
* Try a different payment method: Use a payment method, such as another card or payment service (e.g. PayPal).

If you try these steps and are still having trouble, you can contact Wix Customer Care or contact your bank directly. The Strong Customer Authentication process is solely managed by your bank, which means they should be able to resolve any issue you might have.

title: How can I set the opening seasons and check-in/check-out times for my property using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Manage General Settings. Scroll down to the Season and time. Choose your opening season under The property operates: All year round if you don't close during the off-season, or Only in a specific season if you operate only during a specific season of the year; select your opening and closing dates in the drop-downs. Select your Check-in after time and Check-out before time from the drop-downs. Click Save at the top.

title: Is it possible to impersonate a member to preview what my site looks like to them?
content: Currently, it is not possible to impersonate a member to preview what your site looks like to them. It is only possible to view your site according to your own role. However, you can create new members and add them to the role you want to test so that you can see your site as they see it. To create a member role for testing: go to your live site, sign up as a new member, add the new member to the role that you want to test, and visit your live site as that member to see what the site looks like for them.

title: How can I auto-translate my entire Wix site using the Translation Manager?
content:
Go to the Translation Manager in your site's dashboard. Click Auto-translate Site at the bottom left. Click Auto-translate Site in the pop-up to confirm. If you don't have enough word credit you can purchase more.

Note: Any text you already edited will not be changed. Review the translations. (Optional) Replace the text in the text box to match the correct translation and click Done to confirm the change. Repeat these steps for each text you want to translate automatically.

When you have finished translating all the fields, click Save and Publish. To show the translation on your live site, change the status of the relevant language from Hidden to Visible.

title: Can I create plugins for the dashboards of Wix business solution apps using Wix Blocks?
content: In Wix Blocks, you can create plugins that integrate directly into Wix business solution apps, such as Stores or Bookings. However, you cannot create plugins for the dashboards of these apps.

title: How can I block visitors from specific countries using the Blocky IP & Country Blocker app by Effective Apps?
content: With the Blocky: IP & Country Blocker app by Effective Apps, you can block visitors from certain countries from accessing your site. You can immediately block multiple countries with a click of a button. After a visitor is blocked, they are automatically redirected to a page of your choice on your site. Note: This app is only available in English.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings for a category page in Wix Stores?
content: In the dashboard, go to Categories, select the category you want to edit, and click Edit SEO Settings under Marketing & SEO. You can edit the URL slug (keep it short and easy to read; if you change it, manually create your own redirect so the previous link redirects to the new one), the title tag (concise category names, maximum 60 characters), and the meta description (maximum 156 characters). Then click Save.

title: How can I change the sender details for my email marketing campaigns in Wix?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Scroll to the Sender details section on the right and click Manage Senders. To edit sender details, click the Edit icon next to sender details and update the Sender's name and Reply-to email. Select the Make this sender the default checkbox to make this email the address used when sending Email Marketing campaigns and triggered (automated) emails. If you updated the Reply-to email, confirm your email address: open the email titled "Your email confirmation code", copy the confirmation code, return to the Confirm this email address message, paste the code into the Enter code field, click Confirm, then click Got It. You can also change your sender details when sending an email campaign.

title: How can I customize the expand mode in Wix Editor galleries?
content: This article refers to Editor galleries. To customize the expand mode to look how you want, Wix recommends using the Wix Pro Gallery. In Editor galleries, images are always displayed with a padding of 50px above and below. Adding a title and description to images makes them appear smaller. Wix recommends not to use transparent .png images in expand mode due to the colored background and no frame features.

title: How can I enable future ordering for my Wix Restaurants site?
content:
To enable future ordering: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Order scheduling. Click the Scheduled orders toggle to enable and set how far in advance customers can place an order.

For Minimum time: Enter a number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list. This is the minimum time customers can place a future order in advance.

For Maximum time: Enter a maximum number and select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list. This is the maximum time customers can place a future order in advance.

Optional: Disable the ASAP toggle to accept future orders only. Click Save.

Note: If you require customers to pick a delivery date and time, the Order Now button is inactive until your customer chooses a time.

title: How can I design a horizontal menu in Editor X?
content: Click your horizontal menu. Click the Inspector icon to open the panel. Click the Design icon. Select the element you want to design from the drop-down: Menu container, Menu items, Submenu container, Submenu items. For menu or submenu items, select the relevant state: Regular, Hover or Clicked. Design the menu using the available options: Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, Shadow, Text, Spacing.

title: How can I permanently delete audio files from the Wix Music Media Manager to free up storage space?
content: Go to Music Library in your site's dashboard, click the relevant album, single or playlist, hover over Add Tracks, and click Select Tracks to open the Music Media Manager. Next, click the More Options icon next to the relevant file and click Move to Trash. Then click Trash on the left-hand side, click the More Options icon next to the relevant file, and click Permanently Delete. Permanently deleting a file from your Music Media Manager automatically removes it from your live site and storage.

title: Is Wix Services HIPAA compliant?
content: Currently, Wix Services are not compliant with the U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

title: How can I create an automated response for product purchases in Wix Stores?
content:
To create an automated response for product purchases in Wix Stores, set up an automation with the "order placed" trigger, optionally add a delay, select products using a condition, and choose the automated response.

Set up the trigger: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation. Click + Start from Scratch on the left. Click the title at the top to give the automation a name. Select Wix Stores. Select Order placed.

Optional delay: Click Add Delay, select Days, Hours, or Minutes, and enter the number.

Select products: Click +Add Condition. Select Line items from the first drop-down. Select Includes any of from the second drop-down. Select the relevant products. You can select up to 50 products per automation.

Choose the automated response: Choose whether to send an email, a chat message, or email your customer a coupon. If sending an email, customize the message and design the email to suit your brand.

title: How can I invite clients to join my site using the Wix member apps?
content:
You can invite clients to join your site using one of the Wix member apps, such as the Spaces app, Fit app, Dine app, or your branded app. In the Wix app:
- Go to your site.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Mobile App**.
- If needed, switch to editing a different mobile app: tap the mobile app name at the top, then tap **Spaces by Wix app** or the relevant mobile app (e.g. **Fit by Wix app**). A tip in the source says to go to your site's dashboard on desktop to choose your preferred member app.
- Tap **Invite new members**.
- Choose an invitation method: **Send an SMS** to add contacts and send the invite message containing an invite link; **Share via Social & More** to choose how to send your invite (e.g. Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail); or **Copy Link** and paste the link into a new message in an application of your choice.

You can send invites via social media, email, text message, or through a direct link.

title: Is it possible to create a multilingual site directly in ADI?
content: Currently, if you want your site to be in more than one language, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: How can I fix the issue of text and other elements overlapping on my Wix mobile site?
content: If you've added a large amount of text to your site in a single text box, and added an element on top of it, the text may overlap with other elements on your live site. This is usually seen in text that has been added to your site in the desktop Editor. To resolve the issue, open the desktop Editor. Break up the text into multiple text boxes - one per paragraph. Add the elements between the text boxes with some space between them. Group the elements together to ensure they're aligned.

title: How can I set up a loyalty program for my Wix store to increase customer retention?
content: Create a loyalty program to boost sales, increase retention, and keep customers happy. Customize it to reflect your store's personality by choosing a program name, a name for your points, and an icon that represents your brand. Customers get points every time they perform set actions. You decide which actions they take to earn points, how many points they get per action, and what the rewards are. When they have accumulated enough points, they can redeem them using coupons. Learn how to create your own loyalty program.

title: 如何用 Instagram Carousel 制作“选购 [品类] 的 5 个常见误区”这类教育型内容，以教育用户并建立品牌专业形象？
content: 可以按以下提示模板生成：先设定角色为 Instagram Carousel 内容专家，再给出产品 [名称] 与 [品类]，目标为“教育用户 + 建立品牌专业形象”。请生成一个 8 页的教育型 Carousel，主题为“选购 [品类] 的 5 个常见误区”。每页都提供：① 标题文字（大字，不超过 6 个词）② 正文（不超过 30 个词）③ 视觉建议（配图/图标/颜色方案）④ 设计备注。结构要求：第 1 页为封面（Hook 标题 + 品牌 logo）；第 2-6 页讲 5 个误区，每页一个，按“问题→正确做法”展开；第 7 页为总结 + 产品推荐（自然植入，不硬推）；第 8 页为 CTA（“保存这篇” + “关注获取更多”）。风格要求：简洁、专业、符合 Instagram 美学，并建议配色方案。文案纪律：不要写出产品实际不具备的功能、材质、认证或效果；面向客户的内容不要做出无权承诺的保证（退款金额、赔偿、时效、平台政策例外需由你确认后才能写）；涉及疗效、安全、环保、专利的表述单独标出，提示人工核对。交付前自检：① 是否恰好 8 页，结构是否符合“封面 → 5 个误区 → 总结+产品推荐 → CTA”② 每页标题是否不超过 6 个词、正文是否不超过 30 个词 ③ 第 7 页产品推荐是否为自然植入，而非硬推 ④ 文案是否未出现产品实际不具备的功能、材质、认证或效果。

title: How can I design the header of my Wix AI Site-Chat to reflect my brand's style?
content: In your editor, click the Wix AI Site-Chat, click Settings, click the Design tab, and choose Header. You can customize the background, font and button colors by selecting a color from your site's theme or choosing a custom color. Choose a font style and font using the drop-down menus, and adjust the size using the slider. Click the toggle to display or hide the AI icon from the header.

title: How can I add cells to a section in the Studio Editor to create a responsive layout?
content: Select the relevant section, click the **Blank** drop-down at the top of the section, and choose a layout such as Rows, Columns or Collage. Then drag elements to the relevant cells. You can change the layout from the drop-down at any time — it will not move your elements around. If your grid cells overlap on mobile, we recommend switching to a vertical layout (like Rows) to resolve this issue.

title: How can I translate my restaurant menu using Wix Multilingual?
content: First, add and set up Wix Multilingual. You can add Wix Multilingual from your editor, your site's dashboard, or from the Wix App Market. Then go to Translation Manager in your site's dashboard and click Restaurant Menus on the left. Select what you want to translate first: Items, Item labels, Menu names, Sections, Modifier group names, Variants & modifiers. If you auto-translated your site, review the automated translations and edit if necessary. If you didn't use auto-translation, translate the custom fields and policies manually.

title: How can I access the email marketing dashboard in the Wix app to manage my campaigns?
content:
To access the email marketing dashboard in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Marketing and select Email Marketing.
- Tap the relevant tab:
  - Published: See all the email campaigns you've sent from mobile and desktop and view the campaign status. You can also duplicate, archive or send the email to more recipients.
  - Drafts: Access and edit email campaigns you've started working on but haven't sent.
  - Archived: View all the email campaigns you moved to the archive (either drafts or published campaigns). You can unarchive any campaign or delete it permanently if you no longer need it.

Note: You can only access the dashboard once you've created a campaign.

title: How do I enable or disable autoplay for Wix Video?
content: To enable or disable autoplay in Wix Video, go to your editor, click the Wix Video player on your page, click Settings, click the Player tab, and use the Autoplay on load toggle. Note: Videos set to autoplay always start on mute due to browser restrictions. The Autoplay on load toggle is not available for the strip and slider layouts. Some browsers no longer support autoplay, so visitors may need to change the settings in their own browsers, such as Safari, Chrome, and Firefox.

title: How can I add an additional meta tag to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add an additional meta tag to your site in the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor, click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant page, click **SEO basics**, click the **Advanced SEO** tab, click **Additional Tags**, click **+ Add New Tag**, add your meta tag code in the **HTML Code** field, and then click **Apply**. As a tip, you can also add meta tags to your site's SEO Settings.

title: Can I change the icons next to the fields on my members' profile page?
content: While you can customize the fields that appear in your members' profile page, it is not possible to change the icons next to the fields.

title: What should I do if I'm unable to sign in to my Wix account after resetting my password?
content:
If you're still unable to sign in after resetting your password, try the following troubleshooting steps:

- Clear your browser’s cache.
- Close the browser and reopen it.
- Go back to the password reset email and click the link.
- If you see a security warning pop-up, click Load Anyway.
- Check that cookies aren’t blocked in your browser. A cookie is a small file stored in your browser which helps a website recognize you. If you have chosen to block cookies in your browser, you will not be able to sign in to Wix. Go to your browser settings and make sure that you have not chosen to block cookies.
- If you still need help, fill out the ownership verification form and add a detailed explanation of your case so the site or domain can be properly verified. Fill out the entire form, even if you're not completely sure of the answers. Provide a valid contact email so support can respond.

title: How can I schedule a discount for my products using the Wix Store Scheduler app?
content:
This app is no longer available in the Wix App Market. You can schedule discounts using Automatic Discounts.

To schedule a discount:
- Access the app:
  - Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard.
  - Click Open next to Wix Store Scheduler.
- Click + Schedule Activity.
- Select Set sale price.
- Select what you want to apply the discount to:
  - Select an option from the Choose product or category drop-down.
  - Select the relevant product or category.
- Select a discount option:
  - Amount off discount: Click the Amount icon. Enter the discount amount.
  - Percentage discount: Click the Percentage icon. Enter the discount percentage.
- Select a start date, time, and time zone.
- Click Schedule.

title: Can I charge clients a late cancellation fee using Wix Bookings?
content: Yes, you can now charge clients for cancellations and no-shows using Wix Bookings. This feature helps reduce late cancellations and missed appointments. Clients can either cancel and be charged automatically, or you can handle it manually.

title: How can I enable online ordering for my restaurant using Wix Restaurants?
content: Before you begin, set up payment methods for your site in Accept Payments in your dashboard. To enable online ordering, go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard and click the Ordering is on/off toggle. Tip: You can temporarily disable online ordering by clicking Edit next to the toggle and leaving a message for customers explaining why online ordering is currently off.

title: How can I customize the registration form for an RSVP event in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard, select the relevant event, click the Settings tab, and click Edit next to Registration Form. Use the Guests can RSVP "No" toggle to enable or disable it: when enabled, guests can indicate on the form if they are attending and you can edit the "I'm Going / Not Going" text; when disabled, guests only need to RSVP if they are attending. To edit form text, hover over text fields, click the Edit icon, edit the text, and click the checkmark to save. To add preset fields, click Add More Options, select the field, customize the option, and optionally select Make this info required; when selected, guests cannot RSVP without entering the requested information. To add a custom question, click Custom Question, enter a title under Custom Question Text, select the response type, and if you selected Dropdown Menu, Multiple Choice, or Checkboxes, enter all options guests can choose from and press Enter after every choice, then click the checkmark to save. You can optionally edit the Submit button text by hovering over Submit, clicking the Edit icon, editing the text, and clicking the checkmark. Click Save at the top right.

title: Can I edit or trim a video after uploading it to the Wix Video Library?
content: Currently, it is not possible to edit or trim the content of a video once you've uploaded the file to your Video Library. However, details like the video's name and description can be updated at any time.

title: How can I test my site on different screen resolutions using Google Chrome's DevTools?
content:
The source recommends using the actual devices you want to test rather than third-party tools. If you do not have access to certain devices, you can use Google Chrome's DevTools to simulate them. Important: DevTools and other third-party tools are emulators and should be used only as guidelines for viewing your site in other devices; third-party emulators are not supported, as they may not accurately represent your site's full browsing experience.

To test your site using DevTools:
- Open the Google Chrome browser.
- Click the Customize and control icon at the top right.
- Hover over More Tools and click Developer Tools.
- Click the Toggle device toolbar icon.
- Click the Responsive drop-down and select a device to emulate.
- Note: Select Edit to emulate an unlisted device.
- Press F5 or Ctrl + R on your keyboard to reload the page (press Cmd + R on Mac).

title: Can I use Google Pay as a payment method in Wix Payments?
content: Yes. You can now add Google Pay as a payment method with Wix Payments. Google Pay offers your customers a swift and secure checkout experience on your website. When customers use Google Pay, they don't need to input their credit card details or shipping address manually. This promotes a faster checkout for your customer and a better conversion rate for your business.

title: Can I use PHP programming language in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix only supports adding HTML code, which can be added through the HTML element. Velo by Wix, which uses Javascript, also allows the use of Java Script Libraries when using the HTML element. It is not possible to add PHP code to your Wix site.

title: How can I edit the text for an event in the Wix Events app using the Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor, then go to the Events page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, clicking Event Pages, and clicking your Events page. Click the Event List element on your page, click Settings, click the Text tab, and edit the available text options. If you have a multilingual site, you can translate your event using Wix Multilingual.

title: Can I add outlines and shadows to text in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. You can now add outlines and shadows to text, and change the capitalization.

title: How can I connect a Pro Gallery to a media gallery field in my CMS collection using the Wix Editor?
content: First add a media gallery field to your collection and add and organize the media for each collection item. In the Wix Editor, go to the page where you want a gallery that displays media for a single collection item at a time. Click Add Elements, then Gallery, and drag the relevant Pro Gallery onto your page. Remove the default images: click Manage Media, click Select All, click Delete, then click Done. Click the Connect to CMS icon. Create a new dataset or choose an existing dataset: if creating a new dataset, select the relevant collection, optionally enter a Dataset name, click Create, then select the relevant (Media Gallery) field under the dataset; if using an existing dataset, select the relevant (Media Gallery) field under that dataset. Optionally, if connected to a regular dataset rather than a dynamic page dataset, add a filter to control which item's media displays; if using navigational buttons to cycle through items, add a sort condition to control the order in which the previous/next items load. Click the Pro Gallery element and select Settings to customize your gallery's layout, design, and more. You can use the gallery's built-in 'Load More' button in the layout settings to restrict the number of images or videos displayed on the page before visitors click to see more.

title: How can I create a custom click or hover interaction in the Studio Editor?
content:
### Step 1 | Add a trigger (click or hover)
Select the element that should trigger the interaction. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor. Click the **Animations and Effects** tab. Select **Hover** / **Click**. Click **+ Add**.

### Step 2 | Set up the interaction
In the **Setup panel**, select an option from the **On Hover** / **On Click** drop-down:
- **Start Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element triggers the chosen animation.
- **Toggle On/Off:** Similar to a toggle, clicking the element triggers the animation and a second click removes it.
- **Reset Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element removes any animation that was previously applied.

Select an option from the **Animated element** drop-down:
- **Make the element trigger its own animation:** Click the element's name (the word **(self)** appears next to it).
- **Animate a different element on the page:** Select an element from the drop-down, or click **Choose on Canvas** to select it on the page.

Click the **Custom** tab. Click **Create Custom Animation**.

### Step 3 | Customize the animation
Adjust the relevant settings in the Inspector panel to create the custom animation:
- **Opacity:** Change the opacity of the element by entering a value lower than 100%.
- **Rotate:** Make the element rotate in a certain direction by entering an angle in the text box.
- **Scale:** Make the element shrink or grow. You can enter the same value in both X (width) and Y (height) so that the element resizes in its original proportion.
- **Skew:** Make the element turn sideways. Enter a value for the width (X) and the height (Y) of the element.
- **Translate:** Move an element right/left (X) or up/down (Y) by adjusting the X and Y values.
- **Fill Color & Opacity:** Choose a different color and opacity for the element's background.
- **Corners:** Make the element's corners sharper or rounder.
- **Border:** Add a border to frame the element.
- **Shadow:** Add shadow behind the element.

Design the element's initial state: Click the **Designing** drop-down on the floating bar. Select **Initial state**. Adjust the relevant settings in the Inspector panel. When ready, click **Done**.

Set the animation's duration and ease in the **Timing** panel:
- **Start and End:** Set the duration of the animation (in seconds) using these fields. The Start field also controls the delay of this animation.
- **Easing:** Choose how the animation eases in and out.

(Optional) Click **Play** on the floating bar to preview the animation. When ready, click **Done**.

title: How can I customize the chat icon on my mobile site when Wix Chat is the only action in the Quick Action Bar?
content: If Wix Chat is the only action in your Quick Action Bar (QAB), the color of the mobile chat icon is pulled from the Design tab in your desktop chat settings. To change the color of the icon, go to your Editor from desktop and update the Minimized Chat settings. Note that the chat icon color is the same for desktop and mobile.

title: How can I set up sales notifications for my music on Wix?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Music Settings. Click the Sales notifications toggle to enable or disable it. When enabled, you get an email notification when you make a sale. Notifications go to the email address that is registered to your Wix account.

title: What should I do if my payout from Wix Payments has failed?
content:
If your payout from Wix Payments has failed, click the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see any known details about the failed transaction and follow the troubleshooting steps:

Step 1 | Verify the bank details associated with your Wix Payments account
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments. Click Edit Account Details next to Account Details. Check the information listed under Bank Details. If necessary, correct it and click Resubmit.

Step 2 | Verify that your bank account can receive EFT payments
Wix Payments sends payouts to your bank account as EFT payments. If you have a failed payout, verify with your bank that your account can receive such a transfer. If your account cannot receive EFT payments, update your settings to a different bank account that can receive them. Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments. Click Edit Account Details next to Account Details. Enter the new bank details under Bank Details and click Resubmit.

As soon as your payment details are updated, and your new account details have been verified, the funds will be included in your next scheduled payout.

title: How can I check an unknown charge from Wix using the invoice number without logging into my account?
content:
To check an unknown charge from Wix without logging into your account:

1. Find the invoice number on your card or bank statement.
2. Open the charge locator tool.
3. Enter the invoice number, the last 4 digits of the card used to pay the invoice, and the expiry date of the card.
4. Click **Search.**

**Note:** This method is only available if you paid for the Wix service via card payment. The charge locator tool is not yet available in all locations.

title: How can I set up my Wix Bookings to require approval for appointment bookings?
content: To require approval for appointment bookings: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Select an existing appointment or click Add a New Service. Scroll down and click the Expand icon next to Booking preferences. Enable the Online bookings toggle. Optionally, edit your booking form or add a new custom booking form. Under Booking requests, select Manually approve or decline booking requests. This option is only available if the appointment is not connected to a membership plan or a package. Use the Multiple clients can request the same time slot toggle to choose what happens when a client sends a booking request: Enabled means the time slot remains available until you approve the booking; Disabled means the time slot becomes unavailable. Click Save at the top to update your appointment preferences. Note that clients cannot pay online for appointments which require your approval, and clients can only request to book appointments, not classes or courses.

title: How do I create a 404 page in Editor X?
content:
You must have a Premium Plan to create a custom 404 error page. A custom 404 page includes limited design options from Editor.

To create a 404 page:
- Click the Pages icon at the top left of the Editor.
- Click the Add New Page icon next to Main Pages.
- Name your new page "error404".
- Make sure that the page URL looks like the following example: https://www.mystunningwebsite.com/error404
- Hide the page from search engines: Click the Show More icon next to the relevant page. Click Page SEO. Click the Show the page in search results toggle to disable it.
- Design the page to your liking. Below are some ideas:
  - Add vector illustrations related to error 404 in the Media from Wix folder of your Media Manager.
  - Add links, buttons or a menu to help visitors navigate to other parts of your site. This minimizes the chances of your visitors leaving after getting the 404 error message.
  - If necessary, you can hide the master header and master footer on this page.
- Make sure to check how the page looks like in all breakpoints.

title: Can I search for members using their title, company name, or email address on the Members Page?
content: From the Members Page, members can find each other by typing a person's first or last name in the search bar. Currently, it is not possible to search for members using other information like their title, company name or email address.

title: How can I organize my contacts using labels in Wix Contacts?
content: In Wix Contacts, you can organize contacts by adding labels to group them based on their relationship to your business. Each contact can have multiple labels such as leads, customers, and service providers. You can use labels to filter your contacts, send email marketing campaigns to multiple contacts at once, and more.

title: How can I save a design element in Wix Editor to reuse it later?
content: Go to your editor. Right-click the element(s) that you wish to save. Click Save to My Designs. (Optional) Enter a name for your design. Click Save. You can also save pre-made designs from Wix templates if you see a ready-made design you like.

title: How can I add one video to my Wix site using the Single Video Player?
content: Use the Single Video Player in the Wix Editor. Upload your own video (up to 1GB) or add a video from a social network by copying and pasting the link. The player is resizable, and you can customize the settings and frame.

title: Can I add hyperlinks to text within a collapsible text box in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to hyperlink text in a collapsible text box. The only hyperlink that you can add is to link button to the full text.

title: How can I access the quick actions menu in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap the Add icon at the bottom. Tap the relevant action you want to work on.

title: What are the recommended image sizes for service images in Wix Bookings, and what should I consider when uploading them?
content:
For service images in Wix Bookings, recommended image sizes vary by layout:

- Side by side: 800 x 800 pixels
- Overlapping: 800 x 800 pixels
- Strip: 200 x 200 pixels
- Grid: 600 x 600 pixels

Notes:
- If you use an image that is larger than recommended, it may appear cropped on your page.
- If you use an image that is smaller than recommended, the system zooms in to fill the available area. This prevents the appearance of white or black bars to fill up the empty space.
- The mobile version of Wix Bookings currently supports only the grid layout option.

title: How can I manually enable or disable caching for a page on my Wix site?
content:
To enable or disable caching:

- Go to the relevant page in your Editor:
  - **Wix Editor:** Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the Editor.
  - **Editor X:** Click **Pages** at the top of Editor X.
- Hover over the page and click the More Actions icon.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click **Advanced Settings**.
- Click the **Manually control caching for this page** toggle and choose what you want to do:
  - **Enabled**: You can manually control the caching for this page.
    - **How often do you want to reset this page's cache?**: Choose how frequently your page cache resets from the dropdown menu, or select **Never (disable caching)** to prevent the page from being cached altogether.
  - **Disabled**: The page will be cached automatically.

title: Is it possible to integrate Airtable with the Wix CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Airtable with the Wix CMS (Content Management System). Workarounds: With Wix Automations, you can use Zapier to automate connections with Airtable and other third-party apps. You can view Airtable workflow templates in Zapier. You can use the Sync: Connect to data sources app to connect site elements with data from Airtable.

title: Can I print packing slips using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, it's not possible to print packing slips using the Wix app on your mobile device. You can only print packing slips from desktop.

title: How can I mark attendance for my classes using Wix Bookings?
content: To mark attendance for your classes in Wix Bookings, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the relevant class in your calendar, and click Manage next to participants. Next to the relevant client, use the Attendance drop-down and choose Booked, Checked-In, or No-Show. Booked means your client booked the class and hasn't yet arrived; Checked-In means your client arrived to the class; No-Show means your client booked the class but never arrived. You can mark the attendance of multiple clients by selecting the checkbox next to each one.

title: Can I connect to Wix Payments if I am located in a country not listed in the supported locations?
content: If your country is not on the list, it means you currently cannot use Wix Payments as your payment provider. However, you can still accept payment using one of our many third-party providers. See the full list, then click Setup next to the relevant provider to learn how to connect it to your site.

title: How can I manage the preset markups for my site's pages in Wix?
content:
To manage your preset markups in Wix:

- Go to your SEO Dashboard.
- Select **Go to SEO Settings** under **Tools and settings**.
- Select the page type that you want to edit. **Note:** It's not possible to customize the default markup for your Main Pages. You can customize markup for individual pages in the Edit by Page section or in your editor.
- Click **Edit** beside **Structured data markup**.
- Choose what you want to do:
  - **Preview or switch a preset markup:** Click **Preview Preset** beside the markup you want to preview, or **Switch Preset** for pages that have multiple preset markup options.
  - **Include or exclude a preset markup:** Click the Show/Hide icon beside the markup you want to include or exclude.
  - **Create a custom markup:** Click **Preview Preset** beside the markup you want to create a custom markup from, then click **Convert to custom markup**. Enter a name for the markup, edit your markup under **Write your markup in JSON-LD format**, and click **Apply**.
  - **Create a new custom markup:** Click **+ Add New Markup**, enter a name for the markup, add your new markup under **Write your markup in JSON-LD format**, and click **Apply**.
  - **Edit or remove a custom markup:** Click **Edit** beside any custom markup you want to edit, or click the Remove icon beside any custom markup you want to remove.

**Tip:** You can have up to 5 markups per SEO Setting, including the preset markup.

title: What does 'Discovered - Currently Not Indexed' mean in Google Search Console, and how can I resolve this issue?
content: When checking your site's coverage status report in Google Search Console, you may see that Google has marked some of your URLs as Discovered - Currently Not Indexed. This means that Google found the page, but decided not to crawl it for search results at the moment. It doesn't necessarily mean that your page has errors. It may mean that Google decided that crawling the page would overload your site and rescheduled crawling for a later time. It can also mean that you need to improve the quality of the content on the page. Check the troubleshooting steps below to resolve the issue: Confirm that the page can be indexed by Google by clicking Test Live URL in Google's URL Inspection Tool. Make sure to organize your page's content and divide it into categories/sections with unique text that doesn't exist in other pages. Duplicate content, or very similar content, appearing on different pages of your site may prevent them from being indexed. See that your subpages incorporate your keywords organically and have a visible connection to them. Tip: Learn more about optimizing your site's content for SEO.

title: How can I activate and customize abandoned cart emails in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click Set Up Automation under Increase sales by reminding customers of abandoned carts. To customize the sender details, click Edit next to Action, click Edit under Sender details, enter a From name and a Reply-to email, then click Save. To customize the email, click Edit next to Action, click Edit Template under Create an email, edit the text and design, then click Save & Publish. The email is set up to automatically show each customer a product they abandoned, the product name and price, and a link to the cart; do not edit the parts of the template outlined in red, and the button design can be edited but do not change the button link. To schedule timing, click Edit next to Timing, select an option from the Choose a time to send this action drop-down, and select how many times the same customer can receive an abandoned cart email: Don't limit, Once per contact, or Once per contact every 24 hours (Recommended). When ready, click Activate at the top right.

title: How can I customize the Product page in ADI for my store?
content: In ADI, click the Pages menu on the top bar, click Product Page, then click your Product page. Customize it using Display elements, Image scaling, Button, and Sharing options. Use the Show/Hide icon to show or hide parts of the Product page, choose how to display product images from the drop-down, show or hide the Add to Cart button, and show or hide the social share icons.

title: How can I add the Wix Task List add-on to my site?
content: Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left, then click Tools. Click Editor Add-ons, then click Get Add-ons. Hover over Task List and click Add. Once you have added Task List, you can start creating tasks for yourself. When you have finished a task, select the checkmark next to the relevant task and it will move to your 'Completed tasks' section in the add-on.

title: Can I use a membership form to gather information about participants before they register for my online program?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use a membership form to gather information about participants before they register for your program. However, you can collect information from site visitors by adding a membership form to your site. This form does not connect directly to your Online Program registration.

title: How can I edit the elements of my email campaign using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Marketing, and select Email Marketing. Tap the Drafts tab. You can only edit draft campaigns; if you want to edit a campaign that was already sent, duplicate the campaign first. Tap the More Actions icon next to the campaign you want to edit and tap Edit. If you don't see this option, your campaign was created from desktop. Tap the element in the campaign that you want to edit; the relevant menu opens at the bottom. You can change the design of an element using the available design options, add a link to an element by tapping the Link icon, enabling Include Link, choosing My Wix Site, My Spaces App, or Custom Link, tapping the place you want to link to, and tapping Done. You cannot add a link to a divider. You can duplicate an element with Copy, reorder an element with the navigation arrows, or delete an element with Delete and confirm. Click Next to save your draft. When you're done editing the campaign, send it to your subscribers. Important: you can only edit email campaigns in the Wix app if the campaign was originally created from mobile; if a campaign was created or edited from a desktop, you must edit it from there.

title: How can I add a link to an element in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a link to an element in the Wix Editor, click the Link icon. Select the link type and enter the details. Click Done. To remove a link, select None in the What do you want to link to? Popup and click Done.

title: How can I report a Wix site that is sending electronic spam?
content: If you encounter any Wix sites that you believe are sending electronic spam, you can file a complaint.

title: Why do the service times on my Wix Bookings live site differ from the times in my calendar?
content: Service times on your live site can differ from the times you set or see in your Wix Bookings calendar because of time zone display settings or because the service duration exceeds your business hours. For time zones, you can choose to display service times in your time zone, your customers' time zone, or let customers select a time zone. The time zone in the Business Info tab determines the live site service times when you display them in your own time zone, the Wix Bookings calendar time zone, and the Google calendar time zone if synced. Confirmation emails for one-on-one services state the service time in the customer's time zone; confirmation emails for group services state the service time in your time zone. For duration, Wix Bookings only displays service times within your business hours, so a customer cannot book a service that exceeds your business hours. If you set a time buffer between appointments, some time slots may be unavailable.

title: How can I cancel a customer's appointment and issue a refund using the Wix dashboard?
content:
Open Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the appointment you want to cancel. Click the More Actions icon and select Cancel. Then follow the path for the session type.

For an individually paid session without a cancellation fee: optionally select the Send cancelation email checkbox and add a message for your customer; optionally select the Mark as refunded checkbox to refund your customer; click Cancel Session; click Mark as Refunded to confirm the refund.

For an individually paid session with a cancellation fee: optionally select the Apply cancellation fee checkbox to charge a cancellation fee; optionally select the Send cancelation email checkbox and add a message for your customer; click Cancel Session; optionally edit the cancellation fee (you cannot charge more than the fee stated in the policy); click Confirm Fee & Continue; click View Order; click Actions in the Payment info section; click Issue refund; enter the refund details (Refund amount; Reason for Refund optional, which appears only in the order's activity section; Send a confirmation email to customer; Add a personal note in the email optional); click Continue; click Mark as Refunded. Note: this cannot be undone.

title: I can't select or find an element in the footer of my Wix Editor, and I don't know where the Overlapping Items feature is located. How can I locate and select it?
content:
If you are unable to select or find an element in the editor, it may be behind another element. Use the Layers panel: click the Layers icon at the bottom of your editor, click Header, Page or Footer, find the relevant element on the list, and click to select it.

If the element is behind another element, right-click the element covering the element you're trying to select, hover over Overlapping Items, and select the relevant element.

If you still cannot select it, right-click the covering element, hover over Arrange, and click Move Backward until you are able to access the desired element.

If you see the element on your live site or in Preview mode but not in the editor, hold down Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift and press M to scroll through the elements on your site until you reach the desired element.

If your header or footer is frozen, you may be unable to select an element. To unfreeze your footer, click the footer, click the Settings icon, and click the Freeze Footer toggle to disable it. For a frozen header, click the header, click the Settings icon, and select a new scroll setting.

title: Can I refund customers directly from my Wix site dashboard?
content: Yes, it's now possible to refund customers directly from your site dashboard. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I delete a site using the Wix app?
