content: To delete a site using the Wix app: go to the Wix app on your mobile device, tap the Site List drop-down at the top, tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant site, tap Move to Trash, then tap Move to Trash to confirm. Optionally, tap the Trash folder to permanently remove a site: tap the site you want to delete, tap Remove Site, then tap Remove to confirm. Notes: Only site owners can delete a site. When you permanently delete a site, all site and member data will be erased and you cannot restore it.

title: How can I add a poll to a blog post from the Blog section of my site's dashboard?
content:
To add a poll to a blog post from your site's dashboard:
- Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
- Select the post that you want to add media to.
- Click the Add icon beside the section where you want to add the poll.
- Select Poll under Elements.
- Select the type of poll that you want to create: Text in a list, Text & main image, or Images in a grid.
- Enter your poll question and the answers that you want your readers to choose from.
- Optional: Customize the layout, design, and settings of your poll. In Settings, you can choose who can vote, allow people to pick multiple answers, choose who can see results, show vote count, and show who voted.
- Click Publish.

title: How can I send automation data via a webhook in Wix Automations?
content:
To connect automations with a webhook:
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation in the top right corner.
- Click + Start from Scratch or choose a suggested automation.
- Click the title to give your automation a name.
- Select a trigger for your automation.
- Choose Send via webhook as your automation's action.
- Enter the URL the webhook should send a notification to under Target URL. Every time your automation is triggered (e.g. a customer fills out a form on your site) the webhook sends data to the URL you've specified.
- Choose whether the webhook should send all available data to the URL or only certain data:
  - All keys and values: All data from the trigger is sent to the target URL. For example, if the trigger is Wix Forms, the webhook sends data from every form field. Tip: Click View Structure to see all the data that the webhook will send. When you're done, click Got It.
  - Customize structure: Only specific data is sent to the target URL. For example, if your trigger is Wix Forms you might only want to send the Name and Email fields. Click Customize structure next to Add your own keys and values. Enter a key name in the Key field. This helps you distinguish what data is sent. Click Insert Variable next to Value to choose the data that should match the key. (Optional) Click + Add Key-Value to add another row and match key names to data. Note: If you choose not to map a specific key to a value, the webhook will notify the URL without any additional information from the trigger. When you're done, click Save.
- Click the Timing drop-down to select a timing for your automation.
- Click Activate or Save.

title: How can I add Alt Text to images in a Wix repeater item?
content: Click the repeater in the Editor, click the image, then click the Settings icon. Under What's in the image? Tell Google, enter a short description of the image. In repeater items, the Alt Text is the image description, which helps search engines "read" the images.

title: How can I restore deleted collections from a backup in my CMS?
content: To restore deleted collections from a backup in your CMS: go to CMS in your site's dashboard; click More Actions at the top; click Backups; click Restore next to the backup you want to restore; select the checkbox next to each collection you want to restore; click Restore [#] Collections; click Yes, I am sure to confirm you want to permanently override changes made after the backup creation date; click Restore. When you restore a backup, you can choose whether to restore all your collections or specific ones. Restoring a collection permanently deletes any changes made to the collection after the backup was created, including site visitor submissions saved after the backup date.

title: What should I do if my Wix Video is pausing or skipping during playback for both me and my site visitors?
content: Follow the troubleshooting steps in the Wix Technical Assistant guide. If issues still persist after following all the troubleshooting steps, delete and re-upload the video to your video library. If the video is from an external platform (e.g. YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook), disable all privacy settings before trying to embed. If you still need help, contact Wix with what happened, what you have already tried, and the name and file type of the problematic file.

title: Can I convert plans sold offline to online plans by updating the customer's payment method?
content: You can now convert plans you sell offline to online plans by updating your customer's payment method.

title: How can I use grids in Editor X to create complex layouts?
content: The Grid element in Editor X is an actual CSS grid. You can use it to create complex layouts while defining their responsive behavior. You can choose the number or size of columns and rows for each breakpoint so the composition is always pixel-perfect. When setting the size of columns, rows and gaps (gutters), you can use fixed and fluid measurements such as px, percentage, fr and more. Note: It is not possible to connect CSS grid elements to content collections.

title: How can I show or hide the document title in the mobile view using the Wix Editor?
content: Click the document in the mobile editor. Click the Settings icon. Click the toggle next to Show the title to show or hide the document's title. Enabled: The document title is displayed on the document on your mobile-friendly view. Disabled: The document title is not displayed on the document on your mobile-friendly view.

title: Can I add the same contact to multiple steps in a workflow?
content: Currently, you can only add a contact to a single step in a workflow. Since each contact is linked to a card, you can move them to another step by moving the card. However, you cannot create a new card under a different step for the same contact. Exception: It is possible to have the same contact in two workflow columns if one of these columns is the "final step" (e.g. "Paid & Completed") or archive column (these columns indicate that the contact has moved through the workflow and appear to the right of a dividing line).

title: Is it possible to add a 'Save to Pinterest' button to blog posts on mobile?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a "Save to Pinterest" button to blog posts on mobile. However, you can enable social icons for Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn on your mobile blog posts.

title: Can I connect an Accordion in the Studio Editor to the CMS?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to connect the Accordion element to the CMS (Content Management System).

title: How can I add and customize text in the Studio Editor?
content:
To add text in the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, then click Text. Drag a text element on to your page. You can use Text Themes, Collapsible Text, Text Marquee, or Text Mask. Click Edit text and type your text. The Studio Editor uses your browser's spell check whenever you add text to a site.

To format your text, select the relevant text element in the editor and click Edit Text. In the Inspector, use the available tools to apply a Theme from the Site Styles panel, choose a Font, set Responsive behavior and Font size, adjust Spacing, Color, Blend mode, and Styles, use Alignment and Formatting, set Capitalization, Orientation, and Shadow, choose a Heading tag so search engines and screen readers read the page in the correct order, and use the Link icon to hyperlink the text. You can format and style your text differently per breakpoint so it looks ideal for every screen.

To change the bullet or numbering color, select the relevant text element in the editor, click Edit Text, choose a color for your bullets or numbers, highlight the entire text inside the text box including any bullets or numbers and select the color you want, then highlight the relevant text without its bullet or number and select a different color for the text.

title: How can I set up shipping rates by product in Wix Stores?
content:
Before you begin: If you previously set up shipping (and tax) in a merchant account (e.g., PayPal), remove these settings before starting.

1. Go to the Shipping & fulfillment settings in your site's dashboard. Create or select the shipping region: click the region you want to set up to edit a default rule, or click Add Region, then +Add destination and select a country. Optionally select specific regions within a country, rename the region, and click Done.
2. Click Shipping and select Rate by Product from the Select how shipping is calculated drop-down. Create product groups: click Create Groups, give the first group a name (e.g., Default), and click Next; use the Setting icon, select +Add New Group, give the group a name (e.g., Heavy), and click Add Group. Assign each product to a group by selecting the relevant group from the drop-down, then click Done.
3. Set shipping rates for product groups: enter a title in the Shipping Option Name field (e.g., Standard Shipping), optionally enter the estimated delivery time, and enter the shipping fees for each product group. Optionally offer free shipping when customer buys over a certain amount and enter the amount. Optionally click +Add Another Delivery Option and set delivery times and rates.
4. Select advanced settings: choose how to apply the shipping rates at checkout—Apply group rate to each product in the order, Apply group rate once for all products ordered from a group, or Apply the highest group rate once to the entire order. Optionally add a handling fee to every order.
5. After saving your shipping rule, optionally select the region again to add local delivery or pickup options.
6. Optionally set up additional regions by following the same instructions and skipping product group creation. After choosing a new region and selecting Rate by Product from the drop-down, enter the name, time, and rates for each delivery option you want to set up; the product groups are already there.

title: How can I add a favicon to my Wix site?
content:
To add a favicon to your site, you need a Premium plan and a connected domain, and you need to publish your site before you can add a favicon. Note that it is not guaranteed that your site will get a favicon in Google search results.

To add a favicon:
- Go to Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click Website Settings.
- Click Update Image under Favicon.
- Select an image, or click Upload Images to upload one from your computer.
- Click Choose File.
- Click Save.

Tips for a good quality favicon:
- Make sure your favicon looks good at a resolution of 16x16px as Google rescales favicons to that size. Wix Photo Studio can help you edit image.
- Use a .jpg or .png image file.
- Your favicon should be a 1:1 image ratio (a square shape). Google recommends a multiple of 48px square, e.g. 48x48px, 96x96px, 144x144px etc.

After you add or update a favicon, search engines will update their version the next time that they crawl your site. If you want to try to speed up the process, you can submit your homepage's URL to search engines. Google will not show any favicon that it deems inappropriate.

title: How can I add and manage multiple languages on my Wix site using Wix Multilingual?
content:
To add and manage multiple languages on a Wix site with Wix Multilingual:
- Choose whether to translate your content manually or automatically, and decide whether to make the new language available to visitors or keep it hidden while you're working on it.
- In the Studio Editor, use the drop-down menu showing the current language in the top bar to select a language to work on, or click Manage Languages to access the Multilingual dashboard.
- Use the newly added languages dropdown at the top of your editor to access the translation panel, where you can translate your site's content automatically or manually.
- Translate both your site and apps content in one place on your site's dashboard using the Translation Manager. Add and translate languages as your customer base and business grow.
- Choose what languages to show or hide, and delete any languages that you no longer wish to display.
Important: Once you've selected your site's main language, you cannot change it to a different language. You can vote for this feature. We recommend reviewing the list of translatable content before translating your site and learning more about what apps can and can't be translated with Wix Multilingual.
Tip: Wix Multilingual affects your site's regional settings, automatically adjusting the date format, numbers, and other metrics to that specific locale.

title: Can I offer a one-time appointment set on a specific date in Wix Bookings?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to offer a one-time Appointment set on a specific date.

Tip: You can create a class or course and set the maximum number of participants to 1. Then create a one-time session by adding the class or course through the Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard.

title: How do I connect my Airbnb account to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
Before connecting, ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, as this integration overwrites your Airbnb.com calendar.

To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Airbnb:
- Go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
- Click Connect next to Airbnb.
- Click Connect with Airbnb.
- Log in to the Airbnb extranet.

Note: Please log in to Airbnb using the main host login information. You should not have another Airbnb account open in your browser during this process because it will automatically connect to that account.

Review the permissions and then click Allow.

Note: If the system does not allow you to connect, check in your Airbnb extranet if another channel manager is already connected under Account, Privacy & sharing, Services.

title: How can I add and set up online programs on my Wix site to generate extra income?
content: To add and set up Online Programs on your Wix site, add Online Programs to your site; some Wix templates already include Online Programs. Upgrade your site so people can start joining your program. Use the Learning Management System (LMS) to add certificates, quizzes, content dripping, and connected groups in one place, and use detailed analytics to understand how your program is performing. Offer online courses and step-by-step programs, choosing from scheduled programs or self-paced ones. If you are a personal coach, you can create a 30-day challenge for your clients and use the coaching sessions option in Wix Bookings. To generate extra income, display your expertise and earn passive income, and choose flexible payment options such as one-time payments or pricing plans. You can also combine other Wix apps, such as Wix Stores and Wix Payments, with Wix Online Programs.

title: How can I delete the original Wix Hotels from my site?
content: To delete the original Wix Hotels from your site, click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor. Hover over the Hotel page and click the Show More icon. Click Delete, then click Delete in the confirmation window. Note: Deleting Wix Hotels does not cancel your Premium Plan.

title: How can I start using Google Analytics with my Wix Stores and view the event data?
content: To start using Google Analytics with Wix Stores, install Google Analytics on your site and enable Enhanced eCommerce in Google Analytics. To see the event data in Google Analytics, sign in to your Google Analytics, click Conversions in the left-hand side, click Ecommerce, and select the report you want to view. You can see all of the events by clicking Behavior and then Events. It can take a few days until the reports start receiving data.

title: Is it possible to duplicate a collection in the CMS?
content: Currently, in the CMS (Content Management System) it is not possible to duplicate a collection to create a copy. Workaround: You can export a collection as a CSV file, then import the file to a new collection to create copy of the original collection.

title: How can I delete my workspace in Wix Studio?
content: Only the workspace owner can delete a workspace. Before deleting it, move the sites in the workspace to the Trash. If the workspace has Premium plans, subscriptions, or domains, cancel or transfer them first; if you cancel a subscription, wait for it to expire. To remove services, go to Premium Subscriptions in your workspace, click More Actions next to the relevant subscription, and click Cancel Plan/Domain/Mailbox/App. For an external domain, go to Domains, click More Actions next to the relevant domain, and click Remove from Wix. To move sites to Trash, go to Sites, click More Actions next to the relevant site, click Move to trash, and confirm by clicking Move to Trash; repeat for all remaining sites. Once sites are in the Trash and existing Premium services and domains are canceled, you can delete the workspace. Deleting a workspace permanently deletes all projects, settings, and data associated with it and cannot be undone. If you only belong to one workspace and delete it, you will also close your account.

title: How can I update the typography on my client's site using the Studio Editor?
content: Click Site Styles on the left side of the editor and select the Typography tab. Choose what you want to customize: a font or a text style. To update a font, click the font under Fonts, select a new font from the drop-down, and click Update. To update a text style, click the text style under Text styles, then customize the font, font size, scale proportionally with maximum and minimum size in px, bold and/or italic, line and character spacing, and text color. Return to the main panel by clicking the Arrow icon at the top left.

title: How can I set a redirected domain as my site's primary domain on Wix?
content: Go to your Domains page. Click Set as Primary next to the domain you're setting as your primary domain. Click Set as Primary Domain. Allow 24 hours for the redirection to propagate: for the first 24 hours, the site is available under two domain names (both the primary and redirected domain). After 24 hours, the URL in your browser's address bar changes to your primary domain when you enter your redirecting domain's URL. Note: If you get an error message, check to make sure you've properly connected both your primary and redirected domains to Wix. Click the troubleshooting link on that page to troubleshoot your connections.

title: How can I create my first Site Inspection report using Wix?
content: To create your first Site Inspection report in Wix, go to your SEO Dashboard. Then select **Go to Site Inspection** under **Tools and settings**. Click **Inspect Site**. Click on a page result under **Full Report** to open a panel with more information about the page. Click **Close** to close the information panel when you're finished with it.

title: How can I duplicate my menu in Wix Restaurants to create a draft for new ideas?
content: Go to Menus in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the title of your menu. Select Duplicate menu. Click Duplicate. Review, make changes or publish your duplicated menu. All menu sections and items are duplicated, including names, descriptions, prices and images. If you're using Wix Restaurant Orders (New), modifiers, variants, tax, stock and settings are duplicated as well. You can make any edits you need on the duplicated version without affecting the original menu. Note that variants, labels and modifiers set up in the original menu are reused rather than copied, so updating them on the duplicated version also affects the original menu.

title: How can I display a single event on a Wix site page using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to the page where you want to add a single event. Click the Wix Events element on your page. Click Display Events. Select A single event. Scroll down and select the event you want to display. Note: Currently, displaying a single event is only available in the Wix Editor.

title: How can I manage individual invoices in Wix, such as editing or duplicating them?
content: To manage individual invoices, go to Invoices in your site's dashboard, then click the More Actions icon next to the relevant invoice and choose an action. To preview, click Preview to see the invoice your customer will receive. To edit, click Edit; you can edit any invoice as long as it is not marked as Paid or Void, update the relevant information, then choose Preview, Save & Close, Collect Payment, or Send Invoice. To duplicate, click Duplicate, optionally make changes, then choose Preview, Save & Close, Collect Payment, or Send Invoice. When sending, review or edit the email content and click Send. In a duplicated invoice, Issue Date, Due Date, and Invoice # update automatically.

title: How can I add the Map Plugin to my Service Page in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to your editor and open your Service Page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Bookings Pages, then click the Service Page. Click the Service Page element on your page, click the Plugins icon, hover over Map Plugin, and click + Add. Then click the Map Plugin element in your editor, click Manage Locations, and choose whether to show the Service location or your Business location. Note: You can add or update service locations in the service form. You can add business locations in Business Info in your site's dashboard.

title: How can I set up multilingual subdomains for my Wix site, and what should I be aware of?
content: A multilingual subdomain uses your site's main URL and adds a language code before the domain name, for example the French version of mystunningwebsite.com can appear as fr.mystunningwebsite.com. To get language subdomains, you must have a domain connected to your multilingual site. You can purchase the domain from Wix, or purchase it elsewhere and connect to Wix's name servers. Wix cannot create multilingual subdomains if you connect your domain to Wix through pointing. If you have more than one domain connected to your site, the subdomain is connected to your primary domain. It can take up to 48 hours for a subdomain to propagate. Page URL's using a query parameter (e.g. www.mystunningwebsite.com/about?lang=fr) are still accessible, they simply redirect to the subdomain. There is a separate sitemap for each subdomain. There is a separate robots.txt file for each subdomain which includes a reference to the corresponding sitemap.xml file. If you don't want people to reach a specific subdomain, delete the language in the multilingual dashboard. Search engines consider each subdomain site as unique and distinct from your main site, so search engine optimization on your main site may not benefit your subdomains and vice versa.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix app to my preferred language?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app, then tap your profile icon at the top. Tap App language, then tap the relevant language. Tap Save at the top right, then tap Restart for the changes to take effect.

title: Does Wix support Internet Data Exchange (IDX) integration for real estate agents?
content:
Currently, Wix does not support Internet Data Exchange (IDX) integration for real estate agents.

Alternative solutions:
* A third-party app solution, iHomefinder Real Estate, is available to download from the Wix App Market.
* With a little coding experience, you can integrate IDX from an external server using Velo by Wix.

Need some help? Check out the Velo forum or hire a Velo Expert to help you.

title: Why was my Wix Payments account closed and what happens after closure?
content: Wix may close a Wix Payments account if it deems the account to be in breach of the Wix Payments terms of service. Your account may be closed if you do not complete a request in time to provide information or documentation during onboarding or continued use, update your details, or provide further documentation. Your account will also be closed if it receives an excessive number of fraudulent transactions, or if you are selling goods or services listed in the prohibited products and services list. Once your account is closed, any credit remaining in your account is refunded to the credit card owner (the customer). You can check your Wix Payments account status at the top left of your Wix Payments dashboard. You can still access your Wix Payments dashboard even if your Wix Payments account has been disconnected.

title: Can I change the color of the footer and footer elements in email campaigns?
content: Yes. You can now change the color of the footer and footer elements in email campaigns.

title: How can I add a forum login bar to my Wix Forum site?
content: To add a forum login bar to your Wix Forum site, click the Wix forum app in your editor, click Settings, click the Display tab, and enable the Login from forum menu toggle. To use the forum as admin, log in to the forum using the email associated with your Wix account.

title: Can I add a scroll bar to text boxes in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix does not support adding a scroll bar to text boxes. Wix lists these reasons: it isn't advised in modern web design; scroll bars do not work well on touch devices such as iPads and iPhones; and it is advisable to have only one scroll bar on your site, the site scroll-bar. As an alternative, you can add CSS to an HTML element on your site and see the tutorial available at w3schools. Wix cannot provide support for external HTML codes added to Wix sites because the codes have not been tested by Wix.

title: How can I add a subscriber opt-in checkbox to my Wix form using the new forms editor?
content:
Go to your editor and click the relevant form. Click **Edit Form**. Click **Subscribe**. Click the new field in your form. Click **Settings** and customize it using the available options:

- **Checkbox message:** Update the text next to the checkbox. It should tell visitors what happens if they select the checkbox e.g. 'I want to subscribe to your newsletter,' or 'Make me a subscriber!'
- **Checked by default:** Enable the toggle so that the checkbox displays as automatically checked. Visitors must deselect it if they don't want to subscribe.
- **Required:** Enable the toggle so that visitors must fill out this field before submitting the form.
- **Enable Double opt-in:** Visitors must verify their email address before they can subscribe to your mailing list.

Once visitors select the checkbox, they are added as 'subscribers' in your contact list.

title: How can I show a page only on the mobile version of my Wix site?
content: To show a page on your mobile-friendly view only, hide the page from the menu on your desktop site, then unhide it on mobile. In the mobile editor, click Menus & Pages, click the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, and click Hide from menu. Click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the editor, click Menus & Pages, click the relevant page, click the More Actions icon, and click Show on mobile. Note: Hiding the homepage on mobile only hides it from the menu. Visiting the domain or free Wix URL on a mobile device still loads the hidden homepage.

title: How can I change the font set and size across my site using ADI?
content: To change the font set and size for your site: Click **Design** on the top bar inside ADI. Select **Fonts**. Choose how you want to customize your site font set: **Change the set:** Select a new font set from the list. **Size:** Drag the slider to make the font size as big or as small as you want. Note: Changing your site's font size does not affect the text in the header and footer. To reset a text font back to its original one, open **Design** on the top bar, select **Themes**, click **Customize Site Design**, and select **Reset**.

title: How can I hide product prices on the Category Page using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your Category page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then Store Pages, then Category Page. Click the Category Page element on your page, click Settings, and in the Settings tab deselect the Product price checkbox.

title: How can I increase the storage and bandwidth for my Wix site?
content:
You can increase your site's storage and bandwidth at any time by upgrading your site. Free Wix sites come with up to 500MB of storage and up to 1GB bandwidth. Upgrades are available for sites built on the Wix Editor and for sites built with Wix Studio.

Premium plans:

| Plan Name | Storage | Bandwidth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Light | 2 GB | Unlimited |
| Core | 50 GB | Unlimited |
| Business | 100 GB | Unlimited |
| Business Elite | Unlimited | Unlimited |

Studio plans:

| Plan Name | Storage | Bandwidth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | 10 GB | Unlimited |
| Standard | 50 GB | Unlimited |
| Plus | 120 GB | Unlimited |
| Elite | Unlimited | Unlimited |

If you need additional media storage but don't wish to change your plan, you can purchase extra storage.

title: What browsers does Wix support for desktop devices, and are there any specific version requirements?
content: Wix supports the following desktop browsers for viewing and editing sites: Google Chrome (version 92 and above), Safari for Mac (version 14 and above; the Studio Editor supports version 15 and above), Microsoft Edge (version 100 and above), and Firefox (version 91 and above). For best functionality and full access to the Editor interface, Wix recommends keeping browser zoom at 100%.

title: How can I create a new custom role for collaborators on my site?
content:
To create a new custom role for collaborators on your site:
- Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage Roles.
- Click + Create New Role.
- In Role Details, enter the Role Title and a Description of the role.
- Under Permissions, click an action to view the specific permissions for that action. Select the checkboxes for the permissions you want to include in the custom role.
- You can use the Filter search bar to find more actions.
- If all permissions within a category are required, click Select All.
- Some actions automatically enable other permissions. For example, if you let someone manage your orders, they can view your contacts by default.
- Click Save.

title: Can I delete multiple messages at once in Wix Inbox?
content: Currently in Wix Inbox, you cannot delete multiple messages at once. You can, however, select each conversation one by one and delete them individually.

title: How can I change the design of my site's header in the Wix Editor?
content: To change your header's design in the Wix Editor: Click the header. Click the More Actions icon. Click Change Header Design. Click to edit Regular or Scroll state. Use the options to customize the header design: Fill Color & Opacity: Choose a color for your header and adjust its opacity. Border: Add borders to your header to make it stand out on your page. Corners: Make the corners of your border rounder, or more square. Shadow: Add and design a shadow to give your header a cool 3D effect. Spacing: Make the spacing between your header and its offset bigger or smaller. You can also customize your header by clicking Quick Edit.

title: How can I translate CMS collection content on my Wix site using Wix Multilingual?
content:
To translate CMS collection content that appears on your live site using Wix Multilingual:
- Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your Editor.
- Click the relevant collection.
- Click More Actions at the top and select Manage translations. This opens the Translation Manager in Wix Multilingual.
- Click Add/remove collections under CMS on the left.
- Select the collection(s) you want to translate and click Save.
- Click the collection that you want to translate under CMS on the left.
- Auto-translate your entire site or each field individually:
  - Auto-translate site: Click Machine Translation at the top and select Auto-translate Site.
  - Translate each field separately: Click the relevant field under {Language} translation. Manually enter your translation for the text or click Auto-translate to have the text translated automatically. Click Done.
- Repeat these steps to translate each field.
- Click Save and Publish at the top right to make the changes go live.

Tip: Click the Restore Last Saved Translation icon to revert the translation to its last saved version.

title: How can I connect a Google 'book' button to my Wix Bookings site?
content: Before connecting, create your Google Business Profile; verification can take several days to complete. Then go to Booking Channels in your site's dashboard and click Connect under Google. Click Get Started to agree to Google's terms of use and Privacy policy. Use the Choose profiles drop-down to select the relevant Google Business profile or profiles, then click Continue. Use the Select services drop-down to select the relevant services you want to display on Google, then click Connect.

title: What should I do if my button in the Wix Editor is not working?
content: If your button is not working in the Wix Editor, try the following: click the Link icon on the button to check that it is set up correctly. Make sure no other element overlaps the button. Try disabling the freeze setting on your header and footer.

title: How do I copy and paste a page between Wix Editor sites?
content: Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor, right-click the relevant page and click Copy. Open the Editor of the site you want to paste to. Right-click anywhere on the screen and select Paste, or select Paste & Apply Site Theme to apply the color and text themes on the target site. In the Pages panel, rename the new page and click Done. You can only copy regular pages. The pasted page is always added as a main page to the Site Menu page list, even if the original was a subpage.

title: How can I manually back up my collections in the CMS?
content:
To create a manual backup:
- Go to CMS in your site's dashboard.
- Click More Actions at the top.
- Click Backups.
- Click + Add Backup.
- If necessary, click Add Backup again if you already have 3 manual backups. This replaces your oldest manual backup.

title: How can I schedule a new social media post using Wix's Social Media Marketing tool?
content: Scheduling a social post is available if you have upgraded your social media plan. Go to Social Media Marketing in your site's dashboard and click Quick Actions to choose an option. For Select media to publish, select a file or upload media, click Select media, then click Schedule for later under When do you want to publish?; use the date picker to choose the day, choose a time of day, check the time zone, click Apply, and click Schedule. For Create image with Wix, choose and customize a template, click Publish, then follow the same Schedule for later, date picker, time zone, Apply, and Schedule steps. For Create video with Vimeo, choose between Wix Video Maker or Vimeo if necessary, customize the video, click Save & Share, click Share, then follow the same Schedule for later, date picker, time zone, Apply, and Schedule steps. The final publishing status will show 'Scheduled' instead of 'Published'.

title: Can I translate my Wix Email Marketing Campaigns using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Email Marketing Campaigns with Wix Multilingual. See the list of Translatable Content in Wix Multilingual to learn what content can be translated.

title: What should I do if I see an error message when trying to connect my payment provider on Wix?
content: If you see the error message "This payment provider is currently unavailable. Reload the page and try again." when trying to connect your payment provider, try the following steps: refresh the page and try connecting again; clear your cookies and cache and try connecting again; make sure your credentials are correct; make sure your provider account is in active mode (not test mode); check with your provider that there are no holds or restrictions on your account; and check that your currency is matched. The currency used in your payment provider account must match the currency that you set in your Wix site. To change currency, either learn how to change your currency in Wix or contact your provider to change currency settings in their platform. Note: Some payment providers, such as PayU India, require your account to be created using a specific connection available through Wix.

title: How can I customize the design of a Wix form to improve accessibility?
content:
To customize the form's design:
1. Select the form in your editor.
2. Click Settings.
3. Select Design.
4. Choose which part of the form you want to customize:

Fields:
- Select Form Fields.
- Select Hover from the drop-down menu.
- Change the field design:
  - Fill color & opacity: Set the color of the field background and drag the slider to change the opacity.
  - Border color & opacity: Set the color and opacity of the field border.

Buttons:
- Select Buttons.
- Select the button you want to customize (Submit, Back, Upload, etc.).
- Click the Hover tab.
- Change the button's design:
  - Text color: Set the color of the button text in the hover state.
  - Color & opacity: Set the color of the button background and drag the slider to change the opacity.
  - Border color & opacity: Set the color and opacity of the button's border.

Tips:
- You should also customize the form fields in the Error state to ensure improved accessibility.
- Learn more about colors and contrast in site accessibility.

title: How can I edit a section in ADI and what additional customization options are available?
content:
To edit a section in ADI:

- Click the section you want to edit.
- Click **Edit**.
- Edit the content in the section.

### Additional customization options

- You can change the layout of your section by clicking **Design**.
- You can show or hide different elements from the section by clicking the **Show/Hide** icon.
- You can duplicate, move, or delete the section by clicking the **Show More** icon.

title: How can I upgrade my Business Phone Number plan on Wix?
content: To upgrade your Business Phone Number, go to Business Phone Number in your site's dashboard to access your settings. Click Upgrade Phone Plan in the Automations tab. You can also upgrade your plan from the Call Agents tab. Choose a subscription period: Billed Yearly or Billed Monthly. Click Select under the plan you want. Enter your payment details. (Optional) Enter promo code if you have one. Click Submit Purchase. Currently, the packages available for purchasing in the US and Canada are Local Basic, Local Plus, and Local Premiere.

title: How can I enable or disable push notifications in the Check-in by Wix app?
content: Open the Check-in by Wix app. Tap the Profile icon at the top. Tap Notification settings. If you have multiple sites, choose the relevant site. Tap the Allow Push Notifications toggle to enable or disable the relevant notifications. When enabled, choose the notifications you want to receive by enabling the specific toggles. If you're disabling a notification, choose how long you want to mute notifications for. When disabled, all notifications are disabled; choose how long you want to mute the notifications for.

title: How can I add a Program Manager to my online program?
content: To add a Program Manager to your online program, click **Add New Instructor**, select **Program Manager**, click **Continue**, enter their email, and click **Send Invite**. This invites the selected individual to join your program as a Program Manager, allowing them to oversee online courses and manage course offerings.

title: How can I expand my product list using dropshipping in Wix Stores?
content: Connect to a dropshipping or print-on-demand service and select the products you want to add to your store. When a customer buys a product, the dropshipper ships the product directly to the customer. Dropshipping options include Modalyst, Spocket, Printful, and Printify.

title: How can I create a new custom report in Wix Analytics?
content:
Before creating a new report, you must upgrade your Wix site to the Business Elite plan (for Wix Editor users) or an Elite plan (for Studio users).

To create a new report:
- Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon at the top right and select Create a custom report.
- Click Get Started.
- Add your report name and description.
- Click Create Your Report.

title: What steps should I follow to change my domain after purchasing a Premium or Studio site plan on Wix?
content: Once you've upgraded to a Premium or Studio site plan, you are eligible to connect your own domain and remove "Wix" from the URL. Important: Your domain is not automatically changed once you upgrade to a site plan. You must connect your own domain for the domain name to change. If you haven't yet purchased your own domain, you can purchase one directly from Wix. Additionally, with selected yearly site plans, you receive a voucher to get a free domain for a year.

title: Can I create a negative balance invoice for refunded or returned products or services in Wix?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create a negative balance invoice when crediting a customer account to correct a payment error or for a product/service that was refunded or returned (e.g. refunded store orders, items returned by your customer). While you can't issue an invoice reflecting a refund, you can issue a refund through Wix Payments.

title: How can I add a new item to a list section in ADI?
content: Click the section that contains the list items inside ADI. Click the Edit icon. Click Add Item. Click the new item name that you just added. Enter the details of your item.

title: How can I ensure my clients receive video conferencing links in their confirmation emails for online services in Wix Bookings?
content: If you recently switched to the latest version of Wix Bookings, clients may receive both a confirmation email and a second email containing the video conferencing link. To make sure clients receive the links, disable your normal confirmation emails by going to Booking Settings, clicking Emails & SMS Reminders, and disabling the toggle next to Confirmation email. Then create an automated email: go to Automations, choose + New Automation and + Start from Scratch, select Wix Bookings, choose Session booked as the trigger, choose Specific services, select the relevant online services, click Apply, choose Send an email, and edit the template. Add Text with wording such as "Video conference link:" or "Online lesson link:", add a Dynamic Value and select Video Conference URL, optionally enter fallback text, and click Save & Publish. If you use Zoom with password protection, optionally add Video Conference Password and enter the password. Note that if you select specific services, no confirmation email will send for the remaining services, so it is recommended to apply the automated email to all services; you can also create a second automation for offline services without adding the video conference link. Clients can unsubscribe from automated emails but not from Booking confirmation emails.

title: How can I change the browser tab title for my live site in the Wix Editor?
content: By default, your page's title tag is displayed as the title in your browser tab. To change the browser tab title for your live site, go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO basics, enter the page title under Title tag, and then publish your site. Note: adding custom code to your site may affect your browser tab title, so try removing any custom code you added to your site if you see an incorrect browser tab title.

title: Is the feature to close the Expand Mode by clicking the back button supported in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, clicking the back button on your browser tab returns you to the previous page you visited, and not the main gallery view. To close the Expand Mode, click the Exit icon on the top right of the gallery. Tip: Customize your Expand Mode icons to increase their visibility.

title: Can I customize booking emails with automations from the Wix app?
content: Currently, you can use Wix Automations to create custom booking emails. However, this option is not available from the Wix app.

title: How can I resolve a soft 404 error in Google Search Console for a page with meaningful content?
content: If your affected pages have meaningful content, use the URL Inspection Tool to request reindexing for your page by submitting your page's URL. If the pages are not supposed to appear in search results, you can ignore the error message. Soft 404 errors are sometimes caused by a lack of organic or unique content on a page. To resolve this issue, optimize your affected pages' content for SEO, ensuring that your pages' content contains unique and organic text, and add alt text to your images too. Learn more about optimizing your site's content for SEO.

title: Can I add Wix Hotels using ADI?
content: Currently you cannot add Wix Hotels inside ADI. If you want to make a site for your hotel, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions here.

title: What apps are recommended for musicians to use on their Wix site to share and sell music?
content: Wix recommends using apps from the Wix App Market to introduce, share, and sell your music and let visitors know about upcoming performances. Recommended apps include Wix Music, which lets you showcase albums, tracks, and playlists and allows visitors to listen and buy your music; Bandsintown, which displays tour dates and lets you sell tickets to performances; and SoundCloud, which lets you use a SoundCloud player to share a track or playlist on your site. You can also check the full range of music apps.

title: I would like to know how many sites I can have.
content: With Wix, you're not just limited to creating a single site. You can create as many as you need to manage multiple businesses, separate your personal site or blog, or experiment with different designs. If you reach the limit of free sites you can have within your account, you can move old sites to trash or upgrade your sites to Premium. Important: Premium plans are valid for a single site only. To make use of Premium features on a second site, you'll need to purchase a second Premium plan.

title: How can I reactivate a canceled Premium or Studio site plan on Wix before the subscription ends?
content: To reactivate your Premium or Studio plan, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account and click Turn Auto Renew On under the relevant subscription. If the subscription has already ended, you can simply purchase a new plan. Note: Site plans canceled during the 14-day money back period are canceled immediately. This means they cannot be reactivated by turning the auto renew back on. You can go ahead and upgrade the site again to purchase a new plan.

title: How can I print restaurant orders using a thermal printer from the Wix app?
content: Connect a thermal printer to the Wix app. Once the printer is connected, orders are automatically printed when you have the app open. You can see the list of supported thermal printers by Star and Epson.

title: What are the terms of service for using Wix Payments in Canada?
content: For Canada, the relevant terms are the Wix Payments Terms of Service and the Stripe Canada Terms of Service. When you open a Wix Payments account, you accept all Terms of Service that may apply in your region.

title: Can I create subcategories under main categories in Wix Blog?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create subcategories under your main categories in the Wix Blog to help you organize and structure your content. Tip: You can add new categories and manage existing ones by renaming and reordering them. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

title: How do I set up shipping, delivery, and pickup in Wix Stores?
content: Go to the Shipping & fulfillment settings in your site's dashboard. Set up the regions you want to ship to, then select and configure a shipping rule such as Free shipping, Flat Rate, Rate by Weight, Rate by Price, Rate by Product, or USPS Calculated Rate. You can also offer Local Delivery and Local Pickup, and add additional shipping options. Customers select the shipping option they prefer in the Cart (if you enabled the cart shipping display) or on the Checkout Page.

title: How can I enable and customize a search function for my blog on the Wix app?
content:
In the Wix app, go to your site and tap Site & App at the bottom. Tap Customize under Members App, tap + Add Element, tap Blog, scroll down and tap Blog Search. Enable the Element Title toggle to add the search option to the top of your site on the member apps, enter the name for the menu item, tap Add, then tap Done.

To customize the search settings, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Blog under Content & Community, tap Page Settings, then tap Search at the top. Enable the toggles to set what your readers can search for: Posts, Categories, Tags and Authors. Tap Edit next to Info Shown on Results, select the features that you want to appear in the search results, and tap Save.

title: How can I ensure that my OBS settings are correct for live streaming on Wix Video?
content:
To ensure your OBS settings are correct for live streaming on Wix Video:
- Open the OBS Studio Encoder on your computer.
- Click Settings on the bottom right.
- Select the Output tab to change the codec, audio, and video bitrates.
- Select the Video tab to change the video resolution.
- Click OK.

For best results, make sure you do not exceed the following settings:
- Video Resolution: 720p (1280x720)
- Codec: x264
- Video bitrate: ~2500 kbps
- Audio bitrate: AAC 44.1kHz ~128kbps

Also ensure that your encoder is set to software:
- Open the OBS Studio Encoder on your computer.
- Click Settings on the bottom right.
- Click Output on the left.
- Check that the Encoder setting is set to Software.
- Click OK.

Make sure the output is set to 'Simple' as well, as setting it to 'Advanced' can cause issues with the live stream.

title: How can I set a submission limit for my Wix form to stop accepting entries after a certain number or date?
content: To limit form submissions, click the form in your editor, click Form Settings on your form, click Settings, then click Form Submission Limit. Choose Allow unlimited submissions, Limit number of submission, or Limit form submissions by specific date & time. For a submission number limit, enter the total number of submissions you want to receive and review or edit the message that replaces the form once the limit is reached. For a date and time limit, click the calendar icon to select a date, select a 24H or 12H time format, and write the last hour your visitors can submit the form by. If you select the 12H time format, include AM or PM in the time. This feature is only available for old Wix Forms, and the option to limit form submissions is only available once your form is published on your site. If you have not published your site since adding the form, click Publish now. If your limit was 100, and you changed it to 150, you will now be able to receive additional 150 form submissions from the moment you click Publish.

title: How can I adjust the settings of an image that was carried over from my desktop site to my mobile site?
content: Click the image in your mobile editor. To change its settings, click the Settings icon and choose from the available options: use Reset Image Proportions to reset the image's original proportions; use Image Behaviors to decide how visitors interact with images; and set what happens when an image is clicked, such as Nothing happens, A link opens, It opens in a popup, or It can be magnified. You can also crop the image or add an image animation. If needed, you can add and customize mobile-only images from the mobile editor by clicking Add to Mobile on the left of the mobile editor, clicking Image, selecting the image type you want to add, clicking the image you want to upload, and clicking Add to Page.

title: Can I view a site visitor's IP address in Wix Analytics reports?
content: You can view by IP address in Wix Analytics traffic reports. In your site's dashboard, go to Reports, click the relevant traffic report, and in Table view click Select columns. Scroll down and select the IP address checkbox.

title: What should I do if I receive an Editor Error 30003 message?
content:
If you receive an Error 30003 message, it means there's an issue in the backend that may interfere with publishing your site.

If you experience this issue, please contact Customer Care so that we can resolve the error.

When contacting Wix Customer Care, include the following:
* Your site name or URL.
* The steps you took before receiving the error message.

title: How can I allow a customer to redeem loyalty points using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet. During checkout, assign a customer to the sale. Tap the customer's name. Tap **Redeem & Edit**. Select an option: if the customer already has a coupon, tap **Apply to Cart** under **Your customer's coupons**; if the customer has points but no ready coupon, tap **Get Coupon** under **Available Rewards** to create a coupon, tap **Redeem & Get Coupon**, then tap **Apply to Cart** under **Your customer's coupons**. Complete the sale.

title: How can I set up Wix Payments on my site?
content: To get started with Wix Payments, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and select Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix. Learn more about creating a Wix Payments account.

title: How can I add a Facebook Page Like box to my Wix site?
content: The Facebook Page Like box lets you promote your business' Facebook page on your site and lets visitors like your Facebook business page directly from your site. Retrieve your page ID to start getting likes on your Facebook page.

title: Can I customize different tax variables for my pricing plans, such as tax per state or country?
content: Currently, you can set one fixed tax rate for all of your plans. It is not possible to customize different tax variables (e.g. tax per state, country, or different tax groups).

title: How can I avoid losing content when editing a Wix blog post in multiple tabs?
content: Writing blog content across multiple open tabs can cause other versions of drafts to be overwritten. To avoid losing any content, it is recommended to work in one single tab. If you start writing your blog post in one tab, then open a second tab and continue writing, your content is spread across two tabs. If you go back to the first tab without closing both tabs, you will find it's still the first draft version. Once autosave triggers, a pop-up box will appear on that tab prompting you to refresh.

title: Can I use the SEO Assistant with Wix Events to optimize my event pages?
content: Currently, the SEO Assistant is not available to use with Wix Events. The Wix SEO Assistant is only available for your site pages and Wix Blog post pages.

title: How can I find out who my domain registrar is?
content: Your domain registrar is the company that hosts your domain. If you don't know who your domain registrar is, you can find out by visiting whois.com and entering your domain name to view your domain details.

title: 如何审计Amazon广告中的否定关键词列表，避免误伤有效流量？
content: 审计否定关键词列表时，先检查是否有被误否定的有效关键词、哪些短语否定可能误伤相关搜索词、建议移除哪些否定词以恢复流量、建议将哪些短语否定改为精确否定。移除建议要说明该词为何有效并以产品描述为依据；只有当短语包含与产品相关的词时才标记为有风险。精确否定词要么与产品完全不相关，要么花费 > $[X] 且零转化；短语否定需标出可能误伤有效流量的风险。两个否定列表按“预计节省 ÷ 风险”排序。精确+短语否定合计 ≤20 个词；超出部分标注“观察 3 天后再继续”；单批移除不超过 20 个否定词。最后给出预计节省月度花费总额和否定词总数。

title: How can I set the image display settings in a Product Gallery on Wix Stores?
content: Go to the relevant Product Gallery in the editor. Click the Product Gallery. Click the Settings icon. Click the Layout tab. Select an image ratio. Choose an option under How's image resized?: Crop: Images are cropped to the same size. Fit: Displays the entire image.

title: How can I display pricing plans on multiple pages of my site using the Wix Editor?
content: To display pricing plans on multiple pages of your site using the Wix Editor, you can use either the Add panel or the Pricing Plans settings panel. From the Add panel: click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor; click Payments; choose whether to display a Plan List or a Single Plan and drag the element onto the page; select the plans you want to display by clicking the element in the Editor, clicking Settings, selecting the Plans tab, and selecting the checkboxes next to the plans you want to display; then customize the design and layout of your new Pricing Plans widget. From the Settings panel: go to the Pricing & Plans page in your Editor; click the Pricing Plans app on the page; click Settings; click the Add-Ons tab; click the Add to Page drop-down next to Plan List or Single Plan; select the page where you want the widget to appear; select the plans you want to display on the new page by clicking the new Pricing Plans widget in your Editor, clicking Settings, selecting the Plans tab, and selecting the checkboxes next to the plans you want to display; then customize the design and layout of your new Pricing Plans widget. If you want to add the plans to a new page, first add a new page to your site. If you add a folder to your site menu, you cannot display plans on pages that are in that folder.

title: How can I check my monthly email marketing balance on Wix?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Under Monthly balance you can view your current balance as well as a progress bar that shows how close you are to the limit.

title: How can I add and customize the Featured Members list on my Wix site?
content:
To add the Featured Members element, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Community, click Featured Members, then drag the Featured Members element onto your page.

To manage the member list, click the Featured Members element in your Editor, click Members, search for a member by typing their name in the search bar or scrolling through the list, hover on the member, click the More Actions icon, and click Show. You can also use drag and drop to change the order, or click Hide after More Actions to remove a featured member.

To select details shown, click the Featured Members element, click the Elements icon, and select checkboxes for Image, Role description, Company name, About, and Link.

To design the list, click the Featured Members element, click the element again to select a container box, click the Design icon, and adjust Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, and Shadow.

To change layout, click the Featured Members element, click Preset, and choose Cards or Side by side.

Important: As of January 2024, we're no longer actively maintaining the Featured Members element. Suggested alternatives include a repeater or the Pro Gallery, a pre-designed strip or section featuring the team, or the Staff Member widget.

title: How can I view my Customer Care ticket log in Wix Studio?
content: In your Wix Studio workspace, go to Customer Care Tickets. Search for a ticket or use the filter to narrow the tickets by the reporter, sites, and ticket status. Hover over a ticket and click View to see the conversation with Wix Customer Care.

title: How do I set up a dynamic ad for my Facebook shop using Wix Stores?
content: You can set up dynamic ads in your Facebook Ads Manager.

title: What can I do with the Wix app as a site owner?
content:
From the Wix app you can:

* Set up and customize your site on the member apps
* Manage all aspects of your business
* Communicate with your members and live site visitors
* View your site's analytics
* Promote your business with email campaigns

title: How can I hide or reorder fields in my CMS collection view?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection. If you have multiple collection views, select the relevant collection view at the top. Click Manage Fields. To show or hide fields, click the checkboxes next to the relevant fields. To reorder fields, click and drag the Reorder icons next to the fields. To edit, duplicate, or delete a field, hover over it and click the More Actions icon.

title: How can I access my Google Business Profile Insights in my Wix account?
content: In your Wix site's dashboard, go to Marketing & SEO. Click Google Business Profile on the left menu. Click Insights on your Google Business Profile profile.

title: How can I organize my multiple Wix sites into folders?
content:
Go to Sites in your Wix account. Click **Create New Folder** at the top right. Enter a name for the folder and click **Create**.

**Tip:** You can move one folder into another to create a subfolder.

To move a site to a folder: go to Sites in your Wix account, click the **Site Actions** icon next to the site you want to move, select **Move to Folder**, then select the relevant folder.

**Tip:** Click **New Folder** to create a new one on the spot, then click **Move Here**.

title: Can I create a brand book using the New Wix Logo Maker?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a brand book that details your brand guidelines in the New Wix Logo Maker. You can, however, review your logo's color guide once you download your logo, and view the colors and fonts you used.

title: What happens if my credit card expires before my Wix subscription renewal, and how can I update my payment details?
content: Wix participates in Visa® and MasterCard® account update services whereby banks may notify Wix of changes to credit card expiration dates and card numbers held by users. This means Wix automatically updates your saved credit card information so that Wix can renew your subscriptions as scheduled. Similar services may be supported by other card brands. If your card has expired or if your renewal payment has failed or declined, you can update your card details.

title: How does Wix ensure compliance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) for its users?
content: Wix has worked with a team of experts and has implemented the required adjustments to its products, services, and documentation to ensure compliance with the LGPD. This empowers Wix customers to get more control over their personal data and gain the tools necessary to protect the information of visitors to Wix sites. In accordance with the LGPD, site visitors have the right to access their data or to be permanently deleted from your databases. Wix has developed tools to assist you in becoming LGPD compliant: the right to access and the right to be deleted.

title: How can I set up a payment form on my Wix ADI site to accept payments?
content: Before you begin, accepting payments with Wix Forms is only available with Business and eCommerce Premium plans. In ADI, go to the page where you want the form, hover over Add at the top, click Section to Page, scroll down to Forms and choose a type of form, then pick a section design and click and drag it onto your site. Click the section with the form, click Edit next to Form at the bottom of the section panel, click Form Settings, click Get Started under Get paid with this form, and choose a type of payment form: Single item, List of items, or Visitors enter price. Then click Connect Payment Method and connect a payment method from Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Once a payment method is connected, click Next on the form and click Done to finish setup. You can change the payment method and remove it at any time by clicking the Settings icon next to Payment Settings status and choosing an option.

title: How can I enable or disable the 'Skip to Main Content' feature on my Wix site?
content: Skip to main content is automatically enabled on all sites you build with Wix. It appears as a link when visitors navigate the page using the Tab key. To check or change the setting in Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Settings at the top and select Accessibility Wizard, click the More Actions icon at the top of the Accessibility Wizard panel, select Advanced accessibility settings, click Skip to main content, and select the toggle to enable or disable the feature. Enabled: Skip to main content is displayed on your live site and is the first link visitors see while using keyboard navigation. Disabled: Skip to main content is not displayed on your live site. You can test by opening the live site or site preview and navigating the page using your keyboard's Tab key. If the link does not appear on the preview or live version of your Wix Editor site, check and change the settings from the Accessibility Wizard. On Studio Editor sites, it is not possible to disable Skip to main content.

title: How can I manually adjust the docking of an element in the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant element. Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Scroll down to Position. Click the relevant docking points (top, bottom, right or left). Alternatively, click the Align to center icon so the element is always in the center. Note: This automatically deselects the Element auto docks checkbox.

title: How can I change my account email or password in my Wix account?
content: Sign in to your Wix account. Click your profile at the top right corner and select Account Settings. Under Login info, edit your account email or password and set up your recovery phone number.

title: How can I enable or disable a payment method on my checkout using the site's dashboard?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant payment method. Click the toggle to enable or disable the payment method. Confirm your choice.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site is accessible and complies with regional laws?
content: You can use external tools to review your site's accessibility and get suggestions for improvement. Wix has created a guideline that lists their recommendations. Because each country and region has different laws, Wix recommends having your site reviewed by an Accessibility Advisor to make sure it complies with the requirements for your region.

title: How can I manually submit my Wix site's sitemap to Google Search Console?
content: In Google Search Console, select your site from the drop-down, select Sitemaps, enter the URL slug of the sitemap you want to submit under Add a new sitemap (for example, sitemap.xml to submit the sitemap for your entire site), and click Submit.

title: What should I do if I'm not receiving email notifications from Wix Bookings?
content: If you or your staff are not receiving emails from Wix Bookings, check that your MX records are set up correctly and your domain is properly connected if you use your domain's email address. Confirm that your email address in Business Info under Location & Contact Info is correct, and that staff email addresses in Staff are correct. Send a test email from Booking Settings under Emails & SMS notifications using Preview & Test to verify that you can receive emails. Check your spam or junk folder for messages from appointments@wixbookings.com and whitelist that address if needed. If the test email still does not arrive, contact your email provider to ask whether Wix notification emails are being blocked and request whitelisting. Note that email notifications are not sent for bookings made in preview mode.

title: Can I set the responsive behavior for multiple elements at once in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to select multiple elements and change the responsive behavior for all of them at once.

title: How can I view and manage my blocked numbers list for my Business Phone Number using the Wix dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Business Phone Number. Click the General tab. Scroll down to Blocked Numbers and click View Numbers to see your blocked numbers list. To unblock a number, hover over it in the list, click Unblock, then click Unblock to confirm.

title: How can I add a custom field to my contacts in Wix?
content: To add a custom field to your contacts in Wix: Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top and select Custom fields. Click + Add New Field. Click the Field Type drop-down and select the type of content: Text, Number, Date, or URL. Enter the name of the new field (e.g. "Date of Birth") in the Field Name field. Click Add. Click Done. Any custom field that you add is automatically added to all contacts in your Contact List.

title: Is it possible to navigate between different states in a custom panel using tabs in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to navigate between different states in a custom panel using tabs.

title: How can I set up my store gallery in Wix ADI to display specific collections and enable product filtering and sorting?
content:
To set up your store gallery in Wix ADI:

- Click the Page drop-down menu at the top of ADI.
- Click **Shop**.
- Hover over your Product Gallery and click **Settings**.
- Click the **Full Width** toggle to enable or disable it.
- **Display a Collection:** Click a collection to display it on your Shop page.
- **Image Ratio:** Click the drop-down menu and select a ratio for your images.
- **Image Scaling:** Click the drop-down menu and choose how your images are scaled:
  - **Crop Image:** Cuts the images to fit the image space in the gallery.
  - **Scale to Fit:** Fits the images in the image space in the gallery.
- **Filters:** Click the **Show/hide** icon to allow customers to filter your store products by collection, price and by any product options you've specified (size, color, etc).
  - (Optional) Click the **Filter By** text field to update the title shown at the top of the filtering feature in your product gallery.
- **Sorting:** Click the **Show/hide** icon to allow customers to sort your store products by newest first, price and name.
  - (Optional) Click the **Sort By** text field to update the title shown in the sorting bar of your product gallery.

title: How can I download an invoice for my Wix subscription?
content: Go to Billing History in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click View Invoice. Then click the Download icon to download your invoice or the Print icon to print your invoice. Invoices are downloaded in PDF format.

title: How can I change the text and link on a button in ADI?
content: In ADI, click the page section that contains the button, then click Edit. Enter the text for your button in the Button Text field. Click Edit Link in the Link field, select the link for your button, and click Done.

title: Can I hide the duration of an appointment on the Calendar page in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to hide the duration of an Appointment on the Calendar page. However, you can hide the duration on the Service Page and the Book Online page.

title: What are the steps to apply to join the Wix Marketplace?
content: Go to Marketplace Overview in your Wix Studio workspace. Click Apply Now. In the General Info tab, add your general business info to show potential clients, and click Next. In the Preferences tab, choose countries you'd like to get leads from and languages you support, and click Next. In the Portfolio tab, click + Add Project and add at least 5 Wix premium sites you've built, and click Next. In the Services & Rates tab, select the services you offer and enter your starting rates, and click Next. In the Your Experience tab, add additional info about your experience and work with Wix clients. Click Apply.

title: Can I use Wix's Site Search to find videos or related content in Wix Video?
content: Currently, Wix’s Site Search cannot search Wix Video, along with anything that is connected to Wix Video, such as channels, titles, description, tags, and cost.

title: How can I send an announcement as a push notification using the Wix mobile app?
content:
To send an announcement as a push notification using the Wix mobile app:

Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap **Manage** at the bottom. Tap **Mobile Announcements** under **Marketing**. Tap **Create New Announcement**. Write your announcement title and body text. (Optional) Tap the **Add** icon at the bottom left to include media in your announcement (an image, video, GIF or a divider). Tap **Next**. Preview your announcement and make sure the **Send announcement as a push notification to all members** toggle is enabled. Click **Publish**.

Your Member App's members will receive the announcement on their device if they have enabled notifications for your app.

title: How can I add a Google Map to my Wix site and set it up for multiple locations?
content:
Add a Google Map element from **Add Elements** > **Contact & Forms** > **Maps** or **Full Width Maps**, place it on your page, then click **Manage Locations** and choose **Multiple**. To set up locations:
- Hover over the default (**Wix Office**) location and click the **More Actions** icon, then click **Edit**.
- Enter the location details: **Address**, **Title**, **Description**, **Link**, and **Link text**. A link cannot point to a lightbox, anchor, or the top/bottom of the page.
- Click the **Back** icon at the top left.
- Click **Add Location**, enter the location details, and click the **Back** icon at the top left. Repeat for each location you want to add.
- Use the **More Actions** icon next to a location to edit, duplicate, or delete it.

title: Can I add a custom logo (watermark) to the videos I upload to Wix Video?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a custom logo (watermark) to the videos you upload to Wix Video. You can, however, add a custom logo to embedded videos.

title: How can I choose the right template for my Wix website?
content: Choosing the right template is like finding the perfect canvas for your online masterpiece. Wix templates are organized into categories for easy browsing: Business & Services, Store, Creative, Community and Blog. Hover over each one to discover subcategories. Templates in each category are already set up with popular design trends, layouts, features and tools that are in line with common goals in your industry. Since every template is fully customizable and free to use, it’s okay if the content isn’t an exact match for your website topic. Think about the look and feel you want for your website (e.g. bold, simple, elegant, playful), then browse multiple categories to find one that fits the style you had in mind. If you already have something specific in mind or don’t see a category that matches your needs, type what you’re looking for into the "Search all templates" search bar at the top. Wix Editor templates are organized into categories and subcategories based on business intent. Go to the Wix Editor templates page to view them.

title: How can I check the billing cycle of my Wix Premium subscription?
content: To check the billing cycle of your subscription, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account and check your subscription in the Next Payment Due column.

title: How can clients cancel or reschedule their sessions on a Wix site?
content:
When you add a Wix Members Area to your site, clients can log in and make changes to their bookings. On their personal My Bookings page, they can view upcoming and past bookings. Each of the upcoming bookings has a Reschedule and Cancel option, so clients can make changes without taking up any of your time.

Important: Clients cannot reschedule sessions paid for with different price options.

Notes:
* To avoid last-minute cancellations, set a cancellation policy that includes cancellation and no-show fees.
* Clients can also book, reschedule, or cancel attendance at their upcoming sessions using the Wix mobile member apps (Spaces, Fit, Branded, Dine).
* When clients cancel sessions booked using pricing plans, the session is added back into their pricing plan allowance.

title: Can I run multiple Facebook ad campaigns for one site using Facebook Ads?
content: Currently in Facebook Ads, it is only possible to run one ad campaign per site.

title: How can I add an app to my Wix site if it is not available in Marketing Integrations or Wix App Market?
content: If an app is not displayed in Marketing Integrations or Wix App Market, you can add it using Google Tag Manager, custom code, or Velo. With Google Tag Manager, you can integrate popular solutions such as Crazy Egg, Hotjar, and Pinterest. Many applications provide a custom code snippet that can be installed through your Wix dashboard; the third party should instruct where to place the code (head or body). Velo is a development platform created by Wix that can be used to integrate any application to your Wix site; to use Velo, you may wish to hire a professional at Wix Marketplace.

title: How can I add a background scroll effect to a strip in Wix Editor?
content: Click the strip in the editor. Click the Background Scroll Effects icon. Select a scroll effect. Optionally, preview your site to see the scroll effects in action. Important: You can only see scroll effects in preview or on your live site; the way it is displayed inside the editor is not how it looks on the live site. It is not possible to add a scroll effect to your strip if you have added columns to it. Scroll effects are not displayed on the mobile version of your site.

title: How can an admin reset the password for an additional Office 365 mailbox?
content:
If you are the owner (admin) of your Office 365 mailbox, you can change the password of your additional mailboxes. Important: This feature is currently not available to all users.

To reset the password for your Office 365 mailbox:
- Go to Business Email in your Wix account.
- Click Manage at Microsoft.
- Sign in to your mailbox: enter your email address, enter your password, and click Sign In.
- Click Users.
- Click Active Users.
- Select the checkbox next to the relevant user.
- Click Rest Password and choose one of the following: Auto-generate password, or Let me create the password.
- Select the checkbox next to Make this user change their password when they first sign in.
- Click Reset.

title: How do I manage the ribbon on a highlighted plan in Wix Pricing Plans?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your Plans & Pricing page: click Pages & Menu, then your Plans & Pricing page. Click the Plans & Pricing element and open Settings. On the Display tab, use the Show highlighted plan toggle and choose the plan. The Show ribbon toggle adds a ribbon (e.g. 'Best Value') to your highlighted plan; to remove the ribbon from the highlighted plan, turn off the Show ribbon toggle. The source only covers ribbons for highlighted plans, not removing ribbons from other individual plans.

title: Can I print my daily agenda or weekly schedule from Wix Bookings?
