content: Currently, it is not possible to print out your schedule of upcoming sessions from the Booking Calendar to display in your premises. It is possible to export reports on past bookings. If your schedule remains the same each week, you can export and print a .CSV file to display a physical copy of your weekly schedule.

title: How can I duplicate a blog post in Wix Blog?
content: To duplicate a blog post, go to the Blog tab on your site dashboard. Click the Show More icon on the published post or draft you want to duplicate. Click Duplicate Post. After duplication, a draft (unpublished) copy of the original post opens. You can edit the post and publish it when you are ready. Anyone with admin or editor privileges can duplicate any post. Contributing writers can duplicate their own posts.

title: how to cancel premium
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Cancel Plan. Click Cancel Now to confirm. Your plan will remain active until the end of the current subscription period.

title: How can I generate a title using the Wix Title Generator?
content: Go to the Title Generator. Enter your topic or keywords into the generator. Click Get Your Title. Click the copy icon next to a title to copy it to your clipboard, then paste it to your blog, articles, emails, etc. Optionally, select a subject from the drop-down to refine your search results. You can also check out the Blog Title Generator and the YouTube Title Generator to get started creating your blog and YouTube titles.

title: Can I use subscript and superscript text in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, subscript and superscript text are not supported in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can use separate text boxes to achieve a subscript or superscript effect: add a separate text element for your superscript / subscript text and enter the text, resize the text as needed and adjust the position, then stack the text elements to ensure they keep their spacing across breakpoints.

title: Is the running text (marquee effect) feature supported in Wix Editor?
content: Yes. You can now add and customize text marquee using Wix Editor.

title: Can I transfer a .co.uk domain to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer a .co.uk domain to Wix. However, you can connect a .co.uk domain, purchased from another domain host to your Wix site.

title: How can I change the order of my blog posts on Wix?
content:
Your blog posts appear in chronological order. You can change the order of your posts by changing the creation dates.

To change the date of a post:
- Click to edit a blog post or create a new one.
- Click the **Settings** icon on the left side panel.
- Click the **Publish Date** box.
- Click the date and click to select a new date from the calendar.
- Click **Save & Publish**.

**Tip:** You can also pin posts so that they stay at the top of your feed.

title: How can I share a site with clients for feedback in Wix Studio?
content: Go to Client Feedback in your Wix Studio workspace. Click "+ Get Feedback" at the top right. Choose the site to send for feedback and click "Continue." Enter the name or email address of each person you want to get feedback from. (Optional) Enter a message your clients will see when they receive the invite. Click "Send." Tip: Click "Copy Link" next to the shareable link to send it on your own. The shareable link URL is valid for 2 weeks.

title: How can I create a new service in Dayful by Wix?
content: Go to the Services tab in your Dayful dashboard. Select a template or click + Start from Scratch under the relevant service type: Appointment: a 1-on-1 session that clients book depending on availability; Class: a group session that clients book to join at any time; Course: a multi-session service that starts and ends on specific dates. Enter the Service Name. Optional: click Add Image, enter a Tagline, and enter a Description. Under Location, choose Business address for services where clients come to you, Client's place where you meet clients at their home, or Custom location for services with varying locations. Open the Price type drop-down and choose: Fixed price; Varied Prices (set a default amount, click Manage Price Options, enter a Price options label such as "Participant age" or "Service type", enter the different pricing options, optionally click + Add New Price Option, then click Save); No fee; or Custom Price (enter a description in the Price Description field; clients cannot pay online when they book custom price services). Under Payment Preferences, choose Entire amount online if you have a Dayful premium plan and want clients to pay online; Entire amount in person if you have a free Dayful plan; Entire amount either online or in person if you have a Dayful premium plan and want to offer flexible payment options; or Online deposit and the rest in person if you have a Dayful premium plan and want to reduce no-shows. Click Save.

title: How can I select overlapping elements in the Wix Editor using the Layers panel?
content: If you are having trouble selecting an element because it is behind another element, you can use the Layers panel. To select elements from the Layers panel: go to your editor; click Layers on the bottom left of the editor; click Header, Page or Footer; click the relevant element from the list. Once you have selected an element in the panel, you can customize and adjust it as needed.

title: How can I download and sell my custom templates using Wix Studio?
content: Go to Custom Templates in your Wix Studio workspace. Click the More Actions icon on the template and select Download shareable file. Click Accept and Download to accept the terms & conditions. Once downloaded, you can add your template as a digital product on your Wix site or anywhere else online to start selling. If you're a Wix Partner, you can also showcase and sell your Studio templates in the Wix Marketplace.

title: Why might there be discrepancies between Wix Analytics and Google Analytics data?
content: Discrepancies can occur because Wix Analytics and Google Analytics filter bot traffic using different algorithms. Sales and people reports differ because Wix Analytics has access to production data in your Wix site, will not show cancelled orders, and will show zero sum (free) orders, while Google Analytics relies on client events, may lose data due to network issues or cookies not being enabled, will show cancelled orders, and will not show zero sum (free) orders. Metric names are not always an exact match; for example, Users in Google Analytics equals Visitors in Wix Analytics. Time frames also differ: when Google shows stats for the last 7 days, the end date is yesterday, whereas in Wix Analytics the last 7 days time period includes today.

title: How can I hide the view counter on my Wix blog feed using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your Blog page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then Blog Pages, then your Blog page. Click the Blog Feed element, then Settings. Click the Display tab and deselect the Views counter checkbox under What shows on your feed?. Publish your site to view the changes.

title: Can site members delete their own accounts?
content:
Currently, it is not possible for members to delete their own accounts (including profile pages). Members can do this by contacting the site owner. As a workaround, your site members can use the Spaces by Wix app to leave your site. This removes them as members of your site and deletes their profile page.

### To leave a site:
- Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android).
- Type "Spaces by Wix" in the search field.
- Tap **Get** or **Install** to download the app.
- Open the app.
- Tap **I already have a Wix Account**.
- Sign in to your account.
- Tap the More Actions icon.
- Tap **Manage my sites**.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant site.
- Tap **Leave**.

title: Can I export the participant list of classes in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now export the participant list of classes.

title: How can I turn off email and SMS notifications for table reservations in Wix Restaurants?
content: To manage notifications in the Wix Table Reservations app, go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click Outgoing notifications, hover over a Wix Table Reservations notification, and click View Summary. To turn both email and SMS notifications off, click the toggle at the top for that notification. To disable a specific channel, hover over the channel you want to disable, click Edit Action, click Delete Action, then click Delete again to confirm, and click Save. Your monthly SMS message limit is determined by your SMS quota, which varies based on your site's plan; to view your quota, go to SMS Settings in your site's dashboard.

title: Which languages are currently supported in Wix Blog?
content: According to the source, Wix Blog currently supports: Bulgarian, Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Filipino (Tagalog), French, German, Greek, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian Bahasa, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, and Turkish. The source also invites users to submit a ticket with feedback and suggestions regarding additional languages.

title: How can I organize my FAQs using the Wix FAQ app?
content: Once you've created your FAQs, organize them into categories to make it easier for visitors to find an answer to a question on a particular subject. For example, you might split your FAQs into separate categories such as Delivery, Returns, and Refunds. You can choose which categories you want to display on your site.

title: Can I make my site content fade when scrolling in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to make your site content fade when you or your visitors scroll down your site. However, you can set your strip background to fade on scroll, which has a similar effect.

title: How can I add a new product to my catalog using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet, tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, tap Catalog, then tap + New Product at the top right. Enter the product name and the product price including cents. Optionally add a sale price by enabling the On Sale toggle, selecting a discount type, and entering the discount value. Upload product images by tapping the Add Images icon. Set the product's visibility using the Point of Sale toggle and the Online Store toggle. Optionally enter the product's SKU / UPC by tapping the Barcode icon and scanning the product or by entering it manually. Then either enable Track Inventory and enter the amount in the Inventory field, or disable Track Inventory and select In stock or Out of stock from the drop-down. Assign a tax group. Add the product to categories from the Categories tab, select the relevant checkboxes, and tap Done. Tap Save at the top right.

title: Can I restore translations when using Backups to restore CMS content?
content: Currently, it is not possible to restore translations when using Backups to restore CMS content.

title: Can I change the text alignment on my mobile site using ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot change the alignment of the text on your mobile site. In the meantime, you can change the text alignment from a desktop or change the design of the section which might affect the alignment of the text. If you are still experiencing an issue, you can head to the Editor.

title: What will happen to my current sites built on Editor X when Wix Studio is introduced?
content: You can keep building on Editor X for now. We’ll gradually open up the option to update sites to Wix Studio in January over several weeks. Once the update is available to everyone, we’ll close the option to create new sites on Editor X — for this reason, we highly recommend using Wix Studio for any new projects you get. Having said that, know that you’ll get plenty of notice and all the info before this happens. Note: If you've never used Editor X before, the option to create new sites is now closed.

title: How can I add a verification meta tag to my Wix site using the Site Verification Tool?
content:
Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings. Click a search engine to expand. Enter the meta tag relevant to that search engine. Click Save.

Important:
- The tag must be in a valid HTML format.
- The format should be `<meta name=”XX” content=”XX”/>`. Missing or extra attributes such as ‘<’, or ‘ “ ‘, will create an issue.
- The tag must belong to the right webmaster tool. For example, if you try to verify with Google Search Console using a Bing verification meta tag, it won't work.

title: How can I rename my Wix site and update the site address for a free site?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Site Actions, then Rename Site. Enter your new site name. For free sites only, you can optionally edit the Site Address (URL) if you want to change your site's free domain. Click Save.

title: How can I connect a domain purchased elsewhere to my Wix site using the recommended method?
content: To connect a domain purchased elsewhere to your Wix site using the recommended method, you must first upgrade your site. You also need access to your current domain registrar; if you do not know who your domain registrar is, visit whois.com and enter your domain name to see your domain details. Wix strongly recommends connecting the domain by changing its name servers. With the name server connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records while your domain remains registered with its current host, and you continue to pay for domain registration with your current domain host, not Wix. Follow the steps to connect your domain to the Wix name servers.

title: How can I add a new modifier group to a menu item in Wix Restaurants?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Menus (New). Click Manage next to the relevant menu. Click on a menu item or add a new one. Click the Modifiers tab. Click + Add Modifier Group. Either select an existing modifier group, then click Add to Item and Save, or create a new modifier group: click + New Modifier Group, enter a modifier group name (e.g. "Dips" or "Toppings"), add the first choice under Modifiers (e.g. "Salsa" or "Mushrooms"), optionally enter a price (e.g. $0.5), optionally use Preselect to set default modifiers, and optionally click + Add Modifier to add more modifiers. Under Modifier group settings, choose Optional or Required and set the minimum and maximum number of modifiers that customers can add. Click Save & Add, then click Save. Optionally, click + New modifier group to create additional modifier groups. Once you create a modifier group, you can add it to any menu item and do not need to create it again.

title: How can I add a chatbox to my site using Editor X?
content:
To add a chatbox to your site using Editor X:

- Click the App Market icon on the top of Editor X.
- Type "Wix Chat" in the search field and press Enter.
- Click Wix Chat.
- Click Add to Site.

Once added, a minimized chat bar appears at the bottom right corner of your Editor. You can then go to your inbox to view and reply to all chat messages, and initiate chats with live site visitors to keep them engaged.

title: How can I connect iDeal as a payment method through Stripe on my Wix site?
content:
To connect iDeal as a payment method through Stripe, if iDeal is available in your location, follow these steps:

- Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard.
- Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to iDeal.
- Click Connect next to Stripe.
- Click Connect.
- Select an option:
  - Have a Stripe account: Sign in to connect your account.
  - Don't have an account: Sign up to create / claim your Stripe account.
- Note: After successfully completing the setup process, you will receive a confirmation email to the email account associated with your Stripe account. Wait for this email before continuing to set up local payments.
- Set up local payments (through iDeal) in your Stripe account:
  - Go to Stripe.
  - Click Settings.
  - Click Activate next to iDeal.

title: How can I limit the number of times a coupon can be used in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard, click +New Coupon, select a coupon type, enter the coupon code in the Coupon Code field, enter the coupon name in the Coupon Name field, and enter the required details in the Discount / Now only / Offer field. To limit the number of times a coupon can be used, select the Limit the total number of uses for this coupon checkbox and enter the number of times. Multiple purchases by the same customer or purchases by different customers are both counted. To let customers use a coupon only once, select the Limit to one use per customer checkbox.

title: How can I create videos using the Vimeo Video Maker and save them to my Wix site?
content:
To create videos with the Vimeo Video Maker and save them to your Wix site:
- Make sure you've signed up to a free Vimeo account.
- Go to the Video Maker in your site's dashboard.
- Create unlimited videos with the Vimeo Video Maker.
- Choose from Vimeo templates or create from scratch.
- Use Vimeo's editing tools to customize the length of your videos, control the timing between slides, upload music, choose your video style, and add additional text fields.
- Your videos are saved to the Wix Media Manager.
- Manage videos from your site dashboard in the My Videos tab of the Wix Video Maker.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my Business Identification Number (BIN) for a tax exemption in Kazakhstan?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your payment information, and add your tax ID to the BIN field. Click Update.

title: How can I add Google AdSense ads to my blog posts in Wix Blog?
content:
First, sign up for a Google AdSense account and verify your site. You need to connect a domain before you can verify your site.

Step 1 | Create a Google AdSense account
- Go to Google AdSense.
- Sign up for a new account.
- Click Sites in the left sidebar.
- Click Add site.
- Enter the URL of your site.
- Click Save and continue.

Step 2 | Create an ad unit and generate an AdSense code
- In Google AdSense, go to the Ads tab.
- Click the Ad Units tab.
- Select Display ads under Create new ad unit.
- Enter a name for your ad in the field provided.
- Click the Ad size drop-down at the top right and select Fixed.
- Click Create.
- Click Copy code snippet to copy the code.
- Save the code for future use.

Step 3 | Add the AdSense code to a blog post
- Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
- Select the blog post you want to edit, or click Create a Post to start writing a new post.
- Click Add on the left.
- Click AdSense under From the web.
- Paste the AdSense code from your document under Insert an ad from AdSense.
- Click Save.

Notes:
- It may take a few moments for the ad to appear in the post.
- To view the ad, make sure to disable any ad blockers you've installed on your browser.

title: Can I add a date field to a form using the New Wix Forms?
content: Yes, you can now add a date field when creating your form with New Wix Forms.

title: Can I manage inventory directly on the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Currently, it's not possible to manage inventory on the POS tablet. You can, however, make inventory changes in your Wix dashboard or through the Wix app. Update: It's now possible to manage how you handle inventory that is out-of-stock on the POS tablet.

title: How can I connect my existing .it domain to my Wix site?
content: Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .it domain you already own to your Wix site. You will need access to your current domain registrar. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via name servers. With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, which means you can manage them in your Wix account, and Wix Customer Care can help if you need assistance managing your DNS records. There is another connection method called pointing, but it is not recommended as Wix is unable to assist with some issues that may arise. New DNS records can take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

title: How can I add a Grid Product Gallery to my Wix site and choose a specific category to display?
content: To add a Grid Product Gallery to your Wix site and choose a specific category to display: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Store. Select the Grid Product Gallery element you want to add. Click the gallery and Choose Category, then select which category you want to display.

title: Can I create a custom automation trigger using Velo?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a custom automation trigger using Velo.

title: What changes were made to the page structure of Wix websites for accessibility, and how can I resolve any design issues caused by these changes?
content: The update corrected the page structure of your site for accessibility purposes. As a result, elements can no longer overflow from the footer into the main container above it. The update also removed the "arrange" option from the footer's right-click menu, so you can no longer move the footer forward and backward. If the footer design on your site has changed, make sure all elements in the footer are properly attached to it and fully contained inside the footer, without overflowing into the container above it. By placing them correctly, they will become visible. If you are having problems with your footer and the elements inside it, contact Customer Care for help. Note: this feature is not open to all users yet.

title: Can I add Apple Pay as a payment method for my Wix Store if I'm using an alternative provider and not located in a Wix Payments supported area?
content: Currently, Apple Pay can be added as a payment method for your Wix Stores checkout only in locations where Wix Payments is available. Apple Pay for alternative providers as a Wix Stores checkout option is unavailable at this time. Apple Pay is also available as a payment method with the following 3rd party payment providers, where the Apple Pay option appears at the provider's checkout and not directly in your Wix site: Affirm (United States), PayPlus (Israel), PayTR (Turkey), RazorPay (India).

title: Can site members sign up and log in using a phone number or username instead of an email address?
content: Currently, when a visitor signs up or logs in as a member to your site, they enter an email address. It is not possible to let them sign up or log in using other identifying information such as a phone number or username. Tip: Your site visitors can sign up with social logins (e.g. Google or Facebook account) if they don't want to use an email address and password.

title: How can I create a video from my media files using Wix Media?
content: Go to your Media Manager and select the images or videos you want to use. To select multiple files, hold the Ctrl / Cmd key while clicking the other files. Click Create a Video on the right. Customize the video by going through the design steps: Content (use the Add icon + to add more images or video clips and add titles), Design (choose a Video Style, Layout, and Colors and Font), Music (select a music track or enable Music Off), and Business info (use the Include info at the end of the video toggle). Click Apply & Preview, then Save & Share. You can click Back to Editing to make changes, and click Download File to download your video to your computer, or share it on Facebook, Youtube, or Vimeo.

title: How can I add a Wix Blog to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click the Add Elements icon on the left side of the editor. Click Blog. Click Add to Site. When you add Wix Blog, you are asked if you would like to install with or without a Member's Area. This gives members access to several features including the ability to log in, create a public profile and comment on blog posts.

title: How do I add a Members Area to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Open the Add panel in your Wix Editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor. Enter "Members Area" or "Wix Members Area" in the search bar. Select the Wix Members Area app. Click Add to Site.

Tip: If you add certain Wix Apps such as Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Blog, a Members Area is also added automatically.

title: Can I add or update my Facebook Catalog using Meta Pixel?
content: Currently it is not possible to add or update a Facebook Catalog using Meta Pixel. To connect a Facebook Catalog, go to Marketing Integrations and follow the instructions.

title: Can I create a floor plan for table reservations using Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can now create and manage a floor plan with the Wix Table Reservations app.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my VAT ID for a tax exemption in Ukraine on Wix?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your VAT number to the VAT ID field. Click Save. The exemption will apply from the next payment after that date.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to a yearly plan?
content:
To upgrade with a yearly plan: Go to the Upgrade page. Click Select under the plan you wish to purchase. Select Yearly and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase.

Note: After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: Is it possible to sell Wix Stores products on YouTube using YouTube Shopping?
content: Currently, it's not possible to sell your Wix Stores products on YouTube using the YouTube Shopping program.

title: Can I set a global section to appear only on specific breakpoints in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set a global section to only appear on the specific breakpoint(s) you choose (e.g. a mobile-only section). Tip: You can hide global sections from specific breakpoints, but it only affects the page you're working on.

title: How can I change the background image of my Wix site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Select Website. Tap Edit. Tap the image background. Select Change. Note: It is not possible to link background images using the mobile or desktop editor.

title: How can I flush the DNS cache on a Windows 10 computer to resolve domain connection issues with Wix?
content: To flush the DNS cache on a Windows 10 computer: Click Start. Type cmd in the search field. Right-click Command Prompt and select Run as Administrator. Type ipconfig /flushdns and press Enter. If the command succeeds, the system returns: 'Windows IP configuration successfully flushed the DNS Resolver Cache.' If you're still unable to view your site on your domain, review the Wix Domain Assistant to make sure your domain is properly connected.

title: What should I do if I encounter an 'Unsupported MP4 format' error when uploading a video to Wix?
content: If you encounter an 'Unsupported MP4 format' error when uploading your video to Wix, upload the video file in a different format. Check the specs of your video, make sure that it is H.264 codec, and re-encode or convert the file using the supported specs.

title: How can I change my page URL?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon. Click SEO Basics. Enter the page URL under URL slug (last part of the page's URL). Press Enter on your keyboard.

title: Can viewers choose a lower video quality in Wix Video to prevent lags if their internet connection is slow?
content: Yes. You can now allow your viewers to choose a lower video quality to prevent lags if their internet connection is slow.

title: How can I cancel a client's plan myself using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant plan. Click Manage Subscription. Select Cancel Subscription. Select when the cancellation takes effect: Cancel at end of this billing period, where the plan continues until the end of the current payment cycle and does not renew; or Cancel immediately, where the client's access to services stops immediately. Click Yes, Cancel. Canceling a plan does not refund it; you must contact your payment provider to issue a refund. You can undo cancelations for plans with the "Pending cancelation" status, and the status returns to "Active".

title: How can I connect a custom domain to my Wix site?
content: Upgrade your site to any one of Wix's Premium or Studio site plans. Once your site is a premium site, you can connect to it a domain purchased directly from Wix, or a domain purchased elsewhere. If you upgrade to selected Premium or Studio site plans, you receive a free domain voucher for your site.

title: How can I add an action to my Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix?
content: Log in to Hopp by Wix and open Link in Bio. Click Edit Page at the top right, then Actions on the left, then + Add Action. Choose the type of action you wish to add, such as embedding a video, linking to a product, adding sign up for a service, or embedding a contact form. Customize your action using the options on the left, then click Finish at the top. To choose the order in which actions are displayed, hold the Reorder icon next to an action and drag it to the relevant position on the list.

title: Can I accept orders that are less than 1.00 in my restaurant's currency?
content: Yes. It is now possible to accept orders that are less than 1.00 in your restaurant's currency. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I add a shape divider to a section in Editor X?
content:
To add a shape divider to your section in Editor X:
- Click the section in your Editor.
- Click the Shape Dividers icon.
- Click the Top or Bottom tab to choose where to add the divider.
- Select a divider to add:
  - Suggested designs: Click one of the styles available in the panel.
  - Additional designs offered by Wix: Click + More Shapes, then in the Media Manager select a design from the Media from Wix tab, and click Choose File to apply it.
  - Your own shape divider: Click + More Shapes, then in the Media Manager select the shape you want to use from the Site Files tab, or upload a new one, and click Choose File to apply it.

title: How can I change my availability for Marketplace project requests in the Wix Studio app?
content:
To set your availability to receive project requests:
- Go to the relevant workspace in the Wix Studio app.
- Tap View All Projects under Marketplace projects.
- Tap Available at the top left to enable or disable the toggle:
  - Available: Clients can find your profile in the Wix Marketplace to send you project requests, and Wix can send you leads.
  - Unavailable: Your profile is hidden from the Wix Marketplace, and you cannot receive project requests from clients or leads from Wix.
- Tap Save.

title: How can I add custom fields to member profiles on my site?
content: To add custom fields to member profiles, go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Click More Actions at the top right. Click Manage Member Info. Click + Add More Fields at the bottom. In the pop-up, choose to create a custom field: click + Add Custom Field at the bottom. Enter the custom field details: Field Name (the title of the field), Field Privacy (Public or Private), and Field Type. Note: Public information appears on the members' public Profile pages; Private means only the member can see this information. Your members can also change this setting at anytime. Click Save. (Optional) Repeat steps 4-6 to add more fields to your member profiles.

title: Can I add a New Arrivals smart product gallery in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, other types of smart product galleries, such as New Arrivals, are not supported. You can add a smart Related Products gallery and Best Sellers gallery, both of which automatically display products based on store data.

title: How can I add a 'buy now, pay later' option to my Wix site using third-party payment providers?
content: Wix offers third-party payment providers that let you offer a 'buy now, pay later (BNPL)' solution. To set it up, choose an installment provider from Wix's BNPL options and follow Wix's instructions to connect that provider. You must upgrade to a Premium plan that allows you to accept payments to take payments on your Wix site. Once connected, shoppers automatically see the installment payment option on your product pages and checkout, including how many installments are available and the amount due for each payment. Shoppers selecting a BNPL solution at checkout are directed to the installment provider's site to create an account, or to select or review their payment plan and securely complete their purchase if they already have an account. You can also add a PayPal 'Pay Later' button to your Wix Store checkout.

title: Can I connect more than one account to the Instagram Feed app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect more than one account to the Instagram Feed app. Tip: You can add several widgets and connect each of them to the same/different Instagram accounts.

title: How can I fix my menu to the top of my Wix site so it remains visible when visitors scroll down?
content: Place your menu in your header. Click the header. Click the More Actions icon. Click Header Scroll Settings. Select Freezes. Tips: We recommend keeping the height of your header small so it doesn't cover any element or content when visitors scroll through your site. You can also pin your menu to the top of your site by right clicking on your menu and selecting Pin to Screen. Freezing keeps the header always visible at the top, while pinning fixes it at a specific point as you scroll.

title: Is it possible to add a single item collection to my app in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it is not possible to add a single item collection to your app. Single Item collections are used when there is information that you want to pass together with your app, but it does not have a repeatable nature.

title: How can I add a color or gradient to my strip background in Wix Editor?
content:
Click the strip in your editor. Click Change Background. Click Color and select from one of the following options:

Color: Choose a block color to apply to your strip.
Gradient: Apply a cool effect to your strip background with a Linear, Radial, or Conic gradient.
Fluid gradient: Make your strips stand out with a sophisticated fluid gradient.

You can add a color and an image or video. The color appears while the image or video is loading. You can see the color behind the image or video in the Strip Background panel.

title: How can I add and set up an 'Add to Cart' button on my Wix site?
content:
You can place a standalone 'Add to Cart' button anywhere on your site. The button is linked to the product you choose.

Step 1 | Add the 'Add to Cart' button
Navigate to the relevant page, then drag the Add to Cart button from the Add Panel to the ideal spot.

Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Stores.
- Drag the Add to Cart Button to the page.

Studio Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Stores.
- Drag the Add to Cart Button to the page.

Step 2 | Connect the button to a product
For the button to work properly, select which product is added to the customer's cart when clicked.
- Click the Add to Cart button in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- (Optional) Edit the button text.
- Connect the button to a product. Select the default product or select a different product.

Step 3 | Design the button
- Click the Add to Cart button in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Design.
- Make any of the following customizations:
  * Select a button style.
  * Select a button color and drag the slider to adjust the opacity.
  * Select a border color and drag the slider to adjust the border width.
  * Drag the slider to make the corners rounder or more square.
  * Select a text color or font.

Note: When a product is out of stock, the button text changes to "Out of Stock". It is not possible to edit the design of the "Out of Stock" button.

title: How can I create and send invoices using Wix Invoices?
content: Wix Invoices is a payment request system that allows business owners to create, send, track, and manage invoices, as well as receive payments online. You can learn how to set up and create invoices, add products or services, add tax settings, and manage your invoices. Note that Wix Invoices is an online payment request system and not an accounting service; you are solely responsible for ensuring that the invoices you issue conform to the legal requirements applicable to you and your customers. If you do not have a Wix account, you can create invoices with the Wix Invoice Generator, which is completely free of charge. You can create as many invoices as you need and download or send them directly to clients via email. To download your invoices and send them via email, sign up for a Wix Account or log in to your existing account.

title: How can I create a custom template from an existing site in Wix Channels?
content: Go to Custom Templates in your Channels dashboard. Click + Create Custom Template at the top right. Choose one of your sites to use for the template. Click Continue. Enter a name for your custom template and click Create Template.

title: How can I display my Wix Stores products on any page using the Wix Editor?
content: Prerequisites: create your products in Wix Stores, add the CMS to your site, and enable Wix app collections so Wix Stores works with the CMS. In Wix Editor, go to the page or section where you want to display products, click Add Elements, and add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table. For a Pro Gallery, drag the Pro Gallery onto the page and remove default images via Manage Media, Select All, Delete, Done. For a repeater, drag the repeater onto the page and ensure it has an image or button to link to the Product Page. For a table, drag a table onto the page. Click the element, click Connect to CMS, click Create Dataset, choose Products under the Stores Wix app collection, optionally enter a dataset name, and click Create. For repeaters, under Connections choose the elements to connect. Select Wix Stores dynamic collection fields such as Name, Formatted Discounted Price, and Main Media, or choose linking options for buttons and images such as Navigate to Product Page URL, Add to cart, or Open quick view. For repeaters, use Repeater connections to connect additional elements. Adjust the element as needed, click Preview to test, and click Publish to make changes go live.

title: Can I create event tickets using add-ons in Wix Events?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to create an event ticket using add-ons, such as discounted parking or a free meal. Workaround: You can create event tickets with different price options. For example:

Event ticket with an add-on:
- "Event Ticket + Meal" for $60.
- "Event Ticket + Parking" for $50.

Separate tickets for events and add-ons:
- "Event Ticket" for $40.
- "Meal" for $20.
- "Parking" for $10.

title: How can I add a video mask to my VideoBox in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click your VideoBox, then click the Mask icon. Choose a shape for your VideoBox by selecting a shape from the list, or click the Add icon to view more shapes and vector art in the Media Manager. You can also upload your own SVG file from there. To replace the video, click your VideoBox and click Change Video to access the Media Manager; you can choose a free video offered by Editor X or use a video from your site files.

title: How do I connect Printify to my Wix Store?
content: To connect Printify to your Wix Store: Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor; in Editor X, click App Market at the top of Editor X. Start typing Printify in the search box and select it. Click +Add. Click Allow and Install. Select an option: sign up to create a new Printify account, or log in to an existing Printify account. For new accounts, follow the instructions in the email you received to confirm your email address. Go to the Printify dashboard. Click the Profile icon at the top right. Select My Account. Click My Stores. Click Add new store. Click Connect next to Wix. If you have more than one Wix site, click Select next to the site you want to connect. Click Allow and Install. From the Select store that you want to connect to drop-down, select the Printify store you want to connect to your Wix site, and click Continue. Tip: If you just created your Printify account, your default store is named "My new store".

title: What tools does Wix provide to help site owners comply with privacy regulations like GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD?
content: Wix provides tools to assist site owners with privacy compliance: site owners can handle data requests from visitors from their dashboard, such as accessing their data or permanently deleting their data; add a cookie banner to request consent from visitors to use cookies and similar technologies; add a link to allow visitors to Opt-Out of a “Sale” of their personal information; and use Wix Forms to build forms and collect data, including an option to add a checkbox to receive explicit consent from visitors to process their data.

title: How can I restrict purchases to only signed-in customers on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To restrict purchases to signed-in customers using the Wix Editor:

- If you don't already have it, add the Wix Members Area to your site.
- Go to your editor and click Pages & Menu.
- Depending on your site setup: for only Wix Stores, click Store Pages then Cart Page; for only Wix Bookings, click Bookings Pages then Cart Page; for Wix Restaurants Orders (New) or sites with multiple business solutions, click Cart & Thank You then Cart Page.
- Click the Settings icon next to Cart Page.
- Select the Permissions tab and click Members Only.
- Decide Which members can access this page: choose All members, or choose Only selected members or paying customers to limit access to a member role you created or to clients who have purchased a pricing plan.

Note: Some order paths bypass the Cart page, so restricting Cart page access may not stop customers from completing orders without signing in.

title: How can I add a WebView element to my branded app using the Wix dashboard?
content:
To add a WebView element to your branded app from your site's dashboard:

- Go to the Branded Mobile App tab in your site's dashboard.
- Click **Edit Mobile App**.
- Click the **Screen** drop-down at the top and choose the screen you want to edit.
- Click **Elements** on the left.
- Click **Embed** and select the **WebView** element.
- Customize the following in the panel on the right:
  - **Content:** Enter the page URL of the site you want to embed.
  - **Layout:** Choose a height for your WebView: **Dynamic** (the height auto-adjusts with the screen) or **Fixed** (set the height in pixels).
  - **Display:** Enable the toggles to show the website header and footer.
  - **Margins:** Drag the **Margins** sliders to adjust the padding around the WebView. Click the **Edit individually** icon to separately adjust the margins.
  - **General Settings:** Click **General Settings** and choose which device to show this element on: **All**, **Android**, or **iOS**. Your elements are visible on all operating systems by default, but you can decide what to show on iOS, Android, or both.
- Click **Save**.

**Note:** This element is only available for the Branded app, so make sure to purchase a Branded App plan.

title: Can I connect my app elements and widgets to custom panel elements in Wix Blocks without using code?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, there is no way to connect your app elements and widgets to custom panel elements (e.g. toggles, dividers, buttons) without the use of code.

title: How can I protect my Wix site from spambots and ensure that new members are genuine?
content:
To protect your Wix site from bots and spammers, customize your site member settings and Wix Forms settings. You can:
- Ask new members to confirm their email. You can send a confirmation email to new site members when they join, which ensures they signed up with an active email address they own. You can request confirmation from only new members who are already in your contacts, which is the default email confirmation status and cannot be disabled, or from everyone who signs up, which is recommended for added security. Enable this in the Signup & Login Security section of your dashboard.
- Add a reCAPTCHA field to signup and login forms. Site visitors need to check the field; if they do not, they cannot continue to the member's area. Enable it in the Signup, Login, and Security section of Site Member Settings in your dashboard. You can show the reCAPTCHA boxes only to suspected bots or to everyone.
- Add a reCAPTCHA field to your Wix Forms. This creates a checkbox on your form that site visitors need to check before they can submit it.
Note: The source says this information refers to the old Wix Forms; new Wix Forms are automatically integrated with spam filters and a site viewer CAPTCHA.

title: How can I access the Cart page settings in the Wix Editor for my Wix Stores site?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Select an option: My site has only Wix Stores: Click Store Pages. Click Cart Page. Click the Cart Page element on your page. Click Settings.

title: Can I manually play or autoplay all the videos in my Wix Pro Gallery at the same time?
content: Currently, it is not possible to manually play / autoplay all the videos in your gallery at the same time. Depending on the settings applied to your videos, your videos play individually in a loop, on hover, on click, or one after the other.

title: How can I change the shape of images in a Honeycomb Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content: Click the gallery in the Editor. Click the Layouts icon. Choose the shape of your image under Which shape are images?: Diamond changes the image shape to diamond; Triangle changes the image shape to triangle; Hexagon (honeycomb) changes the image shape to hexagon (honeycomb).

title: Can I make a specific element on my site visible only to members?
content: While you can restrict entire pages so only members are allowed to access them, it's not possible to do the same with individual elements. For example, you cannot change the viewing permissions of an element so it doesn't appear for visitors who aren't members.

title: Can I customize the fields on the Guest Details form in Wix Hotels?
content: Currently, it is not possible to edit, add or remove fields on the Guest Details form which guests are asked to fill in when booking a room in your hotel. The form currently includes First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Country, and Special Requests.

title: How can I update my payment details in my Wix account to add my ABN for a tax exemption in Australia?
content: To update your payment details and add your ABN for a tax exemption: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update Payment Method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your tax number to the ABN field. Click Update.

title: Is it possible to add a discount or custom charge to a POS Bookings order in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes, it's now possible to add a discount to a POS Bookings order or charge your client a custom amount. You can add a discount or custom charge when you accept payment for services that were already booked or when you book services yourself and accept payment for them.

title: How can I update my payment details to include my SST registration number in my Wix account?
content: In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription, then click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your SST registration number to the SST registration number field. Click Update.

title: How do I add and set up a gallery on my Wix site?
content: Go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Gallery, then click a gallery type (for example Grid, Slider, or More Galleries options like 3D Carousel or Freestyle), and click and drag the gallery onto the page. To add images, click the gallery in your editor, click Change Images, click + Add Images, select a stock image or images from your site files, click Add to Gallery, then click Done. Note: this refers to editor galleries, which allow you to display images only; if you would like to display different media types on your site, you can add and set up a Pro Gallery.

title: How can I pause my Facebook ad campaign until a specific date, and what happens if the date is before or after my subscription expires?
content: Go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard. Click the Campaign Actions drop-down at the top right, then click Pause Temporarily. Click Select a date next to Resume on and select the day you want your campaign to resume. If the selected date is before your subscription expires, Wix automatically resumes your campaign on that date and any remaining ad spend is saved until then. If the selected date is after your subscription expires, you must go to the dashboard and restart your campaign with a new subscription. Any remaining ad spend will be added to the new subscription once your campaign is active.

title: Can I add a drop-down feature to a text box in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a drop-down feature to a text box which your visitors can click to select an option. In the meantime, you can use the selection user input element to add a drop-down to your site.

title: How can I retrieve a Dailymotion URL for a video I want to use in a single video player?
content: Go to dailymotion.com and find the relevant video. Copy the URL of the relevant video.

title: How can I add a page about myself to my portfolio website using Wix?
content: According to the source, add a page that tells your site visitors about you, your brand, and everything your portfolio stands for. You can add an about page by clicking the Add icon in your Editor; the source also says to learn how to create pages in the Wix Editor.

title: How can I enable the option to control item visibility in my Wix collection using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click CMS on the left side of the editor. Click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection. Click More Actions at the top and select Collection settings. Enable the Control item visibility toggle. Choose the default status for new items: Visible: New collection items can be visible on your live site if the elements are properly connected to a dataset. Hidden: New collection items are hidden from your live site as they cannot be read by datasets. Click Save.

title: How can I create a custom template in the enterprise dashboard?
content: Go to Custom Templates in your enterprise dashboard. Click + Create Custom Template at the top right. Choose the site that you want to use as a base for your new custom template, then click Continue. Enter a Template name and select the template type: Organization or Client. Note that a custom template can be for your organization or for your clients, but not both. Click Create Template. Once created, click the More Actions icon next to the custom template, select Make Available, and click Make Available again to confirm.

title: What do I need to upload to verify my EIN for Wix Payments?
content: To verify your EIN, upload a copy of your EIN confirmation notice. Make sure the company name and Employer Identification Number are visible and clear and match the business details in your Wix Payments account. Documents must be sent in jpeg, jpg, pdf, or png format. The maximum file size is 10 MB, and the minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF and 100 kB for other formats. If all details are entered correctly, the verification process usually takes 1 working day. If your EIN has not been successfully verified after that timeframe, contact Wix Payments.

title: How can I add a custom cursor to a specific element in Editor X?
content:
To add a custom cursor to a specific element in Editor X:
- Select the relevant page, section, or element in Editor X.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top.
- Click the Design tab.
- Click Cursor.
- Add your cursor: click + Add; in the Media Manager choose one of the suggested cursors, or click + Add image or .svg to upload your own file; when ready, click Add to Site.
- Optional: click Preview at the top right to see how the cursor looks on your site.

You can choose from many different designs or upload your own image file (e.g. JPG, PNG, SVG).

title: How can I create SEO tags using AI on my Wix site?
content: To create SEO tags using AI on your Wix site, you need a Premium plan. You can access your page title tag and meta description settings in either the SEO panels of your installed Wix apps or the SEO Settings "Edit by Page" tabs. Click "Create AI text" next to the Title tag or Meta description field. The AI Text Creator opens and presents 3 suggestions. To use one, click "Use Text" next to the suggestion, then edit the text if needed. To refine suggestions, provide key details and select a tone of voice to generate 3 refined suggestions, click "Create", then click "Use Text" next to the suggestion you want. Edit the text in the Title tag or Meta description field if needed, then click "Save". The AI Text Creator uses your business name, business category, page title, page description, and location; it also uses your keywords if you are using it for a Wix Blogs page.

title: How can I create a dedicated page for legal notices on my Wix site?
content: In your Editor, click Pages & Menu, click + Add Page, enter the new name for your page, and click Done. After your page is created, make sure visitors can easily locate and access it; adding a link to this page in your footer makes your legal notices easily identifiable. For simplified management, use one text box per section so you can modify or delete a section without having to interact with the rest of the content of your page.

title: Why are my Wix Payments payouts on hold, and what can I do if a payout has failed?
content: Payouts are placed on hold when an issue is blocking your payout. The held amount includes the failed payout plus any other available funds that cannot be sent to your bank because of the issue. Once the issue is identified and resolved, the payout is added to your next scheduled payout. To see the reason and instructions, click the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard. If the payout failed, verify that your bank account details are registered correctly: the bank account holder's name must match the name of the Wix Payments account owner. Also verify that your bank account can receive EFT payments; if you are located in the United States, payouts are sent as ACH transfers. If your account cannot receive EFT payments, update your settings to a different bank account that can receive them, making sure the account details match. After your payment details are updated and your new account details are verified, the funds will be included in your next scheduled payout.

title: How can I add a dynamic list page for my Wix Stores products using the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin:
- Create your own products in Wix Stores.
- Make sure to add the CMS to your site if you haven't already.
- Enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.

To add a dynamic list page in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click CMS on the left of your editor.
- Click Wix App Collections on the left.
- Scroll down to Stores, hover over Products and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Add dynamic page.
- Click List page.
- Click Add to Site.

Tip: You can display your products in a Pro Gallery or table (Wix Editor only) instead of a repeater. To do so, remove the repeater and add a gallery or table. Then follow the rest of the steps in this article to connect your gallery or repeater to the CMS.

title: Can I upload additional file types to the File Share app?
content: Currently, only the file types that are listed can be uploaded to the File Share app.

title: How can I add a document button to my site to share documents with visitors?
content: Add a document button to your site to share important information and documents with your site visitors. Click the relevant section. Hover over the button. Click the Edit icon. Click Link to. Select Document. Click Select File. Select a file from your media or click Upload Docs to add a new file. Click Apply. Click Done. When your site visitors click the button, they are directed to your document on a new page.

title: Does the Wix Loyalty Program automatically adjust points balances when refunds are issued?
content: No. Currently, it is not possible to have a customer's loyalty points balance automatically adjusted when they are issued a refund. However, you can manually set a customer's points balance.

title: How can I attach an element to a box in the Wix Editor?
content: To attach an element to a box in the Wix Editor, drag the relevant element onto the box and drop it when the Attach to Box message is displayed. An element must be smaller than the box in order to be attached. To detach the element from the box, drag and drop it outside of the box. Note: When attaching elements to a box, the layers of the Editor may cause them to be hidden behind the box; you might need to move your box backward and your elements forward for them to appear on the box.

title: How do I access the Facebook Ads dashboard?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Marketing & SEO. Click Facebook & Instagram Ads.

title: How can I create a photo album using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: To create a photo album in the Wix app on your mobile device: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Photo Albums. Tap Create Album. Tap Add Cover Photo to upload a cover image for your album. Tap Album Name to give your album a name. Optionally customize how your album will appear using More info, business name, or logo options. Tap the Galleries tab and select a gallery layout. Tap Save.

title: How can I connect an email purchased outside of Wix to my Wix domain?
content:
To connect an email purchased outside of Wix to your Wix domain:

- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Select Connect an email purchased outside of Wix or Edit MX records.
- Select your provider from the drop-down and click Save.

If your provider isn't listed, select Other and follow the manual instructions:
- Select Other from the list.
- Click the Points to field and enter the mail server address of your MX record.

Note: The Host name field cannot be edited. It is not currently possible to connect a business email to a subdomain in Wix.

If you have multiple MX records, enter the record with the lowest Priority value first. The Priority values do not need to match your provider's directions, but they do need to be in the same order. Click Add Another, enter the mail server address of the next MX record, and repeat for each additional MX record. Click Save when you're done adding all the MX records.

To add other DNS records if required:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records.
- Scroll to the record type you'd like to add (e.g. CNAME, TXT) and click Add Record.
- Enter the DNS record in the relevant fields.

Note: If instructed to add an @ sign in the Host name field, leave the field blank instead.

- Click Save. Repeat these steps to add additional DNS records.

It can take up to 48 hours for this process to complete while the new records propagate.

title: How can I edit the default booking confirmation email in Wix Bookings?
content: In Wix Bookings, go to the Booking Settings tab, click Emails & SMS notifications, then click Edit next to Send clients an email confirmation when they book. Click the relevant tab to choose the service type: Appointments or Classes & courses. Optionally enable the Email video conferencing link toggle to add a video conferencing link to this email. Choose Subject to customize the email subject line, or Message to edit the text of the email. Optionally click Send Test Email to send yourself a preview, then click Save. Note: The confirmation emails you receive display your business's time zone; the emails you send to your clients display the time zone they select. Test emails display ${priceText} and $12.34 as the service price and total; this will not appear in your actual confirmation emails.

title: How can I add affiliate links to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: You can add affiliate links to your site by adding the links to text, images or buttons. You can learn how to add a link to text, an image, or a button.

title: How can I enhance the design of my Wix site using third-party apps?
content: Wix offers a variety of design apps in the Wix App Market. These apps are built by third-party app developers to help enhance the overall look and feel of your site. Many are widgets you can add for a specific function, such as a clock widget that displays the time or a promo slider that shows your latest promotions. Adding these apps can improve your customers overall experience and can lead to a positive impact in sales and increase in engagement. Design element apps in the App Market include Search apps that help make indexing easier, Buttons and menus that give customers more ways to navigate your site, Banners and badges that can help automate scheduling and display of banners, and Image effects including seasonal effects. A third-party app is made by other developers or companies and is not considered a product of Wix, but Wix provides access to these apps from the App Market.

title: Can I print and ship images myself directly through Wix Photo Albums?
content: Currently, printing and shipping images yourself directly through Wix Photo Albums is not supported. However, Wix Photo Albums works with a third-party service, Order a Print, to give you even more options when selling your photos. Order a Print provides a complete print-on-demand service for you to sell your digital images and prints online.

title: How can I delete a site page in Wix Stores?
content: The Category Page, Product Page, Thank You page and Cart page are essential to your store and cannot be deleted. You can delete a site page by clicking Pages on the left side of the Editor, clicking Main Pages, clicking the More Actions icon next to the page you want to delete, selecting Delete, and clicking Delete to confirm. You can also delete a page with a store element that you previously added, such as a product gallery.

title: How can I create a social post using the Wix Logo Maker?
content:
To create a Social Post in the Wix Logo Maker, go to the Brand Studio. Click the My Logos & Brands drop-down at the top and select the relevant brand. Under Brand Designs, click the Create a New Design icon. Click the Social Post tab, hover over the Social Post template you like best and click Select.

Use the tabs on the left to customize your logo (you can also click the element itself to open its tab):
- Templates: Select a new template for your post that suits your brand.
- Palette: Select a new color palette for your post. Color palettes come in presets of 4 colors. You can change the individual colors in the other tabs.
- Text: Customize the text on your post. There is a 50-character limit for each text box.
- Symbols: Click Add Symbol to add a symbol or your logo to your Social Post. To add your logo to your post, click My Logos at the top of the Manage Symbols tab, then click your logo design to add it to your post and customize it to your liking.
- Shapes: Click Add Shape to add a shape to your post.
- Images: Click Add Image to upload your own image or choose an image from the Wix Library. Currently, you can only upload .JPEG and .PNG images with a maximum size of 25MB.
- Background: Choose a color for your post's background.

Depending on whether or not you have a logo plan, follow the relevant step:
- Don't have a Logo + Website plan: Click Next to purchase a plan with unlimited Social Posts.
- Already have a Logo + Website plan: Click Download to download your .PNG Social Post file.

Extract your Social Post files and upload them to your social media of choice. Each Social Post file created is downloaded at 1080 x 1080px file size.

title: How can I track my restaurant's inventory using Square POS with Wix Restaurants?
content:
Log in to your Square POS account. Click View Dashboard by your restaurant location. Click the Items tab on the left. Click on a stock item. Click Manage Stock. Enable the Tracking toggle to track inventory for the stock item. For Stock action, select the action for the stock inventory. For Add stock, enter the amount to add or subtract from the stock inventory. Optionally, enable the Low stock alerts toggle to receive notifications when your stock reaches a certain amount. Click Done, then click Save.

Notes:
- When the stock quantity of an item reaches zero, or you manually enter zero and save changes, the item will be marked as 'Sold Out' on your Wix Restaurant site.
- When you save changes to a stock item in Square, it can take several minutes for those changes to sync with your Wix Restaurant site.

title: How can I export my Figma designs to Wix Studio using the Wix Studio plugin?
content: Before exporting, upload your custom fonts to Wix Studio and compare the Figma frame width to the editing size of the relevant page; if they do not match, the design may not export in the right proportions. Install the Wix Studio plugin from the Figma Community page, open the Figma file, and copy its URL. In the client's site editor, click the Wix Studio icon at the top left, hover over Tools, click Import from Figma, paste the Figma file URL, click Connect, and on first use click Allow access. In Figma, open the file, click the Figma icon, hover over Plugins, click Figma to Wix Studio, click Set up Export, select I'm done connecting my file, and click Next. Verify that the editing size in Wix Studio matches the Figma frame width, then click Start Export. Choose Styles and click Export Styles, or choose a frame and click Export Frame. Back in the editor, open Import from Figma, review the selection, upload missing fonts if needed, and for styles click Apply Styles to Site; for a frame, match editing size if needed, select the relevant option next to Add frame as, and click Add.

title: Can I use Afterpay as a BNPL payment method with Wix Payments in the United States?
content: Yes. The source announces that you can now add Afterpay as a BNPL payment method in Wix Payments. Afterpay is a BNPL payment method that enables your customers to pay over time while you receive the money upfront. By offering more flexibility to your customers at checkout, you can increase your sales and improve your cash flow.

title: How can I add and manage items in an Accordion element in Editor X?
content: Click the Accordion element in your Editor. Click Manage Items. Hover over the item and click the More Actions icon. Choose what to do with this Accordion item: Duplicate, Rename or Delete. To add a new blank item, click Add Item at the bottom of the panel. To change the order of your items, hold the Reorder icon next to an item and drag it to the desired location.

title: Can participants in Online Programs view each other's progress?
content: Currently in Online Programs, only the owner can view the list of program participants as well as view their progress. The participants are unable to see or monitor each other's progress.

title: How can I upload my own fonts to the Wix Editor?
content: Click the text element in the Editor. Click Edit Text. Click the Fonts drop-down. Click Upload Fonts to upload your own. Click Done once the font has uploaded. Note: Uploading fonts larger than 4MB can affect your site's performance and speed. We recommend using system fonts available from Wix, as they're optimized for your site.

title: How can I offer multiple delivery options to my customers in Wix Stores?
content:
Offering more than one delivery option is available when you set up the following shipping rules: Flat Rate, Rate by Weight, Rate by Price, Rate by Product, USPS Calculated Rate.
Start by creating the first delivery option and then click +Add Another Delivery Option.
Tips: To offer multiple delivery options which include a free option, select a rule (e.g. Flat Rate) and make one of the options free (e.g. Standard Shipping at $0, Express Shipping at $8). You can display shipping options to your customers in the cart.

title: How can I delete my Wix account using the Wix app?
content:
To delete your account using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap your profile icon at the top.
- Tap **Manage Account Settings**.
- Tap **Delete Your Account**.
- Tap **Continue** to follow the steps on how to delete your account.

Once you delete your account, you can no longer use any of your Wix services. Your account and all its data will be removed permanently. **Important:** Wix will not be able to restore your account or retrieve your data in the future.

title: How can I add members to a Wix group and review requests to join a private group?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Groups, click the relevant group, and click the Members tab. Click + Add Members on the right, then choose Send email invites, add existing site members, or copy a sharable link to send. If the group is private, potential members need to request to join; review pending requests under Member Requests and choose Approve or Decline. You can also set who can add site members in the group's member permissions.

title: How can I customize the sender details for 'New Post' notification emails in Wix Blog?
content: To customize your sender details, go to your Email Marketing Dashboard. Click Edit Details under Sender Details. Edit the sender name in the From Name field. Edit the Reply-to Email field. Click Save. Check the email address that you entered in the Reply-to Email field for the verification code. Enter the code and click Confirm. If you did not receive a verification code, check your spam folder before clicking Send again.

title: How can I show or hide elements on my Wix site for different mobile operating systems?
content:
To show or hide an element on your site for different mobile operating systems:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Mobile App.
- Tap Edit.
- Tap the navigation tab that includes the element you want to manage.
- Tap Edit icon next to the element.
- Tap Customize Element.
- Tap the Visibility drop-down under General Settings and select the device you want to show the element on.
- Tap Save.

If you hide an element, you can show it again by tapping Show on Android or Show on iOS next to the relevant element.

title: How can I set up my Wix restaurant to offer both ASAP and scheduled orders?
content: Go to Restaurant Orders Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Order Scheduling. Select As soon as possible (ASAP) or scheduled for later. Set up Scheduling Rules: select an option under How quickly orders can be prepared? such as Up to a certain number of minutes or A range (e.g. between 30 to 40 minutes). Click How far in advance orders can be scheduled? and select the relevant option (e.g. Until the end of the business day). Note: Days are calculated as business days, not 24-hour periods. Click Save.

title: Can I connect the backgrounds of the slideshow repeater element to the CMS in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to connect the backgrounds of the slideshow repeater element to the CMS (Content Management System). This feature would allow you to use images or videos from your CMS collection as dynamic backgrounds for each slide (item).

title: How can I create a membership option for an event using the Wix app?
content:
Prerequisite: Create the ticketed event you want to connect to membership plans and create event tickets.

To create a membership option:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events.
- Select Published Events.
- Select the relevant ticketed event.
- Tap the Manage tab.
- Select Promotion.
- Select Memberships.
- Tap Create Membership.

title: How can I customize the outer background of my email campaign?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one. Click Background on the left. Choose whether to show background colors or patterns and images in the outer background: Background colors: select the relevant color or click the Pick Color icon to choose a custom color. Patterns and images: select the relevant pattern/image or click the Add icon to choose another pattern or image, then click the Settings icon to choose the color behind the image or to have the image repeat itself across the background. The recommended image size is 1920 X 1080 pixels, but the background width is limited to 720 pixels when viewed as an email. We suggest using decorative images for the background. If a subscriber clicks to view the full email, they will see the complete background.

title: How can I connect my Norwegian (.no) domain to my Wix site?
content:
Once you've upgraded your site, you can connect a .no domain you already own to your Wix site. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via nameservers. With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, so you can manage them in your Wix account. This also means Wix Customer Care can help if you need assistance managing your DNS records.

Before connecting your domain, keep the following in mind:

* You will need access to your current domain registrar.
* New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate.

Currently, it is not possible to purchase a .no domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix. If you would like to see this feature in the future, you can vote for this feature.

title: How can I customize the text box design in my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click the Pro Gallery element on your page, click the Design tab, and click Texts. Under the Text Design section, customize your text and text box using these options:
- Title style and color: select the font and color of the title text.
- Description font style and color: select the font and color of the description text.
- Horizontal alignment: align the horizontal text to the left, center, or right.
- Fill color & opacity: select the background color of the text box and drag the slider to adjust transparency. Note: if you choose the No background text box style, this option isn't available.
- Adjust text box height: choose Automatically to set the height based on font size, or Manually to drag the slider. Tip: make your font smaller or manually adjust the text box height if you use long descriptions for your images.
- Space between image and text: drag the slider to change the space from 0 to 100 pixels.
- Text vertical padding: drag the slider to change the space between the vertical text and the border.
- Text horizontal padding: drag the slider to change the space between the horizontal text and the border.
- Space between title & description: drag the slider to change the space from 0 to 50 pixels.
You can also choose from three text box styles in the Item Style tab: No background, Background attached, Background detached.

title: How can I add and set up a Featured Service element on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add and set up the Featured Service element in the Wix Editor: go to your editor; click Add Elements on the left side of the editor; click Bookings; drag the Featured Service element onto the page; click the Featured Service element on the page; click Settings; click the Services tab; select the checkmark next to the service you want to display. Tip: click Add a New Service to add a new appointment, class or course. Click the relevant tabs to customize the layout, display, text and design of the Featured Service element. Notes: the Featured Service element is not a standalone element; it works together with Wix Bookings. Make sure to delete the element if the service displayed is no longer available.

title: How does Wix ensure the security of user passwords during sign up and login?
content: Wix's sign up and login services are completed through a secure server. In addition, Wix does not keep users' passwords in its database, but rather encrypts them in a one-way encryption method. This means that, even in the event of a database breach, the passwords cannot be restored by any means. For advice on securing your account please see our password recommendations.

title: Can I repurchase the same business phone number after it has already been purchased once?
content: Currently it is not possible to repurchase the same business phone number after it has already been purchased once.

title: How can a charity or non-profit organization apply for the Wix Premium plan discount through TechSoup?
content: Wix partners with TechSoup to offer a discount for charities or non-profit organizations that are TechSoup members. The promotion includes a 70% discounted rate for a 2-year Wix Premium plan to create and host one website, plus a free 1-year domain registration voucher. Organizations can request 1 coupon code every 2 years. To get started, apply for this discount through Wix/TechSoup; if TechSoup approves your request, you will receive an email with instructions for receiving your Wix subscription. If you do not cancel your subscription or request a new offer before the end of the second year, Wix will automatically bill you for an additional two years of service at the standard rate.

title: How can I resolve a 502 (Bad Gateway) error on my website?
content:
To resolve a 502 (Bad Gateway) error:

- Reload the page using one of the following methods:
  * Press F5 on your keyboard (Cmd + R on a Mac).
  * Click the Reload icon at the top of your browser.
  * Re-enter the URL into your address bar and press Enter.
