Tip: If you still get the same error message, wait a few minutes and try again. The issue may be temporary. If the problem persists, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve.

title: How can I create a monetary discount coupon in Wix Bookings?
content:
To create a monetary discount coupon for services in Wix Bookings:
- Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Coupon.
- Fill out Coupon Code and Coupon name.
- Set the monetary discount offered by the coupon.
- Choose which services or products the coupon applies to from the Apply to drop-down menu.
- Select either Apply once per order (to the lowest priced item) or Apply to each eligible item in an order. This doesn't apply if you selected Minimum order subtotal.
- Optional: Set an end date using the Valid between field for limited-time offers.
- Optional: Select the Limit the total number of uses for this coupon checkbox and enter the number of times the coupon can be used.
- Optional: Select the Limit to one use per customer checkbox.
- Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I create and send a push notification using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Push notifications under Marketing. Tap Send Push Notification. Tap Start Creating. Enter the message you want to appear in the notification. Choose what opens when members tap the notification: An Item, A Screen, or A Custom Screen. For An Item, choose the relevant product or service from the Select an item drop-down. For A Screen, choose the relevant screen from the Select a screen drop-down. For A Custom Screen, tap + Create a Custom Screen, add your content, and tap Save. Optionally, tap Send a test notification to my phone to see how members will see your notification. Tap Next. Select the members you want to receive the notification and tap Next. Review the notification details. When ready, tap Send Push Notification.

title: How can I hide my entire site from search engine results using the SEO settings?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Click the Let search engines index your site toggle and set it to Disabled: people can't find your site when searching keywords and phrases in search engines (e.g. Google).

title: How can I change the text color of menu items on my Wix mobile site?
content: To change the text color on your mobile menu, open the mobile editor, click the mobile menu, and click Edit Menu. Click the Design icon, then select either the Regular or Selected tab. Click the Text icon, then click the color picker beside Color and select a color for the text items. You can also change the color of submenu items by clicking the Color box under Submenu.

title: How can I add the Adobe Express add-on to my Wix site?
content:
To add the Adobe Express add-on to your Wix site:

- Log in to your Adobe Express account.
- Click **Add-ons**.
- Click **Wix**.
- Click **Add**.
- Click **I already have a Wix site** in the popup on the right.
- Select your site in the Site Selector popup.
- Review the Terms of Use and click **Agree and Add**.

**Note:** Once you've added the app, your site files are displayed in the panel on the right.

title: What should I do if I'm experiencing issues with my Wix Forum on my live site?
content: If you're experiencing issues with the Wix Forum, check if cookies or cache are causing the problem by opening your browser in incognito / private mode and seeing if the problem persists. You can also try disconnecting and reconnecting to your internet, and opening your site in a different browser. If you're still having trouble, go through the Technical Assistant, including clearing your browser's cache and cookies, to check whether the issue is local to your computer or related to your internet connection. If the issue continues after completing the assistant, contact us and let us know which troubleshooting steps you've taken, along with a screenshot or video showing the issue.

title: How can I customize the Thank You page for my pricing plans on my site?
content: Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard. Click one of your existing plans, or click + Create plan. Scroll down to Settings. Click Edit next to Customize the Thank you page. Enter a Title for your Thank You page. Enter the text for this page in the Message field. Use the formatting options available to make important information stand out. (Optional) Add links to your Thank You page: select the text you want to link, click the Link icon, enter the relevant URL, select any linking options you want to apply (Link opens in a new tab, noreferrer (recommended), nofollow, sponsored), and click Save. Enter your Button text. Choose where the button directs customers to: Home Page or Other page. For Other page, enter the Redirect URL in the field. Click Save.

title: Can I add folders in ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot add folders in ADI. To use this feature, you should head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: How can I share a track from my Wix Music player on social media?
content: Access your live site. Hover over the Share icon in the relevant track. Select a social network. You can enable or disable music sharing from Wix Music settings. Sharing your music shares a link to the page of your site that contains the Wix Music player.

title: How can I change the subscription period of my Wix Premium plan?
content: To change your subscription period, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, then click Change Billing Cycle. Select your new billing cycle, click Continue, review your billing information, and click Confirm. If you switch to a shorter plan cycle, your billing cycle will switch over on the date when your current cycle ends. If you switch to a longer plan cycle, the upgrade takes effect immediately, and we will credit you for any remaining time on your current plan.

title: Can I manually save a site I'm working on in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes, you can now manually save a site you're working on.

title: How can I change the Lottie animation on my Wix site?
content: To change your Lottie animation, sign in to your LottieFiles account and copy the animation's link. In your editor, click the Lottie element, then click the Settings icon. Paste the new URL under What's the animation's URL? and press Enter on your keyboard. Tip: Clicking Change Animation takes you directly to LottieFiles in a new browser tab.

title: Can I add a form to the Cart page in Wix Stores to collect additional information from customers?
content:
Currently, it's not possible to add a form to the Cart page to collect additional information.

Workarounds:
- You can create a form on the Checkout page by adding custom fields.
- Customers can enter information using the "Add a Note" link in the Cart page.

title: What are the steps to add an app to my Wix site through the site's dashboard?
content:
To add an app to your Wix site through the site's dashboard:

- Go to the Wix App Market in your site's dashboard.
- Browse for apps or use the search bar to search for a particular app.
- Click an app to learn more about it.
- Click +Add to Site to add the app.
- Click Allow and Add to confirm.

Note: If the app you chose has an editor component as well, it will appear as a pending app when you open your Editor. Not all apps available in the Wix App Market are available through the Wix app.

title: What should I do if I receive the error message 'Your subscription has been suspended by your reseller' for my Google Workspace email purchased from Wix?
content: If you see the error message 'Your subscription has been suspended by your reseller' while trying to access your Google Workspace business email purchased from Wix, either the email subscription has expired, or there is an issue with your payment. Check the status of your business email on the Business Email page. If it has expired, click Renew Subscription if prompted to renew subscription. If it is still active, go to Payment Methods if prompted to update your payment method, click Actions, click Update, click Next, update your card details, and click Update.

title: Can I host my Wix site on a different server or embed it elsewhere?
content: Your Wix site is a standard HTML5 site and is built with Wix’s technology. For your site to work properly, it needs to be hosted and operated on Wix's servers. Wix is a SaaS solution, and your site must run on Wix’s servers because the SaaS architecture does not support external hosting since it uses Wix’s proprietary technology and relies on Wix’s services to operate. If you embed your site into an external location, Wix cannot provide support, and Wix is no longer in control of the way your site appears or functions. Additionally, Google Analytics and search engines may not work properly with embedded sites.

title: How can I enable desktop notifications for Wix Inbox?
content: To enable desktop notifications: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings drop-down at the top right. Click Notifications. Click Edit Desktop Notifications next to Desktop notifications. Click the Enable desktop notifications toggle to activate desktop notifications.

title: How can I use the Rabbit SEO app to improve my website's search engine ranking?
content:
With the Rabbit SEO app by SEO Tools, you can find and monitor the right keywords for your site to boost traffic and rank higher on search engines. The app's features and benefits include:

* Find and monitor the right keywords for your website
* Explore the top keywords of your competitors
* Know who visits your site and learn how they got there
* Get hints and tips about improving your site's search engine ranking

Note: This app is added to your site's dashboard - it does not appear on your site.

Check out the Rabbit SEO app by SEO Tools to get started. For questions or comments, contact SEO Tools directly:
Website: https://www.rabbitseo.com/
Email: info@rabbitseo.com

title: How can I use the Member's Area on my site with Wix Bookings?
content: On sites with Wix Bookings, the Member's Area includes a My Bookings page where clients can reschedule appointments or re-book past appointments. You can view and manage your members in your dashboard's Member List tab.

title: Is the feature for vertical responsiveness supported in Wix Editor?
content: Wix offers solutions to help you build a horizontally responsive site, but Wix is still working on solutions for vertical responsiveness. In the meantime, you can try Wix's recommendations for space under your footer.

title: How do I set up manual (offline) payments on Wix?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Connect next to Manual Payments. Click the drop-down menu and select a title for the payment instructions: Cash payment, Offline payment or Cash on delivery. Enter instructions to complete the payment in the text box. Click Connect.

title: Can I accept credit card donations on my site using Wix Payments?
content: Yes. It is now possible to accept donations using Wix Payments along with the Wix Donations app. Learn more about accepting donation payments.

title: Can I enable multiple attempts to charge for failed renewals before a customer's plan is cancelled?
content: Yes. You can now enable recurring retries. This allows you to make multiple attempts to charge for failed renewals before your customer's plan is cancelled.

title: How can I allow customers to add a personalized message when purchasing a product on my Wix Store?
content:
Add a custom text box to your Product Page so customers can leave a message when they purchase a specific product. To add a custom text field to your Product Page:

- Go to Products in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant product or click New Product to add a new one.
- Scroll down and click Add Custom Text Field.
- Enter the title of the text field (e.g. What name should we engrave?).
- Enter the character limit for the text field.
- Select or deselect the Mandatory field checkbox:
  - Selected: The customer must fill in the text field.
  - Deselected: The customer can leave it blank.
- (Optional) Click Add Another to add a second custom text field. Tip: You can add up to 2 fields.
- Click Save.

After a customer makes an order, you can see the information they wrote in the Orders tab.

title: Can I have different header and footer designs on different pages of my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to have different header or footer designs on different pages of your Wix site. The same header and footer designs are applied to all site pages. However, you can hide them on certain pages. You can display different headers and footers across different pages on your site with Editor X. Editor X is a responsive site builder, meaning you can customize and tailor a site for your exact needs.

title: How do I connect Pagsmile as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Pagsmile.

If you already have a Pagsmile account, enter your app id and security key and click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create Pagsmile account, register for a Pagsmile merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved you will be provided with your unique app id and security key credentials. Then return to Accept Payments, repeat the earlier steps, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Pagsmile account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How does Apple's in-app purchase policy affect the sale of online goods and services on iOS devices?
content:
Apple's in-app purchase policy affects the way you sell online goods and services to customers using iOS devices. This policy only affects the sale of online goods and services, not physical products. You are affected if you want to sell the following on your app:

- Pricing plans (both single payment plans and recurring plans).
- Products integrated with pricing plans (e.g. online programs or events sold via pricing plan).
- Recurring payments (e.g. subscriptions).

To sell most other online goods and services via single payment, you can set up in-app purchase from your Branded app dashboard.

If you currently have pricing plans on your app that include online classes or services, such as online group workout classes or any online programs added as part of a pricing plan, you can either remove all elements associated with pricing plans from your app or hide the element from iOS devices before submitting your app for approval.

Additionally, Apple has a price limitation of $1000 USD for products sold as IAP products, and this policy only applies to members attempting to purchase online content with an iOS device, not Android devices.

title: How can I migrate my Shopify store to Wix Stores using the Cart2Cart app?
content:
Before you begin: add Wix Stores to your site. To migrate store orders, upgrade to a Premium plan or Studio plan that allows you to accept payments.

Add the Cart2Cart app from the Wix App Market. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Cart2Cart app, and click Add to Site. In Studio Editor, click App Market on the left side of the editor, search for the Cart2Cart app, and click Add to Site. Then sign in to an existing Cart2Cart account or create a new one. In the Cart2Cart dashboard, make sure the email associated with the relevant Wix account is selected, then click Source and Target Cart Setup.

Select Shopify from the Source Cart drop-down and enter your store's URL. Get your Shopify API password by logging in to Shopify, clicking the Apps tab, clicking Manage private apps, clicking Create a New Private App, entering Cart2Cart in the Private app name field, entering the email of a developer or the person most suited to deal with technical issues in the Emergency developer email field, setting permissions to Read Access, clicking Save, and copying the API password. Paste the API credentials in the API Password field. Select Wix from the Target Cart drop-down and click Choose Entities.

Select the data types you want to migrate, such as products, orders, and coupons. Imports are limited to 1,000 products and 1,000 orders. Optionally select available additional options, such as Clear current data on Target Store before Migration, Skip product thumbnail images migration, and Change products quantity to 100 on Target Store ($29), and perform data mapping for orders. Click Start Free Demo.

After the demo migration, click Check the Results to view your data in your Wix dashboard. When satisfied, select an insurance plan or click Skip Migration Insurance, review the migration price, click Add Funds for Full Migration, enter the required details, and click Buy now. When the migration is complete, you'll receive an email notification.

title: How can I upgrade my existing Ascend Plan on Wix to a plan with more features or a longer subscription period?
content:
To upgrade your Ascend Plan:

- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the Show More icon next to the relevant plan.
- Click Upgrade Ascend.
- Click Select under the new Ascend Plan.
- Select the subscription period and click Next.
- Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase.

Important: Any remaining credit from your old Ascend Plan is deducted from the price of your new upgrade during the purchase process. This credit is deducted after any discounts from a coupon or seasonal sale are applied. The upgrade takes effect immediately.

title: How can I connect Fondy as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Fondy. If you have a Fondy account, enter your Merchant ID and Merchant key, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Fondy Payments account, register for and activate your Fondy merchant account, then once approved return to this window and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account. Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Fondy account to avoid transaction declines.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site is compliant with the LGPD regarding cookies and data processing consent?
content: Under the LGPD, you are required to provide complete information about which cookies you are using; you can use your privacy policy to provide such information to your visitors. The LGPD does not explicitly require that you get affirmative consent from site visitors before placing cookies and similar technologies on their device. You can use the Wix Privacy Center to add a cookie banner to your site, and with a cookie banner visitors can give their consent to non-essential cookies being placed on their device. If you want to receive affirmative consent from your site visitors before processing their data, you can do so by displaying a cookie banner on your site, using Wix Forms to receive explicit consent, creating a custom form and connecting it to a database using Velo by Wix, adding a policy checkbox to your Wix Stores checkout page, or customizing your booking form’s fields in Wix Bookings. Wix states that information in the article is not legal advice, and recommends reviewing details of the regulation and seeking legal advice.

title: How can I add and customize an Accordion element in the Studio Editor?
content: Use the Accordion element to show a large amount of content in a small space. To add an Accordion, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Layout Tools, click Accordions, and drag an Accordion you like onto your page. Select it and click Manage Items to choose an item to edit; this opens the item on the canvas so you can add the relevant elements and information. In Manage Items, hover over an item and click the More Actions icon to Duplicate, Rename, or Delete it. Click Add Item at the bottom of the panel for a new blank item, and hold the Reorder icon next to an item to drag it to the desired location. To control opening and closing, select the Accordion, click Settings, choose an option under Choose the default state, and use the Allow multiple open items toggle. To design it, select the Accordion, click Open Inspector, and choose Titles, Containers, or Accordion items from the drop-down. To adjust layout, select the Accordion and click Layout to choose an icon, icon position, and title padding.

title: I'm encountering a 403 forbidden error message on my Wix site. How can I resolve it?
content: A 403 error occurs when a visitor does not have the relevant permissions to access a collection that appears on the page. Edit the permissions to allow the visitor to access the page. Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, click the relevant collection, then click More Actions at the top and select Permissions & privacy. For a live site 403 error, make sure the URL you entered is correct, clear your browser's cache and cookies, then go to the web address again. If the problem persists, contact us.

title: How can I change the direction of my Wix Pro Gallery to be right-to-left using the Wix Editor?
content:
To change the direction of your Wix Pro Gallery to be right-to-left in the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click the Pro Gallery element on your page, click **Settings**, click **Advanced**, and select **Right to left** under **General Settings**.

**Note:** If you have chosen to display text (image title / description) on your gallery, make sure that the gallery direction you choose matches your language's direction, to avoid punctuation issues.

title: How can I add the WhatsApp channel to my Wix Chat chatbox?
content: Before you begin, make sure Wix Chat is added to your site. Go to the Channels tab in your Chat Settings. Click the toggle next to WhatsApp to let visitors contact you via WhatsApp in your chatbox. If this is your first time setting up chat channels, click Get Started. Enter your phone number in the Your phone number (with country code) field; use the phone number linked to the WhatsApp account you want to use. Enter it in full international format: a plus sign (+) followed by the country code, city code, and local phone number, and remove any leading zeroes. Optionally, enter an info message such as availability hours in the WhatsApp info text field; this appears in your chatbox when visitors select 'WhatsApp' as their preferred chat method. Optionally, enter a default message in the Pre-filled message field; visitors can edit or change it before sending. Click Save Changes at the top right.

title: How can I change the size of the menu icon on my mobile site?
content: Click the menu icon in the mobile editor, then click and drag the resize handles to increase or decrease the size of the menu.

title: How can I create a Wix site using my Microsoft Office 365 subscription?
content: Sign in to your Office 365 account, go to your Office 365 admin center, click Public Website on the left, click Learn more under Wix, then click Start Now on the Microsoft Office 365 page and sign up for a Wix account. If you already have a Wix account, click I'm an existing user and sign in. You can learn more about choosing your template; once your site is built and ready to publish, upgrade to Premium Plans and connect your Office 365 domain to your Wix site.

title: Can I sync my Wix Bookings calendar with additional Google Calendars in the same Google account?
content: Currently, when you sync your Google Calendar with Wix Bookings, you can only sync with your primary Google calendar (the first calendar created when you opened your Google account). It is not possible to sync with additional calendars in the same Google account.

title: How can I connect Wix services and content to my pricing plans?
content: Go to Pricing Plans in your dashboard. Click Edit to update an existing plan or click + Create Plan to make a new one. Enter or update the name, tagline and benefits as required. Select which content and services you want to include in the plan under Connect & manage benefits. Select the checkbox beside the services or content types to connect them to your plan. Click Save. You can create new content or services and add them to your pricing plans whenever you like.

title: How can I embed interactive content in an article or section of my online program using Wix?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard and select the relevant program. Create a new step or edit an existing one: click + Add next to Schedule (for scheduled programs) or Content (for self-paced programs) and select Article or Section; or click Edit next to an Article or Section. Add or edit the basic info and content. To add more interactive content, use icons at the bottom of the Content field: Image, Gallery, Divider, HTML code, Video, GIF, File, Table, or Audio file. For a video, you can upload from your computer or paste a URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook. To embed an event, service, or product, select the relevant Wix app icon at the bottom of the Content field: Wix Events, Wix Bookings, or Wix Stores, select the item, then click Embed. To add a call-to-action button, click the Button icon, click the newly added button, click the Settings icon, enter display text, paste the relevant link, optionally customize settings and design, then click Save. Click Save when done adding content. Tip: If you want to add a video to your article, consider adding a video step instead.

title: How can I add a button to my ADI site and customize its text and link?
content:
To add a button to your ADI site and customize its text and link, follow these steps:

* Click the relevant page section.
* Click **Edit**.
* Select or deselect the **Show/Hide** icon next to the **Buttons** field:
  * **Selected**: The button is shown.
  * **Unselected**: The button is hidden.
* (Optional) Click **+ Add Button** to add another button.
* Enter the text for your button.
* Click **Link** and select the link for your button.
* Click **Done**.

**Notes:**
* The style of your secondary button is based on the settings of your first button.
* The option of adding a second button may not be supported in some sections of your ADI site.

title: What should I do if I want to sell a new product that might be prohibited by my payment provider?
content: If you decide to begin selling a new product, you should check your payment provider's Terms of Service before you begin selling the item. If the products are prohibited, you’ll need to select a different payment provider that supports those products, or remove them from sale. For Wix Payments users, check the list of Wix Payments restricted and prohibited goods and services. For users of other payment providers, check with your individual provider for their list of prohibited items.

title: How can I add additional information to my videos in Wix Video?
content:
To add information to a video in Wix Video, go to Video Library in your site's dashboard and click the Edit icon next to the relevant video. Then add your information:

* Title: Enter a title for the video.
* Publisher: Add information about the person or company responsible for distributing the video.
* Categories: Add your videos to categories to group them together. The categories help your visitors identify what your channel is about. For example, Breakfast, Snacks, Dessert.
* Tags: Add tags to your videos to describe specific characteristics of your video. Your visitors can search the tags to find a video they're looking for quickly. For example, Chocolate, Cookies, Eggs.
* Description: Enter a description of the video.
* Add Action Cards to Your Videos: Action Cards are clickable links that appear on your video to get likes from visitors or promote products.
* Video Pricing: Choose whether this video is free or viewers are required to pay to view it.
* Trailer: Choose whether you would like to have a trailer for your video.
* More About This Video: Give your audience more info. Credit cast & crew, add a cover poster and more.
* Let Viewers Embed This Video: Allow viewers to generate a simple piece of HTML code and play your video on any site.

Click Save on the top right.

title: How can I mark a blog post as 'featured' using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Blog. Tap Posts. Tap More Actions next to the relevant post. Tap Post Settings. Enable the Feature Post toggle. Tap Next. Click Save. Then choose Save Changes to save your changes in draft form, or Publish Post to publish your updated post.

title: How can I view my mobile site using a QR code from the Wix Mobile Editor?
content: Open the mobile editor. Click Preview on the top tool bar. Click the QR icon. Scan the QR code using your device. You need to publish your site before you can view the mobile version.

title: How can I permanently delete a media file from my Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click Trash. Click the file you want to delete. Tip: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) on your keyboard and click to select multiple files. Click Permanently Delete on the right. Click the checkbox next to I'm sure I want to delete it. Click Permanently Delete. Tip: Delete all files in Trash by clicking Empty Trash on the right.

title: How can I view the cached version of my site on Google?
content: Search for your site on Google. Click the Show More icon beside your site's result. Click Cached at the bottom of the About this result section.

title: How can I create a Back to Top button on my Wix site?
content:
In the Wix Editor, add a button by clicking Add Elements on the left side of the editor, then clicking Decorative, clicking Arrows, and dragging an arrow onto your site. You can also use other elements such as vector art or icon buttons for your Back to Top button.

Link the button to the top of the page: click the button in your editor, click the Link icon, click Top/Bottom of Page, click Top, and click Done.

Pin the button to the screen: right-click your button, click Pin to Screen, and select a position on the grid under Set position. Optionally, move the element by setting an offset: drag the Horizontal offset slider or type a number in the field next to the slider, and drag the Vertical offset slider or type a number in the field next to the slider.

Show your button on all pages: right-click your button and enable the Show on All Pages toggle.

Note: The Back to Top button will not be displayed on your mobile site. However, you can add the mobile Back to Top button, specifically designed for your mobile site.

title: Can I add dynamic values from Wix Stores to automation emails?
content:
Yes, you can now add dynamic values linked to your store (e.g. a product ID, a specific order, etc.). To add dynamic values linked to your store:

1. Customize an automated email and edit your email template.
2. Click + Add Dynamic Value.
3. Select relevant Wix Stores dynamic values (e.g. order number).

title: How can I add link rel attributes to a link in a Wix Blog post?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Blog and select the post you want to edit. Select the text you want to add a link to, then click the Link icon in the top bar. Enter the URL you want to link to in the field and select whether or not you want the link to open in a new tab. Select the checkboxes for the link rel attributes you want to add: Tell Google to ignore this link adds a "nofollow" attribute, and Mark as a sponsored link adds a "sponsored" attribute. Click Save, then click Publish.

title: Can I have more control over my store design using Wix ADI?
content: Currently ADI offers limited customization options for designing your online store. If you want more control over your store design, you need to switch your site to the Editor and then follow the instructions.

title: How do I document my Velo Package using the README.md file provided by Wix Blocks?
content:
Wix Blocks provides an empty README.md markdown file for you to edit as part of the package creation process. To document your Velo Package:

- Click **README.md** in the code files panel README section.
- Write your text in the markdown file provided.
- Click **Preview** to see how the file is rendered.

Your readme should include the following sections:

- An introduction that explains what the package does and why it's useful.
- How to use the package.
- Package contents and functions provided.
- Packages, such as npm packages, included in your package, along with licensing information for those packages. For example, your users should be aware that when they install a package that uses an npm package, they agree to that npm package's license agreement.
- Instructions for using the package's functions.
- Usage examples.

title: How can I ensure that my site's design looks great on all screen sizes using the Studio Editor?
content:
In the Studio Editor, you can customize your designs per breakpoint. Breakpoints are screen width ranges that represent the possible screens and devices visitors tend to use, such as tablet and mobile. The Studio Editor uses a cascading concept: changes made on larger breakpoints trickle down to smaller breakpoints, but changes on smaller breakpoints don't affect larger breakpoints.

You can also use the responsive AI tool to make your sections responsive on all screen sizes in just one click. This tool identifies groups of related elements and applies the ideal layout tool for each group, such as stack or grid.

For element resizing, you can edit the element's size in pixels and select a responsive behavior. Every element comes with a default responsive behavior, such as scaling proportionally, which controls how it gets resized on other screens. From the Inspector panel, you can change an element's responsive behavior to better meet your needs.

When an element is set to scale proportionally, you can enable the Scale properties toggle in the Inspector panel so its design looks ideal on every screen and adjusts properties like borders automatically.

For text, the Studio Editor automatically scales text in proportion to the screen size. You can set minimum and maximum values to make sure the text never gets too small or too big. For more precise control, select Custom to set the size range for each separate breakpoint.

title: How do I enable guest checkout for pricing plans on my site?
content:
To enable guest checkout:
Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard.
Click the Checkout tab.
Click to enable the Guest checkout toggle.

title: How can I access the Hotels tab in my Wix site's dashboard?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Hotels tab on the left.

title: How can I add a Twitter Tweet button to my Wix site and set it up with my Twitter username?
content: Click Add on the left side of the Editor. Click Social. Click a Twitter Tweet button under Twitter to add it, or drag the button to the relevant location. Click Set Username. Enter your Twitter username. Enter the text which appears on your visitors' Twitter feeds when they click on the Twitter Tweet button.

title: How do I connect Goibibo & MakeMyTrip to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Before connecting, set and update the rates and availability of all rooms on the Inventory Calendar. To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Goibibo & MakeMyTrip, log in to the Goibibo & MakeMyTrip extranet, go to Property, choose HotelRunner from the Select Channel Manager drop-down, click Add, and copy your access token. In the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, go to Channel Manager, click Connect next to Goibibo & MakeMyTrip, enter Hotel ID, enter the access token from Goibibo in the Username field, and click Save and Continue. To map room types, collect your room IDs on the Goibibo & MakeMyTrip extranet, go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, click View channel details next to Goibibo & MakeMyTrip, click Fetch room types, hover over each room type and click Expand, match your Goibibo & MakeMyTrip room types with your room types on Wix Hotels by HotelRunner using the drop-downs, and click Save at the bottom. After completing room mapping, click Activate. Once the Goibibo & MakeMyTrip connection is complete, all inventory (rates, availability, and restrictions) on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar will be transferred to your Goibibo & MakeMyTrip account.

title: How do I download and set up the OBS Studio encoder for live streaming on Wix Video?
content:
In order to stream videos live from your computer you'll need an encoder. An encoder is the software that connects your computer's camera to the stream. Important: The output needs to be set to 'Simple'. If it is set to 'Advanced' it can cause issues with the live stream. You can download the OBS encoder, or choose any encoder you want as long as it supports custom keys.

Step 1 | Download the Installer from OBS Studio
- Go to the OBS Studio downloading page.
- On the download page, select your computer's operating system.
- Scroll down and click Download Installer.

Step 2 | Install the Encoder on Your Computer
- Open the OBS Installer.
- If you see a verification window, click Install anyway.
- Click Next.
- Click I Agree.
- Choose where the file should go and click Next.
- Review the components and click Install.
- Click Finish.

Step 3 | Connect Your Camera to the Encoder
- Open the OBS Studio Encoder.
- Under Sources at the bottom left, click Add.
- From the list, select Video Capture Device.
- Select Create New, name your camera, and click OK.
- From the Device drop-down list, select your computer's integrated camera and click OK.

Step 4 | Change Your Streaming Settings
- Open the OBS Studio Encoder.
- Click Settings on the bottom right.
- Select the Output tab to change the codec, audio and video bitrates.
- Select the Video tab to change the video resolution.

Note: To get the best results, make sure you don't exceed: Video Resolution: 720p (1280x720); Codec: x264; Video bitrate: ~2500 kbps; Audio bitrate: AAC 44.1kHz ~128kbps.

Currently, Wix Video only offers support and troubleshooting for the OBS Studio encoder. Other encoders may not connect with Wix Video. If you want to use a different encoder, make sure you know where to enter the Server URL and the stream key.

title: How can I import my mailing list from another platform to Wix Email Marketing?
content: Export your mailing list in a CSV format from the platform you're using. Then import your mailing list to your Wix account so that you can send email campaigns to your subscribers, and select the Mark as subscribers checkbox when importing. Only set contacts as Subscribers if they've given you permission to do so. Learn more about Wix Email Marketing best practices.

title: How can I customize my statement descriptor in Wix Payments?
content:
To customize your statement descriptor in Wix Payments:
- Go to Manage Wix Payments.
- Scroll down to Customer Statement Descriptor.
- Enter the name you do business as under Statement Descriptor.
- Your statement descriptor must be between 5-19 characters.
- Your statement descriptor must be similar to your business name, legal entity name, or URL.
- Your statement descriptor should not be too generic (e.g. "Store") or already in use (e.g. "Wix.com").
- Click Save.

Note: Most banks display financial information consistently and in-line with the statement descriptor you provided to Wix Payments. Some may display it incorrectly or not at all. Wix Payments has no control over how banks choose to display financial information.

title: Can I integrate CMS collections with Zapier to sync changes with Google Sheets?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to integrate CMS (Content Management System) collections with Zapier. For example, with a Zapier integration, you would be able to sync CMS collection changes with Google Sheets and other apps available in Zapier.

Workaround: You can create an automation that connects with Zapier each time you receive a form submission from input elements.

title: How can I edit a published website?
content: You can edit your site at any time from the Wix Editor. Open the Editor from your site's dashboard and update it as much as you want. To open the Editor, go to your site's dashboard and click Edit Site next to your site's name.

title: What steps can I take if I am unable to view images on my site?
content:
To resolve missing images on your site:
- Clear your browser's cache.
- View your site using incognito or private browsing mode.
- View your site in the latest version of another supported browser.
- Temporarily disable any internet security programs installed (e.g. antivirus, firewall) and try to access your site again. It is preferable to try this while connected to the modem directly.
- Try viewing your Wix site from a different computer that uses a different network to connect to the internet.

title: How can I set up my notification preferences for online orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: To set up your notification preferences: Go to Restaurant Orders Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Notification preferences under Notifications. (If disabled) Click the Enable notifications for this site toggle to receive notifications for your site. Set your notifications by channel: Desktop: Click the Enable desktop notifications toggle to enable or disable push notifications on your browser. Dashboard: Click Dashboard and enable the notifications you want to receive in your Wix dashboard. Note: By default, "New order was submitted" is enabled under Wix Restaurants Orders (New). Email: Click Email and enable the notifications you want to receive to your email. By default, "New order was submitted" is enabled under Wix Restaurants Orders (New). Notes: Email notifications are sent to your Wix account email address and not the business email set in your business info. If you'd like others to also receive these notifications, you can invite them to manage your restaurant.

title: How can I customize the Wix Audio Player on my mobile site in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the player in your mobile editor, then customize it for mobile: resize the player using the drag handles; click the Layouts icon to change the layout; click the Hide icon to hide the player on your mobile site. Any changes made to audio and video players on mobile will not be reflected on the desktop version of your site.

title: How can I start a discussion with event guests using the Wix Member Apps?
content: If you have not already done so, download the Spaces by Wix app or any other relevant member app. Tap Member App on the relevant site. Tap Events. Tap Published Events. Select the relevant event. Scroll down and tap Event Promotion. Tap the Discussion tab. Tap Create New Post / Share something. Type the message you want to share. You can add images, videos, GIFs, or a poll. Optionally, tag a member by typing the @ and selecting a member. Tap Post once you're ready to make your post live.

title: How can I duplicate an email marketing campaign?
content: To duplicate an email marketing campaign, go to My Email Campaigns. Click Manage next to Most Recent Email Campaigns. Hover over the relevant campaign and click the Show More icon. Click Duplicate. Note: If one of your campaigns was declined, you can duplicate it and send again.

title: How can I change the URL of a page in the Wix Editor?
content:
To change your page URL in the Wix Editor:

- Go to your editor.
- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Hover over the relevant page and click the **More Actions** icon.
- Click **SEO Basics**.
- Enter the page URL under **URL slug (last part of the page's URL)**.
- Press **Enter** on your keyboard.

**Tip:** Use words related to the page's content to increase the chances of that page showing up in relevant search results.

title: Why are my customers unable to checkout from my Wix store?
content: If customers are unable to checkout from your store, check the following: 1) Make sure you have set up at least one payment method by going to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Providers can include Wix Payments, Credit Card via a third-party payment provider such as Square or Stripe, PayPal, or Manual. 2) Check that your site has been upgraded to a plan that allows you to accept payments. 3) Create shipping rules: you must have a shipping/delivery/pickup rule that applies to the customer's country, or the customer may get a message that your store doesn't ship to their area. 4) Make sure coupons or discounts do not reduce a product's price below zero. Review which products each coupon or discount applies to, and consider creating percent discount coupons instead of price discount coupons to avoid this problem.

title: How can I set up a subdomain in my Wix account to connect to an external site?
content: If your primary (root) domain is a Wix domain or connected to Wix via name servers, and the subdomain destination is an external (non-Wix) website, resource, or blog, add the required DNS records in your Wix account. The source also refers to learning how to connect a subdomain to an external site.

title: How can I add a 'Save to Pinterest' button to my Wix site?
content: To add the Save to Pinterest button: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Social. Scroll down to the Pinterest section. Drag the Pin to Pinterest button onto your site. Note: Place the button near or on the image you want visitors to be able to save. Click Add Image. Select the relevant image from your Media Manager and click Add to Page. Note: This should be the same image that you just placed your pin on. Enter a description to appear next to the pin when it's saved or shared: Click the Settings icon. Enter your description under What's this pin? Tell Pinterest. (Optional) Click the Layout icon to change the look of the button: under What size is the button?, select either the small or large button; under How does it look?, show or hide the number of times the image has been saved. (Optional) Click the Animation icon and select an animation from the available options. Important: Place the Save to Pinterest button on or next to the image you want visitors to share, however this does not automatically link it to the button. You still need to click Add Image to link it to the image you want to share.

title: How can I add a daily agenda to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Bookings. Click Daily Agenda. Drag the daily agenda onto your page. The daily agenda automatically displays your classes on the days they are available. Note: Courses and appointments do not appear in the daily agenda.

title: How can I add and customize the Cookiebot™ for Wix app on my website?
content: Before you begin, note that the Cookiebot™ for Wix app requires a monthly subscription, and you need to add your payment information before you can start configuring the app. To add the app, go to the Wix App Market, click Add to Site below Cookiebot™ for Wix, review the Terms of Use and click Agree & Add, click Upgrade app to Premium, choose a package, click Select, choose a plan, click Continue to Checkout, complete the purchase, click View your apps, click Open next to the Cookiebot app, and review the scan report on the screen. To customize the banner, go to the Manage Apps tab in your site's dashboard, click Appearance, select a theme for your banner, click Save, click Content, click the Text labels tab, enter the required content for your banner, click Save, click Language settings, click Add Language, select the relevant languages, and click Save.

title: How can I verify my multilingual subdomains with Google Search Console?
content: Go to Google Search Console. Click Start now. Click the drop-down at the top left and select Add property. Enter the full URL of the multilingual subdomain you want to verify under URL prefix. Click Continue. Make sure to verify your site before verifying your multilingual subdomains. If Google Search Console can't verify your subdomain after following these steps, try again in an hour as your subdomain's records may need time to propagate.

title: How can I apply SEO settings to all languages on my Wix multilingual site?
content: Wix Multilingual lets you maintain a site in multiple languages and use SEO Settings to apply changes to all languages automatically. Instead of editing each page's individual settings, you can customize the settings that apply to entire sections of your site. Any changes you make to your SEO Settings affect the related pages regardless of their language (e.g. Product pages, Site pages, etc.). Once you save your edits, no action is required to ensure the pattern supports other languages. You can also customize the SEO Basics settings of individual pages for every version of your site. By default, Wix adds hreflang tags to your pages so search engines can identify their language and show the correct version to your visitors.

title: Is the centralized collection feature supported in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, centralized collections are not supported. This means that when a Blocks app is installed on several sites, each site receives its own instance of the collection and manages its data individually.

title: I'd like to see what items my customers added to their cart, and how items were sold
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and view the reports in the Sales section. To see how items were sold, view the Sales by item report, which gives you a breakdown of the specific items and services you've sold. To see products customers placed in a cart but didn’t end up buying, view the Most Abandoned Products report in your Wix Stores reports.

title: How can I enable the Snap to Objects tool in the Wix Editor?
content: Click **Tools** on the top right of the Editor, then select the **Snap to Objects** checkbox.

title: Is it possible to integrate Google AdMob to show ads in my branded app?
content: Currently there is no option to display ads in your branded app to earn revenue using Google Admob. Google Admob is a way to monetize mobile apps by making ad space available on your app for advertisers to promote their products.

title: How can I add a watermark to my images using Wix Photo Studio?
content: To add a watermark with Wix Photo Studio: Go to your editor. Click the Settings icon. Click Adjust. Click Text on the left. Select a text style and click to add it to your image. Enter your chosen watermark message. (Optional) Click Design to customize the text: Font: Click the relevant drop-down menu to change your font and font size. Styles: Format your text using the options: Bold, Italic or Underline and choose your text color. Alignment: Choose your text alignment: Left, Center, Right or Justify and adjust your line spacing. Opacity: Increase or decrease the transparency of your text. Rotate and flip: Change your text orientation: Rotate left, Rotate right, Flip horizontally or Flip vertically. Click Save at the top right.

title: Can I set up video conferencing for my bookings using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: It is not possible to set up video conferencing from the Wix app on a mobile device. You or your staff members can set up video conferencing from the Booking Services or Staff tab in the dashboard.

title: How can I add a filter to my dataset in the CMS to control which items appear on my live site?
content:
To add a filter to your dataset in the CMS, in the dataset settings:

- Select the field: choose which collection field you want to filter by.
- Define the condition: specify the condition that your filter should apply. Depending on the type of field, you can use conditions like "is," "Starts with," "Greater than," or "Equals."
- Set the Value: decide on the value that your filter should match. This could be a specific category, a numerical threshold, or even the logged-in user.

If you ever need to change or remove a filter, you can do it from the dataset settings.

title: How can I resolve crawl errors using Google Search Console?
content:
View information about crawl errors and warnings in the Pages section of Google Search Console. In some cases, such as a 404 error or a 5xx error, Google was not able to crawl your page and will likely remove your page from search results. Other errors such as the "page resources couldn't be loaded" error may not necessarily affect your page's SEO. For a specific error, read the relevant article listed in the source article.

Note: Partially loaded page resources have no impact on your site's SEO. These URLs are part of the structure of your Wix site, and they do not affect Google's ability to crawl your site's content. You don't need to take any action for this error.

title: Can customers buy a Wix Gift Card together with other products in one purchase?
content: Currently, when customers purchase Wix Gift Cards, they need to pay for the gift card purchase separately. It's not possible to add gift cards and other products to the cart and pay for them together.

title: How can I connect my existing domain to Wix using the pointing method?
content:
Before you begin, you must upgrade your Wix site before you can connect your domain.

Step 1 | Add the domain to your Wix account:
1. Go to Domains in your Wix account.
2. Click Add an Existing Domain.
3. Click Connect a domain you already own.
4. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Continue.
5. Enter the domain name and click Let's Go.
6. Click Yes, I own this domain in the sentence below the search field.
If a Start Transfer option appears, click connect your domain in the sentence below it.

Connect your domain manually (Start button):
1. Review the information on screen and click Start.
2. Click pointing in the sentence at the top of the screen.
3. Click Switch to Pointing Instructions.

Step 2 | Update the DNS records in your domain host account:
1. Log in to your domain's current host account: open a new tab, go to your domain host's site and log in, go back to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard, and click I logged in.
2. Find your domain settings page: go to the domains page on your domain host's site, find your domain and go to its settings panel, return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard, and click I found my domain settings.
3. Find your DNS records: in your domain settings, find the area where you manage or edit DNS server records, return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard, and click I found the records.
4. Replace your DNS records: on your domain host's site, replace your current records with the Wix DNS records provided on your Wix domains page, return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard, and click I updated my records.

Important: Be sure to update both your CNAME and A record with your domain host. If you don't, your site will appear unsecure and your visitors may see a warning message.

Step 3 | Wait for your domain to propagate:
Your work is done. It may take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and your site to appear worldwide.

title: How can I resolve the issue of text being unreadable on top of an image in ADI?
content: If you cannot see the text on top of an image, it is because the text is a similar color to the image. To resolve this, you should change the design of your site.

title: How can I move a site to trash in Wix?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon. Click Move to trash. Click Move to Trash to confirm. Note: It's not possible to move a premium site to the trash folder. If you wish to do so, first cancel or reassign the plan to another site in your account.

title: Can I change the Facebook Business page connected to my Facebook Ads dashboard myself?
content:
Currently in Facebook Ads, you cannot change the Facebook Business page you connected to the Facebook Ads dashboard. However, it is possible for our team to switch the page for you. Please contact us and provide the following information:

* Your Wix site URL
* The URL of the new Facebook Business page that you want to connect

title: Can Wix Forms detect the specific address from which a form was submitted?
content: Currently, using Wix Forms, it is not possible to detect the specific address from which a form was submitted. However, you can access the general location of the form submission using the form submission report.

title: Can I generate a cost of goods report directly from my POS tablet using Wix Retail POS?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create a cost of goods report from your POS tablet. Workaround: It is possible to create a cost of goods report from the Wix dashboard.

title: Can I use tags as choices in dropdown input elements set to collect content?
content: Currently, when using the dropdown input element to collect content, it is not possible to use the tags field type as choices. However, you can use the tags field type when using the dropdown input element to filter the content that displays.

title: How do I connect the Stripe Reader M2 card reader to my POS tablet?
content: Tap and release the power button on the card reader to turn it on. The Bluetooth turns on automatically. Open the POS tablet, then tap the Connect Reader icon at the bottom right of the tablet. Tap Set up Card Reader. Tap Connect next to the relevant reader. Tap Done.

title: How can I create a form with input elements to manage collection content directly from my live site using the Wix Editor?
content: To manage collection content from your live site in the Wix Editor, start by adding the CMS (Content Management System) to your site and creating a collection that people should manage from the live site. In the editor, go to the page or section where you want a custom form, click Add Elements, click Input, choose the input element type, drag it onto the page, select Settings, and fill out the settings. You can optionally use Layout and Design to adjust the element. Repeat for each input element your form needs. Then connect each input element to a dataset bound to the collection you want to manage, and set the dataset mode and collection permissions. Add a Submit button connected to that dataset and set its click action to Submit.

title: How can I add collapsible text to my page using the Studio Editor?
content: To add collapsible text using the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Text, then click Collapsible Text. Drag your chosen text box onto the page.

title: How can I update a client's payment status to 'paid' in Wix Bookings?
content: To update a client's payment status to "paid": Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant client and click View. Click the Bookings tab. Hover over the relevant unpaid session and click Collect Payment. Click Mark as Paid. Note: You cannot undo this action. Tip: You can also update a client's payment status from the Bookings Calendar.

title: How can I mark a task as complete in my site's dashboard?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Customer Management. Click Tasks & Reminders. Check the circle to mark your task as complete. Optionally, check off the circle again to mark the task as incomplete. Note: Once you mark a task as complete, it disappears from your view and appears under Completed Tasks with a strikethrough.

title: How can I add business elements for my booking-based business in the Wix Member App?
content: To add business elements for a booking-based business in your Wix Member App, go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant tab, such as Spaces by Wix app or Branded Mobile App, and click Edit Mobile App. Use the Screen drop-down at the top to choose the screen you want to edit, then click Elements on the left. Under Add Elements, select the relevant business category, such as Store, Bookings, Events or Table reservations, and click the element you want to add. Edit the element on the right panel. The details you can edit depend on the element you add. Repeat these actions to add and customize additional business elements, then click Save & Publish. For a booking-based business, you can add Upcoming bookings, Agenda, Services, and Upcoming sessions. Upcoming bookings remind clients of upcoming bookings, let them book a new appointment, and show booking history. Agenda adds a weekly timetable. Services lists all your services so clients can book from the app and filter services by location. Upcoming sessions shows a preview of your upcoming sessions.

title: How can I track the source of traffic to my Wix site using UTM parameters?
content:
Wix Analytics can identify traffic sources using UTM parameters. A UTM is a tag added to your site's URL which identifies the exact source of your site's traffic. The UTM tag is composed of three parts, known as UTM parameters:

- Source: The platform the visitor came from. Examples: Facebook, Google, Bing, email.
- Medium: How the visitor reached your site. Examples: an advert, email, or organic search.
- Campaign Name: The name of the campaign, as defined by the campaign creator.

The URL is connected to the UTM with a question mark (?) and the UTM parameters are connected with ampersands (&).

For example: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=ppc&utm_campaign=mysearchcampaign

When you use Wix Email Marketing or Facebook Ads by Wix, the UTM tag is added automatically to the URL. You can also manually add UTM tags to URLs in other marketing campaigns.

title: How can I set my Wix Pro Gallery items to open in full screen when clicked?
content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click **Settings**. Click the **Settings** tab. Click the **When clicking on an item:** drop-down and choose **Open in Full Screen**. Your gallery items will then open in a popup that fills the entire screen.

title: How can I display policies in the footer of my site's checkout page?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Checkout settings. Click Policies. Select the checkbox next to any policies you want to display. Enter the policy text. For the custom policy, enter a policy name as well. Optional: To make agreeing to these policies mandatory to complete checkout, click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it. Optional: Select the Checked by default checkbox if you want the agreement checked by default.

title: How can I download a Wix Analytics report to review offline?
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard. Select a report. Click the Download drop-down at the top right. Select a file format (Excel, CSV, or Image).

title: How can I upgrade my video storage on Wix if I'm reaching my storage limit?
content: To upgrade your video storage on Wix, go to your Video Library in your site's dashboard. If you're approaching or have reached your storage limit, a warning bar appears at the top of your screen; click Upgrade to view upgrade options. Select the Premium plan you wish to add to your site and complete the purchase process. Once purchased, your new storage limit is automatically applied to your site. You can upgrade at any time.

title: How can I customize my logo using the Wix Logo Maker on a mobile device?
content:
After choosing a logo design that you like, you can customize your logo's finer details. Personalize the color palette, text design, and background of your logo, and even add additional icons.

Color Palette
- Tap the Palette icon to change the logo's color palette.
- Scroll through the available color palettes and tap a palette you like best.
- Tap Done.

Manage Text
- Tap the Text icon below your logo.
- Tap the Add icon to add new text, or tap existing text to change it.
- Customize the text with options such as Font, Text Align, Color, Size, Outline, Line Color, Flip, Curve, Opacity, Position, Spacing, Rotate, Shadow, and Blur.
- Tap Done.

Manage Symbols
- Tap the Symbols icon below your logo.
- Tap the symbol you want to customize. If you haven't yet added a symbol, tap Add.
- Use options such as Change, Color, Opacity, Size, Position, Flip, Rotate, Shadow, Blur, and Delete.
- Tap Done.

Manage Shape
- Tap the Shape icon below your logo.
- Tap the shape you want to customize. If you haven't yet added a shape, tap Add.
- Use options such as Change, Fill Color, Line Width, Line Color, Position, Size, Rotation, Shadow, Blur, and Delete.
- Tap Done.

Upload Image
- Tap the Image icon below your logo.
- Tap Upload Image.
- Choose the file you want to upload.
- Tap Done.
- Customize the uploaded image with options such as Size, Position, Flip, Rotate, Opacity, Shadow, Blur, and Delete.

Background Color
- Tap the Background icon below your logo.
- Select a background color based on your color palette, or tap the plus icon to add a new color.
- Tap Done.

title: Can I recall or unpublish a newsletter after it has been sent?
content: Currently, it is not possible to recall or unpublish a newsletter. We recommend sending a test newsletter before sending it to your subscribers.

title: How can I add and set up Wix Reviews for my Wix Store?
content: Add Wix Reviews in your editor: go to your editor, click Add Apps in Wix Editor or App Market in Studio Editor, search for Wix Reviews, select it, and click +Add to Site. Then customize functionality in your site's dashboard: go to Reviews, click More Actions at the top right, and select Settings to edit the review form, moderation settings, reply name, and helpful votes. Optionally customize review requests by going to Reviews, clicking Review Requests, then Automation Settings. To customize display and design, go to the Product Page in the Editor, click Wix Reviews, then Settings. Optionally remove Wix Product Ratings by going to the Product Page element, clicking the Plugins icon, hovering over Wix Product Ratings, and clicking Remove.

title: How can I add a slideshow to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Interactive. Click to full-width or box slideshows. Click a slideshow to add it, or drag the slide element to the relevant location.

title: How can I add a new menu to my client's site using the Studio Editor?
content: To add a menu to your client's site in the Studio Editor, click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor, then click **Menu & Search**. Drag the relevant menu design onto the page. The source lists these menu designs: **Horizontal Menus**, **Vertical Menus**, **Anchor Menus**, and **Hamburger Menus**. To add items to the new menu, select the menu, click **Manage Menu**, then click **+ Add Item** at the bottom. Select the item to add: **Main pages**, **Dynamic and app pages**, **Link**, **Submenu title**, or **Mega menu**. The source notes that this article refers to the old menu flow.

title: How can I connect Atome as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Atome as a payment provider on Wix:

- Go to Accept Payments in your dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Atome.
- If you have an account, enter your API Key and Password, then click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, sign up for an Atome account using the link that matches your location: Atome for Indonesia, Atome for Malaysia, Atome for Singapore, or Atome for Thailand. Fill in the registration form and click Agree and Submit. Wait for an email from Atome to get your API Key and Password. Then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I change the currency for my Wix Bookings site?
content: Go to the Language & Region section of your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Site Currency. Select a currency from the Currency drop-down. If your currency is missing from the list, vote for additional currencies.

title: Is it possible to transfer a storage plan to a different site in Wix Media Manager?
content:
Yes. It is now possible to transfer a storage plan to a different site. To transfer a storage plan:

- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant storage plan you want to transfer.
- Click Assign to a different site.
- Select the site you want to transfer the storage to.
- Click Next.
- Click Assign.

title: How can I preview my site in different screen sizes using Editor X?
content: Inside Editor X, you can drag the handles on the sides of the page to increase or decrease the width and see how your elements are arranged. You can also click Preview at the top right of the Editor, then use the drop-down menu at the top to select a device, drag the handles to change the width, or define the width and height of the screen in pixels. Click Edit Site to continue editing, or Publish to make your changes live. You can also add custom breakpoints to edit your site for a specific screen size.

title: is there no way to get a domain name and set up a simple website for free
content: No. Connecting a custom domain requires upgrading to a plan. After you publish your free site, it will be available online with the Wix free URL.

title: Can I require customers to order certain menu items in advance on Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, it is not possible to require advanced ordering for certain menu items. For example, if you need two days to create a fruit platter, customers must order the fruit platter at least two days in advance. It is possible for a customer to place an order for a future date, however it is not possible to make this mandatory. In the meantime, Wix recommends placing a notice on your site stating that certain items must be ordered in advance.

title: How can I display collection content on my Wix site using the CMS?
content: Create a collection in the Wix CMS. Then design your page according to the type of display you need: static pages (connect elements like text, images, repeaters, or Pro Galleries to the CMS; there is a limit of 100 static pages per site), dynamic list pages, dynamic item pages, dynamic item pages for listing items by category, or dynamic manage item pages (Studio Editor only). Connect the relevant page elements to a dataset that reads your collection content. Manage the dataset settings: set the dataset mode to determine whether it can read from your collection, write to it, or both; set the "Maximum items displayed" number to control how many items load at a time; add filters; and create sort conditions. Optionally add a "Load More" button to improve loading performance, and add navigational buttons or pagination bars. Optionally let visitors filter content using Radio Buttons, Checkboxes, Dropdown, Selection Tags, or Slider (Range Sliders only).

title: How can I ensure my website elements resize properly on different screen sizes using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, use fluid sizing and relative units of measure. In the Inspector panel, choose between Fixed and Fluid sizing options: Fixed means the element’s size stays the same regardless of the viewport, while Fluid means your element automatically resizes according to the breakpoint and your preferences. Your layers are structured according to the parenting model, where the top layer acts as a parent to the bottom layer (i.e., the child). To make sure your elements don’t overlap and look great in every screen size, set the sizing of your layers from top to bottom. Using relative measurements like the percentage (%), you can make child elements resize in relation to their parent elements. For example, set a section to take up 50% of the page’s width regardless of the screen size, and do the same with any element or container within the section.

title: How can I change the meta description of a page in Wix Editor?
content: To change a page's meta description: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon beside the relevant page. Select SEO Basics. Enter the page description under Meta description (description in search results)?. Publish your site. Important: Search engines will update your page's meta description the next time that they crawl your site. If you want to try to speed up the process, submit your page's URL to search engines. Tip: See how your page is displayed in Google search results under Preview on Google at the top of the SEO Basics tab.

title: How can I edit the button on a list item in ADI?
content:
To edit the button on a list item in ADI:
- Click the section of your site inside ADI that contains the list.
- Click **Edit**.
- Hover over the list item that you want to edit.
- Click the **Settings** icon.
- Click **Edit**.
- Enter the text for your button in the **Button Text** field.
- Click the **Link** field.
- Select the link for your button.
- Click **Done**.
- (Optional) Edit the style of your button.

**Tip:**
- If you do not see the button part of the list item, then that item cannot contain a button.
- You may need to unhide the button fields by clicking the **Hide** icon.

title: Can I connect a repeater item's background directly to the CMS in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to click a repeater item and then connect the background directly to the CMS. However, you can add a background image to a repeater item first, then connect this image to the CMS to display images from your collection. To do this, go to the Studio Editor, select a repeater item, click **Add Media**, select an image or click **+ Upload Media** to upload a new image, then click **Add to Page**. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon, choose a dataset that connects to the collection with the images you want to use as backgrounds, and select the image field under **Image source connects to**. Optionally, use the remaining drop-down menus under **Connections** to connect the image's alt text, tooltip, and link.

title: What should I do if I can't access my Wix site or editor from a public computer at a school or library?
content: Some public institutions such as schools, universities, public libraries, or government facilities restrict access to certain URLs, including the Wix servers. If you are unable to access your editor from one of these institutions, we recommend that you contact the relevant IT department at your location (if possible) to see if they can whitelist Wix.

title: How can I set up my Wix site to allow clients to check in using a chip, card, or barcode?
content:
Before you begin, add the Client Check-In app to your site. If it is already installed, update it to the latest version.

To allow clients to check in by scanning a chip, card, or barcode:
- Go to Manage Apps in your dashboard.
- Click Open next to Client Check-In.
- Click the Scan tab.
- Enable the Let members scan to check in toggle.
- Choose what happens when clients scan using the wedge reader: check them into all sessions, check them into their first available sessions, or let members choose which session to check into.
- Click Save.

After enabling the toggle, the CheckInId field appears on members' Contact cards. Enter the member's card, chip, or barcode ID number in that field. Then scan the card, chip, or barcode to sync it with the client's profile so they can check themselves in when arriving for their bookings.

To connect the Client Check-In app to a wedge reader:
- Connect your wedge reader to your computer or tablet.
- Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard.
- Hover over the relevant contact and click View.
- Click Edit Contact.
- Enter the ID number next to checkInId.
- Scan the client's card, chip, or barcode for the first time to activate the client on the system.
- Click Save.

Important: Editing the ID number or renaming the CheckInId field can create issues and prevent clients from checking in.

title: How can I customize the search box on my Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix?
content:
To customize your search box on your Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix:

- Sign in to your Hopp account.
- Click Link in Bio on the left.
- Click Edit Page at the top right.
- Click Search on the left.
- Under Search Box, choose the settings you wish to customize:
  - Visibility: Select Shown or Hidden from the drop-down to show or hide your search box on your Link in Bio page.
  - Search bar content: Customize your heading or placeholder text.
    - Heading: Enter a title above your search box to guide your audience to search for your links. Click the toggle to show or hide this heading.
    - Custom search placeholder: Enter your own text to appear on the search bar, like "enter a code here". Click the toggle to show or hide this text.
- Click Publish at the top right to make your changes live.

title: How can I close table reservations for a special event using Wix Restaurants?
content: To close table reservations for a special event using Wix Restaurants: Go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click Settings at the top right. Click Online reservations. Click Edit under Online availability to set the days and times that table reservations are unavailable at your restaurant. Click + Add Special Day. Enter a name for the event. Click the Availability drop-down and choose Unavailable. Set the event's Start Time and End Time from the relevant fields. Click Apply. Click Save.

title: Can I add a search bar to my site using ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot add a search bar to your site inside ADI. To add a search bar to your site, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions here. Note: if you decide to go back to ADI after moving to the Editor, you will not see any of the changes made in the Wix Editor.

title: How can I track Quick Action Bar events on my mobile site using Google Analytics?
content:
To track Quick Action Bar events on your mobile site using Google Analytics, connect Google Analytics to your site, sign in to your Google Analytics account, then click Reports in the menu on the left, select Engagements, and select Events.

By default, Wix sends Google Analytics information about these Quick Action bar events:
- Leads: when a visitor on your mobile site tries to contact you using the Quick Action bar by clicking the phone, email, WhatsApp, or LINE buttons.
- Engagement: when a visitor clicks any other item on your mobile site's Quick Action bar.

It can take up to 24 hours for your events to appear in Google Analytics. Use the Google Analytics Real-Time report to test your events and make sure they're logged.

title: How can I apply hover effects to my gallery in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the gallery, click the Design icon, click Customize Design, and click Hover. You can customize Rollover, Navigation arrows, and Corners. Hover effects are currently only available for Grid galleries and specific preset designs of Slider galleries; if you have a different gallery, you can switch to one of these designs. The customization options depend on the gallery design you choose.
