title: How can I enable downloading of an entire photo album on my Wix site?
content: To enable downloading of an entire album, go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Album next to the relevant album. Click Edit next to Privacy and Permissions. Enable the Let visitors download album galleries toggle in the Download settings section. Click Save.

title: How can I cancel my Branded App plan and request a refund within the first 30 days?
content:
To cancel your Branded App plan and request a refund within the first 30 days:

- Go to Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Scroll down to the site with the branded app and click the More Actions icon next to Branded App.
- Click Cancel Branded App.
- Click Cancel Now in the pop-up to confirm.

You are eligible to receive a refund within the first 30 days from initial purchase. If you canceled within 72 hours of a purchase during the trial period, it is likely that the transaction was canceled before the funds settled. In this case, instead of receiving a refund, the original charge(s) will be removed from your account within 20 business days. Please allow up to 20 business days for your refund to appear on your credit card statement.

title: Can I view feature requests that are currently collecting votes in the Wix Product Roadmap?
content: Yes. The Wix Product Roadmap now shows Feature Requests which are collecting votes, in addition to Feature Requests that are currently being worked on or planned for release in the upcoming quarters. Click the Collecting votes tab to filter and click Vote on the right side to add your vote.

title: Is it possible to create a multi-day service in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, Wix Bookings does not offer a multi-day service type. As a workaround, create services and set a custom duration to cover multiple days (up to 99 hours). For appointments, set the duration in the service details. For classes and courses, set the duration when scheduling the class and course times.

title: How can I avoid my email marketing campaigns from being marked as spam?
content: Follow email marketing best practices: create high quality, value driven email content from the subject line to the text and images; only email people who have explicitly consented to receive your messages, and add a subscribe form to your site to make it easy for people to join your mailing list; establish a consistent email schedule and stick to the frequency that fits your subscribers, with best practices recommending sending 1 to 5 campaigns per month; do not purchase email lists, send only to your active contacts, clean your contact list at least twice a year, and remove recipients you have not been in touch with for over 6 months; use campaign statistics to locate and remove addresses that consistently bounce or remain unopened; and test your campaigns by sending them to yourself or a small group first before sending to your entire list.

title: How can I add and customize a text mask element in Wix Editor?
content:
Text masks are a great tool for short pieces of text that should grab your visitors' attention, and they can display an image, video or gradient inside so your text stands out on the page.

**To add a text mask element:**
- Open the relevant page in your Editor.
- Click **Add Elements**.
- Click **Text**.
- Click **Text Mask**.
- Drag a text mask design you like onto your page.

**Tip:** Some of our designs include a video background. Hover over a design to see it in action.

**Best practice:** We recommend adding up to 10 text masks per page, to ensure the best site performance on mobile.

**To change the text:**
- Click the text mask element in your Editor.
- Click **Change Text**.
- Enter your text under **Add your own text**.

**Note:** The text saves automatically.

**To resize a text mask:**
- Click the element in your Editor.
- Drag the handles around the element to make it bigger or smaller.

**To design a text mask:**
- Click the text mask element in your Editor.
- Click the Design icon.
- Choose how you want to design your text mask:

*Customize the Fill*
- Click the Fill icon.
- In the **Media** tab, click **Change Media**.
- Drag the slider to adjust the opacity of the media fill.
- (Optional) Enable the **Apply Color Overlay** toggle to add a layer of color on top of the background. Tip: You can set the overlay opacity and choose how to blend it under Blend Mode.
- Scroll up and click the **Gradient** tab.
- Click the Change Gradient box next to the slider.
- (In the Custom Color panel) Choose the type of gradient you want from the dropdown: Linear, Radial or Conic.
- Design your gradient by adjusting the colors, angle and focal point.
- Click the Fluid Gradient icon at the top.
- Design your gradient by adjusting the colors and setting the size and spread of each color.

*Format the Text*
- Click the Text icon.
- **Font:** Choose a different font from the drop-down.
- **Styles:** Make your text bold, italicized, underlined or add a strike through.
- **Alignment & formatting:** Align your text to the left, center, or right, and choose your text direction (e.g. left to right).
- **Capitalization:** Choose how you want to capitalize your text.
- **Character spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of spacing between each character.
- **Line Spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of spacing between each line.
- **Choose HTML tag:** Choose the relevant tag for your text (e.g. H1, P) to improve your accessibility and SEO.

*Define the Shadow*
- Click the **Apply shadow** toggle to enable it.
- Click the wheel to adjust the angle of the shadow, or enter the angle degree in the box.
- **Distance:** Change the amount of distance between the text and the shadow.
- **Blur:** Make your shadow more or less blurry, depending on what you like.
- **Opacity and color:** Adjust the opacity and color of your shadow.

title: How can I make my Wix Editor site more responsive?
content: Wix sites built in the Wix Editor are becoming more and more responsive as Wix continues to add full-width elements that expand to fill the entire width of the screen. Wix recommends using full-width elements. If you use elements such as text boxes and images that can’t be stretched to full width, keep them within the vertical grid lines so they appear correctly on most screen sizes. The following elements are full-width and responsive: Strips and columns; Full-width slideshows; Galleries; Horizontal menus and lines; Google Maps and other Wix apps. Since non-responsive elements (such as images, text and shapes) do not adjust based on screen width, placing them on top of a responsive element, such as a strip, may cause differences in how your page looks in different browsers or on different devices. If you are an agency or enterprise, you can build responsive sites using the Studio Editor in Wix Studio.

title: How can I add my VAT number to my Wix account to get a tax exemption in Taiwan?
content: In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription, click Update Payment Method, select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next, click Edit Details, re-enter your card details and add your VAT Number to the VAT ID field, then click Update. The exemption will apply from the next payment after that date.

title: How can I change the size of thumbnails in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: To change the size of the thumbnails, click the Pro Gallery in your editor, then click Settings. Click the Layout tab, then click Customize Layout. Drag the Thumbnail size slider to make the thumbnails larger or smaller.

title: Can I move cells in a section using arrow buttons or keyboard arrow keys in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, this option is not available for selected cells in a section. It is also not possible to use the arrow keys on your keyboard to move cells. As an alternative, you can use drag and drop to swap a cell with another in the section.

title: How can I allow clients to cancel subscriptions on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard. Create a new plan or edit an existing one. Scroll down to the Settings section. Enable the Allow customers to cancel their subscription toggle. Click Save to save the plan. Repeat these steps for any other plans in which you want to enable cancellation.

Refunding clients:
Canceling a plan does not trigger a refund.
One-time payment: To issue a refund, contact your payment provider (e.g. PayPal, Stripe, etc.)
Recurring payment: When a client cancels a recurring payment, such as a monthly payment, the purchased plan and payment does not continue for the next cycle (e.g. for the next month).

title: How can I move my site from ADI to the Wix Editor and what should I expect after the switch?
content: Access your site in ADI. You can switch to the Editor using the top bar under Site, or click Go to Editor on the right. Click Site on the top bar inside ADI, select Go To Editor at the bottom, and in the pop-up click Switch to Editor. Your site then automatically moves to the Editor. After the switch, you can use drag and drop to add elements and apps. On the left side of the Editor, the menus let you manage your site: Add panel adds new elements and apps to your page; Pages adds new pages and manages existing pages; Theme Manager lets you view and adjust your site's color and text themes; Background changes the current page's background and lets you choose a color, an image or a video; Add Apps adds new apps from the App Market; Media lets you upload media, edit images and videos, and access your site's Media Manager. When switching to the Editor, the layout and design of your ADI site stay exactly the same, so you can continue building from where you left off. If you move to the Wix Editor, you will not be able to return to ADI. Currently, if you move to the Wix Editor, you will no longer be able to edit your site on a mobile or tablet device.

title: How can I view client booking form responses in the Booking Calendar on Wix?
content:
To view client responses in the Booking Calendar:

- Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard.
- Choose what you want to do:

  - View appointment responses: click the relevant appointment in your calendar, then view the response details next to the Booking Form icon.
  - View class or course responses: click the relevant class or course in your calendar, click Manage next to the participants, then click the Booking Form icon next to the relevant client.

title: Can I set up an affiliate program offering cash incentives or payouts through the Wix Referral Program?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set up an affiliate program offering cash incentives or payouts through a Wix Referral Program.

title: How can I share a Wix blog post on social media directly from my live site?
content: Go to your blog on your live site. Click the Show More icon on the post you want to share. Click Share Post. Then do either of the following: share on social media by clicking the relevant social media icon, logging in to the social media site if not already logged in, and clicking to post; or click the Link icon (the link is already copied) and paste the link in an email or anywhere you like.

title: How can I manually enter credit card details to accept a complete payment for an order in Wix?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant order. Click the Collect Payment drop-down and select Charge card manually. Enter the card details. Click Charge.

title: How can I create a coupon in Wix Stores that requires a minimum order amount?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to the Coupons tab and click +New Coupon. Select a coupon type: $ Discount, % Discount, or Free Shipping. Enter the coupon code in the Coupon Code field and the coupon name in the Coupon Name field. Enter the coupon details as applicable; free shipping coupons have no coupon details. From the Apply to drop-down menu, select Minimum order subtotal, then enter the minimum amount in the Minimum subtotal field. Set the coupon validity in the Valid between field by entering a start date and an end date, or select Don't set an end date. Optionally, select a limit on coupon use: Limit the total number of uses for this coupon, or Limit to one use per customer. Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I add a glass effect to a box in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a glass effect to a box in the Wix Editor, select the box in your editor. Click the Design icon. Click Customize Design. Select Fill color & opacity. Enable the Apply glass effect toggle. Optionally, use the Blur intensity slider to increase or decrease the blur. Glass effect is currently only available to add to container boxes.

title: How can I display available payment methods on my Wix site to ensure customers see them on every page?
content: One way to display available payment methods on your Wix site is to add the information to the footer, so customers can see it no matter which page they're viewing. You can learn how to place elements in your site's footer.

title: Can I translate Wix Photo Albums using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Photo Albums with Wix Multilingual. See the list of translatable content in Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I add a new staff member using the Wix app?

To add a new staff member using the Wix app:

- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Scroll down and tap Settings.
- Tap Booking Settings.
- Tap the Staff tab.

title: How can I add a Profile page for site members using Wix Editor?
content: First, check the Pages panel to see if this page doesn't already exist in your Member's Area – when using certain social apps (e.g. Wix Blog, Wix Forum), it automatically adds content like the Profile page. To add the Profile page in Wix Editor: Click Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click Member Pages. Click + Add a Member Page at the bottom. Click + Add Page under Profile.

title: How can I add and customize a hover effect on a box in Wix Editor?
content:
To add effects to your hover box in Wix Editor:

- Select your box in the Editor.
- Click the **Hover** tab to open hover mode.
- Click **Choose Effect**.
- Select an effect from the list.
- (Optional) Click **Customize** to adjust your chosen effect's settings.

### Customization Options:

- **Grow Effect:**
  - Use the slider to adjust how much your element should grow on hover.
  - Choose a starting point from which your element should start growing. By default, it starts growing from the center of the element but you can select a different point (e.g., top left).

- **Shrink Effect:**
  - Use the slider to adjust how much your element should shrink on hover.
  - Choose a point towards which your element should shrink. By default, it shrinks towards the center of the element but you can select a different point (e.g., top right).

- **Skew Effect:**
  - Choose a skew direction: horizontal or vertical.
  - Drag the slider to determine the angle in which your element should skew when visitors hover over it.
  - Choose a point from which your element should start skewing. By default, it starts skewing from the center of the element but you can select a different point (e.g., top left).

- **Rotate Effect:**
  - Choose a direction for your element's rotation: clockwise or counterclockwise.
  - Drag the slider to determine the angle by which your element should rotate when visitors hover over it.
  - Choose a point around which your element should rotate. By default, the element rotates around the center but you can select a different point (e.g., top right).

- **Combo Effect (combined effects):**
  - **Grow / Shrink:**
    - Use the toggle to enable or disable whether the box keeps its proportions.
    - Use the sliders to adjust scale's width and height.
  - **Rotate and Skew:**
    - Use the slider to adjust the angle of the rotation.
    - Use the sliders to adjust the degrees of the horizontal and vertical skew.
    - Select a starting point for the skew effect.

title: Can I create multi-step forms in the Studio Editor using Wix Forms?
content: Yes, you can now create multi-step forms in the Studio Editor using the new Wix Forms. With the new Wix Forms, you can add multiple 'pages' to any form. Pages help better organize your form's information and guide visitors through a multi-step process to fill out the form.

title: Can I enable local inventory adds on Google Merchant Solutions through Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it's not possible to enable local inventory adds on Google Merchant Solutions.

title: How can I schedule a multi-service appointment for my clients using Wix Bookings?
content: Open Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click Add at the top right, or select a time slot on the calendar, then select Appointment. Enter the Client name; for new clients, add them to contacts and enter their email and phone number. Click Continue, select the first service, choose the date and arrival time, leave the Repeats checkbox unchecked because multiple services cannot be recurring, choose the location if relevant, then click + Add Another Service and select another service. Repeat to add more services. Optionally edit each service's Session starts, Duration, Staff member, or Payment options and save. Finish by clicking Book to schedule without collecting payment up front, or Book & Collect Payment to schedule and collect payment.

title: How can I add a cart to my Wix site for booking multiple services?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Settings. Click Cart checkout. Click Install Cart, which takes you to your editor. In your editor, click Done when the installation finishes. Click Publish at the top of your editor. This adds a cart icon to your site. With cart checkout, you and your clients receive order confirmation emails after purchases; you can edit or deactivate these emails in your eCommerce settings.

title: How can I add and customize the Wix Studio Tab Chrome extension?
content: To add the Studio Tab extension in Google Chrome, go to the Wix Studio Tab extension in Google's Chrome Web Store. Click Add to Chrome, then Continue to install, then Add extension to confirm. To customize the tab, launch Google Chrome and click the Settings icon at the top right of the Studio Tab. You can set Default search to Google or Wix Help Center; toggle News center notifications to receive push notifications with the latest news from Wix Studio; use Shortcuts to add shortcuts for favorite pages for quick access; and switch the Color theme between light and dark mode.

title: How can I connect my Singaporean (.sg) domain to my Wix site?
content: Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .sg domain you already own to your Wix site. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via Nameservers. With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, which means you can manage them in your Wix account. This way, if you ever need assistance managing your DNS records, Wix Customer Care can help you. Keep in mind that you will need access to your current domain registrar, and new DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Note: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a .sg domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix.

title: How can I import reservations from an external calendar to Wix Hotels using iCal?
content: To import your external calendar to Wix Hotels using iCal, locate your iCal URL, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, expand the Reservations tab, and select iCal. Click the Choose Type drop-down menu and select a room type, then paste your iCal URL into the URL field. Optionally, click Add Calendar to add another room type and paste the iCal URL in the URL field. Click Save. You can only import from services that allow you to export your calendar in iCal format. The sync is one way only, from iCal to the Wix Calendar. If you have multiple room types, you must add a different iCal URL for each room type. This feature is not compatible with the Wix Hotels Channel Manager; if you want to connect the Channel Manager, delete all the URLs in this tab before doing so.

title: How can I design my business card using the Wix Business Card Maker?
content:
After choosing your card's template, you can start designing it from the business card editor. From this editor you can customize the card's text, image, color and more.

You may also want to change an element's location. You can reposition elements by dragging and dropping, or arrange any overlapping elements using the toolbar above your card design, which appears when clicking on the element. To edit the other side of the card, click Switch to Front / Switch to Back.

### Text
1. Select the relevant text on your card or click Add Text Box on the left.
2. Customize the text using the following options:
   * Edit Text: Type to replace the existing text.
   * Font: Select a font from the dropdown menu.
   * Opacity & Color: Click the color box to change the text's color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.
   * Font Size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the text.
   * Letter Spacing: Drag the slider to adjust the space between letters.
3. (Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking Switch to Back / Switch to Front and repeating steps 1 and 2.

### Shape
1. Click Add Shape on the left or click the existing shape on your template.
2. Choose from a square or circle shape.
3. Customize your shape using the following options:
   * Shape Opacity & Color: Click the color box to change the shape's color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.
   * Border Width: Drag the slider to adjust the shape's border width.
   * Border Opacity & Color: Click the color box to change the shape's border color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.

### Vector Art
1. Click Add Vector Art on the left or click the existing vector art on your template.
2. Search for and select the vector art you like.
3. Click Add to Template.
4. Drag and drop the vector art to its position and resize using the grip handles.
5. Customize your vector art using the options on the left:
   * Image Opacity: Drag the slider to adjust the vector art's transparency.
   * Image Colors: Click Change Colors. Then click the relevant color box to change the vector art's color(s).
(Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking Switch to Back / Switch to Front and repeating steps 1 to 5.

### Image
1. Click Add Image on the left or click the existing image on your template.
2. (If uploading an image) Click the relevant image in the Media Manager and click Add to Template.
3. Customize your image using the options on the left:
   * Image Opacity: Drag the slider on the left to adjust the transparency of the image.
(Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking Switch to Back / Switch to Front and repeating steps 1 to 3.

### Background
1. Click Change Background on the left.
2. Click the color box to change the card's background color.
3. Drag the slider to adjust the color's opacity.
(Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking Switch to Back / Switch to Front and repeating steps 1 and 2.

Once you finish customizing your design, click Done on the top right to choose your paper type and card quantity.

title: How can I create a standalone page for a specific menu using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the Menu page. Click your menu on the page. Click Choose Menus. Click +Add Menu Page to create a new page for your menu. Then edit the new menu page: click your menu on the new page, click Choose Menus, select Only specific menus, select the checkboxes next to the menus you want to display on this page, and click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor to rename the new menu page.

title: How can I add Tap to Pay on mobile as a payment method using Wix Payments?
content: To add Tap to Pay on mobile as a payment method using Wix Payments, first set up Wix Payments and download the Wix app. Tap to Pay on mobile is currently available only in the United States. In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments, click Manage next to Wix Payments, and enable the toggle next to Tap to Pay on mobile. You can disable this toggle at any time to remove Tap to Pay from your payment options. To activate Tap to Pay on your mobile device, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Point of Sale under Getting Paid, tap the Connect icon at the top right, tap Tap to Pay on mobile, and tap Activate. Items sold via Tap to Pay are subject to Wix's list of prohibited goods and services. Disabling card payments in Wix Payments will also disable Tap to Pay; however, you can disable Tap to Pay payments without disabling card payments.

title: Can dropdown input elements be used to filter content on a Wix site?
content: Yes. Dropdown lists allow visitors to filter content on your live site or to submit content to your collection. You can filter content by Text, Number, Tags, or Reference.

title: How can I customize the SEO settings for my Wix site's pages using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Customize any of the following SEO settings: URL slug, title tag, or meta description. For the URL slug, only change it if necessary to reflect the content of your page; keep it short and easy to read. For the title tag, add a title that summarizes the content of the page and enter it as it is meant to appear on search engine results. For the meta description, add a short description of the content on the page to help users decide if the page is relevant to them. Publish your site.

title: How can I show or hide the number of participants in my online program using the Wix Editor?
content: To show or hide the number of participants in your online program using the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor, click **Program Pages**, and select the relevant program page. Note that the Program List page and Visitor Page automatically sync the setting that shows or hides the number of participants — showing or hiding the number of participants in one of these pages also applies the change to the other page. Next, click the relevant program element on your page, click **Settings**, click the **Display** tab, and click the **Participants** toggle to change the visibility of the number of participants in your program. When **Enabled**, the number of program participants is displayed on your live site; when **Disabled**, the number of program participants is not displayed on your live site. Publish your site when you're ready to make the change go live.

title: How can I add and set up a progress bar in Wix Editor with a dynamic target value?
content: To add and set up a progress bar in Wix Editor with a dynamic target value, go to your Editor and enable Velo by clicking Dev Mode at the top and then Turn on Dev Mode. Then click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Interactive, click Progress Bar under Indicators, and drag the Progress Bar of your choice onto the page. To use a dynamic target value, click the Connect to CMS icon on the Progress Bar element. Choose an existing dataset from the Choose a dataset drop-down, or select Add a Dataset, choose the collection, give the dataset a name, and click Create. In the Progress value connects to drop-down, select the field for progress toward the target goal. In the Target value connects to drop-down, select the field for the target goal. Click the Layout icon to choose the direction in which the progress moves, and click the Design icon to choose a preset design or customize the existing design further. You can also use Velo to update the progress bar's value without connecting to the CMS; see Working with the Progress Bar API.

title: Can I customize the size of order printouts in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, orders printed from your online ordering system are printed in A4 size by default and cannot be customized. You can print receipt-sized orders with the Wix app using specific Star Micronics and Epson Bluetooth printer models. You can also choose your size preferences in the printer dialog box when printing a specific order.

title: How can I use the Melhor Envio app with my Wix site for shipping management?
content: To use the Melhor Envio app on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. The app is only available in Brazil. With Melhor Envio, you can simplify quoting and purchasing freight with various carriers, including Correios, and access features such as multiple shipping options, real-time shipping rates, shipping label printing, shipment management, and Integrated Tracking. For integration steps, use the 'Learn how to integrate your site with Melhor Envio' resource in the source article (in Portuguese), or contact Melhor Envio directly via https://melhorenvio.com.br/ or integracoes@melhorenvio.com.

title: Can I sell products in multiple currencies in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell products in multiple currencies in Wix Stores. It is, however, possible to display prices in multiple currencies.

title: What are the features and benefits of the skuIQ Real-Time Inventory Sync app by skuIQ?
content:
Features and benefits include:
* Keep your inventory, orders, and customer data synced between your point-of-sale (POS) and eCommerce store
* Keep all your inventory data in sync and manage your retail platforms from one interface
* Get combined cross-platform analytics to make informed decisions
* Free setup consultation with a sync expert
* Integrates with most point-of-sale systems including Clover, Square, Lightspeed, Vend, and Erply

Important: This app is only available in the US, Canada, Australia, and the UK. This app is only available in English.

title: How can I add and customize a decorative shape or line in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a decorative shape or line in the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, then click Decorative. Drag a shape, arrow or line onto your page. You can use the available options to customize the shape, arrow or line. Once added, you can customize the color and border, resize it, or even turn it into a button. To customize the design of your line, click the line in your editor, click Change Design, and then click Customize Design. Different line designs have different customization options.

title: How can I edit the text in the confirmation email for my guests in Wix Hotels?
content: To edit the text in the confirmation email in Wix Hotels: go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Settings tab, click Emails, then edit the confirmation email details by entering the email title, the introduction text, and the closing text. Click Save. Note: It is not possible to edit the design, spacing, or color of the confirmation email.

title: Can I transfer my existing Google Workspace billing to Wix?
content: Currently, transferring your existing Google Workspace billing to Wix is not supported. Wix cannot accept Google transfer tokens. If you already have an account with Google Workspace or if your domain is already listed as an alias in Google Workspace, you will need to manage your account billing with Google. Note: You can connect your existing Google Workspace business email to Wix.

title: How can I customize images carried over from the desktop version on my Wix mobile site?
content:
To customize images carried over from the desktop version on your Wix mobile site, click the image in your mobile editor. Depending on what you want to customize, do the following:

- Change my image settings: Click the Settings icon. Choose from Reset Image Proportions, or Image Behaviors. Under When an image is clicked, choose Nothing happens, A link opens, It opens in a popup, or It can be magnified.
- Crop my image: Click the Crop icon. Drag the slider to zoom the image in and out. Move the image to display the part you want, or click the Shape Crop icon and choose a shape. Click Apply.
- Add an image animation: Click the Animation icon. Select the animation you want to apply. Click Customize to adjust your animation.

title: How can I connect UAPay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to UAPay. If you have an existing UAPay account, enter your UAPay Merchant ID and Merchant Secret Key, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create new account and register your account with UAPAY, retrieve your Merchant ID and Merchant Secret Key, then return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: How do I connect PaidBy Bank as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your Wix site dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to PaidBy Bank. If you already have a PaidBy Bank account, enter your API Client Name, Authorization Token, Merchant ID, and Workflow, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create PaidBy Bank account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from PaidBy Bank to get your credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: Can I translate Google Maps using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Google Maps with Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I add a new element to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click a tab, e.g., Gallery, Interactive, Box etc. Click an element or drag it to your site to add it. Tip: Some element tabs (such as text and buttons) have themed elements. These elements have been handpicked for you, as they match your site's color and text theme.

title: Can I use different grids for different design presets in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it is not possible to use different grids in different design presets. This means that you are restricted to a single grid layout across all presets. A feature request would allow you to apply different grid layouts to various presets.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my GST number in my Wix account for a tax exemption?
content: For GST-registered businesses in Singapore, you can add your GST registration number to your Wix account by updating your payment details. In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your GST number to the GST Registration Number field. Click Update.

title: Can I add an address input component in Wix Blocks?
content: We are pleased to announce that you can now add an address input component in Blocks. Learn more about address inputs in Wix Docs.

title: What is Wix's main establishment under the NIS2 directive, and how can inquiries be submitted?
content: Pursuant to article 2, Wix appoints Wix Online Platforms Limited as the main establishment for the purposes of the NIS2 directive based on the highest number of employees in the Union. Wix's point of contact for inquiries from member state authorities, the EU Commission, ENISA, and recipients of the service is legal@wix.com. Please submit inquiries in English.

title: How can I add custom code to my Wix site and ensure it loads correctly?
content: Before you begin: Make sure that your site is published and has a connected domain. To add custom code to your site: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Custom Code in the Advanced section. Click + Add Custom Code at the top right. Paste the code snippet in the text box. Enter a name for your code. Select an option under Add Code to Pages: All pages, or Choose specific pages. Choose where to place your code under Place Code in: Head, Body - start, or Body - end. Click Apply. The placement of your code is crucial for it to load and execute properly. Generally, place tracking and verification codes in the head section, and other functional scripts in the body section. Always follow the third-party provider's instructions for optimal performance.

title: How can I add product options to my products using the Wix app?
content:
Use the Wix app to add product options to your products; any changes you make appear live on your site.

To add product options:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap **Manage** at the bottom. Tap **Store Products**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Store Products**. Tap to select the relevant product. Scroll down and tap **\+ Add Options**.

Create a new product option:
Tap **\+ Add Option** at the top. Enter an **Option name** (e.g. size). Tap **Next**. Select a product option display type: tap **Colors** for color options, or tap **List** for all other options. Enter the first **Choice name** (e.g. Small) and tap the **Plus** icon. Enter additional option choices (e.g. Large) and tap the **Plus** icon after each entry. Tap **Save**.

Select a product option you created for another product:
Tap **Select** next to the product option you want to apply. Then do any of the following to add product option choices: tap **Add All** at the bottom left to add all the existing product option choices; tap a product option choice to add it; or create a new product option choice by entering the option choice name (e.g. X-Large) in the **Choice Name** field and tapping **Save**.

title: Can I upload my own fonts to use in Wix Stores?
content: It's now possible to upload your own fonts in the Wix Editor and use them in your store. After uploading a font, check to make sure that it displays correctly in all your Wix Stores elements.

title: How can I preview a draft blog post in Wix Blog before publishing it?
content: Go to the Blog tab in your dashboard, click Drafts on the left, click the Show More icon next to the draft you want to preview, and click Preview Draft. Make sure to publish your site in order to preview blog post drafts.

title: What are the benefits of upgrading my Wix site to sell plans online?
content: You can add and set up the Wix Pricing Plans app on your site for free. To sell membership plans and packages online and remove Wix branding, you need to upgrade your site. You do not need to upgrade to manually add plans (sell them offline) or to sell free plans. Upgrading lets you accept payments directly on your website, improve your branding with a custom domain such as www.mystunningwebsite.com, and track your subscriptions sold over time with advanced analytics. When you upgrade to a Business and eCommerce plan, you also get your domain for free for the first year.

title: How can I choose a format for displaying date and time fields in my CMS collection on a live site?
content: To choose a format for displaying date and time fields in a CMS collection on a live site: 1. Go to your editor. 2. Connect an element, such as text, to a dataset that connects to your collection. 3. Click the relevant field (e.g. Text connects to) in the dataset connections and select the date or time field you want to display. If needed, select Add new field to create and connect a new collection field. 4. Click the Choose a format drop-down and select the format you want to display your dates or times in. 5. Click Publish when you are ready to make the changes go live. Notes: The date and times displayed on your live site adjust according to the visitor's local time zone. Your site's regional settings determine date and time language, time zones and other regional formatting options. When you export a collection to a CSV file, the time fields in the file are formatted as UTC+0 and are not formatted to local time.

title: How can I get started with Wix Email Marketing?
content: Use Wix Email Marketing to create, send, and manage professional email marketing campaigns. Start by picking a stunning template, then add your content, contacts, and send. You can also view a step-by-step tutorial for creating and sending campaigns, start your first email campaign, and grow your contact list with a subscribe form. All emails are fully customizable and exist as standalone landing pages, and Wix Email Marketing makes it easy to keep track of your statistics and performance.

title: How can I access the Inspector panel in Editor X?
content: Click the Inspector icon at the top right of Editor X. The panel opens on the right, showing the element you're working on at the top.

title: How do I connect ACH by Choice as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to ACH by Choice. If you have an account, enter your API Key and Device GUID and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Choice account, register for a Choice merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account. Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Choice account to avoid transaction declines.

title: How do I start selling products in the Wix member apps?
content:
To get started selling in the Wix member apps, download the Wix app and the member app your customers use to connect with you (Spaces by Wix, Fit by Wix, Dine by Wix or Branded App by Wix).

**1. Download the Wix app**
The Wix app is where you set up and manage your store on the go: add products, manage inventory, set up shipping and tax, and fulfill orders. Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android), type 'Wix app' in the Search field, then click Get or Install.

**2. Download the relevant member app**
Visitors connect to your business and can purchase your products using one of the Wix member apps: Spaces by Wix (recommended for most general sites), Branded App by Wix (a custom app with your own branding), Fit by Wix (designed for fitness businesses, e.g. gyms, yoga studios) and Dine by Wix (designed for restaurants). Download the relevant member app so you can view your business as your customers see it: go to the Apple App Store or Google Play, enter the name of the member app in the Search field, then click Get or Install.

**3. Build your store**
Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Manage Apps, then tap Add next to Store. Build your store by adding products, organizing them into categories, and setting up a payment method as well as shipping and tax preferences.

**4. Customize your member app**
Customize every aspect of your site as it appears in the member apps to put the most important information and actions front and center. You can add your logo and header, customize the app colors and more. Customizations to the member apps do not affect the look of your desktop site.

**5. Customize your store in your member app**
By default, there is a Shop tab that displays all your products. You can customize your app so that you display different categories in different shop tabs. Note: tabs you create in the app do not affect your desktop site; it is not currently possible to sell product subscriptions in the member apps; and products you've hidden from your store won't appear in the member apps.

**6. Invite visitors to connect to your member app**
When your site is ready, invite your customers, clients, and contacts to download your member app and connect to your site. Contacts receive a link to download the relevant member app, and your members can then engage with your shop and other parts of your site.

title: How can I perform a ping test on my Windows computer to troubleshoot connection issues with my Wix site?
content: On Windows, right-click the Start menu and select Run. Type cmd, and then click OK. If you have a domain connected to your site, type ping www.domain.com and replace domain.com with your own domain name. If you have a free site, type ping site-url-prefix.wixsite.com and replace site-url-prefix with your Site URL prefix, located in your account settings. Press Enter. Take a screenshot of the information. Send your screenshot to Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix restaurant site to accept payments and connect my own domain?
content: To upgrade your Wix restaurant site so you can accept payments and connect your own domain, go to the Upgrade page to compare plans. Choose a plan that supports payments, click Select under the site plan you wish to purchase, select a subscription period, and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity; if you have issues with authentication, contact your bank directly.

title: Can customers schedule a pickup time for their orders in Wix Stores?
content: It is not possible to let customers select a pickup time. Currently, you can send customers a pickup ready email to let them know when an order is ready for them to collect.

title: What types of changes to my Branded App require approval from Apple and Google?
content: Changes to your app's design or store listing descriptions must be re-submitted to Apple and Google for approval. These changes include anything that comes before the member log in or visitor mode in your app. Changes that must be approved include: Brand and design: name and icon changes; launch screen design changes; login screen changes. Store listings: any content, icon, or category changes must be reviewed and approved by Apple and Google before the updated listings go live, since store listings appear in both the App Store and Google Play.

title: What are the rules for interacting with Wix Customer Care, and what actions can Wix take if these rules are violated?
content: By requesting a callback, calling, or chatting with Wix Customer Care, you agree to all of the rules in the Wix Customer Care Terms of Use as well as to the full Wix Terms of Use. Debates and discussions with Wix Customer Care team members are fine, however, the following are not tolerated: support requests that are insulting and provocative by nature; personal attacks, name calling and discriminatory remarks; making unfounded allegations (slander); support requests contesting Wix's policies; publicly lobbying against Wix actions and policies; intentional attempts to disrupt the workload of the Wix Customer Care team by multiple support request submissions; support requests that are sexual in nature, discriminatory, harmful, threatening, abusive, defamatory, obscene, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive; support requests that contain sexually explicit remarks or excessive obscene or vulgar language; support requests which discuss or illustrate illegal activity such as software and music piracy or other intellectual property violations; and links to sites that contain any of the aforementioned. Wix reserves the right to remove any support requests that violate these terms of use without warning or explanation. Wix reserves the right to ban anyone who willfully violates these terms of use. The Wix team is the sole arbitrator of what does and what does not violate these terms of use. Wix reserves the right to take any actions it deems appropriate to ensure Wix Customer Care is not disrupted or abused in any way.

title: Can I block specific IP addresses from accessing my Wix site?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to block specific IP addresses or visitors from specific locations from accessing your site.

Workaround: You can use the Blocky IP & Country Blocker app by Effective Apps from the Wix App Market to block IP addresses and countries.

Note: Wix prevents registration and use of services from certain countries.

title: How can I check the status of a site transfer on Wix?
content: Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Search for the recipient and check the status next to their name. Site recipients have 3 days to accept the transfer invitation; you can check the status to see if it has been accepted.

title: How do I specify a service fee that only applies to delivery orders over a certain amount in Wix Restaurants?
content:
Go to **Service Fees** in your site's dashboard. Click **+ New Service Fee**. Add your service fee details and set the conditions:

- **Service name**: Add a name for your service fee.
- **Amount**: Enter your service fee. It can be a fixed amount ($) or a percentage (%).
- (Optional) **Add sales tax**: Click the checkbox to add sales tax to this service fee and select a tax group.
- **Apply based on fulfillment types**: Choose **delivery orders**.
- **Apply based on subtotal**: Choose **Set minimum** and enter the minimum order amount. Orders placed above the amount you set will be charged this service fee.

Click **Save**. Customers will see the service fee in their order summary during checkout, with a separate line in the price breakdown and receipts.

title: Can I see my collaborators' cursors moving around inside the Studio Editor when working on a site together?
content: When working with others on the same site, you can see the page and element they are working on. However, there is currently no "Cursor Mode" that allows you to see their cursors moving around inside the Studio Editor.

title: How can I remove the black overlay from gallery images viewed in expand mode on mobile devices in Wix Editor?
content: When clicking a gallery image in expand mode while using a mobile device, a black overlay is added to the image. At the moment, you can remove the black overlay by removing the title and description of the image. Alternatively, you can switch to the Wix Pro Gallery, which allows you to customize the expand mode window according to your preferences.

title: How can I connect Printful to my Wix Store?
content: Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor: in Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor; in Editor X, click App Market at the top of Editor X. Start typing "Printful" and select it. Click Add to Site. Review the permissions and click Add to Site. Select either Create a new account or Connect an existing account. Click to connect your Wix Store to the email address associated with your Printful account. For new accounts, follow the instructions in the email you received to confirm your email address. If you already had a Printful account and want to delete old products or have products that reappear after you delete them: delete the products in your Wix dashboard, go to the Stores tab in the Printful dashboard, select the relevant store, and click Refresh data.

title: How can I create a master-detail page using multiple-item reference fields in a CMS?
content: To create master-detail pages, put 2 datasets on your page, one for the master and the other for the details. Filter the detail dataset by the multiple-item reference field it shares with the master dataset so the detail dataset only includes items that match the current item in the master dataset. Then connect a gallery or a table to the filtered detail dataset to display the relevant items. You cannot connect any element directly to a multiple-item reference field. For example, for an actor page, the Actor dynamic dataset is the main dataset; add another dataset connected to the Movies collection and filter the Movies dataset by its multiple-item reference field that points to the Actors collection. Connect a Text element and an Image to the Actor dynamic dataset, and connect a table to the filtered Movies dataset.

title: Can I offer upsells and cross-sells on the Cart and Checkout Pages in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, Wix doesn't have an integrated solution that offers cross-sells or upsells on the Cart Page or Checkout Page. It is now possible to offer cross-sells and upsells through the ReConvert third party app.

title: How do I access settings and layout options for a Single Video Player, and do they vary by video source?
content: Click the Settings and Layouts icons on the Single Video Player. Depending on the video source you choose, you will see different settings and layout options.

title: Is Cyberplus (Banque Populaire) supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content:
Currently, Wix does not offer Cyberplus (Banque Populaire) as a payment provider.

Tip: You can accept payments to your Banque Populaire account by connecting PayZen as a payment provider.

title: How can I delete my Link in Bio page on Hopp by Wix?
content: Log in to Hopp, click Link in Bio on the left, click the More Actions icon, then click Delete page. Only the person who created the Link in Bio page can delete it, and this action cannot be undone.

title: Can I use Affirm as a BNPL payment method with Wix Payments in the United States?
content: Yes. You can now add Affirm as a BNPL payment method in Wix Payments. Affirm is a BNPL payment method that enables your customers to pay over time while you receive the money upfront.

title: How can I enable Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) for my Wix Blog posts?
content: You can enable AMP for your Wix Blog posts in the Blog tab of your site’s dashboard or in your site's SEO Settings.

title: Is it possible to export and save email campaigns to a PDF file format directly from the site's dashboard?
content: Currently, it is not possible to export and save email campaigns to a PDF file format directly from your site's dashboard. As a workaround, you can view your campaign and print to PDF. To manually save an email campaign as a PDF: go to Email Marketing Campaigns in your site's dashboard, hover over the campaign you want to save as a PDF, and click the More Actions icon; click View; right click on the email campaign and select Print; in the Destination drop-down, click Save as PDF; click Save. The printing options available depend on the device you use to view your email campaign.

title: How can I sync my Microsoft calendar with Wix Bookings?
content:
To sync your Outlook or Office365 calendar with Wix Bookings, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, then:

- Click the Manage Calendar drop-down in the top right.
- Click Sync Personal Calendar.
- Select the relevant account you want to sync.
- Click Sync next to Outlook or Office365.
- Login with your Microsoft account details.
- Click Yes to grant Wix access to your personal calendar.
- Enable the Import Microsoft Calendar events toggle.
- Select the checkboxes next to each Microsoft calendar you want to import to your Booking Calendar.
- (Optional) Enable the Export Booking Calendar events toggle to display your bookings sessions on your Microsoft Calendar.
- Click Sync.

Events from your Microsoft calendar are now visible on your Wix Bookings calendar. Your Wix Bookings sessions also appear in your Microsoft calendar if you enable Booking calendar events exports.

Note: Currently, you cannot sync your Microsoft Exchange calendar with Wix Bookings.

title: How do I create a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign with Wix?
content:
To get started creating a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign with Wix:
- Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads in your site's dashboard.
- Click Start Advertising.
- Complete the Get ready to advertise on Facebook & Instagram checklist, which includes publishing your site, upgrading your site by purchasing a plan that fits your business, and connecting a custom domain.
- Connect your Meta assets to Wix, including the Facebook page you want to advertise, the relevant Meta Business Account, and a Facebook Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI).
- Build your campaign, including customizing your ad targeting, creating your ad content, and setting a budget.
- Purchase a Facebook & Instagram Ads with Wix subscription and launch your campaign.

A new Meta Ads account is created for you when you launch a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign with Wix. Any existing Meta Ads accounts you may have are separate from this account.

title: Is there a MixCloud app available on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a MixCloud.com app. Tip: Check out Wix Music to promote, sell and distribute your music on your site!

title: How can I change the page background on my mobile site?
content:
Go to the relevant page in your mobile editor. Click Background on the left. Select a background, or click a background type:

Color: Select a color to use as your page background. You can choose from your site's colors or custom colors, or add a new one.

Image: Select an image to add as your page's background on mobile. You can select a stock image, or upload your own. Your image is automatically optimized to fit different screen sizes and resolutions.
- Click Image and choose from these sources: Site Files, Media from Wix, Shutterstock, or Unsplash.
- Select your chosen image.
- Click Change Background.

Video: Add a video as your page background. You can add a stock video, or upload your own.
- Click Video on the Mobile Background panel and choose from these sources: Site Files, Media from Wix, or Shutterstock.
- Select your chosen video.
- Click Change Background.

Note: If you set a video as your page background on desktop, it is automatically converted to an image on your mobile site.

title: How can I add a service or product to an existing order in Wix Bookings?
content: This option only applies to appointments. To add services and products to an existing order: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant order. Click More Actions at the top right and select Edit order. Click Add Item and select Service, Product, or + Add Custom Item. Choose Products and Services: select the service or product you want to add and click Add to Order. Or choose Custom Item: enter the Title, Item info, and price for your custom item and click Add to Order. Finalize the order updates: optionally enter a Reason for editing, click Update Order at the top right, optionally select the checkbox to email the customer about changes to this order, and click Update Order to confirm.

title: How can I transfer my Wix store to another Wix account?
content: You can transfer the entire site, and the store transfers with it. While transferring the account, you can choose whether to keep your role as co-owner. You can also create a copy of the site for your personal account.

title: How can I connect WeChat Pay as a payment method through Oceanpayment on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to WeChat Pay. If you have an Oceanpayment account, enter your Terminal and SecureCode, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Oceanpayment account, fill in the registration form and click Send, wait for an email or chat message from Oceanpayment to get your Terminal and SecureCode, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Oceanpayment account to avoid transaction declines.

title: Can I connect my Wix store with Mercado Libre to sell my products?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect your Wix store with Mercado Libre and sell your products there.

title: How can I set my Wix Store to update inventory when an order is placed?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Store products & inventory settings. Under Update store inventory, select When the order is placed. This setting updates inventory as soon as the customer checks out.

title: Can I track clicks on my site buttons and links using Wix Analytics?
content: Yes, you can track visitor clicks on your site buttons and links with Wix Analytics Behavior reports. The Button Clicks report shows which buttons, links, and clickable images are clicked most on your site. The Button Clicks over time report allows you to track clicks over a specific time period to see which buttons or clickable images on your site are performing best and how that changes over time. To access these reports, go to All Reports in your site's dashboard, scroll down to the Behavior section, and select the Button Clicks or Button Clicks over time report.

title: Is it possible to list dorm rooms or shared accommodation in Wix Hotels?
content: Currently, listing dorm rooms or shared accommodation is not supported as it is not possible to list individual beds. As a workaround solution, you can add a room; enter the number of beds in Units; enter 1 guest under Max Guests; enter 1 bed; write in the room description that it is a dorm room; enter the rest of the room details; then click Save.

title: How can I manually check in a guest using the Check-in by Wix app?
content:
To manually check in a guest using the Check-in by Wix app:
- Open the Check-in by Wix app.
- Tap the relevant event.
- Tap **Guest List** under **Event management**.
- Optional: Filter your guest list by tapping the **Filter** icon, choosing what you want to sort by (status, ticket type or alphabetically), and tapping **Save**.
- Tap the **Checkmark** icon next to the relevant guest.

title: How do I customize the duration and direction of an entrance animation in the Studio Editor?
content:
Select the relevant element, section or page. Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Click the Animations and Effects tab. Click the animation you want to change. Click Adjust Animation to change its settings:
- Direction: Decide which direction the animation should come from. Depending on the animation type, you either set the direction in degrees or choose an option from a drop-down.
- Duration: Change the length of time of the animation.

Note: The available customization options depend on the animation you choose.

title: How can site members upload photos to the Wix Shared Gallery using their mobile devices?
content: When accessing the Shared Gallery app on mobile, members can take a picture using their device's camera and upload it directly to a gallery. Site members can perform any actions (view, upload, share, etc.) they have permission to do.

title: How can I set up a custom fulfillment service in my Wix store to handle orders?
content:
Go to the fulfillment services settings in your site's dashboard. Click **Add Fulfiller**. Enter the service name (seen only by you). Enter the email address (orders are sent to this address). Select the action that triggers sending a store order to the fulfiller. Click **Save & Continue**.

Before the service can start fulfilling your store orders, select which products it fulfills. If you are not already on the **Assign products to fulfiller** page, go to the fulfillment services settings and click **Assign Products**. To assign individual products, click the **Fulfillment service** drop-down next to a product and select a fulfiller. To assign multiple products at once, select the products you want to assign (all products or individual products), click the **Choose Services** drop-down and select a fulfiller, then click **Done**.

For new products, go to Products in your site's dashboard, create a new physical product or edit an existing one, scroll down to the **Advanced** section on the right, click the **Fulfilled by** drop-down, and select a fulfiller. By default, a new product is set to be fulfilled by you. Email notifications are sent to your fulfillers, manually or automatically, to let them know when there are orders they need to fulfill.

title: Can I choose a different layout for the Wix Video widget in the Studio Editor, such as a grid or a slider?
content: Currently, it is not possible to choose a different layout for the Wix Video widget in the Studio Editor (e.g. a grid or a slider displaying your videos).

title: How can I upload my own vector art to Wix Editor?
content:
In Wix Editor, you can upload your own vector art through the Media Manager:
- Click Media on the left side of the Editor.
- Click the Upload Media icon.
- Select your file(s) from your computer.
- (Optional) Click Add to Page to add it to your site.

Keep these points in mind:
- Animated SVG files are not supported on Wix.
- SVG files usually contain a lot of redundant information such as editor metadata, comments, hidden elements and other stuff that can be safely removed without affecting visual result.
- Wix uses industry standard tools to sanitize your SVG and prevent malicious code from being uploaded on your site so it remains safe for your visitors.
- Make sure the SVG files you upload don't contain embedded images (JPG, PNG, etc.).
- Check that the SVG files you upload contain visual content, otherwise, the upload will fail.

title: Can I reset the invoice numbering in Wix Invoices?
content: Currently, it is not possible to reset the invoice numbering in Wix Invoices. For example, if your initial invoice number is 0001, and you send 2 test invoices, the first invoice that a real customer receives is invoice number 0003. It is possible to set your initial invoice number.

title: How can I customize the permissions and member settings for the File Share app on my Wix site?
content:
After you add the File Share app to your site, click the app in your editor, click Settings, then click the Settings tab. Choose the permissions you want to customize.

Library permissions:
- Use the Who can view and download items? drop-down. All members means visitors who are members and log in can view and download files. Site visitors means anyone who visits your site can view and download files.
- Under Who can upload files?, click the Edit icon. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to upload files. To create a custom role, click +Create New. Click Apply.
- Under Who can manage the library?, click the Edit icon. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to manage files. Click Apply. Click Save Changes.

Folder permissions:
You can manage these from your site's dashboard or your live site.
From your site's dashboard: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant folder. Click Permissions. Type the name of the member/group/plan you want to add in the search bar. Select a member/group/plan to edit. Click the drop-down on the right to assign permissions. Optionally select Notify members. Click Add & Notify. Optionally click the drop-down beside unwanted groups and select Remove. Click Save.
From your live site: Click the Expand icon to open the File Share app. Make sure you're signed in to your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant folder. Click Permissions. Type the name of the member/group/plan you want to add in the search bar. Select a member/group/plan to edit. Click the drop-down on the right to assign permissions. Optionally select Notify members. Click Add & Notify. Optionally click the drop-down beside unwanted groups and select Remove. Click Done.

Member Signup Settings:
Click the Expand icon to open these settings. In the General tab, choose which option visitors see first in the signup window: New member signup or Existing member login. Click Additional Signup & Login Settings to manage who can become a member.
In the Social & Community tab, select social networks members can use to log in under Allow social login? Enable Google login or Enable Facebook login. Use the Join the community is checked by default toggle.
In the Policies tab, use the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and Code of Conduct toggles. When enabled, click the Link icon and select the page containing the relevant policy; when disabled, no link is added in the signup window.

General settings:
Under General, you can choose whether members can favorite files and upload videos. Use the Let member favorite files toggle and the Let members upload videos toggle.

title: How can I customize the design of breadcrumbs on my Wix mobile site?
content:
To customize the design of your breadcrumbs trail on your mobile site, click the breadcrumbs element in the mobile editor, then click the Design icon. Select what part of the trail you want to design from the dropdown menu.

Background
- Click Background in the dropdown menu, and use the options to adjust the design:
  * Background Fills: Choose a color for your trail background, and set its opacity.
  * Borders: Add a border to your trail background, and change the color, width and spacing.
  * Corners: Make the corners of the trail background square, or more circular.
  * Shadow: Add and adjust a shadow on your trail to give it a cool 3D effect.

Separators
- Click Separators from the dropdown menu.
- Click the Show text toggle to enable separators between trail items.
- Choose how you want to customize the separator:
  * Style: Apply one of your saved text styles to the separator.
  * Fonts: Choose a font from the dropdown menu for the separator.
  * Font size: Set how big or small you want the item separator to be.
  * Formatting: Add different formatting options to your separator, such as bold, underline, and strikethrough.
  * Color and Alignment: Choose the colors for your separator, and set the text direction and alignment.
  * Spacing: Make the spacing between the characters and lines bigger or smaller.

Items
- Click Items in the dropdown menu, and use the options to make them look the way you want:
  * Items state: Select which mode you would like to adjust the items for:
    + Regular: How the items look before a visitor interacts with them.
    + Hover: How the items look when a visitor hovers their cursor over them.
    + Current page: How the item is displayed when it is the page the visitor is currently on.
  * Background Fills: Choose a color for your items, and set their opacity.
  * Text: Adjust the text for your trail items. You can choose and edit options such as the font, color, and alignment to suit your site's look and theme.
  * Borders: Add and adjust a border on your items. You can change the color, width and spacing to make them stand out on your page.
  * Corners: Make the corners of the trail items square, or more circular.
  * Shadow: Add and adjust a shadow on your items to give them a cool 3D effect.
  * Layout: Adjust the padding around your items to make the space around them smaller or bigger.

title: Can I manage my FAQ's from a mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add new FAQ's or make changes to your FAQ's using a mobile device. You must use a desktop computer to manage your FAQ's.

title: Connect my domain to external site
content: To connect a Wix domain to an external site, get the relevant DNS records (A and CNAME records) from your site host. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain, and select Manage DNS Records. Edit your CNAME records and A records as needed. If your host requires changing name servers, you'll need to transfer your domain away from Wix.

title: How can I add a content box to my app?
content: Go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant tab (e.g. Spaces by Wix app, Branded Mobile App). Click Edit Mobile App. Click the Screen drop-down at the top and choose the screen you want to edit. Click Elements on the left. Click Content box under Basic items. Customize your Content box using these options: Start Adding Content — click Add Content to add custom text or media, then click Publish to save. Show title — enable the toggle to add a title to the top of the content box. Margins — drag the Margins sliders to adjust the padding for the button(s); click the Edit individually icon to separately adjust the margins. General Settings — click General Settings and under Element visibility, choose All, Android, or iOS. Click Save & Publish.

title: How can I redeem my Smile: Points & Rewards promo code after purchasing a Premium Plan?
content: Add the Smile: Points & Rewards app to your site: go to the Wix App Market, search for "Smile: Points & Rewards", select the app, and click Add to Site. Then create a Smile: Points & Rewards account: click Get Started on the page that opens after adding the app, enter an email address and password, click Create Account, enter a program name and choose a language, click Next, choose brand and text colors, click Next, select an industry, click Next, select an average order value, click Next, review the details, and click Launch Points. Finally, go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard, click Upgrade next to Smile: Points & Rewards, select Premium, choose a yearly billing period under Select a Subscription Period, choose a payment method or enter billing information, click Enter a promo code under Summary, enter the promo code "SMILE1YEAR" and click Apply, then click Submit Purchase.

title: Why is some of the text on my Wix Chat widget not appearing in the correct site language?
content:
Some sites might experience an issue with some of the text on the Wix Chat widget not appearing in the correct site language. For example, this may affect the "Let's Chat", "We'll reply as soon as we can" (response time text), and the pre-chat form texts.

### Workaround
In your site's dashboard, navigate to **Settings** and click on **Language & Region**. Change the **Site language** to something different, then click **Save** in the upper right. After that, change the **Site language** back to the desired language and click **Save** in the upper right.

This should reset your site language and resolve the un-translated text.

title: Can I hide image titles and descriptions in expand mode in Wix galleries?
content: Currently, hiding gallery image titles and descriptions in expand mode is not supported.

title: How can I connect Vipps as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Vipps as a payment provider, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Vipps.

If you already have a Vipps account, enter your Merchant Serial Number, Client ID, Client Secret and Subscription Key, then click Connect.

If you do not have an account, click Create Vipps account, register for a Vipps merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the instructions under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I change the scroll effect of the header on my Wix mobile site?
content:
In the mobile editor, click the header, click **Change Header Scroll**, and select an option:

* **Scrolls with site:** The header is always at the top of the site and scrolls with it.
* **Freezes:** The header is always at the top of the mobile screen.
* **Disappears:** The header disappears when you scroll down the page, but is at the top of the screen when you scroll upward.
* **Fades out:** The header slowly disappears as you scroll down the page. It reappears as you scroll upward.

Important note about the freeze scroll effect: If your header has too much content and is too big on mobile, the freeze scroll effect is disabled on the live mobile site. This is because when set to frozen, the header would cover the entire viewport of the mobile device and hide the rest of the site content as a result.

title: How do I enroll in the Apple Developer program for my branded app?
content:
To enroll in the Apple Developer program for your branded app:
1. Create or sign into your Apple ID (Step 1).
2. Follow the steps under **Enroll in the developer program** to register for the program and purchase a membership. Once you've enrolled, Apple will review your information (this can take up to two business days) and send you an activation email.
3. Once you've received an activation email, go back to the **Developer Accounts** tab of your Branded App dashboard and click **Step 2 Create developer account**.
4. Under **Required Info** on the right, click **I've created a new Apple Developer Account.** If you already have an existing account, click **I already have an Apple developer account**.
5. Click **Continue**.

title: Can I reposition individual elements on a Wix project page?
content: Currently, project pages are available in a range of preset designs. The individual elements within those designs are locked into position and cannot be freely repositioned. If you want to change the position of the elements in your project page, you can choose a different preset design. Learn how to edit the project page design.

title: How can I activate email notifications for new bookings in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to the Booking Settings tab. Click Emails & SMS reminders. Enable the toggle next to New booking emails. Notification emails for you and your staff go to the addresses in the Business Info and Staff tabs in the dashboard. Make these email addresses are up-to-date, so you and your staff receive the relevant client emails.

title: How can I change the site URL prefix for my free Wix site?
content: Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Click the Site URL prefix field. Edit your Site URL prefix. Click Save.

title: How do I add and design states in a multi-state box in Editor X?
content:
Prerequisite: Turn on Dev Mode in Editor X, as this feature requires some code.

To add and design states in a multi-state box:

- Add a multi-state box: Click **Add Elements** at the top of Editor X, click **Layout Tools**, click **Multi-State Boxes**, then drag a multi-state box to the relevant location on your page.
- Select and design a state: Select the multi-state box, click **Manage States**, click a state to select it, then add elements and design the state as you wish. While designing the states, Dev Mode is not required.
- Add a state: Select the multi-state box, click **Manage States**, click **Add New State**. To add an ID, hover over the new state, click the More Actions icon, click **Edit ID**, enter a new ID, and click **Done**.
- Rename a state: Select the multi-state box, click **Manage States**, click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name, click **Edit ID**, enter the new ID, and click **Done**.
- Remove a state: Select the multi-state box, click **Manage States**, click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name, and click **Delete**.
- Reorder states: Select the multi-state box, click **Manage States**, then click and drag the Reorder icon up or down to change the order of the states.

Design tip: States can have different height properties, which can reveal additional info; however, the width of your states always stays the same.

title: How can I add animation to an element on my Wix mobile site?
content:
Click the relevant element in the mobile editor. Click the **Animation** icon. Select an animation from the available options.
