Tip: Hover over an effect in the panel to see a preview of the animation. Click **None** in the **Choose Animation** panel to remove an animation effect from your element.

title: Can I sell product subscriptions using the Wix mobile point of sale (POS) on my mobile phone?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell product subscriptions on the Wix mobile point of sale (POS) via mobile phone. However, your customers can purchase product subscriptions from your site.

title: How can I enable or disable the mobile friendly view of my Wix site?
content: To enable or disable the mobile friendly view of your Wix site: click **Settings** in the top bar of the editor, click **Mobile Friendly**, click the toggle in the pop-up to enable or disable it, then click **Close**.

title: How can I change the order of my blog posts in the Wix app?
content: Your blog posts generally appear in the order they were posted. You can change the order by updating the creation dates of the posts. To change the date of a post: go to your site in the Wix app, tap **Manage** at the bottom right, tap **Blog**, tap **Posts**, tap the post you want to edit, tap the **Show More** icon, tap **Post Settings**, tap **Edit** next to the publish date, select a new publish date, then tap **Update**.

title: Can I add collapsible text to my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add collapsible text to your Wix Pro Gallery.

title: Is it possible to disable the image optimization done by Wix?
content: Wix automatically optimizes your images for both site loading time and image quality. Currently, it is not possible to disable this optimization.

title: How can I add and set up the Google Event Calendar on my Wix site?
content:
Step 1 | Add Google Event Calendar to your site
Wix Editor:
- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Google Event Calendar app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.
Studio Editor:
- Click **App Market** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Google Event Calendar app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.

Step 2 | Connect your Google account
- Click the calendar in your Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click **Connect Account**.
- Enter the credentials of the account you want to display.
- Click **Allow** to give access to Wix.com.

Step 3 | Set up your events visibility
- Click the calendar in your Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Calendars** tab.
- Select the checkboxes next to the calendars you want to be visible to your site visitors, and visible but with details hidden.

Step 4 | Change the layout, display, and settings
- Click the calendar in your Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click to expand steps to customize your layout, display, and settings:
  - **Choose a layout for your calendar**
    - Click the **Layout** tab.
    - Choose your layout: Monthly, Weekly, or Agenda.
  - **Update your display settings**
    - Click the **Display** tab.
    - Choose your display settings: Show time zone, event start time, and private events.
  - **Change your app settings**
    - Click the **Settings** tab.
    - Choose your app settings: Time format, start week on, language, and time zone.

Step 5 | Design your calendar
- Click the calendar in your Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Design** tab.
- Choose the elements you want to customize, such as Header and Background, Calendar Grid, Events, and Buttons.

title: How can I find high-performing keywords for my site's pages using the SEO Setup Checklist?
content: Go to your SEO Setup Checklist in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit icon next to Keywords at the top of the page. Click Find high performing keywords. Choose your keyword provider from the list and add it to your site (log in using your existing credentials or register for an account). Once your provider is connected, enter a keyword in the Keyword field. Your existing keywords appear in a drop-down or you can enter a new keyword. (Optional) Select a country to search in from the drop-down. Click Analyze. Check the box under Selected next to any keywords you want to use for your checklist. Click Apply. Click Save. Note: Once you have connected a keyword research provider, you will see Find high performing keywords with [your chosen provider] under Keywords. Click this option to open the keyword research tool.

title: How can I update the rewards in my Wix Referral Program?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Referral Program and click Manage Program. To update the referring customer reward, scroll to the Referring customer reward section and select an option from the drop-down. To update the referred friend reward, scroll to the Referred friend reward section and select an option from the drop-down. Click Save. Any changes you make to your rewards will not apply to rewards that have already been redeemed by your customers.

title: How can I add a new reservation using the Wix app for Wix Hotels?
content: To add a reservation from the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app; tap Manage at the bottom; tap Hotels under Business; tap the Add icon; add a Check-in and Check-out date; set the number of Adults and/or Children staying in the room; tap Search Availability. If there are no available units available, you will be prompted to select new dates. Select any available unit you want, enter the guest details, review your reservation, and tap Save to confirm.

title: How can I edit a blog post using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Blog. Tap Posts. Tap the post you want to edit. If the post has not yet been published, tap Drafts at the top and then tap the post. Tap More Actions. Tap Edit Post. Make your changes and then tap Next. Tap Update / Save & Publish.

title: Can I set a price per weight or size for products in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set a price per weight (e.g. $10 /pound) or a price per size (e.g $10 / yard). In the meantime, as a workaround solution, you can create product options to offer different weights or sizes at different prices.

title: Is it possible to create a dynamic HTML sitemap that automatically updates when new pages are added to the site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a dynamic HTML sitemap, which would automatically update when you add new pages to your site. As an alternative, you can create a site page that lists and links to all of your site pages, and update the list when needed.

title: Is it possible to remove the 'plus' icon from an upload button?
content: Removing the 'plus' icon from the existing upload button is described as a CMS request. Currently, there is no way to make an upload button completely transparent. As a workaround, you can customize your upload button so that its color matches your page's background. To customize your upload button's color: click the upload button in your site's Editor; click the Design icon; click Customize Design; click the Fill Color & Opacity icon and drag Background slider to 0%; click the Shadow icon and disable the shadow toggle; click the Text icon and set the color to match the element underneath; click Settings and select the Show custom text button; type a space in the Custom text field; publish your site.

title: How can I add a new gallery to my Wix photo album?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant album. Click Customize. Click Media on the left. Click Add New Gallery at the bottom. To add photos, either upload new photos by hovering over the gallery, clicking Manage Media, uploading via the media manager, and clicking Done at the bottom; or move photos from other galleries by hovering over the gallery with the photos, clicking Manage Media, selecting the photo to copy or move, optionally holding Ctrl to select multiple photos or clicking Select All, clicking Move To on the top bar, and selecting the new gallery from the drop-down menu. Optionally click Publish Now to publish your changes. Each page is part of the general album but can also be accessed directly using its own subdomain. Each gallery receives a unique URL.

title: How can I add an AI-generated section to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, select Add Section in the left editor menu, then select AI Creator. Add or edit your site information and desired section content: Site info includes your site type and name; to update it, select Edit and make the necessary changes. Choose a Section type from the drop-down menu, and enter Text details such as keywords and important information. Select Create Section, then click and drag the section to add it to your page.

title: How can I add the Online Programs app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Wix Online Programs app in the search bar, and click Add to Site.

Note: A Payment Page is automatically created when you add Online Programs to your site. You can change the design of the Payment Page by customizing your site theme's colors and text. It is not possible to edit the fields on this page.

title: How can I hide and unhide elements in the mobile editor?
content: To hide an element, click the element in the mobile editor and click the Hide Element icon. To unhide an element, click the Hidden Elements icon on the left of the mobile editor, then click the Show Element icon next to the element you want to show.

title: How can I add and set up collapsible text in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add collapsible text to your site: go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Text, click Collapsible Text, then click and drag your chosen text box to add it to your site.

To adjust the layout, click the Layout icon on the text box. Customize the layout using these options: Choose how the text appears with Collapsed or Show all; Number of lines displayed; Button alignment; Spacing between text and button. The options displayed depend on whether you choose to collapse or display all of the text.

To type and set up your text, click the collapsible text box, click Change Text, and type or paste your chosen text into the box under Change Text. Under What does the button do?, choose Expand or Link. For Expand, enter Expand button text, for example "Read More", and Collapse button text, for example "Read Less". For Link, enter Link button text, for example "Click to read more", and enter the details for Links to. Optionally, add a description and select your text's HTML tag from the dropdown menu under SEO & accessibility to define its text type.

title: Can I have multiple business phone numbers associated with one site?
content: Currently, you can have one business phone number per site. It is not possible to have multiple business phone numbers associated with one site.

title: How can I customize the design of a section on my ADI site?
content:
To customize a section of your ADI site:

- Hover over the section of your site you want to customize.
- Click **Design**.
- Click **Customize Section Design**.
- Select an option below:

**Media**
- Under your **Media Settings**, you can change the media type, replace the image or choose a different media size.
- **Note:** The customization options depend on the media size selected.

**Color**
- Select an option presented to change the section's colors.

**Text Settings**
- Drag the slider to increase or decrease the font size.
- Click on the desired text alignment.

**Height**
- Click the + or - icons to enlarge or shrink the section.

**Animation**
- Click an animation option to see how it appears in the selected section.

**Note:** The design and customization options vary based on the section selected.

title: Can multiple people edit a site at the same time in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible for more than one person to edit a site at the same time in the Wix Editor. However, in the Studio Editor, it is possible for your entire team to work simultaneously on the same site. With Wix Studio, your team can edit the layout, design, and content of the pages and elements without overriding each other's actions.

title: Can I add items from different Wix Photo Albums to one cart?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add items from different Photo Albums to one cart. Photo Albums function as separate sites, and so they each have their own separate carts and checkouts.

### Tips
* The Wix Photo Albums app has been deprecated. However, you can sell your digital prints using Wix Stores. When you add products (e.g. images for sale) to your store, your customers can pick and choose what they want to buy.
* If you want to display your images, add a Wix Pro Gallery to your site.

title: Can I lock layers in the Wix Editor to prevent accidentally moving elements?
content: Currently, it is not possible to lock layers in the Editor to prevent accidentally moving elements while editing your site. However, if you want certain elements to always be visible on your live site, you can pin them. Visitors can always see pinned elements on their screen, even if they scroll.

title: Why am I receiving the error message 'That URL's Unavailable' when trying to edit my page's URL on Wix?
content: It is most likely because you're trying to change your page's URL to a URL slug that is used by Wix apps or reserved for SEO. Some examples of URL slugs to avoid for your pages are: apps, _api, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, feed.xml, sites, events (when using the Wix Events app). If you try to use these URL slugs, you'll see an error that the URL's unavailable. Try adding a different URL slug, then publish your page.

title: Can site members create events within a group on Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible for your site members to create events within a group. However, you can allow members to create their own group based on shared interests to form an online community.

title: I can’t see our paid ad in the campaign list, and I want to know how our Google Ads with Wix subscription and ad credits work. What does the article say?
content: The article explains that you can view and manage your Google Ads with Wix subscription from the campaigns page in your dashboard. The monthly subscription amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month. You can also make one-time payments to purchase extra ad credits. To manage these settings, use Manage Spend & Credits on the campaigns page. The article does not address campaign review status or whether payments are automatically deducted.

title: How can I set up shipping fees based on the price of an order in Wix Stores?
content:
Create or select the shipping region the rule applies to (Step 1). Then:
- Click Shipping.
- Select Rate By Price from the Select how shipping is calculated drop-down.
- Enter a name in the Shipping Option Name field (e.g. Standard Shipping).
- (Optional) Enter a time in the Est. Delivery Time field.
- Enter the top limit of the first price range (e.g. enter $20 to create a rule for purchases from $0 - $20). The top limit of the first price range is automatically set as the bottom limit of the second price range.
- Enter the rate (shipping price) for the first range.
- Enter the top limit of the second price range (e.g. $50).
- Enter the rate (shipping price) for the second price range.
- (Optional) Click Add Range to add another price range and rate (up to 30 ranges).
- Click Add another Delivery Option to add additional options (e.g. Express Shipping).
- (Optional) Check the Add a handling fee to every order checkbox and enter the handling fee.
- Click Save.

Tip: To offer free shipping for orders over a certain price, type "0" in the Rate field for that price range.

title: Can I add a video to the Event Details page in Wix Events?
content: Yes. You can now add a video to display on an Event Details page.

title: How can I add a new element to my site using Editor X?
content: To add elements in Editor X, click the Add icon on the top of the Editor, click the element category, click the element subcategory, then click an element or drag it on to your page.

title: How can I embed a VKontakte community widget on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Create a VKontakte community widget in your VK account and copy the code. In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Embed Code, click Embed HTML, paste the copied code into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field, and click Update. You can optionally enter alt text in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field. When ready, publish your site. Note: We cannot provide support for external codes that were not created or tested with Wix. If you are experiencing an issue with your code snippet, please contact the provider directly.

title: How can I sync my Google Calendar with Wix Bookings to manage my appointments?
content: To sync Google Calendar with Wix Bookings, first make sure you upgrade your site to sync your personal calendar with Wix Bookings. You can connect a Google calendar to Wix Bookings. When synced, your clients' sessions with you appear on your Google calendar, and your personal appointments block off time in your booking calendar. This is a two-way sync. The information you see in your personal calendar depends on the type of service that a client books. Appointments: you can access the service name, address, customer name and contact details, and which staff member is providing the service. Classes and Courses: the name of the class or course appears in your personal calendar (except for Apple calendar); even if no one booked a session, classes and courses still appear in your personal calendar.

title: How do I create a course in Wix Bookings?
content:
To create a course in Wix Bookings:
- Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard.
- Click + Add a New Service in the top right.
- Scroll down to Courses and choose what you want to do:
  - Click Edit below the relevant course template.
  - Click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template.
- Fill out the Service details:
  - Name: Enter the name of the course.
  - Tagline (optional): Enter a tagline that will appear below the service name on your site.
  - Description (optional): Enter a description that will appear on the service page of your site. Tip: Click Generate AI Description to let AI (Artificial Intelligence) help you create a description.
  - Image (optional): Add an image for clients to see when they look through your list of services.
  - Max participants: Enter the maximum number of course participants.
Note: While you can manage courses in the Wix app, you can only create them on desktop.

title: How can I change the author of a blog post in Wix Blog?
content: As a blog admin, you can re-assign a published post or draft to someone who has writing privileges. To switch the author of a post, do one of the following: edit a published post or draft, or create a new post. Click Settings. Select who you want to re-assign the post to from the Author drop-down menu. For a New Post, click Save, then click Publish. For an Edited post, click Save & Publish.

title: How can I report a security vulnerability I found on Wix?
content: If you believe you've found a security issue or vulnerability, please contact the Wix Security team using our security contact page. If you are a security researcher and would like to submit your vulnerability report to our Bug Bounty program, please send the report with all the relevant details to bugbounty@wix.com. Security issues or vulnerabilities may include: XSS attack, CSRF attack, SQL injection vulnerability, DNS hijacking, Session vulnerability, Unsecured API, Authentication spoofing.

title: How can I set up Google Ads conversion tracking on my Wix site?
content:
Prerequisites: You must have a Premium site with a connected domain. If your site uses a cookie banner, Google Ads only gathers data after a visitor provides consent and approves using the relevant cookies.

Create a conversion action: Sign in to your Google Ads account. If you're using Smart Mode, click Tools & Settings and select Switch to Expert Mode; after this switch, you can't switch back to Smart Mode. Click Tools & Settings, select Conversions under Measurement, click Add conversion, select Website, choose the conversion action type from Category, enter a name in Conversion name, select Don't use a value for this conversion action in Value, then click Create and continue.

Get your global site tag ID: Select Install the tag yourself in Tag setup. Select The global site tag isn't installed on all your HTML pages in Global site tag. Copy your global site tag (gtag.js) ID; copy only the numbers and do not copy AW-.

Add the ID to Wix: Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Click Connect under Google Ads, click Add Google Ads Tag, paste your global site tag (gtag.js) ID, paste only the numbers and do not paste AW-, then click Save.

Important: Do not add both Google Tag Manager tags and global site tags (gtag.js) to your Wix account at the same time.

title: Can I connect my event to Wix Live for video conferencing?
content: As of March 2024, the option to connect to Wix Live is no longer available. If you’ve already created events with Wix Live, you can continue using it in the meantime.

title: How can I connect my Instagram personal account to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor. Search for the Instagram Feed app in the search bar. Click **Add to Site**. Select the app on the page. Click **Settings**. Click **Connect Personal Account**. Click **Allow** in the pop-up.

If the Instagram log-in pop-up doesn’t open, try turning off your pop-up blocker, or updating your browser version.

title: How can I set up an Instagram feed on my site using ADI?
content: First add the Instagram Feed app to your site. Then click the Instagram feed inside the ADI Builder, click Connect Instagram on the left, and click Allow in the Instagram pop-up. Set up your feed using the available options: Full Width, Show More Button (Enabled/Disabled), and Pop-up Mode (Light or Dark). Optionally, click Design next to Settings and choose a new design. Tip: To switch accounts, sign out of Instagram in a different tab and return to your ADI Editor to connect a different Instagram account.

title: How can I delete my blog from my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Hover over Blog Pages and click the Settings icon. Click Delete Blog. Click Delete to confirm.

Note: If you've set your blog as your homepage, you need to delete the entire homepage. If you want to delete it, you can set a different page as the homepage and copy all the elements you had in your previous homepage.

Tip: Deleting Wix Blog does not permanently delete your content. Re-adding it restores your content, but it does not restore your settings. It also does not re-add any additional blog elements, e.g. Post List etc.

title: How do I correct my business account information for Wix Payments verification?
content: Make sure your personal and company information is written correctly. For a business account, your company's name and its registration number/tax ID must match the company's registered information. Confirm that the Legal Business Name, Shareholder and VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN entered in the form matches those associated with your business bank account. Upload a document that proves the validity and ownership of the VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN during registration. Also upload a color copy of your photo ID and bank statement to verify your identity. Allow 7 business days for the account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've verified the information is correct and matches your bank account details, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I customize the Twitter settings for my site's pages in the Editor?
content: Click the Pages icon on the left side of the Editor. Click the page you want to edit. Click the Show More icon. Click Social Share. Click Twitter settings. Then you can click Upload Image to add an image; click the Change icon to replace the image; click Adjust Image to edit the image in Photo Studio; click the Delete icon to remove the image; choose the card size under What size card do you want to display on Twitter?; add a title under What's the page's twitter:title (title on Twitter?); and add a description under What's the page's twitter:description (description on Twitter?). Publish your site.

title: How do I add the Wix Groups app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix Groups app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.

title: Can I add a shadow effect directly to the header section in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to apply a shadow effect to the header section. You can add a container and stretch it across the header section. Then, add shadow to the container.

title: How can I invite participants to my online program using the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Online Programs. Tap the relevant program. Tap Invite Participants. Choose what you want to do:

- Invite Participants: Tap the box next to the member(s) you want to invite to join your program, then tap Done.
- Invite another way: Tap Invite Another Way and choose from the following options: Email Wix Contacts (send an email to contacts saved in your Wix account, such as site members, customers, contacts, etc.); Send an SMS (send the link and invitation code to people by SMS/text message); Copy Link (copy the link and paste it into a new message in any application); Invite via Social & More (share the link and invitation code to Gmail or any social network connected to your phone).

title: How can I access my Facebook Ads dashboard using the Wix Owner App on my mobile device?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Facebook Ads under Branding & Marketing.

title: When I restore a previously deleted site, are my contacts automatically restored with it?
content: Currently, when you restore a previously deleted site, your contacts are not automatically restored with it. If you have a CSV file with your contacts, you can import it again.

title: How do I set up payment providers for my Wix online store?
content: Before you can start selling products, you must set up a way for customers to pay you. Connect at least one payment method so you can start selling. Choose from: Wix Payments; Credit card payment providers; PayPal (which can also be used to process credit card payments); Payment providers that let customers pay in installments (where available); Manual (offline) payments; and more. The payment options available vary according to where you are located. For detailed instructions, learn how to set up a payment provider.

title: How can I allow clients to save their card details during checkout in Wix Bookings?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Settings, click Checkout, scroll down to Payments, and enable the Save customers' cards on file toggle. Once a card is saved to a client's file, you can use it for future orders as long as you have the client's consent. Only customers who are site members will see this checkbox and can choose to opt in.

title: How can I troubleshoot my cash drawer on Wix Retail POS if it's not operating correctly?
content: To troubleshoot your cash drawer, disconnect it from the receipt printer. Wait a few minutes, then reconnect it to the receipt printer. Tap Checkout on the bottom bar, select Actions, and choose Open Drawer w/o Sale to open it manually. If the cash drawer is still not working, restart the tablet. If the problem persists, contact Customer Care.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site is PCI compliant?
content: Every site built on Wix is automatically PCI compliant by default with the highest Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards, regardless of the payment provider used. This means that our certifications extend to your site and its checkout process. Wix holds PCI DSS Level 1: Merchant & Service Provider, a standard which provides protection of the privacy and confidentiality of card data used to complete online transactions.

title: How do I create and connect a Google Developer account for my Branded App?
content: Before your app can go live in the Google Play Store, you need to create a Google Developer account. From your Branded App dashboard, follow the step-by-step instructions; if it is your first time in the dashboard, click Get Started and design your app first. Then go to the Developer Accounts tab, click Connect under Google Developer Account, and create or sign in to your Google account. Register for a Google Play Developer account and enter your Google developer account email under Required info. Invite Wix to access your Google Developer account and select the checkbox under Required Info. Link your project to your Google Play Console Developer and invite Wix as a project owner, then click Save. Once you have given all required info, Wix submits your app on your behalf. You can disregard emails from Google at this time. Check approval progress in the Developer Accounts tab; approval may take up to one business week.

title: How can I edit an existing pricing plan on my Wix site?
content: To edit a pricing plan, go to the Pricing Plans tab in your site's dashboard and click the plan you want to edit. You can then make changes such as updating the Plan name, Image, and Description; selecting relevant checkboxes in the Benefits section and removing existing or outdated benefits; entering a new price under Pricing options and choosing available payment frequency or length of plan options; and clicking add or edit next to Add a policy under Settings. When finished, click Save. Note that changes to the price and plan duration only affect new purchases, while changes to connected benefits do affect existing plan holders.

title: How can I add a Welcome screen to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your mobile editor, click Mobile Tools on the left side, click the Add to site icon next to Welcome screen, then customize the screen using the design options.

title: How can I change the password for a password protected page in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor, click the relevant page, click the Show More icon, click Settings, click the Permissions tab, select Password Holders, and type a new password under What's the page's password?.

title: How can I test my Wix AI Site-Chat before making it live on my site?
content: Test the AI Site-Chat in your site's dashboard in a test environment that only you can see. Chat with it as your visitors would, asking questions about your products, services, and content. Think like a site visitor and ask specific questions, such as about products/services, booking availability, and pricing where relevant. Vary your questions, use concise words site visitors would use, and try different formats. Review each answer and give positive or negative feedback; for negative feedback, explain why it isn't a good response. When satisfied with its performance, click the toggle at the top right of the page to set it as active.

title: How can I set up a new menu using the Wix Restaurants Menus app?
content:
Go to Menus (New) in your site's dashboard. Select an option:

- Create new menu: Click +Add New Menu. Enter a menu name. (Optional) Enter a description for the menu.
- Edit an existing menu: Click Edit Menu Details next to the relevant menu name. Enter a menu name. (Optional) Enter a description for the menu.
- Upload menu with AI: Convert a file (e.g. PNG, JPG or PDF) into an interactive menu with the help of AI. Your menu will be added as a draft, and you can always edit it later. Click the More Actions icon. Select Upload menu with AI. Click Start and select the relevant file. Click Continue to turn your file into a menu. Review your menu summary and confirm. Click Confirm & Add. (Optional) Edit the relevant menu details.

Select or deselect the Mark as a draft checkbox. Tip: When a menu is marked as a draft, it won't show in your editor or your live site. Click Save.

title: How can I close my Wix account if I have active premium services?
content: To close a Wix account that has active premium services, the account must have no active services or subscriptions associated with it. You can cancel each service separately by going to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, clicking the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription, clicking Cancel plan/Domain/Mailbox/App, and following the on-screen instructions. If you have active services, you'll need to cancel your subscriptions and wait for them to expire, or transfer your services to another Wix account. To transfer your premium site and services, go to your site's dashboard, click the Site Actions icon at the top of the page, click Transfer Site, enter the recipient's email address, fill out the Transfer Ownership form, click Next, review and confirm the transfer details, and click Transfer Ownership. To transfer your domain only, go to Domains in your Wix account, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, and click either Transfer away from Wix or Transfer to a different Wix account. To remove any additional domains from your account, go to Domains in your Wix account, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, and click Remove from Wix. Move remaining sites to Trash by going to your site's dashboard, clicking the Site Actions icon at the top of the page, clicking Move to Trash, and clicking Move to Trash to confirm; repeat these steps for all remaining sites in your account. Once you've moved your remaining sites to the trash, canceled all existing premium services, subscriptions, and domains, you can close your account. Note: when canceling a Wix domain subscription, you must wait until it expires, is past the redemption period, and is no longer registered before you can close your account.

title: I’m experiencing an “error 404 not found” message when trying to go to my live site. How can I resolve it?
content:
If you receive an “error 404 not found” message when attempting to go to your live site, it means the page doesn't exist on the server at the URL you've entered. This error message is an HTTP standard response code that most commonly occurs when clicking an outdated link that leads to a URL where a page used to exist.

To resolve it, try the following: reload the page by pressing Ctrl + F5 (or Cmd + R on a Mac); check that the URL you are trying to access is correct, then re-enter it in your address bar and press Enter; if you're trying to access a page other than your homepage, go to the homepage URL, then access the page via a different link; use another supported browser; if the error only occurs in one browser, clear your browser's cache. If the problem persists, contact us and we will be happy to help.

title: How can I edit a past event in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Make sure you're in the Published tab. Select Past from the Status drop-down. Click Edit next to the relevant event. Edit the available details. Note: Some details cannot be edited. It's not possible to change a past event into an upcoming event. You can, however, duplicate a past event by clicking the More Actions icon next to the relevant event and selecting Duplicate as Draft.

title: How can I create a multi-reference field in my CMS collection?
content: To create a multi-reference field, go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant collection. Click the Add icon to create a new field. Select Reference or Multi-Reference as the Field Type. Enter a Field Name. Select which collection you want to reference to under Referenced Collection. Click Save. After setting up your multiple items reference field, you can learn how to display content from multiple content collections using reference fields.

title: How can I download a free sample of my logo using the Wix Logo Maker on desktop?
content: On desktop: go to Brand Studio, click the My Logos & Brands drop-down at the top, select the relevant brand, click Download Logo, click View Files under Sample Logo, select the logo you would like to download and click Download. The free sample is a low-resolution sample for testing.

title: How can I add my Wix site to the home screen of my iPhone?
content: Open the site in Safari on your iPhone, tap the Share icon, tap Add to Home Screen, enter a name for the shortcut, and click Add.

title: Can I customize the overlay and shadowing of the Wix Video Player on mobile?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the overlay and apply drop shadowing to the Wix Video Player on mobile. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

title: Is it possible to add Google Shopping as a sales channel in Wix Stores?
content: Yes. Google Merchant Solutions (Google Shopping) is now available through Wix as a full integration. You can learn how to add Google Merchant Solutions as a sales channel.

title: How can I add a new video to my site using Editor X?
content: To add a new video to your site using Editor X: Click Add on the top of Editor X, click Media, select a video type under Video (e.g., Single videos, VideoBox), and drag a video to the desired location on your site. Optionally, click Change Video to upload your own, add a free Wix video, or purchase a professional video.

title: How can I change the font of a specific word in my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Select the relevant text box in your editor. Click **Edit Text**. Optionally highlight the specific word(s) you want to show in a different font. Click the **Fonts** drop-down. Then do one of the following: select a Wix font, click **Upload Fonts** to upload your own font, or click **Add Languages** to add a language font.

title: How can I create a combo meal in the original Wix Restaurants Menus App?
content: Before you begin, make sure that the dishes you want to add to the combo meal are available on your menu. To create a combo meal: go to Menus in your site's dashboard; navigate to the relevant menu section; click Add Dish; enter the combo meal details, including Name, Price, Tax if applicable, Description, Dish Labels such as Special, Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten Free, Organic and Spicy levels, Visibility to show this combo meal to customers in the menu, and Image; click Save; click + New Option and then New Option; click New Choice at the top right and then Select Existing; hover over and select the existing dishes you'd like to add to the combo meal; click Add. Note: The dishes are added with their dish options. To remove the dish options, click Use without. Click Add.

title: How can I set up a 301 redirect for a specific product page in Wix Stores?
content: To set up 301 redirects for your product pages in Wix Stores: Go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Tools and settings. Select Go to URL Redirect Manager. Click + New Redirect. Select Single redirect. Enter the old product page URL you want to redirect from (e.g., /product-page/cactus) under Old URL. Start typing the new URL and select it from the drop-down (e.g., /product-page/succulent). Click Save to finish or click Save & Add Another to add more.

title: 在电商业务中，什么情况下应该使用 AI 适用性评估技能？
content: 当用户提出“should I use AI for X?”、“can AI do X?”或“is it worth automating X?”这类问题时；当用户需要在 AI、人工、脚本、SaaS 工具或工作流引擎之间做选择时；或在准备投入 AI 工具、代理或流水线之前，需要做可行性/ROI sanity check 时，就使用该技能。判定时依据三项规则：数据是否充足、工具是否存在且符合约束、出错成本是否可控或可逆；任一项不满足，答案就是“否”，直到前置条件满足。

title: Can I sell products in bulk (wholesale) using Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a wholesale section where you sell products in bulk. It is, however, possible to use a workaround to create a restricted page that you can use to sell wholesale.

title: How can I display FAQs in my Wix member app using the Wix FAQ app?
content:
Prerequisite: add the Wix FAQ app to your site from a desktop computer before displaying FAQs in your member apps.

To add a screen: go to your site in the Wix app; tap Manage at the bottom; tap Mobile App; tap Edit under the name of your app; tap Screens; tap Add New Screen; type the screen name; tap Save.

To customize the display: tap the FAQ screen; tap + Add Element; scroll through the top menu and tap FAQs; tap the FAQs element; use toggles for Show search bar, Show first question and answer, Open one answer at a time, and FAQs displayed per category. Decide whether to show categories, including Show categories, Show "All" label, and Display FAQs to select specific categories. Optionally enable Show element title, and choose visibility for Android, iOS or All. Tap Add at the top right.

title: How can I add shipping to an order during checkout using Wix Retail POS?
content: Before you begin, make sure you have set up shipping or delivery options in the Wix dashboard; shipping must be added to the order before you complete payment. To add shipping during checkout in Wix Retail POS, add any products, charges, and discounts to the cart. Tap Actions at the top right corner of the cart and select Ship to Customer. If needed, add a customer to the sale: for an existing customer, select the customer from the list and make sure a shipping address is listed; for a new customer, tap +New Customer, enter the customer's details, and tap Next. If the customer wants to ship to another address, enter that address here. Select one of the shipping or delivery options you set up, then complete checkout.

title: How can I view my settlement report in Wix Payments and what options do I have for filtering or downloading the report?
content: Go to your Settlement Report in your site's dashboard. You can optionally filter by transaction type and date range, or click Download Detailed Table to download a CSV file of your settlement report. Tip: You can still access your Wix Payments dashboard, even if your Wix Payments account has been disconnected.

title: How can I manually create a new contact in the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click + Create New. Click Contact. Enter the contact's details, including their full name, email address, phone number and address. (Optional) Click the Add New Field to include an additional email address, phone number, or address. (Optional) Click + Add Label to add a new label to the client's contact card. (Optional) Select the staff member in charge of the contact's subscription from the Assignee drop-down. Click Save. Tip: Click Save & Create Another to add more than one new contact.

title: How can I manually send an invoice to a guest for a Wix event?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant event. Select the Orders tab at the top. Click the relevant paid order. Note: It is not possible to send an invoice to an order that has not yet been paid. Click Create Invoice / View Invoice. Choose a send option at the top: Share Link, then click Copy Link and paste the link in any message to share it with your guest; Print, to print the invoice; or Resend via Email, optionally edit the subject line or message, then click Send.

title: How can I refund a customer for a payment made through Wix Payments?
content: To refund a customer through Wix Payments, go to Payments in your site's dashboard on desktop, click the payment to refund, click Refund, enter the amount to refund and a note if needed, then click Refund. From the Wix app, go to Payments, tap the payment to refund, tap Refund, optionally add a note, enter the amount to refund, tap Issue Refund, and confirm. Refunds can take up to 3-5 business days to reach your customer's credit card/bank account, depending on the financial institution.

title: How can I report a copyright infringement on Wix.com?
content: To report a copyright infringement by a Wix user, fill out the automated DMCA Copyright Complaint Form. This form is the fastest way to report a case of copyright infringement.

title: How can I change the player settings for a channel of videos in Wix Video?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Wix Video player. Click Settings. Make sure Channel is selected on the Videos tab. Click the Layout tab and choose the layout you want to use. Click the Player tab. Customize your player settings. These will be different for each layout, such as Classic, Compact, Grid, and Sliders and strip.

title: Can I access the Booking List from the Wix App?
content: According to the announcement, you can now collect payments and manage sessions using the Booking List on the Wix app.

title: How can I show my event guests nearby accommodation options using the Hotel & Airbnbs Map app?
content: Use the Hotel & Airbnbs Map app. Enter your event address to display nearby accommodation options. Guests can search on the map by preference and then click straight through to book.

title: How can I enable a waitlist for my classes using the Wix app?
content:
To enable the waitlist for your classes using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Services.
- Tap the Settings tab.
- Tap Booking Policies.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant policy.
- Tap Edit.
- Scroll down and tap the Allow clients to join a waitlist checkbox.
- Tap the Max waitlist capacity field and enter the maximum number of clients you can have in the waitlist at one time.
- Tap An open spot will be held for and choose a booking time limit before the spot is offered to the next client on the waitlist.
- Tap Save to confirm.

title: How can I switch from the old Instagram Feed app to the new Instagram Feed app by Wix?
content: Click the Instagram Feed app in your editor. Click Settings. Click Try It Now.

title: Can I change the text size for gallery images in expand mode using Wix Editor?
content: Currently, changing the text size of gallery images in expand mode is not supported. You can, however, change the text size of the regular view in some galleries.

title: How can I provide a copy of my customer's data collected on my Wix site?
content: To get a copy of your customer's data collected on your Wix site, go to Privacy & Cookies in your site's settings, click Visitor Data, click Data Request, click + New Request, click the dropdown and select Get a copy of their data, click Continue, verify that the email or phone number belongs to the customer who made the request by entering their phone number and email address, and click Submit Request. Make sure to enter the email address exactly as it is saved in your contact list. After submitting a request, you will receive a notification confirming the start of the process, and you will receive your customer's data file within 48 hours. After you've received your customer's data file, confirm the customer's identity and contact details, download your customer's data file using the link in the email, and send the file to your customer via email. For larger files, you may wish to use a file sharing service agreed with the customer. No email is sent to your customer; as a site owner, it is your responsibility to send the data file.

title: How do I access Wix Analytics email marketing reports?
content: Go to Analytics & Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Marketing & SEO and click Show more reports. Select the email marketing report you want to view: Performance, Campaigns Over Time, or Campaign Clicks.

title: How can I customize the hover view of my gallery items in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Design tab. Choose which hover elements you want to customize: Overlay & Icons, Texts, Item Style, and Scroll Animations. For Overlay & Icons, choose Full Overlay or Partial Overlay and customize options such as Gradient, Color & Opacity, Gradient direction, Overlay color, Icon color, Set size in, Size, Overlay starts from, and Padding. Choose an overlay effect: No effect, Fade in, Expand, Slide up, or Slide right. For Texts, customize Info to display, Info position (Underneath, Above, or On Image), What happens to the info on hover? (Appears, Disappears, or No Change), Title style and color, Description font style and color, Horizontal alignment, Vertical alignment, Text vertical padding, and Text horizontal padding. For Item Style, customize Border width and color, Corner radius, Shadow, hover behavior (No effect, Zoom in, Blur, Grayscale, Shrink, Invert, Color in, Darken), and loading behavior (Blurred image, Color placeholder). For Scroll Animations, apply effects to galleries that load as visitors scroll downwards (e.g. Collage, Masonry, Grid); you cannot apply these effects to Slider galleries. Choose No effect, Fade in, Grayscale, Slide up, Expand, Shrink, Zoom out, or One color. While you are customizing the hover view, you can see it on the Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Exit Hover Preview to go back to the regular Pro Gallery view.

title: How can I add a new image to my site using ADI?
content: To add a new image to your site, you must first add a new section from the Add panel. There are many different image layouts to choose from depending on your purpose. To add a new image: hover over the **Add** drop-down in the top bar of the ADI builder; click **Section to Page**; scroll down to **Elements** in the Add Section Panel and click **Image**; choose an image layout that you like. Some layouts include a title and text along with the image, and some layouts offer standalone images only. Hover over your favorite one and click **Add This Section**.

title: How can I change my Premium or Studio plan if the Change Plan button does not appear?
content:
If you cannot change your plan using the standard steps, you can use the workaround described in the source. These steps are complex, so keep the page open in a separate tab for reference. In summary, cancel your plan's auto-renewal, duplicate your site, sign up for the plan you want to change to, then apply your new subscription to your original site.

Important: Canceling your plan's auto-renewal means your old plan remains active until the end of the subscription period. If you cancel after your refund period, both subscriptions will overlap, and you won't receive a credit for the remainder of your old plan.

- Cancel the plan you want to change: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Cancel Plan. Click Cancel Now. Enter the reason for cancellation and click Cancel Now.
- Duplicate the site that the plan is assigned to: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Site Actions drop-down. Click Duplicate Site. Enter a name for the duplicate site. Click Duplicate.
- Reassign the canceled plan to the duplicate site: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Select the canceled plan. Click Assign to a different site next to Assigned to:. Click Assign next to the duplicate site.
- Upgrade the original site to the plan of your choice: Go to the dashboard of the original site. Click Upgrade at the top of the dashboard. Click Select under the plan you want to purchase. Follow the steps to complete the purchase.
- Assign your domain back to your original site: Go to the Domains page. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the domain you want to reassign. Click Assign to a site. Select the site you wish to assign the domain to, your original site and not the duplicate. Click Next. Click Assign.

title: How can I customize the overlay and icons for the Wix Pro Gallery on my mobile site?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Switch to mobile icon at the top of the editor. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page. Click Settings, then the Design tab, then Overlay & Icons. Choose between a Full or Partial overlay. For Full Overlay, customize using Gradient, Gradient Direction, Icon Color, Color overlay, and Icon color. For Partial Overlay, customize using Set size in, Size, Overlay starts from, Padding, Gradient, Gradient Direction, Icon Color, Color overlay, and Icon color. Then choose an overlay effect: No effect, Fade in, Expand, Slide up, or Slide right.

title: Can I access my music library using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to access your music library from the Wix app on a mobile device. To access your music library on your desktop, click here.

title: Can I add a survey to my site using the Wix Editor's Add Elements panel?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a survey to your site from the Add Elements panel in the Wix Editor. As an alternative, you can search the Wix App Market for Survey apps, or embed code on your site.

title: Why don't my music and videos autoplay on mobile and tablet devices using Wix Editor?
content: You may find that your music and videos do not play automatically on iPhones, Androids and tablets. This is because Apple and Chrome block the autoplay function to prevent additional data charges from the visitor's cellphone network. No data is loaded until the user taps the play button on the audio or video player. Autoplay functions are also disabled if the visitor has enabled low-power mode on their iOS device. For more information, please see Apple's Safari Developer Library and Google's Developers guidelines.

title: How can I access the details of a class session in the Wix app?
content: To access the details of a class session in the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Booking Calendar, navigate to the relevant day and time in the Schedule, then tap the relevant session. You can view the details including the participant list and waitlist.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings of a blog post using the Wix blog post sidebar?
content:
Go to your Blog in your site's dashboard. Select the blog post you want to edit. Click SEO in the left sidebar. Customize the following SEO settings:

- URL slug: This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read.
- Title tag: Add a title tag that summarizes the content of the page. Enter your title tag as it is meant to appear on search engines results.
- Meta description: Add a short meta description of the content on the page. This description helps users decide if the blog post is relevant to them.

Click the Let search engines index this page toggle to set whether search engines can crawl and index your page or not:

- Enabled: Search engines will index your page. People can find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
- Disabled: Search engines will not index your page. People cannot find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.

Click Publish.

title: How can I add social media account links to my site using ADI?
content: Open your site in ADI. Click the section you want to add the links to (header, footer or contact). Click the Show/Hide icon next to Social Accounts. Click the social icons. Click the Show/Hide icon next to the icons you want to show. Hover over each icon and click the Edit icon. Enter the URL of the relevant social page.

title: Can I add a table to my site using Wix ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot add a table to your site inside Wix ADI. If you want to add a table app, you need to head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: How can I remove horizontal scroll bars from my Wix site when viewed on different devices?
content: To remove the horizontal scroll bars and spaces, use the Layers panel to identify elements that have a horizontal scrollbar. Look for elements that are not stretched to full-width, have a width bigger than 980px, or are placed at the edge of your Editor screen (or going off the screen). If the element does not have Stretch enabled, enable it. If the Stretch option is not available, add a strip and place the element inside the strip. If you have images placed outside the gridlines, add them as a strip background instead. If you stretched a gallery to full-width manually, change it to a full-width gallery.

title: What are the differences between transferring and connecting a domain to Wix, and how do I manage my domain in each case?
content:
Important: You must upgrade your site with a plan before you can assign a domain to your site.

Transferring your domain: When you transfer your domain to Wix, Wix becomes your domain host. You can manage your domain's registration payments, contact information, and DNS records from your Wix account.

Connecting your domain: If you keep your domain with your current host, you can connect it to your Wix site. Your domain remains hosted at your current domain host, not at Wix, and is only connected to your Wix site via name servers or pointing.

Name servers are the preferred connection method, and you manage your DNS records from your Wix account. With pointing, which is not recommended, you continue to manage your DNS records at your domain host. Billing and contact details are managed at your current domain host, not at Wix; contact your existing domain host for assistance with domain renewals, contact information, and other domain-related billing inquiries.

Once you connect your domain to Wix, it may take up to 48 hours for the DNS changes to take effect.

title: How can I extend the duration of a client's subscription plan on Wix?
content: Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant plan. Click Manage Subscription. Click Extend subscription. Enter the new end date for the plan. Click Save. Note: If a client cancels a plan or allows it to expire, it is not possible to extend it. They can purchase a new plan instead. Extending a plan does not charge clients any additional fees.

title: Is it possible to connect PostFinance as a payment provider to my Wix site?
content: Yes, you can now connect PostFinance as a payment provider to your Wix site.

title: What information should be included in a privacy policy regarding the collection and use of personal data?
content: A privacy policy should clarify the types of personal information collected from site visitors, such as email, name, IP addresses, billing details, social security number, and information provided by visitors or collected automatically through monitoring tools. It should explain how information is collected, for example through contact forms, purchases, or newsletter subscriptions; why it is collected, such as for services, customer assistance, service notices and promotional messages, aggregated statistical data, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations; how it is stored, used, shared, and disclosed, including with third-party services or legal enforcement agencies according to relevant local regulations; how the site communicates with visitors, including means and purposes and how visitors can opt out; how cookies and other tracking tools are used and what information they gather; how visitors can withdraw consent and delete or change collected information; that the policy may be updated; and how visitors can contact the site owner to access, correct, amend, or delete personal information. The source also recommends adding the privacy policy to the site's footer.

title: How can I set custom call hours for specific call agents in Business Phone Number?
content: Go to Business Phone Number in your site's dashboard. Click the Call Agents tab. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant agent. Click Edit Call Agent. Select Custom Hours under Agent's Call Hours. (If enabled) Click the Receive Calls 24/7 toggle to disable it. Set the Time Zone from the drop-down. Set the days and times that the agent is available. Tip: Click the Add icon to add multiple time slots to the same day. Note: Customizing agent calls hours is only possible from your site dashboard.

title: How can I upload a video from my computer to the Wix Video Library?
content:
Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard.

Note: You can also access your video library by clicking a video in your Editor and then clicking Manage Videos.

Depending on whether you're uploading a video for the first time or adding additional videos:
- Uploading your first video: Click Upload Videos.
- Adding additional videos: Click Add Videos at the top right.

Then choose where you want to upload the video from:
1. Click Computer.
2. Select the video(s) you want to add.
3. Click Open.

Once you've uploaded your video(s), you can click the Edit Video Info icon to edit a video's info and organize your videos to choose what you want to display on your site.

title: How can I customize the layout and design of my Wix Blog page?
content: You can completely customize the Blog page, including the All Posts feed and the Category feed, to look exactly how you want. For example, you can change the layout, choose what information is displayed, and design them using a huge range of customization options. Tip: Click Settings on the Blog element to get started. Note: The Category feed design is also used for the tags, hashtags and archive results pages.

title: How can I create and add tags to my Wix blog posts?
content:
From Tags in your dashboard, you can create and manage your tags. To create tags:
- Go to Tags in your site's dashboard.
- Click + Create Tag.
- Enter your Tag Name and Slug in the fields provided.
- Note: The slug field automatically populates based on what you add in the tag name field.
- (Optional) Click Edit SEO Settings and customize the tag's SEO information.
- Click Save.
- Go to Posts in your site's dashboard.
- Hover over a post and click Edit.
- Click Settings in the sidebar on the left.
- Click Tags.
- Add the tag you created.
- When you're ready, click Publish.

title: How can I upload a Google Sheets spreadsheet to the Table Master app?
content:
Prerequisites: Before you can upload your Google Sheets spreadsheet, you need to publish it and get the public URL for it. Note that some organizations do not allow spreadsheets to be fully public, which means that you won't be able to share them on the app.

Step 1 | Publish Your Google Sheets Spreadsheet
Open your Google Sheets spreadsheet. Click **File** at the top left. Click **Share**. Select **Publish to the web** from the drop-down menu. Click **Publish**. Click **OK** in the pop-up window. Copy the URL displayed on the **Link** tab.

Step 2 | Add Your Spreadsheet URL to Table Master
After you publish your Google Sheets spreadsheet, you can add it to your Table Master app in your site's Editor. Click the Table Master app in your Editor. Click **Settings**. Select **Data**. Select **Google Spreadsheet URL**. Paste your Google Sheets spreadsheet URL under **Spreadsheet URL**. Click **Submit**.

**Note:** It may take some time for updates to be visible on your live site.

title: Can I customize the reset password email my site members receive?
content: You can now customize the reset password email your members receive.

title: How can I add reservation and cancellation policies to my hotel on Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Hotels tab on the left, then Settings, then Policies. Add your reservation and cancellation policies. Use the text editing toolbar to change the font, formatting, and alignment of your policy text. Click Save. When creating policies, keep them clear and concise, use simple language and avoid jargon, and do not use abbreviations.

title: How can I preview my online program on my Wix site to see how it appears to both visitors and participants?
content:
To preview your program on your Wix site, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard, click the relevant program, and click Preview. Then choose how you want to view your program:

- Visitor View: People who have not joined your program can see program details such as program name, program duration, number of steps, and price (if any).
- Participant View: Participants can click the steps to expand and view the details. They can also view the discussion tab in your group to see what everyone is talking about.

Before previewing, make sure your site is published.

title: How can I add and set up a lightbox on my site using the ADI Builder?
content:
To add a lightbox: Click the Add drop-down at the top left of the builder. Click Page. Select Lightbox. Hover over your favorite design and click Add This Page.

To set up your lightbox: Click on the lightbox in the ADI Builder to open the design and settings panel. Click Edit to change the lightbox's text and media settings. Use Title to choose the header or main action item such as Subscribe, Join, or Welcome. Use Subtitle to add a subtitle beneath the main header. Use Paragraph to encourage visitors to sign up, promote a sale, or further describe the lightbox's purpose. Use Media to edit the lightbox image; click Edit & Replace to change the image, adjust it, or link the image to another page or URL. Use Buttons to change the button text and link the button to a page or URL; you can also add multiple buttons by clicking + Add Button. To hide any text or media element, deselect the blue checkmark beside the element.

Click Design to change the layout and design. Scroll to see different options for lightbox layouts including recommended designs. Hover over a design and click Use This Layout to update the lightbox. Optionally, click the Customize Section Design drop-down under the current layout to make text and color changes.

Click Settings to customize how your lightbox appears and choose what page it shows up on. Enable the Automatically show lightbox toggle to make the lightbox appear on your site. Click the text field under Which Pages Is It On? to choose the page(s) where the lightbox shows up. For example, for a welcome lightbox, select Home to have it pop up only on the homepage, or select All Pages to have it appear on every page. Choose placement carefully because visitors may get frustrated if a pop-up appears on every page. Click and drag the Delay slider to choose how many seconds someone can view your site before the lightbox appears; you can also input a number in the number field at the right.

title: How can I connect a subdomain to my Wix site?
content: First, upgrade the site to a Premium plan. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click **Add an Existing Domain**, select **Connect a domain you already own**, select the site you want to repackage as a subdomain, and click **Next**. Enter the new subdomain URL for the chosen site, using the main domain plus your chosen subdomain, then click **Let's Go**. Follow the on-screen steps for the main domain connection type: if the main domain is a Wix domain or connected by name servers, no action is needed and DNS records are added automatically; if it is connected by pointing or not connected to Wix, add the CNAME details at the domain host, including both sets of CNAME records. The subdomain may take up to 48 hours to be visible worldwide, and Wix will send an email when the connection is live.

title: How can I filter my Wix Booking Calendar to only show services I am interested in?
content: Go to the Booking Calendar tab in your site's dashboard. Click Services in the Filter by section. Deselect the Select all checkbox. Select the services you want to view in your calendar. Tip: Click the Search field and enter the name of a service to quickly find it.

title: How can I update inventory for multiple products at once?
content: Go to Inventory in your site's dashboard. Select the checkboxes next to the products whose inventory you want to update. Click Update Inventory at the top right. Select an option: choose Add to add the same number of items to multiple products, or choose Set to set the inventory of multiple items to the same level. If you are not tracking inventory, select an inventory status (In stock or Out of stock).

title: How can I assign a payments role to a collaborator on my Wix site?
content:
To assign a payments role on your Wix site:
- Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard.
- Click Invite People.
- Enter your collaborator’s email address.
- Select the checkbox next to the relevant role/s.
- Click Send Invite.

Note: Invitation emails are valid for 30 days. If a collaborator doesn't accept the invite in time, you can resend it.

title: How can I cancel my Wix Premium or Studio Plan?
content:
To cancel your Wix Premium or Studio Plan:

- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan.
- Click Cancel Plan.
- Click Cancel Now to confirm.

This does not cancel your plan immediately. Your plan will remain active until the end of the current subscription period. At that time, the plan will not renew.

title: How can I customize the layout of the daily agenda in Wix Bookings?
content:
To customize the layout of the daily agenda in Wix Bookings:
* Click the daily agenda element in your editor.
* Click Settings.
* Click the Layout tab.
* Use the available formatting options to adjust the alignment of the header.
* Use the sliders to adjust the amount of padding between elements in the daily agenda.

title: How can I create an introductory offer using the Wix app for my pricing plans?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog. Tap Create a Plan / Create New Plan. Create a plan with any of the available options. To create a recurring plan that starts with a free trial period, scroll down and enable the Free Trial toggle, enter the number of days the free trial lasts, complete the plan, and tap Save. To create a free plan that clients can book only once, scroll down and enable the Single Purchase Only toggle, complete the plan, and tap Save. Clients who try to purchase the free plan a second time receive a notice that the plan can only be purchased once.

title: How can I handle reported posts in Wix Forum?
content: Forum readers have the option of reporting content they find offensive or that they think is spam. When they do, you receive a notification of this report. You can review the report and decide if you want to take action. Important: Members can only report other members' posts, comments, and replies. Posts, comments, and replies created by Admins and Moderators cannot be reported. You can learn how to delete a post and how to block or delete a site member.

title: Can I control which collection items are visible to specific logged-in site members?
content: Currently, it is not possible to control which collection items are visible to specific logged-in site members without the use of member roles. Workarounds: You can limit access to dynamic CMS content that appears on your site to members that have specific member roles or are paying subscribers. You can limit access to specific pages on your site to members that have specific member roles.

title: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Facebook Ads subscription on Wix?
content:
To turn off auto renewal for your Facebook Ads subscription:
- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Find the relevant site and click the Show More icon to the right of the subscription that says Facebook Ads.
- Click Cancel Facebook Ads.
- Select Cancel Subscription and provide a reason for cancellation.
- Click Cancel Subscription to confirm.

Turning off auto renewal does not automatically end your campaign. Your campaign remains active for the rest of the current subscription, and it ends when the subscription ends. You can turn auto renew back on from the Premium Subscriptions dashboard by clicking Turn Auto Renew On.

title: Can I use the SEO Assistant with Wix Bookings services?
content: Yes. You can now use the SEO Assistant with Bookings services. Choose a service and select Edit SEO Settings to open the assistant and get tasks and suggestions.

title: What business contact information must be displayed on my website to help ensure my Wix Payments account can be verified?
content:
Add the name of your business and easy-to-find contact details to your website. Hard-to-find or no contact information is a reason your account cannot be verified on Wix Payments.

Business Name: Display your business name clearly on your website. It can be the name of your business entity or your Doing Business As name. If you're a sole proprietor, this may be your own name. When presenting your legal business name or your trade name on your website, make sure it's identical to the ones you provided during your Wix Payments account setup. The business name you display on your site should also appear as your statement descriptor, the business name your customers see on their card statements.

Business Location: Add your business's physical address, including the country. Make it easy for your clients to see this information before they complete a payment or book a service. This information is usually placed in the footer and checkout area for easy visibility. Certain types of addresses, such as a post office box or mail-forwarding address, are not considered valid business addresses.

Customer Service Contact Information: Your site needs to include an email address and/or telephone number where customers can reach you. We recommend giving customers multiple ways to contact you.

title: How can I set my GIF files to play in a loop before uploading them to Wix?
content: GIF files need to be set to loop before they are uploaded to Wix. You can edit the GIF's looping settings using an external image editing program such as LunaPic. Using LunaPic, go to the LunaPic website, click Browse to upload the GIF from your computer, or enter the URL next to Open from URL and click Go. Then click Animation from the menu at the top, click Edit GIF Animation, click the drop-down menu next to Looping and choose how many times you want the GIF to loop, and click Apply.

title: How can I add member tabs and pages to my site's menu using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add member tabs and pages to your site's menu using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Site Menu**.
- Click the Add a Link icon at the bottom.
- In the Link panel, select **Page**.
- Choose the relevant member tab / page from the **Which page?** drop-down:
  - **Private member page:** Select your custom page from the drop-down. Select **Current window** under **How does it open?**.
  - **Member tab (e.g. My Account):** Select **Member Page** from the drop-down. Select the relevant tab from the **Which item?** drop-down.
- Click **Done**.
- Repeat the relevant steps to add more member pages / tabs to your menu.

title: How do I create a group for an event in Wix Events using Wix Groups?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant published event or event draft. Click the Features tab, then click Groups. Click Create Group or select an existing group. Set a privacy level: Public means Anyone site visitor can view discussions and images, and event guests are automatically asked to join the group; Private means Only members can join and view this group, and event guests are automatically invited to join the group. If you select Private, select Visible or Hidden from the Visibility drop-down and choose who has access: Only members approved by admin, where you must approve each request, or Only event participants, where any event participant can join the group. Click Create, then click Done. When you use Wix Groups for the first time, the Groups List page and the Group Page are added to your site.

title: How can I move a domain purchased elsewhere from one Wix account to another?
content:
Moving a connected domain purchased elsewhere from one Wix account to another: It is not possible to add the same domain name to more than one Wix account at a time. First remove the domain from its current account, then add it to the new account.

Remove the domain from your Wix account:
- Sign in to the Wix account where your domain is currently added.
- Go to Domains in the account.
- Copy your domain's DNS records. If your domain is connected by pointing, skip ahead to step 4.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Remove from Wix.
- Click Remove Domain to confirm.

Add the domain to another Wix account:
- Sign in to the Wix account you're adding the domain within.
- Go to Domains in the account.
- Click Add an Existing Domain and select Connect a domain you already own.
- Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Continue.
- Enter your domain name and click Let's Go.
- Click Yes, I own this domain under the search field.
- Finish connecting your domain via name servers or pointing: Name servers (Recommended) keeps the domain's DNS records managed in your Wix account; continue at step 1.7 here to finish connecting via name servers. Pointing requires the domain's DNS records to be hosted outside of Wix; learn how to finish connecting your domain via pointing.

title: Can I perform calculations on form fields in Wix Forms to provide a total price to my customers?
content: Currently in Wix Forms, it is not possible to calculate the data from multiple form fields to create a response for the site visitor. For example, a website design company may want to offer customers a total project price in real-time based on the sum of the fields they've chosen (website design only = X amount, website design + logo + business cards = Y amount).

title: How do I add the Wix Podcast Player to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix Podcast Player app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I optimize third-party code on my site to improve performance?
content: You can optimize third-party code by adding the defer attribute to your third-party script so the browser does not wait for the script and your site content can load uninterrupted. You can also place third-party scripts at the end of the code body so regular site content is not delayed or prevented from rendering. Where possible, reduce the amount of third-party code and only use code that is necessary for your business and site needs, removing code that is no longer required.

title: How can I set up my videos for rental on Wix Video?
content:
To set up your videos for rental on Wix Video: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Select the checkbox to the left of the video or videos that you want to rent. Click Set Pricing at the top of your list of videos. Select Paid, then select Video can be rented. Enter the price and length of the rental availability, then click Save.

Important: Your site visitors need to sign up/become a site member in order to rent videos. Video rental periods begin when your site visitors purchase them. Videos can only be rented for a maximum of 72 hours. Social Media videos cannot be rented. Videos set to rent cannot be downloaded.

title: How can I adjust the content that hangs over the edge of a slideshow in Wix Editor?
content:
You can choose to cut the content that is over the edge of the slideshow frame, or leave it like that. To change the Content Outside Frame setting:

• Click the slideshow in the Editor.
