• Click the Settings icon.
• Click the Hide content outside frame toggle:
   * Enabled: Elements that are over the edge of the slide are cut off so that they appear inside the slide only.
   * Disabled: Elements that are over the edge of the slide are not cut off.

title: How can I block or delete a site member in Wix Forum?
content: Go to the forum on your live site. Go to a post or comment written by the member you want to block. Click the member's name. Click the More Actions icon on the relevant site member. Select an option: to block a member, click Block Member and then click Block to confirm; to delete a member, click Delete Member and then click Delete to confirm. Any site admin can block or delete members. Blocked members cannot like or comment on a post or follow a writer, but they still appear on the members page. Deleted members cannot like or comment on a post or follow a writer; all their posts, comments, and likes are removed from the forum, and they no longer appear on the member's page.

title: How can I archive and later unarchive orders in Wix?
content:
To archive an order: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Select the checkbox next to the order(s) you want to archive. Click More Actions. Select Archive.

To access archived orders and unarchive them: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click Filter at the top right. Scroll down and click to expand the Archive Status section. Select the Archived checkbox. To unarchive an order, select the checkbox next to the archived order you want to unarchive, click More Actions, and select Archive.

When you're done, don't forget to cancel the filter.

title: How can I change the URL of a page in ADI, and what should I be aware of when doing so?
content: To change your page URL: Click the Page Menu. Click the Settings icon. Click Page SEO. Under Page URL, delete the existing name and enter a new one. Important: If you change your page URL, the new URL is treated as a new page and your old page will no longer work. Existing links to the old page URL that you shared on social media will stop working, and existing page SEO rankings will be lost because search engines treat a different URL as a new page. To keep links working and move SEO to the new page, set up a 301 redirect from the old URL to the new URL. To set up 301 redirects, you need to upgrade your site to a Premium Plan and connect a domain to your site.

title: How can I verify my Cloudflare settings to ensure my domain is properly connected to Wix?
content: To verify your Cloudflare settings for connecting a domain to Wix: Log in to your Cloudflare account. Go to the Websites tab and click on your domain name. Go to the DNS tab and scroll down to your A and CNAME records in the DNS management section. Under Proxy Status, make sure that both A records and CNAME records are set to DNS Only. If your records are set to DNS Only, you don't need to do anything else. Your domain will function normally with Wix, as long as your DNS records are configured correctly with your domain registrar as well.

title: How can I prevent bots and spammers from attacking my site's Members Area?
content:
To prevent attacks by bots and spammers, go to Signup & Login Security in your site's dashboard.

- Scroll down to Ask new members to confirm their email.
- Enable the toggle next to Everyone who signs up.
   Note: You can disable this toggle at any time. If you do so, only new site members who are already in your contacts will need to confirm their email.
- Customize the reCAPTCHA settings under Use reCAPTCHA for signup and login.
   - Add reCAPTCHA to signup: Enable the toggle to add a reCAPTCHA field to your signup form. You can choose to always display the field, or only display it to suspected bots.
   - Add reCAPTCHA to login: Enable the toggle to add a reCAPTCHA field to your login form. You can choose to always display the field, or only display it to suspected bots.
- Click Save.

title: I'm having an issue with changing the name of a menu item on my site using the Wix Editor.
content: In the Wix Editor, click the advanced menu, then click Manage Menu. Next to the relevant item, click the More Actions icon, then click Rename / Rename page. Enter the new name into the field and click Done.

title: How do I customize a Grid Gallery or Slider Gallery in Wix Stores, including layout, images, and button text?
content: To customize a Product Gallery in Wix Stores, go to the page in the editor containing the gallery, click the gallery, and click the Settings icon. For a Grid Gallery, use the Category tab to choose the product category you want to display. Use the Display tab to show or hide gallery elements and to enable or disable Quick View. Use the Settings tab to customize Scroll behavior, Image hover effect, and what happens when the Add to Cart button is clicked. Use the Layout tab to stretch the gallery across the browser, set margin size, choose Grid behavior, select how Product images are displayed, place the Add to Cart button, choose Product info layout, and adjust Ribbons. Use the Design tab to style the gallery, Product cards, Product info, Quantity & product options, Ribbons, the Name & price divider, Add to Cart button, Quick View button, and Load More/Previous buttons or Pagination. Use the Text tab to customize Add to Cart Button text, Pre-order button text, Out of Stock Text, and Load more /Previous buttons. Use the Filters and Sorting tabs to enable and customize filters and sorting. For a Slider Gallery, use the Settings, Display, Layout, Text, and Design tabs to customize the slider, Product images, Add to Cart button, Product info, Ribbons, Navigation arrows, Pagination dots, and Quick View; use the Quick View tab to customize the Quick View popup. To customize a gallery for mobile, go to your editor, click the Switch to Mobile icon or Switch to Tablet / Mobile icon, go to the page with the gallery, click the gallery, click Settings, and customize the available options.

title: Does Wix support Google Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) for mobile sites?
content: Aside from the latest version of Wix Blog, your mobile-friendly site does not have Google Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) capabilities. AMP creates mobile-simplified content for your site, which makes it load instantly on all mobile devices.

title: How can I search, filter, and sort my invoices or price quotes in Wix?
content:
To search, filter, and sort your invoices or quotes:

1. Go to your Invoices or Price Quotes tab on your site's dashboard.

2. Choose what you want to do:

- Search for an invoice or price quote: Enter a search term in the search bar above the Invoice list or Price Quote list.
- Filter your invoice list or price quote list: Click the Filter By drop-down and select a status for Invoices or Price Quotes.
- Sort your invoice list or price quote list: Click a column name to sort the list. For Invoices, you can sort by Number, Customer, Issue date, Due date, Total, or Status. For Price Quotes, you can sort by Number, Title, Customer, Created On, Total Price, or Status. Optionally, click again to reverse the order.

title: How does the pricing for Google Ads with Wix work?
content: Google Ads with Wix is paid through a monthly subscription or by purchasing one-time ad credits. Wix gets 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign, and the remaining 85% goes towards your ad credit, which is spent on ad clicks. Your ad credit may include your monthly subscription, any rollover ad credit from previous months, and any qualifying Google Ads credit applied to your account. If you pay in a supported currency (e.g. EUR, GBP, JPY, USD), the ad credits are in the same currency. For all other currencies, ad credits in your dashboard show as USD. It is possible to continue running an ad with existing ad credit even if your Google Ads with Wix subscription has expired.

title: Can I use third-party contact form apps in Wix Inbox?
content: Currently, third-party contact form apps are not supported in Wix Inbox. In the meantime, you can add Wix Chat to your site and add a Custom Form to receive contact information, whether you are online or offline.

title: How can I crop my mobile background image in the Wix Editor?
content: Click Background on the left side of the mobile editor. Click Image. Hover over the image in your Media Manager and click the Crop & Edit icon. Click Crop & Extend. Crop your image and click Save. Click Change Background.

title: How can I create a 'Pay what you want' ticket for my event using the Wix app?
content:
To create a 'Pay what you want' ticket for your event in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events.
- Tap Published / Draft Events, then tap the relevant event.
- Tap Create Tickets.
- Enter a ticket name and, optionally, a ticket description.
- Select Pay what you want under Ticket Type.
- Optionally set a minimum price: tap the Minimum Price toggle to enable it, then tap the Currency drop-down and enter the minimum price.
- Select an option under Ticket Quantity: Unlimited tickets or Limited tickets.
- Select who pays the Ticket service fee: Pass fee on to buyer or Absorb fee.
- Optionally edit the default Ticket Policy.
- Optionally set when ticket sales start and end under Advanced Settings: enable Set Ticket Sale Period, select Opening date and Opening time, select Closing date and Closing time, optionally select Hide ticket if it is not on sale, then tap Add.
- Optionally tap + Add a Ticket to create additional ticket options.
- Tap Done.

title: How can I add a Rich Text field to my CMS collection in Wix?
content: To add a Rich Text field to your collection: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection. Click Manage Fields. Click + Add Field. Select Rich text and click Choose Field Type. Enter a name in the Field name field. (Velo only) Update the Field ID, which is used in the site's code; you cannot update this ID later. (Optional) Enter Help text if you want a tooltip to appear in your collection next to the field title. Click Save.

title: How can I create social media covers using the Wix Logo Maker?
content:
From the standalone logo maker: Go to the Logo & Brand Studio. Click the My Logos & Brands drop-down at the top and select the relevant brand. Click the Create a New Design icon under Brand Designs. In the Create a New Design window, click Social Media Covers. Choose the social cover you want to create: Twitter Header, YouTube Banner, Facebook Cover, LinkedIn Personal, LinkedIn Business, or Etsy Banner. Hover over your desired template and click Select. Customize your template using the Brand Studio menu. Click Download to download your file. Extract your social cover files and upload them to your social media of choice.

From your site's dashboard: Go to Logo & Brands in your site's dashboard. Click Create New and select Social cover from the drop-down. Select the social cover you want to create: Twitter Header, YouTube Banner, Facebook Cover, LinkedIn Personal, LinkedIn Business, or Etsy Banner. Hover over your desired template and click Select. Customize your template using the Brand Studio menu. Click Next. Click the More Actions icon on your social media cover. Click Download to download your file. Extract your social cover files and upload them to your social media of choice.

title: How can I add a knowledge enhancement to my AI Site Chat?
content:
To add a knowledge enhancement to your AI Site Chat:
- Go to Manage AI Site Chat in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Training rules tab.
- (First time only) Click Get Started.
- Click + Add More.
- Click Next on the Add knowledge option.
- Give the enhancement a clear name that you'll recognize later.
- Choose an option:
  - What knowledge enhances the chat?: Enter your description in the text field.
  - Upload PDF/DOCX file: Upload a file from your computer containing the description. Click Add a File.
- Click Save.

Tip: If you add enhancements with information for time-sensitive events, such as business hours during holidays, remember to delete those enhancements afterwards.

title: Can I add a LinkedIn Share Button using the Wix Editor?
content: We are excited to announce that you can now add a LinkedIn Share Button.

title: How can I enable search engine indexing for my Wix page to get SEO recommendations?
content: To get SEO Setup Checklist recommendations for a page that is not indexed by search engines, enable indexing for that page in your editor, then return to the SEO Setup Checklist and follow its recommendations. In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO basics, enable the Let search engines index this page toggle, and publish your site. In Editor X, click Pages at the top of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO Basics, enable the Let search engines index this page toggle, and publish your site. In Studio Editor, click Pages on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO Basics, enable the Let search engines index this page toggle, and publish your site. After updating your page, go back to the SEO Setup Checklist and follow the recommendations for optimizing your page. You can optionally hide your pages from your site menu again and disable indexing by search engines for your page.

title: How can I set up a new route to redirect visitors to a different site using Wix Studio for enterprise?
content: In your Enterprise dashboard, go to Routing and click + Create Route at the top right. Create your custom URL subdirectory: in the URL Base field, select the base URL you want to use; in the URL Path field, choose path words that suit the destination or leave it blank. Under Destination, choose whether to direct traffic to a Wix site or an external link, then select the site or enter the URL next to your selection. Click Create Route. Optionally, hover over the relevant route and click Manage Sites to add alternative sites to the route and set their language and location targeting. You can set up as many routes as you need; there is no limit.

title: Can I link questions in the Wix FAQ app to dynamic pages?
content: Currently, it is not possible to link questions in the Wix FAQ app to dynamic pages.

title: Can I adjust padding directly on the canvas in the Studio Editor?
content: You can now adjust padding directly on the canvas. Double-click the drag handle on the padding to enter a specific value.

title: Can I move my app between different Wix Studio workspaces?
content: Currently in Blocks, you can't move your app between different Wix Studio workspaces. This means that if you created an app in one workspace and worked on it, it will remain in that workspace.

title: How can I unhide an element in the Studio Editor's Layers panel?
content: Click **Layers** on the left side of the editor. Locate the hidden element on the list. Hover over the element and click the **More Actions** icon. Click **Display**.

title: Can I create multilingual blog posts directly from my live Wix site?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create multilingual blog posts directly from your live site. Any posts that you create on your live site are automatically assigned to your site's primary language. After you've created your post, you can use Wix Multilingual to translate it and create unique content for each language on your site.

title: I accidentally erased something in the Wix Editor and I need to add it back on.
content: If you delete an element by mistake, click the Undo icon in the top bar of the Editor, or press Ctrl + Z on your keyboard. You can only undo changes you have made in the current session. If you make a change in the Editor, then close the tab or sign out of your Wix account, it is not possible to undo that change when you open the Editor again.

title: Can I connect my .kz domain to my Wix site?
content: No. From Feb 1, 2021, the Kazakh government enacted a new data localization regulation stating that all .kz domains must be hosted within Kazakhstan. Wix does not have any hosting facilities in Kazakhstan, so Wix users cannot connect their .kz domain to their Wix site. If you are an existing Wix user with a .kz domain, you will have to connect a domain with a different domain extension to keep using your Wix site. For new Wix users in Kazakhstan, Wix recommends purchasing or connecting a domain extension other than .kz for your Wix site to be accessible. Tip: Upgrade your site and receive a free domain voucher valid for the following extensions: .art, .com, .net, .org, .info, .biz, .rocks, .pictures, .club, .space, .shop, .store, .online, .co.uk, and .xyz.

title: How can I customize the member approval email for my site members?
content: To customize the member approval email, first make sure Signup & Login Security settings are set to Only people I manually approve; no approval email is sent if this setting is turned off. Go to Automations in your site's dashboard and click the Installed for you tab. Find the automation titled Let site members know they’re approved. Click the More Actions icon next to the automation and select Edit. Scroll down to Action 1 (Send an email) and click Edit in the Create an email section. Edit the email contents: for Subject line, click Edit next to the subject line and optionally click + Personalize to add a dynamic value; edit Text elements and use the left panel for formatting or design; edit Button content or design; use Add in the left panel to add elements; use Themes to personalize the email theme; use Background to update the background. Optionally click Preview & test to generate a preview and send yourself a test email. Click Save & Continue, then click Save to save the automation. Using a domain-based email for the sender details is recommended because free email services have limitations.

title: How can I change a member's login email on my site?
content:
Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant member and click the More Actions icon. Select Change login email. Enter the New login email for your member. Click Change to confirm.

Tip: You can also change a member's login email from Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant member to open their contact card on the right. The option to change their email is located in the Member info section.

Note: The new login email must be unique and not associated with any other site member.

title: How can I place a one-time 20% discounted test order in my Wix Photo Albums Store?
content: Make sure you have added and set up your Wix Photo Albums Store. Sign in and go to your published site. Make a purchase on your Wix Photo Albums Store the same way a regular customer would. Note: The discount only appears at checkout, not in your cart. Before entering your details in Order a Print, you'll see the offer. Click Use Discount.

title: How can I connect Nimbbl as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Nimbbl. If you have an account, enter your Access Key and Secret Key, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Nimbbl account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from Nimbbl with your credentials including your Access Key and Secret Key, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: Can I create datasets and connect app elements to collections with data binding in Wix Blocks?
content: We are pleased to announce that you can now create datasets and connect app elements to collections with data binding. Learn how to connect elements to collection fields.

title: How can I export my orders from Wix and customize the data included in the export?
content: Go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard. Select the orders you want to export by checking the boxes next to the relevant order(s), or choose the checkbox next to Order at the top left to select all orders. Click Export. Select how you want to display exported orders: Item purchased shows each item purchased in a separate row, even if items are part of the same order; Orders shows each order in one row, even if multiple items were purchased. Deselect the columns that you do not want to include, such as billing and payment columns if they are not relevant at the moment. Save the file to your computer: in Chrome, the CSV file downloads and appears on the bottom of your screen; in Firefox, select Open with to open or Save File to save; in Internet Explorer, click Save at the bottom of your screen; in Safari, the file opens, and you click cmd + s on your keyboard to save the file with a .csv extension and Page Source format. The time of purchase recorded in the CSV file is always given in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

title: What are the keyboard shortcuts for auto-translating a field and saving translations in the Wix Multilingual: Translation Manager on a Windows computer?
content: On Windows, use Ctrl + M to auto-translate a field and Ctrl + S to save translations.

title: How can I add Wix Events to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add Wix Events to your site using the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Wix Events & Tickets app in the search bar, and click Add to Site.

Tip: You can also add the Events widget and showcase events anywhere on your site, making it easier to promote your events and get them noticed.

title: How can I extract my Wix logo files from a .zip folder on a Windows computer?
content: Once you download your logo, the files are delivered in a .zip folder. On Windows, right-click the compressed (zipped) folder and select **Extract All** from the context menu. By default, the compressed files will extract in the same location as the zipped folder, but you can click the **Browse** button to select an alternative location. Check the **Show extracted files when complete** option, then click **Extract**. Alternatively, inside the zipped folder, you can select the items you want, and on the **Extract** tab, select the location to extract the files. If the location isn't listed, click the **More** button, and then click the **Choose location** button to find the correct folder.

title: Is Mercanet supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Mercanet as a payment provider. You can accept payments to your BNP Paribas account by connecting PayZen as a payment provider.

title: How can I create a test site and set the audience exposure for it?
content: After you have published your site at least once, make additional changes and create a test site from inside your editor. Then move over to the Release Manager, where you can choose what percentage of your audience you want to expose it to; you can choose the percentage of traffic (0-100). You can change the exposure at any time throughout the test from the Release Manager. Once you have finished testing your test site, you can publish or discard it. Publishing the test site sets its exposure to 100%, and it replaces the current published version of your site.

title: Can I add a DKIM record for my Google Workspace business email, and what does it verify?
content: If you have a Google Workspace business email, you can add a DKIM record for your domain. A DKIM record verifies that your email was sent from a reliable, trustworthy source, and was not modified in transit.

title: How can I view the details of each payment transaction on the Wix Mobile app?
content: Open the Wix Mobile app. Tap Dashboard on the relevant site. Scroll down to Payments. Tap View Payments. Once in the payments list, tap a transaction to see more details: Payment Details, Payment Method Details, and Customer Info. Payment Details includes the payment ID and an explanation of the payment status. Payment Method Details includes the payment provider and credit card details. Customer Info includes the name, email address and phone number your customer provided during the checkout process. Tip: If you don't see the Payments option, try updating to the latest version of the Wix app.

title: How can I update the Simplified View settings for my Wix site when accessed through a Chrome browser on Android?
content: Wix Sites are not compatible with the "Simplified View" feature. Enabling it does not affect your Wix site.

title: How can I update my Facebook ad campaign's products if they aren't syncing with the live ad?
content: Open Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard, click Edit Campaign, go to the products section, and remove a small selection of your store products. Click Save. Check that the campaign is not in review; if it is in review, the products and caption will not update until the campaign is approved. Open Facebook's Debugger tool, log in using your Facebook credentials, paste your site URL, click Debug, and click Scrape Again. Check your Facebook Ads dashboard afterward. Then return to Facebook Ads, click Edit Campaign, add back the products you removed for testing, go back to Facebook's Debugger tool, scrape the site again, and check your Facebook Ads dashboard to see whether the campaign is updated with all the products.

title: How can I upload my own fonts to the Studio Editor?
content:
To upload a font to the Editor:
- Select the relevant text element in the Editor.
- Click Edit Text.
- Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor.
- Scroll down to Design and click the Font drop-down.
- Click Upload Fonts at the bottom.
- In the pop-up, click Upload Fonts and select your font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF2 or WOFF).
- Click Close once the font has uploaded.

Your font is now available to use across your site. You can find it in the Font drop-down, under My Fonts.

title: Can I use rulers and guides in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the option to show rulers and add guides (personal position markers) is not available in the Studio Editor. Tip: Use the Design Guides add-on to structure your client's site in a more organized manner, splitting it into rows, columns or cells.

title: How can I look up domain registration details using the Wix Whois Lookup tool?
content: Go to the Wix Whois Lookup tool. Enter the domain name you want to look up and click Search. View the domain and registration details that appear below the searched domain.

title: Can I preview my branded app from my desktop computer?
content: Currently, you can't preview how your app will look and function directly from your desktop computer. However, you can preview it on your actual device.

title: What are spam traps and how can I avoid them in my email marketing campaigns?
content: A spam trap refers to email addresses that cannot receive emails. There are several types of spam traps, including misspelled email addresses, inactive email addresses, and non-existent email addresses. Internet Service Providers (ISPs) such as Gmail or Yahoo Mail, as well as anti-spam organizations, use the non-existent addresses to identify marketers who aren't following the email distribution regulations. If your recipient list includes non-existent or inactive addresses, it may be flagged as proof that your campaign is being sent to people who didn't give permission for you to contact them. It can also signify a purchased email list. Continuously sending campaigns to purchased email lists can lead to your Wix Email Marketing account being restricted. The best way to avoid a spam trap is to make sure all your recipients have given you explicit permissions (i.e. through a subscriber signup form) to contact them. It's also important to go through your email list and 'clean it' by removing old email addresses.

title: Can I add music to my Wix blog posts using Wix Music?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add music to blog posts using Wix Music. However, it is possible to add music by embedding a music track (such as a SoundCloud track) using HTML code.

title: How can I connect Param as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Param as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Param.
- If you have a Param account, enter your Terminal No, Kullanıcı Adı, Şifre, and GUID, then click Connect.
- If you do not have an account, click Create Param account, register for a Param merchant account, and once approved you will be provided with your unique Terminal No, Kullanıcı Adı, Şifre, and GUID credentials. Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under "Have an account" to connect your account.

title: How can I restrict access to dynamic content on my website to specific member roles?
content:
First, make sure to add a Members Area to your site. Then follow these steps:

1. Create members-only pages: Create or make an existing static or dynamic page a members-only page. This restricts access to pages for logged-in members.

2. Create member roles: Member roles help you manage which site members can access which pages. For example, on a teaching website, you might create some pages accessible to any signed-up member (i.e., students and teachers) and some pages restricted to specific members only (i.e., teachers).

3. Limit pages to specific member roles: Use member roles to limit specific restricted pages of your site to a group of members (a role).

Note: Dynamic pages can only be restricted to member roles via your editor, not via the site's dashboard.

4. Change your collection permissions: It is recommended to review your collection permissions and modify your permissions to member roles only. When you create a new collection, you define its permissions. Permissions control who can view, create, update, and delete content in a collection. You can change these permissions from the CMS (Content Management System).

title: Does Wix provide SSL certificates for free, and how can I tell if my site has one?
content: Yes. All Wix sites include an SSL certificate at no extra cost. You can tell if your site has an SSL certificate when the URL begins with https rather than http; there is often a lock icon beside the URL in your browser's address bar.

title: Can I automatically sync my CMS collection changes with Google Sheets?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to automatically sync CMS collection changes to Google Sheets. However, you can use the following workarounds:

* You can export your CMS collection data as a CSV file, then import the CSV file to Google Sheets. This allows you to work with your collection content in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
* You can export your Google Sheets spreadsheet as a CSV file, then import the CSV file to your CMS collection. This allows you to replace your CMS collection content with data imported from Google Sheets.

title: How can I add SEO title tags and meta descriptions to my pages using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Enter your title tag under Title tag (title in search results). Enter your meta description under Meta description (description in search results). Click Publish at the top right of the editor. Search engines will update your page's title tag and meta description the next time that they crawl your site. You can also add title tags and meta descriptions to Wix Stores product pages and category pages, Wix Blog posts and categories, Wix Bookings services, Online Programs service pages, and Wix Events pages, and you can add them to multiple pages at the same time using your site's SEO Settings.

title: How can I hide tabs from my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click the tab element in your mobile editor, then click the Hide Element icon. After you hide a tab element, you can access and show it again from the Hidden on Mobile panel.

title: Can I connect CSS styling of elements in the Studio Editor to CMS collections?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect the CSS styling of elements in the Studio Editor to CMS (Content Management System) collections. This feature would allow you to make dynamic adjustments to the design options available for your site's elements.

title: How can I change the language of my business email in Google Workspace?
content: You can change the language of your business email from inside your Google Workspace (Gmail) account. Open your Google Workspace email in Gmail, click the Settings icon at the top right, then click Settings. Click the drop-down menu next to Language and select the language. Scroll down to the bottom of the page and click Save Changes.

title: Can I edit the URL of a media file in Wix Media Manager?
content: No. Currently, it is not possible to edit the URL of an image, video, etc. that you upload to the Media Manager. When you copy the URL of a media file in the Media Manager, the name of your file does not appear in the URL. Instead, the Wix server where your images are hosted automatically assigns an ID to your file.

title: How can I invite someone to collaborate on my Wix site using the Wix app?
content:
To invite collaborators to your Wix site using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Scroll down to Settings and tap Roles & Permissions.
- Tap Collaborators.
- Tap + Invite Others under Collaborators.
- Enter the email address of the person you're inviting.
- Choose the role you want to assign them under Choose Roles.
- Tap Send.

When you invite someone to work on your site, they receive an invitation email. If they already have an account, they can log in to accept the invitation. If they don't, they can create a free Wix account to get started.

title: Can I use Photoshop directly within the Wix Editor to edit images?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use Photoshop within the Wix Editor. You can upload images that you have edited in Photoshop. Wix also offers an Image Editing tool in the Wix Editor. To edit an image: click the image to select it, click the Crop & Edit icon, edit your image by selecting the available editing tools, click Apply, and click Save.

title: How can I update the details of my Wix loyalty program, such as the program name and points icon?
content:
To change your loyalty program details, go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Program, then click Edit Details next to Program details. Update your program name, points name, and points icon that are shown on your site, then click Save.

Note: To make design updates to the Loyalty pages on your site (the Loyalty page and the My Rewards page), select the relevant element in your Editor and click Settings.

title: How can I make a credit card payment on behalf of a client using Wix Bookings?
content: To make a credit card payment on a client's behalf, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the relevant session, click Manage to view the participant list for the session, hover over the relevant client, click Collect Payment, click Charge with Credit Card, enter the client's credit card details, and click Charge. You can also make credit card payments on a client's behalf from the Booking List.

title: How can I create a product subscription in Wix Stores?
content: To create a product subscription in Wix Stores, go to Products in your site's dashboard. Create a new physical product or edit an existing one, then scroll down and click Create a Subscription. Enter a name and, optionally, a tagline. Select how often a new order is created and choose a time unit. Use the Expires after drop-down to choose a preset option or select Custom and enter the number of billing cycles before the subscription expires. Optionally, offer a discount by selecting the discount type and entering the discount amount, then click Apply. If needed, click +New Subscription to add another subscription option and drag the options to reorder them. Choose whether the product is offered By subscription only or By subscription and for one-time purchase, then click Save.

title: How can I import reviews into Wix Reviews using a CSV file?
content: Go to Reviews in your site's dashboard, click Import Reviews, then click Download Sample CSV. Open the CSV file; Mac users should open it with Numbers or Excel version 15 or higher, and save it in CSV (Comma delimited) format. Enter your review data into the template, delete the sample data rows, and save the file as CSV. Mandatory fields include customer_name, customer_email, rating, and product_id; customer_name has a max of 100 characters, customer_email has a max of 320 characters, and rating must be a whole number from 1 to 5. Do not add or delete columns or edit column names. Then go back to Reviews, click Import Reviews, click Upload CSV File, upload the saved file, and click Continue. You can import up to 500 reviews. If there are errors, click View Errors; you can import reviews without errors or correct the errors and click Upload New CSV. Images may take up to 1 hour to upload if you have many reviews.

title: How can I add and set up a SoundCloud player on my Wix site?
content:
Step 1 | Add the SoundCloud player: In Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Video & Music, click SoundCloud Player, and drag the player onto your page. In Studio Editor, go to your editor, click App Market on the left side of the editor, search for the SoundCloud app in the search bar, and click Add to Site. In Dashboard, go to the Wix App Market in your site's dashboard, search for the SoundCloud app in the search bar, and click Add to Site.

Step 2 | Add the SoundCloud URL or embed code: In your SoundCloud account, search for the music you want to add, click Share, click Share or Embed, and copy the URL or code. In your editor, click the SoundCloud player, click Settings, paste the URL or code, and click Confirm.

Step 3 | Set up your player: Click the SoundCloud player in your editor, click Settings, and click the relevant toggle to show or hide the play count and comments.

Step 4 | Design your player: Click the SoundCloud player in your editor, click Settings, click Design, then choose what you want to customize, such as layout or color for the play button.

title: How can I create and send a pay link using the Wix app?
content:
To create and send a pay link using the Wix app:
• Go to your site in the Wix app.
• Tap Add at the bottom.
• Tap Create a pay link.
• Tap One-time payment to create a link that accepts one payment, or tap Multi payment to create a link that accepts multiple payments.
• Set up your pay link:
  • Link Name: Enter a name for your pay link.
  • Price: Enter the amount of money your pay link will charge your customer.
  • (Optional) Description: Enter a description for your pay link. This should clearly summarize the reason for payment.
  • (Optional) Set an expiration date: Enable the Set an expiration date toggle. Set a date when the link will expire and cannot be used.
  • (Optional, multi-payment only) Limit the number of payments: Enable the Limit the number of payments toggle to set the number of times the link can be used before it expires.
  • (Optional) Customize link: Tap Customize link and set a button color, edit button text and upload an image. Tap Save.
• (Optional) Tap + Add Contact to select a contact to send your pay link to. Note: Tap + Add Contact and then + Add New Contact to create a new contact.
• Tap Preview and Share.
• Choose how to share your pay link:
  • Copy Link: Copy the link to your clipboard.
  • Show QR Code: Display a QR code that when scanned will bring contacts to your pay link. Note: Take a screenshot of this QR code to share it with contacts.
  • Share via: Share your link via one of your phone's native apps.

title: How can I add and manage tags in my CMS collection?
content: In your CMS collection, add the Tags field and manage the values associated with each item. Changes to a tag value automatically apply to every item using that tag, so you do not have to manually edit them everywhere in your collection. To add a new field to your collection, select Add new field, enter the field name, and select the Tags field type. You can add content to the field in your CMS collection later.

title: Can I store a backup of my Wix site outside of Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to back up your site externally. Wix has created the Site History feature, which automatically creates site revisions every time you save or publish, so you can go back to a previous version of your site any time you want. You can also duplicate your site at any time to create a manual backup in your Wix account. Be aware that the duplicated site is not automatically updated when you update your original site.

title: How can I add and set up the Wix Music Player on my site using ADI?
content:
Inside ADI:

Step 1 | Add the Wix Music app
- Click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI.
- Click **Apps**.
- Hover over **Music** and click **Add**.
- Select the page you want to add the app to and click **Add to Page**.

Step 2 | Add music to your app
- Click the music player in ADI.
- Click **Manage**.
- Click **+ Add Music**.
- Choose whether you want to create an album, a single or a playlist.

Step 3 | Design your app
- Click the music player in ADI.
- Customize the following options on the left:
  - **Featured Music:** Click the drop-down menu to choose the music you want to play, or add **New Music**.
  - **Control Bar:** Choose from 2 preset designs for your player's control bar.
  - **Album Cover:** Click the icon to show or hide the album cover.
  - **Track List:** Click the icon to show or hide the track list. Then, choose which track actions and info displays.
- (Optional) Click the app in ADI and click **Design**. Choose a new design preset for your player.

**Note:** Your music must be selected in the **Featured Music** drop-down in order to appear in the player.

title: How can I add or update an A record in my Wix account?
content:
An A (Host) DNS record is used to point your domain name and host names to a static IP address. You can add or update your A records from the Domains page of your Wix account.

Important: If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, you must add or update A records with your domain host (not Wix).

To add or update an A record:
- Go to the Domains page.
- Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records.
- To add an A record: click + Add Record in the A (Host) section; click Got it in the pop-up message; click the Host Name field and enter the host name (leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign); click the Value field and enter an IP address the record points to; click Save; click Save Changes in the pop-up message.
- To update an A record: hover over the A record and click Edit; click Got it in the pop-up message; click the Host Name field and enter a host name (leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign); click the Value field and enter an IP address the record points to; click Save; click Save Changes in the pop-up message.

title: How can I view Wix Pricing Plans events in Google Analytics?
content: Wix automatically sends Wix Pricing Plans events to Google Analytics. To see Pricing Plans events in Google Analytics, add your Google Analytics Tracking ID to your Wix site and enable Enhanced eCommerce in Google Analytics. The Pricing Plan events you see in your Google Analytics account include: Product Impression when a visitor views Pricing Plans you offer; Product Click when a visitor clicks on a button or link that selects a Pricing Plan; View Content when a visitor sees the selected plan details page; Select Payment when a visitor selects a preferred method of payment; Initiate Checkout when a visitor clicks on the "Buy Now" button; and Purchase when a visitor completes the purchase and is redirected to the "Thank you" page. To find event data in Google Analytics, sign in to your Google Analytics account, click Conversions on the left side, click Ecommerce, then select the report you want to view, or to see all events click Behavior and then Events. Note: It can take a few days until the reports start receiving data.

title: Can I add stickers to images in the Wix Photo Studio?
content: Yes. You can now add stickers to images in the Wix Photo Studio. You can choose from basic shapes, icons and vector art from the Decorative section of the Photo Studio, or upload your own image as a sticker.

title: Is it possible to change my site's main language in Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change your site's main language to a different language. Workarounds: Delete Wix Multilingual and re-add it. This allows you to start from the beginning and choose a new main language. We recommend duplicating your site before deleting Wix Multilingual. This will help you later on when you re-add Wix Multilingual. You can refer to the duplicate for your previous translations and site design/layout. Note: When you delete Wix Multilingual and re-add it, your purchased word credits will not be restored, and you may need to purchase more word credits to automatically translate your site. You can enable the Auto-switch language toggle, and automatically redirect visitors to the language version of your site that matches their browser's language.

title: How can I schedule a blog post to be published later on Wix?
content: Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard. Click **Create New Post**. Add in the relevant content. Click the **Expand** icon at the top right. Click **Schedule Post**. Choose when you want the post to go live. Click **Schedule**. Scheduled posts appear in the **Scheduled** tab until they are published. You can cancel a scheduled post or set it to be published at another time in the **Scheduled** tab.

title: How can I customize the member signup settings in the Member's Area using ADI?
content:
Add the Member's Area app first.

To customize member signup settings:
- Click the Page drop-down at the top of ADI.
- Click the Settings icon beside Member's Area.
- Select Member Signup Settings.
- Customize the following options:

Who can be a member?
Choose who can be a member of your site.
- Everyone: When a new member signs up to your site, they are approved automatically.
- People I approve: When a new member signs up to your site, you need to approve them first. Only those who you approve become site members.

Which option shows first?
Choose which option appears first in the signup window:
- New member signup: The signup option is displayed first.
- Existing member login: The login option is displayed first.

Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
Click the Show/Hide icon to display or hide the following elements on your site:
- Terms of Use Page: Select the page containing your Terms of Use.
- Privacy Page: Select the page containing your Privacy Policy.
- Code of Conduct Page: Select the page containing your Code of Conduct.

title: How can I provide personalized business email addresses for team members with Wix?
content: Wix states that you can provide a personalized business email address for each team or individual team member, such as hello@mywebsite.com for customer queries, or sales@mywebsite.com. You can check your business email page in your Wix account, and learn how to create additional custom email addresses.

title: How can I crop or extend an image using the Wix Photo Studio?
content:
To crop or extend an image using the Wix Photo Studio, follow these steps:

1. Access the Photo Studio.
2. Click **Crop & Extend** on the left.
3. Choose to crop or extend your image using the options available.

### Crop
1. Click **Crop**.
2. Choose how to crop your image:
   * **Crop ratio:** Crop your image to a predefined size and ratio (e.g. 1:1, 9:16, 3:4).
     **Tip:** Select **portrait** or **landscape** orientation to change the ratio options.
   * **Image size (px):** Set the size your image will be cropped to, using the **Width** and **Height** fields.
     **Note:** The maximum image size is 3000px x 3000px.
   * **Free hand:** Manually drag the corners of the image with your mouse.
3. (Optional) Click **Upscale** to automatically improve the resolution of your image.
   **Note:** The maximum image width/height for upscaling is 2,000px. Upscaling your image may increase the size it appears on your site.
4. (Optional) Change your image orientation: **Rotate left**, **Rotate right**, **Flip horizontally** or **Flip vertically**.
5. Click **Save**.

### AI Extend
1. Click **AI Extend**.
2. Choose how to extend your image:
   * **Extend ratio:** Extend your image to a predefined size and ratio (e.g. 1:1, 9:16, 3:4).
     **Tip:** Select **portrait** or **landscape** orientation to change the ratio options.
   * **Image size (px):** Adjust the size of your image using the **Width** and **Height** fields.
   * **Free hand:** Manually drag the corners of the image with your mouse.
3. Click **AI Extend**.
4. (Optional) Click **Upscale** to automatically improve the resolution of your image.
   **Note:** The maximum image width/height for upscaling is 2,000px. Upscaling your image may increase the size it appears on your site.
5. (Optional) Change your image orientation: **Rotate left**, **Rotate right**, **Flip horizontally** or **Flip vertically**.
6. Click **Save**.

**Notes:**
* Your image can be extended up to 512px on each side, but the generated image should not be bigger than the maximum image size (3000px x 3000px).
* The minimum image size that can be extended is 64px x 64px.
* The image aspect ratio (i.e. ratio of the image's width to its height) should be within 2.5:1 and 1:2.5 to be able to extend the image.

title: Can I save and edit my merchandise designs later in the Wix Print Shop?
content: Currently, it is not possible to save merchandise designs (business cards, stickers, mugs etc.) you've worked on in the Print Shop, and edit them later. You can save your merchandise design by adding it to your cart in the Print Shop. When you come back to your cart later, you can click Edit Item next to the relevant design and continue customizing it.

title: How can I set a menu as an advanced menu in the Wix Editor?
content: To set a menu as an advanced menu in the Wix Editor: Click the menu in your editor. Click the Settings icon. Click Set as Advanced. Click Set as Advanced in the pop-up. Repeat steps 1-4 for any menus you want to set as advanced.

title: Can I flip the cells in a section grid horizontally or vertically in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes, it is now possible to flip the cells horizontally or vertically in a section grid.

title: How can I set whether tax is included in the product price for my Wix Store?
content: Go to tax in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Tax Settings section. Select an option: Add tax at checkout, where an item that costs $100 shows a total of $110 during checkout; or Include tax in item price, where the tax amount is subtracted from the total price and an item that costs $100 shows a total of $100 during checkout, with the sales tax listed separately.

title: How do I delete the original Wix Restaurant Orders app from my site?
content: To delete the Wix Restaurant Orders app, go to your editor. Click Pages on the left side of the editor. Click Site Menu. Hover over the Online Orders page and click the More Actions icon. Click Delete. Click Delete App to confirm. After deleting, publish your site so changes go live.

title: How can I change the title on my welcome section using ADI?
content: Click the welcome section of your site inside ADI. Click Edit. Enter the title of your welcome section in the Title field.

title: Can I offer gift cards for my restaurant using Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it's now possible to offer gift cards for your restaurant. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.

title: How can I make sure the promo code link is visible on my Wix Store's Cart Page?
content:
Check the visibility of the promo code link. If you disabled the "Enter a promo code" link, or selected a color that is the same or very similar to your site's background color, the button is hidden or hard to see. Make sure the promo code link is enabled and the font color you chose is a suitable one.

For Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Select an option based on your site setup:
  - My site has only Wix Stores: click Store Pages, then click Cart Page.
  - My site has only Wix Bookings: click Bookings Pages, then click Cart Page.
  - My site has Wix Restaurants Orders (New) / 2 business solutions: click Cart & Thank You, then click Cart Page.
- Click the Cart Page element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Select the Promo code link checkbox.
- Select a color that makes the link visible: click the Design tab, click the Links color box, and select a color that contrasts with the Cart Page background.

For Studio Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Pages on the left side of the editor.
- Select an option based on your site setup:
  - My site has only Wix Stores: click Store Pages, then click Cart Page.
  - My site has only Wix Bookings: click Bookings Pages, then click Cart.
  - My site has Wix Restaurants Orders (New) / 2 business solutions: click Cart & Thank You, then click Cart Page.
- Click the Cart Page element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Select the Promo code link checkbox.
- Select a color that makes the link visible: click the Design tab, click the Links color box, and select a color that contrasts with the Cart Page background.

title: Is 2-step verification supported for site members?
content: Currently, it is not possible to enable 2-step verification for your site members. As a workaround, you can use Velo by Wix's integration with Twilio to provide 2-step verification for your site members.

title: Can I create fixed appointment hours in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create fixed time slots each day exclusively for appointment bookings. Appointment availability is determined by staff members' schedules, and may vary each day depending on existing bookings, synced events on staff members' personal calendars, and other factors. You can create a class service with a single participant and set fixed times. For example, a psychologist with patients scheduled at regular intervals could create a recurring class schedule with set hours such as 09:00, 10:15, 11:30, etc.

title: How can I add an Unsplash image to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor: go to the editor, click Media on the left side of the editor, click Show More under Site Files, click Unsplash on the left side of the Media Manager, click the image you want to add, then click Add to Page. Tip: Use the search and filters at the top to find what you are looking for.

title: How can I duplicate my site on the Wix dashboard?
content: On the Wix dashboard, click the More Actions icon at the top right to open site actions. Click Duplicate site. Add a new site name. Click Duplicate. Note: Not all your business content is copied over when you duplicate a site.

title: How can I manually give loyalty points to a customer in the Wix Loyalty Program?
content: Go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard. Click + Give Points at the top right. Type a customer's name into the search bar to locate them. Select the customer you want to manually give points to. Tip: You can also click + Add New Customer to create a new contact. Click Next. Select Give points under What change would you like to make?. Enter the number of points you want to give the customer. Click Save. Tip: You can also click the More Actions icon next to a customer's name on the Loyalty Program dashboard and select Adjust points balance.

title: How can I update my homepage's title tag using the Wix Editor?
content:
Update your homepage's title tag from your SEO Setup Checklist. Go to the SEO Setup Checklist in your site's SEO dashboard. Hover over the error message and click Go for it. Select a suggested title tag from the list, or select Other to enter your own title tag.

Tips: Use at least one of your keywords and your business name. Enter between 55-70 characters. If you create your own title tag, check the tips for writing your own title tag.

Click Copy. Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to your homepage. Click SEO basics. Paste the page title under Title tag (title in search results). Click Publish. Go back to your SEO Setup Checklist. Click Refresh.

title: How can I arrange elements in the Wix Editor using right-click options?
content: Right-click an element, click Arrange, then select Bring to Front, Send to Back, Move Forward, or Move Backward. If an element is tucked behind another, use the Layers Panel to select it, then right-click it and choose the Arrange option.

title: Why does my text shift and get cropped when I try to edit a textbox with a bulleted or numbered list?
content: If you try to edit a textbox that has bulleted or numbered list formatting, it causes the text to shift down and go outside the bounding box. This makes part of the text cropped and not visible while editing. Workaround: Click Edit Text on the specific textbox you need to edit. Remove the bullet or numbered formatting. Make the necessary changes to your textbox. Enable bullets or numbered formatting again.

title: How can I set up a deposit fee for reservations in Wix Hotels?
content:
To add a deposit fee in Wix Hotels: go to your dashboard; click the Hotels tab; click the Payments tab; scroll down to the Price Settings section; click the Deposit drop-down menu and select a deposit option; click Save.

The deposit fee can be Total Charge, 1 night, 25% of the cost of the reservation, or 50% of the cost of the reservation. The remainder of the fee is paid in person when your guests arrive, not through the Wix Hotels system.

Important: This option is only available for online payment options (PayPal, Stripe). When the 1 night, 25%, or 50% options are selected, taxes as well as any extra charges (e.g. room service) need to be collected in person, outside of Wix Hotels.

Tip: Once your guest has paid the remainder of the fee, you can manually mark the reservation as Paid from your hotel reservation calendar.

title: How can I manually create an order in Wix Restaurants and add existing menu items to it?
content: This applies to the new Wix Restaurants Orders app. In your site's dashboard, go to Orders and click + Add New Order. To add an existing menu item: click + Add Item next to Items, select Menu item, select the item you want to add, and click Continue. If the item has modifiers, choose the relevant modifiers for the item. Optionally enter any Special Requests your customer asked for, then click Add to Order. Optionally repeat to add more items.

title: How can I add and set up a table in the Studio Editor to display a dataset?
content: First add and set up the content collection you want to display in the table. Then click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Layout Tools, click Tables, and drag the design you like onto your page. To connect the table to a content collection, click the Connect to CMS icon, then in the Inspector choose the dataset you want to display in the table. Click Manage Table and set up the table columns: reorder by clicking the Reorder icon next to the relevant column and dragging it up or down into place; change column name by hovering over the relevant column, clicking the More Actions icon, selecting Edit label, entering the new name, and clicking Done; delete a column by hovering over the relevant column, clicking the More Actions icon, and selecting Delete; manage connections by clicking Manage Connections to change CMS connections, then clicking the relevant drop-downs under Connections in the Inspector panel to edit the connections and links.

title: How can I fix the error "Looks like you've changed your password" in the Instagram Feed app by Wix?
content: If you see this error in your editor, it means that your Instagram Feed app has disconnected from your Instagram account. To fix this issue, disconnect your Instagram Feed app and then reconnect it: Click the Instagram Feed app in your editor. Click Settings. Click Disconnect at the bottom of the Settings panel. Click Connect Business Account if you have an Instagram Business account, or Connect Personal Account if you have an Instagram personal account. Follow the instructions in the pop-up to complete the connection process.

title: How can I add a new interaction to an element in Editor X?
content: Select the relevant element. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X. In the Inspector, click the Interactions tab. Click + Add under Hover / Click. Create your preset or custom interaction.

title: How can I customize the elements and design of my existing Wix Appointment Form?
content: This form is no longer available to add to your site. If you already have an Appointment Form, you can customize it as needed. To customize your Appointment Form, go to the page with the Appointment Form in your Editor and click the Appointment Form widget. To customize widget elements, click the Elements icon, then select the checkbox next to each of the elements you want to display on the form. The elements vary depending on the settings you choose when creating the appointment. To customize the design, click the Design icon and adjust the design of the text, background color, borders, and corners using the available formatting options. You can customize the following widget elements: Input fields, Book Button, and Background.

title: Can I accept the calendar sync invitation from the Wix app?
content: Currently, when you invite staff members to sync their Bookings and personal calendars, your staff members can only accept the invitation on desktop. It is not possible to accept the invitation from the Wix app.

title: Can I change which host server my data is stored on with Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to select or change which host server your data is stored on. Select service custom hosting solutions may be available with Velo by Wix. Velo solutions are included with the enterprise solution.

title: How can I delete an event ticket in Wix Events?
content:
To delete a ticket, go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant event. Click the Tickets tab. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant ticket. Click Delete. Click Yes, Delete to confirm.

Note: Deleting a ticket does not affect tickets you've already sold. Instead of deleting it, you can also hide a ticket type.

title: How can I change the currency for my music tracks in Wix Music?
content: To change your currency in Wix Music, go to Music Library in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant single/album/playlist and click the More Actions icon. Click Edit. Click the drop-down under Select a currency for this playlist. Select a currency. Click Save. For playlists, the currency refers to the tracks inside it because you cannot sell the playlist as a whole. You can set different currencies for each album, single, or playlist, but you cannot set different currencies within each of them.

title: Are there additional shipping label options available in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, Wix offers a variety of shipping label solutions. Other solutions are not supported.

title: How can I access my Site Files folder in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to the editor, click Media on the left side of the editor, then click Show More under Site Files. Your Site Files folder is where the images, audio, videos, and documents, etc. that you upload while working on your site are housed.

title: Is it possible to automatically create a group chat for all members who join a group in Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically create a group chat for all members who join a group. However, with a members area and members chat, any group member can manually create a group chat. In the chat, only members who join the group would be able to chat with each other.

title: How can I upload 360 images to the Wix 360 Images app and enable auto-rotation?
content:
Important: The 360 Images app is no longer available in the Wix App Market. It will be removed from your site on December 11th 2024 and Wix will no longer support it. As an alternative, you can add the Virtual Tours app by ViarLive OÜ.

For the 360 Images app, to upload images and enable auto-rotation:
1. Go to your editor and click the app.
2. Click Settings.
3. Click the Images tab.
4. Do one of the following:
   * Upload a 360° image.
   * Select one of the app's images.
5. Click the Settings tab.
6. Choose a rotation starting point (from 0 to 360 degrees).
7. Click the Auto rotate image toggle:
   * Enabled: Image rotates automatically. Site visitors can click to pause the rotation.
   * Disabled: Image can be rotated manually by site visitors.
8. Click the Show navigation controls toggle:
   * Enabled: Directional controls and zoom controls appear on the image.
   * Disabled: No controls appear on the image.

title: How do I confirm my email address with Wix?
content:
To confirm your email address with Wix:

- Go to Account Settings in your Wix account.
- Click **Confirm Your Email** under **Login Info**.
- Go to your email inbox and open the confirmation email. This email is sent from: **wix-team@notifications.wix.com**.
- Click **Confirm Email**. Make sure you confirm your email within 24 hours after receiving the email verification email, or you will receive a Wix account notification.

**Note:** If you don't see the email in your inbox, check your junk or spam.

**Tip:** Want to change your account email address? Learn how in Wix support.

title: How can I add an ads.txt file to my site using the Wix platform?
content: Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Click Connect under Ads.txt. Click Add ads.txt. Paste your list of sellers and publisher IDs. Click Save. You can view the ads.txt file by visiting your site and adding "/ads.txt" to the end of the URL.

title: How can I set up Wix Bookings to accept payments in person?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Services. Select an option: edit an existing service or click + Add a New Service. Scroll down to the Price & Payment section. Click the Payment Preferences drop-down and select the option that meets your needs: Entire amount in person; Entire amount either online or in person; Online deposit and the rest in person. If you choose online deposit, enter the amount in the Deposit field. In-person payments aren't tracked automatically in your Wix dashboard, but you can manually mark sessions as paid.

title: How can I add Wix Chat to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add Wix Chat to your site using the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Wix Chat app in the search bar, and click Add to Site. Next, you can design your site's chatbox and customize your chat settings.

title: How can I set up an automation in Wix Chat to automatically send a chat message when a visitor submits a form?
content:
To set up a Wix Chat automation that sends a chat message when a visitor submits a form:
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation, then + Start from Scratch. You can also search and select a suggested automation under Popular and edit its trigger and actions.
- Click the title to give your automation a name.
- In the Trigger section, click the app you'd like to base your trigger on, then select your chosen trigger from the available options. These options differ depending on the app you selected.
- Use the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency.
- In the Action section, click Send a chat message. This action is only an option for certain triggers.
- Enter the chat message in the Message field.
- Use the Send this message only when I'm online to chat toggle to specify whether the message is sent only when your chat status is online, or whether it is sent online or offline.
- Optionally add a delay, add a condition using Continue the automation if and + Add Criteria, and add another action with + Add an Action.
- Click Activate to save the automation.

title: How can I sync my Apple Calendar with Wix Bookings?
content: Before you begin, make sure you upgrade to a Premium plan to sync your personal calendar with Wix Bookings. Then go to the Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the Manage Calendar drop-down and click Sync Personal Calendar. Select the relevant account you want to sync, then click Sync beside Import your Apple Calendar Events. Follow the on-screen instructions and sign in to the Apple website. In the Sign-In and Security section, click App-Specific Passwords, then click Generate Password. Enter your Apple ID and the app-specific password you created, then click Connect. Select the checkboxes beside each Apple Calendar you wish to sync with Wix Bookings. Optionally, enable the Export Booking Calendar events toggle to display your bookings sessions on your Apple Calendar, then click Sync. After syncing, your personal appointments from your Apple Calendar block off time in your Bookings calendar, and your Bookings sessions are visible in your Apple calendar.

title: How can I restrict specific categories in my Wix Forum to paying subscribers?
content:
To restrict specific categories in your Wix Forum to paying subscribers, follow these steps:

- Go to your forum in your dashboard.
- Click the **Categories** tab.
- Do one of the following:
  - Create a new category
  - Select an existing category
- Scroll down to **Access** and click **Selected Members**.
- Click **Add** next to **Subscriptions**.
- Click **Create New Plan**.
- Enter the **Plan Info**:
  - List the benefits included in the plan.
  - Click **+Add More** to add more benefit options.
- Choose which categories are included in the plan:
  - Click **Add Category**.
  - Select the category from the drop-down.
- Scroll down and choose the **Pricing and Duration** of the plan:
  - Select a pricing and duration of the plan.
  - Enter the payment details.
- Click the **Enable free trial** toggle to enable or disable a free trial:
  - **Enabled:** Customers can try out the plan before paying. Click the drop-down to select the length of the free trial.
  - **Disabled:** Customers must pay before they can access your forum category.
- Click the **Single purchase only** toggle to enable or disable it:
  - **Enabled:** Customers can only purchase one plan.
  - **Disabled:** Customers can purchase multiple plans.
- Click the **Allow plan cancellation** toggle to enable or disable it:
  - **Enabled:** Customers can cancel their plan at any time.
  - **Disabled:** Customers cannot cancel their plan.
- Click the **Custom start date** toggle to enable or disable it:
  - **Enabled:** Customers can select a specific date for their plan to start on.
  - **Disabled:** Customers start their plan from the date of purchase.
- (Optional) Add **Plan Policies**.
- Click **Create**.

This setup allows you to monetize your forum by restricting access to certain categories to only those who have subscribed to a plan.

title: Can I set different availability settings for each appointment service in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set separate availability settings for individual appointment services. For example, if a staff member works five days a week, all their associated appointments are available to book for those five days. Creating different availability settings for different appointment types would offer more flexibility to your overall business operations. For example, you could offer one appointment type only on weekends, and another type only in the afternoons on weekdays.

title: Can I add Wix Chat as an app dependency in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, it's not possible to add Wix Chat as an installation dependency on Wix Blocks. This would allow you to integrate direct communication lines between you and your site visitors within your app.

title: How can I customize the sliding behavior of my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: To customize how your Pro Gallery slides, click the Pro Gallery in your editor, click Settings, click the Layout tab, and click Customize Layout. You can then adjust: Loop images, to allow visitors to scroll through gallery items in a continuous loop; Slide automatically, to display items in a continuous slideshow; Intervals, where you drag the Time Between Images slider to change the seconds between items; Continuous, where you drag the Slideshow speed slider to adjust how fast the gallery slides; and Pause on hover, where you enable the toggle to pause the slideshow when a visitor hovers over a gallery item. The loop images setting is only available for the Slider, Slideshow, Thumbnails, and Column layouts.

title: Can I promote an entire product category in a single Facebook ad?
content: Currently, you cannot promote an entire product category in a single Facebook ad. You can choose specific products and take control of the ad's creative (caption, headline, etc.) with classic ads. Facebook Ads are dynamic and can use a different product from your categories each time your ad is displayed.

title: How can I add a video background to a page on my mobile site using Wix Editor?
content: In the mobile editor, click Background on the left side, click Video, select a video in the Media Manager, then click Change Background. Optionally, click Apply to Other Pages at the bottom to add this background to other pages of your mobile site.

title: Is it possible to receive notifications about rejected orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it's now possible to get notified about rejected orders your customers placed on your site (e.g. declined by the payment gateway, address is out of delivery range, etc.). This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I add media to my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix app?
content:
To add media to your Pro Gallery using the Wix app:

Go to the relevant site in the Wix app. Tap **Manage** at the bottom. Tap **Gallery**. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant gallery. Tap **Manage Media**. Tap **Add Media**. Tap **All Media** and choose where you'd like to upload your media from: **Site media**, **Device**, **Free by Wix**, etc. Select the relevant file(s) and tap **Next**. (Optional) Tap **Edit** and use the tools at the bottom to edit the file. Then tap **Save** and repeat for each file you want to edit. Tap **Next**.

title: Is it possible to connect a PEC business email to Wix?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to connect a PEC business email to Wix. This is because the MX records needed are those for a subdomain (for example, mx.yourdomain.pec.it). This is a format that Wix does not support.

At the moment, the only workaround to using the PEC business email associated with your domain is to proceed as follows:
1. Delete the domain currently connected to your site (if you have already connected it via Name Servers).
2. Add the same domain, this time using the pointing method.
3. Ask your host to set up their NS records and, therefore, your business email as well.

You can use this email template and send it to your service provider. Make sure the records are configured as below.

My name is XXX and I have purchased the following domain from you: mydomain.it

I have created a site on Wix.com and would like to connect my domain by pointing.
Please make sure my records are set up as follows:
An A record for mydomain.it: 185.230.63.107
CNAME record for www.yourdomain.it: pointing.wixdns.net

Also, please set up your NS records and configure the business email associated with this domain accordingly.

Once your provider has configured their Name Servers for your domain, you can add your PEC records in their control panel.

title: How can I resolve issues with galleries on my Wix site?
content:
Follow these troubleshooting steps:

Step 1 | Test other devices: The issue may be local and occur only on a certain device. Open your live site on a different device and compare to see if the issue occurs there too.

Step 2 | Check your gallery images: Gallery issues can be caused by uploaded images. Ensure images meet these guidelines:
- Supported image types: JPG, PNG, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, WEBP, JPEG 2000 and RAW.
- Images can be a maximum size of 25MB.
To check gallery images: Open the Media Manager in your Editor, click Site Files, click the relevant image, and check the details under File Info.
Note: Only certain formats of JPEG 2000 and RAW files are supported. Animated WEBP files are not supported and are automatically reverted to static images.

Step 3 | Check the gallery type: Your gallery may be one of the retired galleries. If you are experiencing an issue with a retired gallery, replace it with a gallery available to add from the add panel. Retired galleries include Impress Gallery, Collage Gallery, Accordion Gallery, Strip Showcase Gallery, Strip Slideshow Gallery, Thumbnails Gallery, Animated Grid Gallery, Slider Gallery, Slideshow Gallery, Grid Gallery and Slide Deck. Some galleries in the Add Elements panel with these names are Pro Galleries, which have different and/or additional capabilities to classic galleries. It is currently not possible to migrate an Editor gallery to a Pro Gallery.

Step 4 | Try our troubleshooting assistant: If you are still experiencing the issue after completing the steps above, use the Wix Technical Assistant. This is an interactive troubleshooter that guides you through steps such as enabling incognito mode and opening your site on a different browser.

If the steps do not resolve the issue, contact the support team and include a description of the issue, a screenshot of the issue, and the steps you have already taken to resolve the issue.

title: How can I create a coupon for my Wix event tickets?
content: Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard, click + New Coupon, and select a discount type: $ Discount or % Discount. Enter the coupon code customers need to use, enter the coupon name (it appears on the cart page and dashboard), and enter the discount amount or percentage under Discount. Use the Apply to drop-down to choose Specific ticket, Specific event, or All tickets. Choose whether the coupon applies once per order to the lowest priced item or to each eligible item in the order. Set the start date and either the end date or select Don't set an end date. Optionally, select Limit the total number of uses for this coupon and enter the number of times it can be used; multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually. Click Create Coupon.
