Note: Coupons cannot be applied to Pay what you want or Free ticket types.

title: How can I view and manage my outgoing notifications on Wix?
content:
To view your outgoing notifications, go to Settings in your site's dashboard and click Outgoing notifications.

To manage outgoing notifications, go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click Outgoing notifications, hover over the relevant notification and click View Summary. Then choose what to do next:

- Edit a notification: Click More Actions, then Edit. Edit the automation as necessary and click Save.
- Duplicate a notification: Click More Actions, then Duplicate. Edit the relevant details and click Activate.
- Rename a notification: Click More Actions, then Rename. Edit the notification's name and click Save.
- View email automation stats: Click More Actions, then View email stats. Scroll down in the pop-up to see the statistics.
- Deactivate a notification: Disable the Active toggle. You can reactivate it by clicking the toggle again.
- Delete a notification: Click More Actions, then Delete. Confirm by clicking Delete in the pop-up.

Note: Notifications marked as "Installed for you" can be deactivated but not deleted.

title: How do I set up a flat rate shipping rule in Wix Stores?
content:
First create or select the shipping region the rule applies to. Then set up the Flat Rate rule for that region:
- Select **Flat Rate** from the **Select how shipping is calculated** drop-down.
- Enter a name in the **Shipping Option Name** field (e.g. Standard Shipping).
- (Optional) Enter a time in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
- Enter the shipping rate.
- (Optional) To offer free shipping on orders above a specific price, click the **Offer Free Shipping when customer buys over a certain amount** checkbox and enter the amount. If you create additional shipping services (e.g. priority shipping), this checkbox must be selected and the amount specified to apply to each rule.
- Click **Add another Delivery Option** to add additional options (e.g. Express Shipping).
- (Optional) Check the **Add a handling fee to every order** checkbox and enter the handling fee.
- Click **Save**.

title: How does Wix ensure compliance with data protection laws when transferring personal data to its sub-processors?
content: Wix states that personal data of Users-of-Users may be transferred to other Wix entities, covered by a Wix intra-company Data Processing Agreement that puts in place appropriate safeguards as required to ensure cross-border transfers are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection laws such as the EU’s GDPR. For third-party sub-processors, each enters into a written contract with Wix that enforces compliance with applicable data protection laws; cross-border transfers are conducted under applicable approved mechanisms, together with additional measures where required, to ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws, as detailed in the Data Processing Addendum for Users.

title: Can I adjust the radius of corners on strips and columns in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the radius of corners on strips or columns. As an alternative, you can display content with container boxes, and adjust the corner radius from the design panel.

title: Why am I not receiving my test email campaign from Wix Email Marketing?
content:
If you don't receive your test email campaign, check your email's spam or junk folder to verify that it wasn't filtered. Common reasons a test email campaign is not delivered include:

- Spam Filters: The email service provider receiving your email campaign decides whether or not to mark it as spam. Once an email newsletter is accepted by an email server, we are not able to gather additional information about what happens to the email from that point forward. Most email service providers, such as Google and Yahoo, have systems in place that automatically scan incoming mail.
- Delivery Time: Not following Wix Email Marketing best practices leads at a minimum to a delay in delivery of your newsletter. Sending to a large number of recipients increases the time it takes for all recipients to receive your newsletter email.
- Small Batch Delivery: Webmail providers that deliver in small batches include Yahoo, AOL, and Hotmail. If your sender's email account is hosted at one of these providers, it may take up to 24 hours for your email campaign to be delivered to all recipients.
- DMARC: Several free email service providers like Yahoo and AOL have updated their DMARC policies to reduce email abuse issues. If you send an email campaign with a Yahoo (including Ymail and RocketMail) or AOL sender's email address, the receiving email provider may reject the newsletter.

When sending a test email campaign, or sending to one contact only, the email campaign is sent from no-reply@usrmailtest.com even if you are using a Reply-to email address on your own domain.

If you're getting a specific error message when trying to send a test email, contact us with the following info:

- A screenshot of the error message
- The 'Reply-to Email' address used
- The recipient email address

title: How can I dispute a chargeback if I am using Wix Payments?
content: If you use Wix Payments to process your payments, you can dispute the chargeback directly from your Wix Payments dashboard. If you win the dispute, the funds for the payment are returned to your account. If your customer wins, they keep the funds that were already transferred to them. If Wix Payments is your payment provider, your chargeback fee is also returned to your account following a dispute win.

title: Can I use Caisse D'Epargne as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Caisse D'Epargne as a payment provider. You can accept payments to your Caisse D'Epargne account by connecting PayZen as a payment provider.

title: What are the benefits of using the Shared Gallery with the Members Area?
content: Using the Shared Gallery with the Members Area helps create a community around your shared gallery system. Members can track the amount of uploads, tags and likes that other members have made, share and report photos through the Members Area, and sort photos, view in expand mode and delete photos. Only members who are part of the community are able to see which photos a member uploaded. When a site visitor logs in, they are logged in to all parts of your site. Some parts of your site have their own special member sections; for example, with Wix Stores, customers can log in and access their "My Orders" page to view store orders.

title: Why is my Wix site's menu missing on the live site, and how can I fix it?
content: If you cannot view your menu on your live site, first make sure you've added a menu to your site. If your menu is attached to the header or footer, or set to "show on all pages," make sure you are not hiding the header and footer: click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor, click the relevant page that isn't displaying your menu, click the Show More icon, click Settings, click Layouts, and select Standard. Then click Publish at the top right of the Editor, refresh your live site, and check that your menu works as expected. Learn more about hiding your header and footer.

title: Can I transfer my Belgian (.be) domain to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer a Belgian (.be) domain extension to Wix. If you already have a domain purchased elsewhere, you can connect it to your Wix site. Note: To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site to a Premium plan.

title: Can I set separate availability for video conferencing appointments in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add separate availability for video conferencing appointments only. For example, businesses offering consultation services both physically and virtually on different days or hours cannot set separate availability settings for each. As a workaround, you can add virtual meetings as an additional location and set the staff hours accordingly. This option is not recommended for businesses with multiple physical locations, as it may complicate scheduling management and reporting.

title: Can I make my referral program available to my customers through the Branded App by Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to make your referral program available to your customers through the Branded App by Wix.

title: Can I choose the start day of the week for the Wix Bookings calendar?
content: Currently, you cannot choose the day of the week the Wix Bookings calendar starts on. The day which is used as the first calendar day is determined by the Regional format in your Language & Region settings.

title: How can I display a cookie consent banner on my site to comply with GDPR regulations?
content: Add a cookie banner to ask for permission before placing "non-essential" cookies, in accordance with regulations like the GDPR. The banner informs visitors about the cookies you're using and collects their consent. The content of your cookie banner is fully customizable; you can edit any text or explanation to your individual style and needs.

title: How can I turn off auto-renewal for a Wix Premium subscription?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Cancel Plan. Click Cancel Now in the pop-up to confirm. Note: This does not cancel your plan immediately. Instead, your plan does not renew at the end of the subscription period.

title: How can I add the Wix Colorblind Simulator to my site using the Wix Studio Editor?
content:
In the Wix Studio Editor:
- Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left.
- Click Tools.
- Click Editor Add-ons.
- Click Get Add-ons.
- Click Colorblind Simulator.

title: How can I find out when my Premium or Studio plan will renew?
content: To find out when your Premium or Studio plan will renew, you can see the exact date your renewal payment will be processed in the Next payment due section of Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Yearly and multi-year plans are charged the full amount 14 days prior to the plan's expiration date, and you will receive email notifications starting 30 days before your next payment date. Monthly plans are charged monthly on your plan's expiration date, and you will not receive an email notification before your subscription renews.

title: How can I customize the layout of my Program List using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click Program Pages. Click your Program List page. Click the Program List element on your page. Click Settings. Under the Layout tab, select between a Grid or Side by side alignment. Grid displays your programs in rows and columns. Side by side displays your programs in a vertical stack. Customize the layout according to your preferences.

title: How can I set up a 301 redirect for a specific blog post on my Wix site?
content:
Before you begin, you must have a Premium Plan and a connected domain to use 301 redirects.

To set up 301 redirects for your blog posts:
- Go to your SEO Dashboard.
- Select Go to URL Redirect Manager under Tools and settings.
- Click + Create New Redirect.
- Select Single Redirect.
- Enter the old post page URL you want to redirect from under Old URL.
- Start typing the new URL and select it from the drop-down.
- Click Save & Close to finish or click Save & Add Another to add more.

title: How can I choose what information to display on my Wix restaurant menu?
content: Select your restaurant menu in the Editor and click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Select or deselect the checkbox next to menu elements to display or hide them: Price displays the dish price; Dish Options displays dish options (e.g. sizes), if you created them; Section Images displays an image for each menu section (e.g. Appetizers); Dish Labels displays the label(s) for each dish, if you added them. Select which menus to display: Show all displays all the menus you created; Show specific menus lets you select which menus you want to display. To hide a menu, hover over it and click the Hide icon. To show a menu, hover over it and click the Unhide icon.

title: How can I change the location of the navigation menu in my branded Wix app?
content:
In your site's dashboard, go to the Branded Mobile App tab, click Edit Mobile App, click Screens on the left, then click Edit Navigation at the bottom left. Under Edit Navigation on the right, choose Top tab bar to keep the menu at the top, or Bottom tab bar to move it to the bottom and change it to an icon menu. For the bottom bar, you can enable or disable the Show screen names under the icons toggle, and hover over an icon and click Change icon to choose a different icon.

In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App, switch to editing your branded app if needed by tapping the mobile app name at the top and then Branded Mobile App, tap Edit, tap Design from the bottom menu, then tap Navigation. Under Type, choose Top tab bar or Bottom tab bar. For the bottom bar, you can enable or disable the Show screen names under the icons toggle, and tap one of the icons to change it.

title: How can I view Wix app collections in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your Editor. Click CMS on the left of the Editor. Click Your Collections. Click Manage. Click More Actions at the top. Select Advanced Settings. Enable the Wix App Collections toggle. Click the X at the top right to close the CMS window. Click Wix App Collections on the left to view all your collections created by other Wix products.

title: What are the eligibility requirements for receiving the Google Ads credit offer with Wix, and how is the credit applied to my account?
content: To be eligible for the ad credit offer, you must be new to Google advertising and have not previously run a Google Ads campaign with your site. You must spend $500 USD (or your currency equivalent) on ad clicks within the first 60 days of your campaign. If you are eligible, Google applies the credit directly to your available ad credits, and you receive a notification via email as well as in your site's dashboard. The ad credit is not refundable, and you must spend it within 60 days of receiving it in your account. After you have spent $500 USD within the first 60 days, Google automatically applies the amount to your available ad credits. You receive an email about the new credit, as well as a dashboard notification. Since the credit comes directly from Google, it may take a few days to see the credit applied to your account after you have fulfilled the requirements.

title: How can I add a custom action to the Quick Action Bar on my Wix mobile site?
content: To create a custom action on your Quick Action Bar in the Wix mobile Editor, select your QAB in the mobile Editor. Click Set Up Quick Actions. Click More Actions. Select Custom Action from the list. Choose a predesigned icon, or click the Add icon to upload your own. Select the action in the panel to set up the details.

title: How can I check if my Wix domain is active to resolve issues with my Google Workspace business email?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Check the Next Payment Due or Upcoming payment column next to the relevant domain to ensure your domain hasn't expired; you should see a renewal date in the future. If you need to renew your domain, click Update Payment Method.

title: Is it possible to delete or hide a subscription from the dashboard?
content: Currently, it is not possible to delete, archive or hide a subscription from your Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. You can however, filter the list to show only subscriptions with specific statuses.

title: How can I archive an email campaign in the Wix App?
content: In the Wix app, go to the email marketing dashboard. Tap the email campaign you want to archive from the Published or Drafts tabs. Tap Archive.

title: How can I delete a collection in the CMS, and what should I check before doing so?
content: To delete a collection in the CMS, go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon on the relevant collection, click Delete Collection, click Yes, delete collection to confirm, then click Delete. Before deleting a collection, Wix recommends checking whether there are dynamic pages connected to the collection; if so, convert them to regular pages or delete the pages unless you plan to connect a different collection. Visitors to your live site will encounter a 500 error when attempting to view dynamic pages associated with the deleted collection. Also check whether any datasets are connected to the collection and remove any connected dataset filters that are in use, including datasets set to filter by reference field or by dataset; if filter settings are unmatched, the dataset will be empty. Check whether the collection is referenced in another collection; if so, remove the reference by updating it to a different collection, modifying the field type, or deleting the reference field; otherwise there will be broken references in the items.

title: How can I display my DeviantArt content on my Wix site now that the DeviantArt app is retired?
content: The DeviantArt app has been retired from the Wix App Market. You can still upload your DeviantArt content to your site and use the DeviantArt iOS and Android apps. To connect your account: Go to your Media Manager. Click + Upload Media at the top left. Click the DeviantArt icon. Click Connect DeviantArt. Log in to DeviantArt. Select the files you want to add to your site and click Upload Selection. Your files upload to the Site Files tab in your Media Manager. Once your files have uploaded, select them and click the relevant button at the bottom right (e.g. Add to Page, Choose Image) to add them to your site.

title: I'm having trouble adding content to a repeater in the Wix Editor. I need assistance with this issue.
content: To add content to a repeater in the Wix Editor, drag and drop the element you want onto one repeater item. When you add an element to a repeater item, it is automatically added to every item to keep the design consistent. You can customize individual elements inside an item, such as text and images, but the design stays the same. For example, you can change the text on a button for each item, but moving the button to a different location inside the item moves it in all items to the same location. Note: Some elements cannot be attached to repeater items.

title: Can I restore a product after it has been deleted in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to restore a product after it has been deleted. If you want to temporarily remove products from your store, you can hide them.

title: How can I make an element or section sticky in the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant section or element. Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Scroll down to Position. Select Sticky from the Position type drop-down. Choose where the section/element sticks to: Top, Bottom, or Bottom and top. You can optionally enter an offset value to create space above or below. By default, the page's DOM order, including the section order, is automatically organized. If you want a sticky section to appear above others in the DOM, right-click the section, select Arrange and Bring to Front.

title: How can I sell physical gift cards using Wix Retail POS?
content: Order and receive the physical gift cards, and enable gift cards in your Wix dashboard. Then, on the POS tablet, tap Checkout, tap Gift Cards, tap Issue gift card, select the actual gift card (the plastic card), scan or manually enter the card's code (codes are not case sensitive), enter the value, tap Add to Cart, and complete checkout as you would for any product.

title: How can I create a new email campaign using Wix Email Marketing?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Then choose what you want to do: use a template and select the template you want to use, or start from scratch by clicking Start Email from Scratch, or click More Templates and then click Start from Scratch. Before sending any email campaigns, make sure you read the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use.

title: How can I customize the SEO settings for the Wix Pro Gallery Expand Mode?
content:
Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Click Pro Galleries. Customize your SEO Settings.

Note: The gallery's SEO settings apply to all Expand Mode pages. It isn't possible to set different settings for different Expand Mode pages.

To prevent your Expand Mode pages from appearing in search results, go to Basics & social share and disable the Let search engines index your gallery items toggle.

To have your Expand Mode pages indexed as separate pages from the gallery page, change the canonical variable to Expanded Item URL under Additional meta tags.

title: How can I connect Square as a payment provider for online transactions on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Square. If you have a Square account, click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Square account, follow the steps to create an account, then return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I save a proposal as a template in Wix Proposals by Prospero?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Proposals. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant existing proposal. Click Save as template.

title: Can I import and export translations in Wix Multilingual?
content: You can now import translations and export translations from Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I check the status of my POS hardware on the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, then tap Settings. Scroll down and tap Manage Hardware. Check the status listed under each device.

title: Is Velo by Wix supported in ADI?
content: Currently, Velo by Wix is not supported in ADI. If you would like to work with Velo with Wix, you need to head to the Editor, click Velo in the top bar of the Editor and click Turn on Developer Tools.

title: How can I access my form submission reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and type "Form" in the search bar.

title: How can I add a new staff member to my Wix Bookings site using the dashboard?
content:
To add a new staff member to your Wix Bookings site using the dashboard, follow these steps:

- Go to Staff in your site's dashboard.
- Click +Add Staff.
- Enter the staff member's basic details including their full name, a description of their role, their email address, phone number, and a profile picture. Make sure you have permission to use staff members’ personal details and image.
- Add the staff member's Staff settings:
  - Booking permissions: Click Give Permissions to allow the staff member to view their personal booking calendar, and to manage their own clients and sessions.
  - Personal calendar syncing (requires booking permissions): Click Invite to Sync Calendar to allow the staff member to sync their personal and work calendars. The staff member must have the relevant permissions.
  - Video conferencing account: Click Add Individual Account to override the default video conferencing account for your site and add the staff member's personal account. Choose between adding Zoom or a custom video conferencing account.
- Optionally, click Add Working Hours to customize the staff member's working hours.
- Click Save.

Note: If you added the Staff Widget to your site, visitors will see your staff members' working hours in the widget.

title: How can I use the Site Booster app by AppSharp to improve my site's visibility on search engines?
content: With the Site Booster app by AppSharp, you can drive more traffic to your site and get found on search engines. Site Booster lists and monitors your business online in the most important places across the web. Note: This app is added to your site's dashboard and does not appear on your site. Features and benefits include: rank higher in search results; get your site listed in directories & business listings like Google, Yahoo, Bing and more; add your business address, hours, and phone number; start today and list your site for free. Check out the Site Booster app by AppSharp to get started. For questions or comments, contact AppSharp directly.

title: How can I view and restore a previous version of my site in Editor X?
content: From the Site History panel, you can see all of your site's autosaved versions. To use a previous version, hover over it and click Restore.

title: How can I sync content between my Sandbox and Live collections in the CMS?
content: Sync allows you to move content between your optional sandbox and live collections. You can copy selected or all items in a collection from a sandbox collection to the live version of that collection. You can also overwrite a sandbox collection with all the content from the live version, or overwrite all your sandbox collections with the content from their live versions. You can only initiate sync operations from the sandbox collection. The Sandbox can be synced to the Live collection at anytime, but this will overwrite the current Live collection content.

title: How can I add a new booking policy using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Booking Services, or tap Catalog and select Booking Services. Tap Settings at the top. Tap Booking Policies. Tap + Add a New policy. Enter the Policy name. Select the checkboxes and choose the timeframe next to the relevant Client Booking Rules, such as Allow cancelation, Allow rescheduling, Limit early bookings, and Limit late bookings. You can optionally enter a Policy description. For classes only, you can allow clients to join a waitlist. For classes and courses only, choose the Maximum number of participants allowed per booking for group bookings. For courses only, select the checkbox to Allow clients book a course after it's already started. Tap Save Policy.

title: How do I create my first online program using ADI?
content: After adding Online Programs to your ADI site, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click Create New at the top right. Pick a program template with pre-filled content or click Start Fresh to create a program from scratch. Fill in your online program's basic information as well as its pacing, timing and duration. Click Continue. Add content to your program such as sections and steps. When you're finished adding content, click Publish to publish your program and make it possible for participants to join. Tip: You can also get to Online Programs in your dashboard by selecting the Online Programs element in the ADI Builder and clicking Manage.

title: What features are included in the Wix Business Elite plan?
content:
The Business Elite plan includes:

* 1 year free domain voucher (yearly plans only)
* Priority Customer Care
* 15 collaborators
* Unlimited storage
* Site analytics
* Customer accounts
* Site chat
* 75 lead-capture forms
  + Up to 100 fields per form
  + Up to 100 steps per form
  + Up to 100 conditions per form
  + Up to 20 submission email recipients
  + File upload field
  + Signature field
  + File download
* Automated marketing tools (including site chat)
* Accept payments
* Sell products online
* Point of Sale (POS)
* Automated sales tax (500 transactions per month)
* Booking functionality
* Advanced eCommerce tools
* Option to connect your own domain
* Priority Customer Care
* Advanced developer platform

title: Can I add YouTube Shorts to my Wix Video player for site visitors to view?
content: Currently, it is not possible to upload YouTube Shorts in Wix Video for your site visitors to view. If you attempt to add a YouTube Short URL to your player, you will see a "not supported URL" error.

title: How can I upload photos from Lightroom Classic to my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Before you begin, make sure Lightroom Classic is installed on your computer. In your editor, click the Pro Gallery, click Settings, click Advanced, scroll to Integrations, and click Download Now; unzip the downloaded zip file. In Lightroom Classic, open File, click Plug-in manager, click Add, select the unzipped plug-in file, click Add Plug-in, then click Done. Go to Publish Services in the Library Module, click Set Up next to Wix Pro Gallery, click Authorize, log in to your Wix Account, return to Lightroom Classic, select the Sync checkbox in the Publishing Manager window, and click Save. Make sure your Wix Pro Gallery is added to your Wix site before uploading images from Lightroom Classic. Then go to your Pro Gallery in Lightroom Classic, drag the photos you want to upload to your gallery, and click Publish.

title: Can I view Wix Forms Statistics and Reports?
content: It is now possible to view Wix Forms Statistics and Reports.

title: What steps can I take to troubleshoot local issues with my Wix Forum?
content: Try disconnecting and reconnecting to your internet, clearing your cache and cookies, and opening your site in a different browser. You can check if the issue you are encountering is cookie or cache related by opening your browser in incognito / private mode and seeing if the problem persists. If you still have trouble, go through the Technical Assistant. If the issue persists, contact us with the steps you have taken to troubleshoot the issue, and send a screenshot or a video of the issue using screencast. Make sure to add the screencast URL to your response.

title: How can I access a site in a workspace using the Wix Studio app?
content:
To access a site in a workspace using the Wix Studio app:

* Go to the relevant workspace in the Wix Studio app.
* Tap **Sites** at the bottom.
* Scroll through the site list and tap the relevant site, or enter the site name in the search bar at the top.

Once you select the site, you can perform the following actions:

* Tap the **Preview** icon to see how the site looks on your mobile device.
* Tap the **Copy** icon and send the site URL directly to clients so they can see the progress of their site.
* Tap **Inbox** to view and reply to chats.
* Tap **Site & App** to choose which member app to set as the preferred app for your clients' members to use.
* Tap **Dashboard** for quick access to the apps added to a site and track the performance of site activity such as site analytics.

title: How can I remove the 'Kids' option from the reservation process in Wix Hotels?
content:
To remove the Kids option:
- Click the Wix Hotels app in the Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Rooms list tab.
- Deselect the Kids checkbox next to Fields.

Note: If you've added the Wix Hotels Search Bar to your site, you need to update its settings separately to remove the Kids option. To do so, click the Search Bar in the Editor, click Settings, and then deselect the checkbox next to Kids.

title: How can I preview my live Facebook ad from the Facebook Ads dashboard?
content:
Go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard. Click the Campaign Actions drop-down at the right. Click Preview ad. Click Preview on Facebook to view one of the ad variations on Facebook.

When previewing your ad, you are only seeing an example of what a variation of your ad may look like. With a dynamic campaign, there are several versions of your ad running at the same time updated according to the audience and their interests. The number of likes, views, and comments on an ad may differ from the total stats of the campaign, as it is only one of the variations running simultaneously.

title: How can I purchase Shutterstock media through the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Scroll down and click Show More under Shutterstock Images. Enter keywords in the search bar. Click the relevant drop-downs next to Filter by to refine your search. Click the image or video you want to purchase. Click Buy Image or Buy Video at the bottom right. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase.

Note: After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: Can I customize the layout and design settings of the Related Posts element on my Wix Blog Post Page?
content: Currently, the Related Posts element does not have its own dedicated layout and design settings. The current settings are pulled from your Post Page settings.

title: How do I find the Payments section in my Wix dashboard and refund a payment made through Wix Payments?
content: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click the payment you want to refund. Click Refund. Enter the amount to refund and, if needed, a note. Click Refund again.

title: How can I create sub-sub-items in a Wix advanced menu?
content: Set up sub-sub-items by creating a dropdown menu, then moving the relevant items under your chosen page or link. Note that it is only possible to create sub-sub-items with horizontal menus you have manually added from the Add Elements panel. They are not available on menus that come with your chosen site template, or on vertical menus.

title: How can I contact a customer who placed an order or made a reservation through the Wix app?
content:
To contact a customer from the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Open the order or reservation you want to view contact details for:
   - **For orders:** Tap **Manage** at the bottom right. Tap **Orders**. Tap the New, In Progress or All tab to locate the correct order.
   - **For reservations:** Tap **Manage** at the bottom right. Tap **Reservations**. Tap the Open, Upcoming or History tab to locate the correct reservation.
- Scroll to the end of the order or reservation to locate the contact info. Choose what you want to do:
   - **Call the customer:** Tap the **Call** icon under Phone Number.
   - **Email the customer:** Tap the **Email** icon under Email Address.

**Note:** If you can't see a contact option it means the customer did not provide that information when making their order or reservation.

title: How do I change my Wix payment provider for accepting credit card payments?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Wix Payments, or click See More Payment Options. If you do not see your preferred provider, click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect beside the provider you want to change to, then click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider. To connect your account, click Connect Existing Account if you have an account, or click Create an Account if you do not have an account, and follow the steps. If you are using Wix Hotels, follow the Wix Hotels payment setup instructions.

title: How can I add a gradient background to a section in the Studio Editor?
content:
To add a gradient background to a section:

- Select the relevant section.
- Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
- Click the color box under **Design**.
- In the Color Picker, choose the gradient type and adjust it.

For a Linear, Radial or Conic gradient:
- Click the Gradient icon.
- Choose the gradient type from the drop-down: **Linear**, **Radial** or **Conic**.
- Adjust the gradient and its colors:
  - **(Linear and Conic) Change the angle:** click the current angle on the gradient preview, then enter the desired angle.
  - **(Radial and Conic) Change the focal point:** click the current focal point on the gradient preview, then hold and drag it to the desired location.
  - **Change an existing color:** on the colors bar under the preview, click the color dot you want to change, click the color box, and select a theme color or any custom color.
  - **Add more colors:** on the colors bar under the preview, click the desired location for your new color, select a theme color or any custom color, and optionally drag the slider to change the color's opacity.
  - **Delete a color:** on the colors bar under the preview, click the color dot you want to remove, then click the Delete Color icon.
- **Tip:** Save the gradient by clicking **+ Add** next to **My color gradients**.

For a Fluid gradient:
- Click the Fluid Gradient icon.
- Adjust the gradient and its colors:
  - **Change an existing color:** on the gradient preview, click the color dot you want to change, click the color box below the preview, and select a theme color or any custom color.
  - **Add more colors:** on the gradient preview, click the desired location for your new color, select a theme color or any custom color, then adjust the color's opacity, **Size**, or **Spread** using the sliders.
  - **Delete a color:** on the gradient preview, click the color dot you want to remove, then click the Delete Color icon.
- **Tip:** Save the gradient by clicking **+ Add** next to **My fluid gradients**.

title: Can I group several components together in a horizontal arrangement or stack in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to group several components together in a horizontal arrangement or stack. This feature would allow you to align elements side-by-side in a single row, making it easier to create organized and visually appealing layouts.

title: Can customers redeem loyalty points when purchasing Online Programs on Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible for customers to earn and redeem loyalty points when purchasing Online Programs.

title: Can I send payment requests for clients' subscriptions in Wix Studio?
content: You can now let clients pay for Wix Premium plans using a payment request in Wix Studio. Once you send a request, your client can review the plan and upgrade the site themselves.

title: How can I share a link to my service list using Wix Bookings?
content: In the Wix dashboard, go to Shareable Links and click Create Link under Service list. Select the relevant staff member or All staff members, then click Continue. Choose Copy link to copy the complete link, Share via to send it through WhatsApp, Email, or generate a QR Code, or Publish to social. For Publish to social, connect the social accounts if needed, customize how the post appears, and click Publish at the bottom right. The number next to Publish indicates how many posts you are about to publish.

title: How can I access and view specific Bookings analytics reports in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Analytics. Tap All Reports. Scroll down to Bookings and choose the analytics reports you want to review. To view a specific report, tap the report in the Bookings analytic menu (for example, Bookings Over Time). You can customize the report by changing the time period: tap the existing time period, then select a timeframe under Select a time period. Choose a preset time period or tap Custom to set your own dates. You can display the report as a line chart, table, or bar chart by tapping the relevant tab at the top of the report. For Line, compare to the previous period, group results by Day/Week/Month, and select what you want to measure from the drop-down menu. For Bar Chart, choose the categories to display and the time period to group by Day/Week/Month. For Table, choose the number and type of columns from the drop-down menus, group them by Day/Week/Month, and tap the checkboxes next to the information you want included. To download the report, select the desired view you want to download (Line or Table), tap the More Actions icon at the top right, tap Schedule Delivery, and set up your download destination, format, and recurrence.

title: Can I track the number of times a typography theme is used across my client's site in the Site Styles panel?
content: Currently, the Site Styles panel does not include an indication of the number of times you've used a typography theme (e.g. Heading 1) across your client's site.

title: How can I reduce the number of business email users in my monthly Google Workspace subscription?
content: First, delete the relevant user(s) from your Google Workspace account. In your Wix account, go to Business Email, click the More Actions icon next to the business email you want to remove, and click Manage at Google. You may need to sign into your Google Workspace account if you are not already signed in. From the Google Admin console menu, go to Directory, then Users, and remove or delete the user. Then go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the business email subscription you want to reduce, click Remove users, select the 'I want to delete my inactive Business Emails' checkbox, and click Reduce Subscription. This option only appears for monthly subscriptions. Subscriptions with outstanding invoices cannot be reduced.

title: Is there a dedicated documentation center for developers available?
content: Yes. Wix Docs is a dedicated documentation center exclusively for developers. It includes content and documentation relating to coding with Velo, creating a headless experience, app development, and API references (REST & SDKs).

title: How can I undo a change I made in the Wix Editor?
content: To undo a change you have made, click the Undo icon at the top of your Editor, or press Ctrl + Z on your keyboard.

title: How can I adjust the strips on my Wix mobile site to improve their appearance?
content:
To adjust strips for mobile on your Wix site:

- Open your site in the mobile editor.
- Click the relevant strip.
- Choose how you want to adjust the strip:
  - Resize your strip: Drag the stretch handle up or down to make the strip larger or smaller.
  - Reorder your strips: Click the Move Up or Move Down arrow until the strip is in the desired position.
  - Hide a strip: Click the Hide Element icon.
  - Add an effect to your strip: Click the Animation icon and choose whether to add a background scroll effect or an entrance animation to the strip.

Note: It is not possible to add effects to a strip that contain columns.

title: How can I customize the design of a decorative shape in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the shape, click the Design icon, then customize your shape using the available options: Fill color to select the shape's color and opacity; Border by enabling the Apply border toggle to customize the color, opacity, and width of a border; Shadow by enabling the Apply shadow toggle to customize a shadow.

title: Can I choose which collaborators can access custom dashboard pages in Velo?
content: With Velo, you can create custom dashboard pages for you and your collaborators. Currently, it is not possible to choose which collaborators can and can't access custom dashboard pages.

title: How can I connect my existing .es domain to my Wix site?
content: Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .es domain you already own to your Wix site. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via Nameservers. With this method, Wix hosts your DNS records, so you can manage them in your Wix account and Wix Customer Care can help if you need assistance managing them. You will need access to your current domain registrar. New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Currently, it is not possible to purchase a .es domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix.

title: What are the steps to edit a blog post in the Wix app?
content:
To edit a blog post in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Blog.
- Tap Posts.
- Tap the post you want to edit.
  - Note: If the post has not yet been published, tap Drafts at the top and then tap the post.
- Make your changes and then tap Next at the top right.
- Tap Save & Publish.

title: How do I upload an image using the Media Manager?
content:
To upload an image using the Media Manager:

- Click Media on the left side of the editor.
- In the Media Manager, click + Upload Media.
- Select where you want to add the media from:
  - Your computer: drag and drop files into the Media Manager or click Upload from Computer.
  - Your other Wix sites: click My Wix Account on the left, select the site folder, select the files you want to upload, and click Upload Selection.
  - External platforms (e.g. Facebook, Google Drive): click the relevant platform on the left, click Connect, select the files you want to upload, and click Upload Selection.
  - A URL: click the Link icon on the left side, paste the URL link, and click Import.
- Optional: select the file you just uploaded and click Add to Page.

title: Can visitors sort live site collection content connected to the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to provide a way for visitors to sort live site content that is connected to the CMS. Workaround: With Velo, it is possible to give visitors the ability to sort live site content. To do so, add the action event handler (e.g. dropdown onChange) and within it, use the setSort() function for the dataset connected to the displayed content.

title: How can I update the contact information for my .com.br domain?
content: First, update your domain's contact information at Registro.br. Go to https://registro.br/2/login, log in, click My data, update the domain's contact information, and click TO SAVE. After updating, you'll receive a confirmation email from hostmaster@registro.br. Then send an email or forward that confirmation email to support@wix.com. Include your domain name and specify which contact fields you changed and whether they were changed for your Administrative contact, your Technical contact, or both. Wix updates your domain's contact information internally; you will not see the updated changes in your Wix account.

title: Why are my widgets not attaching to sections in Editor X, and how can I fix this issue?
content:
Currently there is an issue that causes widgets for some applications to not be attached inside of a section. We're aware of the issue and are currently gathering more information regarding this matter.

Meanwhile, you can use the following workaround:
- Add a new blank section to the top of the page.
- Arrange the affected widget to be on top of the page for every breakpoint (even above the header).
- Set the Position type to "pinned" for the affected widget.
- Set the Position type back to "default".
- Adjust the Size, Docking, Margins for the widget on all breakpoints after is attached to a section.

- The Widget must be at the top of page for every breakpoint or it will not be able to be pinned.
- In the cases you have another component already pinned to the top of the page, it must be temporarily set back to default first.
- When adding a new blank section, make sure it is placed at the top of the page (below the affected widget).
- If you are having any issues applying this workaround, please contact our customer care team for assistance.

title: Does Wix Events support recurring events, and what is the benefit?
content: Yes. Wix Events lets you create single or recurring events. If you host the same event multiple times, you can create a recurring event instead of creating the same event from scratch again and again, saving time. You can also make changes to individual occurrences if necessary.

title: How can I create a non-square logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Go to the Brand Studio. Open the My Brands drop-down, select the relevant brand, hover over the relevant logo design, and click the Edit icon. Choose the shape of your logo using the Icons panel or the Shapes panel. For the Symbols panel, click the Symbols icon, search for your preferred symbol, click the symbol to add it to your logo, then click the Move Backward icon as many times as necessary in the toolbar. For the Shapes panel, click the Shapes icon, select your preferred shape, then click the Move Backward icon as many times as necessary. Resize and customize your logo elements if necessary. Click Next at the top right to purchase and download your logo, extract your files from the .zip folder, and use the "Original on Transparent" logo file.

title: How can I view a client's subscription and payment history in Wix?
content: Go to the Contact List in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant client and click View. Click the Subscriptions tab. Hover over any subscription and click View to see more details. Learn how to manually mark a subscription as paid (for example, when your client pays you in person).

title: Is the Cashier role available for accepting mobile POS payments in Wix Bookings?
content: The Cashier role, which gives permission to accept mobile POS payment only, is not currently available for Wix Bookings. Currently, you can allow someone else to accept payment at a mobile POS by assigning them roles such as Admin or Back Office Manager + Payments Admin.

title: How can I send a broadcast message to my clients using the Wix app?
content: To send a broadcast message in the Wix app: Open the Wix app. Tap the Manage icon. Tap Bookings. Tap the relevant booking. Tap Broadcast. Select the checkboxes next to the contacts you want to send an SMS broadcast to. Tap Next. Tap the channel drop-down and select Chat, Email, or SMS. Chat sends a live chat broadcast to clients in their inbox in the member app; Email sends a broadcast email to clients whose email addresses are saved in your contact list; SMS broadcasts via SMS to clients if they have provided their contact numbers. You must have a Business Phone Number to send an SMS message. Compose the message, and you can attach elements to your message. Tap Send.

title: Can I connect section backgrounds in the Studio Editor to the CMS?
content: It is now possible to connect section backgrounds to the CMS (Content Management System) in the Studio Editor. This allows you to manage the images that appear as section backgrounds in your CMS collections. In the Studio Editor, select a section and go to the CMS tab of the Inspector panel to connect the section background. Learn more about connecting elements to the CMS.

title: Can I set up a one-time payment for my app when it's installed on Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to allow site creators to make a one-time payment for an app on installing it. Learn more about available pricing options for your app in Wix Blocks (e.g. free app installation, Premium paid recurring, dynamic pricing).

title: How can I change the layout of my photo album in Wix Photo Albums?

title: How can I create a new online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: Before you begin, add Online Programs to your site and upgrade your site to allow people to join your program. In your site's dashboard, go to Online Programs and click + Create New. Click the type of program you want to create: Template or Start Fresh. For Template, click Next, select one of the templates, and click Finish. For Start Fresh, click Next, enter a name and click Next, set the pace and click Next, set the duration and click Let's Go. title: Is there a Prezi app available in Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer a Prezi app. You can also embed your Prezi presentation onto your site by adding the HTML code.

title: What are the supported file types and size limits for images and videos in Wix Photo Albums?
content:
Images: supported files are JPG, GIF, PNG; file size limit is 40MB. JPG is the recommended format for Photo Albums, but PNG is recommended if your image requires transparency.

Videos: supported files are AVI, MPEG, MPG, MPE, MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, OGV, VOB, M4V, 3PG, DivX, XVID, or embed from YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, Dailymotion or Twitch; file size limit is 1000MB. The recommended resolution is 1920 x 1080px.

For optimum performance, we recommend having less than:
- 150 photos per upload
- 400 photos per album
- 4000 albums per site

title: Why are my email campaigns marked as 'delivered' but not reaching my subscribers' inboxes?
content:
Subscribers may not see a campaign even when it shows as 'delivered' because it reached the intended recipient but is caught in a spam folder. Other possible causes include: the email provider is slowing delivery or performing it in batches to prevent potential spam; there is an issue with the domain associated with the campaign; the campaign doesn't follow email marketing best practices; or Internet Service Providers (ISP) rules have been violated.

To help ensure delivery, ask subscribers to check their spam filters and move the campaign back to their inboxes; add the 'From' email address to their contact lists; and check their webmail provider rules. Some providers such as AOL, Yahoo and Hotmail deliver campaigns in batches, so the campaign could take up to 24 hours to get to their inboxes. Also make sure campaign content, including the subject line, doesn't include anything that could flag it as suspicious, and keep the contact list up to date so the campaign doesn't go to bad or old email addresses; if too many emails bounce, the campaign could be flagged as spam.

title: How can I set up an automated push notification for my branded app users when they perform a specific action?
content:
Prerequisites: This action is only available if you have a Branded App Premium plan and your app is live in the App Store and Google Play Store. To receive notifications, make sure your app is live on both the Google Play Store and the App Store, download your branded app to your device, and enable notifications for it.

Step 1 | Create an automation with 'send a push notification' as the action
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation at the top right.
- Click + Start from Scratch.
- Name your automation and choose a trigger (e.g. when someone books an online session).
- Under the Actions drop-down, click Send a push notification (new).
- Click the Recipient drop-down and add the specific individuals. The Recipient type is pre-selected to send notifications to your members.

Step 2 | Customize your push notification message
- Enter the notification title that appears above the main message.
- Enter the push notification message. You can add up to 200 characters.
- Click + Add Dynamic Value under Message / Title, select the relevant dynamic value, and click Save. Dynamic values appear in bold at the top of your notification.

Step 3 | Set the notification details
- Select the relevant option from the Notification topic drop-down.
- Add a link under Notification behavior to determine where the notification leads. For Mobile link, you can choose Open a specific page in the app, or Open a specific product or service. To open a specific product or service, click the Category drop-down to select the app (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Bookings), then click the Item drop-down to select the product or service page. You must have Wix Stores and/or Wix Bookings on your site to see this option.

Step 4 | Choose the timing and activate the automation
- Optional: Click + Add Delay, use the up and down arrows to set the number, and choose between days, hours, and minutes.
- Click Activate at the top right to publish your automation. The new automation appears on your Automations dashboard under the Created by you tab. If the automation status is Active, it is live.

title: How can I troubleshoot technical issues with my Wix site manually?
content:
Try these manual troubleshooting steps:
- Open your site in incognito mode. If the issue does not occur, it is likely a local issue.
- Clear your browser's cache. If the issue persists, disable your browser's add-ons and extensions.
- To disable Google Chrome extensions: open Google Chrome, click the More icon, select More tools and click Extensions, then deselect the Enabled checkbox.
- To disable Firefox extensions: open Firefox, click the Menu icon, select Add-ons, select the Extensions or Appearance panel, select an add-on and click Disable, then click Restart now.
- To disable Edge extensions: open Edge, click the More icon, select Extensions, right-click an extension and select Turn Off.
- To disable Safari extensions: open Safari, click the Safari menu and select Preferences, click Extensions, select an extension and deselect the Enable checkbox.
- Check your browser's version to make sure you are using the latest browser version, and install the latest version if needed.
- Try opening your site in a different supported browser.
- To disable custom code: go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click the Custom Code tab under Advanced Settings, disable the toggle next to each custom code snippet, and reload your site or editor.
- Temporarily disable your antivirus software and reload the site.
- Connect to a different Wi-Fi network, or create a Wi-Fi hotspot with your mobile phone.
- If you're still having issues after completing these steps, contact us for help.

title: How can I integrate Wix Pricing Plans with other Wix apps to offer exclusive content or services?
content:
You can integrate your pricing plans with other Wix apps used on your site. For example, you can create a plan that grants access to members-only pages on your site, or create a plan that bundles multiple Wix Bookings services into one package.

Integrate the following Wix apps and features with pricing plans:
- Site Pages: Use your pricing plans to sell access to exclusive content on hidden site pages.
- Wix Bookings: Sell access to services created in Wix Bookings. You can sell membership plans that last a set amount of time or create a package of services (e.g. 5 manicures at a reduced rate).
- Wix Events: Offer discounts to membership plan holders when they buy event tickets.
- Wix Blog: Create exclusive content on your blog and limit access to plan holders. You can limit access to specific blog posts or to your entire blog page.
- Wix Online Programs: Create an online program, such as a 30-day pushup challenge, and sell access to it through your pricing plans.
- Wix Forum: Create exclusive forum categories that only plan holders can access.
- Wix Video: Create exclusive content in your video channel and limit access to plan holders.
- Wix File Share: Create a file-sharing library with the File Share app and limit access or permissions to all or part of your library to plan holders.
- Wix Groups: Create a members-only community where you can share tips and advice and clients can get to know each other better.

To combine pricing plans with Wix apps, go to the Wix App Market to add and set up the apps you want to integrate with pricing plans.

Note: This refers to the original Wix Hotels. If you are using the new Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, which is not yet available to all users, different information applies.

title: How do I add default values to fields in my CMS collections?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your editor. Click the relevant collection. Click Manage Fields. Click the field you want to add a default value to. Click the Default value tab. Enter the default value you want to use for the field. Click Save. Default field values are not applied to items added via input elements or the Wix app; they only apply to items that you or site collaborators add within your CMS collections from desktop computers.

title: How can I update my payment details in my Wix account to include my GST/HST and QST numbers for tax exemption in Canada?

Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your tax IDs to the GST/HST/QST ID fields as applicable. Click Update.

To add frames to your Wix Pro Gallery items: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Design tab. Click Item Style and customize your frame using Border width & color and Corner radius.

title: How can I enable or disable visual indicators on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your site in the Wix Editor. Select Settings in the top toolbar. Select Accessibility Wizard. Select the More actions icon at the top of the Accessibility Wizard panel. Select Advanced accessibility settings. Select Visual Indicators. Click the toggle beside Allow keyboard users to navigate through your site. When enabled, visitors using a keyboard to navigate your site see a blue rectangle to indicate their location on the page. When disabled, visitors do not see an indication of their location on the page. Focus / visual indicators are automatically enabled on all sites you build with Wix. The indicator is designed to fit most site color combinations, but it is less visible on buttons with a white fill over a blue background, so check site element colors to help ensure all visitors can see it.

Use a supported IP address format: a single IP address, an IP address range, or CIDR notation. A URL can only be used in one rule at a time.

title: My site is unable to provide a secure connection.
content:
SSL is used by websites and browsers for secure communication; an SSL-enabled site uses HTTPS in its URL instead of HTTP. If you cannot view your site over HTTPS, troubleshoot your SSL certificate:
1. Make sure your DNS records are correct. Your domain must be connected to your site. If connected via name servers, ensure your domain host has the correct name servers, and in your Wix account check the default A and CNAME records under Manage DNS Records. If connected via pointing, ensure your domain host has the required A record and CNAME record. If you purchased your domain from Wix, check the default A and CNAME records in your Wix account.
2. If you recently updated DNS records, wait up to 48 hours for domain propagation.
3. If your domain was purchased outside Wix, check with your domain host that DNSSEC is not signed, as it can interrupt propagation. If purchased from Wix, disregard this step because Wix domains have DNSSEC automatically not signed.
4. If an HTML element contains HTTP code instead of HTTPS, make sure the code contains HTTPS only. In the Editor, click the HTML element, click Edit Code, and under Add your code here (HTTPS only) make sure the code does not contain HTTP, then click Publish.
Older operating systems can sometimes fail to recognise a modern SSL Certificate; this does not mean there is an issue with your site's SSL Certificate. Update the device to the most recent OS available from Apple or Windows.

title: How can I troubleshoot issues with adding items to a collection in my CMS?
content:
To troubleshoot issues with adding items to a collection, check the following scenarios from the source:

- Not enough permissions to add an item: With limited access, you can read or update existing content but not add new items. The error message displays: "You don't have permission to add items to a collection. Contact the owner for access." To resolve, contact the owner of the site and ask them to assign you a role with more permissions.
- Wix App Collections and external collections: Wix App Collections (e.g. Blog, Stores, Events) are read-only by default. External collections may have mixed permissions. The error message displays: "You can't add items to this type of collection." To resolve, open the relevant section from within the dashboard (e.g. Blog, Stores) and add the item. For external collections, ask the site owner to adjust the settings.
- The server returns a collection item ID error: This error can occur for various reasons, displaying an error message over the collection content area. The collection header and options, including the + Add Item button, are still visible. To resolve, refresh the collection and try to add an item again. If the issue persists, contact Customer Care.
- A collection is not available (deleted, doesn't exist or the server can't find it): If a collection is deleted or unavailable, an error message will display to let you know. To resolve, if a collection was deleted accidentally, use backups to restore it.

content: Currently, Wix Forum supports all of the languages supported by your Editor. You can submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions for additional languages.

title: How can I add and set up a Facebook Page Like box on my Wix site?
content:
Retrieve your Facebook page ID by opening your Facebook business page and copying the page ID from the URL in the address bar. In order to set up the Facebook Like box, disable your page's privacy settings from your Facebook account by changing Country Restrictions and Age Restrictions to Page is visible to everyone.

To add a Facebook Page Like box, go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Social, click Facebook, and click or drag the Facebook Like element (News Feed or Mini) to add it to your page.

To set up your Facebook Page Like box, click the Facebook Page Like box, click Add Page Name, and enter your Facebook page ID.

To customize the box, click the Layouts icon on your Like box and use the toggles to enable or disable Show profile pics, Show news feed, and Show header. To add an animation, click the Animation icon. If the news feed is not updating, check that the privacy setting on your posts are not set to private/restricted.

title: How can I enable the site search feature for my site using the Wix app?
content: Before you begin, make sure you've downloaded the Wix app to your mobile device. Then go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App under Manage, tap the More actions icon at the top, tap Manage app settings, and enable the Allow site search toggle to make your site searchable on the Spaces app. To encourage members to download the Spaces App, enable the mobile web banner.

title: How can I change the registration status for an event using the Wix app?
content:
To change the registration status for an event using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events.
- Select Published Events or Draft Events.
- Select an event.
- Tap the Manage tab.
- Select Registration settings.
- Tap Registration Status.
- Set the status:
  - Tap Open or Closed to immediately change the status.
  - Tap Custom dates to set when registration opens and closes, then select an opening date and time and a closing date and time.
- Tap Save.

title: Can I set specific availability for each location in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, the availability settings in Wix Bookings apply to all business locations. It is not possible to set specific availability for each location. As a workaround, you can set staff hours separately for each location where you offer the service, which influences the availability accordingly. For example, if a staff member works at location A from Monday to Thursday and at location B on weekends, the service availability reflects these specific hours per location.

title: Can I connect an email provider other than Gmail to Wix Inbox?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect an email provider other than Gmail to your Wix Inbox.

title: Can I share a link to get feedback for a site in Wix Studio?
content: You can now share the latest version of sites with your clients for their direct review and feedback.

title: Can I create a multilingual menu with Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can create a menu that has more than one language with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app. For sites that offer online ordering, the new menu app works with Wix's new online ordering app Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW). The new online ordering app already offers many advantages over the old app, however, a number of features available in the old app are still missing.

title: How can I access my tax settings in Wix Stores to set up tax collection?
content: Go to your site's dashboard, click Settings, and select Tax.

title: How can I report a privacy issue with my Wix site?
content: If you believe you've found a privacy issue, or have a query regarding our privacy practices, please contact our team.

title: How can I set up an Upload Button to allow visitors to upload multiple documents on my Wix site?
content: In the upload button settings, select Document from the Supported file type drop-down. Drag the Max number of files slider to set the limit on how many files can be uploaded per submission. Click the Connect to CMS icon on your upload button. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to the collection you will store submissions in, or select Add a Dataset and choose the collection you want to store submissions in. Add a 'Multi-document' field to your collection where you will store the upload button submissions, or connect to an existing 'Multi-document' collection field. Click the File connects to drop-down and select Add new field. Enter a Field Name, choose Field Type Multi-Document, and click Add. To let visitors submit the uploaded files, add a regular button, change the text to 'Submit', connect the button to the same dataset that connects to your upload button, and set the Click action connects to field to Submit.

title: How can I add and customize the new Wix Tips app on my site?
content:
To add and customize Wix Tips on your site:
- Go to the Wix App Market in your site's dashboard.
- Search for the Wix Tips (New) app in the search bar.
- Click Add to Site.
- Click Get Started.
- If you have the old Wix Tips app, follow the directions on your site to remove it.
- Customize your tip settings: enable Allow clients to leave a tip when they check out on your site. The first time you enable this, install the Tip plugin: in the pop-up, click Add Plugin, then click Stay in Dashboard. You can also enable Allow admins to add a tip when collecting payment. Set tipping options such as percentages, fixed amounts such as $2.00 or $5.00, a default selected tip, and let clients leave a custom tip. For booking services, choose whether to split tips proportionately or split tips evenly.
- Click Save.
- Publish your site from your editor when you're ready to add Wix Tips to your live site.

title: How can I add an image to my Wix app using the dashboard?
content: To add an image using the dashboard: go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard; select the relevant tab (e.g. Spaces by Wix app, Branded Mobile App); click Edit Mobile App; click the Screen drop-down and choose the screen to edit; click Elements on the left; click Image under Basic Items; click Change on the panel on the right, then click + Upload Media to upload an image from your computer or from your Media Manager; click Add to Page. Then configure options: use Photo Studio to edit your image; select a Crop ratio and Corner radius; choose image behavior—Nothing, It opens in a pop-up, or It triggers an action; drag the Margins sliders to adjust padding, and click the Edit individually icon to separately adjust margins; click General Settings and under Element visibility choose All, Android, or iOS. Click Save & Publish.

title: How can I update outdated page information and thumbnails for my Wix site when sharing on Facebook?
content: Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant page. For Page Title and Description, click SEO (Google), then edit the text under the page title and description sections. For Thumbnail, click Social Share, click Upload Image, select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one, then click Add to Page. Once you have updated the above, publish your site from inside the Editor. Facebook may take some time to process the new information. If your information still appears out of date, use the Facebook debugger: enter your site's URL in the URL field, click Debug, then click Fetch new information or Scrape Again. If needed, click Scrape Again a few times. Make sure that you have added your personal Facebook Account username under the Social Settings and that the thumbnail follows Facebook's recommendations in terms of size and resolution.

title: How can I add a moderator to my Wix Forum?
content: Go to the forum on your live site. Log in using the email associated with your Wix account. Navigate to the relevant forum member. You can access forum members from the members page or through one of their forum posts by clicking on their profile picture. Click the Show More icon. Click Set as Forum Moderator. Click Confirm. To remove a member as moderator, follow the steps above and click Remove Moderator.

title: How do I add and set up a Pay Button on my Wix site?
content:
Important: To accept online payments using a Pay Button, you must purchase a plan that allows you to accept payments.

Add a Pay Button:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Pay Button app.
- Click Add to Site.

Set up your payment method:
- Click the Pay Button in the editor.
- Click Manage Payment Methods.
- Click Connect next to the relevant payment methods (you can select multiple).
- Follow the relevant set-up steps. For Automatically Connected, you can start accepting payments immediately, but to receive funds you must complete the set-up process. For Recommended Provider, click Set Up Account and connect an existing account by entering credentials and clicking Sign in, or click Create new account.

Customize the button settings:
- Click the Pay Button in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Enter the product's name under Item Name.
- Enter the product's price under Item Price.
- Edit the text under What does this button say?
- Optionally enable the Show Terms & Conditions Checkbox toggle.
- Check the email address under Email Notifications.

Choose a layout:
- Click the Pay Button in your editor.
- Click the Layouts icon.
- Select the direction and alignment for the button's text.

Customize the design:
- Click the Pay Button in your editor.
- Click the Design icon.
- Choose one of the preset designs.
- Click Customize Design for advanced options for the Regular and Hover view.

title: How can I create a package for my Wix Bookings service?
content:
To create a package for your Wix Bookings service:

- Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard.
- Create a new appointment or class, or edit an existing one.
- Scroll down to the Price and Payment section.
- Choose the relevant price option in the Price type drop-down:
  - Fixed Price: Set a standard price for the service.
  - No Fee: Choose this option for free service.
  - Varied prices: Create different price options depending on either the client type or the staff member. Note: This feature is not available for everyone yet.
  - Custom Price: Describe how you charge for the service, for example, "Price negotiable".
- Click Create New Plan next to Pricing Plans (Memberships & Packages).
- Click Package.
- Click Next.
- Enter the plan name and description.
- Choose the services included in the package:
  - Click the What services are included? drop-down.
  - Select the checkbox next to the relevant services.
  - Tip: Click Select All Services to create an all-inclusive package.
- Choose how clients pay under Price and Duration:
  - One-time payment: Your clients pay for the package as they check out. Enter the package's price and decide how long this package is valid for.
  - Free: Offer this package for free. This is a great way to gain new clients.
- Click the Package is valid for drop-down and choose the relevant length of time.
  - Optional: Click Custom to set the number of weeks, months or years the package is valid for using the options available.
- Optional: Add more benefits to your package (e.g. Blog or File Share Subscriptions) under Extra benefits.
- Optional: Further customize your package using the options under Settings:
  - Limit to 1 per person: Enable the toggle to make the package a one-time offer for each client.
  - Let clients cancel: Enable the toggle to allow clients to cancel their package themselves at any time.
  - Clients set start date: Allow clients to set when their package starts at checkout.
  - Add a policy: Create your own terms & conditions for the package: Click Add, enter your terms and conditions in the field provided, and click Save.
- Click Save.

title: How can I connect PayItMonthly as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to PayItMonthly. If you have a PayItMonthly account, enter your access_key and secret. To find your credentials in PayItMonthly, go to Admin > Developers > Create API User > Show secret access key. Then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create PayItMonthly account, sign up to PayItMonthly, wait for an email from PayItMonthly to get your access_key and secret, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS system that is not currently supported?
content: POS integration is partially supported. You can connect your Wix Restaurant site to Square POS in the US, or use a webhook to integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS. If you want to request another POS system, contact us to let us know.

title: How can I enable waitlists for classes in Wix Bookings?
content: To enable waitlists for classes, go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Booking settings, then Booking policy. Click the More actions icon next to the relevant policy and click Edit. Scroll down to the Waitlist section and click the checkbox next to Allow clients to join a waitlist for fully booked classes. Set the Maximum waitlist capacity. Click the An open spot will be held for drop-down and select the duration. This sets how much time a client has to book before the spot is offered to the next client on the waitlist. Click Save.

title: How can I add a quiz to my online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: To add a quiz or survey: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant program. Scroll down to Content / Schedule. Click + Add. Select Add Quiz. You can also click Create with AI, then customize and edit the questions and answers.

title: How can I organize my site list in the Spaces app?
content: Open the Spaces by Wix app. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right of your site list. Tap Manage My Sites. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant site. Select what you want to do from the available options: Pin to top; Hide from My Sites; Add to device home screen; Manage notifications; Invite members; Leave.

title: Can I schedule menu availability for specific dates in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can now choose specific dates for menu availability. For example, you can offer a holiday menu from December 20-24.

title: How can I change the URL of my free site on Editor X?
content: A free Editor X site's URL is based on your account name and the name you've given your site. When changing either of those names, the URL changes automatically to match the new settings. To change this to your own link, purchase a domain from Editor X or connect one you already own.

title: How can I write a blog post on my mobile device using Wix?
