content: From a mobile device, go to your blog and log in using the email associated with your Wix account. Tap **Create a Post**, then write your post title and content. Tap **Save & Continue**. You can then choose categories by tapping to select categories and tapping **Done**, tap **Save as Draft**, or tap **Save & Publish**. Note: Only those with writing privileges can see the **Create a Post** button.

title: Can I create product subcategories and sub-subcategories in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, you can create product categories, but not subcategories or sub-subcategories. You can, however, display product subcategories in your site menu.

title: How can I add a YouTube playlist to my Wix site using Wix Video?
content:
Make sure the videos you want to add are set to "public"; YouTube videos set to private are not supported and may not display properly in Wix Video. You can choose any public YouTube playlist as long as the playlist has 50 videos or less.

Step 1 | Find your playlist URL on YouTube
- Go to YouTube.com and access the relevant YouTube profile.
- Click the Playlists tab.
- Click View full playlist under the relevant playlist.
- Copy the playlist URL at the top of the page.
Make sure to copy the full playlist URL, not an individual video URL.

Step 2 | Create a new channel and paste the playlist URL
- Go to Channels in your site's dashboard.
- Click the New Channel drop-down on the top right.
- Select YouTube Feed.
- Paste your YouTube playlist URL into the field provided.
- Click Connect.
Visitors to your site will now be able to view and browse your playlist.

It may take several hours for your embedded YouTube playlist on Wix to sync with the latest uploads on your YouTube channel.

title: Can I connect multiple addresses from one collection item to the Google Maps element?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect more than one address for the same collection item to the Google Maps element. This feature would allow you to bind multiple address fields from your collection to pins in a map on your site. You can connect only one address field to your map to display one location per collection item. You can display multiple addresses on your map, however, they need to each be for different collection items.

title: How can I customize my site's header in Wix Editor to fit my site's theme?
content: Your site's header appears across the top of your site throughout all of your pages. To design it to fit with your site's theme and palette, choose from the available design presets and customize settings such as the color, border, and corners. If the header is not the right size, make it bigger or smaller using the stretch handle. You can also add a scroll effect. The source also recommends adding your site title, company logo, and site menu to the header; features from apps you added, such as the Wix Stores cart icon, can be added too. It is not possible to delete the header, but you can change the layout to one with no header or footer. You can hide the header and footer from specific pages by changing the page's layout; it is not possible to hide only the header and not the footer. It is not possible to move the header to a different part of your site page, but you can resize it by clicking and dragging the drag handles.

title: How can I translate my Wix forms using Wix Multilingual?
content:
Make sure Wix Multilingual is installed on your site. To translate your Wix Forms:

For New Forms:
- Go to Translation Manager in your site's dashboard.
- Click Forms on the left to see the forms available for translation.
- If you auto-translated your site, review the automated translations and edit if necessary; if you did not use auto-translation, translate the fields manually. You can also click Auto-translate below a field to auto-translate that specific field.
- Click Save and Publish.

For Old Forms:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top of the editor.
- Select the language you want to edit.
- Click the relevant form on the page.
- Select a field or any text box on your form and click Edit Translation to translate it.
- Some fields can only be translated by clicking the More Actions icon and selecting Edit label.

Order forms:
- Order forms are currently not available to translate in the Translation Manager. To translate an order form, go to your editor.
- Go to the main language version in your editor.
- Click the Switch Language drop-down menu at the top of the editor.
- Select the language you want to manage.
- Click the order form on the page.
- Select a field or any text box on your form and click Edit Translation to translate it.

title: How can I set a weekly or monthly rate for a room in Wix Hotels?
content: To set weekly or monthly rates in Wix Hotels, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Rooms tab, click the Edit icon for an existing room or click Create New to add a new one, scroll down to the Price section, click More Pricing Options, enter the weekly and/or monthly price, and click Save. Note that this information refers to the original Wix Hotels; Wix Hotels by HotelRunner is not yet available to all users.

title: Can I edit staff members' timecard reports in Wix Retail POS?
content: Yes, it's now possible to add, delete, or edit staff members' timecard reports.

title: How can I add a button in my Wix Member App to allow members to call me directly?
content: Yes — members can contact you directly through the app with a call phone number button. In your app editor, select the button, open the Select button action drop-down and choose Call phone number. Then enter your phone number in the Add phone number section. Optionally, edit the Button text to what you want displayed on the button.

title: How can I delete multiple elements from my Wix site at once using the Editor?
content:
To select and delete multiple elements at once in the Wix Editor:

- Open the Editor.
- Click and drag your cursor to mark all the relevant elements.
- Choose how you want to delete the elements:
    - Keyboard: Press Delete on your keyboard.
    - Right-click menu: Right-click the element, then click Delete.

Tip: You can also multi-select elements by holding down the Ctrl key on your keyboard and clicking the relevant elements.

title: What should I do if my ADI site is not displaying correctly on my mobile device?
content: If your ADI site is not displaying correctly on your mobile device, check that your device and browser are supported: supported operating systems are iPhone iOS 12 and above and Android 9.0 and above; supported browsers are Google Chrome and Safari for iOS (version 12 and above). Make sure you are using the most up-to-date version of your mobile browser and that it is compatible with Wix (Chrome or Safari). If not, download a new browser from the Apple App Store or the Google Play Store. Clear your browser's cache and cookies; for instructions, choose Android or iPhone. If the problem persists, contact us and provide the manufacturer and model of your mobile device, the Operating System (OS), the browser and exact browser version, the type of connection (3G, Wifi, or both), the network name if the issue occurs on a 3G/4G connection only, and a screenshot of the issue.

title: How can I create an invoice for a custom order using Wix Retail POS?
content: Creating an invoice is not possible on the tablet; use a desktop computer. In the Orders tab, create a manual order. You can select store products or Wix Bookings services, or add a custom item. You don't need to select a shipping option. Then select the order from the list of orders in the dashboard and create an invoice. You can optionally send the invoice to your customer or print it using the options at the top of the invoice. If you want to collect a deposit on the POS tablet, open the POS tablet, tap Sales History from the bottom bar, tap the relevant sale, tap Collect at the top right, tap Split Total at the top right, enter the deposit amount, tap Continue, select a payment method and complete the first part of the payment, tap Continue, and tap Mark as Partially Paid. To complete the sale, go into Sales History in the POS tablet, tap the relevant sale, tap Collect at the top right, and accept payment as you would for any POS sale.

title: How can I customize the text formatting of my Wix blog post?
content: To customize your post's text formatting in Wix Blog, use the Post Composer's rich text editor: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Select the post that you want to edit, or create a new post. Highlight the text that you want to format. Customize your text using the formatting settings: Click the Text Style drop-down to choose and apply a text style. You can also choose to update the current style to match the selected text, or reset the style to its default. Click the Bold icon, Italic icon, or Underline icon to apply the style to the text. Click the Text color icon to choose a color for the text. Click the plus icon to choose a color by hex number, or click Reset to default to reset the text color. Click the Highlight color icon to highlight the text with a color. Click the plus icon to choose a color by hex number, or click Reset to default to reset the text color.

title: How can I disconnect my existing Facebook Shop from Wix before the changes in April 2024?
content: Go to Facebook shop in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon. Select Disconnect Account. Click Disconnect Account to confirm. Note: disconnecting your Facebook shop will also disconnect your Instagram shop, if you have one.

title: How can I change the URL structure of my multilingual site on Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Multilingual. Click Settings. Click Edit next to URL structure. Select Subdirectories, Subdomains, or Language parameters. Click Save. When you change your site's URL structure, your site's previous URLs automatically redirect to the new URLs.

title: How can I ensure that my use of Google Analytics is compliant with GDPR regulations?
content: If you choose to use Google Analytics, check the privacy controls settings on the Google Analytics dashboard and apply the relevant settings according to your jurisdiction’s laws and regulations. If needed, you can consult with a local attorney to advise you whether the use of Google Analytics on your website is compliant with your local laws. You can use IP anonymization to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google if required. The Google Analytics integration is applied to your whole website. If you have reason to believe that you should not use Google Analytics on a specific page on your website, you should not use this integration. The decision whether or not to use Google Analytics is yours, and Google Analytics is only used on your site if you actively connect it.

title: Can I connect my existing Klarna account to Wix Payments?
content: Currently, it is not possible to link an existing Klarna account to Wix Payments. Adding Klarna to your site as a payment method, provided by Wix Payments, requires creating a new Klarna account.

title: How can I reduce the spacing between images in my Pro Gallery on Editor X?
content: Click the Pro Gallery, then click Settings. Click the Layout tab, then click Customize Layout. Scroll down to Design Settings, then drag the slider under Spacing to reduce the gaps between images.

title: How can I continue using VKontakte features on my Wix site now that the app is no longer available?
content: This app has been retired from the Wix App Market and is no longer supported. If you would like to remain using the VKontakte (VK), Community app, create a widget in your VKontakte account and embed the code in your Wix Editor. This allows you to continue adding VK widgets to your Wix site.

title: How can I connect Payguru as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Payguru as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Payguru.
- If you have an account, enter your Merchant Id, Service Id and Private Key, then click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create Payguru account, register for a Payguru merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved, you will be provided with your unique Merchant Id, Service Id and Private Key.
- Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I set a minimum order amount in my Wix Store?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Settings, click Store products & Inventory, click the Set a minimum subtotal toggle to enable it, and enter the minimum amount an order must reach to complete checkout.

title: How can I assign a Premium plan to a different site in my Wix account?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you wish to reassign. Click Assign to a Different Site. Select the checkbox next to the relevant site. Click Next. Click Assign to confirm. Before you begin: If you reassign a Premium plan, the premium features (e.g. the ability to connect a domain, removal of Wix ads) are removed from the original site. Assigning your Wix Premium plan to a Wix Studio or Editor X site requires an upgrade to a Wix Studio plan. Upgrades can only be made to plans which offer more features. Statistics and data related to email campaigns do not transfer with the email campaigns themselves. In addition, data related to site-specific features (e.g. apps, SEO settings and tracking tools, analytics) does not transfer.

title: How can I view the most clicked elements on a specific page in Wix Analytics?
content: In Wix Analytics, go to the Behavior Overview and locate the Top pages section. Use the search bar to find the specific page, then click the page to view stats just for that page. On the right you see all the available metrics, and on the left you see the most clicked elements on the page.

title: How can I create an automation for a new Wix Form to send a thank you email after a form submission?
content: To create an automation for a new Wix Form, go to Automations in your site's dashboard, click + New Automation, and click + Start from Scratch. Click the title to give your automation a name. In the Trigger section, click Wix Forms (blue icon). Under Select a trigger, choose Form submitted. Under Select which forms trigger this automation, choose Any or Specific. Use the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency: Don't limit (trigger every time), Once per contact, or Once per contact every 24hrs. Optionally add a delay between the trigger and its action, and optionally add a condition. Choose an action and select an email action to send an email. Customize the sender details, email template, and email type. Optionally add a chain of follow-up actions. Click Activate to save and activate the automation. You can send an automated email when a site visitor submits a form and customize the sender details, email template, and email type.

title: How can I reschedule an appointment using the Wix app?
content:
To reschedule an appointment using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Calendar.
- Tap Calendar.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant session.
- Tap Edit.
- Edit the date, location, and session start time.
- Optional: Edit additional session details, such as duration, staff member, and relevant resources.
- Optional: Tap Show free time slots to view other available time slots of the staff member and select a new time.
- Optional: Tap Add note to self to add a personal note about the appointment.
- Optional: Tap the Notify client with an email checkbox and add a message to update your customer.
- Tap Save.

title: How can I stretch my Wix blog feed to full width?
content:
To stretch your blog feed to full width in Wix:

1. Click your blog feed in your Editor.
2. Click the Stretch icon.
3. Click the Stretch to full width toggle to enable it.
4. Drag the Margins slider to change the margins, or enter a pixel number. Note: The margin limit is 80 pixels.

If you are using a Post List, you can stretch it to full width as well by selecting the Post List in the Editor and following steps 2-4 above.

title: Does Wix Stores update the inventory when a product is added to the cart?
content: Currently, your product inventory in Wix Stores updates once a customer purchases a product, not when the product is added to the cart. It is now possible to choose whether inventory updates when the order is placed or when you receive payment.

title: Can I manage my business email from the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to manage your business email on the Wix app. You can access your business email in your account on desktop.

title: How can I add a cover image to my Wix blog post?
content: To add a cover image to a post in Wix Blog, go to Blog in your dashboard, select the post that you want to add a cover image to, click Settings, enable the Display Cover Image toggle, click the image box to add a new cover image, click +Upload Media to add an image from your computer, or select an image from your site files or one of the stock image options such as Media from Wix, click Add to Page, then click Save or Publish to apply the changes. Tip: You can also add a cover image by adding an image in the content of your post.

title: How can I ensure my Vimeo video is properly embedded on my Wix site?
content: Log into Vimeo and go to your video manager. Click the relevant video to open the video edit page. Click Privacy on the right. Under the Link section, set the Who can watch? setting to Public. The selection will save automatically. Find the Embed section at the bottom of the panel. Set the Where can this be embedded? setting to Anywhere. This selection will also save automatically. Ensure that the video link privacy setting from the icon next to share and Embed in the top right corner is set to Public. Note: Vimeo has recently updated their privacy settings which requires you to also select a maturity rating for your videos before it can be set to public.

title: How can I create and set up a member badge in Wix Blog?
content: Create any badges your blog needs and design them to suit the look and feel of your site. To create your first badge, go to the Site Member tab in your dashboard and click More Actions at the top right. Badges appear on the Members page on profile cards, and when a site visitor clicks to view a member's profile, they can see the badge there as well, including the badge description if you added one.

title: How can I transfer my domain purchased elsewhere to Wix?
content: To transfer your domain to Wix, first get an authorization code from your current registrar and unlock your domain. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click Add an Existing Domain, and select Transfer your domain to Wix. Read the information on your screen and click Start Transfer. Enter the domain you want to transfer, select the domain host you purchased it from, and click Continue. Log in to the account where your domain was purchased, then select I logged in in your Wix account. Unlock your domain from your current domain host, then select I unlocked it. Get the authorization code from your current domain host, paste it under Enter authorization code, and click Continue. Select an extension period of at least one year and click Continue; if you have a free domain voucher, it is automatically applied. Check and/or edit your contact information, click Continue, and select a privacy option: Private Registration or Public Registration. Click Continue, select your payment method, and click Submit Purchase. Once submitted, an email is sent from wix-team@registrar.wix.com to your domain's registrant email confirming the transfer has been initiated. The transfer may take up to 7 days to complete.

title: How can I change the initial document number for invoices and price quotes in Wix?
content:
Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Getting paid under Finance and Payments. Choose whether you want to change the number of an invoice or price quote:

Invoice document number:
- Click the Invoices tab.
- Click Header details.
- Click Edit invoice numbering in the Document name and number section.
- Enter the number you wish to use in the Start numbering at field.
- Click Done.

Price Quote document number:
- Click the Price Quotes tab.
- Click the Edit icon in the Price quote numbering section.
- Enter the number you wish to use in the Start numbering at field.
- Click Save.

Important: After creating your first invoice or price quote, you cannot replace the number you originally set with a lower number.

title: How can I restore some deleted products?
content: Currently, it is not possible to restore a product after it has been deleted. Tip: If you want to temporarily remove products from your store, you can hide them.

title: How can members make their profile public when signing up or later?
content: When new members sign up, they can select the checkbox to make their profile visible to all other members. From their My Account page, members can change whether their profile is private or public under Profile Visibility.

title: What are the best practices for creating image ads on Facebook?
content: Follow these best practices for image ads: 1) Showcase your product and/or service with a clear image so viewers immediately understand what you're advertising. 2) Use high-resolution images and follow image formatting guidelines so the image does not look blurry or pixelated. 3) Keep ad text in the headline, description, and call-to-action rather than crowding the image. If text must appear on the image, keep it minimal and in a corner. 4) Follow the 20% rule: Facebook research found that image ads with less than 20% text perform better. 5) Use the correct URL formatting when linking your store or services so the link does not break: link to a specific page that is part of your main domain and exactly matches the page name, and do not include spaces or special characters in the URL.

title: How can I delete an expired business email from my Wix account?
content: There is currently no way to completely delete a business email that has already expired from your Wix account. The subscription will still be visible in case you want to repurchase that business email in the future.

title: Why are my notifications being sent from the default site name instead of my domain name?
content:
Currently some users are experiencing an issue where their notifications are sent from the default site name rather than from their domain name. We're aware of the issue and are currently gathering more information regarding this matter.

In the meantime, you can do the following to resolve the issue:
Un-assign your domain. Rename your site. Assign your domain back to the site.

title: How can I add a new field to my CMS collection in Wix?
content:
Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections.

- Click the relevant collection.
- Click Manage Fields.
- Click + Add Field.
- Choose the type of field you want to add and click Choose Field Type.
- Enter the Field name.
- (Velo only) If necessary, update the Field ID, which is used in the site's code. You cannot update this ID later.
- (Optional) Enter help text to include a tooltip in your collection next to the field name.
- (Text and Address field types only) Click the Personally Identifiable Information toggle to encrypt sensitive information like social security and passport numbers.
- Click Save.

title: How can I set up a Wix Photo Albums Store to sell digital files and prints?
content:
Important: Wix Photo Albums Store is not available to all users. It is no longer possible to add Wix Photo Albums Store to your site. As an alternative, you can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your photos. To accept payments on your site, you need a Business & eCommerce Premium plan.

If you are using the Wix Photo Albums Store, it is only available for new albums. Create a new album, then in your site's dashboard go to the Photo Albums tab, click + New Album, choose an album cover style and layout, add your business name or logo, enter an album name, upload media, and create the album. Then click Store, click Set Up Store, choose Digital Files & Prints or Digital Files Only, set your currency, select the products you wish to sell, set pricing for prints or digital products, enter your business information, complete the ownership confirmation, click Done, and click Publish Now.

title: How can I cancel my Ascend by Wix plan and what should I know about refunds?
content: You can cancel your Ascend plan at any time from the Subscriptions section of your Wix account. To cancel your Ascend plan: go to Subscriptions in your Wix account; click the Show More icon next to the plan you want to cancel; click Cancel Ascend; select Cancel auto renew; enter the reason for cancelling your plan; click Submit. If you cancel your Ascend plan within the first 14 days after initial purchase, the plan will be canceled and refunded immediately.

title: How can I add funds to my Wix Payments account to cover a refund if my current balance is insufficient?
content:
To issue a refund and add funds from your Wix Payments account on desktop: go to Payments in your site's dashboard, select the payment to refund, click Refund, enter the amount you wish to refund, optionally add a note, click Refund, and confirm by clicking Yes, Refund. If you need to add funds to refund your customer, click Add Funds & Complete Refund, enter your credit / debit card details, and click Add Funds & Complete Refund.

In the Wix app: go to Payments, tap the payment to refund, tap Refund, optionally tap the Note icon to add a note and tap Save, enter the amount to refund, tap Issue Refund, and tap Issue Refund again to confirm. If you need to add funds to refund your customer, click Add Funds & Complete Refund, enter the amount of funds to be added and tap Continue, then enter your payment details and tap Add Funds.

Once the funds are processed, Wix automatically refunds the relevant customer. It may take up to 3-5 business days for the refund to appear in your customer's statement.

title: How can I add mobile-only collapsible text to my Wix mobile site?
content: In the mobile editor, click **Add to Mobile** on the left side, click **Text**, click **Collapsible Text**, then click and drag your chosen text box to add it to your site. These text boxes are mobile-only and do not appear on your desktop site.

title: How do I add and set up a slider input element in the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin, add the CMS to your site and make sure you have a collection with suitable permissions for storing submissions from the slider input element.

In the Wix Editor: click Add Elements, click Input, click Slider, and drag the slider element onto the page. Click Settings on the slider element. Enter the Field title. Choose the Slider type: Continuous or Stepped. If you choose Stepped, select an option under Set steps by: Step Value or Number of steps. Under Value range, choose the minimum and maximum value and the default selected value. Optional: select Read only to restrict the slider from writing content to the collection. Click the Layout icon to edit spacing, handle appearance, steps layout, value label, prefixes and suffixes. Click the Design icon to choose a preset design, then click Customize Design.

To connect the slider to the CMS: click the slider element, click Connect to CMS, choose or add a dataset that connects to your collection, and choose the number field under Selected value connects to. In Dataset Settings, set Dataset mode to Write or Read & Write, set Collection Permissions as needed, including Form submissions, and click Save. Create a submit button that visitors click to submit their inputs.

title: Can I set the hotel availability calendar to show a specific room type?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set your hotel availability calendar to show a specific room type only. Guests can select the room type themselves on the calendar.

title: How can I track Core Web Vitals for all my organization's sites using the account level monitoring dashboard?
content:
You can quickly and easily track the Core Web Vitals scores for all your organization's sites in the account level monitoring dashboard. Core Web Vitals include:

* **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP):** An indication of a site's loading time - more specifically, how long it takes for the largest content element in the site's viewport to load.
* **Interaction to Next Paint (INP):** An assessment of your site's responsiveness to all click, tap, and keyboard interactions that occur throughout each visit on every page. The final INP value is the longest interaction observed.
* **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS):** A measurement of unexpected movements of elements that change the layout of the page.

By tracking these metrics, you can identify areas for improvement and optimize site performance to enhance site visitor satisfaction. For more detailed, site-specific insights, you can click **View Breakdown** next to the relevant site to explore specific metrics and receive improvement tips.

title: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Google Workspace business email through Wix?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant business email. Click Cancel business email. Select the I still want to cancel checkbox. Click Cancel business email. Turning off auto renewal does not cancel the business email immediately; it prevents the subscription from automatically renewing, and you still have access until the end of its subscription period. Tip: You can see the exact date in the Next payment due section of Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.

title: How can I add a strip to my Wix site and what are some tips for using strips effectively?
content:
To add a strip: Click Add on the left side of the Editor, click Strip, select the type of strip you want to add, then drag a strip element onto your page.

Tips:
- Strips look particularly great on one-page sites.
- You can add another one by clicking the Add strip icon at the top or bottom of the strip.

title: How can I create an appointment in Wix Bookings without displaying a price?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a New Service. Under Appointment, click Edit below the relevant appointment template or click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template. Fill out the Service details section. In the Price & payment section, select Custom price from the Price type drop-down, then describe the price or how you charge for this service under Price Description (for example, "Prices Vary" or "Free after lunch"). Optionally fill out the remaining sections of the appointment (e.g. Locations, Staff & availability). Click Save.

title: How can I use the calculation unit to set the size of elements in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, Calculation is a handy tool when you need to accurately size an element while using fluid units of measure. Using mathematical principals, you can write a "formula" that determines an element's width or height. You can combine different measurements in this calculation (e.g., vh and px). For instance, you can use calculation to design a header (100px) and a section that, together, take up the exact viewport height (100vh) in every screen size. You can set the section's height to (100vh - 100px), so the header is always taken into account in the calculation (100px).

title: Can customers pay in installments when purchasing products in Spaces by Wix?
content: Currently, when a customer is purchasing products in Spaces by Wix, they need to pay the entire amount upfront. It's not possible to allow customers to pay in installments.

title: How can I delete a field from my CMS collection without causing issues on my site?
content: Before deleting, make sure the field is not used in any datasets, SEO settings, or connected page elements. To delete the field: go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your editor and then click Your Collections; click the relevant collection; click Manage Fields; hover over the relevant field and click the More Actions icon; click Delete; click the Yes, delete field checkbox and click Delete. You cannot delete a field if it is used in the dynamic page's URL slug structure. If you're unsure if a field is in use, you can hide it from your collection view instead of deleting it. If you accidentally delete a field, you can use backups to restore the collection.

title: How can I set up a 301 redirect from one domain to another using Wix?
content: To set up a 301 redirect from one domain to another using Wix: set up 301 redirects for the relevant pages on your new site, and skip this step if you have already set up redirects for your site's pages; connect your secondary external domain to Wix; connect the secondary domain to the primary domain connected to your Wix site. Important: to use this feature, you need to upgrade your site and connect a domain. It is not possible to set up a 301 redirect from a free Wix URL to a premium site.

title: How can I hide the Event Details page for RSVP events in Wix Editor?
content:
The Event Details page can be hidden only if your site has only RSVP events. It cannot be hidden on sites that have any ticketed events, including canceled ticketed events.

In Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Go to the Event Details & Registration page:
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click Event Pages.
- Click Event Details & Registration.
- Click the Event Details element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click Pages.
- Enable the Show this page when visitors register toggle to show or hide this page.

title: Can I toggle on or off the date of the last update to a blog post on mobile in Wix Blog?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to toggle on or off the date of the last update to a blog post on mobile. As a workaround, you can disable the mobile display settings in your post settings.

To disable the mobile display settings:
- Go to your Editor.
- Click the mobile Editor icon at the top right.
- Click your blog in the mobile Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Display.
- Click the Enable mobile settings toggle to disable it.

title: How can I create a new tax category in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
To create a tax category in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner:

- Go to Tax Categories in your site's dashboard.
- Click **+ Add Tax Category**.
- Enter the **Tax category name**.
- Click to select the relevant **Discount type**:
  - **Adjust based on a fixed amount:** Enter the relevant amount in the field provided.
  - **Fixed percentage:** Enter the relevant percentage amount. Click to select the **Included in price** toggle if you want your guests to be able to see the tax category when they book.
- Select the relevant option from the **Revenue account** drop-down.

**Tip:** Be sure to assign the tax category to the correct revenue account for accurate bookkeeping.

- Under **Tax by time period**, click to select the relevant checkbox: **Per stay** or **Per night**.
- Under **Tax by unit**, click to select the relevant checkbox: **Per room** or **Per person**.
- Click **Save**.

title: How can I change the text on a menu item in the Wix Editor?
content: To change the text on a menu item in the Wix Editor: Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor. Hover over the relevant page/menu link. Click the Show More icon. Click Rename. Type the new page name. Click Done.

title: How can I require manual approval for new site visitors on my Wix Blog?
content: Go to Signup, Login, and Security in the Settings section of your site's dashboard. Under "Who can be a site member?", select whether you want everyone to be able to sign up or only people you manually approve. Click Save.

title: How can I set my availability to receive project requests in the Wix Marketplace?
content: As a Partner in the Wix Marketplace, go to Marketplace Overview in your Wix Studio workspace and use the Availability toggle to enable or disable availability. When Enabled, clients can find your profile in the Wix Marketplace to send you project requests, and Wix can send you leads. When Disabled, your profile is hidden from the Wix Marketplace, and you cannot receive project requests from clients or leads from Wix. It's essential to set your availability to prevent receiving project requests or leads when you're unavailable. Failure to respond to requests within 3 days can impact your ranking.

title: How can I use the Nash: All-in-1 Local Delivery app with my Wix site?
content: To use the Nash: All-in-1 Local Delivery app, you need to add Wix Restaurant Orders to your site. The app is only available in English. It connects your store to a global network of delivery providers, including Uber, Relay, and Roadie, and lets you personalize tracking links and notifications and provide in-store pickup options. For questions and comments, contact Nash Technologies Inc directly.

title: How can I import products to my Wix Store using a CSV file?
content: To migrate products from a store built on another eCommerce platform, first export your product data from that platform. To migrate from another Wix store, export your products from that store. In your site's dashboard, go to the Store Products tab, click More Actions, click Import, then click Download CSV File. Choose Blank Wix CSV template to import products from another store, or Wix CSV with your products to update existing products. Open the CSV file and save it in CSV (Comma delimited) format. Enter the product data into the template, following the guidelines: do not add or delete columns; do not edit column names; each product must have handleId, name, fieldType, price; each variant must have handleId, fieldType, optionChoices; if you're unsure how to fill out non-mandatory fields, leave them blank; do not add fields not found in the Wix CSV Template file. Delete the rows of sample data, or leave the sample data and delete the sample products after the import, then save the file in a CSV format. To upload, go to the Store Products tab, click More Actions, click Import, click Upload CSV File, upload the updated file you saved, and click Continue. Read the import review and check for error messages. If there are no products with errors, click Import Products. If there are products with errors, correct the errors and import again or import your products as is; only products without errors are imported if you proceed without corrections. Product images may take up to one hour to upload if you have many products.

title: How can I connect AliPay as a payment method through Stripe on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to AliPay. Click Connect again. Select whether you have a Stripe account: if yes, enter your email and password; if not, sign up to create or claim your Stripe account. After setup, wait for the confirmation email sent to the email account associated with your Stripe account before continuing. Then set up local payments through AliPay in your Stripe account: go to Stripe, click Settings, and click Activate next to AliPay. Make sure the currency in your Wix account matches the currency in your Stripe account, and make sure AliPay is activated in your Stripe account.

title: What can I use Google Analytics for with my Wix site?
content: With Google Analytics integrated with Wix, you can discover where your visitors come from and what they do on your site. You can track the number of visitors to a page, where they are, how long they stay, and what keywords they use to find your site.

title: Can I make only the custom buttons clickable in the Wix Pro Gallery without affecting the gallery items?
content: Currently, it is not possible to make only the custom buttons on your Pro Gallery clickable, and not the gallery items as well. The option in the Settings tab for When clicking on an item applies to both the button and the gallery item.

title: Can I customize the 'Go to Link' text in all galleries on Wix Editor?
content: You can edit the 'Go to Link' text on the Pro Gallery. Currently, this is the only gallery in the Editor where you can edit the 'Go to Link' text.

title: Can I enable video conferencing for my services using the Wix app?
content: Currently, you cannot enable video conferencing from the Wix app. From your desktop computer, you can enable video conferencing to offer your service online.

title: Is it possible to set gallery images to open in full-screen mode when clicked in Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to set your gallery images to open in full-screen mode when clicked. You can set your images to open in a pop-up (expand mode), in which case the images open much larger, however there is always a black border around the images.

### Want an alternative?
You can add a Pro Gallery to your site, and customize the expand mode to display images in full-screen.

title: How can I add tax to my pricing plans on Wix?
content: To add tax to pricing plans: go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard, click Add Tax next to Manage tax, enter the Tax rate, select whether to Include in the price or Add to total at checkout, and click Save.

title: How can I connect Easebuzz as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Easebuzz as a payment provider on your Wix site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Easebuzz. If you have an Easebuzz account, enter your Merchant Key and Merchant Salt, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Easebuzz account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from Easebuzz with your Merchant Key and Merchant Salt credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account. Once connected, checkout is active for your chosen payment methods, and your account must be successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: How can I translate my cookie consent banner using Wix Multilingual?
content: Add and set up Wix Multilingual, then enable the cookie consent banner by going to Privacy & Cookies in your site's settings, clicking Get Started, and turning on the Display a cookie consent banner on site toggle. To translate the banner, go to the Translation Manager in your site's dashboard and click Cookie Consent Banner. Choose Auto-translation to automatically translate your text using third-party machine translation services, review the translations, optionally replace text and click the Checkmark icon to confirm, and repeat for each text. Or choose Manual translation: click the field of the text you want to translate and type your translation, or click the Translate icon to automatically translate; after reviewing, click the checkmark to save, and repeat for each text. Click Save & Publish. Auto-translation is suggested as a convenience tool only, and the translations should not be considered exact. Check your translation by viewing your site in other languages and selecting the secondary language from the language dropdown.

title: How can I add a new category in the Wix FAQ app using my site's Editor?
content: To add a new category in the Wix FAQ app using your site's Editor: Click the FAQ app in your Editor. Click Manage FAQs. Note: If a pop-up does not open, try turning off your pop-up blocker or updating your browser version. Click Add New. Select Category from the drop-down menu. Enter a new name for your category. Click the Checkmark icon to confirm.

title: How can I access my SEO reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the reports in the SEO section. Select the report you'd like to view.

title: Can members chat with each other in my Wix Forum?
content: Yes. Wix Forum adds a Members page where forum members can view other members, follow each other, see what other members have written, and chat with one another. The source also mentions a Members Chat feature and says to use the 'Click here' tip to learn more about enabling the Members Chat feature.

title: Is it possible to offer store credit to customers in Wix Stores?
content: No. Currently, it's not possible to offer store credit in Wix Stores. As an alternative, you can create a coupon for the same amount and send the coupon code to the customer.

title: How can I access additional Google Workspace business emails from my Gmail account?
content:
If you have multiple Google Workspace business emails (including @gmail.com email addresses), you can access each account directly from Gmail. If you're already signed in to a Google Workspace account, you automatically access the account's business email when you go to gmail.com. You can add or switch between accounts directly from your profile at the top right side of the page.

To access additional Google Workspace business emails: go to gmail.com and sign in to your Google Workspace account if you haven't yet; click your profile image or initial at the top right; click **Add account**; enter the email address of the additional account and click **Next**; enter the password and click **Next**.

**Tip:** Switch between email accounts in Gmail by clicking your profile image or initials at the top right, then select the business email you'd like to access.

title: How can I manage multiple workspaces in Wix Studio using the same account?
content: You can belong to multiple workspaces using the same account email address and switch between them easily. For example, if you have your own business but are also working for another agency, you can have one workspace where you manage your business sites, and also belong to the agency's workspace. You can access the sites in each workspace from the Sites page. Find a specific site using advanced filters such as Editor type, Premium plans and publish status. You can also view and manage all of your workspace subscriptions in one place. Any subscriptions that need your urgent attention will be highlighted at the top for your convenience. From the Discover page you can stay ahead of the curve with access to new releases, product updates, exciting product betas, and an insightful roadmap for all upcoming Wix features.

title: How can I create a new blog category using the Wix app?
content:
To create a new blog category using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Blog**.
- Tap **Categories**.
- Tap **Create Category**.
- Enter the **Category name**.
  **Note:** This appears in the navigation bar.
- Enter the **Category description**.
- Add an image:
  - Tap **Add Category Image**.
  - Select **All media**.
  - Select an image to upload.
  - Tap **Next**.
- Tap **Save**.

title: Can I automatically respond to customers when they place orders on my Wix Restaurant site?
content: Yes, you can now automatically respond to customers when they place orders on your Wix Restaurant site.

title: How can I choose and customize an image background for my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To choose an image background for your mobile site: Click the Background icon on the left side of the mobile editor. Click Image. In the Media Manager, choose to upload your own image, use a free Wix image, or purchase an image from Shutterstock / Unsplash. Click Change Background. Optional: Click Apply to Other Pages to add the background to other pages of your site.

To customize your image background on mobile: Click Background on the left of the mobile editor. Click Settings. Customize the following:
- Image Opacity: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your background.
- Color behind image: Click the color box and select a color from the Color Picker. This is useful if you decrease the image opacity and want a color behind the image.
- Scroll effects: None means there is no scroll effect. Freeze means the background image is frozen and does not move when you scroll.
- How's the image scaled?: Fill means the background image is displayed in its original size. Fit means the background image maintains its proportional relationship between width and height. Tile means the background displays a specific section of the image, and this section can be redefined using the Where's the image positioned? grid.
- Where's the image positioned?: Select a position on the grid to adjust which part of your image is in focus.

title: Can I use Velo Service Plugins (SPIs) within Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use Velo Service Plugins (SPIs) within Wix Blocks. This feature would allow you to use Velo SPIs in Wix Blocks, enabling you to inject your own custom logic into existing Wix app flows and integrate external services with your Blocks app.

title: How can I customize the permissions for uploading and downloading media in the Shared Gallery app?
content: After you've added the app to your site, you can start customizing your gallery's settings. Choose who has permission to upload or download media and manage your gallery. You can also choose to let your site visitors and members upload and download media. Select who can download media, upload media, and manage your gallery. Customize their level of access to your gallery, or create your own roles with definable permissions.

title: How can I create custom private pages for my site members in the new Members Area app?
content: Create your own private pages with exclusive content for members. You can design the page as you like with the elements and content you need. These pages are automatically added to the Login Bar Menu for easy access.

title: How can I delete a group in Wix Groups?
content:
To delete a group in Wix Groups:

Go to Groups in your site's dashboard.
Click the Show More icon next to the relevant group.
Click Delete.
Click Delete in the pop-up to confirm.

Important: It is not possible to restore a group once you delete it.

title: How can I create a task using Wix Automations when a form is submitted on my site?
content:
To create a task with Wix Automations:
• Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
• Click + New Automation in the top right corner.
• Click + Start from Scratch or choose a suggested automation.
• Click the title to give your automation a name.
• Select a trigger for your automation (for example, a form submitted on your site).
• Select Create a task as your automation's action.
• Enter your task in the Add a task for you or your team field.
• (Optional) Assign the task to you or someone on your team using the drop-down menu.
• Click the Set a due date toggle to choose whether to set a due date:
  - Enabled: Select a value in the Number of days to complete task field.
  - Disabled: Your task will not have a due date.
• Click the Timing section to expand it.
• Click the Choose a time to send this action drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
  - Immediately: The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
  - Set custom time: The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
• Click the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency:
  - Don't limit (trigger every time): Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
  - Once per contact: Your action will take place only once per contact.
  - Once per contact every 24hrs: Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
• Click Activate.

title: My automated emails triggered by form submissions are not sending.
content:
If automated emails triggered by form submissions are not sending, check the following using the Wix Automations and Wix Forms troubleshooting guidance:

- Check automation statistics: go to Automations in your site's dashboard, scroll to Your automations, hover over the relevant email automation, click the More Actions icon, and click View email stats.
- Check the recipient's spam folder; if needed, whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com. If you have not set a confirmed reply-to email, whitelist @automations.ascendbywix.com; if you have set a confirmed reply-to email, whitelist your email address.
- Check that the recipient's email address is active and subscribed to your mailing list; an inactive contact will not receive the email.
- Check that the recipient's email address is valid.
- Check that the form was successfully submitted in your form's submissions table.
- Check that the right form is selected as part of your trigger.
- Make sure there is an email/phone field in your form: for Send an email, the form must include an email field; for Move card in a workflow or Add a label, the form must include an email field or phone field.
- Check that the email field is the correct form field type: in your Editor, hover over the email field to make sure its title is Email Field.
- Check that the email field is synced with an email field in your Contact List: the synced field must be either Email or Email (Main).
- Check if you hold multiple email addresses for one contact; if so, automated emails are usually sent to an additional email rather than the contact's main/primary email.
- Test your automation while logged out of your Wix account, then submit your form.

title: Is there a way to center images in grid galleries when they are resized in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, there is no centering option when the images are resized in grid galleries.

title: Can I display multiple items per slide in a slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to show more than one item in each slide of a slideshow repeater. You can, however, display multiple CMS (Content Management System) items at the same time in a repeater, gallery, or table.

title: Is the loop images feature supported on all horizontal layouts in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, the loop images feature is only available on sliding or slideshow galleries. Therefore, if you have another layout selected, the option to loop images is not shown.

title: How can I upgrade an app from the Wix App Market using my site's Editor?
content: In your site's Editor, click the app, click Settings, then click Upgrade. Select your payment plan and subscription period, click Next, enter your payment information, and click Submit Purchase. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you have issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: Can I integrate my mobile POS with the Pricing Plans app to sell membership packages on my phone?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate your mobile POS with the Pricing Plans app to sell membership packages on your phone. However, you can use the Wix app on your phone to let clients purchase plans or to manually sell plans yourself.

title: How can I set up shipping rates based on weight in Wix Stores?
content: Important: If a region has no shipping rule, customers from that region cannot make purchases. If you previously set up shipping (and tax) in a merchant account (e.g. in PayPal), remove these settings before starting. Create or select a shipping region. For that region, click the Select how shipping is calculated drop-down and select Rate By Weight. Enter a name in the Shipping Option Name field, and optionally enter a time in the Est. Delivery Time field. Set up at least 2 weight ranges, each with its own price. Enter the top limit of the first weight range; the top limit of the first weight range is automatically set as the bottom limit of the second weight range. The last weight range is always "x" weight and up. To add more ranges, click Add Range; you can create up to 30 weight ranges. Optionally offer free shipping on orders above a specific price by selecting the Offer Free Shipping when customer buys over a certain amount checkbox and entering the amount. Click Add another Shipping Option to add additional options, optionally check Add a handling fee to every order and enter the handling fee, then click Save.

title: How can I enable autoplay for videos in Wix Video, and what should I do if I'm using the strip layout?
content:
To enable or disable autoplay in Wix Video:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Wix Video player on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Player tab.
- Click the Autoplay on load toggle:
  - Enabled: Your videos play automatically when the page loads.
  - Disable: Visitors have to click to play the videos.

Note: Videos set to autoplay always start on mute due to browser restrictions.

Using autoplay with the strip and slider layouts:
The Autoplay on load toggle is not available for the strip and slider layouts. You can get a similar effect in strip layout using the following workaround:
- Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard.
- Click Channels on the left.
- Select the channel that you want to play automatically.
- Click Edit on the right.
- Under Channel cover, click Upload or Change.
- Add the video or GIF file that you want to autoplay.
- Click Save on the top right.

Select the channel with the automatically playing cover to appear in the Wix Video player on your site:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Wix Video player on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Select the channel that you updated with the automatically playing cover video.
- In the Player tab, select Channel cover under "What to show in frame"?

Note: Only GIF files will work on your mobile site.

title: How can I resolve the 'Default mail client is not properly installed' error message when clicking an email link on my website?
content:
If you receive the error message: "Default mail client is not properly installed," you are experiencing a local issue related to the email configuration of your browser or computer. This issue occurs when you click an email link from your live site if you do not have a defined default mail client for your device. To resolve this issue, make sure you've set a default mail client in your browser's settings.

Important: This issue is localized to your computer and should not affect your visitors unless they have also not set up a default mail client. If you haven't set up a mail client on your device, you will experience this issue when clicking "mailto:" links on any websites (not just Wix sites).

To avoid this issue, we recommend displaying your email address on your site and using a contact form.

title: How can I add a new item to my site menu in ADI?
content:
To add a menu item:

- Click the header section inside ADI (at the top of your site).
- Click **Edit** next to Menu.
- Click **Add Menu Item** on the bottom of the panel.
- Select where you want the link to connect to:
  - **None:** Creates an unlinked item on your header.
  - **Page:** Select a page within the site and where on the page it links to.
    - **Note:** You will not see an option to select a page section if you have a one-page site.
  - **Web Address:** Creates a link to an external website.
  - **Document:** Lets you link to an external document (E.g. .docx, .xls, .ppt, .pdf, etc.)
  - **Email:** Create a link to an email of your choice.
  - **Phone:** Creates a link to a phone number you can dial to via an external app.
    - **Note:** People that visit your site on mobile can call you.
  - **PayPal Donations:** Connect a PayPal email address with currency and amount.
- Click **Done**.
- Type the title for your item. This title is displayed on your menu.

title: How can I create an automation in Wix to send an email to someone who submits a CMS form?
content:
To send an email to the person who triggered the automation by submitting your form, you must first use the Create a contact action, then add a Send an email action.

- After selecting CMS as your trigger, select the Create a contact action.
- Click Match Data.
- Select + Add Field and choose the Email field.
- Click the drop-down under Automation data and select the Email field that collects the form submitter's email address.
- Repeat these steps for each field you want the automation to update with data submitted by your custom form.
- Click OK.
- Select an option under If a similar contact already exists to choose what happens if you already have a contact with the same email or phone number: Update the existing contact (override the existing contact's contact info); Create a duplicate contact (create a new duplicate contact with the matched custom form data); Do nothing (do not override existing contact info or create a new contact from the matched custom form data).
- Click + Add an Action at the bottom, then select the Send an email action.
- Customize the email that will be sent in the Create an email drop-down.
- Click the Set email type drop-down to choose the type of email that is sent.
- Click Set recipients and make sure Include trigger contact is checked. This ensures that the recipient who triggered the automation receives the email. You can click Change to select an alternative email address where this automated email will be sent.
- Click Activate when you are done setting up the automation.

title: How can I set up call forwarding to my agents using the Wix dashboard?
content:
Before you begin, make sure to add call agents to your team.

To set up call forwarding from the Wix dashboard: go to Business Phone Number in your site's dashboard, click + Add Forwarding Number in the General tab, then select the desired call agent from the Select a call agent dropdown.

Note: Click Add Call Agent to add more agents to your team.

Optional: Click and drag the Reorder icon next to the relevant number(s) to set the order in which calls are forwarded to agents.

If you no longer want to forward incoming calls to an agent: on the General tab, hover over the relevant agent under Call Forwarding, then click Remove and Confirm the change.

When you remove a call agent from your call forwarding list, that person can still make outgoing calls and they remain a call agent.

title: Can customers choose a delivery window for their orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. Customers can now choose a delivery window when placing an order. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I connect KOMOJU as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect KOMOJU as a payment provider on your Wix site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to a payment option provided by KOMOJU. If you have a KOMOJU account, enter the Secret Key from KOMOJU and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create KOMOJU account, follow the sign-up instructions, and after approval repeat the connection process using your Secret Key. If KOMOJU is already connected and you want to add another payment method, sign in to KOMOJU, add the payment method and confirm it is active, then go to Accept Payments in your dashboard, click Manage next to KOMOJU, and enable the toggle for the desired payment method. Make sure the payment method is active in KOMOJU. For Convenience Store payments (Konbini), confirm the payment in your KOMOJU account before the transaction can be completed in Wix. Bank Transfer payments may take longer to process.

title: How can I set the availability of a dish for online ordering in Wix Restaurants?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Menus. For a dish, go to the relevant dish, hover over it and click Edit, then click Edit next to Online ordering. Select the In stock checkbox: selected means the dish appears on your live site; deselected means the words "Sold Out" appear on your live site next to the dish. Select or deselect the availability checkboxes: Delivery, Pickup and Contactless Dine-in, Site, Mobile (Mobile & App), and Phone order. Click Edit in the Availability section to set the hours in which customers can order. Choose Opening Hours and click Apply, or choose Custom Hours, select the days the dish is available, enter the hours for the days you selected, and click Apply. For dishes only, select the checkbox under Special Requests to allow customers to ask for special requests or modifications to a dish. Click Save.

title: How do I connect a signature input element to a CMS collection in Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin, make sure to add the CMS to your site or enable coding if you haven't already, and make sure you have a CMS collection for storing the submitted signatures.

In your Wix Editor:
- Click the signature input element.
- Click the Connect to CMS icon.
- Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, select Add a Dataset, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click Create.
- Click the Value connects to drop-down and select the Image field in which you want to save the signatures. Select Add new field if you need to add an Image field for storing the signatures.
- If needed, adjust the dataset settings: click Dataset Settings in the Connect Video Player panel on the right; click the permission type next to Permissions to edit your collection's permissions & privacy settings; click the Dataset mode drop-down and select Read & Write or Write.
- Add a Submit button for visitors to click to submit their signature and responses to any other input elements that connect to the dataset.
- Click Preview to test your signature input.
- Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I add a recent posts element to my Wix site and customize its settings?
content:
To add and set up a recent posts element on your Wix site, follow these steps:

- Click the Wix Forum app in your editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Add-Ons** tab.
- Click **Add to Page**.
- From the drop-down list, select the page where you want the feed to appear.
- Drag the recent posts element to position it on the page.
- Click the recent posts element.
- Click **Settings**.

Customize the settings:

- Click the **Settings** tab.
- Choose which category to display from the drop-down list.
- Select how the posts are ordered.

Customize the Layouts:

- Click the **Layout** tab.
- Select a layout.
- Click the **Show social stats** toggle to show or hide the views, likes, and comments counters.
- Drag the slider to select the number of posts you want to display.

Customize the design:

- Click the **Design** tab.
- Customize any of the colors, fonts, borders or backgrounds.

Tips:
- You can drag the stretch handles to resize the app.
- You can display up to 30 posts in the Recent Posts element.

title: Is Wix Table Reservations integrated with Wix Members Area?
content: Currently, Wix Table Reservations is not integrated with Wix Members Area.

title: Can I customize the design of the password window on a password protected page in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to design the window that is displayed on password protected pages. The design of the window (i.e. fonts and colors) is taken directly from your site's theme. Choosing a new theme automatically updates the password window's look. Changes you make to your theme apply to your entire site.

title: Why does Wix Email Marketing offer limited font options for email campaigns?
content: Wix Email Marketing provides fewer font options in order to align with email marketing best practices. This decision is also due to the fact that larger mail services, such as Gmail and Yahoo, automatically change all fonts to their preferred default fonts. The font options that are available ensure that your campaigns stick to best practices and align with the rules of most mail providers.

title: How do I add and connect the Instagram Feed app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Start by adding the app to your site. You can do this directly from the Wix App Market. In the Wix Editor: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Instagram Feed app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Select the app on the page. Click Settings. Click Connect Personal Account. Click Allow in the pop-up. Note: If the Instagram log-in pop-up doesn’t open, try turning off your pop-up blocker, or updating your browser version.

title: How can I customize an email campaign in the Wix app?
content:
To customize your campaign in the Wix app:
- Go to the email marketing dashboard in the Wix app.
- Tap the Drafts tab.
- Tap the campaign you want to customize.
- Tap Edit.
- Note: If you don't see the option to edit it means your campaign was created on a desktop and you must customize it from there.
- The customization menu opens at the bottom of the screen. Tap Background to update the campaign's background color.
- Tap the Add icon and choose an element you want to add to the campaign:
  - Text: Tap Text. Tap the text box to edit the text. Optional: customize your text using Format, Font, Size, Color, and Alignment. Format: Swipe to view the different options and tap one to choose it. Font: Swipe to view the different options and tap one to choose it. Size: Drag the slider to increase or decrease the text's size. Color: Choose a text color. Alignment: Choose how your text should be aligned: left, center or right.
  - Image: Tap Image. Choose if you want to upload an image from your device, the Media Manager, or by taking a photo.
  - Button: Tap Button. Tap the new button to edit the button text. Optional: Tap Style to select a different style for your button. Tap Color to change your button color. Choose from a preset color or tap the Add icon on the left to pick a custom color.
  - Divider: Tap Divider. Tap Format to select a style for your divider. Tap Color to change the divider's color. Choose from a preset color or tap the Add icon on the left to pick a custom color.
  - Logo: Tap Logo. Choose if you want to upload your logo from your device, the Media Manager, or by taking a photo.
- Optional: When you're done customizing tap Preview & Test to send a test email.

title: How can I use the Wix AI Assistant to optimize my site's organic search traffic?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Help me grow my site traffic under Analytics. This opens the Wix AI Assistant on the right. Type "Yes" to confirm, then review the suggestion you got and follow the steps: set up your Google Business Profile by clicking Set Up Profile; note that to create a Google Business Profile you need a connected domain and a physical location where you serve customers. Verify your site ownership by clicking Verify Ownership. Write a blog post using Wix Blog. Connect to Google Merchant Center by clicking Connect to Google and following the steps.

title: How can I create a restaurant floor plan using Wix Restaurants?
content:
To create your restaurant floor plan, go to Table Reservations (New) in your site's dashboard. Click Floor Plan View, then click Edit layout. From there you can choose what to add or customize:

**Add and customize tables**: Click a Round or Rectangular table on the left, click the map to add it, and optionally drag the resize handles. In Table Properties, edit Table Name, Min & Max Seats, and enable or disable Let guests reserve this table online. Under Layout, edit Width, Height, and Rotate.

**Add and customize text**: Click Text, click the map to place it, then under Layout edit Text, Text size, Text color, and Rotate.

**Add and customize rectangles or circles**: Click Rectangle or Circle, click the map to place and resize the shape, then under Layout edit Width, Height, Border size, Rotate, Shape color, and Border color.

**Add and customize lines**: Click Line, click and drag on the map to change the line length, then under Layout edit Length, Width, Rotate, and Color.

**Add icons**: Click Icons, click the map to add an icon, then under Layout edit Size, Rotate, Select icon, and Color.

**Add an image**: Click Add Image, select an image and click Apply, drag the image to position it, then under Layout edit Width, Height, and Rotate.

To delete an element, select it and press Delete. To move the entire floor plan, click the Pan icon at the top and drag the map. To move an element, select it and drag it; to move elements together, select and drag them.

title: Can I change my domain name after purchasing it if I made a typo?
content: It is not possible to edit or modify a domain once purchased. When you register a domain name you reserve the letters or characters in that order. If you have already made the purchase, the only way to change the domain name is to register a new domain. Domains purchased through Wix are set to renew automatically. We recommend that you turn the auto renewal option off for the incorrect domain to avoid paying for another year.

title: Can I customize the email address that Wix Stores notifications are sent from?
content:
Currently, no-reply@my.store-emails.com is the email address used to send Wix Stores email notifications (order confirmations, shipping confirmations, resend download link emails, and ready-for-pickup emails). It is not possible to edit the address. However, it is possible to add your store name as the sender name, so customers recognize that the email was sent from your store.

To update the sender name, go to Business Info in your site's dashboard and enter the name of your business under Name. This determines the sender name.

title: Can I display multiple images or videos in the Expand Mode of a gallery item in Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add multiple images / videos to the Expand Mode of a gallery item.

Workarounds:
- You can create a sub-gallery in a lightbox and have this serve as an expand mode for your images / videos.
- Create a Wix Portfolio with multiple images / videos under one project.

title: Is it possible to add a mobile pop-up with a Get Subscribers form in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, the mobile Editor doesn't offer a pop-up element with a Get Subscribers form, allowing visitors to join your mailing list. As a workaround, you can create a mailing subscription lightbox on desktop and enable it for mobile as well. Once you do, you can edit the lightbox and optimize its layout. Note: While you can enable lightboxes on mobile, Google defines these pop-ups as intrusive. Showing lightboxes on your mobile site might negatively impact your SEO.

title: How can I connect my own custom domain to my Wix site?
content: To get your own custom domain or connect one you already own, upgrade your site with a plan. By purchasing a plan, you can replace your free Wix domain with a custom domain name, like www.mystunningwebsite.com.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix Photo Albums storage if I'm nearing my storage limit?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. If you are approaching your storage limit, click Get extra storage at the top and select the storage plan you wish to add to your site. Alternatively, you can upgrade your site; this can be done in addition to adding a storage plan to your site.

title: Can I customize the endpoint URL for HTTP functions in Wix?
content: Currently, when exposing API endpoints using HTTP functions, you cannot customize the endpoint URL. All endpoints must start with the _functions prefix.

title: Can I disable notifications for multiple sites at once?
content: The source only states that you can now manage site notifications in your workspace; it does not state whether notifications for multiple sites can be disabled at once.

title: What responsibilities do I have as a site owner regarding content published by site members and visitors?
content: As a site owner, you are responsible for the content and comments available on your site. When using applications that allow visitors to add content such as Wix Forum, Wix Blog, Wix Video, or third-party applications, you allow your site visitors to post and publish content on your site. Therefore, all of the information posted by your visitors and members also becomes your site content. It's important that you're aware of the content published on your site, and that the content is compliant both with Wix’s Terms of Use, and also with the laws and regulations of your country. In the event Wix receives a valid court order, or law enforcement notice justifying a site's removal, we reserve our right to act upon it. This may mean immediately removing such a website, with or without notice prior to the removal. To learn more about user content and prohibited uses, please see Section 2 of our Terms of Use.

title: How can I set up custom branding for my agency in Wix Studio?
content:
To set up Custom Branding in Wix Studio:

- Go to Custom Branding in your Wix Studio workspace.
- Click Set Up Now.
- Click Upload Image under Logo.
- Select your logo and click Choose File.
- Note: Your logo should have a rectangular aspect ratio (e.g. 4:3).
- (Optional) Click the Edit icon to update your business name in the Business Info tab of your Wix Studio workspace.
- Click Add in Business Info under Business site URL to link your agency's logo to your business portfolio site.

Only workspace owners and co-owners can set up custom branding.

Your agency's brand will be featured in site email invitations, site dashboards, and free site banners.

Pro Tip: To maximize exposure and create a seamless brand experience, add a business site URL. This clickable link in your client's free site banners will drive traffic directly to your business portfolio site, allowing you to showcase your agency's work and services.

title: Is bKash supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer bKash as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through bKash and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I access the Wix Blog post composer from my mobile device?
content:
You can create a new post or edit an existing post directly from the Wix app on your mobile device:

* Go to the Wix app on your mobile device.
* Tap the **Site List** drop-down at the top.
* Select the relevant site.
* Tap the **Manage** icon.
* Tap **Content & Community**.
* Tap **Blog**.
* Tap **Posts**.
* Tap **Create New Post** or tap a post to edit it.
* Write or edit your blog post and tap **Next**.
* Choose what you want to do by tapping the relevant option:
    * **Save as Draft:** You can continue working on your post at a later time.
    * **Post Settings:** Edit your post settings and tap **Save**, then choose to either save your changes or schedule your post.

**Tip:** Tap the Undo icon in the bottom bar to undo a change you made to your post. Tap the Redo icon if you want to restore a change again.

**Note:** Only people with writing permissions can see the **Create a Post** button.

title: How can I enable social sharing for my Wix Pro Gallery?
