content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Click the Social sharing toggle to enable it.

title: How can I add a new room type in Wix Hotels?
content:
Wix Hotels allows you to add additional room types at any time. To add a new room type:

- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the **Hotels** tab on the left.
- Click the **Rooms** tab on the left (or the **Apartments** tab if your property type is "Apartment").
- Click **Create New** to add a new room type, or click the **Duplicate** icon and edit an existing room type.
- Fill in the room details and click **Save**.

**Note:** If you add multiple rooms of the same type (units), they are listed on your reservation calendar with the room type name and a number (e.g., Sea View 1, Sea View 2). You can change the individual room names on the reservation calendar itself.

title: Is Apex Payment Solutions supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Apex Payment Solutions as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Apex Payment Solutions and arrange the payment offline.

title: Can I set up recurring payments and pricing plans for my branded app in the Apple Store?
content: Currently, customers can only make single payment in-app purchases on your branded app in the Apple Store. Recurring payments and pricing plans are not yet supported on your app for the Apple Store.

title: How can I reactivate my domain if it was deactivated due to unconfirmed contact information?
content:
ICANN requires all domain owners to confirm their domain contact information. If you do not confirm your domain contact information within 14 days of purchase, your domain is deactivated, and a parking page replaces your site on your domain.

To reactivate your domain from your Wix account:
- Go to the Domains page. If you have more than one domain in your account, scroll to the relevant domain.
- Click Resend Confirmation Email. If you don't see this option, you do not need to confirm your domain's contact email.
- Confirm your domain's contact information: access the mailbox for your domain's contact email address, open the email titled Confirm Your Domain Contact Information sent from wix-team@notifications.wix.com, and click Confirm in the email.

To reactivate your domain from the parking page:
- Enter your domain in your browser's address bar.
- Click Reactivate Domain on the parking page. If a parking page does not appear on your domain, you must reactivate your domain from your Wix account.
- Confirm your domain's contact information: access the mailbox for your domain's contact email address, open the email titled Confirm Your Domain Contact Information sent from wix-team@notifications.wix.com, and click Confirm in the email.

Once you confirm your domain contact info, it may take up to 48 hours for your domain to propagate and display your site again.

title: Is the feature to add expandable text boxes with a Read More link supported in Wix Editor?
content: This feature is not yet available to all users. You can now add collapsible text boxes to your site. Collapsible text allows you to display content on your page without compromising your site’s layout and alignment. A preview of your text is displayed, and visitors can click a link or an expand label to view the whole body of text. Learn how to add and set up collapsible text on your site.

title: How can I add or update a CNAME record in my Wix account?
content: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records. To add a CNAME record, click + Add Record in the CNAME (Aliases) section, click Got it in the pop-up message, enter a host name in the Host Name field (leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign), enter a web address the record points to in the Value field, click Save, and click Save Changes in the pop-up message. To update a CNAME record, hover over the CNAME record and click Edit, click Got it in the pop-up message, edit the host name in the Host Name field (leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign), edit the web address the record points to in the Value field, click Save, and click Save Changes in the pop-up message. Important: If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, you must add or update CNAME records with your domain host (not Wix).

title: Can I include information from Additional Info Sections in Google Merchant Solutions when connecting Wix products?
content: Currently, when you connect Wix products to Google Merchant Solutions, your basic product information (name, price, image, etc.) is carried over. Product information in any Additional Info Sections doesn't appear in Google Merchant Solutions.

title: How can I manage my online programs using the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Online Programs. Tap the relevant tab according to the status of your program: Published, Drafts or Archived. Tap the Show More icon next to the program you want to manage, then choose one of the following:
- Edit: Edit your program's details.
- Duplicate: Make a copy of your program. This creates a copy of your program in the Draft tab.
- End: Discontinue your program at any time.
- Publish: If your program is still a draft, you can publish it from here.
- Archive: Send your program to the archive. You can find it in the Archived tab.
- Delete: Delete your program and its information permanently.

title: How can I upload media files to my Wix Studio for enterprise account and notify my clients about the new uploads?
content: Go to Media in your enterprise dashboard. Click + Upload Files at the top right. Click Upload Files to select the files you want to upload. (Optional) Choose a category for your files, or click + Add New Category to add a new one. Click Upload. Once you've uploaded a batch and want to share the news, click Notify Clients to notify your clients of the new media available for them to use in their sites. Your clients can also filter their media by the categories you've created.

title: How can I delete the Online Programs app from my Wix site using the dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Manage Apps. Click the More Actions icon next to Wix Online Programs and select Delete. Click Go to Editor. Click the More Actions icon next to Wix Online Programs and select Delete. Select your reason for deleting the app in the feedback form and tell us why (optional), then click Delete App.

title: What are the requirements to use the Product Auction app by Webkul on my Wix site?
content: To use the Product Auction app by Webkul on your site, you need to have Wix Stores or Wix Pricing Plans, have a Premium plan, and have a connected domain. This app is only available in English.

title: How can I set a page link to open in a new window using the Wix Editor?
content: To set a page link to open in a new window using the Wix Editor: Click the element. Click the Link icon. Click Page. Select New Window under How does it open?. Click Done.

title: What measures does Wix Payments take to ensure PCI Compliance for secure financial transactions?
content: Wix Payments complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS). PCI DSS is the highest information security standard for organizations or companies that accept credit card payments. It provides protection of the privacy and confidentiality of the card's data used to complete the online transaction. PCI Compliance helps create a secure environment by improving the quality of the cardholder data in order to reduce credit card fraud cases, and it ensures that the data for each payment is stored securely in a tamper-proof manner.

title: Can I customize the og:image for Instagram, WhatsApp, and iMessage using Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you cannot control the og:image on Instagram, Whatsapp, or iMessage. You can however choose the og:image for Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn.

title: How can I add and arrange anchors on my Wix one-page site?
content:
To add anchors to your page's strips and sections:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Menu & Anchor.
- Click the anchor under In-Page Navigation, or drag it to the relevant location on your page.
- Click the anchor and click Rename.
- Repeat steps 1-4 for each section you wish to mark on your site.

Note: We recommend attaching no more than one anchor to a strip or page segment. Attaching more than one may cause issues for visitors that rely on keyboards to navigate.

To arrange anchors in the layers panel:
- Click the Layers icon on the bottom of the Editor.
- Drag each anchor to be before the strip/section that it's attached to.
- Repeat steps 1-2 on the Mobile Editor.

title: How can I update my Wix Payments account settings for my Wix Retail POS?
content: Go to your site's dashboard, not via the POS tablet. Click Settings, scroll down, and click Accept Payments. Then click Manage next to Wix Payments.

title: How can I use a Pagination Bar on my Wix site?
content: To use a Pagination Bar on your site, you need to add the CMS to your site and create a collection.

title: How can I choose my preferred member app using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom, then tap Mobile App. If needed, switch from editing your own mobile app to editing the relevant member app by tapping the name of your own mobile app at the top and then tapping the relevant member app. Tap the More Actions icon at the top, tap Manage app settings, tap App preference, select the member app you want your members to use, and tap Save.

title: Is it possible to set a lightbox to open only once per site visitor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set a lightbox to only open once per visitor. As a workaround, you can create a one-time popup using Velo by Wix. Velo is an open development platform that lets you add custom functionality and interactions to your site, allowing you to control how and when your lightbox opens.

title: How can I remove design overrides on a specific breakpoint in the Studio Editor?
content:
To remove design overrides on a breakpoint:

- Select the relevant element. Tip: You can select it directly on the canvas, or the Layers panel.
- Click the More Actions icon.
- Click Remove Overrides.

Note: This resets the design and layout of the element back to its properties on the largest breakpoint. The properties of the element on smaller breakpoints are not affected, just the breakpoint that contains the element that you are reverting back. For example, if you're removing overrides on tablet, it does not affect mobile.

Did you know? You can use the responsive AI tool to quickly optimize the layout of sections across all breakpoints.

title: How do I create a new category for online programs on Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Online Programs Categories. Click Add New Category, enter a category name, click + Add Programs, select the checkbox next to the relevant programs, click Confirm, and then click Save.

title: How can I preview my site in ADI before publishing it?
content: To preview your site in ADI, click Preview on the top bar inside ADI. Browse your site. Optionally, click the mobile icon in the top bar to preview your mobile site. Click Edit Site on the top left to go back to editing mode.

title: How do I create a form using the Studio Editor?
content: Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor, then click **Contact & Forms**. Click **Create New Form** and drag the form element onto the page. You can also select a pre-installed template such as Contact, Subscribe, or Order forms. Click the form in the Editor and click **Edit Form** to open the form builder. In the form builder, click the Edit icon at the top left to name the form; this name is only visible internally. Under **Add form fields**, choose fields for the form, including Contact fields, General fields, Date fields, and Layout elements. Optionally, click a field to update settings, make it required, delete it, or resize it. Optionally, click **Rules** or **Pages** on the left to add conditional rules or multiple pages. Click **Save** at the top right. Make sure to add a **Submit** field to the bottom of the form so visitors can send it.

title: How can I claim my 1 year free domain voucher with Wix?
content: Go to the Premium Vouchers page in your Wix account to see and claim your vouchers. The voucher is valid for two months from the date that you purchased your plan. Claiming the voucher requires you to enter your payment information, but you won't be charged for the first year of the subscription; this allows the system to process renewal payments so your domain stays live after your first free year. You can check the expiration date of your voucher in the Premium Vouchers section of your account.

title: Can I display page numbers on an image gallery in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to display page numbers on an image gallery. As an alternative, you can add navigation arrows which your visitors can use to click through your gallery images.

title: How can I add alt text to my images in a Wix portfolio?
content: Go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant project and click Edit. Click Add alt text to images under SEO & Social. To write your own alt text, enter your alt text for each image and click Apply Alt Text. To generate alt text with AI, click Generate missing alt text and then click Apply Alt Text.

title: Can I create new courses using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create new courses using the Wix app on your mobile device. You can only create and schedule courses on desktop.

title: How can I assign roles to collaborators on my Wix site and what permissions do these roles have?
content: Invite people to collaborate on your site, and assign roles based on their expertise. You can access Roles and Permissions from Settings in your site's dashboard. Your Manage Roles page shows the roles available for your site. Beneath each role title is a permission summary, to confirm the access the role grants. Each site has an Owner role, and General Roles for managerial support. The Owner role is assigned to the person who created the site, or received site ownership. Owners can manage and make changes to everything on the site and in the dashboard. You can't duplicate or edit the role, and you can only reassign the role by transferring the site to a new owner. General Roles include: Admin (Co-Owner): Full access to manage, edit and publish site, including billing, inviting people and managing groups, but cannot delete or transfer a site, or connect a domain. Cannot access Inbox, contacts and other sensitive info. Website Manager: Access to manage, edit & publish site, but cannot manage billing, delete, duplicate or transfer site. Website Designer: Can edit the site, manage settings and apps but cannot access Inbox, contacts and other sensitive info. Back Office Manager: Can access the Dashboard to manage site settings and apps but cannot edit the site. When you integrate a Wix app to your site, your dashboard updates to include relevant roles. You can also create custom roles from scratch, and duplicate and edit existing roles to match your permission needs.

title: How can I set up a Multi-Checkbox input element to filter content on my live site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Add the Multi-Checkbox input element: go to the page where you want visitors to use checkboxes to filter live site content, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Input, click Checkboxes, and click and drag the relevant Multi-Checkbox input element onto the page.

Connect the Multi-Checkbox element to the CMS: click the Connect to CMS icon on the Multi-Checkbox element, select Filter content in the panel on the right, click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the elements (repeater, gallery, table) that you want visitors to filter, click the Filter content by drop-down and choose the collection field that visitors will use to filter the content, and click the Condition drop-down and choose an operator that controls how the filter is applied.

Customize the Multi-Checkbox input element: click the Settings icon to edit the field title that lets visitors know what the checkboxes do, click the Layout icon to choose a horizontal orientation or adjust the sizing, spacing, formatting, alignment, or text direction, click the Design icon to choose a preset design and customize it further, and click the Animation icon to choose and customize an animation effect.

Click Preview to test your Multi-Checkbox element. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: What should I do if my domain is in the 'Pending Renew/Delete' status and I want to retrieve it?
content:
It is not possible to retrieve your domain while it is in the "PendingRenew" or "PendingDelete" status in the WHOIS database. These statuses mean that your domain is no longer in the redemption period and registration can't be extended. To retrieve your domain, wait until it becomes publicly available again for anyone to purchase. This usually happens within 10 days from the beginning of the "PendingRenew/Delete" period.

You can only repurchase the domain once it clears the "PendingRenew/Delete" period and becomes available again. This is true for all domains in this status, not just domains purchased from Wix. It is not guaranteed that your domain will be released and become available after the "PendingRenew/Delete" period. This is why we recommend resolving any payment issues before your domain enters this period.

To check your domain's status in the WHOIS database, use Wix's WHOIS lookup tool. Search for your domain name (including the top-level domain, for example, mystunningwebsite.com) and look for Domain Status in the results.

To check when your domain is available to purchase again, monitor the domain status in the WHOIS lookup tool and repurchase it as soon as it becomes available. Once the domain is no longer in the "PendingRenew/Delete" status, you can check if the domain is available to purchase.

title: How can I customize the buttons of a hamburger menu in Wix Editor?
content:
To customize the buttons of a hamburger menu in Wix Editor:

- Select the hamburger menu in your editor.
- Choose which button you want to customize:
  - Menu button: Click the button.
  - Close button: Click Edit Menu, then click the Close button in the container.
- Choose how to customize the button:
  - Design the button: Click the Design icon to customize the button's look.
    - Replace design: Select a new button design from the panel.
    - Adjust design: Click Customize Design to further personalize the button:
      - State: Choose Regular or Hover.
      - Background fills: Choose a color and make it more or less opaque.
      - Text: Set the font, text size, color, and formatting.
      - Borders: Add and customize a border.
      - Corners: Set the radius in pixels to make the button rounder or more square.
      - Shadows: Add and adjust a shadow for a 3D effect.
      - Layout: Make the padding around the button bigger or smaller.
      - Icon: Set the size, color, and rotation of the button angle.
    - Note: Available options depend on what you choose to display on the button: text, icon, or both.
  - Adjust the layout and display: Click the Layout icon. Select an option under Choose what displays: Icon only; Text only; Text and icon. For Text and icon, choose Icon position relative to text: left, right, above, or below, and use the slider for spacing between text and icon. Choose Alignment: Left, right, or center.

title: How should PII data be handled and protected in Wix CMS?
content: Set the permissions of your collection properly, not allowing anyone without the relevant permission to read, update, or delete data. For any collection field that includes PII data, enable the PII toggle in the CMS; a green PII indicator appears next to the field name when the PII toggle is enabled. After marking all relevant fields as PII, publish your site to make sure the new changes take effect. All fields marked as PII are automatically migrated to be stored encrypted in the collection with a unique encryption key. Data in the field is stored encrypted using AES with a 256bit site encryption key, and encryption is applied immediately and affects both Live and Sandbox; the process may take time depending on the size of data being encrypted. PII encrypted fields have limited capabilities for searching via code or via CMS: sorting and querying operations other than "eq" are disabled, i.e. query by exact-match only. Export data can be used to work with collection data locally or to import it to a designated system, but it is not advised to retain large lists of PII locally on your workstation. PII encryption does not change data access permissions, so appropriate permissions must be set to maintain confidentiality.

title: How do I add and set up a ratings input element in the Wix Editor?
content:
Prerequisites: add the CMS to your site if you haven't already, and have a collection with suitable permissions for storing submissions from the ratings input element.

In the Wix Editor: click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Input, click Ratings, then click and drag the Ratings Input element of your choice onto the page.

Set up the ratings: click Set Up Ratings on the ratings input element, enter the Field title that will display, and use the Show hover text toggle. Enabled shows a text explanation for each rating option when visitors hover over the stars; Disabled shows no extra text. Select Required if visitors must select a rating before submitting as part of a custom form.

Use the Layout icon to choose the location of the field title and rating value, and to set value alignment, icon size, spacing, and direction. Use the Design icon to choose a preset design, then click Customize Design to adjust further.

title: Is there a way to view my past interactions with Wix Customer Care?
content: Currently, the Wix Help Center does not offer a Ticket History section where you can look up all the interactions you've had with Wix Customer Care in the past. If you are using Wix Studio, you can view your team's ticket log from your workspace.

title: How can I add and customize text in Editor X?
content: To add text in Editor X, click Add Elements at the top of Editor X, click Text, drag a text element onto your page, then click Edit text and type your text. You can choose options such as Text Themes, Titles, Collapsible Text, or Text Mask. To format your text, click the text box you want to format, click Edit Text, and use the formatting tools in the Inspector to change settings such as theme, font, scale, font size, bold, italics, underline, color, highlight, link, align, line spacing, character spacing, bulleted list, numbered list, indent, text direction, and heading tag. For responsive text across breakpoints, click the Scale Text icon to set the maximum and minimum size of your text across breakpoints. If your text still wraps into additional lines after setting the minimum and maximum sizes, try increasing the width of the text box. You can also use Stack to help keep text elements from overlapping, and set Fixed or Fluid sizing in the Inspector.

title: What are the steps to set up my Wix site to sell hemp and hemp-derived CBD products?
content:
To set up a Wix site to sell hemp and hemp-derived CBD products, follow the source-supported steps:

- Read this article to check Wix's requirements for selling hemp and hemp-derived CBD products.
- Go to the dedicated "Sell CBD on Wix" page. Create a new Wix account by clicking Get Started, or log in to your Wix account by clicking Sign in at the top right.
- Follow the steps to submit the declaration form.
- Connect your site to a payment method: click Connect next to the payment methods you want to connect. If you have an account, enter your credentials and click Sign in. If you don't have an account, click Create new account and follow the steps to create your account.
- Adjust your store's shipping regions to exclude the states that aren't supported by Wix.

title: Can I set up recurring payments using a Wix payment form?
content: Currently in Wix Forms, it is not possible to accept recurring payments using a payment form. Only one-time payments are available.

title: How can I add HTML code to a blog post in Wix?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant blog post, or click Create New Post to write a new one. Click Add on the left side, then click HTML code. Do one of the following: To add HTML code, click HTML Code, enter your HTML code, and click Save. To embed an external site, click Website Address (URL), enter a URL, and click Save. Optionally customize the element using the width, height, and alignment options. Make sure to read through the limitations of the HTML element before using it.

title: How can I add and customize mobile-only elements in the Wix Editor?
content: Access the mobile Editor by clicking the Switch to mobile icon at the top of the Editor. Use the Add to mobile panel to add elements like text, images, buttons and more. To design a mobile-only element, click the element, click the Design icon, and use the customization options available. To adjust the layout, click the element, click the Layout icon, and use the customization options available. To duplicate a mobile-only element, right-click the element, click Copy, right-click the page / strip, and click Paste. Only supported mobile elements can be copied from the desktop Editor and pasted to the mobile Editor; mobile-only elements cannot be pasted to the desktop Editor.

title: How can I manually add a reservation in the original Wix Hotels?
content:
To manually add reservations:
- Go to your dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab.
- Click the Reservations tab.
- Click New Reservation.
- Click the Reservation Status drop-down menu and select a reservation type:
  - Reserved: This booking is to reserve a room.
  - Checked In: The guests have checked in.
  - Checked Out: The guests have checked out.
  - Not Available: This room is not available.
- Enter the booking details (Check in, Check Out, etc.).
- Enter the guest details (First Name, Last Name, Phone Number, etc.). Note: Payment details will display after selecting your Room and Room Type.
- Click Save.

Tip: You can also manually add a reservation by selecting dates on the calendar and clicking Create Reservation.

title: What is the difference between static and dynamic links in Wix?
content: Static links always remain the same, while dynamic links change based on criteria such as which CMS collection item is displayed on your page. Static links maintain the same connection between the element and the link destination. In your editor, you can click the Link icon on an element to open the static link panel and decide where the link takes your site visitors. Dynamic links change based on the destination retrieved by the element's connected dataset.

title: Can I manage group posts from my site's dashboard?
content: You can now manage group posts from your site's dashboard.

title: How can I edit a guest's information for my Wix event?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Events. Select the relevant event. Select the Guests tab at the top. Click the relevant guest. Click Edit Guest Details. Edit the available information. Click Save.

title: How can I view and update my Wix domain contact information?
content:
To view and update your domain contact information, go to Domains in your Wix account, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, and click Edit contact info. If this option is missing, your domain was purchased elsewhere and you must contact your domain host to update the contact information. Edit your contact information. Optionally, use different contact information for your Technical or Administrative contacts by deselecting the Use registrant contact info checkbox below the relevant contact type and entering the person's contact details. Click Save.

Note: As a domain registrant owner, you are required to confirm your domain contact info within two weeks after registering the domain. If not confirmed within two weeks, the domain and any business email attached to it may go offline. To ensure you can still receive a confirmation email, we recommend using an email address that is not associated with your domain as your registrant contact email (e.g. gmail.com).

title: Can customers change the quantity of a specific optional extra added to a dish in Wix Restaurants?
content:
Currently, customers cannot adjust or manually enter the quantity of an optional extra added to a dish. For example, if you allow customers ordering a burger to select how many ketchup packets to include with their order.

In the meantime, you can add multiple versions of the same optional extra (e.g., First Condiment Option, Second Condiment Option) when creating the dish. This allows customers to add the same optional extra more than once.

### To add multiple versions of the same optional extra:
- Go to **Menus** in your site's dashboard.
- Hover over the relevant dish and click the **Edit** icon or click **New Dish** to add a new one.
- Add the first option:
  - Click **New Option** on the left.
  - Enter the name of the first option in the **Name** field (e.g., First Condiment Option).
  - Select **Extras**.
  - Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the first choice (e.g., Ketchup).
  - Click **New Choice**.
  - Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the second choice (e.g., Mayonnaise).
  - (Optional) Repeat the previous steps to add additional choices.
- Add the second option:
  - Click **New Option** on the left.
  - Enter the name of the second option in the **Name** field (e.g., Second Condiment Option).
  - Select **Extras**.
  - Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the first choice (e.g., Ketchup).
  - Click **New Choice**.
  - Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the second choice (e.g., Mayonnaise).
  - (Optional) Repeat the previous steps to add additional choices.
- (Optional) Repeat the process above to add another version of the option (e.g., Third Condiment Option).
- Click **Save Changes** if you are editing an existing dish or **Add Dish** if you are adding a new dish.

Now, when your customer orders this dish, they can select the same optional extra twice (two Ketchup packets) or select two different optional extras (one Ketchup and one Mayonnaise).

title: What features are included in the free version of Wix Email Marketing, and how can I check my monthly email balance?
content:
Using Wix Email Marketing for free includes:

* Drag and drop editor to easily create and edit your email templates.
* Designer-made templates to engage your recipients.
* Automated emails that are sent to the right recipients at the right time.
* Audience segmentation to target key groups of people.
* Custom reports to analyze the success of your campaigns.

The number of emails you can send using the free version of email marketing depends on your monthly balance. You can check how many emails you have left in your monthly balance from your email marketing dashboard. To send more emails per month, upgrade your email marketing plan.

title: How can I set a text field in my CMS collection to accept only specific values?
content:
To set text fields to accept specific values only:

- Go to CMS in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant collection.
- Click Manage Fields.
- Click the text field in which you want to only accept specific values.
- Click the Validations tab.
- Enable the Accept specific values only toggle.
- Enter the values that you want to make available for this field. Press Enter or add a comma (,) after each value.
- Click Save.

title: How can I add the Groups List Add-On to my Wix site?
content:
To add the Groups List Add-On to your Wix site:

- Go to the Group List page in your Editor.
  - In Wix Editor: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click Groups pages. Click Groups List.
  - In Editor X: Click Pages at the top of Editor X. Click Groups under Groups pages.
- Click the Group List element in your Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Add-Ons.
- Click the Add to Page drop-down next to the relevant add-on:
  - Group list widget: Let visitors see a list of all of your groups.
  - Side by Side: Show your groups as cards to site visitors.
  - Feed Widget: Show your public groups in a feed to site visitors.
- Select which page should show the add-on.

The Groups List Add-On is automatically placed on the page you selected.

title: Can I allow only specific collaborators to post announcements on the Wix mobile app?
content: Currently, any of your site collaborators can post announcements from the Wix mobile app to your members. It is not possible to give only specific collaborators permission to post announcements. It is possible, however, to decide how announcements are delivered - as a site notification or as a push notification.

title: How can I add and customize tiers in my Wix Loyalty Program?
content:
To add and customize tiers in your Wix Loyalty Program, you must have a Business or Business Elite plan (for Wix Editor users) or a Plus plan (for Studio users), and at least one of these apps: Wix Stores, Wix Events, Wix Bookings, Wix Pricing Plans.

- Go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage Program at the top right.
- Click the Points and rewards tab.
- Click Set Up Tiers.
- If you've already launched your program, click Continue to Set Up in the pop-up that opens.
- Add new tiers or edit existing tiers: click + Add New Tier, or hover over an existing tier and click Edit.
- Enter the tier details: Tier name; optional Description; Minimum points to enter tier; optional Icon; then click Save.
- Repeat for every other tier you'd like to add.

Note: The "Basic" tier cannot be deleted and the points needed to enter the tier can't be edited—it is always set at 0 points. This means customers who collect loyalty points will enter this tier automatically.

title: How can I share a site with my clients to get their feedback using Wix Channels?
content: In your Wix Channels dashboard, go to Client Feedback and click + Get Feedback. Choose the site to send for feedback and click Continue. Enter the name or email address of each person you want feedback from, optionally add a message they will see when they receive the invite, and click Send. You can also click Copy Link next to the shareable link to send it yourself; the shareable link URL is valid for 2 weeks.

title: How can I customize the appearance of the Member Login Window on my site?
content: You can customize the Member Login Window by changing your font themes and site colors.

title: How can I view and chat with live site visitors using Wix Chat?
content: Make sure Wix Chat is installed on your site. Go to your site's dashboard and click the Inbox icon at the top right corner. All current site visitors appear in the pop-up window. Click a visitor to open a new inbox message. If the visitor provided info before, their name appears; otherwise they appear as "Visitor #". From Wix Inbox, type your message and click Send. Make sure your chat status is set to 'online'; check it by opening the Settings drop-down at the top right of your inbox and enabling the Chat Status toggle. You can also view the visitor's site activity at the top of the inbox message, including the page they're viewing, device type, time on site, visit number, and location. You can also view and chat with live site visitors from the Wix app, and enable desktop notifications so you never miss a chat.

title: Can I send an invoice to multiple recipients using Wix Invoices?
content: Currently in Wix Invoices, it is not possible to send an invoice to multiple recipients.

title: Can I create dynamic pages based on Google Maps pins in a collection?
content: Currently, you cannot create a dynamic page that links to a field containing a Google Maps pin. However, you can create dynamic pages based on Text and Number field types in a collection. For example, a dynamic page can display the title, address, and a map of each item in a collection. The page can link to the 'Location Name' field to select which item to display. You can link to this page with any clickable element that has a link option, for example, a button. You can create a different button for each item, so you can display each of the items in the collection using the same page.

title: I want to add and format text in a Rich Text field in the CMS.
content: To add a Rich Text field to your collection, go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your editor and then click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection, click Manage Fields, click + Add Field, select Rich text and click Choose Field Type. Enter a name in the Field name field. For Velo only, update the Field ID, which cannot be updated later. Optionally enter Help text if you want a tooltip next to the field title, then click Save. To format text, click the Rich Text field for the relevant item, enter the text, and choose from the formatting options at the top such as Bold, Themes, Alignment, and Link. Use the Expand icon to edit the text in a larger window, and repeat for the relevant collection items.

title: How can I customize the design of my Hotel Availability Calendar on Wix?
content:
To customize your hotel availability calendar:

Click the calendar on your site.
Click **Settings**.
Customize the colors and fonts:

* **Text:** Select the color and font of the text.
* **Background:** Select the background color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
* **Separators color:** Select the separator line color and drag the slider to change the opacity.

title: How can I add related posts to my Wix blog post?
content: To add related posts: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post or Edit to edit an existing post. Create or edit the post to include the relevant information. Click the Settings tab on the left side panel. Click the Advanced tab. Click Choose Posts to choose additional posts. Select the relevant posts. Click Done. You can select up to 3 related posts for each blog post.

title: How can I connect POLi as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to POLi.

If you have an account, enter your Merchant Code and Authentication Code, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create POLi account, fill in the registration form, and wait for a message from POLi with your Merchant Code and Authentication Code credentials. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment methods. You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: How can I view event data from Wix Bookings in Google Analytics?
content: Sign in to your Google Analytics. Click Reports on the left. Click Monetization. Select the report you want to view. To see all of the events, click Behavior and then Events. It can take a few days until the reports start receiving data.

title: How can I edit the invite code for my Wix Member App?
content: The source states that editing the invite code is only available if you have a Premium plan, and it also states that currently editing your invite code is not possible while the feature is being reintroduced soon. The source lists these steps to edit an invite code: go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App, then tap the invite code under Mobile Apps. If you haven't set up the mobile app your members will use, tap the drop-down under Mobile Apps and choose your preferred members app. Tap Change Invite Code, enter your new code; if the code is not available, enter another code. Tap Change Invite Code, then tap Change Code to confirm. Once you change your invite code, the original code will no longer work, and your new invite code is activated and ready to send to members.

title: Can I customize the settings of different services separately in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now customize the settings of individual services in Wix Bookings. This includes adding options for early or late bookings, and cancelling or rescheduling individual services independent of one another.

title: How can I connect an existing logo to my Wix site?
content: Go to Logo & Brand in your site's dashboard. Click Connect Existing Logo. Note: If you already have a logo connected to your site, you'll need to disconnect it first before connecting another logo. Select your desired logo and click Connect.

title: How can I connect my Instagram Business account to my Wix site for social media marketing?
content:
Go to Social Media Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Your Social Posts at the top. Hover over a social post and click the More Actions icon. Click Preview & Publish. Tip: You do not have to publish the post.

Click Connect next to Instagram. Note: If you previously connected another platform, click Manage Social Accounts at the top right, then click Connect next to Instagram.

Make sure you meet the connection requirements and click Continue. Note: Even though you're connecting an Instagram account, a Facebook pop-up opens asking you to connect to the Facebook page associated with the Instagram account. Click Continue as (your Instagram name). Select the Instagram Business account you want to connect and click Select Page. Don't see your Instagram account? It might be connected to a different Facebook page. Click Continue.

title: Can I track the status of my submitted feature requests in Wix Studio?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view the status of feature requests that you've submitted in Wix Studio, including whether they have been rejected or accepted. In the meantime, check out the Wix Product Roadmap page to stay updated on the latest developments. You can also head over to the Wix Studio Discord community to share your vision for the future of Wix Studio and engage with others.

title: Can I use iPay as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer iPay as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through iPay and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I translate my Wix portfolio using Wix Multilingual?
content:
To translate your Wix portfolio using Wix Multilingual:

- Go to the Translation Manager in your site's dashboard.
- (If necessary) Click the Language drop-down on the left and select the relevant language.
- Click the Portfolio drop-down on the left and select the page you want to translate: Portfolio collections, Portfolio project items or Portfolio projects.
- Enter your translation in the translation fields or click Auto-translate to automatically translate the content.
- Click Done to move to the next item.
- Save and publish your site.

title: How can I view and manage the list of members on my site using the dashboard?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Contacts on the left. Click the More Actions icon at the top right. Select Site members. Click a tab at the top to view members and their details: Site Members shows all current members of your Members Area; Pending shows member requests if you require approval for potential members; Reported shows members reported by other members; Blocked shows members you've blocked from your Members Area. The member list in your site's dashboard shows the total number of members on your site, which may differ from the Wix app and member apps where only members who joined your site on the member app are shown.

title: What does the 'Could Not Determine the Prominent Video' error mean in Google Search Console, and how can I fix it?
content: In the Video Indexing Report, the "Google could not determine the prominent video on the page" error means that Google has found one or more videos on your page, but it can't determine which is the most important video. Reasons can include: your video is not immediately visible on your page and visitors need to scroll down to see it (also known as "below the fold"); the size of your video is too small; you have more than one video on the page; or you have a background video on your page. If you think any of these issues apply to your video, it is recommended to fix the issue and then request reindexing for the page.

title: How can I customize the look of my Wix Restaurants menu to match my restaurant's style?
content:
Customize your menu to reflect your unique restaurant style by adjusting headings, text, labels, images, width, and prices to your preference.

To customize your menu page:
- Go to the Menus (New) page in your editor.
- Click the Menus (New) app on the page.
- Choose how you want to customize your menu:
  - **Display specific menus:** Click **Choose Menus** to select the menus you want to display and reorder them.
  - **Select which elements you want to display on your menu:** Click the **Elements** icon to show or hide elements from your menu such as the section names, item descriptions, prices, currencies and labels.
  - **Select different menu settings:** Click the **Settings** icon to choose how to show the price for free items marked 0.00, and to choose a default image to display on items that don't have an image. You can set these rules to all sections and menus or select specific sections.
  - **Change your preset:** Click the **Change Preset** icon and select your preferred design. Some presets show a single column and others multiple columns, some display images and others are text-only.
  - **Change the layout of your menu:** Click the **Layout** icon and control the spacing between menu elements.
  - **Design each part of your menu:** Customize the design of your menu, including the menu background, name, section descriptions, item details, labels, prices and more.
    - **In the Wix Editor:** Click the **Design** icon, select the element you want to design, then design the background, text, colors, style and more.
    - **In the Studio Editor:** Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor, click the **Design** tab, select the element you want to design, then design the background, text, colors, style and more.
  - **Stretch the menu to full-width:** Click the **Stretch** icon to stretch the menu across the full width of the page.
  - **Manage your menus:** Click **Manage Menus** to enter your site's dashboard where you can edit your menus, publish or unpublish them, and create new ones.

**Tip:** If you want to revert back to the menu's original design settings, right-click on the Menus (New) app in the editor and select **Reset Widget**.

title: How can I let customers add a message or personalization text when purchasing a product in Wix Stores?
content: In Wix Stores, add a custom text box to your Product Page so customers can leave you a message when they purchase a specific product. Go to Products in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant product or click New Product to add a new one. Scroll down and click Add Custom Text Field. Enter the title of the text field (e.g. What name should we engrave?). Enter the character limit for the text field. Select or deselect the Mandatory field checkbox: selected means the customer must fill in the text field; deselected means the customer can leave it blank. (Optional) Click Add Another to add a second custom text field. You can add up to 2 fields. Click Save. After a customer makes an order, you can see the information they wrote in the Orders tab.

title: How can I customize the header of my Branded app to include a custom button and show the chat icon?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Mobile App and select the app you want to customize (Spaces or Branded). Click Edit Mobile App. Select the Header section in the app editor to open the Edit Header panel. Enable or disable the Show chat icon toggle to show or hide the chat icon at the top of your header. Choose a header type. For Detailed, continue to customize what you want to show. For Minimal, the header appears as a thin strip with just a profile icon, alert icon and chat icon (if enabled); there are currently no further customization options available for the minimal type, however you can change the header style to transparent from the Design panel. The Minimal header type is only available if you're using the Branded app. Customize the action buttons you want to show in your header: enable or disable Show invite button; enable Show custom button to show a button with a specific action and customize its text (e.g. Book Now). If enabled, select the button action and edit the button text. Click Save at the top right.

title: How can I check if my site is indexed by search engines like Google and Bing?
content: To see if search engines like Google and Bing have indexed your site, enter "site:" followed by the URL of your domain. For example, "site:mystunningwebsite.com/". The results show all of your site's pages that have been indexed, and the current Meta Tags saved in the search engine's index. If none of your pages appear, it means that your site has not been indexed yet. If your site or page is not indexed, you can try the steps in the troubleshooting article.

title: How can I edit the 'Buy Now' button text in Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant album and select Customize. Click the Text tab on the left, then click the Galleries tab. Enable the Add a Buy Now button toggle, enter the button text, hover over the image to view the button, and click Publish Now.

title: Is there a built-in way to provide users with a free trial for my Wix Blocks app?
content: Currently, when you set up your Blocks app's pricing, there is no built-in way to provide users with a free trial. You must rely on your own external database to save the date when a user first installed your app. Your records should also take into consideration that users can install, delete and install again.

title: How can I connect an additional domain to my Wix site?
content:
To connect an additional domain to your Wix site, go to Domains in your Wix account and assign your domain to your site. To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

If you want to assign a domain that is currently assigned to a different site:
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Click Assign to a Different Site.
- Select a site and click Next.
- Click Assign.

If you want to assign a domain that is not currently assigned to a site:
- Scroll to the relevant domain and click the Assign button next to the text Not Assigned to a Site.
- Select a site and click Next.
- Click Assign.

If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option: Redirect it to the primary domain, or Replace the current primary domain.

Allow 24 hours for the redirection to propagate. For the first 24 hours, the site is available under two domain names (both the primary and redirected domain). After 24 hours, the URL in your browser's address bar changes to your primary domain when you enter your redirecting domain's URL.

Tip: When using Google Analytics, you only need to add a tracking ID to your primary domain. Learn more about using Google Analytics with your Wix site.

title: How can I adjust the layout of my pricing plans on a mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor, then click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the editor. Go to your Plans & Pricing page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor and then clicking your Plans & Pricing page. Click the Pricing Plans element on the page, click Settings, and then click Layout. Customize the layout using these options: Page Text Layout — choose your alignment preference for your title, subtitle and disclaimer; Plan Card Spacing — use the slider to set the amount of space between elements on your plan cards; Plan Description Layout — set your plan description alignment; Benefits Layout — choose your alignment and line spacing for your plan benefits.

title: How can I add a video to my Wix event page?
content: To add a video to your Wix event page, click Add Video. Choose where to add the video from: Embed lets you paste a URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook; Upload lets you upload a video from your computer or device. Optionally adjust the video settings by using Size / Alignment to adjust size and positioning and Settings to click the toggle(s) to enable or disable video download and mark the video as spoilers. Then click Save.

title: How can I create multiple Facebook & Instagram Ads campaigns using Wix?
content: Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads in your site's dashboard. On the campaigns page, click Create New Campaign at the top right. Customize the settings and ad content for the new campaign. Set its daily budget, which is taken from your total ad credits. Click Launch. The new campaign appears on the campaigns page and shows In Review until Meta approves the campaign content.

title: Can I create separate events for different languages on my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create separate events for different languages on your site. However, you can translate a variety of elements on your event pages. While you can’t currently translate the event schedule, you can vote to request this feature.

title: How can I create a new badge for my online community using the Wix app?
content:
To create a new badge in the Wix app:
- Go to the relevant site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Customers & Leads and select Badges.
- Tap Create New Badge.
- Enter a Badge Name.
- (Optional) Enter a Description to let your members know what your badge is for.
- (Optional) Customize your badge's Design:
  - Badge Icon: Tap the Add icon and select an icon for your badge.
  - Background Color: Choose your badge's background color: Tap one of the colors or tap the Add icon to add a custom color.
  - Text Color: Change the color of your badge's text: Tap one of the colors or tap the Add icon to add a custom color.
- Tap Save.
Tip: Tap Assign This Badge to assign your new badge to the relevant member(s).

title: Why am I seeing a red error message when trying to transfer my domain on Wix?
content:
We're aware of an issue where a red error banner appears when assigning, unassigning, or transferring a domain. This happens when the domain is associated to a payment method that is in another Wix account. We are working on changing the error message to make the issue clearer.

Workaround:
- Go to Premium Subscriptions.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the domain name.
- Click Update payment method.
- Select which services you want to update.
- Select one of your payment methods, or add a new one.

The issue should no longer occur once the payment method for the domain is updated.

title: Can clients schedule multi-service appointments using the Wix member apps?
content: Currently, clients can schedule appointments with multiple services (e.g. a manicure and pedicure) when booking directly through your Wix site. It is not possible for clients to schedule multi-service appointments when booking through any of the Wix member apps (i.e. Spaces by Wix, Fit by Wix, or your own branded app).

title: How can I connect Paysafecash as a payment method through Skrill on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Paysafecash. If you have an existing Skrill account, enter your Merchant ID, E-Mail, Secret Word and MQI/API Password. Sign in to your Skrill account and go to Settings > Developer Settings to create your Secret Word and API Password; your Merchant ID can be seen at the top right of your Skrill account. Click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Skrill account, register your account with Skrill, and once verified retrieve your Merchant ID from the top right of your Skrill account. In Skrill, go to Settings > Developer Settings to create your Secret Word and API Password, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: How do I set a campaign goal for my Facebook Ads using Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Facebook Ads, click Start Now, click the goal you want to use for this campaign, and click Continue. If you haven't connected your Facebook account yet, connect it first via Connect to Facebook. You can only set the campaign goal once, and once chosen it cannot be changed. Goals include More store orders, More leads or bookings, and Promote a page.

title: How do I add Modalyst products to my Wix store from the Wix dashboard?
content: In your Wix dashboard, go to Find Product to Sell and click Add Products. Products you add to your store this way are automatically hidden. When you're ready, you can unhide them.

title: What are the key benefits of using Wix Headless for business management?
content:
Here are some of the key benefits of using Wix Headless:

* One-stop shop: All the services you need in one place.
* Build your way: Use your preferred tech stack to build your frontend and backend. Use Wix's business solutions to take care of the business logic. Wix's services are available as REST APIs and using our JavaScript SDK.
* Flexible: Maximize the ways customers can interact with your business, by connecting multiple clients to a single Wix project. For example, multiple websites, a mobile app, and a smartwatch app can all share the same business data.
* Secure: Use industry-standard OAuth 2.0 for authorizing API calls. Enjoy Wix's enterprise-grade security for peace of mind.
* Admin API: Utilize account and site-level APIs to build dashboards and other admin features.

title: How can I make an outgoing call from the Wix app using my contact list?
content:
To make an outgoing call from your contact list, go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Customers & Leads and select Contacts. Tap the More Actions icon to the right of the contact you'd like to call. Tap Call.

Tip: Your Contact List includes anyone who has interacted with your business (e.g. wrote you an email or booked a session). You can add contacts to make them instantly contactable.

title: How can I add a new table reservation using the Wix app?
content:
To add a new table reservation using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Table Reservations** and select **Table Reservations**.
- Tap **+ Add New** at the bottom.
- Choose the type of reservation you'd like to add:
  - **Reservation:** Enter the reservation details, assign a table, enter the guest's details or add a guest from your contacts, and add notes for your team about this reservation.
  - **Walk-in:** Enter the reservation details and assign a table. You can add the guests' details.

**Note:** You can also save them as contacts, add existing contacts, and add notes for your team about this reservation.

- Tap **Save**.

title: How can I add a file upload field to a site form using the new Wix Forms?
content:
To add a file upload field to a site form using the new Wix Forms, follow these steps:

1. Click the relevant form in your editor.
2. Click **Edit Form** to open the form builder.
3. Click **Add** on the left side of the builder.
4. Click **General**.
5. Click **File Upload** and drag the form element onto the page.
6. Click the newly added field on your form and click **Settings**.

Choose from the following customization options:

- **Field title:** Give a short title that tells people what you are asking for in the field.
- **Button text:** Edit the text that appears on the upload button in the form, e.g., 'Upload file'.
- **Text below button:**
  - **File info:** Only the name of the file appears beneath the button after a visitor uploads a file.
  - **Custom text:** Custom text appears beneath the button after a visitor uploads a file, e.g., 'Add up to 5 files.'
- **Accepted file types:** Select the type of media people can upload (video, image, audio, document, archive).
- **File upload limit:** Choose the maximum number of files people can upload with a single form submission. The current maximum upload limit is 30 uploads per single form submission.
- **Required field:** Enable the toggle to make the upload file field mandatory (visitors cannot submit the form without uploading a file).
- **Field description:** Enter text if your form needs additional explanation (e.g., terms and conditions or additional legal information).

Note: Accepting archive files is a feature available only in new Wix Forms.

title: How can I customize the login settings in the Wix File Share App to control who can access my shared files?
content:
To customize login settings in the File Share app:
- Click the File Share app in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Click Member Signup Settings.
- Choose which option appears first in the signup window: New member signup: The signup option is displayed first. Existing member login: The login option is displayed first.
- Click Additional Signup & Login Settings to manage who can become a member.
- Click the Social & Community tab.
- Under Allow social login?, select the social networks that members can use to log in: Enable Google login: Members can sign in using their Google credentials. Enable Facebook login: Members can sign in using their Facebook credentials.
- Click the Join the community is checked by default toggle to choose whether or not the "Join the community" checkbox is selected by default.
- Click the Policies tab.
- Click the Terms of Use toggle to enable or disable the Terms of Use link: Enabled: A link to your Terms of Use page is added in the signup window. Click the Link icon and select the page containing your Terms of Use. Disabled: A link to your Terms of Use page is not added in the signup window.
- Click the Privacy Policy toggle to enable or disable the Privacy Policy link: Enabled: A link to your Privacy Policy page is added in the signup window. Click the Link icon and select the page containing your Privacy Policy. Disabled: A link to your Privacy Policy page is not added in the signup window.
- Click Done.

title: Can I add a 'scale' field to my form in the new Wix Forms to allow visitors to rank their answers?
content: Currently, in the new Wix Forms, there is no option to add a 'scale' field that allows visitors to rank their answers out of a pre-determined scale.

title: How do I connect Nuvei as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to Nuvei. If you have an account, enter your Merchant ID, Merchant Site ID, Merchant Secret Key and Merchant Hash, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Nuvei account and enter the information to create your account. Once your account is created, retrieve your credentials from Nuvei. Return to the window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I block unwanted visitors, bots, and scammers from accessing my site?
content: You can use the Blocky: IP & Country Blocker app by Effective Apps to block unwanted visitors, bots and scammers from accessing your site. After a visitor is blocked, they are automatically redirected to a page of your choice on your site. The app can block visitors from certain countries, block specific visitors by their IP address, reduce harassment and fraud caused by bots and scammers, and immediately block multiple countries with a click of a button. Important: This app is only available in English.

title: How can I set up a payment method for selling event tickets on Wix Events?
content: Before selling event tickets, set up a payment method. You must upgrade your site to a Premium or Studio plan that supports payments in order to accept payments. Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down to change it. Click Connect next to the payment provider you want to use, or click See More Payment Options at the bottom to view more options. Choose the relevant payment method(s): Wix Payments, Credit Card, PayPal, Apple Pay, or Manual. Wix Payments offers a secure system to manage orders, payments, payouts, refunds, and chargebacks from one dashboard, and accepts all major credit cards and popular payment methods like Apple Pay and Google Pay depending on your location. Credit Card lets you accept credit card payments from the most suitable provider available in your region based on your preferences and location. PayPal lets you accept PayPal payments, credit cards, and debit cards; guests are directed to PayPal for payment and can use a credit card even without having a PayPal account. Apple Pay lets guests on iOS devices checkout using Apple Pay; the Apple Pay button is displayed only to people viewing your site with a Safari browser on iOS or macOS devices. Manual lets you accept cash, payment through apps, checks, bank transfers, or any other form of payment that is not tracked online; guests see instructions at checkout explaining how to complete payment.

title: How can I remove the frame from an image in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the image in your Editor. Click the Design icon. Click the No Frame option.

title: How can I create custom working hours for a staff member using the Wix app?
content:
To create custom working hours for a staff member using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Booking Calendar**.
- Tap the **Staff** tab.
- Tap to select an existing staff member.
- Tap **Add Hours** next to **Working Hours**.
- Tap **Continue**.
- Tap to select the **Start Date** for the staff member's new work schedule.
- (Optional) Tap **Set end date** to make the change temporary.
- Tap the **Repeats** drop-down to select how often the staff member works these hours.
- Select the days the staff member is available to book.
- Tap to select the **Start Time**.
- Tap to select the **End Time**.
- Tap to select the **Location** your staff member is available in.
- A summary of the staff member's custom hours appears at the bottom of the screen.
- Tap **Save** at the top.
- (Optional) Repeat to create additional custom work hours for the same staff member.

**Tip:** This is useful if your staff member is available in different hours or locations on different days, or if they change location during the day.

title: How can I customize the design of my single video player on Wix?
content: To customize the design of your single video player on Wix, go to your editor, click the Wix single video player, and click the Design icon. Use the available options to customize: Cover image (choose an auto-generated cover image or upload your own; enable Fade out so the cover image fades out when visitors click play); Fill color & opacity (Overlay Opacity & Color); Border (Opacity & color, Width); Shadow (Apply shadow, Angle, Distance, Size, Blur, Opacity & color); Text (Title & Play Button, Theme, Font, Font size, and italicize or bold your text).

title: How can I create a saved discount in Wix Retail POS?
content:
To create a saved discount in Wix Retail POS:
- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
- Tap Catalog.
- Select Discounts.
- Tap +New Discount.
- Enter a name for your discount.
- Choose your discount type:
  - Price discount: Tap the Dollar icon $.
  - Percentage discount: Tap the Percentage icon %.
- Enter an amount or leave the amount open:
  - Enter a fixed amount: Enter the percent or the price discount.
  - Leave the amount open and enter during checkout: Tap the Enter the amount during checkout toggle to enable it.
- Tap Save at the top right.

title: How can I add mobile-only HTML code to my Wix site using the mobile Editor?
content: In your mobile editor, click Add on the left side. Click Embed Code, then select Embed a site / Embed HTML to add an iFrame to your page. Click Enter Code / Enter Website Address, type or paste your HTML code or URL into the field, and click Apply. Elements added from the mobile editor are mobile-only, meaning they are not displayed on the desktop version of your site.

title: How can I set up a loyalty program for my Wix restaurant to reward customers?
content: To launch a loyalty program for your Wix restaurant, first upgrade to a plan that includes accepting payments. In your site's dashboard, go to Loyalty Program and click Start Now. Enter the program name, points name, and points icon, then click Continue to Setup. On the Points and rewards tab, hover over Place a restaurant order and click Edit. Describe how customers earn points and choose how many points are earned per $1.00 spent, then click Save. Hover over Order discount and click Edit to set the reward name, discount, and cost in points, then click Save. On the Email automations tab, use the Status toggle to turn email automations on or off. On the Program info tab, review the details and make changes if needed. Click Launch Program and confirm by clicking Launch Program again. Click Add Widget, Add to Checkout, and Add to install the Loyalty widget on the checkout page.

title: Can I use the Text Input element to filter live site content on my website?
content: Currently, it is not possible for visitors to use the Text Input element to filter live site content. The Text Input element can be used to collect content only. Workaround: You can add the Wix Site Search app to allow visitors to search throughout your site's content. The source also describes the requested feature as allowing visitors to enter keywords in the text input and having the page's connected elements only show items that match the keywords.

title: Can I manage my bookings services and sessions using Wix APIs?
content: You can now manage your services and sessions using Wix APIs.

title: How can I change the currency and payment terms for my Wix invoices and price quotes?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Settings. Click Getting paid in the Finance and Payments section. In the General details section, click the Currency drop-down and select the relevant currency. Then click the Default payment terms drop-down and select the relevant payment terms. To customize payment terms, click Set Custom Terms. Changing the default payment terms defines the due date for invoices and the payment terms for price quotes; you can adjust these terms while creating an invoice or price quote.

title: Can I edit the URL slug for each tab in my Wix group?
content: No. Currently, it is not possible to edit the name of the URL slug for each tab in your Wix group.

title: How can I improve my site's performance when displaying a large amount of items on a repeater, table, or gallery in the CMS?
content: You can adjust the Maximum items displayed field in your dataset settings to control the number of items that can load at a time. This helps load your page faster with fewer items on the initial page load, reduce the number of larger items, and enhance your page's design. If you have a large amount of content to show on data-bound elements, limit the amount of items loaded at once and add a "Load More" button or a pagination bar, which will load one batch at a time; a good practice would be to show up to 10 items with every new load. If your repeaters need to contain a lot of content or be connected to a large collection, consider using a deferred dataset, which loads the connected content only after the rest of the page loads. If there is content in your collection that is not needed on your page, add a filter to the dataset and choose what content to display.

title: How can I customize the launch and login screens of my Wix mobile app?
content: In your dashboard, go to Mobile App, click the Your own mobile app tab or the tab with the name of your own mobile app, click Edit Mobile App, then use the Screen drop-down at the top to choose the screen you want to edit. For the launch screen, click Launch, then edit the Color or Image (choose an image or use your app icon), and tap Save. For the login screen, click Login, then edit the Screen text, Colors, or Image (choose an image or use your app icon), and tap Save. This feature is only available if you are building your own app, and you must purchase a Mobile App Premium plan. Changes to your app's launch screen will go live once you resubmit your app to the App Store & Google Play.

title: Why does my Wix mobile site show an error for viewport configuration in Google's mobile friendliness tool?
content: The viewport meta tag controls how a site is displayed on a mobile device, and Google looks at the viewport configuration as a criteria for optimization. Wix uses the meta tag: <meta id="wixMobileViewport" name="viewport" content="width=320, user-scalable=yes">. Google considers <meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to be a better option, as it looks at the width of the device and uses it as the width of the page. However, this can't be implemented in Wix for technical reasons. As Google prefers that configuration, Wix mobile sites lose points in the Google mobile friendliness tool, however they still get a very good score. You may see an error regarding the use of viewport configuration when running a test at https://testmysite.thinkwithgoogle.com/, but this can be ignored as your Wix mobile site score is still high.

title: What does it mean if my domain status is 'clientHold' or 'serverHold' on Whois, and how can I resolve it?
content: If your domain status is 'clientHold' or 'serverHold' on Whois, your domain registrar has not yet activated your domain's DNS records. This can be due to several reasons, such as payment failure. To resolve this issue, you must contact your domain registrar. This domain status can be viewed when visiting whois.com or any other querying databases that store domain registration information.

title: How can I display my Wix Stores product categories on any page using the Wix Editor?
content: To display Wix Stores product categories on a page in Wix Editor, first make sure you have the new version of Wix Stores product categories, create multiple product categories, add the CMS to your site, and enable Wix app collections. Then go to the page where you want to show the categories, click Add Elements, and add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table. For a Pro Gallery, drag a Pro Gallery onto the page and remove the default images via Manage Media, Select All, Delete, and Done. For a repeater, drag a repeater onto the page and make sure it has an image or button to link to the Category Page later. For a table, drag a table onto the page. Next, select the element and click the Connect to CMS icon, click Create Dataset or choose Create a New Dataset if a dataset exists, select Collections under the Stores Wix app collection, optionally name the dataset, and click Create. For repeaters, connect the relevant elements under Connections and use Connection options to select fields such as Name, Main Media, Slug, ID, and Navigate Page URL. Use Repeater connections to connect additional elements. Adjust the elements as needed, click Preview to test, and click Publish to make changes live. You can also use Dataset settings to set Maximum items displayed, add filters, and add sorts; tables are not affected by these dataset settings.

title: How can I add multiple locations to my Wix SEO Setup Checklist after I've already created it?
content: After creating your SEO Checklist, go to SEO Setup Checklist in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit details icon beside Keywords. If needed, select I serve customers from a physical address or within a local service area. If needed, enter or update your first location under Location. Click + Add more under your first location, enter another location, and click + Add more again to add additional locations. You can add up to 5 locations. Click Save. Only add multiple locations if you actually provide services there, not just if you want to target those locations.

title: Can I purchase or transfer a South African (.za) domain with Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a South African (.za) domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix. However, you can purchase a South African (.za) domain from another domain host and connect it to your Wix site. Important: To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

title: I have created pages in the Wix editor, but they are not showing up on the live site even though I have hit publish. I have made sure the pages are not hidden and they are published, but they are still not showing up on the live site.
content: Click Publish in your editor, then check your live site to see if it has updated. Make sure you are using a supported browser, as outdated browsers can display rendering issues between your editor and the live site. If you are receiving an error when publishing, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve the issue.

title: Is it possible to purchase a Photo Albums storage add-on that's billed on a monthly basis?
content: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a Photo Albums storage add-on that's billed on a monthly basis. You can choose from 3 storage plans that renew on a yearly basis.

title: Can I create my own SMS automations using Wix Automations?
content: Currently, Wix SMS allows you to send pre-installed Wix Bookings and Wix Restaurants texts. You can't create your own SMS automations using Wix Automations.

title: How do I add the Members Area to my Wix site in the Studio Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, click App Market on the left side of the Editor. Click App Market. Enter "Wix Members Area" in the search bar, click Wix Members Area, and click Add to Site. This adds the Member Page and a Login Bar element. You can then customize the Members Area to fit your client's design and purposes, for example by switching to a different layout.

title: Can I connect 2Checkout as a new payment provider on my Wix site if I already have a 2Checkout account?
content: As of September 2021, Wix no longer supports connecting 2Checkout as a new payment provider for your Wix site. If you have already set up 2Checkout for your site, you will still be able to accept payments through this payment provider.

title: Can I reschedule appointments in the Wix Bookings calendar on the Wix app?
