content: Yes. Currently, you can reschedule or update appointments from the Booking Calendar tab in the Wix app. However, you cannot drag and drop sessions to change the schedule.

title: How can I create a text slideshow using Wix Editor?
content:
Add a slideshow. Add a text element. Click Edit Text and enter your text. Drag your text on to your slideshow. Repeat adding and editing text and dragging it on to each slide in your slideshow.

Note: Use the arrows to navigate between your slides while you edit.

title: Can I duplicate dish extras and add them to multiple dishes in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, you can add extras to dishes in your online ordering menu, but it is not possible to duplicate these extras and add them to multiple dishes.

title: How can I add a Related Products gallery to my Wix Store using the Wix Editor?
content:
Use the Add panel to add a Related Products gallery to your site, then choose what kind of related products are displayed.

- Go to your editor and go to the page where you want to add the gallery. Tip: the Related Products gallery works best when added to the Product Page.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Select Store.
- Click Related Products.
- Drag the gallery to the page.
- Select the gallery in your editor and click Settings.
- Select the type of related products to display: From the same categories (works best when added to the product page, cart or thank you page), Frequently bought together (works best when added to the product page), or Frequently viewed together (works best when added to the product page).
- Optional: edit the default gallery name ("Related products") by clicking the Text tab and entering a new name under Gallery title text.

Tip: in preview mode, the images do not move from product to product; you can see them on your live site.

title: How can I make bulk updates to product prices in my Wix store's dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Store Products. Select the products you want to change: all products, individual products, or categories using Filter. Click More Actions and select Change Price. Choose an option from the What change would you like to make? drop-down, enter the amount, price, or percentage, then click Change Prices. Note: When you change the base price of a product, other prices change accordingly.

title: Can I customize roles and permissions for group admins in Wix Groups?
content: Yes. You can now customize the permissions for group admins using the "Member permissions" drop-down. You can decide if group admins can post content, invite or add people to a group. When you want to make a member a group admin, you can do so from the Members tab. title: How can I sign in to the Wix member apps using my Apple account?
content: Open the Wix member app you want to sign in to. Tap Log in. Under Apple, tap Continue with Apple. Tap Continue under Sign in with Apple. Choose whether you want to show or hide your email address: Show your email: Your real email is visible in the app and you will be able to sign in with it from a desktop. title: Can I change the title of a blog post on my mobile site to be different from the desktop site?
content: Currently, you cannot change the title of a blog post on your mobile site to say something different to the title on your desktop site. Blog post titles are the same for your desktop and mobile sites. You can write new posts and make changes to existing posts from your mobile. title: Can I customize the background color of my Spaces app?

title: How can I manually convert a price quote into an invoice on Wix?
content: Go to Price Quotes in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the price quote you want to convert. Click Convert to Invoice. Click Convert to confirm. Once a price quote becomes an invoice, it appears in Invoices where you can manage and track it.

title: How can I reset my default A and CNAME records in my Wix account?
content:
Important: If your domain is connected via pointing, these directions do not apply. Contact your domain host for help with resetting your DNS records.

Step 1 | Reset your default A records
Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records. Hover over the A record that has your domain name in the Host Name field and click Edit. If needed, click + Add Record in the A (Host) section. Click the Value field and enter 185.230.63.107. Leave the Host name field blank. Click Save, then Save Changes in the pop-up message.

Step 2 | Reset your default CNAME records
From the same Manage DNS Records page: Hover over the CNAME record that has www. before your domain name and click Edit. If needed, click + Add Record in this section. Type www in the Host name field. Click the Value field and enter initial.wixdns.net. Click Save, then Save Changes in the pop-up message.

Next: It can take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and for your site to appear worldwide.

title: Is it possible to add a pagination bar to the Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add a pagination bar to the Wix Pro Gallery to help visitors navigate your gallery.

Workarounds:
- You can add a Load More button to your gallery to minimize the amount of content facing your site visitors when they access the page. This allows your visitors to load all the gallery images in one click, or section by section.
- If you are using the CMS (Content Management System), it is possible to connect a pagination bar to the Pro Gallery. With the CMS, you connect the gallery to a dataset that connects to a collection field where the media is stored. Then connect the pagination bar element to the same dataset and decide in the dataset settings how many items appear per page.

title: How can I connect my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar to VRBO?
content:
Before you begin, note that the VRBO iCal integration sends your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar to the VRBO channel’s extranet but does not receive other data from VRBO. Rates and reservations do not sync, so reservations from a VRBO iCal channel must be added manually to your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar, and rates and restrictions must be managed from the VRBO channel extranet.

To connect: In your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, go to Channel Manager and click Connect next to VRBO. Choose Send from the drop-down next to all relevant rooms you want to share with VRBO iCal, click Next, then click Copy next to all relevant rooms you want to send to VRBO. Log in to the VRBO dashboard, open Calendar, click Import & Export, click Export Calendar, select the relevant property if you have more than one property on VRBO, open the Import/Export drop-down at the top, click Import calendar, enter Wix Hotels by HotelRunner iCal in the Name field, paste the export URL you copied from Wix Hotels by HotelRunner in the Calendar URL field, and click Import Calendar. Repeat the import for all relevant Export URLs you want to add to VRBO. Then return to Channel Manager in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, hover over VRBO, click Complete Setup, and click Activate.

Once the VRBO connection is complete, your availability on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar transfers to your VRBO account. You can update which rooms you send to VRBO at any time.

title: How do I connect a dropdown element to a CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin, make sure to add the CMS to your site if you haven't already.

In the Wix Editor, go to the page where you want to create a custom form and add the dropdown element: click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Input, click Dropdown, then click and drag the dropdown onto the page.

Click the dropdown element you just added, then click the Connect to CMS icon. Connect to a dataset that binds to the collection where you will store the submissions:
- If you do not have a dataset on the page: click + Add a Dataset on the right, choose the collection to connect, enter the dataset name and click Create. Then click Collect content.
- If you already have a dataset on the page: click Collect content, then click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select the relevant dataset. Alternatively, click Add a Dataset to create a new one, choose the collection to connect, enter the dataset name and click Create.

Click the Value connects to drop-down and select Add new field. Enter a Field Name for the new collection field, select the Field Type from the drop-down (the field type determines what kind of data you can store in the field), then click Add.

Click the Connect list items toggle to choose where to manage the element's choices: when enabled, use a field from another CMS collection for the choices by connecting the relevant dataset and choosing the fields to use from the Labels and values connect to drop-down; when disabled, click Manage Choices to create the choices for the element separate from the CMS.

Set the dataset modes: for the dataset connected to your submissions collection, open Dataset Settings and set the dataset mode to Write, so dropdown selections are added to your collection upon submission. If you connected the dropdown list items to another collection, make sure that dataset is set to Read & Write or Read, so the element can view the items from the collection and use them as list options.

Set the collection permissions: click CMS on the left of the editor, click Your Collections, hover over the collection set to collect the submissions and click More Actions, then Permissions & privacy. Choose Collect content, which allows visitors to add content with input elements or API and lets you specify who can add it, or Custom permissions to control who can add, edit, view and delete the collection items.

title: What is ICANN's 60 Day Lock Policy and how can I manage my domain if I'm affected by it?
content:
ICANN's 60 Day Lock Policy states that it is not possible to transfer a domain within 60 days of:

* Registering the domain
* Changing the registrant contact information
* Transferring your domain between different domain providers

This limitation applies to both incoming (to Wix) and outgoing (away from Wix) transfers and cannot be circumvented by Wix.

If you are unable to transfer your Wix domain away from Wix due to this limitation, you can keep the domain in your Wix account and point it to your external site in the meantime.

Alternatively, if you were trying to transfer your domain to Wix and were unable to due to this limitation, you can connect your domain to Wix in the meantime.

Note:
* After changing your contact information you are required to confirm your information within 14 days of the change. Failure to confirm your contact information within 14 days will result in the suspension of your domain.
* If your final goal is to transfer your domain to another domain provider, please be advised that you should do so before changing your contact information, in order to avoid triggering the 60 day lock.

title: How can I display additional product details on my Wix Stores Product Page using a CMS collection?
content:
Make sure to add the CMS to your site if you haven't already, and enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.

Step 1 | Create a collection that references your Wix app collection:
- Create a Multiple items (Default) collection where you will keep the additional info you want to integrate into your Product page.
- Click + Add Item to add items for each product you want to save additional details about.
- Click + Add Field to add fields for each type of content you want to save (e.g. Rich Content).
- Click the relevant cells to add your content to each item.
- Add a Reference field type and connect it to the Stores Wix app collection: click Manage Fields, click + Add Field, select Reference, click Choose Field Type, enter the Field name, click the Referenced Collection drop-down and select Products under Stores, then click Save. For Velo only, update the Field ID if necessary; you cannot update this ID later.
- For each item, click the reference field and select the relevant product. You can select multiple products if you added a multi-reference field.

Step 2 | Set up datasets and connect elements to them:
- Go to your editor and go to your Product page.
- Add a dataset that connects to your 'Details' CMS collection and filters for your reference or multi-reference field. Skip this step if you do not need to show additional details from a 'Details' CMS collection.
- Add a dataset that connects to your Stores Wix app collection: click Add a Dataset, choose the Products collection under Stores, edit the Dataset name if needed, and click Create.
- Add a URL slug filter to your Stores/Products dataset: open Dataset settings, click + Add Filter, select Slug (Text), leave is selected as the Condition, select URL Slug under Value source, and click Add Filter.
- Add the supported elements you want to connect and connect them to the relevant fields in the relevant dataset: Details dataset for your 'Details' CMS collection, or Stores/Products dataset for your Stores Wix app collection.
- Optional: hide default details from your Product Page widget by clicking the Product Page element, selecting Settings, unchecking the checkboxes for details to hide, and disabling the toggle next to relevant buttons or icons. If you don't see Settings, select the Elements icon and uncheck the boxes next to each widget element you want to hide.
- Use the Preview toolbar to test the connections for the relevant products, and publish your site when ready.

title: How can I add a WhatsApp button to my website using Editor X?

Click the Link icon, then Web Address. Choose whether to create a WhatsApp click-to-chat link with an automated first message or without a message. Enter the WhatsApp click-to-chat address under What's the web address (URL)?, using your full phone number in international format and omitting zeros, brackets, or dashes. To include a default message, use the text parameter in the address. Click Done. You can link from any element on your site, such as a menu tab or image.

title: How can I export my contacts from my Wix site?

If you do not want placeholder text, click None under Initial text. Optionally, click the Read only checkbox to restrict the address input from writing content to the collection.

Under Address autocomplete, choose All countries or One country. For One country, click the Choose a country drop-down and select the country to use. Click the Design icon to choose a preset design, then click Customize Design to adjust the design further.

To connect the address input to the CMS, click the address input element, click the Connect to CMS icon, choose an existing dataset or add a dataset, then use the Value connects to drop-down to choose the address field that the input submits to. Make sure the dataset mode is set to Write or Read & Write, and create a submit button that submits the input to your collection.

title: How does Facebook determine which purchases are attributed to my store campaign?
content: Facebook uses an attribution model to determine which customer actions (such as 'add to cart' and purchases) were a result of your campaign. An attribution model is a rule, or set of rules, that determine how to assign credit for sales and conversions based on online touchpoints. That means if someone sees your ad and goes to your site to make a purchase within 7 days of clicking the ad or within 1 day of viewing it (whichever happened last), that purchase is attributed to your campaign.

title: Can I create another online ordering page with different settings in Wix Restaurants?

title: How can I change the text size of my Wix blog posts specifically for mobile devices?

To customize the font size that readers see when they access a blog post on a mobile device:

- Go to the Blog Post page in your editor.
- Click the **Switch to Mobile** icon on the top bar of your editor.
- Click the Wix Blog app in your mobile editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Design** tab.
- Drag any of the sliders to increase or decrease the font sizes.

title: How can I add a Members Area to my Wix site if it's missing?
content: If you don't have a members page, it may be deleted or hidden. To learn how to add a Members Area to your site and how to unhide a page, follow the instructions in the source.

title: How can I switch from a section grid to an advanced CSS grid in the Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant section in the Editor. Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor. Scroll down to Layout. Click Switch next to Advanced CSS grid. Click Switch to CSS Grid. Note: Once you make the switch, it is not possible to go back to a section grid. However, if you just performed the action, you can use the Undo button at the top right of the Editor. After switching, you can customize the rows, columns, and spacing from the Inspector panel. You can also drag grid lines on the canvas to move them.

title: Can I add HTML code from external sources to individual Wix Stores Product Pages?
content: Currently, it's not possible to add HTML code from external sources to individual Wix Stores Product Pages. As a workaround, you can use the HTML element to embed code onto your product page. It is not possible to add different HTML codes to individual products. The Product Page is a dynamic page, therefore any changes made to one Product Page affect all Product Pages.

title: How do I connect Moneris as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Moneris as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard (tip: check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it), click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Moneris. If you already have a Moneris account, enter your Store ID and API Token and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Moneris account, fill in the registration form and click Send, then wait for an email or chat message from Moneris to get your Store ID and API Token credentials. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under "Have an account" to connect your account.

title: How can I edit the content of my site header using ADI?
content:
Click your site header inside ADI. Click Edit. Choose what to edit:
- Site Menu: Click Edit to make changes to your site menu.
- Business Name: Enter your business name.
- Tagline: Enter a tagline for your site. A tagline is a short statement or slogan that tells visitors what you're all about.
- Logo: Hover over the image or shape and click Edit & Replace to manage your site's logo and resize it.
- Site Email: Enter your contact email address.
- Phone Number: Enter your business phone number. You can also click Manage to purchase a dedicated phone number to better connect with customers (only available in Canada and USA).
- Button: Edit the text of the button in your header and click Link to add a link to the button.
- Social Accounts: Select the checkmark to add social icons to your footer. Hover over the icons and click to add more social accounts, or rearrange the icons.

title: How can I add recipients to my email campaign in Wix?
content: To add recipients to your email campaign, first create an email campaign or edit an existing one, and customize the elements in your campaign to your liking. Preview and test your email campaign before you add recipients and send. Click Next. Optionally, import contacts from a CSV file or your Gmail account: click Import Contacts at the bottom right, click Import Contacts in the popup to confirm, choose between CSV file or Gmail account and follow the steps on-screen, then click Back to email marketing at the top. Select who you want to send this email to: choose Target group to include all subscribers, specific segments or labels, or individual contacts; or choose All Contacts. Click Next at the top right, then send your email campaign. You can enable the Filter out inactive contacts toggle to remove inactive contacts from your list. We do not recommend sending campaigns to inactive contacts as this can increase your bounce rate, cause emails to be marked as spam, and decrease your email deliverability.

title: How can I manage the privacy settings of my Wix Group?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Groups. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant group and select Manage. Select the Info tab. Choose who can view and access your group: Public: Anyone can view this group’s content and join. Private: Only group members can view this group’s content. Only paying members: Members pay to view this group’s content.

title: Can I add free sections or steps within a paid program in Wix Online Programs?
content: Currently it's not possible to add free steps or sections within a paid program, or the opposite; paid sections or steps in free programs. Workaround: Create a single-use free promotional plan for potential participants.

title: How can I add and set up share buttons on my site using the Studio Editor?
content: Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor, click **Embed & Social**, click **Share Buttons**, and drag the design you like onto the page. Then choose the page the buttons link to by clicking **Settings** and selecting the relevant option under **What page is shared?**.

title: How can I add an internal note to a session in the Wix Bookings List app?
content: Go to the Bookings List app, under Booking Calendar, in your site's dashboard. Click the Internal Notes icon at the top right. Enter a name for your field or checkbox. For a text field, select Text Field and enter the Field name (e.g. Session summary). You can add a maximum of 3 text field internal notes. For a checkbox, select Checkbox and enter the Checkbox name (e.g. Follow-up needed). You can add a maximum of 2 checkbox internal notes. Click Apply.

title: Which card readers are available for Wix Retail POS and how do they connect to the tablet?
content:
For Wix Retail POS, the card readers and their connection methods are:
- Stripe Reader M2 (Available in the US): connects to your tablet through Bluetooth.
- WisePad 3 (Available in Canada): connects to your tablet through Bluetooth.
- BBPOS WisePOS E: a network card reader that connects to your tablet through WiFi; available for merchants both in the US and Canada.
- BBPOS Chipper 2X reader (previously available in the US): no longer available; the source identifies it by its black color.

title: Can I customize the video play button in the Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the play button that appears when visitors hover over videos in your Pro Gallery. You can, however, choose to hide or show the play button.

title: How can I apply a blend mode to an image in the Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant text or image. Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Click the Blend mode drop-down under Design. Explore the available modes and select the one that fits your vision. If you apply blend mode to a child element and the element's parent is animated, pinned, or sticky, the effect might not appear properly on your client's live site. If you experience this issue, try removing the parent element's animation or position type.

title: How can I create a 'Buy 2, get 20% off' discount in my Wix Store?
content:
To create a 'Buy 2, get 20% off' discount in your Wix Store:

- Go to Automatic Discounts in your site's dashboard.
- Click Create Discount.
- Enter a discount name.
- Select Specific categories under What does this discount apply to?.
- Select the relevant category (e.g., Shirts).
- Select the Minimum quantity of items checkbox and enter 2 as the minimum quantity.
- Select Percentage off under What is the discount? and enter 20%.
- Complete the discount and click Save.

Note: Only items from the relevant category, in this example, shirts, are sold at 20% off - not other store products.

title: What are the CMS limits for free sites in a Wix Studio account, and how do they change if I upgrade or leave Wix Studio?
content:
If your account is in the Wix Studio platform, your free sites have a CMS quota of **10,000 collection items**. This increased quota applies to all Wix Studio sites and only to sites you own; it does not apply if you are a co-owner or have another site role. The 10,000 collection item limit applies to collections you create, not collections created by Wix apps.

If you upgrade to a Premium or Studio plan that includes higher CMS limits than the free site quota, you automatically move to your new plan's quota, and the items already on your free sites are included. For example, if you have 10,000 collection items on your free site and upgrade to a plan that includes 500,000 items, you have 490,000 items left to use.

If you upgrade to a plan that includes lower CMS limits than the free plan quota, you move to your new plan's quota. Existing collection items are not deleted, but you cannot add more if they exceed the new quota. For example, if a free site has 10,000 collection items and you upgrade to a plan that includes 4,000 items, you need to delete existing items until your count is under 4,000, or upgrade to a plan with more items.

If you leave Wix Studio, your free site CMS quota reverts to **1,000 collection items**, which is also the free site CMS quota if you never joined Wix Studio. If you are a Wix Partner and leave Wix Studio, you also opt out of the Partner Program entirely, losing access to exclusive benefits and features.

title: How can I troubleshoot issues with publishing my social media posts to Facebook using Wix?
content: Make sure you have a Facebook Business page; sharing to Facebook is only available for Facebook business pages, not personal profile pages. If you do not have a Facebook Business page, create one. Then check that Wix has the right Facebook sharing permissions: click Sharing Options in the error message, select all the checkboxes including All Pages at the top, click Next, and click Confirm.

title: How can I enable the option for customers to save their credit card details during checkout on my Wix store?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Settings, click Checkout, select Payments, and click the Save customers' cards on file toggle to enable it. This displays a checkbox on the checkout page so site members can choose to opt in.

title: How can I integrate ShipStation with my Wix store to streamline the shipping process?
content: To integrate ShipStation with your Wix store, access the app, then click Add to Site. Do one of the following: Log in to your existing ShipStation account: click Login, enter your email / username and password, and click Login. Create a new ShipStation account: fill in all the required fields, click Start your free trial, and log in to ShipStation. Click Connect to integrate your ShipStation account with your Wix store. Click Allow and Install. Click Orders at the top of the page to view your store orders. Tip: If you have more than one store, click Stores on the left and select the store you want to view. After connecting, you should see all your orders, including past orders, for the selected site in the ShipStation dashboard's Orders tab. You are then ready to start shipping orders using ShipStation.

title: Can I apply coupons to the sale of booking services at a mobile point of sale?
content: Yes. It is now possible to apply coupons to the sale of bookings services at a mobile point of sale.

title: How do I connect SeerBit as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then select Connect next to SeerBit. If you have a SeerBit account, enter your Public Key and Secret Key and click Connect. If you do not have a SeerBit account, click Create Seerbit account, complete the online sign-up process on the SeerBit website, and once your account is approved, return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the same steps to link your newly-created account.

title: How can I update multiple orders at once in Wix Stores?
content: To update multiple orders at once, go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard. Select the checkboxes next to the orders you want to update. From the top bar, choose an action: Assign Tags to add or remove tags you created; Export to download a .CSV file; Print Orders to send orders to your printer; or Print Shipping Label to create and print multiple labels through Wix Shipping. Note: Print Shipping Label is not available in all regions. You can also click More Actions and select Mark as paid, Mark as fulfilled (relevant only for store orders), Create Invoice, or Archive. You cannot add tracking numbers to multiple store orders at once.

title: How can I create a bookings coupon using the Wix app?
content:
To create a bookings coupon using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap the Manage icon.
- Tap Coupons under Marketing.
- Tap Add a Coupon.
- Select the discount type for your coupon: $ Discount (enter the amount taken off the price) or % Discount (enter the percentage discount you want to offer).
- Tap Next.
- Enter the coupon code your clients will enter to get the discount.
- Enter the coupon name. This name appears in the coupons list in your site's dashboard.
- Tap Next.
- Choose which services the coupon applies to: All services or Specific service. If your site also has a store, you see additional options.
- Set the coupon's start and end date: tap the date under Valid from, select a start date from the calendar, optionally select an end date, then tap Save.
- Optionally apply limits: enable Limit number of total uses and enter the number of times the coupon can be used; enable One use per customer.
- Tap Done.
- Optionally tap Share to share your new coupon.

Notes: Clients cannot apply coupons to membership plans, plans that have no fee, or to services set to Custom Price (Free/Prices Vary). Clients can apply coupons to group bookings. Both the monetary and the percentage discount apply to the total value of the booking.

title: How can I manage the tabs on the Member Menu using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click Members Area. Click Member Page. Select the Member Menu element and click Manage and Navigate. You can then:
• Add more tabs: Enhance the Members Area with new capabilities, like the Profile tab.
• Remove a tab: Hover over a tab, click the More Actions icon and Delete Tab.
• Rename a tab: Hover over a tab, click the More Actions icon and Edit Tab Name.
• Reorder tabs: Hold the Reorder icon next to a tab and drag it to the desired position.
Note: The available tabs depend on the Wix apps installed on this site.

title: How can I disable the pop-up blocker for Wix.com in Safari?
content: In Safari, go to www.wix.com. Click Safari in the top menu and select Settings. Click the Websites tab. Select Pop-up Windows under General on the left. Click the When visiting other websites dropdown at the bottom right and select Allow. Make sure you are using a supported Safari version; if you have an outdated version, update it to the latest version.

title: Can I design widgets in Wix Blocks that adjust according to specific custom breakpoints?
content: Currently, in Wix Blocks, you can build responsive layouts and define which layout is shown on mobile or desktop. However, it is not possible to design widgets that adjust according to specific custom breakpoints.

title: How can I upload a single track to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Media on the left side of the editor. Click the Upload Media icon. Choose your file(s) from your computer. Optional: select the file and click Add to Page to add it to your site.

title: How can I add and customize text for gallery images in Wix Editor?
content:
To add text to gallery images in Wix Editor: click the gallery in your editor, click Change Images, click the image you want to add text to, enter the image title, description, and link into the relevant fields, then click Done.

To customize the design of your text: click the gallery in your editor, click the Design icon, click Customize Design, select the Text tab, then choose how to adjust the text's look. Options include Color & opacity, Theme, Font, Font size, Formatting, and Text box opacity & color. The options displayed depend on the gallery preset you choose.

title: How can I create a new group on my Wix site using the dashboard?
content: Go to Groups in your site's dashboard. Click + Create Group. Choose the type of group: start from scratch or choose a template. Click +Start from scratch. Select a group template (for example, Health and Wellness), or click Create New Group to start from scratch. Enter the group's Info: give the group a name and click the Add Image icon to add a cover image. Under Privacy, choose who can see and join: Public (anyone can view), Private (only members can view the group's content; use the Visibility drop-down for settings such as Visible or Hidden), or Only paying members (click + Connect a Pricing Plan to choose an existing plan or create a new one). Click Create Group. Manage and customize every aspect of your group, then click Save.

title: How can I adjust the image scaling and position on a strip in Wix Editor if my image doesn't fit properly?
content:
To change the image scaling and position on a strip in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

- Select the image on the strip.
- Depending on whether your image takes up the whole strip or just a column, do one of the following:
  - Whole strip: Click **Change Strip Background**.
  - Column only: Click **Change Column Background**.
- Click **Settings**.
- Scroll down to **Scaling & Positioning**.
- Click the **How's the image scaled?** drop-down and select an option:
  - **Original Size:** The original size image is displayed. Parts of it may be cut off.
  - **Scale to Fill:** The image is resized to fill the available space. You may want to reposition it.
  - **Tile:** The image is displayed in tile formation across the available space.
- Select a position for your image under **Where is it positioned?**.

**Tip:** This is helpful if your image is not centered or is focused on the wrong area.

Alternatively, you can crop the image to better fit the available space.

title: Is it possible to increase the total field storage limit for an item in a collection?
content: Currently, there is a limit to how much data you can store in a single item's combined collection fields: you can store up to 500KB of data in an item's total collection fields. This limit does not apply to image, document, multi document, video, audio, or media gallery fields.

title: How can I schedule recurring appointments using Wix Bookings?
content: Before you begin, discuss the details of the recurring appointments with your client. Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the Add drop-down at the top, or select a time slot on the calendar, and click Appointment. Select the client from the Client Name drop-down or type a new client's name and click + Add to contacts. (Optional) Add the client's phone number. Click Continue and select a service. Select the Date and Arrival time. Click the Repeats checkbox, choose how frequently the appointments repeat from the Repeats drop-down, and choose the number of times from the For drop-down. You can schedule a maximum number of 6 recurring appointments at a time. Select the relevant Location. (Optional) Click the Edit icon to edit session details such as Session starts, Duration, and Staff member, choose the relevant Payment options option, click Save, and click Continue. Review the Schedule Summary, optionally click Remove to remove unwanted sessions, then choose Book or Book & Collect Payment. To charge your client from Booking Calendar, select the relevant appointment and choose an option from the Collect Payment drop-down: Charge with pay link, Charge card manually, Charge with invoice, or Mark as paid.

title: How can I delete an entire channel from my video library in Wix?
content: To delete a channel from your video library in Wix, go to Video Library in your site's dashboard, click the Channels tab, click the channel you want to delete, click the Show more icon at the top right, click Delete, and click Delete Channel to confirm.

title: Can I change the padding for mobile app elements in the Spaces app?
content: You can now adjust the padding for elements that you add to your app from the Mobile App Editor.

title: How can I edit my site's robots.txt file using Wix?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to Robots.txt Editor under Tools and settings. Click View File. Add your robots.txt file info by writing the directives under This is your current file. Click Save Changes. Click Save.

title: How do I connect my Hopp account to my Wix account?
content: Go to hopp.co and login. Click Wix Site on the left. Then click either Create New Site or Connect Existing Site.

title: How can I enable or disable the weekly digest email for groups on my site?
content: To enable or disable the weekly digest email, go to Groups in your site dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top and select General Settings. To enable the email, select Send under Groups weekly digest. To disable the email, select Don't send under Groups weekly digest. Click Save.

title: How can I rename a file or folder from my site's dashboard using the File Share app?
content: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. Click the Show More icon next to the file or folder you want to rename. Select Rename. Enter a new name. Click Save.

title: What should I do if I receive the error message 'This Domain Is Associated with Another Wix account' when trying to add a domain to my Wix account?
content: If you receive the error message "This domain is associated with another Wix account. To connect (your domain), you need to remove it from the other account...", sign in to the Wix account where the domain is located and move the domain to your desired account. If you are unable to access the account your domain is currently connected to, you can fill out the account recovery form.

title: How can I enable the scroll bar to always be displayed in the Editor on my Mac?
content: You can enable the scroll bar so it's always displayed from your Mac computer's settings: Click the Apple menu at the top-left of the screen, select System Preferences, click General, and click Always under Show scroll bars. Note: The setting names may be different depending on your computer model and system version.

title: How can I add and set up a Switch input element in the Wix Editor to allow visitors to submit a binary response?
content:
Go to your editor. To add the Switch input element, go to the page where you want visitors to use the Switch input to submit a response. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Input. Click Switch. Click and drag the relevant Switch input element onto the page.

Connect the Switch element to the CMS collection where you will store the submissions. Click the Connect to CMS icon on the Switch element. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select a dataset that connects to the collection where you will store the submissions. Click the Toggled state connects to drop-down and choose the boolean field in which you will store the submissions. To add a new field for storing submissions, select Add new field, then enter the field name and click Add.

Set the dataset mode and collection permissions. Click Dataset Settings. Click the Dataset mode drop-down and select Write or Read & Write. If necessary, click the permissions type next to Collection Permissions and select Form submissions. You can click the additional drop-downs to refine the permissions. Click Save once you are done setting the permissions. Click Back to Switch element at the top of the Dataset Settings panel.

Customize the Switch input element. Click Settings to edit the Field title, Value (Velo only), and Field type. For Field type, select the checkbox if you want the switch to be toggled on by default. Click the Layout icon to set the handle placement, size, icon display, and direction. Click the Design icon to customize the design for both states: Switch On and Switch Off.

Add a 'Submit' button for visitors to click to send their submissions. Click Preview to test your connections. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I use the ReConvert Upsell and Cross Sell app with my Wix site?
content: To use the ReConvert Upsell and Cross Sell app, you need to add Wix Stores to your site. You can also use this app with Wix Bookings if you have Wix Stores installed on your site. The app is only available in English. You can customize your upselling and cross-selling offers using ReConvert’s no-code editor. It integrates with Wix checkout for both Wix Stores and Wix Bookings. Features include targeted product recommendations for high-intent shoppers and clients, native upsell and cross-sell offers with no coding or designing required, and ReConvert conversion specialists who are online 24/7.

title: How can I rename a lightbox in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the relevant lightbox in the Pages & Menu panel, click the More Actions icon, click Rename, enter the new name into the field, and then click Done.

title: How can I create a custom image for social media using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site. Tap Manage at the bottom, tap Marketing, and select Social Posts. Tap any template to get started, then customize your post using the available options: tap the Overlay icon to pick a different overlay with preset text and stickers; tap the Text icon from the bottom menu, tap Add Text, edit your social post text and tap Done at the top right, then optionally customize your text using the available options and tap Done; tap the Sticker icon to add new stickers to your post; tap the Image icon to add images from your site uploads or your phone. When you are done, share your post by tapping Share at the top right and select where you want to share: Facebook to share the post to your Facebook business page and follow the on-screen instructions to connect to the relevant page; Instagram to share the post to your Instagram feed or story; Save Image to save the post as an image in your mobile device; More to share your post to any of the available apps in the menu.

title: How can I add a Back to top button to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Mobile Tools on the left side of your mobile editor. Click the Add to site icon next to Back to top button. Note: The Back to top button only appears on pages with the Standard layout, and pages that are at least 1380 pixels long (not on short pages).

title: How can I delete Wix Bookings from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor. Hover over **Bookings Pages** and click the **Actions** icon. Click **Delete Bookings**. Click **Delete** to confirm. Important: Deleting Wix Bookings does not cancel your site upgrade. Learn how to cancel a Premium or Studio plan.

title: How can I create a 'Buy X, Get Y Free' coupon in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard. Click + New Coupon. Select Buy X get Y free. Enter the Coupon code customers need to enter and the Coupon name. Set up the coupon offer: for Buy, enter the number of products customers must purchase to get free product(s); for Get, enter the number of products customers get free. Select an option from the Apply to drop-down: All products, Specific product, or Specific category. Select when the coupon is valid by entering the start date and the end date, or selecting Don't set an end date. Optionally select the limits you want to apply: Limit the total number of uses for this coupon and/or Limit to one use per customer. Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I connect Bancontact as a payment method through Stripe on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Bancontact through Stripe on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Bancontact.
- Click Connect next to Stripe.
- Select an option:
  - Have a Stripe account: Click Connect.
  - Don't have an account: Click Create Stripe account and follow the instructions to create an account.
- Return to this window and click Connect.

Ensure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Stripe account. If the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I delete the Members Area from my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor. Hover over **Members Area** and click the **Actions** icon, then click **Delete Member's Area** and click **Delete** to confirm.

Keep in mind that deleting this area removes all member pages, including the default ones that were added automatically and any pages you've created on your own, and it may affect other installed applications.

title: How can I connect my Google Tag Manager account to my Wix site?
content:
To use this feature, you must have a Premium site and a connected domain. If your site uses a cookie banner, Google Tag Manager will only gather data after a visitor provides consent and approves using the relevant cookies.

First, sign in to your Google Tag Manager account. Copy the ID from the Accounts page, or select your account and copy the ID from your Google Tag Manager dashboard. Make sure to set up the parameters of your tag(s) in your Google Tag Manager account.

Next, go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Click Connect under Google Tag Manager. Click Add Google Tag Manager. Enter your Google Tag Manager ID. Click Save.

Note: Wix does not provide support for technical difficulties associated with third-party code snippets. If you are experiencing an issue with your code snippet, please contact the provider directly.

title: Can I add notes to customers in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can add notes or instructions to your restaurant's customers, and this feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How do I accept or reject an incoming order using the new Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content:
To accept or reject an order, go to Online Orders in your site's dashboard. Choose what you want to do:
* Accept: Click Accept.
* Reject: Click the More Actions icon. Select Cancel order or Cancel and refund order. (Optional) Deselect the email to customer. (Optional) If sending an email to your customer, enter a short note. Click Continue. Click Cancel order.

Note: This cannot be undone.

title: How does currency conversion work for Facebook Ads if my store currency is different from my subscription currency?
content:
When you purchase a Facebook Ads subscription, Wix takes 15% as a fee. The remaining 85% is your ad spend used on Facebook to run ads on their platform. If your subscription currency is in a currency other than USD, Wix must first convert the 85% remaining ad spend to USD so it can be spent on Facebook.

Your Facebook Ads dashboard shows data such as revenue and remaining ad spend in your store currency. If your store currency is a currency other than USD, Wix also converts the daily amount spent on Facebook from USD back to your store currency to align with the rest of the dashboard.

Example: your location is Spain, your store currency is Euro, and your subscription currency is Euro. You purchase a Facebook Ads subscription in Euro. Wix takes 15% as a fee in Euro. Wix converts the remaining 85% to USD to pay Facebook to run your ads. Every day some of your ad spend in USD is used on Facebook as people see and interact with your ads. Wix converts whatever USD was spent that day to Euro and translates it back to your Facebook Ads dashboard. For example, on Monday $5 was spent on Facebook. Wix converts the $5 to Euro based on the daily exchange rate. Monday's exchange rate was 0.83. Wix takes 5 x 0.83 and gets €4.13 Euro. When you look in your Facebook Ads dashboard for the ad spend that day, you will see €4.13 Euro.

Wix converts back to your store currency each day so the data aligns with your revenue and the rest of the stats on your dashboard, helping you understand the whole picture of your campaign in the same currency.

title: Can I still connect Rappi as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Rappi is no longer available to connect as a payment provider. As part of their newly adopted strategy, Paga con Rappi has decided to stop their connections to all platforms, including Wix. To continue accepting payments, Rappi users must change their provider for accepting payments.

title: How can I delete the Wix Multilingual app from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Deleting Wix Multilingual permanently erases all editor translations and translations from any Wix apps you have installed. In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, then click Manage Apps at the bottom. Click the More Actions icon next to Wix Multilingual, then click Delete. Click the Why are you deleting this app? drop-down and select a reason. You can optionally type additional feedback in the Details field. Click Delete App, then publish your site so changes go live.

title: Is it possible to add an 'Upload File' option to my Wix Stores Product Page?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add an Upload File option to your Product Page which would allow customers to provide more details (e.g. images) about the product they want to purchase.

### Workarounds
* You can add an upload file button to the Product Page using the following apps:
  + Uploadly third-party app
  + FUP: File Upload for Products
* You can add a customer message box to your Product Page so customers can provide more information.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my VAT number for a tax exemption in South Korea on Wix?
content:
If you are a VAT registered business in South Korea with a VAT number from the South Korean National Tax Service, you may be eligible for a tax exemption. You can add your VAT number to your Wix account by updating your payment details.

To update your payment details:
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription.
Click Update Payment Method.
Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next.
Click Edit Details.
Re-enter your card details and add your VAT Number to the VAT ID field.
Click Update.

The exemption will apply from the next payment after that date.

title: Can I set videos to play automatically when users scroll to them on the page?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a scroll animation to a video so that it starts playing as visitors scroll the page.

title: How can I connect a page element to a CMS collection using the Wix Editor?
content:
To connect an element to your CMS collection in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the element you want to connect to the CMS (e.g. text, image, gallery).
- Click the Connect to CMS icon.
- For certain input elements only, choose Filter content to let site visitors filter page content, or Collect content to collect content submitted by site visitors.
- Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click Add a Dataset, choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name, and click Create.
- Use the drop-downs in the panel on the right to connect each part of the element to the relevant collection fields. You can select Add new field to create and connect a new collection field. The options vary depending on the page element type.
- Click Preview at the top right to test your connections.
- Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.
If you've enabled sandbox collections, sync your sandbox collection to your live collection to publish sandbox collection content to your live site.

title: Can I automatically add participants to a program when they purchase its connected Pricing Plan?
content: You can now automatically add participants to a program when they purchase its connected Pricing Plan.

title: How do I open the Wix Editor to start building my website?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Edit Site next to your site's name.

title: Can I create unique shipping rules for different cities and counties in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create unique shipping rules for different cities and counties. It is, however, possible to create different shipping rules for regions (e.g. states, provinces etc.). If you cannot find a shipping region you need, contact us and let us know which region is missing.

title: How can I change the color of the header for my Wix blog feed and post page on mobile?
content:
To change the background color of the header for your Wix blog feed or post page on mobile, use the Settings panel of your blog page or post page in your desktop Editor (not the Wix app on your mobile device). Then switch to mobile view to see how it looks.

Wix Editor:
- Go to the page you want to edit in your Editor.
- Click Pages on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Blog Pages.
- Choose to customize your main blog feed or the post page: for Main Blog Feed, click Blog; for Post Page, click Post.
- Click the Blog or Post element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Design tab.
- Click Background & Buttons.
- Select a background color for your button under Button Style.
- Publish your site.

Editor X:

- Choose to customize your main blog feed or the post page: for Main Blog Feed, click Blog; for Post Page, click Post.

- Click Settings.

- Select a background color for your button under Button Style.
- Publish your site.

title: How do I add a dynamic list page in the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin: Create a CMS collection that includes the items you want to display on your dynamic list page. Create a dynamic item page for your collection. Alternatively, you can add the dynamic item page at the same time as your dynamic list page.

Steps to add a dynamic list page in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click CMS on the left side of the editor.
- Click Your Collections.
- Click the collection that you want to create your dynamic list page from.
- Click More Actions and select Add dynamic page.
- Select List page and click Add to Site.

Tip: Select Item page as well to add a dynamic item page for the collection at the same time.

title: How can I offer online services using Wix Bookings?
content: You can offer online services using platforms like Zoom, Google Hangouts, or Skype by adding video conferencing links to your site. In your site's dashboard, go to the Booking Services tab, scroll down to the Service Details section, click the Add button in the Video Conferencing section, and choose your preferred type of VC connection.

title: How can I connect Pelecard as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Pelecard as a payment provider on Wix: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Pelecard. If you have a Pelecard account, enter your TerminalNumber, User, and Password, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Pelecard account, register for a Pelecard merchant account, and once approved you will receive your unique TerminalNumber, User, and Password. Then return to Accept Payments and follow the "Have an account" steps. Note: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Pelecard account; if they do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: What are the steps to connect a domain to Wix using name servers, and what should I consider regarding business emails?
content: To connect a domain to Wix using name servers, connect the domain by name servers so Wix hosts your DNS records and you manage DNS settings from your Wix account. For business email, ensure the domain's DNS includes the email provider's required records, such as MX, A, CNAME, and TXT records. Wix automatically imports existing MX records when connecting via name servers, but some providers require additional records such as CNAME or TXT; in that case, add those DNS records manually in your Wix account. For Microsoft Office 365 business emails, several custom DNS records are required; if those business emails are already functioning, connect by pointing to avoid re-adding the DNS records in your Wix account.

title: How can I add and customize a search box for events?
content:
Go to the Wix App Market: Editor: click the Add Apps icon on the left side of the Editor. Editor X: click the App Market icon on the top bar of Editor X. Enter Wix Site Search in the search bar. Select the Wix Site Search app. Click Add to Site.

Customize the search box: click the search box in the Editor, click Settings, enter placeholder text suitable for event searches (e.g. Search for an event), then click the Layout icon and Design icon to customize the look of the search box.

Customize the search results page: click Pages on the left side of the Editor, select Site Menu, click the page named Search Results, and click the Search Results page in the Editor. To display only events, click Settings, click the Settings tab, and click the toggle next to other types of search results to disable them. Optionally, in the Settings tab, click the Edit icon next to Events and edit the Events tab label. To increase the number of results per page, click the Layout tab and drag the Number of results per page slider to increase the number of events displayed in the first page of search results. Use the rest of the customization options to further customize the behavior and look of the search results page.

Tips: To see how your event search works, publish your changes and test it on your live site. After your search runs for a while, you can use Wix Analytics to see what customers are looking for.

title: How can I add a Members Area to my site using Editor X?
content: Head over to the Add panel to add a Members Area to your site. Click Add on the top of Editor X. Click Members. Click Add to Site. Once you do, we'll add a login bar, basic member pages and signup and login forms to help you get started.

title: How can I end my Facebook Ads campaign early and what happens to the unused ad spend?
content: To end your Facebook Ads campaign early, go to Facebook Ads, click the Campaign Actions drop-down, click End immediately, and click End Anyway to confirm. If you have unused ad spend once you end your campaign, it is saved until you choose to restart. You can restart at any time by clicking Edit & Restart in the dashboard. If you want your campaign to end once your subscription expires rather than immediately, turn off auto-renewal of your subscription. If you attempt to restart your campaign after your subscription has expired, you must purchase a new subscription before the campaign can go live and use any remaining ad spend.

title: How can I optimize my Google Ads campaign using the Wix AI Assistant?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Google Ads, hover over the relevant campaign, click Go to Dashboard, then click Optimize with AI. The Wix AI Assistant opens on the right and analyzes your campaign data to recommend a metric to start with (impressions, clicks, or conversions). Follow the recommendation: for impressions, optimize Targeted locations, Keyword themes, or Daily spend using Add, Suggest other locations, Add & Replace, or Suggest other keyword themes; for clicks, review search terms and use Exclude Terms or Suggest others, get Ad content suggestions and use Add & Replace or Show more content options, or add Keyword themes; for conversions, modify your ad's landing page (the targeting URL) and choose Add & Replace or I'm satisfied with my URL. You can type "What else can you do?" in the chat to see other options; recommendations may differ based on your site and campaign settings. Note: You can only use the AI Assistant if your campaign has been running for at least 20 days; if you modified the campaign in the last 14 days, wait before optimizing it again.

- Select the checkbox to the left of the videos that you want to sell.

title: How can I effectively choose keyword themes for my Google Ads campaign using Wix?
content:
When picking keyword themes for a Google Ads campaign using Wix, follow these guidelines:

* Aim for a maximum of 7-10 keyword themes. Adding too many keyword themes might show the ad in less relevant results. Your themes need to be relevant and concise enough so they show to the right audiences. Also, don't use punctuation marks, URLs, phone numbers, or keyword themes that exceed 20 characters.
* Use long-tail keyword themes rather than short-tail keyword themes. Long-tail keyword themes (e.g. 'organic coffee shops near me') are more effective than short-tail or single keywords (e.g. 'coffee shop'). Try to be as specific and descriptive to your business as possible to maximize the best audience.
* Don't repeat words you are already eligible for. A single keyword theme also represents similar phrases and words. For example, the keyword theme 'bakery' also means your ad will potentially be shown for searches like 'local bakery' 'cake shop' 'bakery near me.' So don't add both 'bakery' and 'local bakery' as two separate themes.
* Utilize excluded terms to make sure your ad doesn't appear for irrelevant searches. For example, if you sell eyeglasses, you might want to add 'wine glasses' or 'drinking glasses' as excluded terms.
* Remember your advertising strategy. Are you advertising your overall business or a specific product/service? Limit your keyword themes to precisely what you're advertising.
* Think like your customers. What is your audience most likely to be searching for when looking for the product or service you offer? Tip: You can include brands as keyword themes without causing trademark issues.

You can remove the 'More' menu item by renaming it with a title that is not language-specific (such as three dots), stretching the menu to display all site pages, or adding a menu folder and moving the additional pages to this folder. title: How can I send a broadcast SMS message using my Business Phone Number on Wix?

Select the contacts you want to send a broadcast message to; the contacts receive the messages separately, not as a group message. Tap the drop-down at the bottom left and select SMS for your broadcast. You can also send a broadcast message via chat or email. Compose the message that will be sent to your selected contacts via SMS. Tap the Add icon to add photos, saved replies, and more to the broadcast. Tap Send. For contacts with no associated phone number, choose if and how to inform contacts with no phone number: send email to contacts without numbers, or send SMS only to contacts with phone numbers. Tap Send Broadcast to send the broadcast SMS. You can also send a broadcast message specifically to those who booked a service or signed up for an event.

Add elements to your campaign, click Next at the top right, edit the sender details including the subject line, 'From name' and reply-to email, then click Send now. Note: If no contacts currently match a segment's filters, you cannot send a campaign.

content: If your Google Workspace renewal payment failed due to an expired credit card, contact your bank or credit card company to check why the payment failed and update your payment details accordingly. If your business email subscription has already been canceled, then you must repurchase it.

title: How can I edit or reuse an existing email campaign in Email Marketing?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Email Marketing. Click Edit on the relevant email draft or click Reuse on a previously sent campaign. You can also learn how to add and edit the elements in your email campaign and how to preview and test your email campaign before you send it.

content:
To connect your Instagram page to Wix Inbox, go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings drop-down at the top right. Click Communication Channels. Click Connect Account next to Instagram Business. Log in to Facebook and follow the steps to connect your account.

Important: You must have an Instagram professional account that is connected to a Facebook page. Make sure to use a desktop computer rather than a mobile device to connect Wix Inbox to Instagram.

title: How can I ensure that my input elements are correctly connected to my dataset in the CMS?
content: In your editor, go to the page where your input elements are located. Click the relevant input element (e.g. text input, dropdown). Click the Connect to CMS icon. Check that the element connects to the correct dataset that submits to the correct collection. Check that the element connects to the collection field it should submit to. Learn how to check the dataset connections between your input elements and your collection.

title: How can I invite collaborators to edit a site in the Studio Editor?
content:
Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left. Hover over Site, then hover over Team Work. Click Invite People to Collaborate.

When inviting people to help edit a site, you can limit their editing permissions based on the areas they should handle. The Editor is automatically adjusted to each person's role so any unauthorized action is either hidden or disabled.

title: Can I offer combinations of price options for a service in Wix Bookings?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to offer combinations of price options for a service. This would allow you to combine different price options (e.g. location, duration, etc.) to determine the cost of your service.

Workaround: Create your desired combinations using custom price options. For example, create price options for each service duration, at each location, with the relevant prices. You then need to manually assign the relevant staff member, at the relevant location, to the service.

content:
In the Editor, click the Wix Hotels app and click Manage. Choose your property type and click Next. Click Add Rooms. Add your first room type (for example, Standard, Deluxe, Superior).

- Enter the room details: Name this room, Units, Max Guests, Max Kids, and Room Size. Use the drop-down to switch Room Size units.
- Add bed details: choose a Bed type from the drop-down and enter the number of beds. Repeat for each bed in the room if needed.
- Select room amenities. Click +More Amenities for additional options or to add your own.

Charge per person charges for each guest individually. Enter the regular price in Weekday price. You can enter a special Weekend price. Click + More pricing options for options such as weekly or monthly price and charges for additional guests.
- Click Save.

To add another room type, click Create New and repeat the room setup.

title: How can I troubleshoot errors in my structured data markup on a Wix site?
content:
If the Google Rich Results Tool says your markup is eligible for rich results but you still have errors when you add it to your site's pages, follow these checks:

1. Check the format of your markup: Wix site pages can only use markup in a JSON-LD format. Make sure your code begins with the HTML tag <script type="application/ld+json"> and ends with </script>. Use only one script tag and include only one main markup type. Your markup should have less than 7,000 characters.

2. Check for HTML tags inside your JSON-LD: The only HTML tags allowed in your markup are the script tags at the beginning and end of the code. Do not enter HTML tags inside the JSON-LD part, as this will cause validation to fail.

3. Check your punctuation: Each JSON-LD element must be wrapped in curly brackets { }. Separate each element in the JSON-LD with a comma, except for the last element. Use straight quotes rather than curly quotes.

4. Check your fields for spaces: All fields should have the format "key":"content" and each field must be on a single line. Do not press 'Enter' to create a line break within a field, as this will cause validation to fail.

You can also validate your markup for eligibility for rich results or check markup issues by pasting it into the Google Rich Results Tool.

title: Can I add an app-ads.txt file to my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add an app-ads.txt file to your site. The app-ads.txt file works like an ads.txt file for mobile apps. Adding this file would let you identify the digital sellers that you've authorized to sell your products. Learn more about app-ads.txt.

title: How can I connect Cashfree Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Connect next to Cashfree Payments. If you have an account, enter your App ID and Secret Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Cashfree Payments account. Once your account is created, activate your account and retrieve your credentials from Cashfree Payments. Return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I access my Music Library from the Editor?
content: Click your Wix Music player in the Editor. Click Manage Your Music.

title: How can I disconnect a channel from the Channel Manager in Wix Hotels?
content: This applies to the original Wix Hotels. To disconnect a channel from the Channel Manager in Wix Hotels, deactivate it inside your account on the relevant channel. For Booking.com: go to admin.booking.com, click Account, go to Channel Manager, and click Deactivate. For Airbnb (API): log in to your Airbnb host account, click ACCOUNT under your profile picture, click Privacy & Sharing, and remove "Hotel Runner" from the connected apps section. For Expedia and Other OTA's: call your channel account manager and ask them to deactivate the HotelRunner for you. For iCals: go to the Room Type Mapping for the iCal in Wix Hotels / Channel Manager, select Don't send for the mapping, click Save; in another window go to the admin dashboard of the relevant channel, go to the iCal section, delete the import calendars you created for HotelRunner, and click Save. Once you deactivate the channels, your connection at HotelRunner will end within 24 hours. If you would like the connection to be deactivated immediately, email wix@hotelrunner.com after making sure your connection is deactivated on the channel's end. If you are disconnecting all channels, you can turn off your Wix Hotels Channel app subscription so that it does not renew at the end of the subscription period by clicking the Show more icon next to Wix Hotel Channels and clicking Cancel App.

title: How can I hide a page from my site's menu using the Wix Editor?
content: To hide a page from your site menu, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Select Hide from menu. Note: Hiding a page on the desktop version of your site does not mean that the page will be hidden on the mobile version.

title: Can I add alt text to a file directly inside the Wix Media Manager?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add alt text to a file directly inside the Media Manager. You must add alt text to each individual file in the Editor.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site background displays correctly on tablets or iPads?
content: Upload an image that is at least as large as your monitor size. In your Editor, go to the relevant page, click Site Design on the left side, hover over Page Background and click Customize. Click Image. In the Media Manager, click + Upload Media at the top left, select an image on your computer that is at least as large as your monitor size, and click Open. Select the uploaded image and click Change Background. Click Settings on the image background preview, select Original size from the How's the image scaled? drop-down menu, and select the top center position under Where's the image positioned?. Publish your site. You may need to clear your tablet or iPad's cache to view the changes.

title: Can I migrate my gallery content from an Editor gallery to a Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to migrate your gallery content in an Editor gallery to a Wix Pro Gallery. If you want to switch to a Pro Gallery, you must add a Pro Gallery and add your media to the gallery manually.

title: Can I convert my Wix site to a Progressive Web Application?
content: Currently it is not possible to convert your site to a Progressive Web Application. However, you can create an app for your site with the Wix Branded App. The Branded App allows you to connect with your site and customers to expand your business and promote your brand.

title: How can I add a scroll animation to an element in the Wix Studio Editor?
content:
To add a scroll animation in the Wix Studio Editor:
- Select the relevant element or section.
- Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor.
- Click the Animations and Effects tab.
- Click + Add under Scroll.
- Under Animated element, choose which element shows the animation.
- Under Animation type, select In to make the animation's ending point the current design on canvas, or Out to make the animation's starting point the current design on canvas.
- Select an animation from the list. Hover over animations to see a preview.

Notes: A pinned element cannot be set as the trigger because it stays in the same position relative to the visitor's viewport. Make sure there is enough room on the page for the scroll animation to appear properly; for example, an element on the first or last fold might not show the scroll animation.

title: How can I enable search engines to index my Wix site?
content: Go to your SEO dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Make sure the Let search engines index your site toggle is enabled. You can also check out the Wix SEO Setup Checklist for a step-by-step plan designed to help improve your site's SEO.

title: Can I change information in a store order on Wix Stores?
content: It is now possible to make changes to an existing order. You can add or remove products, edit prices, add a tip or discount, update customer details, and more.

title: How can I add a new field to my Wix site form?
content:
To add a new field to your site form:

- Click the site form in your editor.
- Click **Edit Form** to open the form builder.
- Click the **Add** icon on the left.
- Click the type of field you want to add.

For old forms:

- Click **Add New Field** above the form.
- Choose the type of field you want to add on the left.
- Hover over the field you want to add and click the **Add** icon.

The new field appears on your site form. Click the new field to edit it.

title: How can I remove a form from my Wix site using the new Wix Forms?
content: To remove a form using the new Wix Forms, go to the editor and select the form you want to delete. Right-click the form and click Delete. Optionally, you can remove the form from Forms & Submissions in your site's dashboard: click the More Actions icon next to the relevant form and click Delete. This moves the form to the Deleted forms folder. After 180 days, the form is permanently deleted with no option to restore it.

title: How can I automatically send invoices for orders in Wix Bookings?
content: You can send automatic invoices from the eCommerce Settings section of your site's dashboard. Invoices are created only after the order status changes to "Paid". Automatic invoices are created for bookings paid for through your site, but not for bookings paid for through manual payment or payment in person methods. For those payment methods, you can create automated invoicing using Wix Automations.

title: What should I do if I can't sign into my Wix account because I've lost access to my phone and haven't enabled 2-Step Verification for email?
content:
If you are unable to sign into your Wix account because you have lost access to your mobile phone, and you have not enabled 2-Step Verification for email, please fill out our ownership verification form.

Important:
- Don't forget to provide us with a valid contact email so we can respond to you.
- Be sure to fill out the entire form, even if you're not completely sure of the answers. Add a detailed explanation of your case, including that you have lost access to your recovery phone, so we can properly verify your account ownership.

Our team will review your request. We'll contact you if any further information is required for the verification process.

Notes:
- After account recovery, you will need to re-enable 2-Step Verification to continue using it. We recommend enabling both phone and email options.
- Wix reserves the right to determine and/or grant ownership to an account or site based on our reasonable judgment. We also reserve the right to deny granting access to a user who lost the account credentials, in our sole discretion, without liability to any party.

title: Can guests see how many tickets are still available for an event on my Wix site?
content: Currently, guests visiting your site cannot see how many tickets are still available for an event. If you create a seating map for your event, guests buying tickets can see exactly which seats are available while completing the purchase.

title: How can I manually update item information on the Amazon app to see changes immediately?
content: To update the app manually and make the changes visible immediately: click the Amazon app in your Editor; click Settings; click Main; click Manage Items; hover over the relevant item and click the Refresh icon.

title: Can I schedule appointments in Wix Bookings without assigning a specific staff member?
content: Currently, it is not possible to schedule appointments without assigning a specific staff member in charge of the session. As a workaround, you can create a generic staff profile to represent unstaffed sessions, allowing you to offer appointment services without needing to assign them to individual staff members at the time of booking.

title: How can I reorder menu items in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, open the Menus & Pages panel on the left side, then click and drag the menu items to a new position in the list.

title: How can I add a background scroll effect to a section in Editor X?
content: To add a background scroll effect to a section in Editor X, select a page section, click the Background Scroll Effects icon, and then select an effect from the list. Note that the scroll effects available depend on the background type you have chosen for your section (i.e., color, media, or gradient).

title: Can I add additional custom fields to the Checkout Page in Wix Stores?
