content: Yes. You can now add multiple custom fields to the Checkout Page in addition to the preset fields. You can choose from a wide variety of field types, such as text fields, multiple choice, and checkboxes.

title: Are Wix site builders and site dashboards fully accessible?
content: Wix live sites include built-in accessibility settings and features that comply with the highest global standards. However, the Wix site builders and site dashboards are not yet fully compliant. You can follow the checklist to improve the accessibility of your live site.

title: How can I connect my Facebook page to Wix Inbox?
content: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings drop-down at the top right. Click Communication Channels. Click Connect Account next to Facebook Page. Log in to Facebook and follow the steps to connect your account. Important: Make sure to use a desktop computer rather than a mobile device to connect Wix Inbox to Facebook.

title: How can I preview how my Wix page looks in Google search results using the Wix Editor?
content: Use the SEO Basics tab of your page's SEO panel to preview how it will look in Google search results. In the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Check your page preview under Preview on Google. Google search results include the page's title tag, the page's URL, and a snippet from the page's meta description.

title: Can I change the section color in the mobile view of my site?
content: Currently, you cannot change the section color on the mobile view of your site. However, you can change the layout of the section and your site colors, which can affect the section color as well.

title: How can I edit a video created with Wix Video Maker?
content:
You can edit your saved or shared promotional videos at anytime with the Wix Video Maker. Go to Media, select your video, and start making your improvements.

To edit your Video Maker video:
- Click Media on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Show All under any category.
- Click Site Files tab.
- Select the Video Maker folder.
- Hover over your video and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Edit Video to go back to editing.

Tip: You can also edit your videos from Your Social Content in the dashboard. Hover over the relevant video and click Edit.

title: Can I transfer my Swiss (.ch) domain to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer a Swiss (.ch) domain extension to Wix. However, you can connect a .ch domain that you already own to your Wix site. Important: To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

title: How do I connect MakeCommerce as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to MakeCommerce. If you have an account, enter your Shop ID and Secret key and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create MakeCommerce account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from MakeCommerce to get your Shop ID and Secret key credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps. Make sure the currency in your Wix account matches the currency in your MakeCommerce account to avoid transaction declines.

title: How can I add and customize a section grid in the Studio Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, sections come with a built-in grid containing a single cell that houses the entire section. To give the content a responsive structure, split the section layout into more cells. Choose a customizable layout, then refine it by adding new cells or splitting existing ones. To adjust the size of each cell, drag the grid lines on the canvas.

title: How can I add my Wix store products to my TikTok for Business catalog?
content: Go to TikTok Catalog in your site's dashboard, then click Create Now and connect to TikTok for Business by logging in to an existing business account, switching a personal account to a business account, or creating a new TikTok for Business account. Next, log in to TikTok for Business, select your business account, click Assets and select Catalog, click Create, complete the form, and click Create. Then return to your site's dashboard, go to TikTok Catalog, click Get Catalog Link, click Copy, and click Close. Finally, go to your dashboard on TikTok, select the catalog you want to add products to, select Products from the menu on the left, click Add Products, select Data Feed Schedule, and follow the instructions to add products using a data feed schedule. When asked to input the URL where your product file is hosted, paste the catalog link you copied.

title: Can I translate my Events Schedule in Wix Events using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate your Events Schedule in Wix Events with Wix Multilingual.

title: 亚马逊Listing标题的格式要求和字符限制是什么？
content: 亚马逊标题按品牌名、核心关键词、核心卖点、规格/数量的顺序组织；核心关键词与核心卖点位于前80字符内，总长度不得超过200字符，建议控制在150字符以内。标题不得全大写，也不得使用Best、#1、Sale等促销或绝对化用语。

title: How can I add and customize a category menu in Wix Editor for my blog?
content: To add and customize the category menu in Wix Editor: Go to the page where you want the category menu to appear. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Blog. Select the Category Menu element. Drag it to position it on the page. Click the element in your editor. Click Settings. Use the tabs on the left to customize the category menu. Under Display, use the Show All Posts toggle to show all posts in the category widget, and use the Show number of posts toggle to display the number of posts in the category widget. Under Layout, set Text alignment to Left, Center, or Right; adjust Text padding (left & right); and adjust Text padding (top & bottom). Under Design, customize Font style & color using the Expand icon and color box; Background color using the color box and slider; Divider opacity & color using the color box and slider; Divider width using the slider; Border opacity and color using the color box and slider; Border width using the slider; and Corner Radius using the slider.

title: Can I filter my calendar by services in the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to filter your calendar by services in the Wix app. However, you can filter by services on your desktop calendar.

title: How can I resend a collaborator invitation on my Wix site if it hasn't been accepted yet?
content:
Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant person and click the More Actions icon. Choose how you want to resend the invitation:

- To send it through Wix: Click Resend Invite. Wix will resend the invitation to the email address that you entered. Ask your collaborator to check their spam folder if they don't see it.
- To send it myself: Click Get Invite Link. The link is automatically copied to your clipboard. Paste it in an email or chat message to your collaborator.

Note: This feature is currently not available in Safari.

title: What should I do if the Cookie Alert pop-up keeps appearing on my Wix site?
content: The Cookie Alert app has been retired from the Wix App Market, and Cookie Alert banners will no longer be supported on your site. Delete the app and switch to the Privacy Center, where you can set up a Cookie Banner to be displayed on your site.

title: Can I use Velo with Wix Music?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use Wix Music with Velo. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

title: How do I add a scroll animation to my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: To add a scroll animation to your gallery: click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor, click Settings, click the Design tab, and click Scroll Animations. Then select an animation. Scroll animations are available in all gallery layouts except the Magic layout, and available animation effects depend on the layout you choose. Only the Scroll, Fade and Stack slide animations are available in the Slideshow and Thumbnails layouts. You can only customize animations for layouts with a horizontal scroll.

title: Why are my sorted items not appearing alphabetically on my live site even though I set sort conditions in the dataset settings?
content: Verify the sort conditions in your dataset settings, including the field and order. If you enabled the "Mirror on Site" feature, note that sorts added to the dataset override the order from your mirrored collection. Also make sure the dataset is in "Read" or "Read & Write" mode, because a "Write" mode dataset cannot read your collection content or apply sorts. Dataset sorts affect connected site elements, but they do not affect the order in your collection views.

title: How can I connect izipay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect izipay as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click Connect next to izipay.
- If you have an izipay account: enter your Shop ID and Key, then click Connect.
- If you do not have an izipay account: click Create izipay account, fill in the registration form and click Send. Wait for an email from izipay to get your Shop ID and Key. Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account.

The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your izipay account. If the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: Amazon Listing 标题优化有哪些硬性规则？
content: 标题控制在 200 字符以内，并让前 80 字符包含关键词数据中搜索量最高的词；只使用已提供的关键词数据，不要凭记忆补充关键词，也不要估算搜索量；不得写入产品信息之外的功能、材质、认证或效果声明。

title: How can I hire an Editor X specialist to design and build my site?
content: To have an Editor X specialist design and build your site, start your request, select the service you need help with, and click Next at the bottom right. If asked "Which website do you need help with?", select the relevant site and click Next. Then enter your contact details and click Submit. It is up to you and the Wix Partner you hire to determine the costs and terms of your agreement. Wix does not get involved in disputes between Partners and clients. You can view the Wix Marketplace Terms of Service for more details.

title: Can I freeze my footer into a fixed position inside ADI?
content: Currently you cannot freeze your footer into a fixed position inside ADI. If you want to freeze your footer, you should head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: How can I enable and configure pickup options for my restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: To offer pickup for restaurant orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app: go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard; click the Pickup tab; click the Pickup toggle to enable it; set the pickup details: Time until orders are ready, Minimum Order Price, and optionally click Edit to change opening hours. For hours, choose Opening Hours to make pickup available during your restaurant's opening hours, or Custom Hours to set specific days and hours where pickup is available. You can click the box with the + icon to set multiple custom hour settings. Select the checkbox under Curbside Pickup to give customers the option of having their food brought outside your restaurant. Enter curbside pickup instructions displayed to customers when placing their order. Choose whether to require additional customer information and enter the field label for that information. Click Save.

title: Can I add an image or a video to the page background using the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add an image or a video to the background of a page using the Studio Editor. Alternatively, you can add an image or a video background to page sections. To do this, select the section, open the Inspector panel, and click **Add image or video** (under **Design**).

title: How do I connect my Wix store to a Google Merchant Center account?
content:
Before you begin: If you previously created a Google Merchant account (even if it's for the same site), you must remove the old account and feeds before you can connect the new one.

To connect to a Google Merchant Center account:
- Go to Google Merchant Solutions in your site's dashboard.
- Click Get Started.
- Click Sign Up With Wix and complete the form to create a new account.
- Click Allow. Your Google Merchant Center account is now connected to your Wix site.
- Click Continue.

title: How can I add a new participant to a course in Wix Bookings?
content: To add a participant to a course in Wix Bookings, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the relevant course in your calendar, click Manage next to the number of participants, then click + Add Participant. Click the Name field and select who you want to add: an existing client by typing the name or selecting from the list, or a new client by clicking + Add Contact, entering the participant's details, and clicking Save. Enter the total number of participants for the booking under Group of; this can only be edited before the service is marked "Paid". Choose an option under How do you want to charge your client?: Charge with an invoice, Collect payment later, or Mark as paid. Optionally select Send confirmation email to participant. Then choose Save & Add Another or Save.

title: How can I create a discount for my restaurant using the original Restaurants Orders app?
content:
This applies to the original Restaurants Orders app.

To create a discount:
- Go to Marketing & SEO in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Restaurant Discounts tab on the left.
- Click + New Discount.
- Select a discount type:
  - Percentage off item: Offer a percentage discount (per item).
  - Amount off item: Offer a fixed price discount (per item).
  - Amount off order: Offer a discount on the total price of the order.
- Create your discount:
  - Name: Enter a name for the discount.
  - Discount: Enter the percent or amount you're offering to customers.
  - Description: Explain to customers what the discount applies to.
  Note: Customers see this description during checkout.
- Set the conditions for your discount:
  - (Optional) Minimum order price: Offer a discount to orders that are over a certain amount.
  - Delivery type: Choose the delivery types where the discount applies:
    - Delivery: Discount applies for delivery orders.
    - Pickup and Contactless Dine-in: Discount applies for customer pickup and contactless dine-in orders.
  - Platform: Choose the platforms where the discount applies:
    - Site: When customers order from your restaurant site.
    - Mobile (Web & App): When customers order on their mobile phones.
    - Phone order: When you're taking order from customers on the phone.
  - Apply to: Select what restaurant items the discount applies to and click Apply:
    - Entire menu: All items on your menus are discounted.
    - Sections: Select the checkbox next to menu sections to which the discount applies.
    - Dishes: Select the checkbox next to menu items to which the discount applies.
  - Available: Apply the discount to your opening hours, or specific days and times and click Apply.
- (Optional) Click the Discount Coupon toggle if you want customers to enter a coupon code during checkout to receive the discount. Then, select the usage limit for your coupon code:
  - Unlimited: Coupon can be used an unlimited number of times.
  - Limited: Enter the number of times the coupon can be used.
- Click Save.

title: Can I translate content in third-party apps using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate content in any third-party app that you add to your site. To see what content can be translated with Wix Multilingual, refer to the list of Translatable Content in Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I switch between pages in the Wix Editor to view or edit them?
content: Click the Switch Page panel on the top left of the editor, then select the relevant page. You can also navigate between pages by clicking the tabs on your site menu in preview mode.

title: I would like to know how to customize the content in automated emails for Wix Bookings (confirmation, cancellation and reminders for users)
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Booking Settings and click Emails & SMS notifications. Hover over the automation you want to customize and click Edit next to it. For reminder emails only, you can also click Edit next to Timing to adjust the timing. Scroll down to the action area and choose what you want to customize. To edit the email template, click Edit under Create an email, where you can customize existing elements in the email and add more elements. When finished, click Save. Note that you can only customize or edit certain parts of the pre-installed email automations.

title: How can I remove credit card permissions from a Billing Manager in my Wix account?
content: Go to Payment Methods in your Wix account. Click the Actions drop-down on the relevant card. Click Manage permissions. Click Remove Permission next to the relevant Billing Manager. Click Remove. Each credit card you add to your Wix account has independent permissions. If you update the permissions for one card, the other cards on your account are not affected. If you want to update a Billing Manager's permissions for all credit cards, you must do so for each card. Removing credit card permissions from a Billing Manager does not change their role.

title: How can I upload my own media to the Studio Editor site?
content: To upload your own media, click Media on the left side of the Editor, then click Upload Media in the Media Manager. Choose a source: from your computer, drag and drop files or click Upload from Computer, select the files, and click Open; from other Studio Editor sites, click My Wix Account, open the relevant site folder, select the files, and click Upload Selection; from social networks, select the relevant social network, click Connect, select the files, and click Upload Selection; from a link, click the Link icon, paste the link, and click Import. After uploading, the media file can be used anywhere on the site. For supported file types and sizes, see the supported file types and sizes information.

title: How can I duplicate a product in Wix Stores using the Wix mobile app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Store Products, or tap Catalog and select Store Products. Tap the product you want to duplicate. Tap the More Actions icon at the top of the screen. Select Duplicate. Edit the product name and any other details you need to change. Tap Save.

title: I'm interested in customizing the layout of my products in a grid gallery
content:
To customize a Grid Gallery:
- Go to the page in the editor containing the gallery you want to customize.
- Click the gallery and then click the Settings icon.
- Click the Layout tab and customize the gallery using the following options:
  - General: Click the toggle to stretch the gallery across the browser. If enabled, set margin size.
    Note: If enabled, selecting Responsive under Grid behavior is recommended.
  - Product grid:
    Tip: With the Fixed grid behavior setting, the settings stay the same no matter your visitor's screen size. With Responsive, the number of rows and columns adjust to the screen size, but this setting only works when the gallery is stretched to full width.
  - Product images: Select how the images you uploaded are displayed. Learn more
  - Add to Cart button: Choose where the button is placed.
    Note: If the button is placed on the image, the Quick View button won't be displayed.
  - Product info: Choose a product card layout option and customize it.
  - Product options: Click the toggles to display only color options or limit the color options.
  - Ribbons: Select where the ribbon appears and adjust padding.

title: How can I add teammates to my Wix Studio for enterprise account and assign them roles?
content: Click the Team tab on the left. Click + Invite People at the top right. Enter the email address(es) of your teammate(s). Note: To add multiple invitees, enter each email separated by a comma (,). Select the role(s) you'd like to assign to your teammate(s). Choose which sites they can access under Give Site Access: All sites and folders: All sites and folders under your Wix Studio for enterprise account. Specific sites or folders: Specific sites and/or folders that you select. Click Send Invite.

title: Is it possible to automatically notify customers when their order is rejected in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it's now possible to automatically notify customers when you reject their order. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I customize the Group page using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor and open your Group page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Groups pages, then click Group page. Click the Group element on your page and click Settings. Use the relevant tabs to customize the page: under Layout, click General to choose the cover image layout, height, and spacing, or click Media to choose the image gallery layout and the images per row; under Display, choose Discussions, Media, or About and select the checkbox next to each element you want to show; under Text, enter the placeholder text that appears in the field where members can write a post; under Design, customize the colors and fonts used in your header, text, buttons, links, background and borders, and click Reset to original design at the bottom if you need to revert your changes.

title: How can I set up a payment method for pricing plans on my Wix site?
content: To accept payments for pricing plans on your site, you must select an online payment method. The manual (offline) payment method is not available with Pricing Plans. If you offer plans without recurring payments, you can choose any online payment methods available in your region in the Accept Payments tab. If you offer a pricing plan with recurring payments, check which payment providers support recurring payments in your region and connect to one of those payment providers. If you choose to switch payment providers, you must first cancel all active recurring plans, switch providers, and then ask your clients to repurchase the same plan. To accept online payments, you need to upgrade your site.

title: Why is my Wix site not live even though my domain is connected?
content:
If you are unable to view your Wix site on your domain, check the following:

- You have published your Wix site.
- You have upgraded your Wix site.
- You have connected your domain.
- 48 hours have passed since you've changed your DNS records to Wix's records.

If, after 48 hours, you are still unable to access your site via your domain, use the Wix Domain Assistant to determine the connection issue.

Note: To connect your domain, you must upgrade your site. If you are still unable to view your site on your domain, contact Wix and they will be happy to assist you.

title: How can I ensure that my customers receive confirmation emails for their orders placed through Wix Restaurants?
content:
Wix Restaurants automatically sends a confirmation email to your customer after an order is placed through your online ordering system. The confirmation email includes:

* Order number
* Order summary
* Delivery address
* A link which customers can click to view their order status

Currently, you can't customize these confirmation emails. You can vote for this feature. Additionally, you cannot create your own as Wix Automations doesn't integrate with Wix Restaurants. You can vote for this feature as well.

title: Why doesn't my button do anything when I click it on my Wix site?
content: Check that the button link has been set up correctly for a text button or an icon button. Check whether another element, such as a text box, has been placed slightly over the button, since this can prevent your button from working properly. You can move or resize the element covering your button, or bring your button to the front. Try disabling the freeze setting on your header and footer, as these can sometimes overlap with the content of your site.

title: How do I add and set up a PayPal Buy Now button in Wix Editor?
content: To add a PayPal Buy Now button in Wix Editor, you must have a PayPal Business or Premier account. In the Editor, click Add Elements, click Button, click PayPal Buttons, then click and drag the Buy Now button to your site. To set it up, click the PayPal button, click Add PayPal Info, and select Selling under What's this button for?. Complete the fields including What's your PayPal email?, What's the product's name?, Want to add an ID number?, What's the price?, What's the currency?, How does PayPal open?, and What language is the button in?. To choose the layout, click the button, click the Layout icon, and select a layout preset from the options.

title: How can I display a different color variant of an item using the Amazon app on my Wix site?
content:
To display a different variant of an item, such as a color, using the Amazon app on your Wix site:

- Open the item page on Amazon.
- Select the variant (e.g. color) that you want to display.
- Copy the page URL (you can also copy the ASIN from the URL).
- Click the Amazon app in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Add Items.
- Click Add Items.
- Select the relevant country from the drop-down.
- Paste the URL or ASIN in the Manage Items search bar.
- Click Search.
- Click the checkbox next to the item.
- Click Save.

title: How can I create bulk coupons using the Bulk Coupon Creator app on my Wix site?
content: Make sure Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Events has been added to your site, and create a single coupon first. Then go to Bulk Coupon Creator in your site's dashboard. Under Choose a coupon to duplicate, enter the name of the coupon you created and select it. Choose an option for creating a CSV file with a list of codes: Use Wix’s blank CSV template: click Wix’s blank CSV template to download the template file, open the file, replace the sample coupon codes in column A with the codes you want to use, save or download the file as a CSV file, click +Upload CSV File, select the file from your computer and click Open, click Create Coupon, then click Got It once the coupons are created. Or use Wix's code generator tool: click Code generator tool, enter the number of codes you want to create (up to 1000), enter the number of characters in your code (up to 20; this does not include the characters in the prefix), optionally enter a prefix, click Generate, click Download CSV (this automatically uploads the generated codes), click Create Coupon, then click Got It once the coupons are created. To view the codes, go to Coupons in your site's dashboard and select Velo & Apps from the Created with drop-down.

title: How can I manually generate an invoice for an unpaid order in Wix Stores?
content: To manually generate an invoice for an unpaid order in Wix Stores: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant unpaid order. Click the Collect Payment drop-down and select Charge with invoice. Click Create Invoice. This creates a saved draft of your invoice. Then select how to send the invoice to your customer: Share using a link — Click Share link at the top, Click Click Here to Create a Link, Click Copy Link, Click Done, and send the link to your customer. Print a copy of the invoice — Click Print at the top, print a PDF or hard copy of the invoice, and send the invoice to your customer. Send by email — Click Send via email at the top, optionally edit the email's subject line or message, and Click Send.

title: Can I add the Google AdSense app directly in ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot add the Google AdSense app in ADI. However, you can follow the instructions to get an embed code. You can add the code to an HTML embed element to display your embedded content on your ADI site.

title: How can I track the performance of my paid ad campaigns in Wix Analytics if I'm running them outside of Wix?
content:
To track the performance of your paid ad campaigns in Wix Analytics when running them outside of Wix, you need to first complete two steps:

- **Connect to Facebook/Google:** In order to view the Amount spent and CPC (cost-per-click) for your campaigns, make sure you have connected your relevant social account (Facebook and/or Google).
  - Click **Connected platforms** under **Amount spent and CPC**.
  - Click **Connect** next to the relevant account.
  - Follow the prompts to connect your account.

- **Create a UTM tracking link and add it as the destination URL of your external ad:** In order to view the Sales and Sessions measures, you need to create a unique UTM tracking link from Wix and use it as the external ad's destination URL.
  - Click **Create a UTM tracking link**.
  - Fill out the relevant information including:
    - Adding your Wix site page URL (the page you want to open when the ad is clicked).
    - Selecting a traffic source (e.g. Facebook, Google, other).
      - **Note:** If you select Facebook or Google, the remaining fields are automatically populated.
    - (Optional) Adding your campaign ID and/or campaign name to get breakdowns by campaign.
      - **Note:** You will find this information inside the dashboard of the external platform you are running a campaign on (e.g. Google Ads).
  - Once the information is filled out, a unique tracking link appears at the bottom of the link builder. Click **Copy** to copy the link.
  - Open the external ad platform (e.g. Google Ads) and paste the new tracking link as the destination URL in your ad.

Once you have connected your Facebook and/or Google account(s) and added a UTM tracking link for external campaigns, you will be able to see all available data at the top of the paid ad campaign section. **Note:** The data begins from the moment you added the tracking link to the ad.

title: How can I contact the Wix Business Development department for a proposal?
content: To contact the Wix Business Development department, visit https://support.wix.com/en/article/contacting-wix-business-development. If your proposal is relevant, they will get back to you. For PR and Media queries, email pr@wix.com.

title: How can I add a new card to my workflow in Wix?
content: Go to Workflows in your site's dashboard. Click the drop-down next to the title to select the relevant workflow. Click + Add a Card under the relevant column. Click the text box under Link to Contacts to search for a contact. Note: If needed, you can then click + Add Contact to create a new one. (Optional) Enter a title for the card under Card Title.

title: How can I set permissions for a Google Drive file to allow others to edit it?
content: Select the file you want to share. Click Share on the top right. Click the drop-down arrow under Get Link. Choose to share the file with Anyone with the link. To allow others to edit the file, select Editor. Click Copy link.

title: How can I change my payment provider to Square for selling CBD products on Wix?
content: If your site is connected to a provider that does not support the sale of hemp and hemp-derived products, you can change your provider to Square after submitting the declaration form. After reading and submitting the declaration, you will be redirected to the Accept Payments tab in your site's dashboard. Click Connect beside your desired provider. Click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider. Connect your account: if you have an account, enter your credentials and click Sign in; if you do not have an account, click Create new account and follow the steps to create your account. When creating an account with a third-party payment provider to sell hemp or hemp-derived CBD products, the application process may take longer than usual. Wix cannot guarantee the approval of your account, which is at the sole discretion of the relevant payment provider. If you are connected to Wix Payments, after submitting the declaration form, your Wix Payments account will be automatically closed so you can connect to Square.

title: Why does Wix change the sender email address to a wixshoutout.com domain when using free public domains for email campaigns?
content: Mail services might not accept email marketing campaigns sent from free public domains, such as Gmail, Yahoo, and AOL. If you choose to use a public domain as your sender email address, Wix automatically changes the sender address to an authenticated wixshoutout.com email address. This is in order to ensure that your email will arrive to the inbox of your recipients, rather than their junk folder, or to be rejected entirely. Replies to your email campaigns are still sent to the Reply-to email address that you use. If you do not want your email campaigns to be sent from wixshoutout.com authenticated domain, it is best to use an email address on a domain that you own or any other private domain (eg. @your-business.com). You can purchase business email for your own domain directly from Wix.

title: How can I change the layout of my gallery cover photo in Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Create a new album or edit an existing album. Click the Design tab on the left. Click Layouts. Click the Cover tab at the top of the panel. Select a layout from the options available. Changes are saved automatically; to see the change on your live site, click Publish Now at the top right of your Album Editor.

title: How can I request a new payment provider to be added to Wix?
content: If you want to request another payment provider, please contact us to let us know. Alternatively, you can connect unsupported payment providers out-of-the-box using Velo and the Payment Provider Custom Extension.

title: How can I add a single video to my Wix site using ADI?
content: To add a single video to your Wix site using ADI: click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI, then click **Section to Page**. Select a section that contains a media item, hover over the media item and click **Edit**. Next to the media item on the left, click **Settings**, then click **Video** below **Media Type**. Click **Replace** and select where you want to upload from: **Youtube / Vimeo** — type a word or phrase to find a video, select it and click **Add** (switch between Youtube and Vimeo videos by clicking the relevant option below the search bar); **Media from Wix** — choose a free professional video from the Wix Library, click the video you want to upload and click **Apply**; **Upload video** — click the video you want to upload and click **Add to Page**.

title: How can I display past events on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to the Events page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Event Pages, then click your Events page. Click the Event List element on your page, click Settings, and click the Display Events tab. Select an option: To display multiple past events, under How many events are shown select Multiple Events; under Which events are shown? select Upcoming and Past, Upcoming, or Past Events; under Which category will be shown? select All events. To display a single past event, under What do you want to show select Single Event, then scroll down and select the past event you want to display. Tip: To duplicate a past event, go to the event in the dashboard, click More Actions, and then Duplicate.

title: How can I create a service list in Wix Bookings using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to the page where you want to display your services. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Bookings. Click Service List. Drag the Service List element onto the page. Click the Service List widget. Click Settings. Click Services. Under How do you want to choose which services to display?, select the relevant option: Choose by service category, Choose by service location, or Choose services directly. Click the checkbox next to the relevant categories, locations or services you want to display. The options you see depend on your choice in the step above.

title: Is it possible to limit the Selection Tags input element to only one selection?
How can I reassign a Premium plan to a different site in my Wix account?
content: In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Next to the plan you want to reassign, click the More Actions icon, then click Assign to a Different Site. Select the checkbox next to the relevant site, click Next, and click Assign to confirm. Note: reassigning a Premium plan removes the premium features from the original site, such as the ability to connect a domain and removal of Wix ads. Statistics and data related to email campaigns do not transfer with the email campaigns themselves, and data related to site-specific features such as apps, SEO settings and tracking tools, and analytics also does not transfer. Assigning a Premium plan to a Wix Studio or Editor X site requires an upgrade to a Wix Studio plan, and upgrades can only be made to plans that offer more features.

title: What features does the Events Calendar app by inlight labs offer, and how can I contact inlight labs?
content: The Events Calendar app by inlight labs lets you connect external calendars and automatically display all the events in one place. Features and benefits include: Sync with Google, Outlook, or Eventbrite calendars. For questions or comments, contact inlight labs directly: Website: https://help.eventscalendar.co/ Email: support@inlightlabs.com

title: How do I set up my HP Barcode Scanner with the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Connect the cable to the scanner and to the tablet. This automatically turns the scanner on. Open the POS tablet, tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, tap Settings, tap Manage Hardware, and check the status under Barcode Scanner. If the scanner is connected properly, the status should read Connected.

title: Is the Cashier role supported for accepting payments at a mobile POS for Wix Events?
content: The Cashier role, which gives permission to accept mobile POS payment only, is not currently available for Wix Events. Currently, you can allow someone else to accept payment for tickets at a mobile POS by assigning them roles such as Admin or Back Office Manager + Payments Admin.

title: How can I set up email notifications for form submissions in Wix Forms?
content: In the site dashboard, go to Forms & Submissions. Click the More Actions icon next to a form, then click Form notifications. Click Edit under Notifications and Automations. You will be redirected to the Wix Automations dashboard; you can click Back to Forms to return to your Wix Forms dashboard. Click Edit next to the Send an email action, scroll down to the automation action, and click Set Recipients. Select the Include Additional Recipients checkbox; this checkbox must be selected to receive notifications. Click Collaborator Roles, select the collaborator roles you want to receive the form submission notifications, and click Save. You can also access Notifications and Automations by selecting the Settings tab in the form builder. Note: site collaborators must be assigned Wix Inbox permissions.

title: How can I add the Program List Add-On to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click Program Pages. Click your Program List page. Click the Program List element on your page. Click Settings. Click Add-Ons. Click the Add to Page drop-down and select the page to display the add-on.

Note: The Program List Add-On is automatically placed on the page you selected.

title: How can I set up real-time shipping calculations with Correios for my Wix Stores in Brazil?
content: Use the Meu Frete com Correios app. Add the Meu Frete app and follow the available instructions to set it up. If you have an existing Correios contract, you can use it to take advantage of your benefits. The app currently offers SEDEX and PAC throughout Brazil. It is no longer possible to set up real-time shipping with Correios without the use of a third-party app.

title: How can I create a new task in the Tasks & Reminders section on my Wix site?
content: Go to Tasks & Reminders in your site's dashboard. Click + New Task at the top right. Write your task in the text box. Optionally add details: click Due Date and use the calendar to select the date; click Link to Contact and select the relevant contact from the drop-down menu; click Assign to Contributor to assign the task to yourself or a teammate. Click Done to save your task.

title: How can I get certified as a Wix Studio Web Designer?
content: To get certified as a Wix Studio Web Designer, access the Wix Studio Certifications page: go to Sites in your Wix Studio workspace, click Resources at the top, then click Studio Certifications under Learn. Click Explore Certifications, then click Learn more next to the desired certification. You can choose See certification steps to review the project descriptions and grading criteria, or Get certified to start the task. The web designer certification does not include an exam but a task: you recreate a live Wix Studio site from top to bottom, demonstrating your knowledge of site planning, design and construction, including responsive behaviors. Before starting, Wix recommends reviewing The Wix Studio essentials course, the Discover the Studio Editor webinar, and the Embrace fully responsive design using Wix Studio webinar; the Academy Library also offers design courses, webinars, tutorials and sandboxes. For submitted projects like the site recreation assignment, it may take up to 6 weeks to review your submission and certify you.

title: How can I customize the Analytics Overview table in Wix Studio's enterprise solution to display specific data and metrics?
content: Access your Analytics Overview from the enterprise dashboard. In the Analytics Overview table, add or remove columns to display the data and key metrics you want to see. To find a specific site, use the search field and enter the site's name. You can also export a .CSV file with stats for all of your sites or specific ones in the selected time frame. This helps you monitor trends in visitor behavior, sales, and traffic data.

title: How can I design a Ticket PDF for my Wix event?
content: Before you begin, create a ticketed event. In your site's dashboard, go to Events, click Manage next to the relevant event, click Tickets and Seating, click Edit next to the ticket type, and click Design under Ticket PDF. Use the left-side tabs: Templates to choose a design; Display to enable the info shown such as order number, QR code, Ticket & price; Text to customize event text categories; Image to upload and optionally edit an image with Wix Photo Studio; Logo to replace, edit, or create a logo; Dividers to change style, color, and size; Background to change color, add an image, or adjust opacity. Click Apply at the top right, then Back to Events to edit ticket information. To preview, go to Events, click Manage, click Tickets, click Edit next to the ticket type, and click Preview under Ticket PDF. For existing events, new guests get the updated ticket design while current ticket holders keep their original ticket.

title: Can I create a custom automation action using Velo?
content: You can select Run Velo Code as an action when building an automation. Write your code, run it to test, and then activate the automation.

title: How can I create and share a social post using the Wix app?
content: To create a social post using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Marketing and select Social Posts. Tap any template to get started. Customize your post using the available options: Overlay — tap the Overlay icon to pick a different overlay with preset text and stickers. Text — tap the Text icon from the bottom menu, tap Add Text, edit your social post text, and tap Done at the top right; optionally customize your text using the available options and tap Done. Stickers — tap the Sticker icon to add new stickers. Images — tap the Image icon to add images from your site uploads or your phone. When you're done, tap Share at the top right and select where to share: Facebook to share to your Facebook business page and follow the on-screen instructions to connect to the relevant page; Instagram to share to your Instagram feed or story; Save Image to save the post as an image in your mobile device; More to share your post to any of the available apps in the menu.

title: Can I receive a notification when a participant completes a quiz?
content: Yes. You can receive an automated notification when a participant completes a quiz using Wix Automations.

title: Can I use real-time shipping calculations with carriers other than USPS in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, Wix offers real-time shipping in the US via USPS. Wix real-time shipping calculations via other mail services is currently not supported. You can also offer real-time shipping through third-party apps.

title: Can I schedule customized push notifications in the Wix app?
content: You can create and send customized push notifications to your members right from the Wix app on your mobile device. However, it is not possible to schedule the time you send each notification.

title: How can I add item modifiers to my menu items in Wix Restaurants for online ordering?
content: Go to Menus (New) in your site's dashboard. Create a new menu or click Manage next to the relevant existing menu. Hover over the relevant existing menu item and click Edit. Click the Modifiers tab. Click + New Modifier Group. Choose an existing modifier group or create a new one.

title: Can customers book a table at my restaurant using the Wix member apps?
content: Yes. Your customers can now book a table at your restaurant on the Wix member apps (Spaces or your own branded app).

title: Can I add a picture selection field in Wix Forms to allow visitors to choose from multiple visuals?
content: Currently, in the new Wix Forms, there is no option to add a picture selection field that allows visitors to choose an option from multiple visuals and/or colors or thumbnails.

title: How can I customize the social share settings for my Wix site's pages?
content:
To change your social share settings:
- Click the Pages icon on the left side of the Editor.
- Click the relevant page.
- Click the Show More icon.
- Click Social Share to change your social share settings:
  - Click Upload Image to add an image.
  - Click the Change icon to replace the image.
  - Click the Delete icon to remove the image.
  - Add a title under What's the page's og:title (title on social media)?.
  - Add a description under What's the page's og:description (description on social media)?.
- Click Twitter Settings to change your Twitter share settings:
  - Click Upload Image to add an image.
  - Click the Change icon to replace the image.
  - Click the Delete icon to remove the image.
  - Choose the card size under What size card do you want to display on Twitter?.
  - Add a title under What's the page's twitter:title (title on Twitter)?.
  - Add a description under What's the page's twitter:description (description on Twitter)?.
Tip: For best results, upload an image that is at least 600 x 315 pixels.

title: How can I delete an event draft in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard, click the Drafts tab, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant event, click Delete Draft, and click Delete Draft to confirm.

title: Is the Hug Width responsive behavior available for buttons in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the Hug Width responsive behavior is not available for buttons in the Studio Editor. This behavior would ensure the button text remains visible on all screens.

title: How can I create a floating pages menu in Wix Editor?
content: To create a floating pages menu in Wix Editor, add a menu, then pin the element to the desired location on the screen.

title: How do I sign up for a free Wix account?
content: Sign up to Wix with your email address, Facebook account or Google credentials. To sign up for a Wix account: go to the Wix.com sign up page, choose how you want to register and enter your details, then click Sign Up. Once you're signed up, you can start creating — start from a site template or use the AI tools to create a site for you.

title: How can I write Wix blog posts in Arabic or Hebrew with right-to-left justification?
content: You can write posts in Arabic or Hebrew by selecting Hebrew or Arabic as your blog language. Go to your site's General Info tab, scroll to the Regional Settings section, click the Language drop-down menu and select Arabic or Hebrew. In the Post Manager, the placeholder text is always in English; start composing your post in Arabic or Hebrew and the text will automatically align to the right. You can also change the language in your Member's Area pages; the language settings are in the Settings tabs.

title: How can I customize the new Side Cart in Wix Stores?
content: To access the Side Cart settings in Wix Stores, go to your editor and access the Pages and Menus setting. For Wix Stores, the settings are located under Store Pages. The Side Cart has additional elements to choose from, including a "Checkout" button and the ability to display the product options your customer selected. You can select which elements to display, hide the rest, and customize all the elements that make up the Side Cart to suit your business. The Side Cart can also display on mobile to help customers view their selections.

title: How can I connect FasterPay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to FasterPay. If you have an account, enter your Public Key and Wix Integration Secret and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create FasterPay account and register for a FasterPay business account to receive your credentials. To recover your credentials in FasterPay, click FasterPay Processing > Integration. Once registered, return to the window and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: How can I enable SMS reminders for my clients in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Emails & SMS Reminders. Enable the Session Reminders toggle under Notifications clients get. Optional: Click View to preview the message your members receive. Important: You need to upgrade to a Business Premium plan in order to send SMS reminders. SMS Reminders must comply with the Wix SMS terms of use.

title: How do I block off time slots in a staff schedule for a single staff member?
content: To block off time for a single staff member in Wix Bookings: go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard; click Add or click the time slot you wish to block off on the calendar; select Blocked Time; choose the staff member whose time you want to block from the Staff drop-down; optionally enter a Title; select a start date and time; select an end date and time; optionally add a note for yourself; click Block. Blocked time only prevents clients from booking new appointments in that time frame and does not override class or course sessions or existing appointments.

title: How can I add a tooltip to an image in the Wix Editor?
content:
Click the image.
Click the Settings icon.
Enter the text in the Does this image have a tooltip? text field.

To remove the tooltip, follow the instructions above but delete the text in that text field.

title: How can I enable or disable expand mode for images in my Wix blog posts?
content: Go to your blog in your dashboard. Click the relevant post. Click the relevant image. Click the Settings icon. Click the Expand mode toggle to enable or disable expand mode on the image. Click Publish.

title: How can I add and customize divider lines in my Wix blog posts?
content: Start writing a post from your live site or from the Post Manager. Click the Divider icon at the bottom of the page. Optionally customize the divider line by clicking the Divider Style drop-down menu and selecting a style, selecting a line size: Small, medium, or large, and selecting a justification setting: Left, right, or center.

title: How can I set up the Open for Business app on my Wix site?
content:
Important: The Open for Business app is no longer available in the Wix App Market, and Wix will no longer support it. As an alternative solution, you can add the Business Open Hours Widget by Purple to your site.

To set up the Open for Business app, select it in your editor and click Settings. In the Business Hours tab, edit the days and hours to suit your needs. There's no need to delete any of the days, even if you're closed that day; in the Settings tab you can select whether you want to display the "Closed" days at all. Click to expand the Settings tab and customize the layout and display settings of the app. Click to expand the Design tab and customize the colors, fonts, background, and borders used in the app. You can change the language of the app from the top of the Settings panel.

title: How can I change the home page of my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To change your site's home page in the Wix Editor: Click Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click the relevant page. Click the Show More icon. Click Set as Homepage.

Note: If you no longer wish this page to be your home page, you have to select a new home page.

title: How can I set up my business using Wix Bookings to start getting booked?
content:
Use this essential checklist:
- Choose a template: start with a Wix template.
- Create your services: choose which of the 3 types of services are right for you. You can create an appointment, a class, or a course, and take any of your services online.
- Add staff members: add staff members who provide services and let them manage their calendars. The default staff member (you) is labelled "Staff Member #1"; edit the name.
- Set availability: appointment services' availability is based primarily on your default work hours and the hours of staff members who provide the service. Set default work hours and staff hours.
- Customize how Wix Bookings is displayed on your site: decide where to display services, and customize the Service List, Service Page, Calendar Pages, Booking Form, Confirmation Page, Checkout Page, and Members Area.
- Set how you collect payment: connect a payment provider (Wix Payments, Stripe, PayPal, etc.) to accept credit/debit cards and other payment methods online; choose how clients pay for each service (pay when booking? pay when arriving?); offer membership plans or packages.
- Add your business details: set up your business address, currency, time zone, etc.
- Upgrade your site & connect a domain: purchase the right Premium Plan and get your own domain (available for free for 1 year with some Premium Plans).
- Publish your site: click "Publish" and share your site with the world.

title: How can I edit the exposure percentage of a test site on Wix?
content:
To edit the exposure of a test site:

- Go to the Release Manager.
- Click the Show More icon on the test site.
- Click Edit exposure.
- Enter the exposure percentage as a value between 0-100.
- Click Save.

Important: Some features on your site may not be compatible with test sites, such as anything that contains data.

title: How can I ensure that external SEO tools are accurately reading my Wix site's source code?
content: SSR allows most external SEO tools to read your page's source code, but because these tools are external and subject to many factors, we cannot guarantee 100% accuracy. For the best results, you can use official search engines' SEO tools such as the Google Search Console. For any issues or confusion with an external tool's report, confirm the report is correct by checking the issue for yourself in your page's source code. If there is a confirmed issue, contact us with the suggestion from the external tool, and include any steps taken to resolve the issue or any other relevant information. Instead of using external SEO tools, we recommend that you use SEO Setup Checklist.

title: How can I require all new site members to confirm their email address on my site?
content:
To require all new site members to confirm their email address, go to Signup & Login Security in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to **Ask new members to confirm their email**. Enable the toggle next to **Everyone who signs up**, then click **Save**.

**Note**: You can disable this toggle at any time. If you do so, only new site members who are already in your contacts will need to confirm their email.

title: Can I reassign Premium apps from one Wix site to another within the same Wix account?
content: Currently, reassigning Premium apps from one Wix site to another within the same Wix account is not supported. It is possible to transfer Premium apps, along with your site, when transferring the site to another Wix account.

title: How can I disconnect a payment provider from my Wix site?
content: To disconnect a payment provider from your Wix site, go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant payment provider, then click Disconnect. Disconnecting your payment provider from Wix will not close your account with the provider, and you can reconnect your account to Wix whenever you choose. If you prefer to remove it temporarily from your checkout page, disable the Accepting payments toggle; the status next to the toggle changes to Not accepting payments.

title: How can I add a new dynamic item page to an existing collection in Wix?
content: Before you begin, add the CMS to your site and have existing dynamic pages. To add a new dynamic item page: In Wix Editor, click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor, click Dynamic Pages, then click the Settings icon next to the collection you want to link your dynamic page to, and click Add Dynamic Item Page. In Editor X, click Pages in the top bar, hover over the relevant group of dynamic pages and click the More Actions icon, then click Add Dynamic Item Page. To use the page URL to determine the content displayed on the page, click the More Actions icon next to the new page, click Settings, and edit the fields under What's the page URL?. A typical scenario is to click Add Field and select Title. Each dynamic page needs a unique URL; if two items have the same name, only the first item in the collection is displayed. Add a second field to give the URL an additional value, making each one unique.

title: How can I check the renewal cost of my Wix domain?
content:
Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click View Payment Details in the Next Payment Due column for the domain you want to check.

Note: The free domain voucher covers the first year of a Wix domain subscription. If you purchased your domain using this voucher, you will need to pay in order to renew it.

title: Is it possible to waive the ticket service fee for events held by non-profit organizations in Wix Events?
content: Currently, there is no option to waive the ticket service fee for events held by non-profit organizations.

title: How can I access and manage comments in the Studio Editor for a specific site page?
content: Click **Comments** on the bottom left of the editor. Every site page has its own comments panel, so the comments are specific to the page you're working on. In the comments panel, you can see who wrote the comments, when they were posted, and the replies if there's an ongoing discussion. Use the drop-down menu at the top right of the panel to filter the comments you view: **Open** shows open comments that have not been resolved; **Resolved** shows comments that were already resolved; **My comments** shows comments related to you directly, including comments you added and comments that mention you; **Current breakpoint** shows comments related only to the breakpoint you're currently viewing (e.g., desktop, mobile). If you were mentioned in a comment, you can access it directly from the email notification you received by clicking **View Comment**.

title: How can I allow others to embed my video on their site using Wix Video?
content: To set up embedding, go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant video and click the Edit icon. Scroll down to Embed Options, click the toggle to enable embedding, and select the information you wish to display. This option is only available for videos you have uploaded, not videos added from Facebook, Vimeo or YouTube, and only after upgrading to a Premium Plan or for Premium accounts. You can add a custom logo to the embedded video and choose when it appears; the recommended logo format is a transparent PNG file, 254 x 152 px. After setting up the embed option, visitors watching a video on your site can click the share icon and then access the embed code.

title: How can I change the height of a section in ADI?
content:
To change the height of a section in ADI, hover over the section in the ADI builder that you want to change and click **Design**. Click the **Customize Section Design** drop-down and select **Height** from the drop-down menu. Then click the **+** or **-** icons to enlarge or shrink the section.

Keep in mind that not all sections of ADI allow you to adjust their height, especially if doing so will negatively impact the user experience. As a shortcut, you can also click the **Show more** icon at the top left of a section and click **Height** from the drop-down menu. If the option isn't available, the section layout doesn't support height adjustment.

title: How can I set up delivery to pickup points using ShipStation for my Wix store?
content: Add the ShipStation app to your Wix site and connect your Wix store to ShipStation. In ShipStation, set up your ship-from location and add the carriers that support pickup points: Mondial Relay, Chronopost, and Colissimo. Contact ShipStation support and ask them to enable delivery to pickup points. Then, in the ShipStation dashboard, go to Manage Apps, click Open next to ShipStation, open Settings, select Selling Channels, click Store Setup, click More Actions next to your Wix Store, click Edit Store Details, open Checkout Rates, click Add Checkout Rate, and select Pickup and Drop-off. Select Rate active and visible in marketplace, enter an internal title and description, select a pickup and drop-off service, enter the flat rate, click Save Rate, and click Save Changes. In Wix, create a shipping region for France, make the phone field mandatory at checkout, and enable the ShipStation app in the France shipping region under Shipping & Fulfillment. Customers can then select a pickup point nearest the address they enter at checkout; pickup-point delivery is available only for domestic deliveries within France.

title: How can I remove a domain purchased from Wix in order to close my account?
content: You can remove a Wix domain from your account by transferring it to another domain host or by turning off auto-renewal and waiting for it to expire. If you wish to keep the domain, transfer it to another domain host: go to the Domains page in your account, click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain, select Transfer Away from Wix, click Transfer Domain, and click I Still Want to Transfer. Wix sends a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's registrant contact email address. Once the domain has been transferred, you can close your account. Alternatively, turn off auto-renewal and wait for the domain to expire: go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain, click Cancel Domain, select Cancel auto renew, and click Submit. You must wait until the domain expires (past the redemption period and no longer registered) before you can close your account; this process can take up to 80 days.

title: Can I create a logo directly from the Wix Editor?
content: We are delighted to announce that you can now create a logo directly from the Wix Editor.

title: How can I update the location in my Wix SEO Checklist if my business address changes?
content: To update your location in the Wix SEO Checklist, go to your SEO checklist in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit details icon next to Keywords. (Optional) Select I serve customers from a physical address or within a local service area if you didn't select this when you created your checklist. Enter your location as it is in your site's content under Location. Click Save.

title: Can I create automations for Wix Blog when a new blog post is published?
content: You can now create automations for Wix Blog, set to trigger when a new blog post is published or a new comment is added to a blog post.

title: Where can I find information about Wix branding, including colors and logos, and the guidelines for using them?
content: Our Wix Design Assets page has all the information you need about our colors and logos, as well as rules and guidelines for using any of our design assets.

title: Can I change the background and borders of a text box in Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to change the background or border of a text box. However, you can place your text in a colored container box to achieve a similar effect.

To place text in a colored container box:
- Add a container box to your site.
- Customize the background and borders of the container box.
- Click and drag the text box into the container box.

title: How can I delete the Shared Gallery app from my website?
content: To delete the Shared Gallery app, go to Pages in your editor. Click the More Actions icon next to your Shared Gallery page, select Delete, and click Delete on the pop-up. Deleting the app does not delete any of the uploaded images or videos, but does prevent members from viewing or uploading new media. If you decide to re-add the Shared Gallery app at a later stage, all of your media will be restored.

title: How can I verify my Wix site with Google Search Console using a meta tag?
content: Prerequisite: You must have a Premium plan and a domain connected to your site. To verify using a meta tag: Go to Google Search Console, click Start now, select the URL Prefix property type, and enter your full URL. Click Continue, click the Expand icon next to HTML tag, copy the meta tag code, and leave Google Search Console open. In a new tab, go to your SEO Dashboard, select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings, click Google Search Console to expand, enter the meta tag, and click Save. Go back to Google Search Console and click Verify.

title: How can I change the focal point of an image in my Wix Photo Album?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant album. Click Customize at the top right. Hover over your gallery in the panel on the left and click Manage Media. Select an image and click the Focal point icon under the selected image. Click the position on the thumbnail image where you want the focal point to be; the focal point is displayed as a white circle. You can also click and drag the circle over the image to select a focal point. Click Done.

title: How can I connect PagueloFacil as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect PagueloFacil as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click Connect next to PagueloFacil.
- If you have an account, enter your CCLW (Merchant ID) and click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create PagueloFacil account, follow the instructions to create an account, retrieve your CCLW (Merchant ID) from PagueloFacil, return to this window, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.
Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.
PagueloFacil is supported in Panama and supports currencies USD and PAB. Transaction fees are 3.5% + $0.50 per transaction, and account activation takes a few days. The currency in your Wix account must match the currency in your PagueloFacil account; if they do not match, transactions may be declined. Your Wix site needs to have a Business & eCommerce Premium plan in order to accept payments.

title: How can I change the number of sessions in a Wix Bookings package for a client?
content: To change the number of sessions in a package, go to the Subscriptions tab in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant package you want to edit. Click the Edit icon under Sessions Remaining. Click the up or down arrows to add or remove sessions. Click Save. Note: When you change the number of sessions, you do not charge your client an additional amount. You cannot edit an expired plan; once a subscription expires, the number of remaining sessions resets to 0. You cannot edit a recurring plan.

title: Is the Wix Retail Point of Sale available for merchants outside the US and Canada?
content: The Wix Retail Point of Sale (POS) solution for brick and mortar stores is available for merchants in the US and Canada. To request support in additional countries, click the link in the article to submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions.

title: How can I enable sandbox collections in the Wix Editor?
content: To enable sandbox collections, go to your editor. Click CMS on the left side of the editor. Click Your Collections. Click Manage next to Your Collections. Click More Actions at the top right and select Advanced Settings. Enable the Sandbox toggle.

title: How can I change the currency for my Wix Events ticket sales?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Click the Currency drop-down and select the relevant currency. Optionally, make sure all the other regional settings are correct. Click Save. Note: It is not possible to change the ticket's currency once a guest purchases a ticket for your event.

title: How can I add a new menu to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of your editor. Select Menu & Search. Select the menu type you want (Horizontal, Vertical, or Hamburger). Click the menu and drag it to the desired position on the page. To add items to the new menu: select the menu you just added; click Manage Menu; click + Add Item at the bottom; select the item you want to add. Main pages lets you add a regular site page to the menu. Dynamic and app pages lets you add pages from apps (e.g. a Wix Stores product page), or pages connected to collections in CMS. Link lets you add many kinds of links to the menu, such as links to other websites, anchors on site pages, your client's contact details, etc. Dropdown adds a container that appears below the menu when visitors hover over the item; you can design it as needed and use it to display menu items and content.

title: How can I add a new business location to my Wix site for offering services?
content:
To add business locations to your site:
- Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard.
- Scroll down to the Location and contact info section.
- If you have not already done so, enter the details of your location: business address, optional Location name, optional Address description, and contact info relevant for this location.
- Click Save.
- Click Add New Location.
- Enter the details of your new location.
- Repeat as needed to create additional locations.
- Click Save.
Note: Your default location will be set to your default time zone. For additional locations select a new time zone from the Time zone drop-down.

title: What steps can I take to recover my site's ranking after a drop?
content: If you see a definite drop and want to recover your site's ranking, try the following: check your recent changes; use Google Search Console's URL Inspection Tool to check your pages for warnings or errors; check for changes to the canonical tags of your pages; check for edits to your site's robots.txt file that stop search engines from showing your pages in results; check for changes to title tags and meta descriptions, additional meta tags, heading tags, or page content; identify any duplicate content on your site; make sure the desktop and mobile versions of your site contain the same content; check for changes to the internal link structure of your site or menus, especially on your homepage. If you recently moved your site to Wix, check that you created new pages with URLs that match the page URLs from your old site. If it's not possible to match them, you can set up 301 redirects from your old URLs to your new ones. Tip: If you want to change the URL of an existing page and keep the previous ranking for it, you can set up 301 redirects for the old URL of the page.

title: What elements cannot be added to a repeater in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, the following elements cannot be added to a repeater: All third-party apps; Anchors and anchor menus; Box slideshow; Facebook Comments; Facebook Like; Facebook Page Like; Flash elements; Full width slideshows; Google Maps; Horizontal and vertical menus; Most photo galleries (including full-width galleries, and certain layouts such as Masonry and Stacked); Multi-State Box; Pagination Bar; Pay Button; Pin to Pinterest; Pinterest Follow; Repeaters; Share from Pinterest; The HTML component; The Pro Gallery; Twitter Follow; Twitter Tweet; VK Share; Video Box; Wix Chat Button; Wix Music; Wix Video; YouTube Subscribe.

title: How can I allow Wix.com pop-ups in Google Chrome according to the source?
content: According to the source, to enjoy all Wix features you need to allow Wix.com pop-ups in your browser. For Google Chrome, this means disabling the browser's pop-up blocker so Wix.com pop-ups are allowed. The source lists Google Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Microsoft Edge but does not provide step-by-step Chrome menu instructions.

title: How can I add a signature field to a form using the new Wix Forms?
content: To add a signature field to a site form using the new Wix Forms, click the relevant form in your editor, then click Edit Form to open the form builder. Click Add on the left side of the builder, click General, then click Signature and drag the form element onto the page. Click the newly added field on your form and click Settings. You can customize the Field title, enable Allow image upload to let people upload an image of their signature instead of signing with their mouse or trackpad, enable or disable Required field, add a Field description, and protect Personal information (PII) with an additional layer of protection. The signature field is a premium feature. Once the form is submitted, a preview image of the visitor's signature appears in your form submission table, and it is not possible to download this image. The form field key can be found under the Advanced tab in the settings panel and cannot be changed later.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site to allow guests to book and pay online?
content: To upgrade your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site so guests can book and pay online, first make sure you have added and set up Wix Hotels by HotelRunner. Then upgrade your site with a Premium or Studio plan. If you are based in Europe, your bank may require you to verify your identity when purchasing a plan; if you have issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly. Upgrading lets you allow guests to make reservations on your site, accept secure online payments, remove Wix branding from your site, offer advanced pricing options, help guests find and book through major Online Travel Agency channels, offer more extras, promotion codes, rate plans, and amenities, and access more advanced property management features.

title: What features and apps can be translated using Wix Multilingual?
content:
Wix Multilingual lets you translate many features and apps, but not all elements support translation.

Translatable features:
- Wix Automation emails
- Lightboxes
- Single video player
- Menu
- Text (in text boxes, on buttons, in lists and grids, links, etc.)
- Images and backgrounds
- SEO settings

Note: Subdomains are automatically generated for your secondary languages.

Translatable apps:
- Wix Bookings
- Wix Restaurant Menus
- Restaurant Reservations
- Members Area
- Pro Gallery
- Wix Chat
- Wix FAQ app
- Online Programs
- Cookie Banner
- Wix Blog

Note: Blog content is translated through the Blog Manager.

- Wix Forms

Note: You can translate forms within the Wix Editor. With the Studio Editor, go to the dashboard to translate forms.

- Wix Stores

Note: Some automatically generated storefront text does not appear in every language.

- Wix Events

Note: Some text elements in the app need to be translated manually through your editor. Event Schedules are currently non-translatable.

- Accepting Payments: Currently, you can only translate payment instructions for Manual Payments.
- Wix CMS (Content Management System)
- Automatic Discounts

title: Can I change the text size or scale it per breakpoint using percentages in Wix Forms?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it's not possible to control text size per breakpoint using percentages (%), or set it to scale proportionally. You can still change text sizing using pixels (px) for each of the individual form widgets.

title: How can I find and export my invoice history for services paid to Wix?
content: Go to your Billing History page. Use the filters and search fields to find a specific invoice: use the All Dates and All Sites drop-downs to find a charge by date or by site name; click More Filters to filter by payment status and payment method; click Search to look for invoices by keywords. To export your billing history, click the Export button to export your billing history in CSV format. You can choose to export all invoices, or export a filtered CSV based on the More Filters or Search options. You can download a maximum of 3,000 invoices per export. If your export exceeds this limit, try filtering your invoices by year.

title: How can I ensure my Editor X site is accessible to all visitors, including those with disabilities?
content: Use the Site Checker to scan your pages for accessibility issues such as color contrast, missing H1 tag, and text size. Add alt text to all relevant images, including media in apps like Wix Restaurants and Wix Stores; you don't need alt text for decorative images and social icons. When adding or editing a text box, make sure its Heading Tag is correct. Reorganize elements by DOM (tabbing) order so visitors with disabilities can read your content in the same order it appears on screen. Add an accessibility toolbar using custom code from a third-party provider; Editor X doesn't currently offer a toolbar. Also check the accessibility requirements for your region, as they can differ.

title: What do I need before I can start tagging Instagram posts in Wix Stores?
