content: Before you can start tagging Instagram posts, you must create a Facebook shop and have an Instagram business account that is connected to your Facebook page and approved. Your shop button appears on all your tagged Instagram posts only after you share your first tagged post.

title: What are the pre-defined Google Analytics events available for tracking in Wix apps?
content:
The pre-defined Google Analytics (GA4) events available for tracking in Wix apps include:

- **page_view**: When any page is loaded. (General)
- **view_item_list**: When the user has been presented with a list of items of a certain category. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **select_item**: An item was selected from a list. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **view_item**: Some content was shown to the user. Use this event to discover the most popular items viewed. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **add_to_cart**: An item was added to a cart for purchase. (Wix Stores, Wix Events)
- **remove_from_cart**: An item was removed from a cart. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants)
- **begin_checkout**: A user has begun a checkout. (Wix Stores, Wix Events)
- **add_payment_info**: A user has submitted their payment information in an ecommerce checkout process. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants)
- **purchase**: One or more items is purchased by a user. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants, Pricing Plans)
- **sign_up**: A user has signed up for an account. (General)
- **generate_lead**: Lead has been generated, through a form submission or initiating a chat conversation. (General)
- **Widget View**: When a site visitor has been presented with a list of upcoming events. (Events)
- **Select Date**: When a site visitor selects a date of appointment. (Bookings)

title: How can I effectively use keywords on my website to improve SEO according to the article?
content: Use keywords in your site's text organically and in the correct context. If a search phrase cannot be mentioned organically, add more content that contributes value to site visitors. Choose keywords and search phrases that you want search engines to relate to your site, and that potential visitors use to find you, your company, or your service. Keep each search phrase between 1 to 4 words. Consider competition and use specific and unique phrases. Make the most of your content by using keywords and search phrases that contribute to your SEO. Any edits must be crawled again by search engines before they appear in search results.

title: Does Wix automatically display when my site was last updated?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer a feature which automatically displays when your site was last updated. Tip: You can add this feature manually by adding a text box to your site and adding the date each time that you publish your site.

title: Why can't I make outgoing calls using the Business Phone Number in the Wix app?
content: To make outgoing calls from the Wix app, you need to be invited as a call agent. When you invite someone to become an agent, they automatically become a "Limited Agent", which can only accept incoming calls. To make outgoing calls, the agent must accept the invitation sent to their email, which will make them a "Back-office Manager" of the website, allowing them to call others through the business number. Additionally, ensure that the agent's personal number and email are linked, and they are logged in to the Wix app through the same email address used during the invitation. If your Caller ID is disabled, enable it on your personal device to ensure calls go through. If you cannot enable the Caller ID from your device, contact your wireless provider for assistance. Note that international communication is not supported.

title: How can I change the DOM order of my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Use the Accessibility Wizard and Layers panel to change the DOM order on Wix Editor sites. Click Settings at the top and select Accessibility Wizard. Click the More Actions icon at the top of the Accessibility Wizard panel. Select Advanced accessibility settings. Select Automatic DOM Order. Disable the toggle in the panel. Select Turn It Off in the pop-up window. Then select Layers at the bottom left of the editor. Check over the list and delete any redundant elements, including duplicate elements that do not have a use on your site and can confuse screen reader users. Drag and drop the remaining elements into the desired order.

Notes:
- If the tabbing order of your site is logical, then you don't need to do anything. Changing the order when it is already correct can cause issues for visitors using screen readers and / or the Tab key.
- Navigating a site using the Tab key only navigates through the interactive elements and not static elements such as text. If you want to test out a screen reader on static elements such as text, follow the instructions in your screenreader's help center on how to properly navigate a website with a keyboard.
- Pinned elements are automatically placed at the end of the tabbing sequence. If you want it to be tabbed earlier in the sequence, we recommend that you unpin the element and place it in the header.

title: Is it possible to track data for live streaming in Wix Video?
content: Currently, it is not possible to track data for live streaming in Wix Video. However, you can see track data such as video plays, shares, and purchases in your Wix Analytics video reports.

title: Can I add animation to hamburger menu containers in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add or edit an animation on hamburger menu containers.

title: How can I customize the design of my site menu in Wix ADI?
content: You can make changes to the design of your menu: change the layout of your header to change the design of your menu; change your site's colors to change the menu colors; change your site's fonts to change the menu font. If you want to customize your menu even further, including changing the text size, colors and hover color, then head to the Editor. Warning: Once you save in the Editor, you cannot come back to edit your site in Wix ADI.

title: How can I delete a Wix app from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, select the app in the My Business panel, click the More actions icon, then click Delete App.

title: How can I add a private member page using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor:
- Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Members Area.
- Click + Add Private Member Page at the bottom.
- Click Add Private Member Page in the pop-up to confirm.
- Hover over the new page and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Settings.
- Enter the new name under What's this page's name (on your menu)?

title: Why are my album images appearing broken in the Dashboard, Media Window, and on the live site?
content: We are aware of an issue where albums display broken images in the Dashboard, Editor, Manage Media window, and live site due to missing watermark. To resolve the issue, please re-upload the watermark file and publish the affected album again: • Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. • Click Manage Album next to the relevant album. • Click the drop-down in the Watermark section to expand it. • Click Customize watermark. • Click Upload Watermark button to upload an image file from your computer. • Click Save. • Publish album.

title: How do I customize the layout of collapsible text on my Wix mobile site?
content:
Click the collapsible text box in your mobile editor, then click the Layout icon. In the Layout panel, use the "Choose how the text appears?" setting to control how visitors view the full body of text:

- "Collapsed": Your visitors can click an expand button to view the full text on the page, and then click another to collapse the text.
- "Show all text": The entire text piece is displayed on your site, and is not collapsed.

You can also adjust the spacing, the alignment, and choose how many lines of text are displayed in the preview.

title: How can I edit the default post excerpt in Wix Blog?
content: Go to the Post tab in your site's dashboard. Click to edit a blog post or create a new one. Click Post Settings at the top left. Click on the Advanced tab. Enter the excerpt text in the Excerpt field (maximum 140 characters). Note: Excerpts that you enter manually also appear in Post Lists and Recent Posts elements.

title: How can I define an undefined field in my Wix CMS collection?
content:
Undefined fields are fields that appear in your collection but are not part of the defined structure — this can happen if you restore a previous version of your site. To define an undefined field:

- Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections.
- Click the relevant collection.
- Hover over the Warning icon that appears next to the undefined field's name.
- Click Define field.
- Click Change type next to the Field type.
- Select the appropriate field type for the data you are storing in the field.
- Click Change Field Type.
- Click Save.

Note: The Field ID is automatically defined when an undefined field is created and cannot be modified.

title: Can I use in-page menus on my Wix mobile site?
content: Currently, in-page menus on mobile sites are not supported. However, anchors and sections themselves are supported on mobile sites, and you can add them as an item to your site menu.

title: How can I track sales using the Thank You Page URL in Wix Stores?
content: Your customers are directed to a Thank You page after making a purchase on your site. You can use Thank You page visits to track sales or create a customer list using an external tool such as Google Analytics. The URL for your site's Thank You page is made of your domain name followed by: /thank-you-page. For example, if your site URL is www.mystunningwebsite.com, your Thank You page URL is www.mystunningwebsite.com/thank-you-page. Start by creating a rule to track Thank You Page visits using an external tool. Then, enter this part of the Thank You Page URL: /thank-you-page in the relevant tool. If you have a conversion pixel, click here to learn how to add it to your site.

title: Why was my email marketing campaign declined when using a certain sender address?
content: Wix does not allow sending email marketing campaigns from certain email domains and automatically declines any campaign sent from these addresses. If your email address is associated with one of the below domains, update your sender email in order to send future campaigns. Most common declined email addresses: @mail.com (including all domains used by mail.com services), @email.com, @store.com, @contact.com, @shop.com. Note: The above addresses are only the most common examples of declined email addresses. To avoid these errors in the future, do not apply a mailbox you don't own in the sender address.

title: Can I customize the design of the social sharing icons in the Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the design of the social share icons, or add additional ones in the Wix Pro Gallery.

title: How can I create and set up a member badge on my Wix site?
content: To create and set up a member badge, first make sure you have installed a Members Area on your site. Then go to Site Members in your dashboard, click More Actions at the top right, click Manage Badges, and click New Badge. During setup, you can add the badge title and description and design the badge itself.

title: Can I link directly to my site pages using the Rich Content Editor?
content: Currently, when adding links in the Rich Content Editor, it is not possible to select your site pages as link destinations. This includes selecting dynamic pages, blog posts, and other pages as links. Workaround: you can paste the URL of any web address, such as your live site pages' URLs, when linking in the Rich Content Editor.

title: How can I connect Klarna as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Klarna as a payment provider, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect beside Klarna. If you have an existing account, enter your Klarna API keys (username and Password) and click Connect. Note: Playground credentials aren't accepted. If you don't have an account, click Create Klarna Account and fill in the information to create your account. Then return to this window (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Note: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Klarna account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined. Learn how to change your currency.

title: How can I add vector art to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open the Wix Editor. To use free vector art from Wix, click Add on the left side of the Editor, click Decorative, select a category under Vector Art, then click or drag a vector art to add it to your site. To upload your own vector art, click Media on the left side of the Editor, click Upload Media, select your file(s) from your computer, click Open, and optionally select the vector art and click Add to Page. After adding vector art, you can manage its settings by adding a link, adding alt text for SEO and accessibility purposes, and choosing whether to keep the icon's proportions while resizing. You can also customize the vector art by editing fill colors, adding and customizing a shadow, or adding an animation.

title: Is it possible to add the Category Page to my Wix site?
content: Yes, it's now possible to add the Category Page to your site. For merchants with active stores, make sure you read and follow the step-by-step guide to migrate without negatively impacting current SEO ranking.

title: How can I set up a PayPal Donate button on my Wix site?
content: To set up a PayPal Donate button on your Wix site, you need a PayPal Business or Premier account. In the Wix Editor, add a Donate button, then add the relevant information such as the organization's name and ID number. You can set a predetermined amount or allow visitors to choose how much they want to donate. On the live site, visitors are directed to PayPal to complete the donation, and funds usually arrive in the linked account instantly. Donate buttons can only be linked to one PayPal account; if you have more than one organization, you can add multiple Donate buttons and link them to the relevant accounts.

title: How can I add a privacy policy to my site's footer using the Wix Editor?
content: Create a dedicated page for your policy, then add the policy title to your site's footer and link it to the relevant policy page. In Wix Editor: 1. Create a new page for your policy: click Pages & Menu, click +Add Page, click +Blank Page, enter the new page name, and click Done. 2. Add your policy to the new page with a text element: click Add, click Text, drag the text element to the relevant spot, select it, and click Edit Text to enter the wording of your policy. 3. Add a text element to the footer: click Add, click Text, drag the text element to the footer of the page; any text added to your footer shows on all of your site's pages; select your text element and click Edit Text to enter the title of your policy. 4. Link your policy to your footer text: click the text element in your footer, click Edit Text, highlight the policy title, click the Link icon, select Page and then click the dropdown and select the relevant policy, then click Done.

title: Can I move a participant from one class to another in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now move a participant from one class to another.

title: How do Instagram Videos appear in my Instagram Feed gallery using the Instagram Feed app by Wix?
content: The Instagram Feed app by Wix connects your site to your Instagram account and displays your posts in a customizable gallery on your site. Instagram Videos that you add in your Instagram app will appear in your Instagram Feed gallery. It can take some time for your video to appear in your Instagram Feed gallery after you post it. It is not currently possible to display Reels in the Instagram Feed app.

title: How can I connect Peach Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Peach Payments. If you have a Peach Payments account, enter your Entity ID and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Peach Payments account and sign up to Peach Payments. Once your account is approved, go back to the Accept Payments tab and repeat the earlier steps. Then follow the steps under Have a Peach Payments account to link your new account.

title: Is Threads supported on Share buttons?
content: Currently, Threads is not supported on Share buttons.

title: Can I store clients' credit card details on my Wix site?
content: Yes. You can now save and store clients' credit card information on file on your site. Clients can also save and re-use their credit card details when booking services on your site using the My Wallet page in your Members Area.

title: How can I upgrade my site so people can join my program?
content:
To upgrade your site so you can invite participants, you can use your site's dashboard or the Wix app on Android. If you have not already done so, add Online Programs to your site for free. Make sure to choose a plan that accepts payments.

Dashboard: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Upgrade at the top. Click Select under the plan that suits your needs. Select the relevant billing cycle then click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details. Click Submit Purchase.

Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Upgrade. Tap Select under the plan that suits your needs. Tap the relevant billing cycle then tap Select at the bottom. Enter your payment details. Tap Submit Purchase.

After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: How can I use a subscribe form to promote my music on Wix Music?
content: Add a subscribe form to your site so that your fans can subscribe to your music newsletters. Once they are subscribed, you can send them regular newsletters to keep them up to date with your news. Your subscribers are automatically added to your Contacts.

title: I'd like to know how to customize the cart page on the mobile version of my site.
content:
Decide where you want to display the checkout button for customers viewing your site on mobile. Choose from just displaying it only at the bottom of the page or display it at both the top and the bottom.

To customize the cart on mobile:
- Click the Switch to mobile icon at the top of the editor.
- Click the Cart Page in the mobile Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Select a placement option for the checkout button.

title: How can I customize the Loyalty Program page on my Wix site?
content:
To customize your Loyalty Program page from your Editor:
- Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Main Pages**.
- Click the page named after your loyalty program. This is the name you chose during setup.
- Click the **Loyalty** element on your page and click **Settings**.
- Choose what you want to customize:
  - **Header and program details:** Click the **Display** tab. Select and deselect checkboxes to see your page display changing live. Decide whether to include a header, image, title, subtitle, program details and steps. If you've added tiers, choose the tiers info displayed. Note: You must include a header or program details. Deselecting one will select the other by default.
  - **Page layout:** Click the **Layout** tab. Select different options to see your page changing live. Choose your preferred layout and customize aspects of your header and program details. If you've added tiers, customize the layout of tiers info too. Upload your own image and points icon. Note: To change your points icon, click the **Main** tab and click **Manage Program** to access your program dashboard.
  - **Text:** Click the **Text** tab. Edit your page title and subtitle. Edit the text of your buttons for signing up and viewing points. Edit the text in your program details section. If you've added tiers, edit the title and description of your tiers section.
  - **Header design:** Click the **Design** tab and click **Header**. Customize your header and the image and button within it. Set background color, opacity and more.
  - **Program details design:** Click the **Design** tab and click **Program Details**. Design the cards that outline your program steps. Try out different colors, border styles and more. Choose the font and color of the text.
  - **Tiers design:** Click the **Design** tab and click **Tiers**. If you've added tiers, design the cards that outline your tiers. Try out different colors, border styles and more. Choose the font and color of the text.

title: How can I add the Wix Restaurants Menus app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In your Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Use the search bar to find Restaurant Menu (New), then click Add to Site.

title: How can I connect KG Inicis as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to KG Inicis. If you have an account, enter your Merchant ID, Type and API Key. Contact KG Inicis to get your Type information. Click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create KG Inicis account, fill in the registration form, wait for a message from KG Inicis to get your credentials, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your KG Inicis account. If the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: 成本结构还没算清时，能否跑自动调价？
content: 不能。动态定价的下限是真实保本价。若成本只算了采购和头程，漏了退货损耗、长期仓储、广告分摊、汇率波动，用错的下限跑自动调价，会稳定地在你以为赚钱的价位上亏钱。应先把利润模型做实。

title: How can I connect a new pricing plan to my online program on Wix?
content:
To connect a new pricing plan to your online program on Wix:
- Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard.
- Click + Create Plan and create the relevant plan: Free plans, One-time payment, or Recurring payment.
- Under benefits, select the checkbox next to Online Programs.
- Click + Add Program under Programs Included and select the program(s) you want to include in the pricing plan.
- Optionally select the Automatically add subscribers to these programs when they purchase this plan checkbox.
- Optionally review the Plan preview.
- Click Save.

title: How can I suggest additional currencies for Wix Bookings?
content: Use the "Click here" link in the article to submit a ticket with your suggestions and feedback about which currencies you would like to add to Wix Bookings.

title: How can I check the version of my Google Chrome browser?
content: To check the version of your Google Chrome browser, click the More icon at the top right of the browser window, hover over Help, and click About Google Chrome. You can also visit www.whatismybrowser.com to find out what browser version you are using.

title: How do I create a custom 404 error page in Wix Editor?
content:
Important: To customize your 404 error page, you need to have a premium plan.

To create a customized 404 error page:
- Go to your editor.
- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Add Menu Item** at the bottom of the panel.
- Click **New Page**.
- Click **(404) Error Page**.
- Hover over the page template you want to use and click **Add Page**.

Customize your page to match your site. Below are some ideas:
- Change the text to match the voice and tone of your site.
- Add a site menu.
- Add links to popular sections of your site that your visitors might be looking for.
- Change the default image:
  - Click the 404 image.
  - Click **Change Vector Art**.
  - Click the **All Categories** drop-down menu and select **Technology**.
  - Choose another vector art.

Publish your site.

Tip: You can also add an Error 404 by clicking **Settings** on the top of your editor.

Note: You can change the page title for your browser tab from **Page Settings**, but the page URL always contains "error404".

Test it out: You can see how your live 404 page looks in your browser. Go to the URL of one of your site's pages, then add some extra numbers or letters to the URL and try opening it.

title: How can I connect a domain I already own to Wix using the enterprise solution?
content: Connect a domain you already own to Wix by changing its name servers. You need to update the DNS records in your domain host account, usually the company you bought your domain from. Wix Studio for enterprise provides a step-by-step outline to help you. Once the domain has been connected, it can take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and your site to appear worldwide.

title: Is it possible to hide images from a gallery in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, there is no option to hide images from your gallery, you can only delete them.

title: How can I add a video from Wix Video Maker to my site page using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add videos from Wix Video Maker to a page using the Wix Editor:

- Go to the editor.
- Click Media on the left side of the editor.
- Click Show More under Site Files.

Note: If you haven't uploaded media to your site yet, click the Upload Media icon.

- Go to the Video Maker folder.
- Select the relevant video.
- Click Add to Page.

Tip: You can also add a Single Video Player to show a video from the Wix Video Maker. When you click Change Video on the element, you can access the Video Maker folder.

title: How can I find and re-add a hidden anchor on my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open the mobile Editor. Click Hidden on Mobile on the left side of the mobile editor, then click Show next to the anchor. Anchors are not visible on your live site; they are only visible on the editor. If you have hidden an anchor on your mobile site, you cannot add it to a site menu.

title: How can I add an animation to an element on my Editor X site?
content: To add an animation on your Editor X site, click the relevant element, group or stack, click the Animation icon, and select an animation.

title: Can I migrate my site from the Wix Editor to the Studio Editor?
content: If your site was originally created using the Wix Editor, it is not possible to migrate it to the Studio Editor. In order to take advantage of the new features and functionality, please rebuild your site in the Studio Editor.

title: Can I connect my Wix store to dropshipping services other than Modalyst?
content:
Currently, it is possible to connect your Wix store to Modalyst and a number of additional dropshipping services. Other dropshippers are not supported.

To find available dropshipping apps:
- Go to the Wix App Market.
- In the Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor. In Editor X, click App Market at the top of Editor X.
- Type "dropshipping" in the search bar and press Enter on your keyboard.

title: How can I associate my YouTube channel with my Wix site to link directly from videos?
content: First, verify your site (domains) with Google Search Console. Then add a card or annotation to your video that links to your site.

title: How can I change the display options of the PDF Viewer app on my site?
content:
To change the display options of the PDF Viewer app:

- Click the PDF Viewer App in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Select the Layouts tab.
- Choose a layout option:
  - Full Page: Your PDF is displayed as a full page. Choose which page to display first in the dropdown. This layout gives you display options to choose from in the Display tab.
  - Thumbnail: Your PDF is displayed as a thumbnail. Clicking on the thumbnail opens the document in a new tab on your browser. This layout allows you to customize the button in the Display tab.
- Click the Display tab to customize the display settings.

Note: These settings differ depending on the layout that you choose.

Full Page layout:
- Full Viewer: Viewable as a default PDF reader (can be zoomed in on). You can set it so visitors can download, zoom, or print it via the Settings tab. It is currently not possible to use this display mode on mobile devices; this mode automatically switches to Mini Viewer on mobile.
- Mini Viewer: Viewable in an iframe. Visitors can browse the file using the arrow buttons. This display option is not downloadable or printable.
- One Page: Viewable in an iframe. This option is dedicated to show only one page of the file. This display option is not downloadable or printable.

Thumbnail layout:
You can customize the icon’s design by changing any of the following:
- Change Icon: Change the icon to be any other image of your choice via the Media Manager.
- Thumbnail Icon Size: Scale the size of the icon by dragging the horizontal scroll bar or typing in a numerical value.
- Show File Title: Click Toggle to Show/Hide the title of the file.
- File Title: Change the title of your file.
- Title Font and Color: Choose a theme, font, font size, and font color for your title.
- Title Color on Hover: Choose what color your title turns to when you hover over it.

title: How can I change the email address my Wix Chat notifications go to?
content:
Email notifications are automatically sent to the email address you used when signing up for your Wix account. If you want email notifications to go to a different email address, such as your business email address, you can add it as a site collaborator. Any new email address you'd like to add as a site collaborator must have a separate Wix account.

To add your business email as a site collaborator:
- Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Settings drop-down at the top right.
- Click Notifications.
- Optional: Click the Email notifications toggle to disable email notifications if you no longer want to receive email notifications to your main account email.
- Click the Profile & team tab.
- Click + Invite People next to Your team.
- Enter a business email or an alternative email where you want to receive chat and inbox notifications.
- Click Send Invite.
- Go to the new email's inbox and click Accept Now in the email.
- Log in to the Wix account that's associated with the new email address and click Accept.
- The new email address is automatically assigned a Back Office Manager role and appears in the Your team list. Click the toggle under Email notifications to turn on email notifications for this email.

title: How can I create a customer segment in Wix based on specific criteria?
content: To create a segment in Wix, you organize your contacts into groups built from specific filters and criteria. Your contacts are filtered by either a contact attribute (e.g., city, country) or contact activity on your site (e.g., number of purchases, last purchased). Once you decide on your filter, add conditional logic (e.g., is equal to, is less than). Depending on the filter, you might also choose a value. For example, you could create a segment that identifies people who have spent more than $500 but haven't visited in the last 3 months. You can also add custom fields to your contacts to collect additional customer information, which can be used as segment filters.

title: How can I reduce the spacing between images in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: In the Pro Gallery's Settings panel, click the Pro Gallery, click Settings, click the Layout tab, click Customize Layout, scroll down to Design Settings, and drag the Spacing slider to reduce the gaps between images.

title: How can I view and change page editing permissions in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click Site at the top, then select Page Editing Permissions. Use the drop-down next to a person's name to edit their permissions, then select the checkbox(es) next to the relevant access level: All pages lets them edit all site pages; Specific pages lets you select the pages they can edit; Masters lets them edit all master sections. Note: To grant permission to edit Masters, you must first select the All pages checkbox.

title: How can I change a contact's subscription status in Wix?
content: To change a contact's subscription status, go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant contact and select Edit. Choose the type of subscription status you want to update. For Email, click the Never subscribed drop-down next to Primary Email and select a new subscription status, then click Save. For SMS, click the Never subscribed drop-down next to Primary phone and select a new subscription status, then click Save. Note: SMS subscription status is not currently available for all users. You can view the current subscription status of the contact at any time under the Email and Phone columns.

title: How can I perform a traceroute on my Windows computer to troubleshoot live site issues?
content: To perform a traceroute on Windows, right-click the Start menu and select Run. Type cmd, and then click OK. In the cmd window, if you have a domain connected to your site, type tracert www.domain.com and replace domain.com with your own domain name. If you have a free site, type tracert site-url-prefix.wixsite.com and replace site-url-prefix with your Site URL prefix, located in your account settings. Press Enter, take a screenshot of the information, and send your screenshot to Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I create a recurring payment plan using the Wix subscriptions app?
content: When you are creating a plan, select Recurring Payment as your payment type. You can then set the price, payment frequency, and length of plan. You can also give a free trial to encourage new clients to sign up. Both membership plans and packages can be recurring plans.

title: Is it possible to automatically add a cutlery option to all online orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically add a cutlery option to all online orders so that customers can indicate that they do not need you to include cutlery with their order. As a workaround, you can add cutlery as a deselection option to each dish. Customers can check the cutlery option to indicate that you do not need to send it with your order.

title: How can I add a Best Sellers gallery to my Wix store using the Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor and the page where you want the gallery. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, select Store, click Best Sellers, then drag the gallery to the page. Optionally, to edit the default gallery name "Best Sellers", click the Text tab and enter a new name under Gallery title text. You can also customize the gallery layout, design, and more.

title: How can I customize the Program List page using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Program Pages, then click the Program List page. Click the Program List element on your page and click Settings. Customize the Program List element using the available tabs: Categories — select the categories you want to display on your program list and drag and drop them in the order you want them to appear. Programs — select the checkbox next to a program to display it on the list, drag and drop programs in the order you want them to appear, and click Add a Program to create a new program in your site's dashboard. Display — enable the toggle next to the details you want to show on the program list, such as Image, Duration, Participants, and Price. Layout — choose between a Grid or Side by side alignment and customize the layout according to your preferences. Design — choose what you want to design, such as Background & dividers, Text, Buttons & badges, and Categories. Text — click the relevant fields to update the text, such as List title, Buttons, and Labels. Tips: go to your dashboard to edit the specific settings of each program; add your program list to another page in your site by selecting Add-ons.

title: Why was my credit card charged when I used a free domain voucher?
content: If your credit card was charged when purchasing a domain using your free domain voucher, it is possible that you added additional years of service, because the free domain voucher covers the domain registration cost for the first year only, or you registered the domain as private, which is an additional cost.

title: How can I add a new video to a channel in Wix Video?
content: Go to Channels in your site's dashboard. Click the channel you want to add videos to, then click Add Videos. To add new videos, click + Add More Videos, click the Add Videos drop-down at the top right, and choose how you'll upload or add videos: Upload from Computer, Dropbox, or Google Drive, or Add from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook. Upload or add the videos.

title: How can I pin an element to the screen in Editor X?
content: Click the element in the Editor. Click Position in the Inspector. Click the Position type drop-down menu and select Pinned. Choose where to pin the element to using the drop-down next to Pin to: Container: The element stays fixed in place, relative to its parent container. Section: The element stays fixed in place as visitors scroll up and down the section. Page: The element stays visible and fixed in place as visitors scroll up and down the entire page.

title: Can I use Google Ads to create campaigns with the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner app?
content: Currently, it's not possible to use Google Ads in your site's dashboard to create campaigns with the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner app.

title: How can I change the layout of my Media Manager in Wix to display files as a gallery or list?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click the Change layout icon. Select a layout: Gallery displays your media as thumbnails; List displays your media in a list. Tip: Learn how to reorder and filter your files to help you organize your Media Manager in a way that suits you.

title: How can I delete a full page app in the Wix Editor?
content:
To delete a full page app in your Editor:

- If you purchased a subscription for the app, make sure to cancel your app subscription.
- Click My Business on the left side of your editor.
- Select the app you want to delete.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the app you want to delete.
- Click Delete App.

After deleting the app and publishing your site, any related widgets, pages / member pages, data collections and dashboard presence are also deleted.

title: How can I add and customize a search box for my Wix Store to improve product searchability?
content:
Add a search box to your site by opening your editor. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. In Studio Editor, click App Market on the left side. Search for the Wix Site Search app in the search bar, then click Add to Site. By default, the search box is placed in your site's header and is visible on every page.

Customize the search box field: click the search box in your editor, click Settings, enter placeholder text suitable for store product searches (e.g. Search for a product), then click the Layout icon and Design icon to customize the look of the search box.

Customize the search results page: go to your editor. In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side, click Site Menu, then click the Search Results page. In Studio Editor, click Pages on the left side. Click the Search Results page in the Editor, click Settings, click the Settings tab, then click the toggle next to any types of search results you want to hide to disable it. Edit the product search results: click the Edit icon next to Products; optionally edit the label text (relevant only if displaying other results, such as blog posts); select a resizing option: Fit or crop; optionally deselect the checkbox next to Product price to hide prices; click the Show button toggle under Add to Cart to enable or disable the button. If displayed, you can edit the "Add to Cart" button text. Click the Show product filters toggle to show or hide filters. When product filters are displayed, all categories you created that are relevant for the search query are shown. To increase the number of results per page, click the Layout tab and drag the Number of results per page slider to increase the number of products displayed in the first page of search results. Use the rest of the customization options to further customize the behavior and look of the search results page.

Publish your changes and test on your live site. To hide specific products from appearing in site search results, edit their SEO settings; note that this also stops the product from appearing in search engine results. After your search runs for a while, you can use Wix Analytics to see what customers are looking for.

title: What are the options for selling printed photos on Wix now that Wix Photo Albums Store is no longer available?
content: Wix Photo Albums Store is not available to all users. As of February 2023, it is no longer possible to add Wix Photo Albums Store to your site. As an alternative, you can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your photos. Wix Photo Albums also works with a third-party service, Order a Print, to provide more options when selling printed photos.

title: How can I set up a spam word filter in my Wix Forum to block posts containing certain words?
content: Go to Forum in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions drop-down at the top. Click Moderation Settings. Enable the Word filter toggle. In the Spam words field, enter spam words separated by commas. Click Save.

title: How can I send a message from my business site's inbox using the Wix Studio app?
content:
Go to your relevant workspace in the Studio app. Tap Home at the bottom. Tap Inbox at the top. Tap on the relevant contact you want to message. Tap the channel drop-down and select how you want to send your message:

- Chat: Send a chat message to customers. To use this option, you must have the Wix Chat app on your site.
- Email: Send an email to customers whose email addresses are saved in your contact list.
- SMS: The SMS channel is available when you purchase a Business Phone Number and the member's number is saved in your contact list.

Note: You can't send SMS without saving a contact.

title: Can customers place orders on the Wix member apps using the new Wix Restaurant Orders app?
content: Currently, if you're using the new Wix Restaurant Orders app, your customers cannot place orders on the Wix member apps (Spaces or your own branded app).

title: Can I export more than 5000 Wix invoices in bulk to a CSV file?
content: Currently, you can only export up to 5000 Wix invoices in bulk to a CSV file.

title: Can I use the Wix CLI to generate a service plugin extension when building an app?
content: Yes, you can now use the Wix CLI to generate a service plugin extension when building an app. Learn how to add service plugin extensions with the CLI.

title: What happened to the Back to Top App on Wix and what can I do now?
content: The Back to Top App has been retired from the Wix App Market and from September 15th 2022, it is no longer supported. You can learn how to delete the app from your site and learn how to create a Back to Top button on your site.

title: Can I add a calendar to my site using Wix ADI?
content: Currently, Wix ADI does not have a calendar feature to book services, appointments or schedule events. To add a calendar, you need to move to the Editor and follow the steps.

title: Can I sell Wix Store products and Wix Bookings services together in the same sale at a mobile POS?
content: According to the announcement, you can now charge clients for Wix Store products or multiple Wix Bookings services together in the same sale at a mobile POS. You'll also have access to extra features like adding tips, coupons, and discounts to sales. The source also lists: Collect payment for booked services; Book a new appointment and collect payment.

title: Can I have my subscription orders delivered to pickup points using Wix Stores?
content: Currently, delivering subscription orders to pickup points is not supported. One-time purchase orders can be delivered to pickup points through shipping solutions such as Boxtal and Sendcloud.

title: How can I delete multiple products at once in my Wix Store?
content: Go to Products in your site's dashboard. To delete all products, select the checkbox at the top left. To delete specific products, select the checkboxes next to the relevant products. Click More Actions, select Delete, then click Delete to confirm. You can delete up to 999 products at the same time. Note: This action cannot be undone.

title: Is it possible to control the site scroll smoothness in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the Studio Editor does not offer a feature that allows you to control the site scroll smoothness (using the Lerp function, for example). Workaround: You can add the Smooth Scroll app from the Wix App Market.

title: How can I add a shape divider to a section in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add a shape divider:

- Double-click the section in your Editor.
- Click the Shape Dividers icon.
- Click the Top or Bottom tab to choose where to add the divider.
- Select a divider to add to your section:
  - Suggested designs: Click a style available in the panel.
  - Additional designs offered by Wix:
    - Click + More Shapes.
    - In the Media Manager, select a design from the Media from Wix tab.
    - Click Choose File to apply it to your section.
  - Your own shape divider:
    - Click + More Shapes.
    - In the Media Manager, select the shape you want to use from the Site Files tab, or upload a new one.
    - Click Choose File to apply it to your section.

title: Is it possible to add tax to a dish using Wix Restaurants outside of the US and Canada?
content: Yes, it is now possible to add tax to a dish. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: What are the requirements to use the Smile: Points & Rewards app by Smile on my Wix store?
content: To use the Smile: Points & Rewards app by Smile, you need to have a Premium Plan, a connected domain, and Wix Stores. This app is only available in English, French, German, Portuguese, and Spanish.

title: How can I add a new Wix Form to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
This applies to the new Wix Forms (not the old Wix Forms).

To add a form:
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Contact & Forms**.
- Click **Create New Form** and drag the form element onto the page.

**Tip:** You can also select a form from the **Premade Forms** section.

**Tip:** You can display your form on every page of your site with a single click. To set your form to appear on all pages, right-click the relevant form and select **Show on All Pages**. You can disable this option at any time, which will remove the form from other pages.

title: Can I set increased delivery charges with higher order minimums in Wix Restaurants?
content: The update states that it is now possible to set increased delivery charges by adding a service fee to online orders. The request concerns setting increased delivery charges with higher order minimums.

title: What should I do now that the OpenTable Reservations App is no longer available on Wix?
content: The OpenTable Reservations App has been retired from the Wix App Market and is no longer supported. As an alternative, you can add Wix Table Reservations to your site. If you would like to remain with OpenTable, you can create a widget in your OpenTable account and embed the code in your Wix Editor. This allows you to continue having the option to reserve seats on your site.

title: How can I group elements together in the Wix Editor?
content:
To group elements together in the Wix Editor, select the elements you want to group by either clicking and dragging your cursor over the elements, or holding the Ctrl / Shift key on your keyboard (Cmd for Mac) while clicking the elements. Then click Group Elements.

When you group elements, you can move them as one, as well as add an animation effect to the entire group.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my VAT number in my Wix account for a tax exemption in Moldova?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription, then click Update Payment Method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your VAT Number to the VAT ID field. Click Update.

title: How can I add Affirm as a payment method on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments. Enable the toggle next to Affirm. Note: You can disable the toggle at any time to remove Affirm from your payment options.

title: Can I save text scaling in a typography style?
content: Yes. You can now set typography styles to scale proportionally.

title: How do I connect Agoda with my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account?
content: Before connecting, set and update all room rates and availability on the Inventory Calendar in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability so the channel manager can fully register your rooms. Reset extra beds in the Agoda extranet and include them in the number of adults to match the panel's total number of people. Blocked dates on Agoda remain unchanged and must be unblocked from the Agoda extranet. To connect, go to Channel Manager in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard, click Connect next to Agoda, and click Connect with Agoda. Log in to the Agoda extranet using the main host login information, and make sure no other Agoda account is open in your browser. Click Settings, then Property Settings, then Optional Settings. Select the Enable channel manager mode checkbox, choose HotelRunner from the drop-down, and click Save. Then map room types by finding room IDs on the Agoda extranet in Rooms under Property and entering them in the Room type mapping section of the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Use View channel details next to Agoda, click Fetch room types, match the room types, and click Save. After completing room mapping, click Activate.

title: How can I set up monthly analytics reports for my clients using Wix Studio?
content: In your Wix Studio workspace, go to Client Reports and click Get Started. If you want, click a site type to view an example (e.g. stores, bookings), then click Next. Click Add next to the sites you want to generate the report for and select the specific contact(s) you want to receive it, then click Apply, Next, and Done. Only sites with a Premium plan are eligible to receive the report. Reports are sent at the beginning of each month to sites that had at least 30 monthly sessions.

title: Is there a specific gallery for images in portrait orientation in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, there are no specific galleries for images in portrait orientation. As a workaround, you can change the scaling of the images in some of our existing galleries.

title: Im experiencing issues with the mobile view of my site. Elements are misplaced and some are overlapping.
content:
Based on the Wix Editor guidance, try these fixes:

- If an element is on the mobile menu, header, or footer, you cannot click and drag it around the page; use the right-click menu to move it between the menu, header, and footer. For other elements that appear in the wrong location on mobile, use the mobile Editor to manually rearrange them by dragging them to your chosen location.
- If horizontally arranged elements are not aligning as expected on mobile, group them together and attach them to a transparent container box to prevent them from shifting.
- If text and other elements overlap because a large amount of text was added in a single text box, open the desktop Editor, break up the text into multiple text boxes for paragraphs, add the elements between the text boxes with some space between them, and group the elements together to ensure they're aligned.
- In the mobile Editor, you can add mobile-only elements; these do not appear on your desktop site and can be designed and adjusted for mobile.
- Wix notes that content may look different across devices and browsers because different rendering engines are used. If a single line of text splits into two lines, widen the text box by clicking and dragging the handles.

title: Can I add a Youtube Clip to my site using the Single Video Player?
content: Currently, you can add a Youtube video to your site using the Single Video Player, but not a Youtube Clip. A Youtube Clip is a short video played on loop. It has a different URL to the original Youtube video, which isn't accepted by the Single Video Player.

title: How can I set up an eCommerce conversion based on purchase using Google Tag Manager?
content: Connect Google Tag Manager to your Wix site and create a conversion action in Google Ads to obtain your Conversion ID and Conversion Label. In Google Tag Manager, create user-defined Data Layer variables named "dl_transaction_id" for "ecommerce.purchase.actionField.id" and "dl_conversion_value" for "ecommerce.purchase.actionField.revenue". Create Custom Event triggers named "Pageview" and "Purchase". Create a Conversion Linker tag that fires on the "Pageview" trigger, and a Google Ads Conversion Tracking tag that fires on the "Purchase" trigger. For the Google Ads Conversion Tracking tag, enter the Conversion ID, Conversion Label, Conversion Value as "dl_conversion_value", Transaction ID as "dl_transaction_id", and your 3-character currency code. Note: Wix fires business events for recommended Google conversions; do not use the Thank You page capturing method to track eCommerce-based conversions.

title: Can I filter the Booking Calendar by staff member in the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view and filter the Booking Calendar by staff member in the Wix app. However, you can view and filter upcoming sessions by staff member in the Booking Calendar on desktop.

title: How do I set up manual (offline) payments on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Connect next to Manual Payments. Click the drop-down menu and select a title for the payment instructions: Cash payment, Offline payment, or Cash on delivery. Enter instructions to complete the payment in the text box. Click Connect.

title: How can I add a cover image to a blog post using the Wix app?
content:
To add a cover image to a post using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom right.
- Tap **Blog**.
- Tap **Posts**.
- Tap the post you want to edit.
- Tap **More actions** next to the relevant post.
- Tap **Post Settings**.
- Tap the **Select cover image** toggle.
- Select an option:
  - **Upload an image:** Tap **Upload Cover Image**; select an image or take a picture; tap **Upload**; tap **Next**; choose **Publish Post** or **Save as Draft**.
  - **Replace the existing image:** Tap the image; tap **Replace Image**; select an image or take a picture; tap **Upload**; tap **Next**; tap **Save**; choose **Publish Post** or **Save as Draft**.

Note: You can go back to the settings and tap the **Display Cover Image** toggle. **Enabled:** the image you added is displayed in the post feed, custom feed, recent posts feed, and when sharing the post on social media. **Disabled:** the image you added is displayed only when sharing the post on social media.

title: Can I create a draft automation in Wix Automations to activate later?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a draft automation to return to and activate at a later date. However, you can activate an automation and then immediately change its status to inactive. Be aware that because the automation will be active for a brief period of time, actions may be triggered. To deactivate an automation, go to Automations in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon next to the automation you want to deactivate, and disable the toggle.

title: How can I use my free domain voucher with Wix?
content:
Your voucher must be redeemed within 2 months of purchasing your plan. You can check its expiration date in the Premium Vouchers section of your account. You will need to enter your payment information when claiming your voucher, but you won't be charged. To use your voucher:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click Buy a Domain or Get a New Domain.
- Type the domain you'd like to claim, including the domain extensions (e.g. .com), and click Search.
- Click Get It if the domain is available. If your domain is not available, you can claim one of the recommended alternatives or try searching for a different domain.
- Choose a registration period and click Continue. Make sure the domain voucher is applied in the summary section at this point.
- Enter (or edit) your contact information and click Continue.
- Select a privacy option: Full privacy protection means your contact details won't appear in the WHOIS domain information records, and the voucher does not cover the cost of Private Registration; Basic Protection means some personal information will be public, but your name, address, phone number, and email will be kept private, and if someone wishes to contact you, they are redirected to a contact form that protects you from receiving spam. You can only change this option to full privacy protection when manually extending a domain subscription.
- Click Continue.
- Select your payment method. You'll see the voucher discount applied before submitting your purchase.
- Click Submit Purchase.
- Assign the domain to your site.
The voucher is limited to the purchase of new domains only and cannot be used to renew a Wix domain. You can also choose to redeem your voucher when transferring a domain to Wix.

title: What Wix promotion is available?
content: With a Wix Promo Code, you can save 10% on a participating Yearly Premium Plan purchase (does not include the Combo Premium Plan). This promotion is valid for your first purchase only and is not valid for Editor X.

title: How can I upload my own media files to the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to the editor, click Media on the left side of the editor, and click the Upload Media icon. Then drag and drop your files or choose an option on the left to upload media. You can upload images, videos, vector art, fonts, and more. For videos, a limit of ten minutes per video applies to sites with free plans; upgrading your site can increase the video minutes available to you.

title: How can I preview the checkout process in Wix Stores?
content:
Placing a test order is possible only with Wix Stores or Wix Restaurants Orders (New). You can preview the checkout process before you launch your online store, which lets you view what customers will see when they make a purchase. Only the site owner can preview the checkout process.

To preview store checkout:
- Prepare your site to preview the checkout process: enable the manual payment method so you won't be charged. If your site has a Premium plan or Studio plan, temporarily unassign the plan from your site or duplicate your site and test the checkout on the duplicated version. If your site doesn't have a Members Area, add it now.
- If not already logged in, log in to your Wix account.
- Open your live site.
- Log in to your site using the Members Area.
- Navigate to a Shop page.
- Add a product to your cart and click Checkout.
- Click I just want to place a test order.
- Complete the store checkout process.

title: How can I freeze the mobile menu on my Wix site to keep it visible while scrolling?
content: In your mobile editor, click the mobile menu. Click the Settings icon. Enable the Freeze Menu toggle. This makes the menu visible to your visitors as they scroll up and down your site. To unfreeze your menu, follow the same steps and click the toggle again to disable it.

title: Can I hide a page from my published site using the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, in the Wix Editor, it is not possible to hide a page from your published site. As a workaround, you can prevent your site pages from being indexed, password protect pages, or hide pages from your site's menu.

title: How can I verify my site with Bing Webmaster Tools using a meta tag on my Wix site?
content:
Get your meta tag from Bing Webmaster Tools: Sign in to your Bing Webmaster Tools account. Enter your site's URL under Add your site manually. Click Add. Copy the meta tag under HTML Meta Tag. Leave Bing Webmaster Tools open.

Add your meta tag to your Wix site: In a new tab, go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings. Click Bing Webmaster Tools. Enter the meta tag under Site verification tag. Click Save.

Complete the site verification on Bing Webmaster Tools: Go back to Bing Webmaster Tools. Click Verify. Click Done.

title: How can I access my Google Workspace Admin console to manage business email users?
content:
To access your Google Workspace Admin console:

- Go to your Business Email page.
- Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant email account.
- Click **Manage at Google.**
- Sign in to your Google Workspace account.

**Note**: If you are already signed in to a different Google account, click the profile image or initial at the top right and sign in with your admin email address.

**Tip**: You can also access your Google Workspace Admin console by signing in at admin.google.com.

title: What are some best practices for using Wix's generative AI tools responsibly?
content:
To use Wix's generative AI tools responsibly, consider the following best practices:

* Always recheck generated AI outputs to confirm that they meet your expectations and that the information is accurate, and reflects your intention. It is recommended to approach each output with a critical eye and verify any factual information before publishing it on your website.
* Note that while the content was generated by AI, you are still responsible for the content, so make sure that the content complies with Wix's Content Guidelines.
* Be mindful of possible biases within AI-generated content and edit as necessary to align with your values and intended purposes.
* Avoid creating or promoting deepfake content or misinformation, as it can damage your credibility and be harmful to your site visitors or others.
* Do not copy or use others' content as part of your input without permission, as this may cause the AI tools to generate copyrighted material.
* Avoid using AI outputs that appear too similar to existing works of art, paintings, or trademarks and logos of other companies.
* Consider editing the AI outputs to ensure that the final result is uniquely your own.
* Don't use others' personal information as part of your input without consent and permission.
* Check the output to see if it includes personal details or real individuals, and consider changing identifying details if they appear in the generated content.
* Consider informing your site's visitors that some content was AI-generated, to provide transparency and maintain trust.
* As always when using Wix, ensure you comply with your local and applicable laws, regulations and policies.

title: Can visitors add extra text input fields to a custom form on my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to let your visitors add extra text input fields to a custom form on your site. You can create a custom form on your page with user input elements that include text boxes, radio buttons, upload buttons, and text input. However, this form only displays the input elements you add to the page. It is not possible for your visitors to add extra fields if they need them, e.g. for adding additional instructions that are not covered by the form.

title: Can I create global styles for buttons in the Site Styles panel?
content: No. While you can apply color and typography themes to your client's site, the Site Styles panel does not include the option to create global styles for buttons.

title: How can I manage my notification settings for online programs in the Wix app?
content:
In the Wix app, go to your site. Tap your Profile icon at the top left. Tap Notification Settings. Select the site you want to update notification settings for. Scroll down and tap Online Programs. Enable or disable the toggles for the following notifications:

New Participants: Receive notifications for new participants joining or requesting to join your program (if it's private). Participant Progress: Receive notifications every time your participants complete or miss steps.

Your participants can manage the following notifications for online programs they are participants of:

Program updates: Every time you add a new step to your program. Reminders: Every time your participant misses a step.

title: How can I customize the different states of a button in Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the button you want to customize. Click the Design icon, then click Customize Design. You can customize each button state individually. The button states are: Regular (the button's default appearance before visitors interact with it), Hover (the button's appearance when visitors hover over it with their cursor), Clicked / Focus (the button's appearance after visitors click it), and Error (indicates an issue with the button's function, such as file upload failure). The options for button states differ depending on the type of button selected. The customization options available depend on what you choose to display on your button (text, icon, or both).

title: Can I apply the colors and fonts from my Wix logo to an existing site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to apply the colors and fonts you used in your logo to an existing site. As a workaround, you can update your site manually using your logo's Color Code Guide, or you can create a new branded site from the Brand Studio.

title: How can I onboard a new client for the Wix Studio Enterprise plan and earn a revenue share?
content: To onboard a new Enterprise client for the Wix Studio Enterprise plan and earn a revenue share, fill out the enterprise lead form. Upon review, Wix will schedule a discovery meeting with you and an Enterprise sales manager to discuss the opportunity. In an introductory meeting with you and the client, define the project scope, deadline, and needs. The Enterprise sales team will then work with you and the client to finalize and close the deal for the Enterprise plan. To qualify for revenue share, comply with the Wix Partner Program Terms of Use and connect a payout method to receive revenue share payouts. Payouts for revenue share on Enterprise plans, and any associated plans purchased by the client, are issued only after Wix receives the full non-refundable payment; the payout cycle is net 90 days. The source also states that in 2023 and 2024, as a Wix Partner, you can earn 50% of the payment made by a new client you onboard for the Enterprise plan, subject to the source's eligibility terms.

title: How can I verify my site on search engines using custom code with a free Wix site?
content:
With a free site, add custom code in your editor to verify your site pages. For the meta tag to properly validate, the code must be in a valid HTML format, and the tag will work when the site is published.

Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page.
- Click SEO basics.
- Click the Advanced SEO tab.
- Click + Add New Tag under Additional Tags.
- Enter your meta tag in HTML format.
- Click Apply.

Studio Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Pages on the left side of the editor.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page.
- Click SEO Basics.
- Click the Advanced SEO tab.
- Click + Add New Tag under Additional Tags.
- Enter your meta tag in HTML format.
- Click Apply.

title: Can I create seasonal promotions for events like Black Friday using Wix Promos?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create seasonal promotions using Wix Promos for certain events such as Black Friday. As a workaround, you can send a promotional email marketing campaign to your customers to let them know about your upcoming promo.

title: How can I add the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner app to my client's site using the Studio Editor?
content: In the editor, click App Market on the left side. Click App Market again. Enter "Wix Hotels" in the search bar. Click the Wix Hotels app in the search results. Click Add to Site. Click Agree & Add. This adds the Wix Hotels app to your client's site so they can manage their availability and reservations.

title: How can I pin a post to the top of my blog feed using the Wix Editor?
content:
To pin a post to the top of your blog feed using the Wix Editor:
- Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click Blog Pages.
- Click Blog or click the name of your Blog page if you renamed it.
- Click the Blog Post element in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Display.
- Select the checkbox next to More actions menu.
- Publish your site.
- Go to your live site and log in with the email address associated with your Wix account.
- Go to the blog on your live site.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant blog post.
- Click Pin to Feed.

To unpin a post, follow the same steps and select Unpin Post.

title: Is it possible to make custom private fields added to the Members Area visible in the app collection?
content: Currently, when you add a custom private field to the Members Area, it is not possible to see it in your regular collections. The custom field gets stored in a Wix App collection under Members called PrivateMembersData.

title: How can I manually schedule an appointment for a client using the Wix app?
content:
To manually book an appointment for a client using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Calendar.
- Tap the Add icon.
- Tap Appointment.
- Tap to select an existing client or tap Add New Contact to add a new one.
- Select the relevant appointment.
- Tap to choose the Date for the appointment.
- (Optional) Create a recurring appointment: tap the Repeats drop-down and choose how often the appointment repeats; tap the For drop-down and select the total times the appointment repeats; tap Select.
- Tap the Location drop-down to choose where the appointment takes place.
- Tap the Session starts drop-down to choose the start time.
- Tap the Duration drop-down to select how long the session lasts.
- Tap the Staff member drop-down to assign a staff member.
Note: A notification will appear if there are scheduling conflicts. You can continue scheduling or tap Show free time slots to choose a different time.
- Tap the Payment options drop-down to select how your client will pay for the session: Use client's plan now to redeem the session from the client's membership plan or package as soon as you schedule it; Use client's plan later to redeem this session from the client's membership plan or package at a later date; or Collect payment to charge the client for this session or mark as paid at a later date.
Note: If your client doesn't have a pricing plan yet, you can tap Sell Plan to choose a plan for them, before continuing to create the appointment. Make sure you get the client's consent before signing them up for one of your pricing plans.
- (Optional) Select the Notify client with an email checkbox to send your client an email with the details.
- Tap Book.

title: How can I customize the layout of my service page in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor and open your Service Page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Bookings Pages, then click the Service Page. Click the Service Page element on your page, click Settings, then click the Layout tab. Enable the Show header toggle to show the header on your service page, then customize the header by selecting the checkboxes next to the elements you want to display, dragging the sliders to adjust opacity, image height and side padding, choosing the alignment, and clicking Customize Image Cropping to set the image position. Scroll down to the Body & Sidebar section: for Body you can edit spacing, column position and alignment; for Sidebar enable the Show sidebar toggle to customize what is displayed and how it appears.

title: Can I resize the header menu in ADI?
content:
Currently, you cannot change the size of the header menu. However, you can select different layouts with header menus of different heights.

To change your layout, click the header on your site in ADI, click Design, and select a new layout with the header menu of your choice.

title: How can I create a new folder in the File Share app from my site's dashboard?
content: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. (Optional) Navigate to the place that you want the new folder to be. For example, to create a subfolder inside the "Spanish" folder, click the "Spanish" folder. Click + Add New at the top right. Select Folder. Enter a name for the new folder in the What's the folder name field. Click Save.

title: How can I delete the Wix File Share app from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: To delete the File Share app using the Wix Editor: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor. Hover over the File Share page. Click the More Actions icon. Click Delete. Click Delete to confirm. Note: Deleting the app does not delete any of the uploaded files or content, but does prevent members from viewing the files or uploading new ones. If you decide to add the File Share app again at a later stage, all your files and content will be restored.

title: Can I assign screen permissions in the Wix member apps based on a member's role?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set screen permissions in the Wix member apps based on a role that a member has on your site (e.g. site owner, admin, billing manager, domain manager etc). However, you can set screen permissions for pricing plans and badges.

title: How can I create a subscription-based post in Wix Groups?
content: To create a subscription-based post in Wix Groups, first make sure Pricing Plans are added to your site and connect a payment method. In the dashboard: go to Groups, click the relevant group, click Posts, click Create Post, write your post, click Monetize at the top left, then either create a new pricing plan with +Create Plan or enable the toggle next to an existing plan, and click Post at the top right. In the Wix app: go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Groups, tap Manage Posts, tap + Create a Post, tap the relevant group, write your post, tap the Monetize icon, tap Connect next to the relevant Pricing Plan, tap Done, then tap Post.

title: How can I add the Right Click Protect app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add the Right Click Protect app to your site using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Right Click Protect app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.

title: Can I set the line and character spacing of text in a site's typography styles?
content: You can now set the line and character spacing of text in a site's typography styles.

title: How can I exercise my right to be forgotten under the GDPR with Wix?
content: Wix provides you with an easy way to exercise your right to be forgotten under the GDPR, meaning to be permanently deleted from our databases. On the Wix GDPR page, use the "Right to be forgotten" instructions link to follow the instructions.

title: How can I manually save my site in the Studio Editor?
content: To manually save a site, click the Wix Studio icon at the top left. Hover over Site. Click Save. Once you save a site, an indication appears at the top left of the Editor. It also appears every time the site is auto-saved.

title: Can I sell gift cards in the Wix member apps?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell gift cards in the Wix member apps: Spaces by Wix, Dine by Wix, Fit by Wix.

title: How can I check the date and amount of my upcoming renewals for Premium plans or Studio plans?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. View renewal information in the Next payment due column. Click View payment details to see the specifics of your next payment, including the amount due. The Next payment due column shows the renewal date. This date may differ slightly from the expiration date. Hover over the Info icon to learn more. If the auto renew has been turned off, the expiration date of your plan will display.

title: How can I view and manage my reservations in the original Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your dashboard. Click the Hotels tab. Click the Reservations tab. Hover over a reservation to see more details. Tip: Click the reservation to edit the reservation details or mark the reservation as Paid. Note: Changing the size of your browser window changes the amount of days you can see on the calendar. Click the arrows next to the date to view different days in your calendar.

title: How can I view and manage all my automations in Wix?
content: No matter which apps your automations are connected to, you'll be able to view all automations on your Automations page. Here, you can see automation summaries and key information, such as total trigger count and most recent trigger date. You'll also be able to make edits, instantly activate or deactivate, and filter your automation list.

title: Can automations be set up with "if" conditions?
content: You can now set up automations with "if" conditions.

title: How can I add a new page to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click Site Menu. Click Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel. Select New page. Select either a blank page or a template: to add a blank page, click + Blank Page at the top left; to choose a template, hover over the design you want to use and click Add Page. Enter the new page name in the Pages panel. Click Done. Design the new page to your liking.

title: How can I schedule a publish time for a video in Wix Video?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Video Library, click the Channels tab, and click the relevant channel. Hover over the relevant video and click the Show more icon. Click Set video publish time, select a date and time, and click Save. To change the time of a video, click Change next to the current scheduled time.

title: Can I transfer my existing email account to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer an existing email account to Wix, even if you've transferred the domain to Wix. Instead, you can connect your business email to Wix by adding DNS records (MX, A, CNAME and TXT records) provided by your email host in the Domains page of your Wix account.

title: How do I import reservations from an external calendar into Wix Hotels using an iCal URL?
