content: Import reservations from external services such as Airbnb, HomeAway, and VRBO into your Wix Hotels reservation calendar. The sync is one way only, from iCal to the Wix Calendar. To import your external calendar: locate your iCal URL, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, expand the Reservations tab, select iCal, choose a room type from the Choose Type drop-down menu, paste your iCal URL into the URL field, optionally click Add Calendar to add another room type and paste that iCal URL in the URL field, then click Save. You can only import from services that allow you to export your calendar in iCal format. If you have multiple room types, you must add a different iCal URL for each room type. Imported rates do not appear in the calendar; rates can be viewed by clicking on the reservation in the calendar and scrolling down to the Payment Details section. This feature is not compatible with the Wix Hotels Channel Manager; if you want to connect the Channel Manager, delete all the URLs in this tab before doing so.

title: How can I link an element attached to a hover box in Wix Editor?
content: To link an element attached to your hover box in Wix Editor, add the element you want to link to your hover box, then click the element. For a Text Box, click Edit Text, click the Link icon, select a link type, and click Done. For an Image and button, click the Link icon, select a link type, and click Done. Important: Make sure your linked element is in hover view so you can click on it when you hover over your hover box.

title: Can I add a gradient to a shape divider in Wix Editor?
content: No, it is not possible to add a gradient to a shape divider on a section or strip. As an alternative, you can add a gradient to a strip or section background, and adjust the opacity of the divider so that the gradient is more visible.

title: How can I connect Online Travel Agency (OTA) channels to the Wix Hotels Channel Manager and what updates are automatically synchronized?
content:
Wix works with HotelRunner to provide this integration. Set up the channel manager and connect to services. Any changes you make to the Channel Manager must be done through your Wix account. Avoid signing in to HotelRunner to try to make updates, as it may cause discrepancies with rates and availability to external channels.

With OTA channels, the following changes are updated automatically in both systems (two-way synchronization):
- Minimum and Maximum night stays.
- Regular and seasonal rates.
- Temporary rate changes made with Quick Rates.
- Reservations made by guest through your Wix site.
- Reservations made by guests through an online travel agency.
- Room rates and weekend rates you set in the Rooms tab of your Wix Hotel manager.
- The length of stay you set in your Wix Hotel manager.

Note: You cannot make updates to dates you manually set as not available in your Hotel calendar.

title: How can I hide elements in my logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Go to Logo and Brand. Select the logo you would like to edit. Right-click the element in the Logo Maker. Click Hide.

title: How do I connect my domain to Wix using the name servers method?
content:
To connect a domain you already own to Wix by changing its name servers:

Prerequisites: You must upgrade your Wix site with a plan before you can connect your domain. Wix does not support the use of DNSSEC or DNS Proxies like Cloudflare; make sure these options are not enabled before connecting your domain to a Wix site.

Step 1 | Add the domain to your Wix account: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click Add an Existing Domain, then click Connect a domain you already own. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Continue. Enter your domain name and click Let's Go. Click Yes, I own this domain under the search field. Depending on your provider, choose to connect automatically or manually. If a Start Transfer option appears, click connect your domain in the sentence below it.

Step 2 | Update the name servers in your domain host account: Log into your domain host account, find your domain settings page, find the name servers, and replace the old name servers with the Wix name servers shown on the screen. Follow the on-screen instructions and use the buttons I logged in, I found my domain settings, I found the nameservers, and I've replaced my nameservers.

Step 3 | Wait for your domain to propagate: It may take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and your site to appear worldwide. Learn more about domain propagation.

Tip: Get a personalized business email for your custom domain through our partnership with Google Workspace.

title: How can I manage restaurant notification settings for different restaurant locations in the Wix app?
content: This applies to the original Restaurants Orders app. To manage restaurant notification settings in the Wix app, go to your site in the Wix app, tap your profile image at the top left, tap **Notification Settings**, and select the site you want to update notification settings for. Tap the **Allow Notifications** toggle to enable or disable notifications. When enabled, you receive push notifications from your restaurant site and any other Wix apps you have installed. You can customize notifications with the toggles below: **Restaurant Orders** lets you get notified every time you receive an order; if disabled, you will not receive a notification in the app, but you can still view the order in the Orders tab. **Restaurant Reservations** lets you get notified every time you receive a reservation; if disabled, you won't get reservation notifications in the app, but can still view them in the Reservations tab. If you have multiple restaurant locations, enable the toggles for the locations you want to receive notifications for under Restaurant Orders and Restaurant Reservations. If you have set up additional restaurant locations, you can also set your notification settings per restaurant location. You can also tap the toggles for other apps on your site to manage their notification settings. If you have more than one site, you receive notifications only from the site that is currently open in the Wix app; to switch between sites, tap the drop-down at the top.

title: How do I create an RSVP event using the Wix app?
content:
To create an RSVP event using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events under Business.
- Tap Create Event or Create New Event.
- Tap Collect RSVPs.
- Tap Add Event Image and take a new photo or upload one and tap Next.
- Enter the name of the event.
- Optionally enter a short teaser to describe the event.
- Connect this event to one or more event categories: Tap Add Category. Tap to select existing categories or enter the name of a new category. Tap Done.
- Tap the Date & Time toggle to show or hide the event's date and time:
  - Enabled: The date and time appears in the event details. Set up a single or recurring event:
    - Single Events: Enter the start date and time and optionally tap Add End Date and Time to add an end date and time.
    - Recurring Event: Create an event template used for multiple dates.
  - Disabled: A TBD message appears in the event details. Edit the text in the TBD Message field (e.g. Event time will be sent soon).
- Tap the Location toggle to show or hide the event's location:
  - Enabled: The location appears in the event details. Select whether the location is a physical location or online. Enter the event address or online location title.
  - Disabled: A TBD Message appears in the event details. Edit the text in the TBD Message field.
- Add an "About Your Event" description, which appears on the Events Details page: Tap Add Description. Enter your text and click Done.
- Tap Next at the top right.
- Select a save option:
  - Save as draft: The event won't be displayed yet on your site. When you're ready, publish it to display it.
  - Publish: Your event may be visible on your site depending on your event display settings on your desktop site or in Spaces by Wix.

title: Is it possible to automatically create a gallery page that shows a clickable image for each store category in Wix Stores?
content:
Currently, it's not possible to automatically create a gallery page that shows a clickable image for each store category – unless you do it using the Wix CMS (Content Management System).

Workarounds:
- You can display store categories using the Category page.
- You can manually create an index of product categories.
- You can use the CMS (Content Management System) to display all your categories on one page. Learn how to:
  - Display your Wix Stores categories in a repeater, gallery, or table on any page such as your Home or Cart page.
  - Display your Wix Stores categories on a dynamic list page.

title: What are the features and storage options available in the Google Workspace Business Plus plan offered by Wix?
content: The Business Plus plan includes all the features of the Business Starter plan with the following extras: 5 TB cloud storage per user; up to 250 participants in Chat and Google Meet video calls; Advanced endpoint management (ensuring secure connection on different devices); Google Vault for eDiscovery and information governance. You can go to the Business Email page in your Wix account to view prices, purchase and manage a business email, or add an email purchased elsewhere.

title: What should I do if my email campaign sample fails when sending to a new contact list?
content: Make sure that your list contains only valid addresses. Once the emails are validated, make sure you're only adding valid contacts before you send out a new campaign. Any invalid contacts must be removed from your Contact list. Additionally, make sure you only send your emails to contacts who have given you their consent, using a subscribe form. When your list is ready, try sending your email campaign again.

title: How can I find a Wix Professional to create or enhance my web presence?
content: You can find a Wix Professional through the Wix Marketplace. You can submit a project request to get matched with a suitable Wix Professional, or search for a specific freelancer or agency that meets your needs. In the Wix Marketplace, you can filter by service, price, location, and language. If you submit a project request, you should hear back from a Professional within 1 business day. Before you hire a Wix Professional, discuss and agree on the price and payment method together with the Professional.

title: How can I choose and customize a site theme in the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Click Site Design on the left side of the editor. Click Change Theme. Select a theme from the list. (Optional) Customize the theme's fonts and colors:
- Colors: Choose the colors and palette that are featured and displayed across your site.
- Text: Choose the text theme and customize the styles for the different types of text (such as headings and paragraphs) that are used across your site.

title: What should I do if I haven't received the confirmation email for my Wix domain contact information?
content: If you did not receive the confirmation email for your Wix domain contact information, you can resend it from the Domains page in your Wix account by clicking Resend Confirmation Email. Do not use AOL or Yahoo email addresses for the domain registrant email, as they can cause issues with the verification process.

title: How can I follow or unfollow a category in my Wix Forum?
content: To follow a category, go to your forum on your live site and click Follow next to the relevant category. To unfollow a category, go to your forum on your live site, click Following next to the relevant category, and click Unfollow. Admins automatically follow categories they create and can unfollow at any time; members can also choose to follow and unfollow categories. You can control exactly which notifications you receive by customizing your notification settings.

title: How can I customize the text in automated emails for Wix Bookings, such as confirmation, cancellation, and reminder emails?
content: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard, click Emails & SMS notifications, hover over the automation you want to customize, and click Edit. For reminder emails only, click Edit next to Timing and adjust the timing. Scroll down to Action 1 and choose what you want to customize, such as Manage details, Create an email, Set email type, or Set recipients. To edit the email template, click Edit under Create an email; you can customize existing elements or add more elements to the email. For confirmation and cancellation email automations, you can select the Calendar invite file (ICS) checkbox to include a Universal Calendar File format with your email. Click Save when finished.

title: How can I adjust the layout of my breadcrumbs trail in Wix Editor?
content: Ensure Velo Dev Mode is enabled on your site, because breadcrumbs must be added and customized with Velo. Then click the breadcrumbs element in your editor and click the Layout icon. Adjust the layout using the available options: for How are overflow items displayed?, choose Show all items or Collapse items; use Separators to show separators between trail items and choose V-shape or Backslash; use Vertical spacing and Horizontal spacing to change spacing; use Align items to choose Left, Center, or Right; and use Display breadcrumbs from to choose Left to Right or Right to Left.

title: How can I add the Pricing Plans app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Pricing Plans app in the search bar, then click Add to Site. Tip: The Pricing Plans app creates a new page on your site called Plans & Pricing.

title: What are examples of prohibited products and services for Wix Payments in the United States?
content: Wix Payments may not be used in relation to prohibited products or services, including examples such as adult goods, fetish products, pornographic content, and sexually oriented entertainment or dating services; financial businesses such as binary options, buy now pay later / installment payment methods, credit repair, debt repayment and collection agency, e-wallet or e-money, virtual currencies, and independent or unlicensed financial advisors; healthcare items such as prescription-only and regulated medical devices, dental supplies, medical practices, pharmaceuticals, and supplements containing CBD and/or THC; counterfeit products, essay mills, deceptive marketing tactics, and pyramid selling; unregistered charities; airlines, ancestry research, bail bonds, bidding fee and penny auctions, cloud storage, VPN, file sharing, hazardous materials, human body parts or bodily fluids, multi-level marketing, pawn shops, timeshares, and veterinary practices; regulated non-financial products such as alcohol sales as main product, cannabis dispensaries, and illegal drugs; securities and trading such as cryptocurrency exchange, cryptocurrency mining equipment, and high-risk securities; third-party payment processing; and decryption and descrambler products and services.

title: How can I enable access for less secure apps in my Google Workspace business email?
content: Access for less secure apps must be enabled through your Google Workspace admin console, not through your Wix account. If you are not the admin, ask your admin to enable the app. If you have only one business email, you are considered the admin. The relevant settings are found under the Admin console, not in your user dashboard.

title: How can I add and customize text for images in my Wix gallery?
content: In Wix galleries, you can add three text types to gallery images: Title, Description, and Link. Title: add an image title of up to 36 characters to summarize the image. Description: add an image description of up to 500 characters to expand on the content of the image and provide more details. Link: link the image to other sections, pages or sites so visitors can open the relevant link when they click the image; note that links are not displayed in galleries. Choose a gallery design depending on whether text should display on both regular and hover view, only on hover, or not at all. You can customize image text design, including font, color, text size, and alignment; for a large gallery, you can also customize the text content and design of the Show More button. Adding a title and description helps accessibility and SEO, and the title is used as your image's alt text.

title: How can I change the focal point of an image or video in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor. Click Manage Media. Click the image or video whose focal point you want to change. Click the Focal Point icon. Click the position on the thumbnail image where you want the focal point to be; the focal point is displayed as a white circle. Click Done.

title: How can I use AI to create and edit product images for my online store on Wix?
content: To edit product images, click Crop & edit image on your product image to access the Wix Photo Studio. There you can use AI tools to enhance your image: Auto enhance automatically enhances your images to give your product photos a professional look; Remove and change backgrounds uses AI to remove the background and place your product against a different backdrop; Improve image quality uses the Upscale Image tool to increase the resolution of your photos, making them look sharp and clear even on larger screens; Change parts of your image uses the AI Image Editor to select parts of your image and use AI to change it; Remove parts of the image uses the Object Eraser tool to remove unwanted objects from your photos. To create a new image for your store, use the AI Image Creator to generate images based on a description of your product.

title: Can I filter my Services List on the Wix app by staff member, location, service, or category?
content: Currently, you can filter your Services List from your site's dashboard by various parameters such as staff member, location, service, or category. However, it is not possible to filter this list on the Wix app. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

title: How can I access my store in the site's dashboard using ADI?
content: In ADI, click Manage Apps on the top bar, then click Store. You can also access your Store Manager from any of the store sections and galleries on other pages of your site by clicking the section and then clicking Manage.

title: How can I copy and paste text from a Word document into a Wix Editor text box without keeping the original formatting?
content: Highlight the relevant text to be copied from the original source. Press Ctrl + C (Command + C on Mac). In the Editor, double-click the text box, click where you want the text to be pasted and press Ctrl + Shift + V (Command + Shift + V on Mac). This removes text formatting so you can paste your text efficiently.

title: How can I customize my website's menu for mobile view using ADI?
content: You can customize the way your menu looks in the mobile view. First, edit your menu on desktop: click the header on your desktop site, then click the Show/Hide icon next to an element to show or hide it. Selected means the element or text field is shown; Unselected means it is hidden. Then hover over the desktop icon on the top bar of ADI and click Mobile. In the mobile view, click the header, then click the Show/Hide icon next to an element to show or hide it. To change the section design, click the header, click Section Design, and select a new mobile section layout. Important: any changes made in the mobile view do not affect the desktop view of your site.

title: How can I earn points in the Wix Partner Program?
content: You earn points by building Premium sites and completing certifications. You automatically earn 100 points for each Premium site you've built and 300 points for each Premium Wix Studio or Editor X site. If you've worked on Premium sites that are in other Wix accounts, you must be a collaborator on those sites to receive points. When you work on a Premium Wix Studio or Editor X site as a collaborator, you earn 100 points for that site. You can also receive 100 points for completing Wix certifications, including Get an Accessibility certification, Get a Web Designer certification, and Get a Developer certification. You receive points immediately after a site you built is upgraded to a Premium plan. Points for certifications may take a few business days to be applied to your account. You can lose points if the Premium plan is canceled within the first 14 days.

title: How can I purchase a business phone number through Wix?
content: You must comply with Wix's Communication Services Terms of Use. To purchase a Business Phone Number, go to Business Phone Number in your site's dashboard and click Get a Business Number. Choose Local Number or Toll-Free Number, then select the number you want to purchase. Choose a subscription period, such as Billed Yearly or Billed Monthly, click Select under the plan you want, fill in your payment method details, and click Submit Purchase. Then link and verify your phone number by entering the phone number you'd like to connect to your business number, clicking Send Code, entering the verification code you received via SMS, and clicking Send Code. Finally, click Go to Settings.

title: How can I create another Wix account if I already have one?
content: First, make sure you are signed out of your first Wix account. Then go to the Wix.com sign up page and enter an email address for the new account; it must be different from the email of your first account. Enter the email address again, enter a password for the new account, enter the password again, and click Sign Up. Alternatively, click the Facebook or Google + button to sign up using one of these platforms.

title: How do I add a button in the Wix Editor that links readers to a specific blog post?
content:
First, retrieve the live URL of the blog post: go to the live site, open the relevant blog post, and copy the URL.

Then, in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor and navigate to the relevant page.
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Button**.
- Click the button you want to add, or drag it to the relevant location.
- Click the **Link** icon.
- Select **Web Address**.
- Paste the blog post URL in the **What's the web address (URL)?** field.
- Select whether the external URL opens in a **New Window** or in the **Current Window**.
- Click **Done**.

title: How do I connect iyzico as a payment method on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, change it using the drop-down menu. Click Connect next to iyzico. If you have an iyzico account, enter the API Key and Secret Key you received from iyzico when your account was approved, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create iyzico account and fill in the form. Wait for the approval email from iyzico, copy the API Key and Secret Key from your new iyzico account, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your iyzico account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I create a loyalty program for my business using Wix Bookings?
content: Create a loyalty program by choosing a program name, a name for your points, and an icon that represents your brand. Clients get points every time they perform set actions, such as making a certain number of bookings, and they can redeem their points using coupons. You decide which actions clients take to earn points, how many points they get per action, and what the rewards are.

title: How can I add an address to a room in Wix Hotels for my rental properties in different locations?
content:
To add an address to a room in Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the **Hotels** tab on the left.
- Click the **Rooms** tab.
- Click the **Edit** icon for an existing room type or click **Create New** to add a new one.
- Scroll down to the **Address** section.
- Click the **Show map location** toggle to enable the address option.
- Enter the city, state and country of the property.
- Enter the street address of the property.
- Enter the zip code of the property.
- Click **Save** at the bottom of the page.

**Important:** You can only add an address to a room after you've set up your hotel. If you're trying to add an address to your first room and you're unable to find the address section, add the room without the address and come back to add the address after setting up your hotel.

title: How can I change the redirect number for my business phone using the Wix dashboard?
content: To change your redirect number, go to Business Phone Number in your site's dashboard. Click the Call Agents tab. Click the More Actions icon next to your name. Select Edit Owner's Number. Enter the new phone number. Click Send Code. Enter the verification code you've received via SMS. Click Submit Code. Tap the Download link in the SMS message you receive from Wix and connect to the Wix app.

title: How can I manually authorize a payment for an order in Wix?
content: Manually authorizing a payment is available for merchants who connected Wix Payments as a payment provider. To manually authorize a payment, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, select the relevant order, click Collect Payment, select Authorize a payment, and enter the amount you want to authorize. The amount can be less than the order total. Select or deselect the Automatically capture payments before the authorization period ends checkbox: if selected, the payment is automatically sent to you at the end of the 7-day period if you haven't taken any action before then; if deselected, the payment is automatically voided at the end of the 7-day period, meaning the hold on the payment is released from your customer's account if you haven't taken any action. Enter the customer's card number. Optionally, with the customer's knowledge and approval, select Save this card to the customer's file. Click Authorize. Authorized payments are held for 7 days.

title: How can I edit, duplicate, or rename an automation using the new automation builder?
content:
Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Your automations section. Hover over the relevant automation and click the More Actions icon. Choose what you want to do:
- Edit: Click Edit, edit the automation as necessary, then click Save.
- Duplicate: Click Duplicate, edit the relevant details within the duplicated automation, update its name, then click Activate.
- Rename: Click Rename, edit the automation's name, then click Save.

title: Can I use Wompi as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Wompi as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Wompi and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I reduce the number of business email users in my monthly Google Workspace subscription?
content:
First, delete the relevant user(s) from your Google Workspace account, then remove the user(s) from the subscription. Before you begin, make sure you do not have any outstanding or unpaid invoices for your Google Workspace email subscription, because subscriptions with outstanding invoices cannot be reduced. If the user has Workspace Admin status, revoke their Admin status before deleting their account.

To delete a user: Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the business email you want to remove. Click Manage at Google. You may need to sign into your Google Workspace account if you are not already signed in. From the Google Admin console menu, go to Directory, then Users. Click Remove user or Delete user for the user you want to remove. Depending on your Google account setup, you might need to confirm that you want to delete the user. Follow the on-screen prompts to complete the process.

To reduce the business email subscription: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the business email subscription you want to reduce. Click Remove users. This option only appears for monthly subscriptions. Select the I want to delete my inactive Business Emails checkbox. Click Reduce Subscription.

title: How can I change the size of a slideshow on my Wix mobile site?
content: To change the size of your slideshow on a Wix mobile site, click the slideshow in the mobile editor, then click and drag the sides of the slideshow to adjust the height and width. Note: This option is only available for Box slideshows. You can adjust the height of a Full Width slideshow by clicking and dragging the Stretch Handle icon.

title: How can I change the rates for my hotel rooms using the Inventory Calendar in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
To change your rates using the Inventory Calendar:
- Go to Inventory Calendar in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant date range from the drop-down at the top.
- Click Update.
- Select Rates from the drop-down on the left.
- Select the relevant Room types, Rate plans and Channels from the drop-downs at the top.
- Click on the rate you want to edit.
- Enter the new rate for that date.
- Optional: Click Copy across right or Copy across left to fill all other dates before or after the selected date within the selected date range.
- Click Apply Updates in the top right.

title: Can I manually translate the entire Members Area in Wix Multilingual sites?
content: Currently, the only part of your Members Area that can be manually translated is the My Orders page. This page appears only when you have added Wix Stores and Members Area to your site.

title: How can I add a Facebook Share button to my Wix site?
content: Click Add on the left side of the Editor. Click Social. Under Facebook, click the Facebook Share button to add it, or drag it to the relevant location. Click Choose Page, then choose This Page or Home Page to decide which page your visitors share. Type the text for your button under What does this button say?. Tip: Add the Facebook Share button to your blog post page, publish your site, and let your site visitors share your blog posts on their social media streams. Customize the thumbnail and text for each post to match your brand.

title: 成本结构未核算清楚时，能否直接使用AI自动调价工具？
content: 不适合直接使用。成本结构没算清时，用错保本价跑自动调价会稳定亏损，应先做实利润模型；若平台限制调价频率/幅度，先确认平台规则，脚本必须设幅度和频率上限。涉及自动调价（不可逆动作）时，结论必须包含“AI 建议 + 人工确认”或安全阀设置。

title: How can I limit access to my blog so that only members who purchased a pricing plan can view it using the Wix Editor?
content: To limit access to your blog to visitors who purchased a pricing plan using the Wix Editor: click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor, click **Blog Pages**, hover over the **Post** page and click the **More Actions** icon, click **Settings**, click the **Permissions** tab, select **Members only**, select **Only selected members or paying customers**, click the **Edit** icon under **Select from your Pricing Plans**, then select which pricing plans should have access and click **Apply**. Optionally, limit access to the blog and category feeds by repeating those steps and selecting the **Blog** page in the step where you select the **Post** page. Note: to accept online payments through the Pricing Plans app, you need to upgrade your site.

title: How can I create a new site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content:
Before you begin, download the Wix app to your mobile device.

- Go to the Wix app on your mobile device.
- Choose an option:
  - If this is your first site with Wix: Tap **Create Now**.
  - If you already have a Wix site: Tap the site name at the top of your screen, then tap **+ Create New** at the bottom.
- Choose how you want to start creating your site:
  - **Chat to the AI assistant**: Tell the AI assistant about the site you want to create. Use the options to tell the assistant what you want, such as the pages you'd like to add, your logo, etc. Read the site profile to ensure it's correct. Click **End Chat & Continue**.
  - **Set up manually, without the AI assistant**: Type a category or select a category from the list. Click **Next**. Select the apps you want to add.
- **Note:** After you add an app from the Wix app, you need to go to the editor and add the pending app to your site.
- Enter your site's name.
- Click **Let's Go**.

title: Can I customize the design of my portfolio gallery's expand mode in Wix?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to customize the design of your portfolio gallery's expand mode. However, you can set the expand mode's background color and fonts from your site's color and text theme. Keep in mind that customizing your site's color and text theme changes the color and fonts throughout your entire site.

### Workarounds
* To adjust the background color of expand mode: Edit **Color 1** of your site theme's colors.
* To adjust your media's title and description fonts in expand mode: In your theme's text styles, edit **Heading 4** and **Paragraph 2**.
* To edit the actual text that displays for your media files in expand mode: Go to your project and click **Manage Media**. Then enter the relevant text in the **Title** and **Description** fields.
* Alternatively, if you do not want to use expand mode, go to the portfolio gallery settings and select another option from the **When clicking on an item** drop-down.

title: Is it possible to make subpages in the Wix Editor open only when clicked, instead of on hover?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change this behavior so that the subpages menu only opens when clicked. When you hover over a menu button, the header menu and any subpages you have open automatically.

title: How can I show a lightbox on my Wix mobile site?
content:
To show your lightbox on your mobile site:

- Access the mobile editor.
- Click **Menus & Pages** on the left side of the mobile editor.
- Click **Lightboxes**.
- Click the relevant lightbox.
- Click the **Settings** icon.
- Click **Yes** under **Automatically display lightbox on pages**.

**Note:** This option is only visible if you clicked **Yes** under **Automatically display lightbox on pages** in the lightbox settings on your desktop Editor.

title: How do I set up a Google Tag in Google Tag Manager for my Wix site?
content:
First connect Google Tag Manager to your Wix site in Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Do not use custom code to connect Google Tag Manager.

Then, in Google Tag Manager, add a configuration tag:
- Click Tags from the left hand side menu.
- Click New.
- Enter a name for the tag.
- Click Choose a tag type to begin setup under Tag Configuration.
- Select Google Tag.
- Add your Tag ID. We recommend creating a constant variable that contains the tag ID.
- Click Configuration Settings.
- Under Configuration Parameters click Add Parameter.
- Enter “send_page_view” into the Configuration Parameter field and false into the Value field.

Add a trigger to the configuration tag:
- In the Triggering section click Choose a trigger to make this tag fire.
- Select "Consent Initialization - All Pages."
- Click Save.

title: How can I change the order of products in a category?
content: To reorder products on your site, go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant category, click and drag the products to change the order, and click Save. If you're using the Category Page, you can override the product order you set in the dashboard by clicking the Category Page in your editor, clicking Settings, and selecting the Sorting tab. You can select order choices from the Order products by drop-down.

title: What are the limitations of restoring a saved version of my Wix site, specifically regarding Wix apps and CMS collections?
content:
When restoring a saved version of your Wix site, there are specific limitations to be aware of:

- Wix Apps: Content in the following apps does not revert when restoring to a previously saved version of your site:
  - Wix Stores
  - Wix Blog
  - Wix Events
  - Wix Bookings
  - Wix Forum
  - Wix Video
  - Wix FAQ
  - Wix Restaurants
  - Wix Hotels

- CMS (Content Management System): Restoring your site reverts its pages and their designs to a previous version. This applies to your dynamic pages and their layouts. However, the content and data structure (schema) in your CMS collections are not reverted when restoring your site. You can use CMS backups to restore previous versions of your collections.

title: How can I create and set up a member badge on my site?
content: Before you begin, install a Member's Area on your site. To create and set up a member badge, go to your member list. Click More Actions at the top right and click Manage Badges. Click New Badge. Enter the badge details: Badge Name and Description, Background Color, Text Color, and Add Image under Icon to select an icon from the free vector art in the Media Manager or upload your own .svg file. Click Save. Click Assign Members, select the members you want to assign the badge to, then click Add. Click the Permissions tab and enable the toggle if you want to add permissions to badge holders. You can also assign badges to members automatically when they perform a certain action on your site using Learn How.

title: What happens to the media files in the Media Manager when I transfer a Wix site to another account?
content: When you transfer a site to another Wix account, any files in the site's Media Manager are transferred along with it. If you imported files from another site into your site's Media Manager, those imported files are also transferred with the site. Before transferring a site, Wix recommends reviewing the files in the relevant site's Media Manager and deleting any files you do not want to share with the recipient.

title: Is the table layout supported for viewing or editing the Portfolio Wix app collection in the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view or edit the Portfolio Wix app collection in your CMS using the table layout. However, you can use the list or gallery layout in your CMS to edit the Portfolio Wix app collections. Note: The Portfolio Wix app collection automatically gets its content from the Wix Portfolio app. You can go to the Wix Portfolio app if you need to add portfolio collections or projects. To view or edit the Portfolio Wix app collection, enable the Wix App Collections toggle in your CMS Advanced Settings, go to CMS in your Editor, click Wix App Collections, scroll down and click the relevant portfolio collection, and view or edit the collection using the list or gallery layout in the CMS.

title: How can I provide feedback on a Wix site using the Get Feedback feature?
content:
Access the Get Feedback app in a desktop browser, not from a mobile device:
- From the email: click View Site from the invite email titled "You're invited to give feedback on the [site name] website".
- From the shareable link URL: in your browser, go to the Get Feedback URL you received from the site owner, collaborator, or teammate.

Browse through the site to review it. Click Mobile View at the top to review the mobile version of the site.

Click "+ Add Comments" at the top-right. Click the Comment icon and drag it to the area you're commenting about. Enter your name in the "My Name" field. If the "My Email" field appears, enter your email address so you can receive notifications when the site owner or collaborator replies. Enter your comment in the "Add your comment..." field. Click "Post".

You can repeat these steps to add more comments. You do not need to log into a Wix account to add comments. The last saved version of a site displays in Get Feedback so you can provide feedback before changes are published. Protected pages with passwords or set to members-only are viewable in Get Feedback. Site collaborators can only view comments from Get Feedback links they share; they won't see comments posted from Get Feedback links shared by site owners or other collaborators.

title: How can I reset a site member's password from the Site Members dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Site Members. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant member, click Reset password, then click Reset Password in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I upgrade my Google Workspace plan through Wix?
content: Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant existing Workspace plan. Click Upgrade Plan. Click Select under your desired Workspace plan. Confirm your payment details on checkout and click Submit Purchase. Note: Any remaining credit from your existing plan will be automatically applied to your new plan purchase.

title: How can I set up Wix Shipping for my online store?
content:
To set up Wix Shipping:
- Go to Orders in your site's dashboard.
- Select an unfulfilled order that's set to be delivered domestically.
- Click Print Shipping Label.
- Integrate with Shippo.
  - If you previously added and set up Shippo on this site, click Buy Shipping Label.
  - Note: For Wix Shipping, you can connect one Shippo account to one site.
  - If your site is new to Shippo, click Get Started, click Add to Site, review the permissions and click Agree & Add, then create a new Shippo account or log into your existing account.
- Make sure your sender address is accurate: click Addresses, click Sender, and if necessary update your details.

title: How can I export my site's consent log to a CSV file?
content: Go to Privacy & Cookies in your site's dashboard. Click Visitor Data at the top. Click the arrow next to Consent Log. Click Download. Select a time frame for the log using the drop-down menu. Click Export to download the CSV file.

title: Can I display sale prices directly in the ticket list for Wix Events?
content: Currently, you can reduce ticket prices by creating coupons or automatic discounts. However, it is not possible to show these discounted prices directly in the ticket list.

title: How can I stretch an element to full width in the Wix Editor?
content:
To stretch an element to full width in the Wix Editor:
- Click the element in the editor.
- Click the Stretch icon.
- Enable the Stretch to full width toggle.
- (Optional) Set the margins:
  - Click the number field to choose whether to set the margins by px (pixels) or % (percentage of browser width).
  - Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the margins.

Notes:
- Certain elements only allow you to set the margins by pixels.
- The margin limit is 190 pixels, or 5% of the browser size.

title: How can I improve my Wix editor's performance by using dynamic pages?
content: Use dynamic pages instead of duplicating many pages and changing their content manually. Dynamic pages let you reduce the number of static pages on your site and help your editor perform better. They allow you to reuse the same page layout across multiple pages while showing different content in each. Every dynamic page connects to a collection in your CMS (Content Management System) where you add the info you want to display in the page.

title: How can I connect Mercado Pago as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Mercado Pago. If you already have a Mercado Pago account, enter your Public Key and Access Token, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Mercado Pago account, fill in the registration form and click Register; under Account Type, select business account. Click the confirmation link you received in the email from Mercado Pago to activate your account, find your Public Key and Access Token in your Mercado Pago account, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Note: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Mercado Pago account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I customize the header of my site on the Wix member apps using the dashboard?
content:
Go to Mobile App in your site's dashboard. Click Edit Mobile App. Click your app's header in the web editor to open the Edit Header preview panel.

- Click the Icons drop-down to add quick actions to your header and all screens. The icons displayed in the panel depend on the Wix apps you added to your site (e.g., Wix Stores).
- Show shopping cart icon: Click the toggle to add a shopping cart icon to the header so members can easily navigate to their cart.
- Click the App Info drop-down and choose what you want to customize:
  - Name: Enter the name of your site.
  - Subtitle: Enter a slogan or a short announcement.
  - Show logo: Enable the toggle to display your logo in the header.
  - Show general info: Enable the toggle to show a link to a screen with basic information about your business.
- Click the Cover photo drop-down to upload a cover photo for your site.
- Click the Members info drop-down to choose what member information you want to show in the header:
  - Show member count: Click the toggle to show or hide the number of members in your app's header.
  - Show member profiles: Click the toggle to show or hide member profile avatars in your app's header.
- Click the Action buttons drop-down to add buttons to your header:
  - Show Invite Button: Click the toggle to show or hide a button that allows members to invite more people to your app.
  - Show Custom Button: Click the toggle to add a custom button to your header. For example, a 'Send Us a Message' button can send members to chat with you in real-time.
- Click Save & Publish.

title: How can I connect my existing .il domain to my Wix site?
content: Once you upgrade your site with a plan, you can connect a .il domain you already own to your Wix site. You will need access to your current domain registrar. In most cases, Wix recommends connecting your domain to Wix via Nameservers. With this connection method, Wix hosts your DNS records, which means you can manage them in your Wix account, and Wix Customer Care can help if you need assistance managing your DNS records. New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Currently, it is not possible to purchase a .il domain from Wix or transfer one to Wix. If you would like this feature in the future, you can vote for this feature.

title: How can I add a new language to my Wix site using the Multilingual dashboard?
content:
To add a language to your site using the Multilingual dashboard:
- Go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard.
- Click + Add Language.
- Select the language you want to add from the Language drop-down.
- Select a flag to represent the language from the Flag drop-down.
- Choose how you want to start translating: Manual translation or Machine translation.
- (If available) Click the Make site in {language} visible right away drop-down and choose an option:
  - No, keep it hidden for now: Keep the new language version hidden from your live site for now. You can unhide it later.
  - Yes, make it visible right away: Make the new language version of your site available so visitors and search engines can view it. You can do this later if needed.
- Click Add Language.

title: How can I share my Editor X site to get feedback from others?
content:
To share your site for feedback:

- From Editor X: Click Site on the top bar of Editor X. Select Get Feedback.
- From the Dashboard: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Site Actions and select Get Feedback.
- Enter the email address of each person you want to receive feedback from.
- (Optional) Enter a message your commenters will see when they receive the invite.
- Click Send.

Tip: You can also click Copy Link next to the shareable link to send it on your own. The shareable link URL is valid for 2 weeks.

Note: Protected pages (with passwords or set to members-only) are viewable in Get Feedback.

title: How can I update the details of my loyalty program using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Loyalty Program under Customers & Leads, tap the Manage Program tab, and tap Info. Choose what you want to update: Program name, Points name, or Points icon. Tap Change to choose a new icon displayed next to the number of loyalty points a customer has earned. Then tap Save.

title: How can I cancel and refund an order paid via PayPal on my Wix site?
content:
Before you can refund a PayPal order, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and enable advanced features.

Then:
- Go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant order.

Tip: Only paid orders can be canceled and refunded. For stores, only unfulfilled orders can be canceled and refunded.
- Click More Actions at the top right.
- Select Cancel & Refund.
- (Optional) To provide a partial refund, enter the amount you want to refund.
- (Optional) Select the Update inventory checkbox, to return all items to stock.

Tip: This option is relevant only if you use Wix Stores and track inventory amounts.
- (Optional) Select the Send a confirmation email to customer checkbox to send a message. You can enter a personal note to your customer.

Note: Customers may also receive a notification from the payment provider.
- Click Continue.
- Click Cancel This Order.

Note: This cannot be undone.

title: How can I add alt text to items in my Wix Pro Gallery to improve SEO?
content:
To add alt text to gallery items in your Wix Pro Gallery, click the gallery in your editor, click **Manage Media**, select the relevant gallery item, click the **Alt Text** field on the right and type your description, then click **Done** and publish your site.

Alt text is a type of descriptive text you can add to images. Search engine bots can't read images and use the alt text to understand what the images are about. Make sure your alt text describes the item accurately while also integrating your site's keywords.

title: How can I add or update MX records in my Wix account?
content:
Before you begin: if your domain is connected to your Wix account, make sure it is connected via name servers, not via pointing. If it is connected via pointing, you must contact your domain host (not Wix) to configure the DNS records of your email provider.

To add or update MX records:

- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Select Edit MX Records.
- Click the drop-down menu and check if your email provider is listed:
  - If your email provider is listed: Select them from the list and click Start Connecting. You've just added your provider's MX records and do not need to continue adding them in the next steps.
  - If your email provider is not listed: Click Other (provider not on the list) and proceed to the next step.
- Get your email provider's MX records (and any other necessary DNS records).
- Add the MX records:
  - Click the Points to field and enter the mail server address of your MX record.
  - (If you have multiple MX records) Add the additional MX records: click + Add Another, click the Points to field and enter the mail server address of the next MX record, and repeat this step for each additional MX record you need to add.
  - Click Connect Business Email.
- (If instructed by your email provider) Add DNS records:
  - Click the Show More icon on the right and select Manage DNS Records.
  - Scroll to the record type you'd like to add (e.g., CNAME, TXT) and click + Add Record.
  - Enter the DNS record in the relevant fields.
  - Click Save, then click Save Changes in the pop-up message.
  - Repeat the above steps to add more DNS records.

Important: When adding more than one MX record, add the record with the lowest Priority value first. They should appear in ascending order from lowest to highest Priority value. The Priority values themselves do not need to match your provider's directions.

title: Can I export my Wix Forms submissions as a PDF file?
content: Currently, in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible to export your Wix Forms submissions as a PDF file. However, you can always access your submissions table if you need any information about a specific entry.

title: How can I add a transparent video to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add a transparent video in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Decorative or Video & Music.
- Click Transparent Video (scroll down and click More Transparent Videos to see the full menu).
- Click or drag a video onto your website and position it wherever you like.
Tip: Click Preview on the top of your editor to see your video in action.
Note for mobile-friendly sites: Transparent videos cannot be resized lower than 240P.

title: Why did I receive an email requesting payment after canceling my Wix site plan?
content:
Possible reasons why you may receive an email from Wix requesting payment after you canceled your Premium or Studio site plan are:

* **Your plan was canceled too late:** The renewal date for a yearly Premium or Studio plan is 14 days before the anniversary of the original purchase date. If you did not cancel in time, your plan may have been renewed for another year.

  **Tip:** You can find upcoming renewals in the **Next payment due** column of your Premium Subscriptions page.

* **You have an outstanding invoice:** It's possible that one of your previous payments was declined and therefore you still owe money on an older invoice.

If your plan was successfully canceled and you still receive emails regarding payment, contact us so we can resolve the issue.

title: How can I set up tax collection for my business using Wix Bookings?
content: Set up tax collection to help comply with local tax regulations and show clients the correct tax details at checkout. Before setting up taxes, understand the rules that apply to your business; consult an accountant or your local tax authority for specific information. Access your Tax settings by going to Tax in your site dashboard. For clients to see the correct tax details during checkout, set up tax for your location(s) and select the correct business address from the Business Info drop-down. If you type the address but don't click to select it, it may not save, and the correct tax rates may not appear. Wix offers manual tax calculation and automatic tax calculation through Avalara. With the manual method, select the location or locations where you want to collect tax and manually enter the tax rate; if the rate changes, it is up to you to update it. With automatic tax calculation, select the location(s) where you want to collect tax and Avalara adds the right rate; when rates change, your tax updates automatically. By default, if you use Wix Bookings, all your services are part of the services tax group, which is set to collect the default sales tax (VAT) rate for services in each location.

title: Can I add navigation breadcrumbs to my Wix site?
content: This feature is not yet available to all users. You can add breadcrumbs to your site with Velo Dev Mode enabled. Breadcrumbs are a handy and easy way to let visitors explore and navigate your site. You can connect them to your menu, and choose what to display on your trail.

title: How can I update my payment details to add my VAT number for a tax exemption in Chile on Wix?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update Payment Method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your VAT Number to the VAT ID field. Click Update. The exemption will apply from the next payment after that date.

title: Can I transfer my French (.fr) domain to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer a French (.fr) domain to Wix. In the meantime, you can connect a .fr domain to Wix by following the instructions.

title: How can I unassign a Premium plan from my Wix site?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Unassign Plan. Click Unassign Plan in the pop-up to confirm. After you unassign it, you can view your plan in the Unassigned Subscriptions section of your Wix account.

title: How can I change the name and icon of my branded app using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to the Branded Mobile App tab in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit icon next to your app name. To change your App Name, enter your new app name in the App Name field. To change your App icon, click the Update icon and select a new image for your icon. Make sure your app icon does not have a transparent background, because icons with transparent backgrounds will be rejected by Apple. Click Save. Changing your app's name and icon requires approval from Apple and Google before they can go live.

title: How can I handle orders in Wix Stores that contain products not fulfilled by Amazon?
content:
When an order contains products that are not set to be fulfilled by Amazon, Amazon does not automatically ship any product in the order. You can fulfill the entire order yourself, or you can create a manual Amazon order and then fulfill the products that are not set up to be fulfilled by Amazon in your Wix dashboard.

To view orders not fulfilled by Amazon:
Go to Orders in your site's dashboard.
Click Filter at the top right.
Select Unfulfilled and Partially fulfilled in the Fulfillment Status section.
Select only the shipping methods you created for self fulfillment in the Delivery Method section. Do not select the fulfillment methods automatically created by Amazon MCF: Standard, Expedited, Priority.
Click Manage View.
Select Save as new view.
Enter a filter name.
Click Save.

Tip: The next time you want to check for orders not fulfilled by Amazon, select the view you saved from the View drop-down.

title: How do I connect HitPay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect HitPay as a payment provider on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments on your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to HitPay.
- If you have a HitPay account, enter your Api Key and Salt and click Connect.
- If you do not have an account, click Create HitPay account, fill in the registration form, wait for an email from HitPay to get your Api Key and Salt credentials, then return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add images or GIFs to my products in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Products in your site's dashboard, select a product, click Add Images, select images or GIFs from your Media Manager or click Upload Media to add images or GIFs from your computer, then click Add to Page.

title: How can I customize the appearance of my invoices in Wix?
content: To customize your invoices in Wix, go to Invoices in your site's dashboard, click More Actions at the top right, and select Update invoice settings. Then choose what to customize: Header details, Business info, Tax display, Payments received, and Footer notes. In Header details, you can set the document name and number, use your business logo from Business Info, and choose header fields such as reference number or sales representative, including custom fields. In Business info, edit details taken from Business Info and add custom fields such as Tax ID or IBAN. In Tax display, select checkboxes to control how taxes appear; if you select none of the options, invoices just show total taxes. In Payments received, enable Show transaction details to include payment date, method, and amount. In Footer notes, add notes or terms for customers that appear at the bottom of invoices. Note that once you set the invoice number, it cannot be changed to a lower number; logo edits are automatically reflected in invoices; header field information is added when creating a new invoice. To update invoice language, update your account language in your site's dashboard, which affects all invoices. If you have an online store, you can add store products to an invoice, and a store order is automatically created when this invoice is issued.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix site?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Click the Site language dropdown and select the relevant language. Click Save.

title: Is Tap Online Payment Services supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Tap Online Payment Services as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Tap Online Payment Services and arrange the payment offline.

title: What are the supported file types and size limits for images in the Wix File Share app?
content:
### Site images

Supported files: JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, WEBP, JPEG 2000 and RAW. The following JPEG 2000 file formats are supported: .jp2, .jpg2, .j2k, .jpf, .jpm, .j2c, .jpc, .jpx. The following RAW file formats are supported: .arw, .srw, .nef, .cr2, .cr3, .crw, .rwl, .rw2, .raw, .raf, .pef, .orf, .mrw, .dng, .sr2, .srf, .kdc, .k25, .dcr, .x3f, .erf, .3fr. Animated WEBP images are currently not supported and convert to static image.

File size limits: Images: 25MB; GIFs: 15MB.

### Background images

Supported files: JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, and WEBP.

File size: At least 3000 x 3000px.

title: How do I add the Wix Monetize with AdSense app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Before you begin, make sure your site is published and a domain is connected. In the Wix Editor, click App Market on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix Monetize with AdSense app in the search bar, then click Add to Site.

title: Can I view detailed analytics reports for my Branded App, such as the number of downloads from the App Store and Google Play Store?
content: Currently in the Branded App, it is not possible to view detailed analytics reports about your app, such as the number of downloads your app is getting from both the App Store and Google Play Store. In the Member App reports in Wix Analytics, you can see data such as app traffic by time of day as well as how many new app visitors you receive over certain time periods.

title: How can I use dynamic values in my email templates with Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Email Templates in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to the email template you want to customize with dynamic values. Click the Variables drop-down next to the Subject or Body content sections. Choose the relevant variable from the different variable types: Property, Customer, or Reservation. You can also add different Content block variables to the body of the email, including Contact info, Policy tables, Payment content blocks, and a Reservation details button. Copy and paste the variable to the correct location in the email Subject line or Body content. When you are happy with the changes made to your email template, click Update.

title: How can I set the editing size for a specific breakpoint in the Studio Editor?
content:
To set your editing size in the Studio Editor:

- Go to the relevant page and breakpoint in the editor.
- Click the current editing size at the top.
- Enter the new value next to **Editing Size**.
- Click **Apply**.

The canvas instantly changes to the size you set. You can change the editing size again at any time.

**Tip:** You can set an editing size for global sections as well – it automatically applies to every page where the section appears.

title: How can I add a parallax scrolling effect to a background image in Wix Editor?
content:
To add a parallax effect to a background image in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

- Go to the relevant page in your Editor.
- Click **Site Design** on the left side of the Editor.
- Hover over **Page Background** and click **Customize**.
- Click **Settings** on the background image preview.
- Select **Parallax** under **Scroll Effects**.

**Note:** As this effect requires the image to fill the full page, we recommend using large, high quality images for your page background. Also, keep in mind that parallax scrolling is not displayed on the mobile version of your site.

title: How can I prevent ownership disputes over my Wix account and website?
content:
To avoid ownership disputes, keep your username and password secure and only grant access to your account or website settings to individuals you trust. You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account or website. The account information you provide must be your own (or your company’s) and should be accurate and complete.

Always be in control of your content and retain full control over the account(s) that have your website, domain and hosting. Set up your Wix account using an email address that only you can access, allowing you to log in and reset your password as needed, even after parting ways with a web designer, employee or other collaborator.

You can assign roles and permissions to people working on your site without having to give them access to your own account credentials.

Protect your domain name as it is crucial for your business, and losing it can be detrimental. We recommend purchasing the domain yourself and familiarizing yourself with its management. Once your web designer or employee is no longer involved, ensure they no longer have access to your Wix account. If they retain access to your account, they could potentially exploit, cancel or transfer your domain without your consent.

title: Can I create and run image campaigns in Google Ads with Wix?
content: Currently in Google Ads with Wix you cannot create and run image campaigns for your ads. You can only create text ads that include a headline and description. If you have Wix Stores you can also create a Google Ads Performance Max Shopping campaign that includes product images.

title: How can I convert a static page to a dynamic item page in Wix?
content: Yes. You can convert regular pages into dynamic item pages that use content from a CMS collection. Go to the Site Pages menu from your editor. Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon. Click Convert to Dynamic Page. Click Start Now. Select an option to choose where you want to save your content: New collection: Create a new collection for this page's content. The elements that you want to make dynamic will have fields in the collection to store the content. Enter a name for your collection and click Next. Select the checkbox next to each element you want to make dynamic. Unselected elements will not become dynamic and will show the same content on every page. You can make the elements dynamic later if you'd like. Tip: Hover over an element and click the Edit icon to change its field properties. Click Connect Elements. Existing collection: Use an existing collection to store the content of this page's dynamic elements. Click the drop-down and choose the collection you want to use. Click Next.

title: Can I switch my existing site's template in Wix Editor if I haven't added any content or elements?
content: It is not currently possible to change your site's template, even if you haven't added any content or elements. As an alternative, you can create a new site and select the template you want. You can also reassign your Premium plan and domain to the new site as needed.

title: How can I automatically create invoices for each store order in Wix?
content: To automatically create invoices for store orders in Wix Stores, go to Checkout settings in your site's dashboard, click Payments, and select the Invoices checkbox. If you issue a partial or complete refund on a store order, the invoice doesn't update to reflect the refund amount.

title: How can I copy the design of an element to another in Editor X, and what should I keep in mind?
content: In Editor X, right-click the element you want to copy, hover over Copy Element Design, and choose either From this breakpoint or From all breakpoints. Then click the element you want to copy the design to. Hold down Shift to copy to multiple elements. You can also click the More Actions icon on the element to copy the design. Keep in mind: you can only copy the design between the same type of elements, i.e., buttons to buttons, text to text. The design attributes do not include the size or position of elements. Press Esc at any time to exit the copy design feature.

title: How can I create a new tag in Google Tag Manager for Yandex Metrica on my Wix site?
content: First, connect your Google Tag Manager account to your Wix site if you have not already, and get your Yandex Metrica tracking code snippet by logging in to Yandex Metrica, clicking Settings, then Additional Settings, and Copy code snippet. In Google Tag Manager, click Tags, click New, click Tag Configuration, and choose Tag Type: Custom HTML. Paste your copied Yandex Metrica code into the HTML field. Click the pencil icon to edit the tag name and name the tag "YM-Basic". Click Triggering. In Choose a trigger, click the add symbol +. Click Trigger Configuration, then click Custom Event. Enter Event Name "Pageview" and Trigger name "Wix-Page-View". Click Save. In Tag Configuration, click Advanced Settings. In Tag firing options select Once per event. Click Submit.

title: How can I view my sales report using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
Access your sales report to get an overview of the day at your business, including details like the total amount collected in cash and credit, as well as any discounts and taxes you've applied.

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
- Tap Reports.
- Tap Sales Reports.
- Select the dates you want to view at the top.
- Optional: Print or email the report.
  - Tap Print at the top right to print the report using your HP Receipt Printer.
  - Tap Email at the top right and enter the email address the report should be sent to.

Tip: Go to Wix Analytics reports in the Wix dashboard to view reports on sales by employee, sales by channel and more.

title: How do I set up the Wix Audio Player in the Wix Editor after adding it to my site?
content: Ensure that you have added the Wix Audio Player to your site using the Wix Editor. To set up your Audio Player in the Wix Editor: click the player in your editor; click the Settings icon; set up your player using the options. Choose Image: select the image you want your player to display and click Add to Page. Choose audio from: One track: click Upload Track to access your Media Manager, select your chosen track, and click Add Track; External MP3: enter the URL of the track you want to play. Track Details: enter the artist and track name. Playback Options: Play once: the track plays once; Play in loop: the track plays continuously in a loop.

title: How can I connect my WhatsApp Business account to Wix Inbox?
content:
Prerequisites:
- A Facebook account.
- A phone number that isn't already connected to WhatsApp, or an existing WhatsApp Business account that you've migrated.

To connect your WhatsApp Business account:
- Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Settings drop-down at the top right.
- Click Communication Channels.
- Click Connect Account next to WhatsApp Business.
- Click Get Started.
- Select the checkbox next to I read and understand the terms above and click Continue.
- Log in to your Facebook account and complete the setup:
  - Create your Meta and WhatsApp Business account.
  - Create your WhatsApp Business profile.
  - Verify your WhatsApp Business number using the verification code sent via SMS or voice call.

title: Can CAPTCHA verification be implemented on login pages using Wix?
content: You can now implement CAPTCHA verification on login pages using the Wix SDK.

title: How do I enable sandbox collections in the CMS and sync content between sandbox and live collections?
content:
To use sandbox collections, first enable them from your main CMS page's advanced settings. In your editor, click CMS on the left side, click Your Collections, click Manage next to Your Collections, click More Actions at the top right, select Advanced Settings, and enable the Sandbox toggle.

To access and sync collections, go to the relevant collection in your editor. You can sync items from your sandbox to your live collection or vice versa. To sync sandbox items to live: select the items you want to sync, or skip selection to sync all items, click Sync content at the top right, select the relevant option, and click Sync to confirm. To access your live collection, click Live Collection at the top of the collection. You can then select items and sync them to your sandbox collection. Syncing can't be undone; new items get added to the live collection, and updated sandbox items overwrite the same items in the live collection, but items removed from sandbox are not removed from live content.

title: How can I display different blog posts on different pages of my Wix site?
content: Use the Post List element to display posts from a selected blog category on a specific page. First, set up your category in your site's dashboard under Categories, create a new category, and save it. Then assign blog posts to that category by going to Published in your dashboard, clicking Edit next to the post, clicking Categories, selecting the category under Assign a category, and clicking Publish. Next, go to your editor, select the page where you want the Post List to appear, click Add Elements, click Blog, click Post List, and select or drag the Post List to position it on the page. Finally, click the Post List in your editor, click Settings, click the Settings tab, select the category under Choose a category, and click Publish. You can also customize the design and layout of your Post List to match your site.

title: How can I add a performance tracker to my Fit by Wix site?
content: From the Wix app, you can add a performance tracker to your site on Fit by Wix. To do so: go to your site in the Wix app; tap **Manage** at the bottom; tap **Mobile App**; tap **Edit**; tap **Add Section**; tap the **Bookings** tab on the navigation menu at the top; scroll across the top menu and tap **Bookings**; scroll down and tap **My Performance Tracker**; select the **Section Title** toggle and tap to customize the name of your performance tracker; set the **Default weekly session goal** under display settings; tap the **Show total number of sessions** checkbox; optionally, enable the toggle under **Daily Activity** to allow members to connect the health-tracking app on their device to Fit by Wix; then tap **Add**. **Note:** Daily Activity is not available on the Branded App.

title: How can I cancel my Google Workspace business email renewal through Wix?
content: To stop your Google Workspace business email from renewing through Wix, turn off auto renewal for the business email in Premium Subscriptions. If you want to cancel the business email itself, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant business email, click Cancel business email, select the I still want to cancel checkbox, and click Cancel business email. After cancellation, you can still access the business email until the end of its subscription period. To avoid automatic renewal, turn off auto renewal before your next payment date.

title: How can I upgrade my existing Wix Premium plan to a plan with more features?
content:
To upgrade your plan:
- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you want to upgrade.
- Click Upgrade plan.
- Click Select under the new plan you wish to purchase.
- Choose the subscription period and click Continue to Checkout.
- Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase.

The upgrade takes effect immediately when you change your plan or billing cycle. If you upgrade before your next renewal date, you will receive a credit for the remaining time on your current plan.

title: Can I purchase multiple pricing plans together in a single checkout?
content: Currently, clients can purchase one pricing plan at a time. If a client wants to buy multiple pricing plans, they will need to go through separate checkouts for each plan. There is also an option to vote to let clients buy multiple products, services, and pricing plans in a single checkout.

title: How can I disconnect a domain from my site and leave it unassigned?
content: You can disconnect a domain from your site and assign it to a different site in your account or leave it unassigned. The source page explains how to disconnect a domain and leave it unassigned. If the domain is a Wix domain, you can also transfer the domain to another Wix account, transfer the domain to another domain host, or point the domain to an external site.

title: How can I change the channel displayed on my Wix Video player?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Wix Video player element. Click Settings. Click the Videos tab. Select Channel and choose your channel.

title: How can I add my VAT number to my Wix account to get a tax exemption in the UAE?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription. Click Update payment method. Select the subscriptions you wish to update and click Next. Click Edit Details. Re-enter your card details and add your VAT Number to the VAT ID field. Click Update. The exemption will apply from the next payment after that date.

title: How can I add an action card to a video I uploaded on Wix?
content: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant video to which you want to add a card. Click the Action Cards tab. Click the Select an Action Card drop-down and choose a goal. For Get Social Followers, add the relevant YouTube channel URL or Twitter page URL and click Connect. For Promote a Video, select whether to Always promote your latest video or Choose a video to promote, select the relevant video and channel if applicable, and click Save. For Feature a Channel, select the relevant channel and click Save. For Promote a Product, add a product description, select button text, paste the product URL, upload an image, and click Save. For Create a Custom Card, add a description, select button text, paste a URL, upload an image, and click Save. Important: You can only add action cards to videos you upload, not to videos added from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook.

title: How can I enable the sale of out-of-stock products using the Wix Mobile POS?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Scroll down to the Getting Paid section and tap Point of Sale. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right. Tap POS settings. Tap the Sell out of stock products drop-down and select an option: Allow, Allow with permissions, or Don't allow.

title: How can I add a dynamic list page for my Wix Stores product categories using the Wix Editor?
content: Before you begin, create multiple product categories in Wix Stores, add the CMS to your site, and enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.
