In your Editor, go to CMS, then Wix App Collections. Scroll to Stores, hover over Collections, click More Actions, click Add dynamic page, click List page, and click Add to Site. This creates a dynamic list page with a repeater partially connected to your Stores categories. Optionally, delete the repeater and add a Pro Gallery or table; for a gallery, use Manage Media, Select All, Delete, then Done.

title: What are the differences between selling images as 'Web Ready' and 'Original File' in Wix Art Store, and how does it affect pricing?
content:
In Wix Art Store, you can sell your images either as Web Ready, Original File, or both. You can set different prices for each option.

Web Ready: If you upload an image over 1200 pixels, Wix Art Store takes your image file and automatically creates a smaller version (the Web Ready file) which your customers can purchase. The Web Ready file has a slightly reduced quality and therefore can be sold at a lower price. These files are perfect for web use, and ideal if you are selling your images to be used online.

Original File: When purchasing your image through Wix Art Store, customers receive the original file that you upload. The Original File has no reduction in quality and can therefore be sold at a higher price. If you intend to sell images for print, it is recommended to upload images over 1200 pixels in order to retain the quality.

title: How can I stretch columns in a strip using the Wix Editor?
content: Click the strip that contains the columns in the Editor. Click the Stretch icon. Select an option: Screen stretches your strip to the full width of the screen. Page stretches your strip element to the page size, within the gridlines.

title: How can I delete an online program using the dashboard?
content:
To delete an online program using the dashboard:
- Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program.
- Choose Delete your program.
- Click Delete.
- Click Delete in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I get content suggestions for text boxes, buttons, images and shapes in Editor X?
content:
Get professional suggestions for text and visuals, tailor-made for your line of business. To get suggestions for your element:

- Select the relevant element: Text box, Button, Image, or Shape / Vector art.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top right.
- In the Inspector panel, click the Content icon.
- Use the search bar to find your business type (e.g., Fitness Instructor, Online Fashion Retailer, etc.).
- Review the suggestions and replace content on your page:
  - Images and vector art: click an image / vector art on the list to replace your current image.
  - Text boxes and buttons: click Use Text next to the text suggestion of your choice to replace your current text, or click the Copy icon to use this text elsewhere.

Tip: Use the drop-down menus to filter the results even further by categories and text types (e.g., Title, Paragraph, etc.).

As you're looking for image suggestions, you can also access your own uploads from the My Uploads tab: click an image to replace the current image on the page, or Show More at the bottom of the tab to load more of your files. You can also click + Upload Media to add new images to your Media Manager.

title: How does Wix ensure compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) for its users?
content: Wix worked with a team of experts and implemented the required adjustments to its products, services, and documentation to ensure compliance with the CCPA. This empowers Wix customers to get more control over their personal data and gain the tools necessary to protect the information of visitors to Wix sites. In accordance with the CCPA, site visitors have the right to access their data, to be permanently deleted from your databases, and to opt-out of the sale of their personal information. Wix developed three main tools to assist you in becoming CCPA compliant: right to access, right to be deleted, and right to opt-out of the sale of personal information.

title: How can I add a section to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Add a Section on the left side of the Editor, click a category, and then click your chosen section to add it to your page. Note: The panel may show section templates based on your site's business type (such as stores, blogs, etc.).

title: How can I set up a fulfillment service in my Wix store?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Shipping & fulfillment, scroll down, and click Add Fulfillment Service. You can use fulfillment apps that operate in your region, or manually add any person or service you want to work with. You can also set up a combination of fulfillment options, and add dropshipping products to your store, which are fulfilled by the supplier.

title: How can I set up free shipping for orders above a certain price in Wix Stores?
content: Set up a Flat Rate shipping rule, a Rate by Weight shipping rule, or a Rate by Product shipping rule. After setting your rates, click the "Offer Free Shipping on orders above a specific subtotal" checkbox. Enter the price above which shipping is free. If you set up additional shipping services (e.g. Express Shipping), select the checkbox and amount for each shipping service you create.

title: How do I add an event list to an existing page in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to the page where you want to add an event list. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Events. Drag the relevant Event list onto your page.

title: How can I issue a refund for a payment made through a supported payment provider on Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Payments, click the payment to refund, click Refund, enter the amount to refund and a note if needed, then click Refund. If the option to refund does not appear next to the relevant payment, issue the refund directly through your payment provider.

title: How can I download the Spaces App on my smartphone?
content: Go to the Apple App Store on iPhone or Google Play on Android. Type 'Spaces by Wix' in the Search field. Click Get or Install to download the app. You can also download the Spaces App to your phone using the direct download links.

title: How can I set how I manage inventory for a product in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Store Products in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant product or click New Product to add a new one. Scroll down to the Inventory & Shipping section. Select an option: Track inventory — click the Track Inventory toggle to enable it, enter the amount of the product in the Inventory field, and optionally enter an SKU or a weight. Do not track inventory — click the Track Inventory toggle to disable it, from the Status drop-down select In stock or Out of stock, optionally enter an SKU or a weight, and click Save. After setting up inventory in the Store Products tab, you can update inventory when necessary in the Inventory tab.

title: How can I duplicate a column in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the strip that contains the columns, click Manage Columns, click a column under Pick a column, and click the Duplicate icon. Duplicating a column copies its style and design to the new column, so you only need to edit the content.

title: Does Wix Editor support responsive sites?
content: Wix sites built in the Wix Editor are becoming more and more responsive as Wix continues to add full-width elements which expand to fill the entire width of the screen. Non-responsive elements (such as images, text and shapes) do not adjust based on screen width, which may cause differences in the way your page looks in different browsers or on different devices. If you are an agency or enterprise, you can build responsive sites using the Studio Editor in Wix Studio, which includes smart design capabilities and flexible dev tools.

title: How can I disable the Unfinished Payments feature in 2Checkout to prevent failed transactions on my Wix account?
content:
To disable Unfinished Payments in 2Checkout:
- Log in to your 2Checkout account in the Merchant Control Panel.
- Go to your Dashboard.
- Click Marketing tools.
- Click Lead Management.
- Click Manage your leads.
- Scroll down to Order recovery.
- Click Edit beside Unfinished payment.
- Click No under Enable order recovery follow-up.
- Click Update settings.

title: How can I dispute a chargeback in Wix Payments if I believe it to be unjustified?
content: If you believe a chargeback to be unjustified, we recommend you dispute it. A win will improve your chargeback ratio and you can recover the value of the payment, as well as the chargeback fee. To file a chargeback dispute, go to Payments in your site's dashboard, click the relevant payment to see its details, and click Dispute Chargeback under the chargeback's details. Select the product or service type of the transaction: Physical product, Digital Product, Service, Event ticket, or Other. Begin building your case by submitting a cover letter explaining your case and relevant evidence to verify your case. When ready, click Preview & Submit Dispute at the bottom. You can click Save Draft if you'd prefer to complete the form later.

title: Are vertical drag handles supported in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, vertical drag handles are not available in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can position multiple elements using drag and drop. Click and drag your cursor over the relevant elements, then drag them to your chosen position on the canvas.

title: How can I add a logo to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your site in the Wix Editor. Click Add Elements on the left menu. Select the Image tab. Select Custom Logo. If you've already created a logo with the Wix Logo Maker, it will be displayed here. Click Add Logo. Select the logo. Click Manage Brand. Add the relevant information, and select a design from the options available.

title: How can I change my notification email address in Wix Hotels?
content:
To change your email address in Wix Hotels:

- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab on the left.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Enter your email address in the Email Address text field in the Business Info section.
- Click Save.

Important: Make sure the email address being used is not already in use with Hotel Runner directly.

title: How can I integrate my Wix Store with Melhor Envio for shipping in Brazil?
content: Go to the left side of the Editor and click Add Apps. Start typing 'Melhor Envio' and select the app. Click Add to Site, then click Agree & Add. Choose to log in to your existing Melhor Envio account, or create a new Melhor Envio account by filling in the required fields and clicking Finish. Before you begin, make sure to enter your business address in the Business Info page. When you're ready to start printing shipping labels, go to the Melhor Envio dashboard and click Sync Orders.

title: How can I add a hyperlink to text in the Wix Editor and customize its appearance?
content:
To hyperlink text in the Wix Editor:
- Click the text box in your editor.
- Click the Link icon.
- Select the link type and enter the details.
- Choose whether your link opens in a new window or the current window.
- Click Done.

(Optional) To change the color of your hyperlinked text:
- Click Edit Text.
- Highlight the linked text.
- Click the Color icon.
- Select a color from the color picker.

Tip: To remove the hyperlink underline, highlight the linked text and click the Underline icon.

Note: You cannot link text that spans over 2 paragraphs if you separated those paragraphs using the Enter key. To resolve this, you can use Shift + Enter to create the line space instead of the Enter key.

title: How can I edit my profile and 'About' page on my Wix site?
content: On your live site, click the Login Bar. Click Profile. Click Edit to update your profile name and image. For Name, enter a profile name. For Image, click the avatar or image, browse to select a profile image, and click Open. Click Save. To edit the "About" section, enter text introducing yourself, and click either of the media icons to add images, GIFs, or Videos. Click Publish. You can share your About page on social media by clicking the Show More icon.

title: How can I change the cover image of a video in Wix Video?
content: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit icon next to the relevant video. Click Change cover under Cover Image. Select one of the suggested frames, or click the Add icon to upload an image. Click Set as Cover. If the upload fails, check your browser settings, try clearing cache and cookies, and check that your internet connection is working. You can also change the cover image of your single video player.

title: How can I add Wix Hotels to my site and what features does it offer?
content:
This information refers to the original Wix Hotels. To get started, add Wix Hotels to your site.

Wix Hotels is an all-in-one online booking system that helps you manage your hospitality business more effectively. Whether you operate a B&B, apartment, boutique hotel or vacation rental, you can manage all aspects of your business with Wix Hotels, and allow your guests to make reservations directly on your site.

With Wix Hotels you can:

* Take reservations 24/7: Never miss a booking with around-the-clock reservation capabilities.
* Accept online and offline payments: Offer your guests flexible payment options, both online and in person.
* Manage your room inventory: Keep track of your room availability with ease.
* Synchronize bookings with the Channel Manager: Ensure your bookings are always up-to-date across multiple platforms.
* Add up to 12 languages: Cater to international guests by supporting multiple languages.
* Set seasonal rates and extra charges: Optimize your pricing strategy with customizable seasonal rates and fees.
* Let guests book from anywhere - computer, tablet or smartphone: Provide a seamless booking experience on any device.

Please make sure that you have read the legal requirements for Wix features before adding Wix Hotels.

title: How can I generate the embed code for a Service Calendar widget in Dayful by Wix?
content: After creating your services on Dayful by Wix, go to Website Widgets in your Dayful dashboard. Click Embed under Service Calendar. Choose which service you'd like to display from the drop-down. Click Copy Code.

title: How can I remove 'lightbox' from the URLs of images in my Wix gallery?
content: To stop 'lightbox' appearing in image URLs, click the gallery in your editor, click the Settings icon, then click the 'When images are clicked' drop-down menu and select either 'Nothing happens' or 'A link opens.' Publish your site. The next time search engines crawl and index your page, they update the URLs they use for the images on the page. To try to speed this up, submit the page's URL to search engines. Note: this applies to older galleries in the Wix Editor only, not the Wix Pro Gallery.

title: How can I use text operators in Wix Automations to ensure a coupon is sent only when a specific form is submitted?
content: Text operators are used for comparing names, labels, etc., and best practice is to use them for properties that are text strings. In the source example, Drew creates an automation to send a coupon when a form is submitted. To ensure that a coupon is sent only when her Survey 2024 form is submitted, she adds a text operator condition specifying that survey.

title: How can I add an autocomplete address field to my Wix form?
content:
To add an autocomplete address field to your Wix form:

- Click your form in the editor.
- Click **Add New Field**.
- Click **Autocomplete Address** in **Contact Fields**.
- Click the autocomplete address field in the form and click **Edit Field**.
- Customize the autocomplete address field by updating the settings:
  - Click the **Field Title** textbox and enter the field name.
  - Under **Show initial text**, choose to add a hint or placeholder text inside the field:
    - **None:** No text appears inside the field.
    - **Placeholder text:** Text appears inside the field before visitors enter their info.
  - Click the **Required field** checkbox to make the autocomplete address field mandatory.
  - Choose to limit the autocomplete address search results to a specific country under **Search Preferences**:
    - **None:** The autocomplete address field does not limit its search to a specific country.
    - **Filter by country:** The autocomplete address field only searches addresses in a country that you choose. Click the **Choose a country** drop-down to select a country for the autocomplete address to use in its search.

**Note:** This feature is only available in old Wix Forms.

title: How can I show or hide elements in my Branded App based on the mobile operating system?
content:
To show or hide an element in your Branded App based on the mobile operating system:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Mobile App.
- Tap Edit.
- Tap the screen that includes the relevant section.
- Tap the Edit icon at the top right of the section.
- Tap Customize element.
- Scroll to the bottom and tap the drop-down under Visibility.
- Choose what device this element should show on: Android, iOS, or All.
- Tap Save.

title: How can I change the layout of my Wix Restaurants Orders app on mobile without affecting the desktop version?
content: Access the mobile Editor. Go to the page that includes the Order Online app. Click the Order Online app in the Editor. Click Settings. Click the Layout tab. Click the General tab. Customize the layout using these options: Menu description: A general description of your menu. Section image: Images for each section in your menu (e.g. appetizers, desserts, etc.). Section description: A description for each section in your menu. Alignment: Choose how to align the content: Left, Center, or Right. Section image height: Drag the slider to adjust the height of the section image on your menu.

title: How can I sell physical gift cards using the Wix Mobile POS?
content: The Wix POS solution for mobile phones is available only in the US and Canada. First order physical gift cards. In your site's dashboard, enable gift cards and select the option to let customers enter their own custom amount. Then, in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, scroll down to the Getting Paid section, and tap Point of Sale. Tap the Gift Cards tab and tap Issue a physical gift card. Choose a physical gift card, then scan the card's code or manually enter the card's code and tap Next. Select the gift card value or tap Custom Amount and enter the amount, tap Add to Cart, and complete checkout.

title: How can I change the time slots for appointments in Wix Bookings?
content: To change the time slots for appointments in Wix Bookings: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Appointment Time Slots. Select an option: Based on service duration — each appointment has its own time interval based on how long the service lasts, plus any time buffer you add to it; or Every ___ Minutes — select a time interval display from the drop-down, and the interval you choose applies to all appointments. You can also add a time buffer between appointments, so your staff have enough time to prepare for the next client.

title: How can I access my site's editor on Wix to make changes?
content: Sign in to the right account, go to your site's dashboard, and click Edit Site. If you're opening your editor for the first time, you might see Design Site instead of Edit Site. To edit a different site, click the Site drop-down at the top left of your site's dashboard to switch to another site and access the editor. Learn more about managing multiple sites in your account.

title: How do I access my behavior reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Behavior Reports section. Select the relevant report.

title: How can I transfer ownership of my .com.au domain purchased at Wix to another business?
content: Submit a request to Wix Customer Care with the title 'Transfer ownership of a .com.au domain'. This process has a non-refundable transfer ownership fee currently set to USD $12.50, paid before the transfer can occur and charged using PayPal; the fee includes a 1-year domain registration renewal for the new owner. The transferee must have an Australian business address. Wix Customer Care provides two forms: the 'Current Registrant (Transferor) Form' and the 'New Registrant (Transferee) Form'. The transferor fills in and signs the 'Current Registrant (Transferor) Form' with a declaration. The transferee fills in the 'New Registrant (Transferee) Form' and includes either their Australian Company Number (ACN), a 9-digit identifier number, or their Australian Business Number (ABN), an 11-digit number. The registrant name must match the 'Registrant' field on the domain's WHOIS listing. Print each form, make sure each form is signed by the relevant person, and upload legible images in PDF format of the signed documents to your Wix Customer Care ticket. Wix will contact you to confirm whether the transfer was successful or not; confirmation may take a number of days as Wix must rely on independent confirmation from a third party registrar. After a change of ownership, the domain begins a new registration period, and any remaining time on the original subscription will not carry over to the new subscription.

title: How can I set up an automation to send a welcome email when a new site member is approved?
content:
Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
Click + New Automation.
Click + Start from Scratch.
Click the title to give your automation a name.
Click Site Members in the Trigger section.
Select Member approved as the trigger.
Select your chosen action in the Action section and set it up using the available options.
Click the Timing section to expand it, then use the Choose a time to send this action drop-down to choose when the action is carried out.
Use the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency.
(Optional) Click + Add an Action at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
Click Activate to activate and save your new automation.

title: How can I customize the design of my Wix blog post page?
content: To customize the design of the post page, access the Blog Post page in your editor, click the Post page, click Settings, and click the Design tab. Then choose the element to design: Navigation, Text style and color, Ratings, Tags, or Background & Buttons, and adjust the available design settings described in the source. Note that if you hide certain elements, design options for that element do not appear. The changes you make to your Post page settings are applied to all your blog posts.

title: How can I create a branded app using Wix?
content: According to the overview, start creating your app for free by designing its theme, login and launch screens from your Wix account. You can download a free preview link of the app to your phone to see how it looks. Once you like the look of the design, update the content inside your app from the Wix mobile app. Finally, upgrade to a Branded App plan to connect an Apple Developer and Google Developer account and submit your app for approval. Once approved, your app will go live in Apple's App Store and Google Play.

title: How can I retrieve my Wix domain if it has entered the redemption period?
content: If your domain is registered at Wix and has entered the redemption period, you can retrieve it from the Domains page in your Wix account. Go to your Domains page and locate the relevant domain. Click Keep Domain within the redemption notification after reviewing the redemption fee information. Enter your payment details in the checkout, then click Submit Payment. Note: Retrieving your domain can take up to 7 days to complete. We'll notify you of any progress via the email associated with your Wix account.

title: How can I access the Brand Kit after purchasing a Wix Logo Maker plan?
content:
Purchasing a Social, Brand Plus, Unlimited, or Business Logo plan automatically includes a Brand Kit. There are two ways to access the Brand Kit, depending on the Logo Maker you're using:

- Logo Maker in your dashboard: Go to the Logo Maker in your site's dashboard, purchase the Brand Plus plan, and access the Brand Kit from there.
- Standalone Logo Maker: Purchase one of the plans from the standalone Logo Maker and access the Brand Kit from there. If you purchase the Logo + Online Presence plan (includes the Brand Kit), connect your purchased logo to an upgraded site to access the Brand Kit.

title: Can I limit event access to members with a specific pricing plan in Wix Events?
content:
Currently, you can create a membership plan using the Pricing Plans app. However, it is not possible to limit event access to members with a specific pricing plan only.

Alternatives to limit event access:
* Only allow site members to register for events.
* Password-protect event pages, requiring guests to enter a password to access them.

title: Is there a built-in feature in Wix to add a Twitter feed to my site?
content: Currently, Wix does not have an in-house Twitter feed app. You can manually embed your Twitter feed using the HTML element. Wix also offers other Twitter elements, such as the Twitter Follow button and Twitter Tweet button.

title: How can I link a button to a specific product page in Wix Stores using the Wix Editor?
content: To link a button to a specific product page in Wix Stores using the Wix Editor, go to your editor and go to the page where you want to add the button. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Button and drag a button onto the page. Click the button and select the Link icon. Then link the button to a specific product: select Page on the left, select Product Page from the Which page? drop-down, and select the product you want to link to from the Which item? drop-down. You can edit the button text and customize the design to suit your product and your site.

title: How can I test a live URL using the Google Search Console's URL Inspection Tool?
content: Open Google Search Console. Enter your site's domain in the search bar at the top and press Enter. Click Test Live URL on the right. The tool tests your page's URL to make sure it's accessible and working properly, checking for errors or warnings and whether Google is able to index it.

title: How can I add an embed or custom element to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add an embed or custom element to your mobile site, click Add on the left side of your mobile editor, click Embed Code, and click the relevant element to add it to your page: Embed HTML (enter code from external servers to display widget and apps on your mobile site), Embed a site (paste or type a URL to display external websites on your page), or Custom element (display whatever you would like on your site using snippets of code). Enter the relevant details for your widget. Elements added from the mobile editor are mobile-only and are not displayed on the desktop version of your site. If you are adding a custom element to your site, you must choose a source; you may also be able to add attributes to your element.

title: How can I delete the Menus by Wix Restaurants app from my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Menus by Wix Restaurants is a full-page app, so to delete the app you must delete the page itself from your site's Editor. In the Wix Editor, click the Pages icon on the left side of the Editor, click Main Pages, hover over the Menus page and click the More Actions icon, click Delete, then click Delete to confirm. Note: When you delete your Menus app, any menus and orders associated with it will be permanently deleted.

title: How do I add and set up a ratings display element in the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin: Add the CMS to your site or enable coding if you haven't already. Make sure you have a CMS collection that stores your ratings.

In the Wix Editor:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Input.
- Click Ratings.
- Click and drag the Ratings Input element of your choice onto the page.
- Click Settings on the ratings display element and click the relevant tab to choose what is shown when there are ratings and when there are no ratings. Under Ratings, you can enable Show the rating value, enable Show the number of ratings, and enter a Ratings text label (e.g. "Recommend it"). Under No Ratings, choose Nothing, Icons, or Placeholder text.
- Click the Layout icon to adjust the size, spacing, value placement, alignment and text direction.
- Click the Design icon to choose a preset design. Then click Customize Design to adjust the design further.

To connect the ratings display to the CMS:
- Click the ratings display element and click the Connect to CMS icon.
- Choose an existing dataset that connects to your collection, or select Add a Dataset, choose the collection, give the dataset a name, and click Create.
- Set Rating value connects to and Number of ratings connects to using the relevant Number fields.
- Click Dataset Settings, choose Read or Read & Write as the dataset mode, and set collection permissions if necessary. Click Save when done.

title: What does the 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed' message mean in Google Search Console, and what steps can I take if I want my page to be indexed?
content:
The 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed' message in Google Search Console means Google has crawled the page but chose not to index it. As a result, the URL won't appear in search results for the time being. This message does not mean there are errors in your page, and it is not necessary to resubmit the URL to be crawled and indexed. Depending on Google's decision, it may or may not be indexed in the future.

If you consider the page important to display in search results and the live test doesn't show any errors, you can try to request indexing. We recommend confirming that the page doesn't show any other errors/warnings by testing your live URL in Google's URL Inspection Tool.

Tip: Check our content quality guidelines to optimize your site's SEO.

title: How can I upload media from my computer to the Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click Upload Media. Under Your computer, drag and drop files into the Media Manager or click Upload from Computer. Select the files you want to upload. Click Open.

title: How can I add alt text to images in my Wix Blog to improve SEO?
content:
To add alt text to an image in your Wix Blog:
- Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant blog post, or click + Create New Post to write a new one.
- Add a new image or edit an existing one:
  - Add new image: Click Add on the left. Click Image. Add the image to the post. Click the image in the post.
  - Edit existing image: Click the relevant image in your post.
- Click the Settings icon on the toolbar.
- Enter an alt text description.
- Click Save.

title: How can I import my iZettle products to my Wix store?
content: Go to Wix and sign in to create a Wix account. Select a template. In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps, type iZettle in the search field, select the app, and click +Add. Then go to the Manage Apps tab, click Open next to Import from iZettle, click Connect Account, log in to your iZettle account, and click Start Import. After the import, click Manage Products to view the imported products in the Store Products tab. Note: iZettle has been temporarily removed from the App Market.

title: How can I check in guests to my event using the Wix app?
content: Use the Wix app to check guests in as they arrive. Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Events, tap Published Events, and tap the event you want to view. To change a guest's status to "Checked In": tap Guest List; optionally filter your guest list by tapping the Filter icon and selecting a status, a payment status, one or more ticket types, or a sort option, then tap Save; tap the checkmark next to a guest's name. To scan a guest's ticket: tap Guest List; optionally filter your guest list the same way; tap the QR icon at the top right; use your mobile device to scan the QR code that appears on the guest's ticket. Shortly before you leave for the event, while connected to the Internet, go to your guest list in the Wix app so you can access the list and check guests in even if you are offline during the event. Tip: You can also check in guests on desktop and on the Check-in by Wix app.

title: What steps can I take to prevent email throttling in my email marketing campaigns?
content: Maintain and update your contact list regularly, and follow email marketing best practices such as getting explicit consent from every recipient, not including any suspicious or prohibited content, and cleaning your list every six months to make sure all email addresses are still valid.

title: How can I mark a notification as "Read" or "Unread" in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the Notifications icon at the top right of the editor, hover over the relevant notification, click the More Options icon, and then click Mark as Read / Unread. When you have finished handling your notifications, you can click Mark All as Read at the top to dismiss them all at once.

title: Is PayU supported as a payment provider in countries other than Turkey, Poland, and Colombia?
content: Currently, you can connect your site to PayU in Turkey, Poland or Colombia if your business operates in the relevant country. However, PayU is not available as a payment provider in other locations. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through PayU and arrange the payment offline.

title: How do I cancel my Wix domain?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain. Click Cancel domain. Select Cancel auto renew and click Submit. This turns off the auto renew feature, so you'll still own your domain until the end of the subscription period after you cancel. Wix domain purchases are non-refundable and do not include a 14 day trial period. Your site plan and domain are separate services, so if you want to cancel your Premium or Studio plan, you'll need to do that separately.

title: Is the fade out feature for text elements supported in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix does not support the fade out feature on text elements. As an alternative, you can create a similar effect by splitting your text and applying animation to each element at different time intervals. To add animation to your text, select a text element in your Editor, click the Animation icon, select an effect, and click Customize to adjust the time settings (e.g. duration and delay). Repeat for each text field you want to animate.

title: How can I customize a decorative line in the Wix Editor to match my site's design?
content: Click the line in your Editor. Click the Design icon. Click Customize Design. Select a line design at the top. Under Border, set the line color and width. Note: Different line designs have different customization options.

title: How can I import my blog posts from WordPress to Wix using a site URL?
content: To import blog posts from WordPress to Wix using a site URL, go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Click More Actions, select Import posts, select WordPress, and choose By using a site URL. Click Next, then Get Started. Enter the URL of the blog you want to import posts from and click Next. Check the box to confirm that you own or are licensed to use the posts in this blog, then click Yes, Import Posts. Click Got It after your posts finish importing.

title: How can I manually create an invoice for a mobile POS sale using Wix?
content: To manually create an invoice for a mobile POS sale, complete the POS sale, then go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard and select the relevant order. Click More Actions, select Create Invoice, and confirm by selecting Create Invoice again. To send it, click Send via Email, or click More Actions to copy a link or print the invoice.

title: What types of images can I edit using the Wix Photo Studio, and are there any restrictions?
content: You can only edit images that you have uploaded, created using the AI Image Creator, or images from Unsplash. Shutterstock images can be edited, but not downloaded after editing. It's against the Wix Terms of Use to edit Free Wix Images. You can edit .jpg, .png, and .gif images up to 25 MB in the Wix Photo Studio. You can only upload one image at a time to the Wix Photo Studio.

title: How can I add a link to a button in the Wix Editor?
content: Click the button in your editor. Click the Link icon. Select a link type. Add the relevant link information. Click Done. Once you have added your link, test that it is working in Preview mode. If it is not working, check the button troubleshooter. If your URL link contains an unsupported character, the error message "Check the URL and try again" is displayed; to bypass the validation, use a link shortening service.

title: Can I customize the email address notifications are sent from in Wix Bookings?
content: You can now customize the email address you send email notifications from.

title: How can I share a product from my Wix Store using the Wix App?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Store Products, or tap Catalog and select Store Products. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant product. Select Share. Select any of the share options available on your mobile device.

title: How can I change my payment provider to accept credit card payments on Wix?
content: To change to a different payment provider on Wix, go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Wix Payments, or click See More Payment Options. If you do not see your preferred provider, click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect beside the provider you want to change to, then click Yes, Switch to confirm. To connect your account, click Connect Existing Account and follow the steps if you have an account, or click Create an Account and follow the steps if you do not.

title: How can I set up notifications for form submissions on my Wix site so that I and my site collaborators are notified?
content: Click the relevant form in ADI. Click **Edit** next to **Form** on the left. Click **Form Settings** at the bottom. Click **Set Notifications** under **Email Notifications**. Choose how you want to be notified. The **Inbox, email & mobile app** option is recommended because all conversations from the form submission are saved in Wix Inbox for all collaborators to see and respond to. Select **Inbox, email & mobile app**. Click the **Choose collaborators from the list** drop-down and select a collaborator to notify when someone submits this form. You can also click **Add Collaborator** to create a new site collaborator. Optionally, click the drop-down again to add another collaborator. Before you begin, site collaborators need Wix Inbox permissions before they can get notified about form submissions; go to Roles & Permissions in your dashboard and add Wix Inbox permissions to the relevant collaborator. If you don't see the collaborator you're looking for, they might not have Wix Inbox permissions. Click **Manage Roles** next to the drop-down to edit their permissions.

title: How can I manually dock an element in Editor X?
content:
To manually dock an element in Editor X, follow these steps:

- Click the relevant element.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
- Scroll down to Position.
- Click the relevant docking points (top, bottom, right or left). You can also click the Align to center icon.

Tip: It's usually a good idea to dock your elements to the top of the container, section or grid cell that they are in. This ensures that there is always a defined space between the element and the container/section when more content is added to your page.

title: How can I create an inactive category in Wix Stores to use for coupons and discounts?
content: Yes. Create a category, add all the products you want to discount, click the Active on your site toggle to disable it, then create the coupon or discount and apply it to this category.

title: How can I edit the text on my Pricing Plans page using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Go to your Plans & Pricing page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click your Plans & Pricing page. Click the Plans & Pricing element on your page. Click Settings. Click the Text tab on the left. Edit the following text:

- Page title: The title that appears above the plans.
- Page subtitle: The subtitle that appears above the plans. Here you can add more details or highlight newer plans, for example.
- Button: The button clients click to select a plan.
- Button (with free trial): The button clients click to select a recurring membership plan that has a free trial.
- Ribbon: The "Best Value" ribbon on the highlighted plan (if a plan is highlighted).

Note: It is not possible to edit button text separately for different plans.

title: How can I mark items as 'Received' in a Wix Stores purchase order and update the inventory?
content: Go to Purchase Orders in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant order and select Receive inventory. Select the checkbox next to the product(s) you want to update and click Mark as Received. The entire amount ordered is marked as received. You can also manually enter the number of items received. When you're done making changes, click Update Inventory. If you ordered custom products, make sure to edit the new products (for example, add an image or edit the price). Products added via Update Inventory are hidden from your site, so make sure to unhide them when you're ready.

title: How can I add upload fields to my product pages using the Uploadly - File Upload app by Inspon?
content: Use the Uploadly - File Upload app by Inspon. To use this integration on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. The app lets you add upload fields to your product pages, receive files with your orders, create unlimited upload fields and add them to your products, customize your upload button to match your site, and let customers upload photos, images and files from their computer or mobile device. You can also let customers edit their images before they submit them. The app is only available in English.

title: Can I translate the Wix Loyalty Program using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Loyalty Program with Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I use PayPal to pay for Wix services?
content: You can choose to pay for all your Wix services using PayPal, such as plans, domains, and business emails. At checkout, select the PayPal option. You will then be redirected to the PayPal website to finish your purchase, and when completed, you will be brought back to your Wix account. You need to have a PayPal account to use their service. If you do not have an account yet, the option to create one appears right after selecting the PayPal option. Note that this feature may not yet be available in all regions.

title: How can I link an element to a gallery image in Wix Editor?
content: First, publish your site, because you can't retrieve the image URL from inside the Editor. Open your live site, go to the page with the relevant gallery, click the chosen image to expand it, and copy the image URL from the browser bar. Then open the Wix Editor, click the relevant element, and click the Link icon. Choose Web Address from the panel menu, paste the copied image URL into the web address field, and optionally choose whether the image opens in the same or a new window. You can also optionally choose the link rel attribute under Advanced SEO Settings. Click Done, then publish your changes to see the link in action.

title: How can I create a membership plan for an event in Wix Events?
content: Start by creating a new ticketed event or selecting an existing one, and make sure you have created at least one type of ticket for the event. In your site's dashboard, go to Events, select a ticketed event, click the Tickets tab, and click Edit next to Memberships. Click Create Membership and Get Started. The Pricing Plans app is added to your site, and a page displaying your membership plans is added. Enter the plan name, optionally enter a short description, and enter each plan benefit. You can optionally connect the plan to other events or other services your site offers; the event you are editing is automatically connected to the plan. Enter the discount amount next to each event and the maximum number of tickets a guest can apply the discount to. Select a pricing option: Free Plan, One-time Payment, or Recurring Payments. Configure the relevant fields such as Length of Plan, Payment Frequency, and optionally Enable Free Trial. You can optionally make the plan promotional so clients can buy it only once, allow plan cancellation, let people set the start date, add a policy, and collect additional info at checkout. You can also customize a Thank you page. Click Save.

title: How can I receive notifications for reservations made through Wix Hotels?
content:
When a guest makes a reservation on your site, you receive notifications in 2 ways:

* Email: You receive an email with the reservation details.
* Wix app: You receive notifications on your mobile device with the Wix app.

title: How can I arrange elements using the Editor toolbar?
content: Click the element, click the Arrange icon on the toolbar, and select an option: Move forward moves the element forward one layer; Move backward moves the element backward one layer; Bring to front moves the element to the top layer; Send to back moves the element to the bottom layer. You can also arrange elements using the right-click menu.

title: How can I export my guest list for an event using Wix Events?
content: To export your guest list for an event in Wix Events: go to Events in your site's dashboard; hover over the relevant event and click Manage; click the Guests tab; click the Export Guests icon; save the file to your computer. In Chrome, the .csv file downloads and appears on the bottom of your screen. In Firefox, select Open with to open or Save File to save. In Internet Explorer, click Save at the bottom of your screen. In Safari, the file opens; click cmd + s on your keyboard to save the file (with a .csv extension, and Page Source format). Tip: You can view all answers to custom registration questions on one page by exporting the guest list.

title: Can I filter by a particular date using dataset filters in the CMS?
content: Currently, in the CMS (Content Management System) you cannot filter by a particular date using the dataset filters. For example, to only include items with a date field that is today's date. However, you can schedule items in a collection to be visible or hidden.

title: How can I limit my Wix blog to only paying members using the Wix Editor?
content:
To limit your Wix blog to paying members using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Blog Pages**.
- Hover over the **Post** page and click the **More Actions** icon.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Permissions** tab.
- Select **Members only**.
- Select **Only selected members or paying customers**.
- Click the **Edit** icon under **Select from your Pricing Plans**.
- Select which pricing plans should have access and click **Apply**.

(Optional) You can also limit access to the blog and category feeds by repeating the steps above, selecting the **My Blog** page in place of the **Post** page.

title: I have not received my payout in my bank account yet.
content:
If you have not received your payout in your bank account, check these items in your Wix Payments account:

- Ensure your Wix Payments account is successfully verified and Active.
- Confirm the bank details registered for your Wix Payments account are correct and that the bank account holder's name matches the name of the Wix Payments account owner.
- Verify with your bank that your account can receive EFT payments; if you are located in the United States, payouts are sent as ACH transfers.
- Confirm your payout schedule (daily, weekly or monthly) and note that a sent payout should arrive in your bank account within 3 - 5 business days.
- Check your Payouts dashboard for a Failed payout; a failed payout is placed On Hold until the issue is identified and resolved. Click the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see known details and instructions, and click Payouts on Hold to see the amount on hold.

More information on failed payouts is available at https://support.wix.com/en/article/failed-payout-in-wix-payments.

title: How can I claim and add/upgrade a participating third-party app for a free one-year subscription after purchasing a Premium plan?
content: After purchasing or upgrading to a participating yearly Premium plan, go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click Claim App next to the relevant app, click Claim App, click Allow and Add, click Upgrade this app in the top right, click Select, and review the details then click Submit Purchase. The value of any qualifying app purchase will show as 0.00, as you are receiving a free one-year subscription. Note: This promotion is not available for all Premium plans.

title: How can I resize my SVG logo files without losing quality?
content: SVG files can be resized without any quality loss. You can use such software as Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop to resize your files. If you don't have access to this software, you can use a free online alternative like iloveimg.com.

title: Can I trigger automations on my contacts' birthdays?
content: Yes, you can create automations that trigger on your contacts' birthdays. To do this, you first need to create a contacts segment that groups contacts by birthday. Then, create an automation using the Segments trigger set to trigger when a contact enters your birthday segment.

title: Can I use Redeban as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Redeban as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Redeban and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I manage notification preferences for specific sites in my Wix Studio workspace?
content: To manage notification preferences for specific sites in your Wix Studio workspace, go to Notification Preferences in your Wix Studio workspace. Click Manage next to the relevant site. In the Dashboard tab, choose which dashboard notifications to enable for this site. Click the Email tab and choose which email notifications to enable. Click Apply to save your changes. Tip: You can also click the Notifications icon at the top right of your workspace, and then Preferences, to quickly access and adjust your site notification settings.

title: How can I customize the Google Maps settings for my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the mobile editor, click the Google Map, then click the Settings icon. Drag the slider under Zoom to adjust the zoom of the map. Click the toggles to enable or disable these options: Show map and satellite views, Show zoom control, Show Street View control, Show Directions link, and Allow dragging. The source explains that visitors can switch between map and satellite views, zoom in and out on the map, use Google Street View, be directed to the location from where they currently are, and move around the map by clicking and dragging.

title: How can I manually add a pricing plan for a client who purchased it offline using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right. Tap Sell a pricing plan. Select an existing client or add a new one: to select an existing client, tap to select an existing client; to add a new client, tap + Add New Contact at the bottom, enter the new contact's details, and tap Save. Select a plan and tap Next. Optionally, tap the date next to Valid from to edit the start date. Tap Collect Payment. Select Mark as paid / Mark as unpaid and tap Next. Tap Confirm in the pop-up.

title: How can I add a button in Editor X and what are the differences between basic and styled buttons?
content: To add a button in Editor X, click Add on the top left of Editor X, click Button, then scroll through the designs and drag a Basic Button or Styled Button onto your page. Basic Buttons only display text and have a more "minimal" look. Styled Buttons can display both text and icons, and offer advanced customization options such as image backgrounds and color gradients. Styled Buttons do not support copying the button's design to another element or getting content suggestions for the button text. In smaller screen sizes, Basic Buttons auto-wrap the text, while Styled Buttons display an ellipsis.

title: 产品本身没有差异化时，AI 文案是否适合直接用来生成五点描述？
content: 不通过。按 Listing 生成的边界条件第 1 条：产品本身没有差异化时，文案只能讲清已有卖点，应回到选品而不是改五点描述。结论：不属于适合直接用 AI 生成的情况，属于适合但需先补足前置条件，前置条件是先解决产品差异化问题、回到选品环节，而不是靠文案突破。

title: How can I customize the signup form for my client's site using the Studio Editor?
content: Make sure your client's site includes the Members Area app. Click Pages on the left side of the Editor, hover over Signup (Default) and click the More Actions icon, click Settings, select Custom Form under Which member signup form do your visitors see?, and click Add to Site to start customizing. Select the form on the canvas, then customize it by managing the form, designing the form from the Inspector panel, or adjusting the form settings. You can add any element you need (e.g., image, text, etc.) around the custom signup form. Currently, it is not possible to add social login buttons (e.g. Facebook, Google) to the custom signup form; they are only available on the default signup form.

title: How can I connect SumUp as a payment provider for online payments on my Wix site?
content:
To connect SumUp for online payments on your Wix site:

- Open Accept Payments on your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to SumUp.
- If you have an account, enter your API Key and click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create SumUp account and follow the steps to create an account. Return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your SumUp account.

title: Amazon广告的出价调整有哪些硬性限制和推荐策略？
content: 动态竞价的允许值为 down_only 或 up_and_down。单次调价幅度需 <= 20%。新品 Week 1 可按 1.2x suggested bid 起步；日常出价可设在 80%..100% of suggested bid，新品可用 120%。ACOS < target -> +10..20%；ACOS > 1.5x target -> -10..20%。

title: How can I view my payouts from Wix Payments?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Payouts. You can optionally click a payout to see more details about that payout. Even if your Wix Payments account has been disconnected, you can still access your Wix Payments dashboard.

title: How can I invite people to join my site using the Wix app?
content:
To invite people from the Wix app on your mobile device: Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App, and tap Invite new members. Choose a method: Email Wix Contacts, Send an SMS, or Share via social networks.

Email Wix Contacts: Tap the available email provider (e.g. Gmail). Customize your email: use To to choose all contacts or manually select contacts; enter a Title; write a Message. Tap Send.

Send an SMS: Tap Send an SMS, select the contacts you want to invite, and tap Send in the message field on your phone.

Share via social networks: Choose how to send your invite (e.g. Facebook, WhatsApp, or Gmail), then tap Send.

Tip: Turn your visitors into engaged members by adding an invite banner to the mobile version of your site.

title: How can I create a special offer in my Wix Art Store?
content:
To create a special offer in your Wix Art Store:

- Click **Settings** on your Art Store.
- Click **Manage Store**.
- Click **Special Offers**.
- Click **Create Special Offer**.

**Notes:**
- This feature is only available if you are selling digital and print images.
- If there is no promotion currently available, the button will appear as gray and non-clickable.
- The discount amount is set by Order a Print and varies depending on the time of the year. Click here to learn more.

title: Can I enable or disable the delivery option in online orders in the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app?
content: Yes, it is now possible to enable or disable the option for delivery in online orders. This feature is also available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How do I disconnect a payment provider?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant payment provider. Click Disconnect. To remove it temporarily instead, disable the Accepting payments toggle; the status changes to Not accepting payments.

title: How can I assign a Gemini license to a business email user in Google Workspace?
content: Go to Business Email and Add-ons from your site dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the user you want to assign the license to, then click Assign License.

title: How do I refund a customer through Wix?
content: If your payment provider supports refunds made through Wix, go to Payments, click the payment you wish to refund, click Refund, enter the amount to refund and a note if needed, then click Refund. If the refund option is not available, contact your payment provider directly to issue a refund.

title: How can I add custom functionality and interactions to my Wix site using Velo by Wix?
content: Use Velo by Wix to add JavaScript code to a Wix site and work with Wix's APIs to add custom functionality and interactions. Add CSS to customize the site's look and feel. Velo also provides a full server-side runtime system based on Node.js, and you can export functions from the backend to the client-side using web methods. Write your code in the Wix Editor, the VS-Code based Wix IDE, or integrate your site with GitHub and use your own tools.

title: How can I manually mark an order as 'Paid' in Wix Stores?
content:
To manually mark an order as 'Paid' in Wix Stores:
- Go to Orders in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant unpaid order.
- Click the Collect Payment drop-down and select Mark as Paid.
- Optional: Select a custom amount (i.e. accept partial payment):
  - Select the Mark a custom amount as paid checkbox.
  - Enter the amount.
  - Note: Must be less than the order total.
- Click Mark as Paid to confirm.

Note: This cannot be undone.

title: How can I remove the gap above the footer on my Wix mobile site?
content: Go to the mobile editor. Adjust and remove any spacing you find. Scroll to the bottom of the page. Click the page body. Double-click on the page height handle to remove any gaps between the header and footer. Publish your site. If the above steps do not resolve the issue, please contact our support team and we will be happy to assist you.

title: How can an admin reset a user's password in Google Workspace?
content: To reset a user's password, sign in to your Google Admin account. Click Password, then Reset Password. Choose to automatically generate the password or enter a password. Optionally, preview the password, require the user to change the password at the next sign-in, copy the password, or email the password to the user. Click Reset.

title: How can I verify my domain with Yandex using a meta tag on my Wix site?
content: Get a meta tag from your Yandex.Webmaster account: log in, click Get Started, click Add, enter your website URL, click Add to, copy your meta tag, and leave the Yandex screen open. Then add the meta tag to your Wix site: in a new tab, go to your SEO Dashboard, select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings, click Yandex to expand, enter the meta tag, and click Save. Finally, go back to Yandex Webmaster and click Check.

title: How can I connect Pagopar as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Pagopar as a payment provider on your Wix site, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Then click Connect next to Pagopar.

If you already have a Pagopar account, enter your Clave pública and Clave privada, then click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create Pagopar account, fill in the registration form, and wait for a message from Pagopar to get your Clave pública and Clave privada credentials. Then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Note: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Pagopar account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined.

title: How can I check my site's global availability using the Uptime & Security dashboard?
content: You can run an availability test every 24 hours to find out if your site is available globally. Your results display in a world map, with a status message. Click the dots in the world map to learn where your site is live. Access Uptime & Security from Site & Mobile App in your site's dashboard.

title: Can I add a signature field to a form using the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. You can now add a signature field to a form, allowing visitors to electronically sign forms on your client's site.

title: Can I change the two-letter language abbreviation in Wix Multilingual?
content: The two-letter language abbreviations (e.g. EN for English) are based on a standard. It is not possible to change the abbreviations used.

title: How can I reschedule an event using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant event. Click Edit Details. Select an option: change to a specific date or time by clicking the Start date / End date field and selecting the relevant dates from the calendar, then clicking the Start time / End time drop-down and selecting the relevant times; optionally click Add End Time and select the end time. Alternatively, set the event date as to be determined by selecting the To Be Decided (TBD) checkbox and optionally editing the default note in the Display a message field. Click Save. After saving, a pop-up appears at the bottom of the Overview tab confirming your changes and prompting you to notify guests. To notify guests, click Notify Guests in the pop-up, then click Continue to customize a template with the relevant information to send to your guests.

title: How can I connect a domain purchased from Wix to my upgraded site?
content:
In your Wix account, go to the Domains page and assign your domain to the site you want to connect. Important: You must upgrade your site with a plan before you can assign a domain to it.

If the domain is currently assigned to a different site:
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Click Assign to a different Site.
- Select the site you want to connect and click Next.
- If the site you're connecting is currently connected to a different domain, choose either Redirect it to the primary domain or Replace the current primary domain.
- Click Assign.

If the domain is not currently assigned to a site:
- Click Assign below the domain you want to connect.
- Select the site you want to connect and click Next.
- If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose either Redirect it to the primary domain or Replace the current primary domain.
- Click Assign.

title: How can I set up a default booking form in Wix Bookings?
content: To set up your default Booking Form, go to Booking Form in your site's dashboard. Give your default Booking Form a title, and then click the Confirm icon. (Optional) Add a subtitle with more details or instructions for filling out the form, if required. Choose how you want clients to enter their name on the form by hovering over First Name or Last Name, then click the Split icon to split the name fields into first and last name and click the Confirm icon, or click the Combine icon to combine first and last name in the one field and click the Confirm icon. Click the Edit icon on any of the remaining fields on the form to edit their text label, and then click the Confirm icon. Select the Make this a required field checkbox to make specific details mandatory before booking. (Optional) Click + Add custom field if you require any additional information from clients before they can book your services, and then click the Confirm icon. Click Save Form.

title: How can I stay updated on the latest Wix feature updates and releases?
content: To learn more about Wix's latest updates and releases, click the link in the Wix Feature Updates article. You can also view and vote for any of the existing Feature Request articles on the Product Roadmap, and join the Wix New Features Facebook group to receive more notifications.

title: Can I apply text scaling to button text in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the Scale Text option isn't available for text appearing on buttons. When formatting a text element, you can make it responsive to different screen sizes by applying the Scale Text option.

title: How can I change the permissions for a collection in the CMS to allow only site members to add content?
content:
Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, click CMS in your editor, then click Your Collections.

Hover over the relevant collection, click the More Actions icon, and select Permissions & privacy.

Click Collect content.

Click the Who can add content to this collection? drop-down and choose Members only.

Click Save.

This means only site members can add content to the collection from the live site.

title: How can I set permissions for who can download media from my Shared Gallery app?
content:
In your Editor, select the Shared Gallery app, click Settings, click the Settings tab, then click Set Gallery Permissions. Choose who can download media:

* No one: Downloading media from your shared gallery is not possible.
* Everyone: Everyone who visits your shared gallery can download media.
* Members only: Just site members can download media from your shared gallery. This is the default setting.

title: How can I manage my portfolio integrations on Wix after connecting to Instagram, Google Photos, DeviantArt or Dribbble?
content: After connecting your portfolio to Instagram, Google Photos, DeviantArt or Dribbble, go to Portfolio in your site's dashboard. Click the Integrations tab on the left, then click Manage next to the relevant integration. To sync projects: click Manage next to the relevant integration, then click Sync next to the relevant project; your project's status appears as Synced once it's updated. To manage projects: click Manage Project next to the project you wish to manage, update your project details, and click Save & Close on the top right. You must sync the project to your portfolio before you can manage it. To remove a project from your portfolio: click the More Actions icon next to the relevant project, then click Remove from portfolio. You must sync the project to your portfolio before you can remove it.

title: How can I add a track to the Wix Audio Player on my website?
content: Click your Wix Audio Player in your Editor. Click Change Track. Under Choose audio from: select an option. For My Uploads, click Upload Track and select a track from your Media Manager or upload a new one from your computer. For External MP3, enter the URL of a track.

title: Can I display a banner in the Wix Member Apps to advertise a sale or make an announcement?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a banner (e.g. advertising a sale or making an announcement) in your Member Apps. As a workaround, you can add an image to your app and link it to the relevant screen or URL.

title: How do I access my accounting reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Accounting Reports section. Select the relevant report.

title: Can I search for product variants by SKU in the Desktop POS system?
content: Currently, when using POS Checkout to sell products on your desktop computer, you cannot search for product variants when each variant has its own SKU.

title: How can I edit an existing logo in the Wix Logo Maker before downloading it?
content: Go to the Wix Logo Maker. You will be taken to the Brand Studio of the most recent brand you were working on. Click the Logo and Brands drop-down at the top, select the relevant brand, click Edit Logo, and customize your logo using the available options in the Logo Maker. Before you begin, always close all Logo Maker tabs after finishing your edits. Leaving it open elsewhere may cause you to save the wrong version of your logo and you may lose the edits made or purchase the wrong version.

title: How can I add a custom element to my Editor X site and set it up with a server URL or Velo file?
content: Before you begin, make sure your site has a Premium Plan and a connected domain with no Editor X ads. To add and set up a custom element: open the Add panel at the top of Editor X, click Embed & Social, and drag the Custom Element onto your page. Then select the custom element, click Choose Source, and choose how to add your script: Server URL — enter the URL including the file name; or Velo file — select one of your Velo files. Enter a Tag Name for your element. Note: the tag name should be at least two words long, separated by a dash (e.g., big-weather-widget). For security reasons, the custom element is rendered inside an iFrame inside the Editor and in preview mode; go to your published site to see how it looks live. Use the Inspector panel to adjust sizing, docking, alignment and more across breakpoints. You can define your element's SEO settings using Velo API.

title: Can I filter content by translation status in the Translation Manager?
content: Yes. You can now filter content by translation status in the Translation Manager.

title: How can I create and send an email marketing campaign using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Marketing and select Email Marketing. Tap the campaign you want to edit or tap Create New Campaign. Customize the campaign using the available options: tap Background to update the background color; tap the Add icon and choose an element to add to your email; tap Preview & Test to see how your email looks on mobile; to send a test email, tap Preview & Test, tap Send Test at the top right, enter an email address that should receive the test email under Send To, and tap Send at the top right. When you are finished creating your campaign, tap Next at the top left. To send to contacts, tap Send to Contacts, tap Add next to Recipients to add contacts or email addresses who will receive the email marketing campaign, optionally edit email details such as subject line and From Name, and tap Send Campaign. To publish on social, tap Publish on Social, tap Share Now, choose a social app and follow the instructions to share on that platform. If you decide you are not ready to send the campaign, it is automatically saved in your Drafts tab.

title: Can Admin (Co-Owner) and Payments Admin roles access the Tax Documents page in Wix Payments?
content: Yes. Additional roles can now be assigned to view the Tax Documents page in your Wix Payments account. These roles are Admin (Co-Owner) and Payments Admin.

title: How can I delete links from my Instagram Feed posts using the Wix Instagram Feed app on my desktop?
content: Click the Instagram feed app in your Editor, click Manage Links, select the relevant post, click the More Actions icon on the relevant link, click Delete, click Yes, Delete, then click Done.

title: Is there an Infusionsoft app available in Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have an Infusionsoft app available. To create and send stunning email newsletters, check out Email Marketing.

title: How can I extend the duration of a membership plan using my site's dashboard?
content: Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant subscription. Click Manage Subscription. Select Extend subscription. Click the date and select a new end date for the plan. Click Save. Note: When you extend a plan, no additional money is collected. You cannot edit an expired plan. You cannot edit a recurring plan.

title: Can I use PayPal to purchase a Wix Premium Service?
content: It is now possible to pay for Wix Premium Services using PayPal. You need to register for a PayPal account to do so. Important: This feature may not yet be available in all regions.

title: How can I create a member badge in the Wix Shared Gallery App?
content: To create your first badge, go to the Site Member tab in your dashboard and click More Actions at the top right.

title: How do I cancel my Wix Premium or Studio plan?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Cancel Plan, and click Cancel Now to confirm. This does not cancel your plan immediately; it remains active until the end of the current subscription period. Canceling your site plan does not cancel any domain, business email, or app subscriptions—you must cancel those separately.

title: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Wix site plan?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, then click Cancel Plan. Click Cancel Now, and confirm cancellation by clicking Cancel Now after providing your feedback. For yearly and multi-year plans, Wix will attempt to process your renewal payment 14 days before the plan's expiration date. Wix sends reminder emails starting 30 days before your payment is due. If you do not want your plan to renew, you must turn off auto renewal before your next payment date. You can see the exact date in the Next payment due section of Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.

title: How can I claim and apply a voucher after upgrading to a yearly or multi-year site plan?
content: To claim a voucher, go to Premium Vouchers in your Wix account, then click Claim Voucher or Get Your Domain next to the voucher you want to claim. To apply a voucher, go to Premium Vouchers in your Wix account, click Go to (Company) under Claimed next to the voucher you want to apply, and follow the on-screen instructions to redeem it. Make sure to apply your voucher by the Valid until date listed on the voucher.

title: How can I add an explicit consent checkbox to my Wix Form?
content: To add an explicit consent checkbox to your Wix Form: Click the form in your editor, click **Edit Form**, then under **Add form fields** click **Checkbox**. Click the checkbox and edit the **Add a Field message** text, for example “I accept the terms & conditions”. Use **Add a Link** to edit the link text and click the **Link** icon to choose your Terms of Use link page. Enable the **Required** toggle if visitors must give explicit consent before clicking **Submit**. To change how your form looks, click the form and go to **Settings**, then use the **Layout** and **Design** icons.

title: Can I send confirmation emails from my own email address when someone RSVPs to my event on Wix?
content: Currently, confirmation emails sent to guests who RSVP your event are sent from notifications@wixevents.com. Sending a confirmation email from your own email address is not supported. Workaround: You can create an automated email that is sent whenever a visitor RSVPs for an event. You can set this automated email to be sent from your own email address. Note that for RSVP events, you can deactivate the regular confirmation email so guests won't get 2 messages.

title: Can I add a widget inside a repeater in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to add and use widgets inside repeaters when building an app in the Blocks editor. However, you can add one widget inside another in the Blocks editor for reusability. For example, you can create one 'button' widget and then use it inside other widgets in your app. Learn how to create a widget within a widget.

title: How can I hyperlink text to dynamic pages using the Wix Editor?
content:
To hyperlink text to dynamic pages using the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the relevant text element and click Edit Text.
- Highlight the specific text you want to link.
- Click the Link icon.
- Click the Which page? drop-down and select the relevant page under Dynamic pages.
Tip: Your editor names dynamic list pages as {Collection name} (List) and dynamic item pages as {Collection name} (Item).
- (Dynamic item pages only) Click the Which item? drop-down and choose the item you want to link to.
- (Optional) Set rel link attributes to give search engines more info about the link: click Advanced SEO Settings, click the drop-down, and choose rel values such as noopener (recommended), noreferrer (recommended), nofollow, and sponsored.
- Click Done.
Tip: To link to a section or anchor on your dynamic page, select Section or anchor, then follow the page/item steps and select the section or anchor from the Where on the page? drop-down.

title: Can I use the free Wix media images on websites outside of Wix?
content: Free Wix images are available for digital use within Wix only. For more information, see the Wix Terms of Use.

title: Can I change the date and time format on my live Wix Bookings site?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to change the date and time format on a live site in Wix Bookings.

Tip: The day which is used as the first calendar day is determined by the business location you entered in your regional settings. To learn how to change your regional settings, click here.

title: What should I do if I cannot open the Wix Editor?
content: Go through the Wix Technical Assistant and follow the steps to troubleshoot the issue. If you are still unable to open your editor, contact Wix Customer Care and provide the name or URL of your Wix site; the name and version of the web browser you're using; the name and version of your computer's operating system; and a screenshot of your console view showing the first line of the error message. To capture the console error, open an incognito window in your browser, sign in to Wix, try to open your editor, open the console (Ctrl + Shift + J on PC or Cmd + Option + J on Mac), click the Console tab and refresh the page (F5), then take a screenshot of the entire browser window including the console and the first red error message(s).

title: How can I set up an index for my collection in the CMS to improve data search speed?
content: An index maps the structure of your data so a data search has a shortcut to the information it is looking for, making data recovery faster because it doesn't have to search the entire database every time. To set up an index for your collection: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant collection. Click the More Actions drop-down at the top right and select Indexes. Click + New Index. Type a name for your index in the Index Name field.
