Click the Type drop-down to select a regular or unique index: a Regular index uses up to 3 fields with a diverse range of values — fields with a narrow range of values, like Boolean fields, do not make good indexes; click the Choose a field drop-down and select a field on which to base your index, then click + Add Field to add more fields. A Unique index uses fields that won't have duplicate values (e.g. ID number or email address) and is limited to 1 field; click the Choose a field drop-down and select a field on which to base your index. Click the Sort drop-down to select Ascending or Descending for each field. Click Save.

title: Can I add multiple tax types to a single tax location?
content: Yes, it's now possible to calculate tax using 2 or more tax types (e.g. listing both federal tax and provincial tax separately in a Canadian province) for any of your tax groups. You can learn how to create multiple tax types.

title: How can I retrieve a YouTube video's URL using the Single Video Player method?
content: From YouTube.com, find the relevant video. Click Share under the video. Copy the link. Tip: You can also copy the video's URL from the address bar of the browser.

title: How do I set up the Bandsintown app on my Wix site after adding it?
content: First, add the Bandsintown app to your site using Wix Editor, Studio Editor, or Dashboard, then set up the app: click the app in your editor and click Settings. Connect your Bandsintown account by clicking Connect Account. If you don't yet have an account, click Create a Free account and return to this panel once you've created one. Enter your Bandsintown name in the Artist Name field. Click the toggles to choose what info you want to display on the app. Under Display Info, Title displays a title at the top of your list, and if necessary you can edit the title in the Add a title field. Show Description shows the description of the show taken from your Bandsintown account. Under Show Social Buttons, Track Artist includes a link to the artist's page on Bandsintown, and Facebook & Twitter includes a link to the artist's Facebook and Twitter accounts.

title: How can I create a discount coupon for Pricing Plans using the Wix app?
content:
To create a Pricing Plans coupon using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Coupons under Marketing.
- Tap Add a Coupon.
- Select an option:
  - Create a $ Discount coupon: Tap $ Discount, enter the amount that will be taken off the price, then tap Next.
  - Create a % Discount coupon: Tap % Discount, enter the percentage of the discount you want to offer, then tap Next.
- Enter the Coupon Code your clients enter to get the discount.
- Enter the coupon name for your own records. Note: This name appears in your coupons list.
- Tap Next.
- Choose which plans the coupon applies to:
  - All plans: The coupon can apply to any available plans you offer.
  - Specific plan: The coupon can apply to one specific plan you offer. Click the Service drop-down menu and select a service. Tip: If your site has Wix Stores or Bookings, you see additional options.
- Choose the billing cycle that the discount applies to:
  - First billing cycle: Choose this option to only apply a discount to the first billing cycle of a plan.
  - All billing cycles: Choose this option to apply a discount to all future billing cycles of a plan until the coupon expires.
  - Custom: Choose how many billing cycle you want the coupon to last for. Enter the number of first billing cycles the coupon applies to.
- Set the coupon's start and end date: Tap the date under Dates Valid, select the start date from the calendar, optionally tap to select an end date, then tap Save.
- Optionally enable the toggle under Usage Limits and enter the total number of times the coupon can be used.
- Tap Done.
- Optionally tap Share to share your new coupon.

title: How can I resend a digital file to a customer in Wix Stores?
content: To resend a digital file in Wix Stores, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, select the relevant order, click the More Actions icon, and click Resend Download Link.

title: How can I add Wix Bookings to my site?
content: Go to the Wix Bookings app in the App Market. Click Add to Site. Go to your editor. Complete the setup by clicking Add to Site or Add App.

title: Can I create multiple test sites in the Release Manager?
content: Currently, you can only have one test site in your Release Manager. If you want to create another test site, you must first discard the previous one.

title: What should I do if I encounter a 500 Internal Server Error on my live site?
content: If you get a 500 Internal Server Error when trying to view your live site, reload the page using one of these methods: press F5 on your keyboard (Cmd + R on a Mac), click the Reload icon at the top of your browser, or re-enter the URL into your address bar and press Enter. If you are still receiving the error after refreshing, wait a few minutes and try again. This issue is usually temporary and solved in a matter of minutes.

title: Can I add modifiers to my menu using the Wix Restaurant Menu (New) app?
content: You can add modifiers to your menu using the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app. It is not possible to do so when only using the Wix Restaurants Menus (New) app.

title: How can I add a search box to my Wix site to help visitors find content more easily?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix Site Search app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Adding a Wix Site Search bar lets your visitors find what they are looking for more easily.

title: How do I customize the breadcrumbs layout on my Wix site?
content: To adjust the breadcrumbs layout on your site: Go to your editor. Select the breadcrumbs element. Click the Layout icon. Adjust the layout using the available options: Overflow items—select how to display items that don't fit on the trail on smaller screens, using Wrap or Collapse. Show separators—enable the toggle to show separators between trail items, then choose Arrow or Forward slash. Vertical spacing—drag the slider to change the spacing above and below the items. Horizontal spacing—drag the slider to change the spacing between the items. Item alignment—align the items to the left, center, or right. Item direction—choose whether items appear Left to right or Right to left. Your selections in the Breadcrumbs Layout panel apply to all breakpoints.

title: How can I create subcategories in my Wix site menu using the regular site menu?
content:
Before you begin, create all the categories and subcategories you want to display. Then follow these steps for the regular site menu:

- Click **Pages and Menu** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Site Menu**.
- Click the Link icon at the bottom.
- Select **Category Page** from the **Which Page?** drop-down.
- Select the category you want to display from the **Which item?** drop-down.
- Click **Done**.
- Repeat to add all the categories you need to build your menu.
- Drag a category under and to the right of the categories you want to place it under.

title: How can I set a service fee to apply only to orders above a certain amount in my Wix Restaurant site?
content: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Advanced. Scroll down to Service fees and click + New Service Fee. Add your service fee details and set the conditions: Service name: Add a name for your service fee. Amount: Enter your service fee. It can be a fixed amount ($) or a percentage (%). Optional: Add sales tax: click the checkbox to add sales tax to this service fee and enter the percentage to add. Apply based on subtotal amount: Choose Orders above and set the amount threshold. Orders placed above the amount you set will be charged this service fee. Apply based on fulfillment type: Choose the fulfillment type to apply the service fee to (Pickup / Curbside Pickup / Delivery / Contactless Dine-in). Click Create. Click Save. You can edit, delete, or disable a service fee by hovering over it and clicking one of the options.

title: Is it possible to automatically align text boxes across repeaters in Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, it is not possible for text boxes to automatically align across your repeaters. If one of the items contains more text than in other items, the text boxes may become misaligned. However, you can manually align the text by expanding text boxes in the items that have less text, so that the boxes are the same size.

To expand a text box:
- Click the text box with less text in the repeater item.
- Drag the handles on the text box to the same size as the text box with more text.

title: How can I start using the Printify app by Printify on my site?
content: To use the Printify app by Printify on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. With the app, you can create products with your designs and ship them directly to your customer. You can sync your products and descriptions automatically to your online store. Features and benefits include creating and selling custom products, choosing from over 250 products, a network of print providers from more than 90 locations, an easy to use mockup generator, and it is free to use. For questions or comments, contact Printify directly: Website: https://printify.com/ Email: merchantsupport@printify.com

title: Can I split menu item text over several lines in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you cannot split menu items on to more than one line. All items are displayed in one line, and a "More" item is displayed if they do not fit.

title: Why is my Google Workspace business email purchased from Wix suspended by the reseller, and how can I reactivate it?
content: If you see the "suspended by your reseller" error while trying to access your Google Workspace business email purchased from Wix, either the email subscription has expired, or there is an issue with your payment. Check the status of your business email on the Business Email page. If it has expired, renew your Google Workspace subscription. If it is still active, update your payment information. To renew, click Renew Subscription if prompted. To update your payment information, go to Payment Methods if prompted, click Actions, click Update, click Next, update your card details, and click Update.

title: How can I set up a Zapier automation to connect Wix with a third-party app?
content: To set up a Zapier automation to connect Wix with a third-party app, create a Zapier account if you do not already have one, then log in to Zapier. In the Zapier automation builder, use the panel on the right. Use the "Event" drop-down to select the Wix app that will trigger the automation. In the "App & event" section, click "Continue"; in the "Account" section, click "Continue". You may need to sign into your Wix account and grant Zapier permissions to connect to Wix. In the "Trigger" section, use the "Select specific trigger to use" drop-down to choose your exact trigger. Click "Continue"; in the "Test" section, click "Test trigger" and select a test record. Note that testing uses "dummy data" and is not real data from your site. Click "Continue with selected record". In the pop-up, select your action app. Use the panel on the right to select your action event. In the "Account" section, click "Continue"; you may need to sign into an external account and grant Zapier permissions. Make any further selections required to define your action, click "Continue", click "Test step", check that the test has been successful, and click "Publish". If you cannot find the trigger you want, you can partially build the automation within Wix Automations by selecting your chosen trigger and "Connect to Zapier" as your action; after saving, log in to Zapier, create a "Zap", search for and select "Wix custom trigger", and complete setup. A Zapier automation for a Wix app not added to your site can be created but will not function; if the app is added but no data triggers it, nothing will happen.

title: How can I accept an invitation to collaborate on a Wix site if I don't have a Wix account?
content: Open the invitation email in your email account. Click Accept Invite. If you don't have a Wix account, or want to create a new Wix account, click Log In, then click Sign Up. Register with your email address, Google account, or Facebook account.

title: How can I set up an automatic response for incoming orders on my Wix Restaurants site using the original Restaurants Orders app?
content:
Important: This applies to the original Restaurants Orders app. Wix has released a new online ordering app; learn how to add and set up the new Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.

To respond to incoming restaurant orders:
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation.
- Click + Start from Scratch.
- Click the title to give your automation a name.
- Click Wix Restaurants app in the Trigger section.
- Select your chosen action in the Action section and set up the action using the available options.
- Click the Timing section to expand it.
- Click the Choose a time to send this action drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
  - Immediately: The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
  - Set custom time: The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
- Click the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency:
  - Don't limit (trigger every time): Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
  - Once per contact: Your action will take place only once per contact.
  - Once per contact every 24hrs: Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
- (Optional) Click + Add an Action at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
- Click Activate to save your new automation.

You can learn more about creating a new automation and how you can respond to customers when they place orders on your site.

title: How can I create a QR code using the Wix QR Code Generator?
content: Go to the QR Code Generator, click Create QR Code, and select the content type you want your QR code to direct your users to: Text, URL, Image, Email, PDF, and more. Enter or upload the relevant details/content. Customize your QR code using Select Size (drag the slider; maximum size 1000 x 1000 px and minimum size 100 x 100 px) and Colors (choose the background and dots colors). Then click Download and select the file type: PNG, SVG, or JPEG.

title: Can I add additional forward slashes for my subpages?
content: Yes. You can now add additional forward slashes for your subpages by creating child pages in your site's hierarchy.

title: How can I add an anchor to my site menu in Wix Editor for a one-page site?
content: To add an anchor to your site menu in Wix Editor for a one-page site: add an anchor to your site; drag the anchor to the top of a page section; change the name of the anchor to something that describes the content (e.g. "About" or "Services"); repeat those steps for each anchor on your site; click Pages and Menu on the left side of the editor; click Add Menu Item; select Anchor and, on the pop-up, select the relevant anchor under Where on the page?; click Done; rename the menu link to something that describes that page content (e.g. "About" or "Services"). Tip: It can be the same anchor name as you previously entered. Repeat the menu steps for each anchor.

title: What apps are recommended for restaurant owners on Wix?
content: If you are a restaurant owner, you can use Wix Restaurants to create a beautiful online menu in minutes and take orders. You can also try the OpenTable Restaurant Reservation app, available in the Wix App Market.

title: I want to create a new domain name and website with Wix.
content:
To create a website and get a domain with Wix:

- Create a free Wix account. Wix is free to sign up, and you can create a fully functioning website and manage your business without paying. You can also create as many sites as you want in one Wix account.
- Build your site using Wix templates or start from a blank canvas. Templates are customizable.
- To purchase a domain from Wix, go to Domains in your Wix account, click Get a New Domain, enter a domain name and extension in the search field, then click Search. If the domain is available, click Get It, select the registration period, enter or edit your contact information, choose a Privacy & Security option, select your payment method, and click Submit Purchase.
- To connect your domain to your site, you must upgrade your site. Premium features include connecting your own domain and removing Wix ads. You receive a free domain voucher when you purchase selected yearly Premium or Studio site plans.

title: How can I set up the login bar in the Wix Editor to display a greeting before the member's name?
content:
To set up the login bar in the Wix Editor to display a greeting before the member's name, follow these steps:

- Click the Login Bar element in the Editor.
- Click **Set Up Login Bar**.
- Choose what people see on the Login Bar under **Select layout**:
  - **Avatar:** Only the member's profile picture is displayed.
  - **Name:** Only the member's name is displayed.
  - **Initials:** The member's initials are displayed, based on their first and last name.
  - **Full:** The member's profile picture and name are displayed.
- (Optional) Enable the **Show greeting before name** toggle to add a greeting before your member's name. Then, enter your greeting text.

**Note:** This option is only available for the **Name** and **Full** layouts.

- Edit the text on the Login Bar:
  - **What does the bar say before login?:** Edit the text that appears before members log in. This helps your site visitors know what to do (e.g., Sign Up, Log In).
  - **What's the logout message?:** Edit the text that members click to sign out of their account.

title: How do I add a new step to a workflow?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Workflows. Optionally, click the drop-down next to your workflow title to select another workflow. Click + Add Step, click Step Name to enter a name for the new step, and click Save. Then click the Reorder icon next to the step and drag it to the desired location in your workflow.

title: How can I connect a pricing plan to a Wix Group?
content: Before you begin, make sure you have added Wix Groups and created at least one group. In your site's dashboard, go to Groups. Click the relevant group. Scroll down to Privacy. Select Monetization. Click Connect a Pricing Plan. Choose what you want to do: to connect an existing plan, click Connect next to the relevant plan; to create a new plan, click Create New Plan and set up your new plan. If you connect an existing plan that already has subscribers, those subscribers will automatically be added to the group.

title: Is the 3D Carousel feature supported in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, 3D Carousel and 3D Slideshow galleries are not supported in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can display media in a Pro Gallery.

title: How do I update my inventory for PayPal eCheck orders in Wix Stores?
content: When a customer makes a PayPal eCheck purchase in Wix Stores, it appears in the Payments tab of your Wix dashboard with a 'Pending' status. Inventory is not updated at this stage as eCheck payments take between 3 to 5 working days to clear. Once the payment clears, you receive a notification, and the order appears in the Orders tab in the Wix dashboard as 'Completed'. At this point, the order's status in PayPal also updates automatically. When the process above is completed, update your inventory accordingly.

title: How can I set up credit card payments on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to Wix Payments, or click See More Payment Options to see alternative payment providers available in your region. Then click Connect / Complete Setup and follow the instructions to create an account or connect an existing one.

title: How can I connect Rakuten as a payment method through KOMOJU on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, change it using the drop-down menu. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Rakuten.

If you have a KOMOJU account, sign in to KOMOJU and confirm the account is in Live Mode, return to Wix, enter your KOMOJU Secret Key, and click Connect. Make sure your payment method is active in KOMOJU.

If you don't have a KOMOJU account, click Create KOMOJU account and follow the sign-up instructions; when your account is approved, repeat the connection steps and select I have a KOMOJU account.

If KOMOJU is already connected and you want to add another payment method, sign in to KOMOJU, add the payment method and confirm it is active, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to KOMOJU, and enable the toggle next to your desired payment method. Make sure your payment method is active in KOMOJU.

title: How can I filter my orders in Wix to only see those relevant to my current task?
content: Filter orders so that you view only the ones relevant for the task you're working on. To filter your orders: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click Filter. Select one or more filters. The filters you selected appear at the top of the order list. Tip: If you assigned tags to your orders, you can filter by tag. For store owners: You can filter by a specific delivery region and rule (e.g. domestic - standard shipping). To make the delivery filters easier to use, you can also go to a region in the Shipping & fulfillments settings and rename the title (e.g. change Region 3 to "Canada").

title: How can I display events on my Wix Group page?
content:
Create exclusive events for your group members so they can meet up online or in person. You can showcase these events on a separate Events tab on your group page.

Enable the Events tab: Go to Groups in your site's dashboard, select the relevant group, click the Content tab, and click the Events toggle to set it to Visible.

Create your event: After enabling the Events tab, click Edit next to the toggle to choose which event/s you want to show. If you're creating an event for the first time, click Create an Event to get started. Click Create an Event at the bottom left of the popup, choose Ticketed Event or RSVP Event, enter the event details, click Create Event, add additional information, and click Save.

Connect your event to your group: Click Connect Event, select the checkbox next to the relevant event, and click Connect.

Tip: You can also choose which events to display on your Groups Page right from your mobile device.

title: How can I create a category in my Wix Forum to organize discussions?
content: Only admins can create categories. In your site's dashboard, go to Forum, click Categories on the left, then click Add Category at the top right. Enter a name in the Category Name field, customize the New Post button text, enter a Category Header Title, and enter a short description in the Category Header Subtitle field. Choose a header background by color or image, using the Background color, Opacity, and Text color fields, or add an image and set the Overlay color and Opacity. Click Edit next to SEO to customize category SEO. Choose who can access the category: Everyone, Logged in members, or Selected members. Use the Category guidelines toggle to enable or disable guidelines. Click Save. Wix Forum includes a sample category; rename and customize it or delete it.

title: How can I change the language of the Password Window in my Wix site?
content: The language of your Password Window is taken directly from the language of your site. If you have one primary language on your site, you can change it from the Language and Region settings of your dashboard. Go to your site's Language and Region settings. Click the dropdown menu under Site language. Select the language for your site from the list. These steps only apply to sites with one language. If you have added Multilingual to your site, it is not possible to change your site's main language.

title: What elements are automatically added to my site when I install the Wix Site Search app, and how can I customize them?
content: When you install the Wix Site Search app, two elements are automatically added to your site: the search bar and the results page. You can customize the parts of your site that are searchable, how many results are displayed, the layout and design of your search bar, and the placeholder text that's displayed in the bar. The results page displays a list of results related to the term your visitor is searching for. The results page is hidden by default, meaning that it isn't displayed on your site menu; your visitors can only see this page when they search for a term in your search bar.

title: How can I manually mark a price quote as "accepted" in Wix?
content: Go to Price Quotes in your site's dashboard. Click the Show More icon next to the price quote you want to edit. Click Mark as Accepted. You can then convert the price quote to an invoice that your client can pay online.

title: How can I view and manage my existing proposals using the Wix app?
content: Open the Wix app on your mobile device. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Proposals under Getting Paid. Select an existing proposal. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right and choose an action: Preview; Save as template; Copy Link; Send/Resend; Change status; Download PDF; Delete (tap Delete again to confirm). Note: you cannot undo Delete.

title: Can I use AI to write my pages' title tags and meta descriptions in Wix?
content: Yes, you can use AI Text Creator to write your pages' title tags and meta descriptions. You can either choose a focus keyword or get AI text suggestions without adding a specific keyword. The Create AI text option is available in both the SEO panels of your installed Wix apps and the SEO Settings "Edit by Page" tabs.

title: How can I set up tax calculation manually for Wix Stores?
content:
Prerequisite: This tax solution is currently available for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New) & Wix Table Reservations.

To set up tax calculation manually:
- Go to Tax in your site's dashboard.
- Click +Add Location, select a country from the Country drop-down, and optionally click the Set up tax for every region individually toggle. If enabled, select one or more states/provinces etc. from the Districts drop-down. Click Add. You can repeat to add additional tax locations.
- Select a tax location, enter the rates, and click Save. If you have multiple locations, repeat for each one.
- Optional advanced mode: select the relevant location, click the Advanced mode toggle to enable it. You can add an additional tax rate by clicking Add rate, entering a rate name (e.g. GST), entering the tax rate percentages, optionally selecting the Add to all tax groups in this location checkbox, and clicking Add. Then enter the second name and rate (e.g. HST); repeat to add additional rates.
- Set how tax is displayed in your shop by selecting either Tax should be added at checkout or Tax is already included in my prices.
- Optional: If some items are taxed at a different rate, create a custom tax group for them. Note: Tax groups are not currently available for Wix Bookings services.

title: Can guests cancel their tickets for a Wix event themselves?
content: Currently, guests cannot cancel their participation in a ticketed event themselves. They need to contact you so you can remove them from the guest list. If your guest bought an event ticket, you'll need to provide a refund. Tip: Guests can, however, cancel their participation in RSVP events. They can do so through their Members Area.

title: How can I ensure that search engines can index my homepage using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO basics, enable the Let search engines index this page toggle, and publish your site. Search engines will detect the change the next time they crawl and index it. If you want to try to speed up this process, submit the page's URL to search engines.

title: How can I add a mouse effect to an element in the Studio Editor?
content:
To add a mouse effect to an element in the Studio Editor:

- Select the relevant element.
- Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
- Click the **Animations and Effects** tab.
- Click **Mouse Effects**, then click **+ Add**.
- Select an effect from the collection.
- (Optional) Click **Adjust Animation** at the bottom to customize settings like direction, distance and easing.

title: How can I customize my email campaign using Wix's email marketing tools?
content:
Start by choosing a template or starting from scratch. Then use the email campaign editor to customize your campaign:

### Add elements
1. Click **Add** on the left.
2. Select the element you want to add.
3. Customize the element to your liking.

### Manage elements
Click the element you want to edit and choose what you want to do:
* **Edit:** Use the panel on the left to modify the element.
* **Move up / down:** Click the relevant arrow on the right.
* **Crop and resize:** (Images only) Click the Crop icon on the right to go to Photo Studio and crop, edit or resize your image using the available tools.
* **Duplicate:** Click the Duplicate icon to create a copy of the element.
* **Delete:** Click the Delete icon and select **Confirm Delete** to permanently remove the element.

### Change the theme
1. Click **Themes** on the left.
2. Click the theme of your choice to select it.

### Customize the background
1. Click **Background** on the left.
2. Choose what you want to edit:
   * **Outer background:** Choose whether to show background colors or patterns and images in the outer background.
     + **Background colors:** Select the relevant color or click the Pick Color icon to choose a custom color.
     + **Patterns and images:** Select the relevant pattern/image or click the Add icon to choose another pattern or image. Then click the Settings icon to choose the color behind the image or to have the image repeat itself across the background.
   * **Inner background:** Customize the background of the middle portion of your email campaign, which is 700 pixels wide. Click **Customize Inner Background** at the bottom and customize the background color, border width, and border color.

### Change the text direction
If you're writing in a right-to-left language, you can display your campaign in the same direction.
1. Click **Right to left** at the bottom left.
2. Click the toggle to display from right to left.

**Tip:** There's no character limit for email campaigns, but too much text can lead to spam complaints. Stick to 1-3 short paragraphs for better results.

title: Listing本地化交付前需要执行哪些自检标准？
content: 交付前逐条核对并报告结果：①标题不超过200字符，且未使用全大写；②全文使用目标市场的规范用语，不含夸大宣传词；③涉及认证的表述均来自原文或用户提供，未自行添加；④每处本地化调整都已标注类型和原因；⑤未新增原文没有的功能、材质或认证声明。

title: How can I set up an existing Upload Button to accept multiple media files on my website?
content: Open the collection linked to the Upload Button. Click the Add icon. Edit the field name. Click the Field Type drop-down and select Media Gallery. Click Save. Select the Upload Button in your Editor. Click the Connect to Data icon. Click the File connects to drop-down and select the Media Gallery field you just set up. Click Settings. Finish by following Set up the Upload Button.

title: Can I embed videos from third-party tools like YouTube and Vimeo in my Wix Portfolio?
content: Yes. You can now embed videos from third-party tools such as YouTube and Vimeo within the Wix Portfolio app or galleries.

title: How can I add a color or gradient to the background of a column in Wix Editor?
content:
Click the column on the strip in your editor. Click **Change Background**. Click **Color** and select from one of the following options:

* **Solid:** Choose a color to apply to your strip.
* **Gradient:** Apply a cool effect to your strip background with a Linear, Radial, or Conic gradient.
* **Fluid gradient:** Make your strips stand out with a sophisticated mesh gradient.

title: How can I connect PayU India as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to PayU India.

If you have an account: Enter your Alias and Salt credentials. Note: For valid credentials, your PayU India account must be created through the PayU/Wix Plugin. Click Connect.

If you don't have an account: Click Create PayU India account. Enter your email and click Next. Fill in the registration form and click Next. Follow the steps from PayU India to get your credentials: Login to your PayU dashboard. Go to My Account. Go to System Settings, where you’ll find your Login Alias and Salt credentials. Note: Both Salt values can be used. We suggest you use the shorter one. Return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add a new event in Google Tag Manager for my Wix site?
content: From the left-hand side menu, click **Tags**, then click **New**. Enter a name for the tag (e.g., Wix Pageviews). Under **Tag Configuration**, click **Choose a tag type to begin setup**. Select **Google Analytics**, then select **Google Analytics: GA4 event**. Enter the **Google Measurement ID**; this should be the same as in the previous step. We recommend creating a constant variable in Google Tag Manager. Add **Event Name** as **add_to_cart**. Create a custom trigger with the new **addToCart** name. Click **Save**.

title: How can I view buyer notes in my Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant order. Read the note under the customer's name on the right.

title: How can I create a drop-down menu in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, place pages under other pages to create a drop-down menu on your site. Visitors can see the drop-down when they hover over the main page on the menu. To turn a page into a drop-down: go to your editor; click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor; click the relevant page; click the More Actions icon; click Subpage. Tip: You can turn the drop-down back into a main page at any time by clicking the More Actions icon next to the drop-down and clicking Main page. Note: If the drop-down in your menu opens behind other elements, move your menu forward.

title: I need to connect the elements on my dynamic item page to the correct fields in my CMS collection. I'm looking for guidance on how to do this in Editor.
content: To connect elements on a dynamic item page to CMS collection fields in the editor: add and arrange the elements you want on the page, then connect them to the collection fields within the built-in dataset. For text elements, click the element, click the Connect to CMS icon, and choose the field from the Text connects to drop-down. For images, click the image, click the Connect to CMS icon, and use the Connections drop-downs to set Image source, Alt text, Tooltip, and Link. By default, the dynamic item page includes elements such as text and an image connected to CMS collection fields; leave elements disconnected if their content should stay the same across versions. The Previous and Next buttons are connected by default to the previous or next item returned by the dataset, and you can edit their connections. Click Preview to test each version, and click Publish when ready to make changes live.

title: Can I connect a flexbox to CMS collections in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect a flexbox to CMS (Content Management System) collections, so it shows content directly from a dataset. Tip: As an alternative, you can use a repeater which lets you connect its elements to a dataset.

title: Can I add or manage Wix Hotels from the Wix app?
content: Currently, you can add Wix Hotels from the Editor and manage Wix Hotels from the dashboard. However, you can't add or manage Wix Hotels from the Wix app.

title: How can I resize an image in the Wix Editor while maintaining its original proportions?
content: Click the image. Drag the handles on the edges of the image to the size you want. The image and shape stay at the original proportions when resized using the handles at each corner of the image. You can also crop your image in a variety of ways.

title: How do I set up dropshipping with Printful in my Wix store?
content: Go to your Wix editor or site dashboard and add the Printful: Print on Demand app by searching for it, clicking Add to Site, reviewing permissions, and connecting a new or existing Printful account; for a new account, follow the email instructions to confirm your email address. Then log in to Printful, select the Stores tab in the Printful dashboard, and if not connected, click Add next to your Wix store. You can then create products and set pricing. Set up shipping in your Wix dashboard while considering Printful shipping costs; you can charge for shipping separately or increase the product price to cover shipping and offer free shipping, and use the Shipping Rate by Product method for different Printful product rates. In Printful, add a billing method: save credit cards and/or PayPal for automatic charging, manually deposit funds into the Printful Wallet, or set up auto recharge for automatic deposits to the wallet.

title: How can I add and configure security headers for my organization's site using Wix Studio for enterprise?
content:
In your enterprise dashboard, go to Security Headers. Click + Add Headers at the top right. Click the relevant site, then click Select. Select the checkbox next to the security headers you want to add and configure, then configure the relevant headers as needed.

Permissions-Policy: Assemble the relevant directives and their corresponding allowlists, separating each with a comma. Copy and paste your directives into the Directives field under Permissions-Policy.

X-Frame-Options: Click to expand the Directive drop-down under X-Frame-Options. Choose the relevant option: Deny or Same-origin.

Referrer-Policy: Click to expand the Directive drop-down. Choose the relevant option from the drop-down.

Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS): Enter the max-age, specifying the duration in seconds. Optionally select the includeSubDomains checkbox. Optionally select the preload checkbox. When using preload, the max-age directive must be at least 31536000 (1 year), and the includeSubDomains directive checkbox must be enabled.

Content-Security-Policy (CSP): Enter all relevant directives and their corresponding values in the Directives field.

Important: Only click Save at the top when you are finished configuring all the relevant headers.

title: How can I display a one-time class session on my Wix site so that it appears on the Service Page?
content: Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the date and time the class will meet and select **Class Session**. Select the service, staff member, and duration. Adjust the class's Repeat settings: select **Weekly** from the **Repeat** drop-down and select the day of the week you are offering the class. Click **Set an end date**, click the calendar and select a relevant date (for example, for a one-time session that takes place May 7, set an end date of May 8). Click **Save**.

title: How can I overcome the 100-page limit on my Editor X site?
content: Editor X sites have a 100-page limit, referring to the static pages you add from the Pages panel. Dynamic pages are a handy solution to this limitation, as they allow you to have an unlimited amount of pages on your site. You can design dynamic pages as "templates" inside the Editor, then use them to display an entire collection from the CMS (Content Management System). When designing a dynamic page, connect the elements to their corresponding collection fields so they display the right piece of information. A dynamic page is automatically created for every item in your collection, synced with the content you add or edit in the CMS.

title: How can I add a video to a blog post from my Wix site's dashboard?
content: To add a video to a blog post from your Wix site's dashboard, go to Blog in your site's dashboard, select the post you want to add media to, and click the Add icon beside the section where you want to add the media. Click Video, then choose a method for adding a video: paste a URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook and click Add, or click +Upload Video to add your own video. Use the options in the toolbar above your video to customize it: select a size such as Small Fit, Best Fit, or Full Width; select an alignment such as Left or Right; click the Replace icon to choose a different video; or click the Delete icon to remove your video. Click Publish.

title: How can I translate my blog posts and categories using Wix Multilingual?
content:
To translate your blog posts and categories using Wix Multilingual:

Translating category names:
- Go to Blog in your site's dashboard.
- Click Categories in the sidebar. Make sure you are in your main language tab.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant category.
- Click Translate.
- Select the relevant languages and click Continue.
- Click Start Translating.
- Translate your category's Name, Description, Image, and URL Slug.
- Click Save.

Translating blog posts:
- Click Posts in the sidebar.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant post.
- Click Translate post.
- Click the What language do you want to translate into? drop-down and select the relevant language.
- Choose how you want to translate your content: Manual translation or Auto translation.
- Click Translate.
- Review the draft and click Publish.

Tip: Using the Translate tab in your post composer, you can also translate a post as you edit it. Click Add next to the relevant language to open a duplicate version of your current post and start translating in your chosen language.

title: How can I assign a domain to a site in my Wix account?
content:
Once a domain has been added to your Wix account, you can assign it to an upgraded site. To connect a domain, you must upgrade your site. If you try to assign a domain to a site that does not have a Premium or Studio site plan, you will be asked to either upgrade your site or reassign an existing plan from another site.

To assign a domain to a site in your account:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Go to the Domains page.
- If you have more than one domain in your account, scroll to the domain you want to connect.
- Assign your domain to your site.

If the domain is not currently assigned to a site:
- Click Assign next to Not Assigned to a Site in the Unassigned Domains section.
- Select a site and click Next.
- If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option: Redirect it to the primary domain, or Replace the current primary domain.
- Click Assign.

If the domain is currently assigned to a different site:
- Click the Domain Actions icon and select Assign to a Different Site.
- Select a site and click Next.
- If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option: Redirect it to the primary domain, or Replace the current primary domain.
- Click Assign.

If you have not added a domain to your Wix account, first add a domain by purchasing a domain from Wix, connecting a domain purchased elsewhere to Wix, transferring a domain to Wix, or transferring a domain from another Wix account.

title: Can I design individual items in a slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the design and layout of individual items in a slideshow repeater. Any changes you make are automatically applied to all items. As an alternative, you can add a flexbox to the page and select the slides layout to customize each item. Note: Transition effects or auto scroll are not available on slide flexboxes.

title: How can I view a breakdown of the fees charged by Wix Payments for my transactions?
content: You can see a breakdown of the charged fees directly in your settlement report. It includes detailed information about each transaction, including current status, chargebacks, relevant payout, and the exact fees charged by Wix Payments. You can filter by date and by transaction type, and you can download the detailed table.

title: Is the SEO Assistant feature supported for Wix Stores product pages?
content: Yes, you can now use the SEO Assistant with Wix Stores product pages. Choose a product and select Edit SEO Settings to open the assistant and get tasks and suggestions.

title: How can I identify which business email is set as the admin in Google Workspace?
content: Go to your Business Email page. Click Show User info next to the relevant email account. Locate your admin business email next to 'Admin'.

title: How can I filter my product list in Wix Stores and save the filters for future use?
content: Go to the Product tab in your site's dashboard. Click Filters. Select the filters you want. The filters you selected appear at the top of the product list. To save the filters, click Manage View, select Save as new view, enter a view name, and click Save. Use a meaningful name you'll remember, such as Out-of-stock vases.

title: How do I translate automated emails with Wix Multilingual?
content:
Before you begin, make sure you have added and set up Wix Multilingual on your site. To translate automated emails:
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant automation.
- Click Edit.
- Click Edit next to Do this: Send an email.
- Scroll down and click Edit in the Create an email section.
- Click the Now editing drop-down at the top to choose a language. The languages available will be your site languages added via Wix Multilingual.
- Edit the content of your email.
- Click Save & Continue.
- Click Save to make your automation live.

Important: A site language must be visible for your automated emails to be sent in that language. You will need to manually translate each language version of your automated emails.

title: How can I customize the display of my Wix Booking Calendar to better manage my sessions?
content: Click the Display Settings icon on the right side of the calendar and use the available options to adjust how you display your Bookings Calendar. Choose how much spacing you want between sessions, display appointment titles by Client name or Service name, and color code sessions by Services or Staff members. You can also add filters by service, staff, location, session availability, and more. Note that this display customization feature is being released and is not available to everyone yet.

title: How can I customize the design of the navigation menu in my Wix Forum?
content: Click the Wix Forum app in your editor. Click **Settings**. Click the **Design** tab. Click the **Navigation menu** tab to customize the navigation menu settings. **Fonts and icons:** Click the color box to choose a color for your fonts and icons. **Background opacity and color:** Drag the slider to change the level of opacity, and click the color box to choose a color for your background. Click **Back**.

title: How can I customize shape dividers on my Wix mobile site?
content: To customize desktop dividers on mobile: select your section or strip — for strips, click the strip in your mobile Editor; for sections, double-click the section in your mobile Editor. Click the Shape Dividers icon. Select either the Top or Bottom tab if you have dividers on the section or strip. Then choose a new shape divider or click Customize Design at the bottom of the panel to adjust it. Available options can include Opacity & color, Height, Horizontal offset, Layer effect (Centered, Fade to top, Fade to bottom), Invert, Flip, and Number of repeats. Note: The available options depend on the shape you choose.

title: I would like to view my invoices.
content: To view a specific invoice, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the relevant order, click the More Actions button, and select View Invoice. To view a list of all your invoices, go to the Invoices tab in your site's dashboard. In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Manage Invoices under Getting Paid, and review your existing invoices in the Invoices tab.

title: How can I add an image to an event in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Create a new event or select an existing one. Click the Plus icon under Event image in the General info section. In the Media Manager, select an existing image or click Upload Media to upload a new image. Click Save. To replace or delete an image, hover over it and click the relevant icon.

title: Is it possible to integrate the Price Quotes feature with Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate the Price Quotes feature with Wix Stores. Tip: It is possible to integrate Wix Invoices with Wix Stores.

title: How can I check if my site is indexed by search engines?
content: To check if your site was indexed by search engines, search "site:" followed by your site's domain with no spaces. For example: site:wix.com. If any of your domain's pages are listed in the search results, those pages have been indexed. If there are no results for your domain, your website has not been indexed yet. Check that you have allowed search engines to crawl your site.

title: How can I assign a contact to a site collaborator in Wix?
content:
Go to Contacts in your site dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to a contact and select Edit. Scroll down to Assignee and click the Unassigned drop-down. Select a collaborator from the list. Click Save.

Collaborators will receive a notification in the site dashboard when one of their assigned contacts reaches out.

Tip: Collaborators can filter the contact list by Assigned to and select their name to see which contacts they are responsible for managing.

title: How can I access my Sales Forecast in Wix Analytics?
content: Wix Analytics Sales Forecast is currently not available for all sites. To find your Sales Forecast, go to your Sales Overview. On the Sales Forecast tile, click Check it Out.

title: How can I give Wix permissions from my Wix account to manage my Facebook Ads?
content:
Go to Facebook Ads in your site dashboard. Click Start Now. Click Connect to Facebook. Follow the instructions in the pop-up link to link your account. Click Choose what you allow to view mandatory permissions. Make sure all toggles are enabled and checkboxes selected; this is mandatory for Wix's AI to run and maintain your campaign.

Note: You must select every checkbox under Manage your business in order to run a campaign. For all other permissions, you can choose which pages to allow access to, and at least one page must be selected.

Click OK at the bottom right. If you receive an error message after connecting your Facebook account, it means at least one mandatory permission is missing. Click Manage Permissions to view and approve the missing permissions.

title: How can I crop an image in my email campaign?
content:
To crop an image in your email campaign:
- Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard.
- Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one.
- Select the relevant element in your email campaign.
- Click the Crop icon from the toolbar on the right.
- Choose how to crop your image:
  - Crop Ratio: Crop your image to a predefined size and ratio (e.g. 1:1, 9:16, 3:4). Tip: Select the portrait or landscape orientation to change the ratio options.
  - Image size (px): Set the size your image will be cropped to, using the Width and Height fields. Note: The maximum image size is 3000px x 3000px.
  - Free hand: Manually drag the corners of the image with your mouse.
- (Optional) Change your image orientation: Rotate left, Rotate right, Flip horizontally, or Flip vertically. Tip: Rotate your images at custom angles using the degree rotation tool on the right of the Photo Studio.
- Click Save.

title: How can I add and set up the Menus app in Wix Restaurants?
content: Inside ADI, click Add on the top bar, then click Apps. Scroll down to Restaurants and click Add next to Menus. Click Got It. Click the app in the ADI Builder and click Manage. Add your menu sections and dishes.

title: How can I customize the 'Refer Friends' page in the Wix Referral Program?
content:
Important: Wix Referral Program is not yet available to all users. To customize your Refer Friends page in the Wix Referral Program, go to the Refer Friends page in your Editor:

- Wix Editor: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor, click Referral Pages, then click Refer Friends.
- Editor X: Click Pages at the top of Editor X, then click Refer Friends under Referral Pages.

Click the Refer Friends element on your page, then choose what you want to do:

- View the page from a different user's perspective: Click Switch State and use the drop-down to select a state.
- Show or hide parts of the Refer Friends element: Click the Elements icon and use the checkboxes to show or hide text and visuals.
- Change the text on the page: Click the element of the text you want to edit. Depending on the element you've selected, click Edit Text, Change Text & Icon, or begin typing. Note that certain content such as Title, Description, and Terms and Conditions is automatically generated based on your program setup in your dashboard and cannot be edited in the Editor; make changes in your dashboard instead.
- Change the design of the page: Click the Refer Friends element on your page, click the Design icon, then select a pre-made design.
- Change the layout of the page: Click the Refer Friends element on your page and click the Layout icon to change the padding of the main element. Click the Content Box element on your page and click the Layout icon to select the alignment of text within the content box. Click the Banner element on your page and click the Layout icon to select the alignment of text within the banner.

title: How can I create a percentage discount coupon in Wix Stores?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Coupons and click + New Coupon. Select % Discount. Enter the coupon code, coupon name, and percentage discount. From the Apply to drop-down, choose All products, Specific product, Specific category, or Minimum order subtotal, and enter or select the applicable details. Then choose whether to apply once per order to the lowest priced item or to each eligible item in an order. Optionally select Include subscriptions. Set the start date and either the end date or select Don't set an end date. Optionally set limits on total uses or one use per customer. Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I manage items in my CMS collections using the Wix app?
content: Open your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Settings, tap CMS, then tap the relevant collection. From there you can add a new item by tapping + Add New Item at the bottom, entering the details, and tapping Save; edit an item by tapping it, editing the relevant fields, and tapping Save; duplicate an item by tapping the More Actions icon next to it and tapping Duplicate; or delete an item by tapping the More Actions icon next to it, tapping Delete, and tapping Delete again. Note: Default field values are not applied to items added via input elements or the Wix app; they only apply to items added within CMS collections from desktop computers.

title: How can I add and set up an in-page menu in Wix Editor?
content:
In-page menus help visitors navigate your site and are most useful on one-page sites with several sections and anchors. Note: In-page menus are not displayed on your mobile-friendly site.

Set up sections and anchors on your site. To add a section: go to your editor, click **Add Section** on the left side of the editor, click a category, select your chosen section to add it to your page, hover over the section and click the **More Actions** icon, click **Section Settings**, enter the section name into the field and press the **Enter** key on your keyboard. To add an anchor: go to your editor, click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor, click **Menu & Anchor**, click the anchor under **In-Page Navigation**, or drag it to the relevant location on your page. Optionally rename the anchor by clicking it, selecting **Rename**, entering the new name, and pressing **Enter**.

Arrange the anchors in the Layers panel: click the **Layers** icon on the bottom left of the editor, then drag each anchor so it appears right above the relevant section, strip, or element.

Add an in-page menu: click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor, click **Menu & Anchor**, click **In-Page Menu**, then click or drag your chosen menu to add it to your site.

Manage the menu items: click the new in-page menu, click **Manage Menu**, then choose how you want to manage your items. Show / hide an item: select or deselect the checkbox next to the anchor / section to show or hide it. Add another anchor to the page: click **Add New Anchor** to create a new anchor and display it in the menu. Add another section to the page: click **Add New Section** to create a new section and display it on the menu. New anchors are automatically added to the top of your page. You can adjust their position by dragging them.

title: How can I preview the checkout process for my Wix Store without making it available to customers?
content: To preview the checkout process before launch, prepare your site so it is not available to customers, then test checkout through the Members Area. Enable the manual payment method so you won't be charged. If your site has a Premium plan or Studio plan, temporarily unassign the plan from your site or duplicate your site and test the checkout on the duplicated version. If your site doesn't have a Members Area, add it. Log in to your Wix account if needed, open your live site, and log in to your site using the Members Area. Navigate to a Shop page, add a product to your cart, click Checkout, click I just want to place a test order, and complete the store checkout process. Only the site owner can preview the checkout process, not site Admins or people with other roles & permissions. It is not currently possible to preview the checkout process for Wix Bookings services. Placing a test order is possible only with Wix Stores or Wix Restaurants Orders (New). It is not possible to preview checkout of product subscriptions.

title: Can I display a different currency for each language version of my multilingual Wix site?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to display a different currency per language version of your multilingual site. When you change your site currency, it applies to all of your languages.

Tip: Add a currency converter to your store for customers to view prices in familiar currency. This change only affects the display of prices and not the currency used in transactions.

title: How can I connect a payout method to start earning revenue share in Wix Studio?
content:
To connect a payout method in Wix Studio:

1. Go to Revenue Share in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click Connect Payout Method at the top right.
3. Click Continue.
4. Add your contact info and click Next.
5. Add your payout method details and click Next.

Tip: Click Back if you need to edit your payment details. You can always edit your details by clicking Payout Settings in the Revenue Share tab.

title: How can I customize the elements of my Wix Store, such as the Product Gallery or Cart Page?
content: To customize the elements of your Wix Store, go to the element you want to customize, click it, and click the Settings icon. Almost all the fonts, colors, styles, and layouts can be customized. You can customize product galleries, the product page, the category page (not yet available for all), product quick view, the cart page, the cart icon, the side cart, and the thank you page.

title: How can I create a custom app using Wix Blocks for my organization?
content: Create and code your custom app using Wix Blocks, the app and widget building environment. Before you begin, read the App Guidelines and the Terms of Use. Then go to Custom Apps in your Enterprise dashboard, click + Create App at the top right, and click Get Started if this is your first app. Choose the app type from the available options: Blank Canvas, Single item, Multiple items, List, Code package, or Custom element. Build your app by adding widgets, elements, code and more.

title: How can I download the Wix app on my smartphone?
content: To download the Wix app, go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android). Type 'Wix' in the search field. Click Get or Install next to Wix - Website Builder to download the app.

title: How can I control the number of items displayed on my page using datasets in a CMS?
content: Use the "Maximum items displayed" field in your dataset to choose how many items load at a time. Keep in mind that a large number of items loading at the same time can slow down your page's loading time. Instead, add "Load More" buttons, "Next/Previous Page" buttons, or a pagination bar. These allow visitors to view more items when they choose to, keeping a balance between content accessibility and loading speed.

title: How can I set up a domain alias for my Google Workspace business email?
content: If you own multiple domains, you can set up an alias for your Google Workspace business email in your Google Workspace Admin console. If you use a secondary domain as a domain alias, then all users on your primary domain automatically receive a second email address with the alias domain. This feature is subject to certain limitations.

title: How do I connect my Expedia account to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
Before connecting, ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard. Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability for the channel manager to fully register your rooms. Ensure your account on Expedia is active, and the room types are created and updated for at least three months.

To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Expedia:
- Log in to the Expedia extranet.
- Click **Room and Rates** in the menu on the left.
- Click **Expedia Connectivity Settings**.
- Search for "HotelRunner" in both the **Provider for updating rates and availability** and **Provider for receiving reservations** drop-downs.
- Copy and paste your **Hotel ID** at the top.
- Click **Save and continue**.
- Go to the Channel Manager in your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
- Click **Connect** next to Expedia.
- Enter your Expedia **Hotel ID**.
- Click **Save and Continue**.

title: How can I test my Velo package using Wix Blocks before installing it on a live site?
content: After you create your Velo package, use the Wix Blocks testing feature. To create a test version, click Test in your Wix Blocks package environment; if you have never built this package, complete the name and description fields. Click Create to confirm. To update it after more changes, click Test, then Update Test Version. The package updates on any editor after refreshing and on any live site where it is installed. In the Editor, turn on Dev Mode in a Wix or Editor X site, select Code Files > Packages > Install a Package, click My Packages, and click Install for the test version. If you see another version, click see all versions to find your test version. A test version is clearly labeled in your list of installed packages. Publish the site or a test version of the site, which is recommended. The test version only comes into effect when the site is published. To publish a test site, click the arrow to the right of Publish, click Create Test Sites, then click Create New Test Site to confirm. When you create the test site, the editor provides its URL.

title: How can I add new photos and videos to my Wix photo album?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant album. Click Media on the left. Hover over the relevant gallery and click Manage Media. Click Upload Media at the top right. Select the relevant media file(s) and click Open. Optionally, to replace the cover photo: click Replace Cover Photo, click Add Images at the top left, select the platform and file, select the uploaded file from Media Files, click Apply, then click the Focal Point icon to change the focal point. Edit the Title and Description fields for your media, then click Done at the bottom to save your changes.

title: How can I change the language of the automatically generated text on my Wix Bookings site?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Select a language from the Site language drop-down. (Optional) Choose a region from the Regional format drop-down. This controls how you show dates, numbers and measurements. Note: Changing your site language does not translate text you add to your site manually. If you would like to see this feature in future, you can click here to vote for it.

title: Can I send a receipt to customers automatically after an invoice is paid using Wix Invoices?
content: Currently, when an invoice is paid, your customer does not receive a receipt from Wix Invoices after they've made a payment. It is not possible to send your own receipt through Wix Invoices. However, using Wix Automations you can create an automation that sends an email to visitors once an invoice is paid.

title: How can I pause online ordering for my restaurant using the Wix app?
content: To pause online ordering for your restaurant using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Orders under the Business apps. Tap the Settings icon at the top right. Tap the Online Ordering toggle to disable it. Choose whether to pause or turn off online ordering: For the next hour means online ordering is paused for one hour; Turn off permanently means customers cannot order online. You can reactivate online ordering at any time by tapping the toggle to enable it. Optional: Tap the Message (optional) field and enter your message, then tap Done. Tip: To edit your message while online ordering is off, tap Edit message to customers under the Online Ordering toggle.

title: How can I send a pay link to a customer for an unpaid order in Wix?
content: Access the unpaid order in the dashboard, click Collect Payment, and choose the method that works for your business. To send a pay link, send it by email, text message, or paste it in a chat. When your customer clicks the link, a secure payment window opens where they can complete checkout. You can add your logo to the pay link to give it a professional and trustworthy look.

title: How can I start creating an app for the Wix App Market?
content: Use the Wix App Dashboard to get started. Build your app using Wix's custom REST APIs, then launch it, monetize it, and track its performance. Before you begin, it is recommended to check out existing apps to see which apps are popular with users. It is also a good idea to create your own site and add some apps to it to see how they work and how users interact with them. When you are ready, use the launch guide to help you create and monetize your first app.

title: How can I update the twitter:image for my site's Twitter Card using Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, set a twitter:image for each page of your site. Then log in to Twitter and go to the Twitter Card Validator at https://cards-dev.twitter.com/validator. Enter the URL of the article or blog post that you want to tweet. You will see a preview of the Twitter Card which should now show the correct image. Tip: You can also update your headline on Twitter by following the steps above.

title: Can I disable all shipping and delivery options in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, disabling all shipping and delivery options in Wix Stores is not supported. You can offer store pickup or local delivery as the only options. If your store products are only digital goods, they are delivered online and customers do not see any shipping options during checkout. You can also sell services using Wix Bookings or create events with Wix Events, neither of which have shipping.

title: How can I customize the events displayed in the Wix mobile app for my members?
content: To customize the events members see in the Wix mobile app: go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App, tap Edit, then tap the Events tab. Tap the Edit icon, then Customize element. From there you can choose to display events in a different tab, customize the title (the title can be up to 25 characters if displayed), select what events you display (Upcoming & Past, Upcoming, or Select Manually with Select Events, choose events, and Save), optionally select an event category, choose how recurring events are displayed, select which elements appear with each event, edit the RSVP Event Button Text and Ticketed Event Button Text, and use Element Visibility to show events only on iOS or Android.

title: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) supported as a payment method in India?
content: Currently, it is not possible to accept payments using cash on delivery / collect on delivery, where online payment is only collected once an order has been fulfilled. As a workaround, you can accept payments using the manual payment method.

title: How can I connect Mollie as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Find your preferred payment method with 'Provided by Mollie'. Some methods are supported by multiple payment providers, so click See Options to view alternatives where available. Click Connect. If you already have a Mollie account, enter your API Key and Profile ID, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Mollie account, retrieve your credentials (API Key and Profile ID) from Mollie, then return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add a custom member signup form using the Wix Editor?
content:
Prerequisite: You must have a Members Area on your site to create a custom signup form.

In the Wix Editor:
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click Signup & Login.
- Click Member Signup Form (Default).
- Under Which member signup form do your visitors see?, choose Custom Form from the drop-down.
- Click Add to Site.

You can then click any element on the form to customize it. Note: social logins cannot currently be added to a custom signup form, but they can be added to the default signup form.

title: Can I create new labels with my own icons in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It's now possible to create new labels with your own icons. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app.

title: What is the recommended size for og:image in Wix Editor, and what should I do if I recently updated it?
content: The recommended og:image size is 1200 x 630 pixels (px), with an aspect ratio of 1.91:1. This means the width should be 1.9 times the height to avoid cropping issues. Your image shouldn't be larger than 8MB. The minimum size is 200 x 200 px, however Wix recommends keeping it to 600 x 315 px. If your image is smaller than 600 x 315 pixels, it will appear as a small image in the link preview. If you recently updated your og:image, enter your site URL in Facebook debugger so that your site information is up to date.

title: How can I archive a pricing plan on my Wix site?
content:
To archive a plan:
- Go to the Pricing Plans tab in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you want to archive.
- Click Archive.
- Click Archive to confirm.

Important: After you archive a plan:
- It remains active for customers who've already purchased a subscription, but no new customers can purchase it.
- You cannot make it active again.
- You cannot edit the plan, you can only view it.
- You cannot manually add new clients to the plan.

title: My old website pages are still showing on Google despite updating the SEO. I have already tried removing the old URLs and submitting the updated sitemap to Google, but the issue persists.
content: Based on the source, search engines crawl and index most pages on a live site, and it can take some time for changes to appear in search results. If you connected your site to Google Search Console using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, Wix automatically submits and updates your sitemap, so there is no need to submit it to Google again. For old pages still appearing, use Google Search Console: click Removals, click New Request, select Clear Cached URL, enter the page URL, and click Next; using the URL removal tool requires verifying your site with Google Search Console. After sending the request, ask Google to crawl the page again by requesting indexing. Also check that old URLs are redirected to the new URLs using 301 redirects through Wix's URL Redirect Manager, and make sure your new pages do not have noindex tags and that search engines are allowed to index your site.

title: How can I upload my own video as a page background in Wix Editor?
content:
To upload your own video background in Wix Editor:
- Go to the relevant page in your Editor.
- Click **Site Design** on the left side of the Editor.
- Hover over **Page Background** and click **Customize**.
- Select **Video**.
- Click **Upload Media**.
- Browse your computer and select your video.
- Click **Change Background**.

Notes:
- Videos take a few moments to upload regardless of your internet connection speed. As your video is processed, the file is being transcoded, meaning converted and resized, to play in the highest quality on any screen. Processing time may increase for especially long or high quality video uploads. Your video won't appear on your site until the uploading process is complete. For best results, check out the video file guidelines.
- Your video background will automatically be set to not play on the mobile version of your site. To enable it, or select another video background, reselect the video in the mobile Editor.

title: How can I reorder the pages on my Wix site and ensure the changes reflect on the site's menu?
content:
In the Menus and Pages panel, re-arrange the order of your pages using drag-and-drop. You can change the order at any point, and it updates your site's menu automatically.

To reorder your site pages: Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click Site Menu. Click and drag the page up or down the list.

When you change the order of your site's pages, the order also changes on your site's menu. This order is visible both in the Wix Editor, and on your live site to visitors.

title: How can I extend a customer's plan in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Subscriptions. Tap the relevant subscription you want to extend. Tap the More Actions icon at the top. Tap Extend Subscription. Tap the Extend this subscription till drop-down and select the relevant date. Tap Save. Tap Yes, extend to confirm.

title: What can I now set the max width for in the Studio Editor?
content: You can now set the max width for sections on your client's site.

title: How can I lock the aspect ratio of a media element in the Studio Editor?
content: Select the relevant media element. Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right. Click the Lock aspect ratio icon under Size. Resize the element by either entering the width / height value in the Inspector (the other value adjusts automatically), or dragging the handles around the element on the canvas. Note: This option is not available in the advanced sizing mode.

title: How can I add a custom field to my Wix booking form?
content: To add a custom form field, go to Booking Form in your site's dashboard. Click Add custom field at the bottom of the Form Fields section. Choose Short answer (30 characters max), Paragraph (255 characters max), or Checkbox (500 characters max). Optionally select Make this a required field. Click the Save icon, then click Save Form. Note: You can delete, duplicate, or edit custom fields by clicking the icons on the right. Clients who book via the Wix member apps do not see custom form fields. If you enabled SMS reminders, a checkbox appears below the phone number field so clients can opt in.

title: What are the new features available in the Wix Restaurants new Menus app?
content: Features available only in the new Menus app include: Advanced design options to customize menus with advanced design choices, allowing you to show or hide elements, including prices and change presets. Mobile view design capabilities to tailor the design of your menu specifically for mobile devices. Price formatting to format and display prices according to your preferences. Custom labels for items to help customers quickly identify special nutrition and dietary needs in items. Menu management with the Wix app to create, manage and update menus directly from the Wix app on your mobile device. Multiple language support to translate your menu into multiple languages. SEO capabilities for menu pages to optimize your menu pages for search engines. Integration with the Wix Restaurants Orders app to connect your menu to the new Wix Online Ordering app for placing orders online.

title: How can I add a new menu to my site using Editor X?
content: To add a menu in Editor X, click Add Elements on the top of Editor X, click Menu & Search, click a menu type such as Horizontal, Styled Horizontal, Vertical, Hamburger, or Anchor, then drag a menu onto your site.

title: How can I add a reservation widget to a page using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your Reservations page, click Settings, click Add-Ons, click Add to Page next to your preferred widget style (Stacked, Strip, or Button), select the page where you want the widget to appear, and optionally reposition and design it to your liking. The source also lists the same steps for Studio Editor.

title: How can I add alt text to an image or GIF in a Wix blog post?
content: To add alt text to blog images and GIFs: add an image or GIF to a post, click the image or GIF, click the Settings icon, enter an alt text description, and click Done. Note: It is currently not possible to add alt text to cover images.

title: Why might a Wix Payments payout fail, and what should I check?
content: A payout can fail because of incorrect bank account details, or even because your bank changed ownership. In your Wix Payments dashboard, click the payout to see any known details about the failed transaction and instructions for resolving it. The payout and any other funds that have finished processing are placed On Hold until the issue is resolved; once it is resolved, the funds are included in your next scheduled payout.
