To help avoid payout failures, verify that the bank account holder's name matches the name of the Wix Payments account owner. Also verify that your bank account can receive EFT payments; if you are located in the United States, Wix Payments sends payouts as ACH transfers. If your account cannot receive EFT payments, update your settings to a different bank account that can receive them and make sure the account details match.

title: Is there a feature in the Studio Editor that analyzes a site and highlights areas that require adjustment for accessibility?
content: Currently, we do not offer a feature that analyzes a site and highlights areas that require adjustment in order to make it accessible. However, you can apply certain settings that may help make your client's site more accessible, like adding alt text and arranging your elements in the layers panel.

title: How can I maintain my site's Google rankings when moving to Wix using URL redirects?
content: To maintain your previous site's Google search ranking data when moving to Wix, use URL Redirects. You must upgrade your Wix site with a Premium Plan and connect a domain. When building your new Wix site, create new pages with URLs that match the ones from your old site. If you cannot match the new URLs to the old ones, create a URL redirect to retain SEO rankings. Once your new Wix site is published, verify your site with Google Search Console or other search engines, then submit your sitemap directly to Google. To set up redirects correctly, search Google using site:yourdomain.com, note the URL of each page that appears, and set up URL redirects so each relevant URL corresponds to a page on your new site. Publish from inside the Editor for the URL redirects to be activated, and make sure Let search engines index your site is selected from your site's SEO settings. To speed up caching, open a Google Search Console account and submit your automatically generated sitemap to Google. Note: it is not possible to use a Source Link with a # in the URL or to redirect to a blog page or list item. For moving to Wix with a new domain, add your old domain to your Wix account and connect it as a secondary domain to your new domain to set up a URL redirect from the old domain to the new domain.

title: I would like to unpublish my site.
content:
You can unpublish your site from the Wix Editor or from your site's dashboard.

Wix Editor:
- Open your site in the Wix Editor.
- Select Site in the top toolbar.
- Click Unpublish Site.
- Select Unpublish in the dashboard window.
- Click Unpublish in the pop-up to confirm.

Dashboard:
- Go to Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click Website settings.
- Click Unpublish at the top of the page.
- Click Unpublish in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I add the Kudobuzz Reviews app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Kudobuzz app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Review the permissions and click Agree and Add. Learn more about setting up the Kudobuzz Reviews app at the Kudobuzz help center.

title: Can I accept payments in installments with Wix Payments in the United States?
content: Yes. You can now accept installment payments in the United States with Wix Payments. To accept installment payments, enable one or more BNPL options: Add Affirm as a payment method with Wix Payments, or Add Afterpay as a payment method with Wix Payments. Alternative installment payment options may be available with these payment providers: Affirm (United States); Afterpay (Australia, New Zealand, United States); Clearpay (United Kingdom); Isracard / PayMe (Israel) — contact Isracard for more information; Klarna (Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States); Max (Israel) — contact Max for more information; Laybuy (Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom); Sezzle (Canada, United States); and some supported wallet payment methods (e.g. PayPal and PagSeguro).

title: How can I view the Wix Professionals matched with my project request in the Wix Marketplace?
content:
To view your matches and projects in the Wix Marketplace:

- Sign in to your Wix account.
- Go to your projects page in the Wix Marketplace.
- Hover over the relevant project and click View Project to view the project details.
- Optional: Click the More Actions icon on the right and choose what you want to do:
  - View Project: View your project details with the Wix Professional.
  - View Marketplace Profile: View the Wix Professional's profile in the Wix Marketplace.
  - Cancel Request: Cancel this project request. We'll notify your matches that this project is no longer available.

title: How do I add a Spotify player to my site and set it up with specific music?
content:
Step 1 | Add a Spotify player
Adding a Spotify player is a great way to showcase your audio to your visitors. You can add a Spotify Player anywhere on your site.

To add Spotify player:
Go to your editor. Click Add Elements. Click Video & Music. Click Spotify Player. Click and drag the Spotify player on to your site.

Step 2 | Search for music from Spotify
Add specific artists, songs, albums or playlists that you want to play on your site from Spotify. You can either add music manually, or, if you know the URI code (Uniform Resource Identifier code) for the music, you can add this code directly.

To add music from Spotify:
Click the Spotify player in your editor. Click Settings. Choose your music from Spotify:
- Search Spotify manually: Click Search Spotify. Enter the name of the artist, song, album, or playlist in the search bar. Choose the relevant item and click Select.
- Enter the URI code: Click the Settings tab. Enter the code under Spotify URI. Click Update.

Additional information
- The Spotify player only displays a 30 second preview of a track. Your site visitors can only listen to the full track if they are logged into a Spotify account.
- Currently, the Spotify player does not support podcasts.
- To retrieve a Spotify URI code, right-click any artist within Spotify, and select Copy Spotify URI. You must download Spotify on your desktop to retrieve the Spotify URI code. The web version does not produce the URI code.

title: How can I set up affiliate marketing for my Wix store using the Goaffpro app?
content: Go to the Wix App Market. In Wix Editor, click App Market on the left side of the Editor; in Editor X, click the Apps icon at the top of the Editor. title: What are the guidelines for naming an app to avoid rejection by Apple's App Store or Google Play?
content:
When choosing a name for your app, make sure it follows the naming guidelines for both Apple's App Store and Google Play. Your app name cannot include:

- Any special characters (e.g. #,@,&) or emojis
- Prices or pricing information (e.g. 'Free app!')
- Trademarked names or data
- Names already used in popular apps or references to other apps
- Inappropriate or irrelevant content
- Names over the 30 character limit

Tips for choosing a name that won't be rejected:
- Pick a unique name that accurately describes your app and its content.
- Choose a name that is simple and easy for your users to remember.
- Don't try to 'game the system' as Apple says by using popular or existing app names to draw more attention to your app.
- Reflect the app's core features in the name.
- Check the availability of the name before you submit. This includes all social media handles and domain names as well.

Tip: Use the subtitle in the Store Listings section of your app's dashboard to provide extra context about your app without including it in the name.

Read more about Apple's Guidelines and the Google Play Developer Policy.

title: How can I manage a large number of pages on my Wix site without affecting performance?
content:
You can add up to 100 static pages to your Wix site, but sites with a large amount of pages may take longer to load and may also affect the loading time and performance. To keep a content-heavy site loading fast and performing at its best, follow these guidelines:

- **Use dynamic pages**: Dynamic pages let you create and design one page layout that can be used over and over again, each time displaying a different item, content, or image stored in a database collection. They also allow you to easily update the look and feel of all your duplicated pages by updating your dynamic page only. If you are duplicating a page and changing each page's content or design manually, Wix recommends using dynamic pages.

- **Add a blog**: If you are adding content to your site on a regular basis, posting new articles or blog posts, Wix recommends adding Wix Blog.

- **Display your media in galleries**: With galleries, you can showcase a large amount of images and allow your users to open each one of them in full-screen for better viewing. By adding galleries, you can avoid creating a new page for each one of your images.

Note: The 100-page limit does not apply to dynamic pages, such as product pages, blog posts, and pages connected to your CMS (Content Management System).

To moderate comments, add your personal Facebook username in your site's settings under Website Settings, save, and publish your site from the Editor. Then open your live site, navigate to the relevant page, click Moderation Tool, and moderate each comment as needed. Facebook Comments are page specific: a comment appears only on the page where it was added.

title: What are the recommended guidelines for choosing accessible fonts on a Wix site?
content:
Follow these accessibility guidelines when adding text and fonts to your site:

- Choose a font that has a balance between character ambiguity and character complexity. Characters should be easily distinguished from each other, but also have simple patterns and shapes.
- Use a limited number of fonts on your site, and avoid having multiple typefaces in the same block of text.
- Avoid small font sizes where possible. We recommend keeping your text at 14 pixels and above.
- Make sure that your font has sufficient spacing between characters, words, and lines. This ensures that the text is not compacted, and can be read easily.
- Keep in mind that formatted text such as italics, all caps, and strikethrough can be more difficult to read for visitors with visual and reading impairments.
- Be aware of the color contrast between your text and background, especially when using lightweight fonts.
- Keep text alignment in mind. Justified text contains spacing variations, which can impact its readability. We recommend aligning text to the left, as this is the easiest to read in left-to-right languages.
- Text blocks and paragraphs should contain empty space between and around them to ensure they can be easily read and distinguished.
- Having too many or too few characters in a line can impact readability. We recommend keeping your line length between 50 and 120 characters where possible.

Next step: Go back to the Accessibility Checklist to continue improving your site for accessibility.

title: How can I transfer a premium site to another Wix account, and what should I consider before doing so?
content:
To transfer a premium site, you need the email address of the person you want to transfer the site to. After you start the transfer process, they receive a confirmation email which they need to accept to complete the process.

Before you begin:
- Once you transfer the site, site ownership is transferred to the new owner. Your payment information is not transferred, and the new site owner manages all future subscription payments. If you want to continue to manage subscription payments, you can add someone as a collaborator instead of transferring ownership.
- Some premium subscriptions cannot be transferred. If your subscription can't be transferred, unassign the subscription first and then follow the steps to transfer the site.

To transfer a premium site:
- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the Site Actions icon at the top of the Home page.
- Select Transfer site.
- Fill out the Transfer Ownership form:
  - Enter the email address associated with the new owner's Wix account.
  - Choose a description of your relationship with your transferee.
  - Enable or disable the following transfer options:
    - Transfer site plan: Transfer the premium plan assigned to the site, along with the site, to the new owner's account.
    - Transfer domain & business email: Move the domain and its associated mailboxes, along with the site, to the new owner's account. Note: "and business email" appears only if you purchased a Google Workspace business email from Wix.
    - Transfer premium apps: If applicable, the site's premium apps automatically transfer, along with the site, to the new owner's account.
  - Select or deselect the Keep my role as Co-Owner of this site after the transfer checkbox:
    - Selected: You remain a collaborator on the site with limited access. The new site owner can revoke your access at any time.
    - Deselected: You are no longer able to edit or manage the site in any way.
  - Select or deselect the Create a copy of this site and keep it in my account checkbox:
    - Selected: A copy of the site remains in your account after the transfer takes place.
    - Deselected: A copy of the site is not saved in your account. However, if you keep your role as Co-Owner, you can still edit the site.
- Click Continue.
- Review the transfer summary and tick the confirmation box.
- Click Transfer Ownership.

The new owner receives an invite email which they need to accept to complete the transfer. The invite expires in 3 days.

title: Why does my website show empty gaps when scrolling on Safari on macOS and iOS?
content:
We are aware of an issue affecting the scrolling performance of a site when slideshow repeaters or regular repeaters are present on the page and have their heights set to fr or auto (this also applies if it's stretched). This can make empty gaps as you scroll down the page until the content fully loads. It is caused by an issue on Safari on macOS and on multiple browsers on iOS. The issue comes from any container's hierarchy that involves grids inside of grids with their height units used being either fr or auto can be affected by this issue on Safari.

Workaround: Find any slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor. Select component and open the inspector. Under the Size section, click the More Actions icon (...) and enable Advance Sizing. Add any height value to the component using pixels. Repeat these steps for any other slideshow repeater on the page. Publish and visit the live site to confirm the problem is no longer present.

Note: If the slideshow repeater / regular repeater is stretched or docked both on top and bottom it is not possible to adjust the height. You will have to unstretch it (the width can then be adjusted to 100% width) or remove the docking from one of the sides.

Issue has been resolved on macOS and iOS version 17.5. Please update your device to the latest versions to confirm the fix.

title: How can I manually change the DOM order of elements on my Wix site?
content:
To manually change the DOM order of elements on your Wix site:

- Select Accessibility Wizard.
- Select the More Actions icon at the top right of the Wizard.
- Select Advanced accessibility settings.
- Select Automatic DOM Order.
- Disable the toggle in the panel.
- Select Turn It Off in the pop-up window.
- Select the Layers icon at the bottom left of the Editor.
- Check over the list and delete any redundant elements. This includes duplicate elements that do not have a use on your site and can confuse screen reader users.
- Drag and drop the remaining elements into the desired order.

title: What is Wix's policy regarding repeat DMCA infringement and how can I avoid account termination?
content:
Wix.com takes copyright violation very seriously and opposes any unauthorized infringement of intellectual property. To avoid the suspension or termination of your account, please read our policy carefully. As explained in our Terms of Use, Wix respects the intellectual property rights of third parties. To uphold these rights, Wix may terminate or suspend the accounts of repeated copyright infringers.

It is our policy that you may not post content without appropriate permissions, or in a manner that violates third parties' copyrights or other intellectual property rights. If you do so, in accordance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) and other applicable laws, Wix may terminate or suspend your account.

Circumstances for action may exist in the following cases:

- If your site has been found (by a court of competent jurisdiction) to have infringed the copyrights of a third party on two or more occasions; or
- In other cases of repeated clear abuse of usage of Wix Services (e.g., willful commercial piracy, or malicious attempts to destroy the value of copyrighted works); or
- If we receive a notice of infringement and, as a result, content posted on your site is removed, it constitutes a copyright strike. If you get three copyright strikes for content in your account within a one-year period, your account may be terminated.

However, if you submit a counter-notification in response to the copyrights owner's notice (within the timeframe and in the manner specified in our guidelines), and such counter-notice is not answered by the copyrights owner, we may cancel the respective strike. Likewise, if the copyright owner retracts their claim, we may withdraw the strike.

In addition, Wix reserves the right to terminate or suspend your account if Wix believes, in its sole judgment, that circumstances relating to the infringement of third party intellectual property rights justify such action.

title: How can I add a new language to my Wix Hotels app?
content: This applies to the original Wix Hotels. Adding languages to Wix Hotels is a premium feature only available when you upgrade Wix Hotels. To add a language in Wix Hotels: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Hotels tab on the left. Click the Languages tab. Click Create New. Click the Translate to drop-down menu and select a language. Do one of the following: Auto Translate: Click Auto Translate to instantly translate your text with Google Translate. (Optional) Manually edit the text. Click See Current Text to view original text for each field. Translate the texts yourself: Enter the translated text in the relevant fields. Click See Current Text to view original text for each field. Click Save. After you've added a language, you can enable or disable it at any time by clicking the toggle next to the relevant language on the Languages tab. Tips: You can only use Auto Translate when adding a new language. To use auto translate for an existing language, first delete the language then add it again. You can also use Wix Multilingual to translate the rest of your site.

title: Do PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay checkouts bypass custom fields such as a CPF/CNPJ field added to the Checkout Page?
content: Currently, when customers checkout using certain payment methods, such as PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, they may bypass the custom fields you added to the Checkout Page. Customers who complete the checkout process on the page without one of the payment methods mentioned above will see any custom fields you add, such as a CPF/CNPJ field.

title: How can I remove a page from Google search results if it still appears after adding a 'noindex' tag?
content: If you've already prevented search engines from indexing your page, it may still sometimes appear in search results because Google may have crawled your site before you prevented it from indexing the page. You can send a request to Google to remove the URL using their URL removal tool. To use the URL removal tool, you need to verify your site with Google Search Console; Wix can do this using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, or you can verify your site manually. In Google Search Console, go to Removals, click New Request, select Clear Cached URL, enter your page's URL, and click Next. After you send the request, ask Google to crawl the page again by requesting indexing for it. It can take some time for Google to remove your page from search results.

title: What should I do if a customer hasn't received their refund through Wix Payments?

title: How can I update my payment method for Wix subscriptions purchased in Indian Rupee due to the new RBI regulations?
content:
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new regulations for cross-border online payment transactions. Wix subscriptions purchased in Indian Rupee must now be processed through an authorized facilitator of online Payment Aggregator - Cross Border (PA-CB) transactions, and Wix has partnered with Razorpay for this. For subscription renewals originally purchased before July 31, 2024, you must update your payment method(s) to ensure uninterrupted Wix services; if you do not, Wix may not be able to process future payments and your subscriptions could be canceled.

To update your payment method:
1. Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
2. Click Update Payment Methods at the top of the page.
3. Update your payment card details.
   Tip: You can re-enter your existing card details, as long as the card is still valid.
4. Click Submit.

Note: Once you have updated your card details, Wix will verify your updated payment method with Razorpay.

title: How can I assign the role of Bookings Staff Member in Wix Bookings?
content: Make sure you add the relevant person as a staff member. Go to Staff in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant staff member. Click Manage or Edit. Click Give Permissions next to Booking permissions. Click Send Invite. Optionally, after the staff member accepts the invite, click Invite to Sync Calendar to send another email to allow your new Bookings staff member to sync their personal calendar.

title: Why are my email marketing campaigns sent from a Wix email address instead of my own?
content: Email marketing campaigns sent from a public email address such as @gmail, @yahoo, or @outlook have a low delivery rate. To make sure more of your contacts receive your emails, they're sent from an authenticated address owned by Wix. You may also see your campaigns as sent from a Wix email address if your domain is connected to Wix via pointing. If your contacts reply to your email, you'll receive their reply at your reply-to email address. To send emails and receive replies from your own professional email address, you need to have a personalized mailbox that’s connected to your custom domain. It is also recommended to authenticate your custom domain to prevent emails from getting marked as spam.

title: How can I add a customizable calculator to my website using Calculator Builder by Lumifish LABS?
content: With the Calculator Builder by Lumifish LABS, you can add a customizable calculator to your site with a click. title: How can I change the email address for RSVP notifications in Wix Events?
content:
When a guest RSVPs or buys a ticket to an event, you get an email at the address associated with your Wix account. If you'd prefer to receive emails at a different address, you can change it in the site settings.

To change your business email address:

Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard.
Enter a new email address in the Email field under Contact info.
Click Save.

Tip: You can use Wix Automations to send additional notifications to you or other team members every time a guest RSVPs or buys a ticket.

title: How can I create a function in Wix to charge an additional fee for fragile items in a customer's cart?
content: Go to Functions in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Additional Fees and click Create Function. Select Fragile packing fee and click Use Template. Click the Condition step to update the logic for your business. Click the default Item name property to change it to another identifier, like Item price or Item ID. You can also update the specific values the function checks (e.g., wine glasses). Optionally click + Add Criterion to add another condition, then click Apply to save the condition. Click Output to choose the fragile packing fee that should be applied. Edit the amount and name of the fee. Optionally enable the Collect tax toggle to make the additional fee taxable, calculated based on your tax settings. Optionally click + Add Fee to add additional fragile packaging fees. Select your site's main currency from the drop-down, then click Apply to save the output. Edit the function name at the top left; this is only visible to you in the dashboard. Click Activate at the top right. Customers now receive an additional fee at checkout if they meet the function requirements.

title: Is it possible to add a separate allergen info section for each menu item in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a separate allergen info section to each menu item. You can, however, add labels such as 'Vegan' or 'Gluten-Free' to menu items to guide customers with allergies.

title: How can I add a repeater element to my Wix mobile app using the dashboard?
content:

- Use Settings to set the style for all items: choose Layout, Design, Show title, Margins, and General Settings (All, Android, or iOS); click Save & Publish.

title: How can I set up a grace period for my customers' subscriptions on Wix?
content: To set grace periods and recurring retries for subscriptions, go to Subscription settings in your site's dashboard. Enable the toggle next to Grace Period, then enter the grace period you want to offer clients who miss recurring payments. Use the toggles to choose whether to retry a customer's payment method automatically during the grace period, send customers an automated email when a payment needs to be resubmitted, and email the customer when a failed payment is successfully collected. Automated emails for failed payments and for successful payments after entering a grace period are active by default.

title: Can I set a minimum or maximum quantity of products required to checkout in Wix Stores?
content: Yes. It is now possible to limit the sale of a specific item to a minimum quantity (e.g. minimum order is 6 unicorn mugs) and/or a maximum quantity (e.g. sale of unicorn mugs is limited to 1 per customer) using the Checkout Requirements app. Learn how to add and set up the Wix Checkout Requirements app.

title: How can I add Wix Stores to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open the Wix Editor, click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor, then click **Store**, then click **\+ Add to Site**.

title: Is it possible to add a progress bar to a multistep form in the new Wix Forms?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible to add a progress bar to indicate progress of a multistep site form. This would give visitors a clearer picture of how long the form is and how many steps there are. Tip: You can manually add the page number to the title of your form when adding it to your site.

title: How can I set up store pickup as a delivery option in Wix Stores?
content: To set up store pickup, first create or select a region in Shipping in your site's dashboard. Then select the relevant region and click + Add Pickup. Enter a Pickup name and the address customers should go to pick up their order. Optionally enter a time in the When will order be ready for pickup field and enter instructions in the Pickup Instructions field. Click Add Location. You can optionally click Add Another Location to add more pickup addresses.

title: How can I change the pricing plan for selling digital files only in my Wix Art Store?
content:
To change your pricing plan when selling digital files only in your Wix Art Store:

- Click the Wix Art Store app in your Editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Store** tab.
- Click **Set Pricing**.
- Set which licenses you want to use:
  - **License Templates:** Click the toggles under **My Licenses** to enable or disable each license option:
    - **Commercial Use:** Web and digital use only.
    - **Extended Use:** Web, digital and print use.
  - **Custom License:** Click **Create License** and fill in the information to create a custom license:
    - Enter the name of the license in the **License Name** field.
    - Enter a description of the license in the **Description** field.
    - (Optional) Upload your license agreement:
      - Click **Upload**.
      - Select your license document or click **Upload Docs** to upload it from your computer.
      - Click **Apply**.
    - Click **Save**.
- Select or deselect the image resolution checkboxes and enter the price for the selected options:
  - **Web Ready:** Image quality is slightly reduced to allow for quicker web loading.
  - **Original File:** The image is purchased in its original quality.
- Click **Save**.

**Tip:** All images within a specific Wix Art Store gallery are sold with the same pricing plan. Within each gallery, you can offer different prices for different licenses and qualities. To offer different images with a different pricing plan, add the app again to a different page of your site.

title: How can I receive my first payout through Wix Payments?
content: Every payment you accept through Wix Payments must be processed and scheduled before it can be sent to your bank account. Your first payout can only be scheduled once your Wix Payments account is successfully verified. After receiving your first payment, it is available for payout within an average of 7 days. You can see when your payout is scheduled to be sent directly from the Payouts area in your Wix Payments dashboard. Once sent, it can take between 3-5 business days for the payout to reach your bank account. Incomplete Wix Payments account verification may delay the timing of your first payout. If you have multiple payment methods active in your Wix Payments account, your payouts may be scheduled by their group.

title: How can I set videos to autoplay in my Wix Blog Feed and Post List?
content:
To set videos to autoplay in your Blog Feed and Post List:
- Click the Post List or the Blog Feed in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Design tab.
- Click Video Settings.
- Click the drop-down to choose when videos should start playing and select Autoplay. Videos autoplay one at a time.
- Optionally, use the Play with sound toggle, Playback speed drop-down, Loop video toggle, and Show play button toggle to adjust other video settings.

title: How can I customize the Back to Top button on my Wix mobile site?
content: Click your Back to Top Button in the mobile Editor. Click Change Icon. Select a preset icon or click Add to choose vector art or upload your own. Click Customize Design to make further changes. Next, click the Layouts icon to position your Back to Top button on your mobile site.

title: How can I enable and customize a Wix Gift Card in Wix Stores?
content:
Prerequisite: Before setting up the gift card, make sure you have set the currency you want to use on your site.

To enable gift cards, go to the Gift Cards tab in your site's dashboard and click Add Gift Card to Site.

To customize your gift card details, go to the Gift Cards tab and click Edit Gift Card. You can edit the gift card name and description, change the image by hovering over the gift card image, clicking the Show More icon, selecting Change Image, uploading a gift card image, and clicking Add to Page. Wix Logo Maker can help design a gift card image. You can also edit the gift card amounts customers can purchase by typing the amount you want to add and pressing Enter, and click the x next to any amount you want to remove. Set an expiration policy by choosing They never expire, or entering the number of months from the date of purchase. Check your local laws because laws in some regions do not permit expiration dates for gift cards. Click Save.

Once you save your gift card, your Gift Card page updates automatically. Click Preview in your ADI Builder to see how your Gift Card page looks before publishing. When you are ready to start selling gift cards, publish your site. If you later want to stop selling new gift cards, hide the Gift Card page in the ADI Builder; do not click the Enable gift card at checkout toggle to disable it, because this prevents gift card holders from redeeming their cards and may be illegal in some regions.

title: Can I show an element on some pages of my Wix site and not others?
content: Yes. You can use Velo by Wix to show an element on some pages of your site and not others. First, enable Velo by Wix in your Editor. Then follow the instructions to learn how to hide an element from specific pages.

title: How can I add Wix Multilingual to my site using Editor X?
content: Click the Add Elements icon at the top of Editor X, click Multilingual, then click Add to Site. Wix Multilingual lets you translate your content automatically or manually, and visitors can switch between languages using a drop-down menu for a localized experience.

title: How do I add products from Modalyst to my Wix Store?
content: After connecting your store to Modalyst, set pricing and shipping rules, then choose products. To add products to your Import List, click the Ready to sell tab, select a category or click Filter to narrow your search, and click More Details to learn more or Add to Import List to customize a product. To customize products, go to the Modalyst dashboard, click the Import List tab, and update settings in the General, Description, Variants, Pricing, and Media tabs. To add a product to your Wix Store, click Add to Store; it is added to your Products tab in your Wix dashboard and appears on your live site. To add multiple products, select all products or individual products and click Add to store. If this button isn't visible, click the Actions drop-down and select Add to store. Products usually appear in your Wix Store as soon as you add them; products with many images might take a few minutes before they are live.

title: How can I connect Dragonpay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to Dragonpay. If you have an account, enter your Merchant ID and Collection API Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Dragonpay account and enter the information to create your account. Once your account is created, retrieve your Merchant ID and Collection API Key credentials from Dragonpay, return to this window, and follow the steps under Have an account. Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Dragonpay account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I add an address field to my CMS collection to display locations on Google Maps?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your Editor and then Your Collections. Click the relevant collection, then Manage Fields. Click + Add Field. Select Address and click Choose Field Type. Enter a name in the Field name field. Optionally for Velo only, update the Field ID, which is used in the site's code; you cannot update it later. Optionally enter Help text if you want a tooltip to appear next to the field title. Optionally enable the Personally Identifiable Information toggle to encrypt location data that could be considered Personally Identifiable Information. Click Save. Then enter a location for each item in its address field, and make sure to manually select the correct address from the list that appears as you type. If you do not select an address from the list, Google Maps may have trouble reading and properly displaying all your addresses.

title: How can I connect a subdomain to an external resource using Wix?
content:
To connect a subdomain to an external resource using Wix, follow these steps:

- **Contact the host of the external resource/site** (e.g., WordPress) and ask for the DNS records required to point to the resource/site.
- Go to the **Domains** page in your Wix account.

  **Note**: If you have multiple domains in your account, scroll to the main domain of the subdomain you're connecting (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com for connecting blog.mystunningwebsite.com).
- Click the **More Options** icon on the right and select **Manage DNS Records**.
- **Add the DNS records** (e.g., A or CNAME records) you received from your resource/site host:
   - Click **+ Add Record** under the relevant A (Host) or CNAME (Aliases) section.
   - Click **Got it** in the pop-up message.
   - Edit the **Host Name** field with the name of your subdomain (e.g. 'blog'). Edit the **Value** field for each record you need to add.

     **Note:** Leave the **Host Name** field blank if instructed to add an **@** sign in it.
   - Click **Save**, then click **Save Changes** in the pop-up message.
   - Repeat for each DNS record you need to add.

**Note:** It may take up to 48 hours for your subdomain to propagate.

title: How can I change the theme of my email marketing campaign?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one. Click Themes on the left. Select the theme you would like to use.

title: How can I enable guest checkout for pricing plans on my site?
content: Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Checkout tab. Click to enable the Guest checkout toggle. Guest checkout is only available to customers on the Plans & Pricing page on your site.

title: Can I customize the content and design for outgoing emails in Wix Bookings without using automations?
content: Yes. You can customize the content and design for outgoing emails (confirmation, cancelation, reminder). You can also add email attachments.

title: Can I display my Wix Pro Gallery on a test site in the same way it appears on the live site?
content: We are excited to announce that it is now possible to display your Pro Gallery on a Test site just as it would on your published site.

title: Can I rent out individual rooms at a villa using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to allow booking individual rooms at a villa-type property. For example, if the whole villa is booked, the individual rooms can't be rented, and if any of the rooms are booked, the entire villa can't be rented.

Note: Make sure to change the 'room' text to 'villa' to clarify to clients what type of property is available for booking.

title: How can I automate my accounting by connecting my site with QuickBooks Online using the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit?
content:
To use the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit and automate your accounting by connecting your site with QuickBooks Online, first add one of the following apps to your site: Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, or Wix Hotels. The app is only available in English. Then check out the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit to get started.

Features and benefits include:
- Retrieve orders from your Wix Store, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, or Wix Hotels.
- Create new Items in your QuickBooks Online account when you create products in your store.
- Automatically create sales in your QuickBooks Online for orders that customers make on your site.
- Map tax codes from your store orders to tax codes in your QuickBooks Online.
- Eliminate human error from manual data entry between your QuickBooks Online and your website.

This can save hours of manually entering invoices, customers, and products from one app to another.

title: How can I generate a business name using the Wix Business Name Generator?
content: Go to the Wix Business Name Generator. Enter some keywords and the business industry. Click Generate Names. Browse the generated names for ones that suit your business. You can optionally refine the suggestions by adding or editing the Keywords and selecting an Industry at the top, then click Generate New Names.

title: Can I add a pagination bar in the Studio Editor to navigate between pages of items from my CMS collection?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to add a pagination bar that allows visitors to navigate between pages of items from your CMS (Content Management System) collection.

title: Can members save items to a wishlist in the Branded App?
content: Currently in the Branded App, your app members cannot add individual products or services to a personalized wishlist. Having the ability to create a wishlist on your app helps your logged in members keep track of their favorite products and/or services by adding them to a personal list. They can refer back to their wishlist items at any time to decide what to purchase. Learn more about how Wix Stores uses the wishlist feature on desktop.

title: How can I set up my phone to accept Tap to Pay using Wix Mobile POS?
content:
To set up Tap to Pay in Wix Mobile POS:
- Make sure your Wix Payments account is approved. Tap to Pay is currently available only in the US.
- In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments and enable the Tap to Pay on iPhone toggle.
- Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Point of Sale under Get Paid, and tap the Connect icon at the top right.
- Select Tap to Pay or Tap to Pay on iPhone, then tap Activate.

title: How can I reduce motion on my Wix site to improve accessibility for users with cognitive or neurological conditions?
content: To reduce motion on a Wix site, the source recommends minimizing motion by avoiding scroll effects and avoiding or limiting autoplay. Use scroll effects only when essential to the site's functionality or for conveying information. Limit autoplay where possible. For videos or visual content that play automatically, are displayed in parallel to other page content, and are longer than 5 seconds, add a stop, pause, or hide function. For audio content that plays automatically and is longer than 3 seconds, add mute or independent volume adjustment options. Visitors can also reduce motion or autoplay through their device operating system and browser settings; the source lists Windows 11 and Mac for scroll/animation effects, and Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge for video/audio autoplay.

title: How can I download the Wix mobile app to run my Dayful service business on the go?
content: Run your Dayful service business while you're on the go with the Wix mobile app. You can download the Wix app by searching for the app in the store for your mobile device. To download the Wix app: Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android). Type 'Wix' in the search field. Click Get or Install to download the app.

title: How can I password protect a specific page on my Wix site?
content: In the Wix editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side. Next to the relevant page, click the More Actions icon. Click Settings, then click the Permissions tab. Select Password holders, enter your chosen password for the page, and press the Enter key. Send the password to visitors you want to access the page. Note that password protecting a page also prevents search engines from crawling and indexing that page.

title: Can you automatically generate invoices for services in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now automatically generate invoices for services in Wix Bookings.

title: How can I limit the number of guests for my Wix event and manage what happens when the guest limit is reached?
content: For an RSVP event, go to Events in your site's dashboard, select the relevant event, click the Settings tab, and click Edit next to Registration settings. Click Limited guests under Guest limit, enter the maximum number of guests that can register, and select what happens when the guest limit is reached: Close registration or Add guests to a waitlist. Then click Save.

title: How can I add Wix Bookings from the Wix app to my site?
content:
To add Wix Bookings from the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Manage Apps.
- Tap Add next to Bookings under Business.

Optional: Add the app to your desktop site:
- Go to your site editor on desktop.
- Click the Add Apps icon.
- Click the Manage Apps tab.
- Click Add to Site next to Wix Bookings.

title: How can I connect Pay TR as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Pay TR as a payment provider, go to Accept Payments in your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Pay TR. For Have an account, enter the Merchant ID, Merchant Key and Merchant Salt, then click Connect. For Don't have an account, click Create Pay TR Sanal POS account, register for a Pay TR account on the Pay TR site, wait for the approval email from Pay TR, copy the Merchant ID, Merchant Key and Merchant Salt from your new Pay TR account, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I change the way my iTunes button opens on my site?
content: To change the iTunes display: Click the iTunes Button. Click the Settings icon. Under How does the player open? choose an option: In a new window opens in a new tab on the browser; In the same window opens in the same window as the site page.

title: Can I block incoming calls on my business phone number?
content: Currently, it is not possible in business phone number to block incoming calls. However, you can choose to block phone numbers and unwanted messages from your conversation list in your Inbox.

title: How can I set up my Wix Art Store to sell digital files and physical prints?
content:
Important: Wix Art Store is currently not available to all users. It is no longer possible to add the Wix Art Store to your site. Alternatively, you can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your art.

To choose how you want to sell your images:
- Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click Set Up Store.
- Click Start Now.
- Select Sell Digital & Print.
- Click OK.

Note: You can only offer one of the above options per site. If you selected the wrong option, click Change at the bottom of the panel. This changes all the Wix Art Store apps on your site. Your past orders and store data are saved in case you decide to change back.

title: Can I use external identity providers with Wix Headless for a login page?
content: Yes. You can now use external identity providers when implementing a login page using Wix Headless.

title: How can I remove a domain purchased outside of Wix from my Wix account?
content: Only domains purchased elsewhere can be removed from your account. To remove it: Go to the Domains page. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Remove from Wix. Click Remove Domain. If your domain is hosted elsewhere, contact your domain host and ask them to disconnect your domain from Wix's name servers or point it away from Wix's IP address.

title: Can I connect repeaters to the media gallery field type in my CMS collection?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect repeaters to the media gallery field type in your CMS collection. You cannot connect the media gallery field to repeater backgrounds or image elements that are attached to the repeater. This feature would allow you to connect images or backgrounds in repeaters on dynamic item pages to the media gallery field. As a result, you would show several images or videos for a single collection item in a repeater on a dynamic item page.

title: Can I organize my pages into folders in the Pages panel?
content: Currently, it is not possible to organize your pages into folders in the Pages panel. You can reorder the pages in the panel using drag and drop.

title: Can I upload my own shopping cart icon in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible to upload your own shopping cart icon. You can, however, update the Cart Icon's design.

title: How can I invite my staff members to sync their personal calendars with Wix Bookings?
content:
Go to Staff in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant staff member. Click Invite to Sync Calendar. (Optional) Edit the email to invite your staff member. Click Email invite. Ask the staff member to click Accept Invite in the email they receive.

Note: Each staff member needs their own individual email address to sync their personal calendar. It is not possible for multiple staff members to use the same email address.

title: Is the feature to display decimal points in the prices on the menu supported?
content: Yes. You can now choose how to display prices for your menu items: with or without decimal points. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app.

title: How can I record my screen on an Android device if it doesn't have built-in screen recording capabilities?
content: If your Android phone does not have screen recording capabilities, you can use the AZ Screen Recorder app. Open the app on your phone, click the Record icon, click Start Now, upload your video to a hosting site such as YouTube, Dropbox, or Google Drive, make sure to set the video viewing permissions to 'public', then contact Wix Customer Care and send them the URL to your recording.

title: How can I view notifications on the Wix Retail POS tablet for my brick & mortar business?
content: Click the Notifications icon at the bottom right of your screen to view notifications. You'll receive notifications for software updates, hardware disconnections, when a store order should be ready for store pickup, and more.

title: How can I upload photos and videos to the Shared Gallery app from my live site?
content: Log in to your site using the email address associated with your Wix account. Go to the Shared Gallery page on your site. Select the album that you want to add photos to and click Add Media. If you haven't created any albums, click Add Media on the main gallery. Select the image or video file(s) from your computer. Click Open. Optionally, enter a description of the photo or video.

title: How can I access my Microsoft Office 365 mailbox through my Wix account?
content: Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click Go to Inbox next to the relevant mailbox. Enter your mailbox credentials and click Sign in.

title: Can I add dynamic screens to my branded app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add dynamic screens to your branded app. Dynamic screens, similar to dynamic web pages, allow content to be displayed from a CMS (Content Management System) collection.

title: How can I import a CSV file to update my site's 301 redirects?
content:
To import a CSV file for redirects:
- Go to your SEO Dashboard.
- Select Go to URL Redirect Manager under Tools and settings.
- Click More Actions at the top and select Import redirects.
- Click Upload CSV File. If you need a template to create your file, click Download Template.
- Select the CSV file you want to import from your computer and click Open.
- Select the type of redirect to import:
  - New: when the URL has no prior redirects.
  - Existing: when the URL already has a redirect setup. You can choose to override the existing redirect or not. By default, it will not be overridden. To override, switch the toggle on.
- Click Import Redirects.
- Alternatively, click Replace File to upload a different CSV file. Then select the file and click Open.

title: Is there a way to apply updated site styles to all elements with existing design overrides in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, there's no option to "reset" all these elements simultaneously and apply the updated styles, disregarding the overrides. However, you can reset individual text elements with overrides from the Theme drop-down in the Inspector panel.

title: Can I use test credentials to connect a payment provider to my site?
content: Currently, we're unable to accept test credentials when connecting your site to one of the relevant providers. If you already set up your account using these credentials, disconnect from the provider and reconnect it using the live credentials.

title: Can I connect multiple payment providers for credit card payments on Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect more than one payment provider (e.g. Stripe, Square, etc.) to process credit card payments. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can vote for that feature. While you can't connect more than one provider to process credit card payments, it is possible to connect multiple providers for alternative payment methods such as PayPal, cryptocurrency payments, etc.

title: How can members download the Spaces App to their phones?
content: Members can download the Spaces App for free from the relevant app stores on iPhone or Android. You do not need a Premium plan to access it.

title: How can I enable guest checkout for PayPal in my Wix Store?
content: To enable guest checkout in PayPal: Sign in to your PayPal account. Click the Settings icon on the right. Click the Seller Tools tab. Click Update next to Website Preferences. Scroll down and select On under PayPal Account Optional. Note: If you are unable to see this setting in your PayPal account, please contact your local PayPal organization and ask them to enable it for you.

title: How can I connect PayPlus as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to PayPlus. If you have a PayPlus account, enter your API Key and Payment Page UID and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create PayPlus using Credit or Debit card account, register for a PayPlus merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I connect Paidy as a payment method through KOMOJU on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Paidy through KOMOJU on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Paidy.
- If you have a KOMOJU account: sign in to your KOMOJU account and make sure the account is in Live Mode; return to Wix, enter your KOMOJU Secret Key, and click Connect. Check that your payment method is active in KOMOJU.
- If you don't have a KOMOJU account: click Create KOMOJU account, follow the instructions to sign up, and when your account is approved, repeat the earlier connection steps and select I have a KOMOJU account.
- If you have already connected KOMOJU and want to add another payment method: sign in to your KOMOJU account, add the payment method you wish to connect and confirm that it is active, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to KOMOJU, and enable the toggle next to your desired payment method. Make sure your payment method is active in KOMOJU.
Important: Paidy only accepts payments for physical goods when shipping is provided.

title: How can I offer a free service to my members using Wix Bookings?
content: To offer members a free service with Wix Bookings, go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click to edit an existing service or click + Add a New Service. In the Price & Payment section, click the Price type drop-down and select Free. Finish setting up the service and click Save. You can also offer free classes without requiring clients to book a spot.

title: How can I contact Wix Customer Care through my POS tablet for support?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap Help. Tap Contact Us. Contact Wix Customer Care using any of the available options.

title: How does connecting multiple domains to a Wix site affect SEO and search results?
content: If more than one domain is connected to the same Wix site, only the primary domain will appear in search results. Your primary domain is connected directly to your Wix site, while any secondary domains are automatically redirected to your primary domain using a 301 redirect that is Wix implemented. All traffic arriving to a secondary domain is automatically redirected to the primary domain and your Wix site. The information appearing in search results for a page on your site, including the page's title tag and meta description, is determined per site, not per domain, and will appear for your primary domain only. When two or more domains are connected to a site, you only need to add the Google Analytics code to the primary domain.

title: How can I connect a text element to a CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content: To connect a text element to a CMS collection in the Wix Editor, go to the relevant page in your editor and add a text element: click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Text, click the type of text you want to add (Themed Text, Titles, or Paragraphs), and click and drag your chosen text to add it to your page. Click the Connect to CMS icon on the text element. Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection, or click Create a New Dataset and choose the collection you want to connect. Click the Text connects to drop-down and select the collection field you want to connect. You can connect text elements to Text, Number, URL, Boolean, Date and Time, Time, Rich Text, Address, and Tags fields. Select Item Count if you want the text to display the total number of items retrieved by the dataset. If necessary, set additional options depending on the field type: for Date and time, click the Choose a format drop-down and select the format; for URL, choose how the link opens: In the current window or As a new window. Click Preview to test your connections. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I export my physical products from Wix Stores to a CSV file?
content: To export your physical products from Wix Stores to a CSV file, go to the Product tab in your site's dashboard. Choose what you want to export: select the checkbox at the top left to export all products; click filter, select the type of products you want to export, and click Done to export a category or other filtered products; or select the checkboxes next to the products you want to export to export selected products. Then click More Actions, click Export, select an export option, and click Export. Note: Mac users should open the CSV file with Numbers or Excel version 15 or higher.

title: What should I do if I receive a suspicious invoice letter or email from another company, such as DNS Services, for a domain I purchased with Wix?
content: If you receive a suspicious letter or email from another company, such as DNS Services, with an invoice for a domain you purchased with Wix, ignore it as it is a scam. If you don't know who your domain registrar is, you can find out by visiting whois.com and entering your domain name to view your domain details. To help prevent this from happening, we recommend purchasing Private Registration with your domain. This hides your address and phone number from public WHOIS directories. If you have already purchased your domain with Public Registration, you can add privacy protection by manually extending your domain registration for at least an additional year. Learn more about activating private registration for a Wix domain.

title: How can I freeze the footer on my Wix site so that it remains visible while scrolling?
content: To freeze your footer so it is always visible on your live site: go to your editor, click the footer, click the Settings icon, and click the Freeze Footer toggle to enable or disable this option. Enabled means the footer is frozen, so it is always visible when visitors view and scroll through your site. Disabled means your footer remains at the bottom of your site and it is not visible when your visitors scroll away from it.

title: How can I add the Members Area to my Wix Blog using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Enter "Members Area" in the search bar. Select the Wix Members Area app. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I add Wix Music to my site and choose music for the player?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Video and Audio, click Wix Music, then drag a Wix Music player onto your page. To choose music for your player, click the Wix Music player in your editor, click Settings, click the My Music tab, then choose what music to add to the player: Existing music: choose from music you've already uploaded to your Music Library. New music: click + New Music to upload a single, album or playlist.

title: Is it possible to set the submenu to only open when clicked in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change this behavior so that the submenu only opens when clicked. When visitors hover over a submenu title on a menu, the submenu automatically opens.

title: How can I change the text on a button in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the button, click Change Text & Icon, then enter your chosen text under What does it say?.

title: What permissions are required for collaborators to publish a site in Release Manager?
content: Only collaborators with Admin permissions (not Admin Limited) can publish your site, and therefore create and publish test sites and manage the exposure.

title: How can I create exclusive store pages for site members in Wix Stores?
content:
Reward your site members by offering exclusive deals just for them. You can allow access to all site members or only to those who know the page's password.

Step 1 | Add a Members Area to your site: The Wix Members Area allows customers to sign up and log in to your site. When you add Wix Stores to your site, it comes with a Members Area. If you deleted it, you can re-add the Members Area.

Step 2 | Add a private page to your site: When site visitors click to access a private page that's restricted to site members, they are prompted to sign up and log in. If you restricted the page to password holders, they are prompted to enter the password. Learn how to add a private page to your site.

Step 3 | Add products to the new page: Add a store element, such as a Product Gallery or Slider Gallery, to the new page and create a special category with the products you want to display there. Tip: If you want to sell the same products you sell on public pages - but at different prices - you can duplicate your existing products and save them with a different name and price. When the products are ready, add them to a category and display that category on your exclusive page.

Step 4 | (Optional) Hide the page from your site menu: If you don't want site visitors to see that there is a page they can't access, you can hide it from your site menu. Learn how to hide pages from your site menu in the Wix Editor and in the Studio Editor.

After creating restricted pages, you can create an email marketing campaign and send it to selected customers, create coupons and discounts and send them to customers who have access to exclusive store pages, or create a link on another site page that leads to the restricted page.

title: Can I choose different font sizes for the field title and placeholder text in the Mobile Editor for Wix Forms?
content: The source confirms that you can choose a different font style, color, and size for the field title and input text of new Wix Forms in the Mobile Editor. It does not separately confirm choosing different font sizes for placeholder text.

title: How can I create an event schedule in Wix Events?
content: Go to Events in your site's dashboard and select the relevant draft or published event. For recurring events, you can add a schedule to an individual occurrence of an event. Click the Features tab, then click Schedule, then Add Schedule Item. Add the details for the first schedule item: enter the item name (e.g. Opening Session); set the start and end dates and times (the minimum time limit for a scheduled item is 10 minutes); enter the location (e.g. Main Stage); optionally enter a tag and press Enter on your keyboard; optionally enter a description of the schedule item; then click Add. Repeat to add additional items to the schedule. Optionally click the Enable Personal Agenda toggle to enable it. When enabled, guests can mark the events they're interested in and then click View My Agenda to see their selections.

title: How can I troubleshoot not receiving push notifications for my branded app on my mobile device?
content: If you aren't receiving push notifications about activity in your branded app, make sure you have enabled push notifications for the Wix app in your phone's general notification settings. This differs by device. Then check your site notification settings in the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app, tap your profile at the top, tap Notification settings, select your site from the list if you have more than one, and enable the Allow Push Notifications toggle. You can optionally manage notification settings for the apps on your site by enabling or disabling the toggle next to the relevant notification.

title: Can I divide columns in strips using the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to divide columns you have added to strips. As an alternative, you can attach elements such as lines and text to different parts of the column to give the effect that they are divided.

title: How can I import my contacts from Gmail into Wix Contacts?
content: You can manually import a CSV file to your contact list from external mail hosts like Gmail. You can also create an instant mailing list by importing your Gmail contact list, and these contacts will be stored in your Wix account for future use.

title: How can I set my branded app as the preferred member app for my site on Wix?
content:
To choose your branded app as your preferred member app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Mobile App**.
- Tap the dropdown at the top and select your branded mobile app.

**Tip:** Once you switch apps, your members are encouraged to download your branded app for the best visitor experience. However, anyone who continues to use another member app (e.g. the Spaces app) will still see content updates.

**Note:** If you don't see your branded app as an option, it means the app isn't live in app stores yet and not ready for people to use. Until the branded app is available, your members can use another member app to interact with your business.

title: How can I set up payment methods for selling my music on Wix Music?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and set up the payment methods you want to use. Do this before selling your music. Do not edit the album after a purchase is made, as this can cause an error with the download link. Currently, the following payment processors are not supported with Wix Music: pagueloFacil, Isracard, and Offline. For Wix Payments, make sure your release/track/album price is over the minimum amount per transaction.

title: How can I copy and paste a page from one Wix site to another, and what should I be aware of during the process?
content:
To copy and paste a page from a Wix Editor site to another Wix Editor site:
- Open the Editor containing the page.
- Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor.
- Right-click the relevant page and click Copy.
- Open the Editor of the site you want to paste to.
- Paste the page by right-clicking anywhere on the screen and selecting Paste, or select Paste & Apply Site Theme to apply the target site's color and text themes.
- In the Pages panel, rename the new page by entering the new page name and clicking Done.

Be aware:
- You can only copy regular pages. You cannot copy anchors, links, folders, lightboxes, router pages, or pages from third-party and Wix business solution apps.
- If elements on the page have a link to a page, anchor, or lightbox, it is replaced with a link to the home page of the target site.
- If elements on the page are animated, the animation is applied to the target site.
- Password protection is removed when you copy and paste a password protected page.
- When you copy and paste a members-only page, all members will have access to the pasted page.
- The pasted page is always added as a main page to the Site Menu page list, even if the original was a subpage.
- If you are unable to copy and paste pages, it is likely that the browser local storage is full. To resolve this, clear your local storage.

title: Can I edit the text that appears at the top or bottom of my email campaign?
content: Currently, it is not possible to edit the text that appears at the top or bottom of the email campaign. Note: The language of this text changes based on the language of your Wix account.

title: I need help managing the categories my booking services are in on my Wix website.
content:
Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Categories. Click + Add New Category. Enter the Category Name. Click Add to save.

To assign a service to a category: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Select the service you want to assign to a category. Click the Service category drop-down and choose the relevant category. Click Save. Note: You can assign a service to only one category at a time.

To reorder services: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Select a category from the drop-down at the top. Click and hold the drag handle next to your services to drag and drop them into your preferred order. You can only reorder services within their categories, not when viewing the "All categories" list.

To reorder categories: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Categories at the top of the list. Click and hold the drag handle next to your categories to drag and drop them into your preferred order.

To rename a category: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Categories. Hover over the category you want to rename. Click Edit Name. Enter the new category name. Click Save.

To delete a category: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Categories. Hover over the relevant category. Click Delete. Choose what you want to do: move services to another category by selecting the relevant new category from the drop-down and clicking Move & Delete, or delete the category and its services by clicking Delete to confirm. If you choose to delete a category and the services it contains, you cannot recover the services and will have to recreate them manually.

title: Can I sell pricing plans and redeem sessions from an existing pricing plan when using the Wix app as a point of sale?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell pricing plans, or redeem sessions from an existing pricing plan, when selling products and services using the Wix app as a point of sale. For example, if one of the sessions in the cart is plan-only, you can't redeem the session or sell a plan at checkout.

title: Can I add an internal note to a sale using Wix Stores POS?
content: Currently, it's not possible to add an internal note to a sale. You can add a note on desktop.

title: How can I invite collaborators to work in my Wix Inbox and what permissions do they receive by default?
content: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Click the Settings drop-down at the top right. Click Profile & collaborators. Click + Invite People next to Inbox collaborators. Enter the email address of a person you'd like to add. This assigns them the role of Back Office Manager by default; you can edit their role after you add them. Click Send Invite. Click Done. (Optional) Repeat these steps for any other team members you'd like to add. By default, the collaborator is assigned the role of Back Office Manager, which gives them access to your inbox. You can edit their role if needed.

title: How can I customize my site on the Wix member apps using the Wix app?
content: From the Wix app, you can choose how your site is displayed on the Wix Member Apps by customizing the content and layout. Go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage, tap Mobile App, tap Customize, and customize your mobile app appearance by editing the sections. You can show or hide elements, edit the text and reorder the tabs.

title: How can I access and view different types of reports for my Wix Restaurants site?
content: Go to Analytics & Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Restaurants section and select the relevant report. To switch views within a report, click the relevant tab at the top of the report to access different chart types. Depending on the report, you may see different viewing options.

title: How can I start building a website with Wix without any coding knowledge?
content: Creating a website with Wix does not require writing a single line of code. You can choose between the Wix Editor, which offers a user-friendly experience for those who prefer simplicity, and the Wix Studio Editor, which is better suited to website designers and other professionals who want to implement intricate design elements. You can also use Wix's AI Website Builder to create a website from scratch in just a few minutes.

title: Can I change the focal point of a Photo Album cover in Wix Photo Albums?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the focal point of a Photo Album cover. The cover is centered and cropped by default to optimally fit the screen size. You can change the focal point of an image in your Photo Album.

title: How can I assign a task to a site collaborator in Wix?
content: Go to Tasks & Reminders in your site's dashboard. Click + New Task at the top right. Create your task: write your task in the text box, optionally click Due Date to select a due date from the calendar, and optionally click Link to Contact to link the task to a contact. Then click Assign to Your Team and select a collaborator from the drop-down list.

title: How can I find header codes that I added previously in my Wix account?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to Site Verification under Tools and settings. Scroll down and click Your Existing Header Codes.

title: How can I create a dynamic page that lists items by category in my CMS?
content: Make sure you have a CMS collection with items you want to categorize and a dynamic item page for the collection. In the collection, add or choose a category field and enter the category value for each item, keeping spelling, capitalization, and spacing consistent. Then create a dynamic list page: go to CMS, open Your Collections, hover over the relevant collection, click More Actions, click Add dynamic page, select List page, and click Add to Site. Edit the URL slug structure so it includes the category field as a variable and remains unique to your site; it must not conflict with existing URL slug structures. This converts the dynamic list page into a dynamic item page with a version for each unique Page Link value.

title: How can I extend my Wix domain registration period, and what options are available?
content:
To extend your domain's registration period:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click Extend next to the relevant domain.
- Select a registration period and click Continue.
- Select a privacy option and click Continue.
- Enter your payment information and click Submit Purchase.

You can add up to 5 additional years to your domain registration by extending your subscription. While extending, you can also add domain privacy and protection options. 4 year and 5 year registration periods are available for .com, .net, and .org domains. Other domains can be extended for up to 3 years.

It is not possible to manually renew .de, .ch, .at, .nl, .fr, or .be domains. If you've disabled the auto-renewal for one of these domains, click Turn Auto Renew On if you wish to keep your domain.

title: How do I clear my browser's cache?
content:
Before clearing cache: open your browser in incognito/private mode to see if the issue is cache related. If the problem is resolved in incognito mode, follow the steps below to clear your browser's cache.

To clear your browser's cache:
Close all windows and tabs of your browser. Open a new tab, ensuring Wix.com is not open. Follow the steps for your browser below:

Chrome:
Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (press Cmd + Shift + Delete using a Mac).
Click the drop-down next to Time range and select All time.
Make sure the box is checked next to Cached images and files.
Click Clear data.
Close and reopen Chrome.

Firefox:
Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (press Cmd + Shift + Delete using a Mac).
Click the drop-down next to Time range to clear: and select Everything.
Make sure the box is checked next to Cache.
Click Clear now.
Close and reopen Firefox.

Safari:
Press Cmd + , to open Preferences.
Click the Advanced tab.
Check the box next to Show Develop menu in menu bar (at the bottom of the window).
Click Develop in Safari's menu bar.
Click Empty Caches.
Close and reopen Safari.

Edge:
Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (press Cmd + Shift + Delete using a Mac).
Make sure the box is checked next to Cached data and files and click Clear.
Close and reopen Microsoft Edge.

Note: Wix supports viewing live sites on Microsoft Edge, however, we do not support the ADI builder on Microsoft Edge. Wix no longer supports live sites on IE11.

title: How can I add a link to my site menu in Wix Editor?
content: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click the Add a menu item icon. Select the link type you want from the left of the panel. Enter the relevant details. Click Done. Enter the item's name into the field. Click Done.

title: How can I add an element to my mobile app using the Wix app?
content: To add an element using the Wix app, go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile App. If needed, switch to editing a different mobile app: tap the mobile app name at the top, then tap the relevant mobile app. Tap Edit. Tap the Screen drop-down at the top and choose the screen you want to edit. Tap + Add Element in the relevant location. Choose the element you want to add. Add the relevant details to the element. Tap Add at the top right.

title: How can I customize the default member signup form in the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor, click **Signup & Login**, and click **Member Signup Form (Default)**. Then go through the tabs to set up the signup form.

**General tab:** Choose which option appears first in the signup window: **New member signup** (the signup option is displayed first) or **Existing member login** (the login option is displayed first). Click **Additional Signup & Login Settings** to manage who can become a member.

**Social & Community tab:** Choose whether or not to allow new members to sign up using their Google or Facebook credentials. If you have a social app such as Wix Blog or Wix Forum installed on your site, there are additional settings: **Signup privacy footnote customization** can be set to **Footnote only** or **Checkbox**, and **Sign up to this site with a public profile** lets you choose whether or not a member's profile is public by default.

**Policies tab:** Decide if you want to include links to your site's terms of use and privacy policy. After enabling either toggle, click the Link icon to set it up.
