title: How can I preview different versions of my dynamic item page in the Wix Editor?
content:
To preview your dynamic item page's unique versions in the Wix Editor:

- Go to your editor.
- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Dynamic Pages**.
- Click the relevant dynamic page.
- Click the drop-down in the **Preview** toolbar and select the version of the dynamic page you want to preview.
- Tip: You can click and drag the **Move** icon on the toolbar to move it in your editor.
- Click **Preview** at the top right of your editor to test the page's functionality.
- Tip: In Preview mode, you can also select other versions of the dynamic page from the **Preview** toolbar.
- Click **Back to Editor** to return to editing your site, or click **Publish** if you are ready to make your changes go live.

title: How can I add default notes to all my Wix invoices and price quotes?
content:
Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Getting paid. Click Invoices & quotes. Go to the relevant tab:

Invoices: Click the Footer notes drop-down. Enter Notes or Terms.

Price Quotes: Scroll down to Default note sections. Enter Notes or Terms.

Tip: You can also edit default notes when creating a new invoice or price quote.

Important: If you add or edit these default notes, your new notes will only appear on invoices and price quotes issued after you've made these changes. Updates will not be applied to past invoices or price quotes retroactively.

title: Can I connect email accounts from different providers to the same domain?
content:
It is not possible to connect email accounts from more than one email provider to the same domain. You can have numerous domain-based emails, but they must be purchased from the same email provider (e.g., only from Google Workspace, or only from GoDaddy).

If you've purchased a Google Workspace business email from Wix and from another provider, you'll have to choose one and cancel the other:

- If you'd like to keep your external email (e.g., your GoDaddy email), you need to cancel your Google Workspace business email. Please make sure to connect your external email.

- If you'd like to keep your Google Workspace business email, you need to cancel your external email. In order to do so, please contact the external provider directly. Please make sure to add the correct records for your Google Workspace business email.

title: Can I import reviews from third-party apps into Wix Reviews?
content: It's now possible to import reviews that you received using third-party apps or on other platforms into Wix Reviews.

title: How can I add an 'About' profile description in Wix Forum?
content: On your live site, click the Login Bar. Click Profile. Click Edit to update your profile name and image. Under Name, enter a profile name. Under Image, click the avatar or image, browse to select a profile image, and click Open. Click Save. To edit the "About" section, enter text introducing yourself and/or click either media icon to add images, GIFs, or Videos. Click Publish. To share an "About" page on social media, click the Show More icon.

title: How can I add and set up a checkout requirement in Wix Stores using the Checkout Requirements app?
content: Add the Wix Checkout Requirements app from the Wix App Market. After adding it, go to Checkout Requirements in your site's dashboard and click **Add Requirement**. Enter a requirement name; customers won't see this name. Select the type of requirement: Minimum quantity of products, Maximum quantity of products, or Minimum order subtotal. Enter the required quantity or subtotal. If you selected minimum or maximum quantity of products, select whether the requirement applies to **Specific products** or **All products**. If you selected **Specific products**, select those products. Choose what happens if customers don't meet the requirement: **Yes, enable checkout but show a warning message** or **No, disable checkout and show error message**. Enter the message text you want customers to see.

title: How can I add tables to my restaurant using the Wix Table Reservations app on the dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Table Reservations. Click Settings at the top right, then click Table management. Click + Add Table. Enter a table name (for example: small table, big table, bar seats). Set the minimum and maximum number of seats. By default, tables are available for guests to book online; deselect the checkbox if you do not want a table to be available online. Repeat to add all of your restaurant's tables, then click Save. Tip: If you want to create a visual floor plan, create tables in the floor plan itself rather than in Table management settings.

title: Can I manually select which products are displayed in the Related Products Gallery in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, when you display a Related Products Gallery, you can choose whether it shows your customers other products from the same category, products frequently bought together (based on data), or frequently viewed together (based on data). It is not possible to hand pick which products are related to each store item.

title: How can I change the currency for accepting payments on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Settings. Click Language & Region. Scroll down to Currency and use the drop-down menu to select your currency. Click Save. The currency in your Wix account must match the currency in your payment provider account (e.g., PayPal, Stripe) to accept payments through your site.

title: How can I customize the Expand Mode in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor, then click Settings. Click the Settings tab on the left and select Open in Expand Mode from the When clicking on an item drop-down. Click the Design tab, then Expand Mode, then Customize Expand Mode. On the right side of the pop-up, customize Info Settings, Viewing Settings, Background Design, Background Filters, and Text & Icon Design. In Info Settings, choose what info is shown (Title, Description, and/or Link), where it appears (Side or Bottom), and when it shows (Always or When clicking info icon). Note: it is not possible to customize the style of the link in Expand Mode. Displaying info to the side of a horizontal image may cause the image to be displayed smaller. In Viewing Settings, enable Allow Full Screen and/or Magnifying Glass, and adjust Magnifying Size. In Background Design, enable Gradient and adjust Color & Opacity 1 and 2 and Gradient direction, or set Background color & opacity. In Background Filters, adjust Blur or enable Grayscale. In Text & Icon Design, set Icon color, Title style, Description style, and Text alignment (Left, Center, or Right). Click Done. To close Expand Mode, click the Exit icon on the top right of the gallery.

title: How can I view and filter my photo album statistics on Wix?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard and click the Album Stats tab. You can view your stats in the relevant section: Overview shows your overall site and album traffic, including Site visits and Album Views; Album stats shows the breakdown by album, including Photos, Views, and Leads. To filter the albums on display, click the Filter by drop-down and choose All albums, Drafts, or Published. To sort your albums, click the Sort icon and choose Newest, Oldest, Album name: A - Z, or Album name: Z - A. To search for a specific album, click the Search icon and search by any word in the title of the album.

title: How can I change the site name that appears in search results using the Wix Editor?
content: The name that appears for your site in search results is the site name tag of your homepage. If you have not entered a site name tag, your title tag is automatically displayed. To change your site name tag in Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the homepage. Click SEO Basics. Click Advanced SEO. Click Additional tags. Click og:site_name and edit the Tag value, then click Apply. Click Publish at the top right of the editor. Search engines will update your site name the next time that they crawl your site. If you want to try to speed up the process, you can submit your page's URL to search engines.

title: How can I create a Wix Payments account to accept payments on my site?
content: Before you begin, you need a published site and a Premium or Studio site plan that allows you to accept payments. In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments and click Connect next to Wix Payments. Wix Payments is not yet available to all users. Enable the toggles of the payment methods you wish to accept through Wix Payments and click Continue. Click Complete Setup. Select an option under Business Type: Individual/Sole Proprietorship, Partnership/Ltd/Liability Co./Corporation/NGO, or Regional account types. For Regional account types, in some countries other business types may be selected which align with local business definitions. Enter your details: Identification information, Address, Bank details, Business information, and Business description. Select the checkbox to accept the Terms & Conditions and service fees, then click Submit. After submitting your details, you are required to go through a verification process.

title: How can I add vector art to my Wix site using the free options available from Wix?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Vector Art. Click or drag your chosen vector art to add it to your page.

title: Can I upload my own custom fonts to my branded app?
content: Currently, you can select various fonts for your branded app's heading and body. However, it is not possible to upload your own fonts.

title: How do I connect Rapyd Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Rapyd Payments. If you already have a Rapyd Payments account, enter your Access Key and Secret Key. To find them, log in to the Rapyd Payments Client portal, go to Settings, click Plugins, click the More Actions icon next to Rapyd x Wix, and select View Keys. Then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Rapyd Payments account, register for a merchant account, and once your merchant account is approved you will be provided with your unique Access Key and Secret Key. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: How can I add Wix Design Guides to my site using the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left, then click Tools, Editor Add-ons, Get Add-ons, and Design Guides.

title: How can I customize the sender details for my email marketing campaigns to ensure a professional look?
content: You have total control over the sender details that appear when your campaigns hit your audience's inboxes. Set sender details (name and reply-to address) that will be familiar to your audience – this can increase the trust in your campaigns which can lead to better sender reputation.

title: Is it possible to create a dropdown that filters its options based on another dropdown's selection?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a user input element (e.g. dropdown, checkbox) that filters its available selections based on another input element's selection. For example, you cannot have a "dish" dropdown display breakfast dishes only when another "meal type" dropdown has "breakfast" selected. To achieve this type of conditional filtering based on another input's selection, you need to custom code a solution using Velo. Learn how to create a cascading form with Velo.

title: How can I download the Check-in by Wix app on my mobile device?
content: To download the Check-in by Wix app, go to the Apple App Store on iPhone or Google Play on Android. Type 'Check-in by Wix' in the search field, then click Get or Install to download the app. Log in with your Wix credentials.

title: Why can't I view images on my site, and how can I fix it?
content: If you are unable to view images on your site, you are likely experiencing a local issue. Clear your browser's cache; view your site using incognito or private browsing mode; view your site in the latest version of another supported browser; temporarily disable any internet security programs installed (e.g. antivirus, firewall) and try to access your site again, preferably while connected to the modem directly; or try viewing your Wix site from a different computer that uses a different network. If you are still unable to view images on your site, contact us with the steps you've tried, the URL and page name as it appears in the editor with the missing images, a screenshot of the issue, the different browsers and browser versions you have tried, and the internet security programs you have installed on your computer (e.g. antivirus, firewall).

title: How can I embed a social media post into a Wix blog post?
content: To embed a social post into a blog post on Wix: Go to the social post that you want to embed and get the embed code. For Facebook, click the More actions icon at the top right of the post and click </> Embed. For Twitter, click the More actions icon at the top right of the post and select </> Embed Tweet. For Instagram, click the More actions icon at the top right of the post and select Embed. For YouTube, click Share under the relevant video and select <> Embed. Copy the code. Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Select the blog post that you want to edit. Click Add. Click HTML code under From The Web. Select HMTL Code on the pop-up. Paste the code you previously copied. (Optional) Adjust the height and width of the element and select left, center, or right alignment for it. Click Save.

title: Can I apply a single password to the entire site in the Studio Editor?
content: It is not currently possible to apply a single password to the entire site. As an alternative, you can manually add a password to each site page from its settings.

title: Can I select a renewal date for product subscriptions in Wix Stores?
content: It is now possible to change the date a subscription is renewed for product subscriptions in Wix Stores.

title: What can I do if Wix Stores notification emails are being sent to a previous business email address?
content: We're aware of the issue and are currently gathering more information regarding this matter. Meanwhile, you can use the following workaround: Navigate to the business info section of your site's dashboard. Remove the existing email address. Click Save. Go back and add the correct email address. Click Save.

title: How can I sync my Wix products to my Etsy seller account using the Etsy Integration app by Webkul?
content: Use the Etsy Integration app by Webkul. To use this app on your site, you need to have Wix Stores, a Premium plan, and a connected domain. The app is only available in English. Its features include exporting your Wix products to your Etsy seller account, category mapping from Wix to Etsy, exporting your Etsy orders to your Wix stores, and syncing inventory on both sides once a product quantity sells on either the Wix store or the Etsy store. Check out the Etsy Integration app by Webkul to get started; for questions and comments, contact Webkul directly.

title: How can I edit the text of a button in a Wix repeater item?
content:
To edit a button text in a Wix repeater item:

- Click the button you want to edit.
- Click **Change Text & Icon**.
- Edit the text in the **What does it say?** field.

title: How can I stop further charges for my Google Workspace business email subscription?
content: When you no longer want your Google Workspace business email service, you can stop any further charges by turning off the auto-renewal. If you change your mind, you can turn the auto-renewal back on prior to the cancellation date.

title: Why can't I open the App Settings Panel in the Editor, and how can I fix it?
content: Normally, you can access the settings for your apps by clicking the app in the Editor and then clicking Settings. If the Settings Panel does not open, it may be because it is blocked by browser settings or by ad blocking browser extensions / add-ons, such as AdBlock. Check whether popups are blocked by your browser: Chrome, Firefox, Internet Explorer, Microsoft Edge, or Safari. In your browser settings, check to see if any browser extensions / add-ons that block popups are enabled. Another way to test if ads are blocked on your computer is to open your browser window in incognito mode. If you are able to see ads, disable your browser extensions and Internet monitoring software applications one at a time. This may help you determine which ones are blocking your ads.

title: Can I use a drag-and-drop feature to upload files to a CMS collection on my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible for your site visitors to drag and drop files onto your site to upload them to a CMS (Content Management System) collection. However, you can allow site visitors to upload files to a collection by setting up a clickable upload button.

title: Is it possible to set a pinned header to not overlap with the first section in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set the pinned header to not overlap the next section. You can use the Freeze scroll effect instead, as it pins the header while letting you choose whether or not it overlaps. To do this, you also need to disable the Advanced settings toggle in the Inspector.

title: Can I change the purchase flow when clients book a plan-only service with Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the purchase flow when your clients purchase a pricing plan in order to book a plan-only service. At present, they select a plan, go to the Checkout Page, sign up or log in to your site, complete payment, go to the Thank You Page, then select the date/time of the session they want to book and proceed with the booking. For example, it is not possible to change the order of these actions so that clients sign up after completing payment, or book the service and buy the plan in the same transaction.

title: Can I change the button text on my Wix Music Player?
content: Currently, you can customize the background colors, fonts, and button styles of your Wix Music Player, but you cannot change the button text.

title: how to transfer a business email away from Wix
content: Yes. To transfer a Google Workspace business email from your Wix account to Google, contact Wix Customer Care for assistance. This action disconnects the Workspace business email from your Wix account. This is an irreversible action: once transferred to Google, you cannot repurchase the business email through Wix.

title: How can I offer real-time shipping rates on my Wix site using third-party apps?
content:
Using third-party apps, you can offer real-time shipping rates on your Wix site. The calculation is made at checkout for each customer, based on what they purchase and where they are located. In addition to shipping options created through a third-party app, you can offer shipping options created in Wix (e.g. standard shipping and store pickup).

To add an app that offers real-time rates:
- Wix Editor: Go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side, search for the shipping app you want to integrate, and click Add to Site.
- Studio Editor: Go to your editor, click App Market on the left side, search for the shipping app you want to integrate, and click Add to Site.
- Dashboard: Go to the Wix App Market in your site's dashboard, search for the shipping app you want to integrate, and click Add to Site.

Set up shipping rules in the app: go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard, click Open next to the relevant app, and refer to the app's help information to learn how to set up shipping rules.

Enable the rule in relevant shipping regions: go to Shipping & fulfillment settings in your site's dashboard, select a shipping region, scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or pickup options you created, enable the toggle next to the shipping app, and if your app has a Rate at checkout field, enter a rate. Repeat for any additional regions. You must enable the app in each region where you want customers to see it.

When a shipping app is enabled, customers see any shipping options you created that are relevant for their region. If your shipping app is temporarily unable to supply a rate, customers will see a backup rate (if the app supports backup rates and you entered one) or any other delivery options you set up. If none of these are available, customers cannot check out.

When you receive a new order, you see which shipping option your customer chose. You can use this method to fulfill your order, but you don't have to. You're free to fulfill the order using any shipping method you choose.

title: How can I display product prices as a range in my Wix Store?
content: If you created product options with different prices, you can indicate that the price has a range. In your site's dashboard, go to Store products & inventory settings. Scroll down to the Price Range settings. Click the Show "From" next to the price toggle to enable it.

title: How can I book a session and accept payment using Wix Retail POS?
content:
To book a session and accept payment using Wix Retail POS:

Important: To check if a service provider is available, go to your booking calendar on desktop or in the Wix app.

Book sessions:
- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap Checkout on the bottom bar.
- Tap Services.
- Tap the relevant service.
- (Optional) Add additional services, store products, or a custom charge.
- Tap Select Customer to assign a customer to the sale. Select Create a new customer by tapping +New Customer, entering the details, and tapping Save; or select a saved customer by searching for the customer's name, email, or phone number or scrolling down and selecting the customer.
- Tap Charge at the bottom right.
- Choose the relevant payment method:
  - Card: Tap Card; use the card reader to swipe, dip (insert) or tap the card; optionally tap Email Receipt, Print Receipt, or Add a Note; tap Done.
  - Cash: Tap Cash; select the amount received from your customer; if applicable, give your customer their change listed under Change Due; optionally tap Print Receipt, Email Receipt, Text Receipt, or Add a Note; tap Done.
  - Gift Card: Tap Gift Card; enter or scan the gift card code and tap Apply; if there is still money owed, click Add Payment and process the balance using another payment method; optionally tap Print Receipt, Email Receipt, Text Receipt, or Add a Note; tap Done.

After payment is completed, the service is added to your calendar. The service provider is set as the default staff member and the date is the current date. The time is added in the past since sessions are often paid for upon completion.

title: I can't select or find an element in the Wix Editor. How can I locate and select it?
content: If you are unable to select or find an element in the editor, it may be placed behind another element. Use the Layers panel: open your editor, click the Layers icon at the bottom of the editor, click Header, Page or Footer, then find the relevant element on the list and select it. If the element is behind another element, right-click the covering element, hover over Overlapping Items, and select the relevant element. If that does not work, right-click the covering element, hover over Arrange, and click Move Backward until you can access the desired element. If you see an element on your live site or in Preview mode but not in the editor, it might be outside the site's gridlines; hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift and press M to scroll through the elements until you reach the desired element. Also make sure your header and footer are not frozen; you can unfreeze them by selecting a new scroll setting or disabling the Freeze option. If you still cannot select an element, contact support.

title: How can I optimize my website's on-page SEO using Wix tools?
content: Use your chosen keywords to optimize on-page elements such as title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and URLs. Add keywords thoughtfully to headlines, body text, and other relevant areas, and tailor each page to different keywords within a related topic. Use the Wix SEO Assistant to help optimize your site's pages for search engines; it identifies potential issues and gives recommendations to improve your page's content, structure, and SEO attributes. Regularly monitor and analyze your website's performance with tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console, and scan your site's pages for issues using the Wix Site Inspection tool.

title: Can I refund ticket purchases directly through Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to refund ticket purchases for your guests in Wix Events. Instead, the refund must be processed directly through the payment gateway used for the purchase (e.g. PayPal, Stripe), and the guest must be manually removed from the guest list.

title: How can I enable cross-site tracking in my browser to resolve reCAPTCHA issues on Wix?
content:
To enable cross-site tracking in your browser, follow the steps below for your browser:

**Google Chrome:**
- Open the Chrome browser on your computer.
- Click the More Actions icon in the top right.
- Select **Settings**.
- Select **Privacy and security** in the left sidebar.
- Select **Cookies and other site data**.
- Disable the **Send a "Do not track" request with their browsing traffic** toggle.

**Safari:**
- Open the Safari browser on your computer.
- Select **Safari**.
- Select **Settings**.
- Click **Privacy**.
- Uncheck the **Prevent cross-site tracking** box.

**Mozilla Firefox:**
- Open the Firefox browser on your computer.
- Click the Menu button.
- Select **Settings**.
- Select **Privacy & Security**.
- Click **Only when Firefox is set to block known trackers**.

**Microsoft Edge:**
- Open the Edge browser on your computer.
- Select the Settings and More icon.
- Select **Settings**.
- Select **Privacy, search, and services**.
- Select **Balanced** under **Tracking prevention**.

title: How can I add and set up an HTML Embed Element in ADI to display external content on my site?
content: Add external content onto a section of your site using the HTML Embed Element. To add the HTML Embed Element, click Add on the top bar inside ADI, click Section to Page, click HTML Embed, then choose a section design to display your embedded element. Fill in the panel on the left: Title, Subtitle, Paragraph, HTML (click Settings to customize your embedded content), Embed Type (choose HTML, JS, and CSS in HTML syntax or websites via URL; adding an HTTP Website Address in the field automatically removes the prefix, leaving the preset HTTPS prefix), Paste Your Code, Width (drag the slider to change the width of the iframe), and Height (drag the slider to change the height of the iframe). Optionally, click Section Design to choose a new design or customize the color, text settings and height. Embedded content that is not HTTPS may be blocked by your web browser. See our guidelines and limitations of embedding code in Wix.

title: How can I delete an email marketing campaign in Wix, and what happens after I delete it?
content: To delete a campaign, go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Most recent email campaigns. Hover over the relevant campaign and click the More Actions icon. Click Delete, then click Delete again to confirm. After deletion, the campaign is no longer viewable at its previous URL or in your Email Marketing dashboard. The email will still appear in the inbox of your recipients, but the campaign and its links will no longer be possible to view in a browser. If you think you might need the campaign sometime in the future, you can archive it instead.

title: How can I change the layout of my Wix Forum's main page and post page?
content:
To customize your forum layout, click the Wix Forum app in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Layout tab. Choose what you would like to edit: Main page layout or Post Page Layout.

Main page layout:
- Choose a Main Page layout, an option available if you display categories on your forum. Classic is an organized, classic layout, better for forums with lots of text. Cards is a beautiful masonry layout to showcase posts.
- Show subcategories: Click the Show subcategories toggle to enable or disable subcategories. Enabled means any subcategories you've created will be shown on your main forum page. Disabled means any subcategories you've created will be hidden from your main forum page.
- Show header: Click the Show header toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled means a header is displayed on the main forum page. Disabled means no header is displayed on the main forum page.
- Header height: Drag the slider to change the size of the header.
- Header text alignment: Choose to have your header aligned to the left or to the right. Left displays header text aligned to the left. Centered displays header text centered.

Post Page Layout:
- Click the Post Page tab to customize the post page layout.
- Choose a Posts Page layout. Classic is an organized, classic layout, better for forums with lots of text. Cards is a beautiful masonry layout to showcase posts. If you selected the Cards layout, click to select a card size.
- Show header: Click the Show header toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled means a header is displayed on category pages. Disabled means no header is displayed on category pages.
- Header height: Drag the slider to change the size of the header.
- Header text alignment: Choose to have your header aligned to the left or to the right. Left displays header text aligned to the left. Centered displays header text centered.

title: How can I add a vertical menu to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Select Menu & Anchor. Select Vertical Menus. Click or drag your chosen menu to add it to your site.

title: How can I continue tracking events on Facebook pixel or Conversion API after Facebook's announced tracking changes?
content: To continue tracking events on Facebook pixel or Conversion API: Verify your domain on Facebook. This is a mandatory step. Verify your domain as soon as you can so that your tracking is unaffected when Facebook enforces the policy changes. Then choose the 8 events that will be used for conversion tracking. If you do not select events, Facebook will automatically assign events for you. Note: Facebook's Conversion API (CAPI) is also subject to iOS14 changes and is not a solution for complying with the new policy.

title: 什么情况下应将短语否定改为精确否定？如何操作？
content: 当某个短语否定包含与产品相关的词、可能误伤相关搜索词时，才把它标记为有风险的短语否定，并建议改为精确否定，以缩小否定范围；如果短语不包含与产品相关的词，则不要标记为有风险。操作上，在审计报告的“短语否定改为精确否定”部分逐条按“当前短语否定 | 建议的精确否定词”列出，也就是每个建议都必须给出具体的精确否定词，不能只给方向；同时单批移除否定词不超过 20 个。判断要以产品描述为依据，每条结论都标注来源 [输入数据] 或 [模型推测]；数据不足时先列出还需要哪些数据并停下来询问，不要先给结论。

title: Can I transfer sites between different workspaces in Wix Studio?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer sites between different workspaces in Wix Studio. As a workaround, you can transfer the site to another account and then back to your original account, choosing the desired workspace in the process.

title: Can I configure an action button from the outer widget to open the panels of the inner widget in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, when you have a widget-in-widget, you cannot configure an action button from the outer widget to open the panels of the inner one.

title: Can I upload my own screenshots to Store Listings in the Branded app?
content: Currently, in the Branded app, it is not possible to upload your own screenshots to Store Listings when preparing to submit your app to the App Store and Google Play. As a workaround, you can upload your own screenshots to the Wix Chatbot. Once you submit them, the Branded App by Wix submissions team will get notified and upload the screenshots to Store Listings on your behalf. Make sure your screenshots meet the Apple and Google requirements: Apple requires 3 images for the 3 different device types (sizes 6.5, 5.5, and 12.9). Google requires specifications for an app icon, feature graphic, and phone screenshots.

title: How can I update the og:image for my Wix site when sharing on LinkedIn?
content: Set an og:image for each page of your site you want to share from inside the Editor. Log in to LinkedIn. Go to the LinkedIn Post Inspector: https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/. Enter the URL of the page, article, or blog post that you want to share. The preview of your LinkedIn Post should now show the correct image. Important: LinkedIn uses its own criteria to choose the best title, description, and image for the pages that get shared on it. While it's likely that LinkedIn will use the information that you added in your Editor, it's not guaranteed. After you change your page information, it can take up to a week for the new information to appear in LinkedIn shares.

title: How do I connect my Skrill Digital Wallet to my Wix site as a payment method?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Skrill Digital Wallet. If you already have an account, enter your Merchant ID, E-Mail, Secret Word, and MQI/API Password. Sign in to your Skrill account and go to Settings > Developer Settings to create your Secret Word and API Password; your Merchant ID can be seen at the top right of your Skrill account. Then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Skrill account and register with Skrill. Once your Skrill account has been verified, retrieve your Merchant ID from the top right of your Skrill account. Still in Skrill, go to Settings > Developer Settings to create your Secret Word and API Password. Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I make an element follow the cursor in the Studio Editor?
content: You can now use mouse effects to make an element follow the visitor's cursor.

title: How can I start a new group chat in the Spaces App?
content:
To start a new group chat in the Spaces App:

- Go to your site in the Spaces App.
- Tap the Inbox icon at the bottom of the screen.
- Tap New Message.
- Tap New Group Chat.
- Add members to your group by selecting the checkboxes next to their names.
- Tap Next.
- Enter a name for your group.
- (Optional) Add a group image.
- Tap Create Group Chat.

title: How can I purchase a Studio template from the Wix Marketplace?
content:
To buy a Studio template in the Wix Marketplace:
- Go to the Studio Templates page in the Wix Marketplace.
- Browse the Studio templates and click the one you want to purchase.
- Click View Template to preview the template and use the device icons at the top to switch views.
- Click Purchase.
- Complete the checkout process and click Continue.
- Review your details and click Place Order to confirm.
- Click Add to Sites to start using your template.

Note: Studio plans are not included with templates. Some templates might include apps that require additional payment.

title: How can I add product categories to the mobile site menu using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add product categories to your mobile site menu using the Wix Editor:

- Click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of your editor.
- Click the site menu, then click the Settings icon.
- Click Set as Advanced, then click Set as Advanced again to confirm.
- Click the menu in your editor and, if Manage Menu is not already open, click Manage Menu.
- Click + Add Menu Item at the bottom.
- Select Link, then select Page on the left.
- Select Category Page from the Which Page? drop-down.
- Select the category you want to display from the Which item? drop-down.
- Click Done.
- (Optional) Rename the category.
- (Optional) Drag categories to make them into subcategories.

title: How can I continue accepting Giropay payments if it's no longer supported by Wix Payments?
content: Giropay is no longer supported as a payment method for Wix Payments. If you're a Wix Payments user who wishes to continue accepting Giropay, you can do so by connecting Mollie as a payment provider for Giropay payments. You can still process your other active payment methods through Wix Payments. To do this, connect Mollie and enable only the Giropay payment method toggle.

title: How do I connect my Wix site to Avalara for automatic tax calculation?
content:
Before you begin, remove any previous tax setting in a merchant account (e.g., PayPal). Avalara is available for sites upgraded to a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports automated sales tax. Note that you cannot connect the same Avalara account to multiple sites.

To connect: Go to Tax in your site's dashboard. Click Automate Your Tax at the top right. Select the Avalara Service Terms & Conditions checkbox and click Continue. Enter your details to set up your Avalara account, using the exact address of your main business location. Click Create Account (this might take a minute).

title: Can I use checkout.com as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer checkout.com as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through checkout.com and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I delete my Wix Forum using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your Forum page: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click your Forum page. Hover over your forum page and click the More Actions icon. Click Delete. Click Delete to confirm.

title: How can I customize the 'Out of Stock' message in my Wix Store's Product Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor and go to the page with the gallery you want to customize. Click the gallery on your page. Click Settings. Edit the text: click the Text tab and edit the 'Out of Stock' text.

title: Can I use variable fonts in the Studio Editor for my site's typography?
content: Currently, variable fonts are not supported in the Studio Editor. If you need to use multiple typefaces of the same font (e.g. Light, Bold, Semi-Bold), you can upload them as individual font files.

title: How can I edit a price quote in Wix if my client hasn't accepted it yet?
content:
If your client hasn't accepted the quote yet, you can still edit it. To edit a price quote, go to Price Quotes in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant quote, and select Edit from the drop-down menu. Edit the relevant details, then do one of the following:

- Click Update to save your quote and go back to the dashboard.
- Click Next to print or send the quote.

Your client doesn't get a new email after editing the quote. The link in the original email automatically leads to the updated quote.

title: How can I feature specific blog posts on my Wix site using the Post List element?
content: To feature specific blog posts on your Wix site using the Post List element: In your site's dashboard, go to Blog. Click Create New Post or hover over an existing post and click Edit. Click the Settings tab on the left side panel. Enable the Set as Featured Post toggle. Click Publish at the top right. Then go to the page where you want to place the featured posts and add the Post List element from your editor's Add panel: click Pages, select the page, click Add Elements, click Blog, and click your preferred Post List. Click the Post List in your editor, click Settings, click the Settings tab, and enable the Show Featured Posts only toggle. You can also set the Post List to display posts from a specific category or tag, and set the number of posts to display. To customize the look, click the Post List and click Settings, then choose Display, Layout, or Design options.

title: Can I create an invoice with Wix Automations?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create an invoice with Wix Automations. Wix Bookings exception: It is possible to send payment requests (invoices) to Wix Bookings clients using Wix Automations.

title: Amazon 销量/库存/订单和竞品评论分别应通过什么数据源获取？
content: Amazon 销量/库存/订单 → SP-API（A 类，可自动化）；竞品页面/评论 → 多数平台无开放 API（C 类，暂缓 Agent 化）。

title: Can I add a multi-line text input as a custom panel element in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it's not possible to add a multi-line text input as a Blocks custom panel element. This limits text inputs to a single line.

title: How can I optimize the SEO settings for my site's secondary language using the Wix Editor?
content: Before optimizing, choose the three keywords that are most likely to reach people in your secondary language. In the Wix Editor, click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top of the editor and select the secondary language you want to work on. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, and click SEO basics. Enter your page's title tag and meta description in the relevant language. Make sure that the toggle next to Let search engines index this page is enabled, then click Publish at the top right of the editor. For title tags, keep the title tag between 10-70 characters, include a target keyword for each individual page, add your business or site name as well as the page's name (for example, “Page Name | Business Name”), make the title tag unique to that page, and include your business location in your homepage title tag. For meta descriptions, keep the meta description between 50 and 320 characters long, including spaces (Google trims the description at 320 characters), combine keywords that best describe your business and that visitors would probably use to search for your site, and make the meta description unique to that page. You can also update your Social Share settings for each language.

title: Can I customize the design of the password window on a password protected page?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the design of the window that is displayed on password protected pages. The window's fonts and colors are taken from the Site Styles panel. Updating these options changes the look of the window.

title: How do I add a new slide to a slideshow or delete a slide in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a new slide: click the slideshow in your editor, click Manage Slides, then click Add New Slide at the bottom. To delete a slide: click the slideshow in your editor, click Manage Slides, hover over the relevant slide and click the More Actions icon, then click Delete.

title: How can I reorder my programs using the Wix App?
content: To reorder your programs from the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap the Site & App icon. Tap Customize under Members App. Tap Online Programs under Edit Navigation Tabs. Tap Edit Programs List. Tap Customize Section. Under the Sorting section, select the Select Manually checkbox. Tap Open Display Settings. Tap and drag a program to reorder it in the list. The programs automatically rearrange themselves on the page. Tap Save. Tip: You can also reorder or hide your programs from the Editor.

title: Can I limit clients to cancel their subscription within a set timeframe once they purchase it?
content: Currently, you can allow clients to cancel their own subscriptions anytime. However, it is not possible to limit clients to cancel their subscription within a set timeframe once they purchase it.

title: How can I add padding to a container in Editor X?
content: Click the container in your Editor. Click the Padding drop-down in the Inspector. Enter the padding values for the top, bottom, right or left of the container. You can define the padding for each side of the container individually, in pixels (px), percentage (%), viewport width (vw), and viewport height (vh). Padding can also be defined per breakpoint.

title: I want to customize a booking form.
content: You can add custom fields to your booking form, edit the form field labels, and create a custom form for a specific service. You can also customize the page title, buttons and design of your form page from the Editor.

title: Can I search for products by SKU codes in a store search box?
content: Currently, you cannot search for products by SKU codes in a store search box.

title: How can I create a custom CMS role with specific permissions for my team in Wix?
content: To create a custom CMS role in Wix, go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Roles at the top. Click + Create New Role. Enter the Role Title and Description in the relevant fields. Click CMS in the Permissions section. Select the checkboxes next to the permissions you want to assign to the role: View Content, Add Content, Manage Backups, Manage Indexes, and Manage Collections. Optionally, select more permissions from other areas such as Editor, Sites, and Stores to add them to the role. Click Save.

title: How can I add a cancellation and no-show fee to my Wix booking policy?
content: Go to Booking Policies in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant policy or click + Add a New policy and add all relevant details. Select the Charge cancellation and no-show fees checkbox. Click the Edit icon next to Paid window. Select the relevant timeframe from the Cancellations or no-shows drop-down. Under Fee, enter the fee amount and select the relevant icon to choose whether it is a Fixed amount or a Percentage of the session's price. Then click the Checkmark icon. Optionally, click Add a later window to create an additional paid window and repeat the relevant steps. Make sure to repeat the steps above for each of your booking policies to reduce your cancellations and no-shows.

title: How can I create and customize a promotional video for a product in my Wix Store?
content:
In your site's dashboard, go to Store Products and click the relevant product. Click Promote this product on the right, then click the right arrow and select Promotional Video. Then do one of the following:

- Save a video as is: Preview the video or videos created for you, click to select the video you want to save, then click Save & Share.
- Customize the video: Preview the video or videos created for you and click Customize Video. Customize the video content by clicking the Plus icon to add additional media, editing Product Name, adding Business Name, editing the Price you want to display, and adding a Call to Action text to drive potential customers back to your store, then click Next. Customize the video design by selecting Video Style, Layout (horizontal, vertical, or square), Main Color, Secondary Color, and Font Style, then click Next. Customize the background music by optionally clicking the Music On toggle on the right to disable the background music, clicking Play to preview a track, clicking the track you want to use to select it, then clicking Next.

Optionally, display business info at the end of the video by clicking the Include info at the end of this video toggle to enable it, uploading your business logo, and entering the business info you want to display. Click Apply & Preview to view your video. Click Back to Editing to make more changes, or Save & Share to save a high definition version of your video. Optionally, to share your video on social media or download your video, click Upload / Download under the relevant option.

title: How can I connect PayU Poland as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: On your Wix site, go to Accept Payments in your dashboard and confirm your business location. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers, and click Connect next to PayU. If you already have an approved PayU Poland account, enter the Pos id, Second key, and Client secret you received, click Connect, then log in to PayU Poland and open Online Payments, My Shops, and POS. Open your store link and click Disable next to each payment method under Automatic Collection, making sure the value is set to "No". If you do not have an account, create a PayU account using the Create PayU account link, complete the requested personal and company details, accept the agreement, upload company documents, send the amount to PayU's bank account for verification, and set up your PayU Merchant Panel. After PayU approves your account, retrieve the Pos id, Second key, and Client secret from PayU Poland and return to the Accept Payments tab to finish connecting your account.

title: Can I create multiple dashboard pages for my app in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, you can create only one dashboard page for your app in Blocks. Dashboard pages are backoffice pages used to configuring your app.

title: What steps should I ask my site visitors to follow if they are experiencing issues with Wix Video on my site?
content:
If your site visitors are experiencing issues with Wix Video on your site, provide them with these troubleshooting steps:

- Clear your browser's cache and cookies.
- Update your browser to the latest version.
- Try to recreate the issue on different browsers and see if it still happens.
- Disable all of your browser add-ons (extensions and plugins) for the duration of the troubleshoot.
- Disable any anti-virus software for the duration of the troubleshoot.
- Try a different computer.
- Try a different internet connection.

If the issue persists after following these steps, request that the visitor send a screenshot of the Developer Tools view of your site from Google Chrome. Here is how they can do it:

- Open your site in a Google Chrome incognito window (Ctrl + Shift + N).
- Use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + J (on PC) or Cmd + Option + J (on Mac).
- Click the Console tab at the top of the panel and refresh the page (F5).
- Navigate to the page on the site where the issue occurs and take any action necessary to recreate the issue.
- Take a screenshot of what you see on the Console tab.
- Click the Network tab at the top of the panel and take the action again (Tip: if the issue is on your live site you may need to refresh the page).
- Take a screenshot of what you see on the Network tab.

Ask them to send you this information so you can investigate the issue further.

title: How can I tag store products in a Facebook post using Wix Stores?
content: Add an image or video to your Facebook business page. Click the More Actions icon. Click Tag Products. Click the image and then click to select the relevant product. Click Done Tagging & Save on the bottom left. Click Post.

title: How do I enable and customize breadcrumbs on my Wix site?
content: On your Wix site, enable Velo Dev Mode first: click Dev Mode at the top of your Editor, then enable the Enable Developer Mode toggle. Important: this feature is not yet available to all users. Then add breadcrumbs: click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, select Menu & Anchor, select Breadcrumbs, and click and drag a design to your page. To choose what displays, click the breadcrumbs element in the Editor, click Settings, and use the options: Full trail shows both the homepage and the current page; Hide homepage hides the homepage from the trail; Hide current page hides the current page from the trail. For Display 'Homepage' as, choose Text or Icon; for Icon, click the icon below Homepage Icon to choose an icon from Wix or upload your own vector art. To show breadcrumbs on all pages, right-click the breadcrumbs in your Editor and enable the Show on All Pages toggle. You can also customize the layout and design of your breadcrumbs.

title: Is it possible to connect my Wix Blocks app to GitHub and use a CLI to manage my code?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect your Blocks app to GitHub and use a command line interface (CLI) to write, test, and publish code locally on your computer, as is possible for Wix sites.

title: How can I add a calendar to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor. Type "Calendar" in the search field and press Enter. Scroll through the available calendar apps. Note that the Google Event Calendar and Wix Bookings apps are created by Wix. Select the app you want to add, click Add to Site, click the app in the Editor, and click Settings to set up the app.

title: How can I add and set up a standalone Book Button in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add and set up a standalone Book Button in the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor and open the relevant page where you want to add a book button.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Bookings, then click Book Button.
- Drag and drop the Book Button element onto the page.
- Click the Book Button in the Editor, then click Settings.
- Select where visitors are directed when they click the button: The Service List directs clients to your complete list of services. A Specific Service directs clients to one service; select a service by clicking the Expand icon, then choose whether visitors go to that service's Bookings Calendar to choose a day and time, or to the relevant Service Page to learn more about your service.
- Optionally, enter new button text.
- Optionally, replace the icon that appears on the button by clicking the Replace icon, then upload or select an icon and click Choose File.
- Click the Layout, Design, and Animation icons to customize the button.
Note: The standalone Book Button is not currently available in Editor X.

title: Is there a Wix app for offering a rental service for cars or sports gear?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a dedicated app for renting cars, sports gear and equipment, inflatables, or second-hand high fashion. However, you can add the third-party app Twice Rentals to your site directly from the Wix App Market.

title: How can I create a branded site using the Wix Logo Maker with a Just Logo or Free plan?
content: To create a branded site with a Just Logo or Free plan, use the Brand Studio: click the My Brands drop-down at the top, select the relevant brand, scroll to the Get a branded website section, hover over the website template, and click Choose a Website. Choose a website type such as Online Store, Basic Website, or Landing Page. Click Edit this website, customize your site as much as you want, then click Save and Publish when you are ready. Available templates vary depending on your Wix Logo plan.

title: How can I add a Members Area Login Bar to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Community, click Login Bar, then click or drag and drop the login bar to add it to your page.

title: How can I connect PayZen by Lyra as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect beside PayZen - - Connexion aux banques françaises. If you have an account, enter your ShopID and Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create PayZen - - Connexion aux banques françaises account, fill in the sign up form and proceed with the Lyra account verification. Once the Lyra account is approved, sign in to your account to retrieve your account credentials (Shop ID and Key). Return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I create a new form using the Wix Forms dashboard?
content: Go to Forms in your site's dashboard. Click **+ Create Form** at the top right. Create and customize your form in the form builder. Click **Save**. Click **Back to Forms** at the top left. (Optional) Add the form you just created to your site: click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant form, click **Add to site**, click **Go to Editor**, click **Add Existing Form**, then select the form you just created.

title: How can I change the regional settings for a language on my Wix multilingual site?
content: Open your Editor, click the Switch Languages panel at the top, and click Manage Languages. Next to the relevant language, click the More Actions icon, then click Set regional format. Click the Region drop-down and select your chosen locale, then click Save.

title: Can I connect widget API events to Wix-Automations in Wix Blocks?
content: No. Currently in Blocks, it’s not possible to connect widget API events to Wix-Automations so that an event in your app triggers an automation.

title: How can I set up pickup and delivery options for my restaurant using the Wix dashboard?
content:
In your site's dashboard, go to Pickup and Delivery. Select what you want to set up:

- Pickup: Enable the toggle next to your address/hours to activate pickup on your site. Click the Edit icon. Set your Pickup Hours by selecting the checkboxes next to the relevant days and entering your pickup hours. Optionally, click the Plus icon to add more than one timeframe. Optionally, adjust your Pickup settings, including Order minimum and Pickup instructions. Click Save.
- Delivery: Click +Add a Delivery Area, enter a name for the area, and choose how to define the area under Set area by: Radius, ZIP / postal codes, or Draw on map. Click Save. Set your availability by selecting the relevant days and entering your delivery hours. Optionally, click the Plus icon to add more than one timeframe. Adjust your Delivery settings by entering your estimated delivery time and a minimum order amount and / or delivery fee. To offer free delivery above a certain amount, select Offer free delivery above a certain subtotal and enter the minimum subtotal customers must reach. Click Save. Optionally, click + Add a Delivery Area to add another delivery area.
- Default fulfillment method: If you offer both pickup and delivery, click Change Default and select the method that should be preselected when customers visit your site.

title: Can I integrate DoorDash Drive with Wix Restaurant Orders?
content: Yes. You can now use DoorDash Drive as a delivery partner with the new Wix Restaurant Orders app.

title: Is it possible to log directly into my Wix Payments account with Two-Factor Authentication?
content: Currently, it is not possible to log directly in to your Wix Payments account with Two-Factor Authentication. You can always access Wix Payments by logging into your Wix account and following these instructions. In the meantime, take a look at some of the alternative options to enable Two-Factor Authentication for your Wix account: SecureAuth Single-Sign-On (SSO) for Wix, OneLogin for Wix, SAASPASS for Wix.

title: How can I change the order of products in a category in Wix Stores?
content:
To reorder products in a category, go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant category. Click and drag the products to change the order. Click Save.

Tip: If you're using the Category Page, you can override the product order you set in the dashboard. Click the Category Page in your editor, click Settings, and select the Sorting tab. You can select an order choice from the Order products by drop-down.

title: How can I use the Members Area to help clients manage their bookings on my Wix site?
content: When using Wix Bookings, a member page called My Bookings is automatically added to your Members Area. This page lets clients view and manage their bookings or appointments, leading to higher engagement.

title: How can I set up a flat rate shipping option for my Wix store using the Wix app?
content:
To set up flat rate shipping in your Wix store using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Sales.
- Tap Orders.
- Tap the Settings icon.
- Select Set shipping.
- Tap the region you want to set up.
- Tap the Shipping method drop-down and select Flat Rate.
- Tap Next.
- Create a delivery option: enter a title in the Delivery Option Name field; optionally enter a time in the Est. Delivery Time field; enter the shipping fee in the Rate field; optionally select the Offer free Shipping when... checkbox, enter the price above which shipping is free, and tap Done.
- Optionally create an additional option by tapping +Add Shipping Option and follow the instructions above.
- Optionally add a handling fee: select the Add a handling fee to every order checkbox, enter the fee amount, and tap Save.
- Tap Save.
- Tap Save again.

title: How can I connect Splitit as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Splitit as a payment provider on Wix: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, check your business location at the top right and change it via the drop-down menu if incorrect, click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Splitit. If you already have a Splitit account, enter your API Username, App Password and API KEY, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Splitit account and sign up; your TAX/VAT/GST (or equivalent) number is required. When you receive the confirmation email from Splitit, click Activate My Account and establish a password for your Splitit portal. In the Splitit portal, retrieve credentials via Credentials > Splitit Integration Credentials > Reveal API Keys and via Credentials > Gateway Provider Credentials > Payment Terminal API Key. Then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Does Wix Stores support a store locator or postcode search feature?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a store locator or postcode search feature. As an alternative, check out the Located - Store Locator third-party app, or add one by embedding external code.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site is GDPR-compliant when it comes to cookies?
content: GDPR requires that you get affirmative consent from site visitors before placing non-essential cookies on their device. You can use the Wix Privacy Center to add a cookie banner to your site. With a cookie banner, your visitors can give their consent to non-essential cookies to be placed on their device. If your site is based in France, or has French site visitors, Wix recommends adding a 'Decline All' button to your cookie banner, as per the revised guidelines from the French data authority (CNIL). You can also learn more about which cookies are placed on your site-visitors' browsers to help ensure compliance.

title: Can I add custom code to my Branded App or integrate it with Velo?
content: Currently it is not possible to add custom code or integrate the Branded App with Velo. The Branded App gives individuals and businesses the ability to design a native mobile app and add features and content without needing any prior coding knowledge. Most of the process is done in the Branded App dashboard of your Wix account.

title: How do I choose a campaign goal for my Facebook Ads campaign using Wix?
content: Before you begin, make sure you've connected your Facebook Page, upgraded to a Premium Plan, published your site, and connected a domain. Then go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard, click Let's Start, click the goal you want to use for this campaign, and click Continue. Note: If this is your first time creating a campaign, you need to first complete the campaign setup steps. If you've already done this, click Create Ad. Once you choose a campaign goal for your business, you cannot change it.

title: How can I customize the header of my site on the Fit by Wix app?
content:
On the Fit by Wix app, you customize your header as follows:

* Tap **Edit Header** at the top left.
* Choose what to customize:
   * **Name:** Enter the name of your business.
   * **Tagline:** Show or hide a custom tagline (a slogan or a short announcement). This can also appear on your site info.
   * **Logo:** Add your logo so that clients can easily recognize your business. You can also disable the toggle if you don't want your logo to display in the header.
   * **Cover photo:** Upload a cover photo to make your site stand out with your brand. You can add multiple photos to create a slideshow that your members can scroll through.
   * **Theme Color:** Choose your button color, accent color, and header color (if you don't upload a cover photo). You can also create your own custom color.
* Choose what information to show and hide in your header:
   * **Show Member Count:** Show or hide the number of members in your site and their profile images.
   * **Show Invite Button:** Show or hide the button that allows members to invite more people to your site.
   * **Show Custom Button:** Add a custom button and decide where it should take your members. For example, a Book Now button could send members to your booking or appointments tab.
* Tap **Save.**

title: How can I add the Restaurants Orders app in Editor X?
content: Click the App Market icon on the top of Editor X. Start typing "Restaurant Orders" in the search field and select it from the list. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I translate my Wix Store pages using the Wix Editor?
content: Start by adding and setting up Wix Multilingual. In your editor, translate the Product Page, Cart Page, and Thank You page. If you use the Category Page, you can translate that as well. Go to the main language version in your editor, click the Switch Language drop-down menu at the top left of the editor, and select the language you want to manage. Go to a store page (e.g. the Product Page) and click to select it. Click Settings. Click the Text tab. Update the relevant text as needed. If you changed this default English text, you need to manually translate it.

title: Can I connect my business phone number to a landline?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect your business phone number to a landline phone number.

title: Why are the new animations I added not playing on my Wix live site?
content: Your new animation may not be playing on your live site because you have not published your changes. Updates need to be published to be reflected on your live site. To publish site changes, go to your editor, click Publish at the top right, optionally click View Site to be taken to your live site, and click Done.

title: How can I allow my fans to name their price for downloading a single on Wix Music?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Music Library. Click the relevant single. Click Edit next to Single Info. Scroll down to the Sale and Download Options on Your Site section. Select Let fans name their price from the Album Download Options drop-down menu. Enter a minimum price for your single. If you want the minimum price to be 0, you can ask your fans to subscribe to your mailing list to download your music. Use the toggle: Enabled means fans must enter their email in order to download your music; Disabled means fans are not required to enter their email. Click Save. If you are using Wix Payments as your payment processor, Wix Payments includes a minimum amount of $1 per transaction; make sure to enter a minimum price of $1 for your single when using this processor.

title: How can I customize the layout of my Wix Music player?
content: Choose a layout: Vertical, Horizontal, or List. To customize the player's layout, go to your editor, click the Wix Music player, click Settings, click the Layouts tab, choose a layout, then choose what you want to customize. Vertical options include Control bar; Album / Playlist / Single cover image; Show music info; Show track list; Track info includes; Show track actions; Track list spacing. Horizontal options include Control bar; Album / Playlist / Single cover image; Track actions; Track list spacing. List options include Album / Playlist / Single info; Play buttons; Track info includes; Track actions; Track duration; Track list spacing; Stretch to fit.

title: How can I get admin permissions for a Facebook Page to run a campaign?
content:
To get admin permissions for a Facebook Page to run a campaign, you need "full control" access for the Page. You also need admin permissions for the Facebook Business Manager associated with that Page. Ask a current Page admin to add you by following these steps:

- Log in to your Facebook account and switch to the relevant Page.
- Click your Page's profile picture at the top right.
- Click Settings & privacy, then click Settings.
- Under Audience and visibility, click Page setup.
- Click Page access.
- Next to People with Facebook access, click Add New.
- Click Next.
- Enter the information of the person you want to give access to and select their name.
- Scroll down and select the toggle to allow the person full control of the Facebook Page.
- Click Give Access.
- Type your Facebook password, then click Confirm.

The person will receive an email to accept your invitation to access your Page.

title: How can I set up and customize my Wix Portfolio to match my brand?
content: Easily add Wix Portfolio to your site and choose from the variety of beautiful layouts. Customize the look and feel to match your brand. When you install Wix Portfolio on your site, 3 pages are added to your site: the portfolio page, collection pages, and project pages. Your portfolio page is where all your collections are displayed; collections pages display all the projects in a portfolio collection; and project pages display each project's information and media. In the editor, browse through designer-made presets and choose the most suitable one for each of your pages: portfolio, collection pages, and project pages. Once you've applied your presets, you can further customize the pages' designs by adjusting their backgrounds, fonts, navigation buttons and more. You can also further customize the portfolio gallery on each of these pages and adjust the settings, layout, behaviour and design of the gallery itself.

title: How can I manage pending booking requests in Wix Bookings?
content: To manage pending booking requests in Wix Bookings, go to the Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the Booking Activity icon at the top right. Hover over the relevant booking request under Pending Booking Requests. Then click Approve, or click More Actions to decline the booking request or propose a new time. This widget only appears for services where manual approval for bookings is activated.

title: Can I adjust the alignment of thumbnails in the Wix Pro Gallery with the Thumbnails layout?
content: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the alignment of your thumbnails in galleries with the Thumbnails layout. You can customize your thumbnails' size, spacing and placement in galleries with the Thumbnails layout.

title: How can I set up automated emails for my Wix Events when someone RSVPs?
content: To set up automated emails for Wix Events when someone RSVPs, create an automation and select a trigger designed specifically to work with Wix Events. If you don't see the automation screen, click Create an Automation and then Start from Scratch. You can apply the same automation to all your events, or apply an automation to one or more specific events. This lets you automatically send information to guests after they RSVP, such as an email with information about an event any time someone RSVPs. You can also send a coupon a day after an event ends to encourage guests to come back.

title: Can I have different form layouts per breakpoint in Wix Forms?
content: Currently in the new Wix Forms, it's not possible to have different form layouts per breakpoint. On the mobile breakpoint, the form is always shown in a single column layout.

title: Can I sell products by auction in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, Wix Stores does not have a feature that would allow you to sell your store products by auction. However, it's now possible to sell products by auction using the Product Auction app.

title: How can I find and fix mobile usability issues on my Wix site using Google Search Console?
content: Go to your Google Search Console. Click Search Traffic. Click Mobile Usability. Select each 'Usability error' and view the URLs. Make sure that you have enabled the mobile-friendly view of your site. If the error remains and the mobile-friendly view is enabled, open your site's Editor at the specific page referred to in the error message. If you can locate the design issue causing the error and fix it, the problem should be resolved the next time Google crawls your site. If you are unable to locate and fix the issue causing the error, contact us and include the specific URLs of the pages receiving this error. Please include a screenshot of the full screen.

title: Is it possible to get additional country flag icons and images for free from Wix?
content: We currently have a variety of country flag icons and images available in the Media from Wix library. Just search for your flag using the search bar. If your country's flag is missing, submit a ticket to request it. In the meantime, you are welcome to upload your country's flag icon as an image.

title: How can I sign out of my Wix account?
content: You can sign out of your Wix account from your site's dashboard or your Sites page. To log out, go to your site's dashboard or go to Sites in your Wix account, click your profile at the top right, and click Log Out. Signing out on one device does not sign you out on any other devices that you previously signed in on. It is not possible to sign out from all of your devices at the same time. You can vote for this feature.

title: Can I manage and allocate rooms and other resources for my services in Wix Bookings?
content: You can now manage and allocate rooms and other resources for your services.

title: How can I view and manage my subscribers' information on Wix Video?
content: Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Click the Arrow icon next to the relevant plan to view more information. Optionally, click Manage Subscriptions to extend, suspend, or cancel a subscription. Important: Subscriber information can only be viewed for clients that are connected to a pricing plan. It is not possible to manage subscriptions or view subscriber information using the old subscription plan method.

title: How can I hide overflow content to prevent white gaps and horizontal scroll bars in the Studio Editor?
content: Select your page: go to the relevant page, click Layers on the left of the Studio Editor, and click Page. Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Studio Editor. Click the Design tab. Select Hide from the Overflow content drop-down.

title: How do I access the Inspector panel in the Studio Editor?
content: Click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the editor. The panel opens on the right, showing the element you're working on at the top.

title: Can I apply multiple coupons at the same time in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is not possible for customers to apply more than one coupon at a time in Wix Stores. It is, however, possible to offer free shipping above a set price along with another coupon.

title: How can I add and set up hover interactions in Wix Editor?
content:
Add and design a box or repeater first. To access hover mode, select the box or repeater, click the Hover Interactions icon, and click Get Started. Use the tabs at the top of the element to switch between regular and hover mode.

In hover mode, you can:
- Add elements that appear on hover: click the Add to Hover icon at the top left, then click the element you want to add. Note that not all elements are available to add to hover mode.
- Hide elements on hover: select the element and press Delete, or click the Hide Element icon.
- Choose an effect for the element on hover: select the box or repeater, click Choose Effect, select an effect, and optionally click Customize.
- Set timing for effects: select the element, click the Timing icon, and use Duration, Delay, and Easing.
- For containers only, change the container's design on hover: select the box, click the Hover tab, click the Design icon, and edit Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, and Shadow.

title: How can I view form submissions from my dynamic pages in Wix?
content: This feature is only available for old Wix Forms. Go to Forms & Submissions in your site's dashboard, then click View Submissions Table next to the relevant site form on your dynamic page. Make sure you have published your site. Click Hidden Fields to view all form fields that aren't automatically visible on the table. Click the toggle next to your dynamic page to display it on the table; the form field name is the same as your dynamic page name and has a link icon next to it. The new column displays which item of the page collection the form was submitted on.

title: How do I accept ownership of a transferred Wix site?
content:
To accept site ownership, check your email account for an email with the subject line **Wix Website is Being Transferred to You**. Click **Accept Transfer** in the email and sign in to your Wix account (if you are not already signed in). If you don't have an account, click **Sign Up** to create one. Review the transfer details and click **Next**. Enter your billing information and click **Next**. Enter the domain contact information and click **Complete Transfer**.

**Note:** If you receive a site without any Premium services, simply click **Accept Transfer** and sign in to your account (or click **Sign Up** to create one). You do not need to enter any billing or domain transfer information.

title: How can I change the privacy permissions of my Wix photo album?
content:
To change your album's privacy permissions:
- Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard.
- Click Manage Album next to the relevant album.
- Click the drop-down in the General section to expand it.
- In the Who can access this album? section, set album access:
  - Everyone: Anyone with the album URL can view this album.
  - Password holders: Visitors need a password to view your photo album. Enter a password in the What's the password for this album? field. Click Show Password to view the password you've entered. Select the language using the Choose the language visitors will see your album in drop-down.
- Enable the Let visitors share photos toggle to show a Share icon on each photo, video and gallery.
- Enable the Display toggle to show this album on the Photo Albums page of your main site. To show it on other pages, go to the Editor.
- Enable the SEO toggle to let search engines find your album. We recommend disabling SEO for password-protected albums, to prevent people finding links to inner pages of your password-protected albums.
- Click Save.

title: How can I set up PayPal as a payment method for Wix Hotels?
content: This setup applies to the original Wix Hotels. To set up PayPal as a payment method, go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Payments tab, click Connect next to PayPal, sign in to your PayPal account, click Grant Permission, and click Save at the top right of the dashboard. You must have a PayPal Business account to accept payment in Wix Hotels. You can use any currency that PayPal supports; if you use a currency that PayPal does not support, guests will be unable to proceed to PayPal to make the payment for their hotel stay, so it is recommended to use a different payment method. If you use the new Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, which is not yet available to all users, check which version of Wix Hotels you are using and read the relevant information.
