title: Is the currency field type supported in CMS collections?
content: Currently, CMS collections do not have a currency field type you could use to display numbers with a currency prefix/suffix on your site. Workaround: With expressions, you can use the TEXT function to apply currency formatting to numbers. For example, you could use the TEXT function with a pattern format to convert a Number field into a currency format (e.g. $1,234.57).

title: How can I add a new slide to my slideshow in Wix Editor?
content:
To add a new slide to your slideshow in Wix Editor:

- Click the slideshow in your editor.
- Click **Manage Slides**.
- Click **Add New Slide** at the bottom.

title: Can I share FAQs from the Wix FAQ app directly to Instagram?
content: Currently, the Wix FAQ app includes social media sharing options for Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn only. As a workaround, you can copy/paste links to your FAQs if you want to share them in more places such as email, Instagram, YouTube, or Pinterest.

title: Can I create invoices directly from the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create invoices in the retail POS tablet. However, you can create invoices on desktop: for unpaid sales, you can create invoices and optionally accept deposits for unpaid POS sales; for paid sales, you can create an invoice for a paid order.

title: How can I change my username and profile image on my Wix account?
content: Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Update your first name and last name under Basic Info. Click the Camera icon to add or change your profile image.

title: How can I update an app from the Wix App Market using my site's dashboard?
content: To update an app from the Wix App Market using your site's dashboard: Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard. Click Update App next to the app you want to update. Click Update on the pop-up. Click Got It.

title: Can I organize, sort, or group my email marketing campaigns in different ways on the Email Marketing dashboard?
content: In the Email Marketing dashboard, your email campaigns are shown in chronological order. Currently, it is not possible to organize, sort or group your email campaigns in different ways.

title: How can I create a "Back to Top" button in the Studio Editor?
content: Create a "Back to Top" button to make it easy for visitors to go to the top of the page. You can also use any other linkable element (e.g. text, shapes, or media). In the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Buttons, and drag a button to the desired location on the page. Click the Link icon, select Top / bottom of page on the left, click Top, then click Done. Optionally, pin your button to the screen so it's visible as visitors scroll: click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor, scroll down to Position, click the Position type drop-down and select Pinned, then click the Pin to drop-down and select the desired location for your button (e.g. Section / Page). You can also add an Entrance animation to your button and adjust the delay to make it appear after a few seconds as visitors scroll down.

title: Can I display prices on some products but not others in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, you can either display product prices on all products in the Product Gallery and Product Page or hide product prices altogether. It's not possible to display prices on some products but not on others.

title: How can I update the link preview for my page in Telegram if it shows outdated information?
content: Open the Webpage Bot in Telegram, or enter "Webpage Bot" in the search bar and choose it from the results. Click Start. If you previously used the Webpage Bot, you may not see the Start button; enter "/start" in the chat instead. Enter the URLs of the pages that you want to update the link preview image for. You should see a message that tells you that the link preview was successfully updated. It can take some time for Telegram to update your link preview; this waiting period is the same for all websites, not just those created using Wix.

title: What steps should I follow to sign in to my Wix account using an authenticator app after enabling 2-step verification?
content: Sign in as normal on the Wix login page. Open your authenticator app on your phone and get the 6-digit code for your Wix account. Enter the 6-digit code under Enter code here on the Wix login page, then click Verify.

title: How can I upgrade my email marketing plan to access more features?
content: To get access to more email marketing features, upgrade your email marketing plan and choose the package that works for your business. To upgrade your email marketing plan, go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Under Monthly Balance click Upgrade. Choose a plan that works best for you and checkout. If you want to compare plans before upgrading, compare the different email marketing plans to see which is right for your business. Choose your plan by the number of emails you’re planning to send a month and any additional features you are interested in.

title: What are some best practices for writing engaging email content in a marketing campaign?
content:
Here are best practices from the source:
- Clearly identify yourself in the 'from' name; use your business name, and if adding a personal touch, include your name followed by the business name (e.g., Sarah from Wix.com).
- Write a value-driven and concise subject line that tells recipients what to expect and aligns with the action you want them to take.
- Keep brand colors, fonts, and tone of voice consistent to build trust.
- Speak directly to your audience using data from past email campaigns to address their pain points.
- Keep the email short and focused on one topic, linking to your call-to-action for more information.
- Stick to one call-to-action and make the main goal obvious.
- For text and images, maintain an 80% text to 20% image ratio, keep text under 200 words, break up paragraphs with sub-headings, avoid spammy keywords, include credible links, do not send image-only emails, add at least 1-2 sentences of text, use .jpg or .png formats, and use descriptive file names because they become alt text.

title: How can I customize the layout and image display on my Wix Stores Product Page?
content: Go to your editor, click Pages & Menu, click Store Pages, click Product Page, then click the Product Page element. Click the Layout tab and select a layout for the Product Page. Click the Stretch to full width toggle to enable it. Under Show thumbnails, select how you want to display image thumbnails. Click the Image ratio drop-down and select a ratio. Under How's image resized, choose Crop to crop all images to the same size or Fit to maintain the images' aspect ratios. Click the Zoom on image toggle to enable it; this is available for some layouts. To preview the zoom, go to your live site. Click Reset to original layout to reset your Product Page to its original layout settings.

title: How can I use the Gifted app to sell gift cards on my Wix website?
content: The Gifted app by Gifted lets you sell branded gift cards on your website. Before using it, you need to add Wix Stores; the app is only available in English. With Gifted, customers can purchase and send personalized digital gift cards directly to their recipients, and you benefit from integrated gift card order tracking from your Wix Store. Features include adding a gift card solution to your site, redeeming gift cards online, tracking gift card usage with comprehensive reporting, and receiving full gift card revenue transparency. To get started, check out the Gifted app by Gifted. For questions and comments, contact Gifted directly at support@gifted.co.

title: Can I add more than 3 custom tabs to a group in Wix Groups?
content: Currently, you can add up to 3 custom tabs for your own content to a group. However, it is not possible to add more than that.

title: How can I add a Wix Blog to my site using Editor X?
content: To add a Wix Blog using Editor X: Click Add at the top of Editor X, click Blog, then click Add to Site. Select either Wix Blog or Wix Blog with Members Area, then click Next.

title: What should I know before transferring my domain to Wix?
content: Before transferring your domain to Wix, you must upgrade your site. You must request an authorization code from your current domain registrar. Check that at least 60 days have passed since your domain was registered, as the domain will be locked otherwise. Changes to the registrant information also lock your domain for 60 days. Verify that your domain is unlocked. If your domain has private registration, change your domain privacy settings to public at your domain host. Currently, you can only transfer domains with these extensions: .com, .org, .net, .biz, .info, .co, .guru, .email, .expert, .photography, .pictures, .space, .rocks, .tokyo, .xyz, .company, .club, .solutions, .today, .technology, .tips, .center, .directory, .ninja, .photos, .land, .agency, .gift, .holiday, .christmas, .top, .design, .london, .online, .org, .party, .site, .store, .shop, .wiki, .mx, and .website. Any remaining time left in your domain's current registration period is retained when you transfer it to Wix. The minimum 1-year extension you buy when transferring to Wix is added to any remaining time left in your domain's registration period, so you do not lose registration time you've already paid for with your old domain registrar. You can connect your domain to your Wix site rather than transfer it to Wix if you prefer to keep your domain with your current host.

title: Can I customize the PDF tickets sent to event guests in Wix Events?
content: Yes, you can now customize the PDF ticket sent to guests when they purchase a ticket.

title: How can I change the email address displayed on my site using ADI?
content: Click the relevant section in the ADI Editor in which your email address appears. In the panel on the left, change the information appearing under Site Email. Tip: Changing your business information automatically changes it everywhere on your site.

title: How do I use a Pro Gallery to display CMS collection content in the Wix Editor?
content: Use a Pro Gallery to dynamically display images for each item in your CMS collection. You can connect collection fields to the gallery images, image titles, descriptions, alt texts, and links. This setup works for dynamic list pages and static pages because you can link the images to their items' dynamic item pages. This article refers to connecting a Pro Gallery to an Image field for displaying an image per collection item; alternatively, you can connect a gallery to a Media Gallery field for displaying several images or videos for a single collection item on a dynamic item page. To prepare the collection, create a multiple item collection, add an Image field type and Text field types for image titles, descriptions, and alt text, add the images and values for each item, and set the collection permissions as needed.

title: What should I do if Facebook is blocking me from sharing my Wix site?
content: If you receive an error message when trying to share your site on Facebook, it is because your site has been blocked by Facebook. Wix has no control over the sites that Facebook blocks. Make sure your site adheres to Facebook's community standards, and contact Facebook to submit a request for them to unblock your site. It may take some time for them to process the request as they review each site individually.

title: Can I request additional permissions from inside the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to request for additional permissions from inside the Editor; to update your permissions in the system, contact the site owner directly.

title: How can I add a social bar to my site using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click Add at the top left of the Editor, click Menu, click Social Bar, then drag a social bar to the desired location on your site. You can add a Fixed scroll effect to your social bar so it's always shown on screen.

title: Is it possible to add strikethrough formatting to text in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add strikethrough formatting to text. Tip: You can add the HTML element, enter your text and apply the strikethrough tag to the relevant section of text.

title: How can I customize the appearance and functionality of the Wix Music player on my site?
content:
To customize the functionality of the Wix Music player, go to the player's settings in your Editor. From there, you can make your music play automatically when the page loads and choose to include buttons that let fans share your album or tracks.

To personalize how the player looks, choose the layout and design options that best suit your music directly from your Editor. You can upload a cover image, set the layout, choose your color schemes, fonts, button styles, and more.

title: How can I view detailed session information for recent visitors on my Wix site?
content: In the Recent visitors section of Real-time Analytics, you can see a list of all your site visitors up to 24 hours. If the visitor is not a known contact or site member, you will see 'Visitor #X.' You can also see the type of device used, the visitor's location, and the time they began their session. Hover over a visitor and click Session info to see a breakdown of each action they took during that session. If the visitor is currently on your site, you also have the option to open a chat with them if you have installed Wix Chat.

title: What are some tips to improve email deliverability for my marketing campaigns?
content:
To improve your email deliverability, follow these best practices:

- **Only email subscribers:** Send campaigns only to people who have consented to receive correspondence from you. Emailing people who have never heard of your business is the quickest way to gather spam complaints and lower your sender reputation.

- **Build your email list organically:** Avoid bought or scraped email addresses. Grow your list by adding subscriber forms to your site and offering valuable content in exchange for signing up, and add a double-opt in for visitors to confirm their consent.

- **Regularly maintain your email list:** Check frequently for inactive subscribers, spam emails, and addresses that no longer exist, since sending to non-existent addresses causes a hard bounce that negatively affects your sender reputation. Provide an easy way for people to unsubscribe.

- **Write an informative and engaging subject line:** Your subject line should be straightforward and instantly let someone know what the content of the email contains; avoid subject lines that read like spam or clickbait.

- **Clearly identify yourself and your business:** Make sure your business name and address are clearly identified somewhere in the content or footer of the email.

- **Keep your audience engaged:** Send relevant and stimulating content, include links to sign up or view more content, ask for feedback, and keep the conversation going.

- **Gradually increase the number of emails you send:** Warm up your email list gradually to avoid triggering spam filters, starting with fewer emails and increasing frequency as you see engagement and positive responses.

title: Why is the font for product options different on mobile compared to my design selections?
content: The font displayed on mobile for product options is currently taken from your site’s Paragraph 2 style instead of from your design selections. To fix this, you can edit the Paragraph 2 style in the theme manager.

title: What should I do if I lost access to my Apple generated email address used for signing into my Wix account?
content: If you used an Apple generated email address and lost access to the details, you need to manage your Apple ID to recover access. Once you have recovered access to your Apple generated email address, you will be able to sign into your Wix account. Note: Accounts created with an Apple generated email address will have automated emails from Wix forwarded to the email address associated with their Apple ID account.

title: How can I enable and customize the 'Load More' button in my Wix Stores Product Gallery?
content: Go to your editor and open the page with the Product Gallery you want to customize. Click the gallery, click Settings, and click the Settings tab. Select Scroll Behavior, then select Load More button. To edit the button text, click the Text tab and edit the "Load More" button text and the "Load Previous" button text. To edit the button design, click the Design tab, click Load More/Previous button, and customize the text font and color, style, background opacity and color, border width and color, Corner Radius, and Button Width.

title: How can I add a Pro Gallery to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: To add a Pro Gallery to your site: Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor. Click **Media**. Click **Pro Galleries**. Choose a Pro Gallery design and drag it onto the page. Then click the gallery you just added, and click **Manage Media** to select the images and videos. Using drag and drop, you can rearrange the gallery.

title: Does Wix Forms support automatically sending visitors a copy of their form submission?
content: Currently, Wix Forms does not offer a feature which automatically sends your visitors a copy of their form submission. Whenever visitors submit a form on your site, it reaches Wix Inbox, your chosen email addresses and your submissions table. You can connect the automation to the checkbox field in your form with the question of whether your visitors want to receive the copy of their form submission. Then, connect this checkbox to the automation.

title: What types of content should I avoid posting on my Wix site to prevent abuse complaints?
content:
Types of content that could lead to an abuse complaint include, but are not limited to:

- **Defamation of character:** Also referred to as slander, this includes intentional false claims about another person, business, product, group, government, religion or nation, as well as hate speech and libel.
- **Phishing methods:** Attempts to gather private or sensitive information, such as usernames, passwords or credit card details.
- **Content Promoting Self-Harm:** Content glorifying any type of self-harm such as suicide, eating disorders or cutting. This does not include sites created to act as a support system or create awareness.
- **Electronic Spamming:** The use of electronic messaging systems to send unsolicited, and often repeated, messages, usually for marketing purposes. This is especially important for users who have purchased a Wix Email Marketing premium plan; Wix recommends reading its email marketing campaign best practices tutorial.

The nature of the content you choose to upload to your site is under your responsibility, and a site created through Wix is subject to international law.

title: Can I attach a repeater onto another repeater in the CMS?
content: Currently, it is not possible to attach a repeater onto another repeater. This feature would allow you to group items within a repeater based on a reference field. For example, you would be able to group dishes within the main repeater by meal (e.g. breakfast, lunch, or dinner). Learn how to connect a repeater to your CMS collection to display dynamic content.

title: Can clients add a tip at checkout when booking a session on my site?
content: Yes. Clients can now add tips at checkout on your site. When they book a session, the tip will automatically be distributed to the staff member(s). Note: You can also assign tips to specific staff members when collecting payments from clients.

title: How can I add and set up an icon button in the Wix Editor?
content:
To add an icon button: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Button. Click Icon Buttons. Click or drag the button to add it to your page.

To set up the button's text and icon: Click your icon button. Click Settings. Click Choose what displays and select an option from the drop-down: Text and icon (enter text under What does it say?; click the Replace icon to select a new icon from free media available from Wix or upload your own), Icon only (choose icon; enter alt text under What's the alt text?), Text only (enter text under What does it say?), or Nothing (create a transparent button that doesn't display text or an icon; enter alt text under What's the alt text?).

To add a link to your icon button: Click your icon button. Click the Link icon. Select a link type on the left. Depending on the link type you selected, add the relevant information. Click Done.

To customize your icon button: Click your icon button. Click the Design icon. Select a different preset design, or click Customize Design to adjust the existing design. Under Customize Design, choose the button state from the drop-down menu: Regular or Hover. Customize the design from the following tabs: Background Fills, Text, Borders, Corners, Shadows, Layout, Icon.

Note: Hover (tap) effects on icon buttons are not currently supported on iOS.

title: How can I customize my table reservations form on Wix to include custom fields and policies?
content:
To customize the form, go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click Settings at the top right, then click Reservation form. Enable the toggle next to Custom fields to add a custom field: enter a label under Custom field label, select Make this field mandatory to require guests to provide the information, and optionally click Add Custom Field to add another field. Enable the toggle next to Policies to add policies: use Link to URL to add a hyperlink to the relevant policy page, or use Paste as text so the policies are displayed in a pop-up while the guest is ordering or making a reservation. Click Save.

In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Table Reservations and select Table Reservations, tap the More Actions icon at the top right, tap Settings, then tap Reservation form. Tap Add next to Custom fields: enter a label under Custom field label, optionally select Make this field mandatory, and optionally tap Add Custom Field to add another field. Tap Add next to Policies: optionally enable the Privacy policy / Terms & conditions toggle and add the relevant details using Link to URL or Paste as text. Tap Save.

title: How can I open my browser in incognito or private browsing mode to troubleshoot issues with my Wix site?
content:
To check if an issue is related to your browser, open your browser in incognito or private browsing mode:

**Chrome**
Open Google Chrome. Press Ctrl + Shift + N on your keyboard (Cmd + Shift + N on Mac).

**Firefox**
Open Firefox. Press Ctrl + Shift + P on your keyboard (Cmd + Shift + P on Mac).

**Safari**
Open Safari. Press Cmd + Shift + N on your keyboard.

**Edge**
Open Microsoft Edge. Press Ctrl + Shift + N on your keyboard.

**Note:** Wix no longer supports live sites on IE11. We recommend using a supported browser to view and edit your site.

title: How can I pin an element or section in the Studio Editor to ensure it remains visible as visitors scroll?
content: To pin an element or section in the Studio Editor: select the relevant section or element, click the Open Inspector arrow at the top right of the Editor, scroll down to Position, and select Pinned from the Position type drop-down. For elements, choose where to pin under Pin to: Container / Cell keeps the element fixed relative to its parent container or cell; Section keeps it fixed as visitors scroll up and down the section; Page keeps it visible and fixed as visitors scroll up and down the entire page. By default, a pinned section overlaps the section below it. It is only possible to pin one section per page, and the section needs to border the page on all breakpoints.

title: How can I end my Facebook Ads campaign with Wix before the month is up, and what happens to my subscription?
content: The source does not provide the exact steps for ending the campaign; it states that if you end your campaign before the month is up, your campaign ends instantly and auto-renew is turned off. Facebook Ads campaigns with Wix are paid with a monthly subscription and payments are non-refundable. You can restart an ended campaign at any time before your subscription expires by clicking Edit & Restart from your Facebook Ads dashboard. Resuming a campaign also turns auto-renew back on. Any unused ad spend will remain in your account until you resume the campaign. If the subscription expires, you need to purchase a new subscription in order to activate the campaign and use the remaining ad spend. If you don't want your campaign to renew after the current subscription cycle ends, you can turn off auto-renewal of your subscription.

title: How can I issue a refund for an appointment using the Wix app?
content:
To issue a refund for an appointment in the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Calendar.
- Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant appointment.
- Tap Cancel.
- For an individually paid session without a cancellation fee, optionally tap the Mark as refunded checkbox to refund the customer, optionally tap the Notify client with an email checkbox and add a message, then tap Cancel Appointment at the bottom of the screen. Choose Mark as Refunded to issue a refund, or Continue Without Refund to close the message without refunding.
- For an individually paid session with a cancellation fee, optionally tap the Apply cancelation fee checkbox to charge a cancelation fee, optionally tap the Notify client with an email checkbox and add a message, then tap Cancel Appointment at the bottom of the screen. Tap Confirm Fee & Continue. Tap the More Actions icon at the top of the screen. Tap Issue refund. You can optionally offer partial refunds by tapping Edit Amount, entering the relevant amount you want to refund, and tapping Apply. Tap Next. Optionally select the reason you provided a refund from the Refund Reason drop-down. Optionally enable the Send a confirmation email toggle and enter a note to your customer; the note appears in the confirmation email. Tap Next. Tap Issue Refund to confirm.
Note: You cannot undo this action.

title: How can I manage the Wix ticket service fee when creating a new ticket?
content: Wix charges a 2.5% ticket service fee for using the ticketing platform. When creating a new ticket, you can choose whether the buyer or your business covers the 2.5% ticket service fee. If you pass it to the buyer, they pay an additional 2.5% on top of the ticket price; at checkout, they see the service fee and the ticket price separately. For example, a $100 ticket results in a total charge of $102.50, with $100 going to you and $2.50 covering the ticket service fee. If you absorb it, buyers pay only $100 at checkout, and after the 2.5% ticket service fee is deducted, you receive $97.50. Free tickets, manual guest entries, and manual payments have no ticket service fee. Payment processing fees are separate from the Wix ticket service fee.

title: How does the 50% sale on Google Workspace business email through Wix work?
content: From time to time, Wix offers a 50% sale on your connected domain's first Google Workspace business email purchase. When the sale is available, you will see a sale banner in your Wix account. The offer can only be used towards a domain's first business email purchase. If you purchase more than one business email in a single purchase, the discount applies to all business emails. The promotion applies only to yearly business email subscriptions. It is not available in all regions, cannot be applied retroactively towards a previously purchased business email, and is applied automatically to the purchase price with no need to manually enter a coupon code. Offer valid while supplies last.

title: How can I customize the default text style for my blog feeds using the Wix Editor?
content:
To set default text style for your feeds in the Wix Editor:

- Go to your editor.
- Go to your Blog page:
  - Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
  - Click Blog Pages.
  - Click your Blog page under Blog Pages.
- Click the Blog element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Design tab.
- Click Posts.
- Click the tabs to choose which feed you want to design:
  - All Posts feed: This is your main post feed. It displays all of your posts or specific posts that you've selected. You can customize the colors and fonts of the text, choose the color of the text on hover, and adjust the overlay (the semi-transparent background).
  - Category feed: This feed shows a list of all your blog categories. Select the colors and fonts of the text, choose what color the text appears on hover and customize the borders and backgrounds.

title: Can I live stream for more than 3 hours using Wix Video?
content: Currently, the maximum time for live-streaming is capped at 3 hours. It is not possible to stream longer for than this time.

title: How can I manage my Wix mailing list subscription settings?
content: Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Scroll down to Email Preferences. Click Manage Preferences. Click the toggle next to each email type to choose the emails you want to receive.

title: How can I add a cover photo to a video in Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
To add a cover photo to a video in Wix Pro Gallery, follow these steps:

- Click the Pro Gallery in your editor.
- Click **Manage Media**.
- Click the relevant video in the Media Manager.
- Click the Add Cover Photo icon on the right.
- Select the image you want to use as the cover photo.
- Click **Add to Page**.
- Click **Done**.

This will add an inviting cover photo to your video, encouraging site visitors to explore your gallery.

title: How can I view and download a sales report for my pricing plans using Wix Analytics?
content: To view or download a pricing plans report in Wix Analytics, go to Analytics & Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll to the Subscription Reports section and select the relevant report. Click the relevant tab at the top of the report to access different chart types; depending on the report, you may see different views. Click Download in the top right, then click CSV.

title: What are the limitations of the Wix Music Player?
content: The Wix Music Player can play one single, album, or playlist. Limitations: Album: 30 tracks per album. Single: 5 tracks per single. Playlist: 500 tracks per playlist. Note: Wix Music is not yet available in the Studio Editor. See "Adding and Setting Up Wix Music" for setup.

title: How can I set up a Wix Automation to send a discount coupon via email?
content:
Step 1 | Set up an automation: Create a new automation from scratch. Select a trigger and decide if you'd like to limit frequency, include a delay, or add special conditions for your automation.

Step 2 | Choose the 'add a coupon' action: Click Add a coupon. Select whether to send a unique coupon each time in the Select the type of coupon code section. Click the Select a coupon drop-down to choose the coupon you'd like to use or create a new one. Important: This automation will stop working if the coupon end date or use limit is reached. Make sure your coupon has a clear coupon code and coupon name.

Step 3 | Add the coupon to an email as a dynamic value: Click + Add Action. Click Send an email. (Optional) Click Edit in the Manage details section to edit your sender details. Click Edit in the Create an email section to add your coupon dynamic value to your email template. Click any text element or add a new one. Click where you want to add the dynamic value. Click + Add Personalized Content. Search coupon to see the available options in the drop-down menu: Coupon ID, Coupon code, Coupon name, Coupon offer description. (Optional) Write a fallback text in the text box. Under Set email type, select a type: Promotional, Business transactional, or Business critical. Under Set recipients, select all who will receive this automated email when it's triggered: Include trigger contact, Include additional recipients. Click Activate.

title: How can I import blog posts from one Wix site to another?
content: From your destination site's dashboard, go to Blog. Click the More Actions drop-down at the top right. Click Import posts. Select Wix and click Next. Click Get Started. Select the site you want to import the content from. Note: You only see the sites that have Wix Blog installed. Click Next. Select the checkbox to confirm that you own or are licensed to use this content. Click Import Posts. Note: Once you start the import process, there is no way to cancel it. Wait for the import to finish. Your destination site must be in the same Wix account as your source site and must have Wix Blog installed.

title: Can I book classes using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
Currently, it's possible to book and accept payment only for appointments using Wix Retail POS. You cannot book classes using the POS tablet.

Workaround: You can collect payment for a class that was already booked if the class occurs on the same day. For example, if a client booked a class online, when they come to attend the class, you can collect payment at your point of sale.

title: How can I access and customize the settings of the Category Page in Wix Stores?
content:
To access the Category Page settings in Wix Stores, click **Pages and Menu** on the left side of the editor, click **Store Pages**, click **Category Page**, click the Category Page in the editor, and click **Settings**.

In the settings, you can customize aspects such as scroll behavior, image hover effects, and the Add to Cart button. For scroll behavior, select what happens when customers scroll to the bottom of the page, and enable the **Sticky sidebar** toggle to keep filters visible while scrolling. For image hover effect, set what happens when a customer moves their mouse over a product. If the Add to Cart button is enabled in the Display tab, customize what happens when it is clicked, such as showing a success pop-up or opening the side cart. Customizations automatically apply to each category.

title: How can I export content from my CMS collection as a CSV file?
content: To export content from your content collection: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your editor and then click Your Collections. If you need to export a sandbox collection, go to the CMS from your editor. Click the relevant collection. If sandbox collections are enabled, choose Sandbox Collection or Live Collection at the top. Click More Actions and click Export to CSV. Choose what to include: the entire collection, which exports all items and fields including hidden and system fields; filtered data, which exports only items matching the current filter; or collection fields, which exports only field names including hidden and system fields. Click Export. When your file is ready, click Download File.

title: Can I set the offset in px* for sticky elements and sections in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set the offset in px* for sticky elements and sections in the Studio Editor. You can enter the offset value in px, percentage (%), vh or vw.

title: How can I create a certificate of completion for my online program participants?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program. Select Edit Settings. Click Rewards. Click Create Certificate. Design the certificate by choosing a template and customizing text, decorations, logo, signatures, underlines, frames, and background. Click Save at the top right to connect the certificate to your program, so it is automatically emailed to participants when they complete the program.

title: How can I assign a new domain to my Wix site?
content: You need to own the domain you want to use, and you must upgrade your site with a plan before you can assign a domain to it. First add your domain to your Wix account by purchasing it from Wix, connecting a domain you already own, or transferring a domain you already own. Then go to Domains in your Wix account and assign your domain to your site. If the domain is currently assigned to a different site, click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain, click Assign to a Different Site, select a site, click Next, and click Assign. If the domain is not currently assigned to a site, scroll to the relevant domain, click the Assign button next to Not Assigned to a Site, select a site, click Next, and click Assign. If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose whether to redirect it to the primary domain or replace the current primary domain. You can also change the default free Wix URL for your site.

title: How can I connect my Wix form to contact labels?
content: Click your form in the Editor, click Form Settings, click the Contacts tab, click Contact labels, then select the relevant label you want to add. Labels allow you to organize and filter your contacts efficiently and group contacts based on their relationship with you and your business, such as leads, customers, and service providers.

title: Can I connect the PDF Viewer app to CMS collections to display PDFs dynamically?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect the PDF Viewer app to CMS (Content Management System) collections. This feature would allow you to dynamically display PDF files that are uploaded to CMS collections in the PDF Viewer app. You would also be able to create dynamic pages from PDFs uploaded to the PDF Viewer app.

title: How can I check if I was charged tax on my Wix premium subscription invoice?
content: You can check your invoice to see if you were charged tax. If you don't see tax on your invoice, it means that you were not charged for it.

title: Can I change the speed of the parallax scrolling feature in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you cannot change the speed of the parallax scrolling feature in the Editor to make it move faster or slower on your live site.

title: How can I set up a payment method for selling videos in Wix Video?
content:
To set up a payment method for selling videos in Wix Video, go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click the Accept Payments tab, and set up the payment methods you want to use.

Important:
To accept payments for channel subscriptions, you must set your payment method to Paypal, Stripe or Wix Payments (Stripe and Wix Payments allow payment through credit card).
There is no option for offline/manual payments in Wix Video.
Currently, Isracard is not available as a payment provider for Wix Video.

title: How can I add a comment to a specific section or element in the Studio Editor?
content: Open the relevant page in the editor. Select the relevant breakpoint. Choose what you want to add the comment to. For a page, select Comments on the bottom left of the editor. For a section or element, select the relevant section or element and click the Comments icon. Type your comment in the box. Optionally, use the options to add further detail: type @ and then the name of the team member you want to tag; click an icon to add formatting such as bold, underline, and bulleted list; or click the Attach files icon to add files or images. Click the Submit icon to post the comment. You can also add comments to elements or sections by clicking them on stage while the panel is open. When you tag a team member in a comment or respond to another comment, the recipient gets an email and dashboard notification.

title: How can I add the Next Availability widget to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Bookings. Click Next Availability. Drag the widget onto your page. Then click the Next Availability widget and use Settings to select the service you want to display and the service location.

title: Can I get a refund for my Google Workspace business email purchased through Wix?
content: Google Workspace business emails purchased through Wix are non-refundable. If you feel that you deserve a refund, fill out the refund form to tell us why and we will review your request. You can cancel your Google Workspace account if you no longer need a business email. Learn more about canceling your business email renewal.

title: I need help setting up an email for website messages to go to instead of mine.
content: To send website messages to a different email instead of yours, add that email as a site collaborator. Note that any new email address you add as a site collaborator must have a separate Wix account. In your site's dashboard, go to Inbox, click the Settings drop-down at the top right, and click Notifications. Optional: click the Email notifications toggle to disable email notifications if you no longer want to receive them at your main account email. Click the Profile & team tab, then click + Invite People next to Your team. Enter a business email or an alternative email where you want to receive chat and inbox notifications, and click Send Invite. Go to the new email's inbox and click Accept Now in the email. Log in to the Wix account associated with the new email address and click Accept. The new email address is automatically assigned a Back Office Manager role and appears in the Your team list. Click the toggle under Email notifications to turn on email notifications for this email.

title: Can I connect Document buttons to files in CMS collections?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect Document buttons to content in the CMS (Content Management System). Workaround: You can set regular buttons and images to download documents from your collections. Connect the button or image to the CMS, then choose the Download Document dataset click action. When visitors click the button or image, the relevant document is downloaded to their computer.

title: How can I connect multiple database collections in my CMS to display related information?
content: In your CMS, collections are separate entities, but you can connect the data in your different collections so they work together to display related information. You have two options: create reference fields in the collection itself, or filter a dataset on your page. Reference fields create a pointer to a different collection, creating a connection between the collections in the actual structure of the primary collection and giving you access to all the information in the referenced collections. A dataset connected to a collection that has reference fields automatically has access to all the fields in the referenced collections. Note that dynamic page URLs cannot be based on reference fields. Filtering datasets lets you create connections between collections that both have a field with the same data without using a reference field. This lets one dataset respond to another, displaying only items whose field values match the current item of the second dataset. The connection exists only between the datasets on that page, and if you add another dataset connected to one of those collections, you need to filter it again. You can filter a dataset by a regular field or a reference field. These methods can support pages such as a repeater listing songs with artist photos, or a dynamic item page showing artist details and their songs.

title: How can I create a new store product using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
To create new store products using the Wix Retail POS tablet:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap the main menu icon at the bottom left.
- Tap Catalog.
- Tap Add a Product or tap +New Product at the top right.
- Enter your product's name and price.
- (Optional) Add a sale price: tap the On Sale toggle, select a discount type (percent or amount), and enter the discount.
- Tap Add Images on the right to select an image to display. Note: To upload images, go to desktop.
- Set where the product is displayed: tap the Point of Sale toggle to show or hide the product in the tablet, and tap the Online Store toggle to show or hide the product on your live site.
- Manage inventory for products without product options: add an SKU by tapping and entering an SKU number or tapping the Barcode icon and scanning the barcode, then tap Save. Set how you track inventory: to track inventory amounts, tap the Track Inventory toggle to enable it and enter the product's inventory amount; to mark inventory as In Stock / Out of Stock, tap the Track Inventory toggle to disable it and select the product's inventory status from the Status drop-down.
- Add the product to a tax group you created: tap Add to Tax Group, select the relevant tax group, and tap Done. Note: Tax groups can only be created on desktop. Learn more about tax groups.
- Add the product to categories: tap the Plus icon, select the checkboxes next to the relevant categories, and tap Done.
- Tap Save at the top right.

title: How can I add personalized content to my email campaign's text using Wix Email Marketing?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign, select a template, or create a new one. Click any text element or add a new one. Click where you want to add the dynamic value. Click + Add Personalized Content under Styles. Select the value from the drop-down, such as contact last name or contact birthday. Optionally, write a fallback text in the text box.

title: How can I invite someone to help manage my Wix Group without giving them access to the backend of my site?
content: You can set a group member as admin without granting them collaborator access to the backend of your site. Group admins can only manage member requests, moderate discussions, and update group settings, all from the live site.

title: How do the payment processing fees for credit card, PayPal, and Apple Pay work in Canada?
content: In Canada, Wix Payments charges Credit/Debit Card (excl. American Express): 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD, and Apple Pay (excl. American Express): 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD. PayPal transaction fees vary by location; contact PayPal for more information.

title: Can I add input elements that automatically use my site's color and font themes by default?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add input elements that use your site's color and font themes by default. You can, however, manually adjust the font and colors of input elements in their design settings.

title: How can I set up automatic printing for my restaurant orders using my printer's email address in Wix Restaurants?
content:
You can set up automatic printing with Network/Wi-Fi ready printers that have their own email addresses. To set up automatic printing using your printer's email address, follow these steps:

- Go to the Orders tab of your dashboard.
- Click Settings at the top right.
- Click Notifications.
- Click + Add New Notification under Receive Orders.
- Make sure the Email drop-down is selected.
- Enter your printer's email address.
- Click Save.

Note: You can find out your printer's email address through your printer manufacturer. Each manufacturer has its own instructions.

The next time you receive an order, your printer gets an email notification and prints the order automatically. You can also set up auto print notifications about unhandled orders by clicking + Add New Notification under Unhandled Orders to begin.

title: How can I accept payment for booked services using the Wix Mobile POS?
content:
To accept payment for services that have already been booked at a mobile POS, open your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, and tap Bookings Calendar. Select the service from the calendar: for an Appointment, select the relevant date and the relevant appointment, then tap Collect Payment; for a Class or Course, select the relevant class or course, tap Manage Participants, then select the relevant participant.

Then choose an option:
- Go to checkout: collect cash, card, tap-to-pay, or gift card payment; you can add discounts, tips, coupons, or a custom charge, and if you sell Wix Stores products, you can add products to the sale.
- Charge with invoice: issue an invoice requesting payment for the session.
- Mark as paid: accept payment offline and mark the session as paid.

If you chose Go to checkout: optionally tap Add More Items, Add Custom Charge, or Add a Discount, then tap Charge and choose how to accept payment:
- Cash: tap Cash, then enter the amount you received and tap Accept Cash, or select a preset cash amount, and give the customer the change.
- Card: tap Card, if prompted select Bluetooth card reader, let the customer swipe, insert, or tap their credit card, then tap Send Email to send a receipt by email or No Thanks.
- Manual card entry (not yet open to all eligible merchants; only available with a payment provider that allows manual card entry): tap Manual card entry, tap Go to Checkout, enter the credit card details and tap Next, enter the customer's zip code / postal code, tap Confirm & Pay, then tap Send Email or No Thanks. Wix notes that manual entry is the least secure way to accept card payments and that the merchant is liable in case of fraud.
- Tap to Pay (US only): after setting up Tap to Pay, select Card, if prompted select the relevant Tip amount or No Tip, if prompted select Tap to Pay, let the customer tap their credit card on your mobile device, then tap Send Receipt to send a receipt by email, text, or print, or tap No Receipt.
- Gift card: tap Gift card, enter the customer's gift card code or scan their physical gift card and tap Apply, tap Complete Sale, then send a receipt or tap No Receipt.
- Split payment: tap Split Payment, enter the first payment amount, tap Continue, select a payment method and complete the first part of the payment, tap Continue, edit the second payment amount if needed, tap Continue, select a payment method and complete the payment, tap Continue, then send a receipt or tap No Receipt. With split payments, customers can pay using more than one payment method (e.g. 2 credit cards or a combination of cash and credit card).

Before you begin, make sure you set up your mobile device as a point of sale. Note that this feature is not yet available for all users, and that on the mobile POS it is currently not possible to sell or redeem recurring membership plans or packages, offer refunds, collect tax, or edit the payment total.

title: How do I connect my Wix Studio enterprise solution site to Salesforce?
content: Contact your enterprise success manager to connect Salesforce to your Wix Studio for enterprise account. Then, in the relevant site's dashboard, go to Manage Apps, click Salesforce, click Connect, and log in to your Salesforce account.

title: How can I enable shipping to pickup points in my Wix store using Sendcloud?
content: Add the Sendcloud app from the Wix App Market. Set up your Sendcloud account and connect carriers, including selecting the Service Points checkbox. In the Sendcloud app Configuration tab, add pricing for each carrier. In your Wix dashboard, create a shipping region for each pickup-point location. Then go to Shipping & Fulfillment, select a shipping region where Sendcloud operates, scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or store pickup options you created, click the toggle next to the Sendcloud app to enable it, and click Save. Repeat for any additional shipping regions. Pickup point shipping is not available to customers until it is enabled.

title: What should I do if I am currently using the retired Cookie Alert Popup App on my Wix site?
content: Important: This app has been retired from the Wix App Market and Cookie Alert banners will no longer be supported on your site. Action required: Delete this app and switch to our Privacy Center, where you can set up a Cookie Banner to be displayed on your site.

title: Can I use a Wix promo code to renew my existing Premium plan at a discounted rate?
content: No. Promotions offered by Wix are valid for the first month/year of service, depending on the plan purchased, and cannot be used to renew an existing Premium plan. The discounted price is valid for the first year/month ONLY. All subsequent renewals are charged at the original price of the plan, without the discount. It is possible to upgrade an existing Premium plan using a promotional coupon.

title: Can I remove images from some dishes and not others in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it is now possible to remove images from some dishes and not others. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app.

title: How can I rename a workflow in my site's dashboard?
content: Go to Workflows in your site's dashboard. Click the drop-down next to your workflow title, select the workflow you want to rename, then double-click the title of your workflow and update the text.

title: How can I import loyalty points for my existing customers using the Wix Loyalty Program?
content: To import loyalty points, go to Loyalty Program in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top, then click Import. Prepare your CSV file by including a header row, and make sure each row contains an email address and customer points balance. Click Next, then click Upload file. Select the file containing the loyalty points you're importing and click Open. Click Next. Check that the data is matched correctly by ensuring the Email and Points balance columns are correct. If needed, click Match Data and use the drop-down menus to correct the column headers. Click Save and Import, then click View Customers. Note: If you import points from a CSV file for a customer who already has points in your Wix Loyalty Program, their existing points balance is overridden.

title: What should I do if my payment for Wix services is not going through?
content:
If your payment for Wix services is not going through, try the following steps:

- Contact your bank to find out why the payment has not gone through. Your bank can confirm if you are using the correct account details. Once the issue is resolved, try the upgrade again.
- Try upgrading with a different credit/debit card.
- Try making your payment on a different internet browser (e.g. Safari, Chrome, Firefox), or try clearing your browser's cache.

If you are still experiencing problems upgrading after contacting your bank, please contact us for help.

title: Can I download Wix Logo files in formats other than PNG and SVG?
content: Currently, Wix Logo files are offered in PNG and SVG formats. SVG files are only included in the Advanced, Professional, and Deluxe Logo Plans. You can convert your files to another format for free with CloudConvert. CloudConvert is a third-party application, so Wix does not offer support for it.

title: Can I get a refund for my Wix domain purchase if I change my mind within 14 days?
content: Wix domain purchases are separate from Premium or Studio site plan purchases, and therefore do not have a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you feel that you deserve a refund, see further information about refunds. Alternatively, you can contact Customer Care to tell us why and we will review your request. If you no longer wish to keep the domain you purchased, you can cancel your subscription by turning off the auto renewal process. The domain will expire on the next renewal date.

title: How can I add a Members Area to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Community. Click Members. Click Add to Site. After adding the Members Area, you can customize your Members Area.

title: How can I access and update my basic site settings in Wix Stores?
content:
Go to your site's dashboard. Click Settings. From Website settings, you can enter basic information such as your site name. This is the name that appears in your site's dashboard, the My Sites page, and in search results.

Tip: To give your site a more professional look, make sure you upload a 16 x 16 pixel favicon - the symbol that appears on browser tabs.

title: How can I set up spam protection on my new Wix Forms?
content: In the new Wix Forms, click Edit Form to open the form builder, click Settings, and select Spam filter settings. Then choose one of these options: Only reCAPTCHA uses invisible reCAPTCHA to analyze site visitor behavior and determine if they are human or a bot, showing a challenge if suspected to be a bot; this is the lowest level of spam protection. Basic and reCAPTCHA adds a basic spam filter after invisible reCAPTCHA that labels spam based on criteria like network identifiers and contact information; this is the mid-level spam protection. Advanced and reCAPTCHA includes reCAPTCHA and the basic filter plus an advanced filter using additional technologies to mark spam; this highest level of spam protection is only applied if the other two filters do not mark the submission as spam.

title: How can I add a lightbox to my page in Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click the Add icon at the top left of the Editor, click Layout Tools, click Lightboxes, and select the lightbox you need to add it to your page.

title: Can I get a refund for a third-party app upgrade purchased through Wix?
content: It is not possible to receive a refund for a third-party app upgrade (apps not made by Wix). Some app upgrades are monthly subscriptions. Canceling your upgrade stops the renewal payment from occurring at the end of the month. Learn how to cancel an app upgrade.

title: How can I connect a domain purchased from another host to my Wix site?
content: If you purchased a domain from another domain host, you can still connect it to your Wix site.

title: Can I host my podcasts directly on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a feature which allows for hosting podcasts. You can link to your externally hosted Podcasts with the Wix Podcast Player.

title: How can I add a personalized name to an Email Marketing campaign using dynamic values?
content: To add a personalized name to an Email Marketing campaign, go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign, select a template, or create a new one. Click any text element or add a new one, then click where you want the dynamic value. Click + Add Personalized Content under Styles and select the value from the drop-down. You can optionally write fallback text, such as "dear customer", so the email still reads correctly if the data is not available. To personalize the subject line or preview text, when you're done editing click Next, add at least one recipient and click Next, click Edit next to Subject line, click where you want the dynamic value, click + Personalize under the subject line and/or preview text, select the value from the drop-down, and optionally write fallback text.

title: How can I add a new item or service to my Wix invoices or price quotes?
content:
Go to Invoices or Price Quotes in your site's dashboard. Click More Actions at the top right. Select Create items & services. Click + New Item and enter the details: Item / Service: Enter the name of the item or service. Description: Add a short description. Price: Enter the price of the item or service. Click Save.

Tip: You can also add a new item or service while creating an invoice or price quote. Start typing in the Item or Service field and click New Item.

title: Does Wix Email Marketing provide analytics for the best email send times?
content: Currently, Wix Email Marketing does not offer a specific analytical tool to help understand the best times to send email campaigns. Tip: Learn more about the existing Wix Analytics Email Marketing reports. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

title: Can I embed TikTok videos in the Wix Single Video Player?
content: Currently, it is not possible to embed TikTok videos in the Wix Single Video Player. You can add videos from YouTube, Facebook, and Vimeo.

title: How can I add and set up the Wix Tips app on my Wix site?
content:
Important: Make sure to update to the latest version of the Wix Tips app to access the latest features. It is highly recommended to uninstall the old Wix Tips app. If you used custom tip options, copy them to the new app manually.

Step 1 | Add Wix Tips to your site
Wix Tips can be added directly from the Wix App Market. This app only works with e-commerce apps such as Wix Stores, Wix Bookings and Wix Restaurant Orders. Wix Tips is already installed on your site if you have Wix Restaurant Orders.
To add Wix Tips to your site:
Go to the Wix App Market.
Type "Wix Tips" in the search bar and select Wix Tips from the drop-down menu.
Click Add to Site.
Click OK.

Step 2 | Activate the app and customize the settings
To start accepting tips, activate the app in your dashboard and customize the settings. You can customize the tip options according to your needs by charging tips based on percentages or amounts.
To activate the app and customize the settings:
Click Get Started.
Click the Enable tips at checkout toggle.
Choose how you want to accept tips:
Percentage: Set your tips to be a percentage of the total order amount.
Fixed amount: Offer fixed amount tips.
Click the Let customers leave custom tip amounts toggle:
Enabled: Customers can enter their own tip amount.
Disabled: Customers do not have the option to enter their own tip amount.
Click Save.
Click Add to activate Wix Tips on your site.

Step 3 | Track your tip analytics
Once the app is installed on your site, it automatically syncs with the "Sales over Time" report so that you can track and monitor the tips given by your customers. From the column labeled "Tips", you can record and analyze the tips received during specific time periods.
To track analytics for your tips:
Go to Analytics and Reports in your site's dashboard.
Click Reports.
Click Sales over Time.

title: 在Amazon促销ROI分析中，遇到缺失数据应如何处理？
content: 严格遵循“数据纪律”：涉及金额、销量、排名、费率的数字只能来自用户提供的信息；用户没给的一律写“缺失”，不要估算，也不要引用记忆中的行业均值或平台费率，因为这些数字会过期，而用户可能拿它去做真金白银的决策。需要某个数字才能继续时，应告诉用户该去哪里查、查哪个字段，然后停下来等用户补充。每个结论都要标注来源：[我提供的信息] 或 [模型推测]；属于推测的部分要说明推测依据。

title: How can I add a container in Editor X and customize its design?
content:
To add a container in Editor X:
• Click Add Elements at the top of Editor X.
• Click Layout Tools.
• Choose the kind of container: Empty Boxes or Grids.
• Drag a container onto your page.
• Add elements by dragging them into your container.
• From the Inspector panel, click the Design tab to customize the container.

Design options include:
• Fill Color & Opacity: choose a background color and adjust opacity.
• Border: change color and opacity, and set width.
• Corners: curve corners by adjusting radius in pixels.
• Shadow: add and customize shadow angle, size, distance, blur, opacity, or color.

title: Can I use Wix Apps' Collections directly in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, when building Blocks apps that integrate with Wix apps such as Stores or Bookings, you can only use their APIs. However, you cannot access their database collections directly, cannot use datasets to bind your widget to these collections, and cannot test your widgets in Blocks to see how they appear with sample data for the Wix apps.

title: How can I set the Cart Icon to open the Mini Cart in my Wix Store?
content: Click the Cart Icon in your editor. Click Settings. Select the Settings tab. Select an option: Show Mini Cart: When customers click the cart icon, the Mini Cart opens on the right. From there, they can click to go to the Cart Page. Open full Cart page: When customers click the cart icon, they're directed to the Cart Page.

title: Can I run multiple Google Ads campaigns for one site using Wix?
content: You can now create multiple campaigns in Google Ads with Wix. Learn more about multiple campaigns as well as the benefits of running more than one campaign for your site.

title: How can I opt out of Reserve with Google if I opted in before December 2023?
content: If you opted in to Reserve with Google before December 2023, go to Reserve with Google in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top right. Select Disconnect. Click Disconnect to confirm.

title: How can I create a real estate listings site using Wix templates and CMS?
content: To create a real estate listings site with Wix, choose a real estate template from the ready-made site templates. These templates include pre-built pages and elements designed for property listings. If you already have a site, add the Property Listings CMS preset, then replace the demo properties with your own. The preset includes a database structure for properties, making it easy to add, edit, and organize your listings.

title: How do I create a new automation using the new automation builder?
content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation at the top right. Choose how you want to start creating your automation: From Scratch lets you begin from a blank automation template; Suggested automation lets you use the categories or search bar to find the suggested automation you want to edit, then click Set Up next to it. Click the title to give your automation a name. Then choose a trigger in the trigger selection panel from the available options under the relevant app and further define your trigger. After selecting a trigger, continue setting up your automation using the available steps: Action, Delay, Condition. Click Activate to save and activate the automation.

title: How can I enable or disable pinpointing for customer addresses in Wix Restaurants' online ordering?
content: Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Delivery tab. Click the Pinpointing Addresses toggle. Enabled: Customers who enter an approximate address are prompted to enter an exact address. Disabled: Customers can enter an approximate address.

title: How can I add a podcast to my Branded App using an RSS feed?
content: Before you begin, copy the RSS link from the settings section of your podcast hosting platform. Then, in your Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Mobile App, and tap Edit under Mobile App. Tap the navigation tab where you want to add your podcast. To add a new tab, tap Screens at the bottom and Add New Screen. Tap + Add Element, scroll through the elements menu, and tap Podcasts. Tap the Podcasts element, enter the name of your podcast under Element Title, paste your RSS link under Link to podcast, and tap Add. Optionally, tap Element Visibility to only show your podcast on iOS or Android devices.

title: What are the recommended tips for creating a secure password for my Wix account?
content:
We recommend the following tips for creating the most secure password for your Wix account:

* Choose a password that contains at least 8-12 characters.
* Do not include any parts of your name (first and last) in your password, or anything related to your personal info.
* Make sure to include at least 3 out of the 4 character types: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
* Use a unique password for Wix. Do not use a password that is used for other applications, such as your regular email account.
* Consider using a password manager and an automatic password generator to create safe and secure passwords.
* Make your password a passphrase of at least 12 characters. We recommend using an easy-to-remember sentence that includes numbers and special characters. For example, you could use the first 2 letters of each word of a sentence to create an even stronger password.
* Use the Wix Password Strength Indicator to measure the safety of your password. The indicator prompts you to create a tough-to-break password that has extra characters and symbols. The colored bar at the top of the indicator updates you on the strength of your password as you create it.

title: Is it possible to accept card payments through Wix Payments at a Mobile POS outside the US and Canada?
content:
Currently, accepting payment using a card reader at a Mobile POS through Wix Payments is available only for merchants in the US and Canada.

Workarounds:
- If you're connected to Wix Payments, you can accept payment by manually entering in your customers' card numbers.
- You can accept payment using the following third-party integrations:
  - Square: Available in the US, Canada, UK, Australia, Ireland, and Japan.
  - SumUp: Available in Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Switzerland, and the UK.

title: How can I create an image with a transparent background using Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Click the image you want to edit. Click Crop & Edit. Click Cut Out on the left. Click Auto Cut Out. Click Refine Cut Out to edit the image cut out with a brush. Use the editing options: Restore to restore parts of the cut out that you removed; Erase to edit the image to remove parts of the cut out; Fix Edges to fix soft edges (for example, around hair); Size to select the brush size to make more accurate edits; Hardness to select the brush hardness to make more accurate edits; Opacity to select the brush opacity to make more accurate edits. Optional: click and hold the Preview Changes icon to preview the changes you've made. Click Apply once you're happy with your changes. Click Save to save the new image in your Media Manager.

title: How do you make a section or element sticky as visitors scroll?
content: Select the relevant section or element, click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor, scroll down to Position, and select Sticky from the Position type drop-down. Choose where the section or element sticks to: Top, Bottom, or Bottom and top. You can optionally enter an offset value to create space above or below.

title: How can I enable Session Replay in Yandex Metrica?
content: First connect Yandex Metrica to your site. Then sign in to your Yandex Metrica account, click Settings from the left side menu, click the Tag tab, click the Session Replay, scroll map, form analysis toggle to enable it, and click Save.

title: How can I add a new DNS record in my Wix account?
content:
To add a new DNS record in your Wix account:
- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
- Click Manage DNS records.
- Scroll to the record type you'd like to add (e.g. CNAME, TXT) and click + Add Record.
- Enter the DNS record in the relevant fields.
- Tip: If you're instructed to create a DNS record with the @ sign in the Host Name field, leave the Host Name field blank instead.
- Click Save.
- Click Save Changes in the pop-up message.

title: How can I add a Members Area to my Wix restaurant website using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add on the left side of the Editor, click the Community tab, click Members, and click Add to Site. Depending on the template you select, you may already have a Members Area; you can check by viewing the apps installed on your site from your site's dashboard or the Editor.

title: How do I upload a digital file to sell on Wix Stores?
content: You must be the site owner; files cannot be uploaded by a site collaborator. In your site's dashboard, go to Products, click +New Product, select Digital file, click Upload File and select the type of digital file you want to upload, then select or upload the file and click Add to Product.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings for a single blog post in Wix Blog?
content: Go to Blog in your site's dashboard. Select the blog post you want to edit. Click SEO on the left. Customize the URL slug, title tag, and meta description. Click the Let search engines index this page toggle to set whether search engines can crawl and index your page or not. Click Publish.

title: How can I cancel my Business Phone Number service with Wix before it renews automatically?
content:
To cancel your Business Phone Number before it automatically renews:

- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the Business Phone Number you want to cancel.
- Select Cancel Business Phone Number.
- Select Cancel auto renew.
- Click Cancel now.

Important:
- If you turn off the auto-renewal of your phone number subscription, you can still choose to revert to auto-renewal if you change your mind before the expiry date.
- If you cancel your Business Phone Number within the first 14 days after initial purchase, the plan will be canceled and refunded immediately.
- The 14 day money back guarantee period does not apply to renewal payments.

title: What fonts are available in Wix and how can I change them?
content:
Wix lets you choose from a range of fonts. The article includes a table with a complete list of fonts available on Wix, as well as the source for that font type, including sources such as Adobe, Google, Monotype, and System. Examples from the list include Adobe Caslon (Adobe), Amatic SC (Google), Arial (System), Comic sans MS (System), Courier New (System), Georgia (System), Helvetica (Monotype), Lobster (Google), Montserrat (Google), and Open Sans (Google).

You can change your font from the text settings panel, or set text themes to use throughout your site. The availability of some fonts depends on your site language. Some jurisdictions have imposed restrictions of the use of different fonts. Therefore, you need to ensure that you only use the fonts that are allowed according to your jurisdiction's laws and regulations.

title: How can I access and view the Ticket Orders over Time report in Wix Events Analytics?
content: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard and scroll down to the Events section. The Ticket Orders over Time report explores your ticket order performance and trends. You can discover how the number of tickets ordered changed during specific time periods, and compare your data against previous months.

title: Can I migrate my site from the Wix Editor to the Studio Editor?
content: No. If your site was originally created using the Wix Editor, it is not possible to migrate it to the Studio Editor. To take advantage of the new features and functionality, you need to rebuild your site in the Studio Editor.

title: What should I do if I'm having trouble adding additional meta tags to my Wix site?
content:
If you're having issues with adding additional meta tags, try the following:

Check if the meta tag is already added. You can add up to 10 meta tags. However, you can't add the same meta tag twice. It's also not possible to add a default meta tag that Wix already created for you.

Make sure that the meta tag format is correct. You can only use <meta> and <link> tags in valid HTML format.

For example:
<meta key="value" another_key="value"/>
<link rel="value" href="value"/>

title: What is the Wix Retail POS troubleshooting article about?
content: This article is about Wix Retail POS tablet for brick & mortar businesses and provides quick steps to troubleshoot common POS issues.

title: How can I activate notifications for my Wix Forum to notify followers when a forum post is published?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Communications section and click Outgoing notifications. Scroll down to the Wix Forum section. Hover over Notify followers when a forum post is published and click View Summary. If the notification is inactive, click the Inactive toggle to enable it. Note: The default notification Notify followers when a forum post is published is pre-installed for you and cannot be edited.

title: How can I enable or disable push notifications in the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: To enable or disable push notifications in the Wix app on your mobile device: go to your site in the Wix app, tap Inbox at the bottom, tap the More Actions icon at the top right, tap Settings, then tap Notification settings under General Settings. Tap the Allow Push Notifications toggle to enable or disable the relevant notifications. Enabled: you receive push notifications from the notification types of your choice — tap the toggle next to the relevant notification type to enable or disable it; after disabling a notification, choose how long you want to mute notifications for. Disabled: all notifications are disabled — select the time frame you want to disable all notifications for.

title: How can I duplicate a page in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Pages on the left side of the Editor, click the relevant page, click the Show More icon, click Duplicate, enter the new page name, and click Done. Note that you cannot duplicate pages in some apps such as Wix Stores, Wix Blog and Wix Hotels. You can also copy and paste a page from one site onto another site. You can add as many pages to your site as you wish, but sites with a large amount of pages may take longer to load and may affect the performance of the Editor.

title: Can I add a custom podcast feed to my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a custom podcast feed which lets you add specific episodes from different podcasts in one feed on your site. As a workaround, you can add additional podcasts on your site. Note: Adding additional podcasts will automatically add pages to your site.

title: How can I create a revenue or tax report in Wix Invoices?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Invoices. Click the More Actions drop-down at the top right and select View reports. Click Create Report under the type of report you'd like to run: Tax Summary (view all taxes billed during a certain period) or Revenue Summary (view all amounts billed during a certain period). Set the report's date range by selecting start and end dates in the Date Range section. Click the Revenue drop-down and select a report type: Cash Basis (data on invoices paid during the date range) or Accrual Basis (data on all invoices sent during the date range, including both paid and unpaid). Export or print the report: click Export to CSV to download your report in CSV format, or click Print to print the report.

title: How can I add and customize a logo on my site using the ADI Builder?
content: To add a logo using the ADI Builder, click the header inside the ADI Builder. Select the checkbox next to Logo Image / Logo Shape to show your logo. Click Settings next to Logo Image / Logo Shape. Choose Image or Shape. To upload a PNG file, choose Image; to upload an SVG file, choose Shape. Click Replace and select the relevant file. Customize the image or shape with Size, Title (Alt Text), and Link. Size lets you drag the slider to increase or decrease the logo's size; Title (Alt Text) adds a title that also serves as alt text; Link links your logo to an element, page or external site. To customize your logo further, you can use the Wix Photo Studio: right-click your logo in the Header and click Adjust. If you uploaded a logo designed with the Wix Logo Maker, it is not possible to customize it further, in accordance with the Wix Logo Maker Terms of Use. When replacing a logo file, it is not possible to replace a PNG file with an SVG file, and vice-versa.

title: How can I hide a ticket type for an event on my Wix site?
content: Go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard. Click Edit on the relevant event. Click the Tickets tab. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant ticket. Select Hide. To display a hidden ticket, click the More Actions icon and select Show. You can also preselect dates when ticket purchases for an event opens and closes.
