title: How can I purchase additional Google Workspace business emails through Wix?
content:
In your Wix account, go to Business Email. Scroll to the relevant business email and click Add Users. Click the drop-down menu to select the number of additional business emails you want to add, then choose your saved payment method or click Use Another Card and fill in your payment details. Click Submit Purchase.

Important: After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

Note: You can set up your new business emails from the Users section of the Google Workspace Admin console.

title: How can I manually fulfill Printify orders in my Wix store if I haven't set up automatic payment?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Select the relevant order. Click Go to Printify. Click the Orders tab. Select the relevant order. Click the Edit icon. Complete the checkout process, entering your credit card details when prompted. After payment, the order will be created and shipped to your customer.

title: How can I customize the confirmation email for my event in Wix Events?
content:
To edit the confirmation email in Wix Events:

- Go to Events in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant event.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Scroll down to Emails you send to event guests.
- Click the toggle next to Confirmation email:
  - Enabled: Guests receive an email when they register for an event.
  - Disabled: Guests do not receive email confirmation when registering.
- Optional: Edit the content of the confirmation email:
  - Click Edit next to Confirmation email.
  - Change the default text in the email.
  - Deselect the checkbox next to information you do not need to include.

title: How can I remove a dynamic page from my Wix site?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side. For a dynamic page, click Dynamic Pages. Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon. Click Delete, then click Delete to confirm. Publish your site to make the changes go live.

title: Can I purchase a Wix Premium or Studio plan using Sofort?
content: No. From November 29th, 2024, Wix no longer accepts Sofort as a payment method for purchases. If you have used Sofort to purchase a plan in the past, your plan renewal payment will be processed using SEPA. You can update your payment information to use a credit card, or PayPal if that option is available in your region.

title: Can I disable the right-click protect function in my Wix Pro Gallery to allow visitors to download images?
content: Currently, to protect your content, it is not possible to allow visitors to right-click and save/download media from your gallery. You can, however, allow visitors to download gallery items by enabling the Download toggle in your Pro Gallery settings. A download icon appears on each individual item when a visitor hovers over it.

title: How can I ensure that my Wix invoices comply with local laws?
content: Accounting and e-invoicing regulations differ by region, so make sure that your invoices comply with your local laws. You can learn more about managing your invoice settings and the available customizations to ensure compliance with legal requirements. You can also explore accounting apps in the Wix App Market for additional financial integrations to enhance your financial management capabilities.

title: How can I connect a Single Video Player to my CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content: To connect the Single Video Player to the CMS in the Wix Editor: go to your editor. Add a Single Video Player by clicking Add Elements on the left side of the editor, clicking Video & Music, then clicking Single Video Players and dragging the Video Upload player onto your page. Select the player and click the Connect to CMS icon. From the Choose a dataset drop-down, select an existing dataset that connects to your collection, or click Add a Dataset, choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name, and click Create. Under Connections, use the drop-downs to connect the player to collection fields: Video title connects to a Text, Address, or Tags field, or select Add new field; Video source connects to a Video or URL field, or select Add new field. Note: if you choose a URL field type as the video source, the actual title of the embedded video may override the field you chose for your video title. If needed, adjust dataset settings: click Dataset Settings in the Connect Video Player panel on the right, click the permission type next to Permissions to edit your collection's permissions & privacy settings, and choose the Dataset mode: Read or Read & Write. Customize the video player's settings, design, and layout. If the video source is a Video field type, you can enable the video title from the layout settings by clicking the video player, selecting the Layout icon, and enabling the Show video title toggle. Click Preview at the top right to test your connections. Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

title: How can I change the background color of a page in the Wix Editor?
content: To change the background color of a page in the Wix Editor, go to the relevant page in your Editor. Click Site Design on the left side of the Editor. Hover over Page Background and click Customize. Click Color. Select an option from your site's theme colors, or add a custom color under My colors. To add the background to other pages on your site, click Apply to Other Pages at the bottom of the panel. To remove a page background color, change its color to white.

title: What are the initial steps and considerations for exporting products from Mexico to the United States using a Wix Store?
content: The source provides a general summary, not legal advice, and recommends seeking legal counsel. In Mexico, review the official Customs Services Portal and the official Import and Export guide for exportation procedures and requirements, noting requirements may vary by product. Other possible considerations include packaging and labeling, means of transport and freight rates, calculating the export price, an international sales contract, and the most convenient payment method. For importation into the United States, comply with the importation process determined by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), which varies based on the merchandise imported, and investigate any specific requirements such as those set by Partner Government Agencies (PGA). Once the online store is published, set up store shipping to handle potential shipments abroad. The source also recommends checking resources and activities of organizations such as Promexico, Cofoce or the Mexican Association of Online Sales (AMVO).

title: How can I set up shipping to only one or more states or provinces in my Wix store?
content: Go to the Shipping & fulfillment settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Rest of the World toggle to disable it. You should be left with one active shipping rule for your country; if the domestic rule is not set to your country, click Edit Shipping Rule to make changes. Click the All states / provinces checkbox to deselect it. Select the checkboxes next to the regions you want to ship to (e.g. California and Oregon). Click Done. Click Save.

title: 生成否定关键词报告时需满足哪些自检规则？
content: 每个精确否定词要么与产品完全不相关，要么花费高于设定阈值且零转化，触发规则写在每个词旁边；精确与短语否定合计≤20个词，超出部分需标注继续观察的提示；每个否定词都带风险评估，可能误伤有效流量的短语否定被明确标出；预计节省月度花费由粘贴的花费计算（花费×30），不是编造的；观察列表中的词明确标注“暂不否定”，并给出3-5天观察窗口。

title: Can I use the Selection Tags input element to display plain text without any functionality?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use the Selection Tags input element to display plain text without any functionality. You can use the Selection Tags element to let visitors click to filter content or click to submit selections to your collection. Workaround: You can connect text elements to the Tags field type to show the tags as plain text without any clickable functionality.

title: How do I sync SKU IQ with Square and Wix?
content: Before you begin: this feature is currently only available to merchants in the United States, and you must purchase a plan that allows you to accept payments. To sync SKU IQ with Square and Wix: connect Square POS to Wix by going to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, clicking See More Payment Options, clicking Point of Sale, clicking Connect next to Square, and selecting either Have an account or Don't have an account. If you don't have an account, click Create Square account, follow the steps to create an account, then return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account. Add the SKU IQ app to your site by going to the SKU IQ app in the Wix App Market and clicking Add to Site. Create a SKU IQ account by going to the SKU IQ app in your site's dashboard, clicking Sign Up, entering your details such as name, email, and password, clicking Get Started, and verifying your email address. Sync SKU IQ with Square and Wix by opening the SKU IQ app, clicking Start Setup, following the on-screen instructions to connect your Square and Wix accounts, mapping your products and inventory as needed, and clicking Start Syncing. You need to connect your Square account within the SKU IQ app; Wix cannot share user credentials with SKU IQ due to security reasons.

title: How can I add or update an SPF record in my Wix account?
content: To add or update an SPF record, go to your Domains page. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records. Click + Add Record in the TXT (Text) section. Click the Host Name field and enter the host name; leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign. Click the Value field and enter the TXT value. Click Save. Important: The SPF record type is no longer used by all platforms, so you must add SPF records in the TXT section of your DNS records. Contact your email provider to get your SPF record.

title: Can I create conditional sales for restaurant orders using Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes, it's now possible to create conditional sales for restaurant orders by creating coupons and automatic discounts. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app.

title: Can I copy and paste pages between different Studio Editor sites in my account?
content:
While you can duplicate site pages, it is not possible to copy and paste them to a different Studio Editor site in your account.

### Workaround
Save your sections as design assets. This lets you reuse sections you've designed for other Studio Editor sites in your account.

title: How can I change the cover image of a transparent video in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click the transparent video, click the Design icon, then click the Cover Image icon. Select a preset cover image or add your own by clicking the Add icon. Click the Fade out toggle to enable the fade-out effect.

title: How can I set up a Meta Pixel in Wix Stores to track sales?
content: First create a Facebook advertiser account, then sign in to your Facebook account and add the Meta pixel to your Wix account. Next, follow the instructions in the Custom Conversions section of the Meta article to paste your thank you page URL into your Facebook Ads Manager. Your thank you page URL is your domain name followed by /thank-you-page. Once the pixel is linked to Wix Stores, Standard Events are automatically sent to your Facebook account, including when a visitor views a product page, adds a product to their cart, enters the checkout flow, completes a purchase, and the total amount spent on a purchase. You can also define Custom Conversions and Custom Audiences based on your ad tracking needs.

title: How can I customize the SEO basics for my Online Program on Wix?
content:
To customize the SEO Basics for your Online Program:

- Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program. Select Edit Settings. Click the SEO section.
- Click the **SEO basics** tab.
- Customize the following SEO Basics settings under each field:
  * **URL slug (ending of the Online Program page URL):** This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read.
  * **Note:** Click **Go to URL** to view the full URL that potential site visitors see.
  * **Automatically redirect visits from the old URL to the new one:** When you change an Online Program's URL slug, you can choose to let Wix automatically redirect visitors who try to use the old URL to the new URL. Alternatively, you can disable this toggle and manually create your own redirect.
  * **Title tag:** Add a title tag that summarizes the content of the page. Enter your title tag as it is meant to appear on search engines results.
  * **Meta description:** Add a short meta description of the content on the page. This description helps users decide if the Online Program is relevant to them.
- Click the **Let search engines index this page** toggle:
  * **Enabled:** Search engines will index your page. People can find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
  * **Disabled:** Search engines will not index your page. People cannot find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
- Click **Save**.

title: How can I change the payment date for a monthly recurring subscription on Wix?
content:
To change the payment date for a monthly or yearly recurring subscription in Wix:
- Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant recurring plan.
- Click Manage Subscription at the top.
- Click Change payment date.
- Select your preferred payment date, advancing or postponing the payment date, from the calendar in the New date drop-down.
- Click Next.
- Choose whether to apply a credit to the billing cycle: select No, don't apply credit to the next payment if you do not wish to credit your customer for days when services weren't provided as a result of the change; select Yes, apply credit to the next payment to apply credit for those days. If you choose Yes, the relevant amount (including tax) to credit appears automatically, and you can edit the amount.
- Click Next.
- Review the summary of the payment day changes, including credits applied, and click Confirm.

Important: You cannot select a date within 5 days of the date you are changing from. You can change the payment day/date for active recurring Pricing Plans subscriptions only; you cannot change it for subscriptions whose status is pending, in a free trial, or in their last subscription cycle. You also cannot change the payment date if the pricing plan recurs on a daily basis, if you applied a discount to the subscription, or if your site language is not set to English.

title: How do I change the subscription period of my plan?
content: To change your subscription period: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. Click Change Billing Cycle. Select your new billing cycle. Click Continue. Review your billing information and click Confirm. If you switch to a shorter plan cycle, your billing cycle will switch over on the date when your current cycle ends.

title: How can I archive or delete a conversation in the Wix app?
content: To archive or delete a conversation in the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Inbox at the bottom. Tap the relevant conversation. Tap the More Actions icon. Choose the relevant option: Archive conversation moves the conversation to the archive where you can restore later, if needed. Delete conversation permanently deletes the conversation from your inbox; tap Delete to confirm. You can also swipe left on a conversation to archive or delete it quickly.

title: How can I check what my automatic payment to Wix was for?
content: You can check your current subscriptions in the Premium Subscriptions section of your Wix account, and you can view invoices for payments made to Wix on the Billing History page. Learn more about viewing your invoices. If you are still unsure what the payment was for, please contact us.

title: I'm having trouble finding the address section in Wix Hotels rooms. How can I add an address to a room?
content: To add an address to a room in Wix Hotels, go to your site's dashboard. Click the Hotels tab on the left, then click the Rooms tab. Click the Edit icon for an existing room type or click Create New to add a new room type. Scroll down to the Address section, click the Show map location toggle to enable the address option, then enter the city, state, country, street address, and zip code of the property. Click Save at the bottom of the page. Note: You can only add an address to a room after you've set up your hotel. If you cannot find the address section while adding a room, add the room without the address and come back to add the address after setting up your hotel. It is not possible to manage separate hotels with the same Wix site; create a separate site for each hotel.

title: Can I display available class times in a monthly calendar view on Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, when a customer signs up for Classes, they see the available times in a weekly calendar. It is not possible to display the available times in a monthly calendar. Your clients can change the week by changing the date range or using the back and forward arrows.

title: How can I manage my messages in Wix Inbox?
content: Go to Inbox in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant message and click the More Actions icon. Choose the action you want: Save as contact (this option appears only for a message from an anonymous visitor; enter contact details, add a label or assignee, then click Save); Archive (to view archived messages later, click All conversations at the top left and select Archive); Star conversation (to view starred messages, click All conversations at the top left and select Starred); Mark as unread; Report as spam (then click Report & Delete; reporting spam deletes the conversation and deleted conversations cannot be restored); or Delete (then click Delete in the pop-up to confirm; deleted messages cannot be restored). To act on multiple messages, hover over the messages, select the checkboxes to the left, then click the appropriate icon such as Archive, Mark as Unread, or Delete.

title: Can I show or hide services from the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to show or hide services from the Wix app on your mobile device. From your site's dashboard, you can choose which services to show or hide from the Services List.

title: How can I connect my Wix store to a dropshipping service?
content: Connect your Wix store with one of the dropshipping options Wix offers. Then select products that work with your business, set the product markup to determine how much you receive for a sale, tweak the description to suit your style, and add the item to your Wix store. When customers purchase the item, it ships directly from the supplier. You can also look for additional dropshipping services in the app market.

title: How can I add the Wix Focus Timer to my site using the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left. Click Tools. Click Editor Add-ons. Click Get Add-ons. Click Focus Timer.

title: How can I optimize the fonts on my Wix site to improve loading speed and performance?
content:
To optimize fonts and improve loading speed and performance, the source recommends:

- Use system fonts in place of custom fonts where possible. System fonts already exist on most device systems, do not need to be downloaded, and therefore do not impact site performance in the same way custom fonts can.
- Keep the number of fonts (both system and custom) on your page at 3 and below to help keep the site running smoothly and reinforce brand consistency.
- Keep the number of font weights on a page at 3 or below by using them for specific purposes, such as highlighting an area of text.
- Use regular text for meaningful content and avoid overuse of reveal animations above the fold. Animated text can impact readability and SEO because search engines cannot read it.
- Avoid images that contain text where possible. Image text may appear blurry while loading and cannot be translated or crawled by search engines. Use standard text where possible to maintain site performance and SEO ranking.
- If you're using heavy custom fonts on a Studio Editor site, enable default fonts. Default fonts load faster and are temporarily displayed on the live site while custom fonts download in the background. This can optimize page performance by reducing LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), which may improve Core Web Vitals and Google Search ranking. This feature is only available in the Studio Editor.

title: Can clients add tips to the sale of bookings services at a mobile point of sale?
content: Clients can now add tips to the sale of bookings services at a mobile point of sale. Learn how to enable tipping at a mobile POS.

title: How can I improve my Wix site's accessibility using the checklist?
content: Use Wix's accessibility checklist to manually check your site. The checklist recommends: set your site's language; enable visual indicators; check your site's DOM order; prepare your site structure; prepare your images and galleries; prepare your text and graphics; choose clear fonts; reduce motion; make videos and audio accessible; make document files accessible; make Wix Forms accessible; and add an accessibility statement to your site. Wix also notes that you can start from an accessible template, but some advanced features such as custom ARIA labels and alt text need to be added manually. The Accessibility Wizard can scan your site and provide actionable solutions; it is not yet available for Wix Studio.

title: How can I reorder the languages in my Wix Multilingual Language Menu using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the main language version in your editor. Click the Language Menu element on your page. Click Manage Menu. Click a language to drag and drop it into position. Your main language will always appear first in your language menu.

title: How can I optimize the loading order of elements on my website to improve performance?
content: The order that elements load on your site is: static, fluid, interactive. Static elements are low-resolution and generally not animated, such as text and shapes. Fluid elements are content-heavy and may have a higher resolution, such as images or videos. Interactive content may include external code, such as iFrames and third-party apps. Keep the loading order in mind when structuring your site and adding content. We recommend adding elements that load quickest to the above the fold section, as this is the first content displayed when a visitor opens your site.

title: Is it possible to display the File Share app on multiple site pages?
content: Yes, it is now possible to display the File Share app on multiple site pages by adding a Shared Folder.

title: Can I show different registration questions based on the ticket type in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to display different questions on a registration form based on the ticket type. However, you can mark a question as 'optional' for both RSVP and ticketed events.

title: How can I access priority support as a Wix Partner?
content: To get priority support as a Wix Partner, go to your Wix Studio workspace. Click Help at the top. Click Contact Customer Care to get professional support under Chat with us. Click the topic of the issue you're experiencing and follow the directions on your screen to get in touch with priority support. To streamline your support, provide a description of the issue, the domain name (URL) you need help with, the site you need help with, the page name you need help with if applicable, and any relevant details that can help the Customer Care team.

title: Can I reply to Wix Forms submissions directly from my email inbox?
content:
Currently, using new Wix Forms, it is not possible to reply to form submissions through your email inbox. You need to click the button in the email, or head over to your dashboard, in order to respond to the submission.

You can click the email address that appears in the email notification to start a direct conversation. However, the correspondence won’t appear in your Wix account.

title: How can I customize the design of a single event in Wix Events using the Wix Editor?
content:
To customize a design for a single event in Wix Events, use the Wix Editor. Note: customizing the layout for a single event is only available in the Wix Editor.

Go to your editor. Go to the Events page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Event Pages, and click your Events page. Click the Event List element on your page, then click Settings. Choose what you want to customize:

- Ribbons: Click the Display tab, click Ribbons, click the relevant ribbon name and enable the Ribbon toggle. Options include Sold Out Ribbon, RSVP Closed Ribbon, Join Waitlist Ribbon, Membership Ribbon, and Multiple Dates Ribbon. Tip: Click the Text tab to edit the text on the available ribbons.
- General Info / Time and Location: Click the Display tab and use the relevant toggles to show or hide Countdown, Event Name, Description, Event Image, Guests, Social Sharing, Event Time, and Event Location.
- Design: Click the Design tab and click the relevant design elements to customize Text Design, Ribbon Design, Button design, Background, and Spacing.

title: How can I customize the view of a report in the Wix dashboard to focus on specific data?
content:
To customize your view in a report on the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant report.
3. Choose what you want to do:

   #### Change report dates
   Change report dates to get the data you need for a certain time period. You can choose between preset time periods (e.g. Last 7 Days, Previous Month) or choose a custom date range (e.g. January 1, 2023 to March 15, 2024).

   1. Under **Select a time period**, click **Last 30 Days**.
   2. Select a preset period or click **Custom** to create a custom date range.

   **Tip:** Click **More** to see more preset options.

   #### Add filters
   Filter your reports with advanced metrics to only see the data you need. For example, in sales reports you can choose to see only specific service types or payment methods.

   1. Click **More** next to the report options.

   **Tip:** The number next to it (e.g. 23) shows you how many filter options are available.
   2. Select the values next to the relevant filter to apply them to your report.

   **Note:** To remove values from the filter, uncheck the box next to the value name or click the X to remove them.

   #### Select a measure
   Select the value by which you'll be measuring the data. For example, in a Traffic over Time report you can choose to view the number of site sessions or the average session duration.

   Under **Select a measure** click the current measure displayed, then select a different measure in the drop-down.

   #### Group data by time period
   Group data in your chart view according to your preferred time unit. Under **Group by**, click **Day**, **Week**, or **Month** to change the report.

   #### (Table view) Add or remove data columns
   With the new table view, you can add or remove columns to only see the data you need. For example, tailor a report to only include customer details or orders and payment information. You can also drag columns to re-order the table.

   1. Click the **Table (New)** view at the top.
   2. Click **Customize**.
   3. Select the checkbox next to the column(s) you want to add.

   **Tip:** Deselect the checkbox to remove it from the table.
   4. (Optional) Drag and drop columns to reorder the table.

   #### (Bar Chart Split view) Split report data between different metrics
   With the bar chart split view, you can split the data to get a better look based on a specific metric you choose. For example, in the Traffic Over Time report, split data by visitor type to see how many new and returning visitors your site received each day.

   **Tip:** Hover over the report to view exact stats (e.g. the specific date and number of returning visitors).

title: Can I set a step in Online Programs to repeat daily or weekly?
content: Currently, it is not possible in Online Programs to select a step and make it repeat daily, weekly, or periodically throughout the program. You can manually duplicate a step to make it repeat as often as you'd like.

title: I want to create a custom signup form that links to the Members Area on my site.
content:
First, you must have a Members Area on your site to create a custom signup form. The Members Area app comes with a default signup form; you change it to a custom form in the editor.

- In Wix Editor: Click 'Pages & Menu' on the left side of the editor, click 'Signup & Login', click 'Member Signup Form (Default)', choose 'Custom Form' from the drop-down under 'Which member signup form do your visitors see?', and click 'Add to Site'.
- In Studio Editor: Click 'Pages', click 'Signup (Default)', choose 'Custom Form' from the drop-down under 'Which member signup form do your visitors see?', and click 'Add to Site'.

Click any element on the form to customize it. You can add elements such as buttons, images and social share buttons; select a field and click 'Edit Field' to make changes, or click 'Add New Field' to add more fields. To design the form, click the 'Design' icon, click 'Customize Design', and choose 'Input Fields', 'Submit Button', or 'Form Background'. To customize the button, click the button, click 'Change Text' to edit the button text, or click the 'Layout' icon to change text alignment and direction. To change notifications, click 'Form Settings', click the 'Settings' tab, click 'Email Notifications', click 'Set Notifications', and choose how you want to get notified: 'Inbox, email and Wix app' or 'Email only'. When you are finished customizing your form, click 'Exit Mode' on the floating 'Lightbox Mode' bar. Currently, it is not possible to add social logins to a custom signup form; you can add them to the default signup form.

title: How can I replace my old Universal Analytics property with a new Google Analytics 4 property in my Wix site's dashboard?
content:
After you have created your GA4 property, replace your old UA property in the Marketing Integrations section of your site's dashboard:
- In Google Analytics, copy your measurement ID under Web stream details.
- Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard.
- Click View under Google Analytics.
- Click the More Actions icon in the top right corner.
- Click Edit.
- Paste your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID in the pop-up. Make sure there are no extra spaces before the code.
- (Optional) Select the IP Anonymization checkbox if you want to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google.
- Click Save.

title: How can I add individual product categories to my site menu in Wix Stores?
content: To add individual categories to your site menu, click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Click Site Menu. Click the Link icon at the bottom. Select Category Page from the Which Page? drop-down. Select the category you want to display from the Which item? drop-down. Click Done.

title: How can I take a screenshot on my Mac and where is it saved?
content: Press Shift + Command + 4 on your keyboard. Click and drag your cursor to select the area of your screen you wish to capture. Release your mouse or trackpad button. Your screenshot is saved automatically as a .png file on your desktop.

title: How can I connect a payment provider to my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Then either see more options or connect an option: To see more options, click See More Payment Options at the bottom to view more available providers in your location; if available, click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers to view additional providers. To connect, click Connect next to the payment provider you want to use. Connect an existing account by entering your account credentials and clicking Connect, or create an account by clicking Create [Provider] account and following the steps; once created, connect the account using the steps above.

title: Can I create a logo using the Logo Maker directly from the Wix Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a logo using the Logo Maker directly from the Wix Studio Editor, like you can in the Wix Editor. To create a logo, you need to go to Logo & Brand in your site's dashboard and then upload the logo as an image in the Studio Editor.

title: How can I track my Wix Studio payouts and view, download, or print a payout invoice?
content: Go to Payouts in your Wix Studio workspace. From there, you can use Filter to narrow down the list by earning month or amount, use Export to download a .CSV file of your payout invoice history, or hover over a payout and click View Invoice to view, download, or print it.

title: How can I connect Mobile Payment through KOMOJU on my Wix site?
content: On your Wix site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments and check your business location. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Mobile Payment. If you have a KOMOJU account, enter the Secret Key you received from KOMOJU and click Connect. If you do not have a KOMOJU account, click Create new account, follow the instructions to sign up, and after your account is approved repeat the connection steps under the KOMOJU account option. If KOMOJU is already connected and you want to add another payment method, sign in to your KOMOJU account, add the payment method you wish to connect and confirm that it is active, then go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to KOMOJU, and enable the toggle next to your desired payment method. Make sure your payment method is active in KOMOJU.

title: Why was my Google AdSense request rejected due to insufficient content, and how can I resolve this issue?
content: Your site was rejected by Google because it has insufficient content. Not having enough content on your site will cause Google AdSense to reject your application due to "insufficient content". Add more content to your site and resubmit your site to Google AdSense. If your request continues to be rejected, submit a support ticket to Wix and include screenshots of the error message that you received and the home page of your Google AdSense account.

title: How can I change the site title in ADI?
content: Your site's title is displayed in the header at the top of your site. It is automatically taken from your business name. To change your title, click the header section at the top of your site inside ADI, then enter your site title in the Business Name field.

title: how to delete an entire Wix site
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon, then click 'Move to trash'. Click 'Move to Trash' to confirm.

title: How do I get started with the Wix Monetize with AdSense app?
content: Before you begin, make sure your site is connected to a domain and upgraded with a Premium or Studio plan. To get started, add the Wix Monetize with AdSense app. Once it is added, you can manage all the ads from your site dashboard and control where they are displayed. You can choose different ad sizes and shapes, place the ads wherever you want on your site, and choose from text ads, image ads, or ads with both text and image. You have no need for code; everything is done from your Wix dashboard.

title: How can I disable the auto DOM order for specific sections or containers in the Studio Editor?
content: Right-click the relevant section / container. Click Auto DOM Order in the right-click menu to deselect it.

title: How can I add Wix Video to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Video & Music. Select Wix Video. Drag the relevant video player onto your page.

title: Can I create a waitlist for ticketed events in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a waitlist for ticketed events. It is, however, possible to create a waitlist for RSVP events.

title: Can I render Rich Content objects in my Wix Headless projects?
content: You can now render Rich Content objects returned by the Wix SDK in your Headless projects.

title: How can I create a new group of elements in Editor X?
content: To create a new group in Editor X, hold the Shift key and select the relevant elements, then click Group. You can also press Ctrl + G / Cmd + G on your keyboard to group the elements.

title: How can I manage the working hours of my staff members in Wix Bookings?
content: Wix Bookings offers a two-level system for managing staff hours. First, set your default work hours, which apply to all staff. Then, set individual staff members' hours to offer a more flexible service to clients.

title: How can I merge duplicate contacts in my Wix contact list?
content: Go to Contacts in your site's dashboard. Select the checkbox next to the contacts you want to merge. Click Merge at the top of the contact list. View the main contact and contact to be merged. If you need to swap them, click Make Main Contact under the merged contact. If one contact is a site member, it must remain the main contact. Click Preview to review the new contact information. If you need to change the main contact, click Back. Select the checkbox to confirm. Click Merge Contacts.

title: How can I add Site Search to my Editor X site?
content: Click **Add** on the top of Editor X. Click **Menu and Search** on the left. Select **Site Search**. Click the Add to Site icon next to **Site Search** to add the app.

title: How do I customize the Pricing Plans app on my site using the ADI Builder?
content: Add the Pricing Plans app from the ADI Builder: click Add on the top bar, click Apps, hover over Pricing Plans, and click Add. To customize the app, go to the Plans & Pricing page in the ADI Builder, click the Pricing Plans app, click Design to select a new layout, then click the Show More icon and select Settings. In Settings you can: enable Full Width; show or hide Page Header and edit its text; edit Button Text for the "Select" button; choose Plan Info sections including Plan title, Tagline, and Benefits; use Manage Pricing Plans at the bottom to edit plan info text; select a Highlighted Plan (e.g. "Best Value"); edit Ribbon Text; and click the checkmark for Auto Renewal Disclaimer to add an autorenewal disclaimer and tell customers about the renewal policy.

title: How can I send an email campaign to promote my service using Wix Bookings?
content:
To send an email campaign about a service, follow these steps:

- Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant service and click the More Actions icon.
- Click Promote.
- Click Create email campaign.
- Customize your email using the following options: add elements like text, images, videos and links; choose a theme; choose a background.
- Click Next.
- Add participants to the email campaign by: typing contact names in the To: field, selecting a group of contacts by their label, or selecting the checkbox next to the specific contacts.
- Click Next.
- Click Publish.
- (Optional) Click Get Link or any of the social media icons to share your campaign on different platforms.
- Click Done.

You can create a customized email that perfectly matches your brand - select the colors, choose the text and media etc., then choose who to send the email to from your contacts.

title: How can I let clients know how to connect to my online service using Wix Bookings?
content:
To let clients know how to connect to your service, add clear instructions to the confirmation email clients receive when they book your online service. If needed, you can also send the VC link manually from the Booking Calendar.

To customize the confirmation email:
- Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click Emails & SMS Reminders.
- Click Customize on the Confirmation email option.
- Click the relevant tab to choose the service type (Appointments or Classes & courses).
- (Optional) Enable the toggle to Add a video conferencing link to this email.
- Choose which field to edit: Subject or Message. Use Subject to customize the email subject line, and Message to include any information clients need to know before attending.
- (Optional) Click Send test email to send yourself a preview.
- Click Save.

To manually send access details from the calendar:
- Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard.
- Click to select the relevant session.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the video conferencing link.
- Click Email Link.
- Click Send Email.

Note: A default email client must be set up on your computer to contact clients.

title: How can I add a note to a blog post in Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Blog. Select the post that you want to add a note to. Click Notes in the top right corner of the post. Enter your note in the bottom right of the notes panel. Click Add. Tip: Use the "@" symbol with a writer's name to mention them on the post, e.g. "@Jay Cee".

title: Can I upload 360° videos directly to Wix Video?
content: Currently, it is not possible to upload 360° videos to Wix Video. As a workaround, you may upload your 360° video to YouTube and then add it to your Video Library. Note: Embedded videos from YouTube cannot be made available for sale.

title: How can I start earning revenue share as a Wix Partner?
content: First, you need to join the Wix Partner Program. Once you become a Wix Partner, you'll need to connect a payout method in the Revenue Share tab of your Wix Studio workspace to get started. Note: Only workspace owners and co-owners can view and manage the Revenue Share tab.

title: How can I resolve the issue of my homepage's title not matching the business name in the Wix SEO Setup Checklist?
content: Make sure that the business and site name in the SEO Setup Checklist matches your page's title tag and meta description, and the content of your site. You can check your Business or Site Name by clicking the Edit details icon next to your keywords. There, you can also edit your location to match the location written on your site.

title: How can I add a hamburger menu in the Studio Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, then click Menu & Search, click Hamburger Menus, and drag and drop the relevant menu to the desired location on the page.

title: How do I add a Wix Pro Gallery to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Gallery, click Pro Galleries, then drag a Pro Gallery onto your page.

title: How can I resize and crop an image using the Wix Image Resizer?
content:
To resize and crop an image using the Wix Image Resizer, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Wix Image Resizer.
2. Click **Select Images**.
3. Select the image you wish to upload from your computer.
4. Resize your image using the **Resizing Options**:
   * **Pixels:** Enter the width and height you want your image to be.
   * **Percentage:** Use the slider to resize the image to a percent of its original size.
   * **Image Format:** Select a format from the drop-down to download your image in.
   * **Crop & Rotate:** Use the cropping tools to choose a ratio, rotate or flip your image. You can move the cropped area to select the area of your choice.
5. Click **Resize Image**.
6. Click **Download Image** to download your newly resized image.

title: How can I resolve a 403 Forbidden error when trying to access a webpage?
content: A 403 Forbidden error is an HTTP status code that means you are unauthorized to view the page you are trying to access. To resolve a 403 error message: make sure the URL (web address) you entered is correct; clear your browser's cache and cookies; go to the web address you are trying to view again. If the problem persists, contact us.

title: How can I add a new Google Business Profile using my Wix account?
content: To add or set up your Google Business Profile from your Wix account, go to Google Business Profile in your site's dashboard, click Start Now, and select Create New Profile. Enter the name of your business in the search bar. If your business name appears in the list, click your business name, click Next, and click Verify & Manage. If your business name does not appear, click Next, enter a category under Choose a business category and select an option, enter a description and phone number under Basic info, select a location type (At a physical address, Within a service area, or At an address and a service area), and enter your location details based on your previous choice. Click Include optional info (photos, opening hours & more) to add photos, opening hours, and attributes. Click Submit to Google at the top of the page. If you are not signed in to your Google account, you'll be prompted to do so. If you do not have a Google account, you can create one. Follow the prompts to verify your business location. Important: To add or create a profile, you need to have a connected domain.

title: How can I add a new reservation in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click + Add Reservation at the top. Fill out Reservation details: select the Check-in date and time, the Check-out date and time, Adults/Children from the drop-downs, Room type, Rate plan, Meal plan if included with the room type, and Room identifier (for example, "Presidential Suite" or "Beach Hut"). Choose whether Price calculated is Per night or Entire Stay. For Price, click Apply rate plan to use the rate plan pricing, or use Custom price to enter a custom price in the Price field. Fill out Contact details: add the main contact by entering the guest's name and selecting them from the list or clicking + Add New Contact; use Edit to add their phone number, email and billing address; select the checkbox to Email reservation details to the guest; enter the channel through which the guest learned about your hotel. Fill out Extra details: choose Reservation source, enter Confirmation number, and enter Special requests including "early check-in" or "late check-out." Click Add Reservation. Important: make sure to add room identifiers; if a reservation doesn't have a room identifier, it doesn't appear properly in the reservation calendar and only shows that the room is booked. Missing reservations without a room identifier can be found in the Reservations page. Check availability in the Reservation calendar before booking to avoid overbooking; when you overbook, a red line displays under the overbooked room in the reservation calendar.

title: How can I add a new item to my advanced menu in Wix Editor?
content: Click the advanced menu in your editor. Click Manage Menu. Click + Add Menu Item at the bottom. Choose the item type you want to add: Site Pages, Link, Section, Anchor, Dropdown title, or Mega menu. Site Pages add site pages as menu items. Link adds a link to your menu; you can link to external sites, documents, and more. Section adds a page section as an item; when visitors click it, they're brought to the section. Anchor displays a link to a page anchor; clicking it brings visitors to the relevant anchor. Dropdown title adds a dropdown menu to organize your items; once you add the title, you can drag and drop menu items below the dropdown. Mega menu adds a container displayed when visitors hover over the item in the menu; you can change the layout and design of the container and add elements.

title: How do I add and connect the Get Funding app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the App Market in your editor to add the Get Funding app to your site, then connect it to an existing or new PayPal account. In the Wix Editor: click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Get Funding app in the search bar, and click Add to Site. Select the Get Funding app in your editor, click Settings, then click Connect with Paypal. If you don't yet have a Paypal account, click Create one.

title: How can I add a watermark to my photos in Wix Photo Albums?
content: To add a watermark in Wix Photo Albums, go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard, click Manage Album next to the relevant album, expand the Watermark section, enable the Add watermark toggle, and select the Images, Gallery thumbnails, or Cover checkboxes to choose where the watermark is displayed. Optionally, click Customize watermark to upload an image file from your computer, adjust the Opacity slider, adjust the Size slider, and use the Position grid to set where the watermark appears on an image. Then click Save. Note that watermarks are automatically removed when images are purchased or downloaded in high resolution.

title: How can I manage my table reservation notifications in the Wix dashboard?
content:
Go to Table Reservations in your site's dashboard. Click Settings at the top right. Click Notifications. Click Manage Notifications under Notifications preferences. Click the Dashboard drop-down and enable the notifications you want to receive in your Wix dashboard. Click the Email drop-down and enable the notifications you want to receive to your email.

Note: Email notifications for table reservations are sent to your Wix account email address and not the business address set in your business info. If you'd like others to also receive these notifications, you can invite them to manage your restaurant. You can also set up an automation to select additional notifications for table reservations and select the email addresses that should receive them.

title: How can I add the Omnisend app to my Wix site for sending SMS messages?
content: In the Wix App Market, search for “Automated Bookings Emails & SMS”. Click Add to Site. If you have more than one site, select the relevant site. Click Add to Site to grant the app access to your site. Enter your details to register your account with Omnisend, then click Get Started. Optionally, click Launch this workflow and choose an automation such as Booking confirmation via SMS, Booking reminder via SMS, Booking cancellation via SMS, or Booking reschedule via SMS.

title: Why can't I see the Facebook Like and Comment Widget on my website in the EU?
content: A recent change to Facebook's Policy concerning their Like Button for the Web is affecting both the Like and Comment Widget in the EU. As a result of this change, the widgets will not be visible on the site unless the visitor is currently logged into their Facebook account.

title: How can I enable tax collection on my Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap the Settings tab. Tap the Tax tab. Tap the Collect Tax toggle to enable it. If you have more than one tax rule set up, select the rate you want to apply in the POS solution: tap Manage next to Active Tax Rate, tap to select the rate, and tap Save.

title: Is Wix Events integrated with Wix Table Reservations?
content: Currently, Wix Events is not integrated with Wix Table Reservations. This would let restaurant customers see events and buy tickets when they book a table.

title: How do I connect MagicPay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to MagicPay.

If you have an existing MagicPay account: enter your Security Key and click Connect.

If you do not have an account: click Create MagicPay account, register for a MagicPay merchant account, wait for an email from MagicPay to get your unique Security Key, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I add custom info fields to member profiles and ensure they appear on the signup form?
content:
Before you begin, make sure you've added a custom signup form to your site. You cannot add custom fields to the default signup form.

In your site's dashboard, go to Site Members, click the More Actions drop-down, click Manage Member Info, click + Add More Fields, and click + Add Custom Field. Enter the custom field details: Field Name, Field Privacy (choose Public so the information appears on the members' Profile page), and Field Type. Click Save, and repeat as needed.

Make sure the custom fields are public: go to Site Members, click More Actions, click Manage Member Info, hover over the relevant field, click Edit, and choose Public from the Field Privacy drop-down. Make sure the field settings apply to All Members.

In the Editor, click the custom signup form. In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu, click Signup & Login, and click Member Signup Form (Custom). In Editor X, click Pages, then under Lightboxes click the lightbox that serves as your custom signup form. Click Add New Field, click Member Fields, and click the Add icon next to your new custom fields.

Edit the field title and/or placeholder text: click the new field you added, click Edit Field, and enter a title under Field title and/or text under Placeholder text. After members sign up, their responses are automatically displayed on their profile.

title: How can I set multiple contacts as members from the member list?
content: To set multiple contacts as members from the member list, go to Site Members in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions drop-down at the top right, click Set Contacts as Members, select the relevant contacts, and click Set as Members. You can select up to 50 contacts at a time. The selected contacts will receive an email to help them create an account on your site.

title: Is it possible to allow single tap bookings on the Wix Member Apps?
content: Yes. Clients can book a class session in a single tap using their Wix Member apps (Spaces by Wix, Fit by Wix, Branded App by Wix). To enable single tap bookings, select the Skip this form when clients book on a Wix mobile members app option in your Booking preferences.

title: Can I translate CMS Tags fields using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, with Wix Multilingual, it is not possible to translate CMS (Content Management System) Tags fields.

title: How can I manage translations for my Wix Online Programs using the Translation Manager?
content: Before managing translations, add and set up Wix Multilingual. In your site's dashboard, go to Translation Manager. Hover over Online Programs on the left and click the relevant program type: Scheduled programs or Self-paced programs. Note: It is only possible to translate published and active programs. If you auto-translated your site, review the automated translations and edit if necessary. If you didn't use auto-translation, translate the custom fields and policies manually. Click Save and Publish. Currently, it is not possible to override the Online Programs widget texts in secondary languages in your editor.

title: How can I filter blog posts by different writers in the Wix Blog Post Manager?
content: In the Wix Blog Post Manager, go to Blog posts in your dashboard, click the Filter by drop-down, select a filter option, and click Apply. This lets you view your own posts or those by other writers.

title: How can I update my Wix app to the latest version?
content:
To update your Wix app, go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android). Search for 'Wix', then tap Update (if available).

Note: If no update is available, it means you already have the most up to date version, and you can tap Open to access the app.

title: I can't access my old email address to change my password. I have a recovery phone number added to my Wix account.
content: If you previously added a Recovery Phone Number to your Wix account, you can get a one-time SMS code sent to your mobile phone to recover your Wix account. Go to the Wix Log In page, click Forgot Email?, select Can't access my login email, and click Next. Enter the email address associated with your Wix account and click Next. Select Send me a code to my phone number ending with XXXX and click Next. Enter the one-time verification code sent to your phone under Enter code here, click Verify, then enter and retype a new password and click Save New Password. After you recover your account, you should change the email address of your account to one that you are able to access. In Account Settings, click the Account email field, enter your Wix account password in the pop-up, enter and retype your new account email address, and click Next. Check your email account for an email from Wix, copy the confirmation code, return to Account Settings, paste the code into the pop-up, and click Submit.

title: How can I customize the settings of my Wix Pro Gallery to control what happens when a gallery item is clicked?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page. Click Settings. Click the Settings tab. Customize your gallery settings using the options available. To control what happens when site visitors click a gallery item, use the “When clicking on an item” setting. The available options are: Open in Expand — the gallery item opens in expand mode, and you can customize the expand mode from the Design tab; A link opens — site visitors are directed to a link such as a web address, page, or lightbox, and you click Media Manager to set up the link; Nothing happens — nothing happens when site visitors click a gallery item; Open in Fullscreen — the gallery items open in full screen.

title: How can I display room rates on my reservation calendar in Wix Hotels?
content: Go to your dashboard, click the **Hotels** tab, click the **Reservations** tab, then select the checkbox next to **Show Rates**. Note: this refers to the original Wix Hotels.

title: How can I set a lightbox to automatically display when a page loads in Wix Editor?
content: Open the relevant lightbox from the **Menus & Pages** panel. Click the lightbox. Click **Set Triggers**. Under **Automatically display lightbox on pages**, select **Yes**. Click the **Which pages is it on?** field and select the pages you want the lightbox to appear on, or select the **First page visitor sees** checkbox. Drag the **Delay** slider to increase or decrease the time between the page loading and the lightbox appearing. **Note:** This slider does not appear on all lightboxes. Optionally, set a schedule for your lightbox: use **Dates** to select the start date and end date, **Times** to select the start and end time, **Time zone** to choose your time zone, and **Clear scheduling** to remove scheduling you previously added to the lightbox.

title: How can I add and customize a social bar on my site using ADI?
content:
Add a social bar to your site and connect visitors to all your social networks; the social bar displays on all your site's pages and scrolls with your site.

Step 1 | Add a social bar: Most templates already come with a social bar. If needed, add the Social Bar app: Click Add on the top bar inside ADI, click Apps, hover over Social Bar, and click Add.

Step 2 | Add social network links: Click the social bar in the ADI Builder, hover over the social network you want to link to on the left and click the Edit icon, then paste your social network link in the relevant field. You can add additional social networks to the 3 existing networks (Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn) by pasting the link in the Paste your link here field; the relevant icon is automatically added.

Step 3 | Customize: Hover over the social bar in the ADI Builder and click Social Bar. Click Design and choose from 4 design options. Click a color on the color palette to apply it to your social bar. Click Edit site colors to completely change the colors available for your social bar.

Notes: Removing social links or hiding social icons does not delete the app from your site. Click the Edit icon on the social bar and click Delete to remove the social bar from your site.

title: Is it possible to automatically assign member roles when a user fills out a form?
content: Currently, member roles are assigned manually. It is not possible to automate this process, for example, by filling out a form.

title: How can I change the prices for digital and prints in my Wix Photo Albums Store?
content: Go to your Photo Albums Store. Click the Pricing tab. Click the Expand icon on the relevant file to edit. Enter in your new price amount for each file. When you're ready, click Save.

title: How can I reorder my pricing plans in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to your Plans & Pricing page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click your Plans & Pricing page. Click the Plans & Pricing element on your page, then click Settings, Plans, and Reorder Plans. Drag and drop the plans into your preferred order. Click Publish to make the change live on your site, then click Done. You can also display your pricing plans by type using tabs to help customers find the plan that is right for them.

title: How can I connect my Facebook page to Wix Inbox to manage messages more efficiently?
content: Access your Wix Inbox Settings to connect new channels, then connect your business's Facebook page. Once connected, all messages your customers send you via your Facebook page appear in your Wix Inbox, so you can manage communications in one place.

title: What are the recommended image sizes for cover images in a Wix blog, and how do they vary by layout?
content:
The recommended size for cover images in a Wix blog depends on your blog layout:

- **Side by side**: 940 x 705 px (Ratio: 4 x 3)
- **Editorial**: 940 x 705 px (Ratio: 4 x 3)
- **Tiled**:
  - Minimum size: 940 x 186 px (Ratio: 15 x 3)
  - Maximum size: 940 x 1456 px (Ratio: 9 x 14)
- **Magazine**: 940 x 940 px (Ratio: 1 x 1)
- **One Column**: 940 x 400 px (Ratio: 21 x 9)
- **Full Post**: Not applicable

title: How can I manually add a client to a Pricing Plan when selling offline?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Pricing Plans. Click More Actions at the top, then click Sell plan offline. Add your client by selecting an existing contact from the list, or by clicking + Add New at the bottom and entering the person's details. Click Next. Select the relevant plan from the drop-down and choose the start date for the plan. Click Collect Payment at the top right. Depending on the payment status, choose Charge with credit card, Mark as paid, or Mark as unpaid. Click Confirm.

title: How can I ensure that non-Latin characters in my contacts are imported correctly into Wix?
content:
To ensure non-Latin characters are properly imported, your file must be saved as comma-separated.

1. Upload your CSV file to Google Spreadsheets.
2. Click File, then Download As.
3. Select Comma-separated values.

Note: Do not open the file.
4. Import your contacts.

title: Can site members edit their password and email within their profile?
content: Yes. Site members can now edit their password and email from the member profile. Site members have full control over their member login information and can quickly update their login details without the need to contact the site owner. Site owners can still reset members' passwords and change members' login email addresses.

title: How can I invite new members to my site using the Fit by Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile App. Tap the Share icon. Then choose one of the following methods. Email Wix Contacts: Email the contacts saved in your Wix account. Note: To use this feature, you need to upgrade your site with a plan. Tap the available email provider (e.g. Gmail). Customize your email with To, Title, and Message. Click Send. Send an SMS: Send the link and invitation code to people by SMS (text message). Tap Send an SMS. Choose if you want to allow the Wix app to access your contacts. Select the contacts you want to invite. Tap Next. Tap Send in the message field on your phone. Share via Social & More: Share the link and invitation code to any social network connected to your phone. Tap More. Choose how you want to send your invite to, for example Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail and more. Tap Send. Copy Link: Copy the link and paste it into a new message in any application. Tap Copy link. Paste the link into a new message using the application of your choice.

title: How can I manage the privacy settings for my site members using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor; click Members Area, then select the Member Page; select the Member Page element; click Manage Member Privacy. Under Who can set their profile to public, select All site members or No one. Under Who can see public member profiles, select Anyone or Only site members. Click Save to apply your changes.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual with the Branded App by Wix to offer my app's content in multiple languages?
content: Currently, Wix Multilingual is not available to use with Branded App by Wix. Your branded app's content can only be offered in one language.

title: How can I create a new event category in Wix Events?
content: Go to Event Categories in your site's dashboard. Click + New Category. Enter a category name and click the Checkmark icon. Note: This name doesn't appear on your site. You use it to select a category to display. Click + Connect Events. Select the checkbox next to the relevant events, or the checkbox at the top to select all events. Tip: You can adjust the filters at the top right to view specific events. Click Confirm.

title: Can I view a detailed log of information for my invoices, including how many payments were made and when it was sent by which collaborator?
content: Currently, you can view information about your invoices on your Wix Invoices dashboard. However, it is not possible to view a detailed log of information; including how many payments were made and when it was sent by which collaborator. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

title: Is there a feature in Wix Forms that requires visitors to validate their email address by entering it twice before submitting a form?
content: Currently, in the new Wix Forms, there is no existing field requiring visitors to validate their email address by entering it twice before submitting a form. An email validation field is useful to reduce email errors and typos.

title: How can I add and customize a VK Share button on my Wix site?
content: Add a VK Share button to your site so visitors can easily share your site with their VK contacts. To make it unique, customize the button text with a catchy call-to-action. To add a VK Share button: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Social. Under VK, click a VK Share button to add it, or alternatively drag the button to the relevant location. Click Change Text. Enter the text that should appear on the VK Share button. To customize your button layout: Click the Layouts icon. Select one of the VK Share button layout options.

title: How do I upgrade my email marketing plan?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Under Monthly Balance click Upgrade. Choose a plan that works best for you and checkout.

title: How can I send email invitations or promotions for an event using Wix Email Marketing?
content:
Before you begin, make sure your site is published before you send your email invitation.

To send email marketing about an event:
- Go to Events in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant event.
- Click the Guests tab for RSVP events or the Orders tab for ticketed events.
- If your event already has registered guests, click the More Actions icon and then click Send Email Marketing.
- If your event still has no registered guests, click Create Invitation.
- Browse through the templates and select the one you want to use.
- Customize your email template, then click Next.
- Add recipients: select contacts in your account, or enter email addresses manually or click Import Contacts.
- Click Next.
- Enter the newsletter details: Subject Line, From Name, and Reply-to Email.
- If you have not yet confirmed your email address, click Confirm Now.
- Optional: click Send Test Email to see what your event invitation will look like to recipients.
- Click Send.

Important: Read the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use before sending an email campaign. To access more features and send more campaigns, you can upgrade your email marketing plan.

title: How can I personalize my free Wix URL and what are the limitations?
content: When you publish your site for the first time, your web address is in the format siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress. You can personalize the free Wix URL by editing: Site URL prefix: by default this is generated from your name in your Wix account, and you can edit your site URL in your Account Settings. Site address: this is the name of your website; you choose your site name when saving your site for the first time, and you can edit it at any time from your site dashboard. Important: the 'wixsite.com/siteaddress' part of the URL is not removed. You need to upgrade your site with a plan before you can connect a custom domain to your site.

title: How can I use Wix Bookings to manage different types of services for my clients?
content: Wix Bookings offers a comprehensive scheduling solution that allows clients to book different kinds of services. Whether you and your staff offer full courses, classes, one-on-one session for free or for a fee, you can handle it all in Wix Bookings.

title: How do I create a new workspace in Wix Studio?
content: When you switch to Wix Studio you'll land in a new account-level workspace. If you wish to create a new workspace, click the Workspace dropdown located in the top bar, then click Create Workspace. Choose a name, add a logo or image, and click Create a Workspace.

title: How can I customize the sender details for automated emails using the new automation builder?
content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Create a new automation or edit an existing one. Make sure Send an email is selected as the Action. Click the Send an email action in your flow to open the panel. Click Edit under Sender details. For Sender's name, edit the name that appears in the recipient's inbox and click Save. For Reply-to email, edit the email address people reach when they hit reply and click Save. Then click Activate or Save at the top right. Automated emails sent from a public email service like Gmail or Yahoo tend to land in the spam or promotions category, so it is better to use an authenticated address. If you use a public domain address, Wix redirects your email through its own authenticated address; only your name and subject line appear in the inbox, and replies go straight to your inbox. You may be asked to confirm your reply-to address by email with instructions.

title: How can I customize the information displayed on my Wix blog feed?
content:
To choose what info you want to show:

- Click the Blog page in your Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Display tab.
- Select or deselect the checkboxes to show or hide info on the feed.
- (Editor X only) Enable the Category labels toggle to display your categories at the top of the feed.
- (Editor only) Click Blog Menu to choose what appears on the menu:
  - Click the Show Blog Menu toggle to show or hide the menu at the top of the feed:
    - Enabled: Select or deselect the checkboxes to choose what info you want to show on the menu.
    - Disabled: The menu does not appear at the top of the feed.
- Click Social Sharing to choose which social icons you want to show.
  - Click the Enabled Social Sharing toggle to show or hide the social icons:
    - Enabled: Select or deselect the checkboxes to choose which icons you want to show on the feed.
    - Disabled: The social icons do not appear on the feed.

title: How can I block a phone number using my Wix Business Phone Number?
content: Blocking a number is only available if you have purchased a Business Phone Number. If you do not have a Business Phone Number, you can still report a message as spam. To block a phone number using the Dashboard: Go to Wix Inbox in your site's dashboard. Select the conversation you want to block. Click the More Actions icon next to the contact name. Click Block Number. Note: If both the email and phone number of the contact are listed, click Report & Block to block the phone number and report the email address as spam. Click Block & Delete to confirm. To block a phone number using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Inbox at the bottom. Tap the conversation you want to block. Tap the More Actions icon at the top and tap Block Number. Note: If both the email and phone number of the contact are listed, tap Report & Block to block the phone number and report the email address as spam. Tap Yes to confirm. You can view all your blocked numbers in your blocked numbers list.

title: How can I disable the pop-up blocker for Wix.com in Mozilla Firefox?
content:
To disable the Firefox pop-up blocker for Wix.com, follow these steps:

- Click **Firefox** in the menu bar at the top of the screen.
- Select **Preferences** or **Settings**.
- Scroll down to the **Permissions** section.
- Click **Exceptions...** next to **Block pop-up windows**.
- Type **www.wix.com** and click **Allow**.
- Click **Save Changes**.

title: How can I add a title and description to my photos in Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Album next to the relevant album. Click Edit on the top right. Click the Text tab in the panel on the left. Click the Galleries tab at the top. Click the checkbox to enable or disable the title and description that appears on your gallery. Customize how the text appears on your gallery: Alignment: Choose how you want to align your text (to the left, in the center, or to the right). Vertical alignment: Choose how you want the button to align on hover (above, in the center, or below the photo). Note: The above options depend on what gallery layout you choose. Different options are available if you choose Grid, Slider, Strip or Column layouts. Click the toggle to add a Buy Now button. Customize the text in the text box that will appear on the button. Click the Media tab. Hover over the relevant gallery and click Manage Media. Select the relevant image. Edit the title and description on the right. Click Done on the bottom left. (Optional) Publish your changes by clicking Publish Now at the top right. If some of your photo's titles and descriptions are being cut off, set the text box height of the title and description to Set Manually and increase the size until it's big enough to fit in all the text.

title: How can I connect MONEI as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to MONEI.

If you have an account: enter your API Key and click Connect.

If you don't have an account: click Create MONEI account, register for a MONEI merchant account. Once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I use NMI as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer NMI as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through NMI and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I customize the design of my site forms using the new Wix Forms?
content:
To design your site forms using New Forms:

- Click the relevant form on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Design tab.
- Customize the form design using the available options:
  - Form Background: Choose the form background color, as well as the border color and width.
  - Form Fields: Select a form field style and customize the opacity, font, font size, etc.
    Tip: You can design how fields appear in different states: Regular, Hover, and Error.
  - Header and Paragraph: Choose a font and color for the form text.
  - Buttons: Design the form buttons including how they appear on hover (e.g. submit button, back button, etc.)

Note: Designing your form is currently only available for site forms. For standalone forms, you can manage form fields but not update their design.

title: How can I customize the design of my Wix Video player, including text and buttons?
content:
Go to your editor. Click the Wix Video player. Click Settings. Click Design and choose what you want to customize:

* Text: Design the text that appears on your player, including shape and color. If your chosen layout includes thumbnails, you can also choose their font.
* Buttons: Customize the buttons that appear on your player, including their color.
* Player: Choose how your player appears, including the opacity of both your cover image and background.

Note: Make sure that the background color does not match the button text and color. If the colors are the same, the button and text will not show up.

title: How can I create an email campaign to promote my music using Wix Music?
content:
Important: You need to upload music for the player to work.

To create an email campaign for your music:
- Go to your Music Library.
- Select the music you want to promote.
- Click Show More on the top right.
- Click Promote.
- Hover over a template and click Use Template.
- Add the music player to your campaign:
  - Click Add on the left.
  - Click Music.
  - Select your music from the drop-down menu.
  - Next to Choose Theme, select an option:
    - Light: The color scheme is light.
    - Dark: The color scheme is dark.
  - Click Apply.
- Customize your email campaign.
- Click Next to send your email campaign.

Note: You can also access and create an email campaign from your Email Marketing dashboard. From there you can check the status and statistics of your campaign.

Tips:
- Add Get Subscribers to your site, so fans can receive your email campaigns!
- You can track all your analytics related to Wix Music using Wix Analytics Reports.

title: Can I redirect site members to a specific page after they sign up or log in on my Wix site?
content:
Currently, when a site member signs up or logs in to your Wix site, they are directed to the page they signed up/logged in from. It is not possible to redirect site members to a specific page after they sign up or log in.

As a workaround, you can add a button to your page and link it to a members-only page. When your visitors click the button and log in, they will be directed to the members-only page.

To link a button to a members-only page (Wix Editor or Studio Editor):
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Button**.
- Drag a button onto your page.
- Click the button on the page.
- Click the **Link** icon.
- Select a members-only page on your site under **Which page?**.
- Click **Done**.
