content: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Create a new automation or edit an existing one, and make sure Send an email is selected as the Action. Click the Send an email action in your flow to open the panel. Under Create an email, choose Edit to customize existing elements in the email, add more elements, and add personalized content to the email. When ready, click Save & Continue/Publish. You can also choose Switch template to use a different email template from a different automation or email marketing campaign. Then click Activate or Save to activate or save your automation.

title: How can I add an info section to a single product in Wix Stores?
content: To add an info section to a single product in Wix Stores, go to Products in your site's dashboard. Create a new product or edit an existing one. Click + Add an Info Section. Enter the info section title. Enter the relevant information and use the text editing toolbar to format the text. Click Save.

title: Can I still add the Wix Art Store to my site?
content: No. As of October 2022, it is no longer possible to add the Wix Art Store to your site. Alternatively, you can add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your art.

title: Can I access the CSS code of my Wix site?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to access the CSS code of your site. Many CSS changes can be made by updating your content in the Editor. The changes take effect when you click Publish.

Tip: CSS editing is one of many advanced features that are available in the Studio Editor.

title: How can I embed a Pinterest widget on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To embed a Pinterest widget on your Wix site using the Wix Editor, generate the widget code directly from Pinterest for the widget you want (Pinterest Board, Pinterest Pin, Pinterest Profile, Pinterest Follow button, or Pinterest Save button). Copy both sets of code; the last piece of code needs to be added to the end of the first piece of code before the closing tag. Then go to the Wix Editor: click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Embed Code, click Embed HTML, click Enter Code, make sure Code is selected under What do you want to add?, paste the copied code into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field, and click Apply. Optionally enter alt text that describes what you are embedding in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field, then publish your site when ready.

title: Can I embed images into Wix Forum?
content: Currently, it is not possible to embed images into Wix Forum.

title: Can I add a PayPal 'buy now' button directly in ADI?
content: ADI currently lets you add a PayPal donate button inside ADI. For a PayPal "buy now" button, the article directs you to create an embed code and add it to an HTML embed element to display your embedded content on your ADI site.

title: Can I use a free domain voucher to renew my existing domain with Wix?
content: It is not possible to renew an existing domain using the free domain voucher. The voucher is only valid towards the purchase of a new domain from Wix. The voucher is valid for select extensions only, and it does not cover Private Registration or additional years of service, which are available for an extra fee.

title: What should I do if my video fails to upload on Wix Video due to incompatible file type or encoding issues?
content: Wix Video says videos can fail to upload for different reasons, including incompatible file type or encoding issues. If you use video editing software, export the file using the YouTube export settings. Wix Video supports many video formats, but recommends uploading MP4 or MOV files encoded with the H.264 codec. If the upload is slow, check your internet connection, try restarting your modem and router, and make sure your computer does not go into sleep mode. Check browser settings: ensure the browser is updated, try a different browser, and check for add-ons that may slow the upload. Remove privacy settings on the platform's end; for example, if using YouTube, turn off all privacy settings so the video can be added to Wix. If the issue persists, upload the affected video file to Google Drive or Dropbox and add a download link in your next reply, making sure the link is public.

title: Can I run a local build for development and testing purposes using the Wix CLI?
content: Currently, when using the Wix CLI to develop a site, you need to open an editor in order to test your code. A local build for development and testing purposes using the Wix CLI is a requested feature.

title: Is there an alternative data grid format for importing content into a collection in the CMS?
content: Currently, the only option you can use to bulk import content into a collection is to import your content from a CSV file. There is no other built-in data grid or spreadsheet format with more functionality for bulk content import.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site complies with data protection regulations regarding cookies?
content: Wix states it will do its best to provide site owners with the required tools to be compliant with the new regulations. The listed tools include displaying a Cookie Banner on your Wix site.

title: How can I start using the Barcode Man Label Printing app by Gookit on my Wix site?
content: To use the Barcode Man Label Printing app by Gookit on your site, you need to add Wix Stores. The app is only available in English and Chinese. Its features include a convenient drag and drop editor, printing barcodes in different label formats, adjusting every aspect of your labels, and support for SKU, Image, Barcode, QR code, Custom text, and more. For questions or comments, contact Gookit directly.

title: Can I set a different email address specifically for approving site members when manual approval is enabled?
content: Currently, all new member requests are sent to the email address in the business information of the site. If you have manual approval enabled, then it is not possible to set a different email address specifically for approving site members.

title: How can I link my sub-galleries to a main gallery in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Once you have established your sub-gallery pages or lightboxes, add the Wix Pro Gallery where you want the main gallery to appear. Add the media that serve as the "cover images" for each gallery. To link each cover image to its related sub-gallery: select the Pro Gallery in your editor and click Settings; click the Settings tab; click the When clicking on an item drop-down and select A link opens; click Manage Media; select an image for the sub-gallery's "cover image"; click the Link icon on the right and select Page or Lightbox; select the relevant sub-gallery page or lightbox and click Done. Repeat for each of your sub-galleries.

title: Why does Google Search Console show a "Page with redirect" message in the Coverage report, and does it affect my site's ranking?
content: If you see a "Page with redirect" message in your Coverage report, it means Google found a page with a redirected URL on your site and did not index it. Google excludes pages like this from search results to avoid duplicate results or because it has detected errors. This can be caused by situations such as upgrading your site, where the redirect is from your free Wix URL to your own custom domain URL; setting up redirects for these pages in the URL Redirect Manager; a redirect from the HTTP version of your site's URL to the HTTPS version; or a redirect from the version without www to the version with www. In these cases, this behavior is normal and won't affect your site's ranking.

title: How can I change the direction of subpages in a vertical menu using Wix Editor?
content: Click your menu. Click the Layouts icon. Select an option under How do dropdown menus open?: To the right: The subpages of your dropdown menu open to the right of the menu item. To the left: The subpages of your dropdown menu open to the left of the menu item.

title: How can I customize my logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
content:
First, fill in your business info and select a logo suggestion. Then, in the Logo Maker Editor, click **Customize Your Logo** at the top right. Click the tabs on the left (you can also click the element itself to open its tab):

* **Templates:** Choose a new template for your logo.
* **Palette:** Select a new color palette for your logo. Color palettes come in presets of 4 colors. You can change the individual colors in the other tabs.
* **Text:** Customize the business name and tagline. (There is a 50-character limit for each).
* **Symbols:** Click **Add Symbol** to add a symbol to your logo.
* **Shapes:** Click **Add Shape** to add a circle or a rectangle to your logo.
* **Images:** Click **Upload Image** to add your own image to your logo.

**Note:** Currently, you can only upload .JPEG and .PNG images with a maximum size of 500 MB.

* **Background:** Your logo comes with a white background by default. Use the color picker to change the color.

**Note:** Currently, it is not possible to fill the entire logo's background with an uploaded image. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, vote for that feature.

**Managing elements:** Click any element to align, move to the back/front, duplicate or delete it.

title: How do I connect my existing Transbank account to Webpay Plus on my Wix site?
content:
To connect your existing Transbank account to Webpay Plus on your Wix site:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click Connect next to Webpay Plus by Transbank.
- Enter your Código de Comercio.
- Click Connect.

Make sure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Transbank account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined.

title: How can I add alt text to images in my Wix site using the Accessibility Wizard?
content: Go to your editor. Click Settings at the top and select Accessibility Wizard. Click Scan My Site in the Accessibility Wizard panel. Select cards titled Alt text. Enter the image description into the What's in the image? field. Click Set Alt Text. Make sure to publish the site so the alt text is live. The article notes that adding alt text to images or galleries in bulk is not currently possible.

title: How do I set up Dayful by Wix for my business?
content: Go to the Dayful by Wix site and click Start Free. Sign up using email and password, Continue with Google, or Continue with Facebook. Enter your business type, click Next, enter your business name, optionally enter your website URL, and click Continue to dashboard. Important: Connect a payment method and upgrade your plan to accept payments through your site. With a free plan, you can add one staff member and create one service. Free plans do not support online payments.

title: How can I translate my Wix Events page into multiple languages?
content:
Before you begin, add Wix Events to your site and set it up, and add and set up Wix Multilingual.

To translate your Events page:
- Go to Translation Manager in your site's dashboard.
- Click Events on the left.
- If you auto-translated your site, review the automated translations and edit if necessary. If you didn't use auto-translation, translate the custom fields and policies manually.
- Click Save and Publish.

After that, translate the event's text elements in your editor. Use the Switch languages drop-down menu, go to the Events page, click the Event List element, click Settings, click the Text tab, and update the relevant text as needed.

If the Event Details & Registration page is enabled, translate the Event Details element the same way. When finished, publish your site and test your event.

title: How can I use calculation to determine the size of an element in Editor X?
content:
Select the relevant element in Editor X. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X. Under Size, click the current measurement marked in blue. Click Calculation. Enter the formula for your element's width or height.

For example, you can design a header (100px) and a section that together take up the exact viewport height (100vh), and set the section's height to (100vh - 100px).

title: How can I hire a blog writer through Wix Marketplace?
content:
To hire a blog writer through Wix Marketplace:
- Go to the Blog tab on your site's dashboard.
- Click More Actions at the top left.
- Click Hire a Blog Writer.
- Choose what type of content you need.
- Select your site's publication status.
- Choose your preference.
- Select your site language.
- Enter your contact details.
- Click Submit.

Once you've submitted all the relevant details, you will be matched with a blog writer. You are not committed to anything at this stage. Wix Marketplace will contact you with some options and you can decide if you want to proceed.

title: How can I create a branded app without a connected Wix site?
content:
To create a standalone branded app that is not connected to any Wix site:

- Go to the Branded App by Wix site.
- Click Build Your App.
- Select Create a branded app from scratch and click Continue.
- Choose the type of branded app you want to create then click Continue.
- Wix prepares your siteless dashboard. Start setting up your app by adding the app's name, uploading an app icon image, and choosing a brand color and navigation layout. You can change all this later in your dashboard.
- Click Continue to Dashboard.
- To start editing your app's content right away, click Edit Mobile App at the top right of your dashboard.

Tip: The Home tab checklist shows you the next steps to get your app live in the App Store and Google Play.

Your branded app dashboard is where you can manage all aspects of the app. Once you've built your app's content, next steps include connecting a payment method to your app if you are planning on selling goods via the app, purchasing a Branded App plan for this site, connecting an Apple Developer and Google Developer account, and submitting the app to the App Store and Google Play.

title: How can I edit the site colors in the Studio Editor?
content: Click Site Styles on the left side of the editor. Select the Colors tab. Click the color you want to adjust. Choose how to select the middle color in the range: select a new color from the picker using your cursor, input the HEX, RGB, or HSB information into the relevant fields, or click the Dropper to select a new color from anywhere on your screen. Click Apply.

title: How can I get help with an issue regarding my printed merchandise order from Order a Print?
content: Order a Print, not Wix, handles creating and shipping your merchandise, such as business cards, t-shirts, and mugs with your printed logo. For any issue with your order, contact Order a Print directly through their website or by email at support@orderaprint.com. Include your order number and the email associated with your Wix account. Contact them directly if you received damaged, defective, or missing items, want to cancel or update your order, or wish to request a refund for printed merchandise.

title: How can I add an age disclaimer using a popup in Wix Editor?
content: Add a lightbox in Wix Editor, click the lightbox, and open the Settings icon. Under Automatically display popup on pages, select Yes. Set Which pages is it on? to First page visitor sees. Disable the X icon toggle and enable the Close button toggle. Click the Close button on your popup and click Change Text to enter the confirmation text. Customize your popup to create your age disclaimer, then customize and set it up for mobile. Note: by default, popups won’t appear on your mobile site unless enabled in the Mobile Editor, because Google does not like intrusive popups on mobile sites and having a popup enabled may negatively impact your site’s SEO.

title: How can I verify my Wix site with Google Search Console using the Wix SEO Dashboard?
content: To use the SEO dashboard, you need to verify your site with Google Search Console. You can let Wix do this for you using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, or you can verify your site manually. To connect to Google Search Console, you must have a Premium plan and a domain connected to your site. This can be either a domain purchased from Wix or a domain purchased from another domain host.

title: How can I edit an existing Google AdSense ad on my Wix site?
content: To edit an existing Google AdSense ad, in your editor click the Wix Monetize with AdSense app. Right-click and click Copy. Navigate to where you want to place the ad, right-click, and click Paste. Go to the AdSense dashboard and create a new ad. Select Display Ads as the ad type, and do not select "Responsive" as the ad size. Save the ad and copy the ad code. Go back to your site and select the Wix Monetize with AdSense app in your editor. Click Settings. Paste the code and click Activate. Delete the old AdSense App in the editor. Note: It may take up to 48 hours for the ad to be displayed on your site.

title: How can I add and set up a PayPal Donate button on my Wix site?
content:
To use the PayPal button, you must have a PayPal Business or Premier account. You don't get notifications in your Wix account for donations made through PayPal buttons, because payments are made to the PayPal account, not your Wix account.

Step 1 | Add a PayPal Donate button
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Button.
- Click PayPal Buttons.
- Drag the Donate button on to your site.

Step 2 | Set up your button
- Click the PayPal button in your Editor.
- Click Add PayPal Info.
- Select Donating under What's this button for?.
- Set up your button using the options: What's your PayPal email?, What's the donation for?, Want to add an ID number? (optional), Let visitors set own amount (Enabled/Disabled; if Disabled, enter What's the donation amount?), What's the currency?, How does PayPal open?, and What language is the button in?.
- You must fill the PayPal email field in order to complete your button's set up.

Step 3 | Choose a layout for your button
- Click the button in your Editor.
- Click the Layout icon.
- Select a layout preset from the options.

title: Can I book and accept payment for new class sessions using the Wix App at a mobile POS?
content: Currently, it's not possible to book and accept payment for new class sessions at a mobile POS. It is possible to accept payment at a mobile POS for sessions that have already been booked, and to book and accept payment for appointments.

title: How can I add Klarna as a payment method in Wix Payments?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click **Manage** next to Wix Payments. Enable the toggle next to Klarna.

**Note**: You can disable the toggle at any time to remove Klarna from your payment options.

title: How can I edit my Facebook ad campaign using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard. Click the Campaign Actions drop-down. Click Edit campaign. You return to Review & Launch in campaign setup to make edits. Click Edit next to the section where you want to make updates. When you've finished making edits, click Submit Changes. Click Submit Changes in the pop-up to confirm. Your ads will not be live on Facebook as the changes first go to Facebook for review. Important: If you make any changes to your campaign, it must go back through the Facebook review process. While your campaign is in review, your ads are not live on Facebook. If you want to change your campaign budget, you will pay the new amount immediately, regardless of where you are in your subscription.

title: Is Midtrans supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Midtrans as a payment provider. If you use the manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Midtrans Payments and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I ensure that my weekend rates are correctly set up when connecting Wix Hotels to the Channel Manager?
content: Make sure to add both your weekday prices and weekend prices. If the price is the same, input the same value in both fields. The Channel Manager requires both to be completed to avoid any syncing issues.

title: How can I create a price discount coupon in the new Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: In the new Wix Restaurants Orders app, go to Coupons in your site's dashboard and click + New Coupon. Select Price as the Discount type. Enter the Coupon code, Coupon name, and discount amount. Decide which menus, sections or items the coupon applies to, or decide on a minimum order subtotal; if you chose a specific item, section or menu, select which items get the discount. Set when the coupon is valid by entering the start date and end date, or select the Don't set an end date checkbox. Optionally select Limit the total number of uses for this coupon and enter the total number of times the coupon can be used. Click Create Coupon.

title: Can I change my profile name in Wix Customer Care?
content: Your profile name in Wix Customer Care is the Wix account name you used when you submitted your first support request. You can change your account name, however this does not change your support profile name.

title: Can I change the price option for a booked service on a client's behalf in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the price option for a client after they have already booked a service. Workaround: You can cancel and refund the original booking and then manually create a new booking with the correct price option.

title: Can I use a barcode scanner with Wix Mobile POS?
content: Using a barcode scanner with Mobile POS is one of the requests you can vote for.

title: How can I switch my payment provider to Wix Payments on my Wix site?
content: To change your payment provider to Wix Payments, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard and click Connect next to Wix Payments. Click Yes, Switch to confirm your new provider. If you don't have a Wix Payments account, click Create an Account in the pop-up, then click Create an Account to confirm. If you have a Wix Payments account, click Connect Existing Account in the pop-up, then click Connect My Account to confirm. Make sure to complete your account set-up so you can get paid to your bank account.

title: How can I add video conferencing to my Wix event using Zoom?
content: First create and save an event draft. In your site's dashboard, go to Events, select the relevant event, click the Features tab, click Video Conferencing, then click Setup Video Conferencing. Select Zoom and click Continue. If this is your first Zoom event, click Connect, sign in to your existing Zoom account or create a new account, and click Done. Click Copy link to get the link to your Zoom meeting. Guests receive the link and password in their confirmation email as well as reminder emails.

title: I want to use pre-set Wix website designs.
content: Get started on building the site you want by selecting a new template. There are a variety of options and categories available (Business & Services, Store, Creative, Community, and Blog), so you can choose the best style for your brand needs. To choose a new template: Sign in to your Wix account. Go to the Templates Page. Select the category you want to open the drop-down menu. Select the relevant sub-category. Hover over your chosen template. Click Edit to open the template in the Editor.

title: What should I do if my PayPal payment is still pending after 24 hours on my Wix site?
content: If a PayPal payment still shows Pending after 24 hours, check the PayPal pending reason in your Payments page. Confirm that you have a PayPal Business account. Make sure Advanced Features are enabled by going to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, clicking Enable Advanced Options under PayPal, and clicking Grant Permission. Confirm your email address / account with PayPal. Make sure the purchase amount meets the minimum payment threshold; for PayPal in the US the threshold is $1, and for PayPal in the UK it is £1. If payments are still showing as Pending after these steps, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: Can I choose the timing of reminder emails in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now change the timing of reminder emails that you send to clients before a service.

title: How can I add an image background to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the mobile editor. Click Background on the left side. Click Image. Select an image from the Media Manager. Click Change Background. Good to know: You can change your Mobile Background, adjust text, and more from your mobile device using Wix Editor on Mobile.

title: How can I stop my slideshow gallery from flashing on my Wix mobile site?
content:
Click the gallery in the mobile editor. Click the Settings icon. Scroll down to Apply transition effects?. Under How long do they last? drag the slider to set it above 0.

Note: You can only adjust the pause time if you add a transition effect to your gallery.

title: How can I update my Wix Payments account settings if I need to change my bank account information?
content: You can update any of your Wix Payments account settings, including bank account information, at any time. To update your account settings, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, click Edit Account Details, edit the relevant information, and click Save. Use the guidelines for uploading documents to ensure your files are uploaded successfully, then click Resubmit. Whenever you make a change, Wix is required to verify your information. Because of this, your account status temporarily goes back to Accepting Payments. During this time, you can accept payments through your site, but you cannot receive payouts to your bank account. The verification process can take up to 7 business days. Once it is complete, you will be able to receive any payouts accumulated during this time.

title: Can I resize images in Wix Email Marketing?
content: You can now resize images in Wix Email Marketing by enlarging and cropping them. Learn more about customizing your email campaigns.

title: How can I view my live site using the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile App. Tap View to see your site.

Note: If your site was built using Wix ADI, you can edit your site directly from the Wix app.

title: Where can Wix users connect Mollie as a payment provider according to the SEPA availability notice?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area bank transfers) as a payment method in all regions where SEPA is possible. Users located in Austria, Belgium, France, Italy, Germany, and the Netherlands can connect Mollie as a payment provider.

title: How can I add a link to a cell in the Table Master App?
content:
To add a link to your table:
- Click the table in your Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Hover over the cell that you want to link.
- Click the Link icon.
- Choose the link type.
- Enter the link details.
- Click OK.

Important: It is not possible to import links by uploading a Google Spreadsheet due to Google Drive's API.

Tip: You can also create a table using Velo by Wix.

title: Can I charge a setup fee for a one-time payment or recurring payment plan?
content: You can charge your customers a one-time setup fee when they first purchase either a one-time payment or recurring payment plan.

title: How can I manage individual invoices using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Manage Invoices under Getting Paid. Tap the invoice you want to manage. Tap the More Actions icon at the top of your screen. From there, you can choose to send via email, share link, enter credit card manually, charge with card reader, record payment, edit, duplicate as draft, or void. Some invoice management actions, such as printing or deleting an invoice, can only be done from your dashboard. When you update your customer's email address for sent invoices, the status changes back to Draft and a new invoice link is created. For paid invoices, the updated email will only be reflected in your Contact List.

title: How can I add a video to my page background in Wix Editor?
content:
In your Wix Editor, go to the relevant page. Click Site Design on the left side of the Editor, hover over Page Background, and click Customize. Select Video. Then choose what you want to do:

- Upload your own video: Click Upload Media, browse your computer and select your video, then click Change Background.
- Add a free Wix video: Click Media from Wix, select a video, then click Change Background.
- Purchase a Shutterstock video: Click Shutterstock, select a video, then click Buy Video.

Optionally, click Apply to Other Pages to add the background to other pages of your site.

Good to know:
- To remove a page background completely, change the background color to white.
- You can check how the video looks before you publish your site by clicking the Play icon in the Page Background panel.
- Video backgrounds play without sound. If you want to display a video with sound, use a different element, such as Wix Video, Pro Gallery, or the video player.
- Your video background will automatically be set to not play on the mobile version of your site. To enable it, or select another video background, reselect the video in the mobile Editor.
- For best results, check out the video file guidelines.

title: How can I create custom merchandise using Wix's Business Card Maker?
content: Go to the Business Card Maker. If you have a Wix website, you can also access the Business Cards Manager from the Dashboard under the Business Cards & More tab. Click Get Started. Choose your shipping country by clicking the flag on the top right, then select your shipping destination. Hover over the template you want and click Customize. Follow the product-specific steps for business cards, T-shirts, mugs, tote bags, or stickers. For each product, customize the design if desired, choose the relevant options such as paper type, color, size, quantity, number per pack, or dimensions, click Add to Cart, then use the Cart icon at the top right to Continue to Checkout and enter shipping details, or click Add More Items to design more products.

title: How can I add Alt text to images and gallery images in ADI?
content:
To add Alt text to your images:
- Hover over the section inside ADI that includes the image you want to add Alt text to.
- Click Edit.
- Hover over the image thumbnail and click Edit & Replace.
- In the Title (Alt Text) field, enter the title of your image. It should be a short description (just a few words) of the image. This title is used as the image's Alt text.

To add Alt text to your gallery images:
- Hover over the section that includes the gallery you want to add Alt text to.
- Click Settings.
- Click Manage Media.
- Click the desired image.
- In the Title field, enter the title of your image. It should be a short description of the image. This title is used as the image's Alt text.

Alt text is also important for accessibility purposes. Some of your site visitors might be using screen readers, which read out the alt text to describe the media on your site.

Adding Alt text is only available when your Media Layout is set to either Crop or Full Image.

title: How can I add a video to my email marketing campaign using Wix?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one. Click Add on the left and choose Video. Choose an option: My video uploads: click Choose File and select the video you want to add; click + Upload Media if you need to upload the video; then click Add to Page. YouTube: enter the video URL in the field. When adding your own video from YouTube, make sure the video settings in YouTube are set to Public and the Allow Embedding box is checked. Click Apply. Notes: Clicking a video in an email campaign via email opens the video in a new browser window. If you're using Wix Video, you can create email campaigns directly from your Video Library.

title: How can I use my Wix Logo as a favicon on my site, and what should I consider regarding the background?
content: Use the favicon file included in the Wix Logo files; it always has a transparent background. If you prefer to have a colored background, use the "Original.png" file. If you use this file, remove any extra space in it using Wix Photo Studio so the favicon is as visible as possible, and keep the 1:1 proportion while cropping.

title: How can I connect Bankful as a payment provider for my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Bankful. If you have an account, enter your Username and Password and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Bankful account, click Sign Up on the Bankful site, fill in the registration form and click Continue, wait for an email from Bankful to get your credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I generate more traffic to my Wix site?
content:
To generate more traffic to your Wix site, you can:

- Make sure that your site is set up to be found by search engines and that your content has been optimized.
- Share your site on social media: add any of the social sharing buttons available in the Editor, open your live site and share it with your friends. Ask your friends to reshare so that you get even more views.
- Promote your site using Wix Email Marketing: create an email campaign announcing your site and send it to all of your subscribers. You can use Wix Email Marketing to promote special offers on your site, or simply to let your friends know about it.
- Get a personal campaign manager for your business: let a specialist run targeted ads for you on Facebook and Google. Your personal campaign manager will also offer monthly phone consultations and fine tune your site to boost conversions.
- Add a third-party app from the Wix App Market: available apps include GetTraffic, Site Booster, Rabbit SEO, and rankingCoach SEO.
- Use the Wix SEO Setup Checklist for a step-by-step plan designed to help improve your site's SEO.
- Look at the Wix blog post for more ideas on how to promote your site.

title: How can I add additional columns to my table in the Table Master app on Wix?
content: Go to your editor. Click your table in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Layout tab. Drag the slider under Maximum columns to show, or enter the amount of columns you want to display in the field next to it.

title: How can I add a 'Book' button for a single service calendar to my Instagram business page using Wix Bookings?
content:
To add a single service calendar 'Book' button to your Instagram business page:
- Go to Booking Integrations in your site's dashboard.
- Click Connect under Instagram.
- Click the drop-down and click Single Service Calendar.
- Choose which service's calendar you want to show from the second drop-down.
- Click Continue.
- Review the link settings for the Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Page and Meta Pixel. Note: Visit the Meta Business Help Center for more information.
- Optional: Enable the Automatic advanced matching toggle to increase the visibility of your business to users on Instagram.
- Click Continue.
- Click Next.
- Click Done.

title: How can I mark attendance for a class using the Wix app?
content:
To mark class attendance using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Booking Calendar**.
- Tap the relevant class in the Booking Calendar.
- Tap **Check-In**.
- Do one of the following:
  - **Check in all participants at once:** Tap **Check-In All** at the bottom.
  - **Check in one participant:** Tap **Check In** next to the relevant participant.
  - **Mark as no-show:** Tap the **Checkmark** and then tap **Mark as no-show**. If relevant, you can click **Apply a no-show fee** to charge the participant for missing the session.

**Note:** This option is only available for classes that include cancellation and no-show fees in their booking policy. No-show fees do not apply to group bookings.

title: How can I refund an order in Wix that was paid and fulfilled?
content: To refund an order in Wix that was paid and fulfilled, go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the relevant order, click More Actions at the top right, and select Refund. Select the checkboxes next to the items you want to refund. To provide a partial refund, enter the total amount you want to refund for the order on the right. Optionally, deselect the Update inventory checkbox next to a store product if you don't plan to restock it, and select the Send a confirmation email to customer checkbox and enter a personal note to your customer. Click Refund, then click Issue Refund. Note that this cannot be undone. Payments made using the Manual Payment method and with certain payment providers need to be provided outside of Wix. Before you can refund a PayPal order, you need to enable Advanced Feature.

title: Can I use Mobex as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Mobex as a payment provider. However, you can use the manual payment method, and mention that you accept payments through Mobex. You can then arrange the Mobex payment offline.

title: Can I add a custom product to a sale at a mobile POS in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, you cannot add a custom product to a sale at a mobile POS. Workaround: You can create a custom product and set a price (e.g. $50) and charge your customer that price.

title: How can I add the Wix Hit Counter app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Wix Hit Counter app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I create a private member page in Wix for members to view their own uploaded content?
content:
To create a private member page in Wix where members can view their own uploaded content, first make sure you have added a Member Area to your site.

In Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu, then Members Area. Click + Add Member Pages, then + Add Page under Private Page. Add a dataset to the page and connect it to the collection that stores the content your members submitted. Add a filter for the Owner (Text) field with the Condition set to 'is' and the Status to 'logged in'. Add elements that can display collection content (for example repeaters, text, images), and connect the elements to the dataset.

In Studio Editor: Go to your editor. Click Pages, then + Add New Page. Click Add under Custom Member Page. Optionally customize the page's name and permissions: double-click the page to rename it; to limit the page to specific roles or pricing plans, hover over the page, click the More Actions icon, click Settings, click Permissions, and select the relevant option under Which members can access this page?. Then add a dataset, filter by Owner (Text) with Condition 'is' and Status 'logged in', add elements to display collection content, and connect the elements to the dataset.

When you preview the page, you are the logged-in user, so you will see the content you yourself have uploaded. If you have not yet uploaded any items to the collection, your page will not show any content when you preview it.

title: How can I share a link to a specific service from my Dayful site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Go to your Dayful site in the Wix app. Tap Site & App at the bottom. Tap Share. Choose Specific Service to share a link to a single Dayful service. Tap to select the relevant service. Tap Done. Choose how you want to share the link: tap Copy to add the link to the clipboard on your mobile device, then paste it in the relevant app, email or SMS message; or tap to select the relevant app you want to use to share the link, such as your messenger or email client.

title: How can I set up online payment methods for my services on Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your dashboard and set up one or more payment methods. Wix suggests payment methods that are available in your area. After you set up online payment methods, you can enable or disable any of these methods for each service you offer, so clients can pay online for some services and in person for others. Make sure to upgrade your site so you can start accepting bookings.

title: What are the steps to accept payments using manual card entry on a Wix site?
content: To accept Manual Card Entry payments on a Wix site, your site must have a Premium plan that supports payments. Connect a payment provider that supports Manual Card Entry. Supported providers listed in the source include Wix Payments (Austria, Belgium, Canada, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland, United Kingdom and the United States), Cal (Israel), Evergreen Payments Northwest (United States), Eway (Australia and New Zealand), Isracard (Israel), MagicPay (Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands), Stripe (Austria, Australia, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Gibraltar, Hong Kong, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malaysia, Malta, Mexico, Netherlands, Norway, New Zealand, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Singapore, Slovenia, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom and United States), and Tranzila (Israel). Manual Card Entry payments are currently available with Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Pricing Plans and POS. When processing a payment, manually enter the customer's card details with their permission. Manual card entry is the least secure way of accepting card payments, so it is recommended only for buyers you trust. Customers' card details are considered Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and are subject to privacy laws such as the GDPR and the CCPA; it is recommended to delete the card information following the manual entry payment. Manual Card Entry transactions are considered insecure, there is no liability shift, and you may be fully liable for fraudulent chargebacks. Check with your payment provider about their fees for processing manual card entry payments, as they generally incur a higher processing fee than regular card payments.

title: Can I add a hyperlink to the text of a gallery item's description in Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to hyperlink the text of a gallery item's description. It is possible, however, to add a link to a gallery item itself.

title: How do I upgrade from Universal Analytics to Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and add the GA4 property to my site's Marketing Integrations?
content:
You can track information in Google Analytics about your site visitors using either a Google Analytics 4 (GA4) property or a Universal Analytics (UA) property. To upgrade:

Step 1 | Create your Google Analytics 4 property
Use the GA4 Setup Assistant in your Google Analytics account to create and set up a new GA4 property. Sign in to your Google Analytics account, click the Admin icon at the bottom left, select GA4 Setup Assistant, click Get Started under “I want to create a new Google Analytics 4 property”, click Create property, click See your GA4 property under Explore and set up your GA4 property, select Tag installation, select your stream under Data Streams, click the Settings icon, click Show advanced settings under Page views, deselect the Page changes based on browser history events checkbox, disable the Site search toggle, and click Save.

Step 2 | Add your Google Analytics 4 property to your site
Copy your measurement ID under Web stream details. Go to Marketing Integrations on your site's dashboard, click View under Google Analytics, click the Show More icon in the top right corner, click Edit, and paste your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID in the pop-up. Make sure there are no extra spaces before the code. (Optional) Select the IP Anonymization checkbox if you want to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google. Click Save.

Important: From July 1, 2023, UA properties will stop collecting data from your website. After you upgrade to GA4, we recommend continuing to use both properties.

title: How can I export my restaurant orders from the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content:
To export your restaurant orders from the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click More at the top right and select Export. Select a time option from the Received drop-down list. (Optional) Click Show export options and select the checkboxes next to the details you want to include in the export:

* Customer details: Name, phone, email, and delivery address.
* Financial information: Subtotal, discounts, tax, tip, payment details.
* Ordered dishes: Dish titles and counts.

Click Export. Click Download CSV. Save the file to your computer:

* Chrome: The .csv file downloads and appears on the bottom of your screen.
* Firefox: Select Open with to open or Save File to save.
* Internet Explorer: Click Save at the bottom of your screen.
* Safari: Click cmd + s on your keyboard to save the file (with a .csv extension, and Page Source format).

The exported file includes the dish name, quantity, and dish options (e.g. pizza toppings).

title: How do I connect UniPAY Georgia as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click Connect next to UniPAY. If you have an account, enter your Merchant ID and Secret Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create UniPAY account, fill in the information in UniPay to create your account, return to the Accept Payments tab, repeat the previous connection steps, and follow the instructions under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How do I switch from a personal Instagram account to a business account on my Wix site?
content: You can make the switch in the Settings panel in your editor. If you don't have an Instagram business account set up, read the article about converting your personal account.

title: how to close a Wix account
content: To close a Wix account, first make sure the account has no active services or subscriptions: cancel each premium service or transfer your premium site/services or domain. If canceling a Wix domain subscription, wait until it expires, is past the redemption period, and is no longer registered. Remove any additional domains from your account, move all remaining sites to Trash, then close your account using Close Account. Closing your account is not the same as canceling a subscription plan; if you want to retain access to your site but cancel your plan, you can continue to use the free version of your site.

title: Can I view, assign, or filter CMS (Content Management System) content by member roles without using Velo?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view, assign or filter CMS (Content Management System) content by member roles without using Velo.

title: Can I print orders with custom field replies displayed in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, when you print an order, the information that customers entered in custom fields does not appear. This feature request is relevant for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

title: How can I cancel a reservation in Wix Hotels?
content: You can cancel a reservation from your hotel calendar. Go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, then click the Reservations tab. Click the relevant reservation on the Reservation Calendar, click the Reservation Status drop-down menu, click Cancelled, and click Save. Note: cancelling the reservation on your calendar will not inform the guest. Make sure to contact your booking and confirm the cancelled reservation.

title: Can I select which categories are displayed in the Wix blog menu?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to exclude categories from the blog menu. All the categories you create are displayed.

### Tip
You can choose to show or hide your blog menu. Hiding your blog menu means all of your categories in your blog menu are hidden from view.

title: How can I manage dish availability using the Wix app for my restaurant?
content: With the Wix app, you can manage dish availability by marking dishes that are not in stock so customers know not to order them.

title: How can I add and manage my restaurant tables using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Table Reservations and select Table Reservations. Tap the More Actions icon. Tap the Settings icon at the top. Tap Manage tables. Tap + Add Table and enter the following: Table Name (for example: small table, big table, bar seats), Minimum Guests, Maximum Guests, and Available Online. By default, your tables are available for guests to book online. Disable the toggle if you don't want a table to be available for guests to book online. Tap Save. Tip: Tap on a table to edit, duplicate or delete it.

title: How can I add a button in the Studio Editor and what are the differences between basic and styled buttons?
content:
To add a button in the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Button, then scroll through the designs and drag a Basic Button or Styled Button onto the page.

Basic Buttons only display text and have a more minimal look. They support copying the button's design to another element and getting content suggestions for the button text. In smaller screen sizes, Basic Buttons auto-wrap the text.

Styled Buttons can display both text and icons and offer advanced customization options such as image backgrounds and color gradients. They do not support copying the button's design to another element or getting content suggestions for the button text. In smaller screen sizes, Styled Buttons display an ellipsis.

title: How do I set overflow content to scroll in Editor X?
content: Click the relevant container or section. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X. Click the Layout tab. Select Scroll from the Overflow content drop-down. Click the Scroll direction drop-down and choose if you want the scroll to be vertical, horizontal or both. Click the toggle to show or hide the scrollbar.

title: How can I create a pricing plan for a blog post on Wix?
content:
Before you begin, you need to have a payment method set up in order to set up a subscription.

Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post. Click Monetize in the toolbar on the left. Click Get Started. Click Create Plan in the popup. Enter the plan details: Plan name, Tagline, and List of benefits. Under Other Benefits, click Choose Posts under Posts included, select the posts you want to include, and click Done. Under Pricing Options, set the pricing and duration of the subscription by choosing Free Plan, One Time Payment, or Recurring Payments. Optionally, under Settings, use the One purchase per person toggle (Enabled means visitors can only purchase this plan once; Disabled means they can purchase it more than once) and provide important information about the plan, such as renewals, cancellations, and refunds. When you're ready, click Save.

title: Can I automatically assign loyalty points to customers for renewing their pricing plan in Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically give loyalty points to customers for renewing their pricing plan. You can, however, give loyalty points to a customer manually.

title: Can I receive a PDF copy of form submissions in the email notification using Wix Forms?
content: Currently, using new Wix Forms, the notification email you get for form submissions does not include a PDF copy of the actual submission. To view the submission, go to Forms & Submissions in your site's dashboard.

title: Can I create shareable links from the Wix app?
content: Currently, you can create shareable links from the Sharable Links tab in your site's dashboard. It is not possible to create shareable links from the Wix app.

title: How can I show or hide the rulers in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Tools on the top bar. Select or deselect the Rulers checkbox: Selected means the rulers are shown in your editor; Deselected means the rulers are hidden from your editor. Tip: You can also use Shift+R on your keyboard to show or hide the rulers.

title: How can I require customers to provide their phone number when checking out with PayPal?
content:
To require a phone number for customers using PayPal checkout:
- Sign in to your PayPal account.
- Click your name at the top right.
- Click Account Settings.
- Click Website Payments on the left.
- Click Update next to Website Preferences.
- Scroll down to the Contact Telephone Number section.
- Select the On (Required Field) checkbox.

title: How can I add my Facebook username to my Wix website settings?
content: Go to Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Website Settings. Scroll down to the Facebook Username section and type your username in the Enter your personal Facebook username: field. Make sure you type your personal Facebook username and not a business Facebook username. Note: Your Facebook username is not your email or password.

title: How can I connect Cal powered by PayMe as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Cal. Click Create Cal account. Fill in the registration form and wait for a message from Cal powered by PayMe to get your API Key. Once you have your credentials, return to Cal in the Accept Payments tab. Enter your API Key and Email. Optionally enable and set Installment Payments. Click Connect.

title: How can I choose a text theme for my Wix site?
content: Click Site Design on the left side of the Editor. Click Text theme. Select the Heading Font you want to apply to all your headings. Select the Paragraph Font you want to apply to all your paragraphs.

title: How can I delete an item from my CMS collection, and what should I be aware of before doing so?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to CMS and click the relevant collection. Select the checkbox next to the item you want to delete. To select multiple items at once, select the first item you want to delete, hold down the Shift key on your keyboard and select the last item you want to delete. Click Delete, then click Delete to confirm. Before deleting, note: if the content is in both the optional Sandbox and Live collection, you need to delete the item in both locations. If you have the optional Sandbox enabled, syncing your Sandbox collection does not remove the item from the Live collection. Also make sure you don't have any dynamic pages or references in another collection connected to it, as once the item is deleted, these links or references will break.

title: Can I add a webcam feed directly to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, webcam features are not supported. However, if you have access to the external code of your webcam feed, you can embed it onto your site using HTML.

title: Can I create multiple seating maps for a single ticketed event in Wix Events?
content: Currently, you can create one seating map for a ticketed event, that includes different ticket types with unique seating arrangements (e.g. general admission, assigned seating, VIP areas). However, it is not possible to create multiple seating maps for a single ticketed event, such as when using different facilities.

title: Is it possible to disable the mobile view in Wix ADI?
content: Currently, disabling the mobile view is not available in ADI. If you prefer the desktop site to be displayed instead, you need to head to the Editor and follow the steps to disable it.

title: How can I connect Braintree as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Braintree as a payment provider on your Wix site: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Braintree. If you have a Braintree account, enter your Merchant ID, Public Key, Private Key, and Merchant Account ID, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Braintree account and fill in the information to create your account. Wait for your Braintree account to be verified before you can get your Braintree credentials. Return to this window, repeat the connection steps, and follow the instructions under Have an account. If you were not automatically connected to a provider and you received Braintree as a recommended provider, click Connect and follow the connection instructions.

title: How can I customize the Booking Form in Wix Bookings to collect specific information from clients?
content: The Booking Form is where clients fill out the information you require before they can book your services. You can customize this form and add extra fields, or create different booking forms for different services, to collect the information you need to provide the best service possible for your clients. You can also personalize the design of the Booking Form to match your site's design.

title: How can I resolve general text issues in the Wix Editor?
content: To resolve general text issues, if you are copying and pasting text from an external source, try pasting without formatting. Reset to the text theme by clicking the text, clicking Edit Text, and clicking Reset to Theme at the bottom of the panel. Try making the text box a bit larger to allow space for the text to enlarge on different screen sizes and browsers. Follow the general interactive troubleshooter.

title: How do I remove an app from my Wix site using the Wix app and the Editor?
content:
To remove an app using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Manage Apps. Tap Remove next to the relevant app. Tap Delete in the pop-up to confirm.

When you delete an app from the Wix app, you must also go back to your Editor and delete it from there to fully remove it.

To remove an app using the Editor: Go to your Editor and click Pages.
- Wix Editor: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor.
- Editor X: Click Pages at the top of Editor X.
Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click Delete. Click Delete to confirm.

Important: If you delete an app from your Editor, it is automatically removed from your site on the members app and you don't need to remove it using the Wix app.

title: How can I manage the step order and visibility for my self-paced online program?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program, select Edit Settings, and click Content. Choose the step order for participants: Any Order lets them complete steps in the order they want; Fixed Order lets them complete steps in the order you set. For Fixed Order, enable the Hide future steps toggle to hide future step content until the current step is completed. You can also enable the relevant toggles to customize the video step experience: Require to watch videos sets a required percentage participants must watch to complete the step, and Autoplay next video step automatically plays the next video after the current one ends. These settings apply to all video steps in your program. Click Save.

title: How do I connect Eway as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Eway as a payment provider on your Wix site:
- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to Eway.
- If you have an account, enter your API Key and Password, then click Connect.
- If you don't have an account, click Create Eway Account and fill in the form to create your account. An Eway representative will call you to complete the registration process. Ask the representative for your API key. Make sure to ask Eway for your API Key rather than your Merchant ID or Customer ID. Return to this window and repeat the earlier steps, then follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: How can I add an embed to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add an embed in Wix Editor, click Add Elements in your Editor, click Embed Code, then click Popular Embeds. Choose the type of embed: Embed HTML to embed a code snippet to display a widget on your site pages and set it up, or Embed a site to display an external site in a window on your page. Click your chosen embed to add it to your site.

title: Can I purchase a monthly SMS quota larger than the Professional SMS plan allows on Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a monthly SMS quota larger than the Professional SMS plan allows. Visit the SMS plan page to learn more about what's included in each SMS plan.

title: How can I create event coupons using the Wix app?
content: To create a coupon from the Wix app: go to your site in the Wix app and tap **Manage** at the bottom. Scroll down to **Marketing** and tap **Coupons**. Tap **Add a Coupon**. Select **$ Discount** or **% Discount**, enter the amount or percentage, then tap **Next**. Enter the coupon code and the coupon name, then tap **Next**. Choose which tickets the coupon applies to: **All tickets**, **Specific event** (select the event), or **Specific ticket** (select the relevant event and ticket type), then tap **Next**. Choose whether the coupon applies to the lowest priced item or to every item in the order. Set the coupon's start and end date: tap the date, select the start date, enter an end date or tap **No end date**, then tap **Save**. Optionally, enable **Limit number of total uses** and enter the number of times the coupon can be used. Tap **Done**. To share the new coupon, tap **Share**.

title: How can I password protect a gallery page in Wix Editor?
content: You can set up a private gallery by password protecting the page that the gallery is placed on. To password protect a page: Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click the relevant page. Click the Show More icon. Click Settings. Click the Permissions tab. Select Password Holders. Enter a password. Select the language of the login screen.

title: Can I save data from the custom signup form to a submissions table?
content: Currently, it is not possible to save the data that site visitors enter into the custom signup form to a submissions table. As a workaround, you can save submission data from a field to your Contacts List.

title: How can I add more columns to a form in Editor X?
content: Forms in Editor X are made up of a CSS grid, so you can add as many columns and rows as you need. To add a column to your form: click the form in Editor X, click Edit Grid, then hover over the column heading and click the Add Column icon to add more. After adding columns, you can change their size by dragging the handles on the horizontal and vertical gridlines, or by clicking a column heading and entering the exact size while choosing the relevant unit (e.g., px, percentage). Move form fields to the new column by using drag and drop. To adjust or delete a row, click the form in Editor X, click Edit Grid, click the relevant row heading, then adjust the row height or click Delete Row to remove it from the grid.

title: How can I set permissions for a member badge to access specific members-only pages on my site?
content: Before you begin, install a Member's Area on your site. Then go to Site Members, click More Actions at the top right, and click Manage Badges. Click the Show More icon on the badge you want to change, click Edit, click the Permissions tab, enable the toggle, and manage your permissions in the table. Only those members that have the badge will have access to those pages.

title: How can I archive a campaign in Wix Donations?
content: Go to Wix Donations in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant campaign. Click Archive campaign. Click Archive campaign to confirm. Update the site page with the campaign form. If your campaign is collecting recurring donations, cancel them before archiving your campaign. Archiving a campaign removes it from your live site and leaves a blank space, so make any necessary updates to the site page displays correctly.

title: How can I upgrade my social media marketing plan on Wix to access more features?
content: Go to Social Media Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post. Click Upgrade to Publish More. Choose the plan and checkout. Upgrading provides valuable tools to enhance your social media presence and support a comprehensive strategy, such as publishing unlimited posts, connecting multiple accounts, scheduling posts in advance, and tracking post analytics.

title: Can I change the "Priority" and "Frequency" in a sitemap?
content: Currently it is not possible to change the "Priority" and "Frequency" info submitted with a sitemap.

title: Can I charge clients for additional products and services after in-person sessions using Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now add products and services to an existing order, and then collect payment in person using Wix Mobile POS.

title: What information is required for Wix Payments verification for an individual account?
content: For an individual account, make sure your personal information is correct: your first / middle / last name and your date of birth must match those listed in your photo ID. Double check that you've entered your bank account number(s) correctly. Enter a physical address to verify your account; PO Boxes are not accepted as a valid address. Upload an address verification document, such as a utility bill, to confirm your address. The document must have been issued within the last 6 months. Add your Business Description: enter your Doing Business As name, use the dropdown menu to select your Business Type, and use the text box to add a short description of your products / services. Upload a color copy of your photo ID and a bank statement to verify your identity. Allow 7 business days for the account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've verified the information is correct and matches your bank account details, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I add discounts to my service prices when customers pay for a plan?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Pricing Plans, click the More Actions icon at the top, and click Create a coupon. Select a $ Discount or % Discount coupon. Enter the Coupon code and Coupon name. Use the Apply to drop-down to choose All plans or Specific plan. Choose how the coupon works: First billing cycle, All billing cycles, or Custom. Select the valid dates. Optionally, limit the total number of uses and limit to one use per customer. Click Create Coupon. Discount coupons for Pricing Plans cover the plans themselves, but not any setup fees you may have enabled.

title: What should I do if I can't view my live site and suspect my domain might be disconnected from my site?
content: You can check whether your domain is connected to your site on the Domains page. If the domain is not connected, select the domain and click Assign next to Assigned to site.

title: How do I set up a referral program on my Wix site?
content:
To set up a referral program on your Wix site, first make sure you have one of these plans: Wix Editor with a Business or higher plan, or Wix Studio with a Plus or higher plan. You also need at least one of these apps: Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Pricing Plans, or the new Wix Restaurants ordering app.

Step 1 | Create your referral program in your site's Dashboard: Go to Referral Program, click Set Up Program, and provide basic info in the Program details section. Enter a Program name (for internal use only; it does not appear on your site) and choose a Reward trigger: Store order placed, Ticket ordered, Session booked, Plan ordered, or Restaurant order placed.

Step 2 | Set your program rewards: In the Referring customer reward and Referred friend reward sections, choose Coupon, Loyalty points, or No reward. For Coupon, customize the coupon details. For Loyalty points, enter the number of points in the Points given field.

Step 3 | Decide whether to activate automated emails: In the Emails section, use the toggles to enable or disable the email notifications you want.

Step 4 | Review your referral program: Use the Program preview to see how the program will look on your site. When you are happy with the setup, click Save.

Step 5 | View your new site pages: Adding a referral program automatically generates two new site pages: the Refer Friends page and the Referral Landing Page. Go to your editor to see and customize the Referral Program pages. These pages are not live until you publish your site.

title: Can I choose a custom favicon for the Wix Editor that I see on my browser while working on my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to choose a custom favicon for the Wix Editor that you would see on your browser while working on your site. However, you can upload and use a custom favicon on your live site.

title: How can I start building a website with Wix?
content: Create a free Wix account. Then build your site: Wix offers 800+ website templates that are fully customizable; you can customize anything with intuitive drag and drop technology, and if you don't want to use a template you can start from a blank canvas. After that, set up your business using over 250 apps and services, and choose a Premium plan if you want premium features. If you're an agency building sites for clients, go to Wix Studio. Setting up payments is optional; Wix offers different payment methods and providers depending on your location.

title: How can I set up my Google Workspace business email on my Android device?
content: We are unable to provide support for setting up your email address on a mobile device. Please view the Google Workspace support articles for instructions; click the Android instructions link in those articles.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual to translate my CMS collection content?
content: You can now translate your CMS collection content with Wix Multilingual. Learn how to get started translating your CMS content.

title: Why do fonts appear differently on my Wix mobile site, and how can I fix font issues?
content: Different browsers and devices use a variety of rendering engines which may result in minor differences in the way your font appears. Fonts also render differently between iOS and Android, and the significance of the difference can vary from font to font. If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, choose another similar looking font for your site. Certain fonts are not supported by iOS or other mobile devices. If a specific font on your site is not displaying properly on an iOS device, check whether the font is supported. Issues with uploaded fonts are not supported; if you’re experiencing an issue with an uploaded font, try one of the default fonts or upload a different one. If a supported, default font is not appearing on your mobile device, or if you are experiencing other issues with text on your site, contact us.

title: How can I view a submissions table for new Wix Forms?
content:
Go to Forms & Submissions in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to a form. Select View submissions.

To access a submissions table from your editor:
- Click a form in your editor.
- Click Edit Form to open the form builder.
- Click the Submissions tab at the top.

title: How can I edit the details of a project in the Wix app?
content: To edit your project details in the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Portfolio. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant project. Tap Edit. Tap the Edit icon to update your project's cover image. Choose media from your Media Manager, My Boards, upload from your Device, or use a Free by Wix image. Edit your project's title, description, and basic info such as project type and date. Tap Add to Collection to sort your project into a collection. Tap Save on the top right.

title: What should I do if the Cookie Alert pop-up is not appearing on my Wix site?
content: Cookie Alert banners will no longer be supported on your site because this app has been retired from the Wix App Market. Action required: Delete this app and switch to the Privacy Center, where you can set up a Cookie Banner to be displayed on your site.

title: How can I enable a Load More button in my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page. Click Settings. Click the Layout tab. Click Customize Layout. Enable the Load More button toggle. Select an option under How many more images load: All images or One more section.

Note: You can only add a Load More button to layouts that have a vertical scroll. You can't add it to the Thumbnails, Slider, Slide show, or Columns layouts.

title: What are some effective strategies to gain backlinks for my website?
content:
To gain backlinks for your website, consider the following strategies:

* Submit Site URL to Directories: Directories categorize and list websites, boosting your site's visibility with valuable backlinks. Smaller, niche-based directories can be particularly powerful. For example, if your business is an art gallery, search for art-based directories. If your site has a physical location, submit it to local directories relevant to your site's purpose.

* Social Networking: Engage in online communities related to your niche. Blogs, forums, and social media sites are filled with people interested in similar topics, offering link-building opportunities. Join these groups and establish yourself as a valuable community member.

* Content Creation: Create articles or blog posts related to your expertise. Research trending topics and write guidelines, articles with data-based statistics, or infographics that tell an interesting story—anything people would want to quote and share within the industry.

* Guest Blogging: Write guest blog posts for credible sites related to your business's niche. This increases your online presence and creates quality backlinks to your site.

* Posting Testimonials for Other Services: If you regularly cooperate with certain companies or suppliers, contact them to post a testimonial on their website that includes a link to your site.

Remember, a single, quality link from a popular site is better than a large amount of poor quality links. Avoid deceptive practices and consult Google's quality guidelines and the black hat SEO techniques article for more information.

title: How can I add a Pro Gallery to my site using Editor X?
content:
To add a Pro Gallery to your site in Editor X:

Click **Add** on the top of Editor X.
Click **Media**.
Click **Pro Galleries**.
Choose a Pro Gallery and click on it to add it to your site.

**Important:** The Pro Gallery is added as its own section to your page, you can drag and drop it into a different section if you want to display it somewhere else.

title: What steps should I follow to transfer my domain from Wix if I am a Russian resident affected by the service restrictions?
content: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain. Select Transfer away from Wix. After reviewing the info about transferring your domain, click Transfer Domain. Click I Still Want to Transfer. Wix will send a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's registrant contact email address. Once you get the code, follow the instructions from your new domain host to transfer your domain. Learn more about transferring your domain away from Wix.

title: How can I add a product category to a page on my site using ADI?
content:
To add a product category to a page on your site using ADI:

- Click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI.
- Click **Section to Page**.
- Click **Shop**.
- Add a gallery to your site.
- Select a category under **Display a category**.

Tip: Learn how to customize your Wix Stores gallery.

title: How can I customize a Pro Gallery on my Wix mobile site?
content:
Click the gallery in your mobile editor. Click Settings. Choose what to customize:

* Layout: Click the Layout tab and use the available options to adjust the gallery's layout.
* Design: Click the Design tab and use the available options to design the gallery.
* General settings: Click the Settings tab and customize the following options:
  * Gallery Settings: Click the When clicking on an item drop-down to select what happens when visitors click on gallery items.
  * Social Settings: Enable the relevant toggles to allow social sharing, downloading and a heart counter on your gallery.

title: Is there a feature in Wix Stores for additional inventory management apps?
content: Yes. Currently, you can find a number of inventory management apps in the Wix App Market. These include Multi-Store Inventory Sync by Presto Changeo, SKU IQ Inventory Sync, Crafybase, and Stock Sync: Automate Inventory. Go to the Wix App Market to search for additional apps.

title: Can I view specific guest details for each ticket purchased directly from the seating map in Wix Events?
content: Currently, while you can see sold-out seats on your seating map, there is no way to view specific guest details for each ticket purchased directly from the map. This feature would allow you to easily access guest information from the seating map itself.

title: Why are the Facebook Like and Comment elements not visible on my Wix site for some visitors?
content: In July 2021, Facebook changed its policy regarding the Facebook Like button for Web in the EU. Both the Facebook Like button and the Facebook Comments box have been affected by this change. As a result of the update, visitors can only see Facebook Like buttons and Comment boxes if they are logged in to their Facebook account on the same device (either another tab or window). If they are not logged in to their Facebook account, the element is not displayed on your site. This change applies to visitors viewing your site from the EU only, and does not affect the visibility of the elements in other regions. Note: as this is a change implemented by Facebook, the support team are unable to assist you in rectifying this issue.

title: How can I add a new location or edit the details of an existing location in Wix Retail POS?
content: To make changes, you need to go to your desktop.

title: How can I change the availability of a dish in the Wix app for my restaurant menu?
content:
To change the availability of a dish in the Wix app, follow these steps:

Go to your site in the Wix App.
Tap **Manage** at the bottom right.
Tap **Menus** in the Business apps.
