Select the relevant menu.
Select the section that contains the dish you want to update.
Tap the relevant dish.
Manage the dish availability under Dish Settings:

* Tap the **In Stock** toggle:
  * **Enabled**: The dish appears normally on your live site and customers can order it.
  * **Disabled**: The dish is out of stock. A **Sold Out** label appears next to the dish when customers attempt to order it.

* Tap the **Visible to customers** toggle:
  * **Enabled**: The dish is visible in the menu on your live site and customers can view the dish and order it (as long as it's marked 'In Stock').
  * **Disabled**: The dish does not appear on your site's menu and customers cannot see it.

**Note**: A **Hidden** icon appears next to any dish you have hidden from the menu. Only you can see this icon.

### Tip
You can also quickly change a dish's availability by swiping left on a dish in its relevant section and tapping either **Hide** or **Sold Out**.

title: Can I create style presets for elements in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create style classes that let you define the same design settings for all relevant elements. For example, applying the same design to every image or button on your site as they belong to that specific class. Instead, you can copy and paste the design of an element. You can also save single or grouped elements to your library and reuse them on your site, or a different site on your Wix account.

title: How can I add iDeal as a payment method through Wix Payments?
content: Before adding iDeal, you must set up Wix Payments. Then go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, and enable the toggle next to iDeal. You can disable the toggle at any time to remove iDeal from your payment options.

title: What accessibility features are included in Wix's accessible templates, and what additional steps should I take to optimize my site for accessibility?
content: Wix offers templates with basic built-in accessibility features, such as accessible heading structures and site color contrast. Some advanced accessibility features, such as custom ARIA labels and alt text, are not included in these templates and need to be added manually. To continue optimizing your site for accessibility, go through the accessibility checklist and consider these further steps: preparing your site's structure, reducing motion, adding an accessibility statement, preparing images and galleries, and preparing text and graphics. Wix cannot guarantee that your site will be compliant with your local accessibility laws and regulations, and recommends consulting an accessibility expert to ensure your site meets the criteria outlined in your region's accessibility regulations.

title: How can I repurchase an expired or canceled Google Workspace business email through my Wix account?
content: You can repurchase an expired or canceled Google Workspace business email through your Wix account. Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click Renew Subscription under the relevant business email. Follow the steps in the pop-up window to repurchase your business email. According to Google's Terms of Service, business email data is retained for 180 days from the expiration date. If you repurchase your business email within this time frame, your business email data will be restored.

title: How can I add a marketing integration to my Wix site?
content: Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Find the integration that you want to add. Click Connect. Follow the instructions to complete set up.

title: Can I set individual elements as global so they appear on multiple site pages?
content: While you can set any section as global, it is not possible to set individual elements as global so they appear on multiple site pages. Alternatively, you can save elements as design assets. Your design assets are always available from the Add Elements panel, to reuse on any page or Studio Editor site.

title: How can I list my Wix Stores products on eBay?
content: Go to the eBay tab in your Wix site's dashboard. In the Product Overview, click Unpublished to view Wix products not currently listed on eBay. Then either hover over the relevant product and click Publish, or hover over a product and click the Manage Product arrow, review the information that will be listed on eBay, optionally use the Customize for eBay toggle and edit fields, select an eBay Best Offer setting, optionally edit your eBay shipping location, and click Save & Publish. To save changes without publishing, click the More Actions icon. After listing, view products by clicking Published.

title: How can I display a specific Wix Photo Album on a different page of my site?
content:
To display an album on another page:

Open your site in the editor.
Click **Pages** on the left side of the editor.
Click the page that includes Wix Photo Albums.
Click the photo album in your editor and select **Settings**.
Click **Add Ons**.
Click the **Select page** drop-down.
Select the page where you want to add Wix Photo Albums to.
Click the photo album in your editor and select **Settings**.
Click **Albums**.
Click **Show or Hide Albums**.
Enable the **Show on page** toggle next to each album you want to display.

### Tip
You can add Wix Photo Albums multiple times to the same page, with each displaying a different album. Repeat the above steps to add another album on the same page.

title: How can I create a custom 404 error page using the Studio Editor?
content: First upgrade your client's site, as a custom 404 page requires an upgraded site. In the Studio Editor, click Pages on the left. Click Add New Page at the bottom. Click Add under Page. Give the page a recognizable name. Change the page's URL slug to "error404": hover over the page, click More Actions, select SEO Basics, and enter "error404" under URL slug. Design the page to your liking. You can add links, buttons, or a menu to help visitors navigate elsewhere; add vector illustrations related to error 404 from Media Manager's Media from Wix tab; and, if necessary, hide the global header and footer on this page. Check how the page looks on all breakpoints.

title: Can I use the Collection Search to find the total number of matching values and navigate to them in my CMS collection?
content: Currently, when entering keywords in the Search field of a CMS collection, it is not possible to see how many matching values exist, or to navigate to them in your collection. When you enter keywords in the Search field, the matching values get highlighted in orange. However, you need to scroll through your collection to find the matching values, if they exist.

title: How can I add and design states in a multi-state box using the Studio Editor?
content:
Prerequisites: Add a multi-state box to your site first, as described in the article's first step.

Select and design a state:
- Select the multi-state box.
- Click Manage States.
- Click a state in the list.
- Add elements and design the state as you wish.

Tip: While designing the states, code is not required. This means everyone can customize them – not just developers.

Add a state:
- Select the multi-state box.
- Click Manage States.
- Click Add New State.
- Add an ID for the state: hover over the new state and click the More Actions icon, click Edit ID, enter a new ID for this state, and click Done.

Rename a state:
- Select the multi-state box.
- Click Manage States.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name.
- Click Edit ID.
- Enter the new ID in the text box and click Done.

Remove a state:
- Select the multi-state box.
- Click Manage States.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name.
- Click Delete.

Reorder states:
- Select the multi-state box.
- Click Manage States.
- Click and drag the Reorder icon up or down to change the order of the states.

Design tip: The states can have different height properties, which allow you to reveal additional info for example. However, the width of your states always stays the same.

title: How can I add a menu on a desktop breakpoint in Editor X and ensure it appears correctly on mobile?
content: When adding a horizontal menu from the desktop breakpoint, it's automatically hidden from mobile. Instead, a hamburger menu is displayed as it takes up much less space. You can still add a horizontal menu to your mobile site while working on that breakpoint.

title: How can I add anchors to my Wix blog post to improve navigation for my readers?
content: Go to your blog in your site dashboard. Choose to create a new post or edit an existing post. Add the relevant text to the post. Highlight the text that you want to use as an anchor. Click the Link icon on the toolbar. Select Section. Choose the section that you want the anchor to direct to. Click Save.

title: What should I do if I see the 'You're logged out' error message when trying to publish my Wix site?
content: If you see the 'You're logged out' error message when trying to publish your Wix site, it means you need to log back into your Wix account. To log back in and publish your site, keep the tab with the Editor open. In a new tab, go to Wix.com. Log in to the relevant Wix account. Come back to the tab with the Editor. Click Publish in the top right corner.

title: How do I set up Apple's in-app purchase for my branded app?
content:
To set up Apple's in-app purchase:
- Go to your Branded app dashboard in your Wix account.
- Click **Apple-In-App Purchase** on the left.
- Click **Get Started**.
- Click the drop-down next to **Step 1: Sign Apple's Paid Applications Agreement** and follow the instructions provided.
- When you're finished, select the checkbox at the bottom and click **Save & Continue**.
- Click the drop-down next to **Step 2: Set up your banking and tax information** and follow the instructions provided.
- When you're finished, select the checkbox at the bottom and click **Save & Continue**.

title: How can I exclude URLs with tracking parameters from appearing in Google Analytics?
content: If you see a URL with tracking parameters in Google Analytics, you can exclude it by applying filters to your view. We recommend adding a new view and applying the filters there, as filters may change your view's future data.

title: Can I create an adult site using Wix, and what should I consider regarding content?
content: The nature of the content you choose to upload to your site is your responsibility. Like any other website in the world, a website created through Wix is subject to international law. Keep in mind that if you use other content or creations of any kind, you will need to consult the copyright owner first and get their approval. To learn more about user content and prohibited uses, please see Section 2 of our Terms of Use.

title: How do I configure IPN settings in my PayU Turkey account for Wix integration?
content:
Note: Wix no longer supports connection to PayU Turkey as a payment provider. This change affects both new and existing PayU account holders. In Turkey, PayU merged with iyzico, and you can contact iyzico about Wix integration.

If you are enabling settings in your PayU account so that PayU processes orders from your site correctly and notifies you of new transactions, follow these IPN settings steps:

Sign in to your PayU Turkey account. Click **Account Management**. Click **Account Settings**. Click the **IPN Settings** tab. Enter the following URL in the URL field: https://api.paymentsos.com/callbacks/payuturkey/live/notifications

Select the following fields under **Data**: SALEDATE, REFNOEXT, ORDERSTATUS, IPN_PID, IPN_PNAME, IPN_DATE, IPN_TOTALGENERAL. Click **Save Settings**. Click the **Account Settings** tab and select the following under **Notifications**: Canceled and returned orders, Complete orders.

Note: Do not select the Email Text option as your orders won't be processed correctly.

title: How can I add links to images in my Wix gallery?
content: First, go to your editor, click the gallery, click the Settings icon, and under When clicked select A link opens. Then click Change Images, click an image, click the Link field on the right side, select the link type and enter the details, and click Done. Repeat for each image in your gallery that you want to add a link to.

title: Can I fully customize the design of the calendars on my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is possible to make limited customizations to the design of the calendars that appear on your live site (the Appointment calendar and the Class calendar).

title: Can I use superscript or subscript text in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, superscript and subscript text are not supported in the Wix Editor. As an alternative, you can change the size of the text that you'd like to appear as subscript or superscript, or create separate text boxes and group them together. To add and group separate text boxes: Open the relevant page in the Editor. Add a separate text element for your superscript / subscript text, and enter the text you want. Adjust the size of the text. Position the text box so it appears as subscript or superscript. Group the text boxes together so they act as a single element.

title: How can I add a pending app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add a pending app in your Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Click Manage Apps at the bottom left. Click Complete Setup or Add to Site next to the relevant app.

title: How can I create multiple Google Ads with Wix campaigns and manage their budgets?
content: Go to Google Ads in your site's dashboard. The campaigns page lists your current campaigns. Click Create New Campaign at the top right to make another Google Ads with Wix campaign. For Wix Stores only, choose an advertising goal: Drive site traffic or Boost product purchases. Customize the settings and ad content, then set the new campaign's daily budget. The daily budget is taken from your total monthly subscription and applied as ad credits; drag the slider to see an estimate of ad clicks per day with the chosen budget. Click Launch. The new campaign appears on the campaigns page with In Review status until Google approves the content. With multiple campaigns, you pay for a Google Ads with Wix subscription regardless of how many campaigns you run. You can buy extra ad credits that are added on top of your subscription. A new campaign's daily budget is taken from the total bucket of ad credits available for all campaigns in your account. To get more ad credits, click Manage ad credits & budget in the campaigns page and increase your subscription.

title: Can I assign multiple ticket types to a single seat in Wix Events?
content: Currently, you can only assign one ticket type per seat. It is not possible to offer multiple ticket types (e.g. Early Bird and VIP) for the same seat. You can assign different prices to various seats or sections on a seating map using Price Options.

title: How can I add or update a TXT record in my Wix account?
content:
TXT (Text) records are used for various purposes such as verifying ownership of a domain. You can add or update your TXT records from the Domains page of your Wix account.

To add or update a TXT record:
- Go to the Domains page.
- Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Manage DNS Records.

To add a TXT record:
- Click + Add Record in the TXT (Text) section.
- Click the Host Name field and enter the host name. Leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign.
- Click the Value field and enter the TXT value.
- Click Save.

To update a TXT record:
- Hover over the TXT record and click Edit.
- Click the Host Name field and enter the host name. Leave this field blank if instructed to add an @ sign.
- Click the Value field and enter the TXT value.
- Click Save.

Important: If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, you must add or update TXT records with your domain host (not Wix).

title: Is it possible to set a default role for new team members who join my account by themselves?
content: No. It is not currently possible to set a default role for all team members who join your account by themselves. You can assign roles to team members in the Team Management section of your Partner Dashboard.

title: How can I use Wix Automations to send an email when an event ends?
content:
Step 1 | Select a trigger
- Go to Automations in your site's dashboard.
- Click + New Automation.
- Click Start from Scratch.
- Enter an automation name.
- Select Wix Events.
- Choose the event trigger Event ends.
- Select an option from the Select which event triggers this automation drop-down:
  - All events on site: This automation works for all your events.
  - Choose specific events: Select the events that work with this trigger.
Note: The event is considered ended when a guest is checked in.

Step 2 | Select an action
- Click to select one of the available actions. For example, send an email.
- Enter the required information.

Step 3 | Set the timing and activate the automation
- Click the arrow next to Timing.
- Click the drop-down under Choose a time to send this action and select an option:
  - Immediately: The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
  - Set custom time: Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days or hours.
- Click Activate to save and activate the automation.

title: Can I create subscription promotions using Wix Promos?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create subscription promotions using Wix Promos. As a workaround, you can create product subscriptions using Wix Stores.

title: How can I manage or edit quiz questions in Online Programs from my site's dashboard?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant program. Scroll down to the Content / Schedule section. Hover over the relevant quiz and click Edit. Click Edit next to the Edit questions section. From there you can edit an existing question by clicking it and clicking Settings; edit a layout element by clicking it and clicking Edit text; remove a question or layout element by clicking it and clicking the Delete icon; duplicate a question by clicking it and clicking the Duplicate icon; add a new question or layout element by clicking the Add icon in the sidebar and selecting the relevant question or element; or reorder questions or layout elements by clicking the relevant item and holding the Drag icon. Click Save.

title: How can I access my form's submissions table using the ADI builder?
content:
To view your submissions from the ADI builder:
- Click the section that contains your form in the ADI builder.
- Click **Edit** next to Form.
- Click **Form Settings**.
- Click **View Table** under **Submissions Table**.

Important: To view your submissions, you must first publish your site.

title: How can I connect Laybuy as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: According to the source, Laybuy is temporarily unavailable, and Wix says you must change your payment provider to continue accepting payments. The same article also includes these connection steps: go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, check your business location at the top right and change it if incorrect, click See More Payment Options, and click Connect next to Laybuy. If you already have a Laybuy account, enter your Merchant ID and Authentication Key and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Laybuy account, register for a Laybuy merchant account, and after approval return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps. Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Laybuy account to avoid transaction declines.

title: Can I take phone orders and assign DoorDash Drive to fulfill the delivery in Wix Restaurants?
content: You can now take phone orders and assign DoorDash Drive to fulfill the delivery in the new Wix Restaurants Orders app.

title: What should I do if I can't connect my Facebook Business Page to Wix for running ads?
content:
Make sure you have completed all the campaign setup requirements: publish your site and upgrade to a Premium plan, connect a domain, connect an online payment method (for selling sites), and have products in stock (for Wix Stores). Also make sure you have the correct admin permissions: you need to be the admin of both the Facebook page where you want to run the campaign and the Facebook Business Manager associated with that page.

If you still can't connect your Facebook page to Wix, check the following:

- Check that your Facebook page is published. From your Facebook News Feed click Pages, go to your Page and click Settings, then General > Page Visibility, select Page published, and click Save Changes.
- Verify that your Wix site is listed as your Facebook page's website. The URL of your Wix site must exactly match the site you've added to your Facebook page as your 'listed website.' You can find this info in the About section of Facebook. If it doesn't match, update it. It is also okay if there's no website listed, but make sure there isn't a different URL on your Facebook page than the one that should be connected to your Wix site.
- Make sure your page isn't restricted from advertising. If you received an error that you are unable to advertise with Facebook, go to Account Quality in your Facebook Business Manager and view Account Issues. As the issue is on Facebook's side, it must also be resolved through Facebook. Once there are no account issues outstanding, contact Wix Customer Care with a screenshot of the Account Quality page.
- Make sure you've verified your email address used for the Facebook account.

title: What happens to recipients in Wix Email Marketing if their emails are likely to be marked as spam or bounce?
content: After you click to send your email campaign, Wix Email Marketing reviews your list of recipients. Your recipients are automatically removed if emails to them are likely to get marked as spam or bounce. Once these contacts are removed from your recipients list, your email campaign is sent to the remaining recipients. This automatic removal of recipients is to protect your sender reputation and prevent campaigns from getting marked as spam. The following recipients are removed from sending: Contacts who have unsubscribed; Contacts without email addresses; Contacts with duplicate email addresses; Contacts you've sent emails to that have bounced (undeliverable email addresses); Contacts with typos in their email addresses (including extra spaces).

title: How can I set registration opening and closing times for an RSVP event in Wix Events?
content:
To set when registration opens and closes for an RSVP event in Wix Events:

- Go to Events in your site's dashboard.
- Click to select the relevant event.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Click Edit next to Registration Settings.
- Click Custom dates.
- Select an opening date and time.
- Select a closing date and time.
- Click Save.

title: How can I add and set up a social bar in Wix Editor to link to my social media pages?
content:
To add and set up a social bar in Wix Editor:

Add a social bar:
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Social.
- Click Social Bar.
- Drag a social bar on to your page.

Choose the icons for your social bar:
- Click the social bar in your Editor.
- Click Set Social Links.
- To add an icon: click Add Icons, select an available social icon or click Upload Images to upload a new icon, then click Add to Gallery.
- To replace an icon: click an icon, click Replace Icon on the right, select an available social icon or click Upload Images to upload a new icon, then click Choose Image.
- To delete an icon: hover over the relevant icon and click the Remove Image icon.
- To reorder the icons: drag the icons to your desired position.

Add your social links to your icons:
- Click the social bar in your Editor.
- Click Set Social Links.
- Click the relevant icon.
- Click the link field on the right side under What social page does this icon link to?.
- Select Web Address from the list.
- Enter the relevant URL.
- Select if you want the URL to open in new window or the current window.
- Click Done.
- Repeat these steps for each of your icons.

Change the layout of your social bar:
- Click your social bar in the Editor.
- Click the Layout icon.
- Customize the layout using Icon size, Spacing, and How does the bar look? to choose whether your social bar is displayed horizontally or vertically.

title: Can I display 360° videos directly using the Single Video Player?
content: Currently, it is not possible to display 360° videos with the Single Video Player. As a workaround, you can upload your 360° video to YouTube and then embed it to your Single Video Player: Click the Single Video Player in your Editor. Click the Settings icon. Click the YouTube icon. Paste the YouTube video URL under What's the video's web address?. Make sure that you have set your video to "public" on YouTube in order to embed it into your Single Video Player.

title: Can I make my referral program available to my customers through the Spaces by Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to make your referral program available to your customers through the Spaces by Wix app.

title: Can I set a price range for a product or assign multiple prices to the same product in Wix Stores POS?
content: Currently, it's not possible to set a price range for a product or to assign multiple prices to the same product. As a workaround, you can raise a product's price at checkout by adding a custom charge. You can also lower the product price at checkout by adding a discount.

title: Can I place the login and signup forms directly on a site page instead of using lightboxes?
content: Currently, the login and signup forms are displayed using lightboxes. These pop up on the screen rather than appearing on the page directly. It is not possible to place these forms directly on a site page, like you can with a contact form.

title: Can I customize the text and buttons on the Wix Video Player?
content: Currently, it is not possible to edit and customize the text and buttons in the Wix Video Player. In the meantime, you can customize the design.

title: Can I customize the design of menu buttons separately for regular, hover, and selected versions in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It is now possible to customize the design of menu buttons separately for regular, hover, and selected versions. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app.

title: Can I duplicate my site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, you can create, rename, edit and delete your site right from the Wix app on your mobile device. However, it is not possible to perform additional site actions such as duplicating and transferring your site from the Wix app. You can perform all site actions from your dashboard.

title: Can I show a subpage menu under the More item in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, if a menu item with subpages is placed under the More item, the subpages do not appear. We recommend rearranging your menu so that menu items with subpages are not placed under the More item (i.e., place them towards the beginning of your menu).

title: How can I add and set up the Wix Video player on my site using ADI?
content: Adding the Wix Video player: Click Add on the top bar inside ADI. Click Section to Page. Click Video Player. If you don't see it, click See all and scroll down to Video Player. Select a layout. Setting up your video player: Click the section with the video player. Set up your player using the options: Select your channel: Click the drop-down menu and select a video channel or click Create New Channel. Show in frame: Click the drop-down menu and choose if you want to display the Channel cover or Featured Video Cover in the frame. Display elements: Click the check-boxes to show or hide specific elements of the player. Display video thumbnails: Click the drop-down menu and choose if you want to show or hide thumbnails. Display thumbnail titles: Click the drop-down menu and choose if you want to show or hide the thumbnail titles. Thumbnails in row: Select how many thumbnails you want to display in a row. Number of rows: Click the drop-down menu and select the number of rows of thumbnails. Notes: The options available depend on the layout you have chosen. You can change the layout from Design. Click Manage Videos to start adding and managing videos. Designing your Wix Video player: Hover over the section with the video player. Click Design. Select a layout. Note: To customize your player further, go to the Editor.

title: How can I upload my own fonts to Editor X and what formats are supported?
content: To upload a font to Editor X, click a text element, click Edit Text, click the Font drop-down menu in the Inspector, click Upload Fonts at the bottom, then in the pop-up click Upload Fonts and select your font file. Click Close once the font has uploaded. Your font is now available across your site under My Fonts in the Font drop-down. You can upload fonts in TTF, OTF, WOFF2 or WOFF formats.

title: How can I set the max width for my client's site in the Studio Editor?
content: Click Site Styles on the left side of the editor. Click the Max width tab. Enter the desired width in pixels. Note that the max width must be larger than 1001px. On screens that are wider than the value you set, the element sizes stay fixed, and the site gets side margins.

title: Can I send emails in different languages for my multilingual site using Wix?
content: Yes. You can now translate emails in multiple languages—specifically, the languages that are visible on your multilingual site.

title: How can I set specific chat hours for my business using Wix Chat?
content: Nobody is available to chat 24/7. Set your chat hours in advance so visitors see you as available to chat at the times you've set. Instantly disable chat if your plans change and you'd like to appear unavailable. When you're offline, you can share alternative contact details in your chatbox, so a visitor can choose to get in touch in another way.

title: Is it possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Revel POS system?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Revel POS (Point of Sale) system. In the meantime, you can integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS using a webhook.

title: How can I set up my mobile device to use Wix Stores POS for selling products?
content: To use your mobile device as a POS, you must first download the Wix app. After the download, you can start accepting cash payments right away. To accept credit card payments, you need to do one or both of the following: order and connect a card reader; set up tap to pay on your phone. Make sure you understand how tax collection works at a point of sale.

title: How can I customize the login page settings in the Shared Gallery app using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Signup & Login, then click Member Signup Form (Default). Customize the settings available on the General, Social & Community and Policies tabs. To create your own customized signup form, select Custom Form from the Which member signup form do your visitors see? drop-down, then click Edit Custom Signup form to get started.

title: 多渠道销售时如何优化库存分配与防超卖？
content: 基于各渠道日均单量、利润率、Lead Time等已提供数据，给出各渠道库存分配比例；分配比例合计应为100%，分配量合计不得超过总可用库存。总库存不足时，按利润率、缺货成本、渠道重要性说明优先级理由。是否用 FBA MCF 发其他渠道订单需结合上述数据评估。防超卖应覆盖库存同步机制，并用可支撑天数口径说明。

title: How can I add a 'Do Not Sell Data' link to my Wix site to comply with CCPA regulations?
content: Go to Privacy & Cookies in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to Add a 'Do Not Sell Data' Link and click Add Link in Editor. Click Add to Site. Drag the link to the relevant position in your site. The source recommends keeping the link in the footer. Optionally, click Settings to style the link. Publish your site. The source also recommends adding your Do Not Sell Data link to your site's footer, because an element added to your site's footer appears on all your site pages.

title: How can I adjust the text direction and alignment for a multilingual site with right-to-left content on Wix?
content: Before you begin, add and set up Wix Multilingual on your site and translate it in the Translation Manager. Go to your editor, click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top of the editor, and select the language you want to edit. Select the relevant text element on your page and click Edit Translation. Adjust the direction and alignment by clicking the Alignment icon and the Change text direction icon. Wix Multilingual detects and auto-aligns your site when you auto-translate your site, so your text aligns to the right and the direction changes to right-to-left. These steps also apply to text elements that are attached to elements such as strips, repeaters, slideshows and boxes.

title: Can I customize the page my members see when they reset their password?
content: Currently, it is not possible to customize the page your members see when they reset their password. The design of password reset windows is taken directly from your site's theme. You can choose a new theme to make this page look more like the rest of your site. Changes you make to your theme apply to your entire site.

title: Im trying to connect my business Instagram account to my Wix site.
content: Before you begin, you must have a Facebook account to connect an Instagram business account. If you haven't done so already, convert your Instagram personal account to a business account and connect it to a Facebook page. If you have an Instagram creator account, you can follow the steps below to connect it. If you haven't yet connected your Instagram Feed to any of your accounts (business or personal), follow these steps: Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Instagram Feed app in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Select the app on the page. Click Settings. Click Connect Business Account. Choose your profile in the Log In With Facebook pop-up. Select the Instagram business account profile you want to use. Important: You should select only one Instagram account. Select the Facebook page that is connected to the Instagram account you chose. Important: You should select only one Facebook page. Click Next. Review the permissions that the Instagram Feed app requires. Click Done. Click OK.

title: What guidelines does Wix Payments provide for selling PPE and medical products during the pandemic?
content: Wix Payments provides guidelines to help ensure compliance when selling PPE, medical devices, and other medical products. These items are subject to regulatory restrictions and may be included in Wix Payments’ list of Restricted and Prohibited Products and Services. Non-compliance with the rules, local legislation, or card brand rules may result in restriction of your Wix Payments account and reversal of certain transactions. Key guidelines include: check the local laws and regulations relevant to your products in both your jurisdiction and your customers’ jurisdiction; check that you and your suppliers or manufacturers have all necessary and valid authorizations, permissions, certifications, registrations, or licences, with additional attention to masks/respirators, sanitizers, and disinfectants; be mindful of product descriptions, because products marketed as a remedy to prevent, treat, or cure Covid, or promotion of unconventional treatments, may cause restriction of your Wix Payments account; be aware that inflated prices could be deemed illegal in some jurisdictions and may jeopardize your Wix Payments account; and to be considered for Wix Payments verification as a charity or fundraising entity, you need to be a registered charity for at least 5 years. Examples of permitted products include general purpose, non-regulated face masks/respirators that do not claim to meet regulated standards or are not labeled as such, hand-made masks, face shields and protective goggles without any medical claims, and stickers and signs. Examples of prohibited products include Covid test / Covid antibody tests, Covid testing / laboratory and medical services, vaccines / immunizations, medication to prevent, cure or treat Covid, products or services with exaggerated, false or misleading statements or claims, products without a clear disclosure of all relevant details such as manufacturer labels or ingredients, products that do not meet marking requirements, and services related to government / public aid payments. Wix Payments may ask you to provide documents and information regarding your products and services.

title: Is it possible to add vertical scroll snap to page sections in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add vertical scroll snap to page sections in the Studio Editor. If you use Velo by Wix, you can create the scroll snap effect for your sections using code.

title: How can I view and unhide pinned elements in the Wix Mobile Editor?
content: Go to your mobile editor. Click the Hidden Elements icon. Optionally, click Show next to an element to unhide it. Note: Pinned elements in the Mobile Editor can be unhidden but are no longer pinned on your mobile site.

title: How can I add a new section to my self-paced online program using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant program. Scroll down to Content. Click + Add and select Add section. Add information to tell participants what your section is about. Click the Section Dripping toggle to allow participants to complete the section on a specific day. If enabled, choose when participants complete the section by clicking the Select Day drop-down and selecting the week and day. If disabled, participants can complete the section whenever they want. Click Save.

title: How can I accept recurring donations using Wix Donations?
content: To accept recurring donations using Wix Donations, connect a payment provider that supports recurring payments as well as donation payments. If you accept recurring donations, Wix recommends adding a clear donations policy to your site, including information about how donors can cancel their recurring payments.

title: How can I ensure my Wix site is compliant with the CCPA, especially regarding user data requests?
content: To prepare your Wix site for the CCPA, create a clear and comprehensive privacy policy that explains how you collect, store, use, disclose, and manage site-visitors’ data. Add a “Do Not Sell Data” link to your site’s footer via the Wix App Market so visitors can request that their personal information not be shared with third parties. Use Wix tools to help site-visitors exercise their right to access a copy of their data, their right to have their data permanently deleted, and their right to opt out of the sale of personal information. As a site owner, you are responsible for compliance, and Wix recommends reviewing the CCPA details and seeking legal advice.

title: How can I view and filter my site's activities in the Wix Studio for enterprise?
content: Go to Activity Log in your enterprise dashboard. Click Filter at the top right. Click the type of filter you want to add: Category, User, or Time. Category options include Sites, Custom Templates, Media, Domains, Team, SSO Setting, IP Allowlisting, Routing, Roles & Permissions, and Plan Status. User filters by team members in your organization. Time filters by time range, with pre-set or custom times. Tip: To change between Category and User filters, click Reset Filters and start again.

title: How can site members upload files using the Wix File Share app on their mobile devices?
content: Site members can upload files using the Wix File Share app on their mobile devices by taking a picture with their device's camera and uploading it directly to a folder. Members can perform any actions they have permission to do, such as view, upload, share, and move files.

title: How can I design and print a menu using the original Wix Restaurants Menus App?
content:
To design and print your menu using the original Wix Restaurants Menus App:
• Go to Menus in your site's dashboard.
• Hover over the menu you want to customize and click the Print icon.
• Customize your printable menu using the available options:
  - Templates: Click a template that suits your restaurant.
  - Logo: Click Upload to upload your restaurant's logo from your computer, or click Create a Logo to create one with the Wix Logo Maker. Enable the QR Code toggle to include a scannable QR code for customers to scan and order online.
  - Text: Hover over the relevant text style and click Customize to set the styles for menu, section and dishes text. You can show or hide Dish description, click Change Font to choose a font, set Text style with bold, italicize or underline, choose Alignment, set Text color or enter a hex code, and set Size.
  - Symbols: Select a set of symbols and set their colors.
  - Dividers: Use dividers to separate different sections.
  - Background: Choose a background color or enter a hex code.
• Click Download Menu to download your menu in PDF format.

title: How can I build a new menu using the Wix app for my restaurant?
content: To build a new menu in the Wix app, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Catalog, then tap Restaurant Menus (New). Tap + Add Menu. Enter a Menu name and Menu description; you can add line breaks to descriptions. If needed, select Mark as a draft so the menu won't show in the Editor or live site. Tap Save. Open the menu you created, tap Add Section, enter a Section name and Description, then tap Save. Repeat to add more sections. Tap Add Item, then enter the Item name and Item description, select Item labels, enter a Price, and select or upload an Image. You must enter a name and price for the menu item, and you can choose to hide prices in the Editor. Tap Save, and repeat for all menu items.

title: How can I accept incoming restaurant orders using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Restaurant Orders. The New tab displays the new orders waiting to be accepted or rejected. Tap on the order you want to accept. Review the order and then tap Accept Order at the bottom to accept it. The newly accepted orders now appear in the In Progress tab. Once you've completed the order, tap Fulfill Order. You can swipe an order to the right to quickly accept it.

title: How can I make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor?
content:
To make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon.
- Tip: Make sure you don't restrict the main (original) Pricing Plans page. You can restrict other pages where you display plans, and you can hide the main page.
- Click Settings.
- Click Permissions.
- Click Site members.
- Select Specific members.
- Click the Members with plan subscriptions toggle to enable it.
- Click Manage Plans.
- Select the checkbox next to the relevant pricing plans.
- Click Apply.

title: How can I import media files using a URL in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. If you haven't uploaded media to your site yet, you can click the Upload Media icon. Click + Upload Media. Click the Link icon on the left side. Paste the URL link and click Import. Note: It's not possible to import video files with YouTube and Vimeo URL's.

title: How can I accept an incoming order in Wix Restaurants?
content:
To accept an order in Wix Restaurants:

- Go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant order.
- Click Accept at the top right.

After you accept an order, it moves to the In Progress tab. From here, you can mark the order as delivered when you are ready.

You can set additional notification methods (email, text, fax etc.), and backup notifications that are triggered after a set time that an order has not been handled.

title: How can I add a new category to my forum using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Forum. In the Categories tab, tap Add New Category. Add a category name, a description, choose the type of category, add an image, and choose if you want to set a different image for the app.

title: What steps should I follow if Google Ads disapproves my campaign due to Googlebot not being able to crawl my site?
content: If Google emailed that it cannot crawl your site because of robots.txt, go to Google Search Console, log in, choose the correct property, type the URL that was detected and blocked by robots.txt, and click Test. If Google shows "Allowed", robots.txt is not blocking the Google bot; in this case, resubmit your campaign to Google.

title: How can I customize the display of pricing plans on my Wix Member apps?
content: From the Wix app, go to your site and tap Site & App at the bottom. Tap Customize, then Edit Navigation Tabs. Tap + Add New Tab, enter a title, and tap Save. Select Pricing Plans from the options at the top. Select one of the templates: Carousel, List, or Member subscriptions. (Optional) Enable the Section Title toggle to activate it and give the widget a name. Tap Edit in Plan Display and choose up to 5 plans you want to display. (Optional) Enable the Display benefits list toggle to show the plan's benefits. Tap Add at the top. Tap Done.

title: Can I manage my hotel using the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to manage your hotel using the Wix app.

title: How can I restore my site's SEO settings to their default values on Wix?
content: To restore any field to its default, delete the field's content, and click Save. To restore all fields in a setting to their defaults at once, click the Reset to Wix Default icon. Be sure to click Save and confirm in order to save the default settings.

title: How can I delete a published post or draft in Wix Blog?
content: Go to Posts in your site's dashboard. Click the More actions icon next to the post you want to delete. Click Move to Trash. Click Move to Trash to verify. Note: Once a post is moved to trash, its views, likes, and comments are deleted permanently. Even if you restore the post, views, likes, and comments are not restored.

title: How do I connect my Wix site to Meta Pixel & CAPI and view event data in Facebook?
content: To connect your site to Meta Pixel & CAPI, go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Click Connect under Meta Pixel & CAPI, then click Connect to Facebook. If required, choose your profile in the pop-up and sign in. Click Next, then click Next to grant the necessary permissions to Wix Marketing Tools. Click Next, and click Next on the What is Wix Marketing Tools allowed to do? page. Click Done. Before you can connect your site, you need to verify your domain on Facebook. To see event data in Facebook, sign into your Facebook account, click Ads Manager (located in the top left corner), and click Events Manager.

title: What resources are available for someone new to Editor X to learn and improve their skills?
content:
For someone new to Editor X, the source lists these resources:

- A guided tour introducing the Editor X workspace.
- Academy X, where you can take short lessons and practice with short exercises, see what's new, and learn how to streamline your editing process.
- The Editor X YouTube channel, where you can watch webinars, classes, and video tutorials made by graphic designers.
- The Editor X help center, where you can get instructions and explanations for using the Editor.
- The Community Forum, where you can get updates on new features, find out what other users are doing, and get help from the community.
- Community X on Facebook, where you can connect with novice and advanced web designers, get advice, and share your own learnings.

title: How can I create a test site using the Wix Editor and set its exposure to a percentage of my site's audience?
content:
Prerequisite: You can only create a test site after your site has been published at least once.

Create your test site using the Wix Editor:
- Go to your editor.
- Click Site on the top bar.
- Click Deploy Test Site.
- Note: Your test site opens in a new window.

Set the exposure for your test site:
- Go to the Release Manager in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Show More icon next to your test site.
- Click Edit exposure.
- Enter the exposure percentage as a value between 0-100.
- Click Save.

title: How can I remove the Wix Video player from my site without deleting the videos themselves?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Wix Video player on your page. Press Delete on your keyboard. Deleting the player does not delete the videos themselves; your video library remains accessible from your site's dashboard.

title: Can I view my collaborators' edit history in the dashboard?
content: Currently, it is not possible to view the dashboard edit history of your collaborators in the same way that you can view your site's edit history. This would let you see the changes that your collaborators make in your site's dashboard, such as updating your site's SEO settings or updating your domain's DNS records.

title: What can the Visitor Analytics app help me understand about my website's user behavior?
content: With the Visitor Analytics app by Visitor Analytics, you can get a complete overview of your website stats. You can check your site's performance with user behavior analytics and visitor interaction features like polls and surveys. Features include seeing visitors, conversions, session duration, page traffic, competition analysis, and more; using real recordings of visitor sessions, heatmaps, and conversion funnels to see how visitors interact with your site; and getting direct feedback from visitors with targetable surveys and polls. The app offers 100% GDPR & CCPA compliant tracking with no data passed on to third parties, supports 20 languages, and is added to your site's dashboard so it does not appear on your site.

title: Is it possible to browse earlier versions of a logo design in Wix Logo Maker?
content: Currently, saving a logo design will replace any previously saved version. It is not possible to browse earlier versions of the design history. As a workaround, you can duplicate an existing design and set it as a secondary logo before making any further edits. That way all duplicates are saved as a unique design and do not overwrite your last saved version.

title: How can I set up recurring donations for my Wix campaign?
content: When you set up your campaign with Wix Donations, you can add recurring donations that happen weekly, monthly, or yearly. Note: To accept recurring payments from donors, set up a payment method that supports recurring payments.

title: How do I set up page SEO in ADI?
content: Click the Pages menu on the top bar inside ADI. Click the page that you want to set up. Click the Settings icon. Click SEO Basics. Enter the information: Title Tag (For Search Results), Meta Description (For Search Results), Keywords (you can add up to 10 keywords), Hide this page from search results (selected means your page is not displayed in search engine results; not selected means your page is displayed in search engine results), and Page URL (if you do not enter anything, your page name is used by default). If you change your page URL, visitors who reach your old URL will get a 404 error. To prevent this you can set up 301 redirects. Additionally, social features such as likes and comments will be reset. Click Let's Go to view your personalized SEO plan on Wix Wiz. Publish your site in order for changes to take effect. Search engines may take a few days to update the information.

title: How can I sell a service as a product using Wix Bookings?
content: To sell a service as a product, first add Wix Stores to your site and ensure your site is on a Premium plan or Studio plan that allows you to accept payments. In your site's dashboard, go to Products, click +New Product, select Physical product, and add images, GIFs, or videos. Add the product to the page, enter the service name, optionally add a ribbon, enter the description, and add an info section with a title and description. Set the Price, optionally enable On sale and set a percentage or monetary discount, then click Save. You will need to manually schedule any appointments in your Booking calendar.

title: What should I do if my Wix site plan was canceled due to payment issues and I want to repurchase it?
content: If your site plan was already canceled due to payment issues, you can simply purchase a new plan by upgrading the site again. If you are having trouble repurchasing a site plan after cancellation, unassign the canceled plan from your site and try to upgrade again.

title: How can I create a new design library in the Studio Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left, hover over Tools, and click Libraries. Click + Create New Library. Choose what to include from the site you're working on: Typography, Colors and / or Assets. Click Create. Enter a name for your library under Library Name. Optional: enable the Turn on sharing toggle to share this library with your teammates.

title: Can I automatically remove participants from a program after it ends?
content: Yes. You can now remove participants automatically after the program ends. This is true for scheduled programs and self-paced programs with a time limit.

title: How can I design and print a menu using the new Wix Restaurants Menus app?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Menus (New). Click the More Actions icon next to the menu you want to customize and click Design print menu. Customize the printable menu using the design options: choose a template, add your restaurant's logo and enable the QR Code toggle for online orders, customize text styles and dish descriptions, select symbols and colors, use dividers, and choose a background color. When finished, click Download Menu to download your menu in PDF format.

title: How can I customize and share a specific blog category on social media using Wix?
content:
To customize and share a specific blog category on social media using Wix:

Customize your category information:
- Go to Categories in your site's dashboard.
- Click Edit next to the relevant category.
- Enter a category title in the Title field.
- Add a description of your category in the Description field.
- Click the Category Image box and upload an image.
- Click Edit next to SEO settings.
- Customize the URL slug, title tag, and meta description.
- Close the SEO settings.
- Click Save.

Share your blog category on social media:
- Go to your live site.
- Log in using your Wix credentials in the member login bar.
- Go to the category you want to share.
- Copy the category URL.
- Paste the link where you want to share it.

title: Is it possible to trigger an event when a widget is deleted in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it’s not possible to listen to a "widget deleted" event.

title: Can I add images inside text boxes and make the text wrap around the image in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add images or videos inside text boxes, and make the text wrap around the image / video. Wix notes that adding images/videos on top of text boxes is not recommended, as this can cause alignment / layout issues on pages in different browsers. To display images with text, you can use the repeater element to create a layout with text and images that you want to use several times on your site, add the Wix Pro Gallery to combine text and images with a variety of displays, or split your text into several text boxes and manually arrange them around the image or video.

title: What are the limitations for Wix users from OFAC restricted countries?
content:
Users (and their users) from OFAC restricted and sanctioned countries:

- Cannot register or use any of Wix's services including Wix sites.
- Cannot connect to Wix (via pointing or name servers) domains with the following extensions:
  - Cuba (.cu)
  - Iran (.ir)
  - Iran .xn--mgba3a4f16a (.ایران)
  - North Korea (.kp)
  - Syria (.sy)
  - Syria .xn--ogbpf8fl (.سورية)

Attempting to utilize Wix sites from any of the restricted countries, regions, or domains is a violation of our Terms of Use and can result in a revocation of access to Wix’s services. In cases where Wix contacts you via email requesting additional information as part of our monitoring process, you are required to cooperate within the specified timeframe. If not, your account and / or site may be deactivated.

title: How can I upload my own image to the Wix Logo Maker and customize it?
content:
To upload an image to your logo in the Wix Logo Maker:
- Click the Upload icon on the left of the logo editor.
- Click Upload Image.
- Upload an image or select an image from your Site Files.

If you upload an image:
- Click + Upload Media.
- Select the location you want to upload your image from, such as your computer or a social network.
- Click the image(s) you want to upload.
- Click Upload Selection.
- Click Add to Logo.

If you use a site file:
- Select the image you want to add to your logo.
- Click Add to Logo.

After uploading, customize your image using the Customize Image panel:
- Click the Upload icon on the left of the logo editor.
- Hover over the image you want to edit in the Customize Image panel and click Customize.
- Customize aspects such as Size, Image opacity, Flip, Rotate, Horizontal position, Vertical position, Shadow, and Blur.
- For Shadow, click the toggle to enable a shadow around your image and customize Shadow color, Shadow opacity, Shadow horizontal position, Shadow vertical position, and Shadow blur.

title: How can I add the Wix Portfolio app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the Wix App Market in your editor to find the Wix Portfolio app and add it to your site. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Type "Wix Portfolio" in the search bar. Select Wix Portfolio from the drop-down menu. Click Add to Site. Once installed, you can add projects and collections from the editor or your site's dashboard.

title: What are the requirements to receive the Wix Analytics Monthly Highlights email?
content:
To receive a Monthly Highlights email:

* Your site needs to be upgraded.
* Your site must receive 30+ site visits during the previous month.

Note: The Monthly Highlights email is only available for English language sites.

title: Is it possible to switch a client from one pricing plan to another?
content: Currently, it is not possible to switch a client from one plan to another one. You can cancel the existing plan and manually add your client to a new plan, or have your customer cancel their plan and then purchase a new plan online.

title: How can I add a 'Book Now' button to my Facebook business page using Wix Bookings?
content: Wix Bookings says you can add a 'Book Now' button to your Facebook and Instagram business pages to boost bookings on your Wix site. Choose which social platform you want to connect from the available options, and learn more about adding a Book button to Facebook. If you experience any technical issues, contact Facebook for support or visit the Meta Business Help Center. You can add a 'Book' button to either Facebook or Instagram, but not both. The source provides this overview and points readers to learn more, but it does not include detailed step-by-step instructions.

title: How can I improve my site's SEO using Wix's tools?
content: Use the Wix SEO Setup Checklist to set up the basics and identify weak points. Make your site accessible with the accessibility wizard. Add structured data markup to give search engines detailed information about your pages. Use Wix's SEO Settings to optimize multiple pages with a single template, then fine-tune individual pages. Track performance and keyword rankings with Google Search Console, and gain insight into traffic, bounce rate, timeline, and more with Wix's Google Analytics integration.

title: How do I connect my Wix store to an eBay shop?
content: Go to the eBay tab in your site's dashboard. Click Start Now. Select an eBay market from the drop-down. Click Continue & Sign in to eBay. Then select an option: sign in to an existing eBay account, or create a new eBay account by clicking Create an account and completing the required steps to create an account.

title: How can I assign multiple products to a tax group in Wix Stores?
content: Go to **Tax** in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant tax group and click **Add Products**. Select the products you want to add to this tax group. Click **Save**.

title: How can I set up a personalized business email with Wix to enhance my brand's professionalism?
content: Once your site is upgraded to a Premium or Studio site plan and you have a domain, purchase a business email address for your domain, such as info@yourdomain.com. Go to Wix.com to purchase your business email. Wix offers seamless integration with Google Workspace, so you can manage Google Workspace applications under your personalized domain name. When you set up a business email with Wix, you get access to Google Workspace tools including Google Calendar, Drive, and Docs. You can also learn how to create additional custom email addresses.

title: Can I add different animations or extra fields to my app's login and launch screens?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add more customization to your app's login and launch screens, such as different animations, extra fields, and additional elements. However, you can customize your login and launch screens by choosing the colors, text, and image for your brand.

title: How can I change the layout of my member badge in the Editor?
content: To change the layout of your member badge, click the Member Profile Card in your Editor, click Settings, and click Badges. Then customize the badge layout: choose a layout to show the name and icon, or only the icon or the name; choose Badge Size to make the badge small or large; drag the Corner Radius slider to increase or decrease the curve of the corners; click the Text drop-down menu and select the font for the badge.

title: How can I set up automatic tax collection with Avalara in Wix?
content: Make sure your site has upgraded to a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports automated sales tax. Avalara is not currently available for users in Brazil and India. In your site's dashboard, go to Settings and select Tax. Wix offers manual tax collection or automatic tax collection using Avalara; Avalara calculates tax based on up-to-date tax rules, and when rates change your tax updates automatically.

title: How can I translate my site menu using the Wix Editor?
content:
To translate your site menu using the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click the Switch Languages panel at the top of the editor, select the relevant language, then select your menu type and follow the steps for that menu type.

Regular menu:
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant menu item.
- Select the relevant option: Edit name to manually translate the item name, enter your translation, and click Done; or Auto-translate name to translate the name automatically.
- Repeat for the rest of your menu items and languages.

Advanced menu:
- Select your menu.
- Click Edit Translation.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant menu item.
- Select Rename page.
- Enter your translation.
- Click Done.
- Repeat for the rest of your menu items.

title: How can I copy and paste a section or element in Editor X, and are there any limitations?
content: To copy and paste a section or element in Editor X, select the element or section you want to copy, right-click it, and select Copy. Go to the page where you want to paste it, either on this site or another Editor X site in your account. Right-click in the relevant location of the page and select Paste. Copying a section or element also copies all of its data, layout, and design. The following elements cannot be copied and pasted in Editor X: third-party apps from the App Market, header and footer, business solution apps (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, etc.), Pro gallery, datasets and collections, and code on elements and pages.

title: How can I set a section as a global section in the Studio Editor?
content:
To set a global section in the Studio Editor:

- Select the relevant section in the Editor.
- Click the More Actions icon.
- Click **Set as Global**.
- Select the relevant option:
  - **Header:** Sections that appear at the very top of the page.
  - **Section:** Sections that appear in the middle of the page (anywhere between the header and footer).
  - **Footer:** Sections that appear at the very bottom of the page.
- Enter a name for the global section.

Tip: A global section has a green overlay when you hover over it so you can instantly recognize it.

title: How can I change the business location for accepting payments?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check the location at the top right, click the drop-down menu, and select the correct business location. Make sure the location reflects your business registration.

Once payment methods are added, you can also change the business location by either:
- In Business Info under Settings in your site's dashboard, scroll to Location, enable My business has a physical address, and enter your current business address. This does not change the current payment setup, but further actions on the Accept Payments tab follow the chosen location.
- Or go to Accept Payments, remove/disconnect all payment methods by clicking Manage Account under the relevant payment method and clicking Disconnect Account, then begin your Accepting Payments setup again and enter your current business location.

title: How can I issue a refund for specific products using Wix Retail POS?
content:
To issue a refund on specific products using Wix Retail POS:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap **Sales History** on the bottom bar.
- Tap the store order you want to refund.
- Tap **Actions** at the top right.
- Tap **Issue Refund**.
- Tap the Plus icon next to the product(s) you want to refund.

  **Tip:** Tap more than once to refund more than one of the same item.

- Tap **Next**.
- Tap the **Restock** toggle (for items tracking inventory):
  - **Enabled:** Inventory level for this item increases after making the refund.
  - **Disabled:** Inventory level remains the same.
- (Optional) Select a reason for refund.
- Tap **Refund**.

  **Note:** This cannot be undone.

- (Interac payments only) Ask the customer to tap or insert the card.
- Select a receipt option to complete the refund.

title: I am trying to change the order of the items within a CMS collection on my Wix site, but the provided steps did not work for me.
content: In the CMS, open the relevant collection. At the top of the collection, click 'Sort', then click '+ Add a Sort'. Use the 'Sort by' drop-down to choose the field you want to sort by, then select a sorting option under 'Select the order' (for example, A-Z, Low-High, or Oldest-Newest). Click 'Add Sort'. From the Table layout, you can also sort items manually by clicking and dragging the Reorder icon next to the relevant items. To use the same item order in your site's connected elements, click 'Mirror on Site' at the top of the collection and enable the toggle next to 'Mirror item order on the site'. If the order is not reflected on your live site, check whether any sorts added to datasets are overriding the order you set in your mirrored collection view.

title: Can I block or approve multiple site members at once?
content: Currently, you can block and approve your site members individually. It is not possible to block or approve multiple members in bulk. If you need to delete multiple site members, you can perform this as a bulk action.

title: How can I add a download button to my Wix site for visitors to download a file?
content: To create a download button on your Wix site, go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Button. Click Text & Icon Button or Icon Button. Drag a button on to your page. Click the Link icon. Select Document to let your visitors download a file, and click Choose File to add or upload a file. Click Done.

title: How can I access the Media Manager in the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files.

Note: If you haven't uploaded media to your site yet, you can click the Upload Media icon.

In the Media Manager, choose what to do next:
- Upload Media: Click to upload your own files.
- Site Files: All the files that you have uploaded while working on your site.
- Visitor Uploads: Any files uploaded by site visitors are displayed here.
- My Boards: Create private media folders that you can access from any of your Wix sites.
- Trash: These are deleted files that you don't need.
- Media from Wix: Use media from the free Wix library.
- Shutterstock: Purchase professional media to use on your site.
- Unsplash: Add stunning free images from Unsplash.

title: Can I display a video background playlist on my Wix site?
content: Currently, you can only have one video background on a page on your site. You cannot display more than one video in a playlist. Tip: You can apply a video background to sections in sites built on the Studio Editor.

title: Can customers choose a delivery or pickup date without specifying a time in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It's now possible to allow your customers to choose a date for delivery or pickup without specifying a time. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I book a session for a member using the Wix app?
content: To book a session for a member using the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Contact List under Customers & Contacts. Tap the member you wish to book in for a session. Tap Book. Tap the service you want to book. Choose the Staff Member in charge of the booking. Choose the Location of the service. Set the Date & Time for the session.

title: Can I switch my existing site's template and transfer all content, media, and SEO settings to the new template?
content: It is not currently possible to transfer all your site's content, media, and SEO settings from an existing site to a new template. If you just want to update your site's look, you can choose your site's colors, text, and page transitions from the Site Design panel.

title: 判定适合使用 AI 后，下一步应如何处理？
content: 将任务移交给对应领域的执行技能（如 ecom-listing、ecom-advertising、ecom-pricing、ecom-inventory、ecom-research、ecom-compliance 等）；本技能只决定 whether，其他技能决定 how。核心决策规则是数据充分、工具可用、风险/回报；三者任一不满足时，答案在前提满足前为 no，而不是修改提示词。

title: how can I change my Wix account email address
content: You can change your Wix account email address in Account Settings. Click the Account email field, enter your Wix account password in the pop-up, enter your new email address, retype it to confirm, and click Next. Then check your email for a code from Wix, copy the 6-digit confirmation code, paste it into the pop-up in Account Settings, and click Submit.

title: How do I set up receipt printing with Wix Mobile POS?
content:
Important: Connecting a printer is only available for the US and Canada. Printing receipts is currently available only for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

To set up receipt printing with Wix Mobile POS:
- Before purchasing a printer, make sure it appears on the list of compatible printers and supports a Bluetooth, WiFi, or Ethernet connection. Choose from one of the Star Micronics or Epson thermal printers.
- Pair the printer with your mobile device: go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom. Under Get Paid, tap Point of Sale. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right. Select POS settings. Tap Connect next to Receipt printer. Follow the manufacturer's instructions to turn on your printer's Bluetooth and tap Connect.
- For Bluetooth: make sure you have allowed location and nearby devices discovery permissions on your mobile device. Ensure your printer's Bluetooth is turned on. In your phone, tap Connect next to the relevant printer. Pair your mobile POS with your printer.
- For WiFi and Ethernet: follow your thermal printer manufacturer instructions to connect it to the same network as your mobile device.
- Customize your receipt with Wix POS; changes you make affect both printed receipts and emailed receipts.
- At a sale, process a sale and collect payment. Tap Send Receipt. Select Print receipt.

title: How can I set up an automation in Wix to notify me when an invoice is overdue?
content: Go to your Automations Dashboard. Click + New Automation. Click the title to give your automation a name. Set up the trigger by selecting Invoices under Trigger and selecting the checkbox next to When the invoice is overdue. For the response, choose Get notified by email and enter an email address and a message. Choose when the action should be carried out by selecting Immediately or Set custom time, using the up and down arrows to set the number and the drop-down to choose between days or hours. Choose if the action should only be performed once per contact. Click Activate at the top right to save your automation.

title: How can I invite someone to manage my Wix Restaurant site and assign them specific roles?
content: Go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Click + Invite Collaborators. Enter the collaborator’s email address. Scroll down and click + Create Custom Role. Enter a title and a description for the role. Scroll down to Restaurants and select the permissions to assign: Manage Restaurant: Can manage and edit business info, marketing settings, menus, orders, and reservations. Manage Table Reservation settings: Can edit table reservation settings. Manage Table Reservations: Can manage and edit table reservations. Manage Restaurant Menus: Can view and edit menus. Manage Restaurant Orders: Can view and manage restaurant orders. Manage Restaurant Orders Settings: Can view and edit restaurant orders settings. Click Save. Click Send Invite.

title: How can I add a video from YouTube to my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Click the Pro Gallery in your editor, then click **Manage Media** and click **Add Media**. Select the **YouTube** option to embed a video from YouTube, enter the video's web address, and click **Add Video**. When adding your own video from YouTube, make sure that your video is set to **Public**, and the **Allow Embedding** box is checked. Then click **Done**.

title: Why are my completed orders not appearing in the Orders tab on Wix?
content:
When a customer places an online order, the payment needs to be approved by the relevant payment gateway (e.g. PayPal) before the order appears in the Orders tab. This usually happens almost immediately, however, in some cases it may take up to 24 hours.

A few payment methods, such as Boleto, and Degica (Komoju), require customers to make payments in person at a physical location after they complete their online orders. In these cases, the orders appear in the Orders tab only after your customer has paid for it. This may take a few days.

If the problem persists, contact us with the information below:

* A screenshot of the payment confirmation from the relevant payment provider
* The payment amount
* The transaction date

title: How can I customize the robots meta tags for a specific page on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page. Click SEO basics. Click the Advanced SEO tab. Click Robots Meta Tag. Select the directives that you want to use. Publish your site.

title: Can I choose different fonts for different blog posts on Wix?
content: Currently, when you select a font style (e.g. Times New Roman) for body text, the font you choose appears in the body text for all blog posts. It is not possible to choose different fonts for different posts. However, you can customize your fonts by size, color and font style.

title: Can I create tax groups when calculating tax using the manual tax method?
content: Yes, it is now possible to create tax groups when calculating tax using the manual tax method.

title: How can I edit the General Info screen in the Wix Member App?
content:
Currently, it's only possible to edit your General Info screen from the Wix app. To customize it:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Site & App.
- Tap Customize under the relevant member app (Spaces or Branded).
- Tap the Screen drop-down at the top, then tap General Info.

Contact information:
- Tap the Edit icon next to Contact Us.
- Tap Customize element and choose from: Element Title (edit the text under Element Title to change this from the preset 'Contact Us' title); Display Settings (tap the relevant checkboxes next to the elements you want to display); Edit Business Info (customize Business Name, Email, Currency, Time Zone, Description, Phone Number, and Location; for Location, tap the checkbox next to My business has a physical address to enter a business location).
- Tap Save at the top right.

Member:
- Tap the Edit icon next to Members.
- Tip: As some mobile operating systems may have different requirements of what should be displayed on the General Info screen, you have the option to hide the Members section on this screen. Tap Hide element if you do not want to display this on your site. Learn more about hiding elements on different operating systems.
- Tap Customize element.
- Edit the text under Element Title to change this from the preset 'Members' title.
- Tap Save at the top right.

Social Links:
- Tap the Edit icon next to Social Links.
- Tap Customize element and choose what you want to edit: Element Title (edit the text under Element Title to change this from the default 'Social Links' title); Add Social Link (tap + Add Social Link and enter the URL you want to link; repeat this step to add up to 6 social links).
- Note: Tap Remove Link under a specific URL and tap Remove to confirm.
- Tap Save, then tap Done.

title: How can I cancel my Wix site plan and domain?
content: Your site plan (Premium or Studio plan) and domain name are separate services and therefore need to be canceled separately.

title: How can I add a subscribe form to my Wix blog using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Contact and Forms. Scroll down to the Subscribe section and select a form. Click the form in your editor. Click Edit Form and customize your form settings. Click Save. After you've added your form, you can set your blog to send email notifications to subscribers whenever you publish a post.

title: Is PayU Money supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer PayU Money as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through PayU Money and arrange the payment offline.

title: Can I customize the text or color of the PayPal button in the Cart Page for my Wix Store?
