content: Currently, you cannot customize the text or color of the PayPal button in the Cart Page. As a workaround, you can add the information to the footer of your site so that it's always visible, or place information in a lightbox that pops up on your site.

title: How can I set up prepayment rules for table reservations using the Wix app?
content: You can set up prepayment rules straight from the Wix app on your mobile device. Go to your site in the Wix app, then tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Table Reservations and select Table Reservations. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right, then tap Settings. Tap Prepayment, then tap Add Prepayment and define your prepayment rules: under Party Size, enter the minimum number of guests the fee applies to; under Charge Fee, enter the fee to charge each guest for this reservation. When you're done, tap Save. Collecting payment upfront helps reduce no shows and minimize last minute cancellations.

title: Can I set individual color and typography styles for each breakpoint in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, the site styles that you set for your client's site automatically apply to all breakpoints. The option to set individual color and typography styles for each breakpoint is not yet available.

title: Why is my global section being overlapped by another section with sticky position in Safari, and how can I fix it?
content:
We are aware of an issue with global sections being overlapped by another section with sticky position type, which is caused by a matter on Safari browser’s side. As a result, the section with sticky position remains at the front and the global section scrolls behind it.

### Workaround
- Click the section with Sticky position.
- Change its position type to Default.

title: How can I add staff to my Wix Retail POS and assign them roles?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Roles & Permissions and click +Invite Collaborators. Enter your employee's email address; to invite more than one person, enter each email separated by a comma. Select a role: Cashier, Store Manager, or Custom Role. Cashiers can checkout customers, open the cash drawer, and manage contacts. Store managers have complete access to the POS tablet (including Wix Bookings services) and limited access to your site's dashboard. A Custom Role lets you define exactly which parts of your business the staff member can access. Click View Role Permissions for detailed information on permissions, then click Send Invite. Your new employee receives an email with the subject line You're Invited to Collaborate on a Website and must accept the invite by clicking Accept Now. After adding staff members, you can use the POS tablet to track staff hours.

title: How can I resolve the issue of being unable to click an element on my live site due to overlapping elements?
content:
If you cannot click an element that should be clickable on your live site, it is most likely covered by another element or page section. To resolve this issue:

- Search for overlapping elements: go to the relevant page in your Editor, right-click an element to see if there is any overlap, then click Arrange and Bring to Front.
- Check the footer: if you did not find overlapping elements, it might be a frozen footer covering your element. Click the footer in your Editor, click the Settings icon, and check the Freeze Footer toggle. If enabled, either disable this option or resize the footer so it does not overlap your element. If disabled, try resizing the footer so it does not overlap your element.

If you still have issues, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I learn more about the Wix Affiliate Program and get in contact with their support team?
content: Check out the Wix Affiliates Knowledge Base to learn more and get in contact with the Wix Affiliate support team. You can also refer to the Wix Affiliation Program - Terms and Conditions for more details.

title: How can I view my Premium plans and other subscriptions on Wix?
content: Your Premium plans, Studio plans, or other purchases made through Wix can be viewed on the Premium Subscriptions page of your Wix account. If you are unable to find the plan you're looking for, you might be looking in the wrong account. The account email locator can help you find your account.

title: I am trying to cancel my Premium subscription within the 14-day period, but I can't find the cancel feature.
content: In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Cancel Plan, and click Cancel Now to confirm. If you cancel during the first 14 days, your plan ends immediately and you are fully refunded within the next 20 business days. You can cancel your Premium plan at any time.

title: How can I add the Members List element to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Community, then drag the Members List element onto your page. You can show the element anywhere on your site, including a page in your Members Area or a site page that is visible to all visitors.

title: How can I display specific store categories on separate subpages in Wix ADI?
content:
Prerequisites: Make sure to create a product category in Wix Stores.

Create a subpage: In ADI, hover over Add on the top bar, click Page, and click Blank. Click the Page drop-down menu, then click Edit Menu below Manage Pages. Hover over the page you added and click the Show More icon. Click Rename Item to name your page the same as the relevant category, then click Set as Subitem.

Add a product gallery or slider: Click Add on the top bar, click Section to Page, click See all, then click Product Slider or Product Gallery. Choose the product gallery layout you want to use. Click the product gallery on your site and customize the options in the left panel. You can use Full Width, select a Category to Display, choose an Image Ratio, and choose Image Scaling such as Crop Image or Scale to Fit.

Display your category: Go to your subpage in ADI, click the product gallery or slider section, and in the Settings panel select the category you want to display.

title: How do I customize the Facebook Like button's layout on my Wix site?
content:
To change the layout of your Facebook Like button on your Wix site:

- Click the Facebook Like button in your editor.
- Click the Layout icon.
- Select your chosen layout from the panel.

This will allow you to set whether the button displays a Like counter, additional text, or icons.

title: How do I set up a Point of Sale with SumUp using the Wix Mobile POS?
content: Download the Wix app from the Apple App Store or Google Play. In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments and connect SumUp as your payment provider. You can set up SumUp without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments you need a Premium plan or Studio plan that supports payments. To accept credit card payments, order a SumUp card reader from SumUp; the reader connects to your smartphone or tablet via Bluetooth and can swipe, tap, or insert debit/credit cards.

title: Can I port my existing phone number to Wix Business Phone Number?
content: Currently, it is not possible to port an existing phone number to your Business Phone Number. This means you must purchase a local / toll-free number from Wix in order to use the Business Phone Number tools.

title: What can I do now that the Odnoklassniki app is no longer available?
content: The Odnoklassniki app has been retired from the Wix App Market and is no longer supported. If you want to continue creating buttons on Odnoklassniki (OK), you can create the button in Odnoklassniki and embed the code in your Wix Editor.

title: How can I manage and place phone orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Customers can call in and place their order over the phone. To enter a phone order, go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click More at the top right and select + Create New Order. Enter the customer's phone number and click Next. Enter their contact details and click Next. Information for returning customers is saved and you can add comments about the customer. Select the order type and click Next: for Delivery, enter the customer’s delivery address; for Pickup, select the location for customer pickup. Add the customer's order by selecting the dish from the menu, entering any special requests, optionally using the Plus and Minus icons to change quantity, and clicking Add to order. Once you've added the full order, click Go to Checkout. Choose a payment method for the order; you'll only be able to choose from the payment providers that are set up in your account. Click Place Order, then click Done. Phone orders only work for orders placed for right now. Currently, there isn't an option to place an order for another time or date. Make sure to toggle on ASAP orders in Order scheduling.

title: How can I access and add my mobile uploads to my site using the Media Manager?
content: To access and add your mobile uploads to your site, go to your Media Manager on desktop. If necessary, click the Mobile Uploads folder. Click the relevant files. Click Add to Page. Note: Images uploaded from the Wix app are automatically compressed. This may affect the quality of your image.

title: How can I add alt text and a tooltip to an image in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click the image, then click the Settings icon. Enter a description of the image under What's in the image? This description provides visitors and search engines (such as Google) with information about your image. Add the tooltip text under Does this image have a tooltip? This text appears when you hover over the image.

title: How can I approve requests to join my private program in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Online Programs. Tap the program you want to manage. Tap Request to Join at the top. Tap Approve next to the member you want to approve. When ready, tap Done. Important: You must upgrade your site so people can start joining your program. If you've set a price for your private program, new participants are automatically approved once they make the payment.

title: Can I create a mobile app version of my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Creating a mobile app version of your Wix site is currently not supported. However, you can create your own custom app with Branded App to exhibit your brand or business, and encourage visitors to keep in touch.

title: How can I hide a private folder in the Wix File Share app?
content:
To hide a private folder in the Wix File Share app:

- Go to File Share in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant folder.
- Click Permissions.
- Click the drop-down next to All members and select Remove.
- Select the checkbox at the bottom of the pop-up to hide the folder.
- Set up the new permissions for this folder:
  - Use the search bar to find a specific member, role or pricing plan.
  - Choose their permission level from the drop-down: Can view, Can upload or Can manage.
  - Select or deselect the checkbox next to Notify members.
  - Click Add / Add & Notify.
- Click Save.

title: How can I ensure my 301 redirects are set up correctly and avoid redirect loops?
content:
To test whether you've set up your 301 redirect correctly, type your customized URL into your browser's address bar. If everything is set up correctly, you should be redirected to the defined destination page. Make sure that your domain is properly connected to Wix, otherwise the 301 redirect does not function properly.

### About redirect loops
A redirect loop happens when you create a redirect for a URL that goes back to a URL that you've already previously created a redirect for. This makes a constant loop where the two redirects compete with each other in a never-ending cycle.

For example, if your page's URL slug was originally "/about" and you changed it to "/about-us" and set up a redirect, then later changed it back to "/about" and tried to create a new redirect from "/about-us" to "/about", this would create a loop.

- The second redirect would tell the URL Redirect Manager to redirect from "/about-us" to "/about".
- The first redirect would tell the URL Redirect Manager to redirect from "/about" to "/about-us" again.

You'll see an error message if you try to create the second redirect. In this situation, delete your original redirect since your page's URL is now what it originally was. If you still want to create a new redirect, you will need to enter a different URL to redirect to.

### Tip
You can check your domain connection using the Wix Domain Troubleshooter.

title: How can I take a screenshot using the Snipping Tool on Windows?
content: To take a screenshot using the Snipping Tool on Windows: click the Windows Start button (the Windows logo). On Windows 8.1, hover over the lower right corner of your screen and select Search. Type Snipping Tool in the search box, then select Snipping Tool. Click the top left corner of the area you want to snip. Drag the cursor down and to the right until the area you want to snip is outlined. Optionally, use the Highlighter to mark an area of the snip. Click File on the top menu, click Save as, enter the File name, and click Save.

title: How do I connect PostFinance as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click Connect next to PostFinance. If you have an account, enter your Space ID and Secret Key, then click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create PostFinance account, fill in the registration form, and wait for a message from PostFinance to get your Space ID and Secret Key credentials. Then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: What are the differences between selling images as 'Web Ready' and 'Original File' in the Wix Photo Albums Store?
content:
In the Wix Photo Albums Store, you can sell your images as Web Ready, Original File, or both, and you can set different prices for each option.

- **Web Ready**: If you upload an image over 1200 pixels, the Wix Photo Albums Store automatically creates a smaller version (the Web Ready file) that customers can purchase. The Web Ready file has slightly reduced quality and can therefore be sold at a lower price. These files are perfect for web use and ideal if you are selling images to be used online.

- **Original File**: When purchasing your image through the Wix Photo Albums Store, customers receive the original file that you upload. The Original File has no reduction in quality and can therefore be sold at a higher price. If you intend to sell images for print, it is recommended to upload images over 1200 pixels in order to retain the quality.

title: How can I send my email marketing campaign using the Wix app?
content:
Open your draft campaign in the Wix app. Tap the More Actions icon next to the campaign you want to send and tap Edit. If you created the campaign from a desktop, tap Send at this step instead. If editing your campaign, tap Next at the top right. Choose how you want to send your campaign:

Send to Contacts: Tap Send to Contacts. Tap Add next to Recipients to add contacts or email addresses who will receive the email marketing campaign. Edit the campaign info under Email Details: Subject Line, From Name, and Reply-to Email. Tap Send Campaign. You can also tap Send Test Email to send a test campaign; test emails do not count towards your monthly email campaign allowance.

Publish on Social: Tap Publish on Social. Tap Share Now. Choose a social app and follow the instructions to share on that platform. Tap Send at the top right.

title: Can I import more than 4000 blog posts from WordPress to Wix Blog?
content: No. Currently, you can import a maximum of 4000 blog posts from WordPress to Wix Blog.

title: How can I set the privacy permissions for my Wix Forum job board so everyone can view the job posts?
content: First, add Wix Forum to your site and choose an appropriate layout. Then, in your site's dashboard, go to Forum. Click Categories on the left. Add a new category or hover over an existing category and click Edit. Scroll down to Access & monetization and select Everyone. Click the Posts tab at the top. In the Post Permission section, select Everyone with access. Click Save.

title: What features does Wix Stores offer for creating an online store?
content:
Wix Stores offers you all the tools you need to create a professional online store and start marketing your products. All your sales are commission free! With Wix Stores you can:

* Sell physical products or digital downloads
* Accept PayPal, credit cards & offline payments
* Promote your store with integrated email marketing
* Ensure a secure SSL-certificate checkout
* Manage your store on the go with the Wix app
* Add shipping & pickup options
* Create coupons & sales

Note: Wix Stores requires a Business Premium Plan.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix storefront to suit my customers?
content: Go to the language & Region tab in your site's dashboard. Click the Site Language drop-down and select a language. If your language is not available, you can manually translate your store by editing the text on your Cart page, Product page, Side cart, Thank You page, Product Gallery and Product Widget.

title: Can I translate the Table Reservations App using Wix Multilingual?
content: You can now translate Wix Table Reservations with Wix Multilingual.

title: How do I add the ShipBob app to my Wix store for order fulfillment?
content: Go to the Wix App Market and add the ShipBob app. In the Editor, click Add Apps, search for ShipBob and select it, then click +Add App and Allow and Install. If you are not taken there automatically, open your site's dashboard, go to the Manage Apps tab, click Open next to ShipBob, then click Connect. Choose whether to log in to your existing ShipBob account or create a ShipBob account, complete the requested account fields, enter a name for the Wix-ShipBob integration in the Create a new channel field, review the permissions, and click Yes, Allow.

title: How can I allow my viewers to rent or purchase videos on my Wix Video channel?
content: Wix Video lets you allow viewers to rent or purchase a video. For purchases, viewers can pay a set price to have unlimited streaming of the video and can view it as much as they want. Your site visitors need to sign up/become site members in order to purchase videos, subscriptions, and also rent videos. You can only sell or rent videos that you have uploaded, not videos from YouTube, Vimeo and Facebook.

title: How can I create a new automation in Wix Bookings?
content:
Important: For 'Client checked in X times' or 'Client checks in' automations to work, you must also mark attendance.

To create a new automation: Go to your Automations Dashboard. Click + New Automation. Click + Start from Scratch. Note: To use a suggested automation, search and select from the options under Popular. You can edit the trigger and actions of a suggested automation. Click the title at the top to give your automation a name.

title: Can I use Velo with Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. You can now use Velo with Wix Restaurants.

title: How can I attach a screenshot to send to Wix Customer Care?
content:
While interacting with the Wix Customer Care chatbot, you can attach screenshots to accompany your description of your issue:

- Click the Attachment icon.
- Note: If Send does not display, click Edit my description, then click the Attachment icon.
- Select a file from your computer and click Open.
- Enter a description of the issue you're experiencing and click Send.

Supported file types: You can upload image files in these formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG, GIF, ICO, BMP, and TIFF.

Important: If you are taking a screenshot of a billing page or bank statement, make sure you conceal your full credit card number and CVV number. Leave only the last 4 digits of the credit card visible.

title: Is it possible to add a 'Request Quote' button in Wix Stores?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to add a Request Quote button in Wix Stores.

### Workarounds
* You can add a "Request Quote" button to your site using Wix Forms. You can also use any form or quote apps available in the Wix App Market.
* Wix Studio users can add a "Request Quote" button using Velo.

title: What happens if I reassign my Wix Premium Plan to another Editor X site?
content: If you reassign your Wix Premium Plan to another Editor X site, or would like to upgrade to another plan, you will need to upgrade that site to an Editor X Premium Plan.

title: Which mobile operating systems support Wix mobile-friendly sites?
content:
Your mobile-friendly site is currently supported by the following operating systems on mobile devices:

- **iPhone:** iOS 14 and above (iPhone 7 and above)
- **Android:** 9.0 and above

Wix sites are also supported by in-app browsers, such as Facebook and Instagram.

title: How can I customize my VideoBox for mobile viewing in Wix Editor?
content: To customize your VideoBox on mobile, go to the mobile editor. Select the relevant VideoBox. Click the Settings icon and customize the video's settings for mobile. You can use Reset video to reset your video to its original proportions, and use the Play Video on mobile toggle to enable or disable automatic play of your video on mobile. Optionally, add a mask or animation to your video: click the Mask icon to cut out your video into a unique shape, or click the Animation icon to add an animated effect to your VideoBox and click Customize to refine your selected animation. To set up your VideoBox Behaviors for mobile and further customization options, head to the desktop editor. Note: If your device does not support inline video playback, your cover image as well as any design changes (Pattern Overlay, Contour, Border and Shadow) made to your video are displayed instead of the video. The new autoplay policy for certain browsers only allows video to autoplay when the sound is muted; if your videobox is set to play automatically, the video plays without sound.

title: How can I speed up the time it takes for my Wix site to appear in search engine results?
content: You can verify your site ownership with Google Search Console and with Bing Webmaster Tools. Once your site is verified, you can submit your sitemap directly to Google via Google Search Console to make it easier for Google to crawl and categorize your site. The waiting period for your site to be indexed is determined by the search engines themselves and is the same for all websites, not just Wix sites.

title: Can I track who liked, shared, or downloaded items from my Wix Pro Gallery?
content: Currently, it is not possible to track and analyze information on gallery items that have been liked, shared or downloaded by your site visitors. However, you can track the number of likes a gallery item receives by adding a heart counter to your gallery - it is just not possible to view who liked your item and when.

title: How can I print an invoice for my Wix premium subscription?
content: Go to Billing History in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the invoice you want to print. Click Print invoice.

title: How can I approve a guest writer's blog post on Wix?
content: Blog Editors and Owners can approve posts on the Pending Review tab of the Blog section of your site's dashboard. To approve a post, go to Pending Review in your site's dashboard or click the link in the email notification about the review submission, click Review next to the post that you want to review, then click Approve and Publish in the top right corner. If you do not want to publish the post immediately, click the drop-down menu beside Approve and Publish and select Schedule Post.

title: How do I make my services visible in Dayful by Wix?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant service(s). Click the Make Service Visible icon.

title: How do I change the header background color on scroll in the Studio Editor?
content: Select the header. Click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor. Under Design, enable the Color while scrolling toggle. Click the color box to choose a different color. You can optionally drag the slider to change the opacity.

title: How can I request a refund for a new Wix Premium or Studio plan, and what are the conditions?
content: Wix offers a 14-day, money-back guarantee for new Premium or Studio site plans. If you purchased your site plan within the last 14 days, you're eligible for a full refund. The 14-day refund policy only applies to new Premium or Studio plans. The refund policy does not apply if you are requesting a refund for a plan renewal or for the upgrade of an existing plan. If you do not meet the requirements for the 14-day refund policy, but you believe you still deserve a refund, contact us and we'll review your request. To request a refund, cancel your site plan within the first 14 days of purchasing it to receive a full refund. There's no need to submit a request, simply choose a plan to cancel. If you're eligible, your payment method will be refunded automatically. Please allow up to 20 business days for your refund to appear on your credit card statement. After canceling, your site plan is immediately deactivated and you can no longer make use of Wix's premium features (e.g., removing Wix ads or connecting your own domain). Wix is not responsible for any bank charges, commissions or overdrafts. The only way to remove these charges is through direct negotiation with your bank.

title: How can I change the field type in a CMS collection without affecting connected page elements?
content: If the field is connected to page elements, consider creating a new field instead of changing the existing field type. You can paste your existing field's data to the new field; this ensures page elements connected to the existing field remain intact. To change a field type, go to CMS in your site's dashboard, click the relevant collection, click Manage Fields, hover over the relevant field and click the More Actions icon, click Edit, click Change type next to the field type, select the new field type, click Change Field Type, click Save, then click the Yes, change field type checkbox and click Confirm. If you make a mistake, you can revert your collection to a previous version using Backups.

title: How can I rename a Google Workspace user via my Wix account?
content: Sign out of your Workspace account, go to Business Email in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant user, select Rename your user, fill in the details you want to change (first name, last name, or email username), and click Rename your user.

title: Can I manually send review requests to customers using Wix Reviews?
content: Currently, if you're using Wix Reviews, you can send an automated message asking customers to review the product they purchased. It is not possible to manually send requests.

title: How can I create an SEO Checklist for my Wix site?
content: Go to your SEO dashboard, scroll down to Tools and settings, and click Get Started under SEO Setup Checklist. Click Get Started, enter your site name under What's Your Business or Site Name?, and click Next. Select whether you serve customers from a physical location or online, then click Next. Add keyword phrases that describe your business and what it offers, then click Next. If you want suggestions, click Find high performing keywords. Your personalized SEO Checklist will be ready in seconds; follow the checklist steps to connect your site to Google. Note that it can take some time for Google to index your site's pages and display them in search results.

title: Can I add shadows to strips and columns in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, Wix does not support adding and customizing shadows to strips and columns on your site. However, there are lots of design options available for strips and columns, such as changing the background, and choosing scroll settings. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

title: How can I disable the Encrypted Website Payments option in my PayPal account to prevent error messages during customer payments?
content: To disable the Encrypted Website Payments option, sign in to your PayPal account, click your name at the top right, click Account Settings, click Website Payments on the left, click Update next to Website Preferences, scroll down to the Encrypted Website Payments section, and select the Off checkbox.

title: Is the 'Send as a Gift' option supported in Wix Stores?
content: Yes, you can now add a "Send as a gift" option to the Checkout Page. You can add a gift option by customizing the Checkout Page fields or by using the Super Gift Upsell & Cross Sell 3rd party app.

title: How do I delete a coupon in Wix Stores?
content:
To delete a coupon:

- Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard.
- Click the More Actions icon at the top right of the coupon you want to delete.
- Click Delete.
- Click Yes, Delete to confirm.

Note: Once you delete a coupon, you can't undo this action. You can, however, recreate a coupon with the same details.

title: How can I reorder products in my Wix Photo Album Store?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Photo Albums, click the Album Store tab on the left, click Pricing, hover over the relevant product, drag and drop it to a new location, click Save, then publish or preview your site to view the changes.

title: How can I order branded merchandise using the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Before you begin, make sure you first purchase your logo. To order merchandise, go to the Brand Studio. Click the My Brands drop-down at the top and select the relevant brand. Click the Brand Actions drop-down and select Print Logo on Merchandise. Click the Shipping to drop-down and select your shipping destination. Click Get Started below the item you want to order. Depending on the item, follow the relevant steps: T-shirts: optionally click Customize, design the T-shirt, and click Done; select a color (Black or white); choose a size; select a quantity; click Add to Cart; click Continue to Checkout. Mugs: optionally customize and click Done; choose the amount of mugs per pack; click Add to Cart; click Continue to Checkout. Tote Bags: optionally customize and click Done; choose the amount of bags per pack; click Add to Cart; click Continue to Checkout. Stickers: optionally customize and click Done; select the dimensions; choose the amount of stickers per pack; click Add to Cart; click Continue to Checkout. Magnets: optionally customize and click Done; select the dimensions; choose the amount of magnets per pack; click Add to Cart; click Continue to Checkout. After that, enter your shipping details and click Save & Continue. Confirm your payment method and click Submit Purchase. For T-shirts, you can click Size Chart to get the exact measurements of each size.

title: How do I connect my Wix store to Spocket for dropshipping?
content: Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor. In Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the Editor. In Editor X, click App Market at the top of Editor X. Start typing "Spocket" in the search bar and select the "Spocket - US & EU Dropshipping" app from the results. Click Add to Site. Click Agree and Add. An email is sent to the email address associated with your Wix account. Go to the email and click Verify my email.

title: How can I add or remove participants from a class session in Wix Bookings?
content:
To add a participant, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the relevant class, click Manage, then click + Add Participant. Enter the participant details, including Name, Group of, and how you want to charge your client. Optionally add the client to future sessions, then click Save or Save & Add Another.

To remove a participant without cancellation and no-show fees, click the More Actions icon next to the participant, click Remove, optionally select Notify participants with an email and add a message, then click Remove.

To remove a participant with cancellation and no-show fees, click the More Actions icon next to the participant, click Remove, optionally select Apply cancellation fee, optionally select Notify participants with an email and add a message, click Remove, optionally edit the cancellation fee, click Confirm Fee & Continue, then click Collect Payment and choose how you want to charge the participant.

You can issue a refund through the Orders page in your site's dashboard.

title: How can I access the Microsoft Office 365 Admin Center through my Wix account?
content: Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click Manage at Microsoft next to the relevant mailbox. Login using your Admin credentials.

title: How can I add the Get Image Colors add-on in Wix Studio Editor?
content:
To add the Get Image Colors add-on in the Wix Studio Editor:
- Click the Wix Studio icon at the top left.
- Click Tools.
- Click Editor Add-ons.
- Click Get Add-ons.
- Click Get Image Colors.

title: Can I display a different price per unit for product variants of different sizes in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it is possible to display one price per unit for products and product variants. A different price per unit for product variants of different sizes is not supported (e.g. a separate price per unit for a 375 ml mini and a 750 ml wine bottle).

title: How can I create a new CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click CMS on the left side of the editor. Click Create Collection. Click Start from scratch. Optionally, click Create with AI to let AI create a collection for you. Click Next. Enter a name for your collection. Select Multiple items (Default) or A single item. Click Create. Add fields to your collection manually by clicking + Add Field, or import a CSV file by clicking Import CSV file. If you want to add items, click + Add Item, enter details about the item in the relevant fields, and click Save. Repeat to add more items.

title: How can I broadcast a message to all my event guests using the Wix app?
content:
To broadcast a message to guests using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Events.
- Tap Published Events.
- Tap the relevant event.
- Tap the Message icon at the top right.
- Tap Message guests.
- Select the checkbox(s) next to the guests you want to message, then tap Next.
- Note: The options in this section vary according to the types of tickets you create for your event.
- Tap the channel drop-down and select how you want to send your broadcast message:
  - Chat: Broadcast a live chat to guests. To use this option, you must have the Wix Chat app on your site.
  - Email: You can broadcast an email to guests if they have provided their email address and it is saved in your contacts. Note: When sending a message to over 100 guests, you are directed to do so through Gmail.
  - SMS: Send an SMS message directly to contacts. This option is only available if you have purchased a Business Phone Number.
- Compose your message.
- (Optional) Tap the icons to add a saved reply, an image, or send an item (e.g. coupon).
- Tap Send.

title: How can I create a site with unlimited content using Wix?
content: By default, Wix sites are static and have a limit of 100 static pages. You can add the CMS (Content Management System) to your site to create dynamic pages and dynamic elements (e.g. galleries, repeaters, tables). Dynamic pages and elements allow you to easily manage and update your site's content without needing to edit each page and element individually. They get their content from collections you store in the CMS separately from your Editor. Dynamic pages and elements maintain the same layout and design while their content changes based on their connected collection items.

title: How can a site member change their login email address on their member profile?
content:
To change the email address:
- Click the member profile icon and go to Profile.
- Click Edit Profile.
- Scroll down to the Login info section.
- Click Change Email.
- Enter the new email address and confirm the password.

Note: Members can use the Reset or create password link if they don't remember their password, or if they originally signed up using a social media account.
- Click Change.

title: Can I add a Share button to an image or gallery on my Wix site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a Share button to an image or gallery on your site. As an alternative, you can add a Pin to Pinterest button to an individual image so that your visitors can share your content on Pinterest.

title: How can I build responsive sites in the Studio Editor?
content: Design an element the way you want it to look on desktop, then choose a responsive behavior that meets your needs. The responsive behavior ensures the element automatically adjusts to different breakpoints. For more precise control, use advanced, responsive measurements to resize and position elements on every breakpoint. To make the process quicker, use a responsive layout tool to group related elements based on either CSS grid or flexbox; grids keep elements in their respective cells, while stacking elements maintains their vertical or horizontal order. You can also generate a responsive layout with the click of a button: the AI tool analyzes the current layout, then places a responsive structure that makes it look ideal, so you don't have to check every breakpoint and spend time on resolving design issues.

title: What determines the language of my Wix dashboard/workspace and editor, and where can I change my site's language?
content: The language of your dashboard/workspace and editor is determined by the language of your Wix account. The source page says to learn how to change the language of your Wix account, but it does not provide those steps in the text. Your site's language can be changed from Language & Region.

title: How can I unblock a site member in Wix Forum?
content: Go to your Members page in your live site. Click the contact you want to unblock. Click the Show more icon. Click Unblock Member.

title: What should I do if my Google Ads campaign with Wix is disapproved due to a 'Destination not working' error?
content: If your campaign is disapproved with a 'Destination not working' error, check the URL you've entered, fix the ad's destination, and submit your campaign for review. If your main domain is not working, check with your domain provider and resolve any issues with the domain first.

title: How do I connect a network card reader to my Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
Use the BBPOS WisePOS E network reader, and unbox and charge it before setup. To connect it to WiFi, check the tablet's WiFi network by tapping the Menu icon, selecting App & Tablet, and tapping Wi-Fi & Network. On the reader, tap the same WiFi network if networks are displayed. If not, swipe right, tap Settings, enter 07139 as the PIN code, select Network, and connect to the same WiFi network as the tablet.

After WiFi connection, a three-word code should appear on the reader. If it does not, swipe right, tap Settings, select Generate pairing code, and enter the three-word code in the pop-up including the hyphens. On the POS tablet, tap the Menu icon at the bottom left, tap Manage Hardware, select Set up Card Reader, tap Connect next to Network reader, tap +Pair a New Network Reader, and enter the three-word code. You can optionally give the reader a name, then click Pair Reader. After pairing, the reader appears in the available card readers list in the Manage Hardware tab.

title: Can I set up back-in-stock notifications using the Wix app?
content: Currently, you must go to desktop to set up back-in-stock notifications. It's not possible to set up the notifications using the Wix app.

title: How can I generate images using the Wix AI Image Creator in the Wix Editor?
content: To generate images with the Wix AI Image Creator in the Wix Editor, go to the editor, click Media on the left side of the editor, click Photo Studio, and click Create AI Images. Enter your prompt in the Describe your image field, click a style for the image under Choose a style, and click Create Image. Optionally click Create Again to generate another image, or select another style and click Create Image to generate a new image with the same prompt. When happy with the image, click Use Image. Optionally edit the image further if needed, then click Save. Saved AI-generated images are automatically added to the Site Files folder in your Media Manager. Note that this feature is not currently available to all users.

title: How can I create and send an invoice using the Wix Free Invoice Generator?
content: Go to the Free Invoice Generator, click Create Your Invoice, and enter your relevant business information. Use + Upload to add your business logo. Enter the relevant client information, then enter the invoice and payment details under Invoice Settings, including the correct date of issue and due date. Add the relevant products and/or services with a description, price, quantity, and discounts, and click Apply to Invoice after each product or service. Add relevant Notes and Terms using the provided fields. Then choose Email your client to send the invoice directly and click Send, or Download Invoice to send it later. You need a Wix account and must be signed in to email invoices directly; you must sign up to email or download invoices.

title: Can I save a site version with a custom name directly in the editor?
content: While you can rename previous versions in the Site History page, this option is not available when you manually save a site in your editor. The version's name is its timestamp by default, but you can change it later.

title: How can I organize my album galleries in Wix Photo Albums?
content: Go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to the relevant album. You can then use these options: click Add New Gallery on the left to add a gallery; click the Reorder icon to the left of the relevant gallery and drag it up or down the list; click the More Actions icon above your gallery and click Rename, enter the new gallery name, and click Save; click the More Actions icon above your gallery and click Duplicate; click the More Actions icon above your gallery and click Delete, then click Delete to confirm.

title: How can I reorder albums in my Shared Gallery?
content: To reorder your albums in the Shared Gallery, go to your Shared Gallery in your site's dashboard, click Reorder Albums, click the relevant album and drag and drop it in the order you want, then click Save. Before you begin, make sure you have at least two albums created before you attempt to reorder them.

title: How can I add the ProveSource Social Proof App to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add the ProveSource app using the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the ProveSource app in the search bar, and click Add to Site. Before you begin, make sure your site has been upgraded to a Premium plan or Studio plan that allows you to accept payments and has a domain. After adding the app, you are taken to the ProveSource dashboard, where you can perform actions such as customizing notifications, setting goals, and viewing analytics. To learn more, visit the ProveSource help center.

title: How can I set an element to show on all pages in the Wix Editor?
content: Right-click the element in the Editor. On a Mac, hold the Control key and click the relevant element to access the right-click menu. Enable the Show on All Pages toggle. You can also click the Show on All Pages toggle from the Editor Toolbar.

title: How can I retrieve the URL of a file in my Wix Media Manager?
content: From your Media Manager, click Site Files. Click the relevant file. Click Copy URL in the information panel. Paste the URL in a new browser.

title: Can I attach documents to my videos in Wix Video?
content: Currently, it is not possible to attach documents to your videos. However, if you are monetizing your videos and would like to sell a document together with your video, you can follow the workaround: add your document to the hidden page, then add an action card to your paid video and link it to the hidden page with the document. Once your viewer has purchased a video, they can access your action card which leads to a page with your document. Click here to learn how to retrieve a URL for a hidden page.

title: What are the required and recommended fields for setting up a PayPal Buy Now button on my Wix site?
content:
### Required Field
The following field is required, and must be completed in order to continue receiving payments:
* **What's your PayPal email?:** Connect the relevant PayPal email account in order to receive payments.

### Recommended Fields
We recommend filling out the following fields in order to display the product name and price:
* **What's the product's name?:** Enter the name of your product in the field.
* **What's the price?:** Enter the product price to determine how much visitors pay during the transaction.

title: Can I refund orders processed through additional payment providers directly from the Wix dashboard?
content: Currently, it's possible to refund orders from your Wix dashboard only when the payment was processed through PayPal, Stripe, or Wix Payments. If another payment provider was used, you can still refund your customers using the instructions, but you need to complete part of the process outside the Wix dashboard. When you complete the steps, the order in the Orders tab is updated to show the refund.

title: How can I set up my business phone number to send declined calls to my personal voicemail?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Business Phone Number and scroll to Accepting and Declining Calls. Select Connect me right away. Declined calls will then reach your personal voicemail.

title: How can I access my Wix Payments Dashboard after disconnecting my account?
content: If your Wix Payments account has been disconnected, you can still access information about past transactions, payouts and more. Sign in to your Wix account. Click your account name at the top right. Click Wix Payments Accounts. Click View on the Wix Payments enabled site account you wish to see. Select the information you want to view: Payments, Payouts, Settlement Report, or Account Details. Tip: Click on each payment to see more details about that payment.

title: Is it possible to delete a Blocks app in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks it is not possible to delete a Blocks app from your workspace. You can, however, archive an app you no longer need.

title: How can I change the language of my Wix Forum to Spanish?
content: To change the language of your Wix Forum to Spanish, go to your site's General Info tab, scroll down to the Regional Settings section, click the Language drop-down menu, and select Spanish.

title: How can I customize the privacy settings of the member signup form in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Signup & Login, select Member Signup Form, click the Social & Community tab, and select the relevant option under Signup privacy footnote customization. The options include Footnote only and Checkbox for members to choose profile privacy on signup. You can enable the Sign up to this site with a public profile toggle. When Enabled, the checkbox is automatically selected for a public profile. When Disabled, the checkbox for a public profile is not selected.

title: How can I connect PayU Czech Republic as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
In your Wix site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers, then click Connect next to PayU.

If you already have a PayU account:
- Enter the credentials you received from PayU Poland when your account was approved: Pos id, Second key, and Client secret.
- Click Connect.
- Log in to your PayU account, click Online Payments, click My Shops, click POS, then click the link with your store's name.
- Click Disable next to each payment method under Automatic Collection and make sure the value is set to "No".
- If your PayU account was registered before the date specified in the source, contact PayU CZ and request to configure your account as a Wix merchant.

If you do not have an account:
- Click Create PayU account to be redirected to PayU.
- Create your new account by filling in your personal information and selecting the checkbox under Consent to contact, then click Provide company data, fill in your company's information under Company data, enter your Wix site details under Your website, enter the details of the person representing your company under Person(s) authorized to represent the organization, click Go to summary, select the checkbox to accept the agreement with PayU and click I accept, then upload the relevant company documents and click Send documents.
- Follow PayU's instructions for bank account verification.
- Set up your PayU Merchant Panel by logging in to your PayU account, clicking Online Payments, clicking My Shops, clicking Add Shop, and following the instructions to add your site and store details.
- Wait for a confirmation email from PayU.

After approval, connect your PayU account to Wix:
- Go to your PayU account, click Online Payments, click My Shops, click POS, and copy the Pos id, Second key, and Client secret.
- Go back to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to complete your account setup.

title: What should I do if my Wix site is not displaying correctly on my mobile device?
content:
If your Wix site is not displaying correctly on your mobile device, follow these troubleshooting steps:

Check your operating system and browser. Make sure the device and browser you are using are supported and that you are using the most up-to-date version. If not, you can download a new browser from the Apple App Store or the Google Play Store.

Supported operating systems on mobile devices:
iPhone: iOS 14 and above (iPhone 7 and above); Android: 9.0 and above.

Supported browsers on mobile devices:
Google Chrome; Safari.

Clear your browser's cache and cookies. For instructions on how to clear the cache on your mobile device, use the instructions for iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch, or Android.

Check the site view. Check whether you are viewing your site in landscape or portrait view on your device. Currently, Wix sites are only supported on mobile devices in portrait mode.

Important information:
Tablet devices, such as iPads and Android tablets, display the desktop version of your site. Wix sites load on Windows phones, but Wix currently does not test functionality and therefore cannot offer support for issues that may occur on that type of device.

Tip:
If you are using Google Analytics, you can check the traffic received from different mobile devices in the mobile section.

If you are still unable to view your site or your site does not appear correctly, contact Wix and provide the manufacturer and model of your mobile device, the operating system, the browser including the exact browser version, the type of connection when experiencing the issue, and a screencast or screenshot of the issue.

title: Is it possible to display my health waiver in the Wix Member Apps?
content: Currently, it is not possible to display your health waiver on the Wix mobile apps (Spaces, Fit by Wix, Branded app and Dine). Instead, you can add a checkbox field to the Booking Form, make it mandatory and assign a hyperlink to it, that redirects to your health waiver.

title: How can I submit a notice about illegal content under the Digital Services Act on Wix?
content: Under the DSA, platforms such as Wix are required to have a process to aid the notification of illegal content by individuals or entities. Notices may be submitted by users residing in the EU; users residing outside of the EU about content accessible within the EU; and Trusted Flaggers appointed by the European Commission. According to Article 16 of the DSA, government authorities, trusted flaggers, and users online can submit complaints about illegal content. The source article instructs readers to click to submit a notice, but it does not provide a URL in the supplied text.

title: How can I access the Site Styles panel in the Studio Editor?
content: Click Site Styles on the left side of the editor.

title: How can I add a single tracking number to a store order in Wix?
content:
To add a single tracking number to an order in Wix:

- Go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard.
- Click the relevant order.
- Click **Add Tracking No**.
- Enter the tracking number.
- Click the **Shipping Carrier** drop-down and select an option: select an existing carrier, or scroll down and click **Add shipping carrier** to add a new carrier.
- (Optional) Add a tracking URL.
- (Optional) Check the **Send shipping confirmation email** checkbox to send an email to your customer informing them that the item was shipped. The tracking number appears in the email.
- Click **Apply**.

title: How can I change the background of a section in ADI to an image?
content:
To change the background of a section to an image in ADI:
- Click the section you want to update inside ADI.
- Click Edit.
- Hover over the media thumbnail on the left and click Edit & Replace.
- Choose Image as the media type.
- Click Replace.
- Select an image or click Upload Images to add your own.
- Click Apply.
- Click Position to choose what part of the image you want to show.
- Drag the Opacity slider to change the image opacity.
- Select a color to show behind the image.
- Choose a scroll effect.

Note: You can change the height of the section to change the size of your image.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to access premium features?
content:
To upgrade your Wix site and access premium features, follow these steps:

- Go to the Upgrade page.
- Click **Select** under the plan you wish to purchase.
- Select a billing cycle and click **Continue to Checkout**.
- Enter your payment details and click **Submit Purchase**.

**Note:** After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: How can I customize the Wix AI Chat Assistant to reflect my brand's style and voice?
content: Designing and customizing the AI Chat Assistant in your editor allows you to reflect your brand's voice and style. Customize colors, fonts, layouts and more, making it easy to find and use. An inviting chat interface encourages customers to get in touch, providing them with better service and increasing your site's engagement.

title: How can I create a pricing plan with a free trial period for my clients?
content: To create a plan with a free trial period, go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard. Click + Create Plan. Enter the details of the plan, such as the name and benefits. In the Pricing options section, select Recurring Payments. Enter the Price. Set how often you take payment from Payment frequency in the drop-down. Click the Length of plan drop-down and choose from Choose a set length, Until canceled, or Custom. Click the Enable Free Trial toggle. Select the duration of the free trial in the Length of Free Trial drop-down: choose 7, 14, or 30 days, or click Custom and enter the number of days. Finish creating your plan and click Save.

title: How can I invite someone to collaborate on my site using the Wix Studio app?
content: Only site owners and co-owners can invite people to collaborate on a site. To invite collaborators, go to the relevant workspace in the Wix Studio app. Tap **Sites** at the bottom. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant site. Tap **Invite Collaborators**. Tap **Invite Others**. Enter the email address of the person you're inviting. Select the checkbox next to the relevant role under **Choose Roles**. Tip: Create a custom role on your desktop for your collaborators. Tap **Send**.

title: How can I edit my purchased logo if it says I need to upgrade my plan?
content: If you purchased a Logo-Only Plan (Basic, Advanced, and Value), your design is locked once you choose to download it. To edit this logo, either upgrade to a plan that includes unlimited editing via the Brand Kit, or duplicate your existing logo, make all desired changes, and then purchase a separate logo download for that amended design.

title: How can I add a mask to a VideoBox in Wix Editor?
content: After adding a VideoBox, click it in your editor. Click the Mask icon. Choose a shape for your VideoBox by selecting a shape from the list, or click the Add icon to view more shapes and vector art in the Media Manager. You can also upload your own SVG file from there.

title: How can I add a new customer to my Wix Retail POS customer list?
content:
To add a new customer to your Wix Retail POS customer list:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap **Customers** on the bottom bar.
- Tap **+ New Customer** on the left.
- Enter the customer's name and email address.
- (Optional) Add additional information: tap **Add More Info**, then enter the customer's phone number, address, or company.
- Tap **Save**.

title: How can I update the payment method for my active recurring subscription on a Wix site?
content: Log in to the relevant Wix site. Go to the My Subscriptions section of the Members Area. Click the relevant plan. Click Update Payment Method. Click Credit/Debit Cards to add a new credit/debit card or select a previously saved credit card from the drop-down. Enter the relevant details for the new credit/debit card, then click Submit. This option is only available for active, online recurring subscriptions. You cannot update your payment method using the Wix Member apps, including the Spaces by Wix app or Wix Branded app. You can only update your payment method to a credit card, not PayPal. You need to update the payment method on each subscription separately. Adding a new payment method through “My wallet” does not update the payment method on the active subscription.

title: Can I purchase or transfer a domain with special or foreign characters to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to purchase a domain from, or transfer a domain to Wix which contains special or foreign characters. This feature requires IDN (international domain names) support which is not available at this time. You can, however, keep the domain hosted elsewhere and connect a domain with special characters to your Wix site.

title: Is the Crazy Egg app supported on Wix?
content:
Currently, Wix does not have a Crazy Egg app.

Tip: We have many statistics and analytics apps available in the Wix App Market. Additional, you can sign up for Google Analytics.

title: Can I change the language of the confirmation email sent to customers in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now change the language of all the text in the confirmation email sent to customers after they book a service on Wix Bookings. You need to add Wix Multilingual to your site to change the language of the confirmation email.

title: How can I add a new task using the Wix app and assign it to a contact?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Dashboard at the bottom. Scroll down to Tasks & Reminders. Tap Create New Task. Write your task's content in the text box. Optionally, to assign the task to a contact, tap Add next to Select a Contact, then tap the relevant contact. To assign the task to a collaborator, tap Add next to Assign To, then tap the relevant collaborator. To set a due date, tap Add next to Set Due Date, select the date, and tap Done. Tap Add at the top right to save the task.

title: How can I change the header and footer layout for a specific page in Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click the More Actions icon on the page you want to work on. Click Settings. Click Layout. Select an option for this page's layout: Standard — the page includes a header and a footer, as usual; No header & footer — the page does not show a header nor a footer, and this option is mainly recommended for landing pages. Note: your site menu won't appear on this page, nor will any other apps you otherwise show in the header and footer, so you will need to add a navigation link back to your homepage.

title: How can I choose and configure the 8 conversion events for Facebook to track using Wix?
content: Facebook limits tracking to 8 conversion events. From Facebook's Events Manager, rank the top 8 events Facebook should track; the recommended order is Purchase, Initiate Checkout, Add to Cart, and View Content. To configure your events, log in to Facebook's Events Manager and select the pixel you want to use. If you set up Pixel through Facebook Ads by Wix and have not changed the name, the name begins with 'Wix Pixel'. Click the Aggregated Event Measurement tab under the Overview graph, then click Configure Web Events. Read through the introductory screens and click Next. Select the Wix domain you want to configure events for, then click Manage Events. Click Edit. In the top right corner, click Add Event. Under Pixel/Custom Conversion, select the Wix pixel used for Facebook Ads. Select the 4 events mentioned above, plus any additional events you would like. Click Submit, then select the checkbox and click Apply.

title: How can I add a project page to my site menu using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor. Click the menu you want to add a link to, then click Manage Menu. Click Add Menu Item at the bottom of the page. Select Link, then select Page. Click the Which page? drop-down and select Project pages. Click the Which item? drop-down and select the project you want to link to. This option only appears if your projects are connected to a collection and you have more than one project within that collection. Click Done. Update the name of the link as it will display on your site menu. Click Done.

title: Is Monetico (CIC) supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Monetico (CIC) as a payment provider. You can accept payments to your CIC account by connecting PayZen as a payment provider.

title: How can a visitor cancel their channel subscription on a Wix site?
content: To cancel a subscription, the visitor should select the relevant channel, click the Profile icon to access their profile, and on the pop-up click cancel subscription.

title: Can I offer services with online payment through the Reserve With Google integration?
content: Yes. With the new Reserve With Google integration, you can offer more services that are eligible for Google than before, including services with online payment.

title: How can I create color-swatch options for my products in Wix Stores?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to the Store Products tab. Select an existing physical product, or click New Product and select Physical. Scroll down to the Product Options section and click + Add Options. Enter Color under Type in an option name. Select Color under Show in product page as. Enter your first color choice (e.g. Purple) and press Enter on your keyboard. Optional: click the color you just added, select a shade or enter a hexadecimal color value, then click the Checkmark icon. Repeat to add additional colors. Optional: drag the option choices to rearrange their order. Click Add.

title: How can I create an event schedule in the Wix app for my upcoming conference?
content: Before you begin, create and save your event. In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, tap Events, select Published Events or Draft Events, and select the relevant event. For recurring events, you can add a schedule to an individual occurrence. Tap the Manage tab, select Add-ons, and tap Add to Event under Schedule. Add the first schedule item: enter the Item Name, set the start and end dates and times, and optionally fill out Item details by entering the Place, adding tags, and adding a description. Tap Save. To add more items, tap Add New Item and repeat the schedule item steps. To hide, cancel, or delete an item, tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant item and choose Hide Item, Cancel Item, or Delete Item.

title: How can I change the spacing between items in my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the Pro Gallery element on your page, click Settings, click the Layout tab, choose a layout, click Customize Layout, scroll down to the Design Settings, and drag the Spacing slider to increase or decrease the spacing between images. Note: You cannot change the spacing for Slideshow galleries.

title: How can I add additional meta tags to a page on my Wix site to use Pinterest Rich Pins?
content:
To add additional meta tags to a page on your Wix site for Pinterest Rich Pins, use the relevant editor steps below.

Wix Editor:
Go to your editor.
Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page.
Click SEO basics.
Click the Advanced SEO tab.
Click + Add New Tag under Meta Tags.
Add your meta tag code in the HTML Code field.
Click Apply.

Studio Editor:
Go to your editor.
Click Pages on the left side of the editor.
Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page.
Click SEO Basics.
Click the Advanced SEO tab.
Click + Add New Tag under Meta Tags.
Add your meta tag code in the HTML Code field.
Click Apply.

Tip: Make sure to check Pinterest's guidelines on how this metadata should be written.

title: How can I apply to join the Wix Influencer Program?
content: To apply to join the Influencer Program, submit your application for partnership. Your application will be reviewed by our team and, if we feel you're a good fit, we'll be in touch.

title: How can I customize the footer of my email campaign in Wix?
content:
Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Edit next to an existing campaign or create a new one. Click the footer at the bottom of your campaign. Select the tab you want to customize.

Content:
- Enable the toggle next to each element you want to display: Show Wix branding, Show address, Show phone number, Add social links, Add a link to your site, and Invite mobile members.
- For Show Wix branding, a Wix branding banner appears at the bottom of the footer. Upgrade to an email marketing plan to remove Wix branding from emails.
- For Add social links, you can use Sharing this email or Linking to social accounts.

Design:
- Customize your footer using the design options available: Font, Font color, Icon color, and Separator color.

Click Apply.

title: How can I reset a Google Workspace user's password as an admin?
content:
Only admins can reset a Workspace user's password if the user misplaces or forgets it.

- Go to your Business Email page.
- Click the Show More icon next to the relevant business email.
- Click Manage at Google.
- Sign in to your Google Workspace account:
  - Enter your email address.
  - Click Next.
  - Enter the password.
  - Click Sign In.
- Note: If you are signed in to another Google account, click the profile image or initial at the top right and select your account.
- Click Users.
- Hover over the relevant user and click the Reset password icon.
- Optional: Toggle off Automatically generate a password, and enter a new password to manually set a new password.
- Click Reset.
- Optional: Select Click to copy password to copy the autogenerated password.
- Optional: Click Email Password, enter an email address to send the password to, and click Send.
- Click Done.

title: Can I sell physical gift cards using the Wix mobile POS?
content: Yes, it's now possible to sell physical gift cards at a Wix mobile POS.

title: How can I upload files to the Media Manager using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click the Upload Media icon. Select where you want to add the media from: Your computer: Drag and drop files into the Media Manager or click Upload from Computer, select the files you want to upload, and click Open. Your other Wix sites: Click My Wix Account, select the site folder, select the files you want to upload, and click Upload Selection. Social networks: Select the social network, click Connect, select the files you want to upload, and click Upload Selection. A URL: Click the Link icon on the left side, paste the URL link, and click Import.

title: How do I redeem my one year free domain voucher after transferring my domain to Wix?
content: As a promotional gift, you receive a one year free domain voucher with the initial purchase of selected yearly Premium or Studio site plans. You can also redeem your one year free domain voucher after transferring your domain to Wix. If you have a valid domain voucher, it is applied automatically when you select the registration extension period for the domain in your Wix account during the transfer process.

title: How do I change the currency for my Wix Events ticket sales?
content: Go to Language & Region in your site's dashboard. Click the Currency drop-down and select the relevant currency. Make sure all the other regional settings are correct, then click Save. Note: To accept payments through your site, your site's currency must match the currency in your payment provider account.

title: Can I print business card designs directly from the Wix Logo Maker Editor?
content: You can print business card designs directly from the Wix Logo Maker Editor.

title: How can I reduce the number of business email users in my Google Workspace yearly subscription?
content: These instructions are for reducing a yearly subscription only. To reduce your Google Workspace business emails on a yearly subscription, go to Business email in your Wix account. Click Manage at Google beside the relevant subscription. Sign in to your Google Workspace account. From the Admin console menu, go to Directory, then Users. Click Remove user or Delete user for the user you want to remove. Note: Depending on your Google account setup, you might need to confirm that you want to delete the user. Follow the on screen prompts to complete the process. If the user you need to delete has a Workspace Admin status, you'll need to revoke their Admin status before deleting their account. Once you have successfully completed the above, contact Wix Customer Care. We'll update our billing system so that you are only billed for the remaining business emails going forward.

title: How can I use the Site Checker in Editor X to identify and fix issues on my site?
content:
To use the Site Checker in Editor X to identify and fix issues on your site, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Access the Site Checker
* Click **Tools** at the top of Editor X.
* Select **Site Checker** to enable it.
* Click the Site Checker icon at the top of Editor X.
* Choose a tab depending on what you want to check:
  * **Page:** Scan the specific page you're editing for issues related to the design, accessibility, and more.
  * **Site:** Scan your site for potential security issues.
* Click **Check Page**.

### Step 2 | Review the detected issues
* (In the Site Checker) Hover over an issue and click the More Actions icon.
* Click **View Issue** to see it on your site.
* Fix the issue that was detected using the available options.

### Step 3 | Check your site issues again
* (In the Site Checker) Hover over the issue again.
* Click the Check Again icon.

If you want to scan the entire page again, click **Check Again** at the bottom of the Site Checker panel.

title: How can I add tax to ticket sales in Wix Events?
content: To collect tax on ticket sales in Wix Events: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Create a ticketed event and create tickets for the event. Click the Settings tab. Click Edit next to Ticket settings. Enable the Tax toggle. Enter the tax name (e.g. VAT or Sales Tax). The tax name appears on the checkout page. Enter the tax rate (e.g. 10%). Select how to add the tax: Add tax to the total sale at checkout, or Include tax in the ticket price. Use the Apply tax to pay what you want tickets toggle to enable or disable it. The "Pay what you want" ticket type allows guests to set their own ticket price. Click Save.

title: Can I create different pickup and delivery rules for my lunch and dinner menus in Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently it is not possible to create different pickup and delivery rules for different menus at your restaurant (i.e. Lunch vs. Dinner menu). When you set your pickup and delivery options, those settings apply to all menus. You can set different delivery charges and minimum order amounts for different delivery areas. You can also set a minimum order amount for pickup orders.

title: How can I share my Wix site to get feedback before publishing it?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click the Site Actions icon at the top right. Select Get Client Feedback. Enter the name or email address of each person you want to receive feedback from. Optionally, enter a message your commenters will see when they receive the invite. Click Send. Tip: You can also click Copy Link next to the Shareable link URL and send it to anyone you want to receive feedback from.

title: Can I apply customized breakpoints to all pages or multiple selected pages at once in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, in the Studio Editor, you can define breakpoints for each page of the site. It is not possible to apply customized breakpoints to all pages, or multiple selected pages at once.

title: How can I create a recurring event in Wix Events?
content: To create a recurring event in Wix Events, start by creating a template event. Add your details, such as the tour name, image, description, and location, to the template and save it. Next, select the dates when your tour is held. Once you click "Publish", each tour becomes an individual event that you can edit to reflect changes if needed. You can create new event dates from the template at any time.

title: How can I upload a video from my Video Library to the Single Video Player on my Wix site?
content:
To upload a video from your Video Library to the Single Video Player:
- Go to your editor.
- Click the Single Video Player.
- Click **Change Video**.
- Click **Change Video** to open the Media Manager.
- Double click the **Video Library** folder shortcut to open it.
- Select the video you want to use in the player and click **Upload Selection**.
- Select the video you just uploaded and click **Add to Page**.
- Choose the video's **Playback options** from the **Video Settings**:
  - **Autoplays**: Click the toggle to have the video play on mute automatically when the page loads. Visitors can turn the sound on manually if they'd like.
  - **Plays in a loop**: Click the toggle to have the video replay itself continuously.
- Set the **Video Description**: Enter a description of the video under **What's this video about?**

title: How can I allow search engines to index my PDF documents in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click the document. Click the Settings icon. Click Show this PDF in search results. Click Turn On Indexing. If you are linking an element to a document, you can also enable this option from the Link panel.

title: How can I view a client's booking history in Wix Bookings?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Contacts. Hover over the relevant client and click View, then click the Bookings tab. From there you can update the attendance and payment status. You can also access a client's booking and payment history for appointments, classes, and courses through the Booking Calendar.

title: What should I do if I encounter an error message while uploading a video from Wix Video to Facebook?
content:
If you receive an error message when uploading a video from Wix Video to Facebook, use the matching solution:

- **Facebook is experiencing an issue, try again later.**: Come back and try again later.
- **This video file is too big for Facebook, try a different file.**: Keep your video under 120 minutes and 4 GB.
- **Looks like this file is empty, upload a different file.**: Make sure your file is playable and not corrupted.
- **This video was moved or deleted during upload.**: Your file must remain in your Video Library until the uploading process is complete.
- **This file was not uploaded. Try again.**: Try uploading your video again. If the problem persists, contact support.

Also, learn more about Facebook's general uploading policies. Your video can up to 120 minutes long or 4 GB, whichever limit you hit first.

title: How can I customize the mobile view of my Wix blog feed?
content: To customize the mobile view of your blog feed, go to your editor and go to your Blog page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Blog Pages, and click your Blog page. Click the Mobile view icon at the top to switch to the mobile Editor. Click the blog feed, then click Settings. Click the Display tab and choose what info should appear in the mobile view. Click the Enable mobile settings toggle, then under What shows on your feed? select or deselect the relevant elements. You can also click Blog Menu to customize the menu for mobile, click the Show blog menu toggle to show or hide your menu on mobile, click Social Sharing to customize social options on mobile, click the Enable social sharing toggle to show or hide the social icons, click the Layout tab to change the layout of your posts and categories, and click the Design tab to change the font size.

title: How can I add and customize a horizontal menu in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a horizontal menu in the Wix Editor: click **Add** on the left side of the Editor, click **Menu & Anchor**, click **Horizontal Menus**, and drag a menu onto your page. To customize the menu design: click the menu, click the **Design** icon, then click **Customize Design** and adjust the menu with the available options. To adjust the dropdown menu's items and text, click **Dropdown Menu** from the **Customize Design** panel. You can also click the **Layouts** icon to adjust menu or dropdown menu layout settings, such as how to display items that don't fit, spacing, alignment, item padding, dropdown opening style, columns, and padding.

title: Is it possible to notify collaborators when they are removed from a site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to send your collaborators a notification when you remove them from a site.

title: How can I mirror the order of items in my CMS collection to my site's connected elements?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to CMS, or click CMS in your editor and then click Your Collections. Click the relevant collection. If you have multiple collection views, select the view at the top of your collection that you want to use to sort the items. Choose how you want to sort your items: to add a sort condition to the collection, click Sort at the top of the collection, click + Add a Sort, click the Sort by drop-down and select the field you want to sort, select the order in which you want the items to appear, then click Add Sort.
