To manually reorder items, make sure Table is selected as the layout type at the top of the collection, click the Reorder icon next to the relevant item, drag the item up or down to reorder it in the list, and repeat to finish reordering. Then click Mirror on Site at the top of the collection and enable the toggle next to Mirror item order on the site. Keep in mind that any sorts you've added to datasets will override the order you set in your mirrored collection view.

title: How can I add a site menu to my Wix website using the Wix Editor?
content:
In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Menu & Anchor, click a menu type (My Menus, Themed Menus, Horizontal Menus, Vertical Menus, In-page Menus, or Hamburger Menus), and drag your chosen menu element onto your page.

Tips: To create a floating menu, pin the menu to the desired location on the screen. You can also add Site Search from the Menu & Anchor tab. Site Search lets your visitors search for anything on your site using a search bar, and the results of the search are displayed clearly in a list.

Important: A menu should be displayed on every page of your site. If your menu is placed in the header or footer, it automatically shows on every page. If you are using a vertical menu, or a horizontal menu not in your header or footer, make sure you set it to show on all pages.

title: How can I search for a specific blog post in Wix Blog?
content: Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard. Click the search bar at the top right. Enter a keyword. Click the post you want to view.

title: I need to add funds to my Wix Payments account in order to issue a refund. Can you guide me on how to do this?
content: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Select the payment to refund. Click Refund. Enter the amount you wish to refund. (Optional) Add a note. Click Refund and confirm by clicking Yes, Refund. If you need to add funds to refund your customer: Click Add Funds & Complete Refund to add funds to your account. Enter your credit / debit card details and click Add Funds & Complete Refund.

title: How can I add the "Multiorders Etsy & eBay Sync" app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your editor. On the left side of the editor, click Add Apps. Search for the Multiorders: Wix to Etsy eBay app in the search bar. Click Add to Site.

title: How can I upload photos from Lightroom Classic to Wix Photo Albums?
content:
Important: The Wix Photo Albums app has been removed from the Wix App Market. This plugin is only available if you have already previously installed the Wix Photo Albums app on your site, before April 2024.

Step 1 | Download the Wix Photo Albums plugin
Go to Photo Albums in your site’s dashboard. Click Tools on the side bar menu. Click Download Plug-in in the Lightroom Classic section. The Wix Photo Albums plugin is downloaded to your computer as a zip file; make sure to unzip it.

Step 2 | Install the plugin in Lightroom Classic
Open Lightroom Classic. Click File at the top left. Click Plug-in manager. Click Add. Search for the unzipped plug-in file you previously downloaded and select it. Click Add Plug-in. Click Done.

Step 3 | Authorize and sync Wix Photo Albums with Lightroom Classic
Go to Publish Services in your Lightroom. Click Set Up next to Wix Photo Album. Click Authorize. Log in to your Wix account. Go back to Lightroom. Go to your Library. Right-click on the Wix Lightroom Plugin and click Edit Settings. Click Sync in the Sync section. Click Cancel to close the window. This automatically syncs all of your Wix photo albums and galleries. Create the album or gallery on Wix before uploading images from Lightroom; after you create your album (can be a draft), sync it with Lightroom in order to see it.

Step 4 | Publish your photos from Lightroom to Wix Photo Albums
Go to your Photo Album in your Lightroom. Drag the photos you want to upload to the relevant album or gallery. Click Publish on Lightroom. Once you click ‘Publish’ on Lightroom, the changes you made (add, edit or remove photos and galleries) will be applied and updated on Wix Photo Albums.

title: How can I enable advanced accessibility settings using the Accessibility Wizard on my Wix site?
content: Go to your editor. Click Settings at the top and select Accessibility Wizard. Click the More Actions icon at the top of the Accessibility Wizard panel. Select Advanced accessibility settings. Click the relevant setting, then click the toggle to enable or disable it. The available settings include Visual indicators, Skip to main content, Automatic DOM order, and Accessibility dev tools. Visual indicators shows a blue indicator around the shift in focus. Skip to main content lets keyboard users skip directly to the main content of each page. Automatic DOM order organizes your content by the visual order of elements. Accessibility dev tools exposes advanced accessibility settings such as ARIA labels and tabindex.

title: How can I unpublish my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Open your site in the Wix Editor. Select Site in the top toolbar. Click Unpublish Site. Select Unpublish in the dashboard window. Click Unpublish in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I add a new restaurant location to my Wix Restaurants site?
content: This applies to the original Restaurants Orders app. Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a Second Location next to Location & Contact Info. Enter your restaurant's address: Address (start typing your street address and select it from the drop-down list), Address description (optional), and Location Name. Enter your restaurant's contact details: Email, Phone, and Fax. (Optional) Click Edit by Business Hours to edit the opening hours for this location. Click Save. Important: Once you've entered your restaurant's address, make sure the red pin is displayed on the map. If you delete a location later, any menus and orders associated with it will also be deleted. To add additional locations, click + Add New Location and repeat steps 3-6.

title: How can I display blog posts from specific categories using dynamic pages in Wix?
content: Before you begin, make sure the Wix Blog is installed, Wix App Collections are enabled, and you have created posts and categories plus an additional dataset. Then add a dynamic page for your blog category: click CMS, click Wix App Collections, hover over Categories under Blog, click More Actions, and click Add Blank Dynamic Page. Add a repeater or table: click Add, click List, then drag and drop the repeater or table onto the page. Add and connect a second dataset: click CMS, click Add Content Elements, add a Dataset, open its Settings, select Posts from Connect a collection, add a filter, choose Categories (Categories) as the Field, set Value source to Another dataset, select Categories Item as the Dataset, and add the filter. Connect the repeater or table to the Posts dataset and link components to the appropriate fields. You can preview; if multiple posts appear on one page, use load more or pagination bar options. Note that on dynamic blog pages, visitors can't share, edit, or follow posts, and can't like blog posts.

title: Can I create a coupon that reduces the customer's cart total by a specific amount in Wix Stores?
content:
Currently, it's not possible to create coupons or automatic discounts that reduce the customer's cart total by a specific amount (e.g. Buy $200, pay $150 or buy 2 items, get $20 off your cart total).

Workaround: You can create a percentage off coupon or automatic discounts that offer a percentage off all products (e.g. buy $200 get 20% off).

title: How do I verify my Employer Identification Number (EIN) in Wix Payments?
content: To verify your Employer Identification Number (EIN) in Wix Payments: Complete your Wix Payments account setup as a Partnership / LLC / Corporation / NGO; during setup, Wix Payments asks for your company's 9 digit Employer Identification Number. Also upload a copy of your EIN confirmation notice. Ensure the company name is visible and clear and matches the business details in your Wix Payments account, and the Employer Identification Number is visible and clear. Documents must be sent in one of these formats: jpeg, jpg, pdf, png. The maximum file size is 10 MB. The minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF, 100 kB for other formats. If all details have been entered correctly, the verification process usually takes 1 working day to complete. If your EIN has not been successfully verified after this timeframe, please contact us and we'll investigate the issue.

title: How can I correctly add a Google Search Console verification meta tag to my Wix site?
content: Add the Google Search Console meta tag to the <head> section by using the Advanced SEO panel of individual pages or by embedding custom code on your site. Follow Wix's header code guidelines: only add valid HTML tags such as <meta>; do not add free text or scripts; do not add <html>, <head>, or <body>; and do not add duplicate tags for title tag, meta description, Google Analytics, Open Graph, or robots.txt. Use this correct Google Search Console format: <meta name="google-site-verification" content="Code from Google Webmaster tools"/>. When adding multiple verification meta tags, add them consecutively without spaces or commas, and make sure each tag has an opening (<) and closing (>) tag.

title: Is it possible to remove the login bar from the Booking form in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to remove the login bar from the Booking form. Note: If you don't have a Members Area on your site, the login bar doesn't appear on the booking form.

title: Can I customize the automated emails sent to customers about their orders in Wix Restaurants?
content: Yes. It's now possible to customize the confirmation emails sent to customers about their orders. This feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I add video conferencing to my event using the Wix app?
content: Important: As of March 2024, the option to connect to Wix Live is no longer available. If you already created events with Wix Live, you can continue using it in the meantime. For an existing event, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage, tap Events, select Published Events or Draft Events and tap the relevant event, tap the Manage tab, select Add-ons, and tap Add to Event under Video conferencing. Then tap Continue, select the type of event you want to set up, tap Save, and save the event. When guests sign up for your online event, they receive a unique link in their confirmation and a reminder email.

title: Why can't I submit my standalone form that includes a signature field?
content: We're aware of an issue where standalone forms are not being submitted if they have a Signature field. Meanwhile, you can use one of these workarounds: remove the Signature field in the Standalone Form, or create a website form with the Signature field by opening the Editor, creating a website form on a new page, adding an Upload and/or Signature fields, publishing your site, and sharing the web address with your site visitors. Note that adding a Signature field on a website form requires a Business Premium plan.

title: How can I change the cover image for a YouTube video on my Wix site?
content: The video's static image settings (the image which appears before your video begins to play) are determined by YouTube and cannot be changed from your Wix account. If you uploaded the video to YouTube, you can change the image from the video's Advanced settings tab in your YouTube account. Any updates to information or cover images for a video have to be done directly on YouTube.

title: How can I set up shipping options for my online store in the Fit by Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Sales. Tap Orders. Tap the Settings icon. Select Set shipping. Tap + New Region. Enter a region name. Tap + Add Destination. Tap the destination(s) you want to add to this shipping rule. Tap Save.

Then choose what you want to do: Set up free shipping (the default shipping rule; just tap Save), set up flat rate shipping, set up shipping rates by weight, set up shipping rates by price, or set up store pickup.

For flat rate shipping, shipping rates by weight, or shipping rates by price: tap Edit next to Free Shipping, tap Change next to Free Shipping, select Flat Rate / Rate by Weight / Rate by Order Price, tap Next, create a delivery option with Delivery Option Name, optional Est. Delivery Time, and the applicable Rate or ranges, then tap Save. You can optionally add an additional delivery option and a Handling Fee.

For store pickup: scroll down and tap the Store Pickup toggle to enable it. Enter a Pickup title. Select the Use my business address toggle or enter the address where customers can pick up products. Optionally enter when the product will be ready for pickup and enter pickup instructions for your customer. Tap Save. Tap Save again.

title: Can I add tags to orders in Wix Stores?
content: Yes. The source states that it's now possible to assign tags to orders so you can group them by type. This feature request is relevant for Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

title: how to see my website ip address
content: Use whatsmydns.net to perform a DNS lookup: go to whatsmydns.net, enter your domain name without the www. prefix (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com) in the search field, select A from the drop-down menu, and click Search. Next to each server location, you should see your domain IP address. You can compare the search results to the records in your domain host's account to ensure they are the same. To find your records in your Wix account, go to the Domains page in your Wix account, click the Show More icon, and click Manage DNS records.

title: How can I customize the Thank You Page in Wix Bookings using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to your Thank You Page by clicking Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, then click Bookings Pages. If you also have Wix Stores, access the Thank You Page by clicking Cart & Thank You. Click the Thank You Page. Click the Thank You Page element on your page, then click Settings. Set up the Thank You Page using these options: Settings — deselect the checkboxes next to any elements you don't want to display; Design — customize the Thank You Page background and borders, as well as the text fonts and colors; Text — edit the text that appears on the Thank You Page, including General Text (edit the title, subtitle, and various labels), Order with Subscription (edit the title, subtitle, and subscription label that appear when customers purchase a subscription), and Link (edit the Continue Browsing link text and choose where the link takes visitors).

title: How can I change the loop setting on my video background in Wix Editor?
content: To change the loop setting on your video background, go to the relevant page in your Editor. Click Site Design on the left side of the Editor. Hover over Page Background and click Customize. Click Settings on the video background preview. Click the Play in a loop toggle to enable or disable looping: Enabled means the video background plays on repeat; Disabled means it plays once on loading. Note: Video backgrounds are set to play in a loop by default. Important: Your video background will automatically be set to not play on the mobile version of your site. To enable it, or select another video background, reselect the video in the mobile Editor.

title: Can I change a collection item's visibility status from the Wix app?
content: Yes. You can now change a collection item's visibility status from the Wix app.

title: How can I set pinned actions for a contact in Wix Contacts?
content: To set pinned actions in Wix Contacts: go to Contacts in your site's dashboard; click the contact you want to manage to open the contact panel; click the More Actions icon; click Set pinned actions; click the checkboxes to select the actions you want to pin; click Save. You can pin a maximum of 3 actions per contact.

title: How can I transfer a domain purchased from Wix to a different Wix account?
content: In your Wix account, go to Domains. Next to the relevant domain, click the Domain Actions icon, then click Transfer to a different Wix account. Enter the email address and password of the Wix account where you're transferring the domain, and click Transfer Domain. In the new Wix account, extend the domain's registration to prevent it from expiring and update the domain registrant information if necessary.

title: How can I close pop-up notifications in the Wix Editor?
content: You can close pop-up notifications in the editor by clicking the Close icon.

title: Can I sell gift cards using the Wix Mobile POS?
content: It's still not possible to sell gift cards at a Mobile POS. You can vote for that option.

title: How can I add a single service calendar to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To add a single service calendar: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Bookings. Click Calendar. Drag the calendar widget onto your page.

title: How can I access my Bing Ads voucher through my Wix account?
content:
To access your Bing Ads voucher through your Wix account:

1. Go to Vouchers in your Wix account.
2. Scroll down to find your voucher under Bing Ads.
3. Click Claim Voucher.

   Note: This button now reads 'Go to Bing' and the word 'claimed' appears above it.
4. Click Go to Bing and follow instructions there.

The voucher is available 48 hours after purchase of one of the Premium plans, and valid for 2 months from the date of purchase.

title: How do I connect my GoDaddy domain to Wix by updating the name servers?
content:
To connect a GoDaddy domain to Wix by updating name servers, first upgrade your Wix site. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click Add an Existing Domain, click Connect a domain you already own, select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Next, enter your domain name and click Let's Go, click Yes, I own this domain under the search field, review the info about updating your name servers, and click Start.

Then update the name servers in your GoDaddy account while keeping the Wix account page open. Log into your GoDaddy account, return to the Wix domains page, and click I logged in. In GoDaddy, click your profile at the top right and select My Products, find your domain and go to the settings panel, click DNS to the right of your domain, return to the Wix domains page and click I found my domain settings. In your GoDaddy DNS settings, click Change in the name servers section, select Enter my own name servers (advanced), return to the Wix domains page and click I found the name servers. In the Enter My Own Name servers section, replace your name servers with the Wix name servers provided on the Wix domains page, then click I've replaced my name servers. It may take up to 48 hours for the name servers changes to propagate worldwide. If you're having trouble updating your name servers, you can contact your domain host (GoDaddy) for assistance.

title: Can I translate Wix Invoices using Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Invoices with Wix Multilingual. For more details on what content can be translated, see the list of Translatable Content in Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I set up free delivery for orders over a specific price using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: To offer free delivery over a specific minimum price in the original Restaurants Orders app, create 2 separate delivery areas for the same location: 1 with the regular delivery price for that area, and another with a minimum order fee and free delivery. Set up your first delivery area following Wix's instructions; you may have already done this. Then add another delivery area: click + New Area at the top right of the Delivery tab, enter a name for this area (e.g., Delivery - Free), enter the minimum order amount you require for free delivery, and make sure the delivery charge is set to 0. You can also use this method to set different delivery charges based on order price, for example: for orders over $30, free delivery; for orders between $15 and $30, $3 delivery charge; for orders under $15, $5 delivery charge. Create delivery areas for the same geographical area, one for each type of delivery charge.

title: How can I display my site colors in the Google Event Calendar app?
content: In your Editor, click the Google Event Calendar app, then click Settings. Click the Design tab, click Events, scroll down to Event Colors, and select Use site theme colors. Optionally, click the color boxes next to the relevant calendars to adjust the colors. This lets each calendar display a different color from your main site colors.

title: Can I offer advanced customization options for products in Wix Stores?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to offer customers advanced customization options for Wix Stores products. You can, however, use product options to create multiple variations of your product. For example, if you make different sized picture frames, you can create two product options:

- Size product option: Small, medium, and large
- Wood product option: Oak, pine, and walnut

On checkout, customers can choose the size and type of wood to get the option they want. Note that you can add up to 6 types of product options to a product (e.g. size, material, style, etc.) and up to 30 option choices (e.g. small, large; oak, pine) to allow for many customizations.

Tip: You can also add a message box so customers can add custom text.

title: How can I display different pricing plans using tabs on my website?
content:
To display different pricing plans using tabs, start by adding the tabs element to the relevant page on your site. Click Add Elements on the left of the Editor, click Interactive, click Tabs under Boxes, then click and drag your chosen tab design to add it to your page.

Next, name your tabs: click the tabs element in your Editor, click Manage Tabs, hover over the relevant item in the panel, click the More Actions icon, click Rename, enter the new name into the field, and click Done. Repeat steps 3-7 for each tab you display.

Then add pricing plans elements to your tab items: click the tabs element in your Editor, open the relevant tab item from the drop-down, click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Payments, click either Plan List or Single Plan under Pricing Plans, drag the relevant element onto the tab, and drop the element when you see the Attach to Tab message. Repeat steps 2-7 for each tab.

Finally, choose what plans to display in each tab: click the tabs element in your Editor, select the first tab from the drop-down, click to select the pricing plans element you added, and choose which plans to display depending on which pricing plans widget you chose for each tab. For Plan List, click the Plan List widget in the tab, click Settings, click Plans, and select the checkbox next to each plan you want to display in the selected tab. For Single Plan, click the Single Plan widget in the tab, click Settings, click the drop-down and select the plan you want to display.

title: How can I limit access to specific screens in my branded app based on member badges or pricing plans?
content:
To limit access to specific screens in your branded app based on member badges or pricing plans:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Mobile App**.
- Tap **Edit** under your site name or the name of your branded app.
- Tap **Screens** at the bottom.
- Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the screen you want to limit access to.
- Tap **Set Screen Permissions**.
- Select which app members can access this screen's content:
  - **All Members:** All members of your branded app can see the content.
  - **Members with Badges:** Only members who have received a specific badge (e.g. 'VIP badge') can see the content. Select an existing badge or tap **Create New Badge** to add a new badge to limit access.
  - **Members with Pricing Plans:** Only members who have purchased a pricing plan can see the content. Select an existing pricing plan or tap **Create New Plan** to create a new pricing plan to limit access.

Members who do not have permission to view a screen must tap **Request Permission**. You receive an Inbox notification about their request.

title: How can I create a ticketed event using the Wix app?
content:
To create a ticketed event using the Wix app:

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
- Tap **Events**.
- Tap **+ Create New Event**.
- Tap **Start from scratch**.
- Tap **Sell Tickets**.
- Tap **Add Event Image** and take or upload an image, then tap **Next**.
- Enter the name of the event.
- (Optional) Enter a short teaser to describe the event.
- Tap the **Date & Time** toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, set up a single or recurring event using **Start Date** and **Start Time** or create a recurring event template. If disabled, edit the **TBD Message** field.
- Tap the **Location** toggle. If enabled, select whether the location is physical or online, and enter the event address or online location title. If disabled, edit the **TBD Message** field.
- Tap **Add Category**, select existing categories or enter the name of a new category, and tap **Done**.
- Tap **Add Description**, enter your text, and tap **Done**.
- Tap **Next** at the top right.
- Select a save option: **Save as draft** or **Publish**.

Once the event is created, you can start creating tickets for it using the Wix app.

title: Can I access the abandoned cart of site members in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it's possible to access and share the contents of an abandoned cart only if the customer isn't a site member. Assessing a site member's abandoned cart isn't supported.

title: How can I create a one-page site with sections using ADI?
content: A one-page site is a single page that is split into sections. As you scroll down the page, you can view the different sections. To customize your one-page site, edit and change the page sections to suit your needs. On one-page sites, the site menu displays the names of the sections. This allows your visitors to easily access the different sections of your page. Note: If you have Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Members Area or the Wix Blog on your site, you always have more than one page.

title: Is chat support available in Japanese?
content: Chat services are not available in Japanese. We offer callback services in Japanese.

title: How can I ensure my Wix subscriptions remain active under the new RBI regulations?
content: To ensure your subscriptions remain active under the new RBI regulations, you’ll need to resubmit your payment method, or add a new one, through your Premium Subscriptions page. Payments for Wix services using INR will now be made according to e-mandates, which is an instruction to your bank that enables recurring payments. An e-mandate will be created for a maximum amount of INR 15,000, but you'll only be charged for the amount of your purchase. For any purchases over this max limit, Indian banks are required to conduct Additional Factor Authentication (AFA).

title: Does Wix support proxied DNS records for domain connections with Cloudflare?
content: Currently, Wix does not support proxied DNS records for domain connections. With Cloudflare, DNS records are proxied by default. As a workaround, you can ask Cloudflare to disable any active proxies or record masking for your domain. Wix uses a CDN (Content Delivery Network) server, which is an interconnected system of cache servers in different geographical locations. Web content is delivered from the closest cache server, allowing your site to load faster. When a visitor reaches any page of your site, the entire site loads at once. This allows your visitors to move seamlessly from page to page, without experiencing additional loading time.

title: How can I add a button to a blog post in Wix?
content:
Go to your blog in your dashboard. Open the relevant post. Click the Add icon in the panel on the left. Click Button. Click the Settings icon and customize your button:
- Button text: Enter the text that is displayed on your button.
- Link: Enter the destination for the button.
- Link opens in a new tab: Select the checkbox to open the button link in a new tab on the browser.
- Tell Google to ignore this link (nofollow): Select the checkbox to prevent the link showing up in SEO results.
Click Save. Click the Design tab to change the design of your button:
- Border: Drag the sliders to change the width and corners of the border around the button.
- Button colors: Click the colors to choose the color for the text, background and border of your button.
Click Save.

title: Can I change the order in which elements load on my site or enable specific elements to be pre-loaded?
content: Currently, it is not possible to change the order in which elements load on your site, or enable specific elements to be pre-loaded. Site elements automatically load based on their weight and resolution. For example, static or low-resolution elements load faster than high-resolution or interactive elements.

title: Can I send emails from multiple email addresses using the Email Marketing feature?
content: Yes, you can add multiple email addresses to your account and assign and use them for different email campaigns, as well as triggered and automated emails. To add a new sender: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Senders on the right. Click + Add Another Sender and add your new sender details.

title: Can I use a third-party app subscription to upgrade an app on my Wix site?
content: It is not possible to use a subscription created outside of Wix with a third-party to upgrade an app from the Wix App Market. For example, if you have an account with 123 Contact Forms that you created outside of Wix, you cannot use that account to upgrade the 123 Contact Forms app on your Wix site. We suggest you contact the third-party app provider directly to see if they can provide assistance.

title: How can I sell products on my Wix site?
content: Use Wix Stores, which provides the tools to create an online store and sell physical or digital products. You can add Wix Stores to a template, add products to your store, customize your storefront, accept secure online payments, set up shipping, local delivery, and pickup, manage orders and inventory, and sell through multiple sales channels. You can also expand your product list by connecting to a dropshipping or print-on-demand service.

title: How can I cancel a recurring donation in Wix Donations?
content: Go to the Subscriptions tab in your site's dashboard. Select the subscription (recurring donation) you want to update. Click Manage Subscription. Click Cancel subscription. Select Cancel now. Click Yes, Cancel. Your donor will receive an email letting them know about the change.

title: Can I charge guests a fee for last-minute cancellations or no-shows with Wix Table Reservations?
content: Currently, it is not possible to charge guests a fee for last-minute cancellations or no-shows with Wix Table Reservations. You can set up prepayment rules to reduce last-minute cancellations and no-shows by collecting payment upfront.

title: How can I change the og:image for an individual page on my Wix site?
content: Click Pages & Menu on the left Editor menu, click the relevant page, click More Actions, select Social share, click Upload Image, select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one, click Add to Page, and publish your site. You can also set the page's og:title and og:description from the Social share settings.

title: Can I create limited time offer promotions with a countdown clock using Wix Promos?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create limited time offer promotions, for example with a countdown clock, using Wix Promos. As a workaround, you can add the Wix Countdown Clock app to your site and create a countdown timer to promote product sales etc.

title: Can I create templates from email campaigns I've previously designed?
content: Yes. You can now create templates from email campaigns you've previously designed. Learn more about saving and reusing email designs.

title: AI适用性评估的最终结论如何给出？
content: 先按 references/boundaries.md 找到对应领域章节，并逐条核对边界条件（数据充足性、工具可用性、风险/回报）。若某条边界条件适用，明确回答否，并指出该条要求的具体前置条件；若无边界条件适用，回答是，并补充该章节隐含的注意点；若问题跨多领域，则按各领域分别判定，并说明每个部分由哪一章的边界条件决定。任一条件不满足时，在前置条件满足前不应回答是。

title: How can I connect Lyra Collect as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Lyra Collect as a payment provider on your Wix site: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Tip: Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers, then click Connect next to Lyra Collect. If you have an account, enter your Shop ID and Key and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Lyra Collect account, fill in the sign up form and proceed with your Lyra account verification. Once the Lyra Collect account is approved, sign in to retrieve your account credentials (Shop ID and Key), return to this window, and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

title: How can I request a new input element for Wix Forms, such as a scale field or grid field?
content: To request an additional input element for Wix Forms, vote for an existing feature request. Click an existing feature request to read more about the field and vote for it. The listed feature requests apply to both Wix Forms fields and input elements and include: a scale field; a grid field; a picture selection/thumbnail option; an email validation field; an automatic 'Other' option in radio buttons and checkboxes; Drag & Drop for file uploads; and a custom error messages option.

title: How can I adjust the layout of my Weekly Timetable in Wix Bookings to better suit my clients' needs?
content: Click the Weekly Timetable element in your Editor, click Settings, and click the Layout tab. Then choose what you want to adjust: use the available formatting options to adjust the alignment of the header and slot text, and use the sliders to adjust the amount of padding between elements in the Weekly Timetable.

title: How do I get access to a Partner Success Manager in Wix Studio?
content: Partner Success Managers are available to select partners in the Wix Partner Program. Reaching the Icon level is required, and Wix also considers factors such as business activity and overall engagement with the Wix Partner Program. If you are eligible, a Partner Success Manager will be assigned to you and will reach out to get things started. Once they do, you’ll see their contact information in the Help widget in your Wix Studio workspace. If you don't have an assigned Success Manager yet, wait for them to reach out to you.

title: I'm using the Wix website editor and I'm experiencing free space on the edges of my site on larger screens. Why is this happening and how can I correct it?
content: This occurs when you have elements that are placed outside the vertical gridlines. Full-width elements such as strips and lines do not create horizontal scrollbars, so use full-width elements whenever possible, or use the stretch feature when available. To remove the horizontal scroll bars and spaces, use the Layers panel to identify the elements on your page that have a horizontal scrollbar. Look for elements that are not stretched to full-width, have a width bigger than 980px, or are placed at the edge of your Editor screen or going off the screen. If the element does not have Stretch enabled, enable it. If the element does not have the Stretch option available, add a strip and place the element inside the strip. If you have images placed outside the gridlines, add them as a strip background instead. If you stretched a gallery to full-width manually, change it to a full-width gallery.

title: How can I add images, GIFs, or videos to a product in the Wix app?
content:
To add media to a product in the Wix app, edit an existing product or create a new one, then tap Add Product media and choose what you want to do next.

Take a photo: tap All Media, tap the Device tab, select Camera, take the picture and tap the Checkmark icon, tap Next, and optionally tap the Plus icon to take an additional photo.

Upload media: you can upload images, GIFs, or videos from various sources, including your site media, your phone's gallery, or Instagram images. Tap All Media or My Boards, tap to select an image, GIF, or video, then tap Next.

Tip: You can use the Wix app's image editing tools to add filters, adjust brightness, focus, and saturation, apply text and more.

title: How can I add an ads.txt file to my Wix Blog?
content:
Go to the Marketing Integrations tab in your dashboard. Scroll down to Ads.txt and click Connect. Click Add ads.txt File near the top of the page. Paste your list of sellers and publisher IDs. Click Save.

Tip: You can view the ads.txt file by visiting your site and adding "/ads.txt" to the end of the URL. For example: https://www.mystunningwebsite.com/ads.txt

title: How can I add products to a category in Wix ADI?
content: Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant category. Click Add Products. Select the products you want to add. Click Add. Click Save.

title: How can I customize my Wix site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: With the Wix app, you can customize your site directly from your mobile device to keep it up-to-date. Add your brand colors, logo, and media to keep your content fresh and appealing. You can also use your site's dashboard or the Wix app to refine how your site appears on the member app, ensuring a seamless experience for your members.

title: How can I add a custom element to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add a custom element to your Wix site using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Embed Code**.
- Click the Custom Element to add it to your page.
- Click **Choose Source**.
- Select **Server URL** and enter the URL, including the file name.
  **Note:** If you are using Velo, you can click **Velo File**.
- Enter the **Tag Name**.

**Note:** All elements must be defined in the custom elements registry for the page. The tag name is the name used when registering the element. You can find the tag name in the `customElements.define()` line in the JavaScript file.

title: Can customers pre-order products in the Branded App?
content: Currently in the Branded App, your app members cannot pre-order a product or service. They can only pay for a product once it is available for purchase in your online store.

title: How can I handle unused JavaScript files on my Wix site as suggested by Google PageSpeed Insights?
content: When Google PageSpeed Insights suggests removing unused JavaScript files, some of these files are a vital part of your Wix site. Code packaged by Wix is crucial to the site's structure, and these files cannot be modified, manipulated, or deleted. Other unused JavaScript may come from third-party code that is not optimized. Identify these files and review whether they are necessary; if they are not, remove them or replace them with an optimized alternative. When you add apps and components to a page, JavaScript files are automatically added for them. Because this can affect loading speed, it is recommended to space apps and components between different site pages where possible.

title: Can I download videos directly from my Wix Video Library?
content: Currently, it is not possible to download videos directly from your video library. In the meantime, you can allow download on the video you want to download, then go to your live site and download it. If the video you want to download is for sale, you can add it to a hidden page to prevent your visitors from downloading it for free. To access your hidden page: click the Pages Menu from the top bar of your Editor; click the relevant page; click the Show More icon; click Page SEO; click Go to URL.

title: How can I add an event to my restaurant's business hours using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: Go to Business Info in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Business Hours section and click Edit next to the hours. Click + New Event. Click the Event Name field and enter the name of the event. Click the Availability drop-down and choose Available or Unavailable. Set the event's Start Time and End Time from the relevant fields. Click Apply, then click Save.

title: How can I prevent unwanted gaps and horizontal scroll bars in Editor X?
content:
Step 1 | Find elements to re-position in the Layers panel
Click Layers at the top of Editor X. Click on any element to find it on the page. Re-position the element by dragging and dropping it, using the handles to decrease its size, or adjusting margins or resizing it from the Inspector panel.

Step 2 | Check the edges of your page
Click each section and hover over all of the elements close to the edges of the page. If any of them are overflowing, move or resize them.

Step 3 | Change the page's Overflow Content setting
Select your page: go to the relevant page, click Layers at the top of Editor X, and click Page. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X. Click the Layout tab. Select Hide from the Overflow content drop-down.

Step 4 | Check the section's height
Select the relevant section. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X. Click the Layout tab. Check the Height and Min H settings under Size.

title: How can I ensure my newly connected domain appears in search engine results instead of my free Wix URL?
content: When you upgrade your site and connect your own domain, Wix automatically redirects any traffic going to your free Wix URL to your connected domain instead. The next time search engines crawl your site, they detect your newly connected domain, which prompts them to update their index for search results. This process can take time, and your free Wix URL may appear in search results until the search engines recrawl your site. To speed up the recrawling process, you can prompt search engines to crawl your site by submitting your site's sitemap directly to them. You can use the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, or manually submit your sitemap yourself. If you've already previously submitted your sitemap, you can try to speed up the crawling process by submitting your homepage's URL to search engines.

title: What should I do if my Wix domain payment fails and I want to update my payment method?
content: In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions. Under the relevant domain, click Update Payment Method. Update your credit card details, then click Submit. To reinstate your domain and ensure ownership, update your payment details as soon as possible. If payment is not made during the Grace Period, your domain enters the Redemption Period, and you'll need to pay a redemption fee to retrieve your domain.

title: How can I restore my site to search engine results after it was removed?
content:
Restoring your site to search engine results after it was removed involves:

Step 1 | Resolve any issues with your site
Search engines usually let you know what issues exist on your site. For example, Google gives you a Manual Actions report in Google Search Console that details the issues with your site. Follow any advice from search engines to make sure your site is compliant with their quality guidelines before you request a review.

Step 2 | Request a review of your site
After you've removed any black hat SEO optimization and resolved any other issues, you can request a reconsideration review. These reviews can take several days or weeks to complete, and the search engine will notify you when it's done.

Step 3 | Add original content to help improve your site's ranking
Regularly add original content to your site. The rank of your page depends on the quality of your content and how relevant it is to certain keywords. Use your keywords and search phrases organically throughout your content. Ways to create high-quality content that organically uses your keywords include:
- Describe the main purpose of your site in different ways with a variety of keywords
- Go into as much detail as you can about what you do, what services or products you offer, and what your users can get from your site
- Write content that answers popular questions related to your keywords
- Create a blog for news updates and new trends
- Make an FAQs page to help customers with common questions
- Add a testimonials page for customer reviews

title: Can I add a nested list type property to the widget API in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, you can add a list type property to the widget API. However, it is not possible to add a "list in list", or nested list, type of property.

title: How can I enable tipping on Wix Mobile POS?
content: To enable tipping on Wix Mobile POS: go to your site in the Wix app; tap Manage at the bottom; scroll down to the Get Paid section and tap Point of Sale; tap the More Actions icon at the top right; tap POS settings; select Tips; tap the Collect tips toggle to enable it. Optionally, change the preset tip percentages by tapping the tip option you want to update and entering a new percentage. Optionally, tap the Allow a custom tip amount toggle to enable it. Tap Save. Note: To collect tips, Wix Payments must be your payment provider. It is not possible to collect tips for cash payment or when processing split payments. Tips are available with Wix Stores, Wix Booking, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New). If POS settings are not displayed, add Wix Stores to your site and make sure to hide store pages from your live site.

title: How can I manage DoorDash Drive orders using the Wix app?
content:
In the Wix app, go to your site. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Sales. Tap Restaurant Orders (New).

To accept an order:
- Tap Accept on an order marked with the DoorDash badge.
- Enter a delivery time: for delivery times under 2 hours, enter the arrival time in minutes; for delivery times over 2 hours, enter the courier's arrival time in hours.
- Tap Submit.

To manage an order:
- Tap the More Actions icon on a DoorDash order and choose what you want to do:
  - View order details
  - Print order
  - Track with DoorDash
  - Cancel order

Note: You may be charged a delivery fee.

title: How can I sync my sandbox collection to my live collection in the CMS?
content: Access your sandbox collection through your editor. The sandbox collection is a test collection, and working on it won't change your live site. When you're ready, transfer the content from your sandbox collection to your live collection. If your live collection already has content, you have the option to replace it with the content from your sandbox collection.

title: How can I update my mobile menu in the Wix Editor?
content:
To update your mobile menu in the Wix Editor:
- Go to the mobile Editor.
- Click your mobile menu.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Click Update now.
- Click Get it Now.

Tip: Once you've updated your mobile menu, you can begin customizing it to suit you and your site's needs.

title: How can I edit the SEO settings for a blog post using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Blog. Tap Posts. Tap the More Actions icon beside the relevant post. Tap Post Settings. Tap the SEO tab at the top right. Edit your SEO settings. Tap Next. Choose an option: tap Save Changes, or tap Publish Post.

title: How can I troubleshoot if my Wix automation is not triggering?
content: Check the automation summary by going to Automations in your site's dashboard, clicking the relevant automation, and viewing the statistics information in the panel on the right. Check that the right trigger app and filter were set: hover over the automation, click the More Actions icon, click Edit, check the selected trigger, make any updates necessary, and click Save. Check the timing: click Edit, open the Timing drop-down, check the timing under Choose a time to send this action, update if necessary, and click Save. Check the frequency: click Edit, open the Timing drop-down, check whether Once per contact is selected under Limit frequency to, update if necessary, and click Save. Also note that automations don't run retroactively; an automation only runs for triggers that happen when the automation is active.

title: How can I auto-translate my entire Wix site to a new language?
content: Go to the Translation Manager in your site's dashboard. Click Machine Translation. Click Auto-translate Site. Review each page of your site and edit the translations if needed. If the newly added language is still hidden, publish your translations: click the Language drop-down under your language and select Manage Languages; click Hidden next to the relevant language in the status column and select Visible. Tip: Some elements take longer to be auto-translated. We recommend waiting a few minutes and refreshing the page if you can't see the translation.

title: How do I set up additional Google Workspace business emails for different departments from my Wix account?
content: First purchase additional business emails. Then go to Business Email in your account. Click Show User Info on the relevant account. Click the More Actions icon next to the account you want to set up. Select Set Up User. Sign in to your Google Workspace account: enter your email address, click Next, enter your password. Click Users. Click Add new user. Enter the user details and set a password (optional). Click Add. It can take up to 24 hours for Google Workspace services to be available to the new user. There is a limit of 300 business emails, and a limit of 20 emails purchased per transaction.

title: Does Wix support FTP service for file transfers?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer an FTP (File Transfer Protocol) service, like Filezilla. However, Wix offers some transfer / import options when uploading media to your site in bulk: Uploading Media to the Media Manager, Importing Media Files from Social Networks, Importing Media from Your Wix Sites, and Importing Media Files Using a URL. If you are using Velo by Wix, the Fetch-API can integrate third-party FTP solutions with your Wix site. You can also upload files and make them available to your members using the Wix Fileshare app.

title: How do I verify my Wix Payments account as a sole proprietor in the United Kingdom?
content: The verification process begins once you've accepted the first successful payment to your Wix Payments account. As a sole proprietor in the United Kingdom, verify your Wix Payments account by making sure your personal and company information is correct: your first / middle / last name and your date of birth must match those listed in your photo ID; double check that you've entered your bank account number(s) correctly; submit a business bank account; your company's name and its Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) number must match the company's registered information; and your Doing Business As name should match what appears on your customers' statements. Enter a physical address to verify your account; PO Boxes are not accepted as a valid address. Upload an address verification document, such as a utility bill, that was issued within the last 6 months. Upload a document that proves the validity and ownership of the UTR during registration. Add your Business Description by using the dropdown menu to select your Business Type and using the text box to add a short description of your products / services. Upload a color copy of your photo ID and bank statement to verify your identity. Allow 7 business days for the account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've verified the information is correct and matches your bank account details, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: Is the Wix Mobile POS feature for connecting to Wix Bookings available in countries outside the US and Canada?
content: No. This feature is available only for Wix Bookings users in the US and Canada.

title: How can I customize the display image for my Wix Forum posts when sharing on social media?
content:
To customize the display image for your Wix Forum posts when sharing on social media:
- Go to Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click Website Settings.
- Scroll down to General social image.
- Click Upload Image.
- Note: Click Update Image if you want to replace the existing social image.
- Select an image or click Upload Media to upload a new one.
- Click Choose File.

title: How can I assign categories to a new blog post using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom right. Tap Blog. Tap Posts. Tap the relevant post. Tap the Show More icon next to the relevant post. Select Post Settings. Tap the Categories tab. Select up to 10 categories or tap Create New Category to create a new one. Tap Next. Select Save Changes to save your changes in draft form, or Publish Post to publish your post with the updated categories.

title: How can I add and set up a text and icon button in the Wix Editor?
content:
Step 1 | Add your button
- Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
- Click **Button**.
- Click **Text & Icon Buttons**.
- Click or drag your chosen button to add it to the page.

Step 2 | Set up your button
- Click the button in your Editor.
- Click **Change Text & Icon**.
- Select an option under **What does the button show?**: **Text and icon** (both text and an icon are shown), **Icon only** (the button only displays an icon), **Text only** (the button only displays text), or **Nothing** (the button is blank).
- Change the button settings using the available options:
  - **What does it say?**: Enter your chosen button text into the field.
  - **Choose icon**: Choose what kind of icon you want to use: click **Media from Wix** to choose from a variety of free icons offered by Wix, or click **+ Upload Media** to upload and use your own vector art files.
  - **What's the alt text?**: Add a description of the button so it's accessible to visitors using assistive technologies.

Step 3 | Add a link to your button
- Select the button.
- Click the **Link** icon.
- Select a link type from the list.
- Enter or upload the relevant link destination.
- Click **Done**.

Did you know? You can also set up your button link from the **Change Text & Icon** panel.

title: How can I enable invoices for pricing plan purchases in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog. Tap Settings at the top. Enable the Invoices toggle to send invoices to clients who purchase plans. Once enabled, clients receive an invoice with each purchase. For recurring orders, an invoice is sent each payment cycle. Invoices are not sent when you manually add a client to a plan. Most customizations to your invoices can only be made on desktop.

title: How can I add a category to my videos in Wix Video?
content: To add a category to Wix Videos: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Click the Edit icon on the relevant video. Enter the category under Categories. Press Enter on the keyboard.

title: How can I enable Wix Point of Sale (POS) for my Wix Payments account?
content: Wix POS is currently only available to Canadian and U.S.-based Wix merchants who are using Wix Stores, Wix Bookings or Wix Events. You also need a fully verified Wix Payments merchant account. To enable Wix POS, go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Connect next to Wix Payments, or click Manage if you already have a Wix Payments account. Click Accept, or enable the toggle next to Wix Point of Sale. If you’re in the United States or Canada and don’t see the Point of Sale option, contact Customer Care. If required, complete verification as necessary; you can track your verification status from your Wix Payments dashboard. Click Order Hardware under Point of Sale.

title: How do I add a collection to store my content in Editor X's CMS?
content:
Click Create Collection. Enter a name for your collection. Then select an option to choose how many items you want in the collection:

* Multiple items (Default): Manage multiple pages or lists of items with the same layout like projects or services. You can store large amounts of content in this type of collection that is suited for dynamic pages.
* A single item: Manage content for static pages and sections like a homepage or a promotional banner. This type of collection is best suited for static pages because it has just one block of content.

Click Create. Add your fields to the collection manually or import a CSV file.

Next, learn how to set your collection permissions and privacy to control the type of content you store and who can view and edit it, sort and filter your view in the collection, and create a custom view of your collection to switch between different sorts, filters, and visible fields.

title: Can automated emails be translated with Wix Multilingual?
content: Yes. You can now translate automated emails with Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I add an element to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: In the Studio Editor, click Add Elements on the left side, click the element category, click the relevant subcategory, then click an element or drag it onto the page.

title: Can I add an image to my footer using Wix ADI?
content: It is currently not possible to add an image to your footer in ADI. To give your website a sleek and professional look, the footer does not contain any images. If you want to add an image to your footer, head to the Editor.

title: How can I access my Google Workspace business email purchased through Wix?
content: Go to your Business Email page. Click Go to Gmail. If you're already signed in to your Google account, you are automatically taken to your inbox. Sign in to your business email: Click Next. Enter your password. Click Sign In. If you are signed in to another Google account, click the profile image or initial at the top right and select your account. You can also sign into your business email directly through Gmail.com. Simply enter your Google Workspace email address, including @mydomain.com, and your password.

title: Can I create dynamic text hyperlinks by linking characters in text elements to URL fields in CMS collections?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to create text hyperlinks by linking characters in text elements to URL fields in CMS collections. If you connect a text element to a URL field, the text displays the URL itself rather than linking to the URL.

Workaround: You can connect buttons to URL fields in collections to create dynamic links.

title: What happens if I issue a chargeback for a Wix Premium plan payment, and how can I restore the features?
content:
If you perform a chargeback for a payment made for your Premium plan, your plan is canceled. When a Premium plan is canceled:

* Your domain is disconnected from your site
* Your site displays Wix ads
* Your site's storage and bandwidth is limited
* Any other Premium features that come with your plan (e.g. Wix Stores) are removed

### Want to restore these features?
You must purchase a new Premium plan with a different payment card.

title: How can I add and set up a Members Area on my Wix site if I don't have it installed?
content: Some Wix apps like Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Forum automatically add the Members Area to your site. If you don't have the app installed, you can learn how to add and set it up.

title: What should I do if Google Search Console shows a 'Crawl Anomaly' for an API resource on my site?
content: If Google Search Console shows an API resource from your site as a crawled URL with a 'Crawl Anomaly', it means Google accessed it in an unusual manner. The API resource is related to the structure and functionality of your site, and after trying to crawl it Google determined there is nothing to gain from retrieving it. A crawl anomaly does not affect your site's SEO, so you can ignore this message. Members Only pages and password protected pages can cause this error because they return a 403 when Google tries to crawl them.

title: How can I enable cookies in Google Chrome to log in to my Wix account?
content: Click the More icon at the top right of the browser. Select Settings. Click Privacy and security. Click Cookies and other site data. Select Allow all cookies. If you're using Database Collections, make sure Block third-party cookies is disabled.

title: Can I add a 3D model directly from the Add Elements panel in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a 3D element or model from the Add Elements panel. As an alternative, you can add a HTML iFrame to the page, and embed external code to display a 3D model / element.

title: How can I add a new page to my site using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, open the Pages panel at the top, click + Add New Page at the bottom, choose a page type, enter the page name, and press Enter. Page types include Page (a standard blank page), Member's Page (visible only to your site members), and Dynamic Page (content changes while keeping the same design and layout, and connected elements change according to the Content Collection item being viewed). New pages are automatically displayed on your site's main menu. Some apps add pages to your site automatically, and pages are divided into categories in the Pages panel.

title: How can I add a business email to my Wix site plan?
content: Wix Premium or Studio plans do not include a business email account. Business emails must be purchased separately. You can purchase a personalized business email from Google Workspace through Wix.

title: What do I need to connect my own domain to a Wix site?
content:
To connect your own domain, you need to purchase the following:

* **A domain:** This can be purchased from Wix or from another domain host.
* **A Wix site plan:** A Premium or Studio site plan allows you to connect your own domain.

With selected Premium and Studio site plans, you are eligible to receive a voucher for a free domain for one year.

title: How can I set my business site in the Wix Studio app?
content:
To set your business site in the Wix Studio app:

- Go to your relevant workspace in the Studio app.
- Tap Account at the bottom.
- Tap Set Site next to Your business website.
- Tap the relevant site or enter the name of the site in the search bar.
- Tap Set Site.
- Tap Got it.

title: How can I set up notifications for unhandled orders in Wix Restaurants?
content:
Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard. Click the Notifications tab. Click + New Alert under Unhandled Orders. Select an alert method from the drop-down list and enter the relevant information. Enter a number of minutes in the After field. Select Minutes, Hours or Days from the drop-down list. Click Save.

Tip: To temporarily disable a notification method, deselect the toggle next to that method.

title: How can I display a single photo album on my Wix site using a clickable image?
content: Wix Photo Albums automatically displays all of your albums together; currently, there is no layout for displaying an individual album within the app. To showcase an individual album, create a clickable image that drives visitors to the album. Each photo album exists as its own site, so retrieve that site's URL. Step 1: In the Editor, click Photo Albums and then click Manage Albums. Click the More Actions icon next to the album you want to display and click View Album. The album site opens in a new tab; copy the URL in the address bar. Step 2: In the Editor, click the Add button, click Image, click My Image Uploads, and select the photo to serve as the album's "cover". Once the image appears, click it and click the Hyperlink button. Select Web Address, enter the address of the album site, and under "How does it open?" select "New window" or "Current window". If you want to direct visitors to the album through a button instead of a cover image, retrieve the album URL and connect it to a button by clicking the Add button, clicking Button, selecting the button, clicking the Hyperlink button, selecting Web Address, entering the album site address, and choosing "New window" or "Current window".

title: Can I enable a gradient as a background on pages in the Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to enable a gradient as a background on pages in the Wix Editor. However, you can now add gradients to the background of your page sections, strips, and columns.

title: Is it possible to have the same aspect ratio of dish images in Wix Restaurant Menus (New) and Wix Restaurant Orders (New)?
content: It is now possible to have the same aspect ratio of dish images in Wix Restaurant Menus (New) and Wix Restaurant Orders (New).

title: How can I customize receipts in Wix Mobile POS to include my business logo and a custom message?
content: Customizing receipts is currently available only for sales made through Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurants Orders (New). To customize your receipt, go to your site in the Wix app; tap Manage at the bottom; tap Point of Sale under Get Paid; tap the More Actions icon at the top right; select POS settings; tap Customize receipt. To add your logo, tap the Plus icon, select an image, and tap Next. To add custom text, tap the Custom Text toggle, enable it, and enter a message such as Thank you for your purchase. Tap Save at the top right. If you don't see POS settings, you can access them by adding Wix Stores to your site, and make sure you hide store pages from your live site.

title: How can I access Price Quotes in my Wix site's dashboard?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Finances on the left. Click Price Quotes.

title: How can I delete an image from my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: To delete an image from your site in the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click the image, and press Delete on your keyboard. If you uploaded your own images, deleting them from your editor does not remove them from your Media Storage. You can add these images again at any time.

title: How can I create a segment in Wix Contacts to target specific groups for email campaigns?
content:
To create a segment, go to Contacts in your site's dashboard, then follow these steps:

- Click the **Segments** tab.
- Click the **+ Create New** drop-down and select **Segment**.
- Add a name for your segment to help you identify it later (e.g. 'Returning customers').
- Select all the relevant filters that apply to this segment, or click **+ Add a Filter** to create your first filter.

  **Note:** Add the filters one at a time. The more filters you add, the more specific the segment becomes.
- Create your filter by choosing an attribute, condition and value:
  1. Choose an option from the **Contact attribute** or **Contact activity** list. For example, to find all contacts who have previously spent money on the site, select 'total amount spent.'
  2. Click the **Choose a condition** drop-down to choose logic for your filter. For example, select 'is more or equal to'.
  3. (Optional) Depending on the attribute, input a value for this filter. For 'total amount spent,' you might choose '100' as your value.
- (Optional) Click **+ Add a Filter** below the first filter to create another filter for your segment. Both filters work together to find matching contacts.
- Click **Create Segment**. The new segment appears under **Your segments**.

title: How can I add a 'My Subscriptions' page to my Wix Members Area if it's not already included?
content:
If your Members Area version does not include the My Subscriptions page, you can add it in the Editor:
- Go to the Add a Member Page window.
- Wix Editor: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the Editor, click Member Pages, then click Add a Member Page at the bottom.
- Editor X: click the Pages icon in the top bar, scroll down to the Members Area pages, click the More Actions icon next to Members Area, then select Add a Member Page.
- Select the Member Pages tab.
- Click + Add Page on My Subscriptions.

title: Is it possible to automate the suspension or reactivation dates for pricing plans?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automate what date an existing plan suspends or reactivates after a suspension. You can set a reminder in your dashboard to manually suspend or reactivate a plan on the required date.

title: How can I rename a page in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Hover over the relevant page and click the More Actions icon. Click Rename. Type the new name of the page. Click Done.

title: How can I copy and paste an element in the Wix Editor using the right-click menu?
content: Right-click the relevant element, select Copy from the menu, right-click another area on your site, and click Paste. You can also group elements together to copy and paste multiple elements at once.

title: How can I edit my Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix?
content: First create a Hopp by Wix account, or sign in with an existing Wix account. Then, in your Hopp account, click Link in Bio on the left, and click Edit Page at the top right. Use the tabs on the left to choose what to edit: Actions (add links to promote content, take an action such as booking an event, invite people to subscribe or follow you on social media), Social Links (add a clickable social platform logo), Settings (customize profile image/video, title, bio, heading and language), Search (let your audience search links you add to your page and assign a code to each link that your audience can search by), and Design (edit the look of your Link in Bio page).

title: How can I add Wix Chat to my site using the Studio Editor?
content:
To add Wix Chat to your site using the Studio Editor:

- Click App Market on the left side of the Editor.
- Click App Market.
- Type "Wix Chat" in the search bar and press Enter on your keyboard.
- Click Wix Chat.
- Click Add to Site.

title: How can I add a Grid Gallery to my Wix site and select a specific category to display?
content: In the Wix Editor: Go to your editor. Go to the page to which you want to add a gallery. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Store. Drag the Grid Gallery to the relevant location on your site page. Select the category you want to display: Click the gallery in the editor. Click Choose Category. Select an option: Display all your products: Click All Products. Display one category: Click to select a category.

title: Can I bring my Facebook Fan Page site back online after Adobe ended support for Flash technology?
content: The Facebook Fan Page site cannot be brought back online. These sites have been removed from Wix and completely deleted, so they cannot be restored. You can build a new site with the Wix Editor, either using a pre-designed template or from scratch.

title: Can I add an upload button to a custom panel in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it’s not possible to add an upload button element to custom panels in your app. This element would allow site builders to upload their own files right from the app’s custom panel.

title: How can I select a child element in Editor X?
content: By default, when you click an element in the Editor, its parent element is selected. For example, if a button appears inside a container, clicking the button selects the container. You need to click again in order to select a child element. You can also use a keyboard shortcut: hold the Cmd / Ctrl key and click the element. Alternatively, you can change your layer selection preferences so child elements are always selected first. You can also use the Layers panel to locate and select elements on the page.

title: Can I arrange my Wix Pro Gallery items by the date they were added?
content: Currently, it is not possible to arrange your gallery items by the date they were added. You can reorder gallery items manually with drag and drop, or sort them alphabetically by Image Title or File Name.

title: How can I resend an email campaign to recipients who haven't opened it yet?
content: You can resend an email campaign to recipients who have not yet opened it. In Email Marketing in your site's dashboard, go to Most recent email campaigns, then click the Resend icon next to the campaign to resend it to contacts on the list who didn't open. The Resend icon appears 24 hours after the first campaign was sent. Before resending, add a subject line; you can use the same subject line or tweak it. Click Send Now to resend. The resent campaign appears in your Email Marketing dashboard as a new campaign labeled 'Re-sent email.' Important: Resending a campaign counts towards your monthly balance; to increase your balance, upgrade your plan.

title: Can I add drop-down or radio button fields to the Wix Table Reservations Form?
content: No. Currently it is only possible to add a text input for custom fields. Drop-down, radio buttons or any other input fields are not supported.

title: How can I unpublish my site using ADI, and is there a way to keep it accessible via a direct link but hidden from search engines?
content:
To unpublish your site using ADI: Access your Site Manager. Click Unpublish. Click Unpublish to confirm.

If you want your site to remain accessible to users with a direct link, but do not want it to appear in Google search results, you can hide your site from search engines.

title: How can I customize the Thank You Page in Wix for my online store?
content:
Access your Thank You Page in the editor, then customize it. In Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, select the relevant business solution (Store Pages, Bookings Pages or Restaurant Pages), or select Cart & Thank You, and select Thank You Page. In Studio Editor, click Pages on the left side of the editor, and select Thank You Page under the relevant business solution or under Cart & Thank You.

From the Thank You Page, you can:
- Select the elements to display: click the Settings tab and deselect the checkboxes next to any elements you don't want to display.
- Customize the design: click the Design tab and customize the Thank You page background and borders, as well as the text fonts and colors.
- Edit the text and the "Continue Browsing" link: click the Text tab to edit the text that appears on the Thank You page. The Thank You page has a "Continue Browsing" link at the bottom unless you chose not to display it.

To customize the "Continue Browsing" link:
- Scroll down to the Link section in the Text tab.
- Optionally edit link text in the Continue Browsing link field.
- Set where the link directs: click the Link icon, select Page to link to a site page, select a site page from the Which page? drop-down, and click Done.

If a customer pays with Express Checkout (e.g. PayPal or Apple Pay), they are directed to PayPal's own confirmation page. From there, they can click to go back to your site's Thank You Page.

title: How do I add seasonal rates to my hotel in the original Wix Hotels?
content:
To add seasonal rules to your hotel in the original Wix Hotels:

- Go to your dashboard.
- Click the Hotels tab.
- Click the Price Options tab.
- Click Seasonal Rules.
- Click Create New.
- Set up your seasonal rate:
  - Enter the name of the season.
  - Select the start date of the season under Season starts.
  - Select the end date of the season under Season ends.
  - Optional: Enter the minimum number of nights.
  - Optional: Enter the maximum number of nights.
  - Enter the relevant prices for each hotel room:
    - Weekday: The price per night during the week.
    - Weekend: The price per night during the weekend.
    - Weekly: The price per week.
    - Monthly: The price per month.
    - Extra Adult: The price per night for an extra adult.
- Click Save.

Important: Creating a Seasonal Rule overrides the length of stay as well as regular unit rates.

title: How can I embed Songkick tour dates on my Wix site?
content: Before you begin, your Songkick account needs to be set up as the manager of the requested artist. Log in to Songkick, go to the tour dates portal, and customize the options in the panel on the right. Click Grab the code. In your Wix Editor, click Add Elements on the left side, then Embed Code, then Embed HTML. Paste the copied code into the Add your code here (HTTPS only) field and click Update. Optionally, enter alt text describing what you're embedding in the What's in the embed? Tell Google field. When ready, publish your site.

title: Can I attribute tips to the staff member providing the service in Wix Retail POS?
content: By default, all tips are attributed to the cashier processing the sale, not the staff member providing the service or the salesperson that assisted the customer. As a workaround, you can add a service provider to your POS team. The cashier accepting payment can then attribute the sale to the relevant team member so that the tips are directed to them.

title: How can I print shipping labels for my store orders using Wix Shipping?
content: Before you begin, make sure you enter your business's address in the Business Info page. Wix has partnered with Shippo to create Wix Shipping, an integrated print label solution. Use the Wix Shipping integrated shipping label solution to purchase and print labels right in your Wix dashboard. Wix Shipping is currently available for merchants in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the UK, and the US.

title: How can I show or hide the blog menu on my Wix blog's post page?
content:
To show or hide the blog menu on your post page:
- Go to your editor.
- Go to your Post page: click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Blog Pages, then click Post.
- Click the Post Page element on your page.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Display tab.
- Click Blog Menu.
- Click the Show blog menu toggle to show or hide the menu.

title: Can I access my billing information for Wix services from a mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to access the billing information for Wix services from a mobile device. You can access your Billing History at any time while using a desktop device.

title: Can I use a third-party SSL certificate with my Wix site?
content: Currently, Wix does not support third-party SSL certificates. All Wix sites are enabled with HTTPS, so are created with inbuilt SSL certification. We do not authenticate sites built elsewhere. Therefore, we are unable to generate CSR files (SSL authentication) for domains and subdomains connected to external sites.

title: How can I manually schedule an appointment in Wix Bookings and collect payment?
content:
To manually add an appointment, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click Add, or select a time slot on the calendar, then select Appointment. Enter the client details, select the relevant service, and enter the date, arrival time, and location for the service. If you want a recurring appointment, select the Repeats checkbox, choose how frequently it repeats from the Repeats drop-down, and choose how many times it repeats from the For drop-down.

Next, choose Book to complete the booking now and collect payment later using the Booking Calendar, or choose Book & Collect Payment to take payment immediately or send an invoice right away.
