To collect payment, choose the relevant option from the Collect Payment drop-down on the Orders page:
- Charge with pay link: enter a Link name, Price, and Description, then open Settings if needed to set an expiration date or limit the number of payments. Click Create Link.
- Charge card manually: enter the client's credit card details, including their Zip or postal code. Optionally select the charge custom amount checkbox and enter the amount; the remaining balance appears next to Amount due. Optionally select Save this card to the customer's file after getting the client's consent. Click Charge.
- Charge with invoice: click Create Invoice, then choose Print, Share Link, or Send via Email. For Share Link, create a link to the invoice, click Copy Link, and click Done. For Send via Email, edit the subject line and message, then click Send.
- Mark as paid: click Mark as Paid to confirm; you cannot undo this action. Optionally select Mark a custom amount as paid, enter the partial payment, and click Mark [amount] as paid; you cannot undo this action.

A notification appears if you are scheduling outside working hours, if you have not assigned a staff member, or if another appointment is booked at that time. You can still continue with the booking. To schedule a similar session for the same client, select the relevant appointment on the calendar, click Book Again, and fill in the appointment details.

title: How do I connect easypay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right and change it via the drop-down menu if needed. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to easypay. If you have an easypay account, enter your App ID and App KEY and click Connect. To retrieve them, login to easypay Backoffice and generate and copy your App ID and App KEY. If you do not have an account, click Create easypay account, fill in the registration form, login to easypay Backoffice, generate and copy your App ID and App KEY, return to the Accept Payments tab, and follow the Have an account steps to connect.

title: How do I switch my domain's connection method from name servers to pointing?
content: You need access to your domain host account. Log in to your domain host account, find the section where the DNS records are located, and replace the A Record host with @ or [blank] pointing to 185.230.63.107, and the CNAME host www pointing to pointing.wixdns.net. Reset the name servers to the domain host's default, then save the changes. It can take up to 48 hours for the records to propagate.

title: How can I resend a Wix gift card code if the recipient accidentally deleted it?
content: To resend the gift card email, go to Gift Card Sales in your site's dashboard. Select the sale you want to resend. Click Email Gift Card. (Optional) Edit the email address. Click Send Email.

title: How do I add the Shared Gallery app to my Wix site?
content: You can add the Shared Gallery app to your site from the Wix App Market. In the Wix Editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, search for the Shared Gallery app in the search bar, and click Add to Site. In the Studio Editor, click App Market on the left side of the editor, search for the Shared Gallery app in the search bar, and click Add to Site.

title: How can I manually enter a customer's credit card details to accept payment for an unpaid order in the Wix app?
content:
Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Sales. Tap Orders. Select the relevant unpaid order. Click Collect Payment. Select Manual card entry. Enter the card details and tap Next. Tap Confirm & Pay.

Important: Manual card entry is available for merchants using a payment provider that supports manual card entry. Entering card details manually is the least secure way of accepting card payments. We recommend accepting manual payment only from buyers you trust. In case of fraud, it's the merchant who is liable.

title: How can I design the menu box in Wix Editor?
content: Click the mobile menu icon in the mobile editor. Click Edit Menu. Click the menu box. Use the Layout, Design, and Animation panels to adjust and customize the menu box.

title: How can I align multiple elements in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor and multi-select the relevant elements. Click the Layout icon, or the Align icon on the Editor Toolbar, then choose Left, Center, Right, Top, Middle, or Bottom. Left aligns elements to the left of the selected elements box; Center aligns them to the center of the selected elements box on a vertical axis; Right aligns them to the right of the selected elements box; Top aligns them to the top of the selected elements box; Middle aligns them to the middle of the selected elements box on a horizontal axis; Bottom aligns them to the bottom of the selected elements box. You can also position elements using the Editor Toolbar, or drag an element until the Wix Smart Guide indicates that the elements are aligned evenly vertically or horizontally.

title: Why can't I view my Wix photo album after changing its URL?
content: Make sure your album is published by going to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard and checking that your album's status is Published. Make sure your site has been upgraded to a Premium or Studio site plan. After upgrading your site and connecting your domain, it takes up to 24 hours for the new album subdomain to propagate. Check your domain connection by accessing the Domain Assistant and following the instructions according to your situation. Note that subdomains cannot be connected to a domain that is connected to Wix via Pointing. If your domain is not properly connected to Wix, you may see a 404 error and issues with the SSL server telling you that your connection is not secure.

title: How can I manage video channels in the Wix app?
content: To manage video channels from the Wix app, go to your site in the Wix app, tap Manage at the bottom right, then tap Video Library and tap Videos. From there, you can drag and drop the channels to reorder them, or tap the Show/hide icon next to the relevant channel to show or hide it from your site.

title: How can I sign up to become a Wix Affiliate?
content: You can sign up to be a Wix Affiliate by filling out the form referenced in the article (the "here" link).

title: How can I add a new tax type to my Wix invoices?
content:
To set up tax types in Wix: go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click **Getting paid**, then click **+ Add New Tax** in the **Taxes** section. Enter the **Tax name** (e.g., VAT, State Tax) and **Rate** (%). Click **Save**.

You can also add a new tax type directly from the drop-down menu under **Tax** when creating a new invoice or price quote. When creating a new invoice, you can set how taxes are calculated and displayed on the invoice.

Note: This feature is currently only available for Invoices, but not Price Quotes.

title: Can I view my schedule on a weekly basis in the Wix app?
content: Currently, you can view upcoming sessions by schedule, day, or a 3-day view in the Booking Calendar of the Wix app. However, it is not possible to view the schedule on a weekly basis.

title: Is it possible to add an animation in the transition between the menu icon and the 'X' icon when visitors open the hamburger menu?
content: When visitors open the hamburger menu, the menu icon changes to an 'X' icon. Currently, it is not possible to add an animation in the transition between the 2 icons.

title: How can I approve a new site member from the member list in my site's dashboard?
content: Go to Site Members in your site's dashboard. Click Pending next to Site Members. Click Approve next to the relevant member(s).

title: How can I check which payment provider account is connected to my Wix site, and where can I view a payment's details?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the payment provider / method you want to check. View your current provider credentials in the Account information section. For PayPal, enter the email address of your desired account in the Account information section and click Save. To view and manage payments received through your site, go to Payments in your site's dashboard. Click a payment to see more details, including payment method details such as the payment provider and credit card details. You can also filter payments by payment provider.

title: How can I customize where and how my Wix chatbox is displayed on my website?
content: To customize where and how your chatbox is displayed, click the chatbox in the bottom corner of the Editor, click Settings, click the Display tab, and choose what you want to customize. Position on Page lets you decide whether your chatbox appears in the bottom left or bottom right of your live site. New Message Display lets you choose how new messages appear to site visitors: the full chatbox can open automatically when site visitors receive a new message, or a smaller bubble notification can prompt them to open the chatbox to view a new message. Chat Visibility lets you choose where across your live site the chatbox appears: visible on every page of your site or visible only on the pages you select.

title: How can I connect Isracard powered by PayMe as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
To connect Isracard powered by PayMe as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

- Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to Isracard powered by PayMe.
- Create a new Isracard powered by PayMe account: click Create Isracard powered by PayMe account, fill in the registration form, and wait for a message from Isracard powered by PayMe to get your API Key. The API key will be received only after the account is verified with Isracard/PayMe; the verification process may take several business days.
- Repeat the earlier connection steps and enter the API key you received and your email address under Account information.
- Optional: Enable the Installments toggle to allow your customers to pay in installments.
- Click Connect.

title: How can I automatically send an invoice when someone purchases my online program?
content: To automatically send an invoice when a program is purchased, go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. For a new program, click Create New, choose a template, then click Edit to enter your program details. For an existing program, click the More Actions icon next to the program and select Edit Settings. Then click Visibility and Pricing and select the Automatically send invoices checkbox. Click Save. You can click Customize Invoice to tailor invoice details, including the invoice header, transaction details, and company details from Business Info. Make sure your site has been upgraded to a plan that accepts payments.

title: How can I send a broadcast message to multiple contacts using the Wix app?
content: Broadcast messages let you send a single message to multiple contacts at once from the Wix app. Contacts can receive it via Wix Chat in their preferred member app or by email, and they receive the messages separately, not as a group message. From your inbox: open the Wix app, tap the Inbox icon, tap the Compose icon, and tap Broadcast Message. Tap the contacts you want to send to, then tap Next. Tap the channel drop-down at the bottom left and choose Chat or Email. For Chat, members see the message in their member app, such as Spaces by Wix, and you need Wix Chat installed on your site. For Email, send to contacts who have provided an email address saved in your contact list. Compose your broadcast message. You can attach elements to your message, then tap Send. If Wix Bookings is installed on your site and Business Phone Number is available in your country, you can also send a broadcast message via SMS.

title: How do I set up a single item collection in the CMS and connect it to page elements?
content: Go to CMS in your site's dashboard, or click CMS in your Editor. Click Create Collection, enter a name for your collection, click the drop-down and select A single item, then click Create. Click + Add Field and define Field type, Field name, and Field ID. Optionally enter info in the Help text (optional) field, then click Save. Continue to add as many fields as you need. To connect elements, add a dataset to your page, select the dataset and click Settings, click the Connect a collection drop-down and select your single item collection. Click the page element you want to connect, click the Connect To CMS icon, click the Connect a dataset drop-down and select the relevant dataset, then click the Connection Options drop-down and select the required field(s).

title: How can I customize my wishlist page?
content: You can customize the My Wishlist page in the Wix Editor by clicking Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor, clicking Members Area, clicking the My Wishlist page, clicking the My Wishlist page in the Editor, clicking Settings, and customizing the My Wishlist page using the available options. In the Studio Editor, click Pages at the top of the editor, click Members Page, click Member Menu, click Manage and Navigate, select My Wishlist, click the My Wishlist page in the Editor, click Settings, and customize the My Wishlist page using the available options.

title: How can I reschedule an email campaign that I have already scheduled in the Email Marketing dashboard?
content:
Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click View all Campaigns, then click the Scheduled tab. Click the Reschedule icon next to the relevant scheduled email campaign. Select the date you want using the calendar, set the time in the drop-down, and click Reschedule.

Notes:
Pausing a scheduled email campaign prevents it from being sent until you choose to send or schedule it again.
Creating a scheduled campaign requires an email marketing plan.

title: Is the Fotomoto app supported on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not have a Fotomoto app. Fotomoto provides a Javascript code which needs to be added to a site's source code. This is not possible with a Wix site. If you're a photographer, Wix highly recommends checking out Wix Photo Albums.

title: What is an anchor menu on a Wix site?
content: An anchor menu displays your anchors in a floating anchor menu. Visitors can access different page sections by clicking the anchor name on the menu. Because the anchor menu is floating, it is always visible wherever visitors are on your page. You can have a site menu and an anchor menu on the same website; the site menu can let visitors navigate between site pages, and the anchor menu can let visitors navigate between the sections on the page. The source mentions that you can add and set up an anchor menu in just a few clicks, but it does not provide the detailed setup steps.

title: How do I change the thumbnail image that appears when sharing my site on social networks?
content:
To change the og:image for your whole site:
- Open your site's settings.
- Click Website settings.
- Scroll down to General social image and click Upload Image.
- Select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one.
- Click Choose File to add it.
- Click Save at the top of the dashboard.
- Publish your site.

To change the og:image for an individual page:
- Click Pages & Menu on the left Editor menu.
- Click the relevant page.
- Click More Actions.
- Select Social share.
- Click Upload Image.
- Select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one.
- Click Add to Page.
- Publish your site.

You can also set the page's og:title and og:description from the Social share settings.

title: How can I connect my ClassPass account to my Wix site?
content: Go to Booking Channels in your site's dashboard. Click Connect under ClassPass. Follow the on-screen instructions to log in or create your ClassPass account.

title: How can I create a new resource type for my business using Wix Bookings?
content:
To create a resource type in Wix Bookings:
- Go to Resources in your site's dashboard.
- (First time only) Click Get Started.
- Click + Create Resource Type.
- Enter the Resource type.

Tip: Numbering automatically appears next to the resource type, so enter 'Room' instead of 'Rooms' to avoid confusing your staff and clients.

- Enter how many of this resource type you have.
- (Optional) Assign a Location to this resource type if you offer services at more than one location.
- Click Create.

title: How can I re-add the Cart Icon in the Wix Editor if it was previously deleted?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Depending on the app you're using, click Stores / Bookings / Restaurants. Click Cart Icon. Drag the cart to your site's header.

title: Can I duplicate cells in a section grid using the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to duplicate cells in a section grid.

title: How do I customize the columns in the Orders tab to view local delivery orders in Wix Stores?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click the Customize column icon. Select the checkboxes next to Delivery time and Delivery method. Recommended: Deselect the checkboxes next to any columns you don't need.

title: Can I automatically give loyalty points to customers for interacting with my site's forum?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically give loyalty points to your members, customers, or visitors for interacting with your site's forum. You can however, give loyalty points manually.

title: How can I access my site's dashboard while editing in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, hover over the Wix logo on the top left of the editor, then click Go to Dashboard.

title: How can I customize the Group Page in Wix Groups to enhance member interaction?
content: Each group you create has its own dedicated page, featuring a discussion tab for posts and media, as well as a members tab. You can choose to display member names on profile photos to enhance connections among group members. Customize this page with design adjustments and integrate features like emoji reactions and member badges, promoting community recognition and participation. Each group page features various tabs such as "About" and "Media." You can create custom tabs, rename existing ones, and link specific events to the group.

title: How can I use the Accessibility Monitor to check my site's accessibility on Wix?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Hover over Site & Mobile App in the left menu. Select Website under Website & SEO. Check the Accessibility card. If issues are identified, click Fix Issues. Follow the steps in the Wizard to improve your site's accessibility. Save and publish the changes. The Accessibility Monitor is only available for sites built in the Wix Editor, and it identifies issues on the published version of your site only. Check the Monitor every time you publish new changes on your site.

title: How can I use the 123 Form Builder & Payments app to send form data to other platforms?
content: With the 123 Form Builder & Payments app by 123FormBuilder, you can send data to Wix Contacts, Mailchimp, Google Drive, Hubspot (through Zapier), Dropbox, and dozens more. To get started, check out the 123 Form Builder & Payments app by 123FormBuilder.

title: How can I pin a post to the top of a forum category in Wix Forum?
content: To pin a post to the top of a forum category in Wix Forum: for a published site, log in to your live site using the email address associated with your account and navigate to the forum page. For an unpublished site, go to your Wix Forum in preview mode. Click the Show More icon on a post, then click Pin post. Pinned posts appear in the order they were pinned.

title: Can site members view their groups from their profile in the Members Area?
content: Your site members can now view their groups from their profile in the Members Area.

title: How can I schedule a recurring class session in Wix Bookings?
content: To schedule a class session in Wix Bookings, first create the class service you want to schedule. Then go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard, click the time slot in which the class meets for the first time, and select Class Session. Add the class session details: choose the Class service, select the Location if you have more than 1, select the Staff member giving the class, edit the Start Time, and select the Duration. Under Repeat, choose Doesn't repeat for a one-time session or Repeats to offer this class session multiple times. For Repeats, select Weekly, Every 2, 3 or 4 weeks, select the day(s) of the week the class takes place, and optionally click Set an end date and choose the date of the last class. Finally choose Save & Add New to save the session and start scheduling another one, or Save to save the session and return to your calendar.

title: How can I verify my site with Bing to improve its ranking in search results?
content: You can verify your site with Bing by adding a meta tag to your Wix site in Bing Webmaster Tools. After you verify your site, Bing will regularly crawl it for changes. It's a good idea to resubmit your sitemap to Bing when you publish changes to your site.

title: Can I use PicPay as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer PicPay as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through PicPay and arrange the payment offline.

title: Can I connect the slideshow element to a dataset in the Wix Editor?
content:
Currently, in the Wix Editor, it is not possible to connect the slideshow element to a dataset. This would allow you to display details about a different CMS (Content Management System) collection item on each slide of your slideshow.

Workarounds:
- In the Studio Editor, you can connect slideshows to datasets to show a different collection item in each slide. You can build your site in the Studio Editor if you would like this capability.
- You can connect supported elements that are attached to your slideshow slides to a dataset to show CMS content for a single item. This does not allow you to show a different item on each slide, however, you can connect the elements on each slide to different collection fields to show different details about a single item on each slide.

title: How can I improve my email bounce rate with Wix Email Marketing?
content: Create a good quality mailing list: only send email campaigns to people who have actively signed up or subscribed to be on your mailing list; enable Double Opt-In in your form settings so users verify their email address; only import contacts from mailing lists you built and have permission to use; do not use purchased mailing lists or contacts you found online (e.g. Facebook). Check bounced emails regularly: after sending a campaign, check for typos in email addresses that bounced; if you have alternate email addresses for subscribers whose campaigns bounced, contact them directly and invite them to re-subscribe or reach out through another channel; if you cannot correct a contact's email address, delete it from your mailing list and don't send to it again; never add a bounced contact back without verifying the email address and getting permission. Review your mailing list regularly: review lists every 6 months and remove anyone you haven't been in touch with during the past 12 months; use an email validation tool to keep lists clean.

title: How can I show or hide the comments and likes counters on my Wix Blog posts?
content: Click the Wix Blog app in your Editor, click Settings, and click the Display tab. Then select or deselect the comments counter and the likes counter. To make different display choices for your site on mobile, access the mobile Editor, select the blog, click Settings, and enable mobile settings in the Display tab.

title: How can I create and share a favorites list for my clients using Wix Photo Albums?
content: Favorites lists are only available for new albums; they are not available for albums that you created in the past. To create and share a list, go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Create a new album, click Publish Now, then click Manage Album Settings. Click Get Started under Favorites lists on the right. Click +Create List, add a name for your list, and optionally add instructions or additional information for your clients under Add a note. Under Privacy settings, select who can access your list: Public means anyone that can view your album can view this list; Secret means only people with the link can access the list. Click Save. Then choose how you want to share the link, or tap View List to see what it looks like: Copy link, Email, or WhatsApp. After you create your list, you can view it on your live site, download the photos that your clients select, update your list's information, and manage your list's members.

title: Can I automatically assign loyalty points to customers for leaving product reviews in Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically give loyalty points to customers for leaving product reviews. You can, however, give loyalty points to a customer manually.

title: How can I change the title tag and meta description of a page in ADI?
content: In ADI, click the Pages menu on the top bar, hover over the relevant page and click the Settings icon, then click SEO Basics. Enter the page title under Title Tag (For Search Results). To change the meta description, follow the same steps and enter your page description under Meta Description (For Search Results).

title: How can I set up collection permissions to allow only registered members to view and contribute to certain collections on my Wix site?
content: In the CMS, collection permissions control who can view, add, update, or delete collection content on your live site. To allow only registered members to view and contribute to a collection, use the 'Show content' permission and restrict viewing to site members only, and use the 'Collect content' permission to allow only site members to add new items. For more access control, use 'Custom' permissions. Note that 'Collect content' allows adding new items but does not allow visitors to update existing items; use custom permissions if existing items or field values need to be updated from the live site.

title: Does Wix support CAA records?
content: Currently, CAA records are not supported by Wix; if you have connected via pointing method, please make sure to remove the existing CAA record at your domain host's side.

title: How can a visitor log out of a password protected page on a Wix site?
content: A password protected page requires your site visitors to enter a password. They are not required to log in. Therefore, there is no option to log out. If your site visitors would like to re-enter the password, they need to clear their browser's cache to remove the password memory. The next time that they try to access the page, they will be required to insert the password again. If you've protected your page for members only, the Log In / Sign Up button turns into a Log Out button. This enables your site visitors to log out of members-only pages.

title: Can Wix Stores be used to sell services, or only physical goods?
content: Wix Stores is for selling physical or digital products. To sell services, Wix Bookings is an easy-to-use scheduling system that lets your members book and pay for services online. You can add Wix Bookings to your site for free, but you must upgrade your site to accept bookings. You must also upgrade your site in order to accept online payments.

title: How can I assign my Editor X Premium Plan to a different Wix site?
content:
To assign your Editor X Premium Plan to a Wix site:

- Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account.
- Click the Show More icon next to the plan you want to reassign.
- Select Assign to a Different Site.
- Click the checkbox next to the relevant Wix site.
- Click Assign.

title: How does Wix determine the ownership of a site in the event of a dispute?
content: In the event of a dispute between several parties, Wix will determine site ownership by using established guidelines and reserves the right to determine and/or grant ownership based on its reasonable judgment. For free sites, the owner of any sites or content is the owner of the Wix account under which the content was created; in most cases, the account owner is considered to be the person or entity who has access to the email address listed in Wix's records. For premium sites connected to a domain, if the site is/was connected to a domain whose registration information is publicly available via the WHOIS database, the site owner is considered to be the person or entity registered as the owner of that domain. If a domain is not connected or Wix is unable to verify the registration information in the WHOIS database, Wix may use relevant billing information to determine the account or site owner; if paid services were purchased via the account, the owner is considered to be the person or entity whose billing details were used to purchase those paid services.

title: How can I connect Yandex Metrica to my Wix site?
content:
Prerequisites: You must have a Premium site with a connected domain.

Step 1 | Get Your Yandex Metrica Tag
First, create a tag in your Yandex Metrica account:
- Sign in to your Yandex Metrica account.
- Click Add tag at the top left of your screen.
- Enter a tag name next to Tag name.
- Enter your site's domain next to Website address.
- Tip: Enable the Session Replay feature by clicking the Session Replay, scroll map, form analysis toggle.
- Select the I accept the Terms of Use checkbox.
- Click Create tag.
- Select CMS and website builders.
- Copy the tag number under Option 1.

Step 2 | Connect Your Yandex Metrica Tag to Your Site
After you create your tag, add it to your site in Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard:
- Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard.
- Click Connect under Yandex Metrica.
- Click Add Yandex Metrica Tag.
- Enter your Yandex Metrica tag number in the pop-up.
- Click Save.

Note:
- If you have connected multiple domains to your site, make sure to add your Yandex Metrica code to your primary domain only, rather than your secondary domain(s).
- Once you have added the code to your site, it may take up to a week before you begin to see the statistics in your account.
- If your site uses a cookie banner, Yandex Metrica will only gather data after a visitor provides consent and approves using the relevant cookies.

title: Is it possible to set up contactless dine-in with the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set up contactless dine-in with the Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app. This feature would allow customers to view your menu, place orders, pay online, and have food brought right to their table.

title: How can I connect a payment method using the Wix app on my Android device?
content:
To add a payment method using the Wix app, note that connecting a payment method from the Wix app is only available on Android devices; it is not possible on iOS. Some payment providers are only available to connect through desktop; to manage, change or see a wider list of providers, go to the Accept Payments tab on your site's dashboard.

- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Pricing Plans under Catalog.
- Tap Settings.
- Tap Payments.
- If prompted, select your location from the Business Location drop-down, and tap Confirm.
- Tap Connect on the payment methods you want to offer (Credit/Debit cards, PayPal, or Manual) or tap More Payment Options.
- Choose the payment method you want to connect.

Complete setup for credit / debit cards: Wix offers different credit / debit card payment providers depending on your location. Tap Connect and follow the setup instructions for the specific payment provider you are connecting.

Complete setup for PayPal: If you have a PayPal account, tap Connect, enter the email address associated with your PayPal account, enter your country or region, tap Next, and log in to your PayPal account. If you don't have a PayPal account, click Create new account, follow the instructions in PayPal to create an account, and once your account is approved, go to the Accept Payments section in the Wix app and follow the steps above for merchants with an account.

Complete setup for Manual: Customers follow your instructions on how they can pay you. For example, you can instruct people to pay through a bank transfer, a specific app or in person. Select a title for the payment instructions from the drop-down menu, tap Add Instructions, enter instructions for your client, tap Add, and click Connect.

title: How can I add a testimonial strip to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Click Add Elements on the left side of the Editor, click Strip, scroll down to Testimonial Presets, click the testimonial strip that you want to add or drag it to the relevant location on your site, then edit the text appearing on the strip.

title: How can I create a membership plan in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard, then create a new appointment or class or edit an existing one. In the Price and Payment section, choose the relevant option from the Price type drop-down: Fixed Price, Free, Varied prices, or Custom Price. To connect a pricing plan, click Create New Plan next to Memberships & Packages, click Membership, click Next, and enter the Membership name and Description. Use the What services are included? drop-down to select the services, or click Select All Services for an all-inclusive membership. Note: the service you are creating is already linked to this plan. In the next drop-down, choose Unlimited number of sessions or Limited number of sessions; for limited sessions, set the limit in the Number of sessions field. Under Price and Duration, choose Recurring payments, One-time payment, or Free. For Recurring payments, choose the Payment period, enter the Price, choose an end date using Payments stop after, and optionally enable the toggle to offer clients a free trial period. For One-time payment, enter the membership's price and choose how long it is valid using the drop-down. For Free, choose how long the membership is valid using the drop-down. Under Extra Benefits, select any relevant perks. Under Settings, choose additional terms such as Let clients cancel, Clients set start date, or Add a policy; for a policy, click Add, enter your terms and conditions, and click Save. Click Save, then when ready click Save at the top right to update the service. You can edit the membership plan later from Booking Services or from Pricing Plans in the site dashboard.

title: How do I add and set up the Dropbox Folder app on my Wix site?
content:
To add and set up the Dropbox Folder app, use the Wix Editor or Studio Editor and connect it to an existing or new Dropbox account.

**Add the app**

For Wix Editor:
- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Dropbox Folder in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.
- Select the app in your editor and click **Settings**.
- Do one of the following:
  - Click **Connect Account** and sign in to your Dropbox account.
  - Click **Create a new account**, then sign up with Dropbox and verify your email address.
- Click **Allow** to grant access to display your Dropbox folders.

For Studio Editor:
- Click **App Market** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the Dropbox Folder app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.
- Select the app in your editor and click **Settings**.
- Do one of the following:
  - Click **Connect Account** and sign in to your Dropbox account.
  - Click **Create a new account**, then sign up with Dropbox and verify your email address.
- Click **Allow** to grant access to display your Dropbox folders.

**Tip:** If a pop-up does not open, try turning off your pop-up blocker or updating your browser version.

**Choose which folders you want to display**
- Click the Dropbox Folders app in your editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Folders** tab.
- Click **Select Folder**.
- Hover over the folder you want to display and click **Select**.

**Tip:** If you added a folder recently, and it doesn't appear, click the **Refresh** icon.

**Customize how the app looks on your site**
- Click the Dropbox Folders app in your editor.
- Click **Settings**.
- Click the **Layout** tab to choose how you want to display the files inside your folder:
  - **List:** Displays the full list of files in your folder.
  - **Icon:** Displays the folder name. When clicked, a pop-up appears with a list of files.
- Click the **Settings** tab to choose what info you want to show in the folder:
  - Click the **Show title** toggle to show or hide the folder title.
  - Edit the folder title in the **Title text** field.
  - Click the **Show number of items** toggle to show or hide the number of files.
  - Click the **Allow file preview** toggle to show or hide the title.
- Click the **Design** tab to customize the colors, fonts, and icon style.

**Note:** The design options differ depending on the layout you chose.

title: How can I update the contact information for my .at domain through Wix?
content: Download the form at this webpage. The form contains reference to nic.at and says to fax to their contact details, but you can disregard this instruction. Print the form out and fill in the relevant details. Contact Wix Customer Care to provide legible scans (in PDF format) of the signed form. It may take a few days for this change to show up in your account.

title: Can I display Wix Chat on my site if the header and footer are hidden?
content: In the Wix Editor, Wix Chat is attached to your site's footer, so if the footer is hidden, Wix Chat doesn't appear. To display Wix Chat on your site, you must display your header and footer. Note: This does not apply to the Studio Editor. In the Studio Editor, Wix Chat appears even when you remove the footer from your page.

title: Is Clover supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Clover as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Clover and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I add a Facebook Share button to my Wix site?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Social. Click Facebook. Click or drag the Facebook Share button to your site. Set up your Facebook Share button using the available options.

title: How can I record and download my Wix Live event?
content: After you start your Wix Live event, you can begin recording at any time. Click **Record Video** at the top right. When you're ready to stop recording, click **End Video**. You can start and stop recording more than once to produce multiple recordings during an event. After the event has ended, go to the **Live Video** tab in your site's dashboard, select the relevant event, click **Manage Recordings**, click **Download** next to the relevant recording, and click **Done**. The event is available for download for 7 days after the event, before it is removed.

title: How can I change the maximum number of items displayed in my dataset settings using the Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor and navigate to the relevant page. Go to the relevant dataset settings:

1. Click CMS on the left.
2. Click Manage Page Connections.
3. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant dataset and select Dataset settings.

Edit the Maximum items displayed field to adjust the maximum items that can load at a time in the dataset's connected elements. This is also the maximum items that can load when visitors click 'Load More' or 'Next/Previous page' buttons.

title: How can I add an overview to my Program Page in the online program editor?
content: Click Pages on the left side of your Editor. Click Program Pages. Click the Program Page element on your site's page. Click Settings. Click Display on the Visitor tab. Enable the Content Overview toggle to display your program's overview details.

title: Can I accept archive files using Wix Forms?
content: Yes. You can accept archive files using the File Upload field in Wix Forms. Uploading archive files allows visitors to upload a single file containing multiple compressed items, such as a .zip file with various documents, images, or videos.

title: Can I change a connected Google Developer account from the Branded App dashboard?
content: Once you connect a pre-existing Google developer account, there is no way to change the account from the Branded App dashboard. If you want to transfer the connected account, follow the instructions from Google.

title: How can I add a lightbox to my site using the Studio Editor?
content: To add a lightbox to your site using the Studio Editor, click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor, then click **Layout Tools**, click **Lightboxes**, and select the lightbox you want to add.

title: How can I add input elements to allow visitors to filter content in my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin, add the CMS (Content Management System) to your site if you haven't already, and connect a repeater, gallery, or table to your CMS collection.

Step 1 | Add input elements set to filter content: Wix Editor
- Go to the page in your editor where you want visitors to filter the content that appears in a repeater, gallery, or table.
- Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor.
- Click Input.
- Under Selection, click the type of input element you want visitors to use to filter content. You can choose from Radio Buttons, Checkboxes, Dropdown, Selection Tags, or Slider (Range Sliders only).
- Click and drag the relevant input element onto the page.
- Optionally repeat to add more input elements.

Step 2 | Connect your input element(s) to the CMS: Wix Editor
- Click the input element you just added.
- Click the Connect to CMS icon.
- Click Filter content.
- Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the repeater, gallery, or table that you want visitors to filter.
- Click the Filter content by drop-down and choose which collection field visitors will use to filter the content that displays.
- Optionally click Advanced Filtering, then the Condition drop-down, and choose an operator that controls how the filter is applied (e.g. Is not, Does not equal, Does not include).
- Repeat for each input element you want visitors to use to filter content.
- Click Preview to test using your input element(s) as filters.
- Click Publish if you are ready to make the changes go live.

You can also add an 'apply filter' button if you want visitors' filters to be applied only after clicking a separate button, and a reset button visitors can click to clear the filters they've set.

title: How can I create a private forum category in Wix Forum and manage access for specific members?
content: To create a private category in Wix Forum, go to your Forum in your site's dashboard and click the Categories tab. Create a new category or select an existing category. Scroll down to Access & Monetization and choose Selected Members. Click Add next to the relevant option: Members to select members; Roles to give members with the same role access; Badges to give members with that badge access; Subscriptions so only members with access to the plan can access the category. Notifications cannot be sent for private categories. You can approve and manage site members from the Member List in your site's dashboard.

title: Can I translate Wix Video using Wix Multilingual?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to translate Wix Video with Wix Multilingual.

You can display different videos per language version on your site using the Single Video Player. These videos cannot be monetized.

title: Can customers book a table at my restaurant using 'Reserve with Google' through Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, customers can't book a table at your restaurant using 'Reserve with Google'. This would allow your customers to reserve a table directly via Google Search, Google Maps and Google Assistant.

title: How can I change the header design on my website using ADI?
content:
To change your header design in ADI:

- Hover over the **Customize Section Design** button.
- Select a **Header Type**:
  * **Regular**: The header remains at the top of the page and only appears when your visitor scrolls to that area.
  * **Transparent**: A transparent header is one without a background color. It only appears transparent on the homepage; on the other site pages it appears with a background color.
  * **Fixed**: The header appears at the top of the page even when your visitor scrolls down.
- Select the **background color**.

For a transparent header, make sure your site colors are set to **Dark Mode** and the first section immediately following the header includes a **full-width image**.

title: Can I automatically assign loyalty points to customers who follow my social media channels?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically give loyalty points to customers who follow or start following your social media channels. You can however, give loyalty points to a customer manually.

title: How can I set up my Wix Art Store to sell both digital images and prints?
content:
Note: Wix Art Store is currently not available to all users. As of October 2022 it is no longer possible to add the Wix Art Store to your site. Alternatively, add Wix Stores and connect it to Printful to sell your art.

To set up Wix Art Store to sell digital images and prints:
- Step 1: Choose the type of images you want to sell. Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor, click Settings, click Set Up Store, click Start Now, click Sell Digital & Print, click OK.
- Step 2: Add the images you want to sell to your gallery. Click Upload Images, click Add Media, click Image, select images from your media manager or click Upload Images to upload new images, click Apply. You can add a title, description and link for each image, reorder images or edit image quality, then click Done. You do not need to add all images at once. Tip: print sizes depend on file size; for large prints (e.g. art posters, canvas) it is recommended to upload images of 4000px or more, in RGB format.
- Step 3: Set pricing. Click Settings on the Art Store in the Editor, click Store, click Set Pricing, then follow the steps to set the pricing.
- Step 4: Add business information and set up your Art Store. Go to the Store Info tab in the Art Store in your dashboard, add your business name, email for order confirmation, and your country. Choose your email settings. Add location settings: e.g. currency, language, price format, and currency symbol alignment.

title: How can I create a free shipping coupon in Wix Stores?
content:
To create a free shipping coupon in Wix Stores:
- Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard.
- Click +New Coupon.
- Select Free Shipping.
- Enter the coupon code. This is the code customers enter.
- Enter the name of the coupon. It appears in the cart page and dashboard.
- Select an option from the Apply to drop-down:
  - All orders: The coupon can be used for any purchase.
  - Minimum order subtotal: The coupon can be used when the order subtotal is over a specific amount. Enter the amount.
- Select the Include subscriptions checkbox to apply this coupon to product subscriptions. This applies to every cycle.
- Select when the coupon is valid: enter the start date, and enter the end date or select the Don't set an end date checkbox.
- Optionally select the checkboxes next to the limits you want to apply:
  - Limit the total number of uses for this coupon: enter the total number of times the coupon can be used. Multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually.
  - Limit to one use per customer: each customer can use the coupon only once.
- Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I add a text mask element in Editor X and customize its text?
content: To add a text mask element in Editor X, click Add Elements at the top of Editor X, click Text, click Text Mask, then drag a text mask design you like onto your page. Some designs include a video background; hover over a design to see it in action. To customize the text on the text mask, click the new text mask you just added, click Change Text, and enter the text you want to appear.

title: How can I create a new automation in Wix Studio to send personalized emails to new leads?
content: In your Wix Studio workspace, go to Marketplace Overview, click the Automations tab under CRM Tools on the left, and click + New Automation at the top right. Choose whether to create the automation from scratch or from a template. Click the title to give your automation a name, then choose an app and set the trigger and action. Customize your automation by clicking + Add Delay, + Add Condition, or + Add Action as needed. When you are ready, click Activate.

title: I want to update the picture that appears when I share my website link with someone using my editor.
content: To change the og:image for an individual page: Click 'Pages & Menu' on the left Editor menu. Click the relevant page. Click 'More Actions'. Select 'Social share'. Click 'Upload Image'. Select an image or click '+ Upload Media' to upload a new one. Click 'Add to Page'. Publish your site. To change the og:image for your whole site: Open your site's settings. Click 'Website settings'. Scroll down to 'General social image' and click 'Upload Image'. Select an image or click '+ Upload Media' to upload a new one. Click 'Choose File' to add it. Click 'Save' at the top of the dashboard. Publish your site.

title: How do I create a new product category in Wix Stores?
content: Important: This is about the new version of product categories. Go to Categories in your site's dashboard. Click + New Category at the top right. Enter a category name (e.g. Men). Enter a category description. Add a category image: click the Add icon, select an image from your Media Manager or click Upload Media to upload an image, then click Add to Page.

title: Is it possible to transfer a guest's ticket from one event to another in Wix Events?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically transfer a guest's ticket from one event to another. Workaround: You can cancel the order and then add guests manually to a different event.

title: Can I add a color picker to my form using Wix Forms?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add a color picker to your form when using Wix Forms.

title: Does Wix Site Search work with Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, Wix Site Search doesn't work with Wix Multilingual. Wix Site Search works with Wix Blog, Bookings, and several other Wix apps, but it doesn't currently work with Wix Multilingual.

title: Can I add social icons directly to my galleries in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to add social icons to galleries. As an alternative, you can add a social bar to the page containing your gallery.

title: How can I connect Paymentwall as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: On your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Paymentwall. If you have a Paymentwall account, enter your Project Key and Wix Integration Secret, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Paymentwall account, register for a Paymentwall business account, then return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I whitelist my website in Avast if Avast is flagging free Wix sites for phishing?
content: The article provides a workaround to whitelist your website in Avast. Open Avast on your computer and go to the Avast dashboard. Click Menu, and click the Settings tab. Click the Exceptions tab under the General tab. Under this tab, click ADD EXCEPTION and a new window will appear. Type the URL that you want to add to your whitelist. Click ADD EXCEPTION to save the URL. The website and/or web form you want to access should now be available. The article also recommends reporting the false positive to Avast.

title: Can I offer delivery to pickup points in additional countries using Wix Stores?
content: With Wix Stores, you can offer delivery to pickup points in a variety of countries via third-party apps. Delivery to pickup points in additional countries is currently not supported.

title: How can I change the email address associated with my Wix account?
content: Go to Account Settings in your Wix account. Click the Account email field. Enter your Wix account password in the pop-up. Enter your new account email address, then retype it to confirm. Click Next. Check your email account for an email from Wix and copy the confirmation code. Go back to Account Settings, paste the code into the pop-up, and click Submit. Make sure the new email address is real and has no typos because Wix sends a code to verify it. Each Wix account needs a unique email address; you cannot use an email address already linked to another Wix account.

title: Why am I being asked to upgrade my Wix site when I already have a Premium or Studio site plan?
content:
Possible reasons why you might be asked to upgrade when you've already purchased a Premium or Studio site plan include:

* **You have more than one site:** Premium or Studio plans are for one site only. You are welcome to have more than one site in your account, however, each site needs to have its own site plan to access premium Wix features, such as connecting a domain or accepting payments.

* **You are signed in to the wrong account:** Make sure you are signed in to the account which contains your site plan. If you are having trouble finding your account, you can use our account recovery tool.

* **You are trying to use a service not covered by your site plan:** Wix offers a range of Premium or Studio site plans. Make sure that you choose a plan that includes all the services that you wish to offer. If you want to take payments on your site, for example, you must upgrade to a plan that allows you to accept payments.

title: How do I connect my Wix POS tablet to the accessories?
content: Unbox the Wix POS tablet and have the accessories ready. Carefully place the tablet with the screen facing down so you can access the ports; the tablet base can swivel. Plug the power adapter into the tablet’s USB Type C port, but do not connect it to the power outlet yet. Connect the barcode scanner via the USB-A port. For the printer: if you purchased an HP printer, connect it via the USB-C port. If your Epson m30 series printer connects via USB, connect it via the USB-C port; if it connects using another method, learn how to set up and connect your Epson printer. Connect the cash drawer to the printer using a RJ-12 connector. Finally, plug the power adapter into a power outlet.

title: Can I transfer my Austrian (.at) domain to Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to transfer an Austrian (.at) domain extension to Wix. However, you can connect a .at domain that you already own to your Wix site. To connect a domain to your site, you must upgrade your site with a plan.

title: I finished verifying my site with Google Search Console, but the Connect to Google step in the SEO Setup Checklist still shows as incomplete. What should I do?
content: If you previously verified your site with Google manually, your site is already connected. You don't need to connect your site in your SEO Setup Checklist. If the step is marked as not completed in your checklist, you can ignore it.

title: How can I add Apple Pay as a payment method on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments. Enable the toggle next to Apple Pay. You can disable the toggle at any time to remove Apple Pay from your payment options at checkout.

title: Can I change a domain name after purchase?
content: It is not possible to edit or modify a domain once purchased. When you register a domain name you reserve the letters or characters in that order. If you have already made the purchase, the only way to change the domain name is to register a new domain. Important: Domains purchased through Wix are set to renew automatically. We recommend that you turn the auto renewal option off for the incorrect domain to avoid paying for another year.

title: How can I rename the 'More' item in my Wix site menu?
content: To change the "More" menu item text in your Wix site menu: click your menu in the editor, click the Layouts icon, and edit the item text under Show an item that says:. To remove the "More" item, make your menu wider. Once there is enough room for all the pages, the "More" item is removed.

title: How can I add a podcast to my Wix Member App using the dashboard?
content:
Before you begin, go to the settings section of your podcast hosting platform and copy the RSS link.

In your site's dashboard:
- Go to Mobile App.
- Select the relevant tab (e.g. Spaces by Wix app, Branded Mobile App).
- Click Edit Mobile App.
- Click the Screen drop-down at the top and choose the screen you want to edit.
- Click Elements on the left.
- Scroll through the top menu and click Podcasts.
- Click the podcast element.
- Paste your RSS link in the Link to podcast field.
- Enable the Show title toggle to display and edit your podcast name.
- For Margins, drag the Margins sliders to adjust the padding for the button(s). To separately adjust the margins, click the Edit individually icon.
- For General Settings, click General Settings and under Element visibility choose which devices to show this button on: All, Android, or iOS.
- Click Save & Publish.

title: How can I connect a custom domain to my Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix?
content: You must upgrade to Hopp Pro before connecting a custom domain. In Hopp, log in, click Link in Bio on the left, click your Link in Bio URL at the top, and click Customize. From there you can buy a domain, connect a domain purchased with Wix, or connect a domain purchased outside Wix. For a new domain, search for availability, click Buy next to the relevant domain, enter payment details, click Submit Purchase, then click Connect Domain. For a Wix domain, click Connect a domain and click Connect next to the available domain. For an external domain, click Connect a domain, enter the domain, click Check, then click Continue next to the available domain. In each flow, choose whether to connect as a root domain or as a subdomain, click Continue, and click Done. For an external registrar, select your registrar from the Select your external registrar drop-down, or select Other if it is not listed, then follow the instructions for that registrar and click Done. Your domain is then connected. It may take up to an hour for visitors to view your Link in Bio page through the new domain. If you just purchased a new domain, it can take up to a few hours to connect fully, and you can still use your previous Hopp URL during that time.

title: How do I remove gaps under the Pro Gallery on a Wix mobile site?
content: Click the Pro Gallery in the mobile editor. Click Settings. Click the Layout tab. Click Customize Layout. Set the Info Bar Size to a lower number or to 0 to remove the empty space.

title: What happens when I edit my Facebook ad campaign after it goes live, and what should I do if it's rejected?
content:
When you decide to edit your campaign at any point after it goes live, it is automatically submitted to Facebook for another review. If your campaign is rejected by Facebook, it is most likely because it didn't comply with their advertising policies. Common reasons campaigns get rejected include adult content, alcoholic beverages, dating services, and election or political content.

If your campaign was rejected, an error message in the Facebook Ads dashboard will tell you to check specific issues that may have caused the rejection. Once you've fixed the issue, resubmit your campaign: go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard, click 'Edit & Resubmit' in the error message, make the necessary changes to your ad content as explained in the notification (remove certain products, change the text, etc.), click 'Submit Changes' at the top right, and click 'Submit Changes' in the pop-up to confirm.

title: How can I make bulk updates to rates, availability, and restrictions in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Bulk Updates in your site's dashboard. Click the Rate plans drop-down and select the relevant rate plan(s) you want to update. Enable the toggles next to the filters you want to add, such as Base price, Availability, Minimum Stay, Stop sell, Close to arrival (CTA), and Close to departure (CTD). Choose a date range for your bulk updates under Apply to. Optionally, click + Add date range to apply these bulk updates to another time. Click the Days drop-down to apply the bulk updates to specific days of the week. Click the Channels drop-down to apply the bulk updates to a specific channel. Click Preview Changes at the top right. Review your bulk updates, then click Save. Optionally, repeat the process to apply different bulk updates to other room types. Tip: Use the Multi-fill button to quickly apply the same updates to multiple rooms at the same time. As you add more filters to a bulk update, you may need to scroll across to enter the information.

title: How can I set the language for my single-language site on Wix to help accessibility?
content: To set your site's language for a single-language site on Wix, go to Settings in the site's dashboard. Select Language & Region. Select the Site language drop-down menu and set the language of your site.

title: How can I review and download my invoices from my Wix account?
content: You can review and download all of your Wix invoices directly from your Wix account. To review your invoices for Wix services: Go to Billing History in your Wix account. Click the filters or use the search field to search for an invoice. Click the More actions icon next to the relevant service. Click View Invoice.

title: How can I add a Post List element to my site using the Wix Editor?
content: Make sure you are on the page where you want to add the Post List. Then: click the Page drop-down menu at the top of the editor, select the page you want to add the Post List element to, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Blog, and click the Post List you want to use or drag it to position it on the page.

title: How can I search for a specific product in my Wix Store using the Store Products tab?
content: Go to Products in your site's dashboard, then enter a search term in the search field. You can search by product name or SKU. Note that if you assigned separate SKU numbers to product options, they do not come up in search results.

title: How can I share a specific FAQ question from my Wix site's dashboard?
content: Go to FAQs in your site's dashboard. Hover over the relevant questions and click the More Actions icon. Click Copy link. Select an option: Copy, Share on Facebook, or Share on Twitter.

title: Is it possible to resize the project page cover image in Wix Portfolio?
content: Currently, it is not possible to resize the project cover image. The layout that you select for your project page automatically affects the cover image ratio, proportion and size. As a workaround, you can manually change your project page layout to a different option.

title: How can I make the secondary language visible on my Wix site if the Language Menu is missing from the live site?
content: If the Language Menu doesn't appear on your live site but is still visible in your editor, your secondary language might be hidden. When your main language is the only visible language, the Language Menu is not displayed to visitors. Any time you add a secondary language to your site, it's hidden by default. When your translation is ready to go live, make the secondary language visible. Go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard. Ensure the secondary language is visible: click the Status drop-down next to the relevant secondary language and select Visible. In the editor, click Publish at the top right to publish your site.

title: How can I enable 2-step verification for my Wix account?
content: You can verify your account using 2-step verification with the Wix app, by SMS, with an authenticator app, or by email. You can enable more than one verification option at the same time. If you enable multiple options, the default prompt order is always: Wix app first, then an authenticator app, followed by SMS, and then email. To enable 2-step verification, go to Account Settings in your Wix account, scroll down to 2-Step verification, and click Enable next to your preferred method of verification.

title: How can I add and set up a Wix Blog on my site?
content: Go to wix.com and add the Wix Blog. You can easily add it to your site and choose from the beautiful layouts, then customize the look and feel to match your brand. When you install Wix Blog, 2 pages are added to your site: the blog feed and the blog post page. The blog feed displays all your blog posts, and the blog post page shows only one post at a time.

title: How can I manage my Wix Groups on the go?
content: You can manage most aspects of your group from the Wix app. Group members can join and interact with your group in your site's member app (e.g. Branded App by Wix, Spaces by Wix or Fit by Wix).

title: How can I add Afterpay as a payment method in Wix Payments?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Click Manage next to Wix Payments. Enable the toggle next to Afterpay. You can disable the toggle at any time to remove Afterpay from your payment options.

title: How can I add a form to my Wix site and customize it to match my site's design theme?
content: With Wix Forms, choose from premade forms or start from scratch to create your own custom form. Drag and drop the form directly onto your site, then customize it to match your site's design theme. You can modify pre-selected fields in a template or add fields such as contact fields, a signature field, and multiple choice options. You can also add conditional rules to improve how you collect information based on visitor responses, and if your form is too long, turn it into a multi-step form to make it more manageable for visitors to fill out.

title: How can I add and customize text in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
To add text to your Wix Pro Gallery items, click the Pro Gallery in your editor, click **Manage Media**, select an image or video, enter the image's title, description, and alt text in the relevant fields, then click **Done**.

To customize the design of the text, click the Pro Gallery in your editor, click **Settings**, click the **Design** tab, and click **Texts**. Choose which text you want to display: **Title** and/or **Description**. Then customize options such as **Info position** (**Underneath**, **Above**, **On image**, **Left**, or **Right**), **What happens to the info on hover?** (**Appears**, **Disappears**, or **No change**), **Title style & color**, **Description font style & color**, **Horizontal alignment**, **Vertical alignment**, **Adjust text box height** (**Automatically** or **Manually**), **Text vertical padding**, **Text horizontal padding**, and **Space between titles & description**.

**Note:** The text box feature is only available when you select **Underneath**, **Above**, **Left**, or **Right** as the info position in the Text tab of the Design settings panel.

title: Can I add a survey to my site using Wix ADI?
content: Currently, Wix ADI does not have a poll or survey feature, but you can add Wix Forms from the Editor. If you want to add a survey app, head to the Editor and follow the instructions.

title: What should I do if I am having issues viewing my live site after 48 hours of domain propagation?
content: If you are having issues viewing your live site after 48 hours of domain propagation, check which DNS records have propagated by going to whatsmydns.net, and use the Wix Technical Assistant to troubleshoot local issues.

title: How can I rename a file in the Wix Media Manager?
content: Go to your Media Manager. Hover over the relevant file or folder. Click the More Actions icon. Click Rename. Type the file's new name. Press Enter on your keyboard.

title: How can I add a new writer to my Wix blog using the Writers list?
content: To add a blog writer or blog editor from the Writers list, go to your blog in your dashboard, click the Writers tab in the panel on the left, click Add Writer at the top right, select the type of writer you want to add, and click Continue. Then choose whether to invite a new writer or create a managed writer. To invite, enter the person's email address, select the role (Blog Editor, Blog Writer, or Guest Writer), and click Send Invite. To create a managed writer, enter a name under Name, optionally add a profile picture and additional information, and click Save.

title: How can I manually mark a reservation as 'Paid' in the original Wix Hotels?
content: Once your guest has paid in full, go to your dashboard. Click the Hotels tab. Click the Reservations tab. Click the reservation on the calendar. Scroll down to the Payment Details section. Click Mark as paid. Click Yes, I'm Sure.

title: How can I reset my Google Workspace admin password from my Wix account?
content: Go to Business Email in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the admin email. Click Reset admin password. Enter your new password. Confirm your new password. Click Reset Password. If you are still unable to access your Google Workspace business email, refer to the Google Workspace Login Troubleshooter or the Google Workspace Help article.

title: How can I connect a pricing plan to Wix Booking services in the Wix App?
content:
To connect a new pricing plan to existing booking services in the Wix App:

- If you have not done so already, create the pricing plan and save your changes.
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Catalog.
- Tap Pricing Plans.
- Tap to select a plan.
- Tap Edit Plan.
- Scroll down to the Connect Benefits section.
- Tap Connect Services or Manage Services.
- Select the type of plan you want to offer: Membership or Package.
- Tap to select the booking services you want to connect in the What services are included? section.
- Tap Save.
- Tap Save to save the pricing plan.

title: What should I do if I encounter a URL error when adding a link to my email marketing campaign?
content: If you receive an error when trying to add a URL to your campaign, it's likely the URL is blacklisted. Check the URL you are adding to your campaign against the following blacklist checkers: Spamhaus, Barracuda, and Spamcop. If the URL is shown as blacklisted, you cannot add it to your campaign.

title: What apps can I use to allow visitors to chat with me directly on my Wix site?
content: You can use the following chat apps: Wix Chat, LiveChat, and Tidio Live Chat. The Wix App Market offers chat apps that allow visitors to chat with you directly or create a chat room for you to interact with your community.

title: How can I fix an unresponsive mobile menu on my Wix site if elements are overlapping the menu?
content: If elements are overlapping the menu and causing it to be unresponsive, select the menu and arrange it to be in front. Click Layers on the Editor Toolbar, click Header, Page or Footer, select the Menu icon from the list, right-click the icon, click Arrange, then click Bring to Front.

title: How can I contact the Enterprise team for a custom solution on Editor X?
content:
If you're interested in a custom solution for your brand, visit this page and fill out the form. One of our team members will get in touch directly to offer more detailed information about our solutions, pricing and payment terms.

Note: If you would like to be contacted by phone / email, or at a certain time, mention this in the form so we can accommodate your needs.

title: How can I upload a video from my Wix Video Library to my Facebook Business page?
content:
To upload a video from your Wix Video Library to your Facebook Business page, follow these steps:

- Go to your Video Library.
- Select which video you want to upload.
- Click the More Actions icon.
- Click Upload to Social.
- Click Upload under the Facebook icon.
- Log in to your account in the new window.
- Select Continue as yourself.
- Select who can see the post and click Okay.
- If you manage several pages, select the pages that the Wix App has permission to post on.
- Edit your post:
  - Video Title: Give the video a title. The name of the video as it appears in your library appears by default.
  - Upload to: If you've given permissions for more than one page, select which page you want to post on.
  - What do you want to upload?: Select to post either a 20 second preview or the whole video. If it's a paid video with a trailer, you can upload the trailer.
  - Video Description: Write the text that serves as both the content of your post and the video's description once it is saved. A text with a link back to your site appears by default.
- Click Upload Now.

Note: Currently, it is only possible to upload to a Facebook Business page, not to your personal page.

title: How do I connect Razorpay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to the Accept Payments tab on your dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Razorpay. If you have an existing account, enter your Key Id, Key Secret, and Site URL, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Razorpay account and fill in Razorpay's registration form. Once your Razorpay account is approved, sign in and retrieve your account credentials (Key Id and Key Secret). Return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I update my payment method in Wix if my renewal payment was declined?
content: If a renewal payment fails or is declined, you can update your payment method to a credit or debit card. In your Wix account, go to Premium Subscriptions and click Update Payment Method under the relevant subscription. Update your payment card details and click Submit. Once you have updated your payment details, the system attempts to process the payment again. You can also update your payment method on the Payment Methods page in your Wix account. If you are updating your Wix account payment method, you can update it to a debit / credit card, or PayPal if that option is available in your region.

title: Can I create a dynamic link that visitors click to send emails?
content: Yes. Create a URL field type in your collection for storing the email addresses. Add the email addresses to the field with mailto: at the beginning of each address (e.g. mailto:support@email.com). Link a button or image to a dataset that connects to this URL field. When visitors click the link, their email client opens with the relevant address in the 'To:' field.

title: How can I change the header scroll effect on my Wix mobile site?
content:
Note: Your mobile and desktop can have different header scroll effects.

To change the scroll effect on your mobile header:

* Click the header in your mobile Editor.
* Click **Change Header Scroll**.
* Select an option:

**Scrolls with site:** The header is always at the top of the site and scrolls with it.

**Freezes:** The header is always at the top of the mobile screen. This effect does not work if your header is larger than half the screen size.

**Disappears:** The header disappears when you scroll down the site, but is at the top of the screen when you scroll upward.

**Fades out:** The header slowly disappears as you scroll down the page. It reappears as you scroll upward.

Important note about the freeze scroll effect: If your header has too much content and is too big on mobile, the freeze scroll effect is disabled on the live mobile site. This is because when set to frozen, the header would cover the entire viewport of the mobile device and the rest of the site content would not be visible at all.

title: Can I change the font color of translated product descriptions in the Wix Multilingual dashboard?
content: Currently, the color you set for your product description in the Product Settings tab of the dashboard cannot be carried over to the Multilingual dashboard. The translated description remains all one color in the Multilingual Dashboard - black. However, you can change the color of your product description from black to another color in the Wix Editor. Learn how to customize your product description.

title: How can I replace the retired 'Download My App' with a new app on my Wix site?
content: Download My App has been retired from the Wix App Market. As an alternative, you can add the Download the Mobile App application from the Wix App Market. To add Download the Mobile App, go to the Wix App Market, search for 'Download the Mobile App', and click Add to Site under Download the Mobile App. Download the Mobile App lets you boost engagement by inviting visitors to interact with your business from anywhere, send visitors a direct link to download and join you on the app, customize the SMS that your visitors will receive, and choose the text, design and more to match your brand. It also has a modern design and improved performance compared to the previous app.

title: What is the temporary workaround when blog posts connected to pricing plans show the full post instead of the preview?
content: Temporary workaround (this will remove the preview entirely): Enter Post composer for Post; Click monetize; Move preview to the top to remove the entire preview; Republish post; Refresh live site.

title: How can I connect my existing Paytm for Business account as a payment provider in Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Paytm Payment Gateway. Enter your Merchant ID and Merchant Secret Key, then click Connect.

title: Can I create a QR code directly in the Wix Logo Maker?
content: Currently, it is not possible to create a QR code and add it to your brand designs in the Wix Logo Maker. However, you can create and download a QR code using the Wix QR Code Generator, and upload it as an image to your brand designs.

title: Can I customize the spacing between paragraphs in a single text field in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to manually customize the spacing between paragraphs in a single text field. As an alternative, you can add each paragraph separately and adjust the spacing between them. Open the relevant page in the Editor, add a text element for each paragraph, enter your text into the fields, and drag the text elements into place on the page, leaving as much space in between as you need. You can customize your text's line spacing using the Edit Text panel.
