title: How can I clear my browser's cache in Google Chrome to resolve website issues?
content: Close all windows and tabs of your browser. Open a new tab, ensuring Wix.com is not open. In Chrome, press Ctrl + Shift + Del (press Cmd + Shift + Delete using a Mac). Click the drop-down next to Time range and select All time. Make sure the box is checked next to Cached images and files. Click Clear data. Close and reopen Chrome. If you are still experiencing issues after clearing the cache, try flushing your system's DNS. If this doesn't resolve the issues, follow the instructions for disabling add-ons and extensions in the Wix Technical Assistant.

title: Can I create a real estate listings site using the CMS?
content: Yes. It is now possible to create a real estate listings site using the CMS (Content Management System). If you are creating a new site, you can choose a real estate template from the templates page. Alternatively, you can add the Property Listings CMS preset to your existing site, then replace the demo properties with your own.

title: Can I switch my Wix Payments account type from individual to business on my own?
content: Once you've set up your Wix Payments account, it is not possible to change your account type from individual / sole proprietorship to partnership / LLC / Corporation / NGO, or vice versa, within your Wix Payments account. If you are looking to switch from an individual to a business Wix Payments account, our Customer Care team can do it for you. Please check that you have all the necessary documents to verify your business Wix Payments account and contact Customer Care.

title: How can I create an automation in Wix Bookings to send discount coupons to clients after they book a session?
content: In Wix Automations, go to Automations in your site's dashboard, click + New Automation or edit an existing one, and give it a name. Select Bookings as the trigger, then choose a trigger such as **Session is booked** under Select a trigger for this app. Choose which services the coupon automation applies to from the Select which services trigger this automation drop-down. Select **Send coupon via email** as the action. Under Set Coupon, choose whether to send unique single-use coupons or always send the same coupon. Select an existing coupon template or create a new one, and optionally edit the coupon details, sender details, and email template. Use the Timing drop-down to set when and how often coupons are sent. Optionally add a follow-up action, then click **Activate**. Note: The automation stops working when the coupon's end date or use limit is reached. Tip: You can also create up to 1,000 coupons, each with unique codes, using the free Bulk Coupon Creator app; the app currently works with Wix Stores, Bookings and Events.

title: How do I create a site using Wix Editor and what are the steps involved?
content: To create a site with Wix Editor: set up your Wix account and business dashboard, then click Design Site. You can use the AI tool or customize a professionally designed template; Wix offers 800+ website templates, and apps can be added to any template in seconds. In the Wix Editor, customize every part of your site, including text, media, and layout: add and edit text, add media or upload your own, and add animations such as "Float-in" and "Expand-in". When you are happy, publish your site. After publishing, optimize your site's SEO using the SEO Setup Checklist.

title: How can I get started with Hopp by Wix and create a Link in Bio page?
content: Go to hopp.co. Click Get Started for Free at the top right. Log in with your Wix account or create a new account. Choose a name and username for your Link in Bio page and click Create Account. Set up your Link in Bio page. You will then be on the main Hopp dashboard. View your own unique Link in Bio URL in the Link in Bio tab. Click Create New to start building out your Hopp page.

title: How can I create a new workflow using Wix Workflows?
content: Go to Workflows in your site's dashboard. Click + New at the top right, then New Workflow to see the template list. Choose a template that suits your needs, such as Sales Leads, Hiring Process, Help Desk & IT, Website Design, Online Store, Business Meetings, or Site Members. If you can't find a template that works for you, click Start from Scratch to define your own custom steps.

title: How can I assign a badge to a site member from the dashboard on my Wix site?
content: Before you begin, install a Members Area on your site. Then go to Site Members in the dashboard. Click More Actions at the top right and click Manage Badges. Click the Show More icon on the relevant badge, click Edit, click the Members tab at the top, and click Assign Members. Select the members you want to assign the badge to, then click Add.

title: How can I add a preset interaction to an element in Editor X?
content:
To add a preset interaction to an element in Editor X, start by selecting the element that should trigger the interaction. Then click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X, click the Interactions tab, and click + Add under Hover / Click.

In the Interaction Setup panel, choose what happens On Hover / On Click:
- Start Animation: Clicking / Hovering over the element triggers the chosen animation.
- Reset Animation: Clicking / Hovering over the element removes any animation that was previously applied.
- Toggle On/Off: Clicking the element triggers the animation and a second click removes it. Note: This option is only available for click interactions.

Select the Animated element:
- Make the element trigger its own animation: Click the element's name (the word (self) appears next to it).
- Animate a different element on the page: Select an element from the drop-down, or click Choose on Canvas to select it on the page.

Select an animation by clicking the Presets tab and choosing an animation from the list.

Optional: In the Inspector, click Adjust Animation at the bottom and customize the available settings: Delay, Duration, Easing, Scale, Angle, Distance, and Direction. You can also click Preview to see how your animation looks and make adjustments if needed. Note: The available settings depend on the preset animation you choose.

title: How can I add a scroll animation to my Wix Pro Gallery and customize its settings?
content: To add a scroll animation to your Wix Pro Gallery, click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor, click Settings, click the Design tab, click Scroll Animations, and select an animation such as No effect, Fade in, Grayscale, Slide up, Expand, Shrink, Zoom out, or One color. Fun scroll animations are available in all gallery layouts except the Magic layout, and available animation effects depend on the layout you choose. To customize animation settings, click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor, click Settings, click the Design tab, click Scroll Animations, click Customize Animations, then edit the Transition style by choosing from the drop-down and adjust Duration by dragging the slider. Preview your site to see your animations in action. Note that you can only customize animations for layouts with a horizontal scroll.

title: How can I access and view different types of reports in Wix Blog Analytics?
content: Go to the Analytics & Reports page in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Blog Reports section. Select the relevant report. To switch views within a report, click the relevant tab at the top of the report to access different chart types. Depending on the report, you may see different viewing options.

title: Is there a 'Remember Me' option available on the member login form?
content: No. Currently, it is not possible to let members save their login details on the member login form so they can automatically sign in to their account in the future (a "Remember Me" option). Members need to enter their login details every time they access your site. As a workaround, members can enable password saving in their browser's password settings to remember their credentials.

title: How can I activate a pre-installed SMS automation in Wix?
content: To activate a pre-installed SMS automation in Wix, go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click the Installed for you tab under Your automations to view the available pre-installed automations. You can identify an SMS automation by the action 'Send an SMS'. Click the More Actions icon next to the automation you want to activate, then click the Inactive toggle to enable it. This also changes the Status column to show that the automation is now active.

title: How can I connect a domain purchased from another registrar to my Wix site?
content: If you already own a domain from another domain registrar, you can either transfer or connect it to Wix. Transferring a domain makes Wix your new domain host, so you can manage your domain's contact information, DNS settings, and registration payments directly from your Wix account. Connecting a domain means your domain host remains outside of Wix, and you can connect a domain to your Wix account in two ways: via 'name servers' or 'pointing'.

title: How can customers edit their saved addresses and credit card details in the Members Area for fast checkout?
content:
Customers can manage their address list in two ways:

**On the checkout page:**
Customers can click **Edit** to select a different delivery or billing address, edit an address, or add a new address.

**After logging in to your site:**
- Click **My Addresses** to view their saved addresses, select a default address, and add, edit or delete an address.
- Click **My Wallet** to edit or delete a saved credit card.

title: How can I limit registration to a private event on Wix to only approved site members?
content: Before you begin, make sure you have a Members Area added to your site. Then: Go to Events in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to the relevant event. Click the Settings tab. Click Edit next to Registration settings. Select Only site members under Event permissions. Click Save. Set up your site signup form so only people you approve can become site members. Note: This prevents site visitors who aren't invited to your private event from logging in and registering. Optional: Hide the Events Details page from search engines.

title: How can I manage my social logins for my Wix account?
content:
To manage your social logins:
- Sign in to your Wix account.
- Hover over the user panel and click Account Settings.
- Click Enable or Disable next to the relevant social account.

Enabled: Sign in to the social account and allow access. Disabled: The social account is disconnected.

Notes:
- If you disable social logins, you'll still be able to log in using your Wix email and password.
- Apple gives you the option to create an Apple generated email address. If using this option, be sure to remember the correct Apple email for use in your Wix account. Learn how to manage your Apple ID.
- You can always update your email address in Account Settings.

title: How can I set up how clients earn points in my Wix Events loyalty program?
content:
To set up how your clients earn points:

1. Enable the toggle next to the action(s) that should allow clients to earn points.
2. Hover over an action and click Edit to customize it:
   - Give the action a title.
   - Choose the action: Each purchase or Every $1 spent. Clients earn points based on your site currency.
   - Set the number of points clients earn for the action.
3. Click Next.

points based on spending are rounded down to the nearest whole number. For example, if you reward 10 points per $1, a spend of $4.99 earns 40 points.

title: How can I add an appointment waitlist to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor and open your Book Online page. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Bookings Pages, and click the Booking Calendar page. Click the Booking Calendar element on your page, click the Plugins icon, hover over Appointment Waitlist, and click + Add. Note: the source states that the appointment waitlist is currently being released and is not available to everyone yet.

title: How can I customize images for different languages using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top, then select the language you want to edit. Click Pages & Menu on the left side, select the page you want to edit, select the relevant image on your page, and click Edit Translation. Set up the image for the language: click Change to select a different image for the secondary language; under When image is clicked, select an option; under What does this link to?, select an option; under What's in the image?, enter an image description; under Does this image have a tooltip?, enter tooltip text. Tip: If you've specified different images for each language, changing the main language image won't affect the others. However, if an image hasn't been set for a specific language, updating the main language image will change it for all languages.

title: How can I add the Pricing Plans app in the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Manage Apps. Tap Add next to Pricing Plans. Now you're ready to create your first pricing plan.

title: How can I connect FIBONATIX as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers, then click Connect next to FIBONATIX. If you have an account, enter your login, control & endpoint and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create FIBONATIX account and fill in the information to create your account. Once your account is created, retrieve your credentials (login, control & endpoint) from FIBONATIX, return to this window, repeat the connection steps, and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: How can I optimize images on my Wix site to improve loading times?
content:
To optimize images on your Wix site and improve loading times:
- Choose the correct media format. JPEGs are better optimized for web; unless you need transparency, choose JPEG over PNG because JPEG images are smaller in download size while being of similar quality.
- SVG graphics, also known as vector art, are lighter and load at higher speed than other image formats, and resizing the image does not affect its quality or sharpness. Vector art is recommended for decorative shapes or business logos.
- For GIFs, modern video encoding formats have better quality and smaller size, so video files are preferred to GIF animations. Videos can be placed inside VideoBoxes, which support transparent videos.
- Upload the best possible quality images. For best results, upload images of at least 2560 X 1440 pixels in resolution; Wix optimizes them to the exact dimensions displayed on the screen without loss of quality.
- Wix automatically optimizes images for best online quality and fast download. Unless your file is over 25MB, you do not need to resize or compress it before uploading.
- Divide large background images into sections roughly the same length of a screen so other images have time to load as visitors scroll down your page.
- When you upload an image to your site, it is automatically converted to WebP format, as it is better optimized for site performance.

title: How can I create a new video channel on Wix?
content: Go to Video Library in your site’s dashboard. Click the Channels tab on the left. Click New Channel on the top right corner. Select Channel from the drop-down. This opens the new channel's customization page.

title: Can I customize the mobile view of my restaurant menu and online ordering app?
content: Yes. It is now possible to customize the mobile view of your restaurant menu and online ordering app. This feature is also available with the Wix Restaurants Menus (NEW) app and Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I adjust the layout of a lightbox in Wix Editor?
content:
Go to your editor.
- Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor.
- Click Lightboxes.
- Click the relevant lightbox to open it.
- Select the lightbox in the editor.
- Click the Layout icon.
- Choose how you want to adjust the layout:
  - Set position: Click a rectangle on the grid to set the position of your lightbox on the page.
  - Horizontal offset: Move the box to the left or right of the screen.
  - Vertical offset: Move the box up or down on the screen.

title: How can I add a new room type in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Room Types in the dashboard. Click + Create Room Type. Select the relevant room type from the Kind of room drop-down, then click Next. Enter your room's details: Display name, Adult capacity, Total capacity, and Number of rooms. Choose Accommodation from the Revenue Account drop-down, then click Next. Enter your base price details: Base Price (per night), Set base price for what occupancy?, and Different occupancy using Percentage or Fixed amount. Click Next. Click the checkbox next to the amenities you offer in this room type, then click Next. Click the Add Photo icon to upload photos of this room. The maximum image size is 2MB. Click Complete. When ready, click Save at the top.

title: Can I transfer my online store from one Wix site to another?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to transfer an online store from one site to another.

In the meantime, you can try any of the following:

- Export and then import products: Export your original store's products, then import the file to your new store.
- Duplicate your site to create a new one: You can duplicate your current site and use that as a starting point for building a new site. This duplicates the product list and categories. Note that duplicating your site does not duplicate the rest of your store information, such as payment methods, shipping rules or tax settings.
- Transfer your store to another Wix account: You can transfer your site, together with your store, from one Wix account to another.

title: How can I edit the details of an order in Wix Stores?
content:
Go to Orders in your site's dashboard, click the relevant order, click More Actions, and select Edit order. From there you can add an item, remove an item, change an item variant, add a custom item, edit the price of an item, or add a fee, tip, or discount.

To add an item, click Add Item, select the product, service, or menu item you want to add, click Add to Order, optionally enter a note under Reason for editing, click Update Order, optionally select Email the customer about changes made to this order, and click Update Order to confirm.

To remove an item, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant item, select Remove, for store orders deselect Update inventory, click Update Order, optionally select Email customer about changes made to this order, and click Update Order to confirm. If it is too late to remove an item, you can refund all or part of the order.

To change an item variant, remove the item and add it again with the correct variant using the instructions above.

To add a custom item, click Add Item, select +Add Custom Item, enter a title, enter the price, optionally enter additional info about the order, click Add to Order, optionally enter a note about why you edited the order, click Update Order, optionally select Email the customer about changes made to this order, and click Update Order to confirm.

To edit the price of an item, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant item, select Edit price, enter a new price and click Apply, click Update Order, and click Update Order to confirm.

To add a fee or tip, click Add Fees & Tips on the right, enter the name, enter the amount, and click Add. To add a discount, click Add Discount on the right, enter the discount reason, enter the amount, and click Add Discount.

You cannot edit orders containing a store subscription, or orders that were already partly or fully refunded.

title: Why aren't images displayed in my email campaigns?
content: Some mail providers prevent images and multimedia content from appearing directly in the email. Instead, the following message is displayed: Keep in mind, such settings are not determined by Wix but rather the mail provider receiving the email. Note: If automatic picture downloads in Outlook are blocked, information in the footer of your email campaigns can appear cropped. Find out how to block and unblock automatic picture downloads in Microsoft Outlook.

title: How can I connect Oceanpayment as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Oceanpayment. If you have an account, enter your Terminal and SecureCode and click Connect. If you don't have an account, click Create Oceanpayment account, fill in the registration form and click Send, wait for an email or chat message from Oceanpayment to get your Terminal and SecureCode, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the steps under Have an account. Make sure the currency in your Wix account matches the currency in your Oceanpayment account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: Can I print my Wix Table Reservations directly from the dashboard?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to print your table reservations list.

### Workaround
Export and download the reservations to print them out. Go to Reservations in your site's dashboard and click the export icon. Afterward, you can save the file as .pdf and print it as needed.

title: How do I download my Wix Analytics reports?
content:
Download your Wix Analytics reports to your computer for offline review or sharing. You can choose from various file formats like Excel, CSV, or Image (PNG).

To download a report:
Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard.
Select a report.
Click the Download drop-down at the top right.
Select a file format (Excel, CSV, or Image).

title: How can I disable the Event Details Page for events without tickets on my Wix site?
content: Click any of the Wix Events pages in the Editor, click the Settings icon, click the Pages tab, and click the "Show this page when visitors register" toggle to disable it. When disabled, guests who click to register for an event are directed straight to the Registration Page.

title: How can I add a link to a button on my website using ADI?
content:
To add a link to a button on your website using ADI, follow these steps:

- Hover over the section of your site with the button.
- Click **Edit**.
- Click **Link** below the button text field.
- Select a link type:
   * **None**: No link.
   * **Page**: The link leads to a page on your site. Select the page from the **Select Page** drop-down menu, then select the location on the page from the **Where on Page** drop-down menu.
   * **Web Address**: The link leads to a web address. Enter the website address.
   * **Document**: The link leads to a document. Click **Select File**, then select an existing file from **My Docs** or click **Upload Docs** to add a new file.
   * **Email**: The link opens a new email message.
   * **Phone**: The link activates a telephone call for visitors browsing from a mobile device.
   * **PayPal Donations**: The link leads to PayPal so that your visitors can make a donation. Enter your PayPal email address, then click the **Fixed Amount** toggle: if **Enabled**, enter the fixed amount you want your visitors to donate and select the currency; if **Disabled**, your visitors can choose how much they want to donate.
- Click **Done**.

title: How can I add a Members Area to my Wix site so guests who log in can access event information?
content:
To add a Members Area to your Wix site:

Wix Editor
- Click Add on the left side of the Editor.
- Click the Community tab.
- Click Members.
- Click Add to Site.

Editor X
- Click Add Elements at the top bar of Editor X.
- Click the Members tab.
- Click Add to Site.

Once added, members who log in can view complete events details, download tickets for ticketed events, save their details so they can quickly sign up for future events, see who else is going to an event if enabled, share events on social media if enabled, and more. You can limit registration for an event to site members only.

title: Can I add a form to the Cart Page in Wix Stores?
content: Forms can now be created on the Checkout Page by adding custom fields. To vote for the ability to add a form to the Cart Page, use the voting option on the source page.

title: How can I create a new photo album using Wix Photo Albums?
content: If Wix Photo Albums is already installed on your site, go to Photo Albums in your site's dashboard, click + New Album, select a style for the album cover and click Next, select a layout for the photos and click Next, enter your business name or upload your logo and click Next, enter your album's name and date and click Next, choose + Upload Media to upload your photos or Import files from your media manager, click Create Album at the bottom right, design your photo album using the available options, and click Publish Now at the top right. Note: as of April 2024, it is no longer possible to add the Wix Photo Albums app to your site; existing installations can still be used as normal. For selling digital prints, Wix recommends Wix Stores; to display images, add a Wix Pro Gallery.

title: How can I set a ticket limit per order for an event in Wix Events?
content:
To set a ticket limit per order for an event in Wix Events:
- Go to the Events tab in your site's dashboard.
- Click to select the relevant event.
- Click the Tickets tab.
- Click Edit next to Ticket Settings.
- Enter a ticket limit per order under Ticket Limit. The maximum number of tickets per order you can set is 50.
- Click Save.

Note: As soon as a guest selects a ticket and starts the checkout process, that ticket can't be purchased by other guests. After 20 minutes, if checkout isn't completed, the ticket is available again. If this happens with the last available ticket(s), an event's status might change from available, to sold out, and back to available again.

title: Can I use AI to write project and collection descriptions in Wix Portfolio?
content: You can now use AI to generate text automatically for your project and collection descriptions.

title: How can I access the Manage Wix Payments page to see available payment methods?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Click Manage next to Wix Payments.

title: How can I add a text mask element in the Wix Studio Editor?
content: To add a text mask element in the Wix Studio Editor, go to the Add Elements panel, click Text, click Text Mask, then drag a text mask design you like onto the page. To enter the text that should appear on the element, click the new text mask you just added, click Change Text, and enter the text you want to appear. Best practice: We recommend adding up to 10 text masks per page, to ensure the best site performance on mobile.

title: Can I display more than one column in a product gallery on mobile using the Studio Editor?
content: While you can display multiple columns in a product gallery on desktop and tablet, it is not possible to show more than one column of products on mobile.

title: What happens if I do not comply with the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use?
content: If you do not comply with the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use, you will be blocked from using Wix Email Marketing. In such cases, Wix is unable to lift the restriction or provide refunds.

title: Can Wix Events display event times in guests' local time zones?
content: Currently, event times are displayed in your time zone, based on your Language & Regional settings. It's not possible to display event times in your guests' local time zones.

title: How can I create a free plan for my customers using the Wix dashboard?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Pricing Plans and click + Create Plan. Enter the plan details in the Plan Info section, including the plan name, a cover image, an optional tagline, and perks under Tell customers what the main features are. Scroll down to Benefits and select the services or content types to include, then add the relevant details. Select Free under Pricing options. Choose the plan duration from the Length of Plan drop-down: Monthly, Until canceled, or Custom. In Settings, you can enable the option so customers can only purchase the plan once, allow plan cancellation in My Subscriptions, and add a policy that appears on the checkout page. You can also add custom form fields for clients to fill and customize a Thank You page. Click Save at the top to finish creating your plan. When clients subscribe to the free plan, they have instant access to its perks and benefits. During setup, the Let people choose their start date toggle is disabled because the plan is active immediately and does not require payment.

title: How can I set up a card reader for accepting payments using POS Checkout on my desktop?
content: To accept in-person payments with a card reader, connect to Wix Payments and purchase the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader. You can buy the reader from the Wix POS shop or anywhere it is sold. Then enable Wix Point of Sale in your site's dashboard: go to Accept Payments and click Accept or enable the toggle next to Tap to Pay. This card-reader payment option is currently available only for merchants in the US and Canada.

title: How can I create a new site in Wix Studio for enterprise?
content: In your enterprise dashboard, go to Sites and click Create New Site at the top right. Then choose how you want to create your website, such as Studio template, Studio blank canvas, Use Wix Editor, Use your own template, or Start from Scratch.

title: How do I manage inventory and set a product's inventory status in my Wix store using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Store Products, or tap Catalog and select Store Products. Tap to select the relevant product. To manage inventory automatically, enable the Track Inventory toggle and enter the stock quantity. To manage inventory manually, disable the Track Inventory toggle and select In Stock or Out of Stock. Then tap Save.

title: How can I manage my online program from my site's dashboard?
content: Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the program you want to edit, then select an option: Edit Settings to edit program details such as program name, description, price, groups and badges and other settings; Publish to publish a draft and invite participants through an invitation link or an email campaign; End to end an active program; Duplicate to make a copy in the Draft tab; Archive to send the program to the Archived tab, where it cannot be unarchived and participants will no longer be able to view it, though current participants can still see it and it will not be visible on your live site, and to show it on your site you must duplicate the program and publish it as a new program; Delete to permanently delete a program you no longer need.

title: Can I use employee meal cards to order online with Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, Wix Restaurants does not support online ordering using employee meal cards. You can vote for this feature. It is now possible to accept payments with digital wallets using the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

title: How can I customize the text on my logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
content:
To customize text in the Wix Logo Maker:

To add new text:
- Click Text on the left.
- Click + Add Text.
- Enter your text under Edit text and customize it as needed.

To customize existing text:
- Click the existing text on your logo.
- Use the available text options: Edit text, Change Font, Alignment (left, center, right), Text color, Text opacity, Outline width, Outline color, Letter spacing, Flip, Rotate, Text Curve, Horizontal position, Vertical position, Shadow, and Blur.

Note: Under Wix Logo Terms of Use, every logo is required to have a business name. It is not possible to have a logo with an icon only.

title: Can I use the Wix Retail POS to sell products from Wix Restaurants?
content: Currently, the Wix Retail Point of Sale (POS) tablet solution for physical stores can only be used to sell Wix Stores products.

title: How can I add a webhook to online ordering notifications in Wix Restaurants?
content:
To add a webhook to online ordering notifications in Wix Restaurants:
- Go to Order Settings in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Notifications tab.
- Click + Add New Notification.
- Under Receive Orders, select Webhook from the drop-down list.
- Enter the webhook URL.
Note: The URL must begin with HTTPS. Once a webhook notification is successfully received, the order is considered "accepted". An unhandled alert will not be triggered.

title: How can I set up an automatic discount so customers who buy multiple quantities of the same product get a reduced price?
content: Use automatic discounts in Wix Stores. Go to Automatic Discounts in your site's dashboard, click Create Discount, select Standard discount and click Continue. Enter the discount name customers see during checkout. Select Specific products and choose the product or products the discount applies to. To require multiple quantities, select the Minimum quantity of items checkbox and enter the number of items. Select the discount type from the What is the discount? drop-down and enter the required percentage, amount, or price. Set the start date and, optionally, an end date, then click Save.

title: How do I connect the BBPOS Chipper 2X card reader to my tablet?
content: To connect the BBPOS Chipper 2X card reader to your tablet: open the POS tablet, tap the Connect Reader icon at the bottom right, tap Set up Card Reader, tap Connect next to the relevant reader, and then tap Done.

title: Can I transfer my expired Wix domain to another host, and what should I be aware of during the process?
content: You can transfer an expired domain to another domain host as long as the domain is in the grace period (about 30 days from its expiration date). Once the grace period ends and the domain enters the redemption period, it is no longer possible to transfer the domain. If your attempt to transfer an expired domain fails, your domain may enter the redemption period which has a $100 retrieval fee. We recommend extending your expired domain before initiating a transfer. When extending your domain, make sure not to change its contact info, as this will lock your domain from transfer for 60 days. The grace period does not apply for certain domains: .at, .be, .ch, .co.at, .com.br, .or.at, .de, .fr, .me, .mx, and .nl. Renewal payments for these domains are collected 30 days before the expiration date. If a payment isn't made, your domain enters the redemption period 2 days before the expiration date.

title: How can I create a view-only service using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard. Click + Add a New Service. Scroll to the type of service you want to create: Appointment, Class or Course. Then choose what you want to do: click Edit below the relevant service template, or click + Start from Scratch to use a blank template. Complete the form to create your service. Scroll down and click the Booking preferences section. Disable the Online bookings toggle to create a view-only service. Click Save.

title: How can I create a new announcement using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile Announcements under Marketing. Tap Create New Announcement. Write your announcement title and body text. To include media in your announcement, tap the Add icon at the bottom left; media can include an image, video, GIF or a divider. Tap Next. Optionally enable the Send announcement as a push notification toggle to send notifications from your site to your members' mobile devices. If the toggle is disabled, the announcement is created on your site only and members don't receive any notifications. Tap Publish.

title: How can I require buyers to fill out a registration form for each ticket they purchase in Wix Events?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Events and select the relevant ticketed event. Click the Settings tab, then click Edit next to Registration form. Select Fill out a registration form for each ticket in an order, then click Save at the top right. You can view the purchase history and buyer information on the Orders tab, but the information about the individual guests is saved on the Guests tab.

title: How can I add a section to my menu in the Wix Editor?
content: To add a section to your menu in the Wix Editor: Click your site menu, then click **Manage Menu**. At the bottom of the panel, click **Add Menu Item** / **Add a menu item**. For advanced menus, select **Section** from the list; for site menus, click **Section or anchor**. Select the page the section is on from the dropdown menu, select the section from the dropdown menu, and click **Done**.

title: Why am I not seeing my Google AdSense ads on my site?
content:
Check whether any of the following is causing the problem:

- Ad was activated less than 48 hours ago: After you enter a new ad code or edit an existing ad, it can take up to 48 hours for the new ad to appear. Wait until at least 48 hours have passed to see if the problem resolves itself.
- Ad is blocked by security software or a browser extension: Google AdSense ads can be blocked by browser settings or ad blocking browser extensions/add-ons such as AdBlock. Check whether popups are blocked by your browser in Chrome, Firefox, Internet Explorer, Microsoft Edge, or Safari. In your browser settings, check whether any browser extensions/add-ons that block popups are enabled. Another way to test if ads are blocked on your computer is to open your browser window in incognito mode. If you are able to see ads, disable your browser extensions and Internet monitoring software applications one at a time. This may help determine which ones are blocking your ads. Note that ads blocked on your computer can display on other computers; you do not need to take any further action.
- Site no longer has the same domain: Compare your site's domain name to the domain name listed in the Sites tab of your Google AdSense dashboard. Remove the incorrect domain and add your site's new domain name. If you failed to renew your domain, go to the Domains tab in your site's dashboard and connect your domain. If you connected a new domain to your site, add your site's new URL to the list in the Sites tab in the AdSense Dashboard.
- Site verification status in Google AdSense is "unverified": If changes were made to a verified site, ads may no longer display. Check your verification status; if the site is unverified, take steps to re-verify your site.
- Site has a policy violation: If your site does not comply with one of Google AdSense policies, ads won't display. In the AdSense dashboard, click the Account tab, select Policy Center, and check for policy violations. Take appropriate action to fix the specific problem.

If you have followed all the steps above and still don't see ads on your site, contact Google to find out the specific reason that ads are not displaying on your site.

title: How can I customize the layout of my All Posts feed in Wix Blog?
content: To customize the layout of your All Posts feed in Wix Blog: go to your editor, then go to your Blog page. Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Blog Pages, and click your Blog page. Click Settings, click the Layout tab, then click the All Posts Feed tab. Choose a layout from the options available, such as Side by Side, Editorial, Tiled, Magazine, Full Post, or One Column. The available customization options can include image resizing, image ratio, text alignment, layout settings, and post loading.

title: How can I enable shipping to pickup points using Boxtal in my Wix store?
content: First add the Boxtal app and set up your Boxtal account. Then, in your Wix site's dashboard, go to Shipping & Fulfillment and select a shipping region where Boxtal operates (e.g. France). Scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or store pickup options you created. Click the toggle next to the Boxtal app to enable it. Enter a Shipping option name (e.g. Pickup Points) and the Rate at checkout, then click Save. You must enable pickup points in each region where you want customers to see it, so repeat this for any additional shipping regions (e.g. Spain).

title: How can I promote my event using a Link in Bio page with Hopp by Wix?
content:
Create or sign in to a Hopp by Wix account: go to Hopp, click Log In or Get Started for Free, select the relevant Wix site, and click Connect Site. You can click Not Now and connect your Wix site later. Choose a name to showcase and customize the URL for your Link in Bio page, then click Create Account.

Customize your Link in Bio page: choose the actions to show (for example Event or List of Events), select a template and click Use This Template, add social icons, add an advanced search box and click Add Search, then click Edit Page. In the Actions tab, click + Add Action, click Events, then choose Event to let visitors RSVP or buy event tickets: enter the Event page URL or choose an event from your Wix site, click Next, customize Action Appearance (display, title, Button click behavior), click Next, and optionally edit Display settings and Search settings.

Publish and share: click Publish at the top right of the Link in Bio editor, then share a direct link or share on social media such as YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.

title: Can I change the browser theme color for mobile using the Studio Editor?
content:
Currently, the Studio Editor does not offer a feature that lets you choose the color of the browser when visitors view your client's site on mobile.

As a workaround, you can add custom code to change the browser color, specifically for Safari:

- **Single page:** Add it as a meta tag in the page's Advanced SEO settings panel.
- **Multiple or all pages:** Add it to the Custom Code tab in the dashboard.

This code, for example, changes the browser color to white:


<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">

title: Can I manage my Wix Payments account from the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, it is not possible to manage your Wix Payments account from the Wix app on your mobile device. Head over to the Wix Payments dashboard on desktop for any action or info you need.

title: Why does my mobile live site load zoomed in or out on my Android device using Chrome?
content: This is caused by an issue on Chrome browser’s side and affects specific Android devices. As a workaround, check the accessibility font size settings on the mobile device you are using: for a zoomed in mobile live site, decrease the font size; for a zoomed out mobile live site, increase the font size. In addition, make sure you are using the latest version of the Chrome app.

title: How can I enable or disable the gridlines in the Wix Editor?
content: Click Tools at the top of the editor, then select or deselect the Gridlines checkbox.

title: How can I add an accessibility statement to my website using Wix?
content: To add an accessibility statement to your site, add a page and name it "Accessibility Statement". Add text boxes to the page and enter your accessibility statement into them as needed. Create a link to the page with text or a button and name it "Accessibility Statement". Attach the linked text/button to your site's header/footer to ensure visitors can view the statement from any of your site's pages. Note: Use multiple text boxes in your statement to ensure that each part of the text has the correct HTML tag (h1/h2/p). You can check the example in the next section to see which HTML tags to use.

title: Can I customize the printable order page in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, when you print an order in the Orders tab in the dashboard, it's not possible to customize the page. However, it is possible to export your orders to a CSV file. When you do so, you can select the information you want to display in the file.

title: How can I customize the main portfolio page in Wix Portfolio?
content:
To customize the main portfolio page in Wix Portfolio:

- Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
- Click **Portfolio Pages** and select the **Portfolio** page.
- Click the Portfolio Page element in your editor.
- To edit the Portfolio page background, click the **Design** icon on the Portfolio Page element, select **Background**, and customize the background color and opacity, border, corners, and shadow.
- To set stretch settings, click the **Stretch** icon on the Portfolio Page element and use the toggle: **Enabled** stretches the element to fill the width of your site and the **Margins** slider sets the distance between the edges of your site and the element; **Disabled** keeps the element within the Editor's gridlines and doesn't fill the width of your site.
- To edit the portfolio gallery, click the Portfolio Gallery element in your Editor. Use **Layout** and **Customize Layout** to change gallery direction and scroll direction; use **Behaviors** to set video play options; use **Design** and the **What do you want to design?** drop-down to customize **Regular** or **Hover** state, **Background fills**, **Borders**, **Shadows**, and **Corners**; use **Animation** to customize the effect visitors see when they hover over a gallery item or scroll down the page.
- To change the order your collections display on the portfolio page, click **Manage Collections** and drag and drop your collections to change the order they appear in your portfolio.

title: How do I connect the BBPOS WisePad 3 card reader to my tablet for use with Wix Retail POS?
content:
To connect the BBPOS WisePad 3 card reader to your tablet:

1. Tap and release the power button on the card reader to turn it on. The Bluetooth turns on automatically.
2. Open the POS tablet.
3. Tap the Connect Reader icon at the bottom right of the tablet.
4. To connect your card reader: tap Set up Card Reader, tap Connect next to the relevant reader, then tap Done.
5. To disconnect your card reader: tap Unpair at the top right, then tap Unpair to confirm.

title: How can I customize the elements displayed in my Wix Forum?
content: Click the Wix Forum app in your editor. Click Settings. Click the Display tab. Click the Posts tab. Select or deselect the checkboxes next to the elements you want to show or hide. You can revisit the Display settings at any time to enable or disable different elements as needed. This lets you control the types of content your community can share and helps keep your forum organized and relevant.

title: How can I add free illustrations to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Image. Click Show More under Free Wix Illustrations. Select an illustration and click Add to Page.

title: How can I upload media to my Wix site using the Wix app?
content:
To upload media from the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Settings and select Media Manager.
- Tap Add.
- Depending on what you want to upload, tap Take a Photo to Video, Upload Media, or Upload Files.

title: Can I customize the cookie banner in Wix, and what options are available?
content: You can customize your Wix cookie banner by changing the text and color theme. Additional options, such as customizing the banner in your editor, modifying the size of the banner, or changing the banner location on the screen, are unavailable at present.

title: How can I upload an image to my site using Editor X?
content: Click the Add icon on the top bar of the Editor, click Media, then click Uploads. Click the Upload Media icon. Select where you want to add the media from: Your computer, Your other Wix sites, Social networks, or A URL. Follow the corresponding options in the Media Manager, such as Upload from Computer, My Wix Account, Connect, or the Link icon and Import. Optionally, select the file and click Add to Page to add it to your site.

title: How can I upload a document to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the Media icon on the left side of the editor, then click the Upload Media icon. Choose your file(s) from your computer. Optionally, select the file and click Add to Page to add it to your site. You can also learn more about sharing documents on your site or display PDF files directly using the PDF Viewer App.

title: How do I add a policy agreement checkbox to checkout in Wix Stores?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Checkout Settings, click Customize your checkout, and click Policies. Select the policies you want to create and enter the policy text. To ask customers to agree to your policies before completing checkout, click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it. You can then select a Checked by default setting: selected means the checkbox is already checked on the Checkout Page; deselected means customers need to select the checkbox to agree with your policy and check out.

title: How can I use the Editor Toolbar and Layers Panel in the Wix Editor to adjust elements?
content: To position elements using the Editor Toolbar: click the element, type the new values next to X and Y in the Editor Toolbar, and press Enter after each value. To use the Layers panel: go to your editor, click Layers on the bottom left of the editor, click either Header, Page, or Footer to view the elements in that area, locate the relevant element from the list and click it. You can then move the element forward or backward, customize or adjust it, or click and drag elements in the panel to change their order.

title: How can I overcome social media linking restrictions using Hopp by Wix's Link in Bio feature?
content: Many social media platforms restrict the amount of links you can share with your followers. The Link in Bio page helps you overcome these restrictions, as you can add as many links as you need. You can link to products, events, videos – anything with a URL. If you are sharing a large amount of links, you can make your audience's experience easier by adding a search box. The search box lets them look up the links they're interested in, using keywords that you assign to each link.

title: How can I inform my site visitors about the use of cookies on my Wix site?
content: You must inform your visitors that you are using cookies on your site. This can be done by adding a section about your site's cookies in your privacy policy, and by including details about the types of cookies your site uses. You can also use the Wix Privacy Center to add a cookie banner to your site, giving visitors the opportunity to accept or decline non-essential cookies. When informing visitors of cookies, you can direct them to good sources of information such as All About Cookies, and your visitors should be able to see what cookies are used and how to manage them properly.

title: How can I connect Max as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers, then click Connect next to Max.

If you have an account, enter your Max Masof and API Key and click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create Max account, follow the instructions to create an account, and wait for approval. Once approved, you are notified by phone. Save your Business Registration Number (Mispar Aleph), return to the window, and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account.

Important: To activate your account, Max requires that you add Store Policies and Credit Card Logos to your site. Accepted credit cards listed are ChinaUnionPay, Diners, Discover, Electron, Isracard, Jcb, Leumicard, Maestro, MasterCard and Visa; images can be found on the Internet and added to your site. Max may deactivate your account if there is a lack of activity in your store. To reactivate, contact Max.

title: How can I assign my existing Wix Premium plan to an Editor X site?
content: To assign your existing Premium plan to an Editor X site, go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan you want to reassign, select Assign to a different site, and click the checkbox next to the relevant Editor X Site. Click Next, then Compare Plans. Click Select under the new Premium plan, choose your subscription period and click Select, then enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase. Note: Any remaining credit from your old Premium plan is deducted from the price of your new upgrade during the purchase process. This credit is deducted after any discounts from a coupon or seasonal sale are applied.

title: How can I set up channel subscriptions in Wix Video?
content: Important: This feature has been depreciated and has been replaced with Wix Pricing Plans for most users. To accept payment for channel subscriptions, you must set your payment method as PayPal, Stripe or Wix Payments. To set up channel subscriptions in Wix Video: go to your Video Library; click the Channels tab on the left; click the channel you want to offer as a subscription; click Edit next to Channel Info; scroll down to Channel Subscriptions; click the toggle to enable subscriptions for this channel. Enabled means visitors can purchase a monthly subscription to the channel and get access to its paid videos. Disabled means the channel remains free, while individual paid videos remain available for purchase. Enter a monthly fee for the subscription. Select or deselect the Only subscribers can watch paid videos on this channel checkbox. Selected means only subscribers can view paid videos in this channel and non-subscribers cannot purchase individual videos. Deselected means non-subscribers can purchase individual videos. Note: If a purchasable video appears in both a subscriber channel and in a free channel, visitors will be able to purchase it, even if the checkbox is selected on the subscribers-only channel.

title: Can I set up prepayment for table reservations in Wix Restaurants?
content: You can now set up prepayment to add a fee for table reservations.

title: How can participants view their active and ended programs in an online program?
content: Participants can see all their programs in the **My Programs** tab from their members account. The programs are sorted into Active and Ended based on the participant's current status. Participants can click **View Program** next to an active program to see the steps in the Program page. The site owner can customize the layout of their member pages, including the My Programs tab.

title: How can I add the Privy eComm Marketing App to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
content:
Before you begin: Make sure your site has been upgraded to a Premium plan or Studio plan that allows you to accept payments and has a domain.

Go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for the Privy eComm Marketing App in the search bar. Click Add to Site.

Access the app from the Wix App Market, click +Add to Site, review the app permissions, and click Add to Site.

Go to the email associated with your Wix account and open the Privy email. You must complete this step within an hour of adding the app. Click Sign in to Privy. Sign in to your existing account or click Create New Business and create a new account.

title: How can I create a price discount coupon in Wix Stores?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Coupons and click + New Coupon. Select $ Discount. Enter the coupon code, coupon name, and discount amount. From the Apply to drop-down, choose All products, Specific product, Specific category, or Minimum order subtotal. If applicable, choose whether the discount applies only to the lowest priced item or to every relevant item in an order. Optionally select Include subscriptions. Set the start date and either an end date or no end date. Optionally set usage limits. Click Create Coupon.

title: Can I set a preset aspect ratio for images in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to select a preset aspect ratio (such as 16:9, 5:4, etc.) for images in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can manually change an image's width / height by dragging its side handles. You can also enter the width and height values in the Inspector panel for more precise sizing.

title: How do I create a sale price coupon in Wix Stores?
content: To create a sale price coupon in Wix Stores: Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard. Click + New Coupon and select Sale Price. Enter the Coupon code customers need to enter and the Coupon name. Note that this name appears in the cart page and your site's dashboard. Enter the sale price under Now Only; this is the price your customers pay. Select an option from the Apply to drop-down: All products applies to all products and the customer can apply it to multiple products; Specific product applies to one product, so click the Product drop-down and select the product; Specific category applies to all products in a category and the customer can apply it to multiple products, so click the Category drop-down and select the category. Optionally select Include subscriptions to apply this coupon to product subscriptions. Note that this applies to every cycle, so make sure the coupon value isn't greater than the subscription price. Select when the coupon is valid by entering the start date and entering the end date or selecting Don't set an end date. Optionally select the checkboxes next to the limits you want to apply: Limit the total number of uses for this coupon by entering the total number of times the coupon can be used; multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually. Limit to one use per customer means each customer can use the coupon only once. Click Create Coupon.

title: How can I find and edit my mobile menu in the Wix Mobile Editor if it's not visible?
content:
To find and edit your mobile menu in the mobile editor, try the following:

- Click the Mobile Menu icon in your mobile editor, click Button, and click Edit Menu.
- Click the Hidden on Mobile icon on the left side of the mobile editor. If the menu is listed, you can unhide it by clicking the Show Element icon.
- Use Ctrl + M (or Cmd + M on a Mac) to cycle through the elements on the page. Once you locate the menu, you can edit the design of the mobile menu.
- Right-click an element in the editor, hover over Overlapping Items, and click the menu from the list.
- Click the Layers icon on the bottom left of your mobile editor, click Button, select Header, Page or Footer, and click the menu from the list.
- Click Menus & Pages on the left side of your mobile editor, click Button, hover over a page name and click the Show More icon, click Mobile Settings, and select the Standard page layout.

If the menu is not highlighted on your editor when you select it from the list, it is outside the visible part of the editor. You can change its position by adjusting the X or Y axis in the toolbar.

title: How can I upload a file to the File Share app from my site's dashboard?
content: Go to File Share in your site's dashboard. Navigate to the folder you want to place the file in. Click +Add File. Select the files you want to upload from your computer. Click Open.

title: How do I adjust the background image position and scale for a language version in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Switch languages drop-down menu at the top left. Select the relevant language. Click the Background icon on the left. Click Settings. Under How's the image scaled?, select an option from the drop-down menu to adjust image scale. Under Where's the image positioned?, select a position on the grid to change image position.

title: How can I add Wix Bookings to my site using Editor X?
content: To add Wix Bookings to your site using Editor X: Click Add on the top of Editor X, click Bookings, and click Add to Site. You can add Wix Bookings for free, but you must upgrade to a Business & eCommerce Premium Plan to accept bookings.

title: How can I remove the gap under my Wix Pro Gallery in the Slideshow layout?
content: To remove the gap under your Wix Pro Gallery, decrease the Info Bar Size in your layout settings. The Info bar size toggle is only applicable for the Slideshow layout. If the issue occurs on mobile, carry out the steps in the mobile Editor; switch to the mobile editor by clicking the mobile icon at the top of your editor. To decrease the info bar size under your gallery: click the Pro Gallery in your editor; click the Layout tab; click Customize Layout; set the Info Bar Size to a lower number or to 0 to remove the empty space.

title: How do I connect Opn Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Opn Payments. If you already have an Opn account, enter your Public key and Secret key and click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Opn Payments account, fill in the registration form, wait for an email from Opn Payments to get your credentials, then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account. The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Opn account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I access my installed apps from my Wix site's dashboard?
content: Go to Manage Apps in your site's dashboard, then click Open next to any of your installed apps.

title: How can I add a new social media link to my Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix?
content: To add a social link to your Link in Bio page using Hopp by Wix: go to hopp.co and log in; click Link in Bio on the left; click Edit Page at the top right; click Social Links on the left; then click + Add Link, select the relevant social media platform, enter the URL / Username of your social platform, and click OK.

title: How can I enter the cost of goods for a product in Wix Stores?
content: Go to the Products tab in your site's dashboard. Click an existing product or create a new one. Scroll down to the Pricing section and enter the product price. Under Cost of Goods, enter the amount it costs you to make or buy the product. Click Save. The cost of goods amount is not displayed to customers. After setup, when you update a product's price or add a sale to a product, the profit and margin adjust automatically.

title: How can I set viewing permissions for screens in the Wix mobile app for my members?
content: To set viewing permissions for screens in the Wix app: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Mobile App. Tap Edit. Tap Screens. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant screen. Tap Set screen permissions. Select who can view this screen: All Members: All members that visit your site have screen access. Members with Badges: Choose which badge holders can access the screen, or tap Create New Badge to create a new badge. Members with Pricing Plans: Choose which Pricing Plan holders can access the screen, or tap Create New Plan to create a new plan. Members receive a message informing them that they don't have permission to access the screen and to request permission from you (the site owner).

title: How can I add a WhatsApp link to a button on my Wix site?
content:
To link a button to your WhatsApp on your Wix site:

- Add a button to your page.
- Change the button text, for example, "Contact on WhatsApp".
- Click the Link icon.
- Click Web Address.
- Choose an option:
  - Create a link without a message: enter the following address under What's the web address (URL)?: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=<number>
    - Note: The <number> should be your full phone number in international format. Omit any zeros, brackets, or dashes when adding the phone number.
  - Create link with custom message: enter the following address under What's the web address (URL)?: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=12125558471&text=Hi%20requesting%20a%20callback.%20Thanks.
    - Notes: The <number> should be your full phone number in international format. Omit any zeros, brackets, or dashes when adding the phone number. To add a space in your custom message use '%20'.
- Click Done.

Tip: Click Change Text & Icon and upload the WhatsApp icon if you want it to appear on your button.

title: Can I set multiple permissions for a single screen in Wix Member Apps?
content: Currently, it's not possible to choose more than one permission per app screen. You can restrict screen access to members with Pricing plans or member badges, but not both.

title: Can I use gradients as backgrounds for text boxes and shapes in the Studio Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to apply a gradient background to Studio Editor elements like text boxes and shapes. However, you can now set gradients as the background for responsive containers.

title: How can I add a new guest to a ticketed event using the Check-in by Wix app?
content: Only event owners can add guests through the app. Open the Check-in by Wix app. Tap the relevant event. Tap **Guest List** under **Event management**. Tap **Add New Guest**. For a ticketed event, enter the **Guest Details** (e.g. name and email). Select the status from the **Guest Status** drop-down (Going or Arrived). Choose the ticket type and status under **Ticket Details**: select a **Ticket Type** from the drop-down if you created more than one type of ticket; select the relevant **Ticket Status** (e.g. Not Paid or Paid); decide to send your guest a **Ticket PDF**.

title: How can I set up payments in my Wix form using the new Wix Forms?
content:
Before you begin, make sure you've connected your site to a payment method and upgraded your site.

For new Wix Forms, click the form you want to add payments to, then click Edit Form. Under Transaction fields, choose Product, Fixed price, Custom price, or Donation. Click the General tab and complete the fields for the option you chose.

For Single Product, set the title, product name, image, price, and product options such as One of each, Multiples of any, Required field, and Field description. For Multiple Products, click Add Product and enter the additional product details. For Donation, enter the donation amount(s), optionally enable Allow custom amount, and set options such as Required field, Field description, and Column display.

To connect a payment provider, click Connect Payment, set up your payment provider in the Accept Payments tab, then click Back to forms. If you have not upgraded your site, click Upgrade. Click Save, then Publish.

Note: If you added an Order Form template, these templates use the old Wix Forms; follow the Wix Editor steps instead.

Tip: Write a few details about your product/service within your form to give your site visitors more information about what they're purchasing.

title: Can I add a session to the cart from the Weekly Timetable or the Daily Agenda in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, it is not possible to display the 'Add to Cart' button on the Weekly Timetable or Daily Agenda widgets.

title: How can I use whatsmydns.net to check whether my Wix domain's DNS records have propagated?
content:
Use whatsmydns.net to perform a DNS lookup and check whether your domain's DNS records are correct and propagated. First, get your DNS records from your Wix account: go to the Domains page in your Wix account, click the Show More icon, click Manage DNS records, and scroll to the record you want to check, such as NS, A, or CNAME.

To check your domain's name server connection: go to whatsmydns.net, enter your domain name without the www. prefix (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com), select NS from the drop-down menu, and click Search. The search result should match the 'Value' field in your Wix records if your domain has propagated correctly. Make sure you are logged in to the Wix account that contains your domain to view the correct name server records.

To check your domain's pointing connection: your domain must have both the correct A and CNAME records to connect to Wix via pointing. For the A record, go to whatsmydns.net, enter your domain name without the www. prefix (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com), select A, and click Search. Next to each server location, you should see your domain IP address; compare the search results to the records in your domain host's account to ensure they are the same. For the CNAME record, enter your domain name including the www. prefix (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com), select CNAME, and click Search. Next to each server location, you should see the address your CNAME points to; compare the search results to the 'Value' field of your CNAME records in your Wix account. Make sure you are logged in to the Wix account that contains your domain to view the correct CNAME record.

When you perform a DNS lookup at whatsmydns.net, a green checkmark appears next to a record that has propagated at a particular server. If a red checkmark appears, either no records have propagated or a communication issue exists between whatsmydns.net and the server. If you recently changed your domain's DNS records, you may see different records at different locations due to domain propagation, which can take up to 48 hours to complete. If your domain has the correct records but your live site is still not connected, use the troubleshooting link in the article.

title: Can I apply field validations when adding content from the Wix Owner or Wix Studio app?
content: Currently, if you set validations for a CMS collection field, the validations do not apply when you add content to the field from the Wix Owner or Wix Studio app. From these apps, you can add content that ignores field validations you set including; Make this a required field, Limit character count, and Accept specific values only. When you view the collection from a desktop computer, you will see a Warning icon letting you know to fix any values that do not match the validations you set.

title: What should I do if I encounter an error message saying 'Audio File could not be uploaded due to unsupported sample rate' when uploading an audio file to Wix?
content: If you encounter the error message 'Audio File could not be uploaded due to unsupported sample rate,' check that your sample rate is 44,100, 48,000, 96,000, 88,200 or 192,000 hz. Re-encode or convert the file with supported sample rate.

title: How can I duplicate an entire photo album in Wix Photo Albums?
content: To duplicate the entire photo album in Wix Photo Albums, go to your Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click the My Albums tab. Click the Show more icon next to the album you'd like to duplicate. Click Duplicate Album. Select Entire Album. Click Duplicate Album. Tip: You can also find the option to duplicate when you click Manage beside the relevant album and then click the Show more icon.

title: How can I resolve a security warning for my domain that has been flagged for malware or phishing?
content: Check whether your domain is affected by visiting your domain URL or by using Google's Safe Browsing tool. If the domain was flagged for malware, fill out the malware review form. If it was flagged for phishing, fill out the form to report an incorrect phishing warning. Then wait for the review to be processed; processing times can vary depending on the results of the report.

title: How can I set up an email marketing campaign using Wix Video?
content: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Click the Promote icon. Click Promote by Email. Start customizing your email campaign. Click Next on the top right-hand side to add recipients. Click Next to preview the newsletter and click Publish to send your campaign.

title: How can I change the text size in the Wix Editor?
content:
To change the text size in the Wix Editor:

- Click the text element in the Editor.
- Click Edit Text.
- (Optional) To change the size of only part of the text box, select the relevant text.
- Drag the Font size slider to increase or decrease the size of the text, or enter a specific value between 6 and 999 pixels.

title: Can I create discounts that apply only to specific product variants in Wix Stores?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create coupons or automatic discounts that apply only to a specific variant of a product. For example, if you have a ring that comes in gold and silver, you can't create a discount that applies only to the silver variant. As an alternative, product variants can be offered as separate products, and discounts can be created for the relevant product. For example, instead of offering the gold and silver rings as variants, create them as 2 separate products.

title: Can I design a tablet-specific version of my site using Wix Editor?
content: Currently, it is not possible to edit your site specifically for tablets using Wix Editor. However, there are ways you can optimize the desktop version of your site for tablets, such as keeping elements within the gridlines, and using columns and repeaters.

title: How can I assign a contact to a collaborator using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site. Tap **Manage** at the bottom, tap **Customers & Leads** and select **Contacts**. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant contact, tap **Assign contact**, then tap the relevant collaborator. To reassign contacts to a different collaborator or to yourself, repeat these steps. You can also assign contacts to collaborators from your desktop.

title: How can I create a Print on Demand (POD) product using Wix Stores?
content:
To create a POD product in Wix Stores:

- Go to Find Product to Sell in your site's dashboard.
- Click to view the product you want to add.
- Click Start Designing.
- (Optional) In the Product tab, select which option(s) you want to design.
- Add personalized content:
  - Add images: Click File on the left, click Add Image, upload an image, then use the settings to customize, resize, and position the image.
  - Add text: Click Text on the left, enter your text or select a preset, then click the text and use the settings to edit.
  - Add clipart: Click Clipart on the left, select a clipart image, then use the settings to resize and reposition the image.
- When you're ready, click Continue.
- Select one mockup style on the top left.
- (Optional) Click the star on any image to make it your main product image.
- (Optional) Deselect the checkboxes next to mockup angles you don't want to display.
- Click Continue.
- (Optional) Adjust the default pricing and click Continue.
- (Optional) Customize the product name and description.
- Click Continue to add the product to your store.

Tip: The product is hidden by default. When you're ready, go to your product list and unhide it so it appears on your site.

title: Is it possible to subscribe to a forum to receive notifications for new posts or periodical updates?
content: Currently, it is not possible for forum members to subscribe to receive notifications whenever there is a new post or to receive periodical updates (e.g. a monthly update). It is, however, possible to follow individual forum categories and to receive updates when someone posts to them.

title: How can I change the type of gallery in Wix Editor?
content: Click the gallery in your editor, click the Design icon, then browse the available designs and select the one you like. You can choose a traditional grid layout or a Slider that lets visitors navigate at their own pace, and Wix also offers more creative layouts like a 3D Carousel, Honeycomb and Freestyle.

title: How can I edit a reservation in the original Wix Hotels, and what are the limitations?
content: To edit a reservation in the original Wix Hotels: go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Reservations tab, click the relevant reservation, make the changes, and click Save. Note: It is not possible to edit the booking details of a reservation for which a booking fee was paid. You can, however, edit the guest details for all bookings.

title: Can I transfer business calls to an agent once a call has been answered?
content: Once a business call has been answered, it cannot be transferred to an agent. Incoming business calls can still be routed to your forwarding numbers.

title: How can I enable and customize back-in-stock notifications for my Wix store customers?
content: To collect requests, go to the Back in Stock Requests tab in your site's dashboard and click Start Collecting Requests. To activate automated notifications, go to the Back in Stock Requests tab and click Activate Automation. To customize the notification, go to the Back in Stock Requests tab, click the Automations tab, and click Preview & Edit. In Sender Details, click Edit, edit the "from" name, optionally edit the reply-to email, and click Save. To customize the notification, click Edit Template; to display your logo at the top, click Add and then Logo. Click Save & Publish. To preview the email, return to the Automations tab, click Preview & Edit, select Preview & Test, click Send Test Email, and enter your details to receive the notification in your inbox.

title: How do I set up my first card reader with the Wix Dashboard Card Reader solution?
content:
First, connect to Wix Payments and purchase the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader. The Wix Dashboard Card Reader works with the Wix Payments payment provider.

### Steps

#### Step 1 | Connect to Wix Payments
Connect to Wix Payments.

#### Step 2 | Get the card reader
Once your Wix Payments account is set up, order the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader from the Wix POS shop or purchase it anywhere these readers are sold.

#### Step 3 | Unbox and charge your card reader
1. Unbox your card reader.
2. Insert the battery.
3. Press the power button to turn the reader on.
4. If required, charge your reader.

#### Step 4 | Connect your first card reader to WiFi
Important: To use the reader with your dashboard, your computer and reader need to be connected to the same WiFi network.
1. Go to POS Checkout in your site's dashboard.
2. Add a product, service, or charge to the cart (e.g., add a $1 charge from the Custom Charge tab).
3. Click Charge and select Card.
4. Click Pair Reader.
5. Select an option:
   - WiFi networks are displayed: Connect to the relevant network.
   - WiFi networks not displayed:
     1. Swipe right on your card reader screen.
     2. Tap the Settings button.
     3. Enter 07139 as the PIN code.
     4. Select Network.
     5. Connect to the relevant network.
6. Return to the popup and tap Next.

#### Step 5 | Generate and enter your code
1. Go back to the popup on your computer.
2. Select an option:
   - Code is displayed: Enter the three-word code in the pop-up, including the hyphens.
   - Code not displayed: Generate a code and enter it:
     1. Swipe right on your card reader screen.
     2. Tap the Settings button.
     3. Select Generate pairing code.
