     4. Enter the three-word code in the pop-up, including the hyphens.
3. (Optional) Give your card reader a name.
4. Click Pair Reader.

After a reader is paired, you'll see it listed in your POS settings.

#### Step 6 | Enable POS in Accepting Payments
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Scroll down and click Accept or click the toggle next to Wix Point of Sale to enable it.

#### Step 7 | Complete the sale
Go to POS Checkout in your site's dashboard and complete the sale.

title: How can I access and view subscription reports in Wix Analytics?
content: Go to Analytics & Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll to the Subscription Reports section and select the relevant report. To switch views within a report, click the relevant tab at the top of the report to access different chart types. Depending on the report, you may see different views.

title: How can I delete a video from my Wix Video library?
content: Go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Select the checkbox on the left side next to the video(s) you want to delete. Click the Delete icon. Click Delete in the pop-up window. Important: Deleting the video player from your live site does not remove any videos from your video library.

title: How can I publish my photo album on Wix?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Photo Albums, click Edit next to the relevant album, then click Publish Now at the top right.

title: How can I set up real-time shipping calculation with USPS in my Wix store?
content:
To set up Real Time Shipping Calculation with USPS in your Wix store:
- Enter a Shipping weight for each shippable product in the Inventory & shipping section if not already set.
- In your site's dashboard, go to Shipping, then edit an existing shipping region or create a new one.
- Select USPS Calculated Rate from the drop-down list.
- Choose the shipping services you want to offer. You can optionally enter an estimated delivery time, set a Rate Adjustment, or offer free shipping above a specific amount for the service.
- Choose your main package: select Custom and enter a package name and dimensions, or select a USPS flat rate package and enter the maximum number of products you estimate can fit in the box.
- Provide the address you ship from. Make sure to provide a 5-digit zip code and do not add the 4-digit routing number.
- Enter a Backup weight per product and a Backup shipping rate.
- After saving your shipping rule, you can select the region again and optionally add local delivery or store pickup options.

Important: This feature is only available for merchants in the U.S. selling in USD, except Puerto Rico. USPS is used for calculation purposes only; you can actually ship with any carrier you choose. The calculated rate is a close estimate and may vary from final shipping costs.

title: AI Agent 执行改价、下采购单等不可逆操作时，是否需要人工确认环节？
content: 需要。原文在 F4 与 A14 都指出：动作不可逆且没有人工确认环节时，不应把 Agent 用在全自动执行上；这类动作的正确形态是 Agent 提出建议 + 人点确认（human-in-the-loop），判断标准是“错了能不能撤回”，不是“错的概率有多低”。Agent 出错时是静默的，会在没有人看轨迹、没有异常告警的情况下拿着错数据自信地走完全程。

title: How can I add menu items to the cart using Wix Restaurants POS on my mobile device?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site, tap Manage at the bottom, scroll down to the Get Paid section, and tap Point of Sale. If not already selected, tap the Menu Items tab. Select the first restaurant item. If relevant, select modifiers and enter special requests. Tap Add to Cart. Optional: add additional restaurant menu items, store products, booking services, or physical gift cards. Then tap Go to Cart.

title: How can I create a price quote in Wix Studio?
content: In your Wix Studio workspace, go to Marketplace Overview. Click the Price Quotes tab on the left, then click + New Quote at the top right. Enter the quote info: Title, Customer, Expiry Date, and Payment Terms (Due on Receipt / Net + 15 / Net + 30 / Net + 60 or Set custom terms). Enter the quote details: Product or Service (select + Add Item to create a price quote for a new item, then enter the details and click Save), optional Description, Price, Quantity, optional Tax 1 / Tax 2, optional + Add Line Item, and optional Discount (percentage). Enter Notes and Terms; these fields appear at the bottom of your price quote. Click Save as Draft to save, or click Next to preview the quote, then click Send to review the email content, and click Send again to send the price quote to your client.

title: Can I track the PageView event as a server-side event using Meta Pixel?
content: Currently, it is only possible to track a PageView event for Meta Pixel conversion tracking as a browser-side event. This means that when a visitor opens your page on your site, their browser loads your Meta Pixel and sends a PageView event. It is not possible to track a page visit as a server-side event sent from Wix's servers.

title: How can I submit a post to the "Discover" tab in the Spaces app from the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Blog. Choose what kind of post you want to submit. To create a new post, tap Create New Post. To choose an existing post, tap Posts, then tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant post. Tap Submit to Discover, then tap Submit. Before you begin, make sure your site in the app is not requiring approval of new members, set your profile to public, and make sure you add the Blog app to your site.

title: Can I use Instamojo as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Instamojo as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Instamojo and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I purchase a 2 or 3 year Premium or Studio plan on Wix?
content: To purchase a 2 or 3 year Premium or Studio plan on Wix: Go to the Upgrade page. Click Select under the plan you wish to purchase. Select 2 Years or 3 Years and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase. Note: 2 year and 3 year plan subscriptions are not available in all regions. After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: Is it possible to add the Rich Content Element to a Repeater?
content: Yes. You can now add the Rich Content viewer element to repeaters to display content for multiple items at a time. If you have an older Rich Content element on your site, make sure to add a new one so you get the updated version that allows you to attach to repeaters.

title: How can I resolve a 5xx error in Google Search Console?
content: If you see a 5xx error in Google Search Console, test the relevant page's URL in Google's URL Inspection Tool. If there are no errors, go back to Google Search Console and click Validate Fix next to the error. If the error continues to be displayed in Google Search Console, it is possible that there is an ongoing issue on Wix's end. Contact Wix Customer Care to let us know and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: How do I create a new automation in Wix Automations?
content:
Go to Automations in your site's dashboard. Click + New Automation at the top right. Choose how you want to start creating your automation: From Scratch: click Start from Scratch to begin from a blank automation template. Suggested automation: use the categories or search bar to find the suggested automation you want to edit, then click Set Up next to the automation. Click the title to give your automation a name.

Next, choose a trigger: click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the Trigger section, select your chosen trigger from the available options, and use the Limit frequency to drop-down to set trigger frequency if needed. Optionally add a delay with + Add Delay and/or a condition with + Add Condition. Choose an action in the Action section and set it up using the available options. Finally, click Activate to save and activate the automation. It now appears on your Automations page where you can edit, deactivate or delete it.

title: What are the benefits of choosing a Wix Premium plan?
content: Premium plans offer many great benefits – removal of Wix ads, connection of a personal domain to your site (e.g. www.mybusinessname.com), 24/7 priority support, additional storage, extra bandwidth ... and much more. Compare the Wix Premium plans.

title: Can I import content from my collections into a Wix Stores collection?
content: Currently, it is not possible to import content from your collections into a Wix Stores collection. For example, you cannot use pictures that site visitors upload to a collection as product images in a Wix Stores collection. Learn more about managing your collections and working with Wix App collections.

title: How can I add store listing details for my branded app in the Google Play and Apple App Store?
content: Go to the Branded Mobile App tab in your site's dashboard. Scroll down and click Set up app store listings for your app. Click Get Started under the store listing you want to set up first: Google Play or Apple App Store. Add a name and icon that members see in the app store; if you already set them up, they appear by default. Click Next. Describe your app with a promotional text, then add a description of your app's main features and functionality. Complete the Discoverability details. For Google Play, select a category that best fits your app, choose tags to describe your app and the in-app experience, then click Save & Continue. For Apple App Store, add a subtitle if desired, assign a primary category and optionally a secondary category, add keywords, add support information links, an optional marketing link, and copyright details. If optional details are not visible, you can access them when editing your discoverability later.

title: How can I allow customers to see detailed images of my products using the Image Zoom app by Widgetic?
content: With the Image Zoom app by Widgetic, you can add custom navigation on top of your images to give customers detailed images that help them see the materials, build quality, and colors of your products. Features include using smaller areas to show content that can be scaled on the spot, letting customers see your products before they take action, customizable navigation style and position, and familiar interactions like pinch to zoom in and out. Check out the Image Zoom app by Widgetic to get started.

title: What should I do if my site verification meta tag is not working?
content:
If your site verification meta tag is not working, check the following possible errors:

- Meta tag has been added to the wrong search engine: Check that the meta tag added is for the right search engine. For example, pasting a Google tag into Bing will cause issues.
- Meta tag formatting is incorrect: The correct format is `<meta name=”XX” content=”XX”/>`. Check to see if your code is missing a ‘<’, a ‘ “ ‘, or has extra attributes. Any other format will cause an issue.

title: How can I manage messages from different channels using Wix Inbox?
content: To manage messages from different channels using Wix Inbox, integrate it with different platforms to view and reply to all of your messages in one place. This includes channels like your Facebook page and Instagram page, as well as Wix Forms submissions and Wix Chat. You can also connect your Gmail account to Wix Inbox so that any emails you send through your Wix account come from your personal email address. Note that you must have a published site to use Wix Inbox.

title: How can I switch between multiple workspaces in the Wix Studio app?
content: If you belong to multiple workspaces, you can easily switch between them in the Wix Studio app. A drop-down at the top of the app allows you to switch between workspaces so you can handle everything from one place. For example, if you have your own agency and are also working for an agency, you might have one workspace for your business and also belong to the agency's workspace.

title: Can I set a specific renewal date for recurring payments from my clients' pricing plans?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set a specific renewal date for recurring payments from your clients' pricing plans. Renewal dates are defined by the date clients purchase their plans or complete their free trial periods. As a workaround, you can extend clients' plans for subscriptions that already have an end date. You can also charge clients offline, or use a Wix Invoice to cover the additional subscription time period.

title: How can I add an H1 heading tag to my page using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Text. Click Add Heading 1 and drag it to your site page. Click the text element and enter your headline. Important: You can assign a heading tag to more than one line of text by pressing Shift + Enter to create line breaks. Make sure there are no empty line breaks set to the H1 text theme, as these generate blank H1 tags.

title: Is it possible to integrate Adobe Lightroom with Wix Portfolio?
content: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Adobe Lightroom with Wix Portfolio. As a workaround, you can import media directly into your portfolio's projects from the Editor or dashboard.

title: How can I access my Domains page in my Wix account?
content:
For Wix: Sign in to your Wix account. Click the user panel at the top right. Click Account Settings. Click Domains in the menu on the left.

For Wix Studio: Sign in to your Wix account. Go to Sites in your Wix Studio workspace. Go to Billing & Subscriptions then Domains in the menu on the left.

title: How can I customize the overlay and icons in my Wix Pro Gallery?
content:
To customize the overlay and icons in your Wix Pro Gallery, go to your editor. Click the Wix Pro Gallery. Click Settings. Click the Design tab. Click Overlay & Icons. Choose between a Full or Partial overlay and customize using the options available.

- Full Overlay: The overlay covers the entire gallery item. You can enable a Gradient overlay and customize Color & Opacity 1 and 2, Gradient Direction, and Icon Color. You can also set a Color overlay and Icon color.
- Partial Overlay: The overlay covers only a portion of the gallery item. You can manage Set size in, Size, Overlay starts from, and Padding. You can enable a Gradient overlay and customize Color & Opacity 1 and 2, Gradient Direction, and Icon Color. You can also set a Color overlay and Icon color.

Choose an overlay effect from the options available: No effect, Fade in, Expand, Slide up, or Slide right.

title: How can I add Wix Video files to my site's Media Manager using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Note: If you haven't uploaded media to your site yet, you can click the Upload Media icon. Click the folder titled Video Library. Click the video file(s) you want to upload. Click Upload Selection.

title: How can I save a design asset in Editor X for future use?
content: Right-click the section you wish to save, then click Save as Design Asset. Enter a name for your design. Use the drop-down to select the relevant library. To create a new library on the spot, select Create New Library. Click Save. Note: Master sections cannot be saved. You also cannot save a section as a design asset if it contains any of the following: Wix Apps (e.g., Wix Stores), Forms, Hamburger menu, Input fields, Lightbox, Pro Gallery, or Third-party apps (e.g., Instagram Feed).

title: What should I do if my Wix Email Marketing statistics don't seem accurate more than 24 hours after sending an email campaign?
content:
If you view your statistics more than 24 hours after sending an email campaign and your statistics don't seem accurate, submit a support ticket and include the following information:

* The URL of the email campaign
* The date you sent the newsletter
* The number of contacts you sent to
* The names of contact groups you sent to
* A few examples of email addresses you've sent to
* Describe what is inaccurate about your statistics

title: Can I set the availability of sections or items of a menu in Wix Restaurants Online Ordering?
content: You can vote for a feature to set the availability of sections and items of a menu in the new Wix Online Ordering app. Setting the availability of a menu itself is now available, for example to limit it to specific days and times.

title: How can I add and set up share buttons on my Wix site?
content: Open your editor, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, click Social, select Share Buttons, and drag the design you like onto the page. To choose the page the buttons link to, click Settings and select the relevant option under What page is shared?.

title: How can I add a note to a sale using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
content:
To add notes to a sale using the Wix Retail POS tablet, follow these steps:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
- Tap the relevant sale.
- Tap **Actions**.
- Select **Add a note**.
- Enter the note and tap **Save**.

**Tip:** You can also add a note when making a sale, after you collect payment.

title: How can I enable a printer-friendly version of my blog posts using the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Go to your Post page: Click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor. Click Blog Pages. Click Post. Click the Post Page element on your page. Click Settings. Click the Display tab. Click Share & Print. Enable the Enable share & print icons toggle. Select the Print Post checkbox. Publish your site.

title: How can I access and use the Comments panel in Editor X to manage site comments?
content:
To access the Comments panel in Editor X, click the Comments icon at the top right of Editor X. Every site page has its own comments panel so that the comments are page-specific. You can see who wrote the comments, when they were posted, and the number of replies if there's an ongoing discussion. If you were mentioned in a comment, you can access it directly from the email notification you received by clicking View Comment.

When writing a comment, you can:

- Make your text bold or underlined.
- Add a bulleted list.
- Add an image or a file for others to preview, add to the page, or download.

You can also enter the @ symbol when typing up the comment to mention someone on your team.

The Comments panel allows you to filter comments using the drop-down menu at the top right of the panel:

- Open: Open comments that have not been resolved.
- Resolved: Comments that were already resolved.
- My Comments: Comments that are related to you directly, including both comments that you added and other comments that mention you.
- Current Breakpoint: Comments related only to the breakpoint you're currently viewing (e.g., desktop, mobile).

Next to each comment, there is an icon indicating the specific breakpoint the person commenting was reviewing at the time. Hover over the icon to see the exact pixel range of that breakpoint.

title: How can I add a custom interaction to an element in Editor X?
content:
Select the element that will trigger the interaction — the one your visitors hover over or click before seeing the animation. Then go to the Interactions tab in the Inspector panel to add your new interaction.

**Add a trigger (click or hover)**
- Select the element that should trigger the interaction.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
- In the Inspector, click the Interactions tab.
- Click **+ Add** under **Hover** / **Click**.

**Set up your interaction**
- Select an option from the **On Hover** / **On Click** drop-down:
  - **Start Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element triggers the chosen animation.
  - **Toggle On/Off:** Similar to a toggle, clicking the element triggers the animation and a second click removes it.
  - **Reset Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element removes any animation that was previously applied.
- Select an option from the **Animated element** drop-down:
  - **Make the element trigger its own animation:** Click the element's name (the word **(self)** appears next to it).
  - **Animate a different element on the page:** Select an element from the drop-down, or click **Choose on Canvas** to select it on the page.
- Click the **Custom** tab.
- Click **Create Custom Animation**.

**Customize the animation**
- Adjust the element's design in the Inspector panel using settings such as **Opacity**, **Rotate**, **Scale**, **Skew**, **Translate**, **Fill Color & Opacity**, **Corners**, **Border** and **Shadow**. The available settings vary based on the element you choose to animate.
- Design the element's initial state: click the **Designing** drop-down on the floating bar, select **Initial state**, adjust the relevant settings in the Inspector panel, and when ready click **Done**.
- Set the duration and ease in the **Timing** panel: use **Start and End** to set the duration of your animation (in seconds) — the Start field also controls the delay of this animation — and **Easing** to choose how the animation eases in and out. If you closed the Timing panel, re-open it by clicking **Timing** on the floating bar.
- (Optional) Click **Play** on the floating bar to preview your animation.
- When ready, click **Done**.

title: How can I block a site member on my Wix Blog?
content: Go to the Wix Blog on your live site. Go to the Members page. Click the relevant site member. Click the Show More icon. Click Block Member. Click Block to confirm.

title: How can I create a custom animation in Editor X that changes an element's appearance on click or hover?
content: In Editor X, interactions consist of a Trigger and an Animation. Choose whether clicking or hovering over an element sets off the animation, then design a custom animation that changes the element's fill color, opacity, angle, size and more on click or hover. You can also design the element's initial state, meaning how it looks when it loads before visitors interact with it, by adjusting its initial opacity, angle, size and position. After setting up the interaction, preview the final result directly from your Editor.

title: How can I create an appointment using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Booking Services, or tap Catalog and select Booking Services. Tap + Create New Service at the bottom. Tap Appointment. Fill out your service details, including name, category, tagline, description, duration, and buffer time, then tap Continue.

title: How can I disable AMP for my Wix blog posts?
content: Go to your SEO Dashboard. Select Go to SEO Settings under Tools and settings. Click Blog Posts. Click Edit next to Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP). Click the toggle next to Enable AMP on your blog posts to disable it.

title: How can I add the Payroll Calculator app to my Wix site?
content: Go to the Wix App Market. Search for Payroll Calculator. Click Add to Site.

title: Can I change the design elements such as colors, font, or background of a standalone form in Wix Forms?
content: Currently in Wix Forms it is not possible to update the design of a standalone form. You can choose form fields and update the form layout, but cannot change design elements such as colors, font, background, or customize the form field design.

title: How can I enable text receipts on my Wix Retail POS tablet?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left. Tap Settings. Tap Receipt on the left menu. Enable the Enable text receipts toggle.

title: How can I make my website accessible for visitors with sight impairments?
content: Prepare your media by adding alt text to images and galleries on your site, adding text descriptions to GIFs and other media without sound, and adding audio descriptions to videos on your site. Also check that all text on your site has the correct HTML tag so the screen reader doesn't skip or jump around the pages.

title: How can I manually request a recrawl of my website's pages to update title tags and meta descriptions in search engine results?
content: Publish your changes to the title tags and meta descriptions before you request a recrawl. Some search engines allow you to request that they recrawl a page; for Google search results, you can use Google Search Console to manually request indexing for the page. Requesting a recrawl does not guarantee that your page's search result will update quicker. If incorrect information still appears after a recrawl, possible reasons include the search engine deciding that other information is more appropriate, your title tags and meta descriptions not meeting its requirements, or custom code on your site affecting the page's browser tab title.

title: Is it possible to add 'Go to Step' functionality in multi-step forms using Wix Forms?
content: Currently, in the new Wix Forms, it is not possible in the form settings to add 'Go to Step X,' where a visitor is automatically directed to a certain step based on their responses. For example, if someone answers 'A' in Step 1 they are sent to Step 5, but if they answer 'B' in Step 1 they are sent to Step 6.

title: Can I add an expenses section to finance reports in Wix Invoices?
content: Currently in Wix Invoices it is not possible to add an expense section to finance reports. This type of section is often used to track various business expenses.

title: What happens to my site's settings and assets when I update from Editor X to the Studio Editor?
content: When you update from Editor X to the Studio Editor, your live site stays exactly the same with no downtime. Your dashboard data (e.g., contacts, automations, inbox), SEO settings, and site settings are saved. Premium plans, domains, and other subscriptions stay active and connected. Your assets and design libraries from Editor X automatically copy over to the Studio Editor. The exception is vertical sections: they are not supported in the Studio Editor and are not copied. If your site already has vertical sections, you will still see them but can only remove them; you can still adjust any child elements in the vertical section. As a workaround, you can remove the existing vertical section and use a container to achieve a similar effect.

title: How can I add and set up a dynamic page for managing content in my CMS collection on Wix?
content: This feature is available in the Studio Editor only. To add and set up a dynamic page for managing content: Go to your editor; click CMS on the left side of the editor; click Your Collections; hover over the relevant collection and click the More Actions icon; select Add dynamic page; select Manage item page and click Add to Site; click Create Page. Modify the collection permissions by clicking Go to permissions in the banner at the bottom of the editor. If the banner disappears before you click it, hover over the relevant collection in the Your Collections panel, click the More Actions icon, and select Permissions & privacy. Edit the collection permissions by choosing a preset from the What type of content will you store in this collection drop-down, such as Collect content or Custom; choose who can view, add, delete, and update content; then click Save. Edit the page permissions by clicking Pages on the left side of the editor, hovering over your dynamic Manage Item page, clicking the More Actions icon, selecting Settings, clicking the Permissions tab, and selecting an option under Which members can access this page: All members, or Only selected members or paying customers. For the latter, select from your Member Roles or select from your Pricing Plans. Optionally modify input elements or buttons connected to your dataset and CMS collection by clicking the relevant element or button, selecting the Connected to CMS icon, and editing connections in the Inspector panel. Customize any other elements as needed, click Preview to test the dynamic list page, and click Publish when ready. Tip: add a link to your new dynamic Manage Item page so visitors with relevant permissions can access it on your live site.

title: Can I set up pricing plans for premium features in my Wix app without using code?
content: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to implement pricing plans without code. You must use code to make your entire app, or some of its features, require premium pricing. This feature would allow you to create premium features and connect them to your app's pricing plan with no code.

title: I missed my site plan renewal notice and can't find the subscription under my account. Can I update payment details or purchase a new plan for my site?
content: If your Premium or Studio site plan renewal payment failed due to payment issues, update your payment details and we will attempt the charge again. If your site plan was already canceled due to payment issues, you can purchase a new plan by upgrading the site again. If you have trouble repurchasing a site plan after cancellation, unassign the canceled plan from your site and try to upgrade again.

title: I can’t see PayPal in the Accept Payments tab even though I have a PayPal Business account and changed my business location. What can I do?
content:
There are 2 main reasons payment providers may not appear in the Accept Payments tab:

1. Different payment providers are available in different locations. Check our list of available providers to make sure your desired provider is available in your location. You can change your business location in the Accept Payments tab by using the dropdown menu.

2. If you began onboarding with Wix Payments, you may have selected a prohibited product or service. If so, this may remove the option to onboard with other payment providers who prohibit similar items. If you mistakenly completed a CBD declaration, or selected a restricted product/service and want to connect a specific provider, contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How do I accept an incoming DoorDash Drive order?
content: Go to Orders in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant order. Click Accept at the top right. Enter when the DoorDash Drive courier should arrive to pick up the order. Note: You can't edit this after confirming. If you're running late with preparations, you'll need to contact DoorDash Drive directly. Click Confirm Order. Once an order is accepted by DoorDash Drive, it appears in the In Progress tab in Orders with an estimated time for pickup. Your customers receive a text message with tracking info. If your order is rejected by DoorDash Drive, you'll be notified about it in the dashboard.

title: How can I set the general rules for reservations in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Booking Engine next to Reservation Settings. Click the Auto-confirm reservations toggle to choose whether you manually confirm reservations or confirm each reservation automatically: Enabled means reservations confirm automatically, and you can choose whether this rule applies to All Reservations or only to Paid Reservations; Disabled means you prefer to manually confirm each reservation yourself. Click to select the Let guests reserve multiple rooms checkbox: Checked means guests can reserve multiple rooms per booking, and you can set the Max number of rooms per reservation; Unchecked means guests can only reserve one room per booking. Click Save at the top.

title: How do I add and set up Wix Multilingual on my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add Wix Multilingual in the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Add Apps on the left side of the editor, type 'Wix Multilingual' in the search box, select Wix Multilingual, and click Add to Site.

To set up the app in the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Settings at the top and select Multilingual, then click Get Started. Confirm your site's main language or change it. Note: your main site language is the default language for visitors viewing your site, and this cannot be changed after selection. Select a flag to represent the language on your site.

Add your secondary language: click + Add Language and select the relevant language from the Language drop-down. You can add more languages later. Click the Make site visible to visitors toggle: Enabled means visitors will be able to see your site in your secondary language once you publish; Disabled means your secondary language is hidden until you are ready to display it on your live site. Click the Auto-translate site content toggle: Enabled means your site's content is automatically translated and you can review and edit the translation before publishing; you are granted 3000 word credits for free when auto-translating, and if you need more word credits, click Get more word credits and select a package. Disabled means translate your site's content manually by entering your own translations in the translation manager. Click Add Language.

Wix recommends reviewing the list of translatable content before translating your site.

title: How can I create a custom form to collect additional information at checkout for pricing plans?
content: To create your custom form, go to Pricing Plans settings in your site's dashboard, click the Checkout tab at the top, scroll down to the Collect additional info at checkout section, and click + Create Form. Edit the default My Form title at the top left and click the Save icon. Drag a form field to the Add form fields box. Optional: customize the field by clicking the field, clicking Settings, and using the available options on the right. Note: The specific customization options vary depending on the field you added. Repeat the steps above to add and customize more fields. When your form is ready, click Save at the top right.

title: Does Wix Stores support affiliate marketing for my store?
content: Currently, Wix Stores does not offer an affiliate marketing tool that would allow others to become your affiliates and sell your store products. However, you can create an affiliate program using any of the following third-party apps: Goaffpro Affiliate Marketing, Simple Affiliate, OSI Affiliate Software, and Metricks. Go to the Wix App Market to search for additional apps.

title: What are the differences between the Website Plans and Business & eCommerce Plans in Editor X Premium Plans?
content:
The Editor X Premium Plans are divided into Website Plans and Business & eCommerce Plans. Website Plans include Essential, Extra, and Ultra. Business & eCommerce Plans include Launch, Boost, and Scale.

Website Plans:
- Essential: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 10 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Get Ad vouchers and Premium Apps (yearly plans only).
- Extra: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 20 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Get Ad vouchers and Premium Apps (yearly plans only).
- Ultra: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 35 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Get Ad vouchers and Premium Apps (yearly plans only); Receive priority support.

Business & eCommerce Plans:
- Launch: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 20 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Accept online payments; Get Ad Vouchers; Sell on social media.
- Boost: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 35 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Accept online payments; Get Ad Vouchers and Premium Apps (yearly subscription only); Sell on social media; Receive priority support.
- Scale: Connect your own domain; Remove Editor X Ads; Get 50 GB of storage and unlimited bandwidth; Accept online payments; Get Ad Vouchers and Premium Apps (yearly subscription only); Get customized reports; Receive priority support.

title: How do I connect my Wix Studio for enterprise account to HubSpot?
content: Contact your enterprise solution success manager to connect HubSpot to your Wix Studio for enterprise account. Then, to connect your Wix Studio enterprise solution site to HubSpot: Go to Manage Apps in the relevant site's dashboard. Click HubSpot. Click Connect. Sign in to your HubSpot account.

title: How can I save an email design as a template in Wix Email Marketing?
content: Go to Email Marketing in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant email. Select Save as template. Enter a name for your template. Click Save Template. Your template is available to use.

title: Is the Wix IDE supported in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use the Wix IDE in Blocks.

title: How can I display my blog posts in a custom feed using a repeater or table on my Wix site?
content:
To display blog posts in a custom feed using a repeater or table:

Note: When using this method, site visitors cannot comment on or add likes to blog posts displayed in a custom feed using a repeater or table.

Before you begin, make sure your site has:
- The Wix Blog.
- Wix App Collections enabled.
- A few posts and categories.
- A dataset.
- The ability to connect content to a repeater or table.
- A page to display your blog posts feed.

Step 1 | Add a repeater or table to the relevant page on your site
- In the Editor, open the page where you want to display your blog feed.
- Click Add on the left side of the Editor.
- Click List.
- Drag and drop your selected repeater or table onto the page.

Step 2 | Add a dataset to the page (and connect it to the blog post collection)
- Click CMS on the left side of the Editor.
- Click Add Content Elements, then click the Add icon next to Dataset.
- Click the newly added dataset.
- Click Settings.
- Select Posts from the Connect a collection drop-down.

Step 3 | Connect the table or repeater to the dataset
- Click your repeater or table in your Editor.
- Click the Connect to Data icon.
- From the Connect a dataset drop-down, select the Posts dataset.
- Link each of the components of your repeater or table to the appropriate fields in the collection. Click the arrow next to each of the components in the repeater or table (text, image etc.) and connect each one to the desired fields in the collection. Note: You can also link an image or button to Post Page URL (URL). This brings the visitor to that blog post when clicked.
- Click Preview.

What’s Next?
- You can control the number of posts being shown using the repeater’s Dataset Settings or the Table Layout.
- Add a pagination or a load more button to display more blog posts.
- Adjust the order of your post to show a specific sequence.
- Create a custom feed displaying blog posts from specific categories.

title: How can I add or update a DKIM (TXT) record to my domain in Wix?
content: Before you begin, get the DKIM record from your email provider. To add or update a DKIM record in Wix: Go to Domains in your Wix account. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain. Select Manage DNS Records. Scroll to the TXT (Text) section and click + Add Record. Enter the DKIM selector under Host Name. Enter the DKIM signature under Value. Click Save. Note: For Google Workspace business emails, generate a DKIM record with your email provider. Important: If your domain is connected via pointing, these directions do not apply. Contact your domain host to add DKIM records with them, as they control your DNS.

title: How can I add a gradient background to a section in Editor X?
content:
To add a gradient background to a page section in Editor X:

- Click the relevant page section on your site.
- Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
- Click the Design icon.
- If it's disabled, enable the Media & Pattern toggle.
- Click the color box under Color.
- In the Color Picker, click the Gradient icon.
- Choose the gradient type from the drop-down: Linear, Radial or Conic.

For a Linear, Radial or Conic gradient, you can:
- Change the angle by clicking the current angle on the gradient preview and entering the desired angle (Linear and Conic).
- Change the focal point by clicking the current focal point on the gradient preview, then holding and dragging it to the desired location (Radial and Conic).
- Change an existing color by clicking the color dot on the colors bar under the preview, clicking the color box, and selecting a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
- Add more colors by clicking on the desired location on the colors bar under the preview, then selecting a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish. You can also drag the slider to change the color's opacity.
- Delete a color by clicking the color dot you want to remove on the colors bar under the preview, then clicking the Delete Color icon.

To save the gradient, click + Add next to My color gradients.

For a Fluid gradient:
- In the Color Picker, click the Fluid Gradient icon.
- Change an existing color by clicking the color dot you want to change on the gradient preview, clicking the color box below the preview, and selecting a different color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
- Add more colors by clicking on the desired location on the gradient preview, then selecting a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish. Adjust the new color by dragging the slider to change the color's opacity, dragging the slider under Size to change the amount of space this color takes up in the gradient, or dragging the slider under Spread to set how much each color spreads across the gradient.
- Delete a color by clicking the color dot you want to remove on the gradient preview, then clicking the Delete Color icon.

To save the gradient, click + Add next to My fluid gradients.

title: How can I find my site in the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, tap the site drop-down at the top, then tap the relevant site from the list. To organize your sites, tap the More Actions icon next to the site list; you can hide the sites you don't use or move old sites to the trash. If you can't find your site, you might be signed in to the wrong account. Tap your profile picture at the top left to check which account you're signed into, and tap Log Out if you're in the wrong one. If you're not sure which account your site is in, use the account recovery tool.

title: How can I disable a payment method in Wix Retail POS?
content:
To disable a payment option in Wix Retail POS, follow these steps:

- Open the POS tablet.
- Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
- Tap the Settings tab.
- Tap the Payment tab.
- Tap the toggle next to any payment methods to disable them.

title: Can I integrate Wix Stores with Stamps.com for shipping?
content:
Integrating Wix Stores with shipping software, such as Stamps.com, Shipping HQ, Shyp, etc. is not supported. However, the following options are now available:

- Wix Stores Shipping Labels
- Shippo
- ShipStation
- Boxtal (Available only in France)
- Melhor Envio (Available only in Brazil)
- Envia (Available only in parts of North and South America)

title: How can I reorder programs in the Program List using the Wix Editor?
content: To reorder programs in the Program List using the Wix Editor: go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click Program Pages, click your Program List page, click the Program List element on your page, click Settings, and click Programs. For categorized programs, click the Category drop-down and select the relevant one. Then click and drag a program to reorder it in the list.

title: How do I assign my Branded App plan to a different site in my Wix account?
content: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. Click the Show More icon next to your branded app plan. Click Assign to a Different Site. Select the checkbox next to the relevant site. Click Next. Click Assign to confirm.

title: how can we accept payments as a college council that is not a registered business
content: Wix Payments recommends an Individual account if you do not have an EIN or a relevant company registration ID. To create an Individual account, you need acceptable identification, a physical address (PO boxes are not accepted), a brief business description, and bank account details whose holder name matches the personal details; only a personal bank account can be used. If the organization is an unregistered charity/NGO, the source says it is not possible to create a business account and that Wix does not support unregistered charities; it suggests checking other payment providers.

title: What should I do if I am experiencing issues with my images on my site?
content: Please try the following: make sure that the files you are uploading meet the requirements; view your site on another device to see if the image issue occurs there as well; click any "?" inside the editor and type your problem to see if you find the answer you are looking for; and follow the general interactive tutorial. If you are still having problems after completing these steps, contact Customer Care and provide a screenshot of the issue.

title: Is it possible to send an email campaign without publishing its web address?
content: No. When you create and send an email campaign, the email is also published on a specific web address. Subscribers can access it through the email itself, but others can only access it if you give it to them directly. Currently, it is not possible to send an email campaign without publishing it.

title: How do I log into the Avalara dashboard for the first time after starting to calculate tax rates with Avalara?
content: To log in for the first time after you started calculating tax rates with Avalara, set up an Avalara password: click this link to set your Avalara password, enter the email you used to sign up with Avalara, click Request reset, click the link in the email you receive, create a new password, and click Save.

title: How can I set a charge for additional guests in Wix Hotels?
content:
To set the charge for additional guests in Wix Hotels:

- Go to your dashboard.
- Click the **Hotels** tab.
- Click the **Rooms** tab.
- Click the **Edit** icon for an existing room, or click **Create New** to create a new one.
- Scroll down to the **Price** section.
- Click the **Rate Type** drop-down menu and select how you want to charge for the room.
- Click **More pricing options**.
- Click the **For each guest above** drop-down menu and select the number of adults above which the charge applies.
- Enter the additional charge under **Charge**.
- Click **Save**.

**Important:** Additional charges only apply to adults. It is not possible to charge an additional fee for kids.

**Tip:** You can also set a different price for additional guests when creating seasonal rates.

**Note:** This article refers to the original Wix Hotels. The new Wix Hotels by HotelRunner is not yet available to all users.

title: Can customers pay in installments using the Branded App?
content: Currently in Branded App, when your app users purchase a product or service, they need to pay the entire amount upfront. It is not possible to allow customers to pay in installments.

title: How can I pause my Wix Loyalty Program?
content:
Temporarily pause your loyalty program if you want to make changes or stop people from joining. Once your program is paused, customers cannot earn additional points or redeem rewards. New site members also can't join the program. You can still give points manually from your site's dashboard.

To pause your loyalty program:
- In your site's dashboard, go to Loyalty Program. Click Manage Program. In Earn Points, click every Active toggle to make it Inactive. In Rewards, click every Active toggle to make it Inactive.
- Go to your Editor. Click Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click Main Pages. Click the Loyalty page. Click the More Actions icon. Click Hide from Main Menu. Do not delete the page.
- Go to your Editor. Click Pages on the left side of the Editor. Click Member Pages. Click the More Actions icon next to My Rewards. Click Delete.

Important: Do not delete the Loyalty page from your site as that deletes your loyalty program. The My Rewards page, which is a separate page in the Members Area, is the only page you should delete.

title: How can I override the SEO settings for a specific page in Wix Editor or Studio Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO basics, and edit the page's SEO Basics settings. In Studio Editor, go to your editor, click Pages on the left side of the editor, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant page, click SEO Basics, and edit the page's SEO Basics settings. You can override the SEO Settings only for Product Pages, Site Pages, Event Pages, Blog Post Pages, and Blog Category Pages. You cannot override Forum Posts, Forum Categories, Pro Gallery Expand Mode, Blog Tags, or Challenges.

title: Is there a specific field type for email addresses in CMS collections?
content:
Currently, CMS collections do not have a field type used specifically for email addresses.

Workarounds:
* To create dynamic links that open the visitor's mail client: Create a URL field type in your collection for storing the email addresses. Add the email addresses to the field with mailto: at the beginning of each address (e.g. mailto:support@email.com). Link a button or image to a dataset that connects to this URL field. When visitors click the link, their email client opens with the relevant address in the 'To:' field.
* To store email addresses submitted through custom CMS forms: Use the Text Input element set to collect emails. Connect it to a Text or URL field type in your collection where the emails will be stored.

title: How can I get my Wix site featured as an inspiring site?
content: Submit your Wix site to get featured as an inspiring site. All of the showcased sites belong to real Wix users.

title: How can I export my Wix site content for manual translation?
content: Go to Multilingual in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant language. Click Export Content. Click Export Content again to download the CSV file.

title: How can I add a dynamic list page for my events using the Wix Editor?
content: Before you begin, add Wix Events to your site and publish your events; add the CMS to your site if you haven't already; and enable Wix app collections so you can use Wix Events with the CMS. In the Wix Editor, click CMS on the left, click Wix App Collections, scroll down to the Events collections, hover over Events, click the More Actions icon and select Add dynamic page, click List page, and click Add to Site.

title: How can I manage event orders using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Events. Select Published Events. Select the relevant event. Tap the Manage tab. Scroll down and select Orders. Tap the relevant order. You can search or filter your orders to find the one you need. Tap the More Actions icon at the top. Choose what you want to do: Mark as Paid (if unpaid), Resend tickets, View contact, or Cancel order.

title: Can I define a delivery area by district for my Wix Restaurant orders?
content: Currently, it is not possible to select a geographical area (e.g. a city, district or state) when setting up a delivery area for online restaurant orders. You can, however, manually define a delivery area using the Draw your own function. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

title: Can clients reschedule their sessions using the Wix Member Apps?
content: Yes. Clients can now reschedule their appointments, or their class or course sessions using the Wix mobile member apps (Spaces by Wix, Fit by Wix, and Branded App).

title: How can I change the 'Room' text for different languages on my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner site?
content:
To change the 'room' text in Room Types:

- Go to Languages in your site's dashboard.
- Scroll down to the Translate your content section.
- Select the language in which you want to edit your site text from the drop-down on the right.
- Click Translate next to Room Types.
- Hover over the relevant room type and click Translate.
- Select the relevant language from the Translate into drop-down at the top right.
- Click to edit any of the translated text.
- Click Save.
- Repeat the editing and saving for all relevant languages.

Make sure you update the 'room' text in the Booking Engine so it matches the text you chose in the Room Types section under Languages.

To change the 'Room' text in the Booking Engine:

- Go to Languages in your site's dashboard.
- Scroll down and click to expand Property Settings.
- Hover over Booking Engine and click Translate.
- Select the relevant language from the Translate into drop-down at the top right.
- Enter "Room" in the search bar in the top right.
- Enter the relevant text for each relevant reference to "room" on the booking engine.
- Click Save.
- Repeat the language selection, search, editing, and saving for all relevant languages.

title: How can I connect my Wix site to Google using the SEO Setup Checklist?
content: Open the SEO Setup Checklist in your site's SEO dashboard, complete the checklist in Step 1 of your SEO Checklist, then click Connect to Google. To connect to Google Search Console, you need a Premium plan and a domain connected to your site, either purchased from Wix or from another domain host. Only site owners and admin collaborators can access the SEO Setup Checklist; it is not available to back-office managers. If information needed to submit your site to Google is missing, it appears in the pop-up with instructions. You can skip a step and complete later steps, but skipped steps remain incomplete, and you cannot complete the SEO Checklist until all steps are finished. You cannot verify your site using the SEO Setup Checklist more than once; if you need to verify again, do it manually. If you get an error, try the Troubleshooting article.

title: How can I sync my Wix Bookings calendar with my Google calendar?
content: To sync your Wix Bookings and Google calendars, go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon at the top. Click Sync personal calendar. Click Sync next to Google Calendar. If necessary, select the Google account you want to connect to Wix Bookings. Click Allow to sync your calendars. Before you begin, be sure to upgrade your site to sync your personal calendar with Wix Bookings.

title: Can I change the background color for videos uploaded from YouTube or Vimeo in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, selecting a background color for videos uploaded from YouTube or Vimeo is not possible. Meanwhile, you can change your background color and then replace your colored background with your video.

title: How can I cancel an unpaid order in Wix Stores?
content: To cancel an unpaid order, go to the Orders tab in your site's dashboard, click the relevant unpaid order, click More Actions at the top right, and select Cancel Order. Optionally select Update inventory to return all items to stock; this option is available only if you use Wix Stores and track inventory amounts. Optionally select Send a confirmation email to customer, and optionally enter a personal note to your customer; the note appears at the top of the confirmation email. Click Continue, then click Cancel This Order. This cannot be undone.

title: How can I add DNSSEC to an existing Wix domain subscription?
content: Private registration and DNSSEC are available when purchasing a domain or when manually extending its registration for at least one year. To add DNSSEC while extending an existing domain registration, extend for at least an additional year and choose the Private registration and DNSSEC option. In your Wix account, go to Domains, click Extend next to the relevant domain, select a registration period (e.g., extend by an additional one, two, or three years), click Continue, select Private registration and DNSSEC, click Continue, enter your payment information, and click Submit Purchase. You cannot apply Private registration and DNSSEC to an existing domain subscription; if you already have a domain, you can extend your domain subscription and add privacy protection during the extension process.

title: How can I temporarily turn off private registration for my Wix domain?
content: To turn off private registration, go to the Domains page. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant domain and select Edit Contact Info. Scroll down and click Show more to the right of Privacy Protection. Click Turn off privacy protection, then click Turn Off Privacy. Important: If you are an EU citizen and you turn off privacy, the following info will be public in whois: State/ province, country, organization name. You can turn private registration back on by clicking Turn on privacy protection next to Privacy Protection.

title: How can I create and schedule social media posts using the Social Media Marketing dashboard?
content: Use the Social Media Marketing dashboard to create different types of content, such as image or video posts, and publish directly to your social accounts. You can also use the scheduling tool to get your content out there at a time that suits your business best. You can create multiple posts and set them to send over the next few days or weeks, so your content keeps flowing without having to be available to actually send it.

title: Where can I find Marketing Integrations in my site's dashboard to connect tools like Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics?
content: Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. Find the integration that you want to add, click Connect, and follow the instructions to complete set up.

title: What can I do with Wix Video Maker?
content:
Wix Video is a promotional resource for your business and brand, and a great way to showcase your business and make special announcements, such as a sale or a product release. With Wix Video Maker you can:

- Create professional-looking promotional videos that you can use on your site, web and social media.
- Create custom content that appears throughout your video in intervals.
- Choose a video template to suit the style of your business and brand.
- Select the perfect background music to play throughout your video.
- Circulate your business information with viewers.

To learn how to get started with Wix Video Maker, see the Wix support article referenced in the original source.

title: How can I add a preset collection in the Wix Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click CMS on the left side of the editor. Click Add a Preset. Hover over the preset that you want to add and click Add to Site. The Portfolio preset has a dynamic list page with a Pro Gallery that connects to the collection; the dynamic list page with all the other presets includes a repeater with attached elements that connect to the collection.

title: How can I create a full screen pop-up menu using Wix Editor?
content: Use the lightbox element in Wix Editor to create a full screen pop-up menu. Add a lightbox from Add Elements > Interactive, then click the lightbox, open Settings, rename it to something recognizable such as "Menu", and select No under Automatically display lightbox on pages. Delete all elements inside the lightbox but do not delete the 'X' icon. Add a vertical menu to the lightbox and design your menu; Wix recommends large and centered menu fonts. When ready, click Exit Mode. Next, add a button from Add Elements > Decorative > Basic Shapes > More Basic Shapes, type "menu" in the search bar, select a menu button design, and click Add to Page. Select the menu button, optionally use the Design icon, click the Link icon, select Lightbox, choose your lightbox, and click Done. Place the menu button in a prominent location such as the header; if it is not in the header, set it to show on all pages or use Pin to Screen. Finally, access your mobile Editor, click the menu button linked to your lightbox, and click the Hide icon.

title: What features are available for free when using Wix Video, and how can I manage my video storage limits?
content:
### Free Wix Video features
- Customize the layout and design of your video player.
- Organize your videos into channels.
- Upload videos to and from social platforms like YouTube, Facebook and Vimeo.
- Stream up to 10-minute long live stream videos.

### Exceeding the free video limit
- Uploads: You cannot upload a video that exceeds your video limit.
- Live Stream: If your live stream exceeds your storage limit, it is saved in your Video Library.

You can increase your video limit by upgrading your site.

Note: Your video storage limit is per site. To increase the limit on more than one site, you'll need to upgrade each site individually.

title: How can I split a strip into columns using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the strip element, click the Layout icon, then click Add Column.

title: How can I view the available print sizes in my Wix Photo Album Store?
content: To view available print sizes, go to your Photo Albums in your site's dashboard. Click the Album Store tab on the left, click Pricing, then click Edit next to the relevant product. You can also adjust your profit margin up or down or choose to round your pricing; remember to click Save when you're done. Available print sizes depend on the size of the original file (the bigger the original file the more sizes will be available) and on the location of your customer. You can view and select the print sizes you want to offer during the Album Store setup process. Note: Wix Photo Albums Store is not available to all users; as of February 2023, it is no longer possible to add Wix Photo Albums Store to your site, and an alternative is to add Wix Stores to your site and connect it to Printful to sell your photos.

title: Can I use the same coupon for multiple event dates in Wix Events?
content: Currently, you can create a coupon for all events or one specific event. However, it's not possible to use the same coupon for multiple event dates. This includes various dates of a recurring event, or different single-date events.

title: Can I change the design of the Language Menu on my mobile site to be completely different from the desktop version?
content: While you can customize the text size and layout of your Language Menu on mobile, it is not possible to make the design completely different from desktop.

title: How do I set a monthly budget for my Facebook Ads campaign with Wix?
content: Go to Facebook Ads in your site's dashboard. Navigate to Monthly Budget (Step 3) in the campaign setup flow. If you haven't started setting up your campaign, follow the setup steps before you can choose a budget. Drag the slider under How much do you want to invest? to choose a budget amount. You can see how much the monthly subscription equals per day and get an estimate of ad views on this budget. Click Next at the bottom to review your ad and budget. Tip: Let your campaign run for a few months so Wix's AI can learn about your products or service and which ads are performing best.

title: How can I change my domain connection from pointing to name servers in Wix?
content:
To change your connection from pointing to name servers:

- Go to Domains in your Wix account.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select Remove from Wix.
- Click Remove Domain.
- Click Connect a domain you already own.
  Note: If you don't see this option, click Add an Existing Domain, then select Connect a domain you already own.
- Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click Next.
- Enter your domain name and click Next. If required, confirm that you are the owner of that domain.
  Tip: Keep this window open so you can return to verify your connection in step 7.
- Click Start and follow the instructions on screen to update your DNS records with your domain host.

Notes:
- If you don't see instructions to update your DNS records in step 7, you've already updated them.
- It can take up to 48 hours for your domain connection to go live worldwide due to DNS propagation.

title: Can I purchase and print shipping labels using the Wix app?
content: Currently, it is not possible to buy and print shipping labels using the Wix app. Wix shipping labels can only be purchased on desktop.

title: Can I automatically apply discounts for customers who are part of my Loyalty Program in Wix?
content: Currently, it is not possible to automatically apply discounts for customers who are a part of your Loyalty Program. You can, however, automatically give loyalty points to customers.

title: How can I set up installment payment options for my Wix Store using a payment provider?
content:
Connect one or more of the relevant payment providers. For instructions, click any of the links in the table provided in the article.

Then go to your store's Product Page in the Editor:
- Wix Editor: Click the Pages icon on the left side of the Editor, click Store Pages, and select the Product Page.
- Editor X: Click the Pages icon at the top bar of Editor X, scroll down, and select the Product Page.

Click the Product Page in the Editor, click Settings, click the Design tab, click Product Details, and select the Light or Dark display mode.

After you add the payment provider to your site, customers see your installment options on the product page. During checkout, customers can select one of the options, log in to their accounts or create a new one, and complete the purchase.

title: How can I connect Stripe as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: On your site's dashboard, go to Accept Payments. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers, then click Connect next to Stripe. Select an option: if you already have a Stripe account, enter your email and password; to claim your Wix Stripe account, enter an email and password, fill in the form (learn about claiming your Stripe account for detailed instructions), and click Authorize access to this account. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: Can I transfer a purchased Wix logo to another Wix account?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to transfer a purchased logo to another Wix account.

### Workarounds
* You can download the logo files and pass them on to the new site owner or any other person.
* You can attach the logo to a site within your first Wix account, then transfer the whole site to the second account.

title: How can I customize the registration form for a ticketed event in Wix Events?
content: To customize the registration form for a ticketed event in Wix Events: Go to Events in your site's dashboard, select the relevant event, click the Settings tab, and click Edit next to Registration Form. Choose whether to collect info per order or per ticket: fill out a registration form per order, or fill out a registration form for each ticket in an order. Edit the form text by hovering over text fields, clicking the Edit icon, editing the text, and clicking the checkmark to save. Add additional preset fields by clicking Add More Options, selecting the field you want to add (Phone number, Address, Date, Comments or Custom Question), editing the option using the available customizations, and optionally selecting Make this info required. If you add a custom question and select Dropdown Menu, Multiple Choice, or Checkboxes as the response type, enter all the options guests can choose from by pressing Enter after every choice. Optionally edit the Continue button text by hovering over Continue, clicking the Edit icon, editing the button text, and clicking the checkmark to save. Click Save at the top right. Note: First name, last name, and email are required fields on the registration form and cannot be removed.

title: What are the most popular domain extensions available for purchase on Wix, and what are their typical uses?
content: The most well-known and popular top-level domains (TLDs) are .com, .org, and .net. .com is often considered the default extension for web addresses and is widely trusted by online users. .org is typically used by non-profit organizations, but may also include other organizations, communities, and educational institutes. .net is widely used by businesses, individuals, and technology-related websites. You can purchase all of these popular domains on Wix.

title: How can I connect Exactly as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: To connect Exactly as a payment provider on your Wix site: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Exactly. If you have an Exactly account, enter your Project ID and Api Key, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Exactly account, fill in the registration form, and wait for an email or chat message from Exactly to get your Project ID and Api Key credentials. Then return to the Accept Payments tab and follow the Have an account steps to connect your account. Make sure the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Exactly account; if the currencies do not match, transactions may be declined.

title: How can I connect my hotel to booking channels like Booking.com using the Wix Channel Manager?
content: For the original Wix Hotels: go to your dashboard, click the Hotels tab, click the Reservations tab on the left side of the Wix Hotels dashboard to expand the options, click Channel Manager, then click Start Now. Select the first channel you want to connect. If you have an account with the selected channel, enter the required information such as ID, username, and password. If you do not yet have an account, click the provided link to create an account, then enter the required information. Click Next. If Room Types and Rate Types do not appear on the Room Type Mapping page, contact HotelRunner. Match the first room type so the information entered in Wix Hotels matches the channel information. Map Availability for each room type, including room and price options, and map room rates. The mapping process is different for each channel. Click Next Room Type and repeat the mapping process for each room type. After all room types are correctly mapped, click Complete & Send Room Mapping. Complete any additional steps required by the selected channel, then click Activate. After completing this process, reservations made in other channels appear in your Wix Hotels Reservation Calendar.

title: How do I duplicate a brand in Wix Logo Maker's Brand Studio?
content: Go to My Logos & Brands to access the stand-alone Logo Maker, click the brand you want to customize, click Brand Actions, then click Duplicate brand.

title: How can I invite someone to collaborate on a site using the Wix Studio app?
content: Go to your relevant workspace in the Wix Studio app. Tap Sites at the bottom. Tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant site. Tap Invite Collaborators. Tap Invite Others. Enter the email address of the person you're inviting. Select the checkbox next to the relevant role under Choose Roles. Tip: Create a custom role on your desktop for your collaborators. Tap Send.

title: How can I add Modalyst dropshipping products to my Wix store using the Wix dashboard?
content: To add Modalyst products using the Wix dashboard, select the ready-to-sell product(s) you want to add, click **Add Products**, then click **Add Products** to confirm. New products are automatically hidden, so unhide your new products when you're ready to display them in your live store. Products come with optimized settings, so you can start selling right away; if you want to customize the settings, you're free to do so. Wix uses AI to suggest products based on your industry and information about click-through behavior. Select the ones you want and click to add them.

title: Can I create subscription-based posts in my Wix group?
content: Yes, you can now create subscription-based posts in your group.

title: How can I cancel and refund an order using the Wix mobile app?
content:
To cancel and refund an order using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Sales.
- Tap Orders.
- Tap the relevant order.
- Tap the More Actions icon at the top right.
- Select Issue refund.
- For Cancel and refund manual orders: contact your customer and refund the money; deselect products you do not want to refund; if you track inventory, enable or disable Update Inventory; optionally tap Edit Amount for a custom refund amount; tap Next; select a refund explanation from Select; enable or disable Send a confirmation email to customer; optionally enter a note; tap Next; tap Issue Refund to confirm. This cannot be undone.
- For Cancel and refund orders paid through PayPal, Stripe, or Wix Payments: if multiple items were purchased, select what you want to refund and cancel; tap Next; optionally edit the refund amount; if you track inventory, enable or disable Update Inventory; optionally select a reason from Refund Reason; optionally enable Send a confirmation email and enter a note; tap Apply; tap Cancel Order. This action cannot be undone.
- For Cancel and refund orders paid through other payment methods: go to the dashboard of the payment provider and refund the order; return to the app and change the status to canceled and refunded; enable Mark order as Refunded; optionally edit the refund amount; tap Next; tap Confirm. This action cannot be undone.

title: How can I add a policy checkbox for my Wix event registration?
content:
You can add a policy checkbox that guests see during checkout; guests must agree to your policies to register for an event. To add it:
- Go to Events in your site's dashboard.
- Select the relevant event.
- Click the Settings tab.
- Click Edit next to Event Policies.
- Scroll down and click Edit next to Event Policies.
- Click Create Policy.
- Enter a policy name (e.g. Refund Policy).
- Enter the policy details (e.g. You can receive a full refund up to 7 days before the event). Guests can click the link to read your policy.
- Click Create Policy.
- (Optional) Click +Add Custom Policy to add an additional policy.

Note: You can add up to 3 policies. The checkbox applies to all the policies you add. It's not possible to add a separate checkbox for each policy.

title: How can I add the Wix FAQ app to my site using the Wix Editor?
content:
To add the Wix FAQ app to your site using the Wix Editor:

- Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
- Search for the FAQ app in the search bar.
- Click **Add to Site**.

Tip: Cut and paste the app to move it to another page on your site.

title: How can I increase the number of collection items for my site if I have a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan?
content: If you have a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan and need more collection items than your plan allows, contact our sales team to discuss a custom CMS quota. Custom CMS quotas are available only for sites with a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan. Getting a custom CMS quota increases the total number of collection items your site can have. The new quota replaces your current quota rather than adding to it.

title: I am purchasing a yearly Premium plan that includes a free domain for one year. Do I need to purchase the plan first before I can redeem the voucher?
content: With the initial purchase of selected yearly or multi-year Premium or Studio site plans, you receive the 1 year free domain voucher. The voucher must be redeemed within 2 months of purchasing your plan, and you can check its expiration date in the Premium Vouchers section of your account. To use it, go to Domains in your Wix account, click Buy a Domain or Get a New Domain, search for the domain, choose a registration period, and make sure the voucher is applied in the summary section. When claiming the voucher, enter your payment information; you won't be charged, and you'll see the voucher discount applied before submitting your purchase. The voucher is limited to new domains only and cannot be applied retroactively to a domain purchased before your yearly plan or used to renew a Wix domain.

title: How can I add a cancellation policy in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
content: Go to Property Settings in your site's dashboard. Click Manage Policies next to Cancellation and deposit policies. Click + Add cancellation policy. Enter the policy name and a detailed policy description. Optionally add a penalty by enabling Add penalty condition, entering how many days before check-in the penalty applies, choosing a cut-off time, and choosing Fee type: Fixed amount or Percentage. Enable the Activate policy toggle at the bottom. Click Add Cancellation Policy to confirm. Then go to Rate Plans under Property Setup in your site's dashboard, click Edit next to the relevant Rate Plan, select the relevant cancellation policy from the Cancellation policy drop-down, and click Save. Make sure you add the cancellation policy to all relevant Rate Plans for the policy to take effect.

title: How can I customize my Wix site's default SEO settings?
content: Open the SEO panel and enter the text you want to appear in the relevant fields. Once you re-write a field's value, your new custom setting will override Wix's default setting.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual with the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner app to translate my site?
content: Currently, it is not possible to use Wix Multilingual with the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner app to translate your site.

title: How can I connect Tilopay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if it is incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options, then click Connect next to Tilopay. If you have an existing account, enter your KEY, Password and Username, then click Connect. If you do not have an account, click Create Tilopay account, register for a Tilopay merchant account to receive your credentials, and once your merchant account is approved, return to this window and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I customize the automated emails sent to clients for services that require approval in Wix Bookings?
content: Currently, none of the automated emails sent to clients for services that require your approval can be customized. These emails notify clients when: their request was received; their request was approved; their request was denied; the service is being rescheduled. A personal note can be added to emails notifying that the request was declined or the session was rescheduled.

title: How can I add the 'Download The Mobile App' app to my Wix site?
content: To add the app to your site, go to your editor. Click Add Apps on the left side of the editor. Search for "Download The Mobile App" in the search bar. Click Add to Site. Click OK.

title: How can I access my Bookings reports in Wix Bookings Analytics?
content: Go to Reports in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Bookings section. Select the relevant report.

title: Does the 14-day refund policy apply to a Premium plan renewal?
