content: The 14-day refund policy only applies to new Premium or Studio plans. It does not apply if you are requesting a refund for a plan renewal. If you do not meet the requirements for the 14-day refund policy, but you believe you still deserve a refund, contact us and we'll review your request.

title: How do I complete the setup for my Stripe account to start receiving payments?
content: Go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers. Click Connect beside Stripe. Enter your credentials to sign in. Fill in the form with: Country; Your product; Account details, including Your business type, EIN (Tax ID), Business Address, and Your website; You, the business representative, including Legal name, Date of birth, and Social Security Number; Credit card statement details (Statement Descriptor), including Business Name and Phone; Bank details, including Routing number, Account number, and Confirm account number; and Password. Then click Authorize access to this account. Note: The form is shown for a US business, and some fields may differ depending on your location. Your Stripe account is subject to Stripe's applicable terms, policies, and fees.

title: How can I avoid sending my email campaigns to Spam Traps?
content:
To avoid sending your email campaigns to Spam Traps, follow these guidelines:

* Do not purchase email lists.
* Make sure all your recipients have given explicit permission to send them emails.
* Send your email campaigns only to your active contacts.
* Clean your contact list at least twice a year.
* Make sure to remove recipients with whom you have not been in touch for over 6 months. You can also use campaign statistics to locate and remove addresses that consistently bounce or remain unopened.

Important: Wix does not tolerate the use of illegitimate mailing lists and if a spam trap identifies that you are using such a list, your Wix Email Marketing account will be restricted. Purchased mailing lists are against the Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use and Best Practices.

title: How can I troubleshoot printing orders from the Wix app using a Star Micronics TSP654II printer?
content: Check that printer paper is correctly installed and that the status indicator light is a solid green color. Unpair your mobile device and receipt printer: turn off the printer; in your mobile device's settings, tap Bluetooth to see your paired bluetooth devices; tap the 'i' symbol to the right of the printer name; tap Forget this device to remove the printer from your Bluetooth devices list. Return your receipt printer to its factory settings: turn the printer off; find the reset button located on the back of the printer and press and hold down the button; while holding down the reset button, turn on the printer; when the ERROR light flashes, you can release the button; wait until the ERROR light stops flashing; to complete the reset, turn off the printer a second time, wait 5 seconds, and then turn on the printer again. Re-pair your mobile device with the receipt printer. Restart the printer. Go to your mobile device's bluetooth settings, and confirm that the Star Micronics printer shows Not connected. Tap the printer to connect to it. When the printer shows as Connected, restart it again. When the printer turns on, it should show briefly as Not Connected, and then as Connected. Test the printer by printing a test receipt.

title: How can I apply a page layout without a header and footer in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor, click **Menus & Pages** on the left side of the Editor, click the relevant page, click the **More Actions** icon, click **Settings**, then click the **Layouts** tab. Select the checkbox next to **No Header & Footer**. Note: if you choose the **No Header & Footer** layout, the page does not display the menu in the header; if you want visitors to navigate to the rest of your site, make sure to link a button to your site's main page. Pages with no header or footer also do not display elements set to "show on all pages". Certain apps do not appear on your live site if you have hidden the header and footer.

title: Can I create a manual order using the Wix app?
content: Currently, it's not possible to create a manual order in the Wix app. It is, however, possible to create a manual order on desktop.

title: Is Wix ADI supported in Microsoft Edge?
content: No. Currently, several browsers can support ADI, with the exception of Microsoft Edge and IE11.

title: How do I set up the Groups List page in ADI after adding the Wix Groups app?
content:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added the Wix Groups app to your site and created your first group.

To set up your Groups List page in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Click the **Pages** drop-down in the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click **Groups**.
3. Choose a layout for your Groups List:
   1. Hover over the **Groups** element in the ADI builder and click **Design**.
   2. Hover over a design and click **Use this layout**.
4. Manage the settings of your Groups List:
   1. Hover over the Groups element in the ADI builder and click the **Show more** icon.
   2. Click **Settings**.
   3. Edit the title for your Groups List page.
   4. Choose what information to display. Select the checkboxes next to what you want to show:
      * **Title**: The Groups List page title.
      * **Sort and search bar**: A search bar that lets people search for a specific group in the list.
      * **Member count**: The number of members in each group.
      * **Image**: The cover image of each group.
      * **Admin badge:** A badge that appears next to each group you manage.

**Note**: To create a new group or update the group's information click **Manage Groups**.

title: Can I connect Privat24 through Interkassa as a payment method on Wix?
content: As of September 2024, Privat24 (Through Interkassa) is no longer available to connect as a payment provider in Wix. Merchants who have already connected to Privat24 can still process payments. However, if you disconnect your Privat24 account from Wix, you will not be able to reconnect it.

title: How can I view and manage my site's media storage usage on Wix?
content: To view your site's media storage, go to Settings in your site's dashboard and click Manage Storage. Alternatively, go to your Media Manager and view the total storage used at the bottom left; hover over the Info icon to see remaining storage. To manage files, go to Settings in your dashboard, click Manage Storage, click the More Actions icon on the relevant file(s), then choose Preview, Download, Move to Trash, or Permanently Delete. You can select multiple media files for bulk actions, and you can also open the storage manager from the Media Manager by clicking Manage Storage.

title: Can I use Wix Multilingual to translate images stored in my CMS collections for different language versions of my site?
content: Yes. You can now translate 'Image' fields in your CMS collections. Learn more about translating CMS content with Wix Multilingual.

title: How do I add an 'other' option to multi choice options in new Wix Forms?
content: You can add an 'other' option to appear as one of the multi choice options in new Wix Forms. In the editor, click the form, click Edit Form to open the form builder, select the Multi choice option, click Settings, enable the toggle Add "Other", optionally customize Checkbox text and Placeholder text, and click Save.

title: How can I resolve text appearing as two lines on my Wix site when viewed on an iPad or tablet?
content: Text can render differently on different devices and browsers, causing a single line to appear over two lines on the live site. Remove formatting by copying and pasting the text into Notepad (TextEdit on Mac), then paste it into a new text box using Ctrl + Shift + V (or Cmd + Shift + V on Mac). If necessary, format the text using the options in the Text Settings panel. In the Editor, expand the width of the text box slightly so there is room for the text to widen without appearing on the next line. Publish your site, clear your browser's cache, and view your live site to make sure the text appears correctly.

title: How can I create a new album in the Shared Gallery app on my live site?
content:
On your live site, go to the Shared Gallery page. Log in with the email address associated with your Wix account. Click Create Album. Enter a name and description for your album. Click the Add icon to add a cover image. Click Create Album.

Important: When you create your first album, another album with the same name as your site is also created. All of the photos and videos that you previously uploaded are automatically moved to this folder. Your gallery's main page will also display only albums instead of individual photos and videos. To return to displaying individual photos and videos, you need to delete your albums.

title: How can I temporarily suspend a client's membership plan using the Wix dashboard?
content: Go to Subscriptions in your site's dashboard. Select the purchased plan you want to suspend. Click the Manage Subscription drop-down. Click Suspend Subscription. Click Yes, Suspend to verify. You can repeat these steps for other clients. Important: Suspending a plan automatically suspends access to any services you connected to the plan, which may include Wix Bookings services and access to Members-Only pages, blogs, or forum posts. If your plan offers benefits not managed in your Wix dashboard, you may need to take action to stop access to those benefits. You cannot suspend plans sold with Stripe before September 19, 2019.

title: How can I sell my music online using Wix Music without a Premium Plan?
content: Wix Music lets you sell your music online for free without needing a Premium Plan. You can let your fans download your whole album or single or specific tracks in a playlist directly from your site for a price of your choice.

title: How can I customize my site on the Fit by Wix app to better suit my fitness business?
content: From the Wix app, you can customize how your site and business appears on the Fit by Wix app. You can customize every screen on the app, including re-ordering and renaming the site tabs, adding new elements to the pages, and more.

title: How can I add a transition effect to my slideshow in Wix Editor?
content:
Click the slideshow in the editor. Click the Settings icon. Select a transition under **Apply transition effects?** and customize it using the following options:

* **How long do they last?:** Choose how long or short you want the transition effects to be.
* **Where do they start?:** Select the direction the slideshow comes from.
  
  **Note:** This option is available for the vertical and horizontal transitions only.

**Note:** If you disable the **Hide content outside frame** toggle, not all transition options are available.

title: How can I create a custom template in Wix Studio from an existing site?
content: Go to Custom Templates in your Wix Studio workspace. Click + Create Template at the top right. Select Start from an existing site. Choose one of your sites to use for the template. Click Continue. Enter a name for your custom template and click Create Template.

title: How can I unpublish a blog post on Wix?
content:
You can unpublish a post by reverting it to Draft status, so the content remains available to refer to or republish later.

- Go to your site's dashboard.
- Click the Blog tab.
- Click Edit on the post you want to unpublish.
- Click the Expand icon in the top right.
- Click Revert to Draft.

Tip: You can also unpublish a post from the Wix mobile app by clicking the Show More icon beside a post and selecting Revert to Draft.

title: Are additional customization options available in the Orders app?
content: Yes. Additional customization options are available in the Orders app, and this feature is available with the Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app.

content: Currently, it is not possible to add a Post List to your blog in ADI. If you want to add a Post List, you should head to the Editor.

title: When I restore a deleted site, will my invoices be automatically restored as well?
content: Currently, when you restore a previously deleted site, your invoices are not automatically restored with it. You will need to create your invoices again.

title: How can I access the Wix Logo Maker from my site's dashboard?

To access the Logo Maker in your dashboard:

title: How can I add a document button to my Wix site and connect it to a file?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Button. Select a button under Document Buttons, or drag it to the relevant location on your page. Click the button. Click Change File. Select a file. Click Choose File to connect it to your button.

title: How can I access the Release Manager in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Site on the top bar, and click Release Manager.

title: How can I change the layout of a horizontal menu in Wix Editor?
content:
To change the layout of a horizontal menu in Wix Editor: click the menu in your editor, click the **Layout** icon, then click either the **Menu** or **Dropdown menu** tab and customize the options.

**Menu layout options**
* **How to display items that don't fit**: Choose how to display items that don't fit in the menu:
  + **Wrapped:** A second line is added to display the menu items.
  + **Scroll:** Visitors can view the hidden menu items by scrolling.
* **Horizontal spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the horizontal spacing between menu items.
* **Vertical spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the vertical spacing between menu items.
* **Items fill the whole menu:** Click the toggle to enable or disable this option:
  + **Enabled:** Menu is stretched to fit the entire menu.
  + **Disabled:** Items are not stretched, and are automatically aligned to the left, right, or center of the menu.
* **Align text:** Align the text to the left, right, or center.
* **Display items from:** Display items from left to right, or right to left.
* **Item Padding:** Use the sliders to adjust the vertical and horizontal space each item takes up in the menu.

**Dropdown menu layout options**
* **How do dropdown menus open?** Select how the dropdown items appear:
  + **Flyout:** The dropdown items appear under the menu items.
  + **Columns:** Columns appear under the main menu, containing the dropdown items.
* **Spacing between menu & dropdown menu:** Use the slider to adjust the distance between the menu and the dropdown menu.
* **Stretch to full width:** Use the toggle to enable or disable this option:
  + **Enabled:** Dropdown menu stretches to full width of the page.
  + **Disabled:** Dropdown menu stays within the gridlines of the main menu.
* **Number of columns:** Use the slider to adjust how many columns are in the dropdown.
* **Align columns:** Choose to align columns to the left, right, center, or justified.
* **Spacing between columns:** Use the slider to adjust the distance between columns.
* **Align dropdown menu:** Align the dropdown menu to the left or center.
* **Align text:** Align the dropdown text to the left, right, or center.
* **Padding:** Use the sliders to adjust the horizontal and vertical space the dropdown menu fills.
* **Spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the spacing between dropdown items.

**Note:** There are different customization options depending on the display option you have selected (Flyout/Columns).

title: How can I manage my Google reviews in Wix?
content: In your Wix site's dashboard, go to Marketing & SEO. Click Google Business Profile on the left menu, then click Manage Reviews. To reply to a review, click Reply next to the review, type your reply, and click Post reply. To edit a reply, click Edit next to the reply, edit your reply, and click Update. To delete a reply, click Delete next to the reply, then click Delete.

title: Can I start accepting payments on my site while my Wix Payments account is still under verification?
content: Wix Payments is not yet available to all users. You can start accepting payments on your site using Wix Payments almost immediately; however, Wix needs to verify your identity before your account can be fully activated.

title: Can I set repeater items as sticky in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. You can now set repeater items as sticky, so they stick to the page as visitors scroll up and down.

title: Can I manage client notifications and reminders from the Wix app on my mobile device?
content: Currently, you can choose which notifications to send your clients from Emails & SMS Reminders in your site's dashboard. You can also turn the notifications on and off from here. It is not possible to manage these notifications from the Wix app on your mobile device.

title: How do I generate a site with AI in the Wix Editor?
content: After you've entered your site details, in the dashboard click **Design Site**, then click **Generate a Design**. Choose what you want to do with your AI-generated site: **Regenerate Design**, **Tweak Design**, or edit the site brief (site profile and/or site description, site structure, theme, layout). Once you're happy with the site design, click **Continue with this Design**. Then decide how to continue: **Get a domain** (click **Let's Go** to connect or purchase a domain), **Continue to the Editor**, or **Set Up Your Business**.

title: How can I change the fonts in my Wix Restaurants Orders app to better match my restaurant's brand?
content:
To change the fonts in your Wix Restaurants Orders app:

- Go to the page that includes the Order Online app in your Editor.
- Click the Order Online app in the Editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Design tab.
- Click the dropdown icon under Titles or Text to open the font picker.
- Select the desired font.

Tip: Keep your site to 2 or 3 fonts to make it look clean and professional. Having less fonts also improves your site loading time.

title: How can I access my Wix Payments account dashboard from my Wix account?
content: From your Wix account, go to Wix Payments Accounts. Click View on the Wix Payments enabled site account you wish to view. Select the information you want to view: Payments, Payouts, Settlement Report, or Account Details.

title: How can I generate a new API key in the Wix enterprise dashboard?
content:
To generate an API key in the Wix enterprise dashboard:
- Go to API Keys in your Enterprise dashboard.
- Click + Generate API Key at the top right.
- Enter a name for your new API key under Key details.
- Select the permissions you want to assign to the API key. The basic permission to return the IDs of all the sites on your account is selected by default and cannot be deselected. For security, only add the permissions you need.
- Click Generate Key.
- Click Send Code to send a verification code to the email address linked to your account.
- Get your verification code from the email.
- Enter the code in the Verify your account pop-up.
- Click Verify & Generate Key.
- Click Copy Token & Close.
- Store the token in a safe location.

title: How do I connect my existing GMO-Epsilon account to my Wix site for accepting payments?
content:
To connect your existing GMO-Epsilon account:

- Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard.
- Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
- Click See More Payment Options.
- Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
- Click Connect next to GMO-Epsilon.
- Enter your Contract Code. The contract code is the same one you use to log in to your GMO-Epsilon account.
- Click Connect.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

title: How can I create a post in a Wix group using the dashboard?
content: Go to Groups in your site's dashboard, click the relevant group, and open the Posts tab. Click Create Post. Optionally add a title, then enter your post text. Use the available icons to add interactive content such as an image, gallery, video, GIF, file, emoji, divider, or poll. You can also embed an event, service, or product, add social media by pasting a link, add a call-to-action button, add or edit a topic, and connect Pricing Plans under Monetize if the post should be shared only with subscribed members. When ready, click Post. Note: add group members before creating a group post.

title: How can a staff member add an appointment for a client using the Wix app?
content:
To add an appointment for a client using the Wix app:
- Go to your site in the Wix app.
- Tap Manage at the bottom.
- Tap Booking Calendar.
- Tap the Add icon.
- Tap Appointment.
- Select the relevant existing contact or tap Add new contact.
- Select the relevant service from the list.
- Add the booking details.
- Tap Book.

title: How can members use the invite code to join my site on the Spaces by Wix app?
content: Your members can find the invite code in the text message or email sent to them. They should: Open the Spaces by Wix app. Tap the Profile icon at the bottom. Tap Join a site. Enter the invite code and tap Join.

title: How can I use the POS Checkout solution to accept payments for custom charges?
content: POS Checkout lets you add custom charges to the cart and accept payment for them. You can charge clients for custom amounts such as consultations, therapy sessions, or lessons. Cash payments are available for all merchants in any location. Credit/debit card payments using a card reader are available only through Wix Payments and are available for merchants in the US & Canada. You can also accept payment by manually entering credit card details if you use a payment provider that supports this option.

title: How can I manually mark an order as 'Paid' in the Wix Restaurants Orders tab?
content: To manually mark an order as Paid in the Orders tab, go to Orders in your site's dashboard and click the relevant order. Click Collect Payment at the top right, then click Mark as Paid. To mark the entire amount as paid, click Mark [$10.00] as Paid. To accept partial payment, select the Mark a custom amount as paid checkbox, enter the amount, and click Mark [$5.00] as Paid. Note: Orders marked as Paid cannot be changed back to Unpaid.

title: How can I speed up the removal of deleted sites or old URLs from search results?
content: If you verified your site with Google or Bing, you can submit a request to speed up the removal of pages that you don't want in their search results. You can manually request removals using Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools. If you did not verify your site with Google and Bing, you need to wait for them to remove the pages. If you've created a new site and the URLs from the old site are still appearing in search results, you should submit your sitemap to Google and other relevant search engines. This can help speed up both the indexing of your new site and the removal of old site URLs from search results. Note: If you have recently upgraded your site and connected your own domain, Wix automatically redirects any traffic to your free Wix URL to your new domain. When search engines crawl your site, they detect your newly connected domain and remove the free Wix URL from search results.

title: Can I use a shortcut on the canvas to add a row or column to a section grid in the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. You can use a shortcut on the canvas to add a row or column to the grid in any direction.

title: Can I merge cells in a section grid using the Studio Editor?
content: Yes. You can now merge cells in a section grid.

title: How can I add Wix Events to my site using Editor X?
content: In Editor X, click Add at the top, click Events, then click Add to Site. You can add and set up Wix Events on your site for free, but in order to sell tickets, you must upgrade your site to one of the Business Premium Plans.

title: How can I troubleshoot if I'm not receiving email notifications when a guest RSVPs to my Wix event?
content: Check that email notifications are set up correctly for the relevant event; if you are set up to receive email alerts daily, you will not receive a notification immediately each time a guest RSVPs. Send yourself a test email to make sure your mailbox is working. Check your spam/junk/bulk/promotions folder; if the notification is there, whitelist wix-team@notifications.wix.com. Try searching for missing emails using the wix-team@notifications.wix.com email address. Check the correct email address: email notifications are sent to the email address you entered in the General Info tab in your site's dashboard. For testing, try changing your business email in general info settings, preferably under a different domain (for example, if it's a Gmail address, test one that is not Gmail), then complete a test registration to check if you receive email notifications to the other email address.

title: Is there an alert icon for new bookings on the Wix App Calendar?
content: Currently, there is no alert icon or function to automatically navigate you to the new booking. You can view your daily schedule by looking at the Agenda view on the calendar in the Wix app. Whenever a new booking is made, it's automatically added to your schedule.

title: How can I add tags to my media files in Wix Editor?
content: In Wix Editor: Go to the editor. Click Media on the left side of the editor. Click Show More under Site Files. Click the relevant file. Click Tags on the right. Click Edit tags. Click the Tag field and start typing your tag. Press the Enter key on your keyboard to add it. Click Done.

title: How can I delete a page section from my ADI site?
content: Click the section that you want to delete. Click the Show More icon. Click Delete. Click Delete again to confirm.

title: How can I upgrade Universal Analytics to Google Analytics 4 (GA4)?
content: Use the GA4 Setup Assistant in your Google Analytics account to create and set up a new GA4 property: sign in to your Google Analytics account, click the Admin icon at the bottom left, select GA4 Setup Assistant, click Get Started under I want to create a new Google Analytics 4 property, click Create property, click See your GA4 property under Explore and set up your GA4 property, select Tag installation, select your stream under Data Streams, click the Settings icon, click Show advanced settings under Page views, deselect Page changes based on browser history events, disable the Site search toggle, and click Save. Then add your new property to Google Analytics in Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard: copy your measurement ID under Web stream details, go to Marketing Integrations, click View under Google Analytics, click the Show More icon in the top right corner, click Edit, paste your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID in the pop-up, make sure there are no extra spaces before the code, optionally select IP Anonymization to hide site visitors’ IP addresses from Google, and click Save. After upgrading, the source recommends continuing to use both properties.

title: Can I set up an automation condition that includes an 'else' statement?
content: Currently, it is not possible to set up an automation condition that includes an "else" statement. You can add a condition to an automation, but if this condition isn't met, the automatic "else" outcome is exiting the automation's flow.

title: Can I keep CMS database collections hidden from a site builder who installed my app in Wix Blocks?
content: Currently in Blocks, it is not possible to keep CMS database collections you created as hidden from a site builder who installed your app. This feature would allow you to create private collections, which could be used by your app code and logic, but would be hidden from whoever installed the app.

title: How can I select who has profile pages for my Wix Blog site?
content:
Before you start, add Wix Blog to your site and add a Member's Area if your site doesn't already have one. Then go to Member Pages in your Editor.

In Wix Editor: click Pages on the left side of the Editor, then click Member Pages.

In Editor X: click Pages at the top of Editor X, click Profile under Wix Members Area, click the More Actions icon next to Profile, then click Settings.

Under Members' Profiles, select who has profile pages:
- Only Blog Writers: Your Blog Writers have profiles, but your site members do not.
- Blog Writers and Members: Both writers and site members have profiles.

Click Publish, or save your site.

title: How can I manage my Google Business Profile using Wix?
content: You can manage your Google Business Profile details in your Wix account as they change over time. Update your photos to showcase new goods and services, or update your opening hours and contacts details. When you edit your profile information on Wix, the changes are also saved in your Google Business Profile. Currently, you can only invite site collaborators to Google Business Profile through Google. Learn more about adding and removing listing owners and managers.

title: Can I use Wix services to handle electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) in compliance with HIPAA?
content: Wix services are not specifically designed to comply with HIPAA. As such, Wix is unable to operate as a Business Associate, subcontractor, or agent of a Covered Entity, as these terms are defined in HIPAA. Wix does not actively filter or monitor the information or data you store, transmit, or maintain in its services before you upload it to the platform. If your business requires you to be compliant with HIPAA, you are responsible for compliance with all applicable laws governing the privacy and security of ePHI. Likewise, if you are subject to HIPAA as a Covered Entity or Business Associate, you should not use Wix services in a manner that causes Wix to create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI on your behalf. If Wix services being HIPAA compliant is something you'd like to see in the future, you can vote for that feature.

title: Can customers cancel their product subscriptions or update their shipping details on their personal My Subscriptions page?
content: No. Currently, customers cannot cancel their product subscriptions or update their shipping details, etc. on their personal My Subscriptions page. You need to make those changes for your customers. Update: Customers can now update their payment method by themselves.

title: How can I find out which email address I used to create my site if I can't find it in my account?
content: To check which email address you used when creating your site, click to go to the Account Email Locator, enter your site's URL, and click Next. You'll find the email address associated with your account under Your Wix account email is:. If you know your password, click Log In; if not, click Reset Password.

title: How do I set up tax collection for a mobile POS?
content: Go to your site's dashboard. Click Settings. Click Business Info and enter your business address in the Business Info page. Make sure your address includes a zip code / postal code. Click Tax and set up a tax rule for your region. If no tax rule is set up, POS transactions are taxed at 0%.

title: Is Paytabs supported as a payment provider on Wix?
content: Currently, Wix does not offer Paytabs as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Paytabs and arrange the payment offline.

title: How can I delete my Wix Stores when it is set as my home page?
content:
Add a new page. Click the Pages menu on the top bar. Click the Settings icon next to the new page you created. Click Set as Homepage. Click the Settings icon next to Shop. Click Delete.

Tip: If your Shop page is the home page of your site, you need to set a different page of your site as your home page.

title: How can I customize the signup form for my site's Members Area?
content: You can choose whether to show the default signup form or create your own customized version. The default signup form is already designed and matches your site; visitors register with their email address and password, and while you cannot design it from scratch, you can control some colors and fonts from the Theme Manager. A custom signup form lets you design the form from scratch and customize the title, fields, background color, and button, and you can add and remove elements as needed. The custom form appears inside a lightbox (pop-up), which is fully customizable; you can resize the lightbox, add background behind the form, and more. It is not possible to display social login buttons on a custom signup form, so if you want members to sign up and log in using Facebook / Google, use the default signup form. If you enabled Velo by Wix, you can display a Velo form for members to sign up; this option is for technical users who wish to add code to their site.

title: Can I add a tooltip to a text box in Wix Editor?
content: Currently, you can only add a tooltip (text that appears when hovering over an item) to elements such as images. You cannot add a tooltip to a text box.

title: How can I use the Insights page to make well-informed business decisions?
content: You can find the Insights page under Analytics in your site's dashboard. The insights are based on visitor activity over the last 30 days, and your site must receive at least 50 visitors in the last 30 days to see data on this page. Explore the categories to inform business decisions: Attention required shows areas that need attention, such as a major decrease in traffic from Facebook; Growth opportunities highlights opportunities such as visitors viewing a specific product page, where you might consider adding an incentive to buy; Trends shows changes in stats and compares your site with others in the same category. The page also provides tailored suggestions based on successful strategies used by similar sites, including suggestions about increasing traffic and sales. Visit the Insights page in your dashboard to get started.

title: How do I connect my Apple and Google Developer accounts for my branded app?
content: When the design and content of your app is finished, go to the Branded App dashboard in your Wix account. Click the Apple Developer Account tab and follow the instructions to start registering your account. When you've finished registering, do the same for the Google Developer Account tab. Note: Your Branded App plan does not include the app registration fee from Apple and Google. An Apple Developer account requires enrolling in Apple's Developer program, a separate cost through Apple starting at $99 USD a year. A Google Developer account requires joining the Google Developer Program, a $25 USD one-time fee paid separately to Google.

title: Can I allow visitors to filter and sort repeaters on my Wix site?
content: Currently it is not possible to allow visitors to filter and sort repeaters on your site. Workaround: If you connect your repeater to the CMS (Content Management System), you can allow visitors to use input elements such as dropdowns and checkboxes to filter the content.

title: How can I translate my Wix Bookings site into multiple languages?
content:
Start by adding and setting up Wix Multilingual.

In your site's dashboard, go to the Translation Manager and click Bookings. Review each automated translation and edit it if necessary, or manually translate the content types and strings on the left, such as pricing options and variants, categories, services, and booking policies.

In your editor, use the Switch languages drop-down menu to select the language you want to edit. Go to your Bookings pages, such as the Service page, Booking Calendar page, and Cart page. Click the booking element on the page, then click Settings and open the Text tab. Update the relevant text as needed.

You can also translate booking elements such as the featured service, service list, calendar, and next availability elements. Translate any text options that were not automatically translated.

When you finish translating, make the language visible to visitors, then publish your site as usual. Before launching your multilingual Bookings site, preview the checkout process in each language.

title: How can I clear Wix cookies from my Google Chrome browser?
content: Open Google Chrome. Click the More icon at the top right. Click Settings. Click Privacy and security on the left. Click Cookies and other site data. Scroll down and click See all cookies and site data. Type wix in the search field at the top right. Note: Make sure to type "wix" with lowercase letters. Click Clear displayed data. Click Clear.

title: How can I use a Wix Promo Code to save on a Yearly Premium Plan purchase?
content: Use a Wix Promo Code on a participating Yearly Premium Plan purchase to save 10%; the promotion does not include the Combo Premium Plan, is valid for your first purchase only, and is not valid for Editor X.

title: How can I display private events in my Google Event Calendar app on my site?
content:
To display private events in your Google Event Calendar app on your site, follow these steps:

- Click the Google Event app in your editor.
- Click Settings.
- Click the Display tab.
- Click the Show private events toggle to enable it.
- Set the text you want to display.

Tip: You can hide private events from your site calendar by disabling the toggle in the app's Display settings.

title: How can I customize the permissions of a Billing Manager collaborator on my Wix site?
content: To customize a Billing Manager collaborator's permissions, go to Roles & Permissions in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant collaborator. Click Change Role. Scroll down and click Create New Role. Enter a Role Title and an optional description of the new role. Click Billing & Domains and enable only the permissions you wish your collaborator to have. You can enable any additional permissions you'd like for the custom role; these can be outside of the Billing & Domains permissions. Click Save.

title: Can I translate blog tags in Wix Multilingual?
content: Currently, it is not possible to translate blog tags. Once a tag is created, it is given the same language as the post that it was created on or was assigned to. See the list of translatable content in Wix Multilingual.

title: How can I create a collection folder in the CMS to organize my collections?
content:
To create a collection folder in the CMS:

- Go to CMS in your Editor:
  - **Wix Editor:** Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
  - **Editor X:** Click **CMS** at the top of Editor X.
- Click **Collections**.
- Click the Settings icon.
- Click **View all Collections**.
- Click **More Actions**.
- Click **Create folder**.

title: How can I create a mirror image of an uploaded image in the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, click the image. Click Change Image. Click the relevant image in the Media Manager. Click Crop & Edit. Click the Flip horizontally or Flip vertically icons. Click Save. Click Choose Image to replace the image on your site. Note: It is not possible to create a mirror image of a free Wix image.

title: How can I connect membership plans and packages to booking services using the Wix app?
content: In the Wix app, go to your site, tap the Manage icon, tap Bookings Services, tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant service, tap Manage plans, tap Connect under the relevant package or plan or tap + Create new plan, then tap Done at the top right.

title: Can I filter the Pages panel to only show pages I have permission to edit?
content: Currently, it is not possible to filter the Pages panel so it only shows pages you have permission to edit. If you don't have permission to edit a certain page, an indication appears when hovering over it in the Pages panel.

title: Can I connect the page background of dynamic pages to the CMS?
content:
Currently, it is not possible to connect the page background of dynamic pages to the CMS (Content Management System). This feature would allow you to manage the content that appears in your dynamic page backgrounds in CMS collections.

Workaround for the Wix Editor only — you can connect regular static page backgrounds to the CMS: go to the relevant page in the Wix Editor, click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of your editor, click the More Actions icon next to the page you are on, then click **Connect to CMS**. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Add a Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click **Create**. Finally, click the **Page background connects to** drop-down and choose the Image or Video file type you want to connect.

title: How can I collaborate with my team on a site using Editor X without overriding each other's changes?
content: In Editor X, you can collaborate with your team in real-time by working simultaneously on the same site. You can edit the layout, design, and content of pages or elements without overriding people's actions. Changes made by other users appear in your Editor within seconds, which minimizes conflicts and allows efficient collaboration. To start, click Invite at the top right to invite people to join your site/account team directly from Editor X. You can also limit people's editing permissions based on their roles, restrict the pages and Master sections they're allowed to edit, use the Comments panel to stay in sync, and use Get Feedback to share your site with people without them having to create an account.

title: Can I connect my site's navigation menu to the CMS to automatically display content and links from my collection items?
content: Currently, it is not possible to connect your site's navigation menu to the CMS (Content Management System) to automatically display content and links from your collection items. This would allow you to replace your site menu's titles and links with text and links from your collection fields. You can, however, add links to your site's menu that navigate to any of your dynamic pages. Learn how to link your menu to dynamic pages.

title: 如何设计一周 Instagram Stories 互动计划，以提升互动率并为新品预热？
content: 围绕本周目标“提升互动率 + 为新品预热”，按周一至周日规划每天 3-5 条 Stories。每天目的如下：周一为本周新品预告（倒计时贴纸）；周二为用户投票；周三为教程/Tips（产品使用技巧）；周四为幕后花絮（仓库/打包/团队）；周五为用户晒单转发（UGC）；周六为限时优惠（倒计时 + 滑动链接）；周日为 Q&A 问答框（收集用户问题）。每条 Stories 需提供：画面描述、文字内容、使用的互动贴纸（投票/问答/倒计时/滑动条）、CTA。交付前自检：覆盖周一至周日 7 天，每天 3-5 条；每天的贴纸类型与当天目的匹配；每条都含 CTA，且与互动目标一致；文案未出现产品实际不具备的功能、材质、认证或效果。

title: I want to start a new website design from scratch using the Wix Editor.

title: How can I edit the notifications my clients receive through the Pricing Plans app?

Optionally, click the Active toggle next to any of the automations to disable them. Optionally, click Edit Automation next to any of the automations to customize them. To create a new category, tap Create New Category, enter a category name, description, and image, then tap Create. To turn a category into a subcategory: tap the More Actions icon next to the relevant category; if necessary, tap Move Category Up or Move Category Down to place the category directly under the relevant category; tap the More Actions icon and select Make Subcategory. title: I'm having trouble adjusting the page height in the Wix Editor for a page without a footer. The page isn't moving as expected.

If your page isn't resizing, there may be an element that's getting in the way. For example, you cannot make a page shorter if doing so will cut off an element at the bottom of the page. Move or delete the element first. If you can't find the element, use the Layers panel to locate it. This option is only available if you have chosen the No Header & Footer layout for your page.

title: Is it possible to add a 'tip' field to the invoice checkout page in Wix Invoices?

title: How can I customize the design of the Search Results page in Wix Editor?

In Wix Editor, click Pages on the left side of the editor, click the Search Results page, click the Search Results element on the page, click Settings, and click the Design tab. Then choose what you want to customize:

title: What are some best practices for improving email deliverability in Wix Email Marketing?
content:
To improve email deliverability in Wix Email Marketing, follow these best practices:

### Create and maintain your mailing list
- Only send emails to recipients who have specifically signed up for your mailing list. If you're unsure whether you have someone's permission, write them a personal message and ask if they would like to receive your campaigns and updates.
- Send your emails regularly, but not too often. We recommend sending out a maximum of 2-3 emails a week.
- Make sure all email addresses in your mailing list are valid, and clean your list every six months.

### Write engaging subject lines for your newsletter
- Write subject lines that encourage recipients to open the email by creating a sense of urgency or piquing their curiosity.
- Ensure the subject line relates to the content of the email and offers a hint about the topic.
- Avoid spammy words such as “free,” “earn $,” or “no gimmick.”
- Don't use all capital letters or many exclamation points.
- Aim for 30 characters, max.

### Clearly identify yourself and your business
- Send emails from a custom email address with a domain that matches your site.
- Always send emails from the same email address to help recipients identify your business.
- If you manage more than one site from your Wix account, use a different sender email for each site.
- Never use email addresses which expire after a certain time period.
- Stay true to your business’s branding by using colors, fonts, and language that match your marketing materials.
- Put your logo, address (if you have one), and phone number in each email, preferably in the footer.
- Include links to your social media pages and blog.

### Create interesting and relevant content
- Avoid sending emails that are only an image; include at least one sentence of text.
- Be interesting and relevant, and get to the point.
- Break up paragraphs of text with sub-headers to help readers skim your email and quickly get the information they need.

title: What are text & icon buttons in Wix Editor and what can they be used for?
content: Text & icon buttons in the Wix Editor can contain both text and a vector image icon, and you can choose whether to display the text, icon, or both. They are useful for directing visitors to other pages, information, or sites, and a popular use is to lead visitors to your services or store pages. There are a range of styles and colors to add. The source includes a "Learn how to add and set up your text & icon button" link but does not provide the step-by-step procedure.

title: How can I display product categories on the Category Page using the Wix Editor?
content: In the Wix Editor, go to your editor, click Pages & Menu, click Store Pages, click the Category page, select the Category Page in the editor, click Settings, and select List. To hide the entire category list, click the Show category list toggle to disable it. To hide individual categories, select Customize & reorder the list manually and deselect the checkbox next to the category you want to hide. You can optionally reorder categories by dragging them to the preferred order. The category list is not displayed on mobile devices, so Wix recommends adding categories to the site menu so customers viewing your site on mobile can access your categories.

title: Is domain privacy included in the price of purchasing the domain and the yearly charge?
content: The article does not state that domain privacy is included in the domain purchase price. It says that when you buy a new domain with Wix or transfer your domain to your Wix account, you can choose to purchase additional privacy and domain protection. If you already purchased or transferred your domain to Wix, you can add privacy protection by manually extending your domain registration for at least an additional year.

title: What tools does Ascend by Wix offer to help manage and grow my business?
content: Ascend by Wix provides you with a package of tools to manage and grow your business, all within your Wix account. Ascend by Wix includes: Contacts, Wix Inbox and Chat, Wix Forms, Wix Automations, Wix Price Quotes and Invoices, Tasks, Email Marketing, and Social Posts.

title: How can I assign a staff member to an appointment in Wix Bookings?
content: To assign a staff member to an appointment in Wix Bookings, go to Booking Services in your site's dashboard, select the relevant appointment, and scroll down to the Staff & Availability section. Select the checkbox next to the relevant staff member(s) to add them. Complete the rest of the form and click Save. Tip: If you have not done so already, click Rename under "Staff Member #1" to give the service provider a name.

title: How can I add a code snippet to a blog post on Wix?
content: Go to the Blog tab in your site's dashboard. Click Create New Post or Edit on an existing post. Add a post title and content, including the code. Highlight the code, click the Code Snippet icon to format it, then click Publish when ready.

title: How can I ensure that transactions are not declined when using YooKassa with my Wix account?
content: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your YooKassa account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined.

title: How can I preview my mobile site using ADI?
content: Click Preview on the top bar, click the mobile icon in the top bar, then scroll through your mobile site to see how it looks.

title: How can I unhide a hidden element in the Wix mobile editor?
content:
Click **Hidden on Mobile** on the left side of the mobile editor. Click the **Show Element** icon on the relevant element.

Note: You can unhide elements with hover interactions, however they appear without the hover effect on mobile.

title: How can I translate my restaurant reservation form and confirmation page using Wix Multilingual?
content: Before you begin, add and set up Wix Multilingual. In your site's dashboard, go to Translation Manager, click Table Reservations, review or edit automated translations if you auto-translated your site, or manually translate custom fields and policies if you did not use auto-translation, then click Save and Publish. Next, go to your editor, use the Switch languages drop-down to select the language you want to edit, go to the page with your Table Reservations widget, click the widget, click Settings, open the Text tab, update the relevant text, and click Save or Publish. You can also continue translating other pages and automated emails into your site's languages.

title: How can I create a group for my online program using Wix?
content:
Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant program. Select Edit Settings from the drop-down. Click Group. Click Connect Group. Then choose what you want to do:
- Connect an existing group: Select the relevant group.
- Create a new group: Click Create Group at the bottom. Enter the desired group name. Choose who can see and join this group under Privacy: Public, Private, or Only paying members. Click the Visibility drop-down to decide if the group appears on your site. Click Create.
Click Done. Click Save at the top right.

Tip: Existing site members can join any group, regardless of whether they have a public or private profile.

title: Can I remove the shopping cart icon from the header of my site using ADI?
content: Currently, you cannot remove the shopping cart icon from the header of your site, as it is an essential part of your online store. If you want to remove the icon from your site, head to the Editor, select the icon in the Editor, and press delete on your keyboard.

title: How can I set library permissions for users in the Wix File Share app?
content:
To set library permissions for your users in the File Share app, go to your site's editor, select the File Share app, click Settings, click the Settings tab, and click Library Permissions.

Use the Who can view and download items? drop-down to set view and download permissions:
- All members: members with a Public profile who are logged in to your site can view and download files.
- Site visitors: anyone who visits your site can view and download files.

Under Who can upload files?, click the Edit icon to select who has upload permissions. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to upload files. To create a custom role, click +Create New, then click Apply.

Under Who can manage the library?, click the Edit icon to choose who has manage permissions. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to manage files, click Apply, and click Save Changes.

title: How do I set up a billing method in Printify for my Wix store?
content: After you connect your store to Printify, add a billing method in Printify by using one of the options in the Printify dashboard: Automatic: add a payment method (PayPal or credit card) in the Printify dashboard. When a paid order comes in, or when you mark an order as "Paid", your payment to Printify is processed automatically and the order is fulfilled. Manual: when you receive an order, go to the Orders tab in the Printify dashboard and click "Fulfill orders" to pay for the order manually; Printify then fulfills it.

title: How can I add and customize a multi-step form on my Wix site?
content: To add a form, click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, then click Contact & Forms. For New Forms, click Create New Form and drag the form element onto the page; you can also select a form from the pre-installed templates including Contact, Subscribe and Order forms. Click the form and click Edit Form to open the form builder. To customize steps for New Forms, click the form, click Edit Form, click Pages on the left, click Add Page, select the new page, click Add on the left, and drag the relevant fields onto your new page. Field types include Contact fields, General fields, Date fields, and Layout elements. To rename, reorder, delete or add additional pages, select the relevant page and click Manage pages. For Old Forms, click the form and click Manage Steps above the form, select the relevant step, and customize it as needed. Note: To add more steps to your form, upgrade your site.

title: How can I connect Sipay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
content:
Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard. Check your business location at the top right; if incorrect, use the drop-down menu to change it. Click See More Payment Options. Click See Options next to Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers. Click Connect next to Sipay.

If you have an account, enter your App Id and App Secret. Optionally, enable installment payments and set installment payment preferences; you can change preferences or disable installment payments at any time. Click Connect.

If you don't have an account, click Create Sipay account. Register for a Sipay merchant account. After onboarding, retrieve your App Id and App Secret in your Sipay account. Return to Accept Payments and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

title: Can I sell event tickets created through Wix Events on my tablet at a point of sale?
content: Currently, it is not possible to sell event tickets created through Wix Events on your tablet at a point of sale. However, you can set up your phone as a point of sale and use it to sell event tickets.

title: How can I add a new product to my Wix store using the Wix app?
content:
You can add new products to your store on the go using the Wix app — no need to open your computer.

Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap **Manage** at the bottom. Tap **Store Products**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Store Products**. Tap **+ Add a Product** at the bottom. Add images, GIFs, or videos. Enter the product name. Enter the product price. Then do any of the following:

- Add a discount amount or percentage and tap **Apply**.
- Hide this product from your online store or POS: tap **Visibility**, then deselect the checkbox next to the channel where you want to hide the product.
- Enter a brief description of the product.
- Add product ribbons.
- Add an info section.
- Add the product to one or more categories.
- Add a custom text field.
- Create product options.

Next, manage how you track inventory for this product.

**Tip:** Tap the Barcode Scanner icon to add the product's barcode as your SKU.

(Optional) Add the product to a tax group you created using automatic tax calculation.

**Note:** If you created tax groups using manual tax, go to desktop to add the product to a group.

If you have a fulfiller, you can select them from the **Fulfilled by** drop-down. Then tap **Save**.

title: How can I add items to the cart using the Wix app for mobile POS?
content: To add items to the cart in the Wix app mobile POS: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Tap Point of Sale under Get Paid. Then choose what to add. For Wix Bookings services, if you also use Wix Stores tap Services, select the relevant service, add the appointment details, optionally edit the service price, optionally tap Notify client with an email, tap Add to Cart, and optionally book additional sessions. For Wix Stores products, tap Products, locate products by entering a search term, scanning the product's barcode, tapping All Products to search within a category, or scrolling through your products; select the products and variants; tap Go to Cart. For a custom charge, tap Add Custom Charge, enter the amount including cents, optionally tap Add Note and enter information about the sale, tap Apply, then tap Go to Cart.

title: How can I set the language and region details for my Wix Bookings site?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Language & Region. Use the Site Language drop-down to set your site's default language. Use the Regional format drop-down to set your site's region, which ensures that dates and numbers appear in the format of the region you choose. Use the Currency drop-down to set the currency you get paid with; this also sets the currency visitors see on your site. Use the Time zone drop-down to set both your site's time zone and the time zone of your business location. Use the Account Language drop-down to set your account language; this doesn't affect the language people see on your site. You can set which time zone you display on your site or let clients choose which time zone they prefer to see. Make sure to set the correct time zone so that your site functions properly; you can check this in the Formats preview window.

title: Is the feature to display breadcrumbs for site navigation supported?
content: Yes, you can now add a breadcrumbs element to show visitors their exact location on your client's site.

title: What should I do if my .co.uk domain is in a suspended status?
content:
If your .co.uk domain has entered a Suspended status, you may need to verify your domain or update its contact information.

Step 1 | Check for a verification email from Wix
Your domain might be suspended if you haven't verified it with Wix. Check if you received an email about the verification process from wix-team@domain.wix.com. If you find such an email, follow the process to get your domain unsuspended. The subject line of the Wix email is: 'VERIFICATION REQUIRED - Please verify your domain name(s) as soon as possible'. Make sure you are checking the email account address that you used to register your domain, or the one set as the current point-of-contact for your domain. Tip: If you can't see a verification email from Wix, check your spam folder.

Step 2 | Contact the UK domain registry (Nominet)
Another reason your domain might be suspended is if the address and contact information stored in the WHOIS records don't match the information in the official UK records. Nominet, the official registry for all .UK domain names, could suspend a domain if its information does not completely match. Contact Nominet directly to find out if they suspended your domain and how you can resolve this matter. You can reach Nominet support by phone at 01865 332244 or by email at support@nominet.org.uk.

Still need help? If you need further assistance on our part, please contact Wix Customer Care.

title: How can I ensure that only site members can access my Wix Forum and contribute to it?
content: To ensure that only site members can access your Wix Forum and contribute to it, use the Login Bar. Site membership, forum membership, and membership in the new Wix Blog is the same. Once visitors sign up to your site using the Login Bar, they can access members pages and contribute to the forum. Access to member-only pages, as well as your forum or new blog, is through the Login Bar, which by default appears beside your site menu. You can also make forum categories accessible only to members, and edit permissions for a category so only admins and moderators can write posts.

title: How can I activate members chat on my Wix site to allow members to chat with each other?
content: Go to Chat Settings in your site's dashboard. Scroll down to the Members chat section. Click the Enable members chat toggle to add or remove members chat from your site. When enabled, logged-in site members can chat with each other and start group chats. When disabled, site members can only use Wix Chat to chat with you, the business.

title: How can I keep using the free Wix URL for my website, and is it possible to edit it?
content: Your free Wix URL is in the format: siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress. You can edit the site prefix and site address sections of the URL. You can learn more about changing your free Wix URL. Whether or not you decide to purchase an upgrade plan, you are welcome to continue using the free Wix URL. Even if you decide to purchase an upgrade plan and connect a domain, your site is still accessible through your free Wix URL.

title: Is the percentage field type supported in CMS collections?
content: Currently, CMS (Content Management System) collections do not have a percentage field type you could use to display numbers as percentages on your site. Workaround: With expressions, you can use the TEXT function to apply a percentage format to numbers. For example, you could use the TEXT function with a pattern format to convert a Number field into a percentage (e.g. 3.14%).

title: How can I set my default business hours using the Wix app?
content: Go to your site in the Wix app. Tap Manage at the bottom. Scroll down and tap Settings. Tap Booking Settings. Tap Default Hours. Select the checkboxes next to each day your business is open. Enter a default start and end time for each day (e.g. 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM). (Optional) Add another time period if your business closes at any point during the day: Tap + Add Hours. Enter a start and end time. (e.g. 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM and 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM). Tap Save.

title: How can I add and set up a mega menu in the Wix Editor?
content: Mega menus are containers that you can add as items to your advanced horizontal menu. It is only possible to add a mega menu container to a horizontal menu that you set as advanced. To add a mega menu: select the advanced menu in your editor; click Manage Menu; click + Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel; select Mega Menu; enter the title of the container into the field; click Done.

title: How can I add products or custom charges to the cart using Wix Retail POS?
content: Open the POS tablet. Tap Checkout on the bottom bar. Scan the product's barcode or select a product from Favorites or Products tabs. If the product has product options, select them, and tap Add to Cart. To edit the quantity, tap the product, tap the Plus or Minus icons, then tap Add to Cart. (Optional) To add a custom charge: Tap Actions at the top right. Select Add Custom Charge. Enter the charge's amount, including cents. (Optional) Enter a description to identify the reason for the charge later. (Optional) Tap the Add tax toggle to enable tax collection on the charge. Tap Add to Cart.

title: Can staff members edit their own working hours in Wix Bookings?
content: Yes. You can now allow staff members to edit their own working hours.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to a monthly plan?
content:
You can upgrade your site at any time from your Wix account. To upgrade with a monthly plan: Go to the Upgrade page. Click Select under the plan you wish to purchase. Select Monthly and click Continue to Checkout. Enter your payment details and click Submit Purchase.

Note: After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

title: How can I switch to a new template for my Wix site and transfer my existing content?
content: It is not possible to switch to a different template for a site you already created, but you can create as many sites as you want in your account and start over with a new template. Choose a new template, then copy and paste elements and pages from your old Editor site; in Editor X and Studio Editor you can save and re-use design assets, though you cannot copy entire pages. Import media from the Site Files folder in your Media Manager. You can transfer features such as Business email, Ascend Plan and features, and Wix Blog, but features such as Site Theme, Design and Layout, and Premium Apps cannot be transferred. Once your new site is ready, you can transfer your plan and domain from your old site to your new one.

title: How do I set up my restaurant's address and phone number in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
content: In your site's dashboard, go to Business Info. Scroll down to Location and contact info and enter your restaurant's address: for Address, start typing the street address and select it from the drop-down list; for Address description, optionally enter a description to help customers find you (e.g. rear entrance); for Location name, enter a unique name for this restaurant location. Then enter your restaurant's contact details: Email, Phone, and Fax. Click Save. Important: make sure the red pin on the map accurately marks your restaurant's location after entering the address. If Wix Restaurants cannot locate your exact address, enter only the city or country and add the full address in the Address Description field. For phone numbers, ensure the area code matches your restaurant's location and enter the number as it would be dialed locally. You can't enter fake phone numbers.

title: How can I connect a pricing plan to my Wix video channel?
content: To connect a pricing plan to your Wix video channel, make sure you've added Wix Video and created your channel. Add and set up Wix Pricing Plans, then go to Video Library in your site's dashboard. Click the Channels tab on the left, click the channel you want to monetize, click Edit next to Channel Info, scroll down to Pricing Plan, and click Add Plan. Choose whether to connect an existing plan by clicking Connect next to the relevant plan, or create a new plan by clicking + Create New Plan and setting up your plan. Click Save. Note: If you connect an existing plan that already has subscribers, those subscribers will automatically be added to the video channel.

title: How can I hide images from the service list in Wix Bookings?
content: Go to your editor. Click the Service List element on your page. Click Settings. Click the Display tab. Deselect the Image checkbox under Service Details.

title: How can I join the Wix Studio Beta Program to try out new features?
content: Go to your Wix Studio workspace. Click the News Center icon at the top right and select Betas. Click Join Beta Program on the top right. Click Join.

title: How can I enable automatic invoices for my Wix Pricing Plans?
content: Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site’s dashboard. In the Billing tab, scroll down to the Send Invoices section and enable the toggle to automatically send payment confirmation once you’ve been paid online. Then click Save. Note that invoices do not send when you manually add a client to a plan.

title: What should I do if Payze is no longer available as a payment provider in Wix?
content: As of July 2024, Payze is no longer available to connect as a payment provider in Wix. To continue accepting payments, you must change your provider for accepting payments. You can find a complete list of alternative payment providers available in Wix according to your location.

title: How can I add and set up a social bar on my mobile site using Wix Editor?
content: On your mobile site, use the mobile editor. This is a mobile-only element, so it does not appear in the desktop version. To add it, click **Add to Mobile** on the left side of your **mobile editor**, click **Social**, then select the social bar you want to use or click and drag it onto your page. To customize the design, click your social bar in the mobile editor, click **Set Social Links**, click the icon you would like to change, then click **Replace Icon** on the right side of the panel. You can click an option under **Explore** to select an icon available from Wix, Shutterstock, or Unsplash; click **Site Files** to use an image previously uploaded to your site; or click **Choose Image** to upload a file from your device and use it as your icon. Click **+ Add Icons** to add more social icons, or hover over an icon and click the **Remove Image** icon to delete it. To connect social accounts, click your social bar, click **Set Social Links**, click the icon you want to connect, click the field under **What social page does this icon link to?**, select **Web Address**, enter the URL of your social media account in the **What's the web address (URL)** field, choose **New window** or **Current window**, and click **Done**. To adjust layout, click your social bar, click the **Layout icon**, then use **Icon size**, **Spacing**, and **How does the bar look?** to set horizontal or vertical display.

title: Can I still access my old Flash site on Wix or use the Flash Editor?
content: No. Since the beginning of 2021, you are no longer able to access the Flash editor at all, including the dashboard of Flash sites. The sites have been removed from Wix. This means that they have been completely deleted, and cannot be restored. Visitors cannot view the Flash site that you created with Wix because Flash was disabled on all browsers. You can build a new site with the Wix Editor. Depending on your needs, you can create a new HTML site using a pre-designed template or create a new HTML site from scratch.

title: How can I upgrade my Wix site to sell tickets for events and remove Wix branding from event emails?
content: To upgrade your Wix site to sell tickets and remove Wix branding from event emails (excluding the Connect Domain plan): make sure Wix Events is added to your site, then choose a plan that accepts payments (e.g. Core, Business). Go to the Upgrade page, click Select under the plan you want to purchase, select a billing cycle and click Continue to Checkout, enter your payment details, review your total and click Submit Purchase. Once upgraded, you can sell tickets for events and create different pricing tiers for each one.

title: My website displays correctly on PC and smartphone, but not on a tablet. The words on the page are off the screen.
content: On iPads and tablets, Wix sites are cropped within the vertical gridlines of the Editor. To resolve this issue, make sure to place your content within the vertical gridlines in your Editor. You can also use columns which are responsive to your screen's width to fit your content within most screens.

title: How can I log in to my Wix account using my email and password?
content:
To log in to your Wix account using your email and password: go to Wix.com and click Log In at the top right. Choose your login method — Email and password — then enter the email address associated with your account and click Continue with Email. Enter your password in the Password field and click Log In. Note that you need to use the same login method that you used when you initially signed up.

Tip: Forgot which email address you used? Use our Find your login email tool to locate your account.

title: How can I add a translation disclaimer to my Wix site using Auto-translate results?
content: To add a translation disclaimer for Auto-translate results, create a link to the disclaimer from text in the footer: add a new page to your site, hide the page, add your disclaimer to the new page, add text to your footer (e.g. "Translation Disclaimer"), and link the text to your new page. Before publishing, add your company details to the <> sections in the disclaimer. The source recommends consulting your legal advisor about any legal disclaimers on your site, including this one, and provides disclaimer text examples for sites displaying Auto-translate results without modification.

title: How can members download the Fit by Wix app?
content: Members can download Fit by Wix for free by searching for the app in the relevant app store. On iPhone, go to the Apple App Store; on Android, go to Google Play. Type 'Fit by Wix' in the Search field, then click Get or Install to download the app.

title: How can I add a site menu to my Wix site using the Studio Editor?
content: Go to your editor. Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor. Click Menu & Search. Select the menu type you want (Horizontal, Vertical, etc.). Click and drag the menu to add it to your site.

title: How can I ensure that my dynamic item pages have unique URLs in the CMS?
content: Add unique content to the Primary field for each item. The Primary field value is used in the dynamic item page URL, and without content in the Primary field, a dynamic item page URL cannot be created for the item. In your collection, you can see how the Primary field value is added to the Page Link field associated with your dynamic item page. Fields that are used as variables in the URL slug structure appear with SLUG next to the name of the field.
